items.title: Breitling Celebrates Miles Davis’ Centennial With a Limited-Edition Navitimer B09
items.text: Breitling Celebrates Miles Davis’ Centennial With a Limited-Edition Navitimer B09 Summary Breitling unveils the Tribute to Miles Davis Navitimer B09, honoring the jazz legend.Features classic Navitimer design codes with a manual‑wind Calibre B09 and a 70‑hour power reserve.Limited edition release blends aviation chronograph heritage with cultural storytelling. To celebrate the centennial of jazz legend Miles Davis’ birth, Breitling has unveiled the Navitimer B09 Chronograph 41 Tribute to Miles Davis. Inspired directly by the mid-1960s Navitimer ref. 806 Mk5 that Davis famously wore - transforming a pilot's tool into an emblem of mid-century "cool" - the limited-edition release faithfully recreates its vintage predecessor while introducing modern craftsmanship.Set in a classic 41mm stainless steel case, the watch features a monochrome black-and-white reverse-panda dial accented by era-correct "Twin Jet" badging, old radium Super-LumiNova, and a bidirectional slide-rule bezel. Limited to just 500 pieces, the watch is available on a hand-colored gradient brown calfskin leather strap or the newly revived, rally-inspired stainless steel Air Racer bracelet.Inside beats the hand-wound Breitling Manufacture Caliber B09, a COSC-certified movement featuring a column-wheel chronograph mechanism with a vertical clutch and a 70-hour power reserve. Visible through an open sapphire crystal caseback engraved with "One of 500" and "Miles Davis Centennial," the manual-wind architecture pays homage to the pre-automatic chronograph era when Davis originally selected his watch. The release also serves as a gateway to the upcoming Breitling Social Club in Williamsburg, New York, with each of the 500 owners receiving an exclusive two-year membership.For ultimate collectors, Breitling is also introducing the ultra-exclusive "Lifetime Club Member Set," limited to 50 numbered editions. Housed in a custom presentation case designed like a vintage trumpet box - complete with a blue record and a miniature red trumpet - the three-watch set groups the stainless steel edition alongside an 18k yellow gold model and a platinum version featuring a blue panda dial. Buyers of the set receive a lifetime membership to the Breitling Social Club. As part of the brand's ongoing "Navitimer Stories" 2026 campaign, this release honours a musical pioneer who helped transition the Navitimer from cockpit instrument to global style icon. items.title: Thom Browne Captures Quiet, Melancholic Scottish Elegance in Its Fall 2026 Campaign
items.text: Thom Browne Captures Quiet, Melancholic Scottish Elegance in Its Fall 2026 Campaign Summary Thom Browne unveils its Fall 2026 collection campaign, titled "homeward...," shot by Robbie Lawrence in Birnam, Scotland.Key pieces feature Fair Isle cashmere knits, pearl-embellished tailoring and down-filled windowpane tweed outerwear.The collection is available now. Thom Browne has unveiled its Fall 2026 campaign, titled "homeward…", photographed by Robbie Lawrence in and around Birnam, Scotland. Shot across rolling meadows and hillside towns featuring a cast of local residents and brand friends, the visual narrative honors the American designer's long-standing connection to traditional Scottish textile craftsmanship — including his officially registered grey and navy tartan developed with Loch Carron.Grounded in centuries of artisanal weaving knowledge and local raw materials, the seasonal collection highlights a rich array of knitwear, sportswear-infused technical outerwear and reinterpreted formalwear. The knitwear range utilizes time-honored techniques across fine cashmere and merino wool, executing cable-knit constructions, complex jacquards, Fair Isle patterning, and graphic intarsia motifs. These appear across relaxed and classic V-neck pullovers, cardigans, and exaggerated patchwork pieces.Bridging high-performance utility with formal tailoring, new outerwear silhouettes combine technical downfill with suiting fabrics such as chalk stripe flannel, jacket-weight cashmere, and windowpane tweed. Functional ski-inspired details - including engineered thumbholes and rib-knit gaiters - are integrated directly into cropped zip-front vests, football parkas, and low calf-length jackets.Reinterpreting black-tie codes, the collection expands formal silhouettes into sharp dresses, capes, and structured sport coats. Traditional tailoring conventions are subverted using trompe l'oeil detailing and open-back apron closures, while classic windowpane checks are rendered in precise grids of pearls. The Thom Browne Fall 2026 collection is available now globally via thombrowne.com, Thom Browne standalone flagships, and select luxury wholesale stockists. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Capcom’s Iconic ‘Street Fighter’ Universe Comes to Life in New Live-Action Trailer
items.text: Capcom’s Iconic ‘Street Fighter’ Universe Comes to Life in New Live-Action Trailer Summary Paramount and Capcom drop the trailer for the upcoming live-action Street Fighter movie.Highlights Ryu and Ken’s rivalry alongside signature moves like the Hadouken and Hundred Hand Slap.Directed by Kitao Sakurai, the film hits theaters worldwide on October 16, 2026. Paramount Pictures, Legendary Entertainment and Capcom have released a new trailer for the upcoming live-action Street Fighter feature film, offering a dramatic look into the franchise's cinematic reboot.The latest trailer puts the spotlight on the rivalry between Ryu and Ken, framing their strained friendship as the emotional core of the story. Alongside this central conflict, the clip teases faithful recreations of iconic moves from the game, including Chun-Li’s Lightning Legs, E. Honda’s Hundred Hand Slap, and Guile’s signature military bravado.M. Bison, portrayed by David Dastmalchian, emerges as the film’s menacing villain, adding theatrical weight to the adaptation. Paramount and Legendary have leaned heavily into nostalgia, even including a Street Fighter III-style fist bump between Ryu and Ken, underscoring the film’s commitment to honoring the franchise’s legacy.Following previous live-action adaptations in 1994 and 2009, this fresh take aims to combine pure arcade nostalgia with martial arts action. Street Fighter is scheduled for an exclusive worldwide theatrical release, including IMAX formats, on October 16, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Sadie Sink Brings Modern Attitude to Calvin Klein’s Iconic ‘90s Straight Jeans
items.text: Sadie Sink Brings Modern Attitude to Calvin Klein’s Iconic ‘90s Straight Jeans Summary Sadie Sink stars in Calvin Klein’s latest Fall 2026 "Feel the Fit" denim campaign.Key silhouettes feature the '90s Straight, Low Rise Baggy and dark-rinse High Rise Loose jeans.The new styles are available via the brand's online and physical stores. Calvin Klein has unveiled the second chapter of its Fall 2026 "Feel the Fit" denim campaign, starring Sadie Sink. Directed by Aidan Zamiri, the campaign captures Sink in everyday moments where slipping into Calvin Klein jeans sparks a shift in energy and confidence. Styled across multiple fits, the visuals emphasize the brand’s stripped‑back sensuality and modern attitude, underscored by a bold soundtrack that heightens the cinematic feel.The Fall 2026 denim lineup introduces a focused variety of silhouettes designed for effortless seasonal styling. Key styles featured in the campaign include the iconic '90s Straight Jean updated in fresh washes, the Low Rise Baggy Jean delivering a relaxed edge and the High Rise Loose Jean offering a sleek, body-defining fit in deep dark rinses.The featured styles from Calvin Klein's Fall 2026 "Feel the Fit" campaign are officially launched globally across calvinklein.com as well as its brand flagships.   Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Pz' Previews Denim Tears x Billionaire Boys Club Collaboration
items.text: Pz' Previews Denim Tears x Billionaire Boys Club Collaboration At the top of August, Denim Tears presented a full-fledged, 153-piece Fall/Winter 2026 collection inspired by André Leon Talley, historically marking the first-ever authorized apparel collaboration to come from the editor's estate. Since its reveal, Tremaine Emory's imprint has slowly begun rolling out the seasonal range for purchase, now preparing to release the second installment — complete with a brand-new Pz'-fronted lookbook.Fresh off a new MOWALOLA teaser and the Slime Language 3 album, the Øway rapper poses in a selection of Denim Tears collection on the streets of New York City. He's seen wearing the Denim Tears x Billionaire Boys Club collaboration, featuring a chunky, full-zip knit cardigan sweater with BBC branding across the middle and Denim Tears' classic red, black, and green striping on the left upper arm."This Fall/Winter is an exploration of a specific part of André Leon Talley’s style that had social implications within and beyond fashion," Emory said in a statement when the full collection lookbook dropped."André was the first in fashion to herald Black fashion designers such as Phat Farm, Billionaire Boys Club, Dapper Dan, etc, showing up front row at shows and wearing their clothes at a time when no one else did in the fashion world. This collection will focus on the mix of diaspora clothing, Black designers, and traditional fashion that he mixed effortlessly."The bandana-patterned, PrimaLoft-filled down puffer is also a standout piece, dipped in a bright red hue, and finished off with white Cotton Wreath insignias throughout. The Wreath also lands on two new sweat sets (in navy blue and pink), as well as all over a sleek, all-black PrimaLoft-filled down vest.Take a closer look in the lookbook above and cop a piece this Friday, September 4 at 11 AM EST online, in-store at African Diaspora Goods, and at the Atlanta residency in Lenox Square. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: JBL Launches the Cove Series, a New Wi-Fi Speaker Lineup Built for Whole-Home Audio
items.text: JBL Launches the Cove Series, a New Wi-Fi Speaker Lineup Built for Whole-Home Audio Summary JBL pivots from party speakers to the premium whole-home audio market with the newly announced Cove seriesThe modular Wi-Fi ecosystem launches with three models: the Cove M1, the battery-powered Cove P1 and the high-end Cove X1Available starting September 13, the speakers pair through the JBL One app and double as home theater rear channels JBL is shifting its sonic footprint, pivoting from portable Bluetooth devices and outdoor party speakers to the premium multi-room audio market. The audio giant announced the Cove series, a lineup of Wi-Fi speakers engineered specifically for whole-home audio. This launch represents a major evolution for the brand, positioning JBL as a direct alternative for whole-home audio systems. Instead of outfitting a single room or a backyard, the brand now aims to wire the house itself.Connectivity and scalability sit at the core of this new acoustic ecosystem. The Cove series is driven via Wi-Fi and managed through the JBL One app, allowing users to pair units for synchronized multi-room listening. It operates as a modular system where buyers are not locked into purchasing expensive bundles upfront. Instead, users can purchase individual speakers as needed to expand the setup over time.Three distinct models kick off the product line. The standard Cove M1 features three tweeters, a single woofer and built-in AI sound boost technology for $230 USD. For those who want high-end audio that moves around the house, the Cove P1 costs $400 USD. This portable speaker delivers up to 14 hours of playback per charge while featuring full Dolby Atmos integration.At the top of the roster is the flagship Cove X1, designed for maximum acoustic impact. Priced at $450 USD, this powerhouse is loaded with four tweeters and two woofers to deliver room-filling audio via Dolby Atmos. Beyond standalone music playback, the entire lineup offers versatility for cinephiles. The Cove series integrates with compatible soundbars, allowing the Wi-Fi units to act as dedicated rear speakers for a home theater.All three speakers feature a monochromatic black or white finish to maintain a clean aesthetic. The entire Cove series is slated to drop globally starting September 13. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Albino & Preto x atmos x ASICS Charge the GEL-Kayano 12.1 With Volt-Inspired Energy
items.text: Albino & Preto x atmos x ASICS Charge the GEL-Kayano 12.1 With Volt-Inspired Energy Name: Albino & Preto x atmos x ASICS GEL-Kayano 12Colorway: Black/Safety Yellow, White/Safety YellowSKU: 1203B227-100, 1203B227-001MSRP: TBCRelease Date: September 4, September 6 (online)Where to Buy: JJCON, Albino & PretoAlbino & Preto, ASICS and atmos have linked on a three-way collaboration anchored by the GEL-Kayano 12.1, the retro-lifestyle runner reworked here with a distinctly athletic edge. Drawing on the energy of the Volt colorway, the project leans into a vibrant, performance-minded color story rather than a subdued lifestyle palette.The footwear arrives in two distinct colorways, each built around the same design logic. Fluorescent highlights supply the high-visibility punch that ties the look back to its Volt inspiration, while reflective overlays add a technical, light-catching layer across the upper. The result reads as competitive and motion-driven, a palette meant to evoke performance in progress rather than sit still on a shelf. Underpinning the aesthetics is ASICS' signature GEL cushioning, the technology that gives the Kayano line its reputation for reliable, versatile support and keeps this build functional as well as loud.Complementing the shoes, A&P and atmos put together a coordinated mesh apparel kit designed to move as easily as the footwear. The kit centers on performance mesh shorts and a matching polo, built for breathability and range of motion. Its intended use is deliberately broad, engineered to carry from no-gi jiu-jitsu training and soccer matches through to something as low-key as a trip to the local farmers market. That versatility is the throughline: gear that reads as athletic but slots into everyday wear without missing a beat.The collection drops in person at JJCON on September 4 before releasing online September 6 at 9 a.m. exclusively via A&P online. The coordinated mesh apparel kit will be available exclusively in the US market. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The TUDOR Northflag Returns With GMT and Master Chronometer Precision
items.text: The TUDOR Northflag Returns With GMT and Master Chronometer Precision Summary TUDOR officially brings back the cult-classic Northflag in a 40mm steel case.Priced at $5,525 USD, it features an integrated bracelet, monobloc ceramic hour markers, and a new GMT complication.The timepiece is powered by the Master Chronometer-certified METAS Manufacture Calibre MT5652-U. TUDOR has revived one of its most celebrated cult-classic tool watches with the return of the Northflag. Originally launched in 2015 as the first TUDOR timepiece to feature an in-house movement, the Northflag draws its foundational inspiration from the rugged equipment issued during the British North Greenland Expedition of the 1950s, as well as the distinctive aesthetics of the 1973 Ranger II. This second-generation evolution preserves the collection's utilitarian, ice-cold lineage while introducing a brand-new GMT function and Master Chronometer certification.Housed in a 40mm 316L stainless steel case measuring 12.7mm thick, the watch maintains its signature integrated design where the case seamlessly flows into a dedicated two-link steel bracelet. The design combines satin-brushed surfaces, polished chamfers and a cone-shaped screw-down crown with a matte bead-blasted finish. Framing the black dial is an angled 45-degree rehaut with a 24-hour graduation, complemented by monobloc ceramic luminous hour markers, arrow-shaped hands, and a vivid yellow GMT hand. Built for versatile daily wear and arctic durability, the integrated bracelet comes fitted with TUDOR’s "T-fit" rapid adjustment clasp, which offers 8mm of tool-free micro-adjustment alongside ceramic ball bearings for a tactile, secure closure.Visible through the open caseback is the in-house Manufacture Calibre MT5652-U, which integrates the GMT function directly into its architecture. The movement also features a non-magnetic silicon balance spring, a variable-inertia balance wheel and a 65-hour "weekend-proof" power reserve. Rigorously tested to withstand magnetic fields up to 15,000 gauss, the watch is dual-certified by COSC and METAS as a Master Chronometer, complete with up to 100 meters of water resistance.Priced at $5,525 USD, the new TUDOR Northflag is available via the brand's webstore and physical stores and includes a five-year transferable guarantee. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: From Secretly Wearing His Mom’s Reverso to Joining Jaeger-LeCoultre: A Conversation With Robert Pattinson
items.text: From Secretly Wearing His Mom’s Reverso to Joining Jaeger-LeCoultre: A Conversation With Robert Pattinson Jaeger-LeCoultre has officially named Robert Pattinson as its newest Global Ambassador. Renowned for effortlessly navigating between high-concept auteur cinema and international blockbusters - with credits spanning Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey, Matt Reeves’ The Batman, Bong Joon Ho’s Mickey 17 and Denis Villeneuve's upcoming Dune: Part Three - Pattinson has carved out one of the most singular careers in contemporary film. It is also his bold creative instincts, quiet discipline and utmost dedication to his craft, along with the absolute refusal to be boxed in that makes him a perfect fit with Jaeger-LeCoultre.Known historically as the “Watchmaker of Watchmakers,” Jaeger-LeCoultre’s legacy is built not only on its technical mastery, but also on its perseverance in innovation and understated elegance — values that closely align with Pattinson’s personal ethos. Both on and off screen, the actor reflects a refined sophistication that favors character and quiet substance over excess. "A great watch isn’t just about precision – it’s about character, craftsmanship and the story behind how it’s made," Pattinson reflects on the partnership. "Jaeger-LeCoultre has always embodied that kind of quiet mastery. There’s an integrity to everything they create."Following the official announcement, Hypebeast sat down with Pattinson for a candid conversation. The actor breaks down discovering the Master Collection at the Oscars, secretly wearing his mother's Reverso as a teenager, his ideal early morning ritual, and why he lives by the philosophy that "there are no minuses in life."Congratulations on becoming Jaeger-LeCoultre’s newest Global Ambassador. What made the brand feel like the right fit for you?Robert Pattinson: I was doing the Oscars, and my manager asked, "Do you want to wear a watch for the Oscars?" And I was like, "Yeah, okay." When they showed me the presentation of options, they brought out a rose gold Master Control watch from JLC. I was like, "That's literally the best watch I've ever seen in my life." I wanted to just buy it right afterwards.Shortly after, they asked if I wanted to do a proper partnership, and I was like, "Yeah! Do I get the watch?" [Laughs] Meeting everyone at the company sealed it — they were all just great. It felt similar to when I started working with Dior. When the timing is right and you meet the right people, it’s not even a

items.title: Nike Revives the Baltoro High in a "Cave Stone/Mystic Hibiscus" Colorway
items.text: Nike Revives the Baltoro High in a "Cave Stone/Mystic Hibiscus" Colorway Name: Nike Baltoro “Cave Stone/Mystic Hibiscus”Colorway: Cave Stone/Mystic Hibiscus-Black-Mountain BlueSKU: IO4556-202MSRP: $145 USDRelease Date: September 2026Nike is revisiting the Baltoro High with a new “Cave Stone/Mystic Hibiscus” colorway that trades reinvention for nostalgia. Rather than reworking the silhouette, the release reaches back toward the darker, outdoor-leaning palettes that defined the model in its earlier years.Cave Stone covers the majority of the upper, setting a muted, earthy base that gets broken up by Mystic Hibiscus and blue in select spots. Royal blue branding and burgundy accents fill out the rest of the palette, giving the largely subdued shoe a handful of deliberate color pops rather than a single dominant contrast.That restrained-with-accents approach tracks closely with the ACG-style color blocking Nike leaned on decades ago, where a mostly muted shoe would earn its brighter hits only in the right places. The result is a makeup that reads as a callback to the Baltoro's earlier color stories, reaching back toward the palette the model wore in its '90s outdoor era without directly recreating any single pair. The shades have shifted, but the reference point stays legible.For the Baltoro High, a boot-adjacent silhouette built for that outdoor moment, the treatment feels like a return to form. The muted base keeps the shoe versatile, while the pops of Mystic Hibiscus, royal blue and burgundy give it enough character to stand apart from a plain earth-tone build. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: PLEASURES and Umbro Revisit '90s British Terrace Style in a New Capsule Collection
items.text: PLEASURES and Umbro Revisit '90s British Terrace Style in a New Capsule Collection Summary PLEASURES has teamed with Umbro on a capsule collection that reframes the sportswear brand's football roots through 1990s British music cultureThe range spans football shirts, track jackets, training pieces and sportswear, drawing on the era when kit and casualwear became one and the sameIts reference points are the wardrobes of Blur’s Damon Albarn and Oasis’ Liam Gallagher, two faces of the decade's football-meets-music attitude PLEASURES and Umbro have joined forces on a capsule collection that reads Umbro's football history through a distinctly musical lens. Built around the crossover of sport, sound and style that defined 1990s Britain, the collaboration looks back to a moment when a football shirt was as likely to turn up at a gig as on the terraces.The collection pulls from classic Umbro product, revisiting the point in the '90s when football shirts, track jackets, training gear and general sportswear slipped effortlessly into everyday dress. That blurring is the whole premise: kit stripped of its matchday context and absorbed into a broader wardrobe, worn less for allegiance than for how it looked and felt. PLEASURES leans into that idea rather than treating it as nostalgia, framing the pieces as everyday staples first.The tonal anchor is the dress sense of Blur’s Damon Albarn and Oasis’ Liam Gallagher, two figures the release positions as shorthand for the understated, rebellious streak of '90s British youth culture. Their look, all oversized silhouettes, vintage sportswear and loose, casual layering, sat squarely at the intersection of football, music and streetwear, and it is that unbothered attitude, the sense of wearing something simply because it clicked, that the capsule sets out to capture.For PLEASURES, the pairing is a natural fit. The Los Angeles label has built its identity on music-rooted references, and channeling Umbro's heritage through the terrace-and-gig culture of the era lets both names play to their strengths. The result is less a straight football drop than a study of how sport and subculture dressed alike for a brief, influential window.The PLEASURES x Umbro capsule collection drops Friday, September 4 PLEASURES and select retailers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Xbox's New Disc-to-Digital Feature Is Working on Delisted Games
items.text: Xbox's New Disc-to-Digital Feature Is Working on Delisted Games Summary Microsoft Insiders discovered the newly launched Xbox Disc-to-Digital tool successfully digitizes heavily sought-after delisted titlesThe feature allows players to convert physical discs on Xbox One or Xbox Series X into digital copies playable across compatible devicesWhile blockbuster tie-ins and music games are working, Microsoft has not confirmed if this workaround is intentional Microsoft inadvertently supports video game preservation. The company officially announced the Xbox Disc-to-Digital program on August 26. This initiative formally opened to Microsoft Insiders on August 31 and added a requested feature to the ecosystem. Users quickly discovered a major loophole within the first 24 hours of the Insider launch. Digitization is possible for many physical games previously delisted from the Xbox storefront.The mechanics are straightforward but shift how players interact with legacy libraries. This program allows users to insert a physical game disc into an Xbox One or Xbox Series X console to add a digital version to their active account. Owners can then boot up the digitized games on other Xbox-compatible devices, such as a PC, without needing the physical disc. A rare workaround now exists for keeping media alive. Physical games typically disappear when delisted from online storefronts, which often happens when publishers lose rights to songs or franchise licenses. Preservation of these titles is possible through the Xbox Disc-to-Digital feature if users still own the physical disc.The community immediately tested the feature and uncovered a list of working titles. According to X user Nicholas Maguire, the tool digitizes the 2013 Xbox One game Deadpool, which was delisted in late 2017. Franchise tie-in games are seeing a revival, as social media reports indicate that G.I. Joe: Operation Blackout, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants in Manhattan, Star Trek: Prodigy and Transformers: Devastation all work. On Reddit, user Rarefroggy123 compiled a thread of functional titles including Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops 3, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare (2019) and FIFA 15. Compatibility lists include Ghostbusters, Halo: Campaign Evolved, Madden NFL 23, Minecraft: Xbox One Edition, NHL 17 and Rare Replay.Titles plagued by expired licensing rights benefit from the new feature. items.title: Sony Adds Over 100 Free Live TV Channels to the PS5 With Its New Live TV Feature
items.text: Sony Adds Over 100 Free Live TV Channels to the PS5 With Its New Live TV Feature Summary Sony launched a free, ad-supported streaming service on PlayStation 5 consoles in the United StatesThe platform features over 100 live channels and on-demand content powered by Sony Pictures TelevisionThe tech giant plans to expand the streaming service to Canada and other international regions in the future Sony is officially transforming the PlayStation 5 into a broader cultural hub by integrating a massive slate of free, ad-supported TV (FAST) channels directly into the console. As announced via an official PlayStation.Blog post, the tech giant formally rolled out the highly anticipated streaming feature for gamers in the United States on August 31, 2026. Dubbed Live TV on PS5, the new initiative allows users to tap into free live television broadcasts directly through the console's existing media tab. It is a seamless play to keep the community locked into the hardware ecosystem long after they put down the controller.The core of Live TV on PS5 is powered entirely by Sony Pictures Television, arriving with a massive launch-day roster that boasts more than 100 live channels. Its programming grid casts a wide net across key cultural and entertainment verticals, dropping curated feeds dedicated to movies, TV shows, anime, news, sports, documentaries, gaming, esports, podcasts and comedy. On the cinematic front, the service immediately establishes a heavy-hitting rotation by securing dedicated movie networks like MovieSphere by Lionsgate, 50 Cent Action and Sony One Horror Hits.Beyond the live broadcast layout, the ad-supported experience is fleshing out a rapidly growing selection of on-demand entertainment options. Cult-classic television series and reality mainstays anchor the platform, giving viewers direct access to global hits like Community, The Walking Dead, Deal or No Deal USA, Fear Factor and Ice Road Truckers. The streaming anime offerings are equally stacked, leveraging legendary franchises to deliver timeless staples including Naruto, Sailor Moon, Hunter x Hunter and Death Note.This aggressive foray into the FAST space signals a calculated shift in corporate strategy. By baking an expansive entertainment suite straight into the hardware architecture, Sony aims to monopolize user attention and keep audiences firmly planted within the PlayStation ecosystem, actively blocking momentum from competing streaming services like Pluto, Roku or Tubi. items.title: Razer Launches the Prio, a Foldable Mobile Gaming Controller Designed To Fit in Your Pocket
items.text: Razer Launches the Prio, a Foldable Mobile Gaming Controller Designed To Fit in Your Pocket Summary Razer has officially launched the Prio, a foldable and ultra-portable mobile gaming controller that connects via USB-CThe pocket-friendly gamepad features console-grade inputs, anti-drift capacitive thumbsticks and broad compatibility for both iOS and AndroidPriced at $99.99, the device requires no charging and marks the debut of an entirely new lineup of ultra-portable gaming accessories Razer officially released the Razer Prio, a compact mobile gaming controller designed to change how gamers utilize their downtime. This foldable and ultra-portable device is engineered to remain pocket-friendly when not in active use. The brand markets the accessory as a tool that "turns delay into play," allowing users to pull console-grade controls from their pockets during slow moments in waiting rooms or on a daily commute. Strategic hardware shifts often follow such announcements, and Razer confirmed that the Prio is the first entry in an entirely new line of ultra-portable mobile gaming controllers.Despite its minimized and foldable footprint, the Razer Prio does not compromise on tactical hardware. The gamepad features a comprehensive layout that includes a tactile 4-way D-pad, standard face buttons, bumpers and triggers. Moving past standard inputs, the device is equipped with capacitive analog thumbsticks that Razer states are specifically engineered to reduce stick drift and maintain precision. Because the controller attaches to mobile devices exclusively through a direct USB-C connection, it lacks an internal battery and requires no charging. This design choice keeps the unit lightweight and ready for action whenever it is plugged directly into a handset.The versatility of the Razer Prio extends into its broad compatibility across modern digital ecosystems. It works with both iOS and Android smartphones, expanding to support screens up to seven inches in size. This ensures the controller can comfortably secure large flagship devices like the iPhone 17 Pro Max or the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra. Furthermore, the unit is designed to fit most slim-to-medium phone cases, eliminating the need to remove a case just to play. By bridging the gap between heavy-duty console inputs and pocketable convenience, the release positions high-fidelity gaming as a frictionless daily habit. Once connected, the hardware integrates with native games across all mobile platforms while supp

items.title: Sony Expands Its ULT Power Sound Series With Three New Party Speakers, Including a 121-Pound Tower Max
items.text: Sony Expands Its ULT Power Sound Series With Three New Party Speakers, Including a 121-Pound Tower Max Summary Sony expands its audio lineup with three massive new party speakersThe flagship ULT Tower Max weighs 121 pounds and features three 280mm woofersAll models include multi-port connectivity, built-in lighting and dedicated EQ modes Sony is expanding its existing line of audio equipment with a heavy-hitting addition to the Sony ULT Power Sound series. Pushing aggressively into the extreme high-end party speaker market, the tech giant introduced three new formidable models: the ULT Tower 5, the ULT Tower 7 and the massive ULT Tower Max. Scheduled to be available in September 2026 without an exact release date announced yet, the updated roster scales all the way up to wall-powered hardware. By pushing the series to such massive physical and sonic proportions, Sony is signaling a clear intent to dominate the premium, high-volume event space rather than catering strictly to the casual living room setup.The crown jewel of the new release is the ULT Tower Max, the largest of the new lineup and an absolute behemoth that commands a $1,499 USD price tag. Weighing in at a staggering 121 pounds, this colossal unit does not have a battery and must be plugged in for power. Under the hood, it is equipped with three 280mm woofers, two midrange speakers and four tweeters that collectively output 360-degree sound projecting from all sides. Because hauling a 121-pound speaker is no small task, Sony equipped the ULT Tower Max with new wheels featuring wider treads to make it easier to drag across various types of terrain.For those who need premium sound on the move, the $649 USD ULT Tower 7 scales things down to 50 pounds while delivering 25 hours of battery life. It shares the 360-degree sound output of the Max, projecting from all sides via two midrange speakers, four tweeters and a single 280mm woofer. The smallest speaker in the lineup is the $449 ULT Tower 5, which weighs 29 pounds and gets 20 hours of battery life. Despite being the most compact option of the drop, it still features two midrange speakers, two tweeters and a 230mm woofer. To make transporting these weighty units easier, Sony redesigned the handles on the speakers to feature more comfortable grips.Across all three models, Sony integrated features designed strictly for crowd control and atmosphere. All three speakers come with built-in lighting to set the visual tone. To shape the audio experience, t

items.title: Porsche's New 911 GT3 Bergsport Is a Manual-Only Alpine Tribute Limited to Just 100 Units
items.text: Porsche's New 911 GT3 Bergsport Is a Manual-Only Alpine Tribute Limited to Just 100 Units Summary Porsche has unveiled the 911 GT3 Bergsport, an Alpine-inspired model strictly limited to 100 units for the European marketThis exclusive six-speed manual build features forged aluminum wheels, bespoke Valleygreenmetallic paint and an extended range fuel tankA public rolling debut is scheduled for September 3 at the Arosa ClassicCar hill climb in Switzerland Porsche has officially pulled the cover off the specifications for the all-new Porsche 911 GT3 Bergsport, dropping a highly curated, ultra-limited machine strictly for the European market. Handled by the brand’s Exclusive Manufaktur team, the vehicle serves as a direct homage to the Alpine region and caps production at a tight 100 units. Securing an allocation comes with strict geographical boundaries, as the model will only be available to customers residing in Austria, France, Italy and Switzerland. The public will get its first look at the machine in motion during a September 3 rolling debut at the Arosa ClassicCar hill climb in Switzerland. Factory driver Jörg Bergmeister is slated to pilot the car for the inaugural run, tackling a relentless course that packs 76 corners into a 4.5-mile sprint.Under the skin, the Bergsport is built on the bones of the 911 GT3 Touring equipped with the optional lightweight package, though it aggressively rewrites the standard spec sheet to prioritize mountain carving over pure track duty. For purists, every single model rolling out of the factory will be offered exclusively with a six-speed manual transmission. The typical magnesium wheels found on the standard lightweight package have been swapped out for heavier-duty forged aluminum rims, a calculated engineering shift meant to better withstand the punishing and unpredictable road conditions of the Alps. These custom wheels are finished in a precise combination of White Gold and Ceramica, a colorway designed to recreate the stark visual of snowy mountain peaks. Inside the cabin, the car purposefully bypasses the rear-seat delete that normally accompanies the lightweight package, retaining the back seats while adding an extended range fuel tank to keep the car on the twisting roads longer between stops.The visual identity of the vehicle is tied to the geography it was built to dominate. Its exterior is coated in a bespoke paint color dubbed Valleygreenmetallic, a shade directly inspired by the rocks and valleys cutting

items.title: MoMA and Nike Return With a Two-Pair Air Rift 2 Pack in Bright, Gallery-Ready Colors
items.text: MoMA and Nike Return With a Two-Pair Air Rift 2 Pack in Bright, Gallery-Ready Colors Name: MoMA x Nike Air Rift 2Colorway: Black/Cyber-Dark Powder Blue-Light Fuchsia, Hyper Verde/Cyber-Light FuchsiaSKU: IR8669-001, IR8669-300MSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: Fall 2026MoMA and Nike are teaming up again for Fall 2026, this time on a two-pair pack of the Air Rift 2. The split-toe runner, a Nike design that dates back to the '90s, gets two sharply different treatments here, each leaning into bright color rather than restraint.The two pairs sit at opposite ends of the palette. The first comes covered mostly in green, with pink threaded through the smaller details and yellow adding a third hit of color. The second starts from a black upper and works in neon yellow and light blue accents, with small pink Swooshes slipping one more color into the mix without overwhelming the base. It is a study in contrast across the pack, one pair loud and saturated, the other darker with pops that punctuate rather than dominate.Where the collaboration signs its name is in the details. MoMA branding turns up on the lace panels and insoles of both pairs, while the rest of the shoe holds to the Air Rift's familiar shape and setup. That light touch is the point: rather than reengineering the silhouette, the pack treats the split-toe runner as a canvas, letting color and co-branding do the work on an otherwise unchanged base.That approach fits the logic of a MoMA collaboration, where an everyday object gets reframed through a design lens. Reworking a '90s Nike runner into two vivid, gallery-ready colorways positions the Air Rift 2 less as a straightforward retro and more as a wearable design object, which is squarely the territory a museum tie-up is built to occupy. items.title: Netflix Sets ‘The One About Matthew Perry,’ a Three-Part Documentary on the Late ‘Friends’ Star
items.text: Netflix Sets ‘The One About Matthew Perry,’ a Three-Part Documentary on the Late ‘Friends’ Star Summary Netflix has announced The One About Matthew Perry, a three-part documentary series exploring the life and legacy of the late actorThe series is anchored by his sister Mia Perry Bowick and lifelong friends, drawing on unreleased photos and videos from the family's private archiveDirected by Emmy winner Mary Robertson, it premieres October 27 Netflix has officially announced The One About Matthew Perry, a three-part documentary series chronicling the life and legacy of the late actor who became a generation's favorite Friend. Positioned as the first in-depth documentary about Perry, the series sets out to draw a fuller portrait of the man behind Chandler Bing, told through the people who knew him most closely.The series traces Perry's path from a rising comedic talent to global fame on Friends, the sitcom on which he played Chandler Bing across 236 episodes between 1994 and 2004. His self-effacing, quick-witted delivery turned everyday anxieties into some of television's most quoted lines and made him, for millions of viewers, the emotional center of the show. But the documentary is built around the understanding that the public only ever saw part of his story.What separates this project from a straightforward career retrospective is its access. The three parts are anchored by never-before-heard testimony from Perry's sister, Mia Perry Bowick, a licensed psychotherapist, writer and speaker, alongside lifelong best friends and creative collaborators. Their firsthand memories are woven together with unreleased photos and videos pulled from the Perry family's private archive, giving the series a vantage point closer to home than his public image ever allowed. Candid new detail on his private struggles, including the addiction he spoke about openly and advocated around, runs throughout rather than sitting apart as a separate chapter.For Bowick, the involvement was years in the making. "It's taken time for me to feel ready to share these memories and what it was like to love Matthew through all the complexity of his life — to see him as a whole person, not just as Chandler, and not just as someone who struggled with addiction," she said, adding that she hoped the series would give those who loved him a deeper appreciation for who he truly was. items.text: Carlos Sainz and New Era Launch the Debut "TEAM FIFTY5" Headwear and Apparel Collection Summary New Era has teamed with Formula 1 driver Carlos Sainz for TEAM FIFTY5, a debut headwear and apparel collection shaped by his personal styleThe Fall/Holiday 2026 range spans 9TWENTY, 9FORTY and 9FORTY A-Frame caps plus hoodies and T-shirts in a muted palette accented by a red chili-pepper motifA standout yellow 9FORTY cap nods to Sainz's home race in Madrid, tying the launch to his fan community at the track New Era and Carlos Sainz have introduced TEAM FIFTY5, the first headwear and apparel collection from the Formula 1 driver's community brand. Built around Sainz's own aesthetic, the debut range carries the identity of TEAM FIFTY5, named after his car number, off the racetrack and into an everyday wardrobe.The product mix leans on New Era's core headwear vocabulary. Caps arrive across the 9TWENTY, 9FORTY and 9FORTY A-Frame silhouettes, giving the collection a spread from structured to relaxed fits, while the apparel side covers loose and oversized T-shirts and hoodies alongside slim and cropped women's tees. Detailing is where the personal touches land: select pieces feature direct embroidery and a woven red chili pepper, a reference to Sainz's "Chili" nickname that doubles as the emblem of the TEAM FIFTY5 community.The palette keeps things deliberately understated, running through outdoor green, off-white, white, faded blue and red, in line with a creative direction the brand roots in elevated essentials and European heritage. The intent is a set of pieces that reads as considered and versatile rather than loudly branded motorsport merchandise, wearable well beyond a race weekend. Against that restrained backdrop, one piece breaks from the muted tone: a yellow 9FORTY cap with red details, created for fans in the TEAM FIFTY5 Grandstand at Sainz's home race in Madrid. The color pulls from one of the driver's favorites while nodding to the yellow of the Spanish flag, positioning it as the collection's most overtly personal design.That balance between product and personal narrative is the point of the collaboration. For Sainz, the collection is a way to extend a fan community he has built over his career into something tangible and everyday. items.title: Leica Revives a Rare 1960s US Navy Spy Lens for the Classic Line
items.text: Leica Revives a Rare 1960s US Navy Spy Lens for the Classic Line Summary Leica revives the rare Elcan 66 mm f/2 spy lens as the Summicron‑M 66 f/2.Limited to 660 units, it blends historic military design with modern refinements.Launching today via Leica, with a serial #001 example to be auctioned in November. The Leica Summicron-M 66 f/2 is a newly released addition to the brand's Classic Line, serving as a reinterpretation of a highly historic and rare piece of military optics. Originally developed in the late 1960s as the Elcan 66 mm f/2 by optical pioneer Dr. Walter Mandler for the US Navy, the lens was built for covert reconnaissance and was intended to deliver unparalleled resolution in a discreet format.Striking a delicate balance between fine contrast rendition, compact sizing, and an unconventional 66 mm focal length, only about 200 units of the original military specification were ever produced. Modernizing this storied heritage, the new Summicron-M 66 f/2 brings the exact same focal length and optical ethos to the public for the first time. Like all lenses in the Classic Line, the f/2 maximum speed delivers distinctive rendering characterized by high contrast and soft bokeh, while stepping down the aperture unleashes the maximum resolution originally demanded by naval intelligence for capturing minute details.Limited to 660 units worldwide, each lens carries a special serial number and precise focal length engraving. Measuring approximately 60 mm in length and weighing 456 grams, it uses a Leica M bayonet with 6‑bit encoding and an E49 filter thread. The Summicron‑M 66 f/2 is available globally today via Leica, with the first‑numbered lens set to be auctioned at the Leitz Photographica Auction in November 2026. items.text: MB&F’s M.A.D.Editions Teams up With Horological Maverick Vincent Calabrese on the M.A.D.3 Summary M.A.D.Editions teams up with AHCI co-founder Vincent Calabrese on the M.A.D.3.Powered by a reworked La Joux‑Perret G111 calibre, the watch is redesigned for reliability and fluid hour transitions.Released in raspberry pink (Tribe/Friends) and blue (raffle) editions. MB&F's accessible imprint, M.A.D.Editions, has unveiled its third major milestone: the M.A.D.3 Vincent Calabrese. Conceived through a friendship between MB&F founder Maximilian Büsser and 82-year-old independent horological maverick Vincent Calabrese - co-founder of the AHCI and creator of Corum's Golden Bridge - the project functions like a publishing house bringing a legendary creator's voice into a new era.Instead of a typical vintage reissue, the M.A.D.3 reinterprets Calabrese’s signature "Baladin" complication, replacing the abrupt jump of traditional jumping hours with a fluid, slow-wandering hour indicator that moves steadily across the dial while trailing minutes advance alongside it. Translating Calabrese’s highly artisanal display into a reliable, larger-scale production watch required MB&F's technical team to re-engineer the wandering hours module from the ground up.The M.A.D.3 is powered by a specially optimized La Joux‑Perret G111 calibre, reworked to handle the energy demands of the wandering hours module. The complication preserves Calabrese’s hallmark fluid transition of time, while MB&F’s technical team redesigned the system for reliability and larger production volumes. The 40mm stainless steel case, designed by Eric Giroud, features floating lugs, domed sapphire crystals, and layered architecture, balancing elegance with mechanical playfulness.Housed in a 316L stainless steel case designed by Eric Giroud - measuring 40mm in diameter, 12.7mm thick - the watch displays floating lugs, double-domed sapphire crystals, a bombé sapphire minute ring and integrated Super-LumiNova. On the reverse side, the openworked winding rotor exposes a discreetly engraved quote personal to Calabrese: "Il est assez aisé de plaire aux autres, bien plus ardu d'être fier de soi" -- which translates to "It is fairly easy to please others, far more difficult to be proud of oneself" in English.Staying true to Calabrese and MB&F’s shared ethos of keeping inventive watchmaking accessible, the M.A.D.3 debuts at 2,900 CHF (approx. $3,600 USD.) items.title: The Airport Runway Becomes a Surreal Backdrop for Jil Sander’s FW26 Campaign
items.text: The Airport Runway Becomes a Surreal Backdrop for Jil Sander’s FW26 Campaign Jil Sander has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 campaign, crafted under the creative direction of Simone Bellotti. Shot on the open tarmac of a private airport runway by photographer and videographer Moni Haworth, the visual narrative presents a surreal, outdoor interior setup featuring foil-wrapped sofas and latex-covered tables.Starring models Edie Campbell and Daisuke Ueda, the campaign embraces grainy VHS textures, desaturated hues, and a cinematic tension echoing the styles of Hitchcock and Fassbinder. Anchored by the score "If This Is Hell” by Space Afrika featuring Deuén, the campaign channels an unsettling yet elegant atmosphere, charged with what Bellotti describes as “erotic electricity.” The juxtaposition of minimalism and excess, of addition and subtraction, defines the season’s mood — an abstract story where beauty lies in contradiction.The featured seasonal lineup twists Jil Sander's signature stripped-back minimalism through a framework of heightened restraint and subtle contradiction. items.text: Acer's New Predator XB253Q U1 Is the First 1080p Monitor to Hit 1,000Hz Refresh Rate Summary Acer drops eight new displays across its Predator, Nitro and ProDesigner lineups at IFA 2026The 24-inch Predator XB253Q U1 serves as the brand's first 1080p monitor to reach a 1,000Hz refresh rateOLED panels, Mini LED backlighting and dynamic resolution switching feature across the new collection Acer expanded its hardware footprint at IFA 2026 and introduced a lineup of eight new monitors across its Predator, Acer Nitro and Acer ProDesigner lines. This range utilizes OLED panels, Mini LED backlighting and the ability to switch between multiple refresh rates and resolutions. Leading the pack is the 24-inch Predator XB253Q U1 which lands as the first 1080p monitor from the brand capable of hitting a 1,000Hz refresh rate.This 1,000Hz milestone represents a serious leap in practical performance for competitive gaming by elevating the technology from an early-stage concept into a viable daily driver for elite players. Previous high-speed iterations were limited to a 720p resolution at their maximum refresh rates. By bringing that speed to a full 1080p resolution, the new Predator XB253Q U1 ensures that players do not have to sacrifice image quality for performance. To keep those frames pristine, the display features Visual Response Boost Pro technology, a Circular Polarizer to reduce glare and full support for both AMD FreeSync Premium and NVIDIA G-Sync. This curved display goes on sale in Q4 2026 for $1,199 USD. The Predator XB273K V7 also joins the lineup as a 27-inch display boasting a maximum refresh rate of 500Hz for $499. Dropping in Q1 2027 for $899 USD is the 31.5-inch Predator X32 V3 which packs a QD-OLED Penta Tandem panel, a 180Hz refresh rate and support for AMD FreeSync Premium Pro alongside NVIDIA G-Sync.The remaining reveals round out the IFA drop with flexible specs for creators and budget-conscious gamers. items.title: Hong Kong Palace Museum Transforms Into a Haute Couture Stage for “VIRTUOSE”
items.text: Hong Kong Palace Museum Transforms Into a Haute Couture Stage for “VIRTUOSE” Summary HKFDA presented VIRTUOSE: The Artistry of Couture 2026 at the Hong Kong Palace Museum, launching the third Hong Kong Fashion Fest.The event showcased 40 custom looks from haute couture houses, spanning Guillermo Décimo, Phan Huy, Tigerstrolling Artisanal and Vivian Luk Atelier. Presented by the Hong Kong Fashion Designers Association (HKFDA) and sponsored by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency (CCIDA), the flagship VIRTUOSE: The Artistry of Couture 2026 event took place yesterday at the Hong Kong Palace Museum. Serving as the official opening event for the third annual Hong Kong Fashion Fest, the immersive showcase transformed the museum into a cross-cultural stage framed by four architectural arches — ranging from a traditional Chinese courtyard to neoclassical and Franco-Vietnamese designs. Designed to solidify Hong Kong’s position as an international hub for haute couture, the event attracted global fashion figures, industry leaders and local celebrities including Louise Wong Susie Lau, Irene Kim and Hanan Besovic.The runway presentations brought together four emerging and established couture brands from Hong Kong, Spain and Vietnam, delivering a collective showing of 40 bespoke looks worn by international supermodel Christina Chung and a diverse cast. Representing Spain, Guillermo Décimo - led by Guillermo Díez López, who refined his techniques at the Museo Balenciaga - presented hand-crafted creations celebrating theatricality, heritage and slow fashion. Vietnam’s Phan Huy, who recently made history as the youngest Vietnamese designer on the official Paris Haute Couture Week calendar, showcased intricate silk weaving, traditional hand-embroidery, and modern 3D draping.Rounding out the lineup were two Hong Kong-based labels offering distinct interpretations of modern couture. Tigerstrolling Artisanal, founded in 2025 by Tiger Chung (Chung Tsz-ho and Chung Ka-ching), delivered deconstructed tailoring, unconventional proportions, and upcycled materials that bridged everyday object subversion with high-fashion technique. Meanwhile, Vivian Luk Atelier - founded by former Vera Wang designer Vivian Luk - focused on sculptural fluidity, incorporating hidden corset boning, precision bias cuts, and structured fabrications built for bespoke client styling. items.title: De Bethune Unveils the Hand-Free DB25 Digitale at Geneva Watch Days 2026
items.text: De Bethune Unveils the Hand-Free DB25 Digitale at Geneva Watch Days 2026 Summary De Bethune unveils the DB25 Digitale at Geneva Watch Days 2026.Features jumping hours, analogue minutes, and spherical moonphase accurate for 1,112 years.Powered by Calibre DB2144V3, with 5‑day reserve and titanium case. De Bethune has unveiled the DB25 Digitale at Geneva Watch Days 2026, a poetic reinterpretation of its emblematic digital display. Following in the footsteps of the Maison’s emblematic DBD model, this new creation revisits digital time displays through a contemplative, hand-free architectural design.Inspired by the nocturnal imagery of starlit skies and moonlit rivers, the watch combines artistry with horological innovation. The DB25 Digitale replaces conventional watch hands with a concentric, triple-indication layout driven by an internal micro ball-bearing mechanism. Time is read through a jumping-hour window at 12 o'clock and an analogue rotating minute disc at 6 o'clock.Constructed from 82 distinct elements, the dial mimics a tranquil nocturnal landscape beneath a starlit sky. It pairs traditional hand-guilloché barleycorn motifs along the outer silvered minute track with an inner disc executed in blued titanium featuring De Bethune’s proprietary random guilloché finish. Positioned at the very center of the display is De Bethune’s signature spherical moon-phase indicator, crafted from two polished hemispheres of palladium and flame-blued steel. Inclined at 60 degrees, the spherical moon is engineered with mechanical precision that requires a correction of only one lunar day every 1,112 years.Housed in a 42mm mirror-polished Grade 5 titanium case measuring 11.9mm thick, the watch features slender, openworked "bullet" lugs and a screw-down sapphire exhibition caseback. Visible within is the third-generation in-house Calibre DB2144V3, a hand-wound movement comprising 416 components and 32 rubies.The DB25 Digitale comes paired with an extra-supple, dark blue alligator strap secured by a polished titanium pin buckle. items.text: Stephen Curry Confirms He Plans to Finish His NBA Career With the Golden State Warriors Summary Stephen Curry confirms he has no plans to leave the Golden State Warriors and expects to finish his entire career with the franchiseThe iconic guard is eligible for a two-year, $136.7 million max extension as he enters his age-38 seasonGolden State's championship ceiling hinges entirely on Curry's health alongside a retooled roster featuring Jimmy Butler and Kristaps Porziņģis Stephen Curry enters the final season of his contract with no intention of leaving the Bay Area. He confirmed to Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area that he expects to remain with the franchise for the rest of his career. The superstar also spoke with ABC 7 News Bay Area to reiterate his desire to spend his entire playing tenure with the only NBA team he has ever suited up for. His long-term future remains a major storyline as the front office navigates the conclusion of his historic run.The legendary shooter is currently eligible to sign a maximum contract extension worth $136.7 million USD over two years. Curry is strictly prevented from being under contract for more than a three-year span due to the NBA's Over-38 Rule. He is already set to earn $62.6 million USD for the upcoming 2026-27 campaign even without a new deal in place. This figure ensures he will be the highest-paid player in the NBA on an annual basis during that season. Negotiations will happen at the right time and the veteran guard emphasized that talks will not distract the squad from its preparation.The urgency for the Golden State Warriors to maximize this window increases as Curry officially enters his age-38 season. This milestone follows a frustrating 2025-26 campaign where injuries limited the superstar to 43 games. Golden State was eliminated following the play-in tournament without a fully healthy roster. On-court synergy with an evolved roster featuring Jimmy Butler, Draymond Green and Kristaps Porziņģis will dictate the team's overall ceiling. Success depends on the cornerstone remaining available on the floor.Locking Curry down for the rest of his career is the priority for a franchise built on his resume. His achievements include four NBA championships, two league MVP awards, 11 All-NBA selections and 12 All-Star Game nods. The veteran guard also holds a spot on the NBA's 75th Anniversary Team. items.text: Gallet Kicks Off a New Era of Wanderlust With a Complete Brand Relaunch Summary Swiss watch brand Gallet relaunches for its 200th anniversary, now manufactured by Breitling.The relaunch introduces the Flying Officer, Multichron Pilot, Multichron Sport and Classics collections.All models across the collections are offered with interchangeable straps. Celebrating its 200th anniversary since its founding in La Chaux-de-Fonds in 1826, historic Swiss watchmaker Gallet has officially relaunched as a sibling brand manufactured by Breitling. Backed by Breitling’s technical expertise, manufacturing infrastructure, global distribution network, and after-sales service, the revived Maison introduces a new era centered around the spirit of "wanderlust".The relaunch introduces four core collections: the Flying Officer, Multichron Pilot, Multichron Sport, and Gallet Classics. The Flying Officer, first introduced in 1939, returns as a modern world‑traveler’s watch with a reimagined city ring and multiple dial options.The Multichron Pilot is engineered for exploration, offering dual‑time functionality and rugged clarity, while the Multichron Sport draws on motorsport heritage with tachymeter scales and bold chronograph hands. Meanwhile, the Gallet Classics, powered by Breitling’s hand‑wound Caliber B09, reinterpret historic references such as the Multichron Yachting Big Eye, Multichron 45, and Silverlight, each sized at 38mm with refined proportions and approximately 70 hours of power reserve.All collections feature interchangeable quick‑release straps, ranging from leather and rubber to field and fabric, alongside stainless‑steel bracelets with micro‑adjustment. To support the relaunch, select Breitling boutiques globally will feature dedicated safari-inspired Gallet corners. For more information, visit Gallet's official website. items.title: Los Angeles Clippers Hit With $30 Million Fine and Five Draft Picks Stripped Over Kawhi Leonard Deal
items.text: Los Angeles Clippers Hit With $30 Million Fine and Five Draft Picks Stripped Over Kawhi Leonard Deal Summary The NBA slammed the Los Angeles Clippers with a $30 million USD fine, stripped five first-round draft picks and issued widespread suspensions for salary cap circumventionTeam owner Steve Ballmer and presidents Lawrence Frank and Gillian Zucker were suspended for orchestrating off-court income agreements for Kawhi LeonardAn agreed-upon trade sending Leonard to the Toronto Raptors remains on hold while the franchise plans to fight the heavily biased findings in arbitration The NBA officially handed the Los Angeles Clippers a $30 million USD fine and stripped the franchise of five first-round draft picks for circumventing salary cap rules while courting Kawhi Leonard as a free agent. This massive draft penalty leaves the organization without a natural pick from 2029 through 2033. Disciplinary measures also targeted top executives, suspending owner Steve Ballmer from all league and team activities for one year. Lawrence Frank, the president of basketball operations, received a six-month suspension without pay. President of business operations Gillian Zucker was handed a one-year unpaid suspension. Leonard himself received a $700,000 USD fine for his involvement in the scheme. An agreed-upon trade sending the player to the Toronto Raptors remains on hold pending the results of the investigation.The New York law firm Wachtell Lipton conducted the league's investigation after reporting from journalist Pablo Torre prompted the inquiry. Investigators concluded that the Los Angeles Clippers broke league rules by initiating off-court income opportunities between Leonard and four companies: Aspiration Partners, Boingo Wireless, Daktronics and Lockton Insurance. The official report states that the franchise induced those corporate entities to enter into agreements by explicitly offering them team business. Furthermore, the investigation found that the team paid for personal expenses on behalf of Leonard and his representatives.Torre’s reporting detailed the mechanics of these violations and noted that Ballmer partially funded a defunct tree-planting company called Aspiration Partners. This entity allegedly entered into a $28 million USD agreement with Leonard's personal company, KL2 Aspire, LLC. According to Torre, a clause in the Aspiration contract allowed Leonard to receive payment without performing actual work. Another stipulation voided the deal completely

items.text: F1 Champion Lando Norris Launches His Own Junior Racing Team Summary Lando Norris launches LN4 Fusion, marking the first time a modern Formula One world champion has directly backed a junior single-seater teamThe organization aims to systematically remove financial and developmental hurdles for emerging racing talentLN4 Fusion will commence racing in 2027 with entries across F3, Italian F4 and Formula Regional European Championship Lando Norris is reshaping the pipeline to the grid following his 2025 Formula One World Championship victory. Ahead of the 2026 Italian Grand Prix in Monza, the driver formally launched LN4 Fusion, a newly established junior single-seater racing team. This debut marks a historic shift in motorsport infrastructure as the first instance of a modern F1 champion directly backing a team in the junior categories. Personal financial backing from Norris and an investment group fund the organization. Because the driver previously identified the high cost of entry as a fundamental problem, the project works to lower specific barriers for entry through this new structure. The move signals a shift toward veteran drivers taking direct ownership of the developmental paths that once produced them.LN4 Fusion officially commences racing operations in 2027 with a significant footprint across the continent. Confirmation of entries in the FIA F3 Championship, the Italian F4 Championship and the FIA Formula Regional European Championship establishes its initial competitive reach. It strategically acquired key assets from the German outfit AIX Racing to lock down its presence on the F3 grid through the 2027 season. Ambitions extend further up the ladder with a formal application already submitted to participate in the FIA F2 Championship.The LN4 Legacy programme, established by Norris, serves as a core developmental pillar to ensure the pipeline stays primed with elite prospects. This initiative identifies and provides financial, coaching and career support to young drivers starting in karting. Personnel and experience from Fusion Motorsport, which has operated in UK karting for 25 years, provide the foundation for the new team. Dan Hazlewood, the head of Fusion Motorsport karting, steps up to act as team principal for the UK operation. Operations for this division run out of a British base in Cambridgeshire that currently hosts a British Formula 4 testing programme to prepare for future championship entries.Securing veteran leadership remains centra

items.title: A Rare Working "Hatfield" Apple-1 Could Fetch Up to $800,000 USD at Bonhams
items.text: A Rare Working "Hatfield" Apple-1 Could Fetch Up to $800,000 USD at Bonhams Summary Bonhams will auction the "Hatfield" Apple-1, a rare working example of the first pre-assembled personal computerThe motherboard is signed by co-creator Steve Wozniak and the lot includes a 1978 letter signed by Steve JobsTraceable to its original owner with nearly all its components intact, it is one of only 74 verified surviving Apple-1 units Bonhams is bringing one of computing's founding artifacts to the block with the "Hatfield" Apple-1, a still-functional example of the machine that launched Apple. The unit headlines the house's History of Science, Technology & Computing sale this October, distinguished by a rare combination of working condition, complete provenance and the marks of both Apple founders.At the center of the lot is a second-batch Apple-1 motherboard, built in 1976 and preserved in running order. The board carries its original MOS Technology 6502 microprocessor, 8KB of RAM, keyboard interface, three Sprague "Big Blue" capacitors and its original cassette interface board, the setup that made the Apple-1 usable with a standard monitor at a time when rival microcomputers relied on banks of switches or slow teletype output. The sale bundles it with a deep set of period accessories, including the original operation and BASIC manuals, a 1977 Koyo video monitor, a Panasonic cassette recorder and two period keyboards.What separates this example from the field is its paper trail. The motherboard is signed along its top edge by Steve Wozniak, who designed and hand-built the machine, and the lot is accompanied by a typed letter signed by Steve Jobs, dated January 18, 1978, offering original owner Fred Hatfield a trade-in toward an Apple II board. Hatfield, a Computer Data Systems employee who had written to Apple about the Apple-1's thin software library, ultimately declined and kept the computer. Because many owners who accepted the trade-in returned boards that were later parted out, an example traceable to its first owner with most of its components intact is exceptionally scarce. items.title: Acer's Predator Project DualPlay Mini Is a Gaming Handheld That Opens Into a Laptop
items.text: Acer's Predator Project DualPlay Mini Is a Gaming Handheld That Opens Into a Laptop Summary Acer has revealed the Predator Project DualPlay Mini, a 2-in-1 gaming handheld that converts into a laptop-style deviceThe design flips open to expose a built-in keyboard, letting it double as a productivity machine and support keyboard-and-mouse playIt runs Intel Arc G3 Extreme graphics and uses Predator's AeroBlade cooling to sustain performance during long sessions Acer's Predator Project DualPlay Mini rethinks what a gaming handheld can be, folding a full keyboard into a device built around handheld controls. Billed as a first-of-its-kind convertible, it flips between a traditional grip-and-play layout and a laptop-style setup, positioning itself as a hybrid rather than a single-purpose portable.In its closed configuration, the DualPlay Mini behaves like a standard handheld, with familiar controls flanking the screen for on-the-go play. Flip it open and a built-in keyboard appears, turning the same unit into something closer to a compact laptop for email, documents and everyday tasks. The pitch is that one device covers both play and work without a user ever reaching for a second machine.That convertible layout also reshapes how games get played. Pairing the built-in keyboard with a Bluetooth mouse, sold separately, opens the door to a proper keyboard-and-mouse configuration, the setup competitive first-person shooter players tend to prefer over thumbsticks. It is a meaningful distinction in a category where nearly every rival locks players into gamepad-style controls, and it speaks to who Acer sees reaching for this thing.On the hardware side, the machine leans on Intel Arc G3 Extreme graphics to drive its gaming performance. Keeping that silicon in check is Predator's AeroBlade cooling, which combines ultra-thin metal fan blades with what Acer calls Vortex Flow to push airflow up to 10 percent higher than a comparable plastic fan, a design aimed at holding steady output across extended sessions. Acer has kept broader specifications, including processor, display and battery details, under wraps for now.The bigger context is a handheld PC market that has grown fiercely competitive since Valve's Steam Deck reframed the category, with ASUS, Lenovo and others crowding in soon after. Rather than compete purely on raw power, Acer is betting on form factor, using the 2-in-1 concept to carve out a lane the current field has largely left open. As a named "Project," the

items.title: Bottega Veneta's Pier Boat Shoe Weaves Intrecciato Into a Rugged Warm-Weather Staple
items.text: Bottega Veneta's Pier Boat Shoe Weaves Intrecciato Into a Rugged Warm-Weather Staple Name: Bottega Venetea Pier Boat ShoeColorway: Tannin, EspressoSKU: 876072V6TG12006, 876065V4QN02388MSRP: $1,400 USDRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: Bottega VenetaBottega Veneta has reworked a warm-weather classic with the Pier Boat Shoe, applying its house craft language to the traditional deck silhouette. Made in Italy, the shoe leans on rugged suede and the brand's instantly recognizable woven detailing to lift a familiar shape into elevated territory.The defining feature sits right at the front of the shoe. Bottega Veneta carries its signature Intrecciato weave across the vamp, rendering the technique in suede so the interlaced panels read as texture rather than ornament. It is a direct nod to the leatherwork the house is known for, translated onto a silhouette that rarely gets this kind of treatment.Construction pairs two leathers for the body of the shoe. A rugged suede exterior gives the boat shoe its worn-in, tactile surface, while calfskin and lambskin handle the build and a smooth calfskin lining finishes the interior. A rubber outsole grounds the pair for everyday wear, and the whole thing is produced in Italy, keeping the make in line with the brand's craft positioning.The Pier Boat Shoe comes in two earthy options that play to the material's natural depth. Tannin leans into a warm, leathery brown, while Espresso runs darker and richer, giving the style two takes on the same tonal, understated palette. Both keep the focus on texture and construction rather than color contrast, staying true to the shoe's quiet, material-forward design. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: LISA's ‘Always Lalisa’ Documentary Hits IMAX and Cinemas Worldwide in October 2026 Summary LISA is the subject of 'Always Lalisa,' a feature documentary chronicling the year she stepped away from BLACKPINK to build a solo careerDirected by Sue Kim, the film held its world premiere at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival ahead of its worldwide theatrical runIts arrival caps a career-defining stretch that includes a 2026 FIFA World Cup performance, a sold-out Las Vegas residency and an acting turn in 'The White Lotus' LISA is getting the feature-documentary treatment with Always Lalisa, a film that follows the global superstar through the year she stepped out of BLACKPINK to chart her own path. Directed by Sue Kim and released through Sony Music Vision, the project frames a single pivotal stretch, the first time since childhood that LISA has operated apart from the group, as the launchpad for one of the most closely watched solo runs in pop.The documentary's premise is built around risk. With a set clock counting down to her return to BLACKPINK, LISA takes a year of independence and confronts the pressure of standing up a solo career, moving into acting and building a brand, all while trying to hold onto a private life outside the spotlight. It is a rare framing for an artist of her scale, trading the safety of one of pop's biggest acts for the uncertainty of going it alone.That gamble has paid off in a run of milestones the film effectively caps. Over the past year LISA opened the 2026 FIFA World Cup, performing "Goals" with Anitta and Rema and becoming the first female K-pop and Thai artist to take that stage, played Coachella 2025 as a solo act, covered Vanity Fair, sat on the 2026 Met Gala host committee as the first K-pop artist in that role and made her acting debut in HBO's The White Lotus. She also became the first K-pop artist to land a Las Vegas residency, with her four-show VIVA LA LISA run at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace selling out in under 10 minutes. The momentum continues into the fall, with her EP PRESS PLAY due October 23 and its first single "SaWaDika" arriving September 3."Always Lalisa gives fans an unguarded look at LISA's trajectory from BLACKPINK stardom into one of the most recognized artists in the world," said Marc Allenby, CEO of Trafalgar Releasing, which is handling the limited theatrical engagement. “BLINKS have been waiting for this story and we are proud to give them the opportunity to celebrate her incredible jour

items.title: FORWARDS Festival Celebrates Five Years of Genre-Defying Sounds in Bristol
items.text: FORWARDS Festival Celebrates Five Years of Genre-Defying Sounds in Bristol Last weekend, Bristol’s Clifton Downs transformed into a hub of sound and culture for FORWARDS Festival.Commemorating its milestone fifth year over the Bank Holiday weekend, the curated lineup brought together global icons, homegrown legends and emerging talent for a memorable end-of-summer celebration.Saturday spotlighted an all-female co-headlining trio, featuring Tems, indie powerhouse Wet Leg, and UK icon Self Esteem alongside sets from Joy Crookes, Goldie, and Erika de Casier which added another layer of vibes to the main stage. At The Arches dance tent, performances from Crazy P and RUBII kept energy high into the night.The festival didn’t slow down on the Sunday either. Bringing an equally dynamic roster, led by Mercury Prize winner Little Simz, Australian punk outfit Amyl and the Sniffers, and US artist Dijon, additional sets by Jim Legxacy, Jean Dawson, and Princess Nokia underscored the weekend's musical breadth to represent the underground.Beyond the main stages, The Information stage hosted cultural conversations alongside late-night showcases of local Bristol talent. And FORWARDS delivered an elevated vision of contemporary sound, confirming its place as an essential fixture on the UK festival calendar.Hypebeast caught up with French singer-songwriter, anaiis at the festival. items.title: KidSuper and BÉIS Turn Luggage Into a Canvas With Their "Graffiti Cargo" Travel Capsule
items.text: KidSuper and BÉIS Turn Luggage Into a Canvas With Their "Graffiti Cargo" Travel Capsule Summary BÉIS and KidSuper have partnered on a nine-piece travel capsule that introduces the brand's first-ever TrunkEvery piece is wrapped in one of two custom KidSuper prints drawn from Colm Dillane's paintings and hand-drawn graphicsThe collection debuted on the runway during KidSuper's Spring/Summer 2027 show in Miami BÉIS and KidSuper have joined forces on a nine-piece travel collection that treats luggage as something to look at rather than something to overlook. The capsule first surfaced on the runway at KidSuper's Spring/Summer 2027 show in Miami this past June, worn by BÉIS founder Shay Mitchell, and pairs the label's functional travel design with the imagination Colm Dillane has built KidSuper on.The collection's centerpiece is a milestone for BÉIS: The Trunk Check-In Roller, the brand's debut entry in the category and a long-requested addition. It arrives with a wide 70/30 opening, detachable kickstand straps, braking wheels and interior organization built for the piece's scale. Alongside it sits the newest expansion of the sold-out Hybrid Rollers, offered in Check-In and Carry-On formats and equipped with the patent-pending BÉIS Coupling System, which links multiple Hybrid rollers together so they move as a single unit. Filling out the range are a Carryall Duffle, a Pro Travel Backpack Carryall Duffle, a Pro Travel Crossbody, Luggage Covers and a Luggage Tag, several of them pulled from the existing BÉIS Pro Collection.Where the hardware comes from BÉIS, the personality comes from Dillane. Each piece carries one of two custom prints: the Graffiti Cargo artwork or his vivid Finale painting. The Cargo design has an origin story rooted in how KidSuper actually operates. Dillane and his team spent years hauling collections between projects in cardboard shipping boxes rather than proper luggage, and that habit became the concept's jumping-off point, reimagining the worn, well-traveled look of a beat-up box, hand-drawn graphics and all, as a genuinely functional bag.For Dillane, the appeal was in claiming territory most designers ignore. "I travel constantly, so I've spent a ridiculous amount of my life thinking about bags and luggage. I don't think it's a category that always gets treated as a creative canvas, and there's no reason it shouldn't be...
