items.title: PUMA and Hypebeast Hosted “Suede Sessions” in London
items.text: PUMA and Hypebeast Hosted “Suede Sessions” in London Under the arches of Waterloo in London, Hypebeast hosted “Suede Sessions” in collaboration with PUMA last week. Inspired by generations of music subcultures connected to the iconic Suede silhouette, the event set out to platform the distinct sounds and eclectic genres shaping the local music scene today.As the first event of its kind, Yussef Dayes was enlisted to unite emerging music artists and a handful of established rappers, musicians, and vocalists through a unique two-part format. Comprising an artist workshop, followed by a live performance later in the day, each activation was hosted by the drummer and composer who brought his genre-blending jazz to the forefront.Dayes kicked off the event with the music-making session. Acting as a creative incubator, the workshop saw the drummer offer advice to help the participants elevate their respective sounds. After collaborating, the workshop culminated in a collective jam as the artists showcased their latest material to the group. A few hours later, the venue was prepared for a live performance headlined by Dayes. In keeping with the graffiti-emblazoned tunnels outside, it was lit up in moody orange lights and featured spray-painted branding on the walls around the main stage. Elsewhere, a pop-up studio was erected for guests to take their own Polaroid portraits. For the first performance, Nepali-American singer-songwriter Parijita set the mood with her ballads, layering deeply melodic vocals and gentle piano notes. London-based music duo ZENA then picked up the tempo, playing a mix of Ethiopian-inspired jazz and dub. Riffing on the melting pot of music styles, Saiming, a rapper hailing from South London, followed on with his blend of grime and neo-jazz. In a crescendo to the night, Dayes took the stage for the final performance. Having recently announced a feature in Wyclef Jean’s new album Q, guests crowded around eager to get up close to listen to his latest music. Over the 30-minute set, he opted for a mix of tracks from his albums, including Black Classical Music, while also going freestyle to honor the playful and experimental edge of London’s music scene. View this post on InstagramA post shared by HYPEBEAST UK (@hypebeastuk) If you missed out, check out what went down at “Suede Sessions” in the gallery above. items.title: A. Lange & Söhne Reimagines the Classic 1815 UP/DOWN With Striking Blue Dials
items.text: A. Lange & Söhne Reimagines the Classic 1815 UP/DOWN With Striking Blue Dials Summary A. Lange & Söhne debuts new 1815 UP/DOWN and TRIPLE SPLIT editions at Concours of Elegance 2026.The 37.5mm 1815 UP/DOWN drops in white and pink gold with blue dials, limited to 300 pieces each.The platinum TRIPLE SPLIT features a rhodié dial and grey subdials, capped at 100 units. A. Lange & Söhne has unveiled its latest watchmaking novelties. Emphasizing the brand’s commitment to combining classic Glashütte aesthetics with complex mechanical engineering, the Saxon manufacture extends two of its most celebrated families. The release brings a fresh interpretation to traditional watchmaking, debuting refined colorways across both an elegant classic dress watch and an unprecedented horological benchmark.The first highlight of the unveiling is the new 1815 UP/DOWN, a model deeply rooted in the heritage of Ferdinand Adolph Lange’s historic pocket watches. Housed in a compact case measuring 37.5 mm in diameter and just 8.7 mm in height, the timepiece focuses entirely on its power-reserve display positioned opposite the subsidiary seconds sub-dial. Driven by the manually wound L051.2 manufacture calibre, the AUF (UP) and AB (DOWN) indicators are integrated directly into the movement via a space-saving planetary gear system rather than an added module. Offered in 750 white gold and 750 pink gold- each strictly limited to 300 pieces - the new iterations pair deep blue dials with argenté-coloured auxiliary sub-dials, railway-track minute scales, and blued hands, creating a contemporary contrast with classic Glashütte aesthetics.Alongside this, the watchmaker also presents a new iteration of the ultimate chronograph benchmark: the TRIPLE SPLIT. Since its debut in 2018, the TRIPLE SPLIT has held a unique title as the world's only mechanical chronograph capable of measuring comparative and intermediate times up to an aggregate duration of 12 hours. By extending split-seconds rattrapante functionality to both the minute and hour counters alongside the central seconds hand, the watch allows complex additive timing for endurance events, complete with a flyback function. This latest version is presented in a 43.2 mm 950 platinum case with a cool rhodié-coloured dial offset by dark grey auxiliary dials, luminous main hands, and blued rattrapante hands. Capped at just 100 pieces, the watch is fitted with a dark brown alligator leather strap secured by a platinum deployant buckle.At the hear

items.title: Christie's Next Auction is for a New Generation of Design Collectors
items.text: Christie's Next Auction is for a New Generation of Design Collectors Basic.Space is taking over Christie's Beverly Hills with a selling exhibition of 50 chairs, which gathers design classics alongside contemporary pieces.Named "50 Chairs at Christie's", the auction has been curated by Basic.Space and will feature works created by, and also owned by, famed designers. For Basic.Space founder Jesse Lee, the event is designed to cater to the "next generation of collectors", pairing cult favourites such as Gufram's huge Pratone lounge chair with classics like Charles and Ray Eames' LCW in a rare calfskin edition. "Discovery has always been at the heart of Basic.Space and our ecosystem of designers, artists and creatives," says Lee, who founded the platform in 2020 and has spent recent years making his way into the field through IRL experiences and the acquisition of industry tentpole Design Miami. "We are redefining luxury for the next generation of collectors. 50 Chairs at Christie’s is an expression of that ethos - showcasing iconic works from the past alongside original pieces from the voices shaping the future of design."On the more historical end of the spectrum, a hammered-brass chair by Philippe Hiquily made in the 1970s has been put forwards by Kelly Wearstler, and comedian, filmmaker and design collector Eric Wareheim is parting with Joe Colombo's molded-fiberglass Elda Chair from 1963. Los Angeles furniture designer BASA is contributing Gufram's oversized Pratone lounge chair, and collectors Giampiero Tagliaferri and Adrien Dewulf have supplied a CL9 ribbon chair.The contemporary side leans more on pieces from collectible design galleries. Carpenters Workshop Gallery is bringing Rick Owens' Stag Stool, a limited edition in black plywood and natural moose antler, and The Future Perfect has supplied Seoul-based SeungJin Yang's Lounge Chair 01 – Transparent Blue, formed from balloons and resin. Sam Klemick's Trumpet Dining Chair works the fluidity of textiles into solid wood, while Los Angeles furniture and decorative arts dealer JF Chen is contributing pieces by multidisciplinary artist and audiophile Devon Turnbull, California sculptor Vince Skelly and London-based Max Lamb.50 Chairs at Christie's runs September 25 to 30, 2026, at Christie's Beverly Hills, 336 North Camden Drive, Beverly Hills, CA 90210, with a VIP preview taking place on September 24. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Fear of God Unifies Three House Sub-Labels for “An Eternal Perspective”
items.text: Fear of God Unifies Three House Sub-Labels for “An Eternal Perspective” Summary Fear of God unveils “An Eternal Perspective”, uniting Collection Nine, Eternal Order and ESSENTIALS Signature.The campaign emphasizes continuity, transcending seasons and moments with a distinct American luxury vision.Eternal serves as the foundation, guiding the brand’s pursuit of timeless intention. Fear of God has unveiled An Eternal Perspective, a campaign that brings together three distinct pillars of the house - Collection Nine, Eternal Order and ESSENTIALS Signature - under a singular, unified narrative. Rooted in the foundational principles established by founder and creative director Jerry Lorenzo, the initiative frame-shifts away from traditional, isolated seasonal drops. Instead, it presents each sub-label as part of an interconnected design continuum, articulating a refined vision of modern American luxury through quiet elegance, intentional proportion, and meticulous craftsmanship.At its foundation, Eternal serves as the guiding principle from which Fear of God creates and communicates, positioning the brand’s work as an ongoing pursuit of transcendence through intention. “An Eternal Perspective” underscores the idea that fashion is not confined to moments or trends but is instead a lasting expression of identity and vision. Available now through fearofgod.com, the campaign reinforces Jerry Lorenzo’s philosophy of building a cohesive universe where every piece, whether from Collection Nine, Eternal Order, or ESSENTIALS, exists as part of a timeless continuum. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: JISOO Pairs Playful Grooves With Dark Fairy-Tale Aesthetics on "CLICK"
items.text: JISOO Pairs Playful Grooves With Dark Fairy-Tale Aesthetics on "CLICK" Summary JISOO released her new synth-pop solo single "CLICK" alongside an official music video directed by Joseph Kahn.The track explores romantic chemistry, balancing hesitation against an undeniable, magnetic attraction.Set in an overgrown amusement park, the visual blends post-apocalyptic fairy-tale aesthetics with mechanical carnival figures. JISOO has officially unveiled her new solo single "CLICK" alongside a captivating official music video directed by Joseph Kahn. Driven by an infectious synth-pop groove and crisp percussion, the track balances a playful, romantic mood with an undercurrent of hesitation. Lyrically, JISOO navigates the delicate boundary between friendship and deeper physical chemistry, weighing her skepticism about a partner who "flirts with everyone" against an undeniable magnetic connection. Anchored by a rhythmic, addictive hook - "Your lips, my lips, click / We were made to fit" - the song captures the feeling of giving in to romantic attraction despite knowing the potential risks involved.The accompanying music video turns this romantic tension into a whimsical, post-apocalyptic narrative set within an overgrown, abandoned amusement park. Blending dark fairy-tale aesthetics with sci-fi elements, JISOO moves among mechanized carnival mannequins and vintage mechanical attractions alongside a robotic teddy bear companion. Styled in contrasting looks, ranging from corseted ballet dresses to dramatic black lace gowns, she waltzes inside a lit gazebo with a dapper mechanical figure before riding a rusted roller coaster across the dystopian skyline. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Maison Margiela's REPLICA Wraps "Lazy Sunday Morning" and "Jazz Club" Scents in Newspaper Print for Its Second Holiday 2026 Offering
items.text: Maison Margiela's REPLICA Wraps "Lazy Sunday Morning" and "Jazz Club" Scents in Newspaper Print for Its Second Holiday 2026 Offering Summary Maison Margiela's REPLICA line returns with the second installment of its 2026 holiday collection, led by newspaper-print editions of two signature scentsNew additions include an "Up At Dawn" hand cream and a "By the Fireplace" candle built around wintry scent storiesTwo mix-and-match coffret sets let shoppers pair a fragrance with their choice of body care Maison Margiela's REPLICA fragrance line is expanding its 2026 holiday offering with a second wave, anchored by limited-edition versions of "Lazy Sunday Morning" and "Jazz Club." Both eau de toilettes arrive dressed in a holiday-exclusive newspaper-style print, joined by new body care, a candle, and a pair of customizable gift sets.The two returning scents are the centerpiece, each carried over in its full 100 mL format under the "PRINT SHOP" holiday design. "Lazy Sunday Morning" builds its story around a sunny Sunday in Florence, spent wrapped in freshly laundered linen sheets, and reads as fresh and clean on the skin. "Jazz Club" pulls in the opposite direction, drawing on a private New York jazz club for a warmer, spicier profile that suggests rich cocktails and mellow whiskey for a more intimate, grown-up mood.New to this wave is the "Up At Dawn" hand cream, centered on a dawn-rose scent that opens like fresh roses blooming in a mist-covered garden. The formula does functional work alongside the fragrance, using hyaluronic acid to add moisture while shea butter and almond oil guard against dryness, finishing with a light texture meant to leave hands supple rather than heavy.Rounding out the seasonal additions is the "By the Fireplace" candle, a natural fit for winter. Its scent sets the scene in midwinter Chamonix, France, capturing the crackle of a fireplace and the faint sweetness of chestnut for a warm, enclosed feel.The collection also leans into personalization through two coffret formats. The larger 30 mL Holiday Set lets shoppers choose one 30 mL fragrance from all 14 REPLICA scents, add a body care item of their choice, and take home a 1.2 mL "Jazz Club" mini and a holiday-exclusive shopper. A more compact 10 mL Holiday Set pairs a 10 mL fragrance with a hand cream, with both drawn from a choice of "Lazy Sunday Morning" or "Up At Dawn." Standalone holiday gift versions of "Lazy Sunday Morning" in eau de toilette, hand cream, and lip balm complete the ra

items.title: McDonald's Japan Supersizes the Tsukimi Burger Into a 27-Inch Plushie
items.text: McDonald's Japan Supersizes the Tsukimi Burger Into a 27-Inch Plushie Summary McDonald's Japan is running a lottery for a giant Tsukimi Burger plushie tied to the sandwich's 35th anniversaryThe soft toy measures 27.6 inches across and faithfully recreates the burger's signature layersEntry is limited to MyMcDonald's Rewards members and closes in late October McDonald's Japan is handing fans a chance to win an oversized Tsukimi Burger plushie, celebrating 35 years of one of the chain's most recognizable seasonal sandwiches. First introduced in 1991 as a nod to Japan's fall moon-viewing custom, the Tsukimi Burger now gets a plush tribute built at a scale that will not fit neatly on a shelf.The plushie is the whole point, and it commits to the bit. It measures 27.6 inches, or roughly 70 cm, and recreates the Tsukimi Burger's full stack in soft form, from its signature round egg to a chunky beef patty, smoked bacon, and a layer of creamy tomato sauce. Its soft, fluffy texture leans into the toy angle, making it as much a huggable living-room object as an anniversary keepsake.Getting one takes some work, since it is a lottery prize rather than an item for sale. The plushie is available only to members of the MyMcDonald's Rewards program in Japan. To qualify, customers first register through the official McDonald's Japan app, then purchase three eligible Tsukimi Family sets and spend 250 reward points to submit an entry.The entry period runs from September 2 through October 21, with lottery applications accepted until October 27. Anyone in Japan during that stretch has a shot at taking home the giant burger, assuming they can find room to carry it back. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Michael Jordan's Ferrari That Inspired the Air Jordan XIV Is Heading to Auction Estimated at Up to $1.3M USD
items.text: Michael Jordan's Ferrari That Inspired the Air Jordan XIV Is Heading to Auction Estimated at Up to $1.3M USD Summary Michael Jordan's custom 1997 Ferrari 550 Maranello is heading to auction for the first time after disappearing from public view for 24 yearsThe V-12 grand tourer famously inspired the design of the Air Jordan XIV and appeared onscreen during the Chicago Bulls' historic championship runPharrell Williams' platform Joopiter expects the cultural artifact to fetch up to $1.3 million in its inaugural automotive sale Michael Jordan's exactingly customized 1997 Ferrari 550 Maranello is stepping back into the spotlight, hitting the auction block for an estimated $700,000 USD to $1,300,000 USD. The monumental sale marks a first for JOOPITER, the sports collectibles platform founded by singer Pharrell Williams, which is operating in partnership with automotive specialist Curated to move its first-ever car. By bridging the world of high-end automotive collecting with the cultural weight of elite sports memorabilia, this auction tests a new ceiling for modern classic valuation.Jordan took delivery of the new vehicle in May 1997, specifically tailoring the Italian powerhouse to his exact aesthetic and physical dimensions. The grand tourer is cloaked in Rosso Barchetta paint, riding on chrome Speedline wheels and concealing a naturally aspirated, 485-hp Ferrari V-12 engine mated to a purist-approved gated manual transmission. To accommodate his six-foot-six frame, Ferrari uniquely modified the tan leather interior by installing longer chair rails and equipping the seats with slimmer padding. In a move of calculated understatement, Jordan also ordered the car entirely without the traditional yellow Ferrari fender shields.The coupe's provenance is inextricably tied to peak Chicago Bulls dominance. Jordan famously drove the car out of the United Center with an Illinois vanity plate reading "MJ 5" on June 13, 1997, immediately after clinching his fifth NBA Championship. The vehicle was later seen rolling out of a January 1998 practice in the seminal ESPN documentary The Last Dance. Its cultural footprint extends far beyond the pavement, directly shaping sneaker history when the vehicle inspired Nike VP of Design Tinker Hatfield to create the Air Jordan XIV basketball shoe. Hatfield pulled directly from the Italian bodywork, integrating a Ferrari-like yellow-and-black Jumpman shield and a heavy tire-tread sole pattern into the iconic silhouette.Jordan ultimatel

items.title: Jin Sakai Returns as a Playable Fighter in ‘Ghost of Yōtei: Most Wanted’
items.text: Jin Sakai Returns as a Playable Fighter in ‘Ghost of Yōtei: Most Wanted’ Summary Jin Sakai, the hero of 'Ghost of Tsushima,' has been revealed as a playable character in the new 'Ghost of Yōtei: Most Wanted' modeMost Wanted is a single-player roguelike built around bounty runs, unlockable perks, and four distinct fightersThe mode arrives alongside the narrative expansion 'Echoes of Sekigahara' as part of 'Ghost of Yōtei' Complete Edition Jin Sakai is back. Sucker Punch has revealed that the Ghost of Tsushima protagonist joins Ghost of Yōtei: Most Wanted as a playable character, carrying over all four of his signature combat stances. Shown during the September 3 State of Play, his return anchors a brand-new roguelike mode landing inside Ghost of Yōtei Complete Edition on October 1.Sucker Punch built Jin’s return as a faithful bridge between games. The team took his Ghost of Tsushima model and preserved it while applying upgrades for Ghost of Yōtei, keeping all four of the original stances so players can once again shift between them to exploit enemy weaknesses. He starts with a Sticky Bomb and a hankyu, and his kit leans on returning signatures: his Ultimate is the "Dance of Wrath" skill that targets and disarms multiple enemies, while his Kill Streak is, fittingly, Ghost Stance, letting him terrify nearby foes and cut down a limited number in single hits. The nod runs deep, given that Jin headlined Sucker Punch's 2020 predecessor before Atsu took over the Ghost mantle in Ezo.Around him sits the structure of Most Wanted itself, pitched as the studio's spin on the roguelike. Runs begin at a bounty board, where each target is a member of the Yōtei Six, reached only by clearing waves of enemies and minibosses. Finishing waves unlocks perks that shape an increasingly powerful build toward the bounty's final boss, and cleared bounties can be replayed at higher difficulty, culminating in the toughest run against Lord Saito. Between runs, players spend earned Mon on techniques, weapon upgrades, charms, and character unlocks, and any cosmetics earned carry back into the main game. Perks are framed as the real engine of the mode, with frequent choices spanning weapon mastery, gear loadouts, summons, parries, and survivability that reward experimentation.The default fighter is Atsu, who wields dual katana and two Ghost Tools, with a "Call of the Pack" Ultimate that summons wolves. Oyuki fights with the kusarigama, kunai, and tanegashima rifle, backed by a "Shadow Kil

items.title: Square Enix Sets April 2027 Release Date for ‘Final Fantasy VII Revelation’
items.text: Square Enix Sets April 2027 Release Date for ‘Final Fantasy VII Revelation’ Summary Square Enix has dated 'Final Fantasy VII Revelation,' the conclusion of its Remake project, with a new trailer and gameplay shown during PlayStation's State of PlayThe finale introduces a fully open world traversed by the Highwind airship, alongside new systems and playable charactersThe story sends Cloud and his companions toward a final confrontation with Sephiroth as the planet faces total destruction Square Enix has set Final Fantasy VII Revelation, the closing chapter of its sprawling Remake project, for release on April 8, 2027. Revealed during PlayStation's State of Play with a fresh trailer and an extended gameplay deep dive, the finale arrives across PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam, the Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC.The headline change is scale. Revelation opens the planet into a genuinely borderless world, letting players roam every corner aboard the series' iconic Highwind airship. Traversal gets its own companion in Piko, a Chocobo that grows alongside the party and picks up new movement and combat abilities over time, while a new grappling gun lets characters scale rooftops and zip through the environment at speed.Combat builds on the hybrid system the trilogy is known for, now reshaped by the new FITS system. FITS grants abilities and higher tiers of power through specialized roles, including Warrior, Knight, Black Mage, and Summoner, with the extended footage showing new playable character Cid in the Knight FITS and returning fan favorite Vincent in the Summoner FITS. Beyond the two additions to the roster, players can freely swap their active character and rework the party at any point during exploration, and can steer the narrative by choosing which members take on specific quests, changing how certain events play out.All of that flexibility feeds into a story pitched as the end of the line. Cloud Strife and his companions face a world on the edge of annihilation, grieving a fallen ally as Sephiroth closes in on godhood. The party takes to the skies aboard the Highwind in a race to stop Meteor, the ultimate destructive magic, before it wipes out the planet entirely.The finale also caps a trilogy that arrived with heavy expectations and largely met them. The first two entries, Final Fantasy VII Remake and Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, drew wide acclaim, together collecting more than 140 perfect review scores along with Gam

items.title: Converse Elevates the First String Jack Purcell With Premium Canvas
items.text: Converse Elevates the First String Jack Purcell With Premium Canvas Name: Converse First String Jack PurcellColorway: Mountain View/Marshmallow/Chestnut, Premium White/Marshmallow/BlackSKU: TBCMSRP: $250 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: Select RetailersThe Converse First String Jack Purcell returns with a premium update that underscores the franchise’s heritage while introducing elevated material choices. Available in "Mountain View/Marshmallow/Chestnut" and "Premium White/Marshmallow/Black," the sneakers feature canvas uppers paired with refined detailing that highlights the Jack Purcell’s iconic low-profile silhouette.Honoring its vintage roots, the sneaker features upper stitching inspired by mid-1970s models, a slightly raised collar top line mirroring its 1980s iterations, and a tonal molded heel license plate complete with the era-accurate JP script and wedge logo. Crucially, the sneaker's defining toe “smile” remains intact, though its rubber inlay has been subtly reshaped for a refined, modern finish.The two new Converse First String Jack Purcell variants are only available through select retailers. items.title: Japanese Supergroup YAO Drops Emotionally Charged Single “FOR OKINAWA”
items.text: Japanese Supergroup YAO Drops Emotionally Charged Single “FOR OKINAWA” Summary Supergroup YAO - Awich, ONE OK ROCK, Paledusk and CHICO CARLITO - released their second single, "FOR OKINAWA."The track blends heavy riffs and passionate rap, exploring Okinawa's history and advocating for peace.Released ahead of ONE OK ROCK's tour finale, an official music video will follow. Japanese collective YAO - the supergroup formed by Awich, ONE OK ROCK, Paledusk and CHICO CARLITO - has released their second single, "FOR OKINAWA." Following the high-energy, rebellion-driven tone of their debut track "777," this latest offering serves as a deeply emotional and personal reflection on Okinawa's history, cultural heritage and the enduring scars of its past.Born out of candid conversations between Okinawa natives Awich and CHICO CARLITO and their bandmates, the song channels a collective determination to honor their roots and advocate for peace. Frontman Taka (ONE OK ROCK) stepped outside his traditional style to craft a completely unprecedented melody, providing an expansive, soaring sonic foundation where heavy guitar riffs, passionate rap cadences and emotive vocal lines converge around a unified message.The single arrives at a pivotal moment, dropping just ahead of ONE OK ROCK's final DETOX Japan Tour shows this weekend, which mark the grand finale of the band's entire nationwide tour. Adding to the anticipation, Awich recently took to her Instagram story to rally fans attending the upcoming weekend shows, passionately urging the crowd to learn the lyrics and sing along together during the live performance. A music video is set to follow soon, expanding the narrative and visual world behind “FOR OKINAWA.” Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Netflix Orders a Live-Action 'Dungeons & Dragons Ravenloft' Series
items.text: Netflix Orders a Live-Action 'Dungeons & Dragons Ravenloft' Series Summary Netflix is officially developing a live-action series based on the classic Dungeons & Dragons campaign setting RavenloftThe narrative will trace the dark origins and undead transformation of iconic vampire villain Strahd von ZarovichIndustry heavyweights Alfonso Cuarón and John August are steering the adaptation as executive producers Netflix is developing a Ravenloft live-action series to translate a significant corner of the role-playing world to the screen. Alfonso Cuarón joined the production as an executive producer, while John August signed on to serve as both a core writer and an executive producer. Hasbro Entertainment also develops the project alongside these producers to ensure the property carries weight.For decades, the source material has commanded respect in the gaming community as one of the most iconic campaign settings in Dungeons & Dragons, Ravenloft. This atmospheric universe provides a textured canvas for a premium adaptation. The television project specifically adapts the classic tabletop setting to capitalize on a renewed interest in the franchise's darker dimensions. Development of the show aligns with a modern revitalization of the lore following the release of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within. Narrative themes prioritize the psychology of a legendary antagonist over traditional action.The narrative centers strictly on the origins of the most famous vampire in Dungeons & Dragons, Strahd von Zarovich. This character has terrorized campaigns for generations as an enigmatic force. The upcoming series humanizes the backstory of the villain by offering a look at the man before the monster. Intense plot points focus on his pursuit of power, his experiences with love and the blinding obsession that ultimately dictates his fate.The series explores the undead transformation of the protagonist with narrative depth. Its overarching story charts a journey from a tragic antihero into a bloodthirsty vampire Darklord. This evolution ensures the adaptation is steeped in tragedy and complex character dynamics. The Netflix production anchors its central conflict entirely around this dark metamorphosis. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Buffer Drags ‘Fast Times at Ridgemont High’ Into a Capsule Ruled by "No Shirts, No Shoes, No Dice"
items.text: Buffer Drags ‘Fast Times at Ridgemont High’ Into a Capsule Ruled by "No Shirts, No Shoes, No Dice" Summary Buffer, the label helmed by creative director Tetsu Nishiyama and operated by HUMAN MADE, has teamed with the 1982 American teen movie for a graphics-led collectionThe collaboration runs to three T-shirt styles, each filtering the film through Buffer's own design lensA set of Buffer original pieces rounds out the release, including a long-sleeve T-shirt that reworks the brand's main logo Buffer, the brand led by creative director Tetsu Nishiyama and operated by HUMAN MADE, is releasing a collaboration collection with Fast Times at Ridgemont High, the 1982 American high-school comedy. The capsule reads the film's world through Buffer's graphic sensibility, landing as a tight run of T-shirts rather than a sprawling licensing exercise.The collaboration centers on three T-shirt designs, each taking a different route into the source material. One is handled by illustrator Naoki Shoji, who builds his piece around the movie as a motif. A second prints a run of the film's memorable scenes directly onto the shirt, leaning on recognizable imagery. The third distills the movie down to a single line, translating its emblematic rule "NO SHIRTS, NO SHOES, NO DICE" into a standalone graphic.That three-way split is where the technical intent shows. Rather than slapping a single still on a blank, Buffer treats the film as raw material to be reinterpreted, moving from illustration to photographic scene print to text-driven graphic across the set. It is a small collection built to cover distinct graphic registers instead of repeating one idea in different colors.The film crossover also fits a longer pattern for the label. Buffer has built a throughline of movie-referencing capsules, and pairing with a 1982 teen comedy slots neatly into a graphic language rooted in American pop-culture nostalgia. Fast Times at Ridgemont High carries a specific early-80s Americana that maps onto Nishiyama's ongoing interest in vintage US reference points, giving the T-shirts a cultural anchor beyond the artwork itself.Alongside the collaboration, Buffer is offering its own originals in the same drop. Those include a T-shirt drawing on 1990s street culture and a long-sleeve T-shirt that reconstructs the brand's main logo, extending the release past the film tie-in and into Buffer's core graphic identity.The Buffer x Fast Times at Ridgemont High collection releases September 5 at Buffer Sto

items.title: The LEGO PlayStation Rebuilds the Original 1994 Console in 1,911 Bricks With Working Buttons
items.text: The LEGO PlayStation Rebuilds the Original 1994 Console in 1,911 Bricks With Working Buttons Summary Sony and the LEGO Group have revealed the LEGO PlayStation, a brick replica of the original console and controllerThe 1,911-piece build recreates the hardware at close to 1:1 scale and folds in functional details and hidden nods to PlayStation historyTwo removable game dioramas tied to Ape Escape and Gran Turismo extend the set into a display piece marking 30 years of the platform Sony and the LEGO Group have unveiled the LEGO PlayStation, a buildable replica of the original PlayStation console and controller shown during the September 3 State of Play. It is the first time fans can construct the debut hardware brick by brick, arriving as a tribute to a platform that has been in players' hands for more than three decades.The set runs to 1,911 pieces and lands at a near 1:1 recreation of the console, measuring 10.5 inches, or 26 cm, wide once fully assembled. Rather than a static shelf model, it carries functional mechanisms: the Power and Open buttons work, and the included controller can plug into the console, giving the finished piece a layer of interactivity beyond the display.Working with LEGO designers, PlayStation built the assembly around its own origins, tucking hidden references to the platform's history into the process. Two of those references become their own modules, pulling in a pair of games that launched on the original console. The Gran Turismo diorama includes a miniature track with scaled-down cars, while the Ape Escape diorama sets up a nostalgic island scene with a swappable blue or red light on the monkey's helmet. Both dioramas can be removed and displayed on their own, and each carries customizable elements, so the set functions as three connected pieces rather than one fixed sculpture.By recreating the 1994 hardware and threading in Ape Escape and Gran Turismo, the set reaches back to the era that defined the brand's first generation, aiming squarely at players who have followed PlayStation since launch as much as newer fans. The result positions the LEGO PlayStation less as a toy and more as a physical marker of the platform's 30-plus-year run, built to sit on a shelf as a piece of console history.The LEGO PlayStation goes on sale via the PlayStation webstore and for LEGO Insiders Early Access starting October 1, then reaches the LEGO webstore and LEGO Stores on October 4. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Beyoncé Expands ‘B'Day’ Into a 31-Track 20th Anniversary Edition With Unreleased Songs and a Pharrell Collab
items.text: Beyoncé Expands ‘B'Day’ Into a 31-Track 20th Anniversary Edition With Unreleased Songs and a Pharrell Collab Summary Beyoncé has revealed a 20th-anniversary edition of her 2006 album B'Day, released on her September 4 birthdayThe expanded digital version runs to 31 tracks and folds in four previously unreleased songs alongside the original lineupNew collaborations with Maluma and Selena Quintanilla arrive next to a full remaster of the era's music videos Beyoncé has unveiled a 20th-anniversary edition of B'Day, her sophomore album, timed to her birthday on September 4. The expanded digital reissue stretches the record to 31 tracks, pairing the 2006 originals with a set of previously unreleased material and two high-profile new collaborations.The reissue's biggest draw is the vault material. Four previously unreleased songs join the tracklist: "Creole," "Back Up," "Lost Yo Mind," and "Can I Watch You," the last featuring Pharrell Williams. Those sit alongside a remastered version of the original 2006 album, positioning the edition as both an expansion and a clean-up of the source recordings.Two collaborations anchor the new additions. "Cuerpo Tumbao (Get Me Bodied)" marks Beyoncé's first time working with Maluma and builds on a sample of Celia Cruz's "La Negra Tiene Tumbao." A press release ties the choice to Beyoncé's respect for the late artist, noting she has "long admired Cruz's pride in her African culture; her refusal to bend in the wake of racism, colorism and the narrow definition of beauty." The second is "Irreemplazable (Como La Flor)," a duet built with the late Selena Quintanilla and cleared through Selena's estate, extending a Latin influence Beyoncé has cited across her Spanish-language work, including her 2007 EP Irreemplazable.The visual side of the era got the same treatment as the audio. Beyoncé remastered the accompanying videos, all originally shot on 35mm, recoloring the footage and finishing it in 4K. Among them is a redone version of "Déjà Vu," featuring JAY-Z and directed by Sophie Muller, which dropped alongside the anniversary release.Beyoncé first teased the anniversary edition on July 4 with "Morning Dew (Donk)," starting a 60-day countdown to the reveal. The original B'Day set the bar it now builds on, arriving in summer 2006 as a Number One album, later certified quintuple platinum by the RIAA, and home to hits including "Irreplaceable," "Déjà Vu," and "Ring the Alarm."Stream the 20th anniversary edition of B'Day on Spotify and

items.title: PlayStation Unveils Two ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ DualSense Controllers That Shimmer Like a Vice City Sunset
items.text: PlayStation Unveils Two ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ DualSense Controllers That Shimmer Like a Vice City Sunset Summary Sony revealed two limited-edition 'Grand Theft Auto VI' DualSense controllers at the September 3 State of PlayA Black and a White edition each translate Vice City's coastal days and neon nights into a shifting, color-changing finishBoth arrive alongside the game on November 19, tying the hardware directly to Jason and Lucia's story Sony has revealed two limited-edition Grand Theft Auto VI DualSense wireless controllers, unveiled during the September 3 State of Play. Split into a Black Limited Edition and a White Limited Edition, both pull the look of Vice City, the fictional heart of Leonida, straight onto the hardware ahead of the game's November 19 release.Each controller carries a shimmering, color-shifting finish that blends the warm tones of a Vice City sunset with the glow of neon, so the surface reads differently depending on the light. Custom palm tree details are molded directly into the body, adding a tactile texture that sits alongside official Grand Theft Auto VI branding. It is a finish built to move rather than sit flat, which suits a setting defined equally by sun-soaked coastline and after-dark energy.From there, the two editions pull in opposite directions. The White Limited Edition leans into Vice City at daybreak, drawing on white sand, pastel skies and a laid-back sense of glamour. The Black Limited Edition takes the other half of the day, channeling the charge of the city's nightlife into a darker treatment. Together they function as a matched day-and-night pair rather than two versions of the same idea.Beyond the surface, these remain full-featured DualSense units. In Grand Theft Auto VI, the controller's haptic feedback and adaptive triggers respond to the on-screen action with dynamic resistance, pushing the sights, sounds and physical sensations of the game into the player's hands. That functional layer is central to how Sony has positioned the tie-in, framing the controllers as part of the argument that the game plays best on PS5 when it lands November 19.The White edition will be offered in limited quantities globally through PlayStation and participating retailers, while the Black edition runs exclusively through PlayStation where available, reaching other regions via select retailers.Both limited-edition DualSense controllers launch November 19, with pre-orders opening September 10 at 10:00 a.m. local time via PlaySt

items.title: Deana Lawson Links With Gagosian for Inaugural New York Solo Exhibition
items.text: Deana Lawson Links With Gagosian for Inaugural New York Solo Exhibition Summary Gagosian hosts Deana Lawson’s debut gallery solo show in New York from September 10 to October 24, 2026.The exhibition debuts Edge Control , a series recontextualizing beauty store surveillance stills.Works include luminous mirror-framed photographs, glass holograms, and large-scale portraits. Gagosian will present its inaugural solo exhibition of works by acclaimed artist Deana Lawson, opening on September 10, 2026, at 541 West 24th Street in New York and running through October 24.The presentation features a dynamic selection of mirror-framed photographs, holograms, and recent large-scale portraits that collectively explore issues of personhood, surveillance, and control within late capitalist society. A central highlight is the debut of selections from Edge Control, a photographic series initiated in 2023 in which Lawson recontextualizes surveillance stills captured at U.S. beauty supply stores. Borrowing its title from both a gel used to lay down hairlines and the literal systems of image-based policing, the series reimagines surveillance imagery - marked by deep-horizon blues and greens - while intervening to protect the identities of those pictured.Expanding on Edge Control, the exhibition also introduces new glass-encased holograms inspired in part by Philip K. Dick’s 1977 dystopian novel A Scanner Darkly and its conceptual "scramble suits" that obscure a wearer's identity. These futuristic works are presented alongside Lawson’s signature, highly detailed domestic portraits. Drawing structural inspiration from 17th-century Dutch paintings and family photo albums, her large-scale figures gaze directly at the camera, asserting a vivid palette of deep greens, mauves, yellows, and browns. Grounded in intimate collaborations between the artist and her subjects, the exhibition highlights the transformative potential of beauty culture and human agency against a backdrop of contemporary paranoia and widespread surveillance.Gagosian NYC541 West 24th StreetNew York, NY 10011, USA Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike Wraps the Air Force 1 in GORE-TEX and Vibram for a Winterized "Baroque Brown" Build
items.text: Nike Wraps the Air Force 1 in GORE-TEX and Vibram for a Winterized "Baroque Brown" Build Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low GORE-TEX “Baroque Brown”Colorway: Baroque Brown/Speed Yellow-University Red-Shadow BrownSKU: HV5953-200MSRP: $150 USDRelease Date: TBC 2026The Nike Air Force 1 Low GORE-TEX "Baroque Brown" takes one of Nike's most familiar silhouettes and reworks it for colder, wetter days. Set for a 2026 release, the shoe layers weatherproofing and a grippier outsole onto the standard AF1, turning an all-year staple into a purpose-built winter option.The upper is where the seasonal intent shows first. Most of it is finished in Baroque Brown leather, with black Swooshes, heel tabs, lining, and midsole cutting through the tone. GORE-TEX is built into the leather for weather protection, and the product images show the material beading water rather than soaking it in. Brown rope laces and a thicker tongue reinforce the winter-ready feel, while small yellow GORE-TEX tags near the collar provide one of the only bright accents on an otherwise muted build.A metal lace dubrae carries another GORE-TEX callout, and Nike Air branding is embossed into the black heel tabs, keeping the back of the shoe clean without introducing extra color. It is a restrained execution that leans on texture and hardware rather than loud graphics to signal the technical upgrade.Underfoot is the clearest departure from a standard Air Force 1. Nike drops the usual outsole in favor of a Vibram unit with a more aggressive traction pattern, aimed at the same slick, cold conditions the upper is built for. Black rubber wraps the outer edges while University Red fills most of the center, and yellow Vibram branding at the midfoot and lateral heel ties back to the GORE-TEX tag up top.Taken together, the changes reframe the AF1 as more than a seasonal colorway. By pairing a waterproof membrane with a purpose-built Vibram sole, Nike positions the "Baroque Brown" pair as a genuine all-weather version of a shoe that usually trades on year-round wearability, giving the silhouette a functional reason to exist in the depths of winter. items.title: Pas Normal Studios' Fall/Winter 2026 Cycling Collections Split the Cold Into Three Riding Mindsets
items.text: Pas Normal Studios' Fall/Winter 2026 Cycling Collections Split the Cold Into Three Riding Mindsets Summary Pas Normal Studios frames its Fall/Winter 2026 season around the idea that riders share the same conditions but train for personal reasonsThree collections cover racing, gravel exploration and relaxed everyday performance, each built on its own technical constructionA seasonal color palette pulls from the textile traditions of mountain communities where craft blends artistry with function Pas Normal Studios has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 cycling collections, uniting Mechanism, Escapism and Essential under a single seasonal narrative titled "Same Season. Different Reasons." The Copenhagen brand treats winter riding as one shared commitment approached through different motivations, then engineers a distinct garment system for each: dedicated racing, gravel adventure and understated daily riding.Mechanism is the race-fit line, and for FW26 it grows into a fuller cold-weather system. The centerpiece Mechanism Thermal Jacket is built from a three-layer fabric with a Windtex Pro membrane, pairing a highly breathable 20,000 g/m²/24h construction with 10,000 mm of water resistance. A DWR treatment and ultrasonically welded, taped seams seal out the elements, while a grid-fleece backer handles wicking and insulation without loosening the close race cut. It runs alongside the Thermal Long Sleeve Jersey 2.0, which uses Polartec Power Shield Pro Knit and Power Grid fabrics, and the new Thermal Long Bibs, giving the collection a range that stretches from mild fall days to deep-winter training in rain or snow.Escapism turns toward gravel and terrain beyond the familiar, and its FW26 expansion leads with a rethink of protective outerwear. The new Escapism Hooded Lightweight Jacket uses a three-layer waterproof, lightweight ripstop, with high-stretch, breathable ripstop panels placed to preserve range of motion. Critically taped seams add protection at the points that matter while keeping weight and pack size down, and the hood is cut to sit under a helmet, with elasticated adjustment and ear inserts for fit. Completing the setup are the new Escapism Long Cargo Bibs, made from a textured, rugged fabric meant to survive rough ground.Essential rounds out the season with a looser read on performance, matching technical function to understated styling for everyday rides. items.title: L’Épée 1839 Transforms a Soccer Ball Into an 8-Day Kinetic Clock Sculpture
items.text: L’Épée 1839 Transforms a Soccer Ball Into an 8-Day Kinetic Clock Sculpture Summary L’Épée 1839 unveils “The Football” kinetic table clock at Geneva Watch Days 2026.Features a 1:1 scale truncated icosahedron design constructed from 882 individual hand-finished components.Houses an 8-day in-house mechanical movement across four finishes limited to 99 pieces each. Unveiled at Geneva Watch Days 2026, “The Football” by L’Épée 1839 marks the Swiss Manufacture's latest kinetic sculpture. Joining the LVMH group, the brand expands its sports-inspired lineup into the world of soccer. The timepiece draws inspiration from the geometry of the truncated icosahedron - specifically the 1962 Telstar satellite and the 1970 Telstar match ball produced by adidas - featuring an architectural layout made of 12 pentagons and 20 hexagons built to a 1:1 scale of an official soccer ball.Comprising 882 individual components, the kinetic sculpture is divided into two interlocking modules that house an 8-day in-house mechanical movement. The openworked skeletal framework reveals its internal gear train and escapement at the base, creating a dynamic visual contrast between traditional haute horlogerie and athletic industrial design. Time is read through rotating discs visible through the geometric cutouts, while the movement is wound via a custom key positioned at the top of the sculpture.L’Épée 1839 offers "The Football" in four distinct surface finishes: full gold-plated, full palladium-plated and two two-tone variants featuring either black or gold numerals. Each finish is strictly limited to 99 pieces, capping total production across the collection at 396 units. Designed for high-end table clock collectors, every individual component undergoes hand-finishing with alternating polished and satin-brushed textures. For more information, head over to L’Épée 1839's official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: How This 88-Year-Old Whisky Inspired Daniel Arsham’s New Artworks
items.text: How This 88-Year-Old Whisky Inspired Daniel Arsham’s New Artworks Daniel Arsham’s latest zen garden performance could be the makings of your great-grandchildren’s favorite whisky. Four dancers move through a circular bed of barley at S50 in Seongsu, Seoul, sweeping, raking, and gliding through the sea of grains in meditative gestures. While this barley likely won’t hit the mill, the “Dawn Of Our Spirit” experience was inspired by traditional whisky-making, culminating in its last act: the reveal of The Balvenie’s 88-year-old Single Scotch Malt.Distilled in 1931 and bottled in 2019 by Malt Master Kelsey McKechnie, The Balvenie’s oldest (and rarest) edition leads its new 1931 Collection. When it came time to debut the bottle during Frieze Seoul, the label tapped Arsham for a sculptural casing and companion performance that embodies its generations-long devotion to craft, technique, and tradition, while also feeling artistically at home.The story behind the bottle begins with Arsham’s first trip to the distillery in Speyside, Scotland, said to be the heart of whisky country. “One of the things that struck me was the handmade quality of everything. It's technical, but very craft in a way, so I pulled out a lot of materials I saw.” Arsham said, sitting across from Hypebeast at The Distiller’s Library inside the Shilla Hotel. “We went through a lot of different processes around the [bottle’s] design,” with several “experimental” mockups behind him. “In the end, the preciousness of that liquid really needs to be considered.”The liquid itself lay in a hand-blown crystal decanter detailed with 18-karat gold gilding, a stopper made from a decommissioned copper still, and a neck taking after the “Balvenie Ball,” the unique still shape which gives the whisky its famed honeyed flavor. Arsham also created the architecture housing the form. Its face features eight fluid layers of hand-patinated copper, evoking textures and hues found throughout the still safe, while 88 thinly layered sections of oak on the back refer to the European oak sherry butt where it was first poured. “It’s the whisky when it’s moving through time,” he explained. “When you look at the sculpture, it's moving through the copper, into the wood, and then into your glass.”Beyond closing the cask of the 88-year-old, 1931 was a defining year for the label, which then opened its Home Malt Floor, still in operation. items.title: norda and Black Diamond Enter a New Era of Alpine Performance
items.text: norda and Black Diamond Enter a New Era of Alpine Performance In an era defined by collaboration, the partnerships that truly resonate feel inevitable. norda and Black Diamond are exactly that: two brands united by a shared obsession with performance, coming together through the all-new norda 000 silhouette to redefine what alpine exploration can look like.norda, the performance footwear brand built on advanced material innovation, and Black Diamond Equipment, a global leader in mountain sports equipment and apparel, have entered a long-term partnership, bringing together their respective expertise in footwear and mountain equipment. Anchored in an all-new set of trail-ready products, the collection draws on both brands' experience to create the highest-quality gear possible, combining advanced technology with decades of mountain expertise.Hypebeast wanted to learn more about the collaboration, speaking with Adam John, norda’s Creative Director, and Dan Rowe, Special Projects and Design Lead at Black Diamond, about how the partnership began and how it ultimately came to life.What sparked the initial ideas for this collaboration — where did this idea come from?Dan Rowe: The origins of this partnership began at the athlete level, with admiration for Joe Grant in the way he chooses to interact with trails. While he has a decorated past in traditional racing, his movement through the mountains has evolved into something more than numbers and data. Following his journey offers a rare lens into the spirit that drives us outside in the first place, and Black Diamond is a rare brand that caters to the spirited yet serious.How did both Norda and Black Diamond’s DNA show up in the design?Adam John: We built this partnership from the ground up—quite literally. Rather than take an existing shoe model and co-brand it, we created a brand-new shoe that dictated the type of movement we wanted the partnership to convey. The result is the norda x Black Diamond 000, a shoe for long days that can handle highly variable and uneven terrain. Black Diamond's equipment followed suit: complementary upgrades to existing and new products that support these kinds of journeys. What are some of the shared philosophies and crossovers between the brands?DR: There was an immediate mutual respect between the two design teams and the way each approaches product, but finding the spirit of the collaboration took time and flowed organically. Both brands share a deep connection to the mountains

items.title: A First Look at the Melitta Baumeister x Nike Rift Rocker
items.text: A First Look at the Melitta Baumeister x Nike Rift Rocker SummaryMelitta Baumeister officially unveiled her latest Nike collaboration at Seoul Art WeekThe heavily modified tabi-toe sneaker features a crackled upper and extra-chunky rocker solesA special viewing experience will be open to the public on September 5 and 6 in Jongno-guMelitta Baumeister has officially unveiled her latest footwear collaboration with Nike, debuting the Nike Rift Rocker, at Seoul Art Week. Following up on her distinct spins on the Nike Vomero Premium and Nike Pegasus Premium, the NYC designer is now bringing her signature surreal, amorphous aesthetic to the beloved tabi-toe sneaker.Designed to turn heads, the NikeRift Rocker demands immediate attention with its heavily modified, extra-chunky rocker soles, complete with a debossed Nike Swoosh. On the uppers, the silhouette sports a crackled finish that introduces a raw, tactile texture to the split-toe classic. True to Baumeister’s whimsical and avant-garde approach to garment design, the sneaker design is rounded off with a playful pair of eyes staring out directly from the back heels. Further, Melitta Baumeister branding is also emblazoned on the Velcro strap, while both the heel strap and midsole boast cursive Nike wordmarks.The physical debut is anchored by a special NIKELAB SEOUL installation taking place on September 5 and 6, giving attendees a first-hand look at the designer's latest conceptual footwear drop. items.title: Christie's Next Show is for a New Generation of Design Collectors
items.text: Christie's Next Show is for a New Generation of Design Collectors Basic.Space is taking over Christie's Beverly Hills with an exhibition of 50 chairs, which gathers design classics alongside contemporary pieces.Named "50 Chairs at Christie's", the pieces have been curated by Basic.Space and will feature works created by, and also owned by, famed designers. For Basic.Space founder Jesse Lee, the event is designed to cater to the "next generation of collectors", pairing cult favourites such as Gufram's huge Pratone lounge chair with classics like Charles and Ray Eames' LCW in a rare calfskin edition. "Discovery has always been at the heart of Basic.Space and our ecosystem of designers, artists and creatives," says Lee, who founded the platform in 2020 and has spent recent years making his way into the field through IRL experiences and the acquisition of industry tentpole Design Miami. "We are redefining luxury for the next generation of collectors. 50 Chairs at Christie’s is an expression of that ethos - showcasing iconic works from the past alongside original pieces from the voices shaping the future of design."On the more historical end of the spectrum, a hammered-brass chair by Philippe Hiquily made in the 1970s has been put forwards by Kelly Wearstler, and comedian, filmmaker and design collector Eric Wareheim is parting with Joe Colombo's molded-fiberglass Elda Chair from 1963. Los Angeles furniture designer BASA is contributing Gufram's oversized Pratone lounge chair, and collectors Giampiero Tagliaferri and Adrien Dewulf have supplied a CL9 ribbon chair.The contemporary side leans more on pieces from collectible design galleries. Carpenters Workshop Gallery is bringing Rick Owens' Stag Stool, a limited edition in black plywood and natural moose antler, and The Future Perfect has supplied Seoul-based SeungJin Yang's Lounge Chair 01 – Transparent Blue, formed from balloons and resin. Sam Klemick's Trumpet Dining Chair works the fluidity of textiles into solid wood, while Los Angeles furniture and decorative arts dealer JF Chen is contributing pieces by multidisciplinary artist and audiophile Devon Turnbull, California sculptor Vince Skelly and London-based Max Lamb.50 Chairs at Christie's runs September 25 to 30, 2026, at Christie's Beverly Hills, 336 North Camden Drive, Beverly Hills, CA 90210, with a VIP preview taking place on September 24. The pieces will be sold via the Basic.Space platform throughout. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Kith Celebrates the 1996 Yankees With Collectibles and Home Goods Summary Kith marks the 30th anniversary of the Yankees’ 1996 World Series victory.The collection includes a teddy bear, caps, collectible baseballs, a planter and rugs.Campaign imagery lists a September 7 release. Kith is marking 30 years since the New York Yankees’ 1996 World Series victory with a collection of accessories and lifestyle goods. Previewed by Ronnie Fieg, the latest Monday Program release brings the team’s familiar insignia to everything from collectible baseballs to a miniature uniform-wearing teddy bear.The bear is one of the standout pieces, dressed in a dark New York jersey and navy Yankees cap while holding a bat and baseball. Headwear takes a broader approach to the team palette, with stacked caps shown in green, burgundy, purple and darker shades. A cream-colored cap carries an embroidered American League East champions graphic, adding another archival baseball reference to the assortment.The commemorative baseballs combine Yankees and Kith branding with a 1996 World Series emblem and “New York to the World” lettering. Smaller accessories include baseball-shaped keychains in several colors and a string of miniature team pennants. A Yankees-logo planter extends the collection into the home.Fieg also highlighted the rugs, which place the interlocking NY insignia and Kith wordmark inside ornate floral borders. Shown with navy and burgundy surrounds, the designs bring a different scale to the collaboration’s home goods offering.The campaign imagery lists September 7 as the release date for Kith for the New York Yankees. items.title: Economist Explains Why 'GTA VI' Could Drive Launch-Day Absences
items.text: Economist Explains Why 'GTA VI' Could Drive Launch-Day Absences Summary Economist José García Montalvo discussed potential GTA VI launch-day absences with Cadena SER.The circulating 1.5 million figure remains unverified.Rockstar Games lists the launch date as November 19, 2026. Grand Theft Auto VI could disrupt workplaces when it launches, according to economist José García Montalvo’s comments in a July 2025 interview with Cadena SER.The Pompeu Fabra University professor identified young men and technology workers as particularly likely to stay home, noting that remote work can make it easier to spend time gaming.The widely circulated claim that 1.5 million Americans will take release day off remains unverified. Cadena SER’s written report does not establish that number as Montalvo’s estimate or link to a study supporting it. It should not be read as a confirmed count of workers who have booked leave.Rockstar Games currently lists November 19, 2026 as the release date for Grand Theft Auto VI. Set in the fictional state of Leonida, the game follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos through a criminal conspiracy that takes them across Vice City and beyond. items.title: Hiroshi Fujiwara Announces Second Term of FRAGMENT UNIVERSITY
items.text: Hiroshi Fujiwara Announces Second Term of FRAGMENT UNIVERSITY Summary Hiroshi Fujiwara has officially opened applications for the second term of FRAGMENT UNIVERSITY starting in November 2026The nine-part in-person lecture series features guest faculty covering non-traditional perspectives from music theory to human natureProspective students must submit their application and motivation statement by September 28, 2026 Hiroshi Fujiwara has officially announced the second term of FRAGMENT UNIVERSITY, opening applications for its upcoming session starting in November 2026. Supervised directly by the street culture pioneer, the nine-part educational initiative invites visiting professors from various fields to teach subjective perspectives and non-general knowledge.Conceived as a six-month learning program rather than a traditional academic institution, the second term features a specialized faculty roster. Lecture subjects include Ryohei Kamide on "Outsider theory," Yusuke Nakagawa exploring "anti-establishment theory," Keisuke Nakamura discussing "Possession theory," Noritoshi Furuichi covering "Human nature," Bose presenting "Contemporary Music Theory," Jane Su on "Verbalization 'different' theory," and Matsunuma Rei examining "co-creation theory."All nine sessions will be held strictly in person with no online streaming provided. Admission requires a pre-selection process where applicants must submit their purpose and motivation via an entry form alongside registering for a free Shueisha ID. Graduates from the first class receive automatic application approval upon submission before the deadline. Following the conclusion of the lectures, the curriculum content is scheduled to be published as a book after late 2027.Applications for FRAGMENT UNIVERSITY's second term close on September 28, 2026, at 23:59 JST, with selection results and enrollment details released starting October 19 ahead of the November 13 start date. items.title: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Extends Historic IMAX 70mm Run
items.text: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Extends Historic IMAX 70mm Run Summary Universal Pictures and Christopher Nolan have extended IMAX 70mm screenings for 'The Odyssey' through the end of September 2026The film has accumulated $1.55 billion USD globally becoming Christopher Nolan's highest-grossing movie of all timeShot entirely with IMAX cameras the blockbuster stands as the highest-grossing R-rated film in box office history Universal Pictures and director Christopher Nolan have officially extended the theatrical IMAX 70mm run for The Odyssey through the end of September 2026. The extension stretches the cinematic epic into an 11th week across select screens globally.As the first theatrical feature shot entirely with IMAX cameras, The Odyssey has set a record as the highest-grossing IMAX release of all time, generating $457 million USD across IMAX screens worldwide. Nolan’s preferred format, IMAX 70mm, has generated $66 million USD globally with a $1.6 million USD per-screen average. Supported by an average ticket price of $20.58 USD, the film helped drive July and August to the two highest-grossing months in IMAX history.Currently standing as the second highest-grossing film of the year at $1.55 billion USD —behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day—the adaptation of Homer’s epic poem stars Matt Damon as Odysseus alongside Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, and Samantha Morton as Circe. The film also marks the highest-grossing R-rated movie in box office history and the top-grossing global release for Nolan, Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway, and Robert Pattinson.The Odyssey is currently screening in IMAX 70mm at select locations through the end of September 2026. items.text: Garage Italia and Hot Lab Transform the Fiat 500 Jolly Into a Superyacht Toy Summary Garage Italia and Hot Lab have collaborated on a custom Fiat 500 Jolly Spiaggina concept inspired by vintage speedboatsThe build incorporates a two-tone hull livery alongside marine-grade deck flooring and a custom wavy outdoor fabric produced by MariafloraConceived as a luxury land tender for superyacht owners the production-ready vehicle is available upon request Garage Italia and Hot Lab have officially unveiled their latest collaborative concept, the Fiat 500 Jolly "Spiaggina". The custom automotive project reimagines the classic open-air Fiat 500 as a luxury land tender inspired by vintage 1950s speedboats.The custom build introduces a two-tone livery—finished with white on top and blue on the bottom—designed to mimic the visual break between a yacht's hull and the waterline. That nautical color story extends to the canopy and seats, which are wrapped in "Scia," a new indoor-outdoor fabric designed by Garage Italia and produced by Mariaflora. The weave updates classic stripes with a wavy pattern resembling a boat's wake on water.At the center of the cabin sits a wooden "Heritage Tunnel" that can be customized with either a magazine rack or a wine bottle holder, paired with a wooden Nardi Classic steering wheel. Underfoot, blue-and-white floor mats by Italdek utilize marine-grade material designed to resemble wood boat decking, anchored by side ropes featuring traditional nautical knots.The Fiat 500 Jolly "Spiaggina" Concept is currently ready for production and available upon request through Hot Lab. Set in Great Depression-era New York, the plot followed Cage as a down-on-his-luck private investigator forced to grapple with his past life as a superhero. The ensemble cast also featured Lamorne Morris, Li Jun Li, Karen Rodriguez, Abraham Popoola, Jack Huston, and Brendan Gleeson.Spider-Noir served as the debut project under Amazon’s development deal with Sony Pictures Television to adapt characters from the Sony Pictures Universe of Marvel Characters. items.title: Kojima Productions Announces "BEYOND THE STRAND" 10th Anniversary Exhibition
items.text: Kojima Productions Announces "BEYOND THE STRAND" 10th Anniversary Exhibition Summary Kojima Productions will commemorate its 10th anniversary with an exhibition running from October 31 to December 20 2026 at Tokyo's Azabudai Hills GalleryThe event features unreleased development archives, a studio recreation space with a 10th-anniversary Ludens statue, and a 360-degree video installationTickets go on sale starting September 11 2026 via Lawson Ticket with limited packages offering signed art reproductions or a collaboration watch Kojima Productions has officially detailed its upcoming 10th-anniversary exhibition, titled KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS 10th ANNIVERSARY EXHIBITION BEYOND THE STRAND: The Odyssey of Creation and Endeavor. Set to take place at Tokyo's Azabudai Hills Gallery from October 31 to December 20, 2026, the retrospective documents the creative studio's decade-long journey across video games, film, and visual art.Supervised by game creator Hideo Kojima, the showcase is structured across four distinct thematic zones. "Retracing the Steps" chronicles the studio’s history from its 2015 founding through titles such as DEATH STRANDING, DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH, OD, PHYSINTTickets officially go on sale September 11, 2026, via Lawson Ticket, with advance admission priced at ¥2,600 JPY (¥2,800 JPY same-day) alongside limited 300-unit premium packages for ¥57,600 JPY containing an autographed drawing reproduction or an exhibition-exclusive collaboration watch., and its film project alongside A24. "Behind the Scenes" displays rare, unreleased archives for the first time, including preliminary concept art, design proposals, development documents, and developer interviews detailing the studio's trial-and-error process.To provide an immersive look into the development environment, a physical studio recreation space features character statues shown for the first time alongside a 10th-anniversary edition of the studio mascot, LUDENS. The exhibition concludes with an audiovisual installation projecting dynamic visuals across a massive 360-degree screen. Check out the official website for more information here. items.text: Ben Simmons Returns to NBA With One-Year Contract With Sacramento Kings Summary Ben Simmons has agreed to a one-year $3.5 million USD contract with the Sacramento Kings after missing the 2025-26 seasonThe 30-year-old former All-Star completed medical exams and an on-court workout with Kings staff in SacramentoSimmons is expected to serve as a backup point guard while providing versatility across positions one through five The Sacramento Kings have agreed to a one-year, $3.5 million USD contract with Ben Simmons. The deal marks the three-time NBA All-Star's return to the league after sitting out the 2025-26 season to rehabilitate lingering back and leg injuries.Prior to finalizing the agreement, the 6-foot-10 guard impressed Kings general manager Scott Perry during a private workout in Miami, later traveling to Sacramento for comprehensive medical evaluations and on-court drills with head coach Doug Christie. Simmons previously demonstrated his health during an August minicamp with the Australia men's national team, drawing additional interest from the Minnesota Timberwolves and Golden State Warriors.The Kings intend to utilize Simmons as a primary backup point guard for rookie Darius Acuff Jr., leveraging his ability to defend and play positions 1 through 5. Selected first overall in the 2016 NBA draft, Simmons holds career averages of 13.1 points, 7.4 rebounds, and 7.2 assists across 383 regular-season games with the Philadelphia 76ers, Brooklyn Nets, and LA Clippers.Simmons officially joins the Sacramento Kings roster ahead of the 2026-27 NBA season. items.title: Why Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari F40 Arrival Is an Automotive Milestone and Every Collector's Dream
items.text: Why Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari F40 Arrival Is an Automotive Milestone and Every Collector's Dream Summary Lewis Hamilton arrived at the Italian Grand Prix driving an ultra-rare European-market Ferrari F40 with just 69 kilometers on the odometerFerrari Classiche mechanics discovered engine number 44 stamped inside the vehicle during a complete factory restoration in MaranelloThe arrival marks a milestone moment for automotive culture as Hamilton paired the iconic supercar with custom old-school tailoring Lewis Hamilton created a landmark moment for automotive culture at the 2026 Italian Grand Prix, pulling into Monza behind the wheel of every car collector's ultimate dream: an ultra-rare Ferrari F40. Having previously sold off the majority of his private vehicle collection, the seven-time Formula 1 world champion acquired the pristine European-market supercar after finding an example that sat untouched for over three decades with its passenger door never opened.Preserving its original thin factory red paint—where the underlying carbon fiber and Kevlar weave remains visible—Hamilton sent the vehicle to Ferrari’s Maranello Classiche department for a mechanical restoration. During the teardown, factory mechanics uncovered a fateful detail: the engine block was stamped with number 44, matching Hamilton’s signature Formula 1 racing number.Delivering a scene reminiscent of classic Italian cinema, Hamilton stepped out of the non-air-conditioned supercar wearing a custom black suit, tie, beret, leather briefcase, and long camel coat despite 90-degree temperatures at the circuit. The orchestrated entrance represents an unprecedented crossover between Formula 1 heritage, high-end car collecting, and personal style.Hamilton's F40 arrival at Scuderia Ferrari's home race sets a new benchmark for car culture, celebrating both Enzo Ferrari’s final approved road car and a legendary moment in motorsport history. Take a look at the reveal that Hamilton posted on Instagram in a recreation of the iconic Akira poster with his newly restored Ferrari F40. items.title: Nike To Leave the S&P 100 on September 21
items.text: Nike To Leave the S&P 100 on September 21 Nike is set to leave the S&P 100 before U.S. trading opens on September 21, 2026, according to S&P Dow Jones Indices. The change was announced on September 4 as part of the index provider’s quarterly rebalance.The sportswear company joins Honeywell Aerospace, Simon Property Group and Colgate-Palmolive on the list of S&P 100 departures. Dell Technologies, Palo Alto Networks, Arista Networks and Sandisk will enter the index.What Does Nike’s S&P 100 Removal Mean?The S&P 100 tracks 100 major U.S. companies across several industries and is a subset of the broader S&P 500. S&P says the rebalance is intended to keep its indices representative of their respective market-capitalization ranges, which refer to companies’ stock-market values.The announcement does not name Nike among the S&P 500 deletions. This is a change to index membership, not an announcement that Nike’s shares will stop trading. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: CHANGBIN x AUTRY Collection Launch Event Brings a Pink Paradise to Seoul
items.text: CHANGBIN x AUTRY Collection Launch Event Brings a Pink Paradise to Seoul Autry and K-pop artist Changbin are making their partnership official with the release of a new capsule collection. Co-designed by the Stray Kids member, the collaborative drop, featuring two reimagined sneaker silhouettes and a lineup of streetwear staples, sets out to commemorate his arrival at the brand as its first-ever global ambassador. In an official statement, Changbin recently shared, “Designing this capsule with Autry was an exciting journey. It gave me the opportunity to bring my personality and point of view to the brand’s iconic sneakers and apparel. Both reflect strength and playfulness — the balance that defines me as an artist. Autry’s timeless style gave me the perfect canvas to share part of my world through fashion in a meaningful and personal way.”Celebrating the meeting of two identities, Autry went on to host a special launch event in Seoul, Korea earlier this week. The occasion welcomed friends of the brand and others from the region’s creative scene to a pink-emblazoned venue in the Seongsu district that boldly co-ordinated with the collection's dedicated motifs and accent tones. The vibrant and joyful theme flowed from the outside into the interiors. On walls, soft blush lights shone down on posters of the CHANGBIN x AUTRY branding while vending machines and rails were stacked with pieces from the collaboration. In a more sculptural segment, the remodelled Medalist and Hyperway sneakers were raised on pink blocks and 3-D models of the DWAEKKI tail symbol, complementing the graphic detailing on the sneaker designs. Making the event more than a showcase, but a multi-sensory experience, the space was peppered with photo booths, candy stations and platters stacked with rose-tinted gelato and pink pasta. Each element, particularly the refreshments, provided a direct tribute to the partnership with Autry’s Italian heritage coming through in a uniquely K-pop style. As a live DJ set played, guests immersed themselves in the activations before leaving with a limited-edition collector’s item made specially for the launch night. If you missed out, explore the event in the gallery above. The CHANGBIN x AUTRY capsule collection is now available to shop online and in global flagship stores. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week
items.text: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week Summary Palace Skateboards has detailed its Fall 2026 Week 6 drop, spanning outerwear, denim, a trucker jacket and a graphic teeThe lineup foregrounds specific fabrics, from a 10 oz hooded canvas jacket to a Polartec-lined Legacy Jacket Palace Skateboards has laid out the sixth weekly installment of its Fall 2026 season, a five-piece drop that puts its material choices front and center. The release runs from heavyweight canvas outerwear through technical fabrics and worked denim, giving each piece a distinct construction story rather than relying on graphics alone.The outerwear splits between raw material weight and technical performance. Anchoring the drop is a 10 oz Hooded Canvas Jacket, whose stated fabric weight signals a sturdy, structured build, offered in Black, Brown and Navy Blue. Running alongside it, the Polartec Legacy Jacket swaps canvas for a named technical fabric associated with warmth and insulation, arriving in Black and Racey Green for a more performance-minded option within the same release.Denim and the trucker bring the worked-fabric details. The Legacy P90 Jean comes in Black, Indigo and a Woodland Camo treatment, spanning a clean wash, a classic indigo and a patterned option in a single silhouette. The OM Distressed Trucker leans into finishing rather than fabric novelty, with a distressed treatment across Black, Realtree Edge and White that includes a licensed camo pattern among its colorways.The graphic piece keeps the range grounded in everyday staples. The Cat Face T-shirt rounds out the drop with the widest color spread of the five, offered in Black, White, Chalky Green and Grey Marl, giving the release an accessible entry point beneath the heavier outerwear and denim.Taken together, the five pieces read as a deliberately material-led drop, pairing raw canvas and technical fabric up top with camo-inflected denim and a distressed trucker below, each carried across several colorways to widen the options within a compact release.The Palace Skateboards Fall 2026 Week 6 drop launches Friday, September 11 at 11:00 a.m. BST across the UK, Europe and US, followed by Saturday, September 12 at 11:00 a.m. local time in Japan, China, Korea and Australia.
