items.title: A.PRESSE and Supreme Build a Fall 2026 Collection on Calfskin, Silk-Cotton Suiting and Hand-Applied Camo
items.text: A.PRESSE and Supreme Build a Fall 2026 Collection on Calfskin, Silk-Cotton Suiting and Hand-Applied Camo Summary Supreme has partnered with Japanese brand A.PRESSE on a Fall 2026 collection spanning leather outerwear, tailoring, knitwear and accessoriesThe lineup leans on custom-developed fabrics, including a cotton-silk suit, a David & John Anderson Oxford shirt and hand-applied camo on the M-65 and Cargo PantThe pieces were produced by A.PRESSE across Japan, Portugal and the USA with custom fits built collaboratively Supreme and A.PRESSE have unveiled a Fall 2026 collection that channels the Japanese label's fabric-first, heritage-minded approach across a full run of apparel and accessories. The collaboration threads A.PRESSE's custom-developed materials and vintage finishing through leather jackets, tailoring, workwear staples and hardware, each piece cut to fits the two brands developed together.The materials do much of the talking here, in keeping with A.PRESSE's reputation. The label, founded by Kazuma Shigematsu in 2021, built its name on reinterpreting workwear, military and tailored archetypes through meticulously sourced fabrics and vintage finishing techniques, and the collaboration puts that sensibility front and center. Rather than leaning on graphics, the collection foregrounds construction and cloth as its main points of interest.The outerwear anchors the range in leather and military reference. A Leather Jacket arrives in two distinct hides, one in calfskin and one in cowhide, offering different weights and hands within the same silhouette. Alongside it, the M-65 and Cargo Pant both carry a hand-applied camo pattern, a labor-intensive finishing choice that ties the pieces to A.PRESSE's vintage-treatment approach while nodding to the military lineage that informs the brand.Tailoring and shirting extend the fabric story. The Suit is cut from a cotton-silk blend that balances structure with a softer drape, while the Shirt uses a David & John Anderson cotton pin Oxford, a nod to premium British-milled cloth. The Vintage Zip Up Hooded Sweatshirt adds a cotton waffle thermal lining for texture and warmth, and a Tee brings in original photography by Ari Marcopoulos, folding an art-world collaborator into the otherwise material-led lineup.Accessories round the collection out and stretch it into hardware. items.title: The Nike First Sight Shadow Closes the Trilogy With Sculptural Slip-On Build in "Light Crimson/Metallic Silver"
items.text: The Nike First Sight Shadow Closes the Trilogy With Sculptural Slip-On Build in "Light Crimson/Metallic Silver" Name: Nike First Sight Shadow “Light Crimson and Metallic Silver”Colorway: Light Crimson/Metallic SilverSKU: HQ2410-600MSRP: $145 USDRelease Date: September 15Where to Buy: NikeNike has unveiled the Women's First Sight Shadow in a "Light Crimson and Metallic Silver" colorway, positioning the model as the closing chapter of the brand's First Sight collection. The Shadow arrives as a slip-on silhouette that pulls its cues from early-2000s design while grounding itself in Nike's basketball lineage.Construction is where the Shadow makes its case. The model is built as a futuristic slip-on, doing away with traditional lacing in favor of an easy step-in entry, and it is topped by a sculptural upper that gives the shoe its molded, forward-leaning shape. That upper is the defining visual element, prioritizing a bold, contoured profile over conventional paneling.Underfoot, the traction is purpose-built rather than borrowed. Nike finishes the Shadow with a bespoke, court-inspired outsole pattern, tying the silhouette's grip back to the basketball reference points that inform the wider collection. It is a functional nod that keeps the design connected to performance roots even as the overall shape reads as street-focused.The design language traces directly to the early 2000s. The Shadow draws on the silhouettes of that era and filters them through Nike basketball DNA, translating a specific moment in the brand's hoops history into a contemporary, slip-on form. That lineage is what separates the model from a purely futuristic exercise, anchoring its forward-looking build in a recognizable design heritage.Within the First Sight lineup, the Shadow carries a specific role. Nike frames the collection as an effort to push athletic style into new territory, and the Shadow completes that three-model arc, presented as the piece that rounds out the trilogy. The "Light Crimson and Metallic Silver" treatment gives that closing entry a high-contrast finish to match its sculptural form. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: BUNNEY's Teddy Bear T-Shirt Carries Josh Hight's Black-and-White Bear Studies Summary BUNNEY has released the Teddy Bear T-Shirt, printed with a series of black-and-white studies of stuffed bears by Josh HightThe piece is made from 100% cotton and offered across a full S to XL size runThe imagery is framed by the line "What will survive of us is love," pairing childhood nostalgia with the brand's jewellery BUNNEY has introduced the Teddy Bear T-Shirt, a 100% cotton piece built around a series of intimate black-and-white photographs by Josh Hight. The construction keeps things deliberately spare, using a straightforward cotton build as the canvas for the tee's photographic subject matter.The shirt is cut from 100% cotton, a single-material construction that keeps the garment uncomplicated and lets the print carry the design. Rather than layering in technical treatments or blended fibres, BUNNEY leans on a clean cotton base as the surface for its imagery.The print itself is what the construction is built to showcase. Hight's black-and-white studies capture a collection of stuffed bears drawn from shared childhood familiarity, at times playful and at times openly sentimental, their worn surfaces suggesting years of being held and carried. Set alongside BUNNEY's jewellery and framed by the line "What will survive of us is love," the imagery gives the simple cotton piece its emotional weight.The Teddy Bear T-Shirt is available now via BUNNEY. items.title: Etro Leads the Birkenstock Boston and Gizeh With Paisley Outsoles and Pegaso Rivets
items.text: Etro Leads the Birkenstock Boston and Gizeh With Paisley Outsoles and Pegaso Rivets Name: Etro x Birkenstock Boston, Etro x Birkenstock GizehColorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: September 10Where to Buy: Birkenstock, EtroBirkenstock and Etro have released their collaborative footwear, opening with the Boston and the Gizeh as the first pairs in the partnership. The two styles graft Etro's decorative language onto Birkenstock's most recognizable silhouettes while leaving the brand's core footbed engineering intact.The ornamentation is where the collaboration concentrates its detailing. Both silhouettes are worked with a paisley motif and dense material treatments, then dressed with embroidered accents and long fringe for movement and texture. A Western-inspired buckle reshapes the closure hardware away from Birkenstock's standard fittings, while special rivets carry Etro's Pegaso emblem, embedding the house's identity into the functional hardware rather than only the surface.Underneath the decoration, the construction stays true to Birkenstock. Each style is built on the brand's anatomically shaped cork-latex footbed, the contoured base that defines how a Birkenstock sits and supports the foot. It anchors the collaboration's more expressive upper work to a familiar, function-first foundation, keeping the pairs recognizable as the Boston and Gizeh beneath the styling.The outsole is where both brands meet in a single component. Birkenstock's signature bone-pattern tread is retained for grip and identity, then overlaid with Etro's paisley motif, so the underfoot surface reads as a merger of the two design vocabularies. It turns a purely functional part of the shoe into another site for the co-branding.Positioned as the opening chapter of the tie-up, the Boston and Gizeh set the template for what the brands frame as a first drop, suggesting the collaboration is built to extend beyond these two styles. items.title: Anbernic Reveals the RG DS Plus, a Dual-Screen Handheld Built for Nintendo DS Emulation Under $100 USD
items.text: Anbernic Reveals the RG DS Plus, a Dual-Screen Handheld Built for Nintendo DS Emulation Under $100 USD Summary Anbernic expands its retro gaming lineup with a larger dual-screen handheld engineered for authentic Nintendo DS emulationThe device transitions to a Linux operating system powered by the new NNDSS emulator featuring robust touch and microphone integrationHardware updates include an integrated capacitive stylus, a stepless dual alloy hinge and a strategic RAM adjustment to support GammaOS Shenzhen-based hardware manufacturer Anbernic officially announced the Anbernic RG DS Plus, a dual-screen handheld gaming console inspired by the classic Nintendo DS. Arriving with a footprint larger than the original non-Plus model, this updated release is tailored for emulation. The device natively integrates a dual-screen setup alongside an integrated capacitive stylus and a built-in microphone to cater to the retro gaming community. This approach bridges a physical gap in portable emulation by addressing the hardware requirements necessary for legacy Nintendo DS titles.Front and center on the Anbernic RG DS Plus are its twin displays. Both screens measure 4.3 inches and deliver a 1024×768 resolution backed by 4x pixel-perfect scaling. The lower second display operates using a touch-based interface for the included stylus. Connecting these two panels is an upgraded dual alloy hinge. Built for a long lifespan, this hinge mechanism allows for stepless positioning to ensure optimal viewing angles. Physical inputs include four digital shoulder buttons and an analog stick. The handheld is also equipped with dual USB-C ports, dual microSD card slots, a headphone jack and front-facing speakers.A Linux operating system powers the handheld, shifting away from the Android OS used on its predecessor. This software foundation relies on a newly developed dual-screen emulator called NNDSS. The NNDSS emulator natively supports microphone input, allowing players to use the built-in mic for gameplay mechanics. Specialized software delivers screen swapping, an instant save feature and a real-time clock. Players can also customize visual output by cycling through 76 built-in shader options.Internal architecture makes trade-offs to balance community-driven software with affordability. items.title: Neil Druckmann Confirms Multiple New 'The Last of Us' Projects Are in Development at Naughty Dog
items.text: Neil Druckmann Confirms Multiple New 'The Last of Us' Projects Are in Development at Naughty Dog Summary Neil Druckmann confirmed that Naughty Dog has stepped away from the creative direction of HBO's adaptation of "The Last of Us"The acclaimed studio maintains stewardship of the hit franchise with multiple undisclosed gaming projects actively in the worksDruckmann is currently focused on co-directing and co-writing a new title called "Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet" Speaking recently to the Washington Post, Neil Druckmann set the record straight on where Naughty Dog stands with the hit television adaptation of its flagship property. While the game director previously served as the co-creator and co-showrunner of the HBO series alongside Craig Mazin, Druckmann formally announced his departure from the television show in 2025. He confirmed that both he and the studio were uninvolved in shaping the creative direction for the upcoming season of The Last of Us, which is scheduled to return to screens in 2027.Stepping back from the television spotlight does not mean the studio is abandoning the property. Druckmann affirmed the developer's continued ownership of the franchise, stating that as the creator of the games, Naughty Dog remains the steward of the IP. Driving the point home to fans, Druckmann guaranteed the franchise's continuation by declaring that while this adaptation might end, the team is not done with the series. He teased that the studio currently has a couple projects in the works that he remains excited to discuss when the time is right.While those mystery titles develop in secrecy, the studio is pushing boundaries on its upcoming slate. Druckmann and Naughty Dog are currently deep into active development on a brand-new project titled Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet. Bringing his focus back to the native gaming medium, Druckmann is serving a dual role by co-directing and co-writing the new title.This internal focus marks a pivot for the developer after Naughty Dog previously canceled a massive and highly anticipated multiplayer project set within the franchise universe. Druckmann had hinted that a third game in the franchise was in the works. Now, with a new console generation looming and the television show boosting popularity, the studio is positioned to capitalize on the renewed cultural demand for its signature prestige single-player entries. items.title: The Italian State Police Just Got a 907 HP Lamborghini Temerario Built for Emergency Organ Deliveries
items.text: The Italian State Police Just Got a 907 HP Lamborghini Temerario Built for Emergency Organ Deliveries Summary Lamborghini unveiled a specialized 907-hp hybrid vehicle designed specifically for the Italian State PoliceThe high-performance patrol car will be deployed to transport critical medical supplies and organs during emergenciesThe model continues a two-decade initiative that has successfully delivered over 200 organs since launching in 2004 When emergency medical runs demand hypercar-level urgency, law enforcement officers now have a new ultimate responder in their arsenal. Lamborghini has officially introduced the Lamborghini Temerario Polizia, a highly customized, high-performance vehicle created specifically for the Italian State Police. The Italian State Police will use the vehicle, which was engineered to conquer the relentless pressure of time-sensitive operations, exclusively to transport organs and critical medical supplies in high-stakes emergencies. To ensure these vital deliveries reach their destinations before time out, the specialized patrol car relies on staggering performance metrics. Pushing the limits of high-speed response, the Temerario Polizia can accelerate from 0-62 mph (0-100 km/h) in a blistering 2.7 seconds. The vehicle ultimately reaches a maximum top speed of 213 mph (343 km/h), transforming open stretches of highway into high-velocity medical corridors.That blistering pace is generated by a radically advanced plug-in hybrid powertrain engineered for maximum forward thrust. At the core of the vehicle sits a heavily armed twin-turbo 4.0-liter V8 engine, which operates in seamless tandem with three electric motors to lay down massive power. This complex hybrid setup utilizes an aggressive eight-speed dual-clutch transmission, routing energy alongside a 3.8 kWh battery pack. Such performance metrics elevate the technical capabilities available to modern law enforcement. Combining these components, the advanced system delivers a devastating combined output of 907 hp (677 kW / 920 PS). Adding to that sheer aggressive force, the car produces an equally massive 538 lb-ft (730 Nm) of torque, guaranteeing that the vehicle maintains relentless pace when carrying life-saving cargo.Visually, the vehicle seamlessly merges exotic automotive design with authoritative official duty. items.title: Kimi Antonelli Wins His Home Italian Grand Prix, the First Italian Victor at Monza in 60 Years
items.text: Kimi Antonelli Wins His Home Italian Grand Prix, the First Italian Victor at Monza in 60 Years Summary Kimi Antonelli started the Italian Grand Prix 19th after taking new power unit components, then charged through the field to win on home soil at MonzaHis victory made him the first Italian driver to win the Italian Grand Prix since Ludovico Scarfiotti in 1966The result marked his seventh win of the season and moved him 66 points clear of teammate George Russell in the drivers' standings Kimi Antonelli won the Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid, completing one of the great modern comeback drives on home soil at Monza. The Mercedes driver reeled in and passed teammate and title rival George Russell in the closing laps of the 53-lap race, becoming the first Italian to win his home Grand Prix in six decades.A first win at Monza had looked improbable for Antonelli before the race, with a grid penalty for new power unit components leaving him 19th while Russell lined up near the front. The tone shifted early when Charles Leclerc crashed heavily at the final corner on the second lap, bringing out a red flag. By that point Antonelli had already climbed to 12th, and he sliced through the order at the restart to put himself in contention for the lead.The decisive strategic moment came later, when a mid-race Virtual Safety Car allowed Mercedes to bring Antonelli into the pits for fresher rubber while Russell stayed out. Russell's tyres faded over the closing laps, and Antonelli used his pace advantage to hunt his teammate down. The chase nearly ended in disaster when the pair almost touched at the first chicane and Antonelli ran across the gravel, but he gathered it up and completed the move on the run to Ascari with four laps left."Unbelievable, I'm so happy and I could never have imagined to be here today but we managed to pull it off and I'm really happy," Antonelli said immediately after the race, adding that it felt like "a dream coming true." He also recounted the near miss that almost cost him the win, saying, "I thought I could still do the corner but once I went over a bit of gravel I went straight, and I was like maybe I've lost my chance, but then luckily we still had the pace and managed to bring it home."The historical weight of the result is considerable. items.title: Bad Bunny's Super Bowl Halftime Show Makes a Historic Seven Emmy Sweep
items.text: Bad Bunny's Super Bowl Halftime Show Makes a Historic Seven Emmy Sweep Summary The Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show Starring Bad Bunny took every category it was nominated for at Emmys Night 1, formerly the Creative Arts EmmysIts win for Outstanding Variety Special (Live) made it only the second halftime show ever to claim the top program prize and the first Spanish-language program to do soThe victory caps a landmark year that also saw Debí Tirar Más Fotos become the first Spanish-language album to win the GRAMMY for Album of the Year Bad Bunny's Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show has become the most awarded Super Bowl performance in Emmy history, sweeping all seven categories it was nominated for at the 2026 Creative Emmy Awards. The wins hand the Puerto Rican superstar his first Emmy and cement a 13-minute set as one of the most decorated live productions of the season.The sweep was built on craft as much as star power. Alongside the top prize for Outstanding Variety Special (Live), the show collected trophies for directing, music direction, choreography, sound mixing, lighting design, technical direction and camerawork, a spread of wins that reads like a full accounting of everything that goes into staging a halftime show. Each category rewarded a different discipline behind the performance, which threaded Puerto Rican imagery and Latin music through guest turns from Lady Gaga and Ricky Martin.The Outstanding Variety Special (Live) win carries the most weight historically. It marks only the second time a Super Bowl halftime show has taken the category's top program prize, following the 2022 performance that united Dr. Dre, Snoop Dogg, Mary J. Blige, Eminem, Kendrick Lamar and 50 Cent. More significantly, it is the first Spanish-language program to win the award, a distinction that mirrors the barrier-breaking arc Bad Bunny has been on for the better part of a year.The Emmy arrives seven months after Debí Tirar Más Fotos (I Should Have Taken More Photos) became the first Spanish-language album to win the GRAMMY for Album of the Year, stacking two of the industry's highest honors within a single historic run. The through line is a body of work that has kept pushing Spanish-language art into spaces it had never occupied.The performance itself was framed by the message Bad Bunny delivered from the stage. items.title: Crocs' 2026 Horror Pack Loads Two Classic Clogs With ‘Halloween’ and ‘Saw’ Props and Blood Splatter
items.text: Crocs' 2026 Horror Pack Loads Two Classic Clogs With ‘Halloween’ and ‘Saw’ Props and Blood Splatter Name: ‘Halloween’ x Crocs Classic Clog “Michael Myers”, ‘Saw’ x Crocs Classic Clog “Jigsaw”Colorway: MultiSKU: 213831-90H, 213832-90HMSRP: $70 USDRelease Date: September 24Where to Buy: CrocsCrocs is bringing its Horror Pack back for 2026 with two Classic Clogs built around Halloween and Saw. The set hands the spotlight to Michael Myers and Jigsaw, with each clog taking a distinct approach to its source film rather than running the same template in two colorways.The Michael Myers pair goes the comic route. Its upper carries a black and off-white graphic of the character, cut through with orange panels and red blood splatter, and that splatter carries onto the gray midsole. An olive heel strap and black hardware close out the back. Up front, a set of themed Jibbitz includes a knife and Halloween graphics, and Crocs layers in "The Night He Came Home" movie references so the design reads as more than a straight character print.The Jigsaw clog pushes much darker. Black, gray, cream, and red cover the upper, with puzzle-piece outlines linking the graphics across both sides and Jigsaw imagery sitting over the forefoot. The attached Jibbitz pull from across the franchise, including the spiral logo, a key, a timer, a cassette tape, and other props. A brown, industrial-looking trim wraps the midsole and heel, finished with molded screw details and gear-shaped hardware on the strap, while blood splatter runs across both the upper and lower sections.Under all the artwork, both pairs stay true to the Classic Clog. The forefoot ventilation holes remain, the heel straps can be flipped up or down, and each sits on the standard Crocs outsole. The extra graphics, hardware, and Jibbitz are what pull these away from a regular seasonal colorway. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: CDs Are Booming Again With 17.5 Million Units Sold in the First Half of 2026
items.text: CDs Are Booming Again With 17.5 Million Units Sold in the First Half of 2026 Summary The RIAA reported 17.5 million CDs sold in the first half of 2026, marking a 45.7 percent spike in unit salesLuminate research indicates Gen Z and millennials are driving the surge by purchasing K-Pop special editions as collectiblesOverall US recorded music revenues hit $5.97 billion with growth across every major category outpacing inflation The compact disc is officially back in heavy rotation. CD sales sparked a physical media revival in the first six months of 2026, according to a mid-year report by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). Matt Bass, the organization's Vice President of Research, revealed that 17.5 million CDs were sold in the first half of the year. Total unit volume marked a 45.7 percent jump compared to the 12 million CDs sold during the same period in 2025. Cash flowing into the space grew by 58.6 percent to reach $171.1 million USD. This explosion served as a pivot for the format, arriving after a sharp decline where sales shrank by 22 percent between 2024 and 2025.Fan culture rather than pure audiophile demand drives the mechanics behind this retro hardware boom. Luminate research clocked 16.3 million CD units sold in the first half of the year, noting that Gen Z and millennials purchase the discs mostly as collectibles. Data indicated that much of the increase came from special editions released by K-Pop acts like BTS. Aesthetic purchasing is so dominant that only about half of all CD buyers actually own a CD player. Such consumer behavior treats physical music as high-value visual merchandise, reflecting a market where revenues outpace inflation.The resurgence drags the rest of the physical market upward. Vinyl sales continue to cement their legacy status, climbing by nearly 21 percent from last year to reach 26.5 million units sold. Niche categories of other physical media saw their own aggressive spike. This vintage-leaning segment which includes CD singles, DVDs, cassettes, SACD and DVD-Audio surged by over 73 percent to reach 1.6 million units in the first half of 2026.Digital ecosystems remain at the top of the hierarchy despite the cultural obsession with physical artifacts. Streaming revenue grew by 4.7 percent to reach $4.9 billion USD, remaining the largest source of recorded music revenue. Paid streaming subscriptions carried the bulk of that weight, reaching $3.4 billion USD to reflect a 6.4 percent increase. Free strea

items.title: WALLHACK Turns Your Desk Into KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS Territory With Two SP-005 Glass Mousepads
items.text: WALLHACK Turns Your Desk Into KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS Territory With Two SP-005 Glass Mousepads Summary WALLHACK and KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS have collaborated on two glass mousepads, each built on the SP-005 tempered glass surfaceOne design carries LUDENS in its 10th anniversary form on white glass, the other centers the studio logo on black glassBoth pads are single production runs sharing the same dimensions and construction WALLHACK and KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS have teamed on a pair of glass mousepads, both constructed on WALLHACK's SP-005 tempered glass platform. The two pads split into distinct visual treatments while sharing an identical hardware base, translating the studio's imagery onto a rigid glass gaming surface.The shared foundation is the SP-005 tempered glass surface. Each pad measures 44cm by 51cm, or 17.3 by 20 inches, giving both designs the same large footprint and the smooth, hard glide characteristic of a glass pad rather than a cloth one. That common base is what lets the collaboration run two different graphic approaches without changing the underlying product.The first design, the SP-005 KJP Ludens-10, puts the studio's character front and center. LUDENS appears in its 10th anniversary form, printed full-bleed across white glass so the cloak, antenna and full suit stretch edge to edge. Functional-looking graphic details reinforce the theme, with crosshair markers drawn from aerial surveillance grids and a barcode lifted directly from LUDENS' own suit, small callouts that tie the print back to the character's world.The second design, the SP-005 KJP Logo, strips the concept back to the studio mark. Here the KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS logo sits centered on black glass with everything else pared away, offset only by industrial graphic elements including crosshair marks and a barcode. It reads as the quieter of the two, built to disappear into a dark desk setup rather than dominate it, a deliberate contrast to the full-bleed white version.Each treatment is offered in a single colorway matched to its concept, white for the Ludens-10 and black for the Logo, and both are produced as one-time runs. WALLHACK frames the project as a move beyond conventional gaming hardware, putting the studio's aesthetic onto its glass pads as a step forward for the brand.Both the SP-005 KJP Ludens-10 and SP-005 KJP Logo are available on September 8 via the WALLHACK official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Razer Unveils the Clio X, a USD Wireless Speaker Head Cushion for Gaming Chairs
items.text: Razer Unveils the Clio X, a USD Wireless Speaker Head Cushion for Gaming Chairs Summary Razer reveals the $109.99 Clio X wireless speaker head cushion at PAX West 2026The streamlined release costs less than half the price of the brand's original premium modelFeatures THX Spatial Audio and near-field loudspeakers to eliminate headset fatigue Razer unveiled the brand-new Razer Clio X at PAX West 2026. This hardware addition is a dedicated head cushion with a built-in wireless speaker. Priced at $109.99 USD, the new model costs less than half the price of the original $230 USD Razer Clio. The lower price point offers an affordable entry for users upgrading their hardware. Headset-free 3D sound eliminates the physical fatigue that comes with wearing traditional headphones during marathon sessions.Engineered for maximum compatibility, the Clio X attaches directly to the headrest of all Razer gaming chairs using an adjustable nylon strap. External power is required to keep the aesthetic sleek, and the unit must be plugged into a 15W USB-C power source. Razer recommends utilizing a PD2.0 power source to drive the audio because relying on non-PD sources will limit power draw and cap maximum volume. Portable power banks with a capacity of at least 10,000mAh are advised for gamers opting for a completely untethered setup.A redesigned internal acoustic architecture maintains performance levels found in the previous model. While the flagship Clio utilized 43mm aluminum cone drivers, this streamlined iteration packs two 38mm near-field loudspeakers angled toward the user's ears. Two 55mm passive radiators ensure audio depth is not lost during the transition. This precise layout provides immersive audio while maintaining a compact form factor.Beyond raw hardware, localized software integration pushes spatial boundaries. THX Spatial Audio converts standard stereo surround sound into a 360-degree audio environment. Low-latency HyperSpeed 2.4 GHz wireless technology links the speaker directly to computers to ensure tactical sound cues never lag. Connecting the Clio X to a soundbar is an option for expanded audio. Genuine audio immersion is achieved without the physical exhaustion of traditional headwear. Availability includes Razer’s website and physical retail stores. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Invincible, Thragg, Angstrom Levy, and Allen the Alien Get the Super7 DELUXE Treatment
items.text: Invincible, Thragg, Angstrom Levy, and Allen the Alien Get the Super7 DELUXE Treatment Summary Super7 has launched its first 'Invincible' DELUXE figure wave, covering Invincible, Allen the Alien, Thragg and Angstrom LevyEach figure stands 7 inches tall with 32 points of articulation and character-specific accessoriesThe line draws on the Invincible comic universe, which ran from 2003 to 2018 Super7 has revealed its first Invincible DELUXE wave, a four-figure lineup pulled from the Invincible comic universe. The release brings Invincible, Allen the Alien, Thragg and Angstrom Levy into Super7's DELUXE format, each built as a fully articulated, highly detailed collectible rooted in a comic series with a long publishing run behind it.Every figure in the wave stands 7 inches tall and carries 32 points of articulation, giving collectors a wide range of posability across the set. That articulation count is the headline engineering figure here, positioning the DELUXE line as a more poseable, display-focused option rather than a static statue.Sculpt detail and accessories round out each character. The figures are described as ultra-detailed and intricately sculpted, built to capture the essential elements of each core character, and they ship with the accessories specific to each one. That per-character approach means the four figures are differentiated not just by likeness but by the extras packaged with them, tailoring each release to its subject. The wave comes on new blister-card packaging, a presentation the brand ties to an entry-level positioning aimed at newer collectors.The source material gives the line its depth. Super7's DELUXE wave draws on the Invincible comic universe, a series that ran from 2003 to 2018 and followed Mark Grayson, a teenager balancing superhero powers with a dark family history. That run gives the property a substantial body of storytelling for a figure line to pull from, and the four-character selection reflects it, spanning heroes and antagonists rather than a single central figure.That roster choice is what ties the specs back to the property. Invincible himself anchors the wave alongside Allen the Alien, while Thragg and Angstrom Levy fill out the lineup, giving collectors a foundational cast from across the comic's run as the DELUXE line opens.The Super7 Invincible DELUXE Wave 01 figures are available via Super7 as a complete four-figure set or as individual releases. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Secret Elizabeth Holmes Documentary Is Real, and the First Teaser Has Arrived
items.text: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Secret Elizabeth Holmes Documentary Is Real, and the First Teaser Has Arrived Summary Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim have revealed 'You Can See Everything,' a documentary centered on Theranos founder Elizabeth HolmesThe film began 34 days before Holmes reported to prison and grew into a three-year projectIt premiered at the Telluride Film Festival after years of speculation about Fielder's secret Holmes interviews Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim have officially unveiled You Can See Everything, a documentary built around disgraced Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes. The A24 project starts 34 days before Holmes is due to report to prison, when she invites a skeptical film crew to follow her, and expands from that setup into a three-year descent that reaches far beyond a conventional portrait.The premise is anchored to a specific and unusual countdown. With just over a month left before her sentence begins, Holmes opens her life to a crew that approaches her with open doubt, framing the film's central tension from the outset. What is pitched as an intimate study of an enigmatic convicted felon gradually mutates into something stranger and longer, a mind-bending journey that the filmmakers track across three years rather than a single pre-prison window.The directing pairing is a large part of why the film carries weight. Fielder and Oppenheim both trade in boundary-pushing, formally slippery work, and the documentary leans into that reputation rather than smoothing it over. The teaser plays up the uneasy dynamic between subject and filmmaker, with Fielder and Holmes locking eyes and openly sizing each other up, a standoff over honesty in which Holmes insists she has no reason to deceive him and maintains she is always being real, while Fielder presses on whether she is telling the truth.The film also lands atop years of rumor. It had long been whispered that Fielder was quietly interviewing Holmes, including visits to see her in prison, for a project shrouded in secrecy. That speculation resolved when the documentary surfaced publicly, confirming the collaboration that observers had guessed at without proof.You Can See Everything premiered on Sunday night at the Telluride Film Festival, moving the long-secret project out of rumor and into public view with a debut on one of the fall festival circuit's most closely watched stages.Watch the teaser above. You Can See Everything hits theaters this October. Read more at Hyp

items.title: SUBU Warms Its ORIGINALS F-LINE Sandal With New "Lavender" and "Matcha" Colorways
items.text: SUBU Warms Its ORIGINALS F-LINE Sandal With New "Lavender" and "Matcha" Colorways Name: SUBU Originals F-LineColorway: Matcha, MatchaSKU: N/AMSRP: ¥5,280 JPY (approx. $35 USD)Release Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: SUBUSUBU has introduced two new colorways of its ORIGINALS F-LINE sandal, "Lavender" and "Matcha," for the 2026 fall and winter season. Rather than a warm-weather slide, the F-LINE is engineered as a cold-season sandal that can be worn on bare feet, using its layered construction to trap heat where conventional open footwear leaves it exposed.The heart of the design is a four-layer insole that gives the sandal its cushioning and thermal payoff. Underfoot, those stacked layers are tuned to deliver a plush, settled feel that the brand positions as more comfortable than standard house footwear, while the structure hugs the whole foot for a secure fit. It is the part of the build doing the quiet work, turning a slip-on silhouette into something that holds the foot rather than simply covering it.Warmth comes from the materials wrapped around that base. The interior uses a brushed, napped fabric lining that surrounds bare skin in a down-like softness, the kind of insulation associated with a winter jacket rather than a sandal. That lining is what makes barefoot use viable in low temperatures, letting the wearer step outside without socks for quick errands without the discomfort a normal sandal would bring.The outer shell and sole round out the functional package. Up top, a nylon upper carries a slight sheen and handles the elements, while the insole itself is made from a brushed polyester and the sole from synthetic rubber for grip and durability. The result is a self-contained system where each layer, from upper to footbed to outsole, is assigned a job in keeping the foot warm, cushioned and planted.Color separates the two releases within that shared construction. "Lavender" arrives as a soft, pale purple with a nylon gloss that keeps the sweetness from tipping into saccharine, a lighter note for a season otherwise dominated by dark footwear. "Matcha" takes the opposite tack, a deep, calm green drawn from the tones of the traditional Japanese home that reads as understated yet still stands out against the winter default of black and gray. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: BEAMS BOY and Birkenstock Rebuild the Boston in Three-Tone Asymmetric Suede Patchwork
items.text: BEAMS BOY and Birkenstock Rebuild the Boston in Three-Tone Asymmetric Suede Patchwork Name: BEAMS BOY x Birkenstock Boston Patch WorkColorway: Brown PatchworkSKU: 13330193271MSRP: ¥36,300 JPY (approx. $230 USD)Release Date: September 12Where to Buy: BEAMSBEAMS BOY and Birkenstock have reworked the Boston clog for a special-order collaboration, executed in a "Brown Patchwork" colorway assembled from three tones of suede. The project reworks one of Birkenstock’s most recognizable shapes with a paneled, craft-forward upper rather than a single continuous material.The build starts with the Boston’s clog construction and reworks the upper into an asymmetric patchwork. Three suede leathers, in Birkenstock’s Taupe, Mink and Mocha tones, are pieced together in a deliberately mismatched crazy pattern, so each shoe reads as a mix of distinct leather surfaces rather than one uniform panel. The asymmetry is the point, giving the two feet slightly different arrangements and lending the pair a handmade, one-off character.That paneling leans on leather selection and assembly to carry the design. The suedes are cut and joined so the seams themselves become the visual language of the shoe, a construction approach that trades the Boston’s usual clean single-material face for texture and contrast. It layers a crafted, worked-by-hand feel onto a silhouette better known for its uncomplicated lines.The co-branding is worked into the details rather than stamped across the exterior. Inside, the footbed carries both the Birkenstock and BEAMS logos, marking the shoe as a joint effort at the point of contact with the foot. The pair then ships in BEAMS' signature orange box, extending the collaboration's identity to the packaging.Underneath, the specs stay true to the Boston platform. The upper and the insole lining are both natural leather, while the outsole is a synthetic EVA build for lightweight cushioning. The release is produced in Germany and spans a broad size run, with the smaller sizes offered through the BEAMS BOY label for a gender-spanning fit and larger men's sizes available as a companion listing. items.title: Behind the Design: LUAR & Lunazul Tequila’s Moonlit Capsule
items.text: Behind the Design: LUAR & Lunazul Tequila’s Moonlit Capsule After offering a first glimpse at the LUAR x Lunazul Tequila capsule with a dynamic campaign shot between the streets of NYC and a field of agave, designer Raul Lopez exclusively took Hypebeast behind the design, talking through his approach to fusing their worlds and the partners’ shared dedication to craftsmanship.The highly-limited collection is tied together by the innovative use of agave leather, bringing Lunazul’s craftsmanship into the fold with LUAR’s sartorial, city aesthetic. During the creative process, the Brooklyn native stepped away from the hustle and bustle of NYC, visiting an authentic agave farm to get a hands-on understanding of the material from seed to sewing machine. “It gave me a lot of insight into what these agave plants can actually create, not just tequila, but other sustainable materials,” he said.After the trip, Lopez reflected on their shared philosophy: “Craftsmanship is a huge part of it, especially the small details people might not immediately notice. With Lunazul, people don't always see the meticulous work that goes into making the tequila itself. You don't necessarily see the intricate details of how these pieces are created at first glance; you have to really zoom in to appreciate them.”Speaking to the innovative textile, Lopez mused, “Taking an iconic plant like agave, turning it into vegan leather, and making it suitable for everyday wear is incredible to me.” Featured in a two-piece jacket-and-shorts set and a basketball-shaped handbag, the plant-based leather not only serves as a tangible link between the craftsmanship of tequila and textiles but also as a bold pop of color. Lunazul’s signature blue hue is a gentle reminder of the brand name’s etymology and the inspiration both labels draw from the moon. “The moon brings people together,” Lopez mused. “With Lunazul meaning 'blue moon’ [Spanish] and 'Luar' in Galician and Portuguese meaning ‘moonlight’, both play into each other. We both have a sense of community, ritual, gathering, and culture,” the designer added.“I wanted to create an everyday uniform,” he explained as he walked through the final design. “It couldn't get more New York! The hat, the jean jacket, the shorts, and the bag — it's heavily inspired by '90s hip-hop culture in the city.” Indeed, the silhouettes stay in tune with his hometown’s easy-but-elevated approach to everyday style, while leaning into a nocturnal mood with deep black denim

items.title: Louis Vuitton Adds Five Bold Tambour Spin Time References to Its Permanent Lineup
items.text: Louis Vuitton Adds Five Bold Tambour Spin Time References to Its Permanent Lineup Summary Louis Vuitton adds five Spin Time references to its permanent Tambour watch collection.Features 39.5mm and 42.5mm cases in white gold, rose gold and platinum.Incorporates Australian opal dials, worldtime antipodes and a central flying tourbillon. Building on its limited-edition releases from 2025's LVMH Watch Week, Louis Vuitton now introduces five new Tambour Spin Time references to its permanent collection. Conceived as the House's mechanical expression of the "Art of Travel," the signature complication dates back to 2007, when La Fabrique du Temps founders Michel Navas and Enrico Barbasini drew inspiration from airport and railway station departure boards to create a three-dimensional jumping-hour display. Every element of the new lineup - from the cases to the movements - is fully developed and produced in-house at La Fabrique du Temps Louis Vuitton in Geneva, bearing the "LFT" seal engraved like a passport stamp on the calibres.The permanent collection opens with two distinct 39.5 mm iterations that showcase versatile proportions and 100 meters of water resistance. The Tambour Spin Time Green features a white gold case framing a deep, earthy green sunray and sandblasted dial, paired with a matching quilted green rubber strap that incorporates the House's signature V-motif. Marking a first for the Tambour line, the Tambour Spin Time Australia's Opal arrives in an 18-carat rose gold case set with 68 baguette-cut blue sapphires across the bezel and lugs. Its fiery blue Australian opal dial center is framed by 12 baguette-cut diamond indexes, with opal inserts set between each Spin Time cube. Both models are powered by the self-winding calibre LFT ST13.01, visible through a sapphire caseback - a first for the 39.5 mm silhouette — which presents micro-sandblasted bridges, colourless jewels, and a 750 rose gold oscillating weight delivering a 45-hour power reserve.Expanding into 42.5 mm white gold builds, two Spin Time Air references offer elevated travel complications with suspended displays. The Tambour Spin Time Air Blue renders the brand's signature blue across a sandblasted dial, where 12 floating cubes spell out "Louis Vuitton" and feature polished studs reminiscent of vintage trunk rivets. For world travelers, the Tambour Spin Time Air Antipode Blue integrates a 24-time-zone worldtime complication into the in-house calibre LFT ST12.01. By placing antipodal citie

items.title: L’Occitane en Provence Explores the Dialogue Between Beauty and Ballet With Angelin Preljocaj
items.text: L’Occitane en Provence Explores the Dialogue Between Beauty and Ballet With Angelin Preljocaj Over the last 50 years, L’Occitane en Provence has crafted skincare, fragrances and home collections from botanical ingredients, forming a connection to nature that runs deep through every campaign and collaboration. As the Maison marks its milestone anniversary this year, it now reveals a new ballet project that tells the story of its culture from the soil to the soul. Teaming up with French choreographer Angelin Preljocaj, who recently collaborated with Musée d'Orsay and Fondation Louis Vuitton, the project develops from his pioneering contemporary ballet portfolio. Preljocaj began by delving into the written work of L’Occitane en Provence founder Olivier Baussan. Touching on the Maison’s foundational gestures of sowing, cultivating and harvesting, these unseen excerpts – including The Subtle Alchemy of the Drip and The Metamorphosis of Matter – helped the choreographer understand its ethos and find similarities in ballet’s expressive movement.“We share the same sensitivity to the subtle,” shared Baussan in a recent interview on the collaborative process behind the project. “He works with the movement of bodies; I work with plants and stories. Yet, deep down, we are both seeking to reveal something that isn’t immediately visible.”The artistic dialogue between ballet and beauty evolved into a 20-minute dance piece titled D’un geste simple, translating to From a simple gesture. Set against the backdrop of lavender fields in Provence, France, the choreography interpreted the way L’Occitane en Provence harvests flowers and distills oils into products through bold moves.Reflecting on the performance, Baussan went on to say, “Beauty often arises from slowness, from attention, and from repeated gestures. In an ever-accelerating world, this is an invitation to rediscover the rhythm of life. Here, language unfolds into body, light, and music, becoming a collective work. This is undoubtedly the most beautiful fate of a story: to no longer belong to the one who wrote it.”Watch the full performance above or visit YouTube to go behind the scenes of the process.Discover the Lavender Collection by heading to L’Occitane en Provence’s website or boutiques now. You can explore more about the Maison's history on its dedicated page. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Saturdays NYC Elevates Dickies’ Heritage Work Trousers Into Tailored Slacks
items.text: Saturdays NYC Elevates Dickies’ Heritage Work Trousers Into Tailored Slacks Summary Saturdays NYC and Dickies reunite to merge tough workwear utility with refined coastal streetwear aesthetics.Key silhouettes feature modified Double Knee Work Pants and clean, tailored slacks-style trousers.Releasing via Saturdays NYC flagships and webstore starting September 11. Dickies and Saturdays NYC reunite for a FW26 capsule that continues their shared exploration of workwear and urban refinement. The new drop builds on the partnership’s SS26 release, which modernized Dickies’ rugged DNA with Saturdays NYC’s metropolitan aesthetic.This season, the focus is on two key styles: the 875 Slacks, featuring a clean, straight silhouette that leans into a refined, city-ready look, and the 873 Slim Fit Work Pants, which reinterpret Dickies’ classic workwear cut with a sleeker profile. Garment-dyed treatments, subtle pleating, and refined waistband constructions bring a soft, lived-in feel to Dickies’ structured TC twill fabrics. items.title: Olivetti’s Historic Lettera 22 Typewriter Inspires Persol’s Latest Eyewear
items.text: Olivetti’s Historic Lettera 22 Typewriter Inspires Persol’s Latest Eyewear Summary Persol partners with typewriter pioneer Olivetti on the limited-edition PO3416V optical frame.It features Lettera 22-inspired engravings, red temple tips, and custom metallic hardware.Available via Persol flagships and persol.com, priced at $562 USD. Italian eyewear house Persol has joined forces with iconic typewriter manufacturer Olivetti to release the limited-edition PO3416V optical frame. Celebrating a shared heritage of Italian industrial design and tactile precision, the collaboration reimagines a classic oval silhouette through subtle, mechanical design cues. Crafted from premium handmade cotton acetate, the optical frame features a metal nose bridge detailed with intricate radial engravings that mirror the internal mechanics of Marcello Nizzoli’s historic 1950 Lettera 22 typewriter. Persol's signature Meflecto flexible stem system and iconic Arrow hinge are subtly customized, incorporating Olivetti's "O" insignia alongside metallic accents reminiscent of typewriter keys.The PO3416V model is offered in timeless Black, classic Havana and a special Brown Gradient (1259) colorway. Intricate brand details continue along the inner temple, which is stamped with the original Lettera 22 logo, while the temple tips feature a protective rubber sheath finished with a striking red accent inspired by the typewriter's ribbon. Complete with custom collector's packaging, the Persol x Olivetti PO3416V limited-edition eyeglasses are available now through Persol flagship boutiques and online, priced at $562 USD. items.title: The Plaud One Earbuds Capture and Sync Meetings Without a Smartphone
items.text: The Plaud One Earbuds Capture and Sync Meetings Without a Smartphone Summary Plaud One earbuds merge audio hardware with AI, transcribing conversations and generating tasks.Features include noise cancellation, 12 mm drivers and a recording case with beamforming microphones.Retails for around $250 USD, with initial shipments starting in Q4 2026. The Plaud One marks a significant evolution for the brand, shifting from passive voice recorders to a fully functional "agentic" AI wearable designed for modern professionals. Skipping a screen entirely, the Plaud One Explorer Edition pairs half in-ear buds with a standalone charging case that doubles as an intelligent recording puck.Built for continuous, on-the-go productivity, the hardware boasts impressive specifications: each 4.5-gram earbud features 12mm dynamic drivers, adaptive active noise cancellation up to 40dB, Bluetooth 5.4, and LDAC codec support, alongside three MEMS microphones and a voice processing unit (VPU). The true standout feature lies within its IP52-rated charging case, which incorporates a 4G LTE eSIM and a four-microphone beamforming array. This standalone cellular connectivity allows the case to capture, automatically upload, and sync in-person meeting audio to the cloud without ever needing a paired smartphone nearby.Engineered to capture, understand and act on human conversations, the earbuds seamlessly interface with the Plaud Intelligence platform. Utilizing the built-in "Hey Plaud" voice trigger or dedicated Agent button, users can command the Plaud Agent to generate automated workflows based on their recordings — such as drafting follow-up emails, creating workshop reports, or scheduling meetings directly into integrated apps like Gmail, Notion, Slack and Google Calendar.Offering up to 36 hours of total combined recording time (six hours from the earbuds and 25 hours via the case), the device is optimized for leaders and consultants whose work revolves around daily communication. Available in a sleek white finish, the Plaud One Explorer Edition is priced at just under $250 USD and comes bundled with 300 minutes of monthly transcription alongside $200 in Plaud Credits. Pre-orders for the limited 2,000-unit run have already opened, with initial shipments slated for Q4 2026 ahead of a broader retail launch in 2027. For more information, head over to Plaud’s official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Sony's WH-1000XM4C Resurrects the Fan-Favorite Foldable ANC Headphones
items.text: Sony's WH-1000XM4C Resurrects the Fan-Favorite Foldable ANC Headphones Summary Sony is resurrecting its discontinued WH-1000XM4 headphones as the updated WH-1000XM4CThe upgraded release features Bluetooth 6, a 10-band equalizer and a fresh lavender colorwaySony returns to the classic folding design while lowering the retail price to $300 USD Sony is officially bringing a heavyweight back from the vault. After discontinuing the original model in 2025, the brand is resurrecting its acclaimed 2020 audio silhouette as the updated Sony WH-1000XM4C. The device arrives later this fall for $300 USD, which represents a $50 USD decrease from the original launch price and answers a void in the current hardware market. These headphones previously dominated industry lists for their top-tier noise-canceling capabilities and signature compact folding design. By resurrecting the original hinge mechanism and folding capability, Sony returns to a celebrated form factor that the company moved away from with later flagship releases. This revival includes a brand-new lavender color option alongside the standard white and black aesthetics.Internally, the updated headphones blend vintage architecture with modern integration. The Sony WH-1000XM4C retains the original model's QN1 processing chip and its four microphones for active noise canceling. Wireless connectivity now utilizes Bluetooth 6 rather than the previous version. Users gain access to a more precise 10-band equalizer in the companion app, which replaces the standard five bands and adds a dedicated gaming preset. The app also features a new safe mode that allows users to limit the maximum volume output of the headphones, although the limit itself cannot be locked in place. One operational trade-off exists regarding power. The Sony WH-1000XM4C battery life is rated at up to 27 hours with noise canceling on, which marks a slight dip from the previous 30-hour rating. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ROSÉ Styles Her Own ’Fits in Levi’s “Keep It Loose” Campaign
items.text: ROSÉ Styles Her Own ’Fits in Levi’s “Keep It Loose” Campaign Summary ROSÉ joins Levi’s for the FW26 "Keep It Loose" campaign, showcasing her take on the "Loose Prep" aesthetic.Highlights Loose Taper Jeans, Loose Boot Jeans and the Loose Crop Trucker Jacket.Available via Levi's stores and online, starting September 15, with a Tokyo pop-up starting September 15, 2026. Levi’s has partnered with BLACKPINK’s ROSÉ for a Fall/Winter 2026 campaign that blends her effortless style with the brand’s denim heritage. Centered around the theme “Keep It Loose,” the campaign emphasizes relaxed silhouettes, versatile layering and everyday wearability. The range includes wide-leg jeans, oversized trucker jackets, cropped tops and accessories such as embroidered caps and structured bags, all styled to reflect Rosé’s signature mix of casual ease and chic refinement.The collection balances classic indigo denim with muted neutrals and pops of detail, creating a wardrobe that celebrates individuality and freedom of movement. Available from September 15, 2026, the capsule will be released through Levi’s boutiques, the website, as well as select pop-up events and activations across Asia, including Tokyo and Hong Kong. Following the success of their previous collaborative efforts, this sophomore joint venture taps New Balance's iconic barefoot-feel runner - the Minimus - as its foundation.Arriving in two distinct, season-ready colorways characterized by sharp material blocking, the MT10 sneaker features a classic upper constructed from rich suede and breathable mesh in a burgundy red hue -- striking an unexpected visual balance with its contrasting icy blue laces. items.title: Goldwin Unveils FW26 Performance Collection Fronted by Ruy Ueda
items.text: Goldwin Unveils FW26 Performance Collection Fronted by Ruy Ueda Summary Goldwin FW26 Performance Collection focuses on comfort during high-intensity trail running.Key pieces include the Kel Light Crew, PERTEX SHIELD PRO Fast Run Jacket and Moon Trail Pack.Designed with athlete insights, the collection balances lightness, protection and utility. Goldwin has revealed its Fall/Winter 2026 Performance Collection, a lineup designed to respond to the body’s changing needs during high-intensity movement. Shot with professional mountain runner Ruy Ueda, the campaign emphasizes the brand’s rational approach to outdoor performance — balancing silhouette, functionality, comfort, and utility with a distinctly Japanese minimal design ethos. Each piece is engineered to reduce physical burden, adapting to shifts in heat, moisture, and exertion, ensuring athletes can sustain performance across long distances and demanding conditions.Engineered specifically for the rigorous demands of trail running, the FW26 lineup highlights three hero technical styles. The Kel Light Crew acts as an active insulation layer, incorporating Polartec Alpha Direct 60 with wind-resistant front panels and breathable stretch backing for optimal core warmth and heat release. For unpredictable weather, the ultralight, 120-gram PERTEX SHIELD PRO Fast Run Jacket utilizes 7-denier waterproof fabric, pack-friendly back darts, and internal abrasion prints for streamlined mobility. Completing the range, the Goldwin Moon Trail Pack is a Dyneema 3-layer running vest designed for long-distance races up to 100 miles, featuring a magnetic front-buckle system and an ergonomic, high-position torso wrap.The FW26 Performance collection is available now via Goldwin's official website and flagship locations. items.title: POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF)'s Petal Trainers Laser-Cut Flower Petals Into Italian Leather
items.text: POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF)'s Petal Trainers Laser-Cut Flower Petals Into Italian Leather Name: POST ARCHIVE FACTION Petal TrainersColorway: Black, Brown, White, Malva GreySKU: TBCMSRP: ¥89,040 JPY (approx. $570 USD)Release Date: September 9Where to Buy: POST ARCHIVE FACTIONPOST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF) has unveiled the Petal Trainers, the first sneaker in the brand's history and its debut step into the lifestyle footwear category. First shown during the label's Fall/Winter 2026 presentation at Paris Fashion Week, the shoe translates PAF's structural design language into a form the brand has not attempted before.The upper is the shoe's defining element. Built from Italian cow leather, it is cut through with laser-etched slits modeled on flower petals, a detail that gives the design its name and its face. Those cuts are the physical expression of PAF's "Organic Artifact" approach, the brand's method of reinterpreting forms found in nature into the shape of a product. Rather than sitting on the leather as ornament, the petal cutouts are treated as a working canvas.That distinction matters because the cutouts drive how the shoe is worn. The Petal Trainers pair the slit upper with a set of voluminous laces that can be threaded through different openings, so the lacing becomes a styling variable rather than a fixed path. The result is a single silhouette that can be rearranged into multiple looks depending on how the wearer routes the laces through the petals.Underfoot, the shoe uses a Vibram MC2 Road Running Sole, a component chosen to give the leather upper genuine walking credentials. The sole is positioned for durability and stability across varied city terrain, extending the brand's stated pursuit of fluidity into the shoe's function as well as its form. The Petal Trainers arrive in four colorways, Black, Brown, White and Malva Grey, spanning a range from clean neutrals to a soft muted lilac. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Take a First Look at the ROA x fragment design’s Andreas Boot
items.text: Take a First Look at the ROA x fragment design’s Andreas Boot Name: ROA x fragment design Andreas BootSKU: TBCRelease Date: TBCFirst-look images of ROA and fragment design's collaborative Andreas boot have surfaced. Arriving as a rugged reinterpretation of ROA’s technical outdoor silhouette through Hiroshi Fujiwara’s minimalist lens, the boots feature a leather upper with a heel counter that's partially composed of suede. Serving as a reunion following their 2017 three-way project with 1017 ALYX 9SM, this newly revealed silhouette appears to be equipped with added protection and longevity; a robust black rubber reinforcement wraps around the toe box, cementing the shoe's outdoor roots while maintaining a sleek, stealthy profile.Breaking up the monochromatic upper, the boot incorporates metallic lace hooks that introduce a slight industrial edge to the traditional hiking lacing system. Underfoot, the silhouette is anchored by a heavy-duty Vibram outsole - identifiable by its iconic yellow logo - chosen specifically for its superior durability and all-terrain grip. Branding is handled with a balanced contrast: ROA’s signature triangular logo sits prominently on the tongue and toe, while fragment design’s presence is characteristically understated. Fujiwara's influence is quietly signaled by a debossed FRGMT thunderbolt motif stamped at the heel, perfectly complemented by a striking splash of the label's iconic blue running along the sole. Official release dates and pricing for this highly anticipated collaboration remain unannounced. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 27-Year-Old Julie Kegels Wins the 2026 LVMH Prize Grand Award
items.text: 27-Year-Old Julie Kegels Wins the 2026 LVMH Prize Grand Award Summary Julie Kegels wins the 2026 LVMH Prize for her contemporary womenswear.Zane Li’s LII label receives the Karl Lagerfeld Prize for sportswear-couture fusion.Anil Padia earns the Savoir-Faire Prize for her artisan-led brand, Yoshita 1967. The final of the 13th edition of the LVMH Prize for Young Fashion Designers took place on September 4, 2026, at the Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris. Selected by a distinguished jury of twelve creative directors - including Jonathan Anderson, Sarah Burton, Maria Grazia Chiuri, Nicolas Ghesquière, Stella McCartney, NIGO, Phoebe Philo, Michael Rider and Pharrell Williams - alongside special guest jury member and Thai actress Urassaya Sperbund, the annual competition honored three standout emerging talents. Each winner receives tailored one-year mentorship from LVMH experts alongside fabric allowances from the Nona Source platform, which upcycles deadstock materials from the luxury conglomerate’s fashion houses.The LVMH Prize was awarded to Belgian designer Julie Kegels, founder of her namesake womenswear brand. At just 27 years old, Kegels impressed the jury with her multi-faceted, contemporary wardrobe that champions individuality. She will receive a €400,000 EUR (approx. $464, 548 USD) endowment and one year of mentorship from LVMH experts, along with a €20,000 EUR (approx. $23,227 USD) allowance from Nona Source. Presented by actress Jennifer Lawrence, the award positions Kegels as one of the most promising new voices in European fashion.The Karl Lagerfeld Prize went to Chinese designer Zane Li, age 25, founder of the brand LII. His designs seamlessly blend sportswear with couture influences, creating a hybrid aesthetic that resonated strongly with the jury. Li will receive €200,000 EUR (approx. $23,227 USD) and a year-long mentorship, plus a €10,000 EUR (approx. $11,614 USD) fabric allowance. Priyanka Chopra Jonas presented the award, underscoring the global recognition of Li’s work and his ability to merge functionality with high fashion.Rounding out the major honours, the Savoir-Faire Prize was awarded to 35-year-old Kenyan designer Anil Padia for his womenswear brand Yoshita 1967. Presented by Urassaya Sperbund, the prize recognizes Padia’s artisan- and community-led fashion project that champions handiwork and local craft. items.title: The Only Factory Matte Black Ferrari Enzo Is Heading to Auction With Royal Family Provenance
items.text: The Only Factory Matte Black Ferrari Enzo Is Heading to Auction With Royal Family Provenance Summary The world's only factory-painted Matte Nero Opaco 2004 Ferrari Enzo is heading to auction through RM Sotheby's private 'Sealed' platformOriginally ordered by a member of the Royal Family of Brunei, the ultra-rare hypercar has logged just 5,763 milesThe vehicle boasts Ferrari Classiche certification and recently underwent a €110,000 EUR restoration at Carrozzeria Zanasi The hypercar market is currently defined by pristine archival examples, but few machines carry the sheer exclusivity of the 2004 Ferrari Enzo currently surfacing for sale. Offered directly through the RM Sotheby's 'Sealed' sales platform, this specific chassis stands in a league of its own as the only Ferrari Enzo to be painted in Matte Nero Opaco from the factory. Commissioned well before stealthy non-gloss finishes became a dominant automotive trend, the unique matte aesthetic was originally ordered by a member of the Royal Family of Brunei. Upon completion, the one-of-one build was delivered new to the royal family's residence in London, cementing its origin story among the world's most expansive private collections.Since its time in the royal fleet, the matte black hypercar has embarked on a documented global journey. After leaving the royal family's collection, the vehicle was sold to a private buyer in New Zealand. Its next major move occurred in 2022, when the car was sold at auction by RM Sotheby's for an undisclosed amount and relocated to Canada. Now returning to the block, the 2004 Ferrari Enzo is once again being offered through the exclusive 'Sealed' platform. Because the car is being sold via this private format rather than a traditional public auction, the eventual sale figure will remain strictly confidential.To ensure the hypercar remained in flawless aesthetic condition, the vehicle was sent to the renowned Carrozzeria Zanasi in Europe in 2022 for a comprehensive restoration. That restoration cost more than €110,000 EUR, which translates to approximately $127,700 USD. The extensive overhaul included replacing the front and rear headlights, swapping out the rear bonnet glass and addressing the interior's sticky switches. Most importantly, the six-figure process culminated in a full respray in the car's original Matte Nero Opaco paint. The upkeep continued into late summer, as in August 2024 the car received a brand-new clutch, replacement fuel pumps and a fresh left-side valv

items.title: Starbucks Japan Collects 18 of Its Best New Store Designs in a Cup-Sleeved Photo Book
items.text: Starbucks Japan Collects 18 of Its Best New Store Designs in a Cup-Sleeved Photo Book Summary Starbucks Japan has published the second edition of its store-design photo book, collecting 18 recent interiors in one volumeThe release doubles as an object in its own right, arriving inside a reusable craft-paper envelope modeled on a Starbucks cupIt frames each location through the company's idea of a warm, locally rooted space rather than a uniform template Starbucks Japan has released STARBUCKS COFFEE JAPAN STORE DESIGN WORKS 002, the second volume of a photo book built entirely around the design of its stores. The 144-page book gathers 18 interiors drawn from locations that opened or were renewed between the fall of 2024 and the spring of 2026, treating the physical space of a coffee shop as the subject worth documenting.The selection is organized around a specific point of view about what a store should be. Each of the 18 spaces is presented as somewhere anyone can feel at home, designed to sit within its surroundings and make use of its particular location rather than repeat a single house layout. That framing is a direct extension of the "third place" idea Starbucks has built its retail identity on for decades, the notion of a comfortable space between home and work. The book positions its interiors as regional variations on that theme, with photography that invites readers to want to visit the stores in person. Interior images are credited to photographer Ryo Yoshiya.The book ships inside a craft-paper envelope shaped to evoke a Starbucks paper cup, with an ID box printed on the reverse carrying keywords meant to deepen the reading of each store's design. Rather than functioning as disposable packaging, the envelope is built to be kept and reused as a case for documents or small items, fastened with a hook-and-loop closure. The book itself measures 21.0 by 1.7 by 28.7 centimeters and is printed in Japan, while the envelope is made from paper-based cellulose fiber with a synthetic latex backing.For readers tracking the series, this second volume follows a first edition that remains available separately, building the project into an ongoing record of how the chain's spaces evolve over time.STARBUCKS COFFEE JAPAN STORE DESIGN WORKS 002 is available now through the Starbucks Japan online store. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Barbour and Levi’s Japan Rebuild Vintage 501s Into One-Off "Re-Loved" Upcycled Jeans
items.text: Barbour and Levi’s Japan Rebuild Vintage 501s Into One-Off "Re-Loved" Upcycled Jeans Summary Levi's and Barbour have joined their repair-minded philosophies on a capsule that turns worn materials into new garmentsThe centerpiece rebuilds vintage 501 jeans with Barbour wax cotton, tartan and wide-wale corduroy, each piece made individuallyA set of collaborative pins drawing on both brands' archives rounds out the release Levi's Japan and Barbour have partnered on the "Re-Loved" capsule collection, a project that translates both labels' shared belief in repairing and extending the life of clothing into a small, materials-driven lineup. The collaboration takes Barbour's existing upcycling framework and folds Levi's own heritage denim into it, producing garments assembled entirely from reclaimed fabric.Re-Loved began as a Barbour program built around the wax jacket. Under it, customers' unwanted jackets are collected and, where needed, cleaned, mended and re-waxed before going back into circulation, a process meant to prolong a garment's life and return value to it rather than discard it. This capsule pushes that idea a step further by introducing vintage Levi's denim and duck fabric into the mix, layering the two houses' signature materials together so each brand's material story informs the other.The result at the center of the collection is the Levi's x Barbour Re-Loved 501. It starts from a vintage 501 base and reconstructs it using Barbour's wax cotton, tartan and wide-wale corduroy, splicing the two brands' textiles into a single hybrid pair. Because every piece is built one at a time from collected and reused material, no two are identical. Each carries its own accumulated history of wear, repair and regeneration, making the jeans functionally one-of-one rather than a stocked, repeatable style.Alongside the denim, the capsule adds a set of collaborative pins that reference archive designs from both Levi's and Barbour, giving the release a lower-commitment collectible to sit next to its centerpiece.The Levi's x Barbour Re-Loved capsule releases September 11. The Re-Loved 501 will be available exclusively at the Levi's Harajuku Flagship Store, where the launch runs through a lottery entry system rather than first-come order, with registration on the morning of the 11th ahead of the draw. The pins will be sold more widely, at the Harajuku Flagship along with the Shinjuku, Osaka, Nagoya Zero Gate and Kyoto locations. Click here to view full gallery at Hypeb

items.title: Audi Brings Back the A2 After 25 Years as the New A2 e-tron Electric Crossover
items.text: Audi Brings Back the A2 After 25 Years as the New A2 e-tron Electric Crossover Summary Audi revives the A2 badge after 25 years with an electric crossover tailored for European EV demandThe new model swaps the expensive all-aluminum construction of the 1999 original for a steel-dominant build starting at £32,200 GBPThe lineup is strictly rear-wheel drive on the MEB platform and tops out with a 322 hp flagship model Twenty-five years after the original model debuted as an expensive outlier, the four rings are running it back with the 2027 Audi A2 e-tron. The 1999 Audi A2 was an all-aluminum vehicle that hit the streets ahead of the market curve, ultimately suffering from poor sales due to its premium price tag. Today’s reboot completely flips that script. By trading the costly, lightweight aluminum construction of its predecessor for a primarily steel body with select aluminum components, Audi is delivering an accessible electric crossover. Priced from £32,200 GBP, the new A2 e-tron directly capitalizes on strong European EV demand, transforming a commercial failure into a strategically timed volume player. Audi pushed the crossover from the drawing board to its official debut in a rapid 21 months, though the vehicle will not be available for purchase in the United States.Visually, the new crossover heavily borrows design elements from the 1999 original, bringing back the signature boxy shape and the split-glass rear window. However, this modern iteration is obsessed with aerodynamic efficiency, achieving a drag coefficient of 0.24. That wind-cheating profile is aided by an enclosed underbody, an active cooling intake, aero wheels and specialized aerodynamic components fitted around the wheel arches. Moving away from traditional hardware, the vehicle features wing-type door handles integrated at the base of the door pillars. These exterior handles use sensors to open electrically and pack their own backup energy storage to ensure functionality.Built entirely on the MEB platform, all configurations of the A2 e-tron are exclusively rear-wheel drive and entirely omit Audi's signature Quattro system. Buyers are offered three gross battery capacities: 52 kWh, 61 kWh and 84 kWh. The base 52 kWh battery links to a 168 hp (125 kW) single motor, yielding a 262-mile range and an 8.8-second sprint to 62 mph. Stepping up to the 61 kWh option provides a 187 hp (140 kW) motor, dropping the 0-62 mph time to 7.9 seconds while pushing the range to 320 miles. Models equipped

items.title: GU's ‘Pokémon’ Collection Slips Mew, Gengar and Eevee Into an Outdoor-Ready Capsule
items.text: GU's ‘Pokémon’ Collection Slips Mew, Gengar and Eevee Into an Outdoor-Ready Capsule Summary GU's latest Pokémon collection imagines a trainer living in the forest, translating that idea into earthy tones and outdoor-derived hardwareCharacter-specific touches run throughout, from woven tags to embroidery to Poké Ball-shaped zipper pullsThe six-piece unisex lineup spans fleece, knit, sweats and a lounge set, with recycled materials used across much of it GU's Pokémon collection returns with a six-piece unisex range built around a single idea: a trainer living deep in the forest alongside their Pokémon. That concept drives the whole capsule, pushing it toward natural color tones and outdoor-derived details, and it shows up less in loud graphics than in the small functional flourishes stitched into each garment.Three of the zippered styles finish their pulls with a Poké Ball motif, a detail that reads as a subtle nod rather than a costume piece. The Half-Zip Fleece Pullover leans further into the theme by tucking its character reference into a woven tag, offered in a Light Gray marked with the Mythical Pokémon Mew and a Navy carrying Gengar. It is cut from fully recycled polyester, as is the Fleece Full-Zip Parka, which comes in Black and Green and pairs its Poké Ball zipper pull with a Pikachu silhouette worked into an outdoor-toned woven label.The knitwear is the most construction-heavy piece in the range. The Full-Zip Knit Jacket arrives in a Brown design combining Eevee with a Poké Ball and a Navy version setting Pikachu against Electric-type icons, both finished with the same Poké Ball pull. Its acrylic knit build makes it the heaviest and most substantial layer of the capsule.The softer goods carry their Pokémon references through graphics and embroidery instead. The Sweat Pullover splits into a Light Gray printed with the silhouettes of the original starter trio, Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle, and a Black centered on a Pikachu silhouette. The cotton Graphic T comes in a White fronted by Dragonite and a Blue that gathers a group of Flying-type Pokémon. Rounding out the range, the Sweat Lounge Set of a long-sleeve top and long pants swaps loud branding for one-point embroidery, appearing in a Gray with Slowpoke, a Dark Green with Pikachu and a Navy with Snorlax.
