items.title: Seth Rogen's Houseplant by Droplet "The House Scent" Reed Diffuser Bottles a Grasse Original in Hand-Blown Crystal
items.text: Seth Rogen's Houseplant by Droplet "The House Scent" Reed Diffuser Bottles a Grasse Original in Hand-Blown Crystal Summary Houseplant by Droplet returns for a second collaboration with a reed diffuser built around a scent Seth Rogen created in Grasse, FranceThe fragrance layers bright pink pepper and delicate peony over warm santal and rich pine for a balance of crisp woodland, soft floral and warm woody notesHoused in a hand-blown crystal glass vessel, the vegan and cruelty-free diffuser is engineered to run for up to 90 days Houseplant by Droplet has introduced The House Scent Reed Diffuser, translating a bespoke fragrance Seth Rogen developed during a scent-making experience in Grasse into a home format. The release marks the second team-up between Rogen's lifestyle brand and the Modern British fragrance house Droplet, and it puts the emphasis squarely on what goes into the bottle.At the center of the diffuser is a four-part composition. Bright pink pepper and delicate peony sit up top, while warm santal and rich pine anchor the base, giving the blend its balance of crisp woodland, soft floral and warm woody character. The result is a fragrance the brands describe as fresh, calm and inviting, tuned to make a room read as home rather than as a showroom.The scent began as a personal project. Rogen built the original during an immersive fragrance-making session in Grasse, the French town regarded as the world's fragrance capital, before Droplet crafted and bottled it for release. "Making my own fragrance in Grasse, France was incredible. It was wild to see first-hand how complicated and personal scent building is. I wanted something that I'd actually use in my own home, warm, inviting, and a little unexpected," said Seth Rogen, co-founder of Houseplant, in a statement.The diffuser holds its formula in a hand-blown crystal glass vessel and is rated for up to 90 days of continuous fragrance, positioning it as a slow-burn fixture rather than a quick refresh. Both vegan and cruelty-free, it is built to function as a sculptural object and a daily ritual in equal measure, leaning on Droplet's attention to both the liquid and the container that carries it.The House Scent Reed Diffuser is available now via The Droplet. items.title: BlackEyePatch Gives the G-SHOCK DW-5600 a Gold-Tone Finish
items.text: BlackEyePatch Gives the G-SHOCK DW-5600 a Gold-Tone Finish Summary BlackEyePatch and G-SHOCK reunite for their third collaboration.The DW-5600BEP-9 pairs a gold-tone resin bezel and band with a black face.Japan receives the watch in October for ¥19,800 JPY; the international listing shows November. BlackEyePatch and G-SHOCK are back for a third collaboration, giving the DW-5600 a gold-tone finish with a black face. The DW-5600BEP-9 draws on the Tokyo label’s connection to hip-hop, pairing the square watch’s familiar shape with a brighter palette.The gold-tone treatment covers the bezel and band, while BlackEyePatch branding appears on the face and is engraved into the case back. Special packaging completes the collaboration. The design retains the DW-5600’s connection to the original DW-5000, the model that established G-SHOCK’s square silhouette.Despite its metallic appearance, the watch uses resin, including bio-based resin in the bezel and band. It weighs 53 grams and measures 48.9 by 42.8 by 13.4 millimeters. Features include shock resistance, 200-meter water resistance, an LED backlight, stopwatch, countdown timer and alarm. Casio lists an approximate five-year battery life.The BlackEyePatch x G-SHOCK DW-5600BEP-9JR is scheduled for October 2026 in Japan at ¥19,800 JPY including tax. Casio’s international listing gives November 2026, so availability varies by market. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: OM SYSTEM Brings the PEN Back With a Viewfinder and Splash Resistance Summary OM SYSTEM’s new PEN pairs a rangefinder-style body with an electronic viewfinder.The camera features a 20.37-megapixel sensor, five-axis stabilization and AI subject detection.Silver and black versions arrive in late October, starting at $999.99 USD for the body. OM SYSTEM is bringing the PEN name to a new interchangeable-lens camera, pairing a rangefinder-style body with an electronic viewfinder and the series’ first dust-resistant, splash-resistant design. The OM SYSTEM PEN arrives in silver or black in late October 2026, starting at $999.99 USD for the body.A flat top keeps the silhouette compact, while the camera weighs approximately 393 grams with its battery and memory card. Inside, a 20.37-megapixel Live MOS sensor works with the TruePic IX processor. Five-axis image stabilization offers up to 5.5 stops of compensation at the center under the manufacturer’s test conditions. Autofocus combines 121 cross-type phase-detection points with AI subject detection for people, cats and dogs.A front-mounted switch opens Color and Monochrome Profile Control, with presets and adjustments for a film-inspired look. A separate computational photography button provides access to features including high-resolution capture, Live ND and focus stacking.The PEN’s IPX1 splash resistance applies when paired with a compatible dust- and splash-resistant lens, outside charging or HDMI use. A kit with the new M.ZUIKO DIGITAL 14-42mm F3.5-5.6 III zoom will cost $1,099.99 USD. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Aston Martin and Brough Superior Take the AMB 002 Roadster to the Street Summary The AMB 002 Roadster is Aston Martin and Brough Superior’s first street-legal collaboration.A 1,083cc V-twin produces 130 bhp, with the motorcycle weighing 190 kilograms.Production is limited to 300 units, with deliveries planned for Q3 2027. Aston Martin and Brough Superior are taking their motorcycle collaboration onto public roads with the AMB 002 Roadster. Following the track-only AMB 001 and AMB 001 Pro, the new model is the partnership’s first street-legal motorcycle, with production limited to 300 units.Its carbon-fiber bodywork translates familiar Aston Martin details into a two-wheeled form. Crescent-shaped vents help manage cooling, while a reworked side strake extends toward the headlamp. Twin oval exhausts and rear light blades echo the brand’s cars. A hand-finished leather seat and keyless ignition round out the design.Power comes from a new 1,083cc water-cooled V-twin producing 130 bhp and 110 Nm of torque. The engine sits in a titanium frame machined from solid billet that weighs just 5 kilograms. Aston Martin lists the motorcycle’s weight at 190 kilograms, with a 50:50 weight distribution. A double-wishbone Fior front suspension separates steering and braking forces.Orders for the hand-built AMB 002 Roadster are open, with deliveries scheduled to begin in the third quarter of 2027. Summary Tomoo Gokita presents more than 100 new fictional record sleeves at agnès b. galerie boutique.The Tokyo exhibition runs September 12 through November 8, 2026.Venue-exclusive screen-printed T-shirts arrive September 11 for ¥8,800 JPY. Tomoo Gokita is bringing more than 100 imaginary record sleeves to agnès b. galerie boutique in Tokyo. items.title: From Shanghai to Manila, a New Generation Is Redrawing Asian Fashion
items.text: From Shanghai to Manila, a New Generation Is Redrawing Asian Fashion For its tenth anniversary, Fashion Asia Hong Kong turned its 10 Asian Designers To Watch platform into something it had never been before: a runway. The debut 10 Asian Designers To Watch Fashion Show and Award Presentation Ceremony unfolded on September 3 alongside the Hong Kong Fashion Fest Gala, with a concurrent exhibition running through September 13 at Peak Galleria, and MEOVV's Gawon stepping out as a special guest in looks by winning labels DISAYA and LEJE. Behind the show sat ten designers from the Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Thailand, South Korea and the Philippines, each building a distinct language out of craft, memory and hard commercial math. Hypebeast sat down with all ten to hear how they got here.Editor's note: The conversations with Chén Sifān, WMWM, NULLUS and SEAN SUEN were translated from Mandarin; those with Tigerstrolling and KINYAN LAM from Cantonese. Maligaya, DISAYA and NOVEL spoke in English, and LEJE responded in writing. Translated quotes are marked as such. View this post on Instagram  View this post on Instagram Chén Sifān (Sifan Chen), Chinese MainlandSifan Chen starts with himself, drawing on the books he reads and fragments gathered while traveling. He is wary of designing for an international system and prefers to watch the street. "Street style reflects the mood of the whole society," he says (translated from Mandarin), describing the passersby he studies around Shanghai. That instinct for the everyday carries into his standout exhibition piece, a hand-woven denim jacket whose fiber, he explains, is actually cashmere and linen, woven by hand on old machines in Guizhou so it trades denim's usual stiffness for something soft and breathable. His hardest problem is getting buyers and clients to accept a high price, which he answers by walking them through where each piece comes from. Ask him what he wants five years out and he waves off grand ambitions, offering instead a wish "to show a more diverse Asian culture, rather than the fantasy of Asia or the East seen under a Western system" (translated from Mandarin). The line he still returns to came from Fabio Piras, his MA course leader at Central Saint Martins: "I need to trust my simplicity" (translated from Mandarin), he recalls, advice that taught him not to fear a clean silhouette.DISAYA (Disaya Sorakraikitikul), ThailandDisaya Sorakraikitikul always begins with a craft technique, th

items.title: ‘Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration’ Reveals a New Wave of Illustration Rares and Special Illustration Rares
items.text: ‘Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration’ Reveals a New Wave of Illustration Rares and Special Illustration Rares Summary Pokémon has revealed a fresh batch of cards from the 30th Celebration expansion, divided between a bright daytime theme and a nocturnal night themeThe showcase centers on illustration rares and special illustration rares, the art-forward rarity tiers that have become a focus for collectorsThe reveal arrives as lead-up to the anniversary set's launch, marking three decades of the Pokémon Trading Card Game Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration has pulled back the curtain on a new run of cards, sorting them into a day-and-night split that runs through the entire expansion. The reveal leans on the set's illustration rares and special illustration rares, spotlighting the artwork as much as the Pokémon themselves ahead of the anniversary release.The daytime half leans into bright, sunlit scenes. Salamence ex is shown roaming clear skies, while an Alolan Exeggutor and an electrified Morpeko round out the sun-soaked cast. The returning Kanto legendary trio of Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres appears here as well, alongside Sylveon and Fuecoco, giving the day side a mix of nostalgic heavy-hitters and newer faces.The night side flips the mood toward after-dark energy. Gholdengo takes the spotlight mid-dance, a group of Scraggy plays up a tougher look, and Jirachi ex anchors the set with a cosmic tilt. Toxtricity and Greninja carry the same nocturnal theme, and the reveal teases the legendary birds again in a combined image, hinting at how the trio's individual cards might read as a single connected piece.Check out the cards above. Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration launches September 16. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Converse Japan's All Star Yunomi Hi Pours a Teacup's Fish Kanji Print Onto a High-Top
items.text: Converse Japan's All Star Yunomi Hi Pours a Teacup's Fish Kanji Print Onto a High-Top Name: Converse Japan All Star Yunomi HiColorway: White/NavySKU: 31319350210MSRP: ¥11,000 JPY (approx. $70 USD)Release Date: September 25Where to Buy: Converse JapanConverse Japan's All Star Yunomi Hi turns a piece of everyday tableware into a full-coverage sneaker graphic, printing the motif of the yunomi teacup across a canvas high-top. The release lands on a renewed version of the All Star spec and treats the upper as a canvas for a densely detailed, distinctly Japanese print.The graphic is the whole story here. Converse Japan draws on the yunomi, the style of teacup familiar to anyone who has browsed a Japanese souvenir shop, and translates its imagery onto the shoe. Teacups of this kind are frequently decorated with kanji built on the fish radical, and the print leans into that tradition, scattering those characters across the upper.Woven into the design are two additional touches that tie the graphic back to the brand. One is a kanji rendering of "all star," writing the model's name in Japanese characters rather than the usual Latin script. The other is a set of hand-drawn stars worked in among the text, a looser, sketched counterpoint to the printed characters that nods to the All Star's core emblem.Underneath the graphic, the construction stays true to the silhouette. The shoe is built on a renewed All Star spec, with a canvas upper over a rubber outsole in the high-top cut that has defined the model for decades. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: HYKE Reimagines Heritage Military Codes Across a Dual Gender Runway for SS27
items.text: HYKE Reimagines Heritage Military Codes Across a Dual Gender Runway for SS27 Summary HYKE SS27 debuts its first full menswear line alongside its latest womenswear collection.The range comprises tailored silhouettes, military-inspired outerwear and sheer layering.Collaborations include Baracuta jackets, BRIEFING modular totes, and footwear with FOOT THE COACHER, BEAUTIFUL SHOES, and Marbot. HYKE’s Spring/Summer 2027 runway collection continues Hideaki Yoshihara and Yukiko Ode’s exploration of modernized vintage uniforms and workwear, this time marking the debut of a fully developed menswear line alongside womenswear. Distinctly engineered rather than simply upsized from womenswear, both lines share cohesive silhouettes and thematic codes while maintaining distinct tailoring and fits.The season strikes a balance between sharp, elegant tailoring, voluminous drapes, utilitarian outerwear and delicate sheer layers rendered in a refined palette of dark blue, navy, indigo, black and beige. Key outerwear pieces draw directly from mid-century military equipment, including PERTEX® M-65 field jackets, M-48 fishtail parkas, and spring flight blousons inspired by the USAF CWU-36/P, CWU-106/P, and L-2A silhouettes.Slit-sleeve double-breasted blazers and lapelless jackets add a modern edge, styled alongside ankle-cropped wool-mohair trousers and wide-leg M-51 Arctic-inspired drawstring pants. Light layers feature layered US Navy utility shirts, gradient-striped Basque sweaters, sheer knits, and heavy Tilden sweaters paired with sheer pleated skirts. items.title: Phil Jackson Is Getting a Statue in Star Plaza, Joining Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O'Neal Outside the Arena
items.text: Phil Jackson Is Getting a Statue in Star Plaza, Joining Kobe Bryant and Shaquille O'Neal Outside the Arena Summary Los Angeles Lakers to honor Hall of Fame head coach Phil Jackson with a statue outside Crypto.com Arena in April 2027Monument celebrates an 11-season tenure that delivered five NBA championships and a legendary three-peat The Los Angeles Lakers officially announced on Tuesday that Phil Jackson will be honored with a statue in Star Plaza outside Crypto.com Arena. This unveiling ceremony is scheduled for April 9, 2027, taking place just before the Lakers face off against the Minnesota Timberwolves. Jackson is 80 years old and will become the ninth figure immortalized outside the arena. His physical legacy will be cemented alongside the franchise icons he once led.The monument celebrates an era of dominance. Jackson originally arrived in Los Angeles after accepting an invitation from late Lakers owner Jerry Buss. He coached the Lakers for 11 seasons across two separate stints from 1999 to 2004 and 2005 to 2011. His tenure focused on championship execution. Under his watch, the Lakers compiled a 610-292 regular-season record and an equally lethal 118-63 run in the playoffs. Los Angeles reached the postseason in every one of his 11 seasons at the helm and advanced to the NBA Finals seven times. Jackson delivered five championships to Los Angeles, including three consecutive NBA titles from 2000 to 2002.Before building his West Coast dynasty, Jackson was already a certified architect of basketball history, having secured six NBA titles as the head coach of the Chicago Bulls. He was inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame in 2007. In Star Plaza, his monument will join an exclusive club of eight figures: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Elgin Baylor, Kobe Bryant, Chick Hearn, Magic Johnson, Shaquille O'Neal, Pat Riley and Jerry West. His most recent public appearances at Lakers games were to witness the statue unveilings for Bryant and O'Neal, the pillars of his inaugural Los Angeles three-peat. Lakers Governor Jeanie Buss, who is also Jackson’s former fiancee, provided the official quote in the press release regarding the new monument. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Volkswagen Group Is Reportedly Weighing a Sale of Ducati
items.text: Volkswagen Group Is Reportedly Weighing a Sale of Ducati Summary Volkswagen Group is weighing the sale of Ducati amid a massive restructuring plan that targets non-strategic assetsThe historic motorcycle brand saw a 42.8 percent drop in operating profit last year due to international tariffs and exchange ratesShedding the two-wheel division could fetch up to $1.45 billion USD while refocusing the corporate portfolio entirely on carmaking Volkswagen Group is officially putting its portfolio under the microscope with Ducati potentially on the chopping block. This evaluation of the Italian motorcycle brand belongs to a massive corporate overhaul designed to focus the conglomerate strictly on its core carmaking business. The move arrives as Volkswagen initiates a sweeping restructuring plan. Last week the group announced an overarching corporate strategy that dictates approximately one-third of non-strategic activities will be either divested or realigned. Management requires every target firm to deliver a clear strategic and financial contribution to the core business. Divestment of a dedicated two-wheel asset like Ducati sits squarely within this shift, streamlining the enterprise to double down on cars.Audi CEO Gernot Döllner confirmed that Ducati will be discussed as a direct part of this ongoing evaluation process, though he emphasized that nothing has been decided yet. For Volkswagen, shedding the historic motorcycle manufacturer that dates back to 1926 would mark the end of an era. The marque was acquired on July 19, 2012 as the eleventh brand to join the group's portfolio. Bloomberg estimates that Ducati could be worth around €1.25 billion EUR or $1.45 billion USD if the divestment moves forward.The potential sale comes at a turbulent financial moment for the motorcycle manufacturer, which is currently navigating major profitability pressures. Last year Ducati posted an operating profit of €52 million EUR or $60.39 million USD, representing a sharp 42.8 percent drop. Executives attributed this plunge in operating profit directly to unfavorable exchange rates alongside tariffs applied by the Trump administration.External economic hurdles have also coincided with declining sales across the board. The brand delivered 50,895 motorcycles globally last year, representing a 7 percent overall decline. Despite the downturn, the lineup still moved volume across its core offerings. The Multistrada maintained its position as the best-selling model with 13,873 unit

items.title: Glastonbury 2027 Is Officially Happening With Tickets Breaking £400 GBP for the First Time in History
items.text: Glastonbury 2027 Is Officially Happening With Tickets Breaking £400 GBP for the First Time in History Summary Glastonbury Festival returns in 2027 with weekend tickets breaking the £400 barrier for the first timePasses for the flagship cultural event will officially go on sale in October 2026 following a fallow yearOrganiser Emily Eavis has confirmed that three major headliners are already locked in for the comeback Following a scheduled fallow year in 2026, the legendary Glastonbury Festival has officially set the stage for its return, confirming both the dates and a record-breaking price point for its 2027 edition. Slated to run from Wednesday, 23 June to Sunday, 27 June, the expansive cultural gathering will demand a heavier financial commitment from attendees. For the first time in the event's history, standard pricing has shattered the £400 GBP barrier. General admission weekend passes are now locked in at £408 GBP, a figure that includes a mandatory £5 GBP booking fee per ticket. This historic high represents a sharp increase of £29.50 GBP compared to the rates charged for the 2025 event, cementing the sprawling Somerset site's reputation as the most expensive music festival in the United Kingdom. Buyers must also account for additional, unfinalised postage and packing fees on top of the base price tag.This aggressive pricing recalibration is the starkest reflection yet of a broader trend currently reshaping the live music ecosystem. Across the landscape of major UK festivals, the cost of admission has relentlessly surged past the standard rate of inflation. Event organisers are battling an unprecedented confluence of macroeconomic pressures, attributing these steep cost hikes to skyrocketing energy and infrastructure expenditures compounded by severe post-Brexit labour shortages. As the flagship event of the British summer, the new pricing model for 2027 effectively normalises this heightened barrier to entry for top-tier live music, shifting the financial reality for an entire generation of festivalgoers.Securing a spot on the farm for Glastonbury remains a notoriously fierce battle, and the October 2026 on-sale rollout will be split into two distinct ticketing phases. Those willing to commit to sustainable transit can strike first, as tickets packaged with coach travel will officially drop at 6:00 p.m. BST on Thursday, October 1. items.title: UNDERCOVER and George Cox Reinterpret the 4 Eyelet Derby Through Cindy Sherman's Photography
items.text: UNDERCOVER and George Cox Reinterpret the 4 Eyelet Derby Through Cindy Sherman's Photography Name: UNDERCOVER x Cindy Sherman x George Cox 4 Eyelet DerbyColorway: Black, WhiteSKU: N/AMSRP: $450 USDRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: George CoxGeorge Cox and UNDERCOVER have again joined forces on the 4 Eyelet Derby, extending a partnership that runs through Jun Takahashi's label and George Cox's Northamptonshire workshop. For Fall/Winter 2026, the two houses hand the silhouette over to American artist Cindy Sherman, whose photographic studies of identity become the surface of the shoe itself.The construction stays true to George Cox's house methods. Both colorways are built on the 1353 last, a traditional Northamptonshire round-toe form that the brand pushes into something tougher than its heritage silhouettes suggest. A lightweight EVA sole underpins each pair, while steel eyelets handle the four-eyelet lacing that gives the derby its name. Inside, the shoes are finished with natural kip lining leather, the industrially stamped interior that George Cox treats as part of its signature handwriting.Rather than dyeing or embossing the leather, George Cox and UNDERCOVER photo-print it, wrapping Sherman's images around the full body of the shoe so the artwork reads as a continuous surface with its focal point resting on the toe. Sherman built her reputation on staged self-portraits that cast herself in shifting personas, using the camera to interrogate how identity is constructed and performed. That preoccupation with self-image maps neatly onto UNDERCOVER's own history of subversion.The two colorways draw on different works from her catalog. The white pair carries Untitled #122, made in 1983, while the black pair pulls from her earlier film-still period, featuring Untitled Film Still #16 from 1979 and Untitled Film Still #53 from 1980. Across both, the source imagery spans 1979 to 1983, turning the derby into a wearable slice of one of the most influential bodies of work in contemporary American photography. items.text: JJJJound and Diemme Return the Movida in a "Brown" Suede Build With Italian Leather and Vibram Name: JJJJound x Diemme MovidaColorway: BrownSKU: N/AMSRP: TBCRelease Date: September 10Where to Buy: JJJJound, DiemmeDiemme and JJJJound have reworked the Movida in a brown suede colorway, extending a collaboration that keeps returning to the Italian label's utilitarian silhouettes. Handcrafted in Italy, the latest pair leads with material and construction, building the shoe from premium Italian suede over a full leather lining.The foundation is a lightweight Vibram sole, chosen to deliver flexibility and grip for daily wear rather than pure performance duty. Above it, the brown suede upper sits on a full leather lining, a combination that leans on Diemme's technical shoemaking background while keeping the profile clean enough for JJJJound's pared-back sensibility.The detailing is where the collaboration earns its character. Black-coated metal eyelets secure black polyester laces, with a single red secondary lace threaded in for a restrained hit of contrast. A woven nylon back tab and a webbing pull tab handle the utility side, making the shoe easier to pull on while nodding to the outdoor archetypes Diemme draws from.Branding stays subtle across both ends of the shoe. A debossed Diemme logo marks the tongue, while JJJJound's serif logo appears on the heel tab, splitting the identification between the two houses without disrupting the minimalist finish. Diemme has produced footwear in Italy since 1992 from its base in the Veneto region, pulling from mountaineering and performance references to build refined, function-minded designs, and that lineage runs through every element of this release. items.text: Watch the Official 1.43:1 IMAX Trailer for ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ Summary TOHO unveiled an IMAX trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero , set to premiere in theaters globally in November.Directed by Takashi Yamazaki, it's also the first Japanese film to be shot natively using IMAX-certified digital cameras. TOHO and GKIDS have officially unveiled the new theatrical IMAX trailer and key visual for Godzilla Minus Zero. Directed once again by Takashi Yamazaki, the film serves as a landmark production, making history as the first Japanese film ever to be shot natively using IMAX-certified digital cameras.Set two years after the desperate defense of Japan in 1947, the story follows returning characters Kōichi Shikishima (Ryunosuke Kamiki) and Noriko Ōishi (Minami Hamabe) as the nation faces an unexpected resurgence of the radioactive titan, which appears to have regenerated and evolved into an even more monstrous, mutated form.The 85-second trailer offers a high-stakes, epic preview of the film's expanded scale, showcasing high-contrast naval battles, military fighter plane interceptions, and massive urban destruction framed specifically in the immersive 1.43:1 expanded IMAX aspect ratio. Alongside returning cast members, the preview introduces new key characters, including a prodigy forecasting officer (played by Keiko Kitagawa) who proposes a desperate "Plan B" defense strategy as Godzilla unleashes catastrophic atomic bursts. Promising deeper emotional stakes and groundbreaking visual effects, Godzilla Minus Zero expands TOHO’s iconic Kaiju franchise into a new era of large-format cinematic spectacle.With its confirmed worldwide rollout in November 2026 - Japan on November 3 and North America on November 6 - the project is framed as a major international event, bridging domestic heritage with global audiences while reinforcing Godzilla’s enduring role as a cultural icon.Godzilla lives. ⚡️GODZILLA MINUS ZEROVFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi YamazakiIn theatres & IMAX November 6#FilmedForIMAX pic.twitter.com/3zZksAIeYj— GODZILLA.OFFICIAL (@Godzilla_Toho) September 8, 2026 Read more at Hypebeast

items.text: 125 Years Later, J. Press SS27 Continues to Evolve Its Vision of Ivy SummaryJ. Press’s SS27 collection honors its upcoming 125th anniversary by blending British heritage fabrics with modern collaborations.The brand introduced its first women’s collection in 50 years, adapting classic Ivy menswear staples into fresh silhouettes.On September 9, J. Press showcased its SS27 runway presentation at Capitale on Bowery—a former bank built in 1891 whose imposing stone facade faces the corner of Bowery and Broome St. The historic location, characterized by its rich interiors, provided an even grander effect than the venue for Jack Carlson’s sophomore collection at the New-York Historical Society last February. While last season focused on the J. Press re-edition of Take Ivy, this season looks ahead to the approaching 125th anniversary of J. Press, founded by Jacobi Press at Yale in 1902. At this milestone, the OG prep apparel purveyor has dug deep into its roots, highlighting the British provenance of Jacobi Press’s early designs while also looking ahead at the evolving face of Ivy.For the first time in 50 years, the brand designed a dedicated women’s collection, both introducing new silhouettes and emphasizing the way the brand has already been embraced by women. Standing out among the women’s looks was a midi dress with blue and gold stripes running horizontally on the bodice and vertically on the skirt. In a true Ivy League touch, a double-breasted blazer with golden buttons was worn over the shoulders. Other looks translated the brand’s men’s staples for women, echoing the prep aesthetic of NYC writer Fran Lebowitz: tweed blazers were styled with slacks, and shirts were worn with neckties and Fair Isle vests.In an official statement, Carlson shared, “It’s a great time for J. Press to relaunch women’s. I think there’s something in the air: ‘Ivy style’ is taking over the runway—though J. Press, of course, is the real thing. J. Press is synonymous with Ivy style. It’s a timeless, classic way of dressing, and it’s informed everything that’s happened in American fashion since. It hearkens back to a kinder, gentler, more erudite, more genteel time.”Much of what makes Ivy what it is has roots in the British Isles, from the Savile Row tailoring traditions of London to the far islands where native sheep still provide some of the world’s best wool. “He didn’t grow up with any of this British stuff. items.title: For TEN, "OUTWEST" and "IRL" Pair a Look Back With a Leap Forward
items.text: For TEN, "OUTWEST" and "IRL" Pair a Look Back With a Leap Forward TEN has spent ten years being watched, and "OUTWEST" and "IRL" are his attempt to be understood. The two songs arrive as one release, and that packaging is the argument: one of them reaches toward where he is going, the other circles back over the decade that got him here. On their own, each tells half a story. Side by side, they sketch the fuller shape of an artist opening a new chapter without pretending the earlier ones never happened.The neat read would be that "OUTWEST" is the future and "IRL" is the past, and TEN does not really dispute the split. "'IRL' looks back at my journey over the past 10 years, while 'OUTWEST' is more about where I am now," he says. What he resists is the idea that stepping forward means leaving anything behind. He frames the more exposed material as an addition rather than a correction, a way of widening the picture instead of replacing it. "I wanted to share something more intimate without making it feel like I was turning my back on my past," he says, and that refusal to disown the last decade is exactly why he wanted the two songs heard in one sitting rather than parceled out.The bigger change, though, is not what the songs say but how they got made. For the first time TEN was present from the opening idea, writing beside his collaborators instead of being handed a finished track to inhabit, and he treats that access as the whole difference. "Being in the room from the beginning gave me much more freedom to explore," he says. That freedom shows up most plainly on "OUTWEST", which slides between sounds without settling into a lane, a restlessness he traces straight back to temperament. "I've always been open to trying new things, and I don't like defining music by genre," he says. The track wanders because his head was wandering while he wrote it, chasing a mood he describes as "free, curious, and wanting to go somewhere I hadn't been before."If "OUTWEST" is TEN reaching outward, "IRL" is him letting the guard down, and he is aware that the trade is riskier. Audiences met the performer first, and the performer is a role he has no interest in retiring. What "IRL" does is set that role beside a plainer one. "With 'IRL,' I wanted to sing about myself and share a more personal side that people may not always get to see," he says. The timing is not incidental. The song doubles as a threshold for everything he is building next. "It's also the first single at ILLIM

items.title: Official Look at the Song for the Mute x adidas Adizero EVO SL “Dove Grey”
items.text: Official Look at the Song for the Mute x adidas Adizero EVO SL “Dove Grey” Name: Song for the Mute x adidas Adizero EVO SL “Dove Grey”Colorway: Dove Grey/Grey Two/Grey SixSKU: KJ0774MSRP: $180 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: adidasThe Song for the Mute x adidas Adizero EVO SL “Dove Grey” sneaker delivers a muted yet expressive iteration of the lightweight runner. Lightweight construction and a streamlined silhouette highlight the Adizero EVO SL’s performance heritage, while the artistic overlays bring a lifestyle‑driven narrative to the design.Breaking up the tonal grey palette is a series of oversized, childlike hand-drawn graphics that bring an organic, homegrown appeal to the technical runner. items.title: Artisans de Genève “Val Viola” Captures Nature’s Changing Colors
items.text: Artisans de Genève “Val Viola” Captures Nature’s Changing Colors Summary Artisans de Genève’s “Val Viola” Submariner personalization recreates alpine lake hues through hand‑guilloché.Features a moonphase complication in aventurine and mother‑of‑pearl.A brushed grey ceramic bezel frames the dial, balancing shimmering contrasts. Artisans de Genève has unveiled “Val Viola,” a bespoke timepiece personalization crafted for collector Mr. A.N.I., inspired by the shifting hues of an untouched alpine lake at dusk. Based on a client's personal Rolex Submariner (Ref. 116610), the bespoke project takes inspiration from the peaceful landscapes and sharp high-alpine contrasts of Val Viola, a remote valley nestled in the Rhaetian Alps.To recreate the memory of waters transitioning between turquoise, violet, and green under evening light, the workshop turned to traditional hand-guilloché. The centerpiece of the watch is a custom dial meticulously engraved by hand with a precise, relief-cut geometric motif that continuously transforms in tone and depth as light moves across its surface.Balancing the vibrant dial, the exterior architecture relies on subtle material contrast. The watch features a brushed grey ceramic bezel insert, chosen for its scratch-resistant properties and matte finish; rather than reflecting light, the ceramic absorbs it, framing the dial and allowing its shimmering guilloché reflections to take center stage. Adding poetic depth, a moonphase complication is visible through a clean aperture cut into the lower dial. Crafted from a glittering blue aventurine disc inset with a luminous mother-of-pearl moon, the complication echoes the alpine night sky while extending the timepiece's interplay of texture, light and natural landscape aesthetics.Limited strictly to this private commission, the Val Viola Submariner embodies the atelier’s ethos of “personal challenge” projects — where each customization is a dialogue between the client’s vision and the craftsman’s savoir‑faire. For more details, visit Artisans de Genève’s official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Tomorrowland's WR1 Sneaker Is Built to Live Beyond the Festival
items.text: Tomorrowland's WR1 Sneaker Is Built to Live Beyond the Festival Tomorrowland has unveiled the WR1, its first-ever sneaker and the newest way for its global community to carry a piece of the festival into everyday life. Developed over the course of more than a year, the shoe reads less like festival merch and more like something you would reach for on an ordinary Tuesday, built around soft, organic lines and a sole that looks to nature for its shape.The WR1's signature sits underfoot. Its sculpted sole unit takes its cue from the fine, radiating ridges found on the underside of a mushroom cap, translating those natural patterns into a form that curves and layers rather than sitting flat. That organic language runs up into the silhouette too, with flowing lines and stacked textures giving the shoe a soft, sculptural feel. Rather than chase a seasonal look, the design settles on a timeless shape Tomorrowland intends to keep in rotation year after year.For all that detail, this is a shoe made for everyday life, not a festival-only keepsake. It moves easily between settings, from a daytime walk across the city to a late night out, without ever announcing where it came from. The Tomorrowland name stays understated across the design, letting the shape carry the identity instead of an oversized logo.At its heart, though, the WR1 is about the people who wear it. Tomorrowland has always been less a festival than a community, a shared spirit of movement, connection and self-expression that its millions of fans carry long after the last set ends. The shoe is built for exactly that community, a way to keep the feeling of belonging close whether or not you make it to Belgium in a given year. It arrives in several versions too, leaving room for everyone to find the one that suits their own rhythm rather than fall in line behind a single house look. That range is the point: this is a sneaker meant to meet people where they are, and to sit alongside the fragrances, homeware and design pieces the community already folds into daily life as small, personal reminders of the connection they share.The sneaker caps a slow, deliberate build. What started 15-plus years ago with logo tees and caps has grown into a full lifestyle operation covering fashion, accessories, fragrance, wellness, homeware and design, with past collaborators including Grown Alchemist, Baobab Collection, Serax, Sarda and LOOP. items.title: Jaeger-LeCoultre Unveils Three High-Horology Masterpieces Showcasing Its Métiers Rares Craftsmanship
items.text: Jaeger-LeCoultre Unveils Three High-Horology Masterpieces Showcasing Its Métiers Rares Craftsmanship Summary Jaeger-LeCoultre unveils three high-horology releases: Master Hybris Artistica Calibre 945, Duometre Grande Sonnerie and 101 Secrets.Features a celestial Cosmotourbillon, grisaille enamel, and a 1,300-component Westminster chiming movement.The 101 Secrets high-jewelry edition houses the world’s smallest rectangular mechanical movement. Jaeger-LeCoultre has reaffirmed its title as "The Watchmaker of Watchmakers" with the unveiling of three exceptional limited-edition timepieces that showcase the pinnacle of haute horlogerie, celestial mechanics and high-jewelry gem setting.Leading the trio is the Master Hybris Artistica Calibre 945, an artistic reinterpretation of celestial timekeeping limited to just 5 pieces. Housed in a 45mm 18K white gold case, the timepiece captures the night sky above the Vallée de Joux through a multi-level domed dial executed in hand-crafted grisaille enamel — a 16th-century technique using Blanc de Limoges white enamel to create three-dimensional chiaroscuro effects over a midnight-blue background. The dial incorporates a Northern Hemisphere sky chart tracking real-time constellation positions alongside the 73-component flying Cosmotourbillon, which orbits the dial counter-clockwise once every sidereal day (23 hours, 56 minutes and 4 seconds). Completing the astronomical display is an integrated minute repeater that utilizes patented Cathedral crystal gongs and Trébuchet hammers to strike a pure, powerful chime.Reaching the pinnacle of chiming complexity, the Duometre Grande Complication à Grande Sonnerie debuts as a single-piece edition powered by an updated interpretation of Calibre 182. Built from 1,300 individual components across 15 complications, the 45mm 18K pink gold and titanium case houses a Westminster-style Grande and Petite Sonnerie that plays the four-note melody of Big Ben via four gongs and four hammers. The movement leverages the brand's dual-barrel Duometre system - separating timekeeping power from the chiming mechanism - and incorporates a flying tourbillon alongside a retrograde perpetual calendar that automatically adjusts for leap years until 2100. Acoustic enhancements include elongated metallic glass gongs and a titanium inner case, while a newly designed openworked blue-grey lacquered dial reveals the intricate strike sequence governors underneath.Rounding out the releases is a new iteration of the

items.title: The Barefoot-Inspired KEEN Jasper Merko Arrives in Three Understated Colorways
items.text: The Barefoot-Inspired KEEN Jasper Merko Arrives in Three Understated Colorways Name: KEEN Jasper MerkoMSRP: $135 USDRelease Date: September 3Where to Buy: KEENKEEN is reimagining its iconic climbing-inspired sneaker with the bold, ultra-minimal Jasper Merko. Designed to deliver a barefoot-inspired experience with a lighter environmental footprint, the shoe combines tried-and-true shoemaking techniques with groundbreaking sustainable solutions.Arriving in a stealthy black, muted grey and beige colorways, the upper is constructed from premium, responsibly sourced suede, utilizing a stitch-and-turn construction that creates a seamless, flexible fit that feels tailored directly to the foot. This heavily textured, low-profile sole wraps dynamically around the shoe's sidewalls, promoting natural movement and a more connected sensory experience. Staying true to its crag-culture roots, the silhouette features a generous original fit for natural toe splay and a distinctive lace-to-toe design.For durability and sustainability, the shoe employs KEEN.FUSION, bonding the upper to the sole using heat and pressure rather than toxic glues. items.title: Audio-Technica Releases the ATH-AL5NC, Its First Wireless Open-Back Headphones
items.text: Audio-Technica Releases the ATH-AL5NC, Its First Wireless Open-Back Headphones Summary Audio-Technica introduces its first wireless open-back headphone model, the ATH-AL5NCFeatures 53mm open-back drivers, multipoint Bluetooth pairing and up to 75 hours of continuous playbackCompanion app includes discrete modes for sound leakage reduction and low-latency gaming On September 9, 26, the audio engineers at Audio-Technica officially introduced the ATH-AL5NC Open-Back Wireless Headphones for $279 USD. The release marks the brand's first wireless open-back model. This launch introduces an uncommon pairing in the contemporary headphone market. Traditionally, open-back designs allow outside sound to pass through rather than sealing it off. While this continuous airflow naturally prevents true noise isolation and allows audio leakage, it presents sound more naturally and reduces physical heat buildup around the ears.To drive that natural acoustic profile, the device carries 53mm open-back drivers. For wireless fidelity, the ATH-AL5NC supports high-resolution 24-bit/96kHz audio streaming using LDAC, AAC and SBC codecs. Despite the substantial hardware, the physical footprint remains ergonomic. The headphones feature minimal clamping pressure for long-term comfort and weigh 240 grams. A built-in microphone handles everyday calls and wireless gaming sessions.Power management is a central focus of the release. Audio-Technica states the headphones offer up to 75 hours of continuous playback on a single full charge. When the dedicated noise reduction mode is active, the battery life provides 50 hours of playback. A rapid 15-minute quick charge adds eight hours of listening time if the battery runs dry. To manage multiple audio streams, the ATH-AL5NC integrates multipoint Bluetooth pairing to remain connected to two devices simultaneously.Users looking to mitigate the acoustic drawbacks of an open-back chassis can leverage the CONNECT app. The software interface allows listeners to customize their experience through EQ adjustments, codec selection and preset cycles. Furthermore, the app includes discrete modes tailored for low-latency gaming and sound leakage reduction. Physical controls allow users to activate the noise reduction mode via a tactile button on the right earcup. Rounding out the $279 USD package, the headphones include a carrying pouch and a 1.2-meter cable for wired connections. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Moncler Opens Its Largest Flagship on Fifth Avenue With a Made-to-Order Atelier
items.text: Moncler Opens Its Largest Flagship on Fifth Avenue With a Made-to-Order Atelier Summary Moncler opens its largest global flagship on Fifth Avenue across two full floors of Gilles & Boissier-designed spaceThe store debuts a New York-exclusive LoveFrom collection capsule and the brand's first Moncler to Measure made-to-order atelierA new AI-powered digital platform extends the flagship's styling tools online through 5th Ave on the Go Moncler has opened its largest global flagship on Fifth Avenue, a 23,680-square-foot, two-level space built through a two-decade design collaboration with French studio Gilles & Boissier. The store's architecture leans directly into the brand's mountain-meets-metropolis identity, translating that idea into scale, material choice, and structural detail rather than surface-level branding.Ceilings rise more than eight meters from the moment of entry, creating a sense of verticality that echoes both Moncler's alpine heritage and the skyscrapers surrounding the store. Monumental columns punctuate the interior, while a freestanding "curiosity cabin" is built to house rotating seasonal installations. The exterior glass facade is clad in Saint Williams granite and integrated with LED strips, producing a kinetic lighting effect designed to hold its own against the visual intensity of nearby Times Square.Inside, a signature checkerboard floor alternates between polished and raw textures, and that same stone material carries through the columns, arches, and walls to establish an earthy, consistent base beneath the more sculptural elements above it. Towering textured glass displays are built to resemble frozen waterfalls, while curated artworks and multimedia installations run throughout the space. A sculptural stonework centerpiece by Ugo Rondinone connects the two floors directly, anchoring the store's vertical layout with a mountainous physical presence, alongside additional works from Jean-Guillaume Mathiaut, Paul Bik, and Arno Declercq.The ground floor houses the latest Men's, Women's, and Enfant designs from the Moncler Collection main line, along with Moncler Genius co-creations and the brand's newest footwear. The second floor is dedicated entirely to Moncler Grenoble, spanning high-performance skiwear, goggles, après-ski pieces, and lightweight hiking and trekking layers, alongside partner products including Moncler Grenoble's interpretations of Stöckli skis, POC helmets, and WHITESPACE x Moncler Grenoble snowboards developed with

items.title: Not the End, Just “The Beginning”: ONE OK ROCK Closes Out the ‘DETOX’ Era
items.text: Not the End, Just “The Beginning”: ONE OK ROCK Closes Out the ‘DETOX’ Era The long road for ONE OK ROCK's DETOX tour reached its final destination on September 6, 2026, at Chiba’s ZOZO Marine Stadium. For the band and their fans, this closing run carried immense emotional weight — dubbed by many as "Taka’s redemption tour" after the frontman suffered an injury during night two at Nissan Stadium in 2025. Having spent the last 12 months conquering venues and drawing nearly 800,000 fans in 53 cities across the globe, the four-piece closed out their Japanese leg of arena dates and outdoor stadium shows by stepping onto the field in front of 40,000 roaring fans for the final night, determined to make this last stop their most triumphant performance yet.Masahiro YamadaKosuke ItoKosuke ItoKosuke ItoKosuke ItoKosuke ItoKosuke ItoExperiencing the show live out in the elements, amidst the unpredictable outdoor weather and a surging crowd, was nothing short of electric as ONE OK ROCK turned the open-air arena into an infectious, multi-sensory storm. Between the rain and the deafening roars from the field, every song expanded far beyond its studio recording; the acoustic rendition of "Delusion:All" hit with immense emotional weight, while stadium anthems like "We Are" swelled into life-affirming declarations that unified the entire venue.Just over an hour into the concert, the narrative took an ambitious turn with the arrival of YAO - the supergroup collective featuring Awich, CHICO CARLITO and Paledusk alongside ONE OK ROCK. Operating like a parallel story arc in an expanding creative universe, all members of YAO gathered on stage to ignite the stadium with their explosive debut track, “777,” before delivering a deeply moving performance of their second single, “FOR OKINAWA” -- which was only officially released just two days prior to the show. It was a striking testament to how the band’s creative vision continues to evolve without ever standing still.As the night progressed, it became clear that attending a ONE OK ROCK show also doubles as a collective session of therapy. Over two decades, their music has evolved beyond raw teenage angst into a deeply mature, introspective catharsis, where the fire and rage are carefully contained, but never diminished — spoken from the perspective of an older self reaching back to protect and guide a younger self. items.title: Cathay Pacific Teams up With Breitling for a Limited Avenger GMT Watch
items.text: Cathay Pacific Teams up With Breitling for a Limited Avenger GMT Watch Summary Breitling and Cathay Pacific launch the Avenger Automatic GMT 44 80th Anniversary Edition, limited to 300 pieces.Features a Cathay Jade Green dial, Brushwing logo, red GMT hand, and COSC‑certified Caliber 32.Offered with steel bracelet and green calfskin strap, priced at approx. $6,351 USD. Breitling has partnered with Hong Kong’s flagship carrier, Cathay Pacific, to unveil the Avenger Automatic GMT 44 Cathay Pacific 80th Anniversary Edition. Launched to commemorate eight decades of the airline's operations, the limited-edition timepiece merges Breitling’s long-standing aviation heritage with Cathay’s travel lifestyle legacy. Strictly capped at 300 pieces globally, the 44mm watch features a distinctive dial executed in Cathay’s signature Jade Green, accented by the airline's iconic Brushwing logo above 6 o'clock and a contrasting red GMT hand for tracking secondary time zones.The watch is defined by a dial in Cathay’s signature Jade Green, featuring Cathay's Brushwing logo positioned prominently above 6 o'clock. Housed in a 44mm stainless steel case measuring 12.05mm thick, it includes a bidirectional ratcheted bezel with 24-hour markings and crystal-protecting rider tabs, a ridged screw-down crown designed for gloved use, and an impressive water resistance rating of 30 ATM. For dual-timezone functionality, a red GMT hand pairs with the 24-hour bezel and rehaut to offer instant legibility for frequent flyers, while the date window sits at 3 o'clock.Powering the watch is the COSC-certified Breitling Caliber 32 automatic movement, operating at 28,800 vph with a 42-hour power reserve. Turning the watch over reveals a solid steel screwed caseback engraved with the Cathay Pacific logo, "80 YEARS TOGETHER," and an individual "ONE OF 300" limitation mark. Offered with both a three-row stainless steel bracelet featuring an on-the-fly micro-adjustable folding clasp and an interchangeable green military calfskin strap, the limited edition seamlessly transitions between cockpit utility and refined lifestyle aesthetic. Priced at $49,800 HKD (approx. $6,351 USD), the watch is available through Cathay Pacific. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: HOMME PLISSÉ ISSEY MIYAKE Reimagines Henri Matisse’s "The Snail" in Pleats
items.text: HOMME PLISSÉ ISSEY MIYAKE Reimagines Henri Matisse’s "The Snail" in Pleats Summary HOMME PLISSÉ ISSEY MIYAKE is set to launch its second "OPEN STUDIO" project at London’s Tate Modern on September 17, 2026.Inspired by Henri Matisse’s "The Snail," pleated garments emphasize rhythm, color, and movement. HOMME PLISSÉ ISSEY MIYAKE has unveiled its second “OPEN STUDIO” edition at Tate Modern, presenting a capsule collection inspired by Henri Matisse’s iconic 1953 cut-out work "The Snail."Building on the brand’s ongoing dialogue between art, design, and movement, the special activation brings Matisse’s dynamic geometric compositions to life through ISSEY MIYAKE's signature garment-pleating technology. Staged directly within Tate Modern, the installation highlights how structural design can bridge fine art and wearable form, creating a fluid, interactive space where visitors can witness the translation of abstract color blocks into three-dimensional, movement-focused garments.The capsule collection translates Matisse’s vibrant cut-paper composition into pleated garments that emphasize rhythm, color and motion. More than just reproducing the artwork as embellishment, the design team drew from Matisse’s process of cutting and arranging forms, aligning naturally with the brand’s philosophy of transformation through pleating.The capsule will be presented on September 16, 2026, inside Tate Modern’s The Tanks, the launch will include a site-specific dance performance that animates the garments within an architectural and performative setting. This approach underscores the brand’s long-standing connection between pleated clothing and performance, situating fashion within a broader cultural conversation. View this post on Instagram A post shared by HOMME PLISSÉ ISSEY MIYAKE (@hommeplisse_isseymiyake) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Larry June and adidas Originals Serve Up the Adistar Control 5 “Watermelon Smoothie”
items.text: Larry June and adidas Originals Serve Up the Adistar Control 5 “Watermelon Smoothie” Name: adidas Originals Adistar Control 5 “Watermelon Smoothie"Colorway: “Watermelon Smoothie"SKU: TBCMSRP: $160 USDRelease Date: September 12Where to Buy: adidasadidas Originals and Bay Area artist Larry June continue their collaborative partnership with the release of the Adistar Control 5 “Watermelon Smoothie.” Serving as the second colorway following an exclusive Friends & Family drop, this iteration reimagines the early-2000s runner through a fresh lifestyle lens.Inspired by June's personal health and wellness routines - specifically his ritual of making a watermelon smoothie - the design translates his West Coast intentionality into aesthetic cues. The "Watermelon Smoothie" colorway features an open white mesh base paired with layered tonal overlays, establishing a clean, breathable foundation. Its standout design element is a vibrant gradient finish that transitions fluidly through "Semi Lucid Red," "Semi Solar Slime" and Clay hues, directly mimicking the refreshing tones of its namesake beverage. Custom Larry June signature branding completes the upper, adding a personalized touch to the vintage-inspired silhouette. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Jacob & Co. Sets 54 Diamonds Directly Onto a Flying Tourbillon Balance Wheel
items.text: Jacob & Co. Sets 54 Diamonds Directly Onto a Flying Tourbillon Balance Wheel Summary Jacob & Co. unveils the Brilliant Flying Tourbillon Baguette Pastel Arlequino, a pièce unique priced at $693,000 USD.Features the first diamond‑set balance wheel in modern horology, with 54 brilliant‑cut diamonds. Jacob & Co. has unveiled the Brilliant Flying Tourbillon Baguette Pastel Arlequino, a one‑of‑a‑kind creation that pushes the boundaries of both high watchmaking and high jewelry.At the heart of this release is a world‑first innovation: the balance wheel is set with 54 brilliant‑cut white diamonds, creating a luminous halo effect as it oscillates at 21,600 vph in tandem with the flying tourbillon’s rotation. This technical achievement revives a forgotten chapter of horological history, proving that gem‑setting can be integrated into the regulating organ without compromising chronometric performance.The aesthetic language of the Pastel Arlequino is equally daring. Across the 42mm white gold case, dial, crown, and buckle, a total of 366 pastel sapphires and white diamonds are invisibly set, arranged in deliberate contrast rather than blended gradients. Inspired by the costume of Arlecchino from Italian commedia dell’arte, the composition places lavender beside pink, green beside blue, creating a vibrant yet harmonious surface. The proportions - 11.61mm in thickness - offer a more compact expression of Jacob & Co.’s Brilliant Collection, while maintaining its bold presence.Powering the watch is the Jacob & Co. Caliber JCFA02, a self‑winding movement with micro‑rotor and flying tourbillon, delivering a 72‑hour power reserve. The bridges are set with 234 brilliant‑cut diamonds, complementing the diamond‑set balance wheel, and the finishing reflects haute horlogerie standards. Limited to a pièce unique and priced at 693,000 USD, the Brilliant Flying Tourbillon Baguette Pastel Arlequino exemplifies Jacob & Co.’s philosophy of being “Inspired by the Impossible,” merging technical precision with audacious artistry. For more information, head over to Jacob & Co.’s official website. View this post on Instagram Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The A.PRESSE Dedicated Space by Gallery HBX Rebuild 1960s Space-Age Futurism
items.text: The A.PRESSE Dedicated Space by Gallery HBX Rebuild 1960s Space-Age Futurism Summary A.PRESSE opens a dedicated retail space with Gallery HBX built around a Space Age Retro Future conceptThe interior blends rosewood walls and brass fixtures with curated vintage furniture spanning the 1930s through the 1970sGallery HBX frames the space as a vision of the future as imagined by people in the 1960s and ‘70s A.PRESSE has opened a dedicated retail space with Gallery HBX, built entirely around a concept the gallery calls Space Age Retro Future. Rather than centering on new apparel alone, the space treats its own interior design as an extension of A.PRESSE's identity, reworking mid-century futurism into a setting built specifically for the brand's clothing.The interior is built from rosewood walls set beneath a wood louver ceiling, softened by wool carpets and melton curtains throughout the space. Garments are displayed on solid brass racks, a detail that ties the retail fixtures directly into the space's broader material palette rather than treating them as purely functional add-ons.Alongside the clothing displays, the space is furnished with a curated set of vintage pieces spanning several decades: a 1972 Percival Lafer MP-61 sofa, a pair of Brazilian armchairs, and patinated brass "A-lamp" sconces by Louis Poulsen dating back to the 1930s. Percival Lafer built his reputation designing furniture in Brazil known for rounded, sculptural forms that leaned into the same organic-futurist language that shaped space-age design more broadly, while Louis Poulsen has spent nearly a century producing lighting recognized for its sculptural brass and metal fixtures. Placed together, the pieces root the space's futuristic concept in objects that actually came out of the eras it's referencing, rather than newly built replicas.The concept is less a literal reference to outer space and more as "the future as imagined by people in the past," pointing to how 1960s and ‘70s audiences pictured what was ahead of them through rounded furniture, streamlined forms, and industrial materials. The gallery frames the space as an attempt to place A.PRESSE inside that same imagined future, reinterpreting those design cues through the brand's own contemporary clothing perspective rather than recreating the decades wholesale.That approach positions the space as a reconstruction rather than a period piece, taking design language born out of a specific moment in the 1960s and 70s and filtering it

items.title: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Already Generated $50 Million USD in Pre-Sales Three Months Before Its Release
items.text: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Already Generated $50 Million USD in Pre-Sales Three Months Before Its Release Summary Avengers: Doomsday has generated $50 million USD in domestic pre-sales three months ahead of its December 18 releaseMore than 70% of those sales are tickets for Disney's new Infinity Vision premium large-format certificationThe figures were revealed by Disney CFO Hugh Johnston at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference Avengers: Doomsday has already pulled in $50 million USD in domestic pre-sales, according to Disney via Variety, with three months still remaining before the film's December 18 theatrical release. The studio disclosed the figures as part of a broader update on the film's box office trajectory ahead of its debut.Of that $50 million USD total, Disney reported that more than 70% of pre-sales are specifically for Infinity Vision screenings, the studio's newly established certification for premium large-format theaters. Disney unveiled Infinity Vision at CinemaCon, touting the format as delivering "the biggest, brightest and most immersive cinematic experiences" for moviegoers, and the early pre-sale split suggests audiences are prioritizing that upgraded format over standard screenings well ahead of release.The figures were announced Wednesday by Hugh Johnston, Walt Disney Company senior executive vice president and chief financial officer, during a presentation at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference. Sharing pre-sale data this far ahead of a release, and doing so through a financial conference rather than a traditional marketing push, underscores how central Doomsday's opening weekend performance is to Disney's near-term outlook.Anthony and Joe Russo direct the film, which brings together the Avengers, Fantastic Four, Thunderbolts, and the original X-Men for a story centered on Victor Von Doom. Robert Downey Jr. returns to the franchise in that role after Tony Stark's death in Avengers: Endgame, joined by Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Paul Rudd, Letitia Wright, Sebastian Stan, Tom Hiddleston, and Simu Liu reprising their MCU roles.Avengers: Doomsday opens in theaters December 18. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Formula 1 Takes to the Streets of Madrid for the Inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the New City Circuit
items.text: Formula 1 Takes to the Streets of Madrid for the Inaugural Spanish Grand Prix at the New City Circuit Summary Formula 1 debuts the Madrid street circuit for the Spanish Grand Prix this weekendThe track layout features 23 corners and spans city roads and countryside connected by highway tunnelsFormula 3 testing ahead of the event resulted in 19 red flags and five destroyed chassis Formula 1 brings the Spanish Grand Prix to the capital this weekend at the newly constructed Madrid street circuit. Located within city limits in the north-eastern suburbs, the venue follows a strategy of building street circuits in high-profile international cities. Much like additions in Miami and Las Vegas, the site was designed to maximize corporate hospitality opportunities. This focus on accessibility via the nearby airport and metro station allows for high fan attendance without the logistical delays common at rural European tracks. High-end hospitality options include two prime pit garages located between the Red Bull and Mercedes teams reserved for a Gordon Ramsey restaurant.The track operates as a hybrid of environments. Half of the circuit runs on active roads around the IFEMA exhibition complex while the rest sits in the surrounding countryside. Connecting these sections required routing the cars underneath a dividing highway through a pair of tunnels. Drivers navigate 23 corners, a figure evaluated by Lando Norris in a simulator. McLaren boss Andrea Stella stated that the layout features more corners and high-speed chicanes than the street track in Jeddah. A signature feature called La Monumental was engineered to be bigger and faster than the banking at Zandvoort.Aggressive track design produced consequences during recent testing. A two-day Formula 3 test at the Madrid street circuit resulted in 19 red flags and five entirely written-off chassis. Ferrari team boss Fred Vasseur noted that the track surface was noticeably bumpy during those sessions. Alex Albon likened the unforgiving layout to Macau and predicted that there will be no overtaking during the race. With Formula 2 and Formula 3 races on the weekend schedule, the barriers are likely to see heavy action.Ferrari is the only team holding real-world mileage at the track heading into the weekend. The Scuderia used one of its two seasonal filming days to run Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc on Pirelli demo tires across a dirty track surface. Carlos Sainz Jr. has also been involved in promoting the Madrid stree

items.title: Lionel Messi Reaches a Deal to Become the Majority Owner of La Liga 2 Club CD Eldense
items.text: Lionel Messi Reaches a Deal to Become the Majority Owner of La Liga 2 Club CD Eldense Summary Lionel Messi reaches a preliminary agreement to become the majority shareholder of La Liga 2 side CD EldenseThis Alicante-based club announced the pending acquisition amid a coaching shakeup and a turbulent start to their seasonThe takeover expands the 39-year-old forward's growing Spanish football portfolio following his international retirement Following his retirement from the international stage, Lionel Messi is expanding his footprint in the Spanish football hierarchy. The 39-year-old forward, currently playing for Inter Miami, formally reached a preliminary agreement to become the majority shareholder of CD Eldense. Announced by the second-division club on September 9, 2026, the pending acquisition signals a massive power move for the Argentine icon. This boardroom pivot arrives during a transitional phase for the player, coming just after he finished his international career following Argentina's heartbreaking 1-0 defeat to Spain in the 2026 World Cup final. Instead of fading into the twilight of his playing days, Messi is reshaping his post-pitch legacy by increasing his investments within the Spanish sporting ecosystem.The blueprint for the high-profile takeover is in motion, though the final paperwork is not yet complete. This transaction involves Messi acquiring the controlling club shares currently owned by Grupo TH Soluciones. Navigating the bureaucratic requirements of a professional franchise requires a standard due diligence process alongside an array of other vital legal and contractual procedures. Outside of the boardroom agreements, the acquisition requires formal authorization from the Spanish National Sports Council (CSD) before the star can take full control of the organization.Messi inherits a complex rebuilding project, as the Alicante-based club is currently navigating a turbulent start to their campaign in La Liga 2. At the time of the ownership announcement, CD Eldense sat in 20th place in the standings with a mere two points from four games. Internal pressure has already sparked operational shifts; earlier in the week that the preliminary agreement went public, the squad parted ways with head coach Claudio Barragan. Despite the front-office shakeup, the CD Eldense first team is preparing for an upcoming match against Real Sporting de Gijón.This impending takeover represents the second major Spanish football club that Messi has invested

items.title: ‘South Park’ Creators Apologize for Long Delay of Kendrick Lamar Film Collab ‘Whitney Springs’
items.text: ‘South Park’ Creators Apologize for Long Delay of Kendrick Lamar Film Collab ‘Whitney Springs’ Summary Trey Parker and Matt Stone apologize for delaying their Kendrick Lamar film collaborationThe musical comedy, working title 'Whitney Springs,' is in production at Paramount under Parker and Stone's Park County bannerLamar produces alongside Dave Free's pgLang, with plot details still evolving across reports South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone are addressing the yearslong delay on their film collaboration with Kendrick Lamar, issuing a formal apology to their production partners as the project continues moving through Paramount. The musical comedy, currently known under the working title Whitney Springs, has been in development for years without a confirmed release timeline.Whitney Springs is being produced at Paramount, the same studio behind South Park, with Parker and Stone working through their Park County banner. Kendrick Lamar produces alongside Dave Free through their pgLang company, putting two high-profile creative outfits behind a project that has yet to land a release date.Parker and Stone addressed the delay directly in a statement to The Ankler. "We take full responsibility for the schedule delay of this movie," they said. "We apologize to our partners at pgLang and Paramount, and we appreciate their patience. 'South Park' and life's circumstances have gotten in the way, but we still believe in the project." Reps for Paramount, Parker, and Stone did not immediately respond to Variety's request for further comment.Details on the film's plot have shifted depending on the source. Early loglines described a Black man working as a slave reenactor at a living history museum who discovers that his white girlfriend's family once owned his ancestors. According to The Ankler, however, the story has moved toward the reenactor clashing with a racist mayor of a Midwestern town, a role reportedly set to be played by Parker himself. The outlet also reported that Lamar has recorded several original songs for the project, tying his music career directly into the film beyond a producing credit. items.title: The ‘Nintendo Switch Sports Resort’ Turns Wuhu Island Into a Fully Explorable Open World
items.text: The ‘Nintendo Switch Sports Resort’ Turns Wuhu Island Into a Fully Explorable Open World Summary 'Nintendo Switch Sports Resort' expands its predecessor's lineup to 12 motion-controlled sports plus a jump rope warm-upThe game brings back Wuhu Island as a fully explorable resort, reviving a hallmark of Wii Sports ResortPlayers can compete or cooperate online using customizable Sportsmate or classic Mii characters Nintendo is bringing its motion-controlled sports library to Nintendo Switch 2 with Nintendo Switch Sports Resort, a follow-up that significantly expands on the original Switch Sports while pulling directly from Wii Sports Resort's format. The game arrives as one of Switch 2's more nostalgia-driven exclusives, built around the same pick-up-and-play appeal that made its Wii predecessor a fixture of the console generation.The roster spans 12 sports played with Joy-Con 2 motion controls: boxing, table tennis, archery, tennis, volleyball, bowling, basketball, golf, thumb wrestling, skateboarding, power cruising, and prop plane flying, alongside a jump rope activity used as a warm-up. Most events use one or two Joy-Con 2 controllers for motion input, though skateboarding offers an alternative mouse-control option, giving players more than one way to approach the same sport.Outside of the sports themselves, the game brings back Wuhu Island as an explorable resort space, letting players fly a prop plane between activities rather than jumping straight from menu to menu. On the technical side, Nintendo Switch Sports Resort supports both tabletop and TV modes, HDR on compatible displays, and surround sound, while online play for up to four players requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership and syncs progress through Save Data Cloud support.That expanded scope directly answers one of the bigger criticisms of the original Switch Sports, which launched with a noticeably smaller event list and no real exploration layer. Reintroducing Wuhu Island and nearly doubling the sports count positions Switch Sports Resort as a more complete successor to Wii Sports Resort's format rather than a scaled-down reboot, giving longtime fans of the Wii-era games a more direct equivalent on modern hardware.Players build out either a customizable Sportsmate character or a traditional Mii to use across every event, letting the same avatar carry over between separate sports rather than resetting between games.Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launches exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 o

items.title: The Suzhou Museum of Contemporary Art Is Officially Open
items.text: The Suzhou Museum of Contemporary Art Is Officially Open Summary The 60,000-square-meter Suzhou Museum of Contemporary Art is officially opened.Designed by BIG, the 12-pavilion complex reimagines traditional Chinese garden layouts with ribbon-like roofs.Inaugural programming features a major Picasso exhibition and BIG's Materialism installation. The Suzhou Museum of Contemporary Art has officially opened on the shores of Jinji Lake, marking a milestone as BIG – Bjarke Ingels Group’s first completed art museum. Conceived as a 60,000 m² “village” of 12 interconnected pavilions beneath a ribbon‑like roof, the design draws inspiration from Suzhou’s historic gardens and their lang "廊," or covered corridors. Visitors move through a continuous route that links galleries, gathering spaces, and cultural venues, while bridges and tunnels above and below ground create a flexible sequence of experiences shaped by exhibitions and seasons.Celebrating its grand opening, Suzhou MoCA debuted an expansive inaugural arts program spanning cross-cultural dialogue, technology-driven practices, and contemporary surveys. Headlining the launch is Picasso and the World of His Influence, a major exhibition exploring the legendary artist's lasting impact across the globe, alongside a comprehensive survey of contemporary Chinese art. Furthermore, BIG’s own Materialism exhibition - which previously served as a preview installation - remains on view, guiding visitors through a tactile journey of ten different materials from stone to recyclate that shape the firm’s architectural portfolio. The Suzhou Museum of Contemporary Art is now officially open for public visitation in China's Jiangsu province. For more information, head over to the museum’s official website. items.title: Uchronia Brings Fluid Curves and Glitter Finishes to Tiptoe’s Signature Furniture
items.text: Uchronia Brings Fluid Curves and Glitter Finishes to Tiptoe’s Signature Furniture Summary Tiptoe x Uchronia unveil their "DAYDREAM" collection at Paris Design Week 2026, reworking Tiptoe’s iconic furniture.The collection features wave‑like contours and four exclusive colors blending art and function.Launch at Grand Palais, highlighting sustainability and emotional design innovation. French furniture brand Tiptoe and Parisian multidisciplinary collective Uchronia have joined forces to unveil "DAYDREAM," a vibrant collaborative collection debuting at the Grand Palais during Paris Design Week. Showcased within Uchronia's monumental "Le Grand Bouquet" installation, the capsule blends two distinct design philosophies: Tiptoe’s renowned industrial utility and Uchronia’s deeply poetic, sensory-driven universe.Described by Uchronia founder Julien Sebban as a "sensory, colour-driven journey," the "DAYDREAM" concept envisions a suspended dream state where everyday objects break free from their rigid forms, allowing contours to soften and colors to become a highly expressive, emotional language.Aesthetically, the collection transforms Tiptoe's signature steel hardware through a profound exploration of organic volume and vivid pigmentation. In stark contrast to the strictly geometric, minimalist lines that have defined Tiptoe's previous industrial iterations, this new capsule introduces fluid, wave-like curves inspired by the movement of water. This undulating motif softens the brand's historically rigid silhouettes, elevating functional homeware into sensory art objects. The visual language is further anchored by a bespoke palette of four exclusive, mood-inspired shades: a vibrant Magma Orange, a soft Ice Cream Beige, a nostalgic Chocolate Brown, and an Astral Purple that is uniquely flecked with fine stardust-like glitter to invite contemplation.Color plays a defining role in the collaboration, with Uchronia developing a palette of four exclusive shades: Magma Orange, a vibrant signature hue; Ice Cream Beige, soft and luminous; Astral Violet, deep with pearlescent highlights; and Chocolate Brown, nostalgic and comforting. These tones are applied across reworked surfaces and sculpted wood tabletops, each ripple carefully cut to respect the grain and natural nobility of the material. The result is a collection that feels both playful and contemplative, inviting users to experience furniture as part of an inner landscape. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Josh Hartnett Battles a Terrifying Sea Creature in Upcoming Netflix Series 'Below'
items.text: Josh Hartnett Battles a Terrifying Sea Creature in Upcoming Netflix Series 'Below' Summary Netflix has released the official trailer for its upcoming limited drama series 'Below'Josh Hartnett stars as a Newfoundland fisherman confronting a deadly sea creature lurking off the coastCreated by Jesse McKeown the six-part thriller debuts October 8 following its TIFF premiere Netflix has officially unveiled the trailer for its upcoming drama series, Below. The six-part limited series stars Josh Hartnett and is set to make its world premiere at the Toronto International Film Festival before launching on the streaming platform.Set off the coast of Newfoundland, the story follows Calvin Penney (Hartnett), a stubborn small-town fisherman haunted by the mysterious death of his father decades prior. When a terrifying, unidentified sea creature begins terrorizing the local waters, Calvin is forced into action. He teams up with a visiting marine researcher (Mackenzie Davis) to protect his son Wade (Charlie Heaton) and his community, racing to uncover the island's buried secrets before it's too late.Created by Jesse McKeown, the project blends local mythology, suspense, and humor to explore deeper themes of family, community, and change. The ensemble cast features Ruby Stokes, Kaleb Horn, Rohan Campbell, and Willow Kean. Executive production is handled by Jessica Rhoades, Chris Hatcher, Jamie Childs, Louise Sutton, Sharon Hall, and Hartnett.Below will officially launch globally on Netflix on October 8, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast
