items.text: Lil Wayne Officially Joins the 'Fortnite' Icon Series Summary Lil Wayne is officially joining the 'Fortnite' Icon Series starting September 12The release features custom Outfits alongside themed Back Blings Pickaxes Gliders Emotes and Jam TracksPlayers can compete in the Weezy Icon Cup on September 12 to earn select cosmetic items early Fortnite and Lil Wayne have officially partnered to bring the hip-hop legend to the Fortnite Icon Series. Releasing amidst his ongoing tour for Tha Carter VI, the virtual collaboration introduces themed Outfits, Emotes, and reactive cosmetics to the game.The drop features two main cosmetics: the "Lil Wayne Outfit," which showcases gold graffiti that glows and pulses to the beat alongside toggleable sunglasses, and the "Weezy Outfit," incorporating an ember reactive style with a toggleable tank top, hat, and sunglasses. Matching accessories include the Milli Bricks Back Bling—a stack of gold bricks forming the Young Money logo—and the flaming Weezy Board Back Bling paired with the dual-wield Weezy Boardbreaker Pickaxe.Rounding out the release is the Young Money Stage Glider featuring pyrotechnic effects, choreographed "Lollipop" and "6 Foot 7 Foot" Emotes with Las Vegas-inspired lighting, and three Jam Tracks ("Lollipop," "A Milli," and "6 Foot 7 Foot"). Ahead of the store drop, players can compete in the Solo Battle Royale or Solo Zero Build Weezy Icon Cup on September 12 to earn the Weezy Outfit and Weezy Board Back Bling early, while all participants receive the YM Emoticon.The Lil Wayne Fortnite Icon Series collection will be available in the Fortnite Item Shop from September 12 at 8 p.m. ET through September 21. items.title: 'Avatar: Seven Havens' Introduces South Asian-Inspired Earthbender Pavi in New Trailer
items.text: 'Avatar: Seven Havens' Introduces South Asian-Inspired Earthbender Pavi in New Trailer Summary Paramount+ has released a new trailer and episode roll-out plan for 'Avatar: Seven Havens'The animated series will drop in three-episode weekly batches from October 9 through October 30 2026Co-creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko helm the South Asian-inspired Earthbender storyline Paramount+ and Avatar Studios have officially released a new trailer and episode release schedule for Avatar: Seven Havens. The upcoming Avatar: The Last Airbender sequel series is set to premiere on October 9, 2026.Created by franchise masterminds Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko, the animated series adopts a batch release model, dropping three episodes weekly each Friday through October 30. Set in a cataclysmic world, the story introduces Pavi (voiced by Saheli Khan), a young Earthbender who succeeds Avatar Korra, alongside her long-lost twin Nisha (Aishu Devan) as they navigate threats from both humans and spirits across the Seven Havens.Drawing heavy inspiration from South Asian culture and Sanskrit traditions, the project features a core voice cast including Akshay Khanna, Major Curda, Sakina Jaffrey, Darren Barnet, Dianne Doan, and Dee Bradley Baker. Paramount+ has already greenlit a 13-episode second book for the series ahead of its debut.Avatar: Seven Havens officially debuts its first three episodes on October 9, 2026, exclusively on Paramount+. First reported by Mario Briguglio, the collaborative project marks the artist’s debut MADE in USA release, drawing direct inspiration from his nostalgic experience attending the MESD Outdoor School program as a sixth grader in Oregon.Constructed in rich shades of reddish brown, the upper combines breathable mesh, premium suede, and patent leather overlays. The hangtag can be decorated with an included set of charms shaped like a frog, compass, whistle, slug, and fish. Completing the release, the shoe box is specially designed to mimic a traditional fishing tackle box.The Aminé x New Balance 992 "Outdoor School" officially drops on October 2, 2026, for $220 USD exclusively via Club Banana. items.title: McLaren Reveals Plans for an 810 HP Hybrid P34 Supercar, an SUV, and a Luxury Brand Overhaul
items.text: McLaren Reveals Plans for an 810 HP Hybrid P34 Supercar, an SUV, and a Luxury Brand Overhaul Summary McLaren briefed retailers on a future product roadmap highlighted by a new 810-horsepower hybrid V-6 supercarThe automaker plans to ditch its clinical dealership aesthetic to mimic luxury fashion boutiques like Gucci and Louis VuittonA long-rumored SUV and a front-engined grand tourer are slated for release further down the production timeline McLaren is officially drawing up the blueprint for its next era, pivoting its identity from a performance manufacturer to a lifestyle powerhouse. During a recent confidential briefing with its retail network, the British automaker outlined a future product roadmap alongside sweeping changes to its brand aesthetic. Showroom floor transformations represent the most immediate cultural shift. Dealerships are slated for a massive redesign, ditching their current Apple-store-like aesthetic in favor of the opulent ambiance found in luxury fashion stores like Gucci, Louis Vuitton or Burberry. This transformation of retail spaces represents a deliberate strategic pivot to reposition McLaren against high-end lifestyle brands by relying on elite luxury aesthetics rather than just track-day supremacy.The tip of the spear for this incoming product wave is a highly anticipated mid-engined supercar currently operating under the code-named P34. Expected to arrive next summer, the vehicle will be propelled by a hybridized twin-turbo V-6 powertrain. This setup is similar to the system found in the Artura, effectively moving the brand away from its long-lived V-8 engine. Despite the shift in configuration, the output remains entirely uncompromising. The upcoming P34 will reportedly push out approximately 810 horsepower and 800 pound-feet of torque. Slated to slot cleanly between the Artura and the 750S in the McLaren vehicle lineup, the hybrid supercar is expected to carry a starting price of around $310,000, deliberately undercutting the MSRP of the 750S.To match the company's new lifestyle directive, the P34 aims to deliver serious physical and technological upgrades. The exterior shape of the new supercar will reportedly be longer and more dramatic than the current Artura profile. Inside the cabin, the automaker is leaning heavily into its luxury-focused identity. New leather seats and an array of updated LED screens will outfit the interior of the P34, a direct maneuver to better compete with rival high-end luxury brands. Anticipati

items.text: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto x The Weeknd Unearth an Unreleased Saeko Tsuemura Drawing for New Collab Summary WILDSIDE YOHJI YAMAMOTO and The Weeknd have built a five-piece capsule around a previously unreleased illustration by Saeko TsuemuraThe range runs from cotton jersey up to a Japanese-made cow leather jacket and a triacetate crepe de chine tailored jacketA special brooch and printed graphic combining the WILDSIDE and XO logos ties the pieces together WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto has released a five-piece collaboration with The Weeknd marking his "After Hours Til Dawn Tour," built around a previously unreleased illustration by artist Saeko Tsuemura. Rather than keeping the artwork on jersey, the capsule carries it across five very different constructions, from a printed tee up to tailoring and outerwear made in Japan.The leather jacket sits at the top of the range and is the most substantial piece here. It is cut from 100% cow leather in a free size, with polyester padding and a cotton lining, and it puts Tsuemura's illustration across the back as a print. A brooch combining the WILDSIDE and XO logos fastens at the collar, which is a notably different approach to branding than a stitched or printed label.The two-button tailored collar jacket handles the same graphic in a lighter register. Its body is a triacetate and polyester crepe de chine, blended at 57% and 43%, a fabric chosen for its low weight, resistance to creasing and restrained sheen, with a cupro lining underneath. The lapel takes the same logo brooch, and the piece is offered in two sizes rather than the free sizing used elsewhere in the capsule.The rayon shirt inverts the layout. Here the Tsuemura print moves to the front while the back carries the combined WILDSIDE and XO logo, and the printing method leaves a hard contrast between the ground colour and the figure, which is where the piece earns most of its visual weight. It is made in Japan in a single free size.The two jersey pieces handle the graphic most directly. The pullover hoodie, made in the USA from 100% cotton, places the illustration large across the back with the logo graphic sitting small at the left chest, and the short sleeve tee repeats that configuration in Vietnamese-made cotton. Both back graphics fold the tour title into Tsuemura's artwork rather than printing it separately.The choice of artwork is what gives the capsule its depth. items.title: MegaHouse's Life-Size ‘Chainsaw Man’ Pochita Doll Barks, Revs and Stares Back at You
items.text: MegaHouse's Life-Size ‘Chainsaw Man’ Pochita Doll Barks, Revs and Stares Back at You Summary MegaHouse is adding Pochita from Chainsaw Man to its Life Size Doll seriesThe doll reproduces the character at roughly 600mm and is made chiefly from polyesterA five-sound audio unit sits inside the body and activates when the doll's back is stroked MegaHouse is producing a Life Size Doll rendition of Pochita from Chainsaw Man. The series is built on the premise of a doll that stays close to its owner's daily life, and this entry reproduces the character at life-size scale, standing roughly 600mm as a high-end doll rather than a display statue.Articulation is handled through joint parts set into both the arms and the legs, each of which can be adjusted to hold a chosen angle. The tail is built as an interactive element to be pulled rather than a fixed appendage, and the sculpt concentrates its detail around the face, where a plump, rounded mouth sits at the base of the character's blade.The sound gimmick is the centrepiece. Stroking the doll's back plays Pochita's vocalisations, including a bark and a low mechanical churn, and the unit holds five sounds in total with engine noise among them. Power comes from three AAA batteries, sold separately, and the box contains the doll body with its five-sound audio unit plus an instruction manual.Attention has also gone into the eyes, which are large and glossy enough to catch the reflection of whoever is looking down at the doll. MegaHouse frames the piece around that kind of proximity, pitching it as something to keep beside you while eating jam-covered bread or playing games in your room.The Life Size Doll Pochita is slated for late February 2027 and is open for pre-order now, with orders closing November 1, and delivery scheduled for early March 2027. items.title: Tommy Hilfiger Reimagines Heritage Prep at The Plaza Hotel for Spring 2027
items.text: Tommy Hilfiger Reimagines Heritage Prep at The Plaza Hotel for Spring 2027 Summary Tommy Hilfiger has debuted its Spring 2027 Plaza Prep collection at The Plaza Hotel during New York Fashion WeekThe presentation remixed classic collegiate prep with altered proportions washed suedes and '90s-inspired footwearGigi Hadid opened the runway show alongside an all-star front row and a finale performance by Slayyyter Tommy Hilfiger has officially unveiled its Spring 2027 "Plaza Prep" collection with a runway show staged at The Plaza Hotel during New York Fashion Week. Drawing inspiration from four decades of New York street style, the presentation brought modern prep to the landmark address's Palm Court and Terrace Room.The collection remixes heritage prep icons through bold color shifts and dynamic proportions. Primary red, white, and blue tones are refreshed alongside vivid yellow and green hues across color-blocked rugby dresses, Ithaca stripe Oxford shirting, and tartan plaid blazers. Polos alternate between shrunken and oversized fits accented by micro-embroidered crests, while chinos are reworked into high-cut hot shorts and twisted-seam trousers. Faded Tommy Flag motifs adorn superfine suede jackets, silk-cashmere knitwear, and voluminous totes. Grounding the looks, footwear introduces '90s-inspired two-tone skate sneakers, boat shoes, penny loafers, and leather pool slides.Gigi Hadid opened the runway presentation, which brought together an eclectic crowd including Kate Moss, Camila Cabello, JISOO, Patrick Schwarzenegger, Carmelo Anthony, and Arón Piper. Accompanied by the Matt Jones Orchestra, the presentation closed with Romeo Beckham walking the final look followed by a surprise performance by pop artist Slayyyter.The Tommy Hilfiger "Plaza Prep" collection will officially release for the Spring 2027 season. items.title: Toyota Gazoo Racing Releases the $2,500 USD GR KART to Bring Motorsport to Everyday Families
items.text: Toyota Gazoo Racing Releases the $2,500 USD GR KART to Bring Motorsport to Everyday Families Summary Toyota Gazoo Racing launches the $2,500 entry-level GR KART to make motorsports accessibleThe 215-cc vehicle features a space-saving design specifically built for vertical storageSales are currently exclusive to select tracks and official GR Garages within Japan Toyota Gazoo Racing has released the GR KART to democratize the track. The entry-level vehicle costs approximately $2,500 USD and makes motorsports accessible to families. This release follows the vision of Toyota Motor Corporation chairman Akio Toyoda to make grassroots racing as simple as baseball or soccer. By delivering a transportable design, the company eliminates logistical hurdles that previously restricted kart ownership. Lowering equipment barriers allows families to maintain a racing hobby without the logistical overhead usually required for professional circuits.Built to accommodate a wide range of statures, the 183-pound GR KART features a 215-cc engine. A tilting steering wheel and adjustable pedals allow the chassis to be shared across a family. Ergonomic adjustments ensure the vehicle fits drivers ranging from 135 to 185 centimeters tall.Engineering breakthroughs allow the GR KART to solve complex storage problems. Owners can slide the vehicle into Toyota Noah and Voxy minivans without any disassembly. Vertical storage becomes possible through a specially developed fuel system and oil catch tank. These components allow the machine to stand on its end without leaking gasoline or engine oil.Modernized upkeep keeps drivers on the asphalt rather than performing maintenance in a garage. An advanced belt-drive system with an automatic tensioner eliminates messy chain maintenance and periodic adjustments. Newcomers receive support through a dedicated GR app that provides instructional material. Every purchase includes a digital driver's passport for immediate access to participating tracks without a separate license.Sales of the vehicle are currently restricted to the Japanese market. Toyota distributes the product through 36 kart tracks and seven official GR Garage locations across the country. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘GTA VI Online’ Could Have a 32-Player Format
items.text: ‘GTA VI Online’ Could Have a 32-Player Format Summary A Rockstar statement submitted to an employment tribunal in Edinburgh references employees discussing a 32-player online format for GTA VIThe filing stops short of confirming the figure as a launch specification, saying only that it was discussed and highly confidentialThe same statement lays out the measures Rockstar says it takes to keep gameplay details from leaving the building Rockstar Games has inadvertently put a number to GTA VI Online. A statement the studio submitted to an employment tribunal in Edinburgh, where Dexerto reports that 31 former employees are challenging their dismissals, describes staff discussing "an online 32 player format" for a confidential project in a private Discord server, and characterises game features as belonging among the company's most closely guarded secrets.The precise wording matters more than the number. The filing establishes that a 32-player format existed as a topic of internal conversation and that the detail was treated as highly confidential at the time it was raised. It does not state that 32 players will be the ceiling when the mode ships, nor does it describe the figure as final, so anyone reading it as a hard specification is reading past what the document actually says. One staff member is described in the statement as having found the Discord discussion extraordinarily alarming, which says more about how the information was classified internally than about the feature itself.The monitoring side is staffed rather than automated. The studio reportedly maintains five full-time investigators and a director dedicated to tracking potential leaks, and it fitted privacy film to its office windows after drones were allegedly used to photograph the interior of its buildings. Rockstar set the standard it is working to directly in the statement, which reads that "Guarding the secrets of the unique gameplay and design are akin to Apple protecting the iPhone or Coke protecting its formula."For now, that posture makes the tribunal filing an unusually direct source on a mode Rockstar has said little about. Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier has stated that the studio has no plans to discuss what GTA VI Online will look like any time soon, which leaves a court document as the most concrete reference point available.Rockstar describes its internal security culture as being comparable to Apple’s. Visitors must sign NDAs, photography is strictly prohibited, contractors

items.title: The Nike Air Monarch Trades Leather for Suede in Two Gum-Soled Holiday Colorways
items.text: The Nike Air Monarch Trades Leather for Suede in Two Gum-Soled Holiday Colorways Name: Nike Air Monarch Suede PackColorway: Cacao Wow/Gum Medium Brown, Black/Gum Medium BrownSKU: IB2281-200, IB2281-001MSRP: $100 USDRelease Date: Holiday 2026Nike is giving the Air Monarch a material rework for Holiday 2026, rolling out a two-pair pack that moves the trainer from leather onto suede. The pack pairs a tonal brown “Cacao Wow” build with a “Black” version, and both sit on gum outsoles rather than the model's more familiar white tooling.Suede covers the majority of both uppers, which changes how the Monarch reads more than any panel reshuffle would. Where leather gives the shoe its slick, uniform sheen, the nap here absorbs light and softens the overlays, pushing a trainer built for function toward something closer to a seasonal boot finish.Colour is handled differently across the two. The Cacao Wow pair runs brown from the upper straight through the midsole, so the whole shoe holds one register until the gum tooling arrives underneath. The Black version keeps the upper and midsole dark, which lets the Gum Medium Brown outsole do the work of breaking up the block and reads as the higher-contrast of the two.What the pack does not do is touch the shape; the Monarch's bulky, layered profile is carried over as is. This release keeps the proportions the model has always had and lets the fabrication account for the difference. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: House of Errors Packs 1,500,000 Stitches Into the Jacket Leading "The Paint Collection"
items.text: House of Errors Packs 1,500,000 Stitches Into the Jacket Leading "The Paint Collection" Summary House of Errors has built its most detailed capsule yet around paint splatters rendered entirely in embroideryThe lead jacket carries 1,500,000 individual stitches while the matching carpenter jeans hold 1,150,000A hoodie, two caps, two knitted rugbys and a tee complete the eight-piece lineup House of Errors has released The Paint Collection, a Fall/Winter 2026 capsule in which every paint splatter is stitched rather than printed or dyed. The London label has scaled up a concept it first tested on a single hero piece from its 6 Year Anniversary collection, expanding it into a full run of garments where the artwork exists as thread.The Embroidered Paint Workwear Jacket sets the benchmark at 1,500,000 individual stitches. Beyond the embroidery, it runs a brown corduroy collar, a YKK zip and bespoke hardware developed for the capsule. The Embroidered Carpenter Jeans follow with 1,150,000 threads and the same custom hardware, putting both halves of the set above a million stitches apiece.The detail work does not stop at the splatter itself. Each paint colour is embroidered with its own contrasting pattern, worked at a scale that only becomes legible when the garment is viewed up close. From a distance the effect reads as a single splash; step closer and the surface breaks into separate textures, which is where the capsule makes its case for embroidery over a printed alternative.Around the two-piece set, the range extends to an Embroidered Paint Hoodie in Grey, two Vintage Paint Caps, a pair of Knitted Wall Paint Rugbys in Cream and Grey, and a Paint Splatter Tee.The Paint Collection is available now via House of Errors. items.title: Sacha Baron Cohen to Star in Quentin Tarantino's Debut Stage Play 'The Popinjay Cavalier'
items.text: Sacha Baron Cohen to Star in Quentin Tarantino's Debut Stage Play 'The Popinjay Cavalier' Summary Sacha Baron Cohen will star in Quentin Tarantino’s debut West End stage play 'The Popinjay Cavalier'Co-produced by Sonia Friedman Productions and Sony Pictures Entertainment the production is set in 1830s EuropeThe swashbuckling comedy is scheduled to open at an unannounced London venue in spring 2027 Quentin Tarantino and Sacha Baron Cohen are teaming up for The Popinjay Cavalier, marking the director’s first stage play. The upcoming West End production stars Baron Cohen in the title role for his London theater debut.Produced by Sonia Friedman Productions in partnership with Sony Pictures Entertainment, the project is described by producers as a rambunctious comedy of deception and disguise inspired by grand swashbuckling epics of stage and screen. Set in 1830s Europe, the original stage story sees Baron Cohen step into the lead role.The theatrical casting comes ahead of Baron Cohen reprising his signature character in the Amazon MGM feature Ali G Who Iz I? in October. Tarantino’s move into London theater brings together two high-profile creators for an original West End debut.The Popinjay Cavalier is scheduled to open at an as-yet-unannounced West End venue in spring 2027. items.title: Paramount Taps Destin Daniel Cretton to Direct 'Hawaii Five-O' Movie
items.text: Paramount Taps Destin Daniel Cretton to Direct 'Hawaii Five-O' Movie Summary Paramount Pictures is officially developing a feature film adaptation of the classic police procedural 'Hawaii Five-O'Destin Daniel Cretton is set to direct following the massive global box office success of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'The screenplay is being written by Chris Bremner with plot details kept under wraps in early development Paramount Pictures is officially developing a feature film adaptation of the classic police procedural Hawaii Five-O. The studio has tapped director Destin Daniel Cretton to helm the project following the box office run of Spider-Man: Brand New Day.Scripted by Chris Bremner (Bad Boys for Life), the feature marks the latest attempt to bring the classic TV property to theaters. Created by Leonard Freeman in 1968, the original television series became the longest-running police drama on American television by its 1980 finale, famously popularizing the catchphrase "Book 'em, Danno." CBS later revived the franchise in 2010 with a modern 10-season reboot anchored by Alex O’Loughlin, Scott Caan, Daniel Dae Kim, and Grace Park.While specific narrative details remain under wraps during early development, Cretton steps into the director's chair following an extraordinary theatrical run. His recent Marvel blockbuster, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, has earned $924 million USD domestically and $2.4 billion USD worldwide, placing it on the verge of becoming the highest-grossing domestic release in history alongside his previous work on Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings. items.title: Take a Look Inside Ome Dezin’s 4,500-Square-Foot Hollywood Hills Restoration
items.text: Take a Look Inside Ome Dezin’s 4,500-Square-Foot Hollywood Hills Restoration Summary Ome Dezin restored a 4,500-square-foot Hollywood Hills home originally designed by Jeffrey Mills.Interiors feature natural stone, warm woods and a custom stained-glass kitchen pantry.A mirrored exterior sauna houses a vibrant kiwi glass and granite bathroom. Los Angeles-based design firm Ome Dezin has unveiled its latest residential project, a stunning 4,500-square-foot property nestled behind a gated drive on over an acre in the Hollywood Hills, Los Angeles. Originally built in 1997 by architect Jeffrey Mills, the contemporary home was initially conceived with a strong emphasis on natural light and a seamless connection to the outdoors. Over the decades, the residence has boasted a rich history, previously serving as an art gallery and the private residence of an A-list Hollywood actor. In its meticulous restoration, Ome Dezin preserved the property's unique architectural history while thoroughly reimagining its aesthetic footprint.Drawing direct cues from the original architecture and the surrounding woodland landscape, Ome Dezin altered 99% of the home's interior surfaces to further soften the boundary between indoors and out. The refined material palette relies on warm woods, richly veined natural stone, sleek stainless steel, and expansive glass, creating a serene environment that feels deeply connected to its natural setting. A standout feature of the interior is a custom kitchen pantry framed by stained-glass doors; a hidden window positioned behind the glass casts beautiful highlights of color and natural light into the kitchen and hallway, bringing an artful warmth to the space.The property’s most striking addition is a newly constructed, mirrored structure designed to house a sauna and full bathroom. Inspired by Doug Aitken’s Mirage - a famous mirror-clad home installation in the desert - the detached building essentially disappears into the forest, reflecting the landscape rather than interrupting it. A distinctive circular cutout acts as an architectural portal framing views toward the pool. In sharp contrast to its quiet, camouflaged exterior, the structure's interior delivers a vibrant, otherworldly mood. The bathroom is enveloped entirely in two materials: kiwi-colored glass by Zia Tile and Palladium Arte Granite stone. This saturated palette draws directly from the vivid hues of brightly colored tree frogs, creating an immersive, nature-inspired experience.

items.title: Welcome to Maurizio Cattelan’s “Church” of Failure
items.text: Welcome to Maurizio Cattelan’s “Church” of Failure Summary Italian artist Maurizio Cattelan opens a new solo exhibition, 'Night,' at the Neue Nationalgalerie in BerlinOn through March 7, 2027, the exhibition is imagined as a "contemporary church" and features hyperrealistic sculptures exploring authority, religion, and mortality A fire extinguisher might be the easiest piece in Maurizio Cattelan's new Berlin show to miss. But "Dust," perched at the entrance of Ludwig Mies van der Rohe’s modernist glass hall, is also the most significant. Inside are the ashes of the artist's friend.This is just the first piece of Night, now on view at Neue Nationalgalerie. For decades, Cattelan has held down quite the reputation as conceptual art's enfant terrible. His often provocative work unsettles our relationship to authority, value, and mortality, revealing humanity's weaknesses in the process. In his first major go-around at a German museum, the Italian artist skips the tongue-in-cheek pieces he's best known for — like the taped banana or solid-gold toilet, dubbed "America" — instead, bringing new commissions and works from the past 30 years that bend towards the sinister.To enter, visitors must pass through "Purgatory," a scaled-down Brandenburg Gate, confronting ambiguity and division that shapes the historic no-man's land. At the center, "Him" — Cattelan’s infamous miniaturized Hitler, kneeling in prayer — faces "Dawn," a crucified woman suspended in a transport crate.On the rafts above, in "People," thousands of taxidermied pigeons glare down on passersby below. Other animals nearby explore themes of exhaustion and labor: a dead horse hangs midair in "Novecento," while "Pentecost" similarly sees a donkey up high, struggling under the weight of an overloaded cart."Night is not simply the absence of light. It is a condition. The exhibition is not about darkness. It is about the loss of certainty," Cattelan wrote in a press release. "And while failure and despair seem to prevail for now, salvation, reflection, and imagination await on the other side. The space, after all, was imagined "like a contemporary church," fitting to both the architecture and the artist's own fraught relationship with Catholicism. "Night is also temporary," he continued, "it always contains the possibility of morning, even if you cannot see it yet."The exhibition is now on view in Berlin until March 7, 2027.Neue NationalgaleriePotsdamer Str. 50,10785 Berlin,Germany Click here to view full ga

items.title: Explore the Evolution of Skateboarding With the "50 Years of VISION" Traveling Exhibition
items.text: Explore the Evolution of Skateboarding With the "50 Years of VISION" Traveling Exhibition VISION celebrates 50 years of shaping skate, streetwear, and urban art with its traveling exhibition.The "50 Years of VISION" exhibition started its first leg of a global tour in Los Angeles, California at the independent HVW8 Gallery, which saw a complete takeover of VISION's highly curated collection of brand memorabilia. Historic skate decks, prints, flyers, accessories and even original concepts and sketches filled the space, allowing guests to explore the expansive history of the brand dating as far back as 1976. Alongside cultural elements, the gallery housed original artwork rarely seen by the public, including rough draft art by Mark Gonzales, one of VISION's first pro skaters. VISION threw an opening reception on September 4, which saw a large gathering of OG skaters and LA skate community members. The party also saw the return of the brand's designs with new stickers, posters and apparel given to the invited guests in attendance."50 Years of VISION" has concluded its LA leg of the tour, and continue on in Shanghai, China from October 1-30, followed by Tokyo, Japan from December 4-13. items.title: The Globe-Trotter x Aston Martin Aramco F1 Luggage Collection Drops Globally
items.text: The Globe-Trotter x Aston Martin Aramco F1 Luggage Collection Drops Globally Summary Globe-Trotter partners with the Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team on a 100-piece limited luggage collection.Features black Vulcanised Fibreboard, Aston Martin Green accents, lime stitching and houndstooth nylon lining.Available now online, at the London flagship, and in select global stores. Globe-Trotter has unveiled a new limited-edition collaboration with the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One™ Team, continuing its partnership with the motorsport brand through a collection that merges British craftsmanship with racing performance. Limited to just 100 pieces worldwide, the collection is designed for collectors and travelers who value precision, technical detail, and the allure of motorsport. Drawing inspiration from the team’s Formula One car, the cases feature black Vulcanised Fibreboard accented with Aston Martin Green and Lime, with green leather detailing, lime stitching, and bespoke wheels branded in Aston Martin Green.The collection's centerpiece suitcase is constructed from signature Black Vulcanised Fibreboard, accented with striking Aston Martin Green corners and vibrant lime stitching and edge inking. Automotive-inspired details continue across the exterior with custom wheel caps featuring co-branded Globe-Trotter x Aston Martin Green caps. Inside, the case features a durable nylon lining woven with a modernized British houndstooth pattern in the racing team's colors, finished with a co-branded logo patch and an individually numbered stainless steel plaque. Expanding the lineup, the release also includes a Charcoal Grey Leather Passport Sleeve and matching Luggage Tag detailed with coordinating green accents.Handcrafted by skilled artisans in Hertfordshire, England, the Globe-Trotter x Aston Martin Aramco Formula One™ Team collection represents an exclusive, highly collectible capsule. The 100-piece limited run is available globally through Globe-Trotter’s official website as well as its flagship boutiques in London (Burlington Arcade), Paris, and Kobe. Revealed via an early look on Instagram by Patta co-founder Guillaume Schmidt, the upcoming collaboration drastically reworks the casual slip-on for more demanding urban and outdoor environments.At the core of this transformation is the integration of a rugged Vibram rubber outsole, elevating the typically lightweight foam silhouette with an aggressive, trail-ready foundation. This unexpected three-way partnership seamlessly merges Patta’s signature street-level edge with the unmatched grip and durability of Vibram tooling, pushing the Classic Clog into an entirely new functional footwear category.Based on the initial teaser images, the collaborative clog arrives in a muted camo-print, paired with embellishments and a strap in black. Custom Patta branding replaces the standard Crocs logo on the pivot rivets and the adjustable heel strap, subtly marking the Amsterdam imprint's presence on the shoe. Bold, statement-like Patta Jibbitz adorn the upper, including a sculptural piece emulating a brick wall, emblazoned with "Patta" alongside the words "TEAR DOWN THE WALL." items.text: Victor Kan Offers a First Look at His Upcoming Timberland Euro Hiker GTX Collaboration Name: Timberland By Victor Kan F26 Euro Hiker GTXSKU: TBCRelease Date: October 2026Following the opening of his Third of June storefront in NYC earlier this year, Victor Kan is continuing his 2026 momentum by teaming up with Timberland for a curated take on the classic Euro Hiker GTX. Slated for an October release, the "Timberland Curated By Victor Kan F26" project brings a refined, streetwear-adjacent lens to the brand's rugged outdoor heritage. The collaborative boot preserves the utilitarian DNA of the original Euro Hiker while introducing a premium, weather-ready material construction built to navigate both city sidewalks and unpredictable fall climates.As revealed in the first look images, the silhouette arrives in an earthy, color-blocked palette anchored by a smooth taupe suede upper and breathable grey mesh side panels. A rich burgundy brown suede tongue, detailed with an embossed Timberland tree logo, serves as the shoe’s visual centerpiece, offering a deep pop of color against the neutral base. Functional outdoor elements are heavily emphasized through metallic D-ring hardware, contrasting white rope laces, and a heavy-duty black rubber toe bumper that seamlessly transitions into a chunky black lug outsole. Finished with a subtle lateral GORE-TEX tag indicating a fully waterproof construction, this collaborative Euro Hiker offers a compelling blend of high-end material execution and off-road durability. items.title: A ‘Diablo’ Animated Series Officially in Development at Netflix
items.text: A ‘Diablo’ Animated Series Officially in Development at Netflix Summary Blizzard and Netflix announced a new animated series based on the dark fantasy Diablo franchise.Revealed by Blizzard President Johanna Faries at BlizzCon 2026, the series is set within Sanctuary.Release date is unconfirmed, but the project expands Netflix’s video game adaptation slate. Blizzard Entertainment and Netflix have officially announced that a new animated series based on the dark fantasy video game franchise Diablo is currently in development. Revealed by Blizzard President Johanna Faries during the opening keynote at BlizzCon 2026 in Anaheim, the adaptation marks a major effort to bring the iconic universe of Sanctuary into the world of episodic television.The announcement comes alongside a broader initiative by Blizzard and parent company Microsoft to expand their core gaming intellectual properties across film and television, with Faries teasing that the project is "just the beginning" of wider transmedia plans across Blizzard's gaming franchises.Diablo, first launched in 1996, has become a cornerstone of action RPG gaming, known for its atmospheric storytelling, dungeon‑crawling mechanics, and enduring popularity across multiple sequels. The upcoming animated adaptation is expected to draw from the franchise’s rich mythology, including the eternal conflict between the High Heavens and Burning Hells. While specific release dates have not yet been confirmed, the announcement positions the project as a major addition to Netflix’s expanding lineup of game‑to‑screen adaptations, aiming to capture both long‑time fans and new audiences with its dark, immersive world. items.title: Seiko 5 Sports Reveals the SKX SNZH in Two Sleek Colorways
items.text: Seiko 5 Sports Reveals the SKX SNZH in Two Sleek Colorways Summary Seiko expands its 5 Sports lineup with new SKX SNZH models in "Formal White" and "Tweed Green."Features crisp white with yellow gold accents and deep green paired with rose gold accents.Pre-orders are open now; shipping begins in October. Seiko has expanded its versatile 5 Sports lineup with two new SKX SNZH references, coming in "Formal White" and "Tweed Green." Building on a legacy that traces back to the 1960s and the modernized 1990s SKX evolution, these new models combine everyday practical durability - including enhanced water resistance, durable crystals, and luminous hands and markers - with refined colorways. The "Formal White" edition delivers a clean, elevated look with its crisp white dial set against yellow gold-colored accents. In contrast, the "Tweed Green" model offers a richer, more distinctive visual profile by pairing a deep green dial and matching bezel with warm rose gold-colored accents.Both models continue the SKX legacy that began in the 1990s, when Seiko modernized its 1960s sports designs with enhanced durability and practicality. True to that heritage, the new releases feature strengthened crystals, luminous hands and markers, and water resistance suited for daily wear. Priced at £340 GBP (approx. $459 USD), the Seiko 5 Sports SKX SNZH “Formal White” and “Tweed Green” are now available for pre‑order through Seikoboutique.co.uk, with deliveries beginning in October. items.title: Song for the Mute and adidas Originals Revisit Heritage Icons for FW26
items.text: Song for the Mute and adidas Originals Revisit Heritage Icons for FW26 Name: Song for the Mute x adidas Originals FW26 CollectionSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: October 16Where to Buy: Song for the Mute, adidasAustralian fashion label Song for the Mute and adidas Originals are reuniting for a Fall/Winter 2026 collection. Expanding on their highly successful partnership, the upcoming release continues to merge adidas' sporting DNA with Song for the Mute’s signature experimental aesthetic and "slow design" philosophy.This season, the collaboration spotlights two reimagined classics - the timeless Samba OG SFTM-010 and the newly introduced SL 72 PRO SFTM-011 - alongside a cohesive apparel and accessories capsule. The collection embraces a muted, monochromatic, and earthy color palette that emphasizes raw textures, material contrast, and a naturally worn, nomadic style.Taking a completely new structural approach to an iconic silhouette, the Samba OG SFTM-010 transforms the classic low-top into a versatile, deconstructed staple. The most notable feature of this iteration is its collapsible, crumpled heel, allowing the shoe to be effortlessly worn as a slip-on mule. The upper utilizes a premium mix of soft leather and suede overlays, characterized by minimalist branding and tonal stitching that outline the classic Three Stripes. Grounded by a traditional semi-translucent gum sole that honors the shoe's heritage, the Samba OG SFTM-010 will be available in three understated, earthy colorways - "Black," "Brown" and "Green" - providing a sophisticated, highly wearable finish.Complementing the relaxed nature of the Samba is the SL 72 PRO SFTM-011, which introduces a modernized, heavily textured take on the vintage runner. Elevating the traditional slim profile, this model features a massive, stacked rocker midsole while the upper employs a patchwork-like construction that blends woven fabric bases with premium suede overlays. Rope laces and naturally faded finishes give the shoe an intentionally weathered, handcrafted feel, seamlessly blending high fashion with everyday utility. The SL 72 PRO arrives in "Collegiate Green," "Beige" and "Off White." To round out the footwear, the accompanying apparel line mirrors this artisanal approach, offering track tops, track pants, shorts, tees, and accessories that share the same earthy tones, relaxed fits, and meticulous attention to detail. items.title: Alice Diop to Curate Miu Miu’s 2026 Art Basel Paris Show
items.text: Alice Diop to Curate Miu Miu’s 2026 Art Basel Paris Show Summary French filmmaker Alice Diop is the recipient of Miu Miu's 2026 commission for the Art Basel Paris Public Program Diop will premiere her first exhibition, "Geste de Consolation (Gesture of Consolation)," during the fair in OctoberAlongside her own work, Diop has curated a selection of pieces by artists that inspire her, including Zanele Muholi, Mary Lee Bendolph, Simone Leigh, and more French filmmaker Alice Diop is up next for Miu Miu’s Art Basel Paris public program next month, marking her first-ever exhibition.The project, called “Geste de Consolation (Gesture of Consolation),” is billed as “a celebratory chorus of Black creativity,” per a press statement. The exhibition will transform Palais d’Iéna — home to France’s Economic, Social and Environmental Council and Miu Miu’s runway shows — with a “montage" of film, photography, sculpture, poetry, dance, music, and performance.Building on “Fragments for Venus,” her 2025 short for Miu Miu Women Tales, Diop’s upcoming show explores how representations of Black women through history have shaped today’s politics of looking, gathering contributions by those that have artistically "nourished her": South African photographer Zanele Muholi, Gee’s Bend quilter Mary Lee Bendolph, sculptor Simone Leigh, composer Angel Bat Dawid, and all-woman jazz trio Sistazz of the Nitty-Gritty.“I want my curation to center on acts of consolation conceived by Black women artists, each active in their own discipline, to repair the fetishizing gaze to which centuries of art history have confined us, ” she said.Of the four environments on view is a living room and library installation, carpeted in motifs by Bendolph, featuring her favorite books. Another room, a screening space, presents a montage of archival film and image excerpts that have shaped her gaze as a filmmaker.This is the third Miu Miu-backed exhibition at the French mega-fair since the two launched a public program partnership in 2024. Diop is the third artist chosen by Miuccia Prada to participate, following Helen Marten’s 30 Blizzards exhibition and Tales & Tellers by Goshka Macuga and Elvira Dyangani Ose in recent years.“Geste de Consolation” is set to open to the public on October 21 and will remain on view until October 25. Head to Miu Miu’s website for more info on how to book a guided tour. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Hypebeast Guide to London Design Festival 2026
items.text: The Hypebeast Guide to London Design Festival 2026 September is here, which means the London Design Festival is back for its 24th edition, running from 12–20 September.The map has shifted a little. There are 11 districts, with Soho joining for the first time. Shoreditch Design Triangle has rebranded as Shoreditch Design Week and is now the biggest on the programme, with more than 60 showrooms and galleries taking part. Over in Waltham Forest, the William Morris Design Line has become Blackhorse Creates.There's shows taking place at the city's biggest instituions, as well as buildings that have long been closed to the public. But, as always for us, the real story is at the smaller end. We're particularly excited for the shows that are the result of an open-call or graduate-led, and the galleries that were working out of vans and borrowed rooms two years ago now have real spaces. See below for our picks.With LimitationsDesign Everything x AramLast year Design Everything showed furniture out of the back of a Luton van. This year it has Aram's downstairs gallery, done up as a young designer's flat and filled with work by 102 emerging practitioners, each responding to a limitation — space, time, budget, access. Exhibiting is free.Aram, 110 Drury Lane, WC2B 5SGStudio Iron Isamaya Ffrench's design gallery debuted at Saatchi Yates earlier this year and lands at The Lavery with a group show about the line between experimentation and craft. Andu Masebo, Buchanan Studio, Completed Works, Kelly Wearstler x ARCA, Kouros Maghsoudi, Paul Coenen, Barnaby Lewis and Wretched Flowers are all in it.The Lavery, 4 Cromwell Place, SW7 2JECraft x TechVarious designersBack at the V&A for a second year, Craft x Tech pairs six craft regions from Japan's Tokai area with six international designers. Bethan Laura Wood is working with the shibori dyers of Arimatsu Narumi, Atang Tshikare with the braid-makers of Iga Kumihimo, alongside Philippe Malouin, David Caon, Eugene Kangawa and Lanzavecchia + Wai. It runs until 18 October, so this is the one you're allowed to leave until later.V&A, Cromwell Road, SW7 2RLHomenkà: Our ParlourNcheta CollectiveZoë Chinonso Ene has turned one of The Lavery's rooms into a parlour built around Nchọ, the game known globally as mancala. items.title: Aries FW26 Drags Early-2000s Luxury Through Acid-Washed Corduroy and Snakeskin
items.text: Aries FW26 Drags Early-2000s Luxury Through Acid-Washed Corduroy and Snakeskin Summary Aries has introduced its FW26 collection under the title "Faded Opulence," built on fabrications that have been sun-faded, washed and distressedA washed snakeskin print lands on the new lower-rise Lilly jean, which the label has positioned as the hero denim silhouette of the seasonAlpha Industries joins the collection with a reworked CWU-45 Heritage bomber finished with studded hardware Aries has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, "Faded Opulence," a season that puts luxury materials through the wringer and then treats the damage as the point. The London-based label frames the range around early-2000s excess colliding with derelict Baroque interiors, lush animal skins and the residue of it all, and delivers that idea through surface treatment rather than silhouette. Every rich texture here has been degraded in some way, sun-faded or washed or distressed until the polish reads as residue.Denim carries the clearest statement. The Lilly jean returns with a lower rise and arrives in a washed snakeskin print, designated by the brand as the hero denim style of FW26. It anchors a broader run of animal-print work that includes distorted zebra graphics across knitwear and warped animal prints applied to Airtex and jersey hoodies and sweatpants.The texture list is unusually specific for a streetwear season. Acid-washed corduroy, chenille knitwear and washed denim set the lived-in baseline, while sun-bleached jersey finished with diamantés supplies the glint of ruined glamour. Slick snakeskin, glossy leather and sheepskin raise the register at the top end, the three materials that push the collection furthest into what Aries describes as worn glamour.Founded by Sofia Prantera on a diet of trash culture, outsider art and bold graphics, Aries treats its archive as working material rather than heritage to be preserved, and the FW26 artwork reads as a survey of that instinct. New iterations of Aries and Destroy, Smoking Tiger and Cave appear across Airtex and washed jersey, Weedie Pie meets J'adoro Aries on sweats and T-shirts, and a seasonal cherub motif softens the tone on washed jersey staples and fitted cap-sleeve T-shirts. items.title: Sound & Sole: Lost Frequencies, Miss Monique, and NOVAH Lace Up the Tomorrowland WR1
items.text: Sound & Sole: Lost Frequencies, Miss Monique, and NOVAH Lace Up the Tomorrowland WR1 There's a version of Tomorrowland that ends when the last set does — the grounds emptied, the stages struck, the weekend folded into memory. And then there's the version the festival has spent fifteen years building in the other direction: out past the gates, into fragrances and homeware and, now, footwear. The WR1 is the festival's first-ever sneaker, unveiled at Tomorrowland Belgium 2026 ahead of a global release this September. A sculptural, nature-referencing runner — its flowing lines and layered sole drawn from the geometry of a dragonfly's wing and the patterns inside a mushroom's gills — it's pitched less as merch than as something you carry with you long after the music stops. Which is a fitting brief for the three artists chosen to front it, all of whom spend their lives moving between worlds and trying to leave something behind in each one.For Lost Frequencies, the collaboration lands close to home. Felix De Laet has spent the better part of a decade at the top of melodic dance, and he grew up in Belgium knowing the festival long before he ever played it. "Tomorrowland has always felt very close to home for me," he says — which is part of why its first step into footwear "feels really special," especially watching a brand he's close to push beyond the festival itself. His days rarely repeat: studio one morning, an unfamiliar city the next, a crowd of thousands by night. He traces that restlessness straight into the music, drawn to the contrast "between something emotional and intimate and something that can suddenly feel huge on a dancefloor." Longevity, he reckons, is mostly curiosity — constant digging, new edits, unreleased tests, no two sets ever quite alike. Ask what should be playing the first time you lace up a pair and he doesn't hesitate: "Live It All," a track built to move to that keeps an emotional undertow, "a good soundtrack for putting on a new pair of shoes and heading out with no real idea where the night is going to take you."Miss Monique arrives at it with a different kind of reach. Long before touring filled her calendar, the Ukrainian DJ built a global following through her Mind Games and MiMo Weekly series — sets that traveled through screens to people she'd never met. items.title: Flower Mountain and Staple Unveil Collaborative Yamano 3 for FW26
items.text: Flower Mountain and Staple Unveil Collaborative Yamano 3 for FW26 Summary Flower Mountain has officially partnered with Staple on a collaborative Yamano 3 silhouette for FW26The design merges Flower Mountain's signature floral motif with the iconic Staple Pigeon across custom logos and embroideryTechnical specs feature a removable antibacterial natural cork insole alongside a high-grip outdoor outsole Flower Mountain has officially joined forces with streetwear label Staple to present the collaborative Yamano 3. Releasing for the Fall/Winter 2026 season, the collaborative footwear capsule blends technical outdoor performance with Staple's distinct urban heritage.Centered around Flower Mountain’s signature Yamano 3 silhouette, the model is engineered for everyday exploration. The shoe incorporates a removable antibacterial natural cork insole for breathability and lasting comfort, resting atop a high-grip outdoor outsole crafted for traction across varied terrain.Visual details celebrate both brands' aesthetics. The upper features side embroidery and custom tongue logos that merge Flower Mountain's signature flower emblem with the Staple Pigeon. Subtle graphics inspired by New York pigeon footprints appear throughout the upper, dressed in a signature Staple palette of charcoal grey, dusty coral, and vibrant orange accents.The Flower Mountain x Staple Yamano 3 will drop as part of the Fall/Winter 2026 collection online and at select retailers. items.title: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week
items.text: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week Summary Palace Skateboards and Avirex return with a co-branded capsule built around a tracksuit, three jersey options and two headwear stylesOversized branding is applied across multiple placements on every piece in the rangeThe collection follows the heavyweight A-2 leather flying jacket that anchored the first drop Palace Skateboards and Avirex have reunited for a second co-branded collection, this time trading outerwear for a head-to-toe sportswear offering. Where the opening chapter centered on a single statement jacket, the new capsule spreads across a tracksuit, a run of jersey pieces and a pair of accessories, with scaled-up logo work tying the whole thing together.The tracksuit leads the range, joined by jersey options that cover a hooded sweatshirt plus long and short sleeve tees. Accessories round things out with a no-cuff beanie and a cap, giving the capsule a full top-to-bottom spread rather than a single hero piece.Branding does the heavy lifting throughout. Rather than keeping logos to a chest hit, both labels have blown up their marks and scattered them across several placements on each garment, a treatment that carries consistently from the tracksuit through to the headwear.That approach reads as a deliberate counterpoint to drop one. The first release hinged on Avirex's A-2 leather flying jacket, cut from rich pebbled leather in the boxed-out shape that defined the outfitter's 2000s output. Where that piece earned its weight through material, this second wave leans on cut and graphic scale instead, translating the same boxy proportions into knit and jersey fabrications.The Avirex x Palace Skateboards capsule launches Friday, September 18 at 11:00 a.m. BST across the UK, Europe and the US, followed by Saturday, September 19 at 11:00 a.m. local time in Japan, China, Korea and Australia. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Becomes Universal Pictures' Highest-Grossing Film of All Time
items.text: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Becomes Universal Pictures' Highest-Grossing Film of All Time Summary Universal Pictures has announced that Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' is officially the highest-grossing film in the studio's historyThe feature film has generated $601.2 million USD domestically alongside $1.083 billion USD in international ticket salesThe Matt Damon-led epic reached the historic $1.68 billion USD worldwide milestone in less than two months Universal Pictures and director Christopher Nolan have reached a historic milestone with The Odyssey, officially making it the highest-grossing film in the studio’s 114-year history. Starring Matt Damon, the epic has grossed $601.2 million USD domestically and $1.083 billion USD internationally, bringing its worldwide box office total to $1.68 billion USD.Produced by Emma Thomas and Nolan via their Syncopy banner alongside executive producer Thomas Hayslip, the film reclaimed the top box office spot in its eighth weekend in theaters. The project marks the largest opening of Nolan’s career, surpassing The Dark Knight Rises to become his highest-grossing movie to date. NBCUniversal Entertainment chairman Donna Langley lauded the release as an ambitious generational event for cinema.In addition to becoming Universal's top earner, the film has set several global superlatives, standing as the highest-grossing R-rated film in history and the top-earning release for IMAX. Based on 3,000-year-old source material, the project is also the first non-sequel film to cross $1 billion USD overseas since 2009, capping a milestone partnership following Nolan's 2021 move to Universal. items.title: Apple Reportedly Planning Major Apple Store Renovations, Including the Return of the Dedicated Genius Bar
items.text: Apple Reportedly Planning Major Apple Store Renovations, Including the Return of the Dedicated Genius Bar Summary Apple is accelerating retail renovations to prioritize traditional service, retail and fulfillment layoutsDedicated Genius Bars will replace the giant marketing video walls currently sitting at the back of locationsNew 10-foot Avenue bays will be installed to handle online pickups and Today at Apple sessions Apple is accelerating an overhaul of Apple Stores to prioritize traditional retail, direct service and efficient fulfillment. A report by Mark Gurman indicated that the company plans to increase the pace of renovations over the coming years. This shift revolves around three major architectural changes designed to rethink customer movement through the space. The strategy marks a departure from the open-concept Genius Grove layout that the company adopted more than a decade ago. By realigning the floor plan, the brand moves away from communal zones to focus on practical, dedicated service hubs.The most dramatic visual change occurs at the back of most Apple Stores where giant video walls will be removed. These displays currently host Today at Apple sessions and marketing materials, but renovated layouts replace them with dedicated Genius Bars. Reintroducing the iconic service desk reverses a decision to use tree-lined groves for support. This updated Genius Bar features an all-wood look resembling past service stations. To improve accessibility, the new installations incorporate two counter heights. Storage drawers and large printed posters highlighting products sit on the wall behind the new desks.Fulfillment zones and accessory displays also receive a redesign as the company revamps its Avenue sections. These areas occupy the sides of the stores where services and add-ons are traditionally promoted. Current pickup and workshop functions use large tables and seating areas that dominate the floor. Upcoming renovations migrate these experiences into 10-foot side sections known as bays. Two specific Avenue sections will be added for online pickups and Today at Apple sessions.The Avenue bay for online pickups consists entirely of wood and features an integrated logo. Secure drawers for customer orders sit in the lower portion of this bay. A standalone table stands ahead of the pickup bay to provide employees with space to manage the order handoff. items.text: Blizzard Entertainment Announces 'Diablo V' for Spring 2029 Release Summary Blizzard Entertainment has officially announced 'Diablo V' targeting a Spring 2029 releaseSet a century after 'Diablo IV' the storyline explores a world where Sanctuary has fallen and heroes were defeatedA new animated 'Diablo' series is also currently in active development at Netflix Blizzard Entertainment has officially revealed Diablo V, the next mainline entry in its iconic action-RPG franchise. The title was unveiled during the opening ceremony of BlizzCon 2026 at the Anaheim Convention Center, with a target release set for Spring 2029.Set a century after the events of 2023’s Diablo IV, the upcoming game introduces a narrative pivot for the franchise: a reality where Sanctuary has fallen and its defenders have been defeated. Celebrating the 30th anniversary of the franchise since its 1996 debut—which has surpassed 130 million players across four mainline titles—the core storyline centers on survival in a world where evil has already triumphed.In addition to the main game reveal, Blizzard president Johanna Faries announced that an animated Diablo TV series is currently in development with Netflix. The cross-media adaptation arrives alongside other major BlizzCon reveals, including an open-world StarCraft shooter slated for 2030.Diablo V is scheduled to launch in Spring 2029. items.title: Kimi Antonelli Claims His Eighth Win of 2026 at the Inaugural Madrid Street Circuit Grand Prix
items.text: Kimi Antonelli Claims His Eighth Win of 2026 at the Inaugural Madrid Street Circuit Grand Prix Summary Kimi Antonelli takes the inaugural victory at the Madring for his eighth win of the 2026 seasonA severely mistimed pit stop under the Virtual Safety Car strips pole-sitter Lando Norris of the leadMax Verstappen secures second place by utilizing the track's tight layout to block a recovering Norris Victory at the inaugural Spanish Grand Prix went to Kimi Antonelli for his eighth win of the 2026 season. The result followed a race where track position dictated the podium because tight corners limited overtaking opportunities. This circuit layout increased the penalty for a poorly timed pit stop that affected pole-sitter Lando Norris. Such a narrow racing surface ensures that qualifying and strategy remain critical components of the weekend.Norris controlled the pace until a Virtual Safety Car (VSC) period began on lap 14. A car halted by Lance Stroll prompted the majority of the field to pit for fresh tires. McLaren called Norris to the box on lap 16 just as the VSC ended. A 7-second stop on lap 17 further delayed his return to the track. The sequence dropped Norris to fifth place behind George Russell.Charles Leclerc stayed out on old tires for the majority of the race. He led until lap 48 before a late stop resulted in a fourth-place finish. Max Verstappen capitalized on the shifting order after starting third to move into second. He used the layout of the Madring to block a recovering Norris. The Red Bull driver crossed the line in second for his fourth podium in five races. Norris recovered to finish third after starting from the lead.Lewis Hamilton retired on lap seven following a brake failure. He joined Aston Martin's Lance Stroll, Cadillac's Sergio Perez and Williams's Carlos Sainz as a retirement. Hamilton now trails Antonelli by 101 points in the championship standings. Russell finished fifth and sits 20 points ahead of Ferrari driver Hamilton. This result leaves Russell 81 points behind his teammate, Kimi Antonelli.Liam Lawson finished sixth for Red Bull while substituting for Isack Hadjar. Franco Colapinto earned points for Alpine for the second consecutive race. Oscar Piastri took eighth place ahead of Racing Bulls driver Arvid Lindblad and Audi's Nico Hülkenberg. items.title: TSTS's ‘The Wizard of Oz’ Tote Stacks Rhinestones Over a Printed Canvas Body
items.text: TSTS's ‘The Wizard of Oz’ Tote Stacks Rhinestones Over a Printed Canvas Body Summary TSTS has produced a limited-run Wizard of Oz tote bag built on a canvas body finished with a special printRhinestones are layered over that print so the surface throws off the red shine of the film's magic shoesThe bag arrives alongside the brand's FW26 collection "The Saxe Blue Gingham," an official Wizard of Oz collaboration TSTS has made a Wizard of Oz tote bag, and the construction is more involved than the format suggests. The bag starts from a canvas body carrying a special print, then adds a second pass of rhinestones set over the printed surface, a stacking technique that gives the graphic physical relief rather than leaving it flat. The effect the brand is chasing is the red glint of the film's magic shoes.The tote is a special item produced for the occasion rather than a general release, and it is being made in limited numbers. It belongs to a wider Wizard of Oz collaboration series that TSTS has developed into "The Saxe Blue Gingham," the brand's FW26 collection, which puts the film's iconography into the label's own vocabulary.That vocabulary is gingham. The check is TSTS's brand signature, and pieces built on it are being carried alongside the collaboration items, which places the Oz material and the house pattern in the same room for the first time. The pairing also explains the collection's name, with the saxe blue reading as a color direction rather than a graphic one.The bag itself is the most technically involved piece in the mix. Canvas is a deliberately plain base, and the decision to print it first and then bead over the print means the shine sits proud of the fabric rather than being simulated in ink.The Wizard of Oz tote is available at the TSTS pop-up store, held in the 1F POP UP SPACE "GATE" at Shibuya PARCO from September 15 through September 23, and through the TSTS Online Store. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: thisisneverthat x UNDERCOVER Rework the Apple Motif Into a Washed Denim Down Jacket
items.text: thisisneverthat x UNDERCOVER Rework the Apple Motif Into a Washed Denim Down Jacket Summary thisisneverthat and UNDERCOVER have built a joint collection that reinterprets the apple motif and other artworks from UNDERCOVER's graphic archiveThe lineup is led by a washed denim down jacket and a jacquard zip-up hoodie, backed by denim pants and graphic T-shirtsA run of accessories rounds out the collaboration, which opens in Tokyo this week before reaching Seoul in December thisisneverthat and UNDERCOVER have put together a collaborative collection, and the pieces are worth getting specific about. The Seoul label has taken UNDERCOVER's signature apple motif along with a broader set of artworks and run them through its own lens, rather than simply reprinting them at scale. The result covers outerwear, denim, jersey and accessories, with the heaviest construction saved for the top of the range.The anchor piece is a washed denim down jacket, a combination that asks the denim to carry a baffled insulated build while the wash treatment keeps the surface broken in rather than rigid. Sitting beside it is a jacquard zip-up hoodie, where the graphics are woven into the fabric structure itself instead of being applied on top, which is the more labor-intensive route to a motif and the one that holds up better over repeat wears.From there the collection works down through the wardrobe. Denim pants extend the material story from the jacket, graphic T-shirts carry the artwork in its most direct form, and a range of accessories completes the offering. Across all of it, the apple sits as the recurring device, reframed through thisisneverthat's own graphic sensibility.The thisisneverthat x UNDERCOVER collection drops Friday, September 18 at 5 p.m. JST, available exclusively at the thisisneverthat Shibuya Flagship. A pop-up follows at the thisisneverthat Seongsu Flagship in Seoul this December. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Apple Is Reportedly Working on Beats-Branded iPhone Game Controllers
items.text: Apple Is Reportedly Working on Beats-Branded iPhone Game Controllers Summary Apple develops two first-party game controllers for the iPhoneHardware launches under the Beats brand rather than the main Apple lineupLower price points and lifestyle branding target a wider gaming audience Apple is supposedly developing two first-party iPhone game controllers to expand its mobile hardware ecosystem. Joe Rossignol reported the discovery on September 13, after finding references in the macOS 26.7 operating system code. Mark Gurman later confirmed that the hardware targets iPhone users despite the discovery in Mac software. Internal code identifies these devices as first-party products.The tech giant plans to release the hardware under the Beats brand to reach a different market demographic. Beats executives lead the development process according to reporting by Gurman. This move follows recent brand expansions into lifestyle accessories like phone cases and charging cables.iPhone game controllers released under this banner allow for more aggressive pricing. Manufacturers avoid the high-end finishes and premium materials found on mainline Apple products to lower costs. Lower price points help the company target a broader audience of mobile gamers.Using the subsidiary as an incubator lets the parent company test new categories without risking its flagship luxury status. Gaming culture fits the Beats lifestyle image better than the minimalist aesthetic of standard Mac accessories. These iPhone game controllers establish a first-party presence in a market previously served by third-party peripheral manufacturers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Burger King's "Le Nugguette" Is a Nugget-Sized Micro-Bag With a Sauce Charm Inside
items.text: Burger King's "Le Nugguette" Is a Nugget-Sized Micro-Bag With a Sauce Charm Inside Summary Burger King has produced Le Nugguette, a limited-edition micro-bag sized to a single chicken nugget and released during fashion seasonEvery bag ships with one of four sauce-inspired charms, covering Special Savory, Honey Mustard, Buffalo and Sweet & SourEach unit also includes a redeemable code for a four-piece serving of the chain's new chicken nuggets Burger King has made a bag, and it is roughly the size of a chicken nugget. Le Nugguette is a limited-edition micro-bag built to mark the chain's new nuggets, which rolled out nationwide earlier this month alongside an updated sauce lineup. The object itself is the point: a miniature carry scaled down past the threshold of practicality, timed to land while fashion season is in full swing.The detailing is where the bag does its work. Each Le Nugguette arrives with one of four charms modeled on the new sauces, covering Special Savory, Honey Mustard, Buffalo and Sweet & Sour, which turns the release into a set with four possible outcomes rather than a single uniform item. The bag also comes packed with a redeemable code good for a four-piece order of the nuggets, so the accessory and the product it advertises travel together.Burger King has been direct about the intent behind the object. "As we launch our new, high-quality Nuggets, we wanted to have some fun and bring fashion and food together," said Allison Smith, Vice President of Marketing Communications for Burger King US&C, in a statement.Le Nugguette is available exclusively online, with 100 bags released daily at 12:00 p.m. EST until September 16. items.title: The Nike Air Max Goadome "Black/Volt" Blacks Out Everything but a Single ACG Badge
items.text: The Nike Air Max Goadome "Black/Volt" Blacks Out Everything but a Single ACG Badge Name: Nike Air Max Goadome “Black/Volt”Colorway: Black/Anthracite-VoltSKU: IQ7198-001MSRP: $180 USDRelease Date: Fall 2026Nike is lining up a new "Black/Volt" treatment of the Air Max Goadome, and the appeal of this one is almost entirely in the surfaces. The boot's upper pairs black and Anthracite leather in two different finishes, setting smooth panels against textured sections around the sides and collar so the tonal palette still reads with depth. It is a build that asks to be examined up close rather than clocked from across a room.The commitment to tonality is close to total. Laces, eyelets, tongue, stitching and sole all sit in the same register, which leaves the boot without the usual visual breaks that separate a Goadome's component parts. Small silver Swooshes on the lateral sides are the only concession to contrast on the upper, and they are scaled down enough that they register as hardware rather than branding.Underneath, the construction does the talking. Visible Air cushioning is worked into both the heel and the forefoot, giving the silhouette impact protection at both ends rather than at the rear alone, while the outsole keeps the deep tread pattern the model is known for. The one deliberate break in the blackout is a Volt ACG badge sitting on the sole, positioned so the color reads only from certain angles. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Proenza Schouler SS27 Reshapes Sharp Tailoring With Cowling, Cyanotype Roses and a Rounder PS1
items.text: Proenza Schouler SS27 Reshapes Sharp Tailoring With Cowling, Cyanotype Roses and a Rounder PS1 Summary Proenza Schouler has presented its Spring 2027 women's collection, designed by Rachel Scott around the idea that clothes should adapt to the body rather than the reverseCowling, rounded hips and traced seaming soften the label's sharper lines, while a tiger motif runs through silk plissé intarsia, hand-knit intarsia and sequin tuftingThe PS1 Walker debuts as a pared-back evolution of the house bag, keeping the signature latch and belts in a softer, rounder shape Proenza Schouler has unveiled its Spring 2027 women's collection, a season Rachel Scott has assembled almost entirely out of technique. The premise is a New York one, where a gown can read as casual and a casual piece can pass for eveningwear, and the clothes are engineered to accommodate that looseness rather than impose on it. Cowling and rounded hips introduce softness and volume where the label's lines would usually stay sharp, and seaming is used to trace the body across dresses, effectively laying one silhouette over another.The knitwear is where the construction talks loudest. Sunburst pointelle opens into angular flanges at the hip, stripes twist and swirl their way around the body, and merino knits are given the same torque so they sit a little undone. Color is handled with equal deliberation: strong hues are set against one another, sheer layers overlap to generate new shades, and fluorescent pink cotton velvet is used for its ability to swallow light rather than bounce it. On denim, an archival garment-printing technique lays white over ecru for a finish closer to canvas than to indigo.Craft carries the collection's two motifs. The tiger is worked three ways, through silk plissé intarsia, hand-knit intarsia and tufting studded with sequins, giving the same image three completely different surfaces. The rose, the only flower in the collection and one the house reads as both feminist and political, is handled through cyanotype, with real roses used to produce the prints before they are reproduced and manipulated across colorways. Pigment printing then gives the rose an actual physical surface to sit on.Accessories follow the same logic of visible making. The PS1 Walker arrives as a new evolution of the PS1, stripped back to the details that identify it, the latch and the belts, and rebuilt in a softer and rounder form. items.title: Zheng Qinwen’s Nike Zoom Vapor 12 PE Wraps a Comeback Season in Triple Red and Gold
items.text: Zheng Qinwen’s Nike Zoom Vapor 12 PE Wraps a Comeback Season in Triple Red and Gold Name: Zheng Qinwen Nike Zoom Vapor 12 PEColorway: University Red/Tough Red-Picante Red-Metallic GoldSKU: IQ9093-600MSRP: TBCRelease Date: TBCNike has produced a Zoom Vapor 12 player exclusive for Zheng Qinwen, handed to the tennis player after her quarterfinal run at the 2026 US Open. The women's PE is built on a red base with gold accents, and every graphic on it is doing narrative work rather than sitting there for decoration. It arrives at a point in Zheng's career that the shoe is clearly designed to mark, following a previous season in which injuries kept her from building any real momentum.The color work is the first thing to register. Rather than settling on a single red, the PE layers University Red, Tough Red and Picante Red so the upper shifts in tone across its panels, and a gold Swoosh supplies the contrast. "Qinwen" branding appears at both the tongue and the heel, placing her name at the two points a player and a broadcast camera are most likely to see it.The graphic package is split between printing and stitching, which gives the motifs different weights on the shoe. A crown, a medal and a set of wings run across the design, three symbols that read less as generic sports iconography than as a shorthand for what the last two seasons have asked of her. Completing the package is a gold phoenix hangtag, the most direct statement on the shoe, carrying associations of renewal and rebirth that Nike has tied explicitly to her return to competitive tennis.The timing supports the reading. Zheng took the PE after reaching the quarterfinals at Flushing Meadows, a run that included wins over two players ranked inside the world's top 25, which is exactly the kind of result that resets a narrative about a player coming back from injury. Since then, the Italian brand’s imprint on the sport has developed, adapting its signature sportswear to the teams it outfits and the way fans dress.
