items.title: A First Look at LUAR & Lunazul Tequila’s Agave-Infused Capsule
items.text: A First Look at LUAR & Lunazul Tequila’s Agave-Infused Capsule The merging of worlds, integral to LUAR’s cross-cultural ethos, continues in a new partnership between Raul Lopez’s label and Lunazul Tequila. In this consciously crafted, moonlit collection, the designer’s bold city essence goes hand in hand with the tequila maker’s foundations in the growing and distilling of blue weber agave. The official lookbook offers a first glimpse of this extremely limited fusion of creative imprints — a collaboration that only manifests “Once in a Lunazul”.The city-inspired silhouettes, comprising a two-piece denim set, a classic baseball cap, and a basketball-shaped bag, tie LUAR’s signature NYC aesthetic with Lunazul’s craft-driven approach to tequila. Lunazul brings its identity into the mix through its signature blue hue, found in the stitching and agave leather details. With a mastery of agave cultivation spanning more than seven generations, the core element of Lunazul’s hand-harvested, handcrafted tequila shares its basic foundations with this innovative plant-based leather.The broader collection orbits around the handbag, characterized by a blue agave leather shell and a subtle LUAR logo at the front. With its organic shape and bright hue, the bag serves as a perfect accent to the black denim set, which boasts a co-branded agave leather collar and patches on the back of each piece. The denim number comprises a classic trucker jacket accentuated by blue contrast stitching, and wide-leg shorts with matching details. Worn together, the look has the relaxed elegance of a classic dark-wash denim set, steeped in the auratic glow of a moonlit night.Shot on the streets of Lower Manhattan and in a blue agave field, the lookbook ties the foundations of LUAR and Lunazul together just as each style from the collection does on its own. LUAR x Lunazul’s exclusive collaborative range will officially debut at LUAR’s SS27 runway presentation on September 14, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Kevin Hart Is All In on Golf
items.text: Kevin Hart Is All In on Golf Watching Kevin Hart on set is akin to watching a veteran fighter in the ring. There's efficiency to everything he does. At a shoot in South Brooklyn, he transitions from still photography to a scripted commercial to short-form social without ever losing momentum. Someone steps in, gives him the brief and Hart takes it from there as he riffs, adjusts and delivers with the composure of someone who has done this thousands of times. Because, of course, he has.It's an appropriate way to encounter Hart at this particular moment. At 46, after a career built around comedy, entertainment, business and a relentless commitment to fitness, he has thrown himself headfirst into something he is decidedly less experienced at: golf.What began less than a year ago has quickly become another obsession. Hart has joined a growing group of high-profile athletes and entertainers taking up the game, traded playful challenges with LeBron James, started a YouTube channel to document his journey and even appeared at Augusta National during Masters week. Now golf is becoming part of his business world, too, as Fabletics expands into the category with a collection shaped in part by Hart's own rapid immersion in the sport.That's what brought us to the course in Brooklyn: to talk about why golf took hold so quickly, how his instinct for self-improvement translates to a game built on frustration and what happens when someone accustomed to mastering his craft willingly puts himself back in the position of being a beginner.Hypegolf: We know you’ve been getting into golf recently. Once you got into golf, what was the moment you realized that this was becoming more than a hobby for you?Kevin Hart: Probably when I took a liking to it. I'm pretty obsessive, so if I take a liking to anything, it's very hard for me to approach it halfway. It's kind of all or nothing. And the idea of a game that puts you in a position where you're just competing against yourself is fun. It's exciting to also suck and know that you can only get better. So I think that was the driving force in showing up, showing back up.So the question is, how good did I want it to get? And that’s where the obsessive behavior and approach to the game came in.When you started getting into the game, was there maybe a misconception you had about it from earlier in your life that was disproved as you learned more?No. There was no perception of the game at all. items.title: Toronto Raptors Officially Acquire Kawhi Leonard in Blockbuster Trade With Clippers
items.text: Toronto Raptors Officially Acquire Kawhi Leonard in Blockbuster Trade With Clippers Summary The Toronto Raptors have officially re-acquired Kawhi Leonard from the Los Angeles Clippers following NBA trade approvalToronto traded Brandon Ingram Gradey Dick three first-round pick assets and two second-round picks to Los AngelesThe deal was finalized after an NBA investigation into salary-cap circumvention resulted in fines and executive suspensions for the Clippers The Toronto Raptors have officially acquired Kawhi Leonard from the Los Angeles Clippers following trade approval from the NBA on September 14, 2026. The transaction brings the 2019 NBA champion back to Toronto after a months-long league investigation into salary-cap circumvention delayed the deal.To acquire Leonard, the Raptors sent All-Star forward Brandon Ingram, guard Gradey Dick, unprotected first-round picks in 2031 and 2033, a 2027 first-round pick swap, and two second-round picks to Los Angeles. The trade was cleared following the conclusion of an NBA inquiry on September 2, which fined Leonard $700,000 USD while levying a $30 million USD fine, a five-pick draft penalty, and executive suspensions against the Clippers organization.Leonard returns to Toronto after a 2025-26 campaign with the Clippers where he averaged 27.9 points, 6.3 rebounds, 3.6 assists, and 1.9 steals per game. The seven-time All-Star and two-time NBA champion joins a Raptors squad that finished fifth in defensive rating last season, bolstering the franchise's defensive core and championship aspirations.Kawhi Leonard is expected to speak with reporters on September 28, 2026, during Toronto's official media day. items.text: Audemars Piguet Celebrates Serena Williams With a 38mm White Ceramic Royal Oak Chronograph Summary Audemars Piguet unveils the Royal Oak Selfwinding Chronograph “Serena Williams” Limited Edition, crafted in white ceramic with a pink mother‑of‑pearl dial.Limited to 500 pieces, complete with an interchangeable pink rubber strap. Audemars Piguet has unveiled the Royal Oak Selfwinding Chronograph "Serena Williams" Limited Edition, celebrating a decade-long relationship with the professional athlete, entrepreneur and producer. Arriving in a slim and sleek 38mm size, the timepiece boasts a white ceramic case, bezel, and crown, as well as an integrated bracelet that are hand‑finished with alternating satin and polished surfaces.The defining visual highlight of the watch is its polished, pink-tinted mother-of-pearl dial. Designed to reflect a balance of strength and grace, the iridescent dial includes 18-carat white gold hands, rhodium-toned 18-carat pink gold applied hour-markers filled with luminescent material, and rhodium-threaded borders encircling the sub-dials. Positioned between 4 and 5 o'clock is a color-matched pink date window with crisp white numerals.Visible through the glareproofed sapphire exhibition caseback - framed in titanium and engraved with "Limited Edition" - is a 22-carat pink gold oscillating weight and Haute Horlogerie decorations such as Côtes de Genève, circular graining, and hand-beveling. For added versatility, the watch also includes an interchangeable pink rubber strap fitted with white ceramic studs and a titanium AP folding clasp.Strictly limited to 500 pieces, the Royal Oak Selfwinding Chronograph "Serena Williams" Limited Edition is exclusively available through Audemars Piguet. items.title: Kith and Assouline Announce 'Kith: The Footwear Archive' Celebrating 15-Year History
items.text: Kith and Assouline Announce 'Kith: The Footwear Archive' Celebrating 15-Year History Summary Kith has partnered with luxury publisher Assouline to launch 'Kith: The Footwear Archive' in celebration of the brand's 15th anniversaryShot by photographer Tyler Mansour the 444-page book features over 1,800 released footwear models and developmental prototypesThe Classic Edition releases on September 30 2026 alongside a 300-unit Ultimate Edition housed in a monogrammed leather clamshell Kith and publisher Assouline have officially announced Kith: The Footwear Archive, a 444-page catalogue raisonné celebrating the lifestyle brand's 15th anniversary. Created to document the footwear category that defined founder Ronnie Fieg's creative career, the publication features over 1,800 collaborative models and developmental prototypes across partnerships with adidas, ASICS, Clarks Originals, Moncler, New Balance, Nike, On, Timberland, and more.Documented by photographer Tyler Mansour, the volume stands as the largest release in Assouline’s Ultimate and Classics Collection to date. The book is divided into two sections: the first presents 700 released pairs through dedicated studio photography, while the second indexes Fieg's archival collection chronologically by brand to trace the development pipeline from early concepts to final products.The publication debuts in two formats. The Classic edition will release alongside an Ultimate Edition limited to 300 individually numbered copies, each signed by Ronnie Fieg and enclosed in an all-over Kith monogram-debossed leather clamshell. Ahead of the global launch, Kith will host a public exhibition from September 25 to September 27 at 25 Kent Avenue in Brooklyn, New York, placing all 1,800 archival pairs on public display for the first time while offering early sales of the Classic edition.The Classic edition of Kith: The Footwear Archive will release on September 30, 2026, via Kith stores, online, and the Kith App, followed by select Assouline boutiques on December 9, 2026. The Ultimate Edition launches on September 30, 2026, exclusively at select Assouline boutiques. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: RIMOWA and Faber-Castell Built the Most Luxurious Pencil Case You'll Ever See
items.text: RIMOWA and Faber-Castell Built the Most Luxurious Pencil Case You'll Ever See Summary RIMOWA and Faber-Castell have created a limited-edition Artist Case built to house a complete drawing setThe case is made in RIMOWA's Cologne factory from anodized grooved aluminum with the Classic collection's high-gloss corners and TSA-approved locksA two-level tray unfolds to hold 120 Polychromos color pencils, custom graphite pencils and platinum-plated tools RIMOWA and Faber-Castell have unveiled the limited-edition RIMOWA x Faber-Castell Artist Case, a collector's piece that pairs the luggage maker's aluminum construction with a full Polychromos drawing kit. Made in RIMOWA's own factory in Cologne, Germany, the case reworks the brand's travel expertise into a refined home for artist tools.The shell carries over RIMOWA's signature hardware. Built from anodized grooved aluminum, the case adopts the Classic collection's high-gloss aluminum corners and TSA-approved locks, finished with a leather carry handle in Faber-Castell's signature green. It reads as a piece of luggage shrunk down and repurposed, keeping the ridged silhouette that defines the brand's cases.Inside is where the collaboration earns its purpose. A two-level tray system unfolds to open up a space-saving layout, giving clean access to the contents without digging. The set includes 120 Polychromos color pencils, noted for their high pigment load and smudge-proof finish, alongside custom grooved 2B Grip graphite pencils shaped for ergonomic comfort. Rounding out the kit are a RIMOWA-branded platinum-plated sharpener and eraser, small touches that push the case toward display object as much as working tool.The result is positioned for professional artists and enthusiasts alike, equally at home shown off in a studio or carried out into the field. It translates the language of a travel case, durable metal, secure locks, considered internal organization, into a container for drawing tools rather than clothes.The RIMOWA x Faber-Castell Artist Case releases September 17 at RIMOWA stores worldwide and RIMOWA online, as well as Faber-Castell retail stores in Germany and their online stores in Austria, France, Germany, and Italy for $3,100 USD. That pivotal transition birthed the original CJ-2A and sparked a lineage that directly evolved into the modern off-roader. Jeep paid homage to those archival roots with the 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A. Arriving as a detailed limited edition, the release underscores how the utilitarian DNA of the 1940s still commands cultural relevance in today's 4x4 landscape. The tribute vehicle arrived as the 11th consecutive entry in the "Twelve 4 Twelve" series, a rollout that introduces a new limited-edition Wrangler once a month for 12 straight months.Built upon the Jeep Wrangler Rubicon platform, the new edition delivers heritage styling without an aggressive markup. The JL-2A package costs $4,995 USD, meaning the fully appointed vehicle costs just $115 USD more than a similarly equipped Wrangler Rubicon. Visually, the drop is anchored by a two-door version available in Gobi paint, a shade drawing direct inspiration from the Harvest Tan color worn by the original CJ-2A. Buyers looking for different aesthetics can also specify the exterior in '41, Bright White, Sting Gray, Ghost or a bold orange shade named Joose.Every configuration locks in a set of 17-inch retro wheels painted Joose. These rims serve as a modern interpretation of the classic Sunset Red wheels originally offered on the CJ-2A, bridging the gap between archival design and contemporary trail readiness. The retro wheels are wrapped in 33-inch BFGoodrich KO2 all-terrain tires. Orange front and rear tow hooks, a functional three-piece hardtop, body-color fender flares and Dark Metallic Grey grille accents round out the exterior details.Inside the cabin, the aesthetic continues to lean into the archives. items.title: Ford Files Patent for a System That Moves a Parked Truck Using Its Tailgate Handle
items.text: Ford Files Patent for a System That Moves a Parked Truck Using Its Tailgate Handle Summary Ford Global Technologies secures a patent allowing pickup trucks to be moved from the outside via the tailgate handleThe push-to-move system lets operators inch a vehicle forward or backward to assist with exterior workSafety features like a dead-man switch and parking sensors ensure intentional, incident-free operation Ford Global Technologies has officially secured U.S. patent #12,728,722, introducing a control mechanism designed to let operators move a stationary pickup truck without entering the cab. Officially titled "Systems and methods for moving a vehicle using externally mounted HMI," the documentation outlines a physical interface that provides a manual solution for interacting with a stationary rig. This filing prioritizes a functional fix for inching a vehicle along during manual labor.At the core of the newly patented system is the physical pop-up grab handle situated at the rear of the pickup. This component is currently an optional part of the tailgate step on Ford F-series trucks, but the patent gives it movement functionality. Under this design, the operator pushes on the rear handle to request movement, prompting the stationary pickup truck to move forward or backward in small increments. The mechanism is responsive to human input, meaning that pushing harder on the handle could cause the truck to travel a farther distance. Alternatively, applying harder pressure to the handle could deliver a rapid series of more frequent, equal-size nudges. Operation is fully bidirectional and works just as seamlessly in reverse.Handing control of a multi-ton pickup to an operator standing outside the cab requires safety countermeasures. Documentation for the Ford patent notes that onboard parking sensors, alongside monitoring systems, track surroundings to prevent incidents at either end of the vehicle. To eliminate the risk of an accidental activation, the system could be programmed to move the truck only after the operator deliberately applies pressure to the handle and then releases it. This description also emphasizes the addition of a dedicated dead-man switch, a failsafe implemented to confirm that the operator's physical input on the rear handle is intentional before the drivetrain engages.The driving force behind this specialized innovation is assisting users who are manually unloading heavy landscaping materials, moving payloads like stone, dirt or mulch

items.title: MB&F Adds a High-Jewelry Twist to Its "Special Projects" Lineup With the SP One Pavée
items.text: MB&F Adds a High-Jewelry Twist to Its "Special Projects" Lineup With the SP One Pavée Summary MB&F unveils the SP One Pavée in 18K white gold with 255 diamonds.Features a 38mm pebble-shaped case and a dark blue tilted dial.Powered by an in-house hand-wound movement with levitating components. MB&F has unveiled the SP One Pavée, a diamond‑set sequel of its 38mm Special Project One which was first unveiled last year. Designed as the brand answer to classic, elegant dress watches, the original silhouette merged an organic, pebble-like shape with the brand's signature three-dimensional kinetic architecture. This new iteration expands on this "classical MB&F" ethos by reinterpreting the model in 18K white gold, replacing the former black accents with a dark blue PVD-inclined dial while adding a subtle high-jewelry execution.The defining characteristic of the SP One Pavée is its floating, gravity-defying movement suspended within an interior "amphitheatre". A trinity of core mechanical elements spanning the single mainspring barrel, the balance wheel oscillating at 18,000 vph at 2 o'clock, and the tilted hour-and-minute dial driven by conical gearing at 6 o'clock. These three components share identical circumferences and sit beneath a bezel-free, double-domed sapphire crystal shell. The architecture conceals almost all bridges, screws, and gear trains underneath, allowing maximum light to pass through the white gold case and illuminate the floating mechanical performance.Enhancing the watch's sculptural curves without disrupting its aesthetic balance, the SP One Pavée incorporates 255 brilliant-cut diamonds totaling 1.608 carats. Rather than covering the entire watch, the gem-setting precisely lines the pebble case with 165 diamonds, the rhodium-plated amphitheatre flange with 55 diamonds, the crown with 14 diamonds and the 18K white gold pin buckle with 21 diamonds.Measuring 38mm in diameter, 12mm in height and 41.9mm lug-to-lug, the watch features detached lugs rising from the lower case to preserve its smooth, tactile feel. Powered by an in-house hand-wound movement, the timepiece delivers a 72-hour power reserve. Limited in production and as part of MB&F’s Special Projects collection, the SP One Pavée represents a new chapter for the brand — an exploration of classical elegance interpreted through its unconventional lens. For details regarding its price and availability, head over to MB&F's official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Valve's Steam Frame Puts Your Entire Steam Library in a Wireless VR Headset
items.text: Valve's Steam Frame Puts Your Entire Steam Library in a Wireless VR Headset Summary Valve's Steam Frame is a wireless, streaming-first VR headset and controller set built to run the entire Steam libraryThe headset pairs custom pancake lenses with dual 2160x2160 LCD panels, a 72 to 144Hz refresh range and a 4nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processorNew Foveated Streaming and Multi-Link Streaming features use eye tracking and multiple connections to boost image quality and stability Valve has introduced the Steam Frame, a wireless VR headset and controller kit engineered to play a user's whole Steam library, in VR, in flatscreen and increasingly standalone. Positioned as a streaming-first device within the Steam Hardware family, it leans on a mix of custom optics, on-board processing and new eye-tracking-driven streaming tech to hold a stable, high-quality connection without cables or setup.The optics and display do the heavy lifting on immersion. Thin, lightweight custom pancake lenses deliver edge-to-edge sharpness and a large eye box, sitting in front of dual LCD panels running 2160x2160 per eye. Supported refresh rates span 72 to 144Hz, with 144Hz listed as experimental. Tracking runs inside-out with no setup required, using four high-resolution monochrome cameras plus infrared illuminators so the system holds up even in dark rooms.Under the hood, the Steam Frame is effectively a PC. It runs SteamOS 3 on a 4nm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 (ARM64) paired with 16GB of unified LPDDR5X RAM, backed by 256GB or 1TB of UFS storage and a microSD slot for expansion. That hardware is what enables standalone play on a growing list of VR and non-VR titles without a host PC, and it brings SteamOS staples like quick suspend and resume, cloud saves, a browser and user-installed apps into the headset itself. A Steam Frame Standalone Verified program flags which library games run locally, while a developer kit program aims to widen compatibility through Proton and SteamOS.The streaming architecture is where Valve concentrated its engineering. A plug-and-play 6GHz wireless adapter provides a dedicated link for both VR and non-VR streaming, and the headset's dual radios split the workload, one handling audio and visuals while the other maintains the Wi-Fi connection, so the two never compete for bandwidth. items.title: Nike Officially Unveils Caitlin Clark's Debut Caitlin 1 Signature Collection
items.text: Nike Officially Unveils Caitlin Clark's Debut Caitlin 1 Signature Collection Summary Nike has officially unveiled the Caitlin 1 signature shoe and accompanying collection for basketball icon Caitlin ClarkThe performance silhouette debuts a new Nike Opticast upper paired with a forefoot Air Zoom Turbo unit and Cushlon midsoleThe signature sneaker and apparel line release in China on September 24 2026 prior to a global launch on October 1 2026 Nike has officially revealed the Caitlin 1, the first signature sneaker and apparel collection for WNBA star Caitlin Clark. Engineered to amplify her range, speed, and unpredictable pace, the silhouette debuts alongside a full product suite marking the next phase of her partnership with the brand.The footwear debut introduces Nike's new Opticast upper, which incorporates cast polyurethane nodes at varying heights to reduce drag, offer lightweight lock-down, and reflect the visual geometry of the three-point line. For cushioning, a responsive forefoot Air Zoom Turbo unit is integrated with a plush Cushlon midsole. Personal design touches include stacked Swooshes, a custom tongue logo, lateral "C" and medial "2" node configurations, and outsoles inscribed with "Shoot More Threes," "From Anywhere," and "It Was Never a Long Shot."Debuting in "Caitlin Blue" and "Warning Code" launch schemes, the footwear anchors an 18-piece signature apparel range. The clothing capsule debuts Nike Standard Issue Stretch pieces tailored specifically for women hoopers, alongside Aero-FIT cooling garments carrying cement print motifs that reference Clark's childhood driveway court.The Nike Caitlin 1 signature shoe and apparel collection will release on September 24, 2026, in China, followed by a global rollout on October 1, 2026, at online and select retailers. items.title: Hikari no Yami Makes Official NYFW Debut With SS27 "Chapter 11: Parasite" Collection
items.text: Hikari no Yami Makes Official NYFW Debut With SS27 "Chapter 11: Parasite" Collection Summary Hikari no Yami officially debuts its SS27 "Chapter 11: Parasite" collection during New York Fashion Week.Key collaborations highlight upcycled Alpha Industries military outerwear, Vanessa Vun ink-dyed shirtin and 3D-printed ALTER LAB footwear. Hikari no Yami has made its official debut at New York Fashion Week with its Spring/Sumer 2027 collection, titled “Chapter 11: Parasite." Following its initial campaign reveal, the full presentation brings founder Jakarie Whitaker’s philosophical vision into full physical form.The full presentation unveiled the extensive scope of Hikari no Yami’s multi-disciplinary design partnerships. Chief among these is a major outerwear collaboration with Alpha Industries, which saw heritage military silhouettes - including MA-1 flight jackets and field parkas - re-engineered using Whitaker’s zero-waste upcycling techniques.The presentation also offered a closer look at collaborative, one-off pieces created with Art Director Alex Yarally from deadstock Japanese nylon mesh and silk chiffon, as well as hand-painted Sumi ink shirting developed alongside artist Vanessa Vun. Adding an anatomical dimension to the looks, designer Cierra Calmeise contributed molded resin spines and encapsulated tops, while 3D-printed, digitally manufactured footwear by ALTER LAB anchored the collection’s movement.Following its NYFW debut, the SS27 "Chapter 11: Parasite" collection will roll out in limited, made-to-order quantities at Dover Street Market Ginza and online at hikarinoyami.com. items.text: Louis Vuitton Crafts the Ultimate Travel-Ready Flight Mode Collection for FW26 Summary Louis Vuitton Flight Mode FW26 celebrates the Art of Travel with elegant, comfort-driven silhouettes.Highlights include coats, knitwear, and bags like the Low Key, Express, Side Trunk and Neverfull in Monogram Emblème canvas.Accessories and luggage complete the collection, including the Aluminium Horizon suitcase. Louis Vuitton has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 Women’s Flight Mode collection, celebrating the House’s foundational Art of Travel through the romantic charm of station platforms and leisurely train journeys. Built for the modern-day globetrotter, the collection presents a complete seasonal wardrobe where comfort merges seamlessly with effortless elegance. Across ready-to-wear, leather goods, footwear and luggage, the lineup leverages sumptuous fabrics and sophisticated neutral tones to elevate the travel experience across every destination.Led by seasonal outerwear such as belted double-breasted coats, duffle coats, peacoats and a sleeveless cape crafted from two-tone double-faced cashmere, the ready-to-wear range prioritizes versatile layering and high-touch materials. Supple leather and velvet-touch finishes define flight jackets, blousons and wide-leg trousers, while cozy cable-knit and brushed cashmere knits deliver exceptional warmth in Monogram, beige and white variations. On the accessories front, the Colorado comfort Mary Jane in Mahina suede introduces dynamic footwear styling, complemented by the LV Aura Flower sunglasses, the micro-Monogram Forevergram wool scarf, and the bi-material LV Arctic beanie.The collection highlights Louis Vuitton’s evolving bag lineup. The Low Key bag, first introduced in 2024, returns in Monogram red and walnut shades, while the Express bag is revisited with refined versatility. The Side Trunk and iconic Neverfull are adorned with the new Monogram Emblème canvas, available in exclusive Monogram Blue and Jura Green.Completing the Flight Mode offering, Louis Vuitton introduces new luggage and travel accessories designed to accompany every journey. The Keepall bag and Horizon suitcase appear in a striking Aluminium variation, reinforcing the Maison’s heritage in luxury travel while embracing modern innovation. The new Flight Mode collection is available for pre-order now through Louis Vuitton’s boutiques and official webstore. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: MODMNT's FW26 Collection Turns Military Archives Into a Modular Wardrobe
items.text: MODMNT's FW26 Collection Turns Military Archives Into a Modular Wardrobe Summary MODMNT (by NANGA) has begun rolling out its 2026 Fall/Winter collection, 'Beautifully Unpredictable,' featuring modular, military/outdoor-inspired pieces.Made predominantly in Japan, using Spanish duck down, the designs blend British and U.S. military references with an original plaid pattern.The collection releases in stages starting Friday, September 18. MODMNT, a brand developed by NANGA CO., LTD., one of Japan's leading outdoor brands, has begun delivering its 2026 Fall/Winter collection.Taking its name from "Modulement," a coined term born from the combination of “Module”, “Mode”, “Equipment”, and “Element”, MODMNT reinterprets outdoor, military, and vintage elements through a contemporary lens. By redefining the contemporary wardrobe through a modular philosophy, each piece is like a tool that can be freely selected, expanded, and combined.This season, MODMNT presents 'Beautifully Unpredictable.' The collection translates the free-form processes of layering, removing, adding, and rearranging into its designs, proposing a layered style in which combining different parts creates varying looks.The core liner down series introduces a new "Navy" colorway, designed to be worn both on its own and layered with other pieces. Among the outerwear, the lineup includes the MK Jacket, which combines details from British Royal Air Force jackets, the U.S. military's M-41 and CWU-36/P, and airborne trooper gear; the MF Jacket, inspired by the M-65 field jacket; a hooded shirt based on a U.S. Navy smock; and the MAG Pants, based on U.S. military helicopter crew pants and featuring large side-zip pockets.The collection also incorporates the brand's own original check pattern construction, expressing MODMNT's distinctive design language through both color palette and pattern. With the exception of some accessories, the items are produced domestically in Japan, and the down products use Spanish duck down, reflecting the brand's long-cultivated down manufacturing expertise.The MODMNT 2026 Fall/Winter collection will be released in stages starting Friday, September 18. items.title: Hublot and Jeff Koons Reframe Contemporary Art With Two Radical Timepiece Collaborations
items.text: Hublot and Jeff Koons Reframe Contemporary Art With Two Radical Timepiece Collaborations Summary Hublot partners with Jeff Koons to launch two art-driven limited-edition timepieces.The Classic Fusion Balloon Dog features "puffed" 3D geometry in steel and colored aluminum.The MP-14 Origin debuts Hublot’s first automatic central tourbillon inside a sapphire case. Hublot has announced a major partnership with world-renowned contemporary artist Jeff Koons, bringing his iconic sculptural language into the world of horology. Both Koons and Hublot share a philosophy of transforming tension into harmony and material into meaning, making this partnership a natural extension of their creative DNA. The collaboration introduces two standout models that merge Koons’ playful yet precise artistry with Hublot’s technical mastery: the Classic Fusion Balloon Dog by Jeff Koons and the MP‑14 Origin by Jeff Koons Sapphire Titanium.The Classic Fusion Balloon Dog by Jeff Koons reinterprets Hublot’s sleek dress-sports design language through the lens of the artist’s famous Celebration series sculpture. To mimic the internal tension and air-inflated volume of balloon animals, every surface of the 42mm case, bezel, dial, and sapphire crystal has been re-engineered with convex, "puffed" forms using 5-axis CNC milling. Decorative codes abound: a rubber-molded crown styled like a balloon’s inflation valve, a flexible rubber "dog tail" extending at 10:30, 3D Super-LumiNova indices, and a seconds hand featuring a miniature Balloon Dog counterweight. Powered by the automatic HUB1710 calibre with a custom rounded tungsten rotor, the edition is limited to 200 pieces per execution across three colorways - mirror-polished stainless steel, red anodized aluminum, and blue anodized aluminum - retailing at $25,100 USD.Pushing high horology into radical territory, the MP-14 Origin by Jeff Koons Sapphire Titanium acts as an experimental laboratory of mechanical art inspired by the cosmic birth of time. Housed in a 44mm octagonal transparent sapphire box case that requires over 534 hours of precision machining, the watch presents a gravitational architecture where concentric 18K white gold rings, set with 202 baguette diamonds and blue sapphires, orbit a central core.Protected by a translucent blue-varnished sapphire dome evoking Koons’ Gazing Ball works, the timepiece debuts Hublot’s first automatic central tourbillon. items.title: Jeremy Fall and Shake Shack Take Over the Original Madison Square Park Stand for One Morning Only
items.text: Jeremy Fall and Shake Shack Take Over the Original Madison Square Park Stand for One Morning Only Summary Shake Shack and chef Jeremy Fall have built a two-item breakfast menu that reinterprets his Short Order and Drugstore projectsThe collaboration runs for a single morning at Shake Shack's original Madison Square Park location and nowhere elseA "Breakfast Chopped Cheese" and an "Orange Dream Smoothie" make up the entire lineup, each co-created with Shack Executive Chef John Karangis Shake Shack and chef Jeremy Fall have linked for a one-day-only breakfast collaboration at the burger chain's original Madison Square Park location, translating two of Fall's projects into a pair of morning specials. The menu draws on Drugstore, his all-day concept, and Short Order, his street-side breakfast show, reworking both through Shake Shack's kitchen.The savory half of the menu comes from the Short Order side. The Breakfast Chopped Cheese reworks the New York bodega staple with Shack breakfast sausage, applewood-smoked bacon, and American cheese chopped together on the grill, the same technique that defines a classic chopped cheese. It is finished with hard-boiled eggs, lettuce, tomato, and onion, stacked on a toasted double potato bun, with a house-made deviled egg sauce served on the side for dipping.The drink leans into the Drugstore concept and its nostalgic streak. The Orange Dream Smoothie starts from Shake Shack's house-made vanilla custard and blends in an all-organic lineup of orange juice, mango, cauliflower, vanilla collagen, maple syrup, vanilla extract, coconut cream, and orange zest. The result is engineered to echo the flavor of an orange creamsicle, folding a functional-ingredient list into a deliberately throwback profile.Both items were co-created by Shake Shack Executive Chef John Karangis and Fall, and neither is sticking around. The collaboration is a strictly limited affair, available for a two-hour window at a single location before it disappears for good, making it a one-morning-only outing rather than a rollout with a second act.The Shake Shack x Jeremy Fall breakfast menu is available Tuesday, September 22 from 8 to 10 a.m., exclusively at the Madison Square Park Shake Shack. items.title: LAYERED Taps Collina Strada for a Whimsically Expressive Home Collection
items.text: LAYERED Taps Collina Strada for a Whimsically Expressive Home Collection Summary LAYERED x Collina Strada debut home collection of four rugs and two sofas.Designs feature signature pink/green tones, plaid and sculptural flower rugs.Hand‑tufted craftsmanship emphasizes organic forms, individuality, and tactile storytelling. Swedish design house LAYERED has partnered with New York-based fashion label Collina Strada to release a landmark home furnishing collection. This collaboration marks a significant milestone for both brands, serving as LAYERED’s first partnership with a fashion designer and Collina Strada’s inaugural foray into interior design products.The collaboration comprises four hand-tufted rugs and two sofas, spanning models like the Rosso Garden and Rosso Plaid, that translate the intuitive energy of contemporary ready-to-wear into enduring homewares. Anchored by Taymour’s signature pink and green tones, the designs directly reference Collina Strada’s brand history and previous fashion iterations. For instance, one rug pattern is lifted directly from the floor of the label’s New York flagship store, while another design prominently features the distinct plaid showcased on the brand's FW26 runway. The collection also introduces two flower-shaped sculptural rugs, such as the Petal Olive Plum, which utilize organic forms to challenge traditional room geometry and bring a dynamic, natural fluidity to the space.Each rug is hand‑tufted by two to three artisans over several days, with pile heights and edges hand‑carved to capture the spontaneity of a fashion sketch. This meticulous process ensures every piece carries unique variations, echoing Collina Strada’s ethos of imperfection as beauty. To further mimic the tactile structure of hand-drawn fashion illustrations, the pile heights and edges of the rugs are individually hand-carved, ensuring unique textural variations across every piece. This LAYERED x Collina Strada collection is available now us.layeredinterior.com. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Dario Vitale Appointed Creative Director of Emporio Armani and Giorgio Armani Accessories
items.text: Dario Vitale Appointed Creative Director of Emporio Armani and Giorgio Armani Accessories Summary Armani Group has officially named Dario Vitale as the creative director of Emporio Armani and Giorgio Armani AccessoriesThe appointment marks the first external design lead hired across the brand following founder Giorgio Armani's passing in 2025Vitale previously led design teams at Miu Miu for 14 years before a brief tenure as creative director at Versace Emporio Armani has officially appointed Dario Vitale as its new creative director, effective immediately. Vitale will also assume the role of creative director for Giorgio Armani Accessories, marking the first time the Armani Group has brought in an external creative leader to steer one of its primary fashion lines.The appointment represents a major generational shift for the Italian fashion house following the passing of founder Giorgio Armani in September 2025. Vitale arrives at the house after a brief tenure at Versace and a 14-year career at Miu Miu under Miuccia Prada, where he served as design director of ready-to-wear and head of image. His extensive experience guiding Miu Miu through rapid growth will inform his direction at Emporio Armani, which was originally established in 1981 as a youthful, metropolitan brand.The transition comes as Armani Group's designated creative heirs, Silvana Armani and Leo Dell'Orco, prepare to showcase their final co-ed presentation for Emporio Armani on September 24, 2026. Vitale will step into his dual role immediately to construct a new chapter for the label ahead of his official debut runway collection for the Fall/Winter 2027 season. items.title: USM and Symbol Audio Open The Doors to a "Record Shop" in London
items.text: USM and Symbol Audio Open The Doors to a "Record Shop" in London Swiss furniture favorite USM has transformed its London store into a record shop, filled with pieces from its Symbol Audio collaboration. Installed as part of this week's London Design Festival (which runs until Sunday, September 20) the "USM Record Store" takes over the Marylebone space, paying homage to the connection between design and music through talks, performances, and other activations. Pieces from the existing Symbol collaboration, first launched in 2024, are dotted around – from record stands, to a DJ booth, and vinyl crates to display cabinets. “We’ve held USM in high-regard here at Symbol for a long time, not only for their incredible product, but the clarity of their vision for the world of furniture," Walker Tovin, Symbol's brand director said at the time of the first launch. "The opportunity to work with their legendary catalog of components has been an exciting privilege that we've enjoyed from start to finish."In addition, the newest pieces from the collection, which launched in the US earlier this year, will be presented in the UK for the first time. These come in the form of Speaker Module, which are designed to intergrate with the wider system. All of this takes place within the context of a working record shop, which has been curated in collaboration with The Vinyl Factory, where visitors will be able to look through a wide collection of new and old vinyl, while grabbing a coffee (from a bespoke USM coffee bar, of course) from local roaster Origin. USM X Symbol Audio's Record Shop is on view during London Design Festival 2026, and was one of our must-see selections for the week. Check the rest out here. items.title: KOZABURO Revives Rare 1950s Bandana Art for SS27
items.text: KOZABURO Revives Rare 1950s Bandana Art for SS27 Summary KOZABURO marks 10 years with an SS27 collection inspired by mid-century blues, Ganges River memories, and living fabrics that age over time.Archival 1950s cosmic bandana prints, washed terrycloth fleece and sumi ink-dyed linen-cotton elevate relaxed silhouettes.10-year washed denim debuts on the 1960s-inspired Rockaway Jacket, while unstructured suiting introduces fluid Balloon and Skirt Pants. Nostalgia isn’t just a theme for Kozaburo Akasaka — it’s the engine driving his brand toward its 10-year milestone. Presented at New York Fashion Week, the KOZABURO Spring/Summer 2027 collection, titled “ Beat,” channels the quiet weight of memory, tracing a line from an adolescent voyage to the Ganges River back to long nights sifting through vintage shop racks. Anchored by the raw, soul-stirring heritage of mid-century American blues, the lineup discards rigid structures in favor of fluid, living garments. Cool grays, icy blues and sumi ink dyes set a contemplative tone, specifically engineered to fade, shift, and record the wearer’s journey over time.Americana roots run deep throughout the collection, pulling directly from Akasaka’s personal closet to build a dialogue between past and present. The centerpiece is a cosmic, Indian-crafted bandana print derived from a rare 1950s uncut sheet, sweeping across airy Camp Collar shirts, Koikuchi tops, and unisex Skirt Pants built for summer ease. Athletic nostalgia also gets a thoughtful overhaul through 1940s-style terrycloth fleece. Retro details take center stage, from "afterhood" sweatshirts with post-applied hoods to cardigans fitted with split "boxer" pockets, seamlessly paired with flowy Jax sweatshorts.Denim, long the spine of the KOZABURO identity, undergoes a dramatic aging process for SS27. Moving away from the dense, unyielding raw textiles of recent seasons, the fabric arrives heavily washed down to mimic ten solid years of wear, softening rigid indigo and charcoal into sun-faded baby blues and muted grays. Archival workwear makes a bold return via the debut Rockaway Jacket - a boxy homage to 1960s utility gear featuring period-accurate small o-ring zippers - complemented by the relaxed cut of the new Short Dexter Pants.Rounding out the presentation is an ambitious reinterpretation of tailoring that completely rejects stiff formality. items.title: Veronica Leoni Redefines American Minimalism for Calvin Klein Spring 2027
items.text: Veronica Leoni Redefines American Minimalism for Calvin Klein Spring 2027 Summary Veronica Leoni presented Calvin Klein’s Spring 2027 collection at Terminal Warehouse, showcasing a refined take on American Minimalism.Silhouettes featured elongated proportions, bold color accents, and a custom check pattern inspired by Georgia O'Keeffe.The lineup balanced crisp tailoring and bias-cut dresses with silk cady baseball shirts, laser-cut suede and structural origami bags. Calvin Klein's Spring 2027 runway show marked Creative Director Veronica Leoni’s continued exploration of American Minimalism, presented at the historic Terminal Warehouse in New York City. Set against the industrial 1891 architecture, the runway integrated three floor sculptures by Walter De Maria, creating a space where audience and models moved in parallel alongside a soundtrack by Kid Harpoon featuring Laurie Anderson and Solange. The atmosphere reflected Leoni’s ethos of "discipline of removal," centering the relation between design and the body with precise, purposeful restraint.The mood was sleek, disciplined and sensual, with silhouettes elongated, narrowed, or cinched to emphasize structure and movement. Foundational pieces such as coats, shirts, trousers, pencil skirts and slips were reworked with crisp tailoring and bias cuts, creating garments that balanced precision with fluidity. Evening dresses emerged from slip and t‑shirt forms, while extra‑fine silk knits and color‑blocked baseball shirts carried forward Calvin Klein’s American sportswear vernacular.The range highlighted tailoring in cotton and lightweight wool, including a slim three‑button suit with the ease of a t‑shirt and a broader‑shouldered jacket designed for layering. Denim, leather, and laser‑cut suede added texture, while delicate flashes of underwear reinforced the brand’s sensual minimalism. The palette moved through whites and blacks into scarlet, bright yellow, royal blue, cherry, and citron, with a check inspired by Georgia O’Keeffe’s wardrobe providing a subtle nod to artistic heritage.Accessories were purposeful and sculptural, from metal headbands and pointed scarves to enlarged bags in sleek or slouchy forms, including a new triangular origami‑like shape. Standout looks included bias‑cut evening slips, sharply tailored cotton suits and silk cady baseball shirts that merged sport and elegance. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Kurono Tokyo Unveils the Calendrier Small Batch Release in Saxe Blue
items.text: Kurono Tokyo Unveils the Calendrier Small Batch Release in Saxe Blue Summary Kurono Tokyo unveils the Calendrier Small Batch Release (SBR) in glossy saxe blue.Features applied chrome Arabic indices via electroforming and triple calendar display.Limited online release on September 24, 2026, priced at $2,380 USD. Independent Japanese watch brand Kurono Tokyo has announced the Calendrier Small Batch Release (SBR), an off-calendar model born from master watchmaker Hajime Asaoka’s personal creative inspiration and fondness for saxe blue. Conceived to make efficient use of unallocated components and movements, Small Batch Releases are produced in intentionally lower-than-usual quantities. The new timepiece revisits Asaoka’s earlier triple-calendar concept - which debuted in salmon pink - to bring his long-considered saxe blue dial vision to reality.The standout feature of the Calendrier SBR is its applied Arabic indices, crafted using electroforming rather than traditional stamping. This technique allows for sharper, more intricate shapes, producing a striking contrast between the luminous chrome indices and the rich saxe blue dial. The watch retains the triple calendar complication, displaying day, date and month — all powered by the reliable Miyota 9122 automatic movement with a 40‑hour power reserve. Measuring 38 mm in diameter and 10 mm thick, the stainless‑steel case is paired with a calf leather strap, sapphire box crystal, and water resistance to 5 ATM, ensuring both elegance and practicality.The Calendrier SBR will be available for purchase exclusively online on September 24, 2026, at 11 p.m. JST, priced at $2,380 USD. Deliveries are expected to begin in late October 2026. Ahead of the release, Kurono will host previews at its Aoyama and Shanghai salons, allowing enthusiasts to experience the watch in person. As a one‑time production run, the Calendrier SBR will not be repeated, underscoring its rarity and appeal to collectors who value Asaoka’s blend of traditional craftsmanship and personal creative whim. items.title: Jessica Chastain Plays Dual Roles in Blumhouse's Unsettling 'Other Mommy' Trailer
items.text: Jessica Chastain Plays Dual Roles in Blumhouse's Unsettling 'Other Mommy' Trailer Summary Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster have released the official trailer for Rob Savage's psychological horror film 'Other Mommy'Produced by James Wan the story stars Jessica Chastain in a dual role alongside Jay Duplass and Arabella Olivia ClarkAdapted from Josh Malerman's novel Incidents Around the House the film opens exclusively in theaters on October 9, 2026 Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster have officially released the new trailer for Other Mommy, an upcoming psychological horror feature directed by Rob Savage (Host, The Boogeyman) and produced by James Wan (Saw, Insidious, The Conjuring). Adapted from Josh Malerman's bestselling novel Incidents Around the House, the story follows a young girl who forms a chilling bond with an entity masquerading as her mother.The film features Academy Award winner Jessica Chastain in a dual performance, portraying both eight-year-old Bela's protective mother and "Other Mommy," a terrifying entity manifesting inside the family home. Arabella Olivia Clark plays Bela, while Jay Duplass stars as her father, Daddo. The supporting cast is rounded out by Dichen Lachman (Severance), Arian Moayed (Succession), and screen legend Karen Allen (Indiana Jones).Written for the screen by WGA Award winner Nathan Elston (Succession), Other Mommy centers on the psychological terror of a child manipulated by a supernatural force seeking access to her heart. Executive produced by Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Rob Savage, Josh Malerman, and Ryan Lewis, the project brings together two of modern horror's premier creative minds.Other Mommy releases exclusively in theaters on October 9, 2026. items.title: A Knight’s Tale Meets Y2K Punk in Collina Strada’s SS27 “Detour” Collection
items.text: A Knight’s Tale Meets Y2K Punk in Collina Strada’s SS27 “Detour” Collection Summary Collina Strada hosted the first-ever runway show at Storm King Art Center, using the open landscape to explore themes of reinvention and detour.The SS27 collection blended medieval romance, Y2K punk and eco-conscious design through over-draping, complex ruffles, and organza feathers. For Spring/Summer 2027, Collina Strada staged a historic runway presentation by taking a "Detour" at the Storm King Art Center, marking the first time the famed Hudson Valley sculpture park hosted a New York Fashion Week show. Set against open fields, massive outdoor sculptures and the open sky, the presentation treated clothing as an extension of the physical landscape. Models traversed open grass, mirroring the collection's core theme of instinctual exploration, metamorphosis, and breaking away from predefined paths. The environment reinforced Hillary Taymour’s vision of garments as dynamic, sculptural forms that continuously reshape how the wearer moves through space.The aesthetic narrative of the new seasonal collection operates at the intersection of medieval romance and modern street rebellion. Drawing visual references from A Knight’s Tale alongside Y2K codes, punk edges and eco-conscious design, the lineup merges historic softness with contemporary attitude. An earthy yet vibrant color palette dominates the collection, featuring shades of dusty rose, mineral plaid, olive, cocoa grid and sky blue. Visually, the collection balances delicate organza feathers, complex over-draping and cascading ruffles against raw textures, reflecting a spirit of fluid self-reinvention.The range expands across versatile separates, heavy draping and formalwear engineered for movement. Key style silhouettes include volumetric over-draped bottoms, tailored corsetry, deconstructed cargo pieces, and ethereal layering. The offering transitions from playful micro-silhouettes such as high-cut panties and mini skirts to dramatic floor-length gowns. Signature textiles like deadstock fleece, organic cotton, and eco-acetate anchor the casual pieces, while delicate silks, floral-dot shantung, and organza elevate the collection's high-concept romantic shapes.Standout items within the 33-look collection highlight the brand's commitment to sustainable texture play and contrast. Recycled sequins take center stage across multiple hero garments, notably seen in the olive painted plaid Pollen Legging and the floor-sweeping Sky

items.title: How Izaak Brandt Brought Breaking to the Serpentine for the First Time
items.text: How Izaak Brandt Brought Breaking to the Serpentine for the First Time For Izaak Brandt, the body has always been an instrument. As a breakdancer, you learn to fall, get back up and try again. Failure is never the end. But over the past few years, Brandt’s relationship with his own body has changed.Last year, after three years of worsening symptoms, he was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis. His symptoms had become so severe that doctors initially investigated for cancer. “It’s really changed so much in my life,” he says. “In the last two years, I’ve just realised how fragile my physical body is.”That realisation sits at the heart of “Soft Shell,” his latest and most personal work to date. Unveiled last week at the Serpentine Pavilion in London, “Soft Shell” inaugurated XXIe Siècle, a new global art programme focused on the performing arts, and marked Brandt’s first public presentation of the piece.The work brings together sculpture with a seven-person choreography centered on breaking, exploring hardness and softness, strength and fragility, and the relationships between young men and their own fractured sense of self. At its core, however, “Soft Shell” is inseparable from what Brandt has lived.“This work wouldn’t have come into play if I hadn’t found myself fu***d up internally,” he says. The beginnings of the project stretch back around two years, to what Brandt describes as one of the most turbulent periods of his life. His finances, personal life and health were all under pressure, even while, externally, his career appeared to be moving in the opposite direction.“On the outside, things looked very, very good,” he remembers. “There were lots of amazing opportunities happening and me and my team were really pushing, but I was not well at all.” Searching for a way to protect his internal world, Brandt became fascinated by animals that use their own bodies as defence mechanisms. Pangolins and armadillos, and the way they curl themselves into protective forms when threatened, became early reference points.“Everything else was so turbulent, it was like the only thing I’ve got is this physical form,” he explained. “I’ve got to figure out how to navigate through the world in this thing.” Those ideas gradually developed into movement, before the movement itself was translated into sculpture. items.title: IWC Unveils Two Monochrome Ingenieur SL Editions in Brushed Silver
items.text: IWC Unveils Two Monochrome Ingenieur SL Editions in Brushed Silver Summary IWC celebrates 50 years of Gérald Genta’s Ingenieur SL with two limited-edition watches.Features brushed silver-plated dials with a commemorative "50" logo in 40mm and 35mm sizes.Capped at 1,150 pieces each, offering 120-hour power or sapphire casebacks. IWC is marking the 50th anniversary of Gérald Genta’s Ingenieur SL with two special limited editions that pay tribute to the original 1976 design. Known as Reference 1832, the Ingenieur SL introduced bold aesthetics with its integrated bracelet and bezel secured by five screws, a style that would later become a defining hallmark of luxury sports watches. Though only 598 pieces were produced between 1976 and 1983, the model has since become one of IWC’s most sought‑after collector’s watches, inspiring the modern Ingenieur line launched in 2023. To mark five decades of this design heritage, IWC introduced the Ingenieur Automatic 50th Anniversary edition in 40mm and 35mm.Both novelties feature brushed silver-plated dials inspired by a rare vintage variant of the 1970s Reference 1832. Paired with rhodium-plated hands and Super-LumiNova® filled indices, the monochromatic display carries a subtle commemorative detail: the traditional lightning bolt motif beneath the "Ingenieur" inscription has been replaced with the number "50". Crafted from stainless steel, both cases feature the signature five-screw satin-finished bezel with polished edges. While the 40mm version maintains a fully satin-finished integrated bracelet, the 35mm iteration incorporates polished middle links for an elevated dress-sports aesthetic.The 40mm model is powered by the in-house Calibre 32111, featuring a double-pawl winding system that delivers a 120-hour power reserve, alongside a soft-iron inner case to protect against magnetic fields. Conversely, the 35mm edition offers a see-through sapphire caseback exposing the Calibre 47110, complete with a gold-plated oscillating weight and a 42-hour power reserve. Prices range from $12,900 USD for the 35mm variant, to $15,000 USD for the 40mm model. Both models are capped at 1,150 pieces each and are available for inquiry through IWC’s website and boutiques. items.title: Jordan Brand and Nike Strength Launch Gym Equipment Collection
items.text: Jordan Brand and Nike Strength Launch Gym Equipment Collection Summary Jordan Brand has partnered with Nike Strength to launch a full home and commercial strength-training gym equipment collectionDesign elements incorporate elephant print patterns from the Air Jordan 3 outsole graphics from the Air Jordan 7 and shoebox-inspired plyo boxesThe lineup releases on October 13, 2026 with prices ranging from $25 USD for accessories up to $1 750 USD for a half rack Jordan Brand and Nike Strength have officially announced the Jordan Strength Collection, expanding the Jumpman moniker into home and commercial fitness hardware. The comprehensive workout lineup draws historical inspiration from Michael Jordan's late-1980s physical conditioning program to withstand the physical play of the Detroit Pistons.The collection includes roughly a dozen distinct pieces, ranging from adjustable benches, a half rack, barbells, curl bars, and bumper plates to change plates, dumbbells, kettlebells, and a plyo box. Specialized accessories like collars, J-Cups, and storage shelves round out the offering.Signature footwear details are integrated directly into the hardware. Dumbbells and weight plates showcase the iconic elephant print originally introduced on the Air Jordan 3, while structural framing on larger equipment incorporates outsole patterns pulled from the Air Jordan 7. Additionally, the plyo box adopts the silhouette of a classic Jordan shoebox, accompanied by accents referencing the number 23, Chicago Bulls championship years, and design cues from the Air Jordan 4.The Jordan Strength collection will release on October 13, 2026, via Nike Strength. FThe release introduces two distinct iterations—the "Outlaw" and "Rodeo"—drawing design inspiration from the boutique's Louisiana roots and regional culture.The "Outlaw" iteration features a black pebbled leather upper paired with a crocodile-style textured collar. Detailed Western stitching is applied across the toe box and side panels, giving the dark colorway a subtle heritage feel.Contrasting the black pair, the "Rodeo" adopts a classic Western palette with a dark brown leather upper. Cow-print material wraps around the heel counter to provide a bold focal point without altering the boot's timeless silhouette. The project expands on Sneaker Politics' history of designing collections centered around the scenery, music, and bayou landscapes of the Pelican State.The Sneaker Politics x Timberland "Outlaw" and "Rodeo" 6-Inch Boots will launch on September 24, 2026, in-store and online via Sneaker Politics, followed by a wider release through Timberland on September 25, 2026, for $225 USD each. items.title: VILLAGE PM Debuts the 2PM Silhouette, Marking Expansion Into the US for FW26
items.text: VILLAGE PM Debuts the 2PM Silhouette, Marking Expansion Into the US for FW26 Summary VILLAGE PM has introduced its new 2PM silhouette alongside fresh Fall/Winter 2026 colorwaysThe Paris-founded skate brand is officially entering the US market with a dedicated domestic website and premier retail stockistsFounded by Basile Lapray and Bram De Cleen the label merges high-performance climbing shoe functionality with progressive skate design VILLAGE PM has officially announced the launch of its 2PM silhouette alongside its debut expansion into the United States for the Fall/Winter 2026 season. Founded in Paris in March 2025 by Basile Lapray and Bram De Cleen, the progressive skate footwear label expands its global footprint following the breakout success of its flagship 1PM model.The new 2PM model evolves the brand's core design ethos, combining rapid break-in comfort with high abrasion resistance. Engineered closer to the ground with a more structured profile, the shoe retains VILLAGE PM’s signature sticky rubber wrapping and precise, asymmetrical fit derived from technical climbing footwear. Alongside the 2PM silhouette, the Fall/Winter 2026 lineup introduces new colorways including "Lime" on the 1PM, "Green" on the 1PM MID, and "Olive" on the 1.30PM, while restocking staple "Chocolate" and "Black" iterations.Coinciding with the new collection, VILLAGE PM is making its long-awaited entry into the US market. Domestic distribution spans landmark fashion and skate stockists including MAXFIELD, UNION, Dover Street Market, NOTRE, FTC, and LABOR, alongside a dedicated US webstore offering domestic shipping.The VILLAGE PM FW6 collection and 2PM silhouette will launch via select domestic retailers and the brand's webstore and on their dedicated US site for the first time. items.title: Netflix Unveils First Look at ‘The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey’ Ahead of December Premiere
items.text: Netflix Unveils First Look at ‘The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey’ Ahead of December Premiere Summary Netflix has set The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey for a global premiere on December 10, 2026, sharing a first-look image of its leadsMelissa McCarthy stars as Patsy Ramsey opposite Clive Owen as John Ramsey in the limited seriesThe show dramatizes one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history and the reckoning that followed the child's death on Christmas night in 1996 Netflix has revealed a first look at The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey, the limited series starring Melissa McCarthy and Clive Owen as Patsy and John Ramsey, and confirmed a global premiere date of December 10. The image offers the first glimpse of the two leads in character as the parents at the center of a case that has held public attention for nearly three decades.The casting anchors the project. McCarthy, a two-time Emmy winner and Academy Award nominee, takes on Patsy Ramsey, while Owen, himself an Emmy and Academy Award nominee, plays John Ramsey, pairing two performers better known for very different registers on a story rooted in real tragedy. Around them, the series fills out a large ensemble that includes Emily Mitchell as JonBenét Ramsey, Angus Caldwell as Burke Ramsey, and a roster of investigators and officials played by Garrett Hedlund, Alison Pill, Shea Whigham, Clifton Collins Jr., Rory Cochrane, and Chris Bauer, with Will Patton, Margo Martindale, and Tzi Ma among the additional cast.The subject matter gives the series its weight. It centers on the death of JonBenét Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996, one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and on the personal and public fallout that followed. The framing leans less on procedural resolution, which the real case never reached, and more on the devastating reckoning the family and the country went through in its aftermath, a distinction that shapes the series as a character study as much as a true-crime retelling.That approach fits a case whose grip on the public has never fully loosened. The Ramsey story became a defining media spectacle of the late 1990s, and its unresolved status has kept it in circulation across decades of coverage and speculation. The series enters that long conversation with a dramatized account built around the two people who stood at its center.The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey premieres globally December 10 on Netflix. items.title: McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team and Central Saint Martins, UAL Take Pole Position on the Runway
items.text: McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team and Central Saint Martins, UAL Take Pole Position on the Runway As Fashion Week kicked off in London, McLaren united with Central Saint Martins, University of the Arts London, several miles away at the McLaren Technology Centre for a unique showcase of their collaborative collection.Earlier this summer, the project commenced with McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team inviting the university’s MA Fashion students to design 12 looks that reimagine its motorsport heritage up to the present-day Papaya era. Spanning six decades, the cohort was split into groups and given an era to draw inspiration from. The process involved tactile practices like sewing, engineering new materials, and crafting components, as well as using Dell Technologies XPS laptops to elevate their creativity. After months of work, the collection came together at yesterday’s show at the team’s headquarters. Titled Designed to Race: Front Row, the event honed in on the synergy between fashion’s innovative creativity and motorsport’s mechanical ingenuity. With McLaren Mastercard F1 Team Drivers Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri, as well as rapper Kojey Radical and celebrity stylist Edie Liberty Rose, stopping by the showcase, the diverse guest list brought tastemakers and prominent figures from the respective industries to celebrate the moment in the futuristic space. At the start of the evening, Hypebae's Editor-in-Chief kicked off a panel discussion with Chief Marketing Officer at McLaren Racing, Louise McEwen, Course Leader of MA Fashion at Central Saint Martins, Fabio Piras, Senior Vice President at Dell Technologies, Liz Matthews, and TV Presenter and Host of F1, Ariana Bravo. “Design has always played an essential part in our racing team performance and brand,” began McEwen as she explored how design exists in racing. “Not just on the technical side, but with our liveries, and the role these have played in celebrating milestone moments.” Bravo then went on to speak about how this is received with fans, adding, “McLaren delivers that community feel through fan experiences, content creation, and creating tangible moments. Partnerships like these open new, imaginative ways to get excited about your team.” Later, the conversation turned to the forthcoming fashion show. “One of the designers in the Group – Enzo Keuning – invented a technique, you’ll see today in Grit x Glamour,” shared Piras. Giving guests a taste for what was to come, he noted, “The scarf uses an i

items.title: The S’YTE x MOONSTAR 001 Marks a New Footwear Chapter for Yohji Yamamoto’s Label
items.text: The S’YTE x MOONSTAR 001 Marks a New Footwear Chapter for Yohji Yamamoto’s Label Name: S’YTE x MOONSTAR Logo Cotton Canvas Sneakers GC/001Colorway: Black/WhiteSKU: TBCMSRP: ¥29,700 JPY (approx. $191 USD)Release Date: September 19Where to Buy: YOHJI YAMAMOTOS’YTE, the Yohji Yamamoto label built around its “Anti-Mode” philosophy, is entering the footwear realm with the S’YTE x MOONSTAR 001 -- a collaborative sneaker based on MOONSTAR’s heritage GYM CLASSIC.Constructed in Japan from durable cotton canvas, the low-top retains the roomy proportions of the athletic-derived original while introducing S’YTE-specific embroidery at the tongue and branded heel patches. The shoe is produced through MOONSTAR’s FINE VULCANIZED line, using a vulcanization process that bonds the rubber sole to the upper for flexibility and durability, while the upper is shaped and fitted to the insole by hand through the traditional “tsurikomi” process.The Black and White colorways both lean into S’YTE’s characteristically stark palette while reversing their contrasts. The Black edition with a deep black canvas upper, matching black rubber toe cap and sole, offset by crisp white laces and white S’YTE tongue embroidery; its heel carries a tonal black patch finished with contrasting “BLACK IS MODEST” branding.The White version flips the treatment with natural off-white canvas, black laces, black foxing and toe protection, plus a bold vertical black strip running down the heel for a graphic, utilitarian finish. Marking the “001” starting point for S’YTE’s footwear category, the sneakers releases on September 19 with distribution through THE SHOP YOHJI YAMAMOTO and select S’YTE, WILDSIDE YOHJI YAMAMOTO and Ground Y locations. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Le Coq Sportif’s Sporting Archive Gets the vowels Treatment
items.text: Le Coq Sportif’s Sporting Archive Gets the vowels Treatment Summary vowels and Le Coq Sportif unite sporting heritage with research-led design.Black, white and chartreuse pieces feature botanical graphics and archival-inspired details.Yannick Noah fronts the capsule, anchored by a reworked Wendon sneaker. vowels and Le Coq Sportif have joined forces on an exclusive capsule that brings the French sportswear label’s extensive archive into the New York-meets-Tokyo brand’s research-driven design language. Fronted by tennis legend and longtime Le Coq Sportif ambassador Yannick Noah, the collection draws on the idea of sport as a broader cultural force, filtering heritage athletic codes through vowels’ made-in-Japan approach.A black, white and chartreuse palette runs throughout, joined by a recurring botanical motif. Highlights include a black varsity jacket with chartreuse piping and a hand-drawn floral graphic, a white crewneck bearing Le Coq Sportif’s rooster crest, an oversized co-branded raglan T-shirt and a technical long-sleeve top. Wide-leg track pants, matching shorts and a structured cap round out the apparel and accessories.The hero piece from the release is the Wendon, a classic 1960s running silhouette from Le Coq Sportif. vowels reimagined the timeless model into a new elasticated version, softening its aesthetic while preserving its slim, historical proportions. The vowels x Le Coq Sportif capsule collection is exclusively available via vowels online and through its New York flagship boutique. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: KAMIYA Brings a Worn-In Edge to BROTHER BRIDGE’s HENRY Boot
items.text: KAMIYA Brings a Worn-In Edge to BROTHER BRIDGE’s HENRY Boot Name: BROTHER BRIDGE x KAMIYA HENRY BootMSRP: TBCRelease Date: September 19Where to Buy: KAMIYABROTHER BRIDGE and KAMIYA have joined forces on a collaborative boot that reworks the Asakusa-based shoemaker’s signature HENRY through KAMIYA’s vintage-informed design language. Retaining the model’s tall, lace-up construction, the collaboration adds extra volume through the toe for a heavier, more substantial silhouette. Two colorways highlight contrasting treatments of calf leather: Black arrives in smooth leather with a cleaner, subtly lustrous surface, while Brown uses suede, giving the boot a softer, matte appearance with greater textural depth. The dark tonal palettes, metal eyelets and extended lacing maintain the HENRY’s utilitarian character while the enlarged proportions push the familiar shape in a more rugged direction.KAMIYA’s preference for worn-in finishes is further explored through an additional vintage-treated version, which is distressed to resemble a boot that has already undergone years of wear despite being new. The effect introduces an intentionally weathered appearance that contrasts with the cleaner standard editions, reinforcing the label’s longstanding interest in aged and imperfect surfaces. As a result, the differing smooth, suede and distressed treatments allow the collaboration to move between polished and deliberately lived-in finishes while preserving BROTHER BRIDGE’s recognizable footwear framework. The BROTHER BRIDGE x KAMIYA HENRY boots are scheduled to release on September 19 through KAMIYA’s directly operated store, its online shop and authorized retailers. items.title: The Realest Auctions Shohei Ohtani's Historic 2025 Tokyo Series Game-Worn Jersey
items.text: The Realest Auctions Shohei Ohtani's Historic 2025 Tokyo Series Game-Worn Jersey Summary The Realest has opened public bidding for Shohei Ohtani's game-worn Los Angeles Dodgers jersey from the 2025 MLB Tokyo Series openerThe collectible features the first Gold MLB Logoman patch ever worn in an official game alongside a rare kanji signature and handwritten inscriptionsBidding for the piece is currently live on TheRealest.com and will officially conclude on October 17, 2026 The Realest has officially launched the auction for the Shohei Ohtani 2025 MLB Tokyo Series Game-Worn Dodgers Jersey. Worn during the March 18, 2025 season opener at the Tokyo Dome, the piece marks the first official Major League Baseball game Ohtani ever played in Japan.The jersey stands out as a historic milestone artifact, carrying the first Gold MLB Logoman patch ever worn in an official game—a designation introduced in 2025 for defending MVP, Cy Young, and Rookie of the Year winners. The uniform remains intact with the inaugural gold patch stitched alongside the official 2025 Tokyo Series emblem and the Dodgers' Fernando Valenzuela No. 34 memorial patch.Furthering its individual provenance, Ohtani personally autographed the garment in kanji (大谷翔平) and added handwritten inscriptions reading “Opening Day Tokyo Series,” “GU 3-18-25,” and “NL MVP.” The piece has been verified through MLB's on-field authentication program, photo-matched by SIA Photomatching, and documented via Fanatics Authentic as part of The Realest's Certified evaluation program.Bidding for the Shohei Ohtani 2025 MLB Tokyo Series Game-Worn Jersey is open now at The Realest and will close on Saturday, October 17, 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: adidas and Asphalt Serve Up a Cannoli-Inspired Samba
items.text: adidas and Asphalt Serve Up a Cannoli-Inspired Samba Name: adidas x Asphalt SambaColorway: “Cannoli”SKU: TBCMSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: September 25Where to Buy: Asphaltadidas has teamed up with Staten Island-born retailer Asphalt for a limited-edition Samba inspired by one of New York City’s most recognizable bakery staples: the cannoli.The collaboration dresses the classic low-top silhouette in a dessert-informed palette of warm wheat, rich chocolate brown and playful pink, translating the pastry’s golden shell, chocolate chips and colorful bakery-counter presentation into the sneaker’s material and color story. Contrasting accents add depth to the otherwise earthy base, while a removable cannoli charm and illustrated footbed make the culinary reference more explicit.To emphasize personal style, the sneaker is highly customizable, featuring three interchangeable Velcro tongue options - which can also be removed entirely - alongside three distinct sets of laces for endless personalization. Limited to just 600 individually numbered pairs, the Samba will release in sizes 4 through 13, including half sizes through all Asphalt locations and the retailer’s online store. items.title: ‘Stranger Than Heaven’ Previews Its Gritty Combat and “Showbiz” Gameplay
items.text: ‘Stranger Than Heaven’ Previews Its Gritty Combat and “Showbiz” Gameplay Summary RGG Studio previews Stranger Than Heaven’s opening sequence, historical settings and gritty combat.“Showbiz” adds an entertainment-focused dimension to Makoto Daito’s journey.The multi-era action-adventure launches January 15, 2027. SEGA and Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio have offered an extensive new look at Stranger Than Heaven, unveiling the game’s opening sequence alongside fresh footage during a special Tokyo Game Show 2026 livestream.The opening follows protagonist Makoto Daito as he is accused of murder and pursued by police, with the ensuing confrontation doubling as an introduction to the game’s gritty combat system. The presentation also moves through three of the title’s five historical settings - Kokura, Fukuoka in 1915; Kure, Hiroshima in 1929; and Minami, Osaka in 1943 - while showcasing exploration and period-specific activities.The highlight of the special preview was the first official gameplay look at the core "Showbiz" (Show Business) production system. Operating as a Talent Impresario in 1943 Osaka (Minami), players guide Daito as he gathers musical inspiration across city streets, recruits vocalists and band members, adjusts track arrangements using an in-depth mixing interface, and manages live theatrical stage shows.The studio also detailed its new trigger-based combat system, featuring dual light and heavy attacks alongside a revamped stance-based guard system and showcased beginner-friendly options like the "RGG Special Suit" item. Adding to the fanfare, RGG Studio Executive Director Masayoshi Yokoyama confirmed that a live-action Stranger Than Heaven feature film adaptation is currently in development at Netflix, cementing the project’s multi-platform rollout. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: 9090 and adidas Originals Give the Track Jacket a Cow-Print Makeover
items.text: 9090 and adidas Originals Give the Track Jacket a Cow-Print Makeover Summary 9090 reunites with adidas Originals for an exclusive Track Jacket.Velour construction pairs classic Three Stripes with playful cow-print detailing.Available in Navy and Brown, the jacket launches September 18-19. Japanese streetwear label 9090 has reunited with adidas for a collaborative Track Jacket, following the duo’s earlier project centered on adidas’ Heritage JK Bag. For fall, the two parties' turn their attention to a classic adidas track-top silhouette, updating the sportswear staple with a soft, lustrous velour construction. Signature Three Stripes run along the sleeves, while cow-print detailing appears across the stripes and underneath the collar, adding a playful 9090 touch to the otherwise streamlined design. An adidas Originals Trefoil at the chest completes the branding, with the jacket offered in Navy and Brown colorways.Balancing retro sportswear cues with 9090’s contemporary streetwear sensibility, the jacket maintains a clean silhouette while allowing its contrasting animal-print details and textured velour finish to take focus. The collaboration continues a growing relationship between the two brands, after 9090 previously applied its signature pink palette to adidas accessories earlier this year. Priced at ¥14,300 JPY (approx. $92 USD), the 9090 x adidas Originals Track Jacket is scheduled to roll out across September 18 - 19, 2026, with availability through its official webstore.
