items.text: Shareef O’Neal Debuts First-Ever Shareef by Shaq Collection Summary Shareef O’Neal has debuted the inaugural Shareef by Shaq collection during New York Fashion WeekThe preview features an unnamed lifestyle silhouette alongside the Devastator 4XT and a new running-style modelOfficial release dates and pricing for the upcoming Shaq Brand footwear models have yet to be announced Shaq Brand and Shareef O’Neal have officially previewed the inaugural Shareef by Shaq Collection during New York Fashion Week. The footwear showcase marks a new creative direction for the company as Shaquille O'Neal hands a larger role to his son to expand the label beyond traditional basketball performance models.Highlighting the preview is an unnamed lifestyle sneaker that departs from the brand’s historic basketball silhouettes. Constructed with a classic cupsole, thick laces, and a removable zippered shroud, the model incorporates a reworked, relaxed interpretation of the signature Dunkman logo across its side profile.The presentation also showcased additional upcoming silhouettes, including updated takes on the Devastator, the 4XT, and a lightweight running-style model detailed with perforated side panels and a molded sole. These new iterations build on existing Shaq Brand offerings currently available on the market, such as updated versions of the Dunkman 1.0, Reign, and Devastator.Official release dates and pricing details for the new Shareef by Shaq footwear collection have yet to be announced. items.title: Lucien Pellat-Finet Reworks Its Iconic Skull Motif With UNDERCOVER and TAKAHIRO MIYASHITA
items.text: Lucien Pellat-Finet Reworks Its Iconic Skull Motif With UNDERCOVER and TAKAHIRO MIYASHITA Summary Lucien Pellat-Finet joins UNDERCOVER and TAKAHIRO MIYASHITA for exclusive cashmere knitwear.Scottish-made intarsia knits reinterpret the label’s signature skull through contrasting punk and poetic aesthetics.Releasing on September 18, 2026. Lucien Pellat-Finet has partnered with UNDERCOVER and TAKAHIRO MIYASHITA for an ultra-exclusive cashmere knitwear collaboration. Under the creative direction of Tsuyoshi Noguchi, this project reinterprets lucien pellat-finet’s iconic skull motif through the distinct design lenses of both collaborator brands. Crafted in Scotland using traditional intarsia knitting techniques, each piece exemplifies high-level craftsmanship, merging delicate cashmere textures with intricate graphic execution.The UNDERCOVER iteration surrounds lucien pellat-finet's signature brand lettering with a bold, reinterpreted skull and crossbones graphic that bridges Jun Takahashi's subversive punk spirit with high-end luxury. Meanwhile, the TAKAHIRO MIYASHITA design delivers a more minimalist, poetic aesthetic, featuring a crescent moon-inspired skull motif on the front paired with the cursive phrase "Wandering Companionless" across the back shoulders. Both styles rely on stripped-back monochromatic palettes to let the detailed intarsia construction and distinct artistic visions take center stage.Priced at ¥594,000 JPY (approx. $3,812 USD) each, the crewneck cashmere knits represent a pinnacle convergence of Japanese street culture and European luxury craftsmanship. The collection officially launches on September 18, 2026 and wil be available through Lucien Pellat-Finet flagship locations, as well as online via the Coronet official webstore. items.title: Eckhaus Latta Brings Raw Urban Rhythm to New York Fashion Week for SS27
items.text: Eckhaus Latta Brings Raw Urban Rhythm to New York Fashion Week for SS27 Summary Eckhaus Latta has debuted its Spring/Summer 2027 collection during New York Fashion WeekThe conceptual runway narrative balances raw textures bare floors and cashmere socksUnconventional styling accents include papercutters carried as purses alongside themes of physical exertion Eckhaus Latta has officially presented its Spring/Summer 2027 collection on the runway during New York Fashion Week. The new seasonal range explores raw sensory experiences, pairing unexpected styling accents with contrasting textures to establish an understated urban narrative.The collection examines the tension between luxury fabrications and raw utilitarian elements. Show notes highlight sensory contrasts across everyday environments, juxtaposing bare feet against naked indoor floors alongside cashmere socks worn on humid outdoor sidewalks.Visual styling takes an eccentric turn through unconventional props, featuring models carrying papercutters in place of traditional purses. Anchored by existential imagery and the visceral concept of physical effort—framing the satisfaction of sweating in order to sweat again—the presentation grounds the seasonal wardrobe in a dialogue of tactile textures, subtle humor, and poetic daily movement.The Eckhaus Latta SS27 collection debuted as part of the official New York Fashion Week schedule. items.title: A Hello Kitty Collaboration With Burger King Is Reportedly on the Way
items.text: A Hello Kitty Collaboration With Burger King Is Reportedly on the Way Summary Sanrio and Burger King are reportedly set to release a collaborative six-piece collectible figure seriesThe collection features Hello Kitty Kuromi Cinnamoroll My Melody and Keroppi outfitted with signature fast-food accessoriesThe lineup includes a rare Gold Hello Kitty variant and is expected to follow Burger King's upcoming Dragon Ball Super campaign Sanrio and Burger King are reportedly linking up for an exclusive collectible figure collaboration. The upcoming fast-food partnership is set to feature Sanrio's iconic mascot Hello Kitty alongside her fan-favorite co-stars across a limited-edition toy lineup.According to reports, the collection will feature six distinct collectible figures including Hello Kitty, Kuromi, Cinnamoroll, My Melody, and Keroppi. Each character is customized with signature Burger King motifs, depicted either wearing the fast-food chain's traditional paper crown or holding staple meal items. The roll-out also reportedly highlights an ultra-rare Gold Hello Kitty variant, which will be distributed in limited quantities to select customers.The reported promotion arrives amidst Sanrio's broader pop-culture expansion and is scheduled to follow an upcoming Burger King partnership with Dragon Ball Super. The Hello Kitty toy series is expected to debut immediately following the conclusion of the anime fast-food campaign.The Hello Kitty x Burger King collectible collection is expected to launch at participating Burger King locations following the brand's Dragon Ball Super campaign. items.title: Metallica Announces 2027 North American Stadium Dates for M72 World Tour
items.text: Metallica Announces 2027 North American Stadium Dates for M72 World Tour Summary Metallica has officially confirmed a new slate of 2027 North American stadium dates extending its long-running M72 World TourThe upcoming stadium leg features supporting performances from Limp Bizkit and Avatar across twelve citiesTickets will go on general sale on September 25 2026 following fan club and corporate presale opportunities Metallica has officially announced a new series of 2027 North American stadium dates, extending the band's massive M72 World Tour. Promoted by Live Nation, the new leg kicks off on May 8, 2027, at BC Place in Vancouver, hitting 12 new cities across the American Southwest, Midwest, and beyond before wrapping up on June 19, 2027, at Rice-Eccles Stadium in Salt Lake City.The upcoming stadium run follows the heavy metal icons' Life Burns Faster residency at Sphere in Las Vegas, which runs from October 1, 2026, through March 13, 2027. Joining Metallica as support on all 12 newly revealed North American stops will be Limp Bizkit and Avatar.As with previous legs of the tour, a portion of proceeds from every ticket sold will benefit local charities through Metallica’s philanthropic organization, the All Within My Hands foundation. The non-profit supports workforce education through the Metallica Scholars Initiative, combats food insecurity, and provides critical disaster relief services, with all administrative costs covered directly by the band.Tickets for the newly announced M72 World Tour dates will go on general sale starting Friday, September 25, 2026, at 10 AM local time via Metallica's official site, with Fan Club pre-sales launching on Monday, September 21, 2026, alongside exclusive presales for Citi cardmembers and Verizon Shine customers. items.title: The Weeknd Reverses Retirement Decision and Confirms He Will Retain Stage Name
items.text: The Weeknd Reverses Retirement Decision and Confirms He Will Retain Stage Name Summary The Weeknd has officially walked back earlier statements regarding his retirement and name changeIn a recent interview, the artist confirmed he will continue releasing music under his iconic stage moniker indefinitelyThe announcement arrives as his global 'After Hours 'til Dawn' Tour prepares to wrap up in November The Weeknd has officially announced that he is no longer planning to retire from music or abandon his moniker. The pop vocalist addressed his future career plans in a new interview, confirming his intention to continue recording and performing for as long as possible.Reflecting on his heightening inspiration over the past year, the musician stated, “I had a glimpse of what retirement looks like, and it isn’t for me. It’s a real privilege to do what I do. There’s nothing else like this job. The gratitude I’ve felt over the last year has been overwhelming. I’m going to keep doing this for as long as I possibly can. The Weeknd isn’t going anywhere.”The statement marks a clear shift from previous comments where he hinted at ending the persona, having previously noted, "The Weeknd was never a mask I wore to hide from myself, Abel was always there. It was simply a lens I chose to tell certain stories through." Reaffirming his commitment to his creative alias, the artist continues to build momentum as his long-running After Hours ‘til Dawn Tour approaches its final leg.The Weeknd’s After Hours ‘til Dawn Tour is scheduled to officially conclude in November 2026. items.title: Ressence Collaborates With Artist Jules Wittock for the Kinetic TYPE 9 Labyrinth Watch
items.text: Ressence Collaborates With Artist Jules Wittock for the Kinetic TYPE 9 Labyrinth Watch Summary Ressence pairs with Belgian artist Jules Wittock for the TYPE 9 maze watch.The hand-filled labyrinth conceals a secret word that only aligns at midnight and midday.Limited to 60 total pieces across Emerald Green and Black editions. Ressence has unveiled the TYPE 9 Jules Wittock edition, the latest in its art watch series, created in collaboration with Belgian artist Jules Wittock. Known for his freehand labyrinths, Wittock brings his signature maze designs to the dial of the TYPE 9, with each path engraved into Grade 5 titanium and hand‑filled with white lacquer. Limited to 60 pieces - 30 in Emerald Green and 30 in Black - the watches invite wearers to discover hidden words within the maze, revealed only when the dial aligns at midnight or midday.The centerpiece of the collaboration is a 0.2-millimeter-wide maze milled directly into Grade 5 titanium and hand-filled with white lacquer and Grade A Super-LumiNova®. Designed with a single entrance and exit, the labyrinth conceals a secret word embedded within its paths. Because the dial relies on the patented Ressence Orbital Convex System (ROCS 9) - where hours and minutes sub-dials continuously orbit in revolving motion - the labyrinth continuously shifts throughout the day. The secret word only aligns and reveals its hidden message twice daily, at midnight and midday, offering a playful homage to Wittock’s childhood ritual of making wishes at repeating times like 11:11 or 22:22.The Emerald Green edition arrives in its namesake hue in an ALD-coated titanium dial that shifts to purple depending on the light angle. Meanwhile, the Black edition presents a stark white-filled maze over a black PVD-coated titanium dial and black case. Housed in a compact 39mm by 11mm polished Grade 5 titanium case weighing just 42 grams, both models are driven by a customized self-winding movement delivering a 36-hour power reserve. Operating without a traditional crown, winding and time setting are adjusted directly via the rotating caseback. Available via Ressence's online store and select global retailers, each piece is priced at 20,000 CHF (approx. $24,420 USD). Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Samsung Requests Dismissal of Dua Lipa's $15 Million USD Image Lawsuit
items.text: Samsung Requests Dismissal of Dua Lipa's $15 Million USD Image Lawsuit Summary Samsung has asked a California federal judge to dismiss Dua Lipa's $15 million USD lawsuit over her photo appearing on TV packagingLegal counsel for the company contends that a celebrity's face does not serve as a trademark or brand endorsement indicatorJudge Christina A. Snyder is scheduled to hear Samsung's motion to dismiss the lawsuit on December 14, 2026 Samsung Electronics has officially filed a motion to dismiss Dua Lipa's $15 million USD lawsuit regarding the unauthorized use of her photograph on television packaging. The filing submitted to the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California argues that the pop star cannot assert trademark rights over her own face.The legal dispute stems from a registered 2024 Austin City Limits backstage photograph displaying Lipa within a mock-up screen interface on Samsung retail boxes. Lipa claims the packaging falsely implies a commercial partnership and product endorsement. In response, Samsung argues that the image serves merely as a background graphic for a music video channel interface rather than a source-identifying trademark, referencing legal precedent involving Tiger Woods and Bob Marley.Samsung further challenges the lawsuit's right-of-publicity claims, arguing that Lipa's United Kingdom domicile renders California publicity laws inapplicable. Additionally, defense lawyers contend the complaint improperly conflates South Korean parent company Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. with its American subsidiary without identifying specific corporate liability. Judge Christina A. Snyder will hear the motion to dismiss on December 14, 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: McLaren Confirms Its First SUV Is Officially in Development for 2028
items.text: McLaren Confirms Its First SUV Is Officially in Development for 2028 Summary McLaren has confirmed development of its first high-riding four-door SUV scheduled to debut as early as 2028The project is supported by a £500 million GBP investment into the brand's U.K. development and manufacturing facilitiesCode-named P47 the vehicle is expected to feature a hybrid V-8 powertrain along with all-wheel drive and 24-inch wheels McLaren has officially confirmed the development of its first-ever SUV, slated to arrive as early as 2028. The announcement was made alongside a £500 million GBP (approximately $669 million USD) investment into the brand's U.K. manufacturing and development infrastructure under its Abu Dhabi ownership.Speaking on the project, McLaren CEO Nick Collins stated that the upcoming model aims to translate the brand's Formula 1 success into a practical vehicle for high-net-worth buyers seeking supercar performance combined with daily utility. The expanded operations are expected to create 1,000 new jobs, with development likely anchored at the company's carbon-fiber facility in Sheffield.Code-named the P47, the four-door, five-seat vehicle represents a historic departure for the traditional supercar manufacturer. Early details indicate the high-performance SUV will incorporate a hybrid V-8 engine, an all-wheel-drive platform, and 24-inch wheels—marking the largest wheel setup in the marque's six-decade history.The McLaren SUV is expected to make its official debut as early as 2028 through McLaren's global retail network. items.title: Aimé Leon Dore and The North Face Unveil 30-Piece FW26 Collection
items.text: Aimé Leon Dore and The North Face Unveil 30-Piece FW26 Collection Summary Aimé Leon Dore and The North Face have teamed up for a 30-piece Fall/Winter 2026 collectionThe lineup revisits archival silhouettes including a GORE-TEX Mountain Jacket 2000 and a late-1990s Heli VestThe collection launches on September 17, 2026 at 11 AM ET via Aimé Leon Dore and The North Face Aimé Leon Dore and The North Face have officially revealed their Fall/Winter 2026 collection, marking the second seasonal partnership between both brands. The 30-piece capsule merges technical alpine heritage with ALD's distinct New York design language.The range reinterprets core outerwear silhouettes, led by the Mountain Jacket 2000 constructed from seam-sealed three-layer GORE-TEX. The drop marks the first time the waterproof fabric has returned to a North Face collaboration since 2019. The Pertex Nuptse receives a functional overhaul featuring Cloud Down insulation, an integrated hood, and a fully reversible inside-out construction.The collection also revives the late-1990s Heli Vest, an archival piece originally engineered for alpine conditions. Aimé Leon Dore highlighted the silhouette during its New York Fashion Week presentation by parking a co-branded helicopter outside its Manhattan flagship. Updated takes on the Denali fleece and complementary outdoor apparel complete the 30-piece assortment.The Aimé Leon Dore x The North Face Fall/Winter 2026 collection releases on September 17, 2026, at 11 a.m. ET through Aimé Leon Dore, The North Face, and select retailers. items.title: KwolleM Takes Hypebeast on the Road to Tutto Bene With Porsche
items.text: KwolleM Takes Hypebeast on the Road to Tutto Bene With Porsche For a recent installment of DRIVERS, three sportscar owners shared an exclusive look at their love for Porsche, expressing what community and cars mean to them ahead of Sportscar Together Day. Continuing to spotlight the moments that bring fans of the brand together, Hypebeast reunites with KwolleM for Italy’s most picturesque driving event: Tutto Bene. Tucked away in Monte Mottarone in Stresa, Italy, the annual event takes a unique approach to showcasing car culture. Minimizing corporate activations, it allows homegrown communities to experience driving runs and stunts in their truest form. For a new Come with Me feature, the music producer shares a slice of the action at the showcase and all the special Porsche events in between. Setting himself up for the trip, KwolleM picks up Porsche’s 911 GT3 RS with an eye-catching Sportscar Together day livery, a fitting choice for the narrow roads and uphill climbs along the journey. He then heads to a private island in Stresa for a VIP dinner. As well as getting to meet fellow Porsche owners, the dinner brings him into the vast mountainscape that will soon host Tutto Bene. The next day, KwolleM heads to the main event alongside 1,000 other car owners, collectors, and casual enthusiasts. After checking in, he begins by exploring the vehicles on show, ranging from rally cars and hypercars to restomods and custom builds that underscore the breadth of automotive culture.As excitement for the hill climb amps up, KwolleM takes his spot along the 9km stretch that trails from the lake up to the peaks. Here, two-time Le Mans winner Patrick Long gears up in his green-wrapped 911 GT3 Cup, while other drivers take their seats in various Porsche models for the staggering climb.On the final day of the road trip, the producer takes his 911 GT3 RS for one last outing to the Porsche Experience Center in Franciacorta. Coinciding with Sportscar Together Day, KwolleM is one of 14,000 Porsche owners and fans who celebrated the worldwide community activation at a Porsche Experience Center. He unites with the global community by exploring generations of the brand's cars, capturing them in pictures and videos as a small reminder of his trip.Follow KwolleM’s road trip to Tutto Bene in the Instagram post below. Discover how to connect with your local sportscar community at events and gatherings on the Porsche Stories website now. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 424 and DITA Unveil Limited-Edition Artoa.92 Eyewear Collaboration
items.text: 424 and DITA Unveil Limited-Edition Artoa.92 Eyewear Collaboration Summary DITA and 424 have officially released a collaborative edition of the Artoa.92 aviator frameThe release is strictly limited to 100 total pairs split across two exclusive lens colorwaysEach custom-packaged pair comes complete with a piece of sandpaper inviting wearers to distress the titanium frame DITA and 424 have officially launched the 424 x Artoa.92 eyewear collaboration. Designed in Los Angeles and handcrafted in Japan, the limited-edition sunglasses reimagine DITA’s signature titanium aviator silhouette through Guillermo Andrade’s distressed design language.The 424 x Artoa.92 centers on a Japanese-engineered titanium aviator frame, marrying DITA’s precision handwork with 424’s signature Los Angeles attitude. Embodying a design concept titled "Perfection, Disturbed," every pair arrives pristine inside a custom leather case styled after the worn textures found throughout 424’s apparel lines. To personalize each piece over time, the packaging includes an enclosed piece of sandpaper, encouraging the wearer to manually distress and scuff the frame.The release is strictly limited to 100 pairs globally, divided evenly into 50 pairs featuring "Pigeon Blood" lenses and 50 pairs featuring "Smoke" lenses.The 424 x Artoa.92 releases on September 18, 2026, for $595 USD exclusively via DITA, U.S. DITA flagship stores, and the 424 Flagship on Melrose Place in Los Angeles. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Kylian Mbappé Leaves Nike and Joins On to Launch Brand's Football Division
items.text: Kylian Mbappé Leaves Nike and Joins On to Launch Brand's Football Division Summary Swiss sportswear brand On has officially announced its entry into football alongside star forward Kylian MbappéArsenal legend Thierry Henry has been named Director of Football after working with On on the category launch since 2025On will apply its proprietary LightSpray manufacturing technology to develop elite football footwear and apparel On has officially announced its expansion into football alongside world champion Kylian Mbappé, marking the Swiss sportswear brand's debut in the sport. Under the leadership of Arsenal legend Thierry Henry, who steps in as Director of Football after working behind the scenes since late 2025, the brand aims to combine elite athlete insight with Swiss engineering.The partnership positions Mbappé as he departs Nike, as both a core athlete partner and a global ambassador for movement and performance at On. Working directly with On's product development teams in Zurich, Mbappé will test and refine future football footwear and apparel built around On's proprietary LightSpray™ spray-on textile technology.Reflecting on the partnership, Mbappé stated, “From the beginning, what drew me to On was the opportunity to build something entirely new together that will help shape tomorrow’s game. I want to bring my experience and perspective into what we create, push what’s possible through innovation, and always stay true to the joy of football. We have a shared dream, and this is only the beginning.”Henry will oversee strategic growth, athlete relationships, and product direction for the division. FC Barcelona player Sydney Schertenleib also joins the roster to help shape products designed for the women's game, with the launch campaign captured by photographer Juergen Teller at On Labs in Zurich. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: McDonald’s Puts a Bold Stamp on London Fashion Week With New Accessory
items.text: McDonald’s Puts a Bold Stamp on London Fashion Week With New Accessory McDonald’s has hit the streets of London for Fashion Week with a new must-have accessoryThe McHappy Day® Beanie was first spotted on actor Jenny Walser as she arrived at the Mithridate Show earlier this week. A fully reversible knit hat with McDonald’s signature tones, Walser wore the accessory on the yellow side to bring a touch of color blocking to her fit. Outside 180 The Strand, DJ and model Jordan Mainoo-Hames showcased the hat's versatility by pairing it with his usual sporty stylings on his way to Fashion Week events. From the streets of London to McDonald’s locations across the UK, the wider public can now add the limited-edition accessory to their winter wardrobes by buying it at kiosks in their local McDonald’s restaurant. With every purchase, customers will support the charity’s work helping families with children in hospital by providing free accommodation near their ward.The launch celebrates the restaurant’s new national fundraising day, McHappy Day®, with all proceeds from the beanie going to Ronald McDonald House UK. The 14 Ronald McDonald Houses across the UK support families to alleviate the practical and financial pressures that come with hospital stays. Ahead of the drop, find out how fashion week attendees wore the hat – including presenter Charli Fisher, host Kyle De’Volle and DJ Phoenix Brown – by checking out McDonald’s new paparazzi-style campaign in the gallery above. The McHappy Day® Beanie is available in participating McDonald’s restaurants or via the McDonald’s App while stocks last, for £5 GBP (approx. $7 USD). Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: G-SHOCK’s 2100 “Luxe Black” Series Delivers Staple Accessories Every Creative Needs
items.text: G-SHOCK’s 2100 “Luxe Black” Series Delivers Staple Accessories Every Creative Needs Behind every G-SHOCK watch is founder Kikuo Ibe’s ambition to make “a watch that never breaks,” and for its latest release, this approach evolves into the “Luxe Black” series. Maintaining the brand’s signature durability and distinctly structured aesthetic, the series introduces the GM-2100LXB and GA-2100LXB with a refined all-black aesthetic. Taking a closer look, both iterations in the series play with a range of textures. From the matte black dial with a fine-grain surface to the vapor-deposited glass and markers, each component brings a multi-dimensional feel that elevates the foundational design of the boxy 2100 line. As for the “Luxe” element, the brand layers the faces with hints of silver in two iterations and gold in the others. Similar to the dial and bio-based resin band, these metallic tones have a matte finish to round out the refined aesthetic. With the new drop standing out as a modern staple, Hypebeast explores how the 2100 “Luxe Black” series fits into the life of Abu Dhabi-based Osama Mutasem. Captured in a new campaign, the community curator and founder of Hang With Me takes the GA-2100LXB on the go as he visits Al Serkal Avenue and stops off at The Hive.While the watch lends a sleek look that matches Mutasem’s tailored style, its versatility proves to be the highlight of its design. Effortlessly transitioning from meetings with fellow creators to scouting concept stores for fresh inspiration, the model provides the curator with uncompromised reliability and an understated edge of confidence.Discover the campaign in the gallery above and the video below. The G-SHOCK 2100 “Luxe Black” series is now available to buy on the Casio Middle East website and in partner stores across the region. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Kith x On Expands the K-Tech Line With the New K-Tech 3
items.text: Kith x On Expands the K-Tech Line With the New K-Tech 3 Name: Kith K-Tech Fall 2026MSRP: $180- 190 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: KithKith and On are expanding their collaborative footwear partnership for Fall 2026 with the introduction of the K-Tech 3, the duo’s first dedicated lifestyle silhouette. Building upon the foundation of their previous releases, the new K-Tech 3 features a highly textured upper crafted from technical woven mesh and layered with premium suede overlays.Two colorways offer markedly different treatments: Ivory/Storm layers creamy mesh and pale suede with yellow-green detailing around the heel and branding, finished by a contrasting teal-toned midsole edge, while Black/Black takes a more understated approach with tonal black mesh, matte suede and matching tooling that lets the differences in texture define the shoe. Co-branding appears across the tongue, footbed and lateral side, with K&K artwork placed medially.The new drop also revisits the earlier K-Tech 1 and K-Tech 2 with new seasonal finishes. The performance-focused K-Tech 1 appears in Shark/Ox, combining a cool grey, subtly purplish technical mesh upper with darker overlays and an almost-black sculpted CloudTec® sole; underneath, a dual-density Helion™ foam midsole, Speedboard® and Kith Monogram tread maintain its running-oriented specifications.The everyday K-Tech 2 arrives in Grain/Taiga, mixing cream open mesh with muted olive, pale blue-grey and brown suede against dark tooling, and Ruby/Ox, which shifts into burgundy mesh, dusty pink suede and deep berry accents for a richer tonal effect. Both K-Tech 2 versions retain the segmented CloudTec® tooling and dual-density Helion™ foam used across the performance platform. The footwear accompanies K-Tech’s broader Fall 2026 apparel offering of lightweight jackets, moisture-wicking tops, technical pants and shorts, plus accessories. items.title: ENGWE’s “Born to Fly” Spirit Takes Flight With the Eagle All-Terrain Dirt Bike
items.text: ENGWE’s “Born to Fly” Spirit Takes Flight With the Eagle All-Terrain Dirt Bike Global e-bike maker ENGWE is officially turning the page on traditional e-mobility with the launch of the Eagle, its first electric dirt bike. Known for its versatile urban commuting lineup, the brand is stepping beyond point-A-to-point-B utility to embrace youth culture, outdoor adventure, and personal style. Built specifically for Gen Z trendsetters and young speed enthusiasts, the Eagle represents an entry point into off-road lifestyle sport entertainment. Under the banner of "Born to Fly," the bike is designed not just as a vehicle, but as a form of self-expression and creative freedom on two wheels.Built to Ride. Designed to Stand OutVisually, the Eagle commands attention before its tires even hit the dirt. Sporting an aggressive dirt-bike silhouette, compact frame build, and a bold red colorway, its athletic stance offers a striking visual impact compared to conventional e-bikes. That bold attitude translates directly into an experience-driven ride: a 3,200W peak mid-drive motor unleashing 220Nm of raw torque delivers instantaneous acceleration, effortlessly tackling 30-degree inclines, deep sand, and mud trails. Delivering adrenaline-fueled speeds of over 45 mph, the powertrain is balanced by heavy-duty front and rear dual suspension that absorbs heavy trail landings. For maximum control when pushing limits, race-spec hydraulic disc brakes and a magnetic emergency kill switch provide the safety and confidence riders need to shred with peace of mind.Carter Metcalfe: Finding Your Own Way to FlyAt the heart of the "Born to Fly" ethos is 14-year-old mountain bike rider and digital creator Carter Metcalfe. Growing up with Tourette syndrome, Metcalfe discovered that mountain biking offered much more than an adrenaline rush — it became a therapeutic outlet to build confidence, focus energy, and transform personal challenges into motivation on the trail. Today, his story inspires younger riders to embrace their passions and overcome perceived limits. As the official product ambassador for the Eagle, Metcalfe embodies the bike’s core message: finding what you love, building resilience, and discovering your own path forward.Passing the Torch: From One Generation to the NextThis October, Metcalfe is taking the Eagle to Utah for the iconic Red Bull Rampage, where he will connect with and learn from professional freeride legend Tom van Steenbergen. items.title: Brain Dead and Andersson Bell Team up for Outdoor-Inspired Technical Wear Collection
items.text: Brain Dead and Andersson Bell Team up for Outdoor-Inspired Technical Wear Collection Summary Brain Dead and Andersson Bell have joined forces for a collaborative collection inspired by technical outdoor wearThe campaign features Tuareg guitarist Mdou Moctar highlighting the intersection of nomadic culture and functional designThe collection drops on September 25, 2026 with prices ranging from $54 to $600 USD Brain Dead and Seoul-based label Andersson Bell have officially unveiled the Brain Dead x Andersson Bell Collection. Grounded in a tactile approach to technical outdoor wear, the partnership bridges the creative visions of Brain Dead co-founder Kyle Ng and Andersson Bell creative director Dohun Kim.The collaborative range fuses cultural narratives with functional outdoor design. To represent this ideology, the campaign stars Tuareg guitarist and songwriter Mdou Moctar, whose creative work embodies the nomadic culture of the Sahara. The apparel and footwear assortment highlights expressive graphics and utilitarian silhouettes across a full multi-piece lineup.Outerwear and tops are led by a multi-colored Tie-Dyed Jacket ($600 USD), a matching Tie-Dyed Shirt ($300 USD), and graphic offerings including the Cow T-shirt ($54 USD) and Mosquito T-shirt ($54 USD). Bottoms and functional layers feature Fringe Pants ($225 USD), a Denim Print Skirt ($220 USD), and a Traingolo Vest Backpack ($350 USD). Completing the range is a cow-patterned Mary Jane shoe ($375 USD) alongside a Camel Keychain Wallet ($250 USD).The Brain Dead x Andersson Bell collection releases on Friday, September 25, 2026. items.title: G-DRAGON and McDonald’s Serve Up a Gochujang Butter Menu Across Asia
items.text: G-DRAGON and McDonald’s Serve Up a Gochujang Butter Menu Across Asia Summary G-DRAGON and McDonald’s launch a Gochujang Butter menu across 13 Asian markets.Highlights include a K-Crispy Thigh Burger, Chicken McNuggets and Korean-inspired sides and desserts.PEACEMINUSONE branding extends across packaging, collectibles and limited-edition merchandise. G-DRAGON has joined forces with McDonald’s for a new Asia-wide collaboration centred on the Gochujang Butter menu, bringing his distinctly Korean cultural and visual language to the fast-food chain across 13 markets.The campaign launched in Hong Kong and South Korea simultaneously on September 17, marking the first time McDonald’s Hong Kong has aligned its release with the Korean market. At its centre is a Gochujang Butter Sauce developed by McDonald’s Korea and inspired by Korea’s longstanding jang fermentation culture, balancing the savoury, gently spicy character of gochujang with the richness of butter for a sweet, creamy and lightly piquant finish.Leading the Hong Kong menu is the Gochujang Butter K-Crispy Thigh Burger, which layers a whole crispy chicken thigh with the signature sauce, a slice of pineapple and romaine lettuce, allowing the gochujang’s spice and umami to play against buttery richness and a sweeter tropical note. The sauce also appears as a dip for Chicken McNuggets, while the broader Korean-inspired menu extends to Korean Barbecue and returning Honey Butter Shake Shake Fries, alongside a Jeju Satsuma Nata de Coco soda. Dessert offerings include a Sweetheart Crunchy OREO McFlurry finished with pink heart-shaped crisps and Salted Caramel Mini Churros, giving the rollout a more comprehensive food-and-drink treatment rather than limiting the collaboration to a single signature item.Beyond the menu, G-DRAGON’s influence is most visible through PEACEMINUSONE, with his fashion label’s signature daisy reworking familiar McDonald’s iconography throughout the campaign. Promotional visuals place motifs such as the Golden Arches, fries and classic red packaging within G-DRAGON’s design vocabulary, while the Hong Kong food packaging combines PEACEMINUSONE daisies with McDonald’s branding and a specially created red “MCD” heart graphic.The release will continue in stages: limited “I’M M FAN” collectible cards arrive on September 21, followed on September 23 by PEACEMINUSONE collaborative merchandise including a retro McDonald’s cap, metal pins and a canvas tote. items.title: PROJECT PUMA PLUS. Explores “Functional Beauty” for FW26
items.text: PROJECT PUMA PLUS. Explores “Functional Beauty” for FW26 Summary PROJECT PUMA PLUS. returns for FW26 with a focus on “functional beauty.”Natural textures and muted tones inform relaxed, understated sportswear.The collection launches October 16 through PUMA Japan and select retailers. PUMA has unveiled the Fall/Winter 2026 installment of PROJECT PUMA PLUS., continuing the capsule line it introduced for SS26. Built around the concept of “wearing functional beauty,” the project places PUMA’s sports-performance expertise within a contemporary wardrobe designed to move seamlessly between activity and everyday urban life. For FW26, that approach evolves through an emphasis on lightness, durability and breathability, balanced against more refined, understated styling.The collection takes cues from the textures and muted tones of natural materials including washi paper, canvas, wood, shoji paper and blocks, translating their warmth and depth into a subdued palette and a mix of curved and linear forms. The resulting pieces favor relaxed proportions, layered silhouettes and restrained PUMA branding, reinforcing the meeting point between technical function and everyday design.Designed to seamlessly blur the lines between high-performance sportswear and modern street style, the collection delivers a versatile assortment of structured outerwear, layered tops, and relaxed trousers. The new PROJECT PUMA PLUS. collection is scheduled to officially launch on October 16, 2026. It will be available through PUMA Japan's webstore, as well as select physical retail locations. items.title: Hamilton’s ‘Modern Warfare 4’ Khaki Field Watch Is Built for the Mission
items.text: Hamilton’s ‘Modern Warfare 4’ Khaki Field Watch Is Built for the Mission Summary Hamilton reunites with Call of Duty for a Modern Warfare 4 -inspired Khaki Field Mechanical.The 38mm watch features tactical detailing and Captain Price tie-ins.Releasing in tandem with the game's official launch on October 23; priced at $795 USD. Hamilton is returning to the Call of Duty universe with a new Khaki Field Mechanical 38mm created in collaboration with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, extending a partnership first established in 2025. Continuing the watchmaker’s push into interactive storytelling, the new model has been developed as an in-world object rather than simply a branded tie-in: it is worn by Captain Price in Modern Warfare 4, linking the character’s military background with Hamilton’s own field-watch lineage. The design also references historic Hamilton military watches, particularly British-issued General Service models, while translating that utilitarian heritage through the visual language of the game.The collaboration centers on a 38mm sandblasted stainless steel case with black PVD coating, matched with a heavily grained black dial and khaki green textile strap for a distinctly tactical appearance. Details drawn directly from Modern Warfare 4 include typography referencing the game’s recognizable “4,” colored dial accents tied to its visual identity and an engraved caseback bearing the franchise’s signature soundwave graphic. Super-LumiNova Grade X2 appears across the numerals, hour markers and hands, while a sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating and 50-meter water resistance reinforce the watch’s functional field-watch character.Inside, Hamilton equips the model with its H-50 hand-wound mechanical movement, offering an 80-hour power reserve and a Nivachron balance spring. Measuring 9.5mm thick with a 20mm lug width, the watch keeps the relatively compact dimensions associated with the Khaki Field line while adopting a darker, mission-ready treatment tailored to the Modern Warfare setting. Priced at $795 USD, the watch will be officially launched in tandem with the game's release on October 23, 2026. For more information, head over to Hamilton’s official website. The storyline centers on the Fairbank family, whose relentless pursuit of wealth triggers a deadly conflict for inheritance and corporate control.Returning to thematic territory explored in The Gentlemen, the project delves into the ruthless dynamics of the British aristocracy. Produced alongside Ivan Atkinson and John Friedberg, Wife And Dog marks Ritchie's latest project with Black Bear following prior action titles The Ministry Of Ungentlemanly Warfare and In The Grey.Wife And Dog is scheduled for a wide U.S. theatrical release on February 19, 2027. Marking the first joint project between all three Japanese imprints, the collection is highlighted in a campaign starring actor Kenichi Takito.Drawing from Tailor Toyo’s decades-long history of producing traditional souvenir jackets, the Needles x Tailor Toyo Souvenir Jacket adapts a classic U.S. Navy silhouette. items.title: JW Anderson x Wedgwood’s Second Collection Draws From Greek Ceramics and British Landscapes
items.text: JW Anderson x Wedgwood’s Second Collection Draws From Greek Ceramics and British Landscapes Summary JW Anderson and Wedgwood return with Volume II, extending their Greek-inspired Jasperware collaboration.Four tonal pairings explore light, shadow and landscape through matte finishes and ribbed surfaces.Handcrafted in Barlaston, the sets are priced at £300 GBP (approx. $401 USD). Following the success of their inaugural collaboration - which explored unproduced Lucie Rie designs - JW Anderson and Wedgwood have reunited to launch Volume II of their celebrated creative partnership. Continuing a dialogue between antiquity and contemporary design, the new collection takes direct inspiration from fifth-century Greek mugs found in Jonathan Anderson’s personal ceramics collection. Each piece is handcrafted from iconic Jasper stoneware in Barlaston, England, serving as a tangible connection between imaginative modern aesthetics and historic craft expertise.Volume II presents each mug as the chromatic counterpart to another, pairing darker and lighter Jasper tones to emphasize the sculptural quality of the form. Four combinations make up the release: Mercury Blue/Jasper Blue, referencing Wedgwood’s historic Portland and Jasper colours; Dark Brown/Terracotta, evoking the elemental character of clay; and Marsh Green/Sage Green, informed by the natural landscape surrounding Wedgwood’s Barlaston home. A fourth Shadow Grey/Meadow Green pairing is exclusive to Harrods.In comparison with the first drop’s color combinations, the new palette feels more grounded in tonal contrast and landscape-derived hues. Each piece is made from matte, biscuit-finished Jasper stoneware, while its ribbed surface is produced through an engine-turning technique adapted by Wedgwood for ceramics in 1763 — giving the otherwise minimal silhouettes a tactile, almost architectural rhythm.Handcrafted by Wedgwood artisans in Barlaston, England, the mugs continue to connect centuries-old manufacturing techniques with Anderson’s contemporary approach to collecting and reinterpretation. Volume II will be offered through Wedgwood, JW Anderson flagship stores and select retailers worldwide, with each paired retailing at £300 GBP (approx. $401 USD). items.title: Lil Wayne Reveals New York Yankees Forced Redesign of Original Young Money Logo
items.text: Lil Wayne Reveals New York Yankees Forced Redesign of Original Young Money Logo Summary Lil Wayne revealed on 'The Joint Venture Show' podcast that the New York Yankees took legal action against the original Young Money logoThe MLB franchise issued a cease-and-desist letter claiming the stacked YM logo closely mirrored its interlocking NY emblemWayne respected the team's legacy and elected to change the logo rather than contest the legal notice Lil Wayne has revealed that the New York Yankees forced him to retire the original Young Money logo due to trademark concerns. Speaking alongside Craig Carton on The Joint Venture Show, the hip-hop icon detailed how a legal warning from the MLB franchise prompted an early visual redesign for his record label.While reflecting on his first Miami apartment at age 19—which featured a custom door displaying the initial stacked "YM" insignia—Wayne explained that the Yankees issued a formal cease-and-desist letter. The baseball team argued that the label's stacked typography appeared too similar to their iconic interlocking "NY" emblem, a design with roots tracing back to an 1877 NYPD Medal of Valor created by Tiffany & Co. before its adoption by the team in 1909. Wayne revealed, "They just sent me a cease and desist. And I had to stop using it... I just changed my logo."Rather than engaging in a legal dispute with the organization, Wayne chose to comply immediately and replace the logo. He shared, "I felt more cooler getting a letter from the Yankees." The rapper shared that he held no resentment toward the team, citing his respect for the franchise's legendary status and considering the cease-and-desist a memorable moment during his rise in the music industry.Listen to his story above. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Yoshitomo Nara and Mark Rothko Lead Sotheby’s ‘PSYCHO’ Exhibition
items.text: Yoshitomo Nara and Mark Rothko Lead Sotheby’s ‘PSYCHO’ Exhibition Summary Sotheby’s PSYCHO explores identity, alienation and psychological tension through art and literature.Rothko and Yoshitomo Nara anchor the exhibition and upcoming auctions.The Hong Kong showcase runs through September 27, with sales on September 28–29. Sotheby’s Maison in Hong Kong is turning its latest biannual curated exhibition toward the more unsettled corners of the psyche with PSYCHO: Identity Alienation Shadow Duality. On view through September 27, the exhibition brings together museum-quality loans and works from Sotheby’s upcoming Modern & Contemporary Art auctions to examine how identity, obsession, fear, vanity and ambition surface through art and literature.Drawing on the psychological language of cinema and the written word, PSYCHO positions outward appearances against the tensions concealed beneath them, assembling works by Mark Rothko, Yoshitomo Nara, Tetsuya Ishida, Yayoi Kusama, Hans Bellmer, Lee Bul, Frank Auerbach, Paula Rego and more. Literary touchstones extend the premise beyond visual art, with first-edition copies of Bret Easton Ellis’ American Psycho and a 17th-century edition of Robert Burton’s The Anatomy of Melancholy further tracing themes of alienation, despair and fractured identity.Anchoring the exhibition and the September 28 Modern & Contemporary Evening Auction is Mark Rothko’s "Untitled (Plum and Dark Brown)" from 1964, a monumental two-meter canvas estimated to fetch between $78 million and $128 million HKD (approx. $9.9 million - $16.3 million USD). Created shortly before the artist’s Rothko Chapel series, its reduced plum-and-brown palette, restrained composition and enveloping scale reflect the increasingly introspective direction of Rothko’s late period, making it a fitting centerpiece for an exhibition concerned with what lies beneath apparently quiet surfaces.Yoshitomo Nara provides another major focal point with "The Crated Room in Iceland / Drawing Room," returning to public view after more than 15 years and making its auction debut with a $45 million to $65 million HKD estimate (approx. $5.7 million - $8.2 million USD). Created during Nara’s collaboration with graf, the installation surrounds viewers with a shipping-crate structure filled with 97 drawings, chairs, a CD player and personal objects, alongside a large-scale painting — effectively collapsing the distance between artwork, studio and the artist’s internal world.Elsewhere, PSYCHO

items.title: Come Along With Me: Target by Design’s NYFW Party at New Museum
items.text: Come Along With Me: Target by Design’s NYFW Party at New Museum NYFW surely has no shortage of beautiful things behind glass cases or on the runway. But it’s times like these we often forget: some of the most carefully considered items are those we handle every day. Last week, Target took over NYC’s New Museum for Target by Design, an immersive two-day pop-up celebrating its love affair with everyday design and the creatives pushing it forward.The experience began straight out of the elevators, kicking off with a trip through Target’s archives. A kinetic archival installation spread throughout the first room, and I explored some of the brand’s most memorable products and collaborations through the years — from 2010 garments by Jean Paul Gaultier, to Michael Graves’ 90s homeware collection, and, of course, the iconic red shopping bag.For the occasion, Target handed over its classic tote to a collective of creative leaders, debuting designs by Public School, Daniel Arsham, Chloë Sevigny, Venus Williams, and more. With the artists’ touch, the humble shopping bag became everything from a sculpture, a statement piece, or an elevated basic.Guests could have a go at creating their own bags at a customization station nearby. Inspiration from KBB by Kahlana Barfield Brown and whimsy from Laila Gohar came through when it came time for my design. The details made it personal: a custom line-up of pins, print overlays, lanyards, and charms. I wanted the finished piece to feel personal and playful, with nods to the bag’s nostalgic heritage design.DJs SOFI TUKKER, Louise Chen, and Amrit Tietz carried the evening, while cocktails and bites made their way through the floor. The dance floor doubled as additional installations, turning the typical Target retail experience into surreal encounters, like a mirrored selfie room made up of self-checkout cameras, or another where Bullseye the Oracle read my shopping fortune.By night, the Target by Design crowd simmered back into the bustle of Fashion Week, bullseye totes slung over my shoulder. And while a classic is a classic for a reason, it’s nice to remember there’s always room for a little reinvention. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Glenn Martens Is Leaving Diesel
items.text: Glenn Martens Is Leaving Diesel SummaryGlenn Martens is stepping down as Diesel’s Creative Director after his SS27 Milan show, ending a transformative six-year tenure.Martens will remain creative head of Maison Margiela under parent company OTB Group; no replacement for Diesel is announced yet.Glenn Martens’ six-year run as Creative Director of Italian denim label Diesel will conclude after his SS27 runway presentation, scheduled for September 22 at Milan Fashion Week. The news brings to a close a fruitful tenure from Martens, which injected the 1978-born brand with renewed vitality.Formerly known for Y/Project until 2024, Martens joined Diesel in 2020, updating the brand’s appeal for a new generation of shoppers with his cutting-edge aesthetic and inventive approach. Diesel founder and OTB Chairman Renzo Rosso said that Martens “brought Diesel back to the centre of the global fashion conversation while preserving the openness, energy and accessibility that have always distinguished us,” in an official statement. "We are deeply grateful for everything he has achieved," he continued.Announced by the Diesel owner this Friday, OTB Group was sure to note that Martens won't be leaving the conglomerate entirely, confirming that he would remain the creative head of Maison Margiela. Martens took up the highly-regarded role, formerly held by John Galliano, in 2025 and received consistent praise for his continued commitment to Margiela's creative ethos. As of the time of writing, Diesel has not announced an official replacement for Martens. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘House of Kong’: An Illustrated History of Gorillaz
items.text: ‘House of Kong’: An Illustrated History of Gorillaz “If you want something done right, do it yourself.” Perhaps the saying ran through the minds of Damon Albarn and Jamie Hewlett in their shared London flat back in the ’90s. Blur frontman Albarn and Hewlett, the Tank Girl comic illustrator, had become bored with the era’s celebrity artifice, and sought to double down with a group — half art, half music — the industry had yet to witness. In came Gorillaz, the world’s first virtual band.25 years later, the Gorillaz universe keeps getting richer. On the occasion of their now ninth studio album, The Mountain, an immersive exhibition dedicated to the band’s misadventures has landed in New York City. House of Kong has settled into Brooklyn’s Agger Fish Building quite nicely, with a month-long run culminating in its Madison Square Garden show on September 29.Set inside Kong Studios — Gorillaz’ HQ on a sleepy Essex hilltop — the hour-long experience tours the history of artwork, music, artifacts, and mythology behind bassist Murdoc Niccals, singer 2D, drummer Russel Hobbs, and guitarist Noodle. We don’t want to give too much away (though if you’re looking for Lucian Freud’s Francis Bacon painting someone stole in 1988, 2D is a prime culprit). This is all to say, the lore runs deep. View this post on Instagram A post shared by HYPEBEAST (@hypebeast)Gorillaz has left a pretty serious footprint on culture, netting countless chart-toppers, hundreds of shows, awards, and a Guinness World Record. But music is only half the story. Beyond a starry coterie of collaborators and features, or a knack for genre-bending, Gorillaz has gone on to inspire a new generation of animators chasing that punkish rush that first put them on the map and the appetite for invention that kept them there.House of Kong is the first IRL experience dedicated to the band’s full visual legacy, and includes entire galleries of early concepts, scrapped characters, and unreleased videos through the years. The exhibition is less of a retrospective than “an installation that takes a glance backwards in order to identify the path ahead,” as creative director Stephen Gallagher, and both co-founders, made clear earlier this year. Even so, consider this our excuse to revisit the good ole (demon) days with an illustrated history of the Gorillaz’ many eras.Phase One: Celebrity Take Down (1998-2002)The OG Gorillaz character designs, off the bat, claimed roots in counterculture comics tradition. items.title: Jose Alvarado Brought Brooklyn Energy Front-Row to the LUAR x Lunazul Tequila Debut at NYFW
items.text: Jose Alvarado Brought Brooklyn Energy Front-Row to the LUAR x Lunazul Tequila Debut at NYFW New York Fashion Week always serves as a melting pot for high fashion, street style, and pop culture, but designer Raul Lopez’s LUAR Spring/Summer 2027 presentation stood out as a true cultural collision. View this post on InstagramA post shared by HYPEBEAST (@hypebeast) Set against the iconic backdrop of the Unisphere in Queens, LUAR unveiled its latest collection, “Christopher Street Columbus”, alongside a ground-breaking collaboration with Lunazul Tequila. Sitting front-row to witness the spectacle was NBA point guard and Brooklyn native Jose Alvarado, whose presence bridged the distinct worlds of New York basketball and cutting-edge fashion.The headline-grabbing aspect of the runway show was the reveal of the highly limited LUAR x Lunazul Tequila capsule. The collaboration centers on an innovative, plant-based vegan agave leather crafted from the very plant used in Lunazul’s tequila-making process. Inspired by ’90s New York hip-hop culture and the shared nocturnal muse of both brands—“Luar” meaning moonlight in Galician/Portuguese and “Lunazul” translating to blue moon in Spanish—the capsule features items like a dark denim two-piece set and an agave leather basketball-shaped handbag finished in Lunazul’s signature blue.What made Jose Alvarado’s appearance so significant was how seamlessly his identity aligns with the core identity of LUAR and the spirit of the collection. As a proud New York native whose game is built on heart, relentless hustle, and local pride, Alvarado embodies the authentic, everyday grit of the city that Lopez consistently designs for. Seeing a local basketball star take center stage at a major fashion presentation highlighted how deeply intertwined NYC hoop culture, urban street style, and high-fashion runways have become.Alvarado’s presence also highlighted the cultural resonance of the LUAR x Lunazul partnership itself. Both LUAR and Lunazul draw heavily on meticulous craftsmanship and community rituals. Having an athlete who carries that same dedicated work ethic on the court sitting front-row reinforced the campaign’s message: celebrating raw, authentic talent that stays grounded in its roots while reaching new creative heights.Ultimately, Alvarado attending the show encapsulated a powerful moment of New York excellence. items.text: Awake NY Celebrates New York Street Style With FW26 “Cold World” Summary Awake NY’s FW26 “Cold World” celebrates the style and visual language of New York.Layered staples include tracksuits, faux fur, camo and football jerseys.Vanson Leathers returns for collaborative skeleton jackets; wider availability begins September 26. Awake NY is turning its attention back to its home city for Fall/Winter 2026 with “Cold World,” a collection conceived as a tribute to New York and the distinctive style shaped by its streets. Drawing from the city’s recognizable colors, graphics and everyday visual language, the range channels the individuality that defines New York dressing while placing a particular emphasis on cold-weather layering.The seasonal lineup spans elevated tracksuits, heavyweight hoodies, athletic football jerseys, textured knitwear and statement faux fur outerwear designed to be effortlessly styled together. Spotlighted styles range from track jackets emblazoned with Awake NY's emblematic star motif, tricolor zip-up hooded jacket composed of three different camo prints, as well as the brand's newest iteration of skeleton leather jackets crafted in collaboration with Vanson Leathers.The first drop of the FW26 collection is now available to shop at the brand’s NYC flagship store, with wider availability through its official website starting September 26, 2026. items.text: NN.07 and Fracap Reunite for a Third M127 Boot Collaboration Name: NN.07 x Fracap M127 BootsMSRP: $450 USDRelease Date: September 24Where to Buy: NN.07NN.07 has teamed up with Fracap for their third collaborative footwear release. Built on heavy-duty Vibram soles for optimal grip, the rugged M127 boot silhouette preserves essential mountain features - including durable stitching, robust lacing systems, and weather-ready construction - while refining the upper with clean lines and pared-back proportions cut with the restraint of a tailored shoe. Brown Leather draws most directly from Fracap’s archive, with the press release describing its finish as worn-in and honest, emphasizing the boot’s traditional alpine character. Black Leather recasts the silhouette in a darker, cleaner treatment intended to feel more at home in the city, allowing the shape and hardware to read more sharply against the monochromatic upper.The most textural option, Dark Grey Ponyhair, replaces smooth leather with a tactile, visibly directional surface; its charcoal-grey tone keeps the palette understated while the unexpected material pushes the rugged form toward a more fashion-led finish. items.title: ‘Pokémon Horizons: Season 3 — Rising Hope’ Part 4 Lands on Netflix in the US
items.text: ‘Pokémon Horizons: Season 3 — Rising Hope’ Part 4 Lands on Netflix in the US Summary Pokémon Horizons: Season 3 — Rising Hope Part 4 is now streaming on Netflix in the US.Liko, Roy, Dot and Ult reunite for a climactic battle against the Explorers.The latest episodes bring Season 3’s Laqua storyline toward its conclusion. Pokémon Horizons: Season 3 — Rising Hope has reached its climactic fourth part, with the latest batch of episodes now streaming on Netflix in the U.S. Following their journey throughout the season, Liko, Roy, Dot and Ult reunite with allies they have encountered along the way as the Rising Volt Tacklers prepare for a decisive confrontation with the Explorers. With Laqua - and potentially the wider world - at stake, the group draws on Terastallization, Mega Evolution and newly learned moves as their Pokémon and the bonds they share are pushed to their limits. The accompanying trailer sets up the showdown as the culmination of the season’s escalating conflict, bringing its central characters and Pokémon together for an all-out battle against the Explorers.Rising Hope picks up a year after the events at Laqua, continuing the wider Pokémon Horizons story that introduced Liko and Roy as the Pokémon anime’s new central protagonists following Ash Ketchum’s long-running tenure. Season 3 finds the pair reconnecting with Dot and newcomer Ult while rebuilding the Rising Volt Tacklers and investigating new threats to Pokémon across the regions. Part 4 serves as the final collection of episodes for the season, bringing its ongoing Laqua storyline toward a conclusion while continuing the series’ emphasis on friendship, exploration and the evolving relationships between Trainers and Pokémon. Pokémon Horizons: Season 3 — Rising Hope Part 4 is now released on Netflix in the U.S., with Seasons 1 and 2 and the first three parts of Season 3 also available to stream. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Marine Serre and Chaisor Rework the French Folding Chair With Signature Crescent Moon Motifs
items.text: Marine Serre and Chaisor Rework the French Folding Chair With Signature Crescent Moon Motifs Summary Marine Serre and Chaisor reinterpret a heritage French folding chair with the house’s signature Moon motif.Three editions pair gold-toned steel frames with Tan, Inverse Tan and Denim upholstery.Handmade in France, the limited chairs retail from $660 USD. Marine Serre has stepped into furniture with a limited-edition collaboration with French folding-chair specialist Chaisor, translating the fashion house’s signature All-Over Moon motif onto one of the manufacturer’s heritage silhouettes. Founded in 1962, Chaisor is known for its distinctly ceremonial folding chairs, and the collaboration preserves that recognizable structure while recasting it through Marine Serre’s visual language.Designed by Leo Jouk, the chair combines a curved backrest inspired by Napoleon III furniture with Chaisor’s signature Saint Andrew’s cross leg construction, engineered for added stability and durability. A gold epoxy-finished steel frame supports padded seating and a 35 mm high-resilience foam backrest, both wrapped in Moon-patterned textiles. Three serial-numbered editions - Tan, Inverse Tan and Denim, corresponding to Moon Black on Tan, Moon Tan on Black and Moon Laser Denim Blue - shift the piece between warm neutral contrasts and a washed blue treatment, turning an otherwise practical folding object into something more graphic and collectible.The familiar repeating crescent motif remains the defining element, but here it is applied to an object rooted in French furniture tradition, reinforcing both brands’ shared emphasis on craftsmanship, longevity and cultural continuity. Each chair is handmade in France, retaining Chaisor’s foldable functionality while bringing a more fashion-led surface treatment to the historic form; the Denim edition uses cotton upholstery, while the Tan variants use Moon-printed technical fabric. The Marine Serre x Chaisor chairs are available through Marine Serre’s online store, priced at $660 USD. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: An Official Look at the Complete Harris Tweed X Vans Premium Collection
items.text: An Official Look at the Complete Harris Tweed X Vans Premium Collection Name: Harris Tweed x Vans Premium CollectionMSRP: $120 - $140 USDRelease Date: September 24Where to Buy: VansHarris Tweed and Vans extend their partnership into a three-model Vans Premium collection, applying the Scottish textile maker’s handwoven wool to the Old Skool 36, Classic Slip-On 98 and Loafer 53. The capsule builds on the Old Skool first previewed earlier this summer, where a blue-toned plaid upper with lilac, green and brown undertones was paired with deep navy overlays, a crystal-studded Sidestripe and jewelry-like spikes, stones and pins.Across the wider range, Harris Tweed’s coarse, dimensional texture is deliberately contrasted with Vans’ vulcanized construction and glossy sidewalls, while subtle greasing and distressed finishes give the shoes a lightly aged character rather than a pristine dress-shoe treatment.The Premium Classic Slip-On 98 places particular emphasis on the fabric, covering Vans’ laceless silhouette in a "Tweed Red/Blue" look. This iteration works through a warm, earthy check punctuated by cooler blue notes, with the irregular wool weave lending the surface a richer, almost archival appearance. Jewels, pins and studs interrupt the traditional textile with flashes of metallic shine, while contrast stitching and a lightly greased finish heighten its worn-in quality.The Premium Loafer 53 takes the concept in a more formal direction, translating Harris Tweed into Vans’ skate-informed penny-loafer shape. Rendered in a "Tweed Brown" palette, the silhouette emphasizes a muted, autumnal finish, with fuzzy woven wool and smoother leather elements set against a dark vulcanized sole for a mix of traditional tailoring and subcultural styling. Studs decorate the tongue, while removable metal charms, including safety-pin and jewel-like accents, introduce the same rebellious ornamentation seen elsewhere in the collection; subtle greasing again adds a gently weathered effect. items.title: LUAR and Lunazul Tequila Toast to NYFW at Exclusive Brooklyn After-Party
items.text: LUAR and Lunazul Tequila Toast to NYFW at Exclusive Brooklyn After-Party Following the reveal of designer Raul Lopez’s LUAR Spring/Summer 2027 collection, the celebration spilled off the runway and straight into 99 Scott Street in Brooklyn for the official LUAR x Lunazul Tequila after-party. Running late into the night, the event transformed the industrial venue into a vibrant epicenter of New York nightlife. Under moody purple and pink glow lights, a high-energy crowd packed the space to toast the groundbreaking "Christopher Street Columbus" collection and its agave-leather capsule.At the center of the room was a complete Lunazul takeover. The space featured a fully custom, stainless steel bar outfitted with illuminated signage, branded napkins, and branded bar mats, bringing the spirit of the tequila into the heart of the afterparty. Guests moved fluidly between the bar, the dance floor, and the outdoor area behind the venue while sipping on custom cocktails crafted exclusively for the night. Favorites included "The Lunarita"—Lunazul’s fresh take on the classic margarita—and "La Luna Rosa," their signature spin on a Paloma.The soundscape for the evening was curated by a heavy-hitting DJ lineup featuring Bearcat, Alexis De La Rosa, and Sterling Juan Diaz. Decks thumped from the DJ booth—where sets were spun in a bold, monogrammed LUAR jacket—keeping the dance floor moving at a peak all night long. Partygoers, tastemakers, and creatives dressed in sharp tailoring, leather jackets, statement accessories, and LUAR fits gathered in a genuine showcase of NYC’s creative community. Designer Raul Lopez was right in the middle of it all, mingling, raising glasses with guests, and celebrating the launch alongside close friends and supporters.The Brooklyn after-party served as the ultimate punctuation mark to LUAR’s Fashion Week moment, seamlessly bridging runway luxury with authentic street culture. By pairing high-fashion art with Lunazul’s smooth tequila and uninhibited New York energy, the event proved that the culture doesn't stop when the models leave the catwalk. It reinforced how deep-rooted heritage, modern craftsmanship, and community vibe merge into an unforgettable night under the city lights. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Dontella Versace Is Launching a New Brand
items.text: Dontella Versace Is Launching a New Brand SummaryDonatella Versace is launching a new fashion and beauty label with Revolve Group in 2027.The partnership combines her creative vision with Revolve's technological infrastructure, following her exit from the CCO role at Versace and the brand’s $1B+ sale to Prada.After stepping down from her three-decade tenure as Chief Creative Officer of Versace in 2025, Donatella Versace is finally sharing her next move. The Italian designer, sister of Gianni Versace, will launch a new label in partnership with Revolve Group.The brand, whose name has not yet been revealed, is poised to launch in 2027 with a mixture of fashion and beauty products. In an official statement, Versace shared, “Revolve understands something I believe deeply: culture comes from connection.” “Together, we want to create that connection with a new voice, a new look, and a new energy,” she added.Founded in 2003, the fashion retailer continues to see impressive growth today, reporting $1.23B in total revenue for 2025. In 2026 Q2, the company’s active customers increased to 3.04 million — an 11% increase year over year — resulting in Revolve’s highest customer growth rate in three years.On the Donatella Versace partnership, Revolve co-founder and co-CEO Michael Mente called the designer “defining creative voices of our time,” adding, “This partnership gives that vision an entirely new platform and the freedom to build something from the ground up.” The brand’s other co-founder and co-CEO Mike Karanikolas explained, “By combining Donatella’s creative authority with Revolve’s technology, infrastructure and global reach, we have an opportunity to create something genuinely distinctive — and build it for the long term.”The news comes after the more than $1B USD sale of Versace from Capri Holdings to Prada Group, which was completed in December 2025. As of the time of writing, the designer is still Versace’s chief brand ambassador. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Tesla Reopens Roadster Reservations for $50,000 USD Ahead of an October 1 Reveal
items.text: Tesla Reopens Roadster Reservations for $50,000 USD Ahead of an October 1 Reveal Summary Tesla has reopened orders for its next-generation Roadster, requiring a massive $50,000 USD deposit weeks before the vehicle's official unveilingThe October 1 event in Texas is set to feature a hovering, remote-operated stunt car equipped with SpaceX cold gas thrustersThe fresh round of reservations arrives despite the original 2017 Roadster suffering at least eight delays without delivering a single production unit The Tesla Roadster is officially back on the order books, and securing a spot in line requires a massive injection of blind faith. During the week of September 20, the automaker quietly reopened reservations for its next-generation electric hypercar, asking buyers to commit heavy funds before a final production version has even been shown. Claiming a reservation requires a steep $50,000 USD deposit initiated by a fully refundable $5,000 USD credit card payment and locked in by a $45,000 USD wire transfer that must be completed within 10 days. The reservation portal went live approximately two weeks ahead of a highly anticipated October 1 reveal event scheduled near Waco, Texas, where the company states it will finally outline official pricing, hardware specifications and production targets.By demanding an immediate five-figure commitment for an unseen silhouette, the automaker tests the limits of its own brand loyalty against a notoriously fractured track record. This marks the second time the company has collected $50,000 USD deposits for the Tesla Roadster following a November 2017 push that also offered a $250,000 USD Founders Series option requiring total payment upfront. That original 2017 iteration was promised for production in 2020 but has since suffered at least eight separate delays without putting a single unit on the road in nearly nine years. Making matters more complex for early adopters, the company has previously made it difficult for high-profile reservation holders, including tech creator Marques Brownlee and OpenAI executive Sam Altman, to successfully receive refunds on canceled preorders.The upcoming October 1 showcase aims to reset the narrative by swapping outdated concepts for a stark aesthetic overhaul. Recent teasers indicate the new iteration will abandon older curves for a sharp redesign that heavily incorporates angular Cyber styling complete with a modern full-width light bar. items.title: ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot Brings Its Immersive Installation to Dover Street Market Beijing
items.text: ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot Brings Its Immersive Installation to Dover Street Market Beijing ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot’s immersive special installation, A Body Without a Body, has recently arrived at Dover Street Market Beijing in Wangfujing Central, accompanied by the brand’s 21st capsule collection and 10th-anniversary capsule, “The Hollow Carnival.”Founded by designer Karim Fares, ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot is rooted in his long-standing archive of antique textiles, vintage clothing, and old objects. Rejecting the fleeting narratives of trend cycles, the brand remains committed to slow, locally made Italian craftsmanship, preserving rather than erasing the traces of time inherent in its materials. Faded textures, mending stitches, and worn imperfections become inseparable parts of each piece. Drawing on the colorful remnants left after a carnival has ended, “The Hollow Carnival” serves as a metaphor for contemporary society: people continually pursue instant consumption and sensory pleasure, while beneath the appearance of abundance lies a sense of emptiness and melancholy. This is the conceptual core of the 21st collection.The installation makes use of the site’s architectural structure and the flow of visitors, with the building itself forming part of the work. The exhibition space is enclosed by antique screens, while layered scraps of aged wallpaper cover the screens and the venue’s columns, evoking geological strata built up from accumulated memories. At its center, an antique sofa displays timeworn vintage teddy bears marked by repairs, accompanied by arrangements of dried flowers and ribbons. Together, they hold a collective memory in which childhood, emotion, and time intertwine. The central work, “A Body Without a Body,” is composed of layers of clothing piled one atop another. Beneath torn, weathered fabrics, layers of old garments gradually emerge. Each textile layer is a sediment of memory: though the body has vanished, the wear and mending preserved in the fabric recall the traces of human presence.The exhibition also presents ARCHIVIO J.M.Ribot’s two principal creative threads: a limited collection newly made from antique fabrics, and the one-of-a-kind Riforma collection, created by reworking vintage garments. Every piece is handmade in Italy. Industrial overlocking is eschewed in favor of interior details such as hand-worked buttonholes and irregular stitching, inviting visitors to linger over the stories held within the materials. items.title: The Miu Miu x New Balance 530 SL Is Now a Ballet Flat in "White" and "Cinnamon"
items.text: The Miu Miu x New Balance 530 SL Is Now a Ballet Flat in "White" and "Cinnamon" Name: Miu Miu x New Balance 530 SL “Deco Leather Ballerinas,” Miu Miu x New Balance 530 SL “Delave Suede Ballerinas”Colorway: White, CinnamonSKU: 5F846E_Z5O_F0401_F_005, 5F846E_3F33_F0009_F_005MSRP: $1,170 USDRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: Miu MiuMiu Miu and New Balance have reshaped the 530 SL, the sneaker at the center of the two brands' collaboration, into a ballet flat. The house frames the design as a meeting of the 530 SL's athletic build and the softer lines of a ballerina, and releases it in two treatments: a "White" deco' leather and a "Cinnamon" délavé suede.The construction is where the sneaker DNA survives the transfer. Rather than swap in a clean slipper, the flat keeps a laced upper up top, retaining the closure and profile of the running shoe it descends from. Underfoot sits a rubber sole carrying New Balance branding, and inside is a removable fabric-covered insole, a detail lifted straight from performance footwear. Miu Miu screen-prints logo hits in three places, on the upper, the heel collar and the insole, so the branding reads across the shoe without any hardware. Both pairs are built on a calfskin base, with the finish doing the differentiating: the "White" leans on deco' leather that the house ties to a worn, vintage character, while the "Cinnamon" uses a washed délavé suede for a faded, tonal brown.The launch also slots into a lineage Miu Miu has been building for years. Under Miuccia Prada, the label has spent multiple seasons pushing the ballet flat back to the front of the fashion conversation, treating it as one of its defining silhouettes. The New Balance partnership, meanwhile, has run across several drops that filter the sportswear brand's runners through Miu Miu's codes. Turning the 530 SL into a flat folds those two threads together, taking the collaboration's signature sneaker and rebuilding it in the shape the house is best known for reviving.
