items.title: Kojima Productions Breaks Silence on 'PHYSINT' Rumors and Denies Reports of Financial Difficulties
items.text: Kojima Productions Breaks Silence on 'PHYSINT' Rumors and Denies Reports of Financial Difficulties Summary Kojima Productions issues a rare statement shutting down rumors of financial instabilityUpcoming title Physint changed publishing partners from PlayStation to XboxHideo Kojima recently admitted the lost Sony contract sparked fears of the studio collapsing Kojima Productions officially stepped in to address rumors surrounding its financial future. This move follows a report that its upcoming title, Physint, moved to Xbox after Sony dropped the project. Speculation suggested the game was canceled due to missed deadlines, budget and profitability concerns. Studio management took to social media to dispute the chatter, declaring that the studio remains in a healthy and profitable state.The gaming industry has recently seen a wave of studio closures and canceled titles. This environment allows rumors of financial instability for independent developers to catch fire quickly. Kojima Productions broke from its usual protocol to address the situation. Leadership noted the company normally ignores unsubstantiated speculation but felt the volume of claims demanded a response.Disputed rumors alleged a loss of funding from Sony and disappointing sales for the Death Stranding franchise. Kojima Productions called out aspersions regarding its relationship with PlayStation and the production planning for Physint. Addressing the shift to Xbox, the studio asked players to treat reports with skepticism while maintaining that its partnership with Sony remains strong. Management emphasized that the unchecked speculation affected fans, creative partners and colleagues.Internal tension remained high despite the confident public front. Hideo Kojima confessed his own fears about the studio collapsing in a recent interview. He expressed surprise at the situation with Sony because he originally thought the game was safe. The creator revealed that losing a single contract could have forced the studio to terminate staff or face a total collapse due to cashflow issues. Kojima remarked that he wanted to avoid a repeat of the outcome of his past work. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: LOEWE Perfumes Anchors Five New "Crafted" Fragrances to a Single Amber Accord
items.text: LOEWE Perfumes Anchors Five New "Crafted" Fragrances to a Single Amber Accord Summary LOEWE Perfumes has released five new fragrances under its Crafted Collection, each built on the resinous amber base the house calls the LOEWE AccordHouse perfumer Nuria Cruelles composed the lineup, spanning open citrus, gourmand sweetness, dense florals and smoky depth across the five scentsEvery fragrance is presented in a flask topped with a tactile granite cap and finished in textures that run from glossy to powdery-dry LOEWE Perfumes has expanded its Crafted Collection with five new fragrances, each measuring 100mL and each anchored to the resinous amber base the house calls the LOEWE Accord. Composed by in-house perfumer Nuria Cruelles, the set layers familiar perfumery notes over that shared foundation to give every scent its own distinct character.Cruelles treats the amber LOEWE Accord as a common floor, then builds each fragrance upward with a different set of notes, so the five read as variations on a single idea rather than five unrelated launches."Field Diary" opens the range at its airiest, pairing mandarin and blood orange up top before lychee and orange blossom settle in, with artemisia cutting an aromatic contrast and sandalwood and musk trailing off into a soft finish. "Sweet Woodland" turns inward, resting on a base of patchouli and vanilla while rose, orange blossom, mandarin and ginger fill out the middle and a faint touch of cognac lends spicy warmth. "Rosetopia" is the most saturated of the five, centering on damask rose in full bloom and reinforcing it with amber, musk, grapefruit and pink pepper.The remaining two lean cooler and greener. "Smoky Rain" sends bergamot and pink pepper drifting through what LOEWE frames as a soft mist, then deepens the scent with a warm, smoky undertone alongside amber, patchouli and white musk. "Verdant Globe" starts on pistachio and bergamot, uses iris and orange blossom to hold the composition together, and widens into a gourmand stretch of caramel and vanilla before resolving on cedarwood and musk.The presentation is pitched to match the raw-material focus. Each bottle wears a granite cap meant to be felt as much as seen, while the flasks themselves are finished in a spread of textures, from high-gloss and matte to a damp sheen and a dry, powdery surface.Taken together, the launch reinforces the position LOEWE Perfumes has been building around single-ingredient legibility, where the point is to draw out and showcase

items.title: Jhené Aiko Tops the Billboard 200 for the First Time With ‘Westside Whimsy’
items.text: Jhené Aiko Tops the Billboard 200 for the First Time With ‘Westside Whimsy’ Summary Jhené Aiko earns her first Billboard 200 No. 1 as Westside Whimsy debuts atop the chart dated September 26The album opens with 74,000 equivalent album units, almost entirely on the strength of streamingIt stands as the first R&B album by a woman to lead the chart in 2026 Jhené Aiko's Westside Whimsy debuts at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, handing the singer-songwriter the first chart-topping album of her career. The set arrives on the September 26-dated chart with 74,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States in the tracking week ending September 17, according to Luminate.Streaming carried the debut almost single-handedly. Of that 74,000 total, streaming equivalent albums accounted for 70,000, a figure powered by 71.33 million on-demand official streams that also sent the project to No. 1 on Top Streaming Albums. Pure sales told a quieter story: with the album available only as a digital purchase ahead of physical editions slated for January, it moved 3,500 copies to open at No. 25 on Top Album Sales, while track-equivalent albums added another 500 units.The milestone lands more than a decade in the making. Westside Whimsy is Aiko's first full-length studio album since 2020's Chilombo, which debuted and peaked at No. 2 before earning an album of the year nomination at the Grammys. Her latest becomes her sixth top 10 on the Billboard 200, a run that traces back to Sail Out, the 2013 entry that first reached No. 8. The gap between that debut and this leader spanned 12 years and 10 months, making Aiko the second act of 2026 to wait at least a decade for a first No. 1, after Megadeth closed a nearly 40-year gap earlier this year. Among women, the last to wait longer was Solange, whose A Seat at the Table topped the chart 13 years and eight months after her own chart debut.The No. 1 also reshapes the year's R&B picture. Westside Whimsy is the genre's first chart-topper from a woman in 2026 and the first R&B album to lead since SZA's SOS logged its 13th and final week on top in May 2025. The only other R&B set to reach the summit this year was Bruno Mars' The Romantic.Behind Aiko, the rest of the top 10 stayed still, with her album the only new arrival in the region. Ella Langley's Dandelion slips to No. 2 on a little over 60,000 units, trailed by Olivia Rodrigo's you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love at No. 3 (60,000) and Morgan Wallen's I'm the Problem at No. 4 (5

items.title: The 2027 Cadillac Escalade Starts at $105,595 USD as the Flagship SUV Crosses the Six-Figure Mark
items.text: The 2027 Cadillac Escalade Starts at $105,595 USD as the Flagship SUV Crosses the Six-Figure Mark Summary Cadillac has launched the online configurator for the 2027 EscaladeThe elimination of the base 1SA trim pushes starting prices above six figuresThe top-tier Escalade V ESV approaches the $200,000 mark before options Cadillac launched the online configurator for the 2027 Cadillac Escalade recently. This iteration of the SUV arrives with a heavier financial barrier to entry. The automaker eliminated the 1SA base trim level offered during the previous model year. Because the discontinued specification targeted livery services rather than retail buyers, its removal reshapes the bottom of the lineup. Removing the 1SA base model officially raises the starting price above $100,000 USD. A standard-length rear-wheel drive model starts at $105,595 USD. Entry pricing represents an $11,600 increase over the 2026 entry price. The six-figure floor includes a destination charge that remains unchanged from last year.At the absolute pinnacle of the lineup sits the 2027 Escalade V ESV trim. It commands $193,349 USD before any additional options are considered. This price includes a $2,895 USD destination charge. By approaching the $200,000 USD threshold, the American automaker leans into the vehicle's long-standing cultural cachet. The model has served as a flagship for two decades. Pushing pricing into the elite realm targets territory traditionally occupied by exotic luxury flagships.Owners spending these amounts step into an SUV that remains largely identical to its predecessor since Cadillac announced no substantial changes for the 2027 model year. The current generation originally entered the market for the 2021 model year. Recent architecture updates for the 2025 model year refreshed the platform against rivals. This previous overhaul provided enough momentum that the brand kept the hardware static while raising the financial stakes.Economic factors loom while the Cadillac nameplate dictates immense pricing power. Rising gas prices alter the landscape for massive high-displacement vehicles. Such friction transforms the pricing strategy into a significant gamble for the manufacturer. This trend questions whether decades of flagship dominance can outrun the realities of a shifting global economy. Flagship dominance may eventually face the pressure of a market nearing the $200,000 USD mark. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Javier Bardem Set to Star in New HBO Drama Series 'The Spread'
items.text: Javier Bardem Set to Star in New HBO Drama Series 'The Spread' Summary HBO has handed down a straight-to-series order for the new Miami-set drama series titled 'The Spread'Oscar winner Javier Bardem will star as a visionary billionaire and executive produce the projectMatthew Vaughn is attached to direct and executive produce alongside co-creators Bill Dubuque and Sean Sansiveri HBO has officially issued a straight-to-series order for The Spread, a new drama series starring and executive produced by Oscar-winning actor Javier Bardem. The project hails from writers and executive producers Bill Dubuque (Ozark) and Sean Sansiveri, with filmmaker Matthew Vaughn attached to direct and executive produce.Co-produced by HBO and Fifth Season TV Studio alongside Makeready and Topic Studios, the series explores the high-stakes financial landscape of Miami as it transforms into "Wall Street South." The narrative focuses on a visionary billionaire portrayed by Bardem who gathers ambitious, dangerous individuals to manipulate national markets and shift America's economic epicenter to South Florida. The logline reads, "Miami is turning paradise into power — Wall Street South — a subtropical collision of industry titans, elite hedge funds, staggering wealth, ruthless competition, sex, nightlife and fun on an industrial scale. Into this sun-soaked arena comes a visionary billionaire (Bardem) who collects the brilliant, the hungry and the dangerous, then turns their ambitions loose on the markets that power America. He chases something bigger: the power to shift the center of economic gravity to Miami — and decide how long the party lasts."The drama marks a major milestone for Sansiveri as his first credited television writing role, while Vaughn steps in to direct following his work on high-profile film franchises. Executive producers for the project include Brad Weston for Makeready alongside Ian Stratford and Michael Bloom of Topic Studios.HBO has not yet announced an official premiere date or additional casting details for The Spread. items.title: Retroid Pocket Launches the Duo Lite Plus, a Premium Handheld That Combines Slim Design With Flagship Power
items.text: Retroid Pocket Launches the Duo Lite Plus, a Premium Handheld That Combines Slim Design With Flagship Power Summary Retroid Pocket abruptly announced the Duo Lite Plus handheld console shortly after its initial product launchThe new model merges the compact dimensions of the Duo Lite with the premium processor of the flagship DuoThe brand is covering all shipping and exchange costs for early buyers looking to upgrade their preorders Retroid Pocket is shaking up its handheld gaming lineup with the abrupt announcement of the new Retroid Pocket Duo Lite Plus. Arriving just over a week after the brand opened orders for its standard Duo and Duo Lite models, the new addition is currently available for preorder. The device features the slimmer physical dimensions of the standard Duo Lite model while packing the Qualcomm Dragonwing Q-7790 processor. This hardware is the exact processor utilized in the pricier flagship Duo model.Retroid Pocket attributed the later addition of the new tier to customer feedback. This move recognizes a demand for premium power inside a highly portable chassis. The brand priced the Retroid Pocket Duo Lite Plus at $219 USD for standard preorders. However, early adopters can currently utilize a $20 early bird discount code to lower the preorder price to $199. Shipments for the new handheld are expected to begin in mid-November.The timing of the announcement disrupted the initial rollout and left early buyers of the standard Duo Lite feeling blindsided. Many of these enthusiasts had just purchased the lower-powered device. They were unaware that a model combining the smaller form factor with the premium processor was imminent. Dropping the hybrid device days after the initial launch window opened generated customer frustration among those who missed the optimal configuration.Recognizing the backlash, the brand initiated an immediate response to make things right. Retroid Pocket sent out a mass email to its consumers and paused all existing Duo Lite shipments. This pause allows buyers time to compare the available devices. Customers who committed to the base Duo Lite can either stick with their original order or formally exchange it for a Retroid Pocket Duo Lite Plus. To smooth over the launch, the company is covering the exchange and shipping costs for any customers opting to upgrade. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: adidas Originals and VegNonVeg Reshape the Samba Into Two Jutti-Inspired Mules
items.text: adidas Originals and VegNonVeg Reshape the Samba Into Two Jutti-Inspired Mules Name: VegNonVeg x adidas Originals Samba Mule “Black,” VegNonVeg x adidas Originals Samba Mule “Silver”Colorway: Black/Cream/Gum, Metal Grey/Silver-Core Black-Off WhiteSKU: HP4921, HQ2795MSRP: TBCRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: VegNonVegadidas Originals and VegNonVeg have turned the Samba into an open-back mule, reshaping one of adidas' most recognizable silhouettes through the lens of the Jutti, a traditional Indian slip-on. The New Delhi retailer keeps the Samba instantly readable while rebuilding it around the ritual of stepping in and out of a shoe, and releases it in two colorways.The construction is where the two references meet. VegNonVeg retains the Samba's signature T-toe but extends it into a pointed, padded tongue, a detail that pulls the football silhouette toward the shape of a Jutti. The heel is cut away entirely to make it a mule, and the upper is built from premium leather finished with invisible stitching for a clean surface. Contrast cream Three Stripes keep the adidas identity legible against the darker leather.The Indian influence runs through the smaller details rather than sitting on the surface. Tonal botanical embroidery, which the brand ties to ideas of growth, community and roots, is worked into the upper, joined by a gold Trefoil rendered as a flower and gold foil SAMBA and VegNonVeg branding. A red lining, drawn from traditional Juttis, adds a hidden flash of color. The theme continues underfoot with mismatched insoles, one green and one red to represent the Veg and NonVeg halves of the retailer's name, each carrying Jutti-style ornamentation of the brand's leaf-tree motif along with the printed messages "From VegNonVeg with Love" and "To India and Beyond." A gum rubber outsole closes out the build.That reworking sits on decades of Samba history. The model began as a football boot designed for training on frozen and icy pitches before it moved off the field to become one of adidas' longest-running lifestyle staples. Recasting it as a Jutti-inspired mule is a way of holding onto that heritage shape while routing it through a specifically Indian point of view. VegNonVeg frames the project as part of its decade-long effort to represent a contemporary India, positioning the shoe as an old form rebuilt for the present. The "Silver" colorway underscores the exclusivity, capped at 280 pairs and sold only through VegNonVeg. Click here to view full ga

items.title: Nike and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed AIRMAX 1000.3 "Stone/Burgundy Crush"
items.text: Nike and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed AIRMAX 1000.3 "Stone/Burgundy Crush" Summary Nike Sportswear and Zellerfeld have introduced the AIRMAX 1000.3 in a Stone and Burgundy Crush colorwayThe third iteration of the fully 3D-printed silhouette features updated ZellerMESH construction for a softer and lighter feelThe sneaker drops via US SNKRS on September 24 followed by a global Zellerfeld raffle running through September 28 Nike and Zellerfeld have officially introduced the AIRMAX 1000.3 "Stone/Burgundy Crush", marking the latest evolution of their fully 3D-printed footwear project. Reimagining the iconic design language of the 1987 Air Max 1, the updated silhouette combines a sculpted form with visible Nike Air cushioning.Central to the AIRMAX 1000.3 is the integration of advanced ZellerMESH™ technology. The updated open-mesh structure delivers a refined textile-like aesthetic while utilizing less material to reduce overall weight, increase breathability, and improve durability. The modified mesh flexes naturally across the lateral sides, replacing previous feathered paneling with a more adaptive fit.Underfoot, the 3D-printed midsole has been softened to allow the visible Nike Air unit to activate more fully during movement, delivering enhanced responsiveness underfoot. The exterior presents a muted "Stone" upper contrasted by a "Burgundy Crush" Air Max unit, while backend refinements in the digital printing process significantly accelerate production times.The Nike AIRMAX 1000.3 "Stone / Burgundy Crush" launches in the US via Nike SNKRS on September 24, 2026. Global customers can enter the EQL raffle on Zellerfeld, open from September 22 through September 28, 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: “There Are No Rules to Being Wild and Beautiful”: Behind the Scenes of KATSEYE’s Pre-Concert Prep KATSEYE touched down in Paris last week for their WILDWORLD TOUR show at Accor Arena. As the fourth stop of their landmark concert run, the Grammy-nominated group partnered with ALL Accor, the booking platform and loyalty programme of Accor Group, to nail down the pre-concert rituals that happen moments before they hit the stage.In a hotel suite in SO/ Paris, KATSEYE began by imagining the perfect beauty prep space. With hotels serving as the starting point for evenings spent at gigs and concerts, this particular area was transformed with nail art and tooth gem stations. The suite revealed the importance of these spaces for both fans and artists by showing they have become places where creativity can thrive – whether they’re used to get ready or mentally prepare before the show. Before connecting with members of ALL Accor, media and content creators, the girl group got a first look at the suite, exploring the Glam Room while sharing their go-to routine in a recent video. “It's all about what makes me feel super confident,” shared Daniella. “I love accessorizing with big hoops and wearing makeup to feel powerful on stage.” Lara also mentioned how she hopes fans will show up as their most confident selves, saying, “There are no rules to being wild and beautiful; it’s just about expressing yourself and loving yourself and wearing honestly whatever you want.”After talking about face masks, headphones, and those small reminders of home, KATSEYE connected with fans and contest winners in a meet-and-greet. The VIP opportunity allowed attendees to immerse themselves further in the world of KATSEYE by catching the group during the sacred hours of styling and prepping. ALL Accor will soon be extending this program to more music artists for their upcoming gigs. To find out how to get involved, head to its website now. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 10 Era-Defining Figures to Know From Sotheby’s Next Hong Kong Sale
items.text: 10 Era-Defining Figures to Know From Sotheby’s Next Hong Kong Sale The human form is never simply a story of flesh and blood. Throughout human history, artists have turned to the body to make sense of the era and the social world that produced it — from war and alienation to consumerism, identity, and desire. As Sotheby’s Hong Kong readies its Modern and Contemporary Art auction season, we’re taking a look at the stories behind 10 works from the last century of art history.Tradition Meets Modernity (1910s–1950s)The turn of the 20th century wasn’t about throwing the rules out completely, as it was fracturing them. Across Asia, artists blended Eastern and Western philosophies, styles, and techniques to reckon with a new kind of modernity. For Chinese painter Sanyu, that meant bringing the body back to its essential elements. In “Nude, Hugging Knees, Viewed from the Front I” (1950s), anatomy disappears into abstraction, in a figure defined by sparse lines and calligraphic curves. Mai Trung Thu’s “Mélodie” (1950) takes a more nostalgic approach. Working in France at the time, the artist rendered the musician through restrained color and intimate composition to evoke a sense of longing for home, memory, and connection across oceans.“Woman in Chemise” (1925–28) by Zenzaburo Kojima exhibits a similar style of play. Western posture meets the saturated color and flattened space associated with Japanese ukiyo-e. The figure’s inward gaze avoids confrontation often seen in Western portraiture. Instead, she’s absorbed in her own world. Henri Matisse’s “Femme nue” (circa 1915), too, finds defiance in sensuality and warmth. Amid the chaos of World War I is a beacon of hope and contentment, posed in the odalisque tradition.Pop Icons & Pre-Y2K Angst (1960s–1990s)By the second half of the 1900s, bold expression and figuration were taken a step further. Tom Wesselmann, for example, recasts the classical female body through the visual overload associated with American consumer culture. In “Still Life with Odalisque and Black Goldfish” (1999), Matissean desire meets the bright, seductive language of advertising, pin-ups, and mass media.For Japanese artists Yoshitomo Nara and Tetsuya Ishida, the figure becomes a portrait of social unease. Nara’s “Present” (1994) sees a childlike figure, grip tight on a knife. Striding against the backdrop of post-Cold-War realignment and simmering nuclear anxieties, her small-but-mighty bravado asserts itself against forces much larger than her

items.title: AXE Just Revealed the Most Unexpected Luxury Fragrance Drop of the Year
items.text: AXE Just Revealed the Most Unexpected Luxury Fragrance Drop of the Year You may not expect luxury in spray can fragrances, but behind every AXE product lies a high-end blend crafted by some of the world’s most renowned perfumers. Though its craftsmanship has historically been overlooked, the brand now brings its formulations to the forefront in its new over-the-top bottle concept, the Holder.This idea is backed by blind testing too. In recent trials, the brand demonstrated that it could hold its own against premium perfumes, with participants choosing AXE scents over more expensive options. It proves that the high-end experience doesn't require a luxury price tag.Over the years, the luxury fragrance world has developed a recognizable visual language through sculptural bottles and elaborate packaging. Poking fun at conventional visual cues, the entirely unnecessary Holder accessory wraps the familiar can in a square-shaped bottle to show that luxury is often about the vessel rather than the scent itself.In the launch campaign, AXE continues to tell the same story. Taking notes from the polished style of traditional fragrance adverts, the Holder is treated with drama through close-ups and low lighting, normally reserved for extravagant bottles, creating a bold statement as well as a playful parody. The Holder will launch via upcoming activations and collaborations later this year. You can now shop the debut drop in the UK via the dedicated webpage. Those in Mexico can visit the regional webpage from October. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: HUF Pilots a Fall 2026 ‘Neon Genesis Evangelion’ Capsule
items.text: HUF Pilots a Fall 2026 ‘Neon Genesis Evangelion’ Capsule Summary HUF has teamed with anime franchise Evangelion for a Fall 2026 capsule spanning apparel and accessoriesThe lineup pairs the series' imagery with HUF's streetwear sensibility across three T-shirts, a cap and a keychainStandout details include a glow-in-the-dark front print and a six-panel hat that ships with a collectible pin HUF and Neon Genesis Evangelion have joined forces on a new Fall 2026 collection that filters the anime's world through the brand's streetwear lens. The capsule keeps things focused, rounding up a trio of graphic T-shirts alongside a six-panel cap and a metal keychain, each carrying artwork pulled from the long-running series.The T-shirts form the backbone of the range, and all three are built on the same heavyweight foundation: 100% COTTON USA jersey in a 225GSM weight with a one-wash finish for a lived-in feel from the start. The Triple Triangle T-shirt arrives in white with printed artwork across the left chest and back, while the Unit-01 T-shirt runs the same placement in black. The Rei Ayanami T-shirt is the technical standout of the group, swapping in a front print rendered in glow-in-the-dark ink so the graphic shifts once the lights go down. Each shirt finishes with a co-branded HUF X EVANGELION label stitched inside the neck.Topping off the apparel is the collection's six-panel hat, cut from 100% cotton twill with a curved visor. Embroidered artwork lands on both the front and back crown, and the cap adds a few HUF signatures, including a HUF eightynine flag label at the rear and an adjustable plastic snap closure. It also ships with a bonus: a co-branded HUF X EVANGELION pin that doubles as a small collectible alongside the headwear itself.The keychain rounds out the capsule as its most accessible entry point. Made from zinc alloy, it carries the collaboration's artwork on the front and a HUF X EVANGELION engraving on the reverse, hung on a double ring stamped with HUF Worldwide's DBC original logo. It's a compact way into the collection for anyone after the branding without committing to a full apparel piece.The Neon Genesis Evangelion x HUF collection is available now via HUF Worldwide JP. items.text: Aston Martin's Valhalla Spider Is a Rarer Open-Top Version of Its 1,064 HP Mid-Engine Supercar Summary Aston Martin is developing an ultra-exclusive, open-air Spider version of its Valhalla supercar for an anticipated November debutThis new variant will utilize a removable targa top to save weight and preserve the intense dynamics of the original carbon fiber chassisThe drop-top retains the coupe's uncompromised Mercedes-AMG V8 hybrid powertrain, sending 1,064 horsepower to all four wheels The British marque is preparing to unleash the Aston Martin Valhalla Spider, an exclusive, open-air iteration of its mid-engine supercar. Anticipated to make its official debut as early as November, the new drop-top represents a rare escalation in the modern exotic landscape. Production numbers for the forthcoming Spider are expected to be remarkably scarce, deliberately undercutting the already stringent allocation of the standard Valhalla Coupe, which is strictly capped at just 999 units worldwide.Introducing an even rarer open-top variant fundamentally shifts the vehicle's footprint in the exotic sector, elevating Aston Martin's standing among the world's most elite car collectors. The standard closed-roof coupe already operates in a highly exclusive market segment, delivering performance metrics that bridge the gap between heavyweights and multi-million dollar flagship hypercars. Removing the roof from the Valhalla amplifies that exclusivity, transforming an already elusive track weapon into a visceral status symbol for the hyper-wealthy.To achieve this open-sky experience, the vehicle will be built around a highly advanced, lightweight carbon fiber monocoque. While this foundational structure provides immense baseline rigidity, the architecture may require targeted additional strengthening to maintain the exact strength and torsional stiffness of the original hardtop model. For the roof itself, the Spider is expected to utilize a completely removable targa top rather than relying on a motorized folding hardtop or a traditional fabric soft top. This manual targa design was chosen specifically to avoid the added weight and mechanical complexity of automated systems, particularly because the supercar lacks the internal storage space required to house bulky folding roof mechanisms.Beneath the sculpted bodywork, the Valhalla Spider will retain the exact powertrain of the standard coupe without any modifications. items.title: 100 Thieves, Pokémon, and Modernica Reframe Heritage Seating With Fine China Shell Chairs
items.text: 100 Thieves, Pokémon, and Modernica Reframe Heritage Seating With Fine China Shell Chairs Summary 100 Thieves has partnered with Pokémon and Modernica on a four-piece fiberglass shell chair collectionBuilt in Los Angeles each piece features blue and white fine china-inspired artwork across a chrome Eiffel baseThe collection highlights Bulbasaur Charmander Squirtle and Pikachu launching September 25 for $725 USD each Pokémon, 100 Thieves, and Modernica have officially unveiled the collaborative collective. items.title: Marvel's 'Daredevil: Born Again' Will Officially End With Season 3
items.text: Marvel's 'Daredevil: Born Again' Will Officially End With Season 3 Summary Marvel Television and Disney+ will conclude Daredevil Born Again following its third season Production on Season 3 wrapped recently and is undergoing post-production ahead of its 2027 premiere Showrunner Dario Scardapane has exited the project while the final season brings back original Defenders cast members Disney+ and Marvel will officially conclude Daredevil: Born Again following its upcoming third season. The revival series starring Charlie Cox as Matt Murdock is set to wrap up after three seasons on the streaming platform.The decision comes as Season 3 enters post-production following the exit of co-creator and showrunner Dario Scardapane. Originally debuting on Netflix before transitioning to Disney+ in 2025, the series brought back key original cast members including Vincent D’Onofrio as Wilson Fisk, Deborah Ann Woll as Karen Page, Elden Henson as Foggy Nelson, and Wilson Bethel as Bullseye.Building on the storylines set up in Season 2—which saw Murdock imprisoned, his secret identity exposed, and Kingpin stripped of his mayoral office—Season 3 will unite the street-level Defenders universe. Returning cast members Krysten Ritter (Jessica Jones), Mike Colter (Luke Cage), and Finn Jones (Iron Fist) are set to reunite alongside Murdock to confront Fisk.Daredevil: Born Again Season 3 is scheduled to premiere exclusively on Disney+ in 2027. items.title: Tremaine Emory's ‘Denim Tears from the Pool of Black Genius’ Opens at SCAD Museum of Art
items.text: Tremaine Emory's ‘Denim Tears from the Pool of Black Genius’ Opens at SCAD Museum of Art Summary SCAD Museum of Art is staging a retrospective look at Tremaine Emory's practice through his label Denim TearsThe exhibition sets Emory's work against a "Pool of Black Genius" spanning historical and contemporary artistsThe presentation positions his fashion output as a form of conceptual art rooted in the story of the African Diaspora SCAD Museum of Art is turning its focus to Tremaine Emory with Denim Tears from the Pool of Black Genius, a retrospective built around the founder of Denim Tears and his diaspora-driven approach to design. The exhibition traces the breadth of Emory's creative output, treating his self-described "African American sportswear" label as a vehicle for cultural storytelling rather than a straightforward clothing line.The show's organizing idea is the titular "Pool of Black Genius," a framework that situates Emory's work within a wider constellation of influences. To draw that out, the exhibition pulls pieces by Jacob Lawrence, Romare Bearden, Alma Thomas, Faith Ringgold and others from the SCAD Museum of Art Permanent Collection, using them to trace the lineage Emory draws from. It's a deliberate pairing that positions his practice as part of a longer continuum of Black artistic expression rather than a standalone fashion project.Alongside those historical anchors, the presentation devotes significant space to the artists Emory works and thinks in tandem with. Contemporary pieces from collaborators and peers including Arthur Jafa, Hank Willis Thomas and David Hammons round out the display, mapping the network of dialogue that runs through his output. The effect is less a solo survey than a portrait of an artist in conversation, with each collection reflecting another facet of the African Diaspora and the country's complicated shared history.Central to the whole thing is Emory's use of fashion as conceptual art. The exhibition frames his work as a way of translating dense historical references into cultural touchstones, reconfiguring familiar hierarchies and opening up conversations through inclusive gestures. By treating garments as carriers of meaning, the show makes the case that Emory's clothing operates on the same plane as the fine art surrounding it, offering viewers a prompt for reflection and reconsideration.Denim Tears from the Pool of Black Genius, organized by SCAD Museum of Art chief curator Daniel S. Palmer, runs until Janu

items.title: Apple’s New Music Hall Turns a Battersea Power Station Room Into a Full Live-Production Studio
items.text: Apple’s New Music Hall Turns a Battersea Power Station Room Into a Full Live-Production Studio Summary Apple has opened Apple Music Hall, a live music venue inside London's Battersea Power StationThe 600-capacity space is engineered so artists can perform, record and film a show all in one placeA 48-speaker spatial sound system and dual mix studios let performances be captured in Spatial Audio and livestreamed worldwide Apple Music Hall, Apple's new live music venue in London's Battersea Power Station, is built to function as much like a studio as a concert hall. The 600-capacity room is engineered to let an artist play an intimate set and walk away with a finished recording, a broadcast mix and multicamera video from the same night.The core idea is closing the distance between a small-room show and arena-grade production. Every seat sits close to the performer, but the backend infrastructure is scaled for a touring act, anchored by a 38-foot-wide stage that reconfigures between a traditional front-facing layout and in-the-round setups. Wrapping the audience is a 48-speaker spatial sound system, positioned all around the room so that when an artist performs in spatial, fans hear the set as a fully immersive mix rather than a standard front-of-house feed.Behind the stage, the venue operates as a working production facility. Two dedicated recording and mix studios are built to professional standards, allowing any performance to be captured as a multitrack recording and mixed in Spatial Audio, either live or after the show. The camera side is equally serious: the space is hardwired for 16 or more cameras feeding a purpose-built broadcast control room, with infrastructure that runs iPhone video capture in parallel with traditional broadcast rigs. The net result is a single-show pipeline that outputs a Spatial Audio recording, a broadcast-ready mix and multicamera video at once, with performances also livestreamed globally for fans outside London.The architecture leans into its host building rather than fighting it. Apple Music Hall pulls from Battersea Power Station's design language with heritage brickwork, fluted arches and bronze balconies that echo the structure's historic oriel windows, while a giant glass wall opens up a panoramic view of the concourse and the River Thames beyond. Apple also used the opening to relocate Apple Music Radio's London hosts and shows, which now broadcast live from new studios inside Battersea. As Oliver Schusser, Apple's vice

items.title: Apple Is Reportedly Developing a Screenless Health Band
items.text: Apple Is Reportedly Developing a Screenless Health Band Summary Apple’s industrial design team is exploring a screenless fitness tracker band positioned below the Apple Watch SEThe potential hardware pivot follows the September 2026 launch of the data-dense Readiness app for the Series 12 and Ultra 4Health division head Eddy Cue is pushing the stripped-down wearable to accelerate the brand's pace in the fitness category Apple is preparing a radical shift in its wearable lineup by exploring the development of an Apple screenless health tracker. According to an early August 2026 report from Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, the tech giant’s industrial design team has spent roughly a year conceptualizing new hardware formats. Gurman described this internal exploration as something that transforms the product for a new era, equating the scale of the design rethink to the iPhone eventually jumping to a foldable form factor. The display-free band is being weighed alongside other potential wearable changes such as a round display concept and a ceramic chassis reported by PCMag. However, the reporter noted that the round Apple Watch is unlikely to ever ship, framing the screenless band as the most plausible product to emerge from the initiative. By stripping away the display, Apple could eliminate the daily charging requirements that have long been a common friction point for its smartwatch users while simultaneously targeting a lower price umbrella the brand has never fully occupied just below the Apple Watch SE.While Apple remains uncommitted to the screenless band, and while the device lacks a finalized sensor array, official name, price or release date, the software engine required to power it is already on the market. On September 18, 2026, Apple launched the Readiness app on the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4. The system calculates a daily readiness score ranging from 0 to 10 by analyzing recent activity, sleep data and overnight vitals. Users receive one of four daily recommendations: Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready or Go For It. To fuel these insights, the underlying health system samples Heart Rate Variability (HRV) every five minutes. Company officials state this rate is 24 times denser than what the preceding Series 11 could manage. Engineers then split these readings into an overall HRV and a dedicated Recovery HRV, uniquely comparing the data against a user's personal baseline rather than a generic population average.The strongest internal advocate for the st

items.title: The Weeknd Debuts New Song Sampling 'Neon Genesis Evangelion' Theme in Japan
items.text: The Weeknd Debuts New Song Sampling 'Neon Genesis Evangelion' Theme in Japan Summary The Weeknd premiered an unreleased track sampling the 'Neon Genesis Evangelion' theme song during his After Hours Til Dawn tour in JapanJapanese singer Yoko Takahashi joined the artist on stage while NieR creator Yoko Taro directed the multimedia visualsThe live debut marks the second city-linked track unveiled on the tour following his previous performance in Rio de Janeiro The Weeknd has premiered an unreleased track sampling the iconic Neon Genesis Evangelion theme song during the opening night of the Asian leg of his After Hours Til Dawn tour.The singer—real name Abel Tesfaye—performed the song live alongside original recording artist Yoko Takahashi at the Belluna Dome in Saitama, Japan.Dubbed "Tokyo," the track incorporates elements of Takahashi’s 1995 J-pop anthem "A Cruel Angel’s Thesis," famous as the opening theme to Neon Genesis Evangelion. During the performance, Takahashi sang the track in full as Tesfaye joined her on stage. The segment featured multimedia visuals directed by Yoko Taro, the creative director behind the NieR video game series, incorporating imagery from both Evangelion and 2017's NieR: Automata. Tesfaye credited the production on social media as "Presented by YOKO TARO ft. YOKO TAKAHASHI."The performance marks the second unreleased, location-inspired song Tesfaye has debuted on tour, following "Rio" featuring Anitta. While Tesfaye previously suggested retiring The Weeknd moniker after his 2025 album Hurry Up Tomorrow, he recently confirmed he will continue creating and touring indefinitely.The After Hours Til Dawn tour continues across Jakarta, Singapore, Seoul, Bangkok, and Hong Kong before concluding in Kuala Lumpur on November 4, 2026.Presented by YOKO TARO ft. items.title: FunnyPlaying's FPGB Mini Is an Ultra-Compact FPGA Handheld That Plays Original Game Boy Cartridges
items.text: FunnyPlaying's FPGB Mini Is an Ultra-Compact FPGA Handheld That Plays Original Game Boy Cartridges Summary FunnyPlaying introduces the ultra-compact FPGB Mini for original Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridgesHardware utilizes FPGA technology for 1:1 historical accuracy without relying on software emulationFeatures a high-resolution IPS display, physical link cable support and a built-in real-time clock The retro hardware scene recently underwent a massive downsizing. FunnyPlaying announced the FPGB Mini, an ultra-compact handheld console engineered to play original Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges directly without adapters. This form factor measures barely wider than a standard Game Boy cartridge. Handheld weight is approximately 135g with a strictly minimalist footprint measuring 113mm x 64mm x 22mm. A dedicated carrying case is included in the box for immediate portability. Cartridge support remains limited strictly to Game Boy and Game Boy Color titles.Under the hood, the console rejects traditional software emulation in favor of field-programmable gate array (FPGA) technology. By utilizing an FPGA chip to directly recreate original circuitry behavior, the device mirrors the exact hardware quirks, colors and timing of vintage consoles. This device caters to a specific demographic in the retro gaming market, where the inclusion of original cartridge slots and hardware mimicry signals a cultural pivot toward 1:1 historical accuracy.Visually, the handheld modernizes vintage aesthetics. The FPGB Mini features a 2.98-inch IPS screen packing a resolution of 800 by 720 pixels, a specific mathematical choice that scales the original Game Boy display by exactly five times. This screen supports 16.7 million colors and utilizes an RGB565 pipeline. Dedicated processing ensures that original Game Boy Color titles remain properly saturated, delivering the vibrancy intended by developers decades ago.The front layout features a 4-way cross D-Pad on the left, standard B and A buttons on the right and Start and Select buttons on the bottom. Physical controls include a slide power switch on the top and a volume control on the side. Crucially, the console includes a dedicated wired connection for multiplayer battles and trading, though the link cable is an optional accessory sold separately. items.text: Nike Honors Caitlin Clark’s Kansas City Fandom With the Caitlin 1 "Chiefs" Summary Caitlin Clark has provided an early look at her upcoming Nike Caitlin 1 "Chiefs" signature colorwayThe sneaker pairs a bright red upper with gold midsole accents and an oversized black SwooshThe pair is scheduled to release on December 21, 2026 for $140 USD Name: Nike Caitlin 1 "Chiefs"Colorway: University Red/White-University Gold-Black-Metallic Silver-Racer BlueSKU: IH7423-601MSRP: $140 USDRelease Date: December 21, 2026Where to Buy: NikeNike and basketball star Caitlin Clark are expanding her inaugural signature line with the Nike Caitlin 1 "Chiefs". Clark provided an early look at the pair before taking to the court in the new colorway on September 20 when the Indiana Pacers faced off against the Washington Mystics. The sneaker draws design cues from the Kansas City Chiefs, a team the athlete has publicly supported for years.The silhouette comes dressed predominantly in a bright red upper, complemented by gold detailing worked throughout the midsole and outsole. An oversized black Swoosh delivers contrast across the midfoot, while metallic accents highlight Clark’s signature branding on the tongue tag. The execution channels Kansas City's traditional team colors without using official NFL logos or league marks.Rooted in Clark's longtime fandom—which includes attending games and swapping jerseys with wide receiver Rashee Rice—the colorway reflects Nike's personal storytelling approach for the Caitlin 1. items.title: The Nike Air Max Dolce Appears in “Electric Blue”
items.text: The Nike Air Max Dolce Appears in “Electric Blue” Name: Nike Air Max Dolce “Electric Blue”Colorway: Old Royal/Black-Old RoyalSKU: IB4527-400MSRP: $170 USDRelease Date: Fall/Winter 2026Nike's Air Max Dolce returns for another general-release run, this time drenched in a bold "Electric Blue" finish that covers almost the whole shoe. The loafer-meets-sneaker silhouette leans into a straightforward color story that puts the vibrant upper front and center.The Dolce's appeal starts with its unusual build, a hybrid that borrows the low, slip-ready profile of a loafer and grafts it onto Air Max cushioning. That blend makes for a fairly involved construction, which is likely why Nike keeps the palette uncomplicated here. The bright blue runs across essentially the entire exterior, letting the silhouette's shape do the heavy lifting rather than layering in extra contrast panels.Balancing out the saturated upper, the inner lining and the platform underneath both land in black. The result is a clean two-part split that reins in the intensity of the blue and gives the shoe a defined base. It's a restrained approach to color blocking, and given the model's complex layout, there's a decent chance Nike carries the same simple formula across the rest of this release cycle. items.title: McLaren Is Discontinuing the Artura in 2028 to Make Way for the New P34 Supercar
items.text: McLaren Is Discontinuing the Artura in 2028 to Make Way for the New P34 Supercar Summary McLaren announced the official retirement of the Artura from its supercar lineup for 2028The brand's first V-6 hybrid struggled against extreme technical delays and reliability issuesA rumored P34 successor will raise the brand's entry price by roughly $60,000 The era of the McLaren Artura is already working its way toward the exit. McLaren announced plans to officially drop its first V-6 hybrid supercar from the vehicle lineup in 2028, closing the chapter on a platform that currently serves as the brand’s entry-level model. Originally introduced to the market as the direct successor to the brand's celebrated previous generation, the outgoing vehicle will step aside to clear the lane for a rumored new supercar currently operating under the internal designation P34. This shift fundamentally alters the financial barrier to entry for the elite marque. Moving forward, the introduction of the upcoming P34 is expected to command a starting price of around $313,000. By removing the current entry-level option and swapping in the P34, the absolute floor to enter the brand will be raised by approximately $60,000.The upcoming discontinuation marks the end of a run that was inherently compromised from the starting line. Initial launch dates for the McLaren Artura were pushed back multiple times, stalling early momentum. Just as customer deliveries prepared to begin in 2021, the entire rollout was severely hindered by the global semiconductor shortage. Supply chain friction was only half the battle, as the vehicle's early production run was notoriously plagued by aggressive technical issues. Internal crisis reached such a critical pitch that in late 2022, McLaren liquidated more than $120 million worth of cars from its historic heritage collection strictly to fund the necessary fixes for the new platform's relentless technical gremlins.That chaotic rollout ultimately left a permanent mark on the supercar's reputation on the showroom floor. According to a U.S. dealer, the slow launch cycle and the highly publicized technical problems immediately put off prospective buyers. In a space driven by extreme aesthetics and raw performance clout, the car lacks true headline appeal. Dealers note that rather than feeling like a revolutionary step forward, the McLaren Artura essentially looks like a redesigned model that merely swaps out its aggressive V-8 for a V-6 hybrid engine.While the Bri

items.title: Razer's New Tartarus V2 Pro Is a One-Handed Keypad Built for MMO and FPS Gaming
items.text: Razer's New Tartarus V2 Pro Is a One-Handed Keypad Built for MMO and FPS Gaming Summary Razer drops the Tartarus V2 Pro, a one-handed keypad packing 31 programmable controls and adjustable optical switchesThe device integrates a drift-resistant TMR thumbstick and dynamic keystroke features for precise executionPriced at $199.99, the peripheral slims down the traditional gaming setup while minimizing hand fatigue Razer has officially announced the release of the Razer Tartarus V2 Pro, a one-handed gaming keypad designed to radically tighten your desktop setup. Priced at $199.99, the peripheral offers a compact alternative to full-sized keyboards, specifically targeting titles that require rapid access to numerous shortcuts, such as heavily layered MMOs and fast-paced FPS games. By consolidating 31 programmable controls onto a single, focused footprint, the device fundamentally changes how players interact with their game, aiming to minimize hand fatigue and completely eliminate the need to reach across a traditional keyboard during crucial moments. The unit measures a sleek 211 by 159 by 49 mm and weighs in at just 486 grams, ensuring it takes up minimal desk real estate. Customers ordering the hardware during its launch week receive a $30 Razer Store Credit.At the core of the Razer Tartarus V2 Pro are second-generation Analog Optical Switches, built to recognize the precise depth of every single key press. Players can customize the actuation point of these switches anywhere between a hair-trigger 0.1 mm and a deep 4.0 mm, allowing for highly tailored tactile responses. This is bolstered by a built-in Rapid Trigger feature that allows the keypad to instantly detect upward keystroke movements as small as 0.1 mm, resetting inputs with hyper-fast precision. Razer rates these advanced switches for a staggering lifespan of up to 100 million keystrokes, emphasizing long-term durability. Driving the performance even further is the integration of true 8000 Hz HyperPolling, ensuring ultra-low latency and near-instantaneous communication between the hardware and the game.Breaking away from traditional keypad limitations, the peripheral features a dedicated analog thumbstick that utilizes advanced TMR technology with anti-drift positioning. Positioned strategically next to the thumbstick are three dedicated thumb buttons, putting even more immediate inputs directly under your most versatile digit. items.title: Calvin Harris Breaks the Guinness World Record for Largest DJ Set After a 1.6 Million-Person Crowd in São Paulo
items.text: Calvin Harris Breaks the Guinness World Record for Largest DJ Set After a 1.6 Million-Person Crowd in São Paulo Summary Calvin Harris has landed a Guinness World Records title for the largest attendance for a DJ set by a single artistThe record was set at his São Paulo performance, where an estimated 1.6 million people packed the streetsHarris played the set from a carnival float, leaning fully into the spirit of Brazilian football and carnival Calvin Harris has been awarded a Guinness World Records title for the largest attendance for a DJ set by a single artist, following a massive performance in São Paulo, Brazil on February 8. An estimated 1.6 million people turned out for the show, officially making it the biggest crowd ever assembled for a solo DJ set.The scale is staggering. Harris performed from a carnival float that rolled through Rua da Consolação in central São Paulo, effectively converting one of the city's main arteries into a sprawling open-air dancefloor as crowds filled the surrounding streets. Across the set, he ran through a string of his biggest global singles, including “This Is What You Came For,” “One Kiss,” “I Need Your Love” and “We Found Love.”Harris matched the occasion with a fitting look, pulling on a Brazil shirt numbered "00" with "Calvinho" printed across the back as he played from the moving platform. The nod to Brazilian football and carnival culture made the moment feel native to the city rather than an imported spectacle, and it marked his first return to Brazil in more than a decade.Guinness World Records has formally recognized the São Paulo show, citing the 1.6 million figure in confirming the title. "Calvin Harris has spent years creating music that brings people together, so to see that reflected on this scale is really quite remarkable," said Will Munford, Official Guinness World Records Adjudicator. items.title: Nike Dresses Up This Air Force 1 Low in Snakeskin and a Trio of Gold Charms
items.text: Nike Dresses Up This Air Force 1 Low in Snakeskin and a Trio of Gold Charms Name: Nike Air Force 1 Low “Gold Charms”Colorway: White/Metallic Gold/WhiteSKU: IZ8908-100MSRP: $125 USDRelease Date: TBCThe Air Force 1 Low is the latest canvas for Nike’s growing charm obsession, pairing the silhouette's signature all-white leather with a snakeskin-textured Swoosh and a set of removable golden trinkets. It's a restrained update on paper that leans on its accessories to do the talking.The foundation stays true to the AF1 blueprint, built on the clean white leather upper that made the model a wardrobe staple. The tweak comes at the Swoosh, rendered here in a tan finish and wrapped in a snakeskin texture that adds a tactile, slightly exotic edge without disrupting the neutral palette. The effect is deliberately understated, setting a quiet base for the flashier hardware.That hardware is the real hook. A trio of golden charms dangles from the laces, made up of a miniature Swoosh, a star, and an Air Force 1 emblem. The cluster attaches by a lobster claw, so it can be repositioned anywhere the clasp fits or pulled off entirely and used to dress up something beyond the shoe. It's a small detail with outsized flexibility, turning a fixed design element into something wearers can rearrange on a whim.The charm treatment also fits into a bigger pattern for Nike, which has increasingly leaned on removable accessories across its women's footwear as an easy route to personalization. The Air Force 1 is a natural fit for the approach: its simple, roomy construction leaves plenty of space for decorative flourishes without tipping into clutter, letting the extras register as intentional rather than busy. items.title: Inside Brooklyn’s Most Electric NYFW Event Celebrating Public School and WHATMORE for Our September Covers
items.text: Inside Brooklyn’s Most Electric NYFW Event Celebrating Public School and WHATMORE for Our September Covers New York Fashion Week kicked off with an undeniable surge of energy as Hypebeast brought its editorial pages to life for our Digital Cover celebration at Brooklyn’s 99 Scott. The evening brought together two generations of New York creative talent to celebrate our September cover stars: iconic streetwear pioneers Dao-Yi Chow and Maxwell Osborne of Public School, alongside the rising five-piece music group WHATMORE. Transforming the industrial warehouse space into an authentic block party, the night honored the city's multi-hyphenate mindset—where fashion, music, and urban culture naturally intersect.Serving as the seamless thread throughout the venue, Toyota’s all-electric C-HR was integrated directly into the rhythm of the event. The vehicle functioned as an interactive hub for attendees. Guests climbed into the backseat of the all-electric C-HR to record raw "car confessionals" and snap high-energy photo booth shots framed with custom event artwork. Adding an element of play, guests were handed branded keychains upon entry, testing their luck to unlock an in-car lockbox stocked with a curated road-trip style tote filled with Public School merch and JBL speakers.The physical environment tapped into classic New York iconography, featuring a custom newsstand-inspired merch booth set up in the center of the space. In a direct nod to the September digital covers, the booth served limited-edition "No Tricks in '26" graphic tees designed by Public School. Styled in the visual language of vintage newsprint, the shirts were handed out to guests straight from street-vendor racks and clear newspaper dispensers, turning the distribution of ephemera into a memorable design moment.Music powered the atmosphere from start to finish, keeping the crowd engaged throughout the three-hour gathering. Blu DeTiger set the initial tone from the DJ booth with an electric set while attendees enjoyed curated bites from culinary collective Ghetto Gastro. The marquee moment arrived when WHATMORE took the stage, delivering a high-octane 20-minute set that showcased their signature blend of genres, bringing the room’s energy to a peak as fellow creatives, artists, and NYFW tastemakers looked on.The launch event proved that modern NYC culture will always thrive in the creative spaces of fashion and music. items.title: Inside Hypebeast Afterhours: A Saul Nash LFW Afterparty at Soho House
items.text: Inside Hypebeast Afterhours: A Saul Nash LFW Afterparty at Soho House The latest Hypebeast Afterhours hit London last weekend, hosted in collaboration with designer, dancer and choreographer Saul Nash.Hot off the heels of the NYFW edition, the event took place during London Fashion Week at Soho House’s 180 House, with views overlooking the city’s lit-up skyline.With attendees pulling up in their best fits for the late-night event, cocktails were provided by Grey Goose and sounds were spun by Miles Peart, Cktrl, and Saul Nash himself, which brought the energy well into the early hours of Sunday,The Hypebeast x Saul Nash party came hours after the designer showcased his latest collection “Masquerade” at a pop-up installation inside the Dray Walk gallery. Inside, pieces originally shown on the runway at Milan Fashion Week were available to buy ahead of their general launch, with mood boards, design processes, and references from the season all on display for passersby to see.Also on view was a hand-picked curation of art from Gray Wielebinski and Izaak Brandt, alongside magazines, books, and other material that had inspired Nash this season. “Masquerade in Residence is a chance for people to step inside our world and interact with the clothing up close," Nash explains. "Although it is only going to be there for a few days, it is more than just a typical pop-up shop. It is an opportunity to invite London and my community into the brand’s world”.Take a look at the gallery to see what went down. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Heinz’s Simply Spicy and Simply Pickle Ketchup Bring Real Jalapeños and Briny Tang to a Cleaner Recipe
items.text: Heinz’s Simply Spicy and Simply Pickle Ketchup Bring Real Jalapeños and Briny Tang to a Cleaner Recipe Summary Heinz has launched Simply Spicy Ketchup and Simply Pickle Ketchup, the first flavored additions to its Simply lineupBoth varieties rework the brand's best-selling flavored ketchups around a simplified ingredient listSimply Spicy gets its heat from real jalapeños, while Simply Pickle layers a tangy, briny profile over Heinz's signature tomato base Heinz has introduced Simply Spicy Ketchup and Simply Pickle Ketchup, expanding its Simply line with its first flavored varieties. Both build on the stripped-back recipe philosophy behind the original Simply ketchup and bring it to two of the brand's most popular flavor profiles.The foundation is the original Heinz Simply ketchup, which uses just seven real ingredients and contains no artificial colors, flavors, sweeteners or preservatives. Heinz says the recipe keeps the thick, rich texture its classic ketchup is known for, so the shorter ingredient list doesn't come at the cost of consistency. The new flavors take cues from Heinz's top-selling flavored ketchups and rebuild them to fit the same simplified standard.Simply Spicy blends ripe red tomatoes with spices and real jalapeños, relying on actual peppers for its heat rather than a flavoring shortcut. Heinz pitches it as an all-purpose kick for burgers, chicken and even scrambled eggs.Simply Pickle keeps Heinz's familiar tomato base and adds a bright, briny pickle flavor for a sharper, tangier finish. It's aimed at the classic ketchup pairings, including hot dogs, fries and sandwiches, where a hit of acidity cuts through richer foods.The timing tracks with shifting shopper habits. Heinz cites figures showing that two in three shoppers actively look for simple, recognizable ingredient lists, while 85% say taste remains a priority when choosing food. On the flavor side, the brand points to 95% of consumers reporting that they enjoy hot and spicy foods in 2026, and year-over-year category sales growth of more than 30% for pickle-flavored products.Heinz Simply Spicy Ketchup and Simply Pickle Ketchup are rolling out now at retailers nationwide. items.title: Adam Driver, Miles Teller, and Scarlett Johansson Star in Official Trailer for James Gray's 'Paper Tiger'
items.text: Adam Driver, Miles Teller, and Scarlett Johansson Star in Official Trailer for James Gray's 'Paper Tiger' Summary Neon has debuted the official trailer for 'Paper Tiger' written and directed by James GrayThe 1980s crime drama stars Adam Driver Miles Teller and Scarlett Johansson as a family entangled with the Russian mafiaFollowing its premiere at the Cannes Film Festival the film will open the New York Film Festival ahead of its November release Neon has released the official trailer for Paper Tiger, an upcoming 1980s crime drama written and directed by James Gray. The film stars Adam Driver, Miles Teller, and Scarlett Johansson in a story centered on family, crime, and the American Dream.Set in 1986 Queens, New York, the plot follows brothers Gary (Driver), an ex-cop, and Isaac (Teller), an engineer. When Gary draws his brother into a scheme that entangles them with the Russian mafia, their family's safety and survival are put at risk. Johansson stars as Isaac's wife, who faces her own turmoil as the scheme unfolds. Gray noted that the narrative draws loose inspiration from his own family's encounter with the Russian mafia in 1980s New York City.The film made its world premiere in competition at the Cannes Film Festival in May 2026, earning a 10-minute standing ovation following its screening. Acquired by Neon prior to its Cannes debut, the project is scheduled to open the New York Film Festival at the end of September.Paper Tiger begins its limited theatrical run on November 13, 2026. items.text: On Reveals Plans to Launch Golf and Football Categories as It Targets $7 Billion USD in 2029 Sales Summary Swiss sportswear brand outlines 2029 targets approaching $7 billion in absolute net salesExpansions into golf and football product ranges are officially slated for early 2027Strategic shift to U.S. dollar reporting will align financials with actual business economics Swiss sportswear powerhouse On revealed its plan to disrupt the country club during its investor day at the Zurich headquarters on Tuesday. Executives laid out a three-year growth plan to secure 2029 ambitions. The brand is mapping its evolution as a publicly traded company by entering major global sports. Co-chief executive officer Caspar Coppetti announced that the label will add a golf category to its roster in early 2027. Internal backing for the move includes chief design officer Thilo Brunner and president Scott Maguire, who are both avid golfers. Tennis icon Roger Federer attended the event to express excitement for the extension into the golf space.Football represents another arena receiving the Swiss treatment following a recent partnership with superstar Kylian Mbappé. Linking with the French forward generated $8 billion USD in earned media reach, according to founder and co-chief executive officer David Allemann. This cultural alignment shifts the demographic younger, as 72 percent of followers gained since the announcement are under the age of 35. Digital momentum supports the upcoming release of the first On Football product range in 2027. Diversifying into these segments moves the company from a specialized running label into a multi-sport powerhouse capable of sustaining momentum on the public market.The Zurich-based label established specific financial targets for the road to 2029 to support its expansion. Management set a goal to reach at least 5.6 billion Swiss francs, which is approximately $7 billion USD, in absolute net sales by the end of the decade. High-teens constant currency growth is anticipated over the next three years. Existing categories remain the primary engine, with over 75 percent of the net sales addition planned to come from established run, lifestyle and apparel verticals. items.title: Porsche Patents a Dual-Clutch Transmission With a Real Clutch Pedal and H-Pattern Shifter for Hybrids
items.text: Porsche Patents a Dual-Clutch Transmission With a Real Clutch Pedal and H-Pattern Shifter for Hybrids Summary Porsche filed a patent with the European Patent Office for a dual-clutch automatic transmission that incorporates a physical clutch pedal and an H-pattern gear shifterThe versatile system features an automatic mode with paddle shifters as well as a separate mode designed to deliver a full manual driving experienceThis engineering concept provides a viable workaround for existing hybrid powertrains that cannot currently accommodate traditional manual gearboxes Porsche recently detailed a new gearbox in a filing with the European Patent Office to preserve the analog driving experience in an increasingly electrified automotive landscape. The patent depicts a sophisticated dual-clutch transmission that defies conventional design by incorporating both a physical clutch pedal and a traditional gear shifter. This development directly addresses a massive industry challenge of preserving the visceral feel of a manual transmission as modern powertrains evolve. By designing a system that visually and mechanically bridges the gap between old-school engagement and modern performance, the manufacturer is preparing to offer driving purists a lifeline in the hybrid era.During standard operation, the setup functions identically to a normal automatic transmission and allows for effortless cruising without the need to work three pedals. When drivers want to dictate the shifting rhythm without fully committing to a manual experience, they can choose to shift through the gears manually using paddle shifters mounted directly on the steering wheel. The system provides another tactile option in automatic mode by allowing the driver to select gears through shifting the center gear selector backward and forward. This layered approach ensures that the vehicle maintains the efficiency expected from a modern automatic setup while still offering physical inputs.The true centerpiece of the patent is a completely separate driving mode that drivers can engage to access a full manual driving experience. Activating this specialized mode causes the system to immediately awaken the transmission's physical clutch pedal and transforms the footwell into an enthusiast's playground. Furthermore, this manual mode allows the center gear shifter to operate in a traditional H-pattern configuration. items.title: KFC and Surreal Reimagine Original Recipe Chicken as a Savory Breakfast Cereal
items.text: KFC and Surreal Reimagine Original Recipe Chicken as a Savory Breakfast Cereal Summary KFC UK and high-protein cereal brand Surreal have joined forces on KFCereal, a savory take on breakfast modeled on the chain's Original Recipe chickenInstead of milk, the brands suggest drowning each bowl in KFC gravyThe limited-edition box is sold only through Surreal's UK webstore while supplies last KFC UK and Surreal have launched KFCereal, a limited-edition breakfast cereal flavored after the fast food chain's Original Recipe chicken. The pairing swaps the usual splash of milk for KFC gravy, marking KFC's first move into the cereal aisle.Flavor leads the spec sheet. The crunchy cereal is seasoned with KFC's closely guarded blend of 11 herbs and spices, giving it a savory profile far removed from the sweet, fruity and chocolate varieties that usually fill the category.The nutrition leans on Surreal's high-protein formula. Despite its fried chicken inspiration, KFCereal delivers 19g of protein and only 1g of sugar, keeping it in line with the functional positioning Surreal is known for.Then comes the gravy. Rather than milk, KFC recommends topping the cereal with its signature gravy, and it positions the release squarely at die-hard fans, curious cereal eaters and anyone bold enough to make the switch. KFC brand manager Elspeth Allen framed the idea simply: "Our 11 herbs and spices have been doing a pretty good job on chicken," she said, explaining that the team wanted to test the seasoning at breakfast.KFCereal is available now exclusively via Surreal's UK website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Mbappé Is With On Now, But His Boots Didn't Get the Memo
items.text: Mbappé Is With On Now, But His Boots Didn't Get the Memo Name: Nike Mercurial Superfly 11 Elite By YouColorway: White/WhiteSKU: IU4441-100MSRP: $325 USDRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: NikeNike has made an all-white Mercurial Superfly 11 Elite available through its By You customization platform, and the timing is hard to miss. The option went live just after Kylian Mbappé, who recently signed with On, wore a nearly identical white Superfly 11 in his first Real Madrid match since announcing the switch.Mbappé's move to On marks the end of a partnership that started when he was a child. He had been signed to Nike since 2006, when he was eight years old. Announcing the new deal on his website, Mbappé said he saw "opportunity to build something entirely new together."On's boot, however, isn't quite ready for match day. Mbappé has already been seen training in an On prototype built with the brand's LightSpray technology, but for Real Madrid's Sunday fixture he went back to the Mercurial Superfly 11, the same boot he wore at the World Cup before his Nike contract ran out. The all-white upper made the Swoosh nearly disappear, though not entirely, and with Real Madrid kitted out by adidas, the Three Stripes rather than On supplied the other logo on his uniform.Nike's follow-up was subtle. The brand made a similar all-white version of the boot a default option on Nike By You, tagged with a "Just In" label, without any direct reference to Mbappé. However, Nike has not publicly connected the two.The boot itself is Nike's top-tier speed silhouette. The Mercurial Superfly 11 Elite By You is a low-top firm-ground boot built for dry, natural-grass pitches. Underfoot, a forefoot Air Zoom unit adds a springy, responsive feel, while ZoomX foam, which Nike says appears in its football boots for the first time here, delivers the brand's highest energy return. The upper uses FlyWeave Ultra, a material woven into targeted zones from heel to toe for a close, locked-in fit, and chevron studs help players grip and cut sharply. View this post on Instagram  Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: New Era Japan Stacks ‘Batman’ and Slasher Classics Across 59FIFTY, 9FORTY and 19TWENTY Caps Summary New Era Japan has released a five-piece headwear lineup built around DC's Batman and two landmark horror film franchisesThe caps span the brand's fitted 59FIFTY, the pinched-crown 59FIFTY and 9FORTY A-Frame, and the five-panel retro PC 19TWENTYConstruction ranges from structured fitted crowns to adjustable, strapback builds in cotton and cotton-polyester blends New Era Japan has unveiled a new capsule of caps featuring DC Comics' Batman alongside the horror films A Nightmare on Elm Street and Friday the 13th. The five-piece run spreads the three properties across four of the brand's silhouettes, giving each license a shape that suits its attitude, from sharp, structured fitteds to softer, retro-leaning strapbacks.Batman gets the widest spread, appearing on three different builds. The black 59FIFTY A-Frame takes New Era's signature fitted cap and pinches the crown at the top for a peaked, A-shaped profile. A proprietary stiffener sewn behind the front panel holds that shape firmly, and like every 59FIFTY, it skips an adjuster entirely in favor of fitted sizing offered in roughly one-centimeter steps. It is cut from a polyester and cotton blend.For wearers who prefer an adjustable fit, the Batman 9FORTY A-Frame arrives in washed black cotton. It uses a single-panel front pinched at the crown, backed by the same shape-retaining stiffener, and sits slightly deeper on the head than a standard 9FORTY. The visor comes pre-curved out of the box, and a rear adjuster covers various head sizes. Rounding out the Batman trio is the black PC 19TWENTY, a five-panel cap with a retro baseball shape, a rear strap for sizing, and a cotton and polyester build.The horror side of the drop splits across two silhouettes. A Nightmare on Elm Street lands on the classic 59FIFTY in olive, the only non-black colorway in the lineup, with the same stiffened front panel and adjuster-free fitted construction. New Era points out that dropping the adjuster keeps the back of the cap clean and lets the crown follow the shape of the head more closely. Friday the 13th, meanwhile, takes the black PC 19TWENTY in all-cotton, giving the franchise the lineup's most relaxed, vintage-leaning profile.The pairing of properties is a natural fit for the season. items.text: HYBE CINE FEST 2026 Will Screen Two BTS Live Concerts and Three K-Pop Tour Films Worldwide Summary HYBE CINE FEST expands worldwide for the first time, reaching more than 60 territories from October 24 through October 31Two BTS live viewings from Buenos Aires and São Paulo bookend a six-title lineup that also includes three tour films and an interactive 3D screeningSelect cinemas across North America and Europe will host fan zones, photo walls and pop-up shops through the festival's Special Location program Trafalgar Releasing and HYBE are taking HYBE CINE FEST 2026 global, turning the K-pop cinema festival into a week-long theatrical event running from October 24 to October 31. items.title: L.L.Bean x Dunkin' Serve Up a Birdseye Sweater and Boat and Tote for National Coffee Day
items.text: L.L.Bean x Dunkin' Serve Up a Birdseye Sweater and Boat and Tote for National Coffee Day Summary L.L.Bean and Dunkin' have teamed up for the first time on a capsule that remixes two of L.L.Bean's most recognizable piecesThe Birdseye Sweater gets a custom Dunkin'-inspired pattern, while the Boat and Tote picks up the coffee chain's signature orange and pink L.L.Bean and Dunkin' have unveiled their first-ever collaboration, a limited-edition capsule that gives L.L.Bean's Birdseye Sweater and Boat and Tote a Dunkin' makeover. The two New England brands are rolling it out over the first week of fall with giveaways, an in-store event and a traveling Bootmobile, before the full collection launches on National Coffee Day.The capsule centers on two L.L.Bean staples. The Birdseye Sweater, one of the brand's classic knits, returns with a custom version of its signature Birdseye pattern designed around Dunkin'. The Boat and Tote swaps its familiar colorways for Dunkin' orange and pink and adds embroidered L.L.Bean and Dunkin' logos, turning the heritage carryall into a cobranded piece."L.L.Bean and Dunkin' are iconic brands that have called New England home for decades," said Nick Wilkoff, chief marketing officer at L.L.Bean. "We wanted to create something that feels familiar and fun, bringing a touch of Dunkin' to two L.L.Bean favorites that have been a part of people's fall traditions for generations."Two coffee accessories round out the rollout. The first was a limited-edition cup sleeve that mimics a tiny Birdseye Sweater wrapped around a Dunkin' cup. It was handed out with any hot or iced coffee purchase at participating Dunkin' locations. The second, the L.L.Bean Coffee Tote, arrives on National Coffee Day through Dunkin's merch site and at select Dunkin' locations in Maine.The L.L.Bean x Dunkin' Birdseye Sweater and Boat and Tote drop September 29 online, with early access at L.L.Bean Seaport in Boston on September 27. The L.L.Bean Coffee Tote releases the same day online and at select Dunkin' locations in Maine. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
