items.title: Must-See Booths at The Armory Show 2026
items.text: Must-See Booths at The Armory Show 2026 Summary The Armory Show returns to New York from September 24–27 with more than 230 galleries at the Javits Center.From solo presentations to material-driven installations, Hypeart highlights the booths worth seeking out across the 2026 fair. The Armory Show returns to New York from September 24–27, bringing more than 230 galleries to the Javits Center for its 2026 edition. A fixture of the city’s fall art calendar, this year’s fair spans established names and younger programs, with the Focus section turning its attention to Caribbean art and Platform presenting a series of large-scale, site-specific works that move beyond the traditional booth format.With that much ground to cover, the strongest presentations are often the ones that reward a closer look. Across the fair, artists are working through personal archives, inherited histories, material experimentation and collective memory in ways that feel especially immediate. From textiles rooted in family and cultural legacy to paintings shaped by pilgrimage, migration and place, these are some of the booths worth seeking out at The Armory Show 2026.Zoë Pulley at Superposition Gallery, Booth P10Superposition Gallery will present new work by Brooklyn-based artist Zoë Pulley at The Armory Show, marking her first solo presentation in New York and debut with the gallery. Drawing from the archive of her grandmother, Philadelphia fashion designer Sandra Olivia Moon Hightower, Pulley transforms garments, press clippings and personal documentation into large-scale textile works that explore how Black creative histories are preserved, lost and reconstructed across generations.Working through image transfer, collage and text, the new series reframes a deeply personal family archive within a wider conversation around memory, authorship and cultural legacy.Kathia St. Hilaire at Perrotin, Booth 100Drawing from her Haitian ancestry and upbringing in South Florida’s Afro-Caribbean communities, St. Hilaire uses printmaking, painting and collage to examine histories of migration, occupation and resistance. Her presentation at The Armory Show centers on Spiralism, the Haitian literary movement founded in the 1960s by Frankétienne in response to the violence of François Duvalier’s dictatorship.Through layered symbols, carved imagery and collaged surfaces, St. Hilaire treats chaos as a force that can produce transformation rather than only destruction. items.title: Unboxing the LUAR x Lunazul Tequila Clothing Capsule
items.text: Unboxing the LUAR x Lunazul Tequila Clothing Capsule Revealed on the LUAR SS27 runway on September 14, LUAR and Lunazul Tequila have created a limited-edition clothing capsule that merges Raul Lopez’s NYC-inspired aesthetics with Lunazul’s tequila craftsmanship. Featuring a head-to-toe look that Lopez says “couldn’t get more New York,” the consciously-crafted collection centers around an innovative agave twist.The meticulous attention to detail that both labels are known for extends to the unboxing experience. Housed in a collaborative package, the kit opens with a special card detailing the partnership, a co-branded sticker, and bespoke LUAR wrapping beside a complementary bottle of Lunazul Tequila. Translating the foundations of blue agave cultivation into a tangible, wearable experience, the highly exclusive capsule within nods to their shared lunar inspiration and dedication to craft.Peeling away the custom LUAR wrapping reveals the capsule's core elements: the black denim set — comprising a classic trucker jacket and wide-leg shorts — the classic baseball cap, and the basketball-shaped handbag. Designed with matching details, the jacket, shorts, and cap are elevated by striking blue contrast stitching and co-branded agave leather patches. On the jacket, a distinctive agave leather collar amplifies the Lunazul blue details throughout the rest of the look.Zooming out from the denim, the broader collection orbits around the basketball-shaped handbag. Characterized by a Lunazul blue agave leather shell and a subtle LUAR logo at the front, the bag serves as the perfect accent to the pared-back feel of the garments. This cutting-edge plant-based leather is a direct homage to Lunazul’s mastery of hand-harvested agave cultivation and distilling, a craft spanning more than seven generations.The LUAR x Lunazul Tequila collaborative apparel collection runs in extremely limited quantities. items.title: Thom Browne Elevates the Bose QuietComfort Ultra With Signature Cashmere Tailoring
items.text: Thom Browne Elevates the Bose QuietComfort Ultra With Signature Cashmere Tailoring Summary Thom Browne has partnered with Bose to reimagine the QuietComfort Ultra Headphones using signature tailoring materialsPremium grey cashmere wraps around the adjustable headband and removable ear cushions for an elevated tactile experienceDesign details include four-bar exterior branding a tricolor grosgrain loop and signature Bemberg-inspired ear cup linings Thom Browne and Bose have officially joined forces to reinterpret the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones, fusing high-fidelity audio engineering with luxury American tailoring. Inspired by Thom Browne's iconic grey suit, the collaborative noise-canceling headphones swap standard synthetic hardware for premium textiles.Central to the design is rich grey cashmere, which wraps around the adjustable headband and removable ear cushions to mimic the plush warmth of winter earmuffs. The exterior earcups feature Thom Browne’s signature four-bar athletic motif, a detail mirrored on the accompanying zip cashmere carry case. The crest of the headband is punctuated by the house's signature grosgrain loop, fully integrating the tech accessory into the brand's aesthetic universe.Exposing its internal details when worn flat around the neck, the interior earcups feature the label's signature red, white, and blue tricolor stripe lining, referencing the Bemberg fabric found inside classic Thom Browne suiting. The underlying audio framework retains Bose’s advanced active noise-canceling capabilities alongside its immersive spatial audio playback.The headphones will now be available on Bose and Thom Browne beginning September 28th, with preorders opening on September 24. The unexpected Canadian-exclusive collab delivers a sweet and savory carbonated beverage designed for adventurous palate.Formulated in Toronto by Solly's Craft Soda founder Adin Wener, the drink pairs classic cream soda notes with a distinct hint of Kraft Dinner’s signature cheese powder profile. Built on Solly's core base, the formula utilizes real cane sugar, clocks in at 45 calories, and offers a low-sugar alternative that acts as a source of fiber.According to Kraft Heinz Head of Marketing Daniel Lundberg, the novelty release aims to spark debate and satisfy curiosity among die-hard KD fans. The release follows previous experimental food crossovers from Kraft Heinz, continuing the brand's push into unexpected product categories.KD x Solly’s Cream Soda launched on September 23, 2026, exclusively in Canada, with a broader rollout at participating retailers including Walmart arriving in early October 2026. items.title: MM6 Maison Margiela Subverts Everyday Wear for SS27
items.text: MM6 Maison Margiela Subverts Everyday Wear for SS27 Summary MM6 Maison Margiela presented its Spring/Summer 2027 collection exploring reconfigured garments and unconventional dressingThe collection features modular tailoring alongside doll-inspired proportions and specialized material treatmentsA footwear collaboration with Havaianas reinvents the classic flip-flop with split toes and stacked sole constructions MM6 Maison Margiela has unveiled its Spring/Summer 2027 collection during Milan Fashion Week, challenging the unwritten rules of daily dressing through shifting proportions and modular constructions. The collection reimagines familiar menswear and womenswear archetypes for people on the move.In womenswear, garments rotate around the frame—shirts relocate to function as skirts resting at the hip, V-neck tops adapt into bottoms, and skirts elevate into dresses. Taking cues from doll clothes, garments feature shrunken silhouettes and simplified closures alongside folded and re-fastened panels. Menswear takes a parallel approach with side-shifted collars and button plackets applied across classic tailoring, biker jackets, and everyday essentials, accented by starch treatments, overdyes, and painted papery textures.The accessory line mirrors this playful approach to utility. Leather gloves transform into handbags or five-toed shoes, while the signature Soft Bauletto bag collapses to be carried under the arm like a garment. Capping off the presentation is a footwear partnership with Havaianas, which applies the number six as a design mechanism—splitting flip-flops into individual toes or stacking six distinctly shaped soles into a single platform.Take a look at the full collection above. items.title: John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell Confront the CIA in Searchlight's 'Wild Horse Nine' Trailer
items.text: John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell Confront the CIA in Searchlight's 'Wild Horse Nine' Trailer Summary Searchlight Pictures has released the official trailer for Martin McDonagh's dark comedic drama 'Wild Horse Nine'The film stars John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell as CIA agents stationed in Chile and Easter Island prior to the 1973 coupFollowing its Volpi Cup-winning premiere at the Venice Film Festival the feature lands in theaters this November Searchlight Pictures has released the official trailer for Wild Horse Nine, the latest film written and directed by Martin McDonagh. The new preview provides a closer look at the dark comedic drama starring John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell as CIA agents facing moral reckoning on the eve of the 1973 Chilean coup.Following its world premiere at the Venice Film Festival—where Malkovich won the Volpi Cup for Best Actor—and subsequent screenings at Telluride and TIFF, the film centers on longtime partners Chris (Malkovich) and Lee (Rockwell). Dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief MJ (Steve Buscemi), the duo is forced to confront their past actions while Chris forms a relationship with two rebellious students, played by Mariana Di Girolamo and Ailín Salas.Framed against the historical shadow of American intervention in South America, Wild Horse Nine expands McDonagh's signature exploration of fractured male friendship, guilt, and bleak humor. The project reunites the director with composer Carter Burwell, alongside an ensemble cast featuring Tom Waits and Parker Posey, cinematography by Ben Davis, and editing by Mikkel E. G. Nielsen.Wild Horse Nine opens in theaters on November 6, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: The Rollout For Skepta’s 'Fork & Knife' Has Officially Begun
items.text: The Rollout For Skepta’s 'Fork & Knife' Has Officially Begun The rollout for Fork & Knife, Skepta’s first project in seven years, has finally begun, despite being announced in 2024 and initially scheduled for earlier this year. Fork & Knife is the UK grime pioneer’s first full-length rap project since 2019's Ignorance Is Bliss. The rollout for the highly anticipated project kicked off with the high-octane track, “Innocent Smile”, featuring drum and bass duo Chase and Status, and Suggs, the lead singer and frontman of 70s British pop group Madness. The breakbeat track combines grime, ska, and heavy electronic club music — a true reflection of the song’s contributors. With a London-shot music video directed by Aidan Zamiri — blending cinematic storytelling with nostalgic 2000s British references, “Innocent Smile” and Fork & Knife as a whole reflect the realities of the rapper’s experience of being raised by Nigerian parents who immigrated to North London and the negativity he witnesses surrounding multiculturalism in his country, stating in a recent Instagram post that “In the UK, you would have had 10 or more different nationalities in your classroom to begin with, so we are raised to respect other people's beliefs, faith and language from young. This is how the UK always creates the best scenes and subgenres. Our rave culture is literally a melting pot of people who have a mutual respect for what we all bring to the table.”The start of the Fork & Knife rollout reflects Skepta’s connection to British music culture, ranging from grime and garage to house, jungle and rave. The upcoming project does not have an official release date, though it is expected in 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Jacquemus Opens Mediterranean-Inspired Flagship in Miami Design District
items.text: Jacquemus Opens Mediterranean-Inspired Flagship in Miami Design District Summary Jacquemus has officially opened its new flagship boutique located in the Miami Design DistrictDesigned alongside architectural firm OMA the two-story space spans 270 square meters across two floorsThe store features curated artworks custom furniture a dedicated shoe salon and a private VIP area Jacquemus has officially debuted its latest brick-and-mortar location in the Miami Design District. Conceived by founder Simon Porte Jacquemus in collaboration with architectural firm OMA, the new flagship brings the French fashion house's signature Mediterranean sensibility to South Florida.Spanning 270 square meters (2,906 square feet) across two floors, the boutique translates house design codes through natural light, warm materials, and handcrafted finishes. The exterior facade features expansive glass openings and a dedicated window display, while a central Saint-Marc Jaune stone staircase by Marbrek with a bespoke Battaglia forged-metal balustrade connects the levels. Custom yellow Italian terracotta tiles by Cotto Etrusco run underfoot, complemented by handmade stucco walls and forged-iron accents.The interior showcases a curated selection of fine art and collectible furniture handpicked by Simon Porte Jacquemus. Notable art installations include bronze sculptures by Germaine Richier (Le Coureur) and Aristide Maillol (Femme Couchée), alongside works by Pablo Picasso, Joan Miró, Jean Cocteau, and Wolfgang Tillmans. Decorative pieces include furniture by Frank Lloyd Wright, Jean Royère, and Mathieu Matégot, accompanied by French oak orange-tree planters modeled after André Le Nôtre’s design for the Orangerie at the Château de Versailles.The Jacquemus Miami boutique is open now.Jacquemus "The Miami Boutique"157 NE 40th Street33137Miami, FloridaUSA Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" Breaks All-Time Billboard Hot 100 Record With 23rd Week at No. 1
items.text: Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" Breaks All-Time Billboard Hot 100 Record With 23rd Week at No. 1 Summary Ella Langley’s country hit "Choosin’ Texas" has earned its 23rd week at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 chartThe achievement surpasses the previous record of 22 weeks held by Mariah Carey's "All I Want for Christmas Is You"Co-written alongside Miranda Lambert Luke Dick and Joybeth Taylor the single has also logged 41 weeks atop Hot Country Songs Ella Langley has officially made music history as her smash single "Choosin' Texas" logged its 23rd week at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100. The historic run officially breaks the all-time record for the longest-leading hit in the chart's 68-year history.The country anthem surpasses the previous 22-week record established by Mariah Carey's perennial holiday classic, "All I Want for Christmas Is You." Released via SAWGOD/Columbia Records and promoted to country radio by Triple Tigers, "Choosin' Texas" originally debuted on the Hot 100 in November 2025 before reaching the summit in February 2026. The track was co-written by Langley alongside Luke Dick, Miranda Lambert, and Joybeth Taylor.In addition to its unprecedented Hot 100 streak, the single totaled 21.8 million official streams, 58.3 million radio audience impressions, and 6,000 track sales during its record-setting tracking frame. "Choosin' Texas" concurrently holds a 41-week run atop the multimetric Hot Country Songs chart while tying the all-time record for the longest reign on the Digital Song Sales chart at 18 weeks.Stream "Choosin' Texas" on all major music platforms. items.title: The Most Unexpected Signee in Topps Allen & Ginter's 2026 Baseball Card Set Is Abraham Lincoln
items.text: The Most Unexpected Signee in Topps Allen & Ginter's 2026 Baseball Card Set Is Abraham Lincoln Summary 2026 Topps Allen & Ginter Baseball includes a one-of-one card containing an authentic Abraham Lincoln signatureThe autograph was removed from an original signed document, authenticated, and set into the card rather than signed directly on itLincoln is part of the set's Cut Signatures run, where every card exists as a single copy 2026 Topps Allen & Ginter Baseball includes one of the most unusual chase cards of the season: a one-of-one card built around a genuine Abraham Lincoln signature.The card is made differently from a standard autograph. Lincoln obviously couldn't sign a 2026 trading card, so Topps uses a method called a cut signature. A genuine autograph is carefully removed from a historical item, such as a letter, legal document, or check, and then embedded into the card. Topps says these signatures are sourced from original materials and authenticated before insertion, so the card holds a real piece of the 16th president's handwriting rather than a reproduction.Lincoln's card is part of a 51-card Cut Signatures checklist, and every card in it is numbered one of one. The run leans on baseball history, with names like Babe Ruth and Willie Mays, alongside historical figures such as Lincoln and Winston Churchill. The rest of the set is built for broader collecting. It includes a 300-card base set, Signature Minis with rare Chrome and Metal parallels, and limited-edition Rip Cards. Those are cards collectors can tear open to reveal a second card sealed inside.This isn't the first time Topps has featured Lincoln this way. The company included a one-of-one Lincoln cut signature card in 2009, so the 2026 card returns to an idea the company has used before.The Allen & Ginter name has its own history. The brand takes its look from 19th-century tobacco cards, originally produced by a Richmond, Virginia, tobacco company as collectible inserts in cigarette packs in the late 1880s. It kept the vintage styling and small card format that collectors associate with that era.Lincoln also has an unexpected link to baseball. During the 1860 presidential race, a Currier & Ives political cartoon showed Lincoln and his rivals as ballplayers, with Lincoln holding a bat after beating them at "the national game." It's a small historical coincidence, but it makes his presence in a baseball set a little less random than it seems. The card is ultimately a historical artifact

items.title: Pharrell Williams' JOOPITER Brings Two Dinosaur Skeletons to Auction Estimated Up to $1.2 Million USD Each
items.text: Pharrell Williams' JOOPITER Brings Two Dinosaur Skeletons to Auction Estimated Up to $1.2 Million USD Each Summary Digital auction platform JOOPITER has launched a global sale featuring two exceptionally rare Maiasaura peeblesorum dinosaur skeletonsThe offering includes an adult specimen named Koda estimated at up to 1.2 million USD and a juvenile specimen named Hank estimated at up to 800 thousand USDBoth composite mounts originate from Montana's Two Medicine Formation and will remain open for bidding through October 6 JOOPITER has officially announced the auction of Hank & Koda: Two Rare Maiasaura Skeletons, bringing a pair of 76-million-year-old dinosaur fossils to the global market. Offered as two separate lots expected to fetch up to $2 million USD combined, the sale features an adult and a juvenile specimen of Maiasaura peeblesorum, the duck-billed herbivore species celebrated for revealing the first scientific evidence of dinosaur parental care.Excavated from the Linster Quarry within Montana’s Two Medicine Formation, the Late Cretaceous pair represents two distinct developmental stages of the same species. "Koda," the adult composite mount, measures 20.7 feet long and 8.5 feet tall, composed of 68% original fossil bone by count and estimated between $900,000 and $1,200,000 USD. "Hank," the juvenile composite mount, stands 6.3 feet tall and 13 feet long, containing 62% original fossil material with an estimate between $600,000 and $800,000 USD.Prepared under the scientific direction of Dr. Frédéric Lacombat, both mounts incorporate 3D-printed and epoxy resin components in areas where original fossil bone was absent. Displayed side by side, the specimens demonstrate significant shifts in skull development, body proportions, and movement mechanics as the species matured, providing a rare physical representation of prehistoric family life.Bidding for the JOOPITER "Hank & Koda" auction opened globally on September 22, 2026, and closes on October 6, 2026, exclusively via JOOPITER. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Commits to Portugal and Targets 1,000 Career Goals After World Cup Exit
items.text: Cristiano Ronaldo Commits to Portugal and Targets 1,000 Career Goals After World Cup Exit Summary Cristiano Ronaldo confirms his commitment to the Portugal national team following a disappointing World Cup exitThe 41-year-old forward targets a historic 1,000 career goals as Jorge Jesus takes over as head coachRonaldo is confirmed to start against Wales in the upcoming Nations League fixture in Lisbon Cristiano Ronaldo remains active on the international stage. Following a loss to Spain in the last 16 of the summer World Cup, the forward considered stepping away from international football. Instead, the athlete officially confirmed a decision to continue playing for the Portugal national team. Speaking at a press conference at Portugal’s City of Football complex in Lisbon, Ronaldo outlined an ambition to reach 1,000 career goals for club and country. He sits 21 goals shy of the milestone. This commitment provides roster stability for the squad during a period of leadership change.The decision to remain in the national setup followed a conversation with Portuguese football federation president Pedro Proença and the team's new leadership. Jorge Jesus succeeded Roberto Martínez as the head coach of the Portugal national team. This appointment brings a familiar dynamic to the locker room. Jesus previously managed the forward at Al-Nassr, and the reunion helps dictate the current lineup. During a joint press conference, the coach confirmed that the veteran will start against Wales in the Nations League on Thursday. The striker has 233 caps and served as captain during the recent World Cup.Remaining in the spotlight means facing scrutiny that the forward has encountered throughout his career. Addressing his detractors, Ronaldo remarked that certain television channels tried to kill him with ongoing criticism. The veteran established clear boundaries for his future involvement with the squad. He stated that if he ever feels he is no longer adding value or starts creating a bad atmosphere, he will be the first one to go. Until that moment arrives, the focus remains on pushing the team forward and edging closer to his scoring target before the 41-year-old turns 42 in February.Thursday's Nations League clash carries significant weight and narrative symmetry. The match takes place at the Estadio José Alvalade, the home of Sporting. This marks a return to the pitch where Ronaldo launched his professional career before a move to Manchester United in 2003. items.title: Nissan Unveils the Z Kaze Concept, a T-Top Open-Air Sports Car Inspired by the Classic 300ZX
items.text: Nissan Unveils the Z Kaze Concept, a T-Top Open-Air Sports Car Inspired by the Classic 300ZX Summary Nissan unveiled the retro-heavy Z Kaze Concept at Phoenix's annual ZCon gatheringThe passion project flexes a custom T-top roof alongside authentic 18-inch Nismo LMGT2 wheelsGReddy mechanical upgrades complement the standard twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine Nissan just officially pulled the cover off a serious dose of automotive nostalgia, dropping the Nissan Z Kaze Concept at the annual ZCon gathering for Z enthusiasts in Phoenix, Arizona. Developed internally as a dedicated passion project, the vehicle serves as a direct celebration of the brand’s storied open-top heritage. Taking its moniker from the Japanese word for "wind," the Nissan Z Kaze is defined by a custom-engineered T-top roof featuring fully removable sections. This open-air architectural choice leans heavily into the past, specifically mimicking the iconic silhouette seen on both generations of the classic Nissan 300ZX. By reviving this beloved roofline, the concept functions as more than just a modern show car; it actively bridges the gap between today’s contemporary sports car lineup and the legendary 1990s tuning culture that originally helped popularize both Nissan and NISMO on a global scale.The visual execution leans entirely into that golden era of aftermarket modification while keeping the finish unmistakably premium. Paint for the project is a striking Pacific Teal scheme, a color choice directly inspired by panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean found along California’s famous Pacific Coast Highway. Contrasting that vibrant teal is a custom carbon fiber body kit that completely transforms the coupe's factory exterior. A carbon fiber hood and sweeping fender flares give the vehicle a dramatically wider physical footprint, which is perfectly filled out by a set of restored, authentic 18-inch Nismo LMGT2 wheels. These classic rims measure a massive 10 inches wide in the front and 11 inches wide in the rear, aggressively anchoring the car to the pavement.Inside the cabin, the design team opted to keep the layout clean, elevating an otherwise mostly stock cabin with heavily curated details. The cockpit is upgraded with custom white leather seats, while dedicated carbon fiber accent trim runs throughout the space to echo the exterior styling. items.title: This Life-Size Pikachu Is Made With 200 Sheets of Gold Leaf
items.text: This Life-Size Pikachu Is Made With 200 Sheets of Gold Leaf Summary Japanese gold specialist SGC has made a life-size Pikachu statue finished in roughly 200 sheets of gold leafThe statue will be displayed at a six-day gold exhibition at Yokohama Takashimaya department storeA life-size gold-leaf Gholdengo and a solid gold Gholdengo figure round out the Pokémon lineup at the show SGC has created a life-size Pikachu covered in gold leaf, which it will display at its upcoming exhibition at Yokohama Takashimaya department store. The Tokyo-based gold company handles every stage of production, from refining to finished pieces. The statue is one of three Pokémon pieces at the show.The statue stands about 40 centimeters tall. With its ears included, it reaches roughly 50 centimeters, and the upright points add a full ten centimeters to the figure. That size matches Pikachu's official height of about 0.4 meters, which is why SGC can call the statue life-size. Around 200 sheets of gold leaf cover the surface, giving the character's familiar rounded body and lightning-bolt tail a solid gold finish.The statue is for display only and is not for sale. It comes from SGC's in-house workshop, where the company refines its own high-purity gold and its metalworking artisans turn it into finished pieces. The release does not detail how the gold leaf was applied, but the number of sheets gives a sense of how much hands-on work went into covering the full surface.Pikachu stands next to a much larger gold-leaf piece. A life-size Gholdengo, about 120 centimeters tall, uses roughly 730 sheets of gold leaf, so the two statues together show how the amount of gold leaf scales with each character's size. SGC is releasing the pair during the 30th anniversary year of Pokémon Red and Green.One Pokémon piece, however, is for sale. The 24K Gholdengo is a solid 24-karat gold figure weighing roughly 15 grams and standing about six centimeters tall. It is designed around the character's signature ability, known in English as Good as Gold, which describes a golden body that resists corrosion.The statues are part of a larger exhibition of more than 1,000 gold items. These include Buddhist altar pieces, such as a gold orin (a singing bowl) by a Living National Treasure, a title Japan gives to master artisans, as well as traditional oban and koban coins, tableware, and auspicious ornaments.The gold-leaf Pikachu will be on display at the Yokohama Grand Gold Exhibition, held from September 30 throug

items.title: The Los Angeles Lakers and TASCHEN Bind Seven Decades Into the Book ‘Lakers: An Official History of the Purple & Gold’
items.text: The Los Angeles Lakers and TASCHEN Bind Seven Decades Into the Book ‘Lakers: An Official History of the Purple & Gold’ Summary 'Lakers: An Official History of the Purple & Gold' follows the franchise from its Minneapolis beginnings through its 2020 championship across 10 chaptersGatefolds dedicated to the team's 17 championship rings and its uniform history anchor a layout packed with archival photos and never-before-published artworkEssays from players, executives, and courtside regulars trace how the team became part of the fabric of Hollywood The Los Angeles Lakers have partnered with TASCHEN on Lakers: An Official History of the Purple & Gold, a 528-page authorized history of one of the NBA's most storied franchises. Edited by Vikki Tobak, the book pairs rare and previously unpublished photographs and artwork with original essays from the people who built the team's identity on the court, in the front office, and in the stands.The book is organized chronologically across 10 chapters. Kareem Abdul-Jabbar writes the foreword, Lakers Governor Jeanie Buss the introduction, and Phil Jackson the afterword. Jackson's closing piece caps a story that begins in Minneapolis, where the franchise was founded before moving to Los Angeles in 1960.Championship seasons get special treatment. Each title run is set apart with a gold-themed section listing that year's roster, head coach, and standout playoff performances. The system gives the book a consistent visual rhythm across eras.Those eras line up with the franchise's best-known chapters:Showtime: The fast-breaking 1980s teams, led by Magic Johnson and Abdul-Jabbar and coached by Pat Riley, took off after Dr. Jerry Buss bought the team in 1979.The three-peat: Shaquille O'Neal and Kobe Bryant won three straight titles under Jackson from 2000 to 2002.Back-to-back: Bryant and Pau Gasol followed with titles in 2009 and 2010.2020: The run ends with the 2020 championship led by LeBron James and Anthony Davis.Beyond the season-by-season history, the special layouts go deeper into the franchise's material culture. A four-page gatefold displays all 17 championship rings side by side, and a second four-page gatefold follows how Lakers uniforms have changed over the decades. A separate four-page spread honors every retired number. items.title: Logitech's Blue Yeti 2 Modernizes the Classic Streaming Mic With AI Noise Canceling and a 3D Proximity Sensor
items.text: Logitech's Blue Yeti 2 Modernizes the Classic Streaming Mic With AI Noise Canceling and a 3D Proximity Sensor Summary Logitech introduces the Yeti 2, modernizing its foundational 2009 USB microphone with spatial tracking and AI integrationA new 3D proximity sensor and onboard denoiser automate complex EQ and gain settings right out of the boxThe $160 USD device features a redesigned three-capsule array and a 1.3-inch LED display for animated visual feedback Fifteen years after launching foundational creator hardware, Logitech released a reimagined sequel. The Logitech G Blue Yeti 2 modernizes the original 2009 USB microphone that remains a staple for streamers globally. While the predecessor set the standard for plug-and-play audio, the Logitech G Blue Yeti 2 automates complex settings to simplify microphone management. This design shift transforms a static recording tool into a responsive piece of studio gear by moving technical burdens to the hardware. It targets a new generation of creators who prioritize ease of use over manual mixing.The core of this automation is a 3D proximity sensor that physically tracks a user's voice in space. As speakers move around their desks, the sensor adjusts gain, EQ and pickup patterns in real time to maintain vocal consistency. These automatic tracking capabilities work immediately out of the box. To complement spatial tracking, a dedicated onboard AI denoiser isolates the vocal track. This intelligence reduces background noise like mechanical keystrokes or mouse clicks during gaming sessions.Visually, the silhouette moves past the classic metal mesh aesthetic by integrating a 1.3-inch LED display directly into the chassis. The screen displays a Yeti mascot that acts as a digital assistant by providing feedback on gain levels and directional patterns. Customization options allow streamers to replace the mascot with personalized avatars through the G Hub software. Tactile hardware controls including a capacitive mute button and physical control dial facilitate immediate adjustments.Under the hood, a redesigned three-capsule array supports high-fidelity 24-bit / 48kHz audio recording. A built-in headphone jack enables direct monitoring while users toggle through distinct directional modes. Internal memory stores up to five audio presets for creators moving between different streaming environments. The Logitech G Blue Yeti 2 comes in black or white color options for $160 USD at official and third-party retailers. Click her

items.title: ‘Pokémon’ x Starbucks Japan Turn a Coffee Adventure Into a 41-Piece Merch Collection
items.text: ‘Pokémon’ x Starbucks Japan Turn a Coffee Adventure Into a 41-Piece Merch Collection Summary Starbucks Japan's first Pokémon collaboration drink uses golden honey to stand in for Pikachu's yellow and a heart-shaped topping for its red cheeksThe recipe came from an internal barista competition that drew more than 700 Pokémon-themed entries from across the countryA 41-item merchandise range features original artwork of baristas and Pokémon bonding over coffee Pokémon and Starbucks Japan have launched their collaboration with the Pikachu Honey Cream Latte, an iced espresso drink built around Pokémon's best-known character. The drink leads a wider release that includes 41 pieces of merchandise featuring original artwork, along with Starbucks Card and eGift designs.The latte gets its Pikachu look from its ingredients. Honey gives the drink a golden color that stands in for Pikachu's yellow, while honey and caramel add sweetness that balances the espresso. A layer of honey-flavored whipped cream goes on top, finished with a heart-shaped topping that represents Pikachu's red cheeks. The drink is served iced in Tall size only, and Starbucks designed it to appeal to customers who don't usually drink coffee.The recipe came from inside Starbucks. For the collaboration, Starbucks Japan held the Pokémon + Starbucks Barista Battle, which invited baristas nationwide to submit Pokémon-themed drink ideas. More than 700 recipes were entered, six finalists created their drinks, and the winning recipe came from Junko Nitta of the Koriyama Asaka store. Her recipe is now on the menu at Starbucks stores across Japan.Each latte comes with one collaboration sticker featuring the same original artwork used on the merchandise. That artwork, by illustrator Hikaru Ichijo, covers all 41 merchandise items. The series includes 12 illustrations showing Pokémon and baristas building friendships over coffee and new communities forming around it. Ichijo left the human figures faceless on purpose, so anyone can picture themselves in the scenes. The art is paired with eight short written stories. They follow a coffee-driven adventure from a first cup through the search for ingredients and the craft of brewing, ending on the idea that the journey keeps going.The Pikachu Honey Cream Latte is available from September 30 through October 8 at Starbucks stores across Japan, excluding select locations. The 41-piece merchandise range launches the same day. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Barbour x UNITED ARROWS & SONS Give the Bedale Jacket a Bigger, Bolder Build
items.text: Barbour x UNITED ARROWS & SONS Give the Bedale Jacket a Bigger, Bolder Build Summary UNITED ARROWS & SONS has enlarged Barbour's Bedale into an exclusive oversized model called the OS BedaleEach colorway gets its own lining and neck color, and the sleeves and front neck have been adjusted for a more modern shapeThe jacket is cut to fit any gender and comes in black, orange, and light blue Barbour and UNITED ARROWS & SONS have teamed up on the OS Bedale, an exclusive version of the jacket that Barbour treats as one of its defining models. The Tokyo retailer took the Bedale's familiar outline and scaled up the whole body, then refined its proportions so the British classic sits comfortably in a contemporary wardrobe.The biggest change is the fabric. The shell is fully nylon and holds strong color, so the orange and light blue options look especially bright. The inside of the jacket uses more than one material. The solid sections of the lining are nylon, while the patterned panels and the collar are cotton, which puts a softer fabric where the jacket touches the neck.Color works differently for each version. Instead of repeating one interior across the range, UNITED ARROWS & SONS gave each colorway its own lining and neck color. The black version has a classic base, while the orange and light blue options use bright shells with inside details that change from color to color.The proportions were considered piece by piece rather than simply sized up. The body is cut larger throughout, and the sleeve length and front neck height have each been adjusted so the extra volume feels deliberate rather than baggy. The size 40, for instance, measures 78.5 centimeters in body length and 65 centimeters across the chest. It weighs about 930 grams. The extra room works well over knitwear and other layers, and the retailer presents the jacket as unisex.Barbour's history backs up the update. John Barbour founded the label in South Shields, in northeast England, in 1894. Five generations later, it remains a family business, and its headquarters are still in the region. The OS Bedale keeps the recognizable silhouette of that heritage piece while changing its fit, fabric, and color for a new audience.The Barbour x UNITED ARROWS & SONS OS Bedale is available to pre-order now through the UNITED ARROWS online store, with deliveries expected in early October. items.title: LINDBERG Decodes an ‘Enigma of Vision’ With Artist Fabrizio Corneli
items.text: LINDBERG Decodes an ‘Enigma of Vision’ With Artist Fabrizio Corneli Danish eyewear brand LINDBERG returns to The Armory Show in New York with new site-specific installations crafted by Fabrizio Corneli. Landing in its Enigma of Vision exhibition, the experiential works are molded by light and shadows to question changing perspectives. The exhibition comprises two core installations, which are designed to interact with each other to transform the surrounding space. For “Seed,” a cone-shaped form with a built-in light, Corneli directs his signature practice into carving the surface, illuminating a globe image on the wall. Meanwhile, “Eyecatcher” is formed from the brand’s metal frames to explore how the originally minimalist objects can be reworked into a striking sculpture. Through Enigma of Vision, LINDBERG brings visitors in to discover new and unconventional ways of seeing. As well as supporting its long-term commitment as a patron of the arts, it ties into the brand’s mission of working with galleries, artists and institutions that elevate its own craftsmanship in engineering sleek eyewear.Speaking on the exhibition, Founder, President and CEO of Kering Eyewear, Roberto Vedovotto, shared, “LINDBERG’s collaboration with Corneli is a natural extension of the brand’s design philosophy, where technical mastery and artistic expression converge to challenge perception and reveal beauty through simplicity.” The Enigma of Vision exhibition runs from September 24 - 27, 2026, at The Armory Show 2026. Find out more on LINDBERG's website. The Armory Show429 11th Ave.New York, NY 10001 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 9 Art Shows You Need to See During Armory Week 2026
items.text: 9 Art Shows You Need to See During Armory Week 2026 End-of-August escapes are officially behind us, and the arty pour of out-of-towners means one thing, New York: the fall season is in session. Buzz around the 2026 Armory Show is well underway, and galleries cued up to shake off the summer slowdown and bring their A-game to the fairs and beyond.The fall fair circuit arrived a little later than years prior, pushed to the end of the month to avoid the usual overlap with Fashion Week and the U.S. Open, and a breather from Frieze Seoul. But September has been far from sleepy.A stellar run of gallery openings and major museum shows has already taken root in the run-up to the five main events — The Armory, Independent 20th Century, SPRING/BREAK, U-Haul Art Fair, and the Printed Matter Book Fair — with a few more heavy-hitters waiting in the wings. We toured around the city to round up nine can’t-miss exhibitions, and unlike the fairs, they’ll be on well into next month. Walk, don’t run.Lynda Benglis’ KNOTTING, TYING, FOLDING at Pace GalleryWith Fashion Week on the mind, a visit to Lynda Benglis’ wall hangs is a must. After all, it was works like “Toyopet Crown” (1989) and “Vega” (1982) that inspired Jonathan Anderson’s Dior couture debut in January, where we saw sartorial interpretations of the artist’s metal pleats sent straight down the runway.Benglis has been wielding this playful, fearless spirit since the 1960s, emerging alongside Postminimalism, when her wax paintings put her on the scene. She traded muted palettes for vivid colors and visceral surfaces. The ongoing exhibition at Pace Gallery in Chelsea hosts a constellation of sculptures created over the last five decades, spotlighting her ceaseless curiosity when it comes to material experimentation. From her early “Sparkle Knot IV” (1972) to her more recent “Elephant Necklace” (2017), it’s a masterclass in what she calls the “extremes of coloration and texturing.”On view until October 24.Pace Gallery540 W 25th St,New York, NY 10001Joseph Yaeger’s Agita at Gladstone GalleryLooking at a Joseph Yaeger painting feels like walking into a movie halfway through. The subjects, anonymized and cropped, are distant from where they emerged. Yet sympathy for their startled, often muffled, affliction nonetheless persists. items.title: The Red Wing Iron Ranger Is 1930s Workwear With Modern Day Updates
items.text: The Red Wing Iron Ranger Is 1930s Workwear With Modern Day Updates Red Wing is putting a fresh spin on a closet staple with the Iron Ranger, unboxed here, in timeless Oro Legacy leather.The Iron Ranger has been around since the 1930s, when Red Wing built it for iron ore miners working in northern Minnesota. The six-inch design still centers on a leather toe cap, and that's carried through every version the company has put out over the decades. This time around, it comes in Oro Legacy brown leather, adding to the rotating cast of finishes Red Wing cycles through each season.Beyond its worn-in and weathered look, the build hasn't shifted either. Goodyear welt construction and Puritan triple-stitching hold the upper together, both meant to make the boot solid and repairable rather than disposable. Inside, leather insoles sit over a cork midsole that softens and shapes itself to the foot the more it's worn. Nickel speed hooks handle the laces, standing out a bit against the leather. They also make putting on and taking off the Iron Ranger a breeze.Down below, a modern Vibram 430 Mini-Lug outsole handles traction, and the No. 8 Last shape keeps the wider, rounded toe that sets the Iron Ranger apart from other boots in Red Wing's lineup. Close to 100 years after it was first made, the boot still looks and functions almost exactly the same – one of the few work boots that moved into everyday rotation without getting redesigned along the way.Pick up your own pair of Red Wing Iron Ranger boots over at Red Wing's official website. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Palace Skateboards Debuts Winter 2026 Lookbook
items.text: Palace Skateboards Debuts Winter 2026 Lookbook Summary Palace's Winter 2026 lookbook focuses on heavyweight outerwear, from shearling leather flight jackets to technical patchwork parkasNew takes on Realtree camo appear on overpants and recon jacketsA capsule with '2000 AD's' Judge Dredd leads the season's first look at new jersey prints Palace Skateboards has unveiled its Winter 2026 lookbook, a cold-weather season built on serious outerwear and headlined by a capsule with 2000 AD's Judge Dredd. The lookbook previews a range that goes from shearling leather and ripstop down to Realtree camo, and the first drop lands on October 2.The outerwear leads. The standout piece is a hooded B-15 flight jacket in shearling leather, Palace's version of the classic military flyer silhouette. Oversized ripstop puffers add volume, while hooded patchwork parkas combine GORE-TEX WINDSTOPPER and Pertex to handle wind and weather.Realtree makes a return this season. Palace's latest versions of the hunting camo are printed on overpants and recon jackets, extending the pattern from single pieces across a full outfit.Then comes the jersey. The season introduces a new round of prints, led by a capsule with the British comic 2000 AD built around its signature lawman, Judge Dredd. New Palace graphics appear alongside it. Tracksuits and knitwear complete the lookbook and provide lighter layers to wear under the heavy outerwear.Palace Skateboards' Winter 2026 collection launches with its first drop on Friday, October 2 at 11 a.m. BST in the UK, Europe and the US. It then arrives in Japan, China, Korea and Australia on Saturday, October 3, at 11 a.m. local time. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike Co-Founder Phil Knight Donates $1 Billion USD to University of Oregon
items.text: Nike Co-Founder Phil Knight Donates $1 Billion USD to University of Oregon Summary Nike co-founder Phil Knight and his wife Penny have pledged $1 billion USD to the University of OregonThe historic contribution will fund the establishment of a brand-new undergraduate engineering collegeThe donation brings the Knight family's total lifetime giving to the university to over $2 billion USD Nike co-founder Phil Knight and his wife Penny have pledged a historic $1 billion USD contribution to the University of Oregon. The landmark donation represents the largest known individual gift made to a public flagship university in United States history.The funding will directly support the development of a new engineering college, expanding the institution beyond its current bioengineering graduate offerings to establish a comprehensive undergraduate program. University officials estimate the rollout will take approximately a decade, aiming to alleviate a regional shortage of engineers while driving recruitment amid broader demographic shifts in higher education.This latest contribution brings the Knight family's lifetime giving to the University of Oregon to over $2 billion USD. Having competed as a track athlete at the university before founding Nike alongside coach Bill Bowerman in 1964, Knight has previously underwritten major scientific and athletic facilities across campus, including the Knight Campus for Accelerating Scientific Impact.The University of Oregon will begin implementing the decade-long initiative to construct and launch the new engineering college. items.title: 17 Ferrari Cars, From the F40 to the Latest Models, Gather at Tokyo Midtown
items.text: 17 Ferrari Cars, From the F40 to the Latest Models, Gather at Tokyo Midtown Ferrari Festival Tokyo 2026, an event tracing Ferrari’s past and present in one place, will take place at Tokyo Midtown in Roppongi, Tokyo, from Saturday, September 26, through Sunday, October 4. Ahead of its opening, the Hypebeast Japan editorial team visited the venue to photograph the cars displayed in the garden area.The garden area, which will be open to the public, brings together 17 vehicles. On display are the F40, an icon of the 1980s, along with the F50, Enzo Ferrari, and F80—representing the marque’s supercar lineage—as well as the limited-edition Monza SP1 and Daytona SP3.The current lineup is equally wide-ranging, with the Ferrari Amalfi and its open-top counterpart, the Amalfi Spider; the 12Cilindri and 12Cilindri Spider; the 296 Speciale and 296 Speciale A; the 849 Testarossa and 849 Testarossa Spider; and the Purosangue. Also scheduled for display are the 499P, which claimed overall victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans for three consecutive years, and the SF-26, Ferrari’s 2026 F1 car—both showcasing technology honed on the track.Alongside the vehicle displays, the venue will feature an area introducing Ferrari’s personalization program. Select programming, including a private preview of Ferrari Luce, Ferrari’s first fully electric sports car, will be limited to invited guests.Admission to the public areas of Ferrari Festival Tokyo 2026 is free, though advance reservations are required. The event runs through Sunday, October 4. items.title: PUMA x RCB x Dhruv Kapoor Take Cricket to the Milan Runway
items.text: PUMA x RCB x Dhruv Kapoor Take Cricket to the Milan Runway Summary PUMA, Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Dhruv Kapoor unveiled three collector's edition jackets at Milan Fashion WeekKapoor rebuilt performance textiles and technical components and finished them with handcrafted detailsThe jackets appeared in Presence, Kapoor's Spring/Summer 2027 collection, which PUMA says is a first for cricket on the runway PUMA, Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) and Dhruv Kapoor officially unveiled the PUMA x RCB x Dhruv Kapoor jackets at Milan Fashion Week. The three limited-edition pieces appeared in Kapoor's Spring/Summer 2027 show, Presence, putting an Indian Premier League team on a major fashion week runway, a moment PUMA calls a first for the sport.Kapoor started with sportswear and took it apart. Each jacket rebuilds performance fabrics and technical hardware into new shapes, then adds handcrafted work on top. The result mixes the language of match-day kit with the detail and construction his label is known for. It's a natural fit for a designer whose work already sits between street culture, Indian craftsmanship and luxury fashion.The runway setting gives the pieces their context. Presence is built on the tension between cultural memory and contemporary systems, and placing cricket jackets in that collection turns team gear into a fashion statement. For PUMA India, the Milan debut is the latest step in a longer push to take RCB, one of the IPL's most popular teams, beyond the stands and into everyday wardrobes.The three PUMA x RCB x Dhruv Kapoor jackets will be available soon online, at select PUMA stores, and through select Dhruv Kapoor stores and online channels. items.title: Maria Grazia Chiuri Redefines Modern Form for Fendi SS27
items.text: Maria Grazia Chiuri Redefines Modern Form for Fendi SS27 Summary Fendi has presented its Spring/Summer 2027 collection conceived by creative director Maria Grazia ChiuriThe range centers on human physical form utilizing undergarments lace embroidery and contrasting textures as a second skinInspirations draw from Italian pop culture icon Raffaella Carrà E.E. Cummings poetry and Luciano Fabro’s Mirror Cube art installation Fendi has unveiled its Spring/Summer 2027 collection, guided by creative director Maria Grazia Chiuri’s exploration of the human body and emotional freedom. Grounded in the poetry of E.E. Cummings, the presentation reframes clothing as a porous second skin designed to express individual autonomy, strength, and vulnerability.The collection uses men's and women's undergarments as its foundational starting point, elevating intimate interstitial layers through delicate lace, intricate embroidery, and a varied color palette. Drawing visual subversion from Italian pop star Raffaella Carrà's iconic stage costumes and independent spirit, the designs dismantle traditional hierarchies of dress. Metamorphic garments—such as street-ready dressing gowns—blur boundaries between public and private wear, anchored on the runway by reflective, mirrored set pieces inspired by artist Luciano Fabro’s Cubo di specchi (Mirror Cube).Material execution relies on stark structural contrasts, blending glossy and matte finishes alongside light and heavy fabrications. Silks, leopard prints, lace, intarsia, velvet, and parchment elements are layered across fluid silhouettes, eliminating rigid conventions between masculine and feminine wardrobe codes. The lineup is completed by jewel-embellished footwear, emphasizing physical comfort and self-expression over body constriction. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Marvel Re-Releases 'Avengers: Endgame Encore' With Four New 'Doomsday' Teaser Scenes
items.text: Marvel Re-Releases 'Avengers: Endgame Encore' With Four New 'Doomsday' Teaser Scenes Summary Marvel Studios has re-released 'Avengers: Endgame' in theaters featuring four minutes of new teaser footageThe expanded cut includes appearances from Doctor Doom, Loki, Bruce Banner, and the Time Variance AuthorityThe additional scenes bridge the narrative directly into 'Avengers: Doomsday' ahead of its December premiere DISCLAIMER: This post may include spoilers. Proceed at your own risk.Marvel Studios has returned to theaters with Avengers: Endgame Encore, an extended re-release featuring four minutes of brand-new footage designed to set up Avengers: Doomsday. The theatrical cut introduces four fresh scenes shot directly during the production of the upcoming ensemble film.The new additions begin with Tom Hiddleston’s Loki visiting Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter following their time-travel reunion, addressing the multiversal instabilities caused by Rogers' timeline jump. A secondary scene set inside the Time Variance Authority features Mobius, Casey, Ouroboros, and Miss Minutes observing alternate Earths colliding in real time, signaling a widespread collapse of the multiverse.A post-credits sequence picks up after the events of Spider-Man: Brand New Day, depicting Bruce Banner attempting to create a Hulk-suppression serum in an underground bunker before being confronted by Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom. Finally, a closing tag recontextualizes the original 2019 film’s iconic Iron Man armor-forging audio, revealing Doctor Doom crafting his own metal mask.Avengers: Endgame Encore is currently playing in theaters, leading up to the theatrical premiere of Avengers: Doomsday on December 18. items.title: Formula 1 Is Planning a Return to V8 Engines for the 2030 Season With Over 1,000 HP
items.text: Formula 1 Is Planning a Return to V8 Engines for the 2030 Season With Over 1,000 HP Summary Formula 1 is preparing to mandate three-liter turbocharged V8 engines for the 2030 season following a near-unanimous driver revoltThe new rules aim to cut 110 pounds from the power units while pushing total output past the 1,000 horsepower markThe smaller turbocharger doubles as an improvised muffler to satisfy strict noise limits at modern street circuits Formula 1 is orchestrating a course correction for the 2030 season, preparing to mandate three-liter turbocharged V8 engines in response to grid pushback. The decision arrives on the heels of a near-unanimous revolt from drivers regarding the sport's upcoming 2026 power unit regulations. This pivot rewires the championship's trajectory, stepping away from the 2026 engine framework that previously attracted Audi, Cadillac and Ford to join the world championship paddock. By overhauling the blueprint just as new manufacturers enter the fold, the series chooses to prioritize driver satisfaction and vehicle weight reduction over the stability of its upcoming hybrid era.At the core of this 2030 regulation shift is a weight reduction goal. Formula 1 hopes to cut 110 pounds from the combined power unit, directly addressing the weight of the 2026 powerplants which are saddled with a set minimum weight limit of 407 pounds. The 2030 engine regulations retain a degree of electrification, utilizing a smaller battery paired with a 134 horsepower electric motor.The return of the eight-cylinder configuration taps into motorsport history while deploying modern force. Formula 1 last mandated V8 engines from 2006 until 2013, utilizing naturally aspirated powerplants that produced over 750 horsepower before they were retired. Now, the 2030 specifications allow manufacturers to eclipse the 1,000 horsepower mark by combining a turbocharger with 17 years of technical knowledge. To further utilize this output, Formula 1 also debates whether to introduce an IndyCar-style push-to-pass system for the 2030 season.Achieving this power curve requires navigating strict environmental boundaries. The 2030 turbocharger is smaller than the current forced-induction setup, and its inclusion is a compromise to serve as an improvised muffler. This design workaround directly meets the noise restrictions posed by modern street circuits, reflecting the sport's ongoing struggle to balance engine noise with the strict decibel limits of its evolving calendar

items.text: Everything Coming To HBO Max in October 2026 Summary Dominic West and Sienna Miller star in 'War,' an HBO/Sky legal drama set among London's most powerful law firms'The Housemaid,' 'The Death of Robin Hood' and 'The Invite' make their streaming debuts across the monthThe October 1 catalog drop brings the full 'A Nightmare on Elm Street' run, 'The Shining' and 'The Exorcist' just in time for Halloween HBO Max's October 2026 lineup opens with War, the HBO/Sky legal drama starring Dominic West and Sienna Miller that premieres October 1. items.title: Akaku x UNDER R's ‘Youth Knows No Boundaries’ Exhibition Brings Five Illustrators to Tokyo
items.text: Akaku x UNDER R's ‘Youth Knows No Boundaries’ Exhibition Brings Five Illustrators to Tokyo Summary Five illustrators from ASOBISYSTEM's creator label Akaku are showing and selling original work at UNDER R TokyoEach artist designed an exclusive graphic T-shirt for the exhibition, offered in white and blackThe show frames its lineup of retro-leaning and manga-rooted styles as a meeting point for art, fashion and Harajuku culture Akaku and UNDER R are teaming up on "Youth Knows No Boundaries," an art exhibition running at UNDER R Tokyo from October 9 to October 22. The show brings together five illustrators from Akaku, the creator label run by Japanese culture production company ASOBISYSTEM. Each artist is showing original work for sale alongside a limited T-shirt made for the exhibition.The merchandise mirrors the lineup. There are five T-shirts, one per artist, each available in white or black. In the product images, each artist's work is printed in monochrome on the chest, with the black-and-white treatment tying five very different styles together. The shirts were made specifically for the show and join the artists' original pieces on sale at the venue.The illustrators share a sense of nostalgia, and each takes it somewhere different. Kayoubi mixes a contemporary edge with the look of 1980s and 1990s illustration, a "new retro" style that has led to apparel collaborations and CD cover commissions. Natsumi Sato works in saturated, 1990s-inspired pop colors and is best known for "peloringirl," her ongoing series built around a girl sticking out her tongue. The series was collected in her first book, THE VISUAL Natsumi Sato Art Book PELORINGIRL, in June 2024. Her client work includes corporate advertising, album art, merchandise and animated music videos.The other three push in their own directions. NAKAKI PANTZ has built a following for her portraits of women who come across as strong, cute and self-assured, and her work appears across fashion campaigns, advertising and music video design. Illustrator and manga artist Chiaki Harada turns the gloomy, pent-up feelings everyone carries into brightly colored work that swings between horror, retro and celebratory imagery. She bills herself as an insult-maker for well-behaved kids, and her career spans exhibitions in Japan and abroad, collaboration cafés, apparel and even film appearances. Natsumi Yoshida rounds out the group with gentle, peaceful work in a nostalgic palette, with credits in corporate advertising

items.title: HUF x Toyota Land Cruiser's Second Collection Pulls From Vintage Vehicle Catalogs
items.text: HUF x Toyota Land Cruiser's Second Collection Pulls From Vintage Vehicle Catalogs Summary HUF and Toyota are returning with a second Land Cruiser collaboration The designs rework classic typography, graphics and archival details from old Land Cruiser catalogsThe range covers outerwear, screen-printed T-shirts, embroidered caps, skate decks and custom air fresheners HUF and Toyota are back with a second HUF x Toyota Land Cruiser collection. This time, the focus is on the Land Cruiser's heritage models, the rugged vehicles that carried drivers on expeditions around the world. The collection's graphic language is taken directly from the pages of vintage Toyota sales catalogs.The catalogs supply the design. Rather than just reproducing the Land Cruiser badge, HUF went through the archive for the type, illustrations and small print details used to sell the truck in earlier decades, then reworked them through its own streetwear lens. The result puts vintage automotive marketing on skate-ready basics.The apparel does most of the work. Jackets and hoodies cover the heavier end of the range, while five screen-printed T-shirts spread the catalog-inspired artwork across the collection's lightest pieces. Screen printing suits the source material, keeping the flat, bold look of the original print ads.The accessories take the collaboration beyond clothing. Caps feature custom embroidery, and the skate decks bring the Land Cruiser graphics onto HUF's home turf. The oddest item is also the most on-theme: a set of original air fresheners, a nod to the truck's cabin that also works as a small collectible. According to the source, the full lineup includes a few more items beyond these.The HUF x Toyota Land Cruiser collection releases on September 25 at HUF stores and via HUF's online store. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The ‘GTA VI’ Collector's Box Comes With a Gator, Oakleys and a Razor Blade Keychain
items.text: The ‘GTA VI’ Collector's Box Comes With a Gator, Oakleys and a Razor Blade Keychain Summary Rockstar Games has opened pre-orders for The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, a limited-edition GTA VI Collector's BoxThe set centers on a six-inch Macca the Gator figure, GTA VI-branded Oakley Frogskins and a New Era snapbackSmaller Vice City keepsakes, from a razor blade keychain to a manatee shot glass, round out the box Rockstar Games has opened pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, a limited-edition Collector's Box that arrives on November 19. The 11-piece set is themed around Macca the Gator, a hit TV show within the game's fictional state of Leonida. It is available only while supplies last.The centerpiece is Macca himself. A six-inch figure of the gator mascot comes with a hidden stash compartment, an early sign that the box leans into Vice City's seedier side. He also appears on a magnetic mirror, and his wetland co-star is on a Chunkee the Manatee shot glass.The wearables come from real-world partners. Oakley contributes a pair of matte black Frogskins with GTA VI branding and Prizm Sapphire lenses, a blue-mirrored finish suited to the Leonida sun. New Era supplies a 9FORTY A-Frame snapback decorated with Vice City and Leonida details. A Leonida Keys crossbody bag completes the carry-ready pieces.The rest of the box is full of small souvenirs. There's a Vice City swizzle spoon, a Vice City razor blade keychain and a Leonida Keys enamel pin set packed in a custom metal tin. There are also premium stickers that come in their own stash bag. A double-sided poster maps out the full Leonida landscape, giving players a preview of the state before they set foot in it.Rockstar is selling the Collector's Box as a limited edition that is available only until stock runs out, and GTA VI itself is not included. Pre-order details for Asia, Latin America and Australia have yet to be announced. Rockstar has also said that more GTA VI apparel and collectibles are on the way.Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection is available to pre-order now via the Rockstar Store while supplies last, and it arrives on November 19. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Action Bronson and New Balance Expand the 2811 Lineup With "Blackjacques" and "The Whisperer" Summary ction Bronson and New Balance are releasing two new colorways of the 2811 silhouette titled Blackjacques and The WhispererThe signature model combines an original upper with the sole unit from the New Balance 2010Both iterations release on September 25 exclusively through Action Bronson's webstore Action Bronson and New Balance have officially announced two new colorways of the New Balance 2811, dubbed "Blackjacques" and "The Whisperer." The dual drop expands the rapper's signature silhouette following its debut earlier this year.Serving as Bronson’s first signature model with the brand, the 2811 pairs an original upper construction with the existing sole unit of the New Balance 2010. The "Blackjacques" iteration adopts a dark palette—first spotted when Bronson wore them courtside ahead of the model's official announcement—while "The Whisperer" provides a contrasting look with a white and black base. Both pairs incorporate subtle red and blue accents to maintain the artist's Baklava design identity.The launch of "The Whisperer" comes after Bronson addressed social media reports regarding leaked inventory, noting that stolen pairs had entered the supply chain and appeared on resale platforms below retail. Despite the distribution issue, both models are scheduled for an official release.The Action Bronson x New Balance 2811 “Blackjacques” and “The Whisperer” release on September 25, 2026, exclusively via online. The limited capsule reimagines three statement eyewear silhouettes through distinct custom colorways and technical lens treatments.Redesigned by Scott, the launch introduces custom iterations of the Plantaris, Straight Jacket® 99, and Eye Jacket® Redux. Each model is rendered in either "CJ Matte Mesquite" or "CJ Black Ink" finishes, equipped with Prizm™ Snow Black lenses to maximize color contrast and clarity. Every pair is packaged in custom Cactus Jack micro bags and co-branded boxes.For the launch campaign, Scott enlisted director Nicolas Winding Refn to helm the visual project, which stars Team Oakley athlete Justin Jefferson.The Cactus Jack x Oakley Chapter 001 collection releases September 24, 2026, via Travis Scott, followed by an online drop via Oakley on September 25. items.text: Brandon Sklenar Goes Full Action Hero in Official Trailer for Western Thriller 'The Rescue' Summary Paramount has released the official first trailer for modern Western thriller 'The Rescue'Brandon Sklenar plays a former rodeo star who embarks on a dangerous retrieval mission after his daughter is kidnapped for a 45 million USD ransomThe action-heavy revenge flick hits theaters on January 29 2027 Paramount has unveiled the first official trailer for The Rescue, an upcoming modern Western thriller starring Brandon Sklenar. The high-stakes action thriller feature combines the rugged countryside aesthetic of Yellowstone with the visceral revenge elements of John Wick.The narrative centers on Jamie Lee (Sklenar), a former rodeo cowboy forced to take matters into his own hands when his daughter is abducted and held for a $45 million USD ransom. After a sinister caller targets his ex-wife, country music star Kaley Tucker (Hassie Harrison), with a 48-hour deadline, Jamie realizes local law enforcement is ill-equipped to act.Accompanied by the family's loyal dog, Jamie sets out into a treacherous mountain zone known as "no man's land" to hunt down the captors. The teaser showcases a dark, relentless turn for Sklenar as he uses his horseman skills and survivalist instincts to wage war against a wide-reaching criminal syndicate.The Rescue arrives in theaters on January 29, 2027. items.text: Nike Pays Homage to NYC Culture With the Air Force 1 Low ’01 "Subway Rat" Summary Nike is releasing an Air Force 1 Low ’01 inspired by New York City’s iconic subway ratThe sneaker features College Grey shaggy suede uppers accented by Pink Glaze detailing and a rat tail heel extensionKey thematic details include pizza slice insoles a MetroCard hangtag and custom NYC tongue embroidery Name: Nike Air Force 1 '01 "Subway Rat"Colorway: College Grey/Pink GlazeSKU: IV6999-001MSRP: $150 USDRelease Date: October 7, 2026Where to Buy: NikeNike is celebrating an iconic fixture of New York City grit with the Air Force 1 Low ’01 "Subway Rat". The upcoming release transforms the classic silhouette with thematic details nodding to the metropolis, complete with pizza graphics and transit-inspired hardware. Dressed in a "College Grey" and "Pink Glaze" colorway, the upper is constructed from tactile shaggy suede across the toe boxes, quarter panels, Swooshes, and tongue. Soft pink accents frame the Swoosh branding, midsole, and translucent rubber outsole, while a thin pink strip extends from the back of the heel to mimic a rat tail.Nodding directly to NYC subculture, the back of the tongue features embroidered "NYC" lettering intersected by a small Swoosh, while placing the insoles side by side forms a full slice of pizza. Rounding out the pair is a yellow MetroCard-inspired hangtag with a bold blue Swoosh alongside an extra set of pink replacement laces.The Nike Air Force 1 Low ’01 "Subway Rat" drops on October 7, 2026. items.title: The Pokémon Company and European Space Agency Unveil World Space Week Collection
items.text: The Pokémon Company and European Space Agency Unveil World Space Week Collection Summary The Pokémon Company and the European Space Agency have teamed up for a cosmic collaboration launching for World Space Week on October 4The product lineup highlights ESA astronaut-outfitted Pikachu plushies alongside flight-inspired outerwear TCG accessories and graphic apparelThe physical release coincides with educational exhibitions across European science museums and in-game events in Pokémon GO The Pokémon Company International and the European Space Agency (ESA) have officially revealed the Pokémon x ESA World Space Week Collection. Launching in celebration of World Space Week on October 4, 2026, the partnership shines a light on European space exploration through a limited merchandise rollout and international museum exhibitions.The physical collection is anchored by two Pikachu plushies dressed in official ESA astronaut suits, modeled after the plush brought aboard the International Space Station by French astronaut Sophie Adenot. Apparel and accessory offerings include a flight-inspired bomber jacket alongside custom Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) deck accessories featuring ESA-themed artwork.In tandem with the Pokémon Center drop, the ESA online store will release a dedicated line of Pikachu-themed space gear. The secondary range comprises graphic T-shirts, a multi-use tote bag, stationary notepads, and collectible enamel pins. The merchandise launches alongside interactive pop-up exhibitions across ESA facilities and major European museums, as well as themed digital content in Pokémon GO.The Pokémon x ESA collection releases on October 4, 2026, via Pokemon Center and the official ESA online store. items.title: The URBAN RESEARCH DOORS x New Era 9THIRTY Is All About the Corduroy
items.text: The URBAN RESEARCH DOORS x New Era 9THIRTY Is All About the Corduroy Summary New Era and URBAN RESEARCH DOORS have rebuilt the 9THIRTY in fine-wale cotton corduroy with a subtle lusterThe low-profile crown and curved visor keep the silhouette clean enough for everyday wearThe cap comes in three seasonal colorways as the latest entry in DOORS' recurring New Era exclusive series New Era and URBAN RESEARCH DOORS have teamed up on an exclusive 9THIRTY cap for Fall/Winter 2026, trading the usual cotton twill for fine-wale corduroy. It is the newest release in a New Era exclusive line that the Japanese label brings back each season, and this one leans on fabric and texture rather than graphics.The material carries the design. The crown and visor are made from 100 percent cotton corduroy with a tight, narrow wale, so the ribbing sits flat and reads closer to a refined texture than a rugged one. The pile has a soft sheen that catches the light, which gives the cap more depth than a matte fabric and more warmth for colder months. The embroidery uses polyester thread.Underneath is the 9THIRTY, New Era's unstructured-feel dad cap block. The DOORS version keeps its shallow crown and pre-curved brim, a lower, rounder shape that sits closer to the head than New Era's taller fitted profiles. The pattern is the familiar one. The fabric is what changes the character of the cap.The cap comes in one size, fitting head circumferences from 55 to 58 centimeters, with a 14-centimeter crown height and a seven-centimeter brim. The three colorways are black, brown and navy, all muted tones that suit the seasonal fabric and work equally well with casual layers or tailored outerwear.The New Era x URBAN RESEARCH DOORS 9THIRTY Corduroy is available to pre-order now via the URBAN RESEARCH online store, with delivery scheduled for early October 2026. items.title: The LOEWE Double L Loafer Makes Its Logo Part of the Leather
items.text: The LOEWE Double L Loafer Makes Its Logo Part of the Leather Name: LOEWE Double L LoaferColorway: Black, Dark Chocolate, Deep Purple, Caramel LatteSKU: LOVL290X03-1100, LOVL290X02-9517, LOVL290X02-6417, LOVL290X02-0315MSRP: $1,150 USDRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: LOEWEThe LOEWE Double L Loafer is built around softness. Its supple leather is gathered at the upper and shaped around a rounded toe, so it looks closer to a relaxed slip-on than to a stiff, structured loafer. The women's style is available in suede calfskin and soft calfskin, and every version carries the same construction details.The gathered construction defines the shoe. Rather than stretching a flat panel over a hard last, LOEWE gathers the leather across the upper, which gives the loafer soft folds and a flexible feel. The rounded toe continues that approach, avoiding the sharper profile of a traditional penny or horsebit loafer.The branding is applied in an unusual way. Instead of a metal bit or a stitched emblem, LOEWE applies its Double L signature to the upper using a high-frequency process. That keeps the logo flush with the leather and puts the focus on the material and silhouette, not on hardware.Inside and underneath, the loafer is built for comfort. A padded insole sits beneath the foot, and the shoe is fully lined in nappa leather, which is noticeably soft against the skin. The leather outsole includes a rubber island, a section of rubber set into the sole that adds grip without giving up a clean leather base. A low 10-millimeter heel keeps the profile close to the ground.The colorways split by leather. Three versions use suede calfskin: a deep Dark Chocolate, a rich Deep Purple, and a warm Caramel Latte. The fourth comes in smooth, soft calfskin in Black, the most versatile option in the range. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Glenn Martens Presents Final Diesel Show & Donatella Versace Builds New Brand in This Week's Top Fashion News SummaryDonatella Versace joins Revolve for a 2027 brand launch; Glenn Martens leaves Diesel following his SS27 show.Jacquemus opens a Miami flagship; Dior schedules its Cruise 2028 runway for Shanghai.Nike unveils its NYC design archive; Teyana Taylor stars in Calvin Klein’s Fall campaign.Glenn Marten's Diesel SS27 Collection Was a Party About PleasureGlenn Martens concluded his transformative six-year tenure at Diesel with a spectacular send-off for the Spring/Summer 2027 season. Announced just days before the event, his departure marked the end of an era that reinvigorated the Italian denim label. Martens ensured his final runway was a memorable celebration, opening the club-inspired venue with a sensual performance art piece by the Marseille collective (LA)HORDE. The hefty 90-look collection delivered the quintessential Diesel ethos: disruptive, fluid, and fun. Highlights included inventive hybrid garments like "pantasocks," trompe l’oeil outerwear, and denim laser-cut to mimic leather. Softening the industrial edge, recurring orchid-shaped cutaways added an organic touch to the distressed fabrics. Martens’s final bow leaves behind a lasting legacy of inclusivity and pop-cultural relevance.Dontella Versace Is Launching a New BrandFollowing her departure as Chief Creative Officer of Versace in 2025, Donatella Versace is preparing her next major industry move. The Italian designer is partnering with retail giant Revolve Group to launch a brand-new fashion and beauty label in 2027. The yet-to-be-named venture aims to combine Versace's creative authority with Revolve’s expansive technological infrastructure and global reach. Revolve, which reported $1.23 billion in revenue last year, offers a massive platform for the designer to build something from scratch. Versace noted that the collaboration is rooted in a shared belief that culture stems from connection, promising a fresh voice, look, and energy. The announcement arrives in the wake of Capri Holdings’ recent $1 billion sale of Versace to the Prada Group.Dior Is Heading To Shanghai For Its Cruise 2028 ShowDior is already mapping out its long-term runway calendar, announcing that its Cruise 2028 collection will be presented in Shanghai on May 14, 2027.
