items.title: HUF and TAION Reunite for a Packable FW26 Down Capsule
items.text: HUF and TAION Reunite for a Packable FW26 Down Capsule Summary HUF reunites with TAION for its second collaborative capsule.Lightweight quilted down jackets arrive in icy blue, pink and black.Packable construction and co-branded details combine TAION functionality with HUF streetwear. San Francisco-founded skate label HUF has teamed up with Japanese inner-down specialist TAION for a collaborative Fall/Winter 2026 capsule that fuses streetwise utility with lightweight thermal functionality. Known for its high-quality, cost-effective down gear, TAION lends its technical expertise to HUF’s signature skatewear aesthetic, creating a range tailored for cold-weather urban environments. The joint delivery emphasizes clean, functional layering pieces engineered with packable designs and durable water-repellent fabrics, allowing wearers to seamlessly adapt to shifting seasonal temperatures.The capsule highlights lightweight down jackets and functional vests decorated with subtle co-branding, including HUF's classic typography set alongside TAION's minimalist branding. Available in versatile monochromatic colorways such as classic black, the collection balances TAION’s signature square-quilted down patterns with HUF’s relaxed touch. The HUF x TAION FW26 capsule is scheduled to launch on October 2, 2026, with availability through HUF and select retailers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Could Get a Theatrical Re-Release With New Footage and Deleted Cameos
items.text: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Could Get a Theatrical Re-Release With New Footage and Deleted Cameos Summary Sony is preparing an updated theatrical re-release of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' featuring unseen footageThe new version potentially restores deleted cameo scenes of Rosario Dawson as Claire Temple while delivering surprisesA successful run positions the property to close a $50 million USD gap and become the first movie to cross $1 billion USD domestically A theatrical re-release for the blockbuster Spider-Man: Brand New Day could be on the way, according to a report by Anthony D'Alessandro for Deadline. The studio has not yet announced a premiere date for the updated version which is confirmed to feature previously unseen footage. This record-breaking title initially debuted on July 31 and returns to cinemas with fresh material to continue its theatrical run.The updated version potentially restores deleted cameo scenes featuring Rosario Dawson as Claire Temple. New theatrical material could include additional surprises for fans beyond the reintegration of Dawson. Tom Holland and Zendaya lead an ensemble cast that includes Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Tramell Tillman, Michael Mando and Mark Ruffalo.Director Destin Daniel Cretton helmed Spider-Man: Brand New Day which follows Peter Parker as he fights crime in a world that no longer remembers him. An isolated vigilante faces a powerful and invisible new villain throughout the narrative. Kevin Feige, Amy Pascal, Avi Arad and Rachel O'Connor produced the project. Executive producers Louis D'Esposito and David Cain round out the leadership team for the picture.Already the highest-grossing film in US domestic history, the movie nears an unprecedented financial achievement. Statistics from September 28 show the picture sits approximately $50 million USD away from becoming the first film to gross $1 billion solely within the United States. Sony is using the expanded cut of Spider-Man: Brand New Day as a strategic vehicle to reignite ticket sales and close this final monetary gap. Releasing new footage allows the studio to leverage audience curiosity to cross an untouched domestic threshold. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Closer Look at the MM6 Maison Margiela x Havaianas SS27 Collaboration
items.text: Closer Look at the MM6 Maison Margiela x Havaianas SS27 Collaboration Summary MM6 Maison Margiela previews its first Havaianas collaboration for SS27.The Slim 6Toe adds an exaggerated sixth toe in Black and White.A six-layer multicolored platform version appeared exclusively on the runway. MM6 Maison Margiela previewed its first collaboration with Havaianas at its Spring/Summer 2027 runway presentation in Milan, applying its signature fixation with the number six to the Brazilian brand’s instantly recognizable rubber flip-flop.The collaboration takes shape through two uniquely modified designs: the Slim 6Toe and the Top 6Layers. The Top 6Layers, pushes the idea into more sculptural territory by stacking six differently shaped Havaianas soles into an intentionally irregular platform. Runway imagery shows a white strap and uppermost footbed sitting over a vivid sequence of multicolored rubber layers, with flashes of red, green, blue and violet creating a striped, almost compressed-rainbow effect beneath the foot. Despite its exaggerated height, each layer preserves the molded texture and recognizable outline of a conventional Havaianas sole, turning repetition itself into the design feature.Meanwhile, the Slim 6Toe alters the classic rubber model to echo the anatomical outline of a bare foot, deliberately punching an extra toe slot into the silhouette to accommodate a literal sixth toe. The Top 6Layers was created exclusively for the runway and will not be offered commercially, while the broader MM6 Maison Margiela x Havaianas collaboration is scheduled to launch in May 2027. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Sony Is Skipping CES 2027 for the First Time in Over Six Decades
items.text: Sony Is Skipping CES 2027 for the First Time in Over Six Decades Summary Sony officially skips the 2027 Consumer Electronics Show to end a 60-year run at the trade eventThe exit highlights a corporate pivot away from traditional consumer hardware toward entertainment, anime and gaming ecosystemsFuture hardware milestones including a potential PlayStation 6 reveal will bypass the January convention After six decades of anchoring the floor at the US-based Consumer Electronics Show, Sony is officially stepping away. Nikkei first reported that the cultural heavyweight will skip the January 2027 edition of CES entirely. The withdrawal means that neither the primary brand nor any affiliated companies plan to display products at the upcoming trade show. It firmly closes the book on an era of massive tech presentations. Furthermore, the company will not hold its traditional press conference at the 2027 event. Such a move fundamentally reshapes the landscape of the tech calendar's biggest kickoff.The departure represents a calculated evolution of the brand's core identity rather than a sudden exit. In a statement provided to Bloomberg, the company noted that it evaluates its approach to events strategically based on evolving business priorities. This CES exit marks the culmination of a broader corporate pivot for Sony away from legacy consumer electronics hardware. Corporate strategy shifts toward a sprawling ecosystem built on entertainment media and intellectual property. Moving forward, the powerhouse is placing a much greater emphasis on its dedicated entertainment divisions. It is channeling resources into the massive cultural realms of games, anime, films and music. Alongside this push, the company is increasing its focus on intellectual property and developing technology designed to support creators.Signs of this operational shift were visible on the convention floor last year. Sony did not have its own dedicated booth at the CES 2026 event. Instead, its presence was largely limited to showcasing a prototype of the Afeela electric vehicle. High-profile collaboration with Honda defined the project. The automotive ambition proved short-lived as Sony Honda Mobility officially scrapped the Afeela electric vehicle project just a couple of months after the 2026 trade show wrapped. items.title: Lexus Is Selling Its 67-Foot USD LY 680 Luxury Yacht Internationally for the First Time
items.text: Lexus Is Selling Its 67-Foot USD LY 680 Luxury Yacht Internationally for the First Time Summary Lexus is expanding sales of its 68-foot luxury yacht to international markets starting in SeptemberThe vessel will make its official overseas debut at the Fort Lauderdale International Boat ShowBuilt by Taiwan's Horizon Group, the $5 million yacht produces up to 2,000 combined horsepower Lexus is taking its marine ambitions global. After restricting orders to the Japanese domestic market through Toyota Marine sales offices in March 2024, the automaker expands international sales of the Lexus LY 680 luxury yacht starting in September. The craft makes its first major public appearance in overseas markets at the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show, which runs from October 28 through November 1. Such an expansion indicates that the manufacturer seeks to capture high-end marine market share in regions where its automotive presence is already established. Moving into international waters allows the brand to translate its design language from the asphalt to the open ocean.Serving as a direct evolution of the LY 650, which marked the first foray into production yachts, the Lexus LY 680 scales up the physical footprint and onboard amenities. This vessel commands the water with a massive frame that measures 67.7 feet long and stretches 18.9 feet wide. Lexus handles both the exterior design and the curated onboard experience, focusing architectural upgrades on luxury leisure. Upper flybridge space was extended by 4.6 feet compared to the preceding LY 650, carving out room for a lounge sofa and a barbecue grill. Down at the water line, the rear swimming platform was also lengthened by 2.3 feet.Below the deck, the yacht features three distinct cabins designed to accommodate six overnight guests, while the vessel carries a total maximum passenger capacity of 15 people. Directing that weight requires heavy duty marine engineering, and power comes from a pair of Volvo Penta IPS engines. Buyers can configure the yacht with either IPS 1350 or IPS 1050 units. Choosing the Volvo Penta IPS 1050 configuration delivers 800 hp per engine for a combined output of 1,600 hp. For those needing maximum thrust, the Volvo Penta IPS 1350 engines produce 1,000 hp each, pushing the vessel to a combined 2,000 hp. items.title: Bose Launches Its First Wired Earbuds Since 2015 With Active Noise Cancellation for $99 USD
items.text: Bose Launches Its First Wired Earbuds Since 2015 With Active Noise Cancellation for $99 USD Summary Bose returns to wired audio for the first time since 2015 with the $99 Noise Cancelling Wired EarbudsThe plug-and-play USB-C release leverages proprietary QuietControl active noise cancellation without requiring batteries or appsPreorders are open now, with official shipping set to commence on October 15, 2026 Nostalgia remains an undefeated marketing engine, and the physical tether of the headphone cord is officially back in the cultural rotation. On September 28, the audio heavyweights at Bose announced the launch of the Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds and slapped a $99 USD price tag on their latest hardware. The drop marks a major functional shift for the brand, arriving as the first new wired headphones released by Bose since 2015. This pivot back to wired roots operates as a direct response to a massive consumer shift driven largely by teenagers and celebrities. Wired headphone sales experienced a notable 10 percent spike in the back half of 2025, surging even further to a 20 percent increase at the start of 2026. That aggressive upward trajectory prompted Bose president of consumer audio Raza Haider to capitalize on the trend after he personally observed the widespread use of wired earbuds among college students, effectively reviving a dormant product category to meet surging youth demand.Haider pushed the internal development pipeline into overdrive to catch the wave before the demographic moved on. He stated that the new product took approximately eight to nine months to develop from an initial idea to the final product. Hardware in the resulting Bose Noise Cancelling Wired Earbuds release intentionally rejects the modern headaches of wireless ecosystems. These earbuds connect to devices using a plug-and-play USB-C cable to bypass pairing friction entirely. Corded setup allows the device to operate completely without a battery to charge, an app to download or a Bluetooth connection to maintain. Proprietary QuietControl active noise cancellation technology provides the core draw by piping isolation through the wire instead of relying on app-based menus.Physical design choices for the release lean heavily into utilitarian aesthetics, though they introduce some inherent drawbacks unique to the tethered format. The earbuds are operated via an inline central control panel that includes buttons for volume up, volume down and a switch for play, pause an

items.title: Birkenstock Taps Cole Bennett to Reimagine the Boston Clog in Wool Felt
items.text: Birkenstock Taps Cole Bennett to Reimagine the Boston Clog in Wool Felt Name: Birkenstock x Cole Bennett Boston Wooly Moon BuckleColorway: WhiteSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: October 1Where to Buy: Cole Bennett, 1774Reconnecting a relationship that spans nearly a decade, Birkenstock has teamed up with filmmaker and creative director Cole Bennett to reimagine the iconic Boston clog. Launching in celebration of the silhouette’s 50th anniversary, the collaboration honors the original 1976 design while injecting Bennett's personal narrative and cultural influence.The collaboration reworks the clog in a single off-white colorway built around an intentionally tactile wool-felt upper. The material varies in length, density and tone across the shoe, creating an irregular, shaggy surface that gives the familiar semi-closed silhouette a softer and more sculptural appearance. Bennett encourages wearers to trim the wool themselves and allow the pale finish to pick up dirt and wear over time, turning the otherwise neutral color into a surface intended to develop individual character.Inside, a soft microfiber lining ensures everyday comfort. Anchoring the design's themes of imagination and permanence is a custom crescent "Moon Buckle," cast in a striking antique dark copper finish. This bespoke hardware not only serves as a symbolic constant against the evolving wool exterior, but also playfully pays homage to Bennett's own dog, culminating in a fresh, texture-heavy interpretation of the enduring classic. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Cole Bennett (@colebennett) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: BLACKPINK's JISOO Stars in Debut Salomon Campaign
items.text: BLACKPINK's JISOO Stars in Debut Salomon Campaign Summary BLACKPINK member JISOO stars in her first official campaign as Salomon's global brand ambassadorTitled In The Open the campaign explores winter landscapes across Seoul through the brand's Fall/Winter 2026 collectionFeatured footwear models include the XT-6 Protective XT-Whisper Gore-Tex and XT-4 OG Gore-Tex Salomon has officially launched its first global campaign starring BLACKPINK member JISOO, following her appointment as global brand ambassador in May. The "In The Open" campaign highlights the French sports brand's FW26 footwear collection set against the backdrop of South Korea.Shot across parks, trails, and quiet urban corners in Seoul, the visual narrative was crafted under creative director Heikki Salonen to illustrate how the collection performs across shifting environments. Throughout the campaign, JISOO models key new silhouettes from the FW26 lineup, including the XT-6 Protective, the XT-Whisper Gore-Tex, and the XT-4 OG Gore-Tex.Reflecting on her partnership with the brand and the new collection, Jisoo shared her personal connection to the footwear, "I naturally prefer light and comfortable movement in my everyday life, so I feel that Salomon is a great fit for me because it provides comfort regardless of the weather or environment," she stated. "I love how versatile Salomon footwear is, making it suitable for both everyday wear and outdoor activities."The Salomon FW26 footwear collection featured in the campaign is rolling out globally for the current season via Salomon and select retailers. The capsule launches globally on October 7 via the Salomon website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Alfa Romeo's One-Off 33 Stradale Perla Nera Is an All-Black Carbon Fiber Statement From Bottegafuoriserie
items.text: Alfa Romeo's One-Off 33 Stradale Perla Nera Is an All-Black Carbon Fiber Statement From Bottegafuoriserie Summary Alfa Romeo reveals the 2026 33 Stradale Perla Nera as a bespoke and blacked-out iteration of its ultra-limited supercarThe one-off build features hand-laid matte carbon fiber bodywork and an interior tailored to the owner's exact physical requirementsA 620-horsepower twin-turbo V6 powers the vehicle which remains on display at the Museo Alfa Romeo before customer delivery Alfa Romeo unveiled a one-of-one specification of its flagship supercar, the 2026 Alfa Romeo 33 Stradale Perla Nera. The Bottegafuoriserie division produced the custom build to showcase a monochromatic aesthetic. Every car in the 33-unit production run is already sold despite a starting price exceeding $2 million. This demand highlights a market interest in highly personalized vehicles commissioned through bespoke programs. An unnamed collector drove the creative vision for this specific build and selected the Perla Nera name to cement its identity.The exterior of the supercar features a matte black finish over exposed carbon fiber bodywork. Technicians laid the carbon fiber by hand inside the mold to ensure the weave followed the aerodynamic contours of the vehicle. Custom black three-spoke alloy wheels and matching black byte calipers round out the styling. Beneath the skin, the Perla Nera utilizes a carbon fiber monocoque and H-frame aluminum chassis to provide a rigid foundation for the road.A traditional combustion powerplant sits at the heart of this dark build. The twin-turbo V6 engine powers the car and produces 620 horsepower. All power travels to the rear wheels through an eight-speed dual-clutch gearbox. This configuration carries significance because while an electric option was announced for the series, no buyers have ordered an EV version yet. Client preference for the V6 engine suggests that high-end collectors still prioritize gas-powered performance for personalized vehicles.The customized interior follows the blacked-out theme by combining exposed carbon fiber with Alcantara upholstery. This cabin is built entirely around the driver and features sports seats redesigned to fit the specific physical requirements of the owner. Custom elements include a classic cannelloni pattern on the door cards and sills. items.title: ABOVE THE CLOUDS x ASICS Weave the GEL-SD-LYTE in Tonal "Black/Gunmetal"
items.text: ABOVE THE CLOUDS x ASICS Weave the GEL-SD-LYTE in Tonal "Black/Gunmetal" Name: ABOVE THE CLOUDS x ASICS GEL-SD-LYTEColorway: Black / GunmetalSKU: 1203B090.001MSRP: $300 AUD (approx. $210 USD)Release Date: Available now (Australia), October 3 (Global)Where to Buy: ABOVE THE CLOUDS, ASICS AU, KITHASICS SportStyle and ABOVE THE CLOUDS have unveiled their collaborative GEL-SD-LYTE, a tonal version of the silhouette defined by a finely woven upper. The Australian fashion retailer took its cue from Japanese design principles, where shape, purpose and material are treated as one decision, and used weaving as the organizing idea for the entire shoe.The upper is the main story. Instead of relying on panels and color blocking, the pair uses a dense woven construction that serves as both structure and surface, giving the GEL-SD-LYTE a crafted, tactile finish. The choice reflects weaving's history as a skill passed from maker to maker and place to place, and the upper acts as a quiet tribute to the craft and design communities that have kept it alive.Color is kept to a minimum so the texture stands out. The Black/Gunmetal palette runs almost fully tonal, with the gunmetal tones catching light along the weave and trim. In the campaign imagery, the black ASICS stripes sit as molded overlays across the woven base, and a matching black midsole and outsole anchor the shoe. The result is a clean, restrained silhouette that lets the construction do the talking. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: LISA Doesn't Have to Choose
items.text: LISA Doesn't Have to Choose Wherever LISA travels, whether it's a stadium on another continent, a fashion week front row, or a hotel suite she'll leave by morning, one thing always comes with her. It isn't a jewel or a lucky charm. It's a pair of slippers. "I bring them everywhere with me whenever I travel and they are so cozy and make me feel more at home," she says.It's a concise explanation, and an unexpectedly tender detail from someone who spends most of her working life being looked at. The LISA most of the world knows is the one onstage: exact, electric, one of the most recognized performers in pop. But the person carrying slippers from city to city points to another LISA — the one who looks for home wherever she lands. That tension between the star and the homebody is what drives her newest project as creative director: Meta Glasses by LISA. The collection comes in two frames, each representing the two sides to her. The Adventurer, with Blush lenses, is for the LISA who takes her time. The Capri, a sharp cat-eye, is for the LISA who walks onstage.She's never pretended there's only one of her. When she stepped out on her own with her dynamic debut solo album, she gave the world five different personas. Each one was a different character, and each was her. The symbol she chose for that idea was a five-pointed star, and it came up in the very first design meetings for the glasses. Now it sits on the temple tips and the case."I don’t think you have to pick just one version of yourself, so the star became my way of saying all of them can exist at once.""The star was from my first solo album, Alter Ego. The five points represent five different characters of this album," LISA shares. "I don't think you have to pick just one version of yourself, so the star became my way of saying all of them can exist at once. Putting it on the temple tips felt right because it's small and personal. You don't see it from far away, but you know it's there."Like the hidden emblem on the glasses, the things LISA holds closest are the ones you only catch up close: the star, the slippers, and Leo, Luca, Lily, Louis, Lego, and Love, more commonly known as the cats affectionally referred to as the Lfamily. That instinct for the small and personal carries over to how she actually uses the glasses: off stage, and for the hours in between. items.title: What Went Down at the PGA Tour and Hypegolf’s Presidents Cup Watch Party in Chicago
items.text: What Went Down at the PGA Tour and Hypegolf’s Presidents Cup Watch Party in Chicago The Presidents Cup is a team competition, but it is also one of the few moments in golf where the game’s international reach becomes especially visible. This year, as the U.S. Team faced the International Team with players from Canada, Latin America, South Korea, Japan, Australia and New Zealand, Chicago served as the backdrop for a tournament built around different countries, playing styles and relationships to the sport.That sense of exchange extended beyond Medinah Country Club. Roughly an hour from the course, Hypegolf hosted a Presidents Cup watch party at Five Iron Golf, bringing guests together in the middle of the city as the competition unfolded. The event offered a more social way into the week, reflecting how plenty of people now encounter golf through simulators, style, conversation and a shared interest in the game.The room brought together people with very different connections to golf. Roger Steele, Drew Westphal and Ashley Mayo were among the guests, joining a crowd that spanned industry figures, creatives and newer voices in the sport. It made for a setting where people could keep an eye on the action from Medinah while putting their own spin on the experience upstairs at Five Iron.Guests moved between the venue’s simulators, a photo booth and a merchandise display, while a Hypegolf-curated food and drink program kept the evening moving. Light bites were served alongside a cocktail menu featuring a margarita, an Old Fashioned and a non-alcoholic option. The format was intentionally loose allowing people to hit balls, catch up with friends or settle in to follow the matches.The details also created a connection back to the tournament site. Floral arrangements from Derrick Rose’s Rose’s Flower Shop were placed throughout the event, echoing the first-tee presentation at Medinah. The collaboration brought an unmistakably Chicago element to both settings, tying the week’s golf programming to one of the city’s most recognizable sporting figures.Style had its own place in the room, too. B. Draddy and Zero Restriction, the official outfitters of both U.S. Team and the International Team, displayed the uniforms worn during the competition. items.title: InScope Is a New Art Fair That Should Be on Your Radar
items.text: InScope Is a New Art Fair That Should Be on Your Radar Summary InScope, formerly Scope Art Show, will open its inaugural edition from December 1 through December 6 during the upcoming Miami Art WeekThe fair is designed to make collecting personal, allowing for deeper connections between artists, galleries, and collectorsProgramming includes talks, performances, tours, wellness events, and large-scale feature projects from Alake Shilling, Aurora Mititelu, Blue Floor Project, Ceren Arslan, Jason Hackenwerth, Nurse, Rabi Towing, and Swoon InScope is the new fair joining Miami this December, and, designed for discovery, it’s looking to shake things up during the city’s upcoming Art Week.The inaugural edition will hit the sands on Ocean Drive at 8th Street between December 1 and 6, planting its indoor and outdoor art installations, gallery pavilions, and social spaces across 220,000 square feet. Built around curiosity and connection, the event introduces a new format designed to bring artists, galleries, and collectors together in encounters that feel personal. “Art gives those conversations a starting point,” said InScope’s CEO and Co-founder Matt Middleton. “Our ambition is for people to leave with the relationships they came for and the inspiration they didn’t expect.”While the full gallery list is coming soon, its day-to-night programming so far offers a promising mix of talks, performances, tours, and wellness events. And its Feature Projects roster is already looking stacked. The first wave of announced projects includes Alake Shilling (Tlaloc Studios), Aurora Mititelu, Blue Floor Project (Fuze and Baha Mar), Ceren Arslan, Jason Hackenwerth (CAMP Gallery), Nurse (Walshy Fire), Rabi Towing, and Swoon.And while this marks the debut edition, the minds behind it aren’t the new kids on the block. Headed by Middleton, Alexis Hubshman, Hayley River Smith, and the former SCOPE Art Show team, InScope leans on 25 years of championing artists and galleries to reconsider and create space for diverse perspectives and experiences. The art of collecting arrives with a sense of excitement and belonging, whether you're a first-time buyer or a seasoned pro.“There isn’t only one way to experience art,” Smith, InScope’s director and recent State of Art featuree, explained. “We want to give people reasons to spend time, ask questions, and find something that stays with them.”InScope will hold its inaugural edition from December 1 through 6 in Miami Beach. items.title: Maison Margiela’s Tokyo-Exclusive REPLICA Fragrance Smells Like an Unsent Letter
items.text: Maison Margiela’s Tokyo-Exclusive REPLICA Fragrance Smells Like an Unsent Letter Summary Maison Margiela’s “Letter Never Sent” captures the intimacy of an unsent message through a Tokyo 1995-inspired scent.Sumi ink, red cedarwood and white musk evoke ink, paper and lingering emotion.The Tokyo-exclusive fragrance launches October 1. Maison Margiela turns an unfinished thought into an olfactory memory with REPLICA “Letter Never Sent,” the house’s first fragrance created exclusively for Tokyo and the first Eau de Parfum within its REPLICA Memory Collection.Set in “Tokyo, 1995,” the woody-musky composition looks back to a moment when communication was beginning to shift from the physical to the digital: handwritten letters and faxed pages giving way to emails, while words once committed to paper could increasingly disappear as easily as a deleted draft. Against the glow and restless movement of the city, “Letter Never Sent” imagines something quieter — an unposted letter kept close, preserving feelings that were written down but never delivered.That scent unfolds through a deliberately restrained trio of notes. A sumi ink accord opens with a dry, mineral transparency and faint metallic sharpness, recalling the moment fresh ink meets white paper while mirroring the cool polish of Tokyo’s urban landscape. As that initial edge settles, red cedarwood introduces warmth, grain and depth, shifting the scene from neon-lit streets toward the intimacy of a desk late at night. White musk finally softens the composition into something clean and close to the skin, evoking the smooth sensation of fine paper between the fingers. The fragrance treats the unsent letter as something suspended between past and present — its ink still legible, its emotions unfinished, and its memory lingering quietly long after the city outside has moved on.The bottle retains REPLICA’s recognizable, utilitarian presentation, with its archival-style label identifying the memory as “Tokyo, 1995,” almost like a date and place recorded on a piece of correspondence. The understated treatment allows the ink-and-paper narrative to remain central, while the wider launch extends that tactile language through a GINZA SIX concept store inspired by old postal spaces, alongside details including a takuhon-inspired furoshiki and sumi-paper pouch offered as part of the launch experience.The Maison Margiela REPLICA “Letter Never Sent” arrives October 1, 2026 in a 100ml format for ¥31,900 JPY (approx. $203 USD).

Black sections around the heel and collar provide a sharper counterpoint to the sweeter shades, while the sole unit is finished in a subdued matte black, grounding the otherwise playful combination. The contrast between translucent-looking mesh, glossy structural overlays and muted tooling gives the shoe a dimensional finish that shifts between technical trail styling and the candy-like colors behind its “Cherry Cake Party” theme.The silhouette retains the performance-informed construction inherited from Salomon’s trail-running archive. SensiFit™ wraps the foot for a secure fit, while the Agile Chassis™ System provides stability underfoot and Quicklace™ allows the lacing to be adjusted in a single pull. Its narrow, sculpted lines and layered material construction preserve the model’s streamlined lifestyle profile, with the black technical sole creating a heavier visual foundation beneath the saturated pink upper. items.title: First 'Game of Thrones' Movie 'Aegon’s Conquest' Sets Summer 2029 Release Date
items.text: First 'Game of Thrones' Movie 'Aegon’s Conquest' Sets Summer 2029 Release Date Summary HBO has scheduled its upcoming 'Game of Thrones' feature film 'Aegon's Conquest' for a June 6 2029 theatrical releaseThe movie will be directed by Owen Harris with a screenplay written by Beau WillimonThe narrative centers on Aegon I Targaryen and his historical conquest of Westeros centuries before the original series HBO has officially slated Game of Thrones: Aegon’s Conquest for a theatrical release on June 6, 2029. The project marks the franchise's first feature film set within the fictional universe of Westeros.Directed by Owen Harris (A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms) from a screenplay written by Beau Willimon (Andor, House of Cards), the film focuses on Aegon I, the founder of the Targaryen dynasty. The story chronicles his military conquest across Westeros centuries prior to the events of the original Game of Thrones series. Casting for the lead role of Aegon I has not yet been announced.The cinematic expansion arrives alongside HBO's growing television slate in the Westeros universe. In addition to the feature film, House of the Dragon is moving forward with a fourth season, while A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms has been renewed for Season 2.Game of Thrones: Aegon’s Conquest premieres in theaters on June 6, 2029. items.title: Erling Haaland's New Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite Only Shows Its True Colors When It Gets Wet
items.text: Erling Haaland's New Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite Only Shows Its True Colors When It Gets Wet Name: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite "Erling Haaland"Colorway: Baltic Blue/Glacier Blue/Blue EclipseSKU: HQ2332-401MSRP: $280 USDRelease Date: October 1Where to Buy: NikeNike is giving Erling Haaland a cleat that changes with the weather. The Phantom 6 Low Elite "Erling Haaland" arrives in Baltic Blue/Glacier Blue/Blue Eclipse. It pairs a water-activated color-changing upper with the performance package of Nike's precision-focused silhouette, and the whole concept is built around water as a metaphor for how the striker plays.The headline feature only appears once the grass is wet. The upper is printed with white ink that disappears on contact with water, revealing the full graphic hidden underneath. Nike ties the effect to Haaland himself, casting the reveal as a picture of a player who turns into something defenders can't contain. Dry, the cleat reads as a clean study in icy blues. Wet, it shows everything.That dual nature follows Nike's broader framing of Haaland as water: constantly shifting, capable of stillness one moment and a surge the next. The cold-toned palette of Baltic, Glacier, and Eclipse blues keeps the theme consistent before a single drop hits the upper.Underneath the concept, the construction is built for touch. Nike's Gripknit forms the upper, a tacky textured material designed to hold the ball whether conditions are wet or dry. It's a fitting pairing for a cleat that literally responds to rain, since the surface that changes appearance also keeps its grip when the weather turns.Traction and fit round out the spec sheet. A Cyclone 360 circular stud pattern sits in the forefoot to help players plant and pivot quickly. The shoe's frame is shaped for a more anatomical fit, particularly through the toe box, molding to the foot and bringing the wearer closer to the ball on strikes. Nike positions the Phantom 6 as an upgrade over the Phantom GX 2, with refined Gripknit touch zones, the more natural toe-box fit, and an improved Cyclone 360 plate. A cushioned sockliner finishes the interior, and this firm-ground version is intended for dry, natural-grass fields. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Nike Moon Shoe OG Blooms With Florals Atop the Original Waffle Sole
items.text: The Nike Moon Shoe OG Blooms With Florals Atop the Original Waffle Sole Name: Nike Moon Shoe “Floral/Coconut Milk”Colorway: Coconut Milk/Mosswood Brown/Fennel/Light KhakiSKU: IZ6169-122MSRP: ¥15,730 JPY (approx. $100 USD)Release Date: October 1 (Japan), TBC (Global)Where to Buy: Nike JapanThe Nike Moon Shoe OG is returning with its heritage construction intact. Nike presents the shoe as a modern version of the running shoe Bill Bowerman built before the company even carried the Nike name, famously using his wife's waffle iron. This edition reproduces that original design in a Coconut Milk/Mosswood Brown/Fennel/Light Khaki colorway.The outsole is where the story starts. A rubber Waffle outsole anchors the shoe, and its gridded tread is the direct descendant of the pattern Bowerman first pressed out in the kitchen. The rubber gives durable traction, while the waffle pattern itself doubles as the shoe's clearest link to Nike's origins.The upper keeps things period-correct. It's built mainly from nylon, the lightweight material that defined running shoes of the era, and finished with a leather Swoosh along the side. The mix of textile and leather gives the upper a layered, textured look that separates it from the smooth, engineered surfaces of modern runners.The details stay simple inside, too. A foam sockliner handles step-in comfort, and the overall shape leans into the slim, low-slung stance of a '70s runner. The color blocking suits that vintage direction. Coconut Milk, Mosswood Brown, Fennel, and Light Khaki make up a muted, earthy palette that reads more like a lifestyle staple than a performance shoe, putting a piece of Nike's earliest history into an everyday rotation. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Apple Announces the iPhone Duo Pre-Order Date as Its First Foldable Smartphone Launches October 23
items.text: Apple Announces the iPhone Duo Pre-Order Date as Its First Foldable Smartphone Launches October 23 Summary Apple announced the official 'Get ready' pre-order timeline for the highly anticipated iPhone Duo, starting October 12, 2026The brand's first foldable smartphone features a 7.6-inch inner display, a 5.4-inch outer display and the new A20 Pro chipOfficial pre-orders launch October 16, with full retail availability on October 23 and pricing starting at $1,999.00 Apple officially announced the rollout timeline for the iPhone Duo, laying the groundwork for its first entry into the foldable smartphone market. Starting on Monday, October 12, 2026, customers can initiate the brand’s signature 'Get ready' configuration process. Applying this recurring launch strategy to its very first foldable device allows Apple to proactively streamline the checkout experience, ensuring that prospective buyers can minimize technical issues and secure their devices during a high-demand pre-order window.This advance setup window gives buyers a crucial head start to pre-select their exact configuration options well before the official drop. Accessed directly through the Apple Store app and Apple's online store, the 'Get ready' process lets users lock in their preferred storage amount, wireless carrier, payment method and colorway, with the foldable device launching in sharp Night Sky and Star White options. Available wireless carrier options for the initial rollout include AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon. Once the setup is completed, customers will be positioned for a rapid checkout when official pre-orders for the iPhone Duo go live on Friday, October 16, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time (5:00 a.m. Pacific Time). The foldable phone will then be officially available for purchase on October 23, 2026.As Apple's first foldable smartphone, the hardware introduces an entirely new physical footprint for the tech giant. When closed, the device operates using a compact 5.4-inch outer display. Opening the physical architecture reveals a sprawling 7.6-inch inner display that utilizes a special nano-texture finish specifically designed to minimize glare. To ensure flawless visual continuity for the user as they transition between the two modes, both the inner and outer displays share the exact same aspect ratio.Under the hood, the entire experience is powered by Apple's new A20 Pro chip. The device's foundational hardware design relies on a highly engineered precision hinge and a dual-battery archit

items.title: LEGO Unveils Icons 'Dragon Ball: Shenron & Goku' Building Set
items.text: LEGO Unveils Icons 'Dragon Ball: Shenron & Goku' Building Set Summary LEGO has officially announced the Icons Dragon Ball Shenron & Goku building set tailored for adult fans of the franchiseThe 1,764-piece set features a poseable Eternal Dragon Shenron coiling above the seven Dragon Balls alongside a detachable Kid Goku minifigure on the KintounThe centerpiece model stands over 12.5 inches tall and offers interactive assembly via the LEGO Builder application LEGO has officially introduced the LEGO Icons Dragon Ball: Shenron & Goku set, an intricate display model crafted for adult builders. Designed as an homage to the iconic anime franchise, the detailed model captures the show's signature elements in physical brick form.Constructed from 1,764 pieces, the set features the Eternal Dragon Shenron rising in a dramatic coiled pose from atop all seven Dragon Balls. The dragon statue is sculpted with textured scales and includes articulated head and claw joints, allowing for custom display arrangements.The build is accompanied by a detachable Kid Goku minifigure riding his Kintoun (Flying Nimbus) cloud, which can be repositioned or displayed separately from the main structure. Once fully assembled, the model measures over 12.5 inches (32 cm) high, 9.5 inches (24 cm) long, and 10 inches (26 cm) wide, supported by 3D digital instructions available on the LEGO Builder app.The Dragon Ball: Shenron & Goku set arrives at LEGO on November 4, 2026. items.text: ASICS Debuts the GEL-TRANSCEND FJ in two Earthy Hues Name: ASICS GEL-TRANSCEND FJColorway: Ash Green/Graphite Grey, Black Coffee/Graphite GreySKU: 1203B050.300, 1203B050.200MSRP: $150 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: ASICSASICS introduces the GEL-TRANSCEND FJ, a new silhouette that draws from the brand’s archive of 1990s hiking and walking footwear. The upper combines references from the TRANSCEND, GEL-ODYSSEY and GEL-RADIUS series, bringing together rugged leather paneling, perforated detailing, contrast stitching and dimensional ASICS Stripes within a substantial low-top profile.Two colorways lead the debut: “Ash Green/Graphite Grey” covers much of the upper in a pale, muted sage with a softly brushed finish, offset by dark grey mesh around the tongue and collar, patterned rope laces and a black midsole. “Black Coffee/Graphite Grey” takes a richer approach, using deep chocolate-brown leather throughout the upper with black textile accents and cream-speckled laces, giving the shoe a more earthy, utilitarian appearance.Underfoot, the GEL-TRANSCEND FJ borrows its tooling from the GEL-FujiTrabuco 7, introducing a sharply articulated, jagged sole that gives the otherwise retro upper a more aggressive trail-derived foundation. The Ash Green edition extends its palette into dark green outsole sections beneath the black midsole, while the Black Coffee pair keeps the lower half predominantly charcoal and black for a heavier, tonal finish. FLYTEFOAM cushioning keeps the platform lightweight underfoot, while ASICSGRIP rubber adds traction across varied surfaces, reinforcing the model’s mix of archival outdoor references and everyday functionality. items.title: 'One Piece' Anime Enters Hiatus, Confirms Return in 2027 Following Major Cliffhanger
items.text: 'One Piece' Anime Enters Hiatus, Confirms Return in 2027 Following Major Cliffhanger Summary Toei Animation has officially concluded the 2026 broadcast of the 'One Piece' anime following Episode 1180Episode 1181 will not air until 2027 adhering to the series' new 26-episode annual limit designed to improve pacingThe franchise maintains a packed 2027 lineup including Wit Studio's remake on Netflix and 'One Piece Film: God Valley' Toei Animation has officially paused the One Piece anime series for the remainder of 2026, confirming that Episode 1181 will not broadcast until 2027. The hiatus follows the September 27 airing of Episode 1180 on Fuji TV, which concluded on a major cliffhanger within the ongoing Elbaph arc.The broadcast pause forms part of a revamped scheduling strategy established by Toei Animation and producer Ryuta Koike. Under the structure, the long-running series is capped at 26 episodes annually to eliminate filler recap episodes and align the anime's pacing closer to Eiichiro Oda's original manga chapters. In the interim, Fuji TV will fill the Sunday night timeslot with Dragon Ball Super: Beerus starting October 11.Despite the main TV series hiatus, 2027 is shaping up to be a massive year for the broader franchise. The upcoming slate includes the debut of Wit Studio's THE ONE PIECE remake dropping seven episodes on Netflix in February, the theatrical premiere of One Piece Film: God Valley in Japan next summer, and season 3 of Netflix's live-action adaptation featuring Xolo Maridueña as Portgas D. Ace.One Piece Episode 1181 will return to broadcast in 2027, with additional air date details to be announced by Toei Animation.年内最後のTVアニメ『ONE PIECE』ご視聴ありがとうございました🏴‍☠️⠀次回は2027年放送！詳しい放送時期は続報をお待ちください。⠀#ONEPIECE #今週のアニワン pic.twitter.com/G5zYir5wl1— ONE PIECE スタッフ【公式】/ Official (@Eiichiro_Staff) September 27, 2026 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘Street Fighter’ Revisits Ken and Ryu’s Brotherhood in New Featurette Trailer
items.text: ‘Street Fighter’ Revisits Ken and Ryu’s Brotherhood in New Featurette Trailer Summary Street Fighter ’s latest featurette centers on Ken and Ryu’s fractured friendship and rivalry.Andrew Koji and Noah Centineo discuss the characters’ shared history and unresolved tension.The film hits U.S. theaters October 16, 2026. Paramount Pictures has released a new “Ken vs. Ryu” featurette for the upcoming live-action Street Fighter film, putting the franchise’s defining friendship and rivalry at the center of its latest preview.The video opens by referencing the characters’ video game roots before cutting between new fight footage and behind-the-scenes interviews with Andrew Koji, who plays Ryu, Noah Centineo as Ken Masters and director Kitao Sakurai. Koji and Centineo describe the pair as effectively brothers whose once-close relationship fractured after an unspecified event sent them down separate paths, while Sakurai frames their unresolved bond as one of the film’s central dramatic questions.Alongside shots of the two fighters sparring and facing off, the featurette also offers a brief glimpse of Gouken, the martial arts master traditionally associated with training both Ryu and Ken, further grounding the adaptation in established Street Fighter lore.The new featurette builds on earlier trailers that have emphasized the movie’s recognizable special moves, costumes and tournament structure, while sharpening the emotional focus around Ryu and Ken’s relationship. Street Fighter is scheduled to arrive in U.S. theaters on October 16, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Did HOKA Just Drop a Trail-Bound Bus Stop Outside Shibuya PARCO?!
items.text: Did HOKA Just Drop a Trail-Bound Bus Stop Outside Shibuya PARCO?! Did HOKA just drop a "trail-bound" bus stop right in front of Shibuya PARCO? The brand is hosting "Meet the Speedgoat," a limited-time pop-up space exploring the roots of its beloved Speedgoat trail running shoes, open from Wednesday, September 30, to Sunday, October 4.Suddenly appearing in the middle of the city is a lone bus stop where ultra-runner Karl Meltzer sits. Known by his nickname "Speedgoat" for his ability to navigate rugged, technical trails with the effortless agility of a mountain goat, Meltzer takes center stage as the pop-up dives into the history behind the shoe franchise that debuted in his honor in 2015.The venue also showcases the Speedgoat 7, the latest iteration of HOKA's signature trail running line. Set against the backdrop of the bus stop featuring Meltzer holding the newest colorway, visitors can pick up a complimentary booklet detailing the shoe's design specs and featuring an exclusive interview with Meltzer about the birth of the Speedgoat.On the final day, Sunday, October 4, a special HOKA bus will actually pull up to this stop. It will pick up lottery winners for a day trip out of the city to test the Speedgoat 7 on real trails. (Please note that additional entries for this event are no longer being accepted.)The latest Speedgoat 7 is a trail running shoe engineered with enhanced traction and cushioning. By pairing a high-energy-return, super-critical EVA midsole with a Vibram® Megagrip outsole featuring traction lugs, it delivers the ultimate balance of grip and responsiveness. The shoe is priced at 23,100 yen (tax included).The collection offers a robust variety of colorways for both men and women. The men's lineup includes Black/Outer Orbit, Black/Stellar Grey, Outer Orbit/Virtual Blue, Varsity Navy/Barley Flour, Black/HOKA Citrus, Antique Olive/Black, Alabaster/Morning Dew, and Black/White. The women's selection features Barley/Barley Flour, Blueberry/Cosmic Grey, Black/Electric Aqua, and Black/White.Additionally, the lineup introduces the waterproof Speedgoat 7 GTX. Equipped with a GORE-TEX Invisible Fit membrane and 100% recycled Cordura®, this rugged version also boasts toggle lacing, 360-degree reflective elements for low-light visibility, and an anti-odor sockliner. It is priced at 26,400 yen (tax included).Meet the SpeedgoatDates: Wednesday, September 30 – Sunday, October 4Location: Outside Shibuya PARCO Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: SOUTH2 WEST8 and Foxfire Return With Performance-Driven Winter Layers
items.text: SOUTH2 WEST8 and Foxfire Return With Performance-Driven Winter Layers Summary SOUTH2 WEST8 and Foxfire reunite for a second collaborative capsule.Octa and merino-wool constructions emphasize warmth, breathability and layering.Seven cold-weather pieces span insulated outerwear, base layers and trekking pants, launching October 2. SOUTH2 WEST8 and Foxfire are extending their shared fishing roots this fall season with their second collaborative capsule. The seven-piece collection shifts its attention toward cold-weather functionality, combining both brands’ outdoor expertise with silhouettes designed to move comfortably between the field and the city.Key to the range is Foxfire’s functional fabric technology: the V-Neck Cardigan and Trainer Jacket employ Octa Helix Knit, a blend of Octa fiber and polyester engineered to produce a textured, mohair-like appearance, while the GRID WOOL series uses merino wool knitted into dimensional blocks with a gridded reverse structure. Layering anchors the remainder of the capsule, led by the Mid Layer Insulation Jacket and Insulation Parka, both lined throughout with Octa for added cold-weather performance.A Base Layer Half-Zip Shirt and matching Base Layer Pant further build out the wardrobe, while SOUTH2 WEST8’s distinct design language comes through on the Trekking Pant, completing a lineup that balances technical utility with a sportier, urban-facing sensibility.The SOUTH2 WEST8 x Foxfire FW26 capsule launches October 2 through NEPENTHES stores and its online shop.  View this post on Instagram   Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Michael Jordan 1998 NBA Finals Game 3 Jersey Sells for Record $12.26 Million USD
items.text: Michael Jordan 1998 NBA Finals Game 3 Jersey Sells for Record $12.26 Million USD Summary Michael Jordan's game-worn jersey from Game 3 of the 1998 NBA Finals has sold for a record 12.26 million USD on JOOPITERThe white Chicago Bulls jersey represents the most expensive game-worn NBA jersey ever sold at auctionThe piece features the iconic 1998 NBA Finals Championship patch and stands as the only publicly known white 1998 Finals jersey in existence JOOPITER has officially confirmed a record-breaking auction sale, closing on Michael Jordan's game-worn Chicago Bulls jersey from Game 3 of the 1998 NBA Finals for $12,260,000 USD. The historic result sets a new global benchmark for sports memorabilia as the most expensive game-worn NBA jersey ever sold at auction.Worn during Jordan's final championship campaign with the Chicago Bulls—immortalized as "The Last Dance"—the item stands as the only publicly known white 1998 NBA Finals jersey to ever surface on the open market. The physical piece features the iconic 1998 NBA Finals Championship patch stitched onto the chest, widely celebrated by sports collectors as the most significant Finals patch in modern basketball history.Bidding closed at 8:00 p.m. EDT on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, marking a monumental shift in the sports collectibles sector. Following the landmark jersey sale, JOOPITER's curated sports auction block continues with Jordan’s personal 1997 Ferrari 550 Maranello, which he drove during his final years in Chicago, scheduled to close on September 30.The 1998 NBA Finals Game 3 jersey was auctioned exclusively via JOOPITER, closing on September 29, 2026. items.title: JD and Nike Are Dedicating This Year’s 1.10 Day to Liverpool
items.text: JD and Nike Are Dedicating This Year’s 1.10 Day to Liverpool JD has joined forces with Nike for the brand’s second annual 1.10 Day. A celebration of the staple Air Max 95, this year it revolves around the silhouette’s long-standing home of Liverpool, UK.Every sneakerhead knows Liverpool’s connection with the Air Max 95 goes back decades. But for those less familiar, the city’s obsession with the silhouette began in the ‘90s when football fans adopted it as part of their uniforms. It wasn’t until the retail price rose to £110 GBP that it continued to grow as a cultural icon, becoming widely known in the North of England as the 110. Honoring its enduring presence in the city, the sportswear retailer recently enlisted a lineup of local trailblazers for its dedicated 1.10 Day campaign. Headed by Liverpool F.C. footballer Dominik Szoboszlai, former Everton player Duncan Ferguson, rapper Kasst 8, and host Still Ryan as well as a wider cast of Ben Harris and Mark Skully from Bennetts, collector Lola Bennett, sneaker boutique owner Block P, model Paris Chanel, and creator Lew Earle, the collective comes together for a family-style portrait that spotlights the diverse communities connected by the Air Max 95. View this post on InstagramA post shared by JD Sports (@jdsports) The campaign also features a short film directed by UK filmmaker Glenn Kitson. It explores how the silhouette is passed down through generations as a cultural baton, pairing Kitson’s signature snappy cuts with a narration by writer and recovery worker PJ Smith. Beyond the storytelling, the film gives fans a closer look at the highly anticipated Nike Air Max 95, made for Liverpool.Dropping exclusively at JD, the limited-edition pair marks the first time the city will get its own Air Max 95. Channeling its unmistakable spirit, Nike infuses the silhouette with two symbolic Liverpool hues, including the red brick-inspired “Rust Factor” and light-toned “Steam,” referencing the Liver Bird emblem. This color palette highlights “SCOUSE” on the sole, as well as the split “Liverpool” logo on the tongue. Finer details on the sneaker consist of a brick-like pattern and reflective base along the foxing. Leaving no component untouched, the underside of the tongue is embroidered with the area’s “0151” telephone code, while the sock liner comes inscribed with a map of the city’s docklands. items.title: Louis De Guzman Reimagines the Jumpman for Jordan Brand’s Artist Series
items.text: Louis De Guzman Reimagines the Jumpman for Jordan Brand’s Artist Series Summary Louis De Guzman joins Jordan Brand’s Artist Series for Fall 2026.The Balikbayan box inspires a collection centered on family, migration and connection.Geometric Jumpman graphics and handwritten details translate De Guzman’s Filipino-American story into apparel. Chicago-based Filipino-American visual artist and designer Louis De Guzman is joining Jordan Brand’s Artist Series for Fall 2026 with an apparel collection rooted in family, migration and the Filipino tradition of the Balikbayan box.Titled around the concept “It Took This to Get Here,” the collaboration looks back to De Guzman’s childhood in the early 1990s, when he watched his parents pack boxes with photographs, Chicago Bulls T-shirts, shoes, trading cards and handwritten notes to send to relatives in the Philippines. Before video calls made long-distance communication immediate, these packages became a tangible connection between families separated by oceans — including De Guzman and his older brother, who was still living in the Philippines at the time. That personal history is translated into the collection through handwritten details inspired by names marked onto clothing tags, alongside the Jumpman reinterpreted through De Guzman’s signature geometric visual language and color palette.The capsule carries that narrative across a practical lineup of everyday apparel, including men’s and women’s tees, an oversized fleece hoodie, women’s fleece crew, fleece pants, cargo/utility pants, an anorak and a unisex cap. Prices range from $32 USD for the cap to $170 USD for the anorak, positioning each piece as part of a broader wardrobe rather than a singular commemorative item. For De Guzman, the project reflects nearly four decades of family history and the values embedded in the Balikbayan tradition - connection, generosity and carrying one’s roots forward - while extending an artistic practice that frequently brings together his family’s immigrant journey and his own experience growing up as a second-generation Filipino American. The Louis De Guzman x Jordan Brand Artist Series launches October 9, 2026, via Nike’s website, Nike retail locations and select retailers globally. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Zendaya and On Unveil Second Co-Created Apparel and Footwear Collection Summary On and Zendaya have officially launched their second co-created collection developed alongside Law RoachThe capsule introduces technical sportswear with custom python prints and debuts the Cloudnova Moon Mary JaneThe lineup launches globally on October 1 accompanied by immersive retail pop-ups in Los Angeles Paris Tokyo and Chengdu On and Zendaya have officially released their second co-created footwear and apparel collection, accompanied by an action film-inspired campaign. Developed alongside longtime collaborator Law Roach, the latest drop elevates everyday activewear by fusing On's performance innovation with signature styling elements.Captured in a cinematic short film by directing trio Pantera, the collection puts movement and versatility center stage. The apparel lineup introduces an all-over custom python print across a bodysuit, a form-fitting long-sleeve top, and a half-zip anorak. Additionally, oversized crew necks and matching sweatpants incorporate considered ruching and adjustable bungee cord detailing to allow wearers to customize each silhouette.Footwear highlights the launch with the debut of the Cloudnova Moon in a Mary Jane-inspired design. The low-profile model pairs an engineered knit upper with refined speed laces for all-day comfort. The silhouette debuts in three distinct colorways: "Clove/Ivory," "Dew/Antler," and "Black/Ivory."The Zendaya x On collection is available starting October 1, 2026, online, On retail stores globally, and special pop-up spaces in Los Angeles, Paris, Tokyo, and Chengdu. items.title: Hankook Tire Is on Hand to Kit Out Your Electric Car With iON Evo
items.text: Hankook Tire Is on Hand to Kit Out Your Electric Car With iON Evo Demand for the latest electric vehicles may have surged in recent years, but the development of EV tires hasn’t always kept up with this rapidly evolving technology. Hankook, however, is looking to bridge this gap with its iON Evo tires.Launched as part of its wider iON range, the high-performance tires are specially engineered around distinctive EV components, including weight and torque, to make drives more energy efficient. A key element in the design is the brand’s revolutionary ProDurable Compound material. Made from advanced fillers and flexible rubber materials, it can withstand the heavier battery weight of EVs, helping to keep wear and tear at bay over the tires’ lifespan. Beyond the core demands of EVs, Hankook also considers the noticeably quieter experience of riding in these cars compared to ICE vehicles. With tires often adding a layer of noise to the journey, the iON Evo tires incorporate i Sound Absorber Technology with Opti Pitch Technology to reduce tread sound no matter the speed or size of the car. This is paired with Advanced Handling and Reduced Rolling Resistance to provide an all-round smooth journey for both the driver and passengers. Hypebeast captured the latest tires in a new Closer Look with the BMW iX3. See how they perform on the road in the video below. items.title: Joel Lyall Is Flipping His Daily Routine to Stay Ahead of the Fashion Game
items.text: Joel Lyall Is Flipping His Daily Routine to Stay Ahead of the Fashion Game “When everyone else has gone to bed, it always comes back to why I started this,” shares Joel Lyall. The stylist and founder of vintage streetwear boutique Bythepeace is busy unloading fresh stock from his car outside his studio in West London. “Six years ago, I was working from my brother’s room at night, staying motivated to get things done. Now, this time of day is a reminder to keep pushing and persevering.”Hypebeast links up with Lyall at the start of the evening for a new campaign with UGG. As the pace of the city slows down, he lets us into what he considers the peak of his working day. From ideating streetwear looks to preparing vintage garments for sale, the visuals capture how the stylist seizes new opportunities at nightfall, while kitted out in the brand’s functional yet fashion-forward Fall 2026 collection. "This time of day is a reminder to keep pushing and persevering."Surrounded by almost 70 pieces from various stockists, Lyall wastes no time in getting to work. “Sometimes I start by measuring and steaming the clothes, other times I note it all down on my spreadsheet, and that's just the beginning,” he shares. With his evening in full swing, the stylist relies on the UGG Birch Hiker for long-lasting comfort. A low-top, utilitarian shoe originating from the 1999 Birch Collection, the silhouette has been reworked with durable materials to support active lives like Lyall’s. As he mentions, organizing garments is just the beginning, so after separating them into what can be styled for upcoming projects or archived for future collections, he begins posting pieces to the website. “I upload around 9 p.m. whilst my customers are in bed and may be scrolling through what they can buy,” he explains. “People are especially active through the night, so that's when I can take advantage and get ahead of the game, making sure they see my items first.”At this point, Lyall switches to the UGG Birch Boot. Though it's built with a waterproof outer, the lightweight feel and sheepskin liner allow it to double up as a cozy indoor shoe. “I try to prioritize versatility and functionality throughout my day,” he says. Taking us through his outfit, the stylist explains, “I love wearing my blue denim and plain white T-shirt with the UGG boots; they can be styled in so many ways.” "I try to prioritize versatility and functionality, and with the UGG boots, they can be styled in so many ways."Wrapp

items.title: Dom Pérignon's Latest Limited Edition Bottle Comes from Damien Hirst
items.text: Dom Pérignon's Latest Limited Edition Bottle Comes from Damien Hirst Dom Pérignon has enlisted Damien Hirst for its end-of-year 2026 limited edition. The release covers two vintages, Dom Pérignon Vintage 2018 and Rosé Vintage 2010, both dressed in artwork drawn from the British artist's Kaleidoscope series. The collaboration centres on the house's familiar shield-shaped label. Hirst has filled it with a dense, symmetrical pattern that repeats across the bottle and its gift box. The shield stays in place, but it is now one element in a larger repeating composition rather than a plain frame. A black neck collar reads "Limited Edition" above Hirst's signature.Each vintage gets its own colour. Vintage 2018 comes in deep blues and violets, which the house links to infinity and spirituality. Rosé Vintage 2010 takes a palette of magenta, red and pink, meant to reflect the Pinot Noir at the heart of the blend. Matching boxes carry the full kaleidoscope pattern, with the shield set at the centre in silver.Hirst is the latest in a long run of artists and creators to work with the house over nearly three decades. Earlier names include Andy Warhol, Marc Newson, Jeff Koons, the estate of Jean-Michel Basquiat, Takashi Murakami, Karl Lagerfeld, David Lynch, Lenny Kravitz and Lady Gaga.The Dom Pérignon x Damien Hirst Vintage 2018 Limited Edition Gift Box is priced at £230, and the Rosé Vintage 2010 Limited Edition Gift Box at £405. Both are available now from Selfridges in London. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: G-Shock Unveils the $80,000 USD MRG-D5000 Crafted Entirely in Blue Sapphire
items.text: G-Shock Unveils the $80,000 USD MRG-D5000 Crafted Entirely in Blue Sapphire Summary G-Shock has officially unveiled the MRG-D5000 featuring an outer case and bezel rendered entirely in synthetic blue sapphire crystalConceived by brand creator Kikuo Ibe in 2017 the shock-resistant timepiece required nearly a decade of technical developmentProduction is strictly limited to 20 pieces globally with each watch hand-assembled by a single master technician at Casio's Yamagata factory Casio G-Shock has officially revealed the G-Shock MRG-D5000 Blue Sapphire, marking the most expensive production watch in the brand's history. Priced at $80,000 USD (£67,000 GBP), the record-setting model turns a long-standing concept envisioned by brand creator Kikuo Ibe in 2017 into an ultra-exclusive reality.Constructed entirely from lab-grown blue sapphire crystal across its outer case and bezel, the G-Shock MRG-D5000 measures 16.45mm in thickness to accommodate the material's structural requirements. To prevent fracturing without relying on traditional drill holes or screws, G-Shock engineered an interlocking assembly framework inspired by traditional Japanese timber joinery. Each sapphire element interlocks like a three-dimensional puzzle to absorb and disperse impact forces while maintaining 200-meter water resistance and solar-powered functionality.The design stays faithful to the original 1983 square silhouette, featuring a blue vapor-deposition brick-pattern face detailed with 24-carat gold lettering. Flipping the watch over reveals a Grade 5 titanium caseback set with sapphire crystal, engraved with "DREAM PROJECT" alongside its individual edition number from 1/20 to 20/20. Every timepiece in the 20-piece release is hand-assembled by a single senior technician at Casio's Yamagata facility.The G-Shock MRG-D5000 Blue Sapphire is available in an ultra-limited production run of 20 pieces globally via G-Shock. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike Officially Introduces the Apex Marathon Racing Shoe
items.text: Nike Officially Introduces the Apex Marathon Racing Shoe Summary Nike has unveiled the Apex marathon shoe built for peak race-day efficiency and speedThe silhouette introduces double-stacked Air Zoom units in the forefoot paired with ZoomX LT foam and a 40mm zero-drop platformThe shoe officially launches globally in January 2027 via Nike and select stockists Nike has officially introduced the Nike Apex, marking its pinnacle expression of marathon race-day innovation. Built for competitive runners chasing every possible second, the lightweight racing system is engineered to deliver unprecedented energy return and forward propulsion.The Apex stands as Nike’s first racing shoe to incorporate four Air Zoom units configured in two double-stacked pairs under the forefoot—the most Air ever applied to a Swoosh running model. Designed to compress, store, and return energy, the system delivers up to 40% more energy return than the Alphafly 3 while weighing over 10% less. The shoe sits on a balanced 40-millimeter zero-drop platform to provide consistent support, cushioning, and responsiveness from heel to toe.Surrounding the Air Zoom setup is a bed of new ZoomX LT midsole foam, designed to be softer, lighter, and more responsive than traditional ZoomX. A raised, inverse-wave carbon fiber Flyplate directs loading directly into the stacked Air units, working alongside a wider outsole and rocker geometry to maintain pace stability. Up top, a breathable Flyknit X upper with a fitted knit collar and sockliner-free construction creates a minimal, glove-like fit, finished with GOATEK and Fast Shot traction underfoot.The Nike Apex launches in January 2027 via Nike and select retail locations. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Matières Fécales Presents "THE NINETY NINE PERCENT" SS27 Collection at Place de la République
items.text: Matières Fécales Presents "THE NINETY NINE PERCENT" SS27 Collection at Place de la République Summary Matières Fécales staged its SS27 runway presentation titled THE NINETY NINE PERCENT at Paris's Place de la RépubliqueDesigned by Steven Raj Bhaskaran alongside Hannah Rose the collection featured 99 looks modeled entirely by people of colorThe show highlighted a footwear collaboration with Christian Louboutin alongside hand-woven textiles from Burkina Faso and India Matières Fécales has unveiled its Spring/Summer 2027 collection, titled "THE NINETY NINE PERCENT," staging the first-ever fashion show at the historic Place de la République during Paris Fashion Week. Conceived by designer Steven Raj Bhaskaran with support from creative partner Hannah Rose, the presentation served as a deeply personal manifesto honoring immigrant families, working-class communities, and marginalized identities through 99 looks modeled entirely by people of color.Structured across three distinct chapters—“FAMILY,” “TRIBE,” and “GODS”—the collection translates Bhaskaran's personal journey into elevated garments. The opening "FAMILY" segment introduced white draped ensembles, Thawb-inspired cotton dress shirts, hardware-accented silk trenches, and modest micro-pleated chiffon skirts. The section also debuted curved-heel flip-flop footwear created in collaboration with Christian Louboutin, closing with Bhaskaran walking the runway alongside his mother, sister, and niece.Transitioning into "TRIBE," the collection explored alternative youth culture with military tulle tweed sets, decaying lamb leather capes, metallic "Golden Touch" gloves, and heavy-duty "Stomper" combat boots. The final "GODS" section highlighted global artisanal techniques, featuring hand-woven cotton suits by Cabes Gie in Burkina Faso and hand-embroidered sarees by Tilfi in Varanasi, India, reimagined as decayed 1950s ball gowns. In a striking finale, models carried life-like billionaire figures around the République statue to Nina Simone’s "Tomorrow Is My Turn."A portion of sales from the Spring/Summer 2027 collection will directly support La Maison d’Allanah, a non-profit organization providing housing for LGBTQIA+ refugees in France. items.title: Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger Cleared to Close Following $111 Billion USD Settlement Approval
items.text: Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger Cleared to Close Following $111 Billion USD Settlement Approval Summary Paramount and Warner Bros Discovery are set to officially close their $111 billion USD merger on October 6, 2026US District Judge Araceli Martínez Olguín approved a settlement with 12 state attorneys general removing the final legal barrierFormer Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz will join David Ellison as co-CEO to lead the combined entertainment conglomerate Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery are scheduled to officially complete their $111 billion USD merger on October 6, 2026. U.S. District Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín signed off on a settlement agreement with 12 state attorneys general, eliminating the final legal hurdle blocking the largest corporate takeover in Hollywood history.The approved consent decree establishes specific operational parameters for the combined media empire rather than requiring asset divestitures. Key terms mandate that the merged entity cannot sell the historic Paramount Studios or Warner Bros. studio lots for at least five years, must commit an additional $300 million USD annually toward U.S. film production, and must release at least 30 feature films in theaters across the first two years. Furthermore, a dedicated news editorial independence board will be established to govern journalistic principles for both CBS News and CNN.Alongside the legal resolution, the executive structure of the combined conglomerate has been formalized. Paramount chief David Ellison has brought on former Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz to serve as co-CEO, while HBO head Casey Bloys is expected to assume control of the unified streaming division. Outgoing Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav will step down as the merger officially closes.The transaction between Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery is set to close on October 6, 2026. items.title: LISA and Nike Bring the Archival Moon Shoe Back Into Orbit
items.text: LISA and Nike Bring the Archival Moon Shoe Back Into Orbit Summary BLACKPINK's LISA stars in the official global campaign for the relaunched Nike Moon ShoeOriginally prototyped in 1971 by Bill Bowerman the archival runner features its iconic waffle soleThe historic silhouette officially returns to orbit on October 1 accompanied by red color-blocked styling Nike and BLACKPINK's LISA have officially joined forces to relaunch the historic Nike Moon Shoe. The superstar brings one of the brand's oldest archival runners back into orbit, bridging the gap between 1971 track heritage and modern lifestyle appeal.First prototyped in 1971 for speed on the track, the Moon Shoe represents a foundational piece of Nike's performance history. The silhouette is defined by its signature waffle sole, a groundbreaking traction design that stems from co-founder Bill Bowerman’s earliest footwear experiments. Now reimagined and explicitly designed for life in orbit, the runner transitions from its competitive athletic origins into a contemporary footwear staple.In the newly revealed campaign imagery, LISA pairs the archival sneaker with a bold, red color-blocked ensemble. The styling emphasizes the shoe's low-profile construction, exposed traction elements, and classic vintage aesthetics. By bringing the 1971 design language back into clear view, the campaign successfully merges foundational athletic heritage with modern cultural relevance.The Nike Moon Shoe launches globally on October 1, 2026 via Nike. items.title: Sony Sets 2027 Release Dates for '24 Jump Street' and Ridley Scott's 'Treasure Island'
items.text: Sony Sets 2027 Release Dates for '24 Jump Street' and Ridley Scott's 'Treasure Island' Summary Sony Pictures has updated its multi-year theatrical slate led by '24 Jump Street' and Ridley Scott's 'Treasure Island'24 Jump Street reunites Channing Tatum Jonah Hill and Ice Cube for a December 10 2027 releaseRidley Scott's Treasure Island adaptation starring Hugh Jackman opens on November 11 2027 ahead of Helldivers in 2028 Sony Pictures has officially locked in release dates for 24 Jump Street and Ridley Scott’s Treasure Island, anchoring a major 2027–2028 theatrical slate update. The announcements set key holiday release windows for the studio's marquee comedy and adventure productions.Scheduled to hit theaters on December 10, 2027, 24 Jump Street brings back stars Channing Tatum, Jonah Hill, and Ice Cube. Directed by Rodney Rothman (Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse), who penned the script alongside Hill and Meghan Malloy, the comedy sequel is produced by Neal H. Moritz, Phil Lord, Chris Miller, Tatum, and Hill. Meanwhile, Ridley Scott’s adaptation of Robert Louis Stevenson’s Treasure Island takes over the November 11, 2027 slot. Adapted by Jack Thorne, the film stars Hugh Jackman as Long John Silver alongside Hugh Grant and Owen Cooper.In addition to its flagship late-2027 tentpoles, Sony dated the Michelle Yeoh action thriller The Surgeon for April 2, 2027, and the drama Narcs for August 20, 2027. Future calendar shifts include Bad Robot’s Grandgear, directed by Takashi Yamazaki, moving to January 14, 2028, and Justin Lin’s PlayStation video game adaptation Helldivers starring Alan Ritchson shifting to June 9, 2028.  Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Sotheby's Unveils $450 Million USD Collection Led by Rare Van Gogh, Cézanne, and Monet Works
items.text: Sotheby's Unveils $450 Million USD Collection Led by Rare Van Gogh, Cézanne, and Monet Works Summary Sotheby's will offer the 12-piece Blaquier-Arrieta Collection in New York with an estimate in the region of $450 million USDThe historic offering features rare works by Vincent van Gogh Paul Cézanne and Claude Monet unseen publicly for over 50 yearsVan Gogh's Châtaigniers en fleurs and Cézanne's Arlequin are both poised to set new global auction records for the artists Sotheby's has officially unveiled The Blaquier-Arrieta Collection, an extraordinary 12-piece group of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterworks estimated to realize in the region of $450 million USD. Unseen in public for over half a century, the historic assemblage is headlined by landmark paintings from Vincent van Gogh, Paul Cézanne, and Claude Monet.Leading the offering is Van Gogh's Châtaigniers en fleurs (Chestnut Trees in Blossom), painted in May 1890 during his final months in Auvers-sur-Oise and estimated in the region of $180 million USD. The canvas depicts a blossoming chestnut canopy and a solitary figure alongside women in Japanese attire, representing one of only eight Auvers landscapes remaining in private hands.Alongside Van Gogh's work is Cézanne's 1888–1890 oil painting Arlequin, estimated in the region of $120 million USD. Depicting the artist's 17-year-old son Paul in red and black diamond checks, it stands as the only composition from Cézanne's seminal four-part Harlequin series held outside of a museum collection. Both works are positioned to set new global auction records for the respective artists.The collection also features Claude Monet’s 1876 landscape Le Jardin des Tuileries, estimated between $15 million and $20 million USD. Painted from a fifth-floor apartment on the Rue de Rivoli, it is one of only two Paris cityscapes from the series remaining in private hands. The 12-piece lineup is completed by masterworks from Pierre-Auguste Renoir, Camille Pissarro, Edgar Degas, Paul Gauguin, Alfred Sisley, André Derain, Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, and Maurice de Vlaminck.The Blaquier-Arrieta Collection goes on sale November 18, 2026, at Sotheby's New York.
