items.text: Nike Decorates the LeBron 24 "Greater China" in Auspicious Cloud Motifs Summary Nike has officially revealed early imagery for the LeBron 24 Greater China edition celebrating the Lunar New YearThe design features a beige Kingknit mesh upper decorated with red accents and traditional Xiangyun cloud graphicsThe performance silhouette is scheduled to release exclusively within the Greater China market on October 9, 2026 Name: Nike LeBron 24 "Greater China"Colorway: Light Khaki/Metallic-Phantom Grey-SailSKU: IX5105-200MSRP: $190 USDRelease Date: October 9, 2026Where to Buy: NikeNike and LeBron James have offered an official first look at the Nike LeBron 24 "Greater China", a Lunar New Year-themed iteration of James' 24th signature silhouette. The special-edition colorway incorporates traditional cultural motifs ahead of the upcoming NBA season.The model is constructed with a beige Kingknit mesh upper, contrasted by white Swooshes outlined in vibrant red borders and matching red laces running through the center. Traditional Xiangyun—auspicious or lucky cloud patterns—are printed across the forefoot and side panels, while a row of small square accents frames the top of the tongue. Additional Chinese characters are molded directly into the outsole tread.Refining the signature aesthetic of the franchise, the LeBron 24 carries over crown-inspired geometry from its predecessor, integrating subtle crown details across the midfoot plate, heel counter, toe box, and top eyelets.The Nike LeBron 24 "Greater China" drops on October 9, 2026. items.title: Ann Demeulemeester Opens Paris Flagship Store at the Palais Royal
items.text: Ann Demeulemeester Opens Paris Flagship Store at the Palais Royal Summary Ann Demeulemeester has opened a 150-square-meter boutique inside Paris's Jardin du Palais Royal, its second new store of 2026 after MilanThe space houses the complete Ann Demeulemeester collection, including its Serax tableware lineFollowing this opening, London and Tokyo flagships, and a Shanghai shop-in-shop will arrive in 2027 Ann Demeulemeester has opened a new Paris boutique inside the Jardin du Palais Royal, placing its latest flagship within one of the city's most historic settings. The 150-square-meter space is the house's second retail debut this year, arriving months after its Milan store at Via Monte Napoleone 22, and it pushes forward a plan to put down permanent roots in fashion's key cities.Inside, the boutique brings every category under one roof. Menswear and womenswear share the floor with footwear, accessories and the house's tableware collection for Serax, turning the store into a single destination where each facet of the brand sits side by side. To mark the occasion, the brand has produced a limited-edition shirt that revisits one of the label's signature designs, recasting it as a collectible edition. From a design perspective, the interiors juxtapose grand scale with a sense of closeness. The nearly grayscale space houses a masterclass in minimalist design. Materials were selected for their tactile nature, and bespoke furniture and lighting complete the aesthetic. Every architectural choice is tuned to let the garments and the space converse, reinforcing the craft-first, independent spirit that Ann Demeulemeester has always protected.The opening is part of a tightly edited flagship plan that continues in 2027 with a London store, a Tokyo flagship and a shop-in-shop at Shanghai's Plaza 66.Ann Demeulemeester Paris151-154 Galerie de ValoisJardin du Palais RoyalParis, France Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Taryn Simon’s Untold Stories of the FBI Go Up at Guggenheim
items.text: Taryn Simon’s Untold Stories of the FBI Go Up at Guggenheim Summary Taryn Simon unveils her exhibition, 'Father Country I Do Love You,' at the Guggenheim Museum in New YorkThe largest body of work to debut in the museum's history, the show spans photography, video, installation, and sculpture all based off of the accounts of an unnamed ex-FBI agentSimon dedicates the show to her father, also an ex-government worker, whom the structure and closing act is based off of Taryn Simon’s new exhibition, Father Country I Do Love You, covers almost every surface of the Guggenheim’s spiraling rotunda. Her work, much of it appearing pristine, unearths messy, invisible contours of power. The over 1,000 new photographs, videos, sculptures, and text works on view can be traced back to the wild life of just one man, and, for many, you have to see it to believe it.An unnamed FBI agent guides her through the dark maze of the American government for her most ambitious show yet — and the largest body of work ever to debut at the Guggenheim. Organized by Nat Trotman and Nancy Spector, with support from Bottega Veneta, the exhibition was nearly a decade in the making. It chronicles the life of the agent, who acted as a “middleman” in most of these operations, and traces one person’s commitment to duty, to his country, and the livelihoods he’d be willing to put on the line for it.The exhibition is organized into 42 chapters, and each, ensnaring in their earthy, twee palettes, is built around a subject or side character in a story by the agent. Just beyond an opening portrait of a Quantico-trained Jodie Foster, for example, is the “pool room,” washed floor to ceiling in a serene, aquatic teal. Within them is a series of Moore family portraits, shot in the pool where Rasheeda Moore lured former D.C. mayor Marion Barry into the 1990 drug sting that led to his arrest.“Espionage home searches were rare but kind of fun,” the agent told Simon. Plinths topped with roadkill photographs trail into another mustard-yellow section. Massive glossy shots of luxury accessories, all seized and later auctioned by the government, anchor “Un-American Rat 1: A lot of action at government auctions.” The project tells the story of Paul Ames, who was just 5 when agents raided his house, taking most of his family’s possessions, after his father, Aldrich Ames, was arrested for his involvement with the KGB.Another section, this one a heather plum tone, mounts a tenderly posed body of work, titled “The win

items.title: WHITE Box Just Brought 50 Contemporary Brands to Milan Fashion Week
items.text: WHITE Box Just Brought 50 Contemporary Brands to Milan Fashion Week WHITE Box is the latest hub from the go-to trade exhibition WHITE Milano. Expanding on its diverse womenswear offering, the showcase brought a fresh collective of streetwear, art and tech brands to Milan Fashion Week with its debut edition.Running over four days, WHITE Box landed among a series of other new additions to WHITE Milano, including Nuvola, a fashion accessories fair, and More, a beauty and lifestyle fair. Located in the Tortona Fashion District, they came together to reaffirm the area as an important cultural destination for the fashion industry. At the WHITE Box space, an open structure allowed local fashion enthusiasts as well as buyers and journalists to freely explore new trends and unreleased products in the contemporary scene. Designers in the line-up also harnessed this dynamic setting, bringing their artistic vision to life through unique booth displays that challenged the rigid catwalk format.Within the program, wearable art brand Art Ophera led the immersive set-up with airbrush customization. Similarly, Butish, an Italian streetwear label, added crystals to its latest pieces, while creative platform WNLAB hosted workshops on sewing and tote bag painting. Outside, Lotta’s “Low Life on Wheels” truck took retail to another level with a multifunctional space featuring a rotating line-up of brands, such as Grocerybags and Papa Ghana, as well as Twitch live streams, art, and music. These booths revolved around a central site-specific installation by Milanese artist Gioele Corradengo, better known as Sexsdreams. Promoting a new collection of limited-edition bear toys, he showcased a large-scale “Crying Teddy” inflatable and also applied live artwork to attendees’ clothing so no one left empty-handed.Take a look back at the debut WHITE Box show in the gallery above. Find out more about WHITE Milano events on its website now. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Josh Hart Doesn’t Believe in Luck, Only “I Will”
items.text: Josh Hart Doesn’t Believe in Luck, Only “I Will” Josh Hart was the glue guy on the 2026 champion Knicks, a starting shooting guard whose rebounding, defensive versatility, and perimeter shooting held the rotation together. In the series-clinching 94-90 win that ended New York's 53-year title drought, the Maryland native put up 13 points and 11 rebounds. Ask him how it happened and he'll point to the work.Basketball takes up most of the 31-year-old's year, but his off-seasons have gradually pulled him into fashion. In the summer of 2024, David Yurman signed Hart alongside Seth Curry, Kyle Kuzma, Jaime Jaquez Jr., D'Angelo Russell, Kevin Love, and Jalen Green for the jeweler's first major partnership with NBA players. This summer, after the title run, Tommy Hilfiger welcomed him into its "Tommy Family" at a small celebration in New York City.As a kid, Hart watched the athletes he idolized star in blue-chip commercials and told himself, "I will make it happen." Years later, with ambassador roles at two major brands and a front-row seat at Hilfiger's Spring 2027 ready-to-wear show during New York Fashion Week, he's still a little stunned at how it played out: "It's crazy that everything kind of came full circle.""The root of “I Will” is about silencing the doubters." — Josh HartOff the court, Hart's style is effortless, polished, tailored streetwear, and he matches his fragrance to the season as deliberately as he does his clothes. The summer off-season calls for white tees, sneakers, and something light and floral. Once basketball season and its tunnel walks come around, he moves into peacoats, slacks, Chelsea boots, and loafers, with vanilla and amber to match. That routine took years to build. In middle school, he emptied cans of Axe like every other kid, and one of his first real fragrances was a gift from his mother, tucked inside a little cigar case. It wasn't until college that he started taking scent seriously and building a rotation so he wouldn't "just smell like outside."Hart has spent his career fielding the same doubts: whether he can knock down open shots, what he'll do when a defense sticks a center on him. His answer never changes: he'll figure it out, and the work will get him there. It's a mindset that fits the fragrance he's now fronting as Armani Beauty's newest ambassador. The new "I Will" Eau de Parfum draws on Giorgio Armani's own story of building a fashion house through sheer persistence and pitches masculinity as something quietly ear

items.title: Mr. Bailey Launches Terracotta Collection That's Built For The Future
items.text: Mr. Bailey Launches Terracotta Collection That's Built For The Future After six years of exploring craft, longevity and modular construction in partnership with HLT+ and Vibram, London-based designer and founder of CONCEPT(K) Mr. Bailey has released its newest collection, Terracotta.Inspired by the fractured geometry of dried earth, Terracotta focuses on longevity by reinterpreting repairable footwear. Within the soles of each shoe lie three distinctive layers built with the purpose of renewing the components that are exposed to the most use and naturally wear down over time. Central to Mr. Bailey’s mission is extending the lifespan of every creation, making each shoe pass through generations and accumulate years of wear.Maintaining durability is integral to their design, preserving elements that give the shoes an independent uniqueness and mold with the wearer over time. Breaking down the internal design construction of the sole includes a permanent structural outsole, an EVA compression layer that provides ultimate cushioning, and a replaceable Vibram ground layer that forms the external contact surface of the shoe. Every pair is provided with an additional set of replacement Vibram ground components, alongside benefits including access to sole repair services that help the shoes perform at their optimal capacity.The first Terracotta collection includes three key silhouettes. Functional and distinctive in design, the Hiker is a mid-cut style that features Loop Back lacing that wraps around metal hardware to maintain tension around the foot when in use, inspired by early ski and Alpine footwear. The Terracotta Derby references traditional Alpine Haferlschuh through asymmetric side-lacing, while the Mule takes a very simplistic approach with a slip-on function. Each one is crafted using a leather upper as well as the highly anticipated, interchangeable sole system. Putting durability at the forefront to allow this collection to last a lifetime.Check out the shoes in the gallery above and head to Mr. Bailey's Instagram for updates. items.title: Havaianas and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed Top Toe Mule
items.text: Havaianas and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed Top Toe Mule Summary Havaianas and Zellerfeld have expanded their partnership with the launch of the 3D-printed Top Toe MuleThe hybrid silhouette fuses classic flip-flop straps with an enclosed toe and seamless single-piece constructionThe model debuts on October 5 at Dover Street Market ahead of a global launch on October 14 Havaianas and footwear technology company Zellerfeld have officially introduced the Top Toe Mule, marking the Brazilian brand’s first entry into the hybrid mule category. Following their initial sold-out release, the new silhouette reimagines Havaianas' signature design language through Zellerfeld's advanced 3D-printing technology.The Top Toe Mule bridges traditional sandal elements with a closed-toe aesthetic. Engineered as a single continuous piece without stitching or glue, the shoe preserves Havaianas' signature V-shaped strap and toe-post identity while adding a fully enclosed front section for increased protection and versatility. Subtle side cut-outs are incorporated into the upper, designed specifically to encourage styling alongside Havaianas' split-toe sock collection.Utilizing Zellerfeld’s 3D-printing process, the complete shape, structure, and cushioning are integrated into one continuous form. The silhouette debuts across five distinct colorways, ranging from understated neutral shades of oat, black, and stone to bright lilac and yellow options.The Havaianas x Zellerfeld Top Toe Mule launches on October 5, 2026, exclusively at Dover Street Market Paris, London, and New York stores and online. Pre-orders open via Havaianas Europe ahead of the official launch on October 14, 2026, across Havaianas retail locations and Zellerfeld. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ERL Unveils the Vamps Silhouette in "Chocolate Brown"
items.text: ERL Unveils the Vamps Silhouette in "Chocolate Brown" Summary ERL has introduced a rich Chocolate Brown iteration of its signature Vamps silhouetteThe sneaker features a premium cowhide leather upper paired with plush terry lining and an internal sculpted structureDesign details include a two-tone translucent gum sole and cream laces with silicone tips ERL has officially showcased the ERL Vamps in a rich "Chocolate Brown" colorway. Designed in Venice Beach, California, the distinct footwear silhouette combines high-grade materials with an internal sculpted framework to create a bold, voluminous aesthetic.The low-top silhouette is constructed with a rich chocolate brown cowhide leather upper, lined with plush terry cloth engineered for high-level comfort. Its internal sculpted structure shapes the signature Vamps outline, giving the shoe its pronounced and distinctive shape.Underfoot, the design is grounded by a two-tone translucent gum outsole featuring stamped ERL branding. Contrast elements arrive via cream ERL shoelaces finished with silicone tips, completing the California brand's latest footwear offering.The ERL Vamps in "Chocolate Brown" is now available online. items.title: Zara and John Galliano Launch Debut "Re{form}" Vol. 1 Collection
items.text: Zara and John Galliano Launch Debut "Re{form}" Vol. 1 Collection Summary Zara and John Galliano have officially released their debut collaborative collection titled Re{form} Vol 1The genderless lineup uses couture techniques to dismantle and reassemble archival Zara garmentsShot by Steven Meisel the inaugural drop is available now via Zara's webstore Zara and legendary couturier John Galliano have officially launched their inaugural collaboration, introducing a genderless collection titled "Re{form}" Vol. 1. Captured in a campaign shot by photographer Steven Meisel, the release sees archival Zara garments dismantled, distorted, and reconstructed through high-fashion couture techniques.Functioning as a creative exchange between the former Maison Margiela creative director and Zara’s historical wardrobe archives, the collection treats mass-market pieces as raw prototypes. Galliano cuts, splices, shrinks, and reassembles foundational garments into entirely new silhouettes. Conceptually, the design language draws inspiration from "Les Incroyables" and "Les Merveilleuses" of post-Revolutionary France, alongside elements of traditional gardening wardrobes and film noir aesthetics.Key transformations throughout the lineup reimagine staple items in unexpected ways. An oversized Zara button-up shirt features a foil print designed to resemble a leather coat, while a lace shift dress is repurposed into a ruffled collar. Elsewhere, tailored jackets incorporate re-positioned pockets for an expressive attitude, and multi-layered dresses are engineered to create the visual illusion of structured coats.The Zara by John Galliano "Re{form}" Vol. 1 collection is available now via Zara. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Samsung Launches the Galaxy Buds On, Its First Open-Ear Clip-Style Earbuds, in South Korea
items.text: Samsung Launches the Galaxy Buds On, Its First Open-Ear Clip-Style Earbuds, in South Korea Summary Samsung enters the open-ear audio market with the Galaxy Buds On, a new clip-style silhouette launching in South KoreaThe design leaves the ear canal open and utilizes a TwinBoost speaker system to push bass and combat sound leakageEcosystem perks include Gemini Live support and hands-free head gestures for call control Samsung announced the Galaxy Buds On as the brand's first open-ear clip-style earbuds for the South Korean market. This release, scheduled for October 27 in a single black colorway, signals an aesthetic and functional shift for the manufacturer. The device costs ₩299,000 KRW, which is approximately $220 USD. Samsung designed the silhouette to leave the ear canal open for consumers who prefer not to use traditional earbuds.The physical architecture of the Galaxy Buds On utilizes a structural clip-on design that latches onto the ear. Designers built the device with a wide contact area to distribute pressure across the band and ensure comfort. Internal hardware upgrades compensate for the audio bleed inherent to open-ear designs. A proprietary TwinBoost speaker system increases bass output to address sound leakage. This audio engine works with an automatic volume adjustment function that responds to environmental noise.Smart functionalities are accessed through tactile touch controls on the back of each earbud. A dedicated voice-isolating feature assists with call clarity during communication. Compatible Galaxy devices unlock exclusive ecosystem perks when paired with the hardware. Users gain access to hands-free call control via head gestures and support for Gemini Live. A Quick Voice Memo feature activates by pressing and holding the touch area. An external charging case houses the technology.While the October 27 launch remains exclusive to South Korea, the broader strategy extends further. Samsung confirmed plans for a global rollout of the Galaxy Buds On to reach a wider audience. The company has not announced specific international regions, upcoming release dates or localized pricing. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Peacock's 'Fast & Furious' TV Series Eyed for 2028 Debut
items.text: Peacock's 'Fast & Furious' TV Series Eyed for 2028 Debut Summary Peacock has officially greenlit a new live-action scripted television series set in the 'Fast & Furious' universeVin Diesel serves as executive producer alongside co-showrunners Mike Daniels and Wolfe ColemanThe series is aiming for a 2028 premiere to align with the release of the upcoming feature film 'Fast Forever' Peacock has officially given a series order to a new live-action scripted television show set within the Fast & Furious universe. The project brings the long-running action franchise to television, eyeing a targeted premiere window in 2028.The series is executive produced by franchise star Vin Diesel through One Race, alongside Sam Vincent, Neal H. Moritz, Pavun Shetty, Jeff Kirschenbaum, and veteran franchise writer Chris Morgan. Mike Daniels (Sons of Anarchy) and Wolfe Coleman (911: Lone Star) are set to serve as co-showrunners, pilot writers, and executive producers for the Universal Television production.Peacock is aiming to premiere the series in 2028 to coincide with the arrival of Fast Forever, the next feature film installment in the franchise scheduled for theatrical release on March 17, 2028. The development expands on Diesel’s prior announcement during NBCUniversal's upfront presentation, marking the franchise's formal push into live-action episodic storytelling.The Fast & Furious television series is targeted to premiere on Peacock in 2028. items.text: Kiko Kostadinov and Oakley Unveil Collaborative Ellipse Eyewear Summary Kiko Kostadinov and Oakley have partnered on a collaborative interpretation of the Ellipse eyewear silhouetteDebuted during the AW26 Womenswear runway show in Paris the sunglasses feature wood grain and feather applicationsThe collection launched globally on October 1 in two distinct colorways with Prizm Bronze lenses Kiko Kostadinov and Oakley have officially presented their latest collaborative project, offering a distinct interpretation of the Oakley Ellipse frame. First debuted during the Fall/Winter 2026 Womenswear runway show in Paris, the joint design translates outdoor-inspired motifs into a forward-thinking eyewear piece.Drawing visual inspiration from nature, the frame's two distinct colorways—"Brown Smoke Wood" and "Amherst Fade"—translate organic feather and wood grain textures directly onto the silhouette. Constructed from Oakley's signature lightweight O Matter™ material, the frames are paired with no-slip Unobtainium® earsocks and customizable Unobtainium® nose pieces to ensure secure, all-day wearability.Technologically, the Ellipse frame utilizes PhysioMorphic™ Geometry to achieve its distinctive, fluid lens curvature. Both colorways are fitted with Oakley's Prizm™ Lens Technology in a Bronze tint, optimizing contrast and visual clarity while seamlessly completing the natural, outdoor-focused aesthetic.The Kiko Kostadinov x Oakley Ellipse has officially launched globally online. items.title: Sia Sells 50% Stake in Music Catalog to Pophouse in $180 Million USD Deal
items.text: Sia Sells 50% Stake in Music Catalog to Pophouse in $180 Million USD Deal Summary Sia has sold a 50% stake in her publishing and master music catalog to Sweden-based investment firm Pophouse for $180 million USDThe transaction covers iconic hits including Chandelier Titanium and Cheap Thrills alongside future creative projectsThe acquisition was completed through Pophouse Fund I which previously raised over €1.2 billion EUR in total capital Pophouse Entertainment has officially acquired a 50% stake in the publishing and master music rights of Australian singer-songwriter Sia in a deal valued at $180 million USD. The partnership sees the Sweden-based entertainment and music investment firm step in to steward her body of work while developing new creative ventures surrounding her discography.The $180 million USD transaction encompasses major milestones across Sia's catalog, including chart-topping tracks like "Chandelier," "Titanium," "Cheap Thrills," "Unstoppable," and "Elastic Heart." According to reports, $165 million USD of the payment applies to works composed prior to her marriage to Dan Bernad, while $15 million USD for songs written during their marriage will be held in escrow until divorce terms are finalized.Reflecting on the milestone partnership, Sia expressed her enthusiasm for the collaboration: “I’m really excited to be working with Pophouse. These songs mean so much to me, and I love that they really understand that and want to take care of them. I’ve been making music for a very long time now, and it feels exciting to think about all the new and different ways these songs might get to live on and find people. I’m really looking forward to seeing what we can dream up together.”The acquisition was financed through Pophouse Fund I, which closed reaching its €1 billion EUR hard cap alongside additional co-investment vehicles bringing total capital raised to over €1.2 billion EUR. Co-founded by ABBA’s Bjorn Ulvaeus, Pophouse’s high-profile holdings also feature catalogs from Iron Maiden, Tina Turner, Kiss, Cyndi Lauper, Avicii, and Swedish House Mafia.Further creative developments and brand ventures under the new partnership are expected to be announced by Sia and Pophouse. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Sony Releases QSSR AI Upscaling for the Base PS5, Bringing Sharper Visuals Without a Pro Upgrade
items.text: Sony Releases QSSR AI Upscaling for the Base PS5, Bringing Sharper Visuals Without a Pro Upgrade Summary Sony drops QSSR, bringing AI-driven upscaling directly to the base PlayStation 5 architectureThe AMD-backed tech arrives first on 'Marvel’s Wolverine' and 'Ghost of Yōtei' via October 1 patchesQSSR offers a software-level alternative to the hardware-accelerated upscaling previously locked behind the premium PS5 Pro Sony officially leveled the playing field for the base console generation with the launch of Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR). This AI graphics upscaling technology is engineered specifically for the standard PlayStation 5. The current console life cycle has been consistently held back by low resolution outputs and poor upscaling solutions because the original architecture lacks dedicated machine learning chips. Sony bridges that gap by providing a scalable software alternative to the hardware-accelerated upscaling previously locked behind the premium Pro model. Project Amethyst served as the internal banner for the breakthrough partnership with AMD.PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) remains the gold standard according to official brand statements. Because the base hardware is missing dedicated machine learning silicon, QSSR operates at a slightly slower pace than its Pro-level counterpart. Standard rigs can expect the technology to hit an upscaled 1440p resolution instead of pushing the upscaled 4K visuals seen on advanced hardware. Principal graphics R&D engineer Daniel Craig stressed that developers must stay flexible to maximize the software. Studios carefully tune their render resolutions alongside presentation targets based on the active graphics mode.Implementing the upgrade is designed to be largely frictionless for the industry despite the required tuning. Quick Spectral Super Resolution acts as a straightforward drop-in replacement for any title that already supports PSSR. Sony confirmed the toolkit will be offered broadly to all developers moving forward. The rollout officially kicked off on October 1 when Marvel’s Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei became the first games to receive patches. Video demonstrations of the two titles utilizing the update highlighted a visual presentation with slightly sharper graphics across the board.Heavyweight attention is already following the immediate impact of the update across the technical gaming space. items.title: Technics' EAH-A1000 Is a Hi-Fi Speaker Squeezed Into a Pair of Headphones
items.text: Technics' EAH-A1000 Is a Hi-Fi Speaker Squeezed Into a Pair of Headphones Summary Technics has unveiled the EAH-A1000, a new flagship wireless over-ear built around a newly developed 40 mm Magnetic Fluid DriverSpeaker-derived tech including an SST Edge and a cone-shaped carbon fiber diaphragm targets lower distortion and a bigger soundstageA new Flow Arm design, re-engineered fit and up to 45 hours of playback round out the package in Black and a new Platinum Greige Technics has introduced the EAH-A1000, its new flagship wireless headphones, centered on a newly developed 40 mm Magnetic Fluid Driver. The over-ear model pulls acoustic engineering from the brand's speaker division into personal audio, pairing it with a next-generation Adaptive Noise Cancelling system and a newly designed Flow Arm headband.The driver is the core of the build. Bigger drivers deliver more scale, but they are also harder to keep in check, since any tilt, wobble or bending in the diaphragm translates into distortion. Technics' answer is magnetic fluid, a material that behaves as both a magnet and a liquid. Sitting between the voice coil and the driver magnet, it steadies the diaphragm's motion and dampens stray vibration. The approach isn't new to the brand, which previously used magnetic fluid tech in its in-ear models, including the EAH-TZ700 and EAH-AZ100, but this marks its jump to a full-size over-ear driver.Supporting that driver is an SST (Symmetrical Surround Technology) Edge, a component lifted from Technics' Hi-Fi flagship speakers. By making the surround's forward and backward travel more symmetrical as it holds the diaphragm, the edge cuts down on distortion. The diaphragm itself is carbon fiber, chosen for being light and stiff, and shaped as a cone to resist flexing across its larger surface. Technics labels it "Pure Carbon Fiber," a term the brand uses to describe a non-composite, non-laminated construction rather than one made solely from carbon fiber. The combined goal is fast, stable driver response that keeps bass weighty and the soundstage open.The acoustic path has been reworked to protect what the driver produces on its way to the ear. A new Baffle Flat Structure smooths out the surfaces surrounding the driver, cutting reflections that can blur imaging. Behind the driver, an Acoustic Control Chamber regulates airflow to keep low and midrange frequencies in balance so no single band dominates.Noise cancelling is handled by an adaptive system that tunes itself

items.title: A24 Just Dropped the Most Robert Pattinson Collectible Imaginable
items.text: A24 Just Dropped the Most Robert Pattinson Collectible Imaginable Summary A24 has turned Robert Pattinson's run of roles with the studio into a six-piece set of nesting dolls Each doll depicts a different character, spanning The Rover in 2014 through Primetime and The Drama in 2026 The set is made entirely from linden wood and stands 5.75 inches tall A24 is tracking its history with Robert Pattinson with a series of Nesting Dolls that stack six of his characters into a single linden wood set, tracing his work from 2014's The Rover to 2026's Primetime. Released as part of the studio's Primetime merchandise, the collectible turns one of modern cinema's most unpredictable filmographies into a hand-sized object you can open layer by layer.The build keeps things traditional. The set is crafted from 100% linden wood, a soft, fine-grained timber long favored for carving and for Russian matryoshka dolls in particular, and measures 5.75 inches tall. Each of the six figures represents a separate Pattinson role, so the act of unstacking the set becomes a walk through his career.The listing presents the lineup starting with Chris Hansen from Primetime (2026), suggesting he serves as the outermost doll. In the film, Pattinson plays the real-life television journalist Chris Hansen, best known for Dateline's To Catch a Predator segments. Next comes Charlie Thompson from The Drama (2026), the romantic dramedy that paired him with Zendaya.Further in, the dolls move through the run of films that reshaped Pattinson's reputation. There's Ephraim Winslow, who also goes by Thomas Howard, from The Lighthouse (2019), Robert Eggers' black-and-white fever dream opposite Willem Dafoe, and Monte from High Life (2018), Claire Denis' deep-space prison drama. Constantine "Connie" Nikas from the Safdie brothers' Good Time (2017) follows, with Reynolds "Rey" from David Michôd's The Rover (2014) at the core of the set.Taken together, the six characters map the period when Pattinson moved away from blockbuster franchise fame and toward auteur-driven, often deliberately unglamorous roles, a pivot that made him one of A24's most recognizable faces. Packing that arc into a matryoshka format fits the idea neatly: each performance sits inside the next, building into a single career-spanning object.The Robert Pattinson Nesting Dolls are available now as an early access preorder via the A24 Shop. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Nike Dunk Low "Shibuya Halloween" Has Eyes in the Back of Its Head
items.text: The Nike Dunk Low "Shibuya Halloween" Has Eyes in the Back of Its Head Name: Nike Dunk Low “Shibuya Halloween”Colorway: Bog Green/Bog Green-Black-Luminous GreenSKU: IX5169-300MSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: October 2026Where to Buy: NikeThe Nike Dunk Low "Shibuya Halloween" is set to join the brand's Halloween 2026 collection, bringing its Tokyo-inspired Shibuya theme to the Dunk for the first time. The pair keeps its palette moody and restrained, saving its spookiest tricks for the heel and the outsole.The upper is built around a Bog Green and black colorway, with black taking up much of the shoe and the green reading as a deep, swampy olive. Croc-textured leather appears across sections of the upper, giving the panels a scaly, reptilian surface that suits the seasonal theme and adds tactile contrast to the smooth leather elsewhere.The heel is where the design turns playful. A set of eyes sits near the back of the shoe, watching from behind as the wearer walks. The detail is small enough that the Dunk still wears like a dark everyday pair from most angles, with the Halloween reference revealing itself only on a closer look.Underfoot, the outsole uses a glow-in-the-dark finish that lights up after exposure to darkness. The official colorway name includes Luminous Green, which appears to point to that glowing sole unit, turning the bottom of the shoe into the pair's most dramatic feature after dark.Inside, "SBY" is printed on the insoles as a shorthand for Shibuya. Nike used the same abbreviation in 2019 across three Air Force 1 releases tied to the neighborhood, two centered on Shibuya itself and a third that also leaned into Halloween, so the insole branding gives this Dunk a direct link to that earlier run. items.title: Moncler Grenoble Summits Switzerland’s Engadin Valley for Its Fall/Winter 2027 Reveal
items.text: Moncler Grenoble Summits Switzerland’s Engadin Valley for Its Fall/Winter 2027 Reveal Summary Moncler Grenoble is heading to Switzerland's Engadin Valley to present its Fall/Winter 2027 collection on February 6, 2027The show forms the centerpiece of a weekend-long celebration of mountain landscape, culture and lifestyleThe collection promises to fuse technical performance with high style, building on the label's mountain heritage Moncler Grenoble will unveil its Fall/Winter 2027 collection in Switzerland's Engadin Valley on February 6, 2027, staging the reveal at an intimate location that remains undisclosed. Rather than a conventional runway moment, the presentation will anchor a full weekend built around life in the Alps.The setting is a deliberate fit for a line built for altitude. Moncler Grenoble is the house's dedicated skiwear and mountain performance label, and its name nods to the 1968 Winter Olympics in Grenoble, where Moncler outfitted the French national ski team. The brand itself traces back to 1952, when it was founded in Monestier-de-Clermont, a mountain village outside Grenoble.The Engadin is also familiar territory. The valley is home to St. Moritz, where Moncler Grenoble has previously staged runway presentations set against snow-covered terrain. Returning to the region keeps the label's major moments rooted in the landscape its clothing is designed to handle.As for the collection itself, the brand is positioning Fall/Winter 2027 at the meeting point of high performance and high style. It describes the range as drawing on the research, ideas and passion accumulated across its history, pairing a respect for mountain heritage with a push toward what comes next in technical outerwear.The weekend format reinforces that message. By surrounding the show with the culture and lifestyle of the alpine world, Moncler Grenoble is presenting the collection as part of a broader mountain way of life rather than as product alone. Details on materials, construction and silhouettes have not yet been released, and the exact venue is being kept private ahead of the event.Moncler Grenoble unveils its Fall/Winter 2027 collection in Switzerland's Engadin Valley on February 6, 2027. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: mfpen Fall/Winter 2026 Collection Looks Like It Has Already Lived a Full Life
items.text: mfpen Fall/Winter 2026 Collection Looks Like It Has Already Lived a Full Life Summary mfpen's Fall/Winter 2026 collection is built around garments designed to look and feel as though they have been worn for yearsSharp tailoring is roughed up with utilitarian outerwear, washed denim, soft knits and weathered leatherThe materials lean into visible age, from pilled bouclé jersey to brushed and faded organic cotton denim mfpen has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, a co-ed offering that treats signs of wear as a design feature. The season takes familiar wardrobe staples and nudges them slightly off their usual course, so each piece reads as recognizable but quietly out of place, as if pulled from someone else's past.The fabric choices do most of the storytelling. Overcoats are cut from soft recycled wool, while the denim uses organic cotton that has been brushed and faded to suggest seasons of washing. Jersey arrives in bouclé with a deliberately pilled surface, and black leather carries scratches across its face. Rather than chasing a pristine finish, every material is treated to look handled, aged and moved in.Construction follows the same logic. Refined tailoring forms the backbone of the collection, but it is never left to stand on its own. Instead, it is paired with hardworking outerwear, washed denim, soft knitwear and worn leather, so a sharply cut piece might sit against something rugged or relaxed. The mix is intentional, making the wardrobe feel gathered piece by piece over time instead of designed as a single matched set.Texture and silhouette carry the contrast. Smooth wool meets nubby bouclé, structured shapes meet looser layers, and the scuffed leather and faded denim add grit to the cleaner tailored pieces. Each garment hints at its own backstory, while the styling lets those different histories overlap, building a sense of character through accumulation rather than polish.The approach sits squarely within the label's broader focus on reworking classic garments with relaxed proportions and a commitment to responsible production, reflected here in the recycled wool and organic cotton. The collection was photographed in Paris on a cold, clear midwinter morning by Isak Berglund Mattsson-Mårn. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Paramount Releases New 'Ebenezer' Trailer From Director Ti West
items.text: Paramount Releases New 'Ebenezer' Trailer From Director Ti West Summary Paramount Pictures has released the second trailer for Ti West's upcoming film 'Ebenezer'Johnny Depp stars as Scrooge in a dark horror-infused take on Charles Dickens' 'A Christmas Carol'The feature marks Depp's first Hollywood studio film in eight years and hits theaters on November 13 Paramount Pictures and director Ti West have released a new official trailer for Ebenezer, a dark reimagining of Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol. The film stars Johnny Depp as Ebenezer Scrooge, marking the actor's first major Hollywood studio release in eight years.Guided by the logline "The name you know, the story you don't," the new trailer highlights Ti West's signature horror aesthetic—best known from his X trilogy—by leaning into the darker elements of the classic holiday tale. The footage captures Depp's Scrooge facing terrifying spectral apparitions alongside a harrowing sequence depicting him buried alive.The film features a notable ensemble cast alongside Depp, including Ian McKellen, Daisy Ridley, Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, and Tramell Tillman. Marking Depp's return to studio cinema since 2018's Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald, the actor will follow up the release with Lionsgate's Day Drinker in March 2027.Ebenezer releases in theaters on November 13, 2026. items.title: Peacock Taps Eddie Murphy for Upcoming Drama Series 'The Chairman'
items.text: Peacock Taps Eddie Murphy for Upcoming Drama Series 'The Chairman' Summary Eddie Murphy is attached to star in a new drama series in development at Peacock titled 'The Chairman'The project is created by 'Mad Men' showrunner Matthew Weiner and produced by Universal Television alongside 101 StudiosIf officially greenlit the show will mark Murphy's first-ever live-action scripted television role Peacock is currently developing an original drama series titled The Chairman, set to star comedy legend Eddie Murphy. The project is created by Mad Men showrunner Matthew Weiner, marking Murphy's first live-action scripted television role if officially ordered to series.While specific storyline details remain under wraps, the series is being produced by Universal Television alongside David Glasser’s 101 Studios. The Chairman also serves as the first project to originate from former Paramount executive Chris McCarthy's consulting deal with NBCUniversal. Both Murphy and Weiner are attached as executive producers.The venture pairs two influential creative figures. Murphy’s career spans four decades of landmark work across stand-up, Saturday Night Live, and blockbuster feature films like Beverly Hills Cop and Coming to America. Meanwhile, Weiner is best known as the creator and showrunner of AMC's acclaimed drama Mad Men, as well as a writer and executive producer on HBO's The Sopranos.Development on The Chairman remains underway, with further announcements regarding production timelines expected as the project progresses. items.title: Bradley Cooper Cast as Duke in Paramount's 'G.I. Joe' Reboot Directed by Danny McBride
items.text: Bradley Cooper Cast as Duke in Paramount's 'G.I. Joe' Reboot Directed by Danny McBride Summary Bradley Cooper will star as field commander Duke in a new live-action 'G.I. Joe' reboot from Paramount PicturesThe film is directed by Danny McBride, who co-wrote the script alongside Jeff Fradley and John CarcieriParamount has officially uncoupled the 'G.I. Joe' franchise from its previously teased Transformers crossover Paramount Pictures has officially cast Bradley Cooper as field commander Duke in its upcoming G.I. Joe film reboot. The project is set to be directed by Danny McBride, who also co-wrote the screenplay alongside Jeff Fradley and John Carcieri to deliver a fresh take on the iconic Hasbro toy line.While specific plot details and additional casting remain under wraps, the upcoming feature marks McBride’s first major action tentpole as a director following his work on HBO series such as The Righteous Gemstones and Vice Principals. Paramount confirmed that this new standalone iteration has been officially "uncoupled" from the Transformers universe, setting aside the crossover concept previously teased at the end of 2023's Transformers: Rise of the Beasts.Produced by Lorenzo di Bonaventura, Mark Vahradian, and Zev Foreman for Hasbro Entertainment, the project adds to a major slate of IP revivals at Paramount. Cooper, a 12-time Oscar nominee, takes on the iconic leadership role while currently in production on an Ocean's 11 prequel that he is directing and starring in alongside Margot Robbie and Monica Barbaro.Release date and production details for Paramount's G.I. Joe reboot are expected to be announced in the coming months. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike Toughens Up the Vomero 5 for Winter With a Cordura "Camo Green" Build
items.text: Nike Toughens Up the Vomero 5 for Winter With a Cordura "Camo Green" Build Name: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cordura “Camo Green”Colorway: TBCSKU: IQ0380-300MSRP: $170 USDRelease Date: Holiday 2026The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cordura "Camo Green" is gearing up for Holiday 2026, marking what looks to be the silhouette's first outing in Cordura. The update brings a more rugged material to the runner's well-known panel layout, giving fans a tougher cold-weather option without changing the shape that made the shoe a street favorite.Cordura is the headline upgrade. The textile is a high-tenacity nylon prized for abrasion resistance and long used in military gear, packs and workwear, and here it is mapped onto essentially the same layout the Vomero 5 uses in its warm-weather versions. The result is added insulation and resilience for wet, cold days, while the overlays, sculpted midsole and overall proportions stay recognizably Vomero.The colorway keeps things grounded. "Camo Green" and "Neutral Olive" cover much of the upper in earthy, outdoorsy tones, with Anthracite and Black also listed in the full colorway name. Against that muted base, orange flashes at the eyelets and on the embroidered branding provide the pair's main pop of color, giving the dark palette a sharp, utilitarian edge.The Cordura version also fills a gap in the Vomero 5's winter options. At the end of 2024, Nike introduced the Vomero 5 Roam, a spin-off that went all in on weatherproofing with nylon base layers, rubber foxing that wraps around the shoe and beefed-up traction. That approach reshaped the look of the model considerably. This new build lands between the two, adding protection through material choice alone while leaving the silhouette's design language untouched.It's a logical move for a shoe that has become one of the defining faces of Nike's mesh runner wave. Originally a late-2000s performance running model, the Vomero 5 was revived as a lifestyle staple and grew into one of the Swoosh's most recognizable silhouettes. A Cordura upper gives that everyday popularity a way to carry through the colder months, rather than leaving the shoe on the shelf until spring. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Raymond Weil Expands Its Anniversary Story With the Limited-Edition Millesime Jubilee Watch
items.text: Raymond Weil Expands Its Anniversary Story With the Limited-Edition Millesime Jubilee Watch Summary Raymond Weil marks its 50th anniversary with the millesime Jubilee chronograph.The 39mm steel watch features a light-blue bi-compax dial and RW5030 movement.Limited to 500 pieces, it is priced at $4,275 USD. Raymond Weil is continuing its 50th-anniversary celebrations with the new Millesime Jubilee, a limited-edition automatic chronograph that follows the ultra-exclusive The Fifty unveiled at Watches & Wonders earlier this year. Founded in Geneva in 1976, the independent, family-owned watchmaker has been revisiting its history throughout 2026 via its travelling Legacy Tour, and Jubilee translates the anniversary story into a more widely available proposition. Where The Fifty was restricted to 50 examples powered by restored, hand-decorated Valjoux 23-6 movements dating from 1976, Jubilee is limited to 500 pieces, carrying forward its predecessor’s neo-vintage design language within the contemporary millesime collection.The watch is housed in a 39mm stainless steel case measuring 12.9mm thick, with a sapphire glassbox crystal accentuating the layered construction of its light-blue dial. Two midnight-blue, azurage-finished subdials establish the bi-compax chronograph layout, complemented by a silver-toned chapter ring, textured central section and an applied “EST 1976” cartouche referencing the Maison’s founding year. Black hour markers and obelisk-shaped hour and minute hands feature green-glowing Super-LumiNova, while a midnight-blue calfskin strap completes the restrained color palette. Inside is the self-winding RW5030 chronograph calibre, delivering a 62-hour power reserve and visible through a sapphire caseback; the watch is also water-resistant to 50 meters.The millesime Jubilee was officially unveiled in Sydney, the seventh stop of Raymond Weil’s 2026 Legacy Tour, which will subsequently travel to Singapore and Paris as the brand’s anniversary program approaches its conclusion. The timepiece is limited to 500 individually numbered examples and carries an official retail price of $4,275 USD. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ISSEY MIYAKE SS27 Is a Breath of Fresh Air
items.text: ISSEY MIYAKE SS27 Is a Breath of Fresh Air Summary Issey Miyake's Spring/Summer 2027 collection, "Figure of Ma," interprets the Japanese idea of meaningful negative space as the air between fabric and body.Ballooning trench coats, plaster-inspired tops, mesh knit capris, signature pleated pieces and a Camper footwear collaboration all shift shape with the wearer, moving with the body rather than confining it. Built around “Ma”, the Japanese aesthetic concept of meaningful negative space between elements, Issey Miyake’s Spring/Summer 2027 collection interprets “Ma” as the air and space between fabric and the body. Satoshi Kondo, the Japanese house’s head designer and art director since 2019, debuted the latest collection, “Figure of Ma”, with an all-black set at the Judo Institute during Paris Fashion Week. The show opened in silence, with a single dancer draped in beige pleats, then a troupe introduced a giant cloud-like billowing fabric that unveiled a collection of sculptural yet featherlight tops, voluminous ultra-light outerwear that catches the wind, and vibrant signature pleats.The collection introduced rounded silhouettes, airy volumes, and surfaces that morphed with the wearer’s every movement. Each piece captured air and shifted shape with the wearer's movement — ballooning trench coats in purple and black, torso-molded plaster gauze-inspired sleeveless tops, textured mesh knit capris, a puffed-shoulder plisse skirt, and patterned pleated outerwear. Also revealed were buttery leather bags, floppy pleated headwear, and a footwear collaboration with Camper. Issey Miyake's “Figure of Ma” collection moves with the body rather than confining it. Sleeves and hems moved as the models did, billowing and deflating like breathing, taking a new form as fabric met the body, turning tailored silhouettes into dynamic expressions of “Ma”. items.title: Saint Laurent Presents a Golden SS27 & NikeSKIMS Opens Shanghai Pop-up in This Week's Top Fashion News
items.text: Saint Laurent Presents a Golden SS27 & NikeSKIMS Opens Shanghai Pop-up in This Week's Top Fashion News SummaryGlobal retail footprints are expanding with NikeSKIMS and Ann Demeulemeester opening new physical destinations.High-profile collaborations dominated this week, including Zara x John Galliano, Zendaya x On, and Kader Sylla's adidas signature shoe.Saint Laurent's golden SS27 runway show fueled rumors of Anthony Vaccarello’s potential departure.Anthony Vaccarello Drapes Saint Laurent in Gold for SS27Anthony Vaccarello presented Saint Laurent’s Women’s Spring/Summer 2027 collection in Paris, taking over the Trocadéro beneath the Eiffel Tower. The runway show centered entirely on gold — a shade favored by Yves Saint Laurent — to reinterpret the house's archival codes. Vaccarello reimagined foundational archetypes like sahariennes, trench coats, and sharp tailoring through a monochromatic, metallic lens, utilizing materials from organza to gold-leaf-coated latex. The gilded theme extended to filigree accessories and snake-shaped heels before closing with dramatic black velvet tailoring. An intimate final moment, where Vaccarello handed a key to a young boy in the audience, sparked widespread industry speculation that the grand presentation signaled his official exit from the luxury house.NikeSKIMS Debuts First Physical Destination in China With Shanghai Pop-UpNike and SKIMS officially unveiled their joint venture's first physical destination in China. SKIMS Co-Founder Kim Kardashian hosted an early preview of the Shanghai HKRI Taikoo Hui Pop-Up ahead of its late-September opening. The retail space showcases the complete NikeSKIMS Fall Edit 01 collection, spanning apparel, footwear, and accessories. Designed to mirror the joint brand’s aesthetic, the layout integrates custom displays and dedicated lounge areas for try-ons. The Shanghai location also provides localized consumer services, including on-site tailoring. During the preview, Kardashian highlighted the Chinese market's importance for the label's next chapter and detailed her excitement over selecting the Rift as her debut sneaker silhouette. The pop-up remains open through February 2027.Zara and John Galliano Launch Debut "Re{form}" Vol. 1 CollectionZara and couturier John Galliano have officially launched their inaugural collaboration. items.title: Salman Toor Paints the Highs and Lows of Queer Nightlife at London’s Courtauld Gallery
items.text: Salman Toor Paints the Highs and Lows of Queer Nightlife at London’s Courtauld Gallery Summary New York-based Pakistani-American artist unveils his first European solo at Courtauld Gallery in London, open until January 10, 2027The exhibition comprises 19 paintings focused on human connection and belonging, seen through his queer, brown protagonists Making his European debut, Pakistani-American painter Salman Toor lands in London for Someone Like You, his new solo exhibition at the Courtauld Gallery. Featuring 19 of his most iconic works, the presentation gives Britain a deservedly momentous introduction to Toor, who the New York Times dubbed “one of the most fascinating painters of his generation.”For the past decade, the New York-based artist has been redrawing narratives around immigration, desire, and power, placing queer brown men at the center of their own stories. Though the characters are fictional, Toor roots them in his own memories, imbuing them with a diaristic intimacy.But the works are more than odes to queer joy. They “inhabit the tension between intimacy and exposure, belonging and estrangement,” he said. “What it means to find a community, but also the daily costs associated with visibility”. Just as quickly as we succumb to the buzz of Toor’s sumptuously painted club scenes, so lively you can almost hear it, we retreat, with his protagonists, into quieter vignettes of alienation and estrangement. Toor manages a mastery of both the thrills of a night out and its aftermath, awake in the loneliest hours of the night.Zeroing in on human connection through hazy figures, distinctly their own while bleeding into one another. More than they are glamorous, they’re real, caught between the desire to belong while still trying to understand how to feel at home. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Courtauld (@courtauld)Someone Like You is now on view in London until January 10, 2027.Courtauld GallerySomerset House, Strand,London, WC2R 0RN Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: LOEWE Distills a Sporty Spanish Summer for SS27
items.text: LOEWE Distills a Sporty Spanish Summer for SS27 SummaryLOEWE’s SS27 collection delivers wearable, sport-forward apparel emphasizing slick materials, subtle logos, and a bold summer color palette.Standouts include jackets with metallic collars, scuba-style moccasins, and trousers with logos on the flies.At a purpose-built set at Château de Vincennes, Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez presented their third LOEWE collection on October 2. Against the stark white backdrop, the clean yet energetic SS27 collection unfurled, refining their colorful, sport-forward vision of the Spanish label. Across the board, LOEWE introduced a highly wearable lineup characterized by slick materials, a bold summer color palette, and subtle yet interesting logo placements. Rather than ornamentation, the textiles and colors are what made these looks stand out. Minty green, yellow, blue, and red-orange dominated the overall color spectrum of the collection, while summer stripes and florals brought occasional texture. On several looks, where one would expect a leather or corduroy collar, there’s instead a metallic collar with exuberant gradients of orange and blue, matching wrap-style sunglasses styled throughout the show. Other outerwear styles continued to the sport-oriented aesthetic of the previous collections, as seen in a number of shell jackets, utility coats, and anoraks. Notably, small LOEWE tags were sewn onto the flies of pants, offered in turquoise, gray, red, and olive. Discreet LOEWE logos also appeared on the toe box of new scuba-style moccasins, offered in a selection of colors like tan, black, pink, and yellow. The aquatic theme continues in a range of branded leather caps resembling swimming caps.Joining the logo trousers were some more unconventional pant styles featuring blooming flies, flaring out above the waist. The trousers were a bridge to the more revealing looks in womenswear: an ultra-mini leather dress, sheer spaghetti-strap dresses rolled up to the chest, and sheer tank dresses, made in layers of blue, yellow, and red-orange. The show closed with some of the most ornamental pieces, including boucle mini dresses and hotpants with frayed floral embroidery. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Streetsnaps: How Gia Seo Turns the Everyday Target Bag Into Her Main Character Accessory
items.text: Streetsnaps: How Gia Seo Turns the Everyday Target Bag Into Her Main Character Accessory In the landscape of modern styling, few creatives command color, texture, and unexpected proportion quite like Gia Seo. As a creative director, wardrobe stylist, and resident maximalist in New York City, Seo has built a reputation for turning outfit assembly into an art form. Known for her expressive, narrative-first aesthetic, she treats personal style as a continuous conversation between high-end design and everyday utility.Stepping onto the streets of Manhattan, Seo effortlessly integrates Target’s iconic bullseye reusable bag into two distinct, everyday looks. In her first outfit, she leans into classic city tailoring with a twist, pairing a KBB by KAHLANA belted trench coat with a pleated, mixed-pattern plaid midi skirt and sharp black leather boots. Rather than treating the vibrant red-and-white bag as an afterthought, she wears it slung over her shoulder as a graphic anchor that breaks up traditional autumnal tones.For her second look, Seo pivots to a more relaxed, downtown energy. She styles the KBB by KAHLANA low-rise jeans alongside an embroidered cream button-up detailed with black rosettes, accessorizing with studded platform clogs, slim sunglasses, and a green pepper keychain hooked to her belt loop. Here, the red bag acts as a bold pop of color against neutral denim, proving how easily a hyper-functional bag can double as a deliberate statement piece when layered into a well-curated fit.For Seo, a bag’s true value lies in how seamlessly it moves through the chaos of a full city day. Whether she’s carrying fabric swatches between studio visits, grabbing morning coffee, or hauling afternoon market pickups, the canvas bag shifts from pure utility to style component without missing a beat. It’s an approach to dressing that mirrors her broader design philosophy: high-impact style doesn't require overthinking, but just takes the right piece caught in the act of living. items.title: Cult Tokyo Label everyone Is Finally Coming to Hong Kong With a Temporary Brick-and-Mortar at BELOWGROUND
items.text: Cult Tokyo Label everyone Is Finally Coming to Hong Kong With a Temporary Brick-and-Mortar at BELOWGROUND Summary Tokyo label everyone is making its first appearance in Hong Kong with a five-day pop-upTwo tees made only for the city, the ESS Tee and Vincent Logo LS Tee, headline the lineupPieces from A.PRESSE for everyone, adidas Originals, SUICOKE, Erik Schedin and Tomo Nariai fill out the racks Tokyo label everyone is bringing its ESS Tee and Vincent Logo LS Tee to Hong Kong as part of its first pop-up in the city, and neither T-shirt will be sold anywhere else. Founded by Ryo Miyoshi, the brand has made its name on low-key staples where fabric and finish do the talking, and this visit gives local fans their first chance to shop it in person.The two exclusive T-shirts anchor the edit, and the rest of the space is a tight selection of everyone's everyday wardrobe. One standout is the label's easy slacks in Loro Piana fabric, a relaxed trouser in an upgraded material that sums up Miyoshi's approach well.Collaborations make up the next layer. Pieces from A.PRESSE for everyone will be on hand, a fitting addition since the pop-up sits a short walk from the A.Presse Dedicated Space by Gallery HBX in the same building. The label is also bringing its collaborative work with adidas Originals, SUICOKE, Erik Schedin and Tomo Nariai.The timing follows a busy year for the brand. everyone opened a flagship in Maebashi, Miyoshi's hometown, and an atelier in Seijo inside a building designed by Tadao Ando. Its second adidas Originals project put the label's own spin on the Adizero Adios OG runner, and everyone OOAK presented by Casa BRUTUS linked the brand with Min Hee-jin's ooak records.Not everything in the room is for sale. Miyoshi's taste for postmodern design shapes the space, with Ettore Sottsass's Carlton shelving unit, a piece Miyoshi counts among his most treasured, displayed next to Shiro Kuramata's Progetti Compiuti drawers for Cappellini."I’m very happy to bring everyone to Hong Kong for the first time. For me, everyone is about more than just clothes. It’s also about sharing the things we love and creating experiences together. I’m looking forward to meeting everyone in Hong Kong and sharing what we do in Tokyo," Miyoshi said in a statement.The everyone brick-and-mortar is open daily from October 9 to October 13 at BELOWGROUND Hong kong.everyone Temporary StoreShop B57-B58, BELOWGROUNDB1/F, Landmark Atrium15 Queen's Road Central, Hong KongOpening Hours: 10:3

items.title: BEAMS x Lacoste Turned the Iconic Crocodile Into a "BEAMS" Logo for the Label's 50th
items.text: BEAMS x Lacoste Turned the Iconic Crocodile Into a "BEAMS" Logo for the Label's 50th Summary BEAMS has teamed up with Lacoste on a matching Plaid Hooded Jacket and Plaid Pants as part of its 50th anniversary collaborationsBoth pieces use patterns made from scratch for the project, rather than reworked versions of existing Lacoste stylesA plaid built around Lacoste's sportswear look runs across both pieces, finished with a crocodile graphic spelling out "BEAMS" BEAMS and Lacoste have released a Plaid Hooded Jacket and Plaid Pants, a two-piece setup made to celebrate the Japanese retailer's 50th anniversary. Instead of putting a BEAMS label on an existing Lacoste design, the pair built both garments from the pattern up. They share a fabric and a print, so they can be worn as a full set or split up.The print is the main draw. The check is original to the collab, built around the clean, athletic look Lacoste is known for, and it runs across both the jacket and the pants. The other signature detail is a custom graphic that keeps the outline of Lacoste's crocodile emblem and works the "BEAMS" name into it.The jacket is a hooded blouson with a roomy, boxy cut, and the pants follow the same easygoing shape. Worn together, they read as a relaxed, sporty set made for weekends rather than anything tailored. The beige version leans warm and vintage, while the navy is the more understated of the two.The setup sits inside a larger BEAMS x Lacoste capsule that also includes a striped shirt, a long-sleeve polo in heavy piqué and a thermal T-shirt with a logo, all made for the anniversary.The BEAMS x Lacoste Plaid Hooded Jacket and Plaid Pants are available now via the BEAMS online store. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Drake Is Reportedly in the Running to Headline Coachella 2027
items.text: Drake Is Reportedly in the Running to Headline Coachella 2027 Summary Drake is reportedly under consideration as a headliner for Coachella 2027, according to music industry outlet 'HitsDailyDouble''A booking would mark his first time at the top of the bill since he closed out both Sundays of the 2015 editionThe rumored slot would sit alongside a world tour he has already confirmed for 2027 Drake could be lining up a return to Coachella as one of the festival's 2027 headliners, according to a new report. On October 2, HitsDailyDouble said in its HitsList column, a regular roundup of music industry news and gossip, that the rapper is among the names being weighed for the top of next year's bill. Nothing has been confirmed, but the timing lines up neatly with one of the busiest stretches of his career.The report places Drake in early talks rather than in a finalized booking, so the details remain thin. If the slot comes together, it would mean two headlining performances across the festival's back-to-back weekends in Indio, California, adding to a 2027 calendar that already includes a world tour.The rumor comes on the back of a strong 2026. Drake released three albums this year — ICEMAN, MAID OF HONOUR and HABIBTI, and the first of them did most of the chart damage. ICEMAN opened at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 and held the top spot on the Billboard Canadian Albums chart for five weeks. He followed the album run in September with FOMO, an hour-long short film packed with unreleased songs, and four of those tracks reached streaming services on October 2 through the HABIBTI (FOMO) deluxe edition.His history at the festival gives the rumor extra weight. Drake last headlined Coachella in 2015, closing both Sunday nights roughly two months after the release of If You're Reading This It's Too Late. That set covered his whole catalog to that point, and it is still remembered for a surprise appearance from Madonna and the onstage kiss that followed. He returned in 2017, this time as a guest during Future's set, where the pair ran through a few songs including their collaboration "Jumpman."His recent festival work hints at what a 2027 set could look like. When he headlined Wireless Festival in London in 2025, Drake gave each of his three nights its own focus: one for his R&B catalog, one for straight hip-hop and one for his Caribbean-inspired records. His three 2026 albums were split along similar genre lines, which gives him plenty of material if he wants to build two

items.title: iGarden's K70 AI Pool Cleaner Takes Pool Duty Off Your Summer To-Do List
items.text: iGarden's K70 AI Pool Cleaner Takes Pool Duty Off Your Summer To-Do List Summary Fairland Group's outdoor tech arm iGarden has brought its K70 AI Pool Cleaner to Australia just as backyard swim season ramps upAn AI-Inverter system tunes power output to pool conditions, letting the unit run for up to 16 days before it needs rechargingTurbo 200% suction, 22,000 LPH of water flow and a two-stage filter pull in everything from fallen leaves to fine dust iGarden has launched the K70 AI Pool Cleaner in Australia, a robotic cleaner built to take the weekly grind out of pool upkeep. The release comes from Fairland Group's outdoor technology division and lands as the country heads into its warmer months, when backyard pools shift from seasonal fixture to the center of family life and weekend gatherings.The K70 runs on AI-Inverter technology, which reads the state of the pool and dials its power up or down to match. That adaptive approach is what allows the cleaner to keep working for up to 16 days on one charge, so owners can leave it in the water for stretches of the season instead of pulling it out to plug in every few sessions.Coverage is just as thorough. Intelligent navigation guides the unit across the different surfaces of a residential pool, so it reaches the steps, climbs the walls, sweeps the floor and works along the waterline, where grime tends to build up first. The goal is a full-pool clean in one pass rather than a floor-only sweep that leaves the edges to a net and brush.Suction comes from iGarden's Turbo 200% technology paired with water flow rated at up to 22,000 LPH, enough to handle large debris like leaves alongside much finer particles. Everything it picks up passes through a two-stage filter. A 180 μm outer layer catches the bigger material while a 50 μm inner layer traps the fine stuff, and a 4-litre collection basket means fewer stops to empty it mid-clean.Controls stay simple. Instead of routing every setting through a companion app, the K70 places a touchscreen directly on the body of the device, putting its functions within reach at the poolside. For Australian households that treat the backyard as an extension of the living room, the pitch is clear: let the machine handle the scrubbing and spend the summer in the water instead.The iGarden K70 AI Pool Cleaner is available now in Australia via the iGarden Official Store. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Dickies x WACKO MARIA FW26 Unleash a Leopard Active Jacket on Your Workwear Rotation
items.text: Dickies x WACKO MARIA FW26 Unleash a Leopard Active Jacket on Your Workwear Rotation Summary WACKO MARIA and Dickies have lined up a three-piece capsule anchored by a leopard version of the Active Jacket in BeigeThe jacket also arrives in solid Black and Charcoal, with every version cut from 100% cottonPleated Trousers in a polyester and cotton blend complete the lineup across Black, Brown, Charcoal and Ivory WACKO MARIA and Dickies have released a new three-piece capsule led by the Leopard Active Jacket. The drop pairs two takes on the jacket with a set of Pleated Trousers, keeping the focus tight on a top-and-bottom workwear pairing.The Leopard Active Jacket is the statement piece of the set. It comes in a single Beige colorway, letting the animal motif do the talking against a neutral base, and is built entirely from cotton.For those who prefer their outerwear without the print, the standard Active Jacket keeps the same all-cotton makeup and trades the leopard for solid Black or Charcoal. The result is two distinct registers of the same garment: one loud, one built for everyday rotation.The Pleated Trousers shift the fabric story. Instead of pure cotton, they use a 65% polyester and 35% cotton blend, a mix that leans toward durability and easier care in a pant designed for daily wear. The pleated cut gives the trousers a dressier line than a standard work pant, and they have the widest palette in the capsule, available in Black, Brown, Charcoal and Ivory.Taken together, the colorways are designed to cross over. Both Black and Charcoal appear on the solid jacket and the trousers, making it easy to run the pieces as a matching set, while the Beige leopard jacket sits naturally over the Brown or Ivory trousers.The Dickies x WACKO MARIA capsule is available now via the WACKO MARIA online store, with worldwide shipping available. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: KEEN Turns Its Two-Cord UNEEK Into a Luxury Leather Mule
items.text: KEEN Turns Its Two-Cord UNEEK Into a Luxury Leather Mule Name: KEEN UNEEK Mule WKColorway: BlackSKU: 1033311MSRP: $195 USDRelease Date: October 2Where to Buy: KeenKEEN is taking its most recognizable design in a more refined direction with the All Gender UNEEK Mule WK. The shoe converts the brand's iconic two-cord sneaker into an ultra-premium mule, handcrafted in ethically sourced leather and finished in black.The core idea is a change in form. The UNEEK's defining two-cord construction carries over, but the closed sneaker becomes a mule, with the back opened up for an easy slip-on fit. Keeping the cords while removing the heel means the silhouette stays instantly recognizable even as it moves into a more relaxed shape.The material shift is just as significant. Instead of the technical build associated with the original model, the mule is handcrafted from ethically sourced leather. That choice, together with the handwork, is what moves the UNEEK from a trail-adjacent oddity into the premium category KEEN is targeting here. The all-black finish keeps the focus on the leather and the cordwork rather than on color.The move also fits the UNEEK's history. The silhouette first arrived in 2014, and its open, cord-built design has always stood apart from the hiking boots and water sandals that make up most of KEEN's catalog. That outlier status helped it win fans beyond the outdoors crowd. A leather mule leans into that identity, presenting the UNEEK as a design object first and outdoor gear second.
