items.title: Drake's Better World Fragrance House Pours "Summer Mink" Into a Candle
items.text: Drake's Better World Fragrance House Pours "Summer Mink" Into a Candle Summary Better World Fragrance House, Drake's fragrance label, has adapted its Summer Mink scent into a 10.5 oz home candleEach candle includes a gold marker so owners can write a name or personal note directly on the vesselThe scent's concept plays on contradiction, pairing the luxury of fur with the heat of summer to blur seasonal and gender norms Better World Fragrance House has released the Summer Mink Scented Candle, bringing Drake's signature fragrance off the skin and into the home. The 10.5 oz candle carries over the same amber-woody profile as the original scent, adding a gold marker that lets owners personalize the vessel by hand.Summer Mink is built around an idea that shouldn't work on paper. The brand frames the scent as the feeling of draping yourself in mink during the warmest months of the year, a deliberately out-of-season move that ignores who a fragrance is supposed to be for and when it's supposed to be worn. That sense of contrast shapes the composition from top to bottom.The opening is bright and herbal, led by Italian citrus, clary sage and petitgrain, the latter drawn from the leaves and twigs of the bitter orange tree. As the candle warms, the heart turns floral and warm at once, with jasmine sambac and rose oil layered over a blend of spices. The dry-down settles into vetiver, musk and Ambrofix, a sustainably produced amber molecule that gives the base its smooth, mineral warmth. Together, the three tiers land the scent firmly in the amber-woody family.The formula is free of parabens and phthalates, and the vessel doubles as a blank canvas. Rather than a printed label, each candle ships alongside a gold marker designed for adding a custom name or handwritten message, turning the piece into a ready-made gift or a personal signature on a shelf.Care instructions favor a slow, even burn. The first lighting should run three to four hours so the wax melts edge to edge and avoids tunneling, with the wick trimmed to a quarter inch before each relight and sessions capped at four hours.Home scent has become a natural extension for Drake's label, which has offered candles alongside its personal fragrances, including the Carby Musk scent he once described as smelling like himself. Summer Mink now joins that lineup as one of the house's more conceptual offerings.The Better World Fragrance House Summer Mink Scented Candle is available now exclusively online via Ulta Beauty.

items.title: The Nike Air Rift "Black/Desert Ochre" Prowls In Wearing Cheetah-Print Pony Hair
items.text: The Nike Air Rift "Black/Desert Ochre" Prowls In Wearing Cheetah-Print Pony Hair Name: Nike Air RiftColorway: Black/Desert OchreSKU: IO4884-002MSRP: TBCRelease Date: TBCThe Nike Air Rift "Black/Desert Ochre" brings a wild streak to one of the brand's most distinctive silhouettes, covering the women's shoe in cheetah-print pony hair. The material swap gives the split-toe model a tactile, fashion-forward finish while keeping the lightweight comfort and low-profile shape that first made it stand out.The upper is where this pair separates itself. Pony hair printed with cheetah spots in black and desert ochre covers the shoe, giving it a soft, slightly fuzzy texture that catches light differently from standard leather or mesh. Genuine leather sections and textile panels are built in alongside it, adding structure and durability so the plush surface holds its shape through regular wear.The Rift's defining feature, its split-toe construction, separates the big toe from the rest of the foot. Combined with a slim, close-fitting profile, the design carries the delicate look of a ballet flat while staying rooted in sneaker engineering. A hook-and-loop strap secures the fit, making the shoe quick to slip on and adjust.Underfoot, the build stays simple and functional. A foam midsole provides the base layer of comfort, while Nike Air cushioning softens impact with each step. A rubber outsole rounds things out, adding grip for everyday wear on city pavement.The silhouette's sporty roots remain part of its story. The Air Rift first appeared in 1996 as a progressive running shoe, and this pony hair version shows just how far it has drifted from the track. What started as a performance experiment now functions as a statement piece, one that can move between relaxed and dressed-up outfits without missing a beat. items.title: Brooks Brothers and Champion Link Up for Japan-Exclusive Reverse Weave® Capsule
items.text: Brooks Brothers and Champion Link Up for Japan-Exclusive Reverse Weave® Capsule Summary Brooks Brothers and Champion unite for their first collaboration, exclusive to Japan.Made in USA Reverse Weave® sweats merge collegiate sportswear with American trad.An archival-inspired six-button Oxford shirt rounds out the collection. Brooks Brothers and Champion are bringing together two pillars of American style for their first collaboration, a Japan-exclusive collection that bridges preppy tradition with collegiate sportswear. Founded in New York in 1818 and Rochester in 1919, respectively, the brands draw on their shared American heritage through Champion’s signature Made in USA Reverse Weave® construction.The men’s lineup comprises crewneck sweatshirts, hoodies and sweatpants made from heavyweight 12.5-ounce USA cotton-blend fleece, alongside a Brooks Brothers button-down shirt. The sweats feature arched “Brooks Brothers” graphics reminiscent of vintage collegiate apparel and externally placed dual-brand labels at the back of the collar, with the men’s styles offered across classic navy, gray, green, brown, white and black tones.The collaboration also digs deeper into Brooks Brothers’ archive with a white button-down modeled after a six-button style sold in the U.S. during the 1980s. Crafted from 100% American Supima cotton Oxford cloth, the shirt faithfully recreates details including the original yoke proportions, front cut, cuffs, placket and “Makers” woven label, while co-branded embroidery brings Champion into the otherwise traditional design.For women, Made in USA Reverse Weave® crewnecks and hoodies use the same heavyweight foundation but soften the collegiate treatment with felt Brooks Brothers lettering, arriving in navy, gray and white. Prices range from ¥28,600 JPY (approx. $181 USD) for the button-down to ¥44,000 JPY (approx. $278 USD)for the women’s hoodie, with the Brooks Brothers x Champion collection available now exclusively in Japan through Brooks Brothers stores, excluding outlets and the brand’s official Japanese online store. items.title: OMEGA Brings James Bond and Spectre Together for a New Seamaster Collection
items.text: OMEGA Brings James Bond and Spectre Together for a New Seamaster Collection Summary OMEGA launched six new Seamaster Diver 300M timepieces honoring James Bond and Spectre.Individual steel models feature titanium or ceramic bezels and custom-decorated rotors.Ultra-rare 77-piece sets pair stainless steel and platinum-gold watches for $89,800 USD. OMEGA is bringing both sides of the 007 universe onto the wrist with the new Seamaster Diver 300M James Bond & Spectre collection, marking the first time the watchmaker has placed Bond and his fictional adversary within the same series. Building on a relationship with James Bond spanning more than three decades, the six-piece lineup explores the contrast between Bond’s duty and discipline and Spectre’s independence and self-interest.All six watches share the same 42mm Seamaster Diver 300M architecture and Co-Axial Master Chronometer Calibre 8806, but split into three Bond and three Spectre executions. Two stainless-steel editions are available individually, while the remaining four watches form two highly limited two-watch sets - one dedicated to Bond and the other to Spectre - each restricted to 77 numbered sets.The individually available Bond model adopts a brighter maritime treatment, combining a stainless-steel case with a Grade 5 titanium bezel ring and blue aluminum dial laser-engraved with OMEGA’s signature wave pattern, while a coat-of-arms marker appears at 12 o’clock. Spectre takes the opposite direction with a black ceramic bezel and textured, blackened dial for a more monochromatic presence. Both sit on brushed stainless-steel mesh bracelets, while their transparent Naiad Lock casebacks reveal character-specific rotor decoration: Bond receives the familiar gun-barrel motif, while Spectre carries its octopus emblem.The limited sets push those identities further by pairing a numbered stainless-steel model with a platinum-gold counterpart. Bond’s platinum-gold edition uses a polished blue ceramic bezel with a platinum diving scale and an 18K white-gold dial finished in a blue PVD gradient with a gun-barrel pattern; the Spectre equivalent shifts to polished black ceramic and a dark-grey gradient white-gold dial bearing an octopus motif. Both add 18K Moonshine Gold decoration to their rotors and arrive on leather straps.Mechanically, every model is powered by OMEGA’s Calibre 8806, delivering a 55-hour power reserve, Master Chronometer certification and the collection’s full 300-meter water resistance. items.title: Seiko Takes the “Panda” Dial Literally With Two New Limited-Edition Watches
items.text: Seiko Takes the “Panda” Dial Literally With Two New Limited-Edition Watches Summary Seiko launches limited-edition Panda watches featuring ear-shaped pushers and textured dials.Playful details include a 30 km/h "SASAMETER" and a 3D tail caseback.Releasing November 2026, the quartz timepieces arrive in white and pink. Seiko is turning one of watchmaking’s most familiar nicknames into a literal design exercise by introducing a highly literal interpretation of the iconic "panda" chronograph dial. Originally introduced during the brand's 2024 "Incredibly Specialized Watch Exhibition," the concept was developed by in-house designer Kiyotaka Sakai, who set out to create a timepiece exclusively for panda enthusiasts.Sakai's “watch exclusively for panda lovers” became one of the exhibition’s standout concepts, prompting Seiko to develop it into a commercial release. The idea also reflects the wider Power Design Project, first introduced in 2001 as a platform for the company’s designers to experiment outside their everyday briefs. For the production models, the traditional white-dial, black-subdial “panda” chronograph has been pushed considerably further: HHK001 adopts the familiar black-and-white coloring, while HHK002 arrives in pink as a playful reference to a newborn panda.The panda theme extends well beyond color. The chronograph subdials are reshaped to resemble drooping eyes, while textured dial surfaces reference the animal’s coat and rounded black chronograph pushers double as its ears. Seiko even replaces the conventional tachymeter name with a “SASAMETER,” referring to sasa, the Japanese word for bamboo, and calibrates the scale to measure speeds up to 30 km/h — the theoretical maximum running speed of a panda.The caseback recreates the animal’s black-and-white markings and adds a three-dimensional tail beneath the “LIMITED EDITION” inscription. Both watches measure 43mm in stainless steel, come on leather straps incorporating suede-like sections for additional texture, and use Hardlex crystals, while the visual treatment is carried into dedicated presentation boxes in white/green and pink, respectively.The black-and-white HHK001 is limited to 3,000 pieces, while the pink HHK002 is restricted to 2,000 pieces. Both models are scheduled to launch in November 2026 through Seiko Boutiques and select retailers worldwide. The official European retail price is €590 EUR (approx. $650 USD). items.title: adidas Crowns Lionel Messi's Argentina Farewell With a Gold-Trimmed "Sol de Mayo" Jersey
items.text: adidas Crowns Lionel Messi's Argentina Farewell With a Gold-Trimmed "Sol de Mayo" Jersey Summary adidas has created a special edition Argentina jersey for Lionel Messi's final international appearance on October 6A reworked Sun of May graphic runs across the front and back, set against sky blue and white with gold accents on the crest, numbering and trimThe wider collection adds pre-match apparel, culture wear, shorts and socks that carry the same flag-inspired design language off the pitch adidas has unveiled the Argentina Messi Special Edition Collection, a commemorative range anchored by the match jersey Argentina will wear for Lionel Messi's farewell international appearance on October 6. The kit pairs the brand's current performance tech with symbols drawn straight from the Argentine flag, giving one of football's most decorated international careers a send-off built to be worn in competition rather than framed on a wall.The centerpiece graphic is the Sun of May, Argentina's national emblem, redrawn at scale so it stretches across both the chest and the back of the shirt. The familiar sky blue and white base stays intact, but gold now runs through the federation crest, the player numbering and the trim, a nod to the trophies that have marked Messi's run with the national team. The most telling swap sits on the chest: the standard adidas Performance logo is gone, replaced by Messi's personal signature logo, a rare move that underlines how closely the player and brand are tied.The finishing touches lean commemorative. A dedicated sign-off places the number 10 inside a pair of laurel branches alongside the Sol de Mayo, turning the shirt's smallest details into a record of who it was made for.Under the symbolism, this is a genuine match shirt. adidas built it on its latest CLIMACOOL+ platform, using stretch fabrics engineered with 3D body mapping to move air where players run hottest, boost breathability and pull moisture away during high-tempo, high-heat games. Perforations through the three-stripe panels and mesh zones placed at key points push airflow and comfort further.The timing gives the jersey its weight. Messi captained Argentina to the 2022 FIFA World Cup title in Qatar in an adidas kit, a win that followed back-to-back Copa América trophies in 2021 and 2024. items.text: Taofeek Abijako Shows How an Iconic Bag Seamlessly Fits His Studio Life with His Daughter Inside a sunlit studio filled with rolls of textiles and garment racks, designer Taofeek Abijako sits at his drafting desk, sketching the gentle drape of a gown. Beside him, his young daughter leans over the table, crayon in hand, adding her own vibrant pink flourishes directly onto his fashion renders. The atmosphere isn't one of guarded focus or strict professional boundaries but a living space where creativity is inherently collaborative. “I also see my studio as my personal playground,” Taofeek reflects, watching her scribble alongside his tailored silhouettes. “So her joining in... it’s real sharing”. items.title: Carhartt Debuts the Heavy-Duty Steel Series Workwear Collection
items.text: Carhartt Debuts the Heavy-Duty Steel Series Workwear Collection Summary Carhartt has announced the launch of its all-new Steel Series workwear collection engineered for high-durability performanceThe lineup incorporates Ny-co infused fabrics delivering enhanced mobility zoned protection and high abrasion resistanceThe collection is available beginning October 7 via Carhartt's webstore and select retail stockists Carhartt has officially introduced the Steel Series, an all-new collection of heavy-duty workwear engineered to perform in the toughest environments. Designed around the motto "Forged for the Toughest," the system combines advanced material engineering with targeted protection to support natural movement without adding unnecessary weight.The Steel Series centers around three core performance pillars: zoned protection using reinforced overlays in high-wear areas, integrated stretch for enhanced mobility, and high-tensile abrasion resistance. To achieve these standards, Carhartt engineered specialized Ny-co (Nylon-Cotton) infused fabrics tested directly against traditional duck, canvas, and fleece materials.The debut collection comprises six functional styles, led by the Steel Braddock Jacket and Steel Braddock Bib Overall—both delivering four times more abrasion resistance and double the stretch of traditional stretch duck. The range also features the Steel Bridgeport Sweatshirt, crafted from fleece offering twice the abrasion resistance of standard 10.5-ounce fleece, alongside three pant silhouettes: the Relaxed Straight Steel Braddock Pant, Relaxed Tapered Steel Buffalo Pant, and Relaxed Straight Steel Baltimore Pant. Notably, the Steel Braddock Pant provides ten times the abrasion resistance and triple the tensile strength of standard stretch canvas.The Carhartt Steel Series launches today, via Carhartt and select retailers nationwide. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Gap and Whitney Museum Release a Roy Lichtenstein-Inspired Collection
items.text: Gap and Whitney Museum Release a Roy Lichtenstein-Inspired Collection Summary Gap has unveiled a limited edition collection with the Whitney Museum and the Estate of Roy Lichtenstein ahead of 'Like New,' the artist's first major New York show in 30 yearsThe lineup features garments, accessories, and homeware emblazoned with a career-spanning selection of work by the artist The Gap x Whitney x Roy Lichtenstein collection launches online on October 7 ahead of the exhibition's October 11 opening Now you can gear up for Roy Lichtenstein’s landmark New York show in style, courtesy of this Gap and the Whitney Museum collection. A new collaboration between the two, in tandem with the artist’s estate, unveils a limited-edition lineup just a few days ahead of the Like New opening, reworking some of the Pop Art’s most beloved works into everyday staples.The collection spans 18 pieces, including garments, accessories, and homeware. Here, works from the Standing Explosion land across a hoodie, varsity jacket, and poplin top. “Crying Girl” (1963) and “Girl in Window” (1963) make their way onto graphic tees. The red-and-blue Benday dots from the Monet-inspired Cathedral series appear on a quarter-zip pullover and sweatshirt. Even Lichtenstein’s cheeky texts get a turn, with phrases like “Sweet Dreams, Baby!” and “Ohhh…Alright…” appearing on caps.Akin to career-spanning Whitney forthcomer, the Gap collection follows suit, putting some of Lichtenstein’s less familiar work back in the spotlight. Deep cuts get their praise in pieces like the Laughing Cat Sweater, features a painting included in his breakthrough 1962 solo at Leo Castelli Gallery.Like New, curated by Meg Onli and Alex Da Corte, brings together more than 130 works spanning six decades and opens October 11. The Gap x Whitney x Roy Lichtenstein collection will be available starting October 7 online via Gap and the Whitney Museum. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Million Goods Brings Its Menswear, Hi-Fi and Natural Wine Concept to Fort Greene, Brooklyn
items.text: Million Goods Brings Its Menswear, Hi-Fi and Natural Wine Concept to Fort Greene, Brooklyn Summary Million Goods has opened its second location, in Fort Greene, BrooklynThe space includes two custom sound systems split across a ground floor bar and listening room, and an upstairs retail floorThe store stocks brands like Nicholas Daley, OAMC Peacemaker, Soulland, Rold Skov, LC23, Berner Kühl, Ranra and ssstein Million Goods, a Brooklyn-based retail concept combining independent menswear, hi-fi, natural wine and cultural programming, has opened its second location in Fort Greene, Brooklyn. A roughly 2,100-square-foot space set inside a landmarked building, the new location ports the brand's DNA from its original Greenpoint location further south in the borough. Founders Drew Kaufmann and Matt Reyer treated the project as an adaptive reuse, keeping the building's tin ceilings, fireplaces, wood floors and spiral staircase rather than gutting the interior. The store is split into three areas of about 700 square feet each: a bar and listening room on the lower level, a retail floor upstairs and a garden at the rear, visible from the entrance through large windows at the back of the listening floor.The original spiral staircase connecting the two floors is now wrapped in red metalwork, while other details like pecan finished woodwork, honed stone surfaces and limewash paint compliment custom aluminum retail fixtures. Louis Poulsen PH 5 pendants and AJ Eklipta wall lamps illuminate the space while the sound comes Bridge Street Sound designed slim-profile speakers and Million Goods-developed dual-sided speakers, both tuned by Ojas collaborator and sound designer Mo Yasin.The upstairs retail floor carries labels including Nicholas Daley, OAMC Peacemaker, Soulland, Rold Skov, LC23, Berner Kühl, Ranra and ssstein, with Kaufmann and Reyer selecting pieces directly with each brand. Downstairs, the natural wine list centers on France, the Fort Greene location serving a broader by-the-glass selection than Greenpoint. Out back, the garden incorporates the existing trees into the built-in seating with a layout that references Brazilian Brutalism and Japanese garden design.Million Goods Fort Greene is now open Tuesday through Sunday from noon until 10 p.m. on Tuesdays and Sundays, 11 p.m. on Wednesdays, and 12 a.m. on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays. The original Greenpoint store continues to operate at 88 Franklin Street.Million Goods Fort Greene201 DeKalb AvenueFort Green

items.title: Supreme Fall 2026 Tees
items.text: Supreme Fall 2026 Tees Summary Supreme delivers seven new graphic t-shirts for its Fall 2026 delivery.Highlights include Rob Pruitt's Paris Hilton tee, David Gonzales' Pietà and Jim Morrison graphics.Releasing globally on October 8, followed by Asia on October 10. Following its initial seasonal rollouts, Supreme is back to deliver a fresh lineup of graphic t-shirts for its Fall 2026 collection. For this seasonal delivery, the New York skate staple serves up seven distinct styles that merge pop-culture irony, fine art co-signs, rock nostalgia, and subversive street iconography. The assortment captures the brand's irreverent attitude through custom graphics, fine-line illustrations, and bold photographic prints executed across a vibrant spectrum of seasonal colorways.Artistic co-signs and celebrity portraiture lead the assortment, headlined by the Paris Tee featuring original artwork by Rob Pruitt. The piece showcases an illustration of pop-culture icon Paris Hilton cradling a teddy bear alongside her signature catchphrase "That's Hot" and a handwritten message reading "To Supreme with love." Artist David Gonzales contributes original work to the Tears Tee, which depicts a Pietà-inspired marble sculpture framed by "Happy Mother's Day" script and classic block typography. Meanwhile, musical heritage takes center stage on the Jim Tee, displaying a vintage black-and-white portrait of legendary frontman Jim Morrison accented by gothic lettering and a vibrant butterfly graphic.Subversive humor and graphic experimentation define the remaining options, starting with the Pills Tee, which displays a photorealistic pile of prescription medicine bottles customized with Supreme's 190 Bowery address. Aggressive street imagery anchors the Growl Tee, illustrating a caged guard dog above the tongue-in-cheek caption "All I Did Was Growl a Little". Rounding out the seven-piece range are the Script Tee, which utilizes a dizzying, all-over repeat pattern of motion-blurred cursive logos, and the Sharp Tee, featuring edgy, stylized typography designed by Art Dealer.The Supreme Fall 2026 Tees collection is scheduled for a global release later this week. The capsule will land online and across physical Supreme flagships on Thursday, October 8, with a subsequent release following in Japan and Asia on Saturday, October 10. These three pairs inherit the comfort the brand has cultivated while adopting different approaches to create fresh silhouettes.UGG® has long been loved for its sheepskin boots, originally worn by surfers to warm their feet after leaving the ocean. At the same time, they retain recognizable details like the twin seams and the Classic outsole, ensuring their identity as UGG® is immediately clear.The Heritage Utility Grizz combines two-tone faux fur with functional details, expressing "comfort" in a new way. Building on the cushioning, traction, and protection of the Heritage Utility tooling, it incorporates ratchet straps reminiscent of snowboard boots to create a striking contrast between soft fur and rugged hardware.For this release, Hypebeast Japan tapped rapper LEX to model in a special editorial. Inspired by the designs of the three shoes, the shoot was built around the concept of "A Familiar Strangeness," blending reality and unreality. By injecting subtle surreal elements into an initially empty space around LEX, the imagery creates a slightly mysterious world where an uncanny mood creeps into familiar scenes.Additionally, Hypebeast Japan conducted an exclusive interview with Pierce Lopatic, Sr. Director, Design - Global UGG Men's Footwear, based at the California headquarters. We dive into the design philosophy behind the Fall/Winter 2026 collection, the origins of the new items, and the deep attention paid to materials and details—uncovering the design stories that lie beneath the surface of the products.Hypebeast: How do the Classic Micro Distort, Classic Distort Boot, and Heritage Utility Grizz carry forward the UGG® DNA while evolving into new designs?For UGG®, the brand's DNA is a crucial foundation for creating anything new. items.title: H. Moser & Cie. Gives Retrograde Seconds Three Different Personalities
items.text: H. Moser & Cie. Gives Retrograde Seconds Three Different Personalities Summary H. Moser & Cie. expands its retrograde seconds complication across three collections.Pioneer, Streamliner and Endeavour each interpret the 30-second display differently.The trio combines exposed mechanics, fumé dials and automatic calibers with three-day reserves. H. Moser & Cie. is expanding its retrograde seconds concept across three of its core collections with the new Pioneer Skeleton Retrograde Seconds, Streamliner Retrograde Seconds and Endeavour Retrograde Seconds. Following the success of the original Pioneer Retrograde Seconds, the trio takes the same theatrical idea - a seconds hand travelling across a 30-second arc before snapping instantly back to zero - and gives it three distinct personalities. The mechanism itself is deliberately exposed on the dial, where a double snail cam, rack and hairspring coordinate the hand’s repeated journey, accompanied by a two-tone indicator showing whether the watch is within the first or second half of each minute.The Pioneer Skeleton Retrograde Seconds offers the most mechanical interpretation, placing the complication within a fully openworked 40mm steel case where anthracite bridges and wheels contrast against gold-toned hands and markers. Its fully skeletonized HMC 251 automatic caliber integrates the retrograde mechanism directly and delivers a minimum three-day power reserve, while a steel bracelet and additional khaki rubber strap reinforce its sport-watch positioning.The Streamliner Retrograde Seconds takes a smoother approach, pairing the display at 6 o’clock with the collection’s fluid 40mm steel case, integrated bracelet and Midnight Blue fumé sunburst dial. Here, the automatic HMC 252 caliber combines Moser’s base movement with a 30-second retrograde module developed by Agenhor, maintaining the same minimum three-day reserve while letting the hand’s sudden reset interrupt the otherwise flowing architecture.Completing the trio, the Endeavour Retrograde Seconds translates the complication into Moser’s most understated format. Its 40mm steel case frames a Blackor fumé sunburst dial, with the exposed retrograde mechanism at 6 o’clock adding controlled visual tension beneath the collection’s otherwise minimalist display. Like the Streamliner, it uses the HMC 252 automatic caliber and is finished with a night-blue nubuck alligator strap, keeping the overall presentation more formal.The trio is priced between $35,200 USD and $44

items.title: BAIT x G-SHOCK Went Bananas on the "Yamagata's Finest" DW5600
items.text: BAIT x G-SHOCK Went Bananas on the "Yamagata's Finest" DW5600 Summary G-SHOCK and BAIT reunite on the DW5600 with "Yamagata's Finest," a release that pays tribute to the Japanese prefecture where G-SHOCK production beginsThe design takes its cue from a banana at peak ripeness, a playful nod to timing that suits both a watch and a long-running partnershipCustom can-and-box packaging introduces "Shawty with Freckles," a mascot built to represent the shared culture behind the collaboration G-SHOCK and BAIT have returned to the DW5600 for "Yamagata's Finest," a banana-themed take on the classic square that honors Yamagata Prefecture, the home of Casio's Premium Production Line. Billed as a "non-GMO" edition, the collaboration trades outside references for a tribute to the place where every G-SHOCK gets its start.The watch commits fully to its fruit theme. The case and strap are finished in a saturated banana yellow, framing a light gray face plate that surrounds a blue-tinted digital display showing the day, date and time. The bezel keeps the DW5600's familiar layout, with "PROTECTION" printed across the top and "G-SHOCK" lettering along the bottom in a muted contrast tone. Small dark flecks scattered across the strap appear to mimic the sugar spots that show up on a banana just as it hits its sweetest point.That ripeness is the core joke. A banana at its peak is all about timing, which makes it a neat fit for a watch and, as the partners frame it, for two brands coming back together at the right moment. The yellow-on-gray palette keeps the concept legible at a glance without leaning on graphics, letting the color do the storytelling.The packaging extends the bit. Rather than a standard G-SHOCK box, the watch arrives in a special can and box carrying "Shawty with Freckles," a makeshift mascot positioned as the face of the partnership and a symbol of the cultural common ground between BAIT and Casio. In the press imagery, the character appears on a blue oval badge styled like a produce sticker, complete with a script "Shawty" logo.The deeper story sits in Yamagata. The prefecture houses Casio's Premium Production Line and the factory where G-SHOCK production begins, making it a fitting focal point for a collaboration about origins. Casio's facility there, Yamagata Casio in Higashine, is also known for producing the brand's high-end MR-G and MT-G models. The DW5600 itself traces its lineage to the original DW-5000C, the shock-resistant square that launched G-SHO

items.title: Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Collection Swings to Physical on Nintendo Switch 2 from Limited Run Games.
items.text: Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Collection Swings to Physical on Nintendo Switch 2 from Limited Run Games. Summary Aspyr and Limited Run Games are bringing Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Collection to Nintendo Switch 2 as a physical release in Standard and Collector's EditionsEach version includes the base game alongside the "Blood Ties" and "Lara's Nightmare" stories, the online Co-Op Endurance mode and the "Extreme Survivor" difficultyThe Collector's Edition adds a SteelCase, a Trinity cloth patch and a light-up replica of the game's "Divine Source" artifact Aspyr and Limited Run Games are taking Rise of the Tomb Raider: 20 Year Collection to the Nintendo Switch 2, issuing Lara Croft's Siberian adventure as a physical release in both Standard and Collector's Edition formats. Each package includes a physical Game Card loaded with the full game and its Season Pass content, giving Switch 2 players the complete version of one of the franchise's most celebrated modern entries.The title has been around for just over a decade. Crystal Dynamics first released Rise of the Tomb Raider in 2015 as the sequel to its 2013 reboot, then expanded it into the "20 Year Celebration" edition in 2016 to mark two decades since the original Tomb Raider debuted in 1996. That anniversary branding carries over to this release even as the franchise itself now sits at 30 years old. Aspyr, which handles development on the Switch 2 version, has recent history with the series, having also overseen 2024's Tomb Raider I–III Remastered.The story follows Lara into the frozen wilds of Siberia in search of Kitezh, a lost city tied to the Divine Source, an artifact believed to grant immortality. Standing in her way is Trinity, a shadowy organization chasing the same prize. Kitezh draws on a real Russian legend of a city that vanished beneath a lake to escape invaders, giving the expedition a mythic anchor.Gameplay splits time between survival, combat and puzzle-solving. Players hunt wildlife and gather scarce materials to craft weapons and gear in hostile terrain, then put that kit to work in open-ended encounters where Lara can climb trees, slip underwater, set traps and improvise explosives. Her compound bow and climbing axe remain the core tools, and loadouts can be tuned for anything from quiet takedowns to full firefights. Optional tombs return in a bigger way, packing large chambers with lethal traps, environmental puzzles and ancient texts that point toward hidden crypts.The Season

items.title: New Wi-Fi Alliance Certifications Hint at an Upcoming PlayStation Portal OLED
items.text: New Wi-Fi Alliance Certifications Hint at an Upcoming PlayStation Portal OLED Summary The Wi-Fi Alliance certified two unannounced PlayStation devices classified as gaming peripheralsCertification documents reveal the new hardware models run on the Android 15 operating systemHardware leaks suggest Sony is preparing an OLED version of its streaming handheld The Wi-Fi Alliance recently certified a pair of unannounced PlayStation devices, signaling an imminent hardware update that appears to be an iteration of the PlayStation Portal handheld. According to the official certification documents, the two new products are formally classified as "Gaming Console/Peripherals." The fresh hardware operates under the model numbers CFI-Y2000 and CFI-Y2105. That specific numbering sequence directly follows the CFI-Y1001 model number utilized by the currently available PlayStation Portal. The original PlayStation Portal officially launched in late 2023, and these freshly certified models appear poised to serve as direct updates to that dedicated remote-play platform. PlayStation did not immediately reply to a request for comment regarding the recent Wi-Fi Alliance certifications.Technical specifications provided by the certification documents show that the newly certified models run on the Android 15 operating system. This software architecture mirrors the current PlayStation Portal model, which also operates on Android. Relying on an Android foundation contrasts with heavier flagship hardware, as the PS5 home console natively runs on a custom operating system. Network capabilities for the unannounced gadgets remain familiar, as they are officially certified for 1x1 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi. The new devices are not certified for 6GHz Wi-Fi, and the certified hardware does not feature more Wi-Fi antennas than the previous model.Earlier this year, hardware leaker KeplerL2 stated that Sony was actively working on "another version" of the Portal. The leaker claimed the new device would arrive as an OLED version, upgrading the original PlayStation Portal that currently features an 8-inch LCD screen. Keeping the identical networking specifications while upgrading the screen aligns with the company's broader hardware strategy. Sony noted in June that cloud streaming requires minimal memory, framing thin client devices as an attractive, low-cost option amid rising memory prices. items.title: Carhartt WIP x Kinto's Kakomi Donabe Puts the Japanese Clay Pot to Work
items.text: Carhartt WIP x Kinto's Kakomi Donabe Puts the Japanese Clay Pot to Work Summary Carhartt WIP and Japanese lifestyle brand Kinto team up on the Kakomi Donabe, a contemporary update of the traditional Japanese cooking potThe ceramic body handles open flame, microwave and oven heat, while a stainless steel plate lets it double as a steamerThe pot holds 2.5 liters and arrives in a Black/Grey colorway finished with a graphic print Carhartt WIP and Kinto have joined forces on the Kakomi Donabe, a modern reworking of the Japanese clay cooking pot finished in Black/Grey. Instead of treating the donabe as a delicate heirloom piece, the collaboration rebuilds it as a hardwearing kitchen tool that moves between cooking methods with minimal fuss.The biggest change is the material. Where the traditional donabe is shaped from clay, this version is made from a heat-resistant ceramic, giving it the range to sit directly over a flame, slide into the oven or go into the microwave. That versatility carries through to cleanup, as the pot is dishwasher safe.Size-wise, the Kakomi Donabe holds 2,500 milliliters (about 85 ounces) and measures 27.5 x 14.5 x 31.5 centimeters (10.8 x 5.7 x 12.4 inches), putting it firmly in the territory of a shared, table-centered vessel rather than a single-serving cooker.A stainless steel steam plate is included in the box, so the pot can be used for steaming in addition to simmering. The metal insert pairs the ceramic body with a second material that suits the brand's utilitarian leanings while expanding what the pot can actually do.Visually, the piece keeps things restrained. The Black/Grey colorway gives the ceramic a muted, workshop-ready tone, and a graphic print finishes the exterior. Kinto, a Japanese label known for refined everyday goods spanning water bottles, kitchenware and specialty coffee equipment, brings its homeware know-how to the build.The Carhartt WIP x Kinto Kakomi Donabe is listed as coming soon via Carhartt WIP's online store. items.title: HOMEGAME and New Era’s "Kasane Pack" Layers Traditional Japanese Patterns Onto MLB Crowns
items.text: HOMEGAME and New Era’s "Kasane Pack" Layers Traditional Japanese Patterns Onto MLB Crowns Summary HOMEGAME and New Era rework three MLB 59FIFTY fitteds with crowns cut from fabric that combines several traditional Japanese motifsEach team is assigned its own color story, with blue for the Dodgers, green for the Mariners and purple for the YankeesPattern placement shifts from cap to cap, so no two pieces in the pack look exactly alike HOMEGAME and New Era have teamed up on the 59FIFTY "Kasane Pack," a three-piece MLB capsule built from patchwork-style fabric that pulls together a range of traditional Japanese patterns. The Japan-based cap specialist gave each team its own palette, matching the Los Angeles Dodgers, Seattle Mariners and New York Yankees with tonal prints and coordinating visors.The starting point is the textile. Rather than printing a single graphic, the pack uses a fabric that assembles several classic Japanese motifs and botanical references into one surface. Three stand out: the geometric asanoha, or hemp leaf, grid; clusters of small, delicate flowers; and upright stalks of bamboo. HOMEGAME pitches the project as a modern reconstruction of these centuries-old designs, with attention paid from the choice of cloth through to how it's cut and set onto the six-panel crown.Each colorway gets a name drawn from its dominant hue and motif. "AIKA" (藍花) dresses the Dodgers cap in blue-toned prints with a solid blue brim. "SUIMA" (翠麻) shifts the Mariners version into greens and finishes it with a Northwest Green visor. "SHICHIKU" (紫竹) gives the Yankees edition a purple-leaning crown set against a navy brim.The trims hold steady across all three. Team logos (LA, S and NY) sit up front in raised 3D embroidery, while MLB's Batterman logo anchors the rear. Inside, a white sweatband lines the crown, and a gray undervisor runs beneath every brim, keeping the busy outer fabric grounded with a clean, classic base.Because the patterned cloth is cut panel by panel, the motifs land differently on every cap. One Yankees fitted might put a bamboo stalk front and center while the next leads with hemp leaf geometry, which makes each piece effectively one of a kind. It's a fitting detail for a pairing between New Era, the 1920-founded headwear label that serves as MLB's sole official on-field cap supplier, and HOMEGAME, a shop known for stocking New Era styles unreleased in Japan alongside its own hip-hop-leaning "HOMEGAME CUSTOM" makeups.The New Era x HOMEGAME 59F

items.title: Xbox Cloud Gaming Is the Only Platform That Can Stream 'GTA VI' at Launch
items.text: Xbox Cloud Gaming Is the Only Platform That Can Stream 'GTA VI' at Launch Summary Microsoft has secured exclusive launch streaming rights for Grand Theft Auto VI via Xbox Cloud GamingRockstar Games has not yet announced a native PC version of the highly anticipated titleXbox is launching pay-as-you-go access and enforcing new monthly hourly streaming caps to monetize the cloud surge Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has confirmed to staff that Microsoft is preparing an initiative for Grand Theft Auto VI that no other platform holder is currently matching. Sources familiar with the company's internal roadmap confirmed that Microsoft has officially secured exclusive launch streaming rights for the title. Under this agreement, Xbox Cloud Gaming is the only platform permitted to stream the game at launch. The exact length of this exclusivity deal remains unknown.This exclusivity deal directly targets PC players. Because publisher Rockstar Games has not yet announced a native PC version of the game, players without a console face a potential hardware upgrade. The streaming arrangement allows Microsoft to offer Xbox Cloud Gaming to PC users who would otherwise need to buy an Xbox Series X, an Xbox Series S or a PS5 console.To prepare for this launch, Microsoft is restructuring its access pipeline before Grand Theft Auto VI releases in November. The company is debuting a pay-as-you-go pricing tier for Xbox Cloud Gaming alongside the game's release. This model allows players without a console or an active subscription to access the game on mobile devices by purchasing individual bundles of streaming hours. Such transactional pricing positions Microsoft to monetize users who do not want a recurring monthly subscription.Managing the expected wave of traffic requires Microsoft to also end unlimited streaming for existing Xbox Game Pass subscribers in November. The company will enforce strict monthly limits on gameplay hours. Under the new rules, Xbox Game Pass Ultimate subscribers are capped at 15 streaming hours per month. Those on the Xbox Game Pass Premium tier are limited to 10 streaming hours per month, while Xbox Game Pass Essential subscribers are restricted to five hours. items.title: NOT A CITY Turns 2,000 Tsubo of the Imperial Hotel Tokyo Into NOT A MUSEUM
items.text: NOT A CITY Turns 2,000 Tsubo of the Imperial Hotel Tokyo Into NOT A MUSEUM Summary NOT A CITY is converting the first four floors of the Imperial Hotel Tokyo's Tower building into NOT A MUSEUM, a temporary hub for art, books, music, fashion and cinemaDAIKEI MILLS and NOT A HOTEL ARCHITECTS are handling the spatial design, with SKWAT co-producing and co-operating the projectThe space occupies the former Imperial Hotel Plaza Tokyo and is set to run for roughly four years before the tower is demolished NOT A CITY, the urban development arm of NOT A HOTEL parent company NOTA, is launching NOT A MUSEUM, a time-limited cultural complex inside the Imperial Hotel Tokyo's Tower building. Set to open in Summer 2027, the project reoccupies the shuttered Imperial Hotel Plaza Tokyo for an operating window of about four years, giving the space one final use before the tower comes down as part of the hotel's redevelopment.NOT A MUSEUM will spread across roughly 2,000 tsubo, or about 6,600 square meters, covering the building's first through fourth floors. A handful of existing ground-floor shops will stay outside the project's boundaries, but the rest of the former retail plaza is being handed over to the new program.Two studios are shaping the interiors. Tokyo design office DAIKEI MILLS is partnering with NOT A HOTEL's in-house team, NOT A HOTEL ARCHITECTS, on the spatial plan. DAIKEI MILLS' involvement runs deeper than layout, as SKWAT, the collective that grew out of the studio in 2019 under founder Keisuke Nakamura, is co-leading planning, production and day-to-day operations alongside NOT A CITY. SKWAT's model centers on temporarily taking over idle or overlooked urban spaces and opening them to the public through exhibitions, publishing, retail and talks.That approach informs how the floors are meant to function. Rather than a gallery with fixed displays, the space is designed as a mixed-discipline venue where art, books, music, fashion and film share the same floors and evolve over time, framed by the tagline "CULTURE, IN THE MAKING." In his comments on the project, Nakamura framed time itself as the site's most valuable resource and described the space as something that will never be finished, built collectively by those who pass through it.NOT A MUSEUM is scheduled to operate from summer 2027 through March 2031, after which the Tower building will be demolished for reconstruction. items.title: Jaguar Reveals the Production Type 01, a 1,015 HP Electric Sedan Starting at $130,500 USD
items.text: Jaguar Reveals the Production Type 01, a 1,015 HP Electric Sedan Starting at $130,500 USD Summary Jaguar officially debuted the 1,015-horsepower Type 01 electric luxury sedan in New YorkThe glassless fastback abandons brand traditions to aggressively target new demographicsPre-orders are currently open with initial customer deliveries planned for mid-2027 Jaguar officially revealed the production-ready Jaguar Type 01 at a world premiere event at STORIED in New York's creative district. The debut featured a digital skyline takeover and a dynamic arrival through city streets, officially introducing an electric luxury sedan that carries a starting price of roughly $130,500 USD. Pronounced "Type Zero One" rather than "Type Oh One," the 5,950-pound vehicle arrived after its launch was delayed by more than a year due to a major cyberattack and shifting EV market conditions. Following the controversial debut of the Type 00 concept car in Miami two years prior, this reveal marked a high-stakes moment for Jaguar. By abandoning legacy touchstones to court entirely new demographics, the production vehicle represented a deliberate, clean break from brand tradition in an attempt to forge a radical new identity.That aesthetic pivot is immediately obvious in the aggressive, massive footprint of the Jaguar Type 01. Measuring 206.1 inches in overall length, the car is 2.7 inches shorter than a Mercedes-Benz S-Class, but its roofline sits a full 4 inches lower. The front fascia eliminates the traditional grille entirely, drawing in air exclusively through active shutters located in the lower section. Along the side profile, the C-pillar features three converging creases and a deep draw from the fender to the roofline dubbed "the impossible panel," requiring six stamping steps on a 2,500-ton press. The rear features a glassless fastback design with no window and utilizes a rearview camera screen mounted just above the driver's line of sight, though United States market regulations force the inclusion of a vestigial reflective rearview mirror mounted at the top of the windshield. The standard paint palette includes white, silver, grey, black, two shades of greyish-blue and "Mermerizing Copper," notably excluding the brand's iconic British Racing Green. items.title: Hideaki Anno Returns to One of His Defining Influences With ‘Yamato √2199’
items.text: Hideaki Anno Returns to One of His Defining Influences With ‘Yamato √2199’ Summary Hideaki Anno and Yutaka Izubuchi are co-directing Cosmoship Yamato √2199 .The film marks the first joint production between Production I.G and Studio Khara.Anno leads the passion project as director, planner, executive producer, and designer. The legendary Space Battleship Yamato franchise is returning to the silver screen with Cosmoship Yamato √2199, a brand-new feature-length anime film boasting a powerhouse production team.Acclaimed Evangelion creator Hideaki Anno is leading the project as director, planner, executive producer, and designer, with renowned mecha designer Yutaka Izubuchi stepping in as co-director and co-designer. Adding to the grand scale of the film, the project marks the very first joint animation production between industry titans Production I.G and Studio Khara, with Production I.G founder Mitsuhisa Ishikawa also credited alongside Anno for planning.The film builds on a project Anno first disclosed during Space Battleship Yamato’s 50th-anniversary celebrations in October 2024, when he revealed that Khara had secured permission to create new animation based on the franchise. Anno has frequently cited the original 1974 series as a formative influence, while Izubuchi brings particularly close ties to its modern incarnation, having served as chief director and series composition writer on 2012’s Space Battleship Yamato 2199. Despite the familiar “2199” designation, the newly titled √2199 - with the symbol read as “Root” - is being developed as a separate project intended to take a different path from the existing remake continuity. Further story, casting and release details have yet to be announced. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Jil Sander and Oliver Peoples Soften Modernism for Their Second Sunglass Collection
items.text: Jil Sander and Oliver Peoples Soften Modernism for Their Second Sunglass Collection Summary Jil Sander and Oliver Peoples return with three new sunglasses for Collection 2.Titanium and sculpted acetate frames balance modernist precision with organic forms.Tonal and contrasting lens combinations expand the collaboration’s color language. Jil Sander and Oliver Peoples are continuing their eyewear partnership with Collection 2, a three-style sunglasses range designed under Jil Sander Creative Director Simone Bellotti. Building on the collaboration’s exploration of precision and restraint, the new release plays with contrasts between modernist rigor and organic softness, translating them into rounded forms intended to follow the contours of the face.Each pair is handmade in Japan and fitted with lenses crafted in Italy, while a broader approach to color introduces both tonal and higher-contrast frame-and-lens combinations. Edition 7 provides the collection’s architectural counterpoint in titanium, pairing a rounded eyewire with a sculptural top bar, shaped bridge, low-set endpieces and curved temples. Editions 9 and 10 shift into sculpted acetate: the former uses a thick, angular frame that unexpectedly widens toward the bottom, while the latter softens its geometry through a rounded, upswept silhouette and flowing curved temples.Color play acts as a central defining element in Collection 2, offering combinations that range from soft, tone-on-tone harmonies to striking visual contrasts. The lineup delivers a rich palette across titanium and acetate variations: Edition 7 is offered in Gold and Silver frames paired with Light Brown Wash, G-15, Indigo, or Grey Gradient lenses; Edition 9 presents bold acetate in Black, Dark Mahogany, Taupe, and Buff; and Edition 10 comes in Black, Dark Mahogany, Bright Blue, and Amber with Carbon Grey or Indigo lenses. Serving as both a functional object and artistic gesture, the Jil Sander x Oliver Peoples Collection 2 is available through select Jil Sander boutiques, Oliver Peoples stockists, and online at JilSander.com. Previewing the core gameplay loop, the video follows Rex from a mission briefing aboard the special service craft Stellarvane down to the dusty, storm-swept surface of Mars, showcasing multi-directional, high-speed combat as the Gundam Helix blazes across the battlefield to overwhelm advancing enemy swarms.Developed by Bandai Namco Studios, the story follows RE-X and a ragtag group of soldiers fighting for humanity’s survival against the mysterious Apocalypse threat, trading the franchise’s familiar large-scale human conflicts for encounters with enormous unknown enemies across planets and space.First unveiled during Summer Game Fest 2026, Gundam: Rogue Orbit introduces an original universe separate from the franchise’s established anime timelines, positioning it as both a standalone entry point for newcomers and a new direction for longtime Gundam fans.Gundam: Rogue Orbit launches March 5, 2027 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam. items.title: fragment and DAB Motors Give BRABUS’ URBAN E Motorcycle a Monochrome Makeover
items.text: fragment and DAB Motors Give BRABUS’ URBAN E Motorcycle a Monochrome Makeover Summary fragment reworks the BRABUS URBAN E in a stark black-and-white finish.The electric motorcycle retains 37 hp, 475 Nm of torque and up to 93 miles of urban range.Production is limited to 10 units worldwide. Fragment, DAB Motors and BRABUS have joined forces on the BRABUS URBAN E FRAGMENT EDITION, transforming the German tuner’s first electric motorcycle through Hiroshi Fujiwara’s distinctly restrained visual language.Based on the BRABUS URBAN E unveiled earlier this year, the new edition leaves its underlying mechanical package intact and instead treats the motorcycle as a study in contrast. The original’s more overt BRABUS treatment gives way to a stark black-and-white palette: black bodywork is offset by white-painted carbon-fiber wheel covers, white Brembo brake calipers, white BRABUS lettering and a white BRABUS Masterpiece leather seat. fragment branding appears selectively across the side panels and front fender, while a bespoke crystal-clear rear light incorporates the label’s logo directly into its lens.The URBAN E retains the sculptural mix of carbon fiber and precision-machined hardware that distinguished the earlier BRABUS iteration. Carbon components extend across the front fender, side ducts, engine covers, belly pan, wheel arches, rear winglets and brake-cooling ducts, contrasted with glossy and matte black aero elements.Up front, an illuminated BRABUS badge sits alongside a bespoke headlight unit with vertical daytime-running lights, while the supermotard-style handlebar incorporates CNC-machined controls, bar-end mirrors and brake levers. Mechanically, the FRAGMENT EDITION remains unchanged from the BRABUS URBAN E, producing 27.6 kW (37 hp) and 475 Nm of torque at the wheel, with a top speed of 120 km/h (75 mph) and up to 150 km (93 miles) of urban range from its 7.1-kWh battery. Five selectable riding modes - Eco, Street, Sport, Nitrous and Reverse - further preserve the performance-focused character beneath its more understated exterior.Each BRABUS URBAN E FRAGMENT EDITION is hand-built by DAB Motors in France, with production restricted to just 10 individually numbered units worldwide. items.text: JW Anderson x UNIQLO Turns Fall/Winter 2026 Into a Campus Drama Summary UNIQLO and JW ANDERSON’s Fall/Winter 2026 collection draws on theater, academia and spontaneous artistic expressionCropped silhouettes lead the outerwear, including a genderless Short Blouson and a women’s Padded Short JacketLambswool Fair Isle knits, flannel shirting and wool cashmere accessories bring vintage detailing into everyday wear UNIQLO and JW Anderson have unveiled their Fall/Winter 2026 collection, a season rooted in the worlds of theater and academic culture. Announced in New York, the lineup pairs vintage-inspired details with practical function across 13 womenswear pieces, 12 menswear pieces and four accessories. The result reads like a well-worn campus wardrobe, sharpened with modern proportions and cold-weather performance.Outerwear sets the tone, with shortened lengths running through the season’s key jackets. The genderless Short Blouson pairs a cropped body with a relaxed silhouette for a contemporary take on a classic zip-up, shown here in a deep burgundy with a gathered hem and cuffs. For women, the Padded Short Jacket delivers soft, generous padding in a boxy charcoal shape finished with oversized flap pockets, blending volume with everyday practicality.Layering pieces round out the cold-weather offering. Men get a Windproof Fleece Jacket, while women receive a Fleece Short Blouson, both designed around a comfortable fit that slips easily under or over other garments. The women’s Pleated Skirt adds movement to the mix through an asymmetric cut, offering a dressier counterpoint to the collection’s utilitarian outerwear.Knitwear carries much of the collection’s academic character. The Lambswool Fair Isle Crew Neck Sweater wraps an oatmeal base in red and pale blue motifs, while V-neck sweaters and crew neck vests arrive in an array of colorways and bold patterns. Underneath, the Flannel Boxy Shirt works a cream-and-black check into a cropped, open-collar shape, and the Straight Work Pants and faded, distressed Straight Jeans anchor the looks with relaxed, straight-leg cuts.Anderson framed the season as a meeting point between the stage and the classroom. “This season reflects the worldview of theater and academic culture, the intersections of unbound creativity. items.title: Starbucks Reportedly Wants to Buy Chipotle in a Nearly $39 Billion USD Deal
items.text: Starbucks Reportedly Wants to Buy Chipotle in a Nearly $39 Billion USD Deal Summary Starbucks has reportedly been working with advisers on a possible proposal to acquire Chipotle Mexican GrillThe coffee giant’s market value is close to triple Chipotle’s, though analysts warn a deal could strain its finances mid-turnaroundNeither company has confirmed the talks, and it is unclear whether a formal offer will follow Starbucks is reportedly exploring a takeover of Chipotle Mexican Grill, according to the Financial Times. The coffee chain has spent recent months consulting advisers on a potential proposal for the fast-casual brand, which carries a valuation of nearly $39 billion USD. Neither company has publicly addressed the reported discussions.On paper, the size gap is significant. Starbucks holds a market capitalization of roughly $107 billion USD, making it around 2.7 times larger than its potential target. Even so, swallowing a company of Chipotle’s scale would not come cheap, and financing is already emerging as the central question. “A deal could require heavy borrowing or issuing shares,” said Lale Akoner, global market strategist at eToro. “Without a compelling financial case, investors may view the deal as an expensive distraction.”The footprint numbers tell a different story. Chipotle closed out 2025 with close to 4,000 restaurants in the US and only about 100 abroad, while Starbucks operates approximately 40,000 stores globally. That imbalance is the core of the bullish case. Northcoast Research analyst Jim Sanderson pointed to Starbucks’ licensed partnerships in Europe as a potential launchpad for pushing Chipotle overseas at a much faster clip.Markets reacted quickly. Chipotle stock rose about 6% on Thursday, October 8, after the report surfaced, while Starbucks shares slipped roughly 3%. The bump offers some relief for Chipotle, whose share price has fallen by almost half since Niccol exited in 2024, a stretch marked by softer foot traffic and climbing food and labor costs.Starbucks’ own metrics show a turnaround still in progress. Niccol took over as CEO in September 2024 after six years at the helm of Chipotle, where he steered the brand through its food safety fallout and built out its digital ordering arm. At Starbucks, his strategy has centered on shorter waits, better staffing and refreshed stores, backed by a labor commitment of at least $500 million USD that has weighed on margins. items.title: A24’s ‘The Encyclopedia of Movie Cats’ Catalogs More Than 1,000 Felines Across Film History
items.text: A24’s ‘The Encyclopedia of Movie Cats’ Catalogs More Than 1,000 Felines Across Film History Summary A24 has published a 420-page reference book dedicated entirely to cats that have appeared on screenEntries run alphabetically and cover everything from famous characters to uncredited extras and real-life animal actorsOriginal essays and spotlight entries group felines by the roles they tend to play in cinema A24 has unveiled The Encyclopedia of Movie Cats, a hardcover reference guide documenting more than 1,000 cats that have appeared in film. Organized from A to Z, the book treats screen felines as a cast in their own right, cataloging marquee characters and fleeting cameos with equal care.The premise starts with range. Across film history, cats have been cast as companions, antagonists and partners in crime, and have turned up aboard spacecraft, dressed in people’s clothes, named as heirs to fortunes and even transformed into half-human creatures. The encyclopedia argues that few animals have been handed such a wide spread of parts, and sets out to track all of them.That scope shows in who gets an entry. Household names like Puss in Boots and Mr. Bigglesworth sit alongside Holly Golightly’s orange tabby and Jones from the Alien franchise, but the book gives just as much attention to the anonymous strays and skittish cats that dart through a single scene. It also reaches back into myth and folklore, featuring the messengers of the goddess Bastet and witches’ familiars, and profiles real working cat actors whose credits are long enough to fill an IMDb page.Navigation follows a strict alphabetical order. The entries open with Abby Barnes’ Cat from The Truth About Cats & Dogs (1996) and close with the Zip-A-Tone Kitten from Zip-Tone-Cat-Tune (1972). Woven between them are original essays sorting felines into recurring screen archetypes, including Bad Omen Cats, Cat Lady Cats and Talking Cats, plus highlighted entries that map out individual feline filmographies and the most notable cats in cinema.A24’s physical build matches the reference-book ambitions. The encyclopedia is bound in a buckram-wrapped hardcover, runs to 420 pages and measures 7.75 x 10.25 inches, with more than 1,900 film stills illustrating the entries throughout.The Encyclopedia of Movie Cats is available to order now via the A24 Shop and ships by October 23. items.text: Two Hong Kong Icons, One Case File: TEAM WANG design x CLOT Is Here Summary TEAM WANG design and CLOT have joined forces for “ON MY WAY,” a debut collaboration rooted in Hong Kong as the shared starting point for Jackson Wang and Edison ChenThe collection is organized around CASE NO.852, an archive-inspired design system named after Hong Kong’s international dialing codeThe limited lineup covers portrait T-shirts, Logo T-shirts, a Tang-style jacket, portrait masks and mugs TEAM WANG design and CLOT have unveiled "ON MY WAY,” the first collaboration between the labels led by Jackson Wang and Edison Chen. Built on a case-file aesthetic dubbed "CASE NO.852," the limited collection treats both founders, both brands and every individual piece as entries in a single archive. Its “ON MY WAY” guiding concept frames the partnership as two creative journeys that began in Hong Kong, split across different eras and disciplines, and have now converged.The design backbone of the collection borrows from old dossiers and personnel records, reworking portraits, names, biographical details, file numbers and traceability data into a graphic system of its own. At its center sits the number 852, Hong Kong’s international calling code, which functions as a master ID connecting the two founders, the two labels and each product. The effect is a capsule where every garment and object reads like a logged record, catalogued under one shared file.That approach is most literal on the portrait T-shirts, which carry black-and-white images of Wang and Chen alongside their names, personal details and CASE NO.852 identification codes. Rather than straightforward fan merch, the tees present each founder as a documented subject, matching the rest of the archival language running through the line.The Logo T-shirts extend the same system with archive numbering, the 852 marker, eyelet hardware and a strict black-and-white palette. They also pull design cues from two existing TEAM WANG design series, “SPARKLES” and “Invisible Man,” folding TWD’s own back catalog into the record. The name itself plays on cohesion and the sense of being on the same squad, a nod to how the partnership bridges the cultural backgrounds of both camps. Those details carry over to the Tang-style jacket, portrait masks and mugs, pushing the capsule beyond apparel into lifestyle goods, all released in limited quantities.The portrait masks double as the centerpiece of the “ON MY WAY” campaign, which casts skaters, dancers,

items.title: Seth Rogen’s Houseplant x Droplet “Scent Burner” Suspends Hand-Blown Amber Glass Over a Tealight
items.text: Seth Rogen’s Houseplant x Droplet “Scent Burner” Suspends Hand-Blown Amber Glass Over a Tealight Summary Houseplant and Droplet have reworked Droplet’s cult-favorite Scent Burner as a special-edition piece built around The House ScentA custom hand-blown amber glass vessel hangs within a solid brass frame, warming fragrance oil and water above a tealightThe set includes the burner, The House Scent Fragrance Oil and eight tealight candles Houseplant and Droplet have released The Houseplant Scent Burner, a special-edition take on one of Droplet’s best-known designs that reframes Houseplant’s signature fragrance as something to be heated rather than sprayed or diffused. The piece pairs a hand-blown amber glass vessel with a solid brass frame, turning the act of scenting a room into a slow, flame-lit process.The burner marks the third chapter in the partnership between Seth Rogen’s lifestyle company and the modern British fragrance house. The two first came together on an incense collection, then followed it with The House Scent Reed Diffuser. This time, they’ve turned to the Scent Burner, a Droplet signature that has built a loyal following for its unconventional mix of fragrance and form. “What excites us about this collaboration is that it goes beyond giving the burner a new look; it creates a completely different way to experience The House Scent,” said Droplet co-founders Sam and Lucie Beecham.The construction is what sets it apart. A custom amber glass vessel, blown by hand, sits suspended inside a frame of solid brass, with a tealight placed directly beneath it. The open structure keeps the flame, the glass and the frame all on display, so the piece reads as a sculptural object on a shelf even when it isn’t lit.In use, the mechanics are simple and analog. Users add 5 to 10 drops of The House Scent Fragrance Oil to water in the glass, and the tealight gently warms the mixture from below. Rather than releasing scent all at once, the heat lets the fragrance build gradually and spread through the space, with the flickering flame adding a layer of ambient light.The fragrance itself was developed by Rogen in Grasse, France. The House Scent opens with bright pink pepper and soft peony, then settles into warm santal and rich pine, balancing spice and florals against a creamy, woody base. Warmed in the burner, the blend becomes fuller and more enveloping than in its other formats. For Rogen, the appeal lies in the routine around it. “What really spoke to us was t

items.title: A 'Naruto x Ninku' Limited Anime Series Is Officially Happening
items.text: A 'Naruto x Ninku' Limited Anime Series Is Officially Happening Summary The “NARUTO: What’s Next?” panel at New York Comic Con 2026 unveiled a 'Naruto x Ninku' TV anime limited series with a teaser trailer and key visualNoriyuki Abe directs the crossover at Studio Pierrot, with Tetsuya Nishio handling both character design and chief animation directionKishimoto’s new Naruto Shadow Rising manga arrived with a super teaser trailer, alongside a multi-year franchise roadmap called PROJECT RASENGAN Studio Pierrot’s Naruto x Ninku anime limited series was officially announced at the “NARUTO: What’s Next?” panel during New York Comic Con 2026, pairing Masashi Kishimoto’s ninja saga with the world of Ninku across four episodes. A teaser trailer and key visual accompanied the reveal, and the creators of both manga are supervising the production. The same panel also confirmed Naruto Shadow Rising, an all-new manga drawn by Kishimoto himself.Noriyuki Abe takes the director’s chair for the crossover, a fitting choice given that he also directed the original Ninku TV anime at Pierrot in the mid-1990s. Kishimoto shares supervising duties with Ninku creator Koji Kiriyama giving the project direct oversight from the two authors whose work it merges. Nozomi Fukui supports Abe as assistant director, while Hinatasho holds the story credit.Tetsuya Nishio carries the heaviest visual load on the production, serving as both chief animation director and character designer. Consolidating those two roles under one artist means the task of reconciling two distinct manga art styles into a single cohesive look rests largely with him. Nishio also designed the characters for the original Naruto TV anime, which gives him a long working history with Team 7.The score is split across a three-way credit of Yasuharu Takanashi, -Yaiba- and Yusuke Honma, effectively blending each franchise’s musical lineage. Takanashi and -Yaiba- previously composed for Naruto Shippuden, while Honma scored the original Ninku anime. The four-episode runtime marks the series as a contained event rather than an ongoing broadcast.On the publishing front, Naruto Shadow Rising was introduced through a super teaser trailer, though the panel held back plot details, characters and a serialization date. Kishimoto drawing the series personally makes it his most hands-on Naruto manga project announced since the original run concluded, and more information is slated for the franchise’s Jump Festa 2027 panel.Both projects si

items.title: Wasted Paris x Clarks Originals Pack Britpop Memorabilia Into a Customizable Wallabee Lite
items.text: Wasted Paris x Clarks Originals Pack Britpop Memorabilia Into a Customizable Wallabee Lite Name: Wasted Paris x Clarks Wallabee LiteColorway: Black/BlackSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: October 15Where to Buy: WastedWasted Paris and Clarks Originals have teamed up on a Wallabee Lite in Black/Black that treats the shoe as a vessel for Britpop memorabilia. Built around a set of interchangeable pins, a guitar pick and a custom fob, the collaboration lets wearers decorate the silhouette themselves, mirroring the way fans of the era accumulated badges and souvenirs over time.The story begins in the mid-to-late ’90s, when the Wallabee became part of the Britpop landscape. The shoe turned up everywhere the scene gathered, from pubs and indie gigs to football terraces and backstage areas, along with every street that connected them. Britpop itself was never solely a sound. It was a mash-up of tastes, rituals, references and possessions that together formed the visual shorthand of a generation.Wasted Paris approaches that moment through memorabilia. Badges, charms, keepsakes and small personal touches pick up meaning the longer they’re kept, each one tied to a specific place, night or memory. The collaboration pulls from that same pool of era-defining imagery and everyday ephemera, and keeps it intentionally rough around the edges, favoring found fragments over anything too refined.That thinking is built directly into the shoe. The Wallabee Lite arrives fully blacked out, with a custom vamp carrying a tonal lion graphic and a co-branded fob that hangs from the laces. Interchangeable pins can be clipped onto the upper in any arrangement, alongside a guitar pick, so no two pairs need to look the same. A set of extra laces in contrasting blue rounds out the kit for further personalization.The packaging doubles as part of the collectible. Everything comes in a custom square box featuring a photograph by Kevin Cummins, the photographer whose images helped define the look of Manchester’s music scene. It’s a fitting partner for Wasted, which has worked across indie music, skateboarding, vintage culture and underground cinema since 2012 and regularly collaborates with photographers and musicians from those scenes. items.title: The 'One-Punch Man' Season 3 Part 2 Trailer Turns the "Monster Association Saga" Up to Full Power

The reveal locks the new episodes into the Winter 2027 anime lineup with a January debut, picking up the thread left by the first half of Season 3, which concluded in 2025. The timing also lands as the franchise marks its 10th anniversary.Part 2 continues adapting the "Monster Association Saga" from ONE’s original series, which stands as the longest arc the franchise has produced so far. Season 3 opened that chapter in earnest, and the second half promises an escalation in clashes between the S-Class Heroes and the most dangerous monsters in the organization’s ranks. Tatsumaki is primed for one of the standout bouts of this run, giving the psychic powerhouse a showcase that has been building since her introduction.All of it points toward the arc’s ultimate collision between Garou and Saitama, although whether that face-off arrives within this batch of episodes remains unconfirmed. For now, the trailer and poster set the stage for a season that leans fully into large-scale action, with the creative team, music and source material all aligned toward the saga’s endgame.Shinpei Nagai directs at J.C. Staff, while Tomohiro Suzuki handles series composition and Makoto Miyazaki returns to score the music. Character design duties are split across a trio of artists in Chikashi Kubota, Shinjiro Kuroda and Ryosuke Shirakawa, a configuration that keeps the visual language consistent heading into the arc’s heavier battles.The trailer also doubles as a first listen for the new opening, “Never Done -SUPREME POWER VS ULTIMATE FEAR-,” performed by JAM Project. The anisong supergroup’s return extends a relationship that stretches back to the anime’s very first season, when it delivered the original opening theme “THE HERO!!” The new track’s title alone hints at the scale of the confrontations ahead, framing the season as a coll

items.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander Reveals He Personally Hand-Drew the Upcoming Nike SHAI 002
items.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander Reveals He Personally Hand-Drew the Upcoming Nike SHAI 002 Summary Shai Gilgeous-Alexander revealed that he personally hand-drew the design for his upcoming Nike SHAI 002 signature sneakerThe model marks his second signature silhouette and his first brand-new design following his move from Converse to Nike BasketballThe Nike SHAI 002 is expected to launch in early 2027 with technical specifications and official imagery still under wraps Nike and Oklahoma City Thunder superstar Shai Gilgeous-Alexander are preparing the upcoming Nike SHAI 002. Following a recent interview with TIME, Gilgeous-Alexander confirmed that he personally hand-drew the design for his second signature silhouette.Maintaining a direct creative role in his footwear line, Gilgeous-Alexander previously crafted early sketches for the SHAI 001 before taking the exact same approach for his follow-up model.
