items.title: Le Labo Expands Its Classic Candle Line With PAPYRUS 20
items.text: Le Labo Expands Its Classic Candle Line With PAPYRUS 20 Summary Le Labo unveils PAPYRUS 20, a Classic Candle honoring the ancient art of recording stories.Earthy cypriol and deep musk ground ephemeral ylang-ylang and warm labdanum.Hand-poured in a clear glass jar with Le Labo's iconic typewriter label. Le Labo turns the act of remembering into scent with PAPYRUS 20, the newest addition to its Classic Candle collection. Inspired by ancient civilizations pressing papyrus reeds into sheets capable of carrying stories across centuries, the fragrance explores a more elusive kind of preservation: memories that return through scent without warning.At its core is cypriol, a material historically associated with papyrus, bringing an earthy, dry and slightly root-like depth that feels almost like aged paper, soil and weathered wood. Against it, ylang-ylang introduces a fleeting floral softness, while warm labdanum lends an ambered, resinous glow and a musk accord settles into the background.The composition moves between something archival and something intangible — the imagined smell of an old manuscript warmed by sunlight, its pages carrying traces of earth and resin before the fragrance slowly dissolves back into the room. Le Labo describes PAPYRUS 20 as an ode to both what endures and what cannot be held, treating fragrance itself as an “archivist of the ephemeral.”Its presentation remains deliberately stripped back, allowing that tension between permanence and impermanence to continue visually. Priced at $92 USD, the 245-gram candle is hand-crafted in the U.S. using a high concentration of fragrance oils, a custom wax blend and natural-fiber wicks, housed in Le Labo’s familiar clear glass vessel with an apothecary-style personalized label. The accompanying kraft box repeats the same utilitarian typography and workshop-minded simplicity, giving the object the feeling of something catalogued, dated and stored away — almost like an archival specimen waiting to be rediscovered. For more details, head over to Le Labo’s online and offline stores. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Prada Gives the America’s Cup Sneaker an Autumnal Update
items.text: Prada Gives the America’s Cup Sneaker an Autumnal Update Name: Prada America's Cup sneakerColorway: Teak/Blue, Cacao/BordeauxSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: October 13Where to Buy: PradaPrada revisits one of its most recognizable footwear silhouettes with a new release of the America’s Cup sneaker, introducing two colorways: “Teak/Blue” and “Cacao/Bordeaux.”Originally conceived in 1997 for the Luna Rossa sailing team, the model retains the streamlined, aerodynamic profile and technical sensibility that have defined it for nearly three decades. Staying true to the beloved original silhouette, the updated America's Cup sneaker maintains its distinctive, multi-layered construction. The upper showcases a dynamic interplay of textures, combining smooth, glossy patent leather overlays with highly breathable, technical textile mesh panels.While the aesthetic heritage and signature Linea Rossa heel branding remain completely intact, the footwear receives a significant modern upgrade underfoot with the introduction of an innovative, ultra-lightweight rubber sole. This technical enhancement ensures the shoe delivers superior modern comfort and everyday wearability without sacrificing the rugged, utilitarian charm that made the 1997 original a global streetwear staple."Teak/Blue" pairs warm brown tones with cooler blue accents, while "Cacao/Bordeaux" shifts into a richer combination of deep chocolate brown and wine-red hues. Both treatments emphasize the sneaker’s distinctive interplay of textile and leather, using changes in material and tone to accentuate the curved paneling and elongated lines of the upper rather than dramatically altering the familiar shape. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Beats Catches Pikachu and Mimikyu for Its First Charm-Loaded Pill Speaker
items.text: Beats Catches Pikachu and Mimikyu for Its First Charm-Loaded Pill Speaker Summary Beats and The Pokémon Company International have teamed up on a special-edition Pill speaker dressed in Pikachu’s electric yellow and a grayscale take on MimikyuA set of bespoke charms, interactive packaging and a color-matched lanyard round out the collectible designUnder the costume sits the standard Pill hardware, including USB-C lossless audio, up to 24 hours of playback and IP67 dust and water resistance Beats has joined forces with The Pokémon Company International on the special-edition Pokémon x Beats Pill, a portable Bluetooth speaker built around two fan-favorite Pokémon. Pikachu and Mimikyu share the spotlight across the speaker’s grill and body, pairing a high-voltage color story with a moodier monochrome counterpart.Both Pokémon appear on the speaker grill, with the front and back of the Pill split between two visual identities. Pikachu supplies the bright, unmistakable yellow, while Mimikyu is rendered in shades of gray, setting up a contrast between bold energy and quiet mystery. The duo is a fitting match, since Mimikyu is known in the games for disguising itself under a homemade Pikachu costume.The accessories mark a first for the line. This is the debut of charms on a Beats Pill, and the special edition includes a bespoke set featuring a Poké Ball, the Beats “b” logo and lightning bolts that nod to Pikachu’s signature move set. The packaging gets its own interactive design treatment as well, giving collectors a reason to hold onto the box.On the audio side, the Pill runs a custom acoustic system tuned for deep bass and sound big enough to fill a room. Plugging in via USB-C unlocks high-resolution lossless playback, and owners of two Pills can link them wirelessly in either Amplify Mode for more volume or Stereo Mode for left and right separation.The speaker is built to travel, with up to 24 hours of battery life and an IP67 rating against dust and water that makes it safe for the gym, the beach or a backyard. A removable lanyard matched to the colorway and a soft-grip silicone back make it easy to carry, and the included USB-C cable lets the Pill double as a power bank for a compatible phone.For Beats, the project is less about novelty and more about meeting an already devoted audience where it lives. “Pokémon Trainers are some of the most passionate in the world, and we saw an opportunity to channel that energy into something fun, unexpected, and created es

items.title: Wrangler and ROA Reimagine Denim Workwear for FW26
items.text: Wrangler and ROA Reimagine Denim Workwear for FW26 Summary Wrangler and ROA reunite for their second collaboration, blending American denim heritage with Italian technical design.The FW26 capsule features denim cargos, hooded jackets and caps in two washes.Inspired by a Swedish lumberjack's training routines, the collection launches today. Wrangler and ROA are returning for a second collaboration for Fall/Winter 2026, continuing their exploration of the intersection between American denim heritage and Italian technical design. Building on their debut collection, the latest release revisits Wrangler's workwear roots through ROA's outdoor-oriented perspective, presenting a concise lineup designed around utility, durability and everyday versatility.The three-piece capsule comprises the Wrangler x ROA Denim Cargo, Denim Hooded Jacket and Denim 6 Panel Cap, each offered in two washes: Owl Dark and Owl Light. Together, the pieces establish a cohesive denim wardrobe that draws on traditional workwear while reflecting ROA's functional design sensibilities, with the contrasting washes offering different interpretations of the same utilitarian aesthetic.The collection's accompanying narrative takes inspiration from Edvin, a 26-year-old forestry teacher from Orsa, a small town in northern Sweden, as he prepares for a professional lumberjack championship. Rather than focusing on the competition itself, the story turns its attention to the discipline and routines that precede it, from training in the woods and maintaining equipment to sharpening axes, traveling and recovering between sessions.Through this perspective, the collaboration places the everyday realities of physical work and preparation at the center of its visual identity, reinforcing the relationship between purposeful clothing and the environments in which it is worn. The second Wrangler x ROA collection launches on October 13, 2026, and will be available online through ROA's official website and Wrangler.com. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Breitling Gives Aston Martin Valhalla Owners Their Own Bespoke Super Chronomat
items.text: Breitling Gives Aston Martin Valhalla Owners Their Own Bespoke Super Chronomat Summary Breitling opens a bespoke Super Chronomat program exclusively for Aston Martin Valhalla owners.Buyers can customize two Super Chronomat models with car-inspired colors and personal engravings.Options include a B19 perpetual calendar chronograph and 38mm diamond-set automatic. Breitling and Aston Martin have deepened their partnership with a highly exclusive bespoke program designed solely for owners of the Aston Martin Valhalla supercar. Reflecting the engineering and aerodynamic mastery of the limited-production, 1,079 PS hybrid Valhalla, Breitling has opened the design process of its distinctive Super Chronomat collection to these select clients. Through a dedicated configurator, owners can commission a timepiece that mirrors their individual vehicle specification and personal taste, merging the high-performance worlds of British automotive design and Swiss watchmaking.The bespoke program offers two distinct models for customization, the first being the Super Chronomat B19 44 Perpetual Calendar Chronograph. Housed in a 44mm titanium case on Breitling’s signature Rouleaux bracelet, this model boasts a complex automatic perpetual calendar chronograph movement that requires no major manual adjustments until the year 2100. It features a carbon-fiber dial, a 96-hour power reserve, and a display caseback that showcases a personalized rotor. Valhalla owners can further customize the timepiece by selecting from a range of exclusive colors for the rehaut, seconds hand, and counter hands.The second option is the Super Chronomat Automatic 38, which balances performance materials with a refined 38mm stainless-steel case and a diamond-set bezel. This three-hand automatic model also incorporates a textured carbon-fiber dial and offers customizable colors for the rehaut and hands, as well as a personalized caseback engraving. Both bespoke timepieces provide an unparalleled ownership experience, which is further enhanced by a complimentary five-year membership to the upcoming Breitling Social Club in New York, set to open in late 2027. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The 2027 Jeep Wrangler Switchback Debuts With Custom Look
items.text: The 2027 Jeep Wrangler Switchback Debuts With Custom Look Summary Jeep drops the 2027 Wrangler Switchback, closing out its monthly "Twelve 4 Twelve" special edition campaignThe factory-built custom aesthetic features swapped doors and hoods in Gloss Black and Sting-Gray colorwaysOrders open in November with prices starting at $66,695 USD for the two-door Rubicon X-based configuration Jeep officially pulled the cover off the 2027 Jeep Wrangler Switchback, serving as the twelfth and final model in its yearlong special edition rollout. Closing out the brand's ambitious "Twelve 4 Twelve" campaign, which dropped one unique Wrangler iteration every month for an entire year, the Wrangler Switchback arrives with a heavy nod to custom off-road culture. The factory-produced contrasting colorway emulates a raw, aggressive look seen on owner-modified Wranglers. By leaning into an aesthetic where mismatched body panels are historically added to achieve a custom multicolored look or replace pieces damaged during off-roading, Jeep transforms a garage-repair necessity into a factory-backed statement piece.To achieve these contrasting color schemes on the factory floor, Jeep altered its standard manufacturing rhythm. The brand sequenced Gloss Black and Sting-Gray Wranglers to run sequentially down the assembly line. Line workers manually swapped the doors of consecutively sequenced vehicles during the production cycle. Factory workers later switched the hoods during the final upfitting process. This manufacturing sequence results in two distinct mismatched exterior configurations. One configuration features gray bodywork, contrasting black doors and a matching black hood. The second option flips that color scheme, producing Wranglers with black bodywork, contrasting gray doors and a gray hood.Beyond the panel swaps, the Wrangler Switchback features vibrant Gecko accents across its exterior. Bright hits of color appear on the front grille, exterior wheel rings, bold hood graphic and rear swing-gate decal. That attention to detail extends into the cabin, where the interior features premium nappa leather with contrasting Sea Salt accents. Custom Lime stitching runs throughout the interior alongside Switchback-exclusive graphics.Structurally, the Wrangler Switchback is based on the high-end Wrangler Rubicon X trim, ensuring the rugged visual aesthetic is backed by heavy-duty trail capability. Enthusiasts can order the limited special edition in classic two-door or expanded fou

items.title: MAAP and Mental Athletic Merge Technical Cycling Gear With Off-Bike Lifestyle Staples
items.text: MAAP and Mental Athletic Merge Technical Cycling Gear With Off-Bike Lifestyle Staples Summary MAAP and Mental Athletic have announced a limited-edition collection bridging technical cycling apparel and off-bike garmentsThe technical lineup features the Pro Air Jersey 3.0 Team Bib Evo Cargo bibs and a new Lightweight Vest alongside casual hoodies and accessoriesThe capsule showcases vibrant electric green corrosive yellow and synthetic magenta tones releasing globally on October 15 Performance cycling apparel brand MAAP and independent sports culture platform Mental Athletic have officially announced a limited-edition capsule collection. Spanning technical cycling gear and off-bike lifestyle apparel, the project merges two distinct perspectives to explore performance, creativity, and contemporary bike culture.Shot on location across New York City, the accompanying campaign contrasts high-function apparel against the city’s unpredictable urban environment. Reinterpreting modern athletic identity, the collection features high-contrast shades of electric green, corrosive yellow, and synthetic magenta designed to stand out against visual background noise. The collaboration pushes back against seamless, algorithmic aesthetics, giving athletic performance a broader definition centered on attitude, physical commitment, and visual experimentation.The lineup reflects this duality across on-bike and off-bike offerings. On the bike, the technical capsule centers on the Pro Air Jersey 3.0 in both short and long-sleeve options, the Team Bib Evo Cargo bibs, a Mesh Short Sleeve Tee, and a brand-new Lightweight Vest. Off the bike, the lifestyle range includes a curated selection of hoodies, tees, caps, socks, and everyday accessories.The MAAP x Mental Athletic collection releases on October 15, 2026, via maap.cc, Mental Athletic, and MAAP LaB retail stores worldwide. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Apple Captures Record 22% Q3 Smartphone Market Share
items.text: Apple Captures Record 22% Q3 Smartphone Market Share Summary Apple captured a record 22% of the global smartphone market in the third quarter of 2026Worldwide smartphone shipments plummeted 20% year-over-year to hit a 14-year lowAn ongoing memory crisis and rising device prices forced brands to prioritize profit over sheer volume Apple just carved out its largest third-quarter slice of the global smartphone market in history, defying a brutal industry-wide slump. According to a newly released report from Counterpoint Research, worldwide smartphone shipments plummeted 20% year-over-year during the third quarter of 2026. The severe double-digit drop pushed global shipments down to their absolute lowest third-quarter level in 14 years. While the report attributed the market decline to memory constraints and rising prices, it notably did not specify what that 20% decline translated to in absolute shipment numbers.Despite the broader market slump, Apple managed to elevate its global smartphone shipment share past the 20% threshold for the very first time in any third quarter. The tech heavyweight ultimately shipped 22% of all smartphones during Q3 2026, marking a significant jump from the 18% share it held in Q3 2025. This record-setting share came even as the brand navigated its own volume declines, largely driven by the absence of a base iPhone 18 model. Without that entry-level flagship, Apple experienced a smaller launch-month channel fill compared to what the full iPhone 17 lineup achieved a year earlier. To offset that higher shipment decline, the company leaned heavily on sustained market momentum from the older iPhone 17 series. Top-tier iPhone 18 Pro models logged a stronger launch than their direct predecessors, generating particularly heavy traction across China and India.Apple's historic surge rapidly closed the gap on Samsung, though the South Korean brand managed to maintain its first-place position in the global smartphone market with a 23% share. Other top five vendors took a noticeable hit during the quarter. Xiaomi secured third place with a 10% market share, followed closely by OPPO capturing a 9% shipment share. vivo rounded out the top five leaderboard by claiming an 8% share of shipments. Crucially, Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo all watched their shipment shares decline compared to their standing in Q3 2025.Faced with crippling component constraints and rising costs, OEMs increasingly shifted their strategies to prioritize profitability over sheer

items.title: James Fuentes Gallery Revisits Teruko Yokoi’s Transpacific Abstraction
items.text: James Fuentes Gallery Revisits Teruko Yokoi’s Transpacific Abstraction Summary Teruko Yokoi’s A Pacific Line marks her first Los Angeles solo show in over four decades.The exhibition traces her evolution from figuration to abstraction.Works span 1954–2005, bridging Japanese aesthetics and postwar Western modernism. Teruko Yokoi’s decades-spanning practice returns to Los Angeles with A Pacific Line, a new exhibition at James Fuentes Gallery tracing the Japanese-Swiss painter’s singular path through postwar abstraction. Marking her first solo presentation in the city in more than four decades, the show carries particular resonance on the West Coast: Yokoi first arrived in the United States by ship in 1954, shortly after the end of the U.S. occupation of Japan, before enrolling at the California School of Fine Arts in San Francisco. That self-directed move became the starting point for a career shaped by continual relocation across Japan, the United States, France and Switzerland, while resisting easy placement within any single school or movement. Bringing together works made between 1954 and 2005, A Pacific Line presents Yokoi’s practice as an ongoing conversation between traditional Japanese aesthetics and postwar Western modernism.Yokoi’s early years in the U.S. marked a decisive shift from figuration toward the highly personal abstraction that would come to define her work. "Pose" from 1954 still retains the contours of a seated human figure, but its body already begins to dissolve into blocks of orange, gray and brown, anticipating her increasingly rhythmic treatment of form and color.After moving to New York in 1955, she studied with Hans Hofmann, attended the Art Students League and moved within circles that included Joan Mitchell, Kenzo Okada and Mark Rothko, while living for a period at the Chelsea Hotel with painter Sam Francis. Yet her work remained distinct from the dominant language of Abstract Expressionism. Paintings such as 1960’s "Shizen–Natur," with its deep green field, saturated blue forms and streaks of red and white, reveal a vocabulary grounded as much in Japanese calligraphy, haiku and observations of nature as in gestural abstraction. Yokoi herself described her paintings as “poems written in colors,” a sentiment rooted in childhood walks through the Kiso River landscape and early lessons in calligraphy and poetry from her father.The exhibition also follows Yokoi’s material evolution after settling permanently in Bern in 1962, where

items.title: Jaylen Brown's 7UICE Announces Special-Edition BAPE STA Collaboration
items.text: Jaylen Brown's 7UICE Announces Special-Edition BAPE STA Collaboration Summary 7UICE and BAPE have officially partnered to release a special-edition BAPE STA collaborationThe sneaker merges BAPE's streetwear heritage with Jaylen Brown's creative vision representing individuality and creativityThe release will be available in strictly limited quantities with no planned restocks once inventory sells out 7UICE and BAPE have officially joined forces to introduce a special-edition BAPE STA. Uniting the worlds of basketball, culture, and contemporary streetwear, the collaborative footwear release marks an official union between the Japanese streetwear staple and the athlete-led lifestyle label.The collaboration serves as a bold fusion of BAPE’s long-standing streetwear heritage and Jaylen Brown’s creative direction for 7UICE. Centered around core themes of individuality, creativity, and the power of pushing personal boundaries, the limited-edition sneaker underscores the evolving dialogue between professional basketball and modern streetwear culture.Reflecting the exclusive nature of the drop, the collaborative silhouette will be produced in strictly limited quantities. Both imprints confirmed that the digital release will operate under an explicit no-restock policy, ensuring that once pairs sell out from the webstore, no additional units will be released.The 7UICE x BAPE STA releases exclusively online on October 18 via 7UICE. items.title: Kojima Productions and CASETiFY Unveil High-Concept Tech Capsule
items.text: Kojima Productions and CASETiFY Unveil High-Concept Tech Capsule Summary Kojima Productions and CASETiFY celebrate their 10th and 15th anniversaries with a collaboration.The collection features Yoji Shinkawa-designed phone cases, Death Stranding accessories and collectible cards.Launching globally on October 15, the range includes sculptural cases, character-inspired accessories and luggage. Hideo Kojima's distinctive creative universe is making its way onto everyday tech accessories as Kojima Productions teams up with CASETiFY for a limited-edition collection celebrating two major milestones: the Japanese game studio's 10th anniversary and CASETiFY's 15th anniversary.Developed in collaboration with Kojima and longtime art director Yoji Shinkawa at Kojima Productions' Tokyo headquarters, the range translates the studio's cinematic visual identity and the dystopian world of Death Stranding* *into a series of functional accessories. Moving beyond conventional graphic prints, the collection explores sculptural construction, tactile finishes and industrial-inspired detailing.Leading the lineup is the Yoji Shinkawa Original Design – 3D Crafted Aluminum Case, which transforms the artist's signature illustrations into a dimensional design. Other highlights include the Yoji Shinkawa Art Edition – From Sapiens to Ludens (Gold Camera Ring) Case and Ludens Emblem – Carbon Fiber Case, alongside designs referencing Death Stranding 2, the studio's anniversary, its recognizable logos and damage sensor tape motifs.The collaboration also introduces an assortment of accessories inspired by characters and objects from the Death Stranding *universe. Standouts include a Qpid Wristlet modeled after the necklace worn by protagonist Sam Porter Bridges, plush keychains depicting Dollman and the Ludens Duck, and metallic grip stands featuring the Ludens Golden Disk and Kojima Productions emblems. The release also incorporates a collectible element, with purchases accompanied by a blind-packed card featuring official studio artwork, randomly selected from several designs. Buyers of the 3D Crafted Aluminum Case will additionally receive two exclusive card designs unavailable through the wider collection.The Kojima Productions x CASETiFY collection launches globally on October 15, 2026, through CASETiFY's official website, Co-Lab app and participating CASETiFY STUDiO locations. items.title: Football Stars Become Marines in Official Trailer for Netflix's 'The Mosquito Bowl'
items.text: Football Stars Become Marines in Official Trailer for Netflix's 'The Mosquito Bowl' Summary Netflix has released the first trailer for director Peter Berg’s WWII feature film 'The Mosquito Bowl'Based on Buzz Bissinger’s book the narrative follows four star college athletes who enlist in the Marines following Pearl HarborThe movie opens in select theaters on October 30, 2026 ahead of its Netflix streaming debut on November 25, 2026 Netflix has officially debuted the first trailer for director Peter Berg's World War II drama, The Mosquito Bowl. The feature adapts Pulitzer Prize winner Buzz Bissinger’s bestselling book The Mosquito Bowl: A Game of Life and Death in World War II.The film stars Nicholas Galitzine as John McLaughry, Bill Skarsgård as Bob Bauman, Ray Nicholson as Tony Butkovich, and Tom Francis as Dave Schreiner. Depicting four prominent college football athletes who trade their stadium jerseys for United States Marine Corps uniforms following the attack on Pearl Harbor, the story follows their transition from collegiate sports to military combat in the Pacific theater.Berg, who also appears on screen as General Simon Buckner, constructed practical battle environments to capture the visceral realities of war. Although named after a historic football matchup between military all-stars on Guadalcanal, the production emphasizes the broader combat experience over sports action, framing the narrative as a war story centered on athletes confronting extreme circumstances.The Mosquito Bowl opens in select theaters on October 30, 2026, before arriving on Netflix on November 25, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Jordan Brand Warms up the Season With the Air Jordan 12 "Fireside"

Following a private preview in New York, the upcoming holiday release offers a cream and brown execution across the classic retro silhouette.Initially rumored under the "Eggnog" moniker, the finalized design utilizes a lighter upper contrasted by darker structural panels. Cream leather dominates the majority of the upper, while a rich dark brown wraps around the mudguard and lower sections. Fine details include metallic brown hardware eyelets, a white rear heel pull tab, a contrasting midfoot shank plate, and matching brown accents throughout the outsole and branding.While the earth-toned palette draws comparisons to the 2024 SoleFly x Air Jordan 12 collaboration, the distinct placement of the lighter upper and darker mudguard distinguishes this pair as a standalone entry in Jordan Brand's late 2026 lineup.The Air Jordan 12 "Fireside" releases on October 24, 2026. items.title: The Rarest Thing at Regal’s ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Screenings Might Be This Doctor Doom ‘Magic: The Gathering’ Card
items.text: The Rarest Thing at Regal’s ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Screenings Might Be This Doctor Doom ‘Magic: The Gathering’ Card Summary Moviegoers catching Avengers: Doomsday during its opening weekend can score a promo-only version of Magic: The Gathering’s Doctor Doom, King of Latveria cardThe alternate-art piece, illustrated by Jorge Molina, depicts Doom in his signature green hood and metal mask with three masked Latverian Witches at his backSupplies are limited and the total print count has not been disclosed, making the card an early collector’s target tied to Marvel’s biggest villain Magic: The Gathering is marking the arrival of Avengers: Doomsday with an exclusive alternate-art version of its Doctor Doom, King of Latveria card, handed out to eligible fans during the film’s opening weekend. The promo pairs a fresh illustration of Marvel’s iron-masked tyrant with the same in-game abilities as the standard printing, turning a trip to the theater into a collectible drop.Artist Jorge Molina handles the new illustration, portraying Doom in full regalia with his green hood drawn and his metal faceplate locked in place. Behind him stand three Latverian Witches, their faces hidden behind masks of their own, framing the image as a portrait of a ruler and his court rather than a straightforward action shot.Beneath the art, the card plays exactly like the original. Doctor Doom, King of Latveria first appeared in the Doom Prevails Commander deck within Magic’s Marvel Super Heroes collection, where he causes opponents to lose life when land cards are discarded and powers up other Villain creatures on the battlefield. That makes the promo a cosmetic upgrade for existing Doom players and a standalone chase piece for collectors who care more about the artwork than the deck.Regal revealed the giveaway during New York Comic Con, tying it specifically to its Infinity Vision premium format. To qualify, fans need to be members of the theater chain’s loyalty program and attend an Infinity Vision showing of Avengers: Doomsday between December 17 and December 20. A standard screening in any other format won’t count.Regal has not shared how many cards are being distributed, and the giveaway runs only while supplies last, so even eligible members aren’t guaranteed a copy. Fans set on securing one will likely want to book an earlier showtime in the window.The timing lines up with Doom’s turn as the central threat of the next Avengers chapter, with Robert Downey Jr. returning to the MCU to

items.title: STANITEMS Turns 3D Modeling Into an Instrument With Form Synthesizer
items.text: STANITEMS Turns 3D Modeling Into an Instrument With Form Synthesizer Summary STANITEMS introduced the Form Synthesizer, a physical instrument for digital 3D modeling.Utilizing knobs and faders, it replaces complex CAD commands with real-time tactile gestures.Currently generating vases, the prototype aims to expand into furniture and architectural design. STANITEMS is rethinking the conventions of digital 3D modeling with the Form Synthesizer, a design project that replaces the familiar mouse-and-keyboard workflow with the immediacy of a physical instrument.Conceived around the idea of “playing with form” in the same way a musician manipulates sound, the device translates hands-on gestures into changes to a digital object, turning modeling into a more tactile and fluid creative process. Instead of navigating layers of software menus, users interact through tangible, analog-style controls, shifting the focus from clicking commands toward continuous physical experimentation. The result sits somewhere between a design tool and an instrument, challenging the computer interfaces that have defined digital creation for decades.That musical analogy also shapes the Form Synthesizer’s aesthetic and interaction philosophy. Physical knobs, faders and other direct controls give the device the character of hardware studio equipment, with each adjustment intended to manipulate digital geometry in real time. Compared with earlier iterations of the project, which explored different tangible interfaces including a linear fader, the current version develops those experiments into a more cohesive, dedicated system supported by custom electronics and software.Its first application is deliberately focused: the present prototype generates vase forms, allowing variations to emerge through physical input rather than conventional CAD commands. This narrow starting point functions as a proof of concept for a much broader ambition, with STANITEMS envisioning the same interface eventually shaping furniture, objects, sculptures, jewelry and architectural elements.For now, Form Synthesizer remains a developing design and research project rather than a commercially released product. For more information, head over to STANITEMS' official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Jane Levy and Jessica Rothe Face off Against a Masked Killer in Blumhouse's 'River' Slasher Horror
items.text: Jane Levy and Jessica Rothe Face off Against a Masked Killer in Blumhouse's 'River' Slasher Horror Summary Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster have released the first trailer for the upcoming slasher film 'River'Directed by Joshua Giuliano the horror feature stars Jane Levy Jessica Rothe and Max Mattern as siblings hunted by a masked strangerThe film premiered at TIFF's Midnight Madness program and hits theaters on January 15 2027 Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster have officially released the first trailer for writer-director Joshua Giuliano's upcoming slasher feature, River. The horror film made its premiere during the Midnight Madness program at the Toronto International Film Festival before being acquired for a global theatrical rollout.The narrative follows three estranged siblings—played by Jane Levy (Don't Breathe, Evil Dead), Jessica Rothe (Happy Death Day), and Max Mattern—who return to their rural hometown following the death of their father. Setting out on a remote river to scatter his ashes, their boat breaks down without cell service, leaving them stranded and mercilessly hunted by a disturbing masked figure portrayed by Dane DiLiegro (Prey).Marking Giuliano's feature directorial debut, River is produced by Steven Schneider (Insidious, Split) via Spooky Pictures alongside Nick Antosca and Alex Hedlund via Eat The Cat. Executive producers include Jason Blum, Jeffrey Tinnell, Robert Tinnell, Matt Brodlie, Jonathan Kier, and Ben Ross, with Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster, and Independent Film Company presenting the Shudder Original production in association with Upgrade.River releases exclusively in theaters on January 15, 2027. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: ASICS Utility Collection GEL-VENTX GTX, GEL-NYC 2.0 GTX & GEL-KAYANO 20
items.text: ASICS Utility Collection GEL-VENTX GTX, GEL-NYC 2.0 GTX & GEL-KAYANO 20 Name: ASICS Utility CollectionMSRP: £125 - £170 GBP (approx. $165 - $225USD)Release Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: ASICSASICS leans into all-weather utility with a three-model Utility Collection, comprising the GEL-KAYANO 20 in “Black/Gunmetal,” GEL-VENTX GTX in a “Carrier Grey/Black” and GEL-NYC 2.0 GTX in “Graphite Grey/Black.” Though each silhouette draws from a different corner of the ASICS archive, the range is unified by dark technical palettes, layered construction and performance-informed detailing.The GEL-VENTX GTX carries the strongest trail influence, building on the GEL-VENTURE lineage with a Carrier Grey/Black finish that layers charcoal mesh and synthetic overlays with lighter grey ASICS Stripes. A GORE-TEX membrane adds weather protection, while rearfoot GEL cushioning and a trail-specific traction pattern reinforce its outdoor-minded character.The GEL-NYC 2.0 GTX “Graphite Grey/Black” takes a more streamlined, city-focused approach, combining references to early-2000s ASICS running design with updated cushioning and support. Its upper mixes graphite grey, black and gunmetal-like tones across densely layered mesh and synthetic panels, creating a monochromatic finish that emphasizes the shoe’s technical construction. A GORE-TEX membrane is joined by a TRUSSTIC support unit, GEL inserts and FF BLAST PLUS cushioning, giving the silhouette a softer, more contemporary ride while maintaining the visual complexity associated with the GEL-NYC family.Rounding out the trio, the GEL-KAYANO 20 “Black/Gunmetal” revisits the 2013 runner with the darkest and most metallic treatment of the collection. Black mesh forms the base beneath a crisscrossing FLUIDFIT TPU cage finished in gunmetal tones, lending the upper a subtle sheen that shifts across its structural overlays. items.title: Les Benjamins & Apple Go "From Earth to Sky" in Turkey Runway Show
items.text: Les Benjamins & Apple Go "From Earth to Sky" in Turkey Runway Show SummaryLes Benjamins partnered with Apple for its 15th-anniversary "From Earth to Sky" collection in Cappadocia, blending East and West.The runway show, featuring custom hot-air balloons, was designed on iPad Pro and filmed on iPhone 18 Pro Max.On Wednesday, Les Bejamins teamed up with Apple to bring its new collection to life, showcasing the “From Earth to Sky” spectacle in Cappadocia, Turkey. Shot on the iPhone 18 Pro Max by French filmmaker Neels Castillon, Bünyamin Aydın’s latest show celebrated 15 years of his Istanbul-based lifestyle brand.Inspired by his Anatolian heritage, Aydın began developing the collection in early 2026 with the iPad Pro (with Apple Pencil Pro) and iPhone 17 Pro Max, capturing photos and 4K video for inspiration, assembling moodboards on Freeform and prototyping the custom-built hot-air balloons on Procreate. On working with the Apple Pencil and iPad, the designer explained, “Working with regular pen and paper feels very natural, but the hover feature on Apple Pencil Pro lets me preview every stroke before I even make it, so I can see any mistakes beforehand.”The collection itself represents Aydın’s multicultural heritage, having been born in Germany. With what he calls a “German discipline and Turkish heart,” the duality runs through the collection. “The canvas is the West; the paint is the East,” Aydın shared about the collection, which combines contemporary silhouettes with Turkish fabrics, along with Silk Road influences. Even the massive hot air balloons drew from the flora of the Anatolian landscape, depicting green Echinops, pink trumpets, and yellow tulips. “I see my role as that of a translator and a bridge between East and West,” Aydın added. “I hope this project makes Turkish people proud.”To capture the runway show, Castillon utilized the iPhone 18 Pro Max’s variable aperture to achieve smooth transitions while filming in varied sunlight, leaning on the A20 Pro chip to sustain continuous 4K recording without overheating. By mounting the phones to custom drones, he leveraged the Ultra Wide lens to frame the gigantic balloons during high-speed passes. Additionally, shooting in 4K120 fps and ProRes RAW provided added flexibility for cinematic slow-motion and complex color grading.See the exclusive imagery above captured by Abdullah M. Alshayji (@shaijieee). Les Benjamins' “From Earth to Sky" show will be released on Apple beginning on October 16. Click

items.title: MING and Massena LAB Rework Their Honey Collaboration Five Years Later
items.text: MING and Massena LAB Rework Their Honey Collaboration Five Years Later Summary MING and Massena LAB reunite for the 57.09 Secret Honey.Three rotating sapphire discs create a constantly shifting “dynamic guilloché” display.Limited to 125 pieces, it pairs tri-tone titanium lugs with a 50-hour automatic movement. MING and Massena LAB” are revisiting one of their earliest collaborations with the new 57.09 Secret Honey, a far more elaborate sequel to 2021’s 17.09 Honey and 17.09 Black.Five years after the original 200-piece collaboration introduced a vintage-inspired honeycomb motif, the two independent names — now fellow members of the Alternative Horological Alliance — have combined both earlier palettes into a single watch. Rather than reproducing the honeycomb literally, the 57.09 transforms the idea into what MING calls “dynamic guilloché,” using three rotating sapphire discs above a dark brown lacquered base dial to create a constantly changing interference pattern. The warm honey tone appears only as the discs move and overlap, giving the “Secret Honey” name a literal role in the design.Each sapphire disc rotates at a different rate - once every 24 hours, 12 hours and 60 minutes - with individual aperture patterns and luminous treatments in orange-emitting Super-LumiNova and MING Polar White. The 12-hour and 60-minute discs also carry the honey-colored hour and minute indications, while the indices and MING and Massena LAB logos are engraved into the box-style sapphire crystal above, creating a second luminous layer after dark.Surrounding the display is a 40mm Grade 5 titanium case using MING’s fifth-generation architecture, distinguished here by triple-stepped, tri-tone lugs assembled from nine individual components. Natural titanium forms the outer step, yellow-gold-referencing TiN coats the middle section and rose-gold-toned TiSiN finishes the innermost layer, visually extending the dial’s shifting black-and-honey palette into the case itself.Powering the watch is the automatic Sellita for MING 330.M2, running at 4 Hz and offering approximately 50 hours of power reserve, with its skeletonized anthracite-coated bridges visible through the sapphire caseback. The case measures 10.17mm thick, offers 100 meters of water resistance and is supplied with both a vachetta-colored goat-leather strap by Jean Rousseau Paris and a black FKM rubber strap, each using MING’s flying-blade tuck buckle with micro-adjustment.Limited to 125 pieces, the MING × Massena LAB 5

items.title: Seeing Red in Milan: Inside The 50 Best Bars 2026
items.text: Seeing Red in Milan: Inside The 50 Best Bars 2026 In the world of mixology, the clearest sign that you’ve made it is a red ceremonial scarf, handed to every team that lands on The 50 Best Bars list. On October 7, that scarf made its last appearance of the year in Milan, where the global edition of The 50 Best Bars 2026 brought the international cocktail community to the city for the first time.The ceremony took over the Palazzo del Ghiaccio, a Liberty-style landmark that opened in 1923 as Europe’s largest indoor ice rink and now hosts runway shows and gala nights. For one evening, the city that gave the world aperitivo culture became the center of it. Bartenders, bar owners and brands from 26 cities arrived via the red carpet for a drinks reception before the night’s main event.Milan marked the final stop on a long road for Cointreau, which spent 2026 as the official sponsor of the iconic red scarf ceremony across all four of The 50 Best Bars 2026 ceremonies. That run took the scarf from North America to Asia and, for the very first time, to Europe. It was the brand’s second year as Official Orange Liqueur Partner, and it came with a promise of bigger, bolder moments at every stop under the “Shake It Up” banner. For a brand that has spent more than a century and a half inside some of the world’s most enduring cocktails, from the Margarita to the Sidecar and the Cosmopolitan, the tagline doubled as a statement of intent.Cointreau Spicy, the brand’s chili-infused spin on its signature orange liqueur, carried that promise into the glass all season, with appearances in Vancouver and Amsterdam, where it starred in a Spicy Watermelon Margarita at the inaugural The 50 Best Bars Europe edition. In Milan, the Cointreau booth closed out the year with cocktails featuring both Cointreau L’Unique and Cointreau Spicy, including two standout serves created by the team at Lyaness: the Cointreau Bubbles, a vibrant celebration of orange in all its complexity, and the Spiced Carrot Margarita, a bold twist on the classic cocktail combining citrus, warming spice and savory notes. It was fitting that the Margarita took center stage. When Cointreau asked some of the world’s leading bartenders about the drinks defining the industry, the Margarita emerged as the clear favorite, named as both their cocktail of choice and the drink they’d most likely order to mark a special occasion. items.title: BEAMS Stitches Three Leathers Into One Broken-In Blouson
items.text: BEAMS Stitches Three Leathers Into One Broken-In Blouson Summary BEAMS’ new Leather Blouson combines sheep nappa, sheep nubuck and goat suede in a paneled constructionWashing, tumbling and hand-applied distressing give each jacket a worn-for-years look straight off the rackThe design draws on vintage sports jackets, reworked with a wide body and shortened length BEAMS has introduced the Leather Blouson as part of its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, a jacket built from three contrasting leathers and finished to look like a long-owned favorite. Offered in Soft Black and Taupe, the piece pairs a vintage sports jacket template with a contemporary wide, cropped silhouette.The jacket’s character starts with its materials, as BEAMS splices together three distinct hides across the body. Smooth sheep nappa and velvety sheep nubuck sit alongside goat suede, with the varying textures set against one another through bold paneling rather than blended into a single surface.Each jacket then goes through a multi-step aging process designed to replicate years of wear. Washing and tumbling break down the leather and draw out a faded tone, after which every piece is individually worked by hand to add the scuffs and highlights that typically form at stress points over time. Because the distressing is done one jacket at a time, the placement and intensity of the wear vary from piece to piece, along with the natural creases and color shifts inherent to the leather itself.Structurally, the blouson takes its cues from vintage sports jackets, updated with practical touches for daily use. Hand-warmer pockets sit at the front, each concealing a zippered security pocket inside, while ribbed trims finish the shape and a polyester lining keeps the interior smooth.BEAMS cuts the jacket in what it calls a Wide Short Fit, pairing a roomy chest with a deliberately shortened length. The boxy proportions give the piece a classic yet updated outline that works well over hoodies and heavier knits for layered looks.The BEAMS Leather Blouson is available now in Soft Black and Taupe via the BEAMS online store and at BEAMS locations in Japan. items.title: Apple’s HomePod mini 2 Just Joined Your Home Theater
items.text: Apple’s HomePod mini 2 Just Joined Your Home Theater Summary Apple’s HomePod mini 2 pairs the S10 chip with computational audio that tunes playback to each track in real timeA new Sound Glow feature turns the speaker’s top into a reactive light canvas synced to bass, treble and album artThe speaker arrives in pink, green, blue, white and midnight, with Siri AI landing in a future software update Apple has unveiled HomePod mini 2, the second generation of its pocket-sized smart speaker, rebuilt around the S10 chip and a fresh five-color lineup. The update brings Sound Glow, a reactive lighting layer across the top surface, along with support for four-speaker surround sound, Mac speaker duty and the overhauled Siri AI assistant, which is set to arrive through a later software update.At the core of the speaker is the Apple S10 chip, which drives a computational audio system that reads music as it plays and adjusts dynamic range, loudness and acoustic output on the fly. The result is 360-degree sound from the same compact footprint, scalable from a single unit to a stereo pair or a full multiroom configuration.Sound Glow is the most visible addition, transforming the speaker’s top into a lit surface that pulses and shifts in real time with the low and high frequencies of a track. Colors are pulled from the album artwork in Now Playing, so each song generates its own palette, while ambient soundscapes such as rain trigger custom animations designed for winding down. Controlling Sound Glow by voice requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone.Those lighting effects play off the new finishes, offered in pink, green, blue, white and midnight and designed to coordinate with Apple’s Mac colorways. HomePod mini 2 can now act as the audio output for any Mac with Wi-Fi 6E or later, either solo or as a stereo pair, covering movies, games and video calls. “HomePod mini 2 brings together Siri AI, gorgeous new colors, and incredible audio,” said Kaiann Drance, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Home Product Marketing, in a press release.Home theater setups get a meaningful bump as well, since HomePod mini 2 can now form a four-speaker surround system with the 4th-generation Apple TV 4K. items.title: The MM6 Maison Margiela FW26 Campaign Is a Study in Motion and Normality
items.text: The MM6 Maison Margiela FW26 Campaign Is a Study in Motion and Normality Summary MM6 Maison Margiela unveils its FW26 campaign, photographed by Philippine Chaumont and Agathe Zaerpour.The collection reimagines everyday staples through unconventional proportions, exposed linings and unexpected styling.Highlights include tailored separates, sportswear, Bauletto bags and colorful concealing sunglasses. MM6 Maison Margiela has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 campaign, offering a fresh perspective on the collection's exploration of everyday dressing and exaggerated normality. Shot by Philippine Chaumont and Agathe Zaerpour, the new visuals revisit the themes established during the label's FW26 presentation at Milano Centrale, where the train station's constant movement of arrivals and departures served as a backdrop for a cast of familiar yet distinctly individual characters.Translating this concept into campaign form, the visuals place MM6's signature design philosophy of reduction, straightforwardness and reinterpreted wardrobe archetypes at the forefront. The collection challenges conventional ideas of ordinary clothing, finding unexpected character in familiar garments and proportions while maintaining the label's deliberately understated, offbeat sensibility.The FW26 wardrobe draws on recognizable staples, including checked shirts, denim jackets, tailored blazers, full skirts, tracksuit tops, ski sweaters and zip-up fleeces, reworked through subtle structural interventions and unconventional styling. Ribbed jersey back panels streamline the silhouettes of shirts, trench coats and jackets, while exposed linings, adjustable snap-fastened hems and reduced proportions introduce an element of experimentation. Styling further disrupts expectations, pairing sportswear with voluminous skirts and culottes, blazers with long johns, and oversized knitwear with tights.Accessories reinforce the collection's playful approach to the familiar, from Bauletto bags and brightly tinted versions of MM6's signature concealing sunglasses to earrings left attached to their retail display cards and rings missing their stones. The MM6 Maison Margiela FW26 collection is now available through the brand's official website and selected boutiques worldwide. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Spinnaker and seconde/seconde/’s New “50 Phantoms” Collaboration Reveals Its Ghosts Under UV Light
items.text: Spinnaker and seconde/seconde/’s New “50 Phantoms” Collaboration Reveals Its Ghosts Under UV Light Summary Spinnaker and seconde/seconde/ return with a fourth “50 Phantoms” collaboration.“CRAZY” reveals its ghosts openly, while “QUIET” hides them until exposed to UV light.Both editions are releasing on October 16, priced at $600 USD. Spinnaker and French watch designer seconde/seconde/ are bringing back their cult “50 Phantoms” concept for a fourth annual collaboration, this time built around the Fleuss 40 Automatic. The 2026 edition turns the series into a literal game of hide-and-seek, placing 50 ghost figures throughout each watch and leaving their discovery to the wearer.Two personalities split the release: the openly playful “CRAZY” (SP-5195-11A) and the more restrained “QUIET” (SP-5195-11B). Both use a 40mm stainless-steel Fleuss case with a 47mm lug-to-lug measurement, screw-down crown and box-style sapphire crystal, while a polished white ceramic unidirectional bezel receives a custom wavy edge designed to recall the hem of a ghost’s robe.The difference lies largely in how each model handles its phantom population. "CRAZY" puts the concept front and center through a multi-layer white dial populated by printed and embossed ghosts in blue, white, green and yellow, distributed between the dial base and crystal and treated with luminous material for an especially animated appearance after dark. "QUIET" initially appears far more conventional, pairing a matte-white dial with applied silver indexes while hiding its ghost graphics until they are exposed to UV light. Swiss Super-LumiNova also appears across the hands, applied markers and bezel on both references.Power comes from a Miyota 9039 automatic movement, visible through the exhibition caseback, while 10 ATM of water resistance keeps the diver-inspired Fleuss platform intact. Each watch is supplied with a stainless-steel bracelet, orange nylon strap and white silicone strap - with the "CRAZY" version even cutting phantom silhouettes into its silicone strap -alongside a UV torch to uncover the concealed details.The presentation continues the joke beyond the wrist, with both watches arriving beneath a purpose-built glass ghost display dome surrounding a sculpted EVA-foam phantom, accompanied by a ghost-shaped cleaning cloth. items.title: 8 Must-See Art Shows and Installations During Frieze London 2026
items.text: 8 Must-See Art Shows and Installations During Frieze London 2026 Summary Frieze London 2026 brings a packed lineup of exhibitions, installations and performances across the city from October 14–18.Highlights include major presentations by Justin Caguiat, Tarek Atoui, Salman Toor and Issy Wood.Beyond traditional galleries, Slawn, JW Anderson and CART Department x Kozo blur the boundaries between contemporary art, fashion, design and public space. As Frieze London and Frieze Masters return to Regent's Park from October 14 to 18, the city's art scene is spilling well beyond the fairgrounds. Across London, major institutions, independent galleries and unconventional spaces are presenting a packed lineup of exhibitions, performances and installations.This year's highlights span everything from experimental sound and contemporary painting to large-scale interventions and collaborations at the intersection of art, fashion and design. Whether you're navigating the city between fair visits or looking to skip the tents altogether, here are standout presentations worth checking out during Frieze Week.Justin Caguiat, ‘Change Ringing’ at Serpentine SouthOctober 8, 2026 – January 10, 2027Justin Caguiat makes his UK institutional debut with ‘Change Ringing,’ an ambitious exhibition spanning painting, sculpture, printmaking, sound and film. Taking over Serpentine South, the presentation explores the relationship between art, architecture and the passage of time. Among the highlights are paintings made with heat-sensitive pigments that shift in color and appearance depending on their environment, alongside bronze bells cast in the forms of flowers and seeds. The result is an evolving exhibition that challenges the idea of an artwork as something fixed.Tarek Atoui, ‘Hold’ at Tate ModernOctober 13, 2026 – April 11, 2027Lebanese artist and composer Tarek Atoui transforms Tate Modern's iconic Turbine Hall into an expansive sonic environment for the latest Hyundai Commission. Titled ‘Hold,’ the installation brings together custom-built instruments, sculptural objects, electronics and percussion to create an evolving orchestra of sound and movement. Visitors are invited to experience the work through both listening and physical sensation, while a program of live performances will continually reshape the space. items.title: Hermès’ New H08 Watches Play With Cool-Toned Ceramic
items.text: Hermès’ New H08 Watches Play With Cool-Toned Ceramic Summary Hermès expands the H08 with Bleu de Malte and Blanc Chantilly editions.Both 39mm models pair ceramic bezels with aluminum-coated glass-fibre composite cases.The H1837 automatic movement provides a 50-hour power reserve. Hermès is adding two fresh colorways to its contemporary sports-watch family with new H08 editions in Bleu de Malte and Blanc Chantilly.First introduced in 2021, the H08 has become one of the Maison’s most distinctive modern watch designs, defined by a cushion-shaped case that sits somewhere between a circle and a square, oversized graphic numerals and an emphasis on contrasting technical materials. The latest pair retains that familiar 39mm architecture, but shifts the character through cooler, lighter tones: both use a braided glass-fibre composite case coated with aluminum, framed by satin-brushed ceramic bezels with mirror-polished chamfers and finished with color-matched rubber straps.The Bleu de Malte version takes the sportier approach, pairing its blue ceramic bezel and rubber strap with a rhodium-plated, crystal-sandblasted dial. Applied ruthenium-plated Arabic numerals are filled with blue Super-LumiNova, while blue PVD-coated hands and a choice of orange or blue minute-track accents sharpen the contrast.Its Blanc Chantilly counterpart is considerably more tonal, using a white ceramic bezel, white lacquered dial and matching rubber strap to create an almost monochromatic treatment. Grey minute markings, ruthenium-plated numerals and black-gold hands add definition without disrupting the pared-back palette. Both retain the H08’s subtly offset date window at 4:30 and are water-resistant to 10 bar, keeping their cleaner aesthetic grounded in everyday practicality.Inside both watches is the automatic Hermès Manufacture H1837 caliber, a 193-component movement running at 4 Hz and delivering a 50-hour power reserve. Its finishing includes circular graining, snailing, satin-brushed bridges and an oscillating weight decorated with Hermès’ repeating “H” motif. For more information, head over to Hermès' official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Tyler, The Creator Gives the Converse Pro Leather Four New Personalities
items.text: Tyler, The Creator Gives the Converse Pro Leather Four New Personalities Name: Converse x Golf Le Fleur* Pro LeatherMSRP: $105 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: ConverseConverse and Tyler, The Creator are expanding their collaborative 1908 program with a bold update to the iconic Pro Leather silhouette. Dropping in four distinct new colorways - “Molten Lava,” “Bison,” “White,” and “Black” - the release showcases the sheer versatility of the reimagined 1976 basketball classic.The “Black” and “White” iterations anchor the collection with a clean, foundational aesthetic built from premium full-grain leather. For a more textured, striking look, the “Bison” colorway offers a warm, earthy brown suede paired with soft yellow accents, while the "Molten Lava" execution turns up the volume in a vibrant red suede complete with contrasting laces. Each expression highlights Tyler's unique instinct for color and material storytelling, proving how much aesthetic range can live inside a single sneaker.Drawing inspiration from the bootleg shops that historically reshaped footwear silhouettes by hand, this updated Pro Leather features significantly exaggerated proportions. The shoe boasts a wider toe box, oversized eyelet rows, and chunky laces that give it a confident, heavy-set stance. Archival cues like the perforated detailing, classic heel panel, and the iconic Star Chevron logo maintain the shoe's rich heritage, while a new embossed star stretching across the toe cap adds a fresh structural dimension. items.title: Jeremy Renner Confirms Hawkeye Will Not Appear in 'Avengers: Doomsday'
items.text: Jeremy Renner Confirms Hawkeye Will Not Appear in 'Avengers: Doomsday' Summary Jeremy Renner confirmed he will not reprise his role as Hawkeye in Marvel Studios’ 'Avengers: Doomsday'The actor joked that the Avengers are destined to lose because the production team never reached out to bring him backThe absence follows Renner’s extensive physical recovery from a near-fatal 2023 snowplow accident Marvel Studios will move forward without one of its original roster members, as Jeremy Renner confirmed he will not appear as Hawkeye in Avengers: Doomsday. The veteran actor confirmed his absence from the upcoming ensemble blockbuster during a recent interview.Renner did not hesitate to shut down rumors about Clint Barton joining the fight against the franchise's newest threats. "No, no, no, no. Not in that one," Renner stated when directly asked about participating in the production. "Doomsday I’m not in, so the Avengers will probably lose, just so you know... they didn't call me, so it's their fault. They’re going to lose."The clarification arrives despite Renner having previously stated in 2025 that he was eager to return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe—whether in a potential second season of Hawkeye or future feature projects—noting he had recovered "more than 150%" following his traumatic 2023 Sno-Cat snowplow accident. While he will sit out the ensemble entry, the actor expressed excitement surrounding the theatrical re-release of 2019's Avengers: Endgame.Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to hit theaters on December 18.even hawkeye knows the avengers lose when he's not in the movie😭 #AvengersDoomsday https://t.co/i81g9ewvti— em | doomsday era (@drdoomarchive) October 11, 2026 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘Attack on Titan: The Musical’ Heads to Singapore for World Tour Kickoff
items.text: ‘Attack on Titan: The Musical’ Heads to Singapore for World Tour Kickoff Summary Attack on Titan: The Musical begins its first world tour in Singapore in April 2027.The production runs at Marina Bay Sands from April 15 to May 2.Additional international tour cities will be announced later. Attack on Titan: The Musical has officially announced plans for an expansive world tour, which will kick off next spring in Singapore. Scheduled to run from April 15 to May 2, 2027, the highly anticipated stage adaptation of Hajime Isayama’s legendary manga will be hosted at the Sands Theatre within Marina Bay Sands. This initial engagement marks the original Japanese production's first-ever performance in Asia outside of its home country, following previous, highly successful, and completely sold-out runs in major cities like Osaka, Tokyo and New York.Presented entirely in Japanese with accompanying English subtitles, the production utilizes a specialized theatrical genre known as "2.5-dimensional theater," which seamlessly blends intricate costumes, complex choreography, high-tech stage effects, and detailed visual design to bring two-dimensional anime and manga properties to vivid life on a three-dimensional stage.Focusing heavily on the early chapters of Isayama's dystopian narrative, the musical adaptation is directed by Gō Ueki and features a book written by Masafumi Hata. The music, distinct from the iconic anime soundtrack, boasts original songs crafted specifically for the production under the guidance of music director and hip-hop artist KEN THE 390, alongside lyricist Kaori Miura. However, fans of the anime will be treated to at least one familiar auditory staple, as the beloved first-season opening theme, "Guren no Yumiya," is slated to be featured.The Singapore engagement is presented by Base Entertainment Asia, with general ticket sales having recently opened, signaling the start of a massive global rollout as the stage show prepares to announce further international tour dates in the near future. items.title: Acne Studios and Hussein Chalayan Reimagine Archival Designs in New Collaboration
items.text: Acne Studios and Hussein Chalayan Reimagine Archival Designs in New Collaboration Summary Acne Studios collaborates with Hussein Chalayan on a 12-piece capsule inspired by his early 2000s collections.Highlights include patchworked denim, asymmetrical silhouettes and a reworked Camero handbag.An accompanying V&A campaign and limited-edition book celebrate Chalayan's creative legacy. Acne Studios has joined forces with British-Cypriot designer Hussein Chalayan for a 12-piece capsule that revisits some of his most influential designs from the early 2000s. Renowned for his conceptual approach to fashion, Chalayan helped redefine the boundaries of garment construction throughout the 1990s and beyond, treating clothing as a medium for exploring transformation, displacement, technology and the passage of time.Drawing inspiration from his SS01 "Ventriloquy", SS02 "Medea" and SS03 "Manifest Destiny" collections, the collaboration reinterprets his experimental design language through Acne Studios' signature materials of denim, jersey and leather. The partnership also reflects a creative dialogue between Chalayan and Acne Studios co-founder and creative director Jonny Johansson, whose shared interest in unconventional construction and material experimentation forms the foundation of the collection.Among the collection's highlights are patchworked denim jeans in Acne Studios' signature 1996 and 2009 fits, alongside a new twisted silhouette featuring a trompe l'oeil python print. A patchworked denim shirt, asymmetrical denim vest and dress reference the layered constructions of Chalayan's "Manifest Destiny" collection, with similar techniques extending into jersey T-shirts and vests. Accessories include a reworked Camero handbag crafted from patchworked leather in denim-inspired hues, while a graphic slogan T-shirt commemorates the collaboration.The accompanying campaign was photographed at London's V&A East Storehouse, where the new pieces appear alongside archival Chalayan designs, including his 2011 Tulle Dress and the Haiku Dress from the Sakoko SS11 collection. Coinciding with the release is Reference: Hussein Chalayan, a limited-edition book of 1,000 copies, editorially directed by Charlene Prempeh and featuring archival imagery, illustrations and essays examining the designer's creative legacy.The Acne Studios x Hussein Chalayan collection will be available online and at select Acne Studios boutiques worldwide, including locations in Beijing, Shanghai, Tokyo, Pa

items.title: Giorgio Armani and Kith Unveil Third Collaboration, Dreams of the Dune
items.text: Giorgio Armani and Kith Unveil Third Collaboration, Dreams of the Dune Giorgio Armani and Kith have announced their third menswear collaboration, Dreams of the Dune.Drawing inspiration from desert landscapes and hues, the collection debuted on October 9 (local time) during a runway show held in the Agafay Desert in Marrakech, Morocco.The collection fuses Giorgio Armani's long-cultivated tailoring aesthetics with Kith's modern approach to menswear. Building on their past two collaborations, the brands reinterpret structure, proportion, and materiality to offer a complete wardrobe spanning ready-to-wear, accessories, and footwear.The inspiration stems from the tranquility of the desert and the colors woven by the sun-drenched earth. A color palette transitioning from black and deep blue to dark brown, reddish earth tones, sand, greige, gray, and icy white is reflected across the materials, layering, and silhouettes.The lineup is anchored by belted shearling jackets, two-tone lamb leather utility jackets, and lambskin suede blousons. Signature Giorgio Armani details—such as unconstructed tailoring, soft shoulder lines, and relaxed silhouettes—are newly interpreted through Kith's lens. Alongside trousers and cargo pants, the offering includes reversible sweater blousons, short-sleeve sweaters, cashmere sets, graphic t-shirts, and embroidered sweatshirts.Materials include leather, suede, silk, cotton, viscose, virgin wool, cashmere, and pure hemp. The fluid landscape of the desert is captured through prints inspired by wind-sculpted dunes. A cohesive aesthetic runs throughout the entire collection, extending to accessories like scarves, gloves, and hats, as well as leather goods, travel items, and eyewear.Furthermore, the launch features special collaborations with ASICS, Diemme, and '47. The shared aesthetic of Giorgio Armani and Kith is expressed through the craftsmanship and design legacy of each partnering brand.The triple collaboration with ASICS introduces the GEL-MAI 0.1 in two colorways: "Quarry" and "Safari." Combining pigskin suede, nubuck, and long-hair suede, the sneakers feature the logos of each brand on the sides, heels, and tongues. The Diemme partnership offers five footwear styles crafted with suede, leather, and shearling linings. The capsule collection with '47 rolls out nine cap styles utilizing wool, cashmere, lambskin leather, and duck canvas."Giorgio Armani x Kith Dreams of the Dune" will be available starting Friday, October 16 at Kith

items.title: Druski Reportedly Set to Become First Digital Creator to Host 'Saturday Night Live'
items.text: Druski Reportedly Set to Become First Digital Creator to Host 'Saturday Night Live' Summary Sketch comedian Druski is reportedly set to become the first digital creator to host 'Saturday Night Live'The milestone episode is slated to air on November 7 marking a major crossover between social media comedy and late-night televisionWhile the NBC institution has historically mined internet talent for cast members this marks the first time an online creator will take on headlining host duties NBC’s long-running sketch comedy institution Saturday Night Live is reportedly set to tap digital comedian Druski as a guest host. According to Puck News, the upcoming booking marks the first time in the show's history that a pure-play digital creator will headline the program.Druski, whose real name is Drew Desbordes, has built a massive following across TikTok and Instagram through viral character-driven sketches. While executive producer Lorne Michaels and the show have scouted internet platforms for featured cast members as far back as Andy Samberg and The Lonely Island in 2005, the hosting slot has remained reserved for traditional stars. Even recent hosts with dominant online fanbases, such as Nate Bargatze and Shane Gillis, established themselves on the live stand-up touring circuit before securing the gig.The impending appearance represents a watershed moment for internet creators crossing over into legacy broadcast media. While a representative for Saturday Night Live declined to comment on the yet-to-be-announced scheduling, the high-profile slot could pave the way for more digital performers making the leap to Studio 8H. items.title: Apple’s New Apple TV 4K Turns the Living Room Into Siri AI’s Home Base
items.text: Apple’s New Apple TV 4K Turns the Living Room Into Siri AI’s Home Base Summary Apple’s 4th-generation Apple TV 4K debuts Siri AI as a full-screen, conversational guide to everything on the big screenThree built-in far-field microphones and an A19 chip with a dedicated AV1 decoder make it the most capable box in the lineupThe streamer arrives as the anchor of a wider Apple Home rollout that also includes HomeView, HomePod mini 2 and the Apple Home Collection Apple has introduced the 4th-generation Apple TV 4K, a reworked streaming box built around Siri AI, the overhauled assistant powered by the next wave of Apple Intelligence. Beyond the software leap, the new unit adds three far-field microphones for voice control without the remote, a significantly faster A19 chip and support for a four-speaker HomePod surround setup that calibrates itself to the room.Siri AI lives on Apple TV 4K as a full-screen interface rather than a small pop-up, letting viewers search by mood, award wins or genre and browse results as poster art pulled straight from the Apple TV app. Mid-episode questions about filming locations or age suitability surface in a discreet overlay that keeps the show running, and owners with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone can lean on personal context for requests like queuing up a series a friend suggested. Siri AI launches as a beta in tvOS 27.2, works on Apple TV 4K units from the 2nd generation onward, and is initially limited to English in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa and the UK.Hands-free operation comes courtesy of a trio of far-field microphones paired with echo cancellation that separates a speaker’s voice from whatever is playing, so “Siri” commands register even at full volume. Mic data runs through Secure Exclaves on the A19, isolated runtimes walled off from tvOS, apps and Apple itself, while Siri requests are handled either on-device or through Private Cloud Compute, where nothing is stored or exposed. Far-field voice support currently covers nine primary languages, including English, Mandarin Chinese, French and German.Under the hood, the A19 chip posts gains of as much as 50 percent in CPU speed and up to double the GPU output of the outgoing model, translating into snappier menus and smoother animation. A new dedicated AV1 decoder also lets the box stream high-quality video more efficiently on less bandwidth. The Siri Remote keeps its existing silhouette but gains Find My support with Pre

items.title: Christopher Meloni and William H. Macy Tackle Gridiron Turmoil in Hulu's 'The Land'
items.text: Christopher Meloni and William H. Macy Tackle Gridiron Turmoil in Hulu's 'The Land' Summary Hulu has debuted the first trailer for 'The Land' a scripted drama centered on the Cleveland BrownsCreated by Dan Fogelman the series stars Christopher Meloni as an embattled head coach alongside William H. Macy as team owner Hal DurkinProduced in partnership with the NFL the show premieres February 15 the day after Super Bowl LXI Hulu has released the first official trailer for The Land, an upcoming scripted drama centered on the Cleveland Browns and produced in direct partnership with the NFL. The series comes from creator Dan Fogelman (This Is Us, Paradise) and explores the volatile dynamics surrounding the franchise on and off the field.Christopher Meloni stars as Danny Roarke, Cleveland's head coach tasked with revitalizing the struggling organization. With his career on the line, Roarke's fortunes hinge on his son, Connor Roarke, a rookie quarterback out of Ohio State whose fictional draft moment was filmed live during the 2026 NFL draft in Pittsburgh. In the front office, team owner Hal Durkin (William H. Macy) faces his own corporate succession battle as he decides which of his two daughters will take over the franchise. Describing the storyline, Macy characterized the writing as "Shakespearean," noting that the series balances the sport with profound personal stakes.The ensemble cast features Mandy Moore, Chace Crawford, Sam Corlett, Tanner Zagarino, Chloe Bennet, Bridget Moynahan, and Omar Epps. With the NFL serving as an official co-producer, the production integrates authentic league branding and behind-the-scenes access to capture professional football culture.The Land premieres on Hulu on February 15, airing the day after Super Bowl LXI. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Fox Revives 'Baywatch' With Stephen Amell Leading the Lifeguard Crew
items.text: Fox Revives 'Baywatch' With Stephen Amell Leading the Lifeguard Crew Summary Fox has debuted the official first trailer for its upcoming 12-episode reboot of the iconic series 'Baywatch'Stephen Amell stars as Captain Hobie Buchannon alongside Jessica Belkin and featured guest Megan Thee StallionThe television series was filmed in Los Angeles and is scheduled to premiere on Fox in January Fox has officially released the first trailer for its upcoming television reboot, Baywatch. Directed in part by McG and spearheaded by showrunner Matt Nix, the 12-episode production revives the iconic beachside drama for the network's 2026–2027 broadcast season.The three-minute preview opens with series lead Stephen Amell orchestrating a high-stakes ocean rescue following a mid-air collision between an airplane and a parasail. Amell stars as an adult Hobie Buchannon, stepping into the footsteps of his father, Mitch, as an active Baywatch Captain. The storyline centers on Hobie’s life being disrupted by the sudden arrival of his long-lost daughter, Charlie (Jessica Belkin), who arrives determined to join the lifeguard ranks and preserve the family legacy.Co-produced by Fox Entertainment and Fremantle, the Los Angeles-filmed drama rounds out its ensemble with Shay Mitchell, Brooks Nader, Hassie Harrison, Livvy Dunne, Noah Beck, David Chokachi, and Thaddeus LaGrone, alongside recurring appearances from Ashley Moore and Luke Eisner. The trailer also confirms a high-profile cameo appearance from hip-hop superstar Megan Thee Stallion.The Baywatch reboot is scheduled to premiere on Fox in January 2027. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: The Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Is Reportedly Coming Back in 2028 With a Supercharged V8
items.text: The Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Is Reportedly Coming Back in 2028 With a Supercharged V8 Summary Internal Stellantis documents reveal plans to resurrect the supercharged Hemi V-8 for the 2028 Dodge Charger SRT HellcatThe returning muscle car will feature a rear-wheel-drive configuration and an automatic-only transmissionDodge plans to produce approximately 12,000 units annually across both two-door and four-door variants The era of the American V-8 is not dead yet. According to internal Stellantis documents cited in recent reports by Automotive News and Mopar Insiders, the legendary Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat is slated to make a massive comeback for the 2028 model year. While Dodge recently pivoted its next-generation muscle car lineup toward a progressive future by focusing on standard all-wheel drive, inline-six engines and battery-powered powertrains, this latest leak confirms a return to traditional, high-octane roots. The documents indicate that Dodge plans to bring back the revered supercharged Hemi V-8 engine, dropping it into the Charger chassis to serve traditional muscle car enthusiasts who previously purchased the high-horsepower iterations in massive volumes. A Dodge spokesperson declined to comment on the emerging reports, holding to the standard line that the company does not comment on future product plans.When the 2028 model arrives, it will pack the familiar heat that defined a decade of modern street culture. The returning vehicle features a massive 6.2-liter supercharged Hemi V-8 engine. To handle that immense power output, Dodge plans to pair the engine exclusively with a ZF 8HP95 automatic transmission. According to reports, the new Hellcat is automatic-only, skipping the manual transmission option once offered on the previous Challenger Hellcat. More importantly for purists, the 2028 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat sends power exclusively to the rear wheels. This dedicated rear-wheel-drive configuration marks a major departure from all other current Charger models, which currently come standard with an all-wheel-drive system. Dodge reportedly uses the internal code "HEV" to refer to the new Hellcat model in its internal paperwork.To provide maximum versatility for drivers, Dodge will offer the supercharged V-8 engine on both the sleek two-door and practical four-door Charger models.
