items.title: Heineken®’s Foosball Table Lets You Take Control of the Baller League
items.text: Heineken®’s Foosball Table Lets You Take Control of the Baller League Baller League stars are going face-to-face, but not as you may expect. In Heineken®’s new Foosballer Table, some of Baller League UK’s biggest names, including Chloe Kelly, Micah Richards and KSI, have been transformed into custom-made foosball figures, letting fans take the reins of the game.The Foosballer Table arrives at the Baller League Arena in London this week. Coinciding with the start of UK Season four, it serves as the centerpiece in a new pop-up celebrating Heineken’s global partnership with the six-a-side competition. Those attending matches at the Arena will have the chance to compete on the Foosballer Table with friends and fellow fans over the next few months.Beyond celebrating the partnership, the game aims to champion the league’s growing presence in football entertainment, a culture that Heineken has similarly connected with over the years. Taking notes from the social pub setting, it comes designed with glossy tiles, bar-tap handles, built-in bottle holders, LED lighting and signature Baller League goal celebrations.The Foosballer Table is also set to land at Heineken® Star Bars across the UK. To find your local bar, head to Heineken’s website now. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Veronica Leoni Steps Down as Creative Director of Calvin Klein Collection
items.text: Veronica Leoni Steps Down as Creative Director of Calvin Klein Collection Summary Veronica Leoni is stepping down as creative director of Calvin Klein Collection after a four-season tenureAppointed in 2024 to spearhead the revival of the house's runway division Leoni previously held design roles at The Row and CélineCalvin Klein confirmed that Collection remains central to its long-term strategy and will name a successor in due course Calvin Klein has officially announced that Creative Director Veronica Leoni will exit Calvin Klein Collection after four seasons. The designer's departure concludes a two-year tenure leading the American label’s high-end runway revival.Leoni, an industry veteran with past tenures at The Row and Phoebe Philo’s Céline, was appointed in 2024 to helm the relaunch of Calvin Klein's pinnacle runway line. The division had previously been shuttered in 2018 following the exit of Raf Simons. Over her four collections, Leoni aimed to re-establish the house's runway presence and recontextualize its core design codes.“I want to thank Veronica for her creative vision, commitment and partnership over the past two years," said David Savman, Global Brand President at Calvin Klein. "Reintroducing Collection was a significant milestone for Calvin Klein, and Veronica’s exceptional talent and fresh perspective on Calvin’s iconic design codes helped build meaningful momentum for Collection."While the runway return generated industry dialogue, the line faced mixed critical reception and minimal commercial impact against wider headwinds, with Calvin Klein’s quarterly sales dropping 7% in its most recent earnings report. Parent company PVH affirmed that Leoni’s departure does not mark the conclusion of the line, emphasizing that Collection remains "an important part of Calvin Klein’s long-term strategy and the pinnacle expression of the brand," with a new creative director to be appointed in due course. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The North Face Reengineers the Iconic Pertex Nuptse for Cold Weather Style
items.text: The North Face Reengineers the Iconic Pertex Nuptse for Cold Weather Style In the landscape of modern outerwear, few garments carry the cultural weight or street-level prestige of The North Face Nuptse jacket. Originally created in 1992 as a high-performance expedition piece for alpine climbers, the jacket quickly transcended the mountains to become an undisputed staple of street culture.Over the decades, legendary partnerships with heavyweights like Supreme, Junya Watanabe, and Gucci cemented its status as a canvas for high-fashion crossovers and coveted drops. Today, the iconic silhouette continues to define cold-weather style, standing as a two-in-one jacket built for those courageous enough to stand out and destined to leave a mark.The latest iteration—The North Face Pertex Nuptse reversible jacket—delivers visionary warmth that flips the script on traditional outerwear aesthetics. Engineered for the modern tastemaker who demands both form and function, this release marries heritage design with advanced technical innovation. Weightless warmth meets unmatched versatility in an icon that dares to show the way, offering a seamless blend of street readiness and technical alpine pedigree that feels right at home in high-fashion editorial spreads or concrete jungle landscapes.Underneath its unmistakable exterior lies uncompromising technical performance. Powered by 700-fill recycled goose down insulation, the jacket delivers exceptional warmth without adding unnecessary bulk or weight. That thermal efficiency is amplified by Pertex Quantum fabric, an ultra-lightweight, durable textile engineered to maximize insulation performance while reliably preventing down leaks. It is a masterclass in functional design, ensuring that the wearer stays warm in harsh winter conditions without compromising on lightweight mobility or clean lines.What truly elevates this release within modern street style is its dual-identity structure. Reversible and unstoppable, it represents an iconic silhouette that’s singular in status, but never in function. On one side, the jacket showcases the heritage, oversized baffle construction that defined '90s street culture and outdoor exploration alike. Turn it inside out, and those iconic baffles reverse to a sleek, matte silhouette for versatility through every chapter. This reversible design provides maximum versatility, allowing you to transition effortlessly between traditional street volume and refined, understated minimalism.As fashion

items.title: McQueen Parts Ways With Creative Director Seán McGirr After Three Years
items.text: McQueen Parts Ways With Creative Director Seán McGirr After Three Years Summary Kering has officially announced the departure of McQueen Creative Director Seán McGirr following a three-year tenureThe executive change arrives alongside operational restructuring including workforce layoffs and a reduced retail footprintThe luxury conglomerate confirmed that new creative leadership for the London fashion house will be announced soon McQueen has officially parted ways with Creative Director Seán McGirr after a three-year tenure at the helm of the British fashion house. According to WWD, the announcement from parent company Kering arrives amid extensive structural reorganization, including company layoffs and a downsizing of the brand's global retail network.The leadership shift follows the appointment of former Prada executive Gianfranco D’Attis as Alexander McQueen's CEO earlier this year. Under Kering CEO Luca de Meo, the luxury group is seeking a comprehensive reset after the house sustained heavy losses driven by an aggressive expansion to 135 stores and an overreliance on footwear, with sneaker sales previously accounting for up to 80 percent of total revenue. De Meo emphasized a goal to establish"“a bold new direction for the house, building on its unique heritage of exceptional tailoring, uncompromising creativity and rebellion."McGirr, who took over following Sarah Burton’s departure, joined the label after leading menswear at JW Anderson, with prior design experience at Dries Van Noten, Burberry, and Christophe Lemaire for Uniqlo. During his time at McQueen, the Dublin-born designer sought to reconnect the label with London’s street culture, recently reuniting the house with longtime jeweler Shaun Leane for the Spring 2027 runway. McGirr's exit marks the latest shift in Kering's design roster, following the departure of Anthony Vaccarello from Saint Laurent after a 10-year run. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Everything We Know So Far About 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2'
items.text: Everything We Know So Far About 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2' Night City is a place where dreams are expensive, human lives are disposable, and dying spectacularly might just be the closest thing to a happy ending. David Martinez became painfully familiar with that reality in 2022's Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, but his story was hardly an exception. Four years later, CD PROJEKT RED and Studio TRIGGER are revisiting the dystopian metropolis with Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, introducing a new generation of characters who may be destined to learn those same lessons.Announced at Anime Expo 2025, the ten-episode standalone series follows four new characters whose paths converge across Night City's corporate and criminal underworlds. . With its October 20 Netflix premiere approaching, here's what the trailers and official announcements reveal — and what the wider Cyberpunk lore suggests might lie ahead. A New Story, But the Same Unforgiving Night CitySet around 2076, the first anime followed David's ascent through Maine's mercenary crew, his growing dependence on military-grade cyberware and his relationship with Lucy. Its tragedy embodied a central premise of Cyberpunk 2077: megacorporations control the city, while those beneath them risk their bodies and lives for a chance at freedom.Rather than another rise to mercenary fame, the sequel revolves around revenge, redemption and the consequences of past decisions. Its official premise brings together a fallen edgerunner seeking purpose and a nomad hunting the person responsible for his clan's destruction. Meet Night City's New Main CharactersWeak "King" Kingsley was once a legendary edgerunner, but has since lost his cybernetic enhancements and reputation. His fall reverses David and Maine's trajectories: where their increasing augmentation came at a psychological cost, Weak must discover who he is without the chrome that once defined him.D is a netrunner from the Snake Nation, seeking revenge for his massacred clan. In Cyberpunk lore, the Snake Nation is a vast, loosely affiliated alliance of nomads, whose communities place family and loyalty above Night City's corporate hierarchy. D's vendetta could bring the world beyond the city's borders into focus.Talia Yang was raised among corporate elites before becoming involved with Maelstrom, the violent, heavily augmented gang familiar to Cyberpunk 2077 players. items.title: Chase Hall’s New Coffee Painting Gets Into the History of Black Appalachia
items.text: Chase Hall’s New Coffee Painting Gets Into the History of Black Appalachia Summary American artist Chase Hall has created a new work, titled “The Affrilachian Mountains” (2026), for Parrish Art Museum and FLAG Art Foundation's exhibition seriesThe piece explores racialized histories of labor, commodity, and trade through its subjects and materials, comprising found objects and coffee as pigmentThe painting is now on view at the Parrish Art Museum in New York until January 25, 2027 Chase Hall, the American artist known for his paintings made of freshly brewed coffee, once said that he’d pull up to 100 espresso shots for a single composition. The unique material was spurred by his experience as a barista, but the fields of amber and burnt umber that emerged spoke to more than just his love for the stuff — they carried him through histories of colonialism, trade, and labor.The Parrish Art Museum and The FLAG Art Foundation recently tapped Hall to create a new painting for the latest FRESH PAINT exhibition, running until January 25, 2027. Hall figures a group of miners in the resulting work, “The Affrilachian Mountains” (2026), exploring the post-abolition period, which saw thousands of African Americans migrate to the Appalachians in search of work in the coal fields.Like many of Hall’s energetic figurations, the base employs acrylic and coffee — brewed and burnt to achieve rich palettes — on unprimed canvas, made to appear as if bursting with white paint. This particular piece also involves a number of found objects — antique agricultural tools and rusted tins that once housed coffee, tobacco, and malt liquor — putting pressure on the wounds of American histories as they relate to commodity, extraction, and race.Being biracial, much of Hall’s oeuvre, which spans the personal to generational, visions of labor and leisure, gives form to duality, not only reckoning with in-between states, but the codes and conditions that undergird racial being. “There is an undeniable sense of freedom in these scenes, which posit identity not as a servant to boundaries and classifications,” the Parrish Art Museum wrote, “but as a space of expansive possibility.”“When I really break it down, I trust what I’m doing in my studio, and what I want to say; my practice is about making space for my younger self, but also making space for a more open, critical, and nuanced world,” Hall adds in a conversation with writer and curator Ekow Eshun. “This is just my place. items.title: Temporal Works and Lee Yuen-Rapati Rethink the Roman Numeral Dial
items.text: Temporal Works and Lee Yuen-Rapati Rethink the Roman Numeral Dial Summary Temporal Works teams with Lee Yuen-Rapati on the Series A: Romanesque.Custom “Colonnade Romans” rework traditional numerals into architectural forms.Limited to 50 pieces, the 37mm manual-wind watch is priced at $2,500 USD. Temporal Works is expanding its Series A collection with the new Romanesque, a typography-led limited edition created in collaboration with London-based watch designer Lee Yuen-Rapati.Adorning the dial are Yuen-Rapati’s custom “Colonnade Romans,” an unconventional reinterpretation of traditional Roman numerals originally developed for his One Hour Watch drawing series in 2022. The system reduces the familiar I, V and X forms to combinations of long vertical and short horizontal strokes, with the repeated lines evoking the rhythm of architectural columns.For the production model, the numerals were softened with subtle tapers and rounded corners, preserving the narrow proportions historically associated with Roman numeral watch and clock dials while giving them a distinctly contemporary character. The typography is emphasized through a two-piece sandwich dial, with each numeral individually laser-cut from a silver-white opaline upper layer to expose the glossy midnight-blue dial beneath.The watch itself uses Temporal Works’ familiar 37mm Series A monobloc case in 316 stainless steel, measuring 10mm thick and 45mm lug-to-lug, with a dual anti-reflective sapphire crystal and 50 meters of water resistance. A light grey pebble-grain calfskin strap by Jean Rousseau completes the standard configuration, while a custom mesh bracelet produced by Staib is available separately.Inside, the Romanesque is powered by the manually wound Sellita SW210-1 b D4, an 18-jewel movement operating at 4 Hz with a 42-hour power reserve and quoted accuracy of ±20 seconds per day. Keeping the watch to hours and minutes alone allows the unusual numeral design to remain the focal point, continuing Temporal Works’ emphasis on straightforward mechanics paired with distinctive visual concepts.Limited to just 50 pieces, the Series A: Romanesque is priced at $2,500 USD and launches on October 16, 2026 at 10 a.m. ET. It will be available through Temporal Works as well as The Armoury online and at its New York City and Hong Kong stores. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Ulysse Nardin’s Freak [S Howlite] Puts a Million-Year-Old Mineral on the Dial
items.text: Ulysse Nardin’s Freak [S Howlite] Puts a Million-Year-Old Mineral on the Dial Summary Ulysse Nardin launched the 15-piece Freak [S Howlite] exclusively for North America.The $190,700 titanium watch features a unique white howlite stone hour disc.Its UN-251 flying carousel movement displays the time without traditional hands. Ulysse Nardin is marking 25 years of the Freak with one of its most visually distinctive interpretations yet: the Freak [S Howlite], a 15-piece edition created exclusively for North America. The release arrives as the Maison also celebrates its 180th anniversary, revisiting the radical watchmaking philosophy that began with the original Freak in 2001 — a watch that famously discarded the conventional dial, hands and crown in favor of making the movement itself the display. Based on the more technically ambitious Freak S introduced in 2022, the new edition pairs that futuristic architecture with natural howlite, a white mineral distinguished by irregular grey-to-black veining, giving each example a unique geological pattern.The howlite is used for the rotating hour disc, sitting beneath the Freak S’s three-dimensional flying carousel and providing a stark, almost marble-like backdrop for its mechanical structure. Each disc is individually cut from stone sourced in Canada, with roughly 60% of the raw material rejected during selection to ensure the required color and veining. Above it, the automatic UN-251 calibre places two oversized silicon oscillators at 20-degree angles and links them through what Ulysse Nardin describes as the world’s smallest vertical mechanical differential, averaging their rates to improve stability. The 373-component movement also incorporates DIAMonSIL escapements and the brand’s Grinder automatic winding system, while the entire carousel completes one rotation every 60 minutes to indicate the minutes. As with the original Freak concept, there are no traditional hands or crown; time is adjusted by unlocking the mechanism at 6 o’clock and rotating the bezel.The Freak [S Howlite] is housed in a 45mm grey titanium case paired with a white ballistic-textured rubber strap and titanium folding clasp, reinforcing the contrast between the pale mineral dial and dark mechanical components above it. The UN-251 delivers a 72-hour power reserve, while the case offers 30 meters of water resistance. Limited to just 15 pieces, the timepiece is available exclusively in North America, retailing at $190,700 USD. For more informat

items.title: Vans and SZA Unveil California-Shot Campaign for Debut VANSZA Drop 1
items.text: Vans and SZA Unveil California-Shot Campaign for Debut VANSZA Drop 1 Summary Vans and SZA unveil the official VANSZA Drop 1 campaign, photographed by India Sleem.Highlights include the Knu Skool Mule, Authentic Kickdown and nature-inspired apparel.Launching October 22, the collection blends skatewear, outdoor influences and SZA's personal style. Following the initial unveiling of their VANSZA collaboration in September, Vans and SZA have released the official campaign for Drop 1, offering a closer look at the singer's nature-inspired interpretation of the California footwear brand's signature designs.Photographed by India Sleem against California's sun-drenched hillsides and rugged landscapes, the campaign brings SZA's creative universe into focus through an interplay of earthy textures, expressive styling and outdoor scenery. Complemented by product and landscape photography from Yudo Kurita, the visuals place the collection's oversized silhouettes, distressed finishes and eclectic patterns against dry grasslands and rocky terrain, reinforcing its themes of individuality, discovery and a connection to the natural world.At the core of Drop 1 are two reworked Vans silhouettes: the VANSZA Knu Skool Mule and Authentic Kickdown, both reflecting SZA's preference for effortless, slip-on footwear. The Knu Skool Mule removes the sneaker's heel entirely, transforming the familiar skate-inspired silhouette into an open-backed design, while the Authentic Kickdown features a collapsible heel that allows it to transition between a conventional sneaker and a slip-on. The latter is constructed from distressed canvas and features custom artwork by Sage Adams, introducing a playful, personalized treatment to the classic Vans model.Beyond footwear, the collection expands into apparel and accessories inspired by vintage outdoor clothing, DIY customization and utilitarian workwear. Oversized outerwear, relaxed cargo trousers, washed denim and graphic pieces featuring fish-inspired illustrations establish a deliberately eclectic wardrobe, combining functional details with SZA's unconventional approach to styling. Together, the collection bridges Vans' skateboarding heritage with the singer's personal references, balancing practical construction with a sense of experimentation and humor.The VANSZA Drop 1 collection launches October 22, 2026, through Vans retail locations and the brand's official website. items.title: Hublot Recreates Its Original 1980 Watch in Yellow and White Gold
items.text: Hublot Recreates Its Original 1980 Watch in Yellow and White Gold Summary Hublot revisits its 1980 origins with the new Classic Fusion Tributo.Yellow- and white-gold editions retain the original gold-and-rubber formula in a 38mm case.Powered by the HUB1711 automatic movement, both retail for $30,900 USD. Hublot is returning to the watch that established its defining “Art of Fusion” philosophy. Its new Classic Fusion Tributo, offered in 18K yellow gold and 18K white gold, looks back to 1980, when founder Carlo Crocco debuted the original Hublot under the MDM Genève name -- pairing a precious-metal case with a black rubber strap at a time when that combination was virtually unheard of in Swiss luxury watchmaking.46 years later, the Tributo deliberately preserves that stripped-back formula - a porthole-inspired bezel, exposed screws, minimal black dial and rubber strap - while updating its proportions and mechanics. The original 36mm footprint grows modestly to 38mm, measuring 9.5mm thick, while 12 slightly domed bezel screws, exposed lugs and the date at 3 o’clock retain the visual language of the 1980 design.The two references share the same architecture but take noticeably different approaches to the original. The yellow-gold Classic Fusion Tributo stays closest to Crocco’s early watch, combining a polished and satin-finished 18K yellow-gold case and bezel with a matte black lacquered dial carrying a subtle charcoal effect. Gold MDM lettering at 6 o’clock references the original MDM Genève signature, while the sapphire caseback reveals a matching 22K yellow-gold oscillating weight.Its white-gold counterpart takes a cooler, more formal direction with a polished 18K white-gold case, black-plated titanium H-shaped screws and a polished black onyx dial, complemented by a black tungsten rotor. Both are fitted to lined black rubber straps, deliberately foregoing Hublot’s One Click system to remain closer to the construction of the original, while a screw-down crown helps provide 100 meters of water resistance.Where the Tributo departs most significantly from its predecessor is inside. The quartz movement of the 1980 model gives way to Hublot’s HUB1711 Manufacture self-winding caliber, a 185-component automatic movement running at 4 Hz and delivering approximately 50 hours of power reserve. Both editions are available through Hublot, retailing at $30,900 USD each. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: LISA Announces New Cinematic Single "Tarantino" From Upcoming 'Press Play' EP
items.text: LISA Announces New Cinematic Single "Tarantino" From Upcoming 'Press Play' EP Summary LISA has announced her new single titled "Tarantino" from her forthcoming 'Press Play' EPThe track follows "SaWaDiKa" as the second preview of the project and pays homage to filmmaker Quentin TarantinoThe single is scheduled to drop alongside the full Press Play EP on October 23 LISA has officially announced her upcoming single, "Tarantino," marking the second preview from her forthcoming EP, Press Play. The track pays direct homage to director Quentin Tarantino and follows the release of her previous single, "SaWaDiKa."Announced via social media, the reveal arrived alongside official cover art depicting the BLACKPINK member concealing her face behind a red envelope inside a circular frame. A preview shared on TikTok showcased the track's cinematic direction, pairing hard-hitting percussion with bold vocal delivery: “Got my nails really long like the barrel of my gun and my lipstick all over your face / It’s a movie, baby, come and press play.”The rollout comes amid a busy slate for the performer, following her Best Pop win at the 2026 VMAs and the theatrical debut of her solo documentary, Always Lalisa. Beyond the impending arrival of the EP, LISA is also preparing for an expanded headlining residency at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas, scheduled to begin in November.The Press Play EP will officially arrive on October 23. items.text: The adidas Samba Gets a Textured “Camo Cow Print” Makeover Name: adidas Samba “Camo Cow Print”Colorway: “Camo Cow Print”SKU: KJ7500MSRP: $120 USDRelease Date: Holiday 2026adidas is giving the Samba a new “Camo Cow Print” makeover, combining two recurring footwear motifs - animal patterning and military-inspired camouflage - across the low-profile classic.The upper is almost entirely wrapped in faux-pony hair, printed with an irregular desert-camo pattern that blends creamy off-white, sandy beige and dark brown patches for a cowhide-like effect. Smooth cream leather Three Stripes cut through the patterned sidewalls, while matching leather appears around the heel to add a cleaner contrast against the busier upper. Muted sage green laces, tongue branding and collar lining introduce a softer outdoor-inspired accent without overpowering the neutral palette.Offered as a women’s release, the Samba retains its familiar slim tooling, finished here in a dark translucent gum-brown rubber that complements the earthy shades above while giving the sneaker a slightly heavier visual base. items.title: Timberland and Jacquemus Rework the Authentic Boat Shoe in Crocodile-Embossed Leather
items.text: Timberland and Jacquemus Rework the Authentic Boat Shoe in Crocodile-Embossed Leather Name: Timberland x Jacquemus Authentic Boat ShoeColorway: Brown Croc, Navy CrocSKU: TBCMSRP: $320 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: Timberland, JacquemusTimberland and Jacquemus reunite to reinterpret the 3-Eye Classic Lug silhouette into a collaborative Authentic Boat Shoe – giving the heritage silhouette a more polished, tactile finish through crocodile-embossed leather. The limited-edition release arrives in two colorways - “Brown Croc” and “Navy Croc” - each built from Premium Timberland leather embossed to mimic the raised texture of exotic hide."Brown Croc" leans into the shoe’s traditional outdoor roots with a warm, earthy tone, while "Navy Croc" offers a cooler, more refined alternative that shifts the familiar boat shoe into dressier territory. The embossed surface adds depth across the otherwise classic upper, allowing the texture itself to become the dominant design feature rather than relying on overt contrast or graphic branding.The collaborative silhouettes retain the construction cues that have defined Timberland’s Authentic Boat Shoe since its 1978 introduction. A rugged rubber outsole grounds the design, while a soft leather lining and padded collar add comfort to the structured upper. Tonal Timberland tree branding keeps the look understated, and bespoke branded aglets introduce a subtle collaborative detail without interrupting the shoe’s clean profile. The result balances Timberland’s utilitarian heritage with Jacquemus’ more refined approach to material and proportion, recasting the classic boat shoe through the visual language of fine leather goods. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Sony’s New ECM-W5 Wireless Mic System Captures Audio From Up to 500 Meters Away
items.text: Sony’s New ECM-W5 Wireless Mic System Captures Audio From Up to 500 Meters Away Summary Sony officially introduced the ECM-W5 wireless microphone kit, delivering 32-bit float recording and deep integration for digital creatorsThe $400 USD base system features dual mic transmitters equipped with 64GB of internal memory and a touchscreen-enabled receiverPre-orders are open immediately ahead of a scheduled November rollout Sony introduced the ECM-W5, a new wireless microphone kit built for sound capture. Priced at $400 USD, the system targets creators seeking tight integration with Sony Alpha series cameras and the workflow advantages of 32-bit float recording. Out of the box, the base setup arrives with one rectangular receiver and two microphone transmitters to set a foundation for high-fidelity audio capture on the move.An advanced set of technical capabilities powers the recording process. The system captures 96kHz audio from up to 500 meters under line-of-sight conditions. Every individual transmitter is armed with 64GB of internal memory, which directly enables 32-bit float recording. This capability captures both quiet and loud sounds with clarity, eliminating manual gain adjustments on the fly so videographers can capture chaotic shoots for post-production without actively riding audio levels.Sony designed the hardware for versatility and device synergy. The ECM-W5 connects directly to Sony Alpha cameras through the proprietary Multi Interface Shoe, which allows the unit to receive power and transfer data without external cables. For alternative rigs, the receiver records audio directly to other devices and includes a dedicated USB-C adapter for connections to a smartphone or a PC. Transmitters deliver 11 hours of battery life and feature built-in magnetic backplates for pinning directly to a shirt.The system can scale alongside expanding production needs. While the base package handles two audio sources, users can capture up to four tracks simultaneously by purchasing additional transmitters. Control is handled through the receiver, which features an integrated touchscreen for immediate adjustments. Professionals can also listen to audio playback wirelessly using Bluetooth LE and Sony headphones connected to the receiver. The entire ECM-W5 lineup is available for pre-order immediately and is scheduled to ship in November. items.title: Yohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME Spins Its FW18 Spider Web Into a Four-Piece Capsule
items.text: Yohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME Spins Its FW18 Spider Web Into a Four-Piece Capsule Summary Yohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME revisits the spider web motif first shown in its Fall/Winter 2018 collectionThe pattern is created by stripping color out of black wool gabardine rather than printing on top of itA two-button jacket, an oversized shirt and two pairs of trousers make up the limited release Yohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME is reviving its spider web pattern for a new four-piece menswear capsule, pulling the motif straight from the label’s Fall/Winter 2018 runway. The lineup includes the 2BS Jacket, the Big Shirt, the Drawstring Pants and the Wrap Pants, each cut from black wool gabardine and finished with the web in white.The archival callback gives the capsule its backbone. The web first appeared in POUR HOMME’s FW18 collection, and this release brings it back for a dedicated regional launch rather than a full seasonal reissue. The menswear line itself has been a core part of the Yohji Yamamoto universe since the mid-1980s, and reworking past runway graphics into new garments keeps those designs in circulation long after their original season.What sets the technique apart is discharge dyeing, a process that removes color from the fabric in specific areas instead of layering ink over it. Applied to black wool gabardine, the treatment draws the web directly out of the cloth, so the pattern sits within the weave rather than on its surface. That approach also preserves the gabardine’s supple hand and its natural drape, both of which shape the silhouettes across the capsule.Leading the range, the 2BS Jacket is a two-button tailored piece cut with a generous body and an extended length, letting the soft wool fall loosely from the shoulders. A web sits over the right side of the chest, while a much larger version spans the back, turning an otherwise minimal black jacket into a statement from behind.The Big Shirt follows the same relaxed proportions in a long, roomy cut that skims rather than follows the body. Webbing spills across the right shoulder and down the left sleeve, a patch pocket sits on the chest and the hem is cut longer at the back than the front. Its oversized shape means it works buttoned up on its own or worn open as a light overlayer.Two trouser styles round out the capsule with very different shapes. items.title: Callum Turner Fronts Louis Vuitton's SS27 Men's Trunk Campaign
items.text: Callum Turner Fronts Louis Vuitton's SS27 Men's Trunk Campaign Summary Louis Vuitton has unveiled its second Trunk Edition for Spring-Summer 2027 designed by Men’s Creative Director Pharrell WilliamsThe offering elevates classic tailoring staples through double-face cashmere vicuña crisp cotton silk poplin and cotton-cashmere indigo-washed denimAccompanied by a campaign starring Callum Turner the collection is available in Louis Vuitton stores worldwide and online Louis Vuitton has officially unveiled the Spring/Summer 2027 Men’s Trunk Collection, marking the French house’s second Trunk Edition helmed by Men’s Creative Director Pharrell Williams. The launch is framed by a dedicated campaign starring house ambassador Callum Turner, photographed on film across New York City by Gregory Harris.Epitomizing the sophistication and ease of Louis Vuitton menswear, the collection reinterprets everyday essentials through staunch dandyism ideals and traditional refinery. Classic shirting, slacks, and tailored jackets replace standard workwear references, centering instead on elevated textiles including crisp cotton silk poplin, double-face cashmere vicuña, and cotton-cashmere indigo-washed denim. Minimal VVN Louis Vuitton signature tabs adorn each garment, shifting focus entirely to precise cuts and material richness.Presented across a series of cinematic portraits and a short film, Turner embodies the quiet respite of an international business traveler. The visual narrative captures intimate moments of contemplation: playing a game of chess, reading the day's newspaper in repose, unwinding with his dog, taking afternoon tea, practicing a golf putt, and taking a moment to freshen up.The Louis Vuitton Spring-Summer 2027 Men’s Trunk Collection is available in Louis Vuitton stores worldwide and online. items.title: Converse Japan’s All Star Westernstitch SU HI Is a Cowboy Boot in Disguise
items.text: Converse Japan’s All Star Westernstitch SU HI Is a Cowboy Boot in Disguise Name: Converse All Star Westernstitch SU HIColorway: Tan, BlackSKU: 31319430, 31319431MSRP: ¥17,600 JPY (approx. $110 USD)Release Date: October 23Where to Buy: Converse JapanConverse Japan has unveiled the All Star Westernstitch SU HI, a pattern-reworked version of its signature high-top that blends western boot detailing with the brand’s updated renewal-spec construction. The shoe trades the classic canvas for a suede upper, steering the familiar silhouette toward ranch-ready territory while keeping its recognizable shape intact.The design centers on decorative stitching drawn from western boots, which Converse pairs with star motifs that tie back to the All Star name. That ornamentation sits on a full suede upper, giving the sneaker the softer texture and heftier look of a boot rather than the lightweight feel of a canvas Chuck. A rubber outsole anchors the build, and the shoe arrives in two colorways, Tan and Black.Beneath the western styling, the Westernstitch SU HI adopts Converse’s renewal spec, a substantial internal overhaul of the All Star platform. Open-cell urethane foam, chosen for its resistance to flattening along with its breathability and cushioning, now lines not only the insole but also the inside of the heel, boosting comfort with every step. The insole itself has been updated to be fully removable, a practical change for anyone who prefers custom footbeds.Weight and fit get attention as well. The new construction trims about 60 grams per shoe compared with the previous version, measured on a single 26.5 cm pair, while a redesigned last and outsole improve fit and stability. A reworked outsole structure also adds flexibility, letting the shoe bend more naturally underfoot. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Prime Video Explores Muhammad Ali's Formative Years in Official 'The Greatest' Trailer
items.text: Prime Video Explores Muhammad Ali's Formative Years in Official 'The Greatest' Trailer Summary Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios have debuted the official trailer and key art for The Greatest marking the first authorized scripted series on Muhammad AliNewcomer Jaalen Best stars as Cassius Clay alongside an ensemble cast featuring Omari Hardwick Giovanni Ribisi and Michael Ealy Created by showrunner Ben Watkins all eight episodes are scheduled to premiere globally on November 4 2026 Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios have officially unveiled the trailer and key art for The Greatest, marking the first authorized scripted series chronicling the life and legacy of Muhammad Ali.Created and executive produced by showrunner Ben Watkins (Cross), the eight-episode drama traces the coming-of-age journey of a young Cassius Clay. Set against the landscape of a rapidly changing America, the narrative follows his personal, professional, and political battles inside and outside the ring, exploring the championship bouts and deep moral convictions that transformed the young fighter from Louisville into a global cultural icon.Newcomer Jaalen Best stars in the dual role of Cassius Clay and Muhammad Ali, joined by a veteran supporting cast. Omari Hardwick portrays Cassius Clay Sr., Dana Gourrier steps in as Odessa "Bird" Clay, and Kai Parham appears as Rudy Clay. The ensemble also features Amin Joseph as Sonny Liston, Giovanni Ribisi as Angelo Dundee, and Michael Ealy as Malcolm X.The production was developed in close coordination with Ali’s estate, with his widow Lonnie Ali serving as executive producer. Watkins’ Blue Monday Productions backs the series alongside Michael B. Jordan’s Outlier Society, Authentic Studios, Roc Nation, Shawn Carter, Polygram Entertainment, and Grace: A Storytelling Company. Executive producers include Elizabeth Raposo, Corey Salter, Matthew Gross, Marc Rosen, Craig Siebels, Aiyana White, Jeff Augustin, Katie Wech, Owen Shiflett, Boyd Muir, Michele Anthony, Josh Wakely, David Blackman, Stefano Agosto, and Desiree Perez.All eight episodes of The Greatest premiere globally on November 4, 2026, exclusively on Prime Video across more than 240 countries and territories. items.title: Ralph Lauren Introduces the Western Cushion 38mmRalph Lauren Packs Piaget Power Into Its Engraved Silver Western Cushion
items.text: Ralph Lauren Introduces the Western Cushion 38mmRalph Lauren Packs Piaget Power Into Its Engraved Silver Western Cushion Summary Ralph Lauren downsizes its Western Cushion to a 38mm case crafted from engraved and lightly aged sterling silverThe lineup spans a black lacquer dial, an off-white lacquer dial and a dial made from natural turquoise stoneEach watch runs on the self-winding RL514 manufacture movement, produced by Piaget exclusively for Ralph Lauren Ralph Lauren has introduced the Western Cushion 38mm, a smaller take on its American Western Collection timepiece rendered in engraved sterling silver. The release arrives in three dial variations, each pairing the brand’s Western silverwork motifs with Swiss mechanical watchmaking underneath.The case is where the Western Cushion 38mm makes its strongest statement, starting with a sculpted cushion shape machined from sterling silver rather than steel or gold. Its surfaces carry dense, intricate engraving, and the metal has been given a light aging treatment that settles into the recesses of the pattern, adding depth and contrast across the case. The trimmed-down 38mm sizing keeps that heavily worked silver wearable on a wider range of wrists.Three dials sit inside that frame, each built with a different material approach. The Black Dial model uses deep black lacquer set against off-white numerals for a high-contrast read, while the Off-White Dial model reverses the palette with a lacquered off-white surface marked by black Roman and Arabic numerals. The standout is the Turquoise Dial model, whose dial is cut from natural turquoise and polished to bring out the stone’s veining, meaning no two pieces will look exactly alike.Powering every version is the RL514, a self-winding manufacture movement that Piaget produces solely for Ralph Lauren. The calibre is finished with traditional Swiss decoration, including Côtes de Genève striping and perlage, details reserved for anyone who gets a look at the movement itself. Hand-finished touches carry through the rest of the watch, and each model comes fitted with interchangeable leather straps, letting the wearer shift the overall tone of the piece without changing the watch. Built around experimentation and subversive design, the collaborative silhouette embraces natural wear and deliberate imperfection as central design elements.The shoe centers on a tearaway Navy canvas upper designed to erode with wear, gradually revealing a classic checkerboard pattern underlay beneath. Exposed foam lining the collar provides a deconstructed look, which is juxtaposed against round multicolor gemstones embedded along the ankle collar for calculated precision and contrast. The shoe is laced with a primary printed lace displaying repeating "Satoshi" text, accented with sandblasted bead detailing to introduce tactile dimension.Underfoot, the vulcanized sidewalls receive a hand-wiped black and yellow patina, creating a naturally aged aesthetic that works alongside a distressed foxing stripe. items.text: Merrell Taps Harris Tweed for a Handwoven Footwear Collection Name: Merrell x Harris Tweed Collection\MSRP: $130 - $190 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: MerrellMerrell brings Harris Tweed into its outdoor archive with a limited-edition collection spanning the Chameleon Redux SE, Jungle Moc, Moab 2 Slide SE and Relay Lace SE, with the latter offered in both men’s and women’s sizing.Made from pure new wool in Scotland’s Outer Hebrides, the fabric is fibre-dyed and spun on the islands before being handwoven by local craftspeople, with its layered coloration drawing inspiration from the region’s heathers, mosses, lochs and rugged Atlantic landscape. The entire range is unified in a single “Dark Walnut” colorway, allowing the construction and texture of the handwoven Scottish cloth to become the defining visual element. Deep brown leather and rubber components frame the richly textured Harris Tweed panels, whose multi-tonal weave gives the shoes a softer, more tactile character than Merrell’s usual technical textiles.The Chameleon Redux SE x Harris Tweed takes the collection’s most technical approach, applying the woven textile to its highly segmented, dimensional upper alongside leather reinforcement. A toggle lacing system, molded TPU heel counter and substantial rubber tooling preserve its outdoor character, while a FloatMax foam midsole softens the ride; against the complex construction, the warm Dark Walnut tweed gives the otherwise futuristic silhouette a distinctly heritage-driven finish.The Jungle Moc is considerably simpler, using Harris Tweed across its rounded slip-on profile with dark leather framing the upper. Its familiar comfort package remains intact through a removable EVA footbed, lightweight EVA midsole, heel-mounted Merrell Air Cushion and sticky rubber outsole, creating a contrast between the model’s utilitarian shape and the more traditional wool surface.The Moab 2 Slide SE carries the textile into an open-backed format, pairing its broad tweed-covered upper with a chunky, dark Vibram TC5+ outsole and lightweight EVA midsole. The difference between the soft, visibly woven wool and the aggressive trail-derived tooling gives it perhaps the clearest meeting point between Harris Tweed’s tailoring heritage and Merrell’s outdoor DNA.The Relay Lace SE offers the collection’s cleanest, most conventional sneaker profile, mixing full-grain leather with Harris Tweed panels, a traditional lace closure and streamlined rubber sole. items.title: Ressence’s TYPE 10 DN Is Designed to Look Like One Continuous Object
items.text: Ressence’s TYPE 10 DN Is Designed to Look Like One Continuous Object Summary Ressence debuts the TYPE 10 DN, its first oil-filled watch powered by an in-house movement.The 41.5mm titanium watch uses a seamless deep-blue “Dark Night” treatment.Its ROCS 10 display and RW-04 calibre deliver dual-time functionality and 60 hours of reserve. Ressence is introducing the TYPE 10 DN (Dark Night), a 100-piece limited edition that represents one of the Antwerp independent’s most ambitious attempts to make mechanical complexity disappear from view.Four years in development, the TYPE 10 began as a series of sketches by founder Benoît Mintiens exploring how a watch might evolve if shaped by the same principles of efficiency, integration and fluidity found in nature. The result is Ressence’s first oil-filled watch powered by its own movement, with the case, dial and integrated rubber strap visually merging into a single deep-blue form. Its 41.5mm Grade 5 titanium case is polished and treated with hard DLC, while the oil-filled display optically pulls the dial toward the sapphire crystal, further dissolving the usual boundaries between case, crystal and time display.Beneath that streamlined exterior sits a remarkably elaborate system comprising 538 components. Ressence’s patented ROCS 10 display replaces conventional hands with rotating discs for the hours, minutes and second time zone, alongside a 120-second runner that also acts as a mechanical shock absorber and a color-coded oil-temperature indicator. Driving it is the newly developed RW-04 self-winding calibre, designed in-house for the TYPE 10 and delivering a 60-hour power reserve from twin barrels.Because the mechanical movement operates in air while the ROCS display moves through oil, the two are housed in separate hermetically sealed chambers and connected magnetically through a 0.1mm titanium membrane. The arrangement allows power to transfer without a physical shaft passing between the two environments, while an expansion chamber compensates for changes in oil volume as temperatures fluctuate.Despite the engineering involved, the TYPE 10 DN weighs just 82 grams, reinforcing Ressence’s idea that greater mechanical sophistication should ultimately make a watch feel simpler rather than more complicated. Double-domed sapphire crystals frame the front and rear, with the RW-04 visible through a donut-shaped opening at the back, while the Ressence Compression Lock System provides 5 ATM water resistance.Limited to 100

items.title: A.P.C. x Barbour Pull Thornproof Wax Cotton From the Archives for FW26
items.text: A.P.C. x Barbour Pull Thornproof Wax Cotton From the Archives for FW26 Summary A.P.C. and Barbour build out a full Fall/Winter 2026 wardrobe spanning outerwear, denim, knitwear, shirts and accessoriesBarbour’s Premium Thornproof Wax Cotton returns from the archive with a denser weave in dark sage and dark navyTartan runs throughout the capsule as linings, waistband trims and back panels across clothing and bags A.P.C. x Barbour have unveiled their Fall/Winter 2026 collection, a complete capsule built around Barbour’s archival Premium Thornproof Wax Cotton and A.P.C.’s denim know-how. The two labels trade materials, proportions and utility details across outerwear, jeans, knitwear, shirts and accessories, folding each brand’s signatures into the other’s staples.The outerwear lineup draws on three established Barbour patterns. The Beaufort for men, first introduced by Dame Margaret Barbour in 1983, and the Spey for women, originally built to be worn with fishing tackle, both keep their standard proportions, while the longer Sugarlump Bedale opens up into a roomier, straighter cut. A.P.C.’s denim jackets inform the pocket construction and structural details on each style, giving the waxed shells a cleaner, more tailored edge.Fabric is the technical centerpiece of the release. Premium Thornproof Wax Cotton, revived from Barbour’s archive, uses a tighter weave than standard waxed cotton, which adds body, toughness and richer color saturation. It comes only in dark sage and dark navy, and like a pair of raw jeans, the wax picks up a patina that deepens with every wear.Barbour’s functional hardware carries through the capsule. Utility pockets, cuffs, wool collars matched to each shell and detachable hoods appear across multiple pieces, and select styles pick up the brand’s signature D-ring. Traditional tartan lines garments and accessories throughout, keeping Barbour’s heritage visible every time a jacket is opened.The denim side includes jackets, A.P.C.’s New Standard and Elisabeth jeans, and a skirt, each finished with tartan on the waistbands, pocket linings and back panels. Totes and caps borrow graphic and functional cues from the outerwear, while the accessories selection rounds things out with waxed and tartan bags, dark navy boots and dark sage clogs.The A.P.C. x Barbour FW26 collection is available now online and at select stores. The outerwear selection highlights a Monogram Macassar parka with matching ripstop-paneled trousers, a technical denim-effect shell set detailed with corduroy accents, and a snowboarding hoodie featuring a water-repellent shell, fleece lining, and an integrated ventilated faceguard.The après-ski offering shifts into relaxed silhouettes featuring trompe l’oeil effects and workwear elements. Key pieces include a shearling trucker jacket printed to imitate denim, a fleece jersey jacket imitating cable knit, and an intarsia blouson displaying the mountain-inspired LV Summit pattern. Bringing eveningwear into alpine terrain, a loden jacket is woven from double-face wool and metallic lurex to produce a glistening snow appearance, paired with cotton corduroy trousers featuring Monogram satin turn-ups. Motifs including Monogram Argyle, snowflake jacquards, and an LV Skier graphic extend across base layers, scarves, beanies, and eyewear such as the LV Frost Ski Mask.Luggage and footwear are re-engineered with cold-weather durability. items.title: Kenshi Yonezu Announces Global 2027 “GHOST” Tour Dates
items.text: Kenshi Yonezu Announces Global 2027 “GHOST” Tour Dates Summary Kenshi Yonezu announced international dates for his 2026-2027 "GHOST" world tour across Asia, North America, and Europe.Promoted by Live Nation, the leg includes arena debuts in Oakland, Mexico City, Toronto, and Amsterdam.General ticket sales begin October 22, 2026. Kenshi Yonezu has expanded his “KENSHI YONEZU 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR / GHOST,” adding a run of 2027 shows across Asia, North America, Europe and the UK. The newly announced leg follows his 2025 “WORLD TOUR / JUNK,” which marked his live debut in the U.S., Europe and Korea and contributed to a wider touring run that drew 440,000 attendees.Yonezu enters the next world tour following another record-setting stretch led by “IRIS OUT,” his theme song for CHAINSAW MAN – THE MOVIE: REZE ARC, which peaked at No. 5 on the Billboard Global 200 - the highest position achieved by a Japanese-language song - and spent 24 consecutive weeks atop Oricon’s Weekly Streaming Chart.The international leg follows the Japanese portion of “GHOST,” which is set to run across six cities and 14 arena performances from November 6 through December 17, 2026. General ticket sales for the newly announced dates begin October 22 at 12 p.m. local time via Live Nation.KENSHI YONEZU 2027 TOUR DATES\Jan 14 — Seoul, INSPIRE ArenaJan 16 — Seoul, INSPIRE ArenaJan 17 — Seoul, INSPIRE ArenaJan 29 — Singapore, Singapore Indoor StadiumFeb 4 — Oakland, Oakland ArenaFeb 6 — Los Angeles, Kia ForumFeb 9 — Mexico City, Palacio de los DeportesFeb 12 — Newark, Prudential CenterFeb 14 — Toronto, Scotiabank ArenaFeb 24 — London, The O2 ArenaFeb 26 — Paris, Accor ArenaFeb 28 — Amsterdam, Ziggo Dome Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Anicorn’s New ‘Evangelion’ Collection Revisits the First Encounter
items.text: Anicorn’s New ‘Evangelion’ Collection Revisits the First Encounter Summary Anicorn and Evangelion reunite for a new NGE Collection inspired by EVA-01 and Sachiel.Two watches translate their opposing visual identities into automatic and quartz formats.The wider capsule also includes cuffs, metal prints and launch-exclusive rewards. Anicorn has announced its latest collaboration, teaming up with the iconic anime series Neon Genesis Evangelion to launch the "NGE" Collection. Reconstructing the pivotal first encounter between Evangelion Test Type-01 and The 3rd Angel (Sachiel) across timepieces, jewelry, and artwork, the drop translates the series' opposing identities into striking objects of design. Anchoring the collection are two highly distinct watches. The first is the Evangelion Test Type-01 Automatic, featuring a black stainless-steel case and a layered dial framework with green numerals, orange details, and a purple inner bezel that mimics the mecha's armored structure. Powered by an automatic movement visible through a red NERV-printed caseback, this model is priced at $820 USD and paired with a black metal bracelet detailed with embossed warning stripes.Serving as the visual counterpoint is The 3rd Angel Quartz watch, which retails for $250 USD. Defined by deliberate restraint, its glossy black dial strips away conventional hour markers in favor of Sachiel's sculpted face at 12 o’clock and an exposed red core at 6 o’clock. The minimalist 39.1mm stainless-steel watch operates via a Miyota 2025 quartz movement and includes an A.T. Field-inspired geometric motif integrated into the crown. Further extending the thematic universe, the collection also offers a black Evangelion Test Type-01 Cuff Bracelet and two EVANGELION Metal Prints, featuring iconic scenes from the anime.To accompany the collection’s release, Anicorn is launching the "Global Synchronization Project," an interactive social media campaign where fans can raise the "Global Sync Rate" to unlock exclusive campaign rewards during the first two weeks. Eligible buyers of The 3rd Angel Quartz will receive a custom pin, while purchasers of the Evangelion Test Type-01 Automatic will be rewarded with a Golden EVA-01 Cuff. The Anicorn x EVANGELION "NGE" Collection will be available exclusively through Anicorn’s official website starting October 26, 2026, at 10 p.m. EDT. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Bocci Reimagines Its 14 Series With a Liquid-Like Mirror Effect
items.text: Bocci Reimagines Its 14 Series With a Liquid-Like Mirror Effect Summary Bocci debuts the 14 Mirror lighting collection at Paris Art & Design Week.The hand-applied mirrored finish dynamically oscillates between transparency and reflection.Milanese duo Cameranesi Pompili introduced the series through a constellation-like installation. Bocci is expanding one of its best-known lighting families with 14 Mirror, a reflective new treatment for the Vancouver studio’s iconic 14 series. The new lighting fixtures are defined by an oscillating, perceptual relationship between light transmission and environmental reflection. When fully illuminated, the internal light passes straight through the glass, rendering the orb fully transparent.However, when switched off or dimmed, a mirror effect takes over, turning the ambient light of the room, sunlight, or even a window into an active part of the fixture's composition. Between these two extremes lies a dynamic gradient condition where the solid glass at once transmits its own glow while softly reflecting its surroundings, creating a fluid visual experience that never quite settles into a single, fixed image.The new finish is intentionally inconsistent, with subtle variations in opacity created through the hand-application process. Those differences allow each piece to respond uniquely to its environment, with reflections appearing to slide, soften and dissolve across the glass as viewing angles and ambient light change. Bocci co-founder Omer Arbel describes 14 Mirror less as a color than a “condition,” and that idea becomes especially clear in clustered compositions, where the pieces move between luminous glass objects and dark, liquid-like reflective spheres. The treatment will be offered across the existing 14 typologies, including the 14p portable, 14 pendant and 14s sconce, giving the established series a new visual language without abandoning its underlying construction.To introduce the collection, Bocci has partnered with Milan-based duo Cameranesi Pompili on ORBITAL, a scenographic installation created for Paris Art & Design Week. Presented across four areas inside the Reference Studios apartment, the display treats each 14 Mirror fixture as a small moon, arranging them in constellation-like formations that play with symmetry, doubling, altered perspective and optical illusion.The collaboration continues Bocci’s earlier work with Valentina Cameranesi on Unexpected Guests, while pushing the studio’s interest in atmos

items.title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Receives an "Iron Man"-Inspired Patent Leather Makeover
items.text: Nike Air Force 1 Low Receives an "Iron Man"-Inspired Patent Leather Makeover Summary Nike is prepping a glossy patent leather Air Force 1 Low sporting an unofficial Iron Man-inspired color paletteThe sneaker features dark red patent leather burgundy laces translucent bright orange outsoles and comic-style black panel outlinesThe pair is scheduled to release on November 1 2026 through select retailers and Nike's webstore for $125 USD Name: Nike Air Force 1 '07 Premium "Iron Man"Colorway: Gym Red/Team Red-Burgundy Crush-Bright CeramicSKU: IX8058-687MSRP: $125 USDRelease Date: November 1, 2026Where to Buy: NikeNike is gearing up to launch the Air Force 1 Low Patent "Iron Man," applying a superhero-inspired aesthetic across the classic basketball silhouette. The release references familiar color blocking seen on an earlier 2013 edition while channeling the bold look of comic-inspired footwear.Though not an official Marvel collaboration, the pair earns its moniker through a vibrant red and gold scheme. High-gloss dark red patent leather constructs the upper, contrasted by deep burgundy laces and a darker heel panel. Bold black borders outline the edges of the leather overlays, delivering an illustrated aesthetic that emphasizes each cut and seam.Bright orange Swooshes sweep across the sidewalls to match the shoe’s translucent rubber outsole. Finishing details include orange Nike Air branding embroidered onto the tongue tag and embossed on the heel tab, completing the high-shine tribute.The Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent "Iron Man" is scheduled to release on November 1, 2026. items.title: Louis Vuitton’s Latest Travel Book Enters the World of K/DA
items.text: Louis Vuitton’s Latest Travel Book Enters the World of K/DA Summary Riot Games and Louis Vuitton reunite for Tempo Point , a K/DA-focused Travel Book.The project follows 24 hours in the lives of Ahri, Akali, Evelynn and Kai’Sa.Editions range from $68 USD to limited signed collector versions. Riot Games and Louis Vuitton are extending their long-running creative partnership with Tempo Point, a new Louis Vuitton Travel Book centered on K/DA, the virtual pop group from the League of Legends universe. The book imagines 24 hours in the individual lives of Ahri, Akali, Evelynn and Kai’Sa, reframing the four champions through their identities as performers, artists and style figures beyond the game itself.The project joins Louis Vuitton’s wider Travel Book series, which invites artists to interpret places, cultures and experiences through a distinct visual lens, while Tempo Point applies that format to a fictional pop world shaped by music, fashion and digital celebrity. K/DA first debuted in 2018 with “POP/STARS” before expanding through releases including the ALL OUT EP, growing into one of Riot’s most visible examples of how game characters can move between music, performance and broader pop culture.Tempo Point also continues a relationship between Louis Vuitton and Riot Games that dates back to 2019, when the French house created the Summoner’s Cup Trophy Trunk for the League of Legends World Championship and Nicolas Ghesquière designed in-game skins and a physical LV x League of Legends capsule collection.The new book will be released in a $68 USD Standard Edition and a $245 USD Collector’s Large-Format Edition limited to 400 copies, with both versions presented as cloth-bound hardcovers featuring six-color printing and a silk-screened cover in English, French and Chinese. A further run of 30 signed and numbered leather-bound copies, each packaged in a slipcase with an exclusive vinyl record, will be available through select Louis Vuitton stores, with pricing offered upon request. The Standard Edition will also be sold at the League of Legends Worlds 2026 Fan Fest in New York, alongside Louis Vuitton stores, its website and select bookstores. items.title: Byredo and Iittala Turn Light and Scent Into Sculptural Objects
items.text: Byredo and Iittala Turn Light and Scent Into Sculptural Objects Summary Byredo and Iittala expand LJUS into a full glass home collection.Sculptural forms explore the interaction of light, scent and flame.Five handcrafted pieces launch globally on October 16, 2026. Following its initial reveal earlier this year, Byredo and Iittala are bringing their LJUS collaboration into full view, expanding the project into a complete collection of glass objects built around the relationship between light, scent and everyday ritual.Rooted in a shared Nordic design sensibility, the partnership combines Iittala’s glassmaking heritage with Byredo’s more atmospheric approach to fragrance, treating flame not simply as a functional element but as something that activates the objects themselves. The collection takes inspiration from the changing character of Nordic light, balancing ideas of fire and ice, permanence and ephemerality through sculptural forms intended to subtly alter the mood of a room.The lineup comprises a candle stand, candle ornament, light refractor, incense holder and fragrance diffuser vessel, each handcrafted at Iittala’s historic factory in Finland. Visually, the pieces share a pronounced rippled and faceted glass language, with thick transparent walls catching and distorting surrounding light while amplifying the movement of a flame within. The light refractor is the most architectural expression of that idea, wrapping a candle within a substantial undulating glass shell, while the diffuser vessel translates the same silhouette into a smaller form with a softly tinted lower section. Subtle differences in surface, proportion and clarity are deliberately preserved as traces of the handmaking process, giving each piece a less uniform, more tactile character.The full Byredo x Iittala LJUS collection launches globally today and will be available through Iittala stores, Iittala.com, and Byredo’s direct-to-consumer channels. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: BIGBANG and Dover Street Market Expand "XX : COSMOS" Collection to Singapore
items.text: BIGBANG and Dover Street Market Expand "XX : COSMOS" Collection to Singapore Summary BIGBANG and Dover Street Market are bringing their collaborative XX COSMOS collection to Singapore following an initial London dropThe monochrome range draws visual inspiration from the acoustic depth and cosmic motifs of BIGBANG’s world tourIn addition to hoodies bags and accessories the in-store pop-up will offer a Singapore-exclusive T-shirt and branded water bottle Dover Street Market has officially teamed up with K-pop group BIGBANG to bring the Dover Street Market "XX : COSMOS" collection to Singapore. Announced by YG PLUS, the exclusive capsule expands on the heels of a successful launch in London, aligning directly with the group's concert tour schedule.Grounded in the central motif of BIGBANG's XX : COSMOS world tour, the collaborative lineup translates acoustic spatiality and cosmic frequencies into minimalist streetwear. The assortment centers on a stark monochrome color palette, juxtaposing the group’s signature tour iconography and emblems against Dover Street Market’s signature typography.The release carries forward key items established during the London debut, including two hoodie variations, two zip-up hoodies, a core T-shirt, a cap, a tote bag, a pouch, and a collectible keychain. Tailored specifically for the Singapore market, the drop expands with two region-locked pieces: a "Singapore City Exclusive T-Shirt" and a limited-edition water bottle. Every garment and accessory features the XX : COSMOS graphic treatment at its center, merging stage performance aesthetics with Dover Street Market's luxury retail sensibilities. In-store shoppers will also receive random limited-edition photocards with each purchase, available while supplies last.The BIGBANG x Dover Street Market "XX : COSMOS" collection releases in-store on Friday, October 16, 2026, exclusively at Dover Street Market Singapore, with customer registration open via the official DSMS portal. items.title: Zendaya to Star in Alex Garland's Upcoming Sci-Fi Film at A24
items.text: Zendaya to Star in Alex Garland's Upcoming Sci-Fi Film at A24 Summary Zendaya is set to star in an untitled science fiction film written and directed by Alex Garland for A24The project extends A24’s collaborative track record with Garland alongside past work with Zendaya on Euphoria and The DramaProduction on the feature is scheduled to begin filming in 2027 with narrative details kept strictly under wraps A24 is officially reuniting with Zendaya and filmmaker Alex Garland for an upcoming untitled sci-fi film. The project marks a return to speculative fiction for the actress, with Garland attached to both write and direct the feature.Plot details are currently being kept under wraps, with principal photography scheduled to commence in 2027. The project deepens established creative relationships between the studio and both talents. For Zendaya, the venture follows her run on the acclaimed series Euphoria and the box-office success of the dramedy The Drama alongside Robert Pattinson. Garland’s collaboration with A24 spans past directorial and writing projects including Ex Machina, Men, Civil War, and Warfare, in addition to his upcoming adaptation of the video game Elden Ring.The casting arrives during a prolific period for Zendaya, following major 2026 releases including The Odyssey, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and the upcoming debut of Dune: Part Three. Garland’s commitment to the project also follows updates from Danny Boyle regarding the 28 Years Later franchise, confirming the director’s creative focus is currently centered on original cinematic developments. items.title: IShowSpeed Teams With Higher Ground and Breakwater Studios for 'The Eyes of Ghana'
items.text: IShowSpeed Teams With Higher Ground and Breakwater Studios for 'The Eyes of Ghana' Summary Streaming creator IShowSpeed has partnered with Breakwater Studios and Barack and Michelle Obama’s Higher Ground to bring 'The Eyes of Ghana' to cinemasServing as IShowSpeed’s debut project as a producer the documentary follows the preservation efforts of historic Ghanaian cinematographer Chris HesseThe film is scheduled for a one-night-only theatrical release across AMC Regal Cinemark and independent exhibitors on October 28, 2026 Higher Ground and Breakwater Studios have partnered with streaming creator IShowSpeed to bring the acclaimed documentary The Eyes of Ghana to cinemas. The collaboration marks the very first project produced by IShowSpeed, who joins Oscar-winning director Ben Proudfoot to deliver the historical film to a broader global audience.Directed by Ben Proudfoot, The Eyes of Ghana debuted at the 2025 Toronto International Film Festival. The film centers on 93-year-old Ghanaian cinematographer Chris Hesse as he races against failing eyesight to rescue and restore more than 1,000 reels documenting Africa’s independence movements across the 1950s and 1960s. The archival footage remained hidden for decades following the 1966 coup that ousted Kwame Nkrumah, Ghana's first president.“It is a great honor to be part of ‘The Eyes of Ghana’ and help bring this extraordinary piece of history to the big screen. I felt a profound connection to Ghana when I visited this year, and learning about Chris Hesse’s work deepened my understanding of the country and its people,” said IShowSpeed. “His camera captured the birth of African independence, and his determination to preserve those images has ensured that future generations can witness it for themselves. I’m humbled by his legacy and proud to help bring his story to my community.”Alongside IShowSpeed, the documentary is produced by Proudfoot, Nana Adwoa Frimpong, Moses Bwayo, Anita Afonu, Brandon Somerhalder, Ethan Lewis, and Vinnie Malhotra, with executive production by Barack and Michelle Obama.The Eyes of Ghana screens for a one-night-only theatrical event on October 28, 2026, across AMC, Regal, Cinemark, and select independent cinemas, with ticketing live via TheEyesOfGhana.com. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Trap Bogeys With TaylorMade’s Spooky New 'Ghostbusters' Collection
items.text: Trap Bogeys With TaylorMade’s Spooky New 'Ghostbusters' Collection Summary TaylorMade Golf has officially unveiled its Ghostbusters collection spanning performance equipment accessories and apparelEquipment highlights include the Containment Unit MG5 Wedge Set and a Slimer-themed Spider Tour X putter featuring Proton Pack shaft detailingThe collaborative range launches to the public on October 15 following an early access window for Eagle-tier loyalty members TaylorMade Golf has officially unveiled the collaborative Ghostbusters collection, merging high-performance golf equipment and apparel with iconic paranormal motifs.Headlining the equipment roster is the Containment Unit MG5 Wedge Set ($749.99 USD), which packages 52°, 56°, and 60° wedges decorated with laser-etched franchise antagonists, custom paint fills, and coordinated shafts and grips. Joining the wedge trio is the Slimer Spider Tour X putter ($399.99 USD), coated in an iridescent green PVD finish with a laser-etched sole plate, a custom shaft inspired by Proton Pack energy streams, and a matching slime-themed mallet headcover. Supporting accessories include branded TP5 and TP5x golf balls ($64.99 USD) encased in Ghost Trap and Firehouse packaging, themed Ball Marker Sets ($39.99 USD), Proton Golf Tees ($19.99 USD), a leather No Ghosts TP Glove ($34.99 USD), and an embroidered Stay Puft Mallet Headcover ($89.99 USD).The apparel capsule presents three graphic tees ($50 USD) referencing the Library Ghost, the classic "No Ghosts" logo, and Slimer eating a hot dog, alongside a fleece No Ghosts Hoodie ($120 USD). Completing the line is the Jumpsuit Polo ($85 USD), crafted from tan technical fabric that references the parapsychologists' classic flight suits, paired with three headwear options: the No Ghosts Hamptons Hat, the Daytona Rope Hat, and the Jumpsuit A-Frame Hat ($39.99 USD each).The TaylorMade x Ghostbusters collection drops publicly on October 15, 2026, at 9 a.m. PT / 12 p.m. ET via TaylorMade, following early access for Eagle-tier loyalty members. View this post on InstagramA post shared by TaylorMade Golf (@taylormadegolf) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: IWC Marks the Year of the Goat With a Gold-Dial Pilot’s Chronograph
items.text: IWC Marks the Year of the Goat With a Gold-Dial Pilot’s Chronograph Summary IWC dropped a 500-piece titanium Pilot’s Watch for the Year of the Goat.It features a gold dial, ceramic bezel, and three-goat rotor.The automatic movement swaps the eighth-day numeral for a Chinese "goat" character. IWC is continuing its annual Chinese New Year series with the Pilot’s Watch Performance Chronograph 41 Year of the Goat, a limited-edition created for the lunar year beginning on February 6, 2027.Where previous festive releases leaned on deep burgundy tones, the new reference IW388310 becomes the first in the series to use a gold-colored dial, chosen for its associations with fortune, prosperity and prestige in Chinese culture. The warm metallic surface is offset by black chronograph counters and a black ceramic bezel, while the brushed titanium case keeps the overall look rooted in IWC’s performance-oriented Pilot’s Watch language rather than pushing fully into decorative territory.The symbolism continues beyond the dial. Gold-plated hands complement the main surface, while the chronograph maintains IWC’s familiar vertically aligned subdial layout and a day-date display at 3 o’clock. On the eighth day of each month, however, the usual numeral “8” is replaced by the Chinese character for “goat,” adding a subtle calendar-specific detail.The most elaborate reference appears on the reverse, where the gold-plated oscillating weight is sculpted as three goats, a motif traditionally associated with bliss and positive energy. Beneath it sits IWC’s automatic 69385 manufacture calibre, running at 4 Hz and offering a 46-hour power reserve, while the 41mm titanium case provides 10-bar water resistance. A black calfskin strap fitted with IWC’s EasX-CHANGE system rounds out the watch, allowing tool-free swaps.The Pilot’s Watch Performance Chronograph 41 Year of the Goat is limited to 500 examples worldwide and is currently listed by IWC across selected regional markets, priced at 10,400 CHF (approx. $ 12,600 USD). items.title: New Balance Delivers the 992 Made in USA in "Medusa Green"
items.text: New Balance Delivers the 992 Made in USA in "Medusa Green" Summary New Balance has introduced the 992 Made in USA in Medusa Green for its Fall/Winter 2026 collectionThe design pairs a dark green mesh upper and teal accent stitching with Thunder Brown suede overlays and matching toolingThe sneaker officially releases on October 27 2026 via New Balance and select retailers for $200 USD Name: New Balance 992 Made in USA "Medusa Green"Colorway: Medusa Green/Thunder BrownSKU: U992BBMSRP: $200 USDRelease Date: October 29, 2026Where to Buy: New BalanceNew Balance has officially unveiled the New Balance 992 Made in USA "Medusa Green," expanding its footwear roster for the colder months. The seasonal offering dresses the beloved archival runner in an earthy mix of deep greens and rich brown suede tailored for Fall/Winter 2026.The construction centers on a dark green breathable mesh base, overlaid with tonal paneling highlighted by precise teal stitching along the contours. Providing an earthy contrast, Thunder Brown suede sweeps across the mudguard from the toe through the lateral and medial profiles before wrapping the heel. This muted palette carries directly onto the ABZORB-cushioned midsole and durable rubber outsole, grounding the silhouette in uniform natural tones.Contrasting white accents brighten the look, appearing on the laces, collar lining, and the outer trim of the midfoot "N" insignias. Archival detailing remains true to the original 992 form, featuring grey panels housing "992" text near the rear, embroidered "USA" lettering on the heel tab, and standard New Balance branding across the tongue.The New Balance 992 Made in USA "Medusa Green" drops October 27, 2026. items.title: Milwaukee Brewers Sweep Los Angeles Dodgers to Reach First World Series Since 1982
items.text: Milwaukee Brewers Sweep Los Angeles Dodgers to Reach First World Series Since 1982 Summary The Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 6-4 to complete a four-game sweep in the NLCSGarrett Mitchell connected on a go-ahead home run in the sixth inning while the bullpen held off late ralliesMilwaukee hosts the opening matchup of the World Series on October 23 against either Cleveland or Tampa Bay The Milwaukee Brewers have officially captured the MLB National League pennant and advanced to the World Series after sweeping the Los Angeles Dodgers with a 6-4 victory in Game 4 of the NLCS. The win ends a 44-year pennant drought, sending the franchise to the Fall Classic for the first time since 1982.After falling behind 4-0 in the second inning courtesy of a Shohei Ohtani three-run homer, Milwaukee orchestrated a resilient comeback against the two-time defending champions. The Brewers erased the deficit in the fifth inning through aggressive baserunning and disciplined plate appearances against Tyler Glasnow and Alex Vesia. Garrett Mitchell broke the 4-4 deadlock in the sixth, launching a 409-foot leadoff home run to center field off Tanner Scott, followed by a ninth-inning insurance shot from David Hamilton off Edwin Díaz.Milwaukee’s bullpen shut down multiple late-inning threats to preserve the lead, with JoJo Romero picking up the win and Aaron Ashby working three scoreless innings to record the save. The victory establishes Milwaukee as the first team in major league history to sweep a best-of-seven series after trailing in every contest, as well as the first club to sweep an opponent that had swept them the prior postseason. Led by NLCS MVP Jake Bauers and manager Pat Murphy, the 103-win roster now prepares for its second-ever World Series appearance.The Milwaukee Brewers will host Game 1 of the World Series on October 23, 2026, against either the Cleveland Guardians or the Tampa Bay Rays.YOUR MILWAUKEE BREWERS ARE HEADING TO THE WORLD SERIES!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! https://t.co/9wrVOIy54p— Milwaukee Brewers (@Brewers) October 16, 2026THE NATIONAL LEAGUE PENNANT IS COMING HOME TO MILWAUKEE #WinOurWay https://t.co/AC1ckMgXxM— Milwaukee Brewers (@Brewers) October 16, 2026 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
