items.title: Blauer’s New Season Collection Is Made for Winters in the City
items.text: Blauer’s New Season Collection Is Made for Winters in the City This season, Blauer elevates its technical apparel to support active city lifestyles. As captured in its latest campaign, featuring UK music artists DYLAN, Cassyette, and Ben Kidson, the new collection aims to provide contemporary style without sacrificing core functionality.In contrast to last season’s rugged, outdoors-ready clothing, the Fall/Winter 2026 range takes on a sharper look throughout its four lines: B Department, B Essential, B Project, and B. Urban Police. A staple for the cooler months, the down jacket is reworked in new ways, including a casual wave-quilted jacket, a thermoregulating graphene version, and a unique semi-transparent ripstop piece with visible feathers. To accentuate the sleek aesthetic, the brand also delivers leather jackets in biker, pilot, and military-inspired cuts. The varied silhouettes adapt Blauer’s heritage styles with washed treatments and a versatile color palette of “Black Ink,” “London Fog,” “Total Eclipse,” and “Peat.” For much-needed winter layering, these jackets drop alongside ribbed jumpers and polo knits. Elsewhere, the new collection also features a special edition B.Cortina capsule. Designed more specifically for mountain escapes, the range offers thermal jackets and a coordinated outerwear set, both adorning a Queen of the Dolomites-inspired print. You can now check out the pieces in the new campaign lensed by Bryan Adams. Adopting Blauer’s signature black-and-white aesthetic, he frames the contemporary feel of the garments while highlighting the cast’s unmistakable individuality. Shop Blauer’s Fall/Winter 2026 collection on its website and at select stockists worldwide. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Salomon XT-6 PROTECTIVE and XT-WHISPER GTX Receive BILLY’S-Exclusive Colorways
items.text: The Salomon XT-6 PROTECTIVE and XT-WHISPER GTX Receive BILLY’S-Exclusive Colorways Name: Salomon XT-6 PROTECTIVE & XT-WHISPER GTX BILLY’s ExclusivesColorway: Stormy Weather/Dark Navy/Trooper, Grisaille/Dark Navy/BlackSKU: TBCMSRP: ¥26,400 - ¥29,700 JPY (approx. $167 - $188 USD)Release Date: October 23Where to Buy: BILLY’s TokyoSalomon continues to blur the lines between rugged outdoor performance and urban streetwear with a newly unveiled footwear capsule arriving exclusively at BILLY'S. The drop reimagines two of the French brand's most celebrated technical silhouettes - the XT-6 PROTECTIVE and the XT-WHISPER GORE-TEX - in mood-evoking, weather-ready colorways. Designed to adapt effortlessly to both city streets and unpredictable natural environments, the collection beautifully balances cutting-edge utility with a sophisticated.The XT-6 PROTECTIVE takes the darker, more utilitarian route, replacing the model’s usual technical mesh emphasis with a ripstop upper inspired by workwear. Its "Stormy Weather" base reads as a muted blue-grey, overlaid with pale Trooper green-grey SensiFit lines that trace the sidewalls and toe before giving way to Dark Navy and black around the heel and heavily lugged sole. The matte ripstop surface and tonal overlays give the shoe a more protective, uniform-like character, while black Quicklace cords and oversized Salomon branding add sharper contrast. Underfoot, EVA cushioning softens the ride, with durable TPU film reinforcing the slim layered construction.The XT-WHISPER GORE-TEX offers a lighter visual counterpoint in "Grisaille/Dark Navy/Black," pairing pale grey technical mesh with flowing navy overlays and metallic silver-white accents that emphasize the silhouette’s distinctive wave-like lines. The silhouette specifically highlights the interplay between matte and glossy finishes, which creates extra depth across the layered upper, while a visible GORE-TEX tab signals the shoe’s weather-resistant construction. A wavy SensiFit structure works with the Quicklace system to wrap the foot securely, complemented by an OrthoLite insole and a black-and-off-white trail outsole that grounds the cooler palette. items.title: MAMMUT and BEAMS Revive the Expedition-Proven “Serac Extreme Jacket” for a Limited Run
items.text: MAMMUT and BEAMS Revive the Expedition-Proven “Serac Extreme Jacket” for a Limited Run Summary BEAMS is reissuing MAMMUT’s Serac Extreme Jacket as a limited special edition built closely on the original designThe updated shell uses GORE-TEX and pairs a large MAMMUT logo on one sleeve with BEAMS embroidery on the otherA sweatshirt and cap arrive alongside the jacket to complete the release MAMMUT and BEAMS are reviving the Swiss outdoor brand’s Serac Extreme Jacket through the “SERAC EXTREME JACKET BEAMS SPECIAL,” a limited reissue that stays faithful to the original while folding in present-day performance and BEAMS-exclusive touches. The shell carries real expedition credentials, having protected climber Stephan Siegrist through harsh conditions during his December 1995 push into the peaks of Patagonia.The jacket’s pattern sticks closely to the first-generation Serac Extreme, keeping the overall shape that earned it a reputation in alpine circles. Rather than chase a full redesign, the reissue upgrades what sits beneath the surface, with a GORE-TEX build bringing the waterproof, weather-blocking protection expected from a modern hardshell.Branding is split across the sleeves to reflect the partnership. An oversized MAMMUT logo runs along the left arm, while the right sleeve carries embroidered BEAMS lettering, giving each label its own side of the jacket without crowding the body.Some of the most considered details sit on the inside. The lining features a special “EIGER STORY LABEL” produced for this edition, joined by a revived MAMMUT brand label that nods to the jacket’s original era. The launch also includes a sweatshirt and a cap, extending the reissue beyond outerwear for those who want the look in lighter layers.The MAMMUT x BEAMS “SERAC EXTREME JACKET BEAMS SPECIAL,” along with the accompanying sweatshirt and cap, drops on Friday, October 23 at select BEAMS stores and via the BEAMS online store. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike’s “Plaid Pack” Dresses Four Classics in Red Tartan
items.text: Nike’s “Plaid Pack” Dresses Four Classics in Red Tartan Name: Nike “Plaid Pack”MSRP: ￥17,600 - ￥29,700 JPY (approx. $111 - $188 USD)Release Date: October 22Where to Buy: NikeNike brings a cold-weather twist to four women’s classics with its new “Plaid Pack,” comprising the Air Force 1 Low, Air Max 90, Air Max Plus and Shox TL. A red tartan pattern - woven with black, white and touches of yellow - runs throughout the collection, set against predominantly black foundations for a distinctly autumnal, punk-leaning effect. The Air Force 1 Low “Black/Tough Red/White/Black” takes the most restrained approach, using smooth black leather across the toe, eyestays and Swoosh while inserting plaid textile into the quarter panels and heel tab, all grounded by a completely black sole unit.The Air Max 90 “Black/Tough Red/Yellow Ochre/Team Red” adds more material contrast, combining black mesh and fuzzy suede-like overlays with deep Team Red TPU eyelets and Swooshes; tartan appears prominently around the collar and rear, bringing pattern into the silhouette without overwhelming its familiar layered construction.The Air Max Plus “Tough Red/White/Yellow Ochre/Black” pushes the plaid motif furthest, wrapping much of the upper in red tartan beneath its signature black TPU cage. Glossy black mudguards and sculpted black Air tooling give the pair a harder technical edge, while small Yellow Ochre details on the outsole add an unexpected warm accent beneath the otherwise dark build.Meanwhile, the Shox TL “Black/Tough Red/Yellow Ochre/Black” uses the same plaid textile beneath a black skeletal cage, paired with glossy black Shox columns and a dark leather heel for the most overtly Y2K treatment of the four. Together, the pack balances collegiate tartan with Nike’s archival sportswear shapes, giving each model a different ratio of pattern, texture and blacked-out hardware. items.title: Marina Abramović Turns Eight Decades of Life Into ‘Long Life, Short Stories’
items.text: Marina Abramović Turns Eight Decades of Life Into ‘Long Life, Short Stories’ Summary Marina Abramović reflects on memory, creativity and personal philosophy in Long Life, Short Stories .The illustrated volume blends drawings, anecdotes and introspection.Published by Rizzoli Electa, the 224-page book is priced at $65 USD. Marina Abramović turns inward for Long Life, Short Stories, a new illustrated volume that reframes one of performance art’s most uncompromising careers through memories, drawings and personal reflection. The book unfolds as what its publisher, Rizzoli Electa, describes as part sketchbook, part diary and part personal philosophy, moving through subjects including love, sex, loss, fear, nature, ancestry, creativity, dreams and even love spells. The fragmented format feels particularly suited to an artist whose practice has long used lived experience as material, offering a more intimate counterpart to the endurance, vulnerability and physical risk that have defined her public work.Published as Abramović celebrates her 80th birthday in 2026, the book arrives at another significant point in a career that helped establish performance art as a major contemporary discipline. Since emerging in the early 1970s, the Serbia-born artist has repeatedly tested the physical and psychological boundaries between performer and audience, from early works including Rhythm 0 and Rhythm 5 to her landmark 2010 Museum of Modern Art retrospective The Artist Is Present. Long Life, Short Stories approaches that history from a deliberately different angle. Original drawings created for the publication sit alongside direct, often humorous accounts and philosophical observations, revealing some of the emotional and psychological terrain behind works more commonly discussed through ideas of endurance, time, presence and bodily limits.The book is less a chronological autobiography than a loosely assembled map of Abramović’s inner world, shifting between the mystical, provocative and unexpectedly everyday while allowing personal episodes to sit alongside broader reflections on creativity and human connection. It also adds a more private dimension to a milestone year that includes major projects surrounding her 80th birthday, including a large-scale presentation at New York’s Park Avenue Armory.Marina Abramovic: Long Life, Short Stories spans 224 pages in hardcover and is priced at $65 USD via Rizzoli. items.title: Technics, ‘PaRappa the Rapper’ and WIND AND SEA Unite for a Triple Collaboration
items.text: Technics, ‘PaRappa the Rapper’ and WIND AND SEA Unite for a Triple Collaboration Summary WIND AND SEA teams up with Technics and PaRappa the Rapper for a three-way collaboration.Highlights include 72 limited-edition stadium jackets, graphic apparel and DJ-inspired accessories.The collection celebrates WIND AND SEA's Shibuya PARCO store opening on October 23. WIND AND SEA is bringing together music, gaming and fashion with a three-way collaboration featuring Technics and PaRappa the Rapper, celebrating the opening of its new flagship space at Shibuya PARCO in Tokyo. The collection celebrates the convergence of real-life DJ heritage and gaming nostalgia by highlighting PJ Berri, the DJ character from PaRappa the Rapper, alongside Technics’ legendary SL-1200 direct-drive turntable.Directly referencing the SL-1200’s design and hip-hop legacy since its 1972 debut, the capsule integrates the turntable's control button labels and details across track jackets, track pants, and custom DJ slipmats. A centerpiece of the collection is a limited-edition Numbering Stadium Jacket, produced in a run capped at 72 individually serialized pieces as a tribute to the SL-1200’s launch year.Elsewhere, graphic hoodies, crewneck sweatshirts and T-shirts feature illustrations of PJ Berri and PaRappa alongside Technics branding, combining the game's cartoon aesthetic with vintage music merchandise influences. Accessories further reinforce the crossover, including DJ slipmats, embroidered caps, knit beanies, a graphic blanket, jewelry, drum bags and character keychains. A silver PaRappa plush toy completes the range, extending the collection's playful visual identity beyond apparel.Prices range from ¥2,500 JPY - ¥90,000 JPY (approx. $16 - $569 USD), the Technics x PaRappa the Rapper x WIND AND SEA collection celebrates the opening of WIND AND SEA's new Shibuya PARCO store on October 23, 2026, located on the shopping complex's fifth floor. The new store will operate daily from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m., offering a dedicated destination for the label's latest exploration of fashion, music and gaming culture.Shibuya PARCO15-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya City,Tokyo 150-8377, Japan  View this post on Instagram A post shared by WIND AND SEA (@windandsea_wear) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Acqua di Parma’s Holiday 2026 Collection Is a Colorful Celebration of Italian Hospitality
items.text: Acqua di Parma’s Holiday 2026 Collection Is a Colorful Celebration of Italian Hospitality Summary Acqua di Parma unveils its Holiday 2026 collection, designed with Italian artist Agostino Iacurci.Inspired by the fictional Grand Hotel Sprezzatura, the collection features sculptural ceramics, festive fragrances and an Advent Calendar.Prices range from $65 to $1,022 USD. For this holiday season, Acqua di Parma is inviting guests to check into the fictional Grand Hotel Sprezzatura, an imaginative alpine retreat where Italian hospitality, theatrical storytelling and festive fragrance converge. Celebrating its 110th anniversary, the Italian fragrance house has collaborated with multidisciplinary artist Agostino Iacurci to create a colorful visual universe inspired by the Dolomites and the effortless elegance of sprezzatura, the Italian art of making even the most elaborate gestures appear natural.Drawing on the theatrical traditions of Commedia dell'Arte, Iacurci imagines a cast of hotel characters whose personalities unfold through bold geometric compositions. Inspired by the modular logic of Tangram puzzles, his illustrations combine architectural facades, mountain silhouettes, expressive masks and playful human figures, transforming the collection's packaging into a series of interconnected visual stories. Rendered in vibrant yellows, oranges, blues and earthy tones, the designs reinterpret Acqua di Parma's signature aesthetic through a festive, surrealist lens, capturing the warmth and eccentricity of an imaginary Italian mountain getaway.At the heart of the collection is a series of limited-edition Masterpiece objects named after the hotel's fictional protagonists, Alfredo, Clementina and Tobia. Handcrafted and painted in Tuscany, the ceramic creations encompass refillable fragrance bottles, candles and diffusers, distinguished by stacked geometric forms, sculptural finials and character-inspired silhouettes. Produced in editions of just 200 pieces, each object bears Iacurci's signature alongside the Maison's branding. The wider holiday assortment introduces seasonal home fragrances in Bosco, Panettone and Torrone, evoking the atmosphere of an Italian winter through references to woodland landscapes and traditional festive sweets.Candles and diffusers arrive in decorated glass vessels featuring distressed gold-leaf detailing, while three signature fragrances - Colonia Il Profumo, Buongiorno and Zafferano - receive special Designer Edition packaging. items.title: Paulin’s Mara Gets a Genuine Galvanic Gilt Dial for Hodinkee
items.text: Paulin’s Mara Gets a Genuine Galvanic Gilt Dial for Hodinkee Summary Paulin and Hodinkee rework the Mara with a vintage-inspired gilt dial and aged lume.The limited edition uses a slimmer 11.8mm case and Miyota 9039 automatic movement.Limited to 250 pieces, it is priced at $1,000 USD. Paulin and Hodinkee have teamed up on a limited edition of the Mara, revisiting the Glasgow watchmaker’s first dive watch through the lens of mid-century tool watches. Founded in 2013 and operating alongside sister brand anOrdain, Paulin has built its identity around expressive color, typography and playful modern design, but the Mara Limited Edition for Hodinkee takes a deliberately more archival direction. Its 39.7mm stainless-steel cushion case retains the architecture of the standard Mara, while the dial trades Paulin’s usual geometric markers for classic diver indices, warm gilt accents and antiqued Super-LumiNova inspired by the black-and-gold dive watches of the 1950s and early ’60s.The defining feature is its genuine galvanic gilt dial, produced using a traditional process rather than simply printing gold-colored details onto a black surface. Each brass dial is first electroplated in gold before the minute track, logos and lettering are masked with a chemical resist; a subsequent galvanic treatment turns the exposed areas matte black, leaving the underlying gold visible through the markings. Paulin then hand-paints the hour markers with aged-tone Super-LumiNova to match the hands and bezel scale. Other period-minded touches include the meters-first depth rating, a gilt Hodinkee signature at 4 o’clock and Paulin’s custom Wim typeface, while a dark grey 120-click bezel uses a double-domed sapphire insert. A black-and-grey striped NATO strap with a Hodinkee-signed buckle completes the vintage-informed treatment.Inside, the collaboration swaps the Swiss movement used by the standard production Mara for a Miyota 9039 automatic calibre, providing a 42-hour power reserve while helping slim the case from 13.5mm to 11.8mm. Water resistance has correspondingly been reduced from 300 meters to a still practical 100 meters, creating proportions closer to vintage skin divers while retaining modern features including sapphire construction and a screw-down crown.Limited to 250 individually numbered pieces, the Paulin Mara Limited Edition for Hodinkee is priced at $1,000 USD and is available for pre-order through Hodinkee and Watches of Switzerland, with deliveries expected to begin i

items.title: Birkenstock Preps for Winter With Two Cozy Loma and Solana Silhouettes
items.text: Birkenstock Preps for Winter With Two Cozy Loma and Solana Silhouettes Name: Birkenstock Loma, SolanaColorway: “Cork Brown”SKU: 26093610000830, 26093610000930MSRP: ¥27,500 JPY (approx. $174 USD)Release Date: November 2026Where to Buy: JOURNAL STANDARD RakutenBirkenstock and JOURNAL STANDARD introduce two exclusive cold-weather styles, bringing the Loma and Solana together in a shared “Cork Brown” treatment.The Loma takes the more enclosed approach, pairing a rounded closed toe with a broad suede strap across the instep, while the Solana opens up the forefoot with a wide single-strap construction for a more relaxed slide profile. Across both, the warm caramel-brown suede has a softly brushed, matte finish that gives the shoes a slightly lived-in character, with subtle tonal variation across the nap. The monochrome treatment keeps stitching and edge details understated, while the dark outsole creates a slim visual break beneath the otherwise earthy upper.The seasonal release is defined most clearly by its plush lamb-wool lining, which fills the footbed and wraps around the interior edges in a deeper, fuzzy brown tone. That contrast between the smooth suede exterior and dense shearling-like interior gives both silhouettes a warmer, more tactile presence without dramatically changing their minimal Birkenstock shapes. The Loma’s extra coverage makes the treatment feel closer to a winter clog, while the Solana retains more of the ease and openness of a traditional sandal. Both JOURNAL STANDARD-exclusive models are available for pre-order now in Japan, with deliveries scheduled to begin in mid-November 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: LEGO Icons’ “Venetian Neighborhood” Turns Your Shelf Into a Canal-Side Escape
items.text: LEGO Icons’ “Venetian Neighborhood” Turns Your Shelf Into a Canal-Side Escape Summary LEGO and Marvel have unveiled The Marvel Skyline, an 18+ microscale model that compresses dozens of landmarks from the comics, films and series into a single cityscapeHero headquarters like the Baxter Building and the X-Men Mansion share the skyline with villain hubs including Oscorp Industries and Roxxon CorporationA Galactus minifigure, Spider-Man and Human Torch trophy figures, and a fleet of miniature vehicles round out the set LEGO is shrinking the Marvel Universe down to shelf size with The Marvel Skyline, a 1,261-piece microscale set aimed at adult builders and collectors. The display gathers headquarters, labs and corporate towers from across Marvel’s comics, films and series into one continuous city block, splitting its real estate between the heroes and the villains who oppose them.The skyline’s heroic side stacks up some of Marvel’s most recognizable addresses, with Avengers Tower, the Daily Bugle, the Baxter Building and the X-Men Mansion all rendered in miniature. Deeper-cut locations make the cut too, including the Wakandan Embassy, Rand Enterprises Building and Pym Laboratories, giving longtime readers plenty of landmarks to spot beyond the usual blockbuster sites.Across town, the villains get their own cluster of buildings. Hammer Industries, Roxxon Corporation, Oscorp Industries and Fisk Tower anchor the darker end of the skyline, setting up a visual standoff between the two halves of the city as the build comes together.Figures add scale and character to the architecture. A Galactus minifigure looms over the scene, while Spider-Man and Human Torch appear as trophy figures that slot into the display. At street level, the X-Jet, the Fantastic Four Rocket Ship and the Spider-Mobile join other vehicles placed around the roads, turning a static cityscape into something closer to a frozen action shot. The finished model stands over 8 inches (21 cm) tall, stretches 15.5 inches (40 cm) wide and runs 4.5 inches (11 cm) deep, sizing it for a desk, shelf or office display.LEGO’s The Marvel Skyline is available for pre-order now via LEGO, with shipping set to begin January 1, 2027. items.title: WALLHACK Seals Guts in the Berserker Armor Beneath a ‘Berserk’ Glass Mousepad
items.text: WALLHACK Seals Guts in the Berserker Armor Beneath a ‘Berserk’ Glass Mousepad Summary Copenhagen gaming brand WALLHACK has partnered with Kentaro Miura’s Berserk on a special edition of its SP-005 glass mousepadThe pad showcases Guts in the Berserker Armor gripping the Dragon Slayer, rendered in black and white with sharp red accentsBerserk details extend to a blood-red silicone base, a Brand of Sacrifice sticker and packaging made exclusively for the release WALLHACK is bringing one of manga’s most recognizable antiheroes to the desk with the WALLHACK x Berserk Glass Mousepad, a special edition of the Danish brand’s SP-005 model. The pad pairs WALLHACK’s competition-grade glass with an image of Guts in the Berserker Armor holding the Dragon Slayer, pitched equally at players chasing performance and fans who might rather hang it on the wall.Miura’s dense, detailed linework gets plenty of room to breathe across the 51 x 44 cm surface. The palette stays mostly black and white, letting the armor’s texture carry the image, while bursts of red and a large Berserk logo give the composition its edge.The artwork sits underneath WALLHACK’s SP-005 glass top, so the visual upgrade doesn’t come at the cost of speed. A finely textured finish keeps the glide quick and even, with just enough tactile feedback to support both fast flick shots and small, controlled corrections. The pad itself is cut from 2.5 mm tempered glass and rests on the brand’s proprietary silicone base, which grips the desk firmly during hard, sweeping movements.Comfort gets attention at the edges too. WALLHACK’s low-profile edge design reduces the drop between the glass and the desk, so wrists and forearms can move across the border without catching. A carrying case comes included for storing the pad or taking it on the road.The Berserk theming runs through the rest of the package. The silicone base arrives in a blood-red finish, and both the packaging and an included sticker bearing the Brand of Sacrifice, the cursed mark carried by Guts, were created specifically for this collaboration.The partnership fits squarely within WALLHACK’s approach of turning manga, anime and contemporary culture into collectible gaming gear, blending performance engineering with a pared-back Scandinavian design sensibility. Berserk, according to the brand, has long been a reference point for many on its team, and the result is a piece built as much for display as for play.The WALLHACK x Berserk Glass Mousepad launches w

items.title: Apple’s October 28 “Pro and Tell” Event Is Expected to Debut the First Touchscreen MacBook Pro
items.text: Apple’s October 28 “Pro and Tell” Event Is Expected to Debut the First Touchscreen MacBook Pro Summary Apple will host its "Pro and tell" special hardware event in Los Angeles on October 28The showcase is rumored to debut the first OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro models featuring a Dynamic IslandExpected reveals include an updated iPad mini alongside M6-powered desktop and laptop options Apple is preparing to close out an unusually dense release schedule with a special hardware event scheduled for Wednesday, October 28, at 10 a.m. PT. Taking place in Los Angeles, the impending showcase marks the company's second major product presentation in a single month. The official tagline for the presentation is "Pro and tell," a moniker directly embraced by leadership. Executive Greg Joswiak stoked anticipation for the presentation by sharing the event invite artwork on social media on October 19, writing to followers, "Can't wait to pro and tell next week."According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the "Pro and tell" presentation is expected to center on Apple announcing its first MacBook Pro models equipped with both a touchscreen and an OLED display. These OLED touchscreen machines will reportedly be available in 14-inch and 16-inch sizes. Beyond the upgraded screen technology, the new laptops are expected to feature a Dynamic Island for the first time. Adding touch input to the Mac line reverses the company's long-standing design philosophy of keeping laptop and tablet interaction models separate.Regarding physical design, the upcoming OLED MacBook Pro models will weigh significantly less than the current generation. Underneath the exterior, these touchscreen laptops are expected to run on the brand's M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.Reports indicate the October 28 event docket includes a suite of supplementary reveals, beginning with a revamped iPad mini. The updated tablet features an OLED screen, an updated speaker system and a relocated FaceTime camera. Apple is also rumored to debut a new iMac alongside entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro models, both expected to be powered by the M6 chip. In contrast to the overhauled touchscreen models, the rumored M6-powered iMac and entry-level laptops will reportedly retain the physical design of current versions. items.title: Cardi B Subtly Addresses Feuds and Past Relationships at Debut 'Tiny Desk' Show
items.text: Cardi B Subtly Addresses Feuds and Past Relationships at Debut 'Tiny Desk' Show Summary Cardi B delivered her debut performance on NPR’s Tiny Desk Concert running through an eight-track set of catalog staplesThe performance introduced a notable lyrical change on ErrTime replacing a prior shout-out to Latto with Kelly RowlandThe live set also featured an altered lyric targeting past relationships during a performance of Be Careful NPR has officially premiered Cardi B's debut performance on its celebrated Tiny Desk Concert series. The Bronx rapper delivered a high-energy, eight-song showcase featuring deliberate lyrical tweaks to some of her most recognized records.Premiering on Monday, October 19, the set bridged fan favorites from her 2018 debut Invasion of Privacy—including "Be Careful," "Bodak Yellow," and "I Like It"—with tracks from her 2025 sophomore project Am I The Drama?, such as "Hello," "ErrTime," "Up," and "Man of Your Word," alongside her latest single, "Ah Ha."During her performance of "ErrTime," Cardi drew attention by swapping out the track's original lyric referencing Latto in favor of Kelly Rowland. Cardi delivered the line, “Bad brown bitch, she look like Kelly in this muthafka,” replacing the original studio bar, “Bad yellow bitch, she look like Latto in this muthafka!” The adjustment follows a 2025 dispute between the two artists, which Latto later addressed on her 2026 track "Gimmie Dat."Cardi also took aim at past relationships during "Be Careful," altering the original lyric “And karma for you gon' be who you end up with!” to “And karma for you? Well, you see it!”—nodding to her 2024 split from husband Offset and her subsequent breakup with NFL player Stefon Diggs in February 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: 7-Eleven x Bam Bird Boutique Shuffle Convenience Store Nostalgia Into a Hand-Painted Mahjong Tile Set
items.text: 7-Eleven x Bam Bird Boutique Shuffle Convenience Store Nostalgia Into a Hand-Painted Mahjong Tile Set Summary 7-Eleven and Bam Bird Boutique have created a custom mahjong set exclusively for 7Collection, filled with references to the convenience store chainThe tiles combine triple-layer acrylic construction with hand-painted artwork and gold-etched backsA signature green velvet bag, two dice and a custom tile guide come included 7-Eleven is moving from the snack aisle to the mahjong table with the 7-Eleven x Bam Bird Boutique Mahjong Tile Set, a 7Collection exclusive that recasts the store’s most recognizable products, colors and symbols as playable tiles. The result sits somewhere between a collector’s object and a fully functional game set, with every design built to stay legible once the tiles hit the table.The appeal starts with familiarity. Rather than relying on traditional tile motifs alone, the artwork pulls from 7-Eleven’s shelves and branding, translating everyday products and nostalgic references into small-scale illustrations that regulars will spot instantly. The challenge, and the point, is balancing that recognition with readability, so each suit still functions as it should during play.That artwork is painted by hand onto tiles made from three layers of acrylic, each measuring 32mm x 23mm x 13mm. The backs keep the brand front and center, carrying 7-Eleven’s signature stripes along with a gold-etched logo, so even a face-down wall reads as unmistakably 7-Eleven.Underneath the branding, the set is built for serious play. Its 160 tiles break down into 36 bams, 36 craks and 36 dots, joined by 8 flowers, 16 winds, 12 dragons, 10 jokers and 6 blanks. Removing 2 jokers and the 6 blanks brings the set in line with National Mah Jongg League standards.The accessories carry the theme through. A 14" x 8" velvet bag in 7-Eleven’s signature green holds the tiles, with added brand details hidden inside, while two dice and a double-sided guide, featuring the tile designs on one face and helpful gameplay reminders on the other, complete the package for new and seasoned players alike.The 7-Eleven x Bam Bird Boutique Mahjong Tile Set is available now via 7Collection. items.title: BMW Reveals the F 450 RR, an Entry-Level Sportbike With Superbike Aerodynamics
items.text: BMW Reveals the F 450 RR, an Entry-Level Sportbike With Superbike Aerodynamics Summary BMW revealed the 2027 F 450 RR, an entry-level sportbike that integrates premier aerodynamic wing elements into its fairingThe US-bound M Sport trim pushes the beginner platform further with an adjustable KYB suspension, lean-sensitive ABS and traction controlPriced at $7,815, the motorcycle is powered by a 420 cc parallel twin engine and draws its visual identity from WorldSBK-spec racing machines Superbike aerodynamics have historically remained restricted to top-tier racing machines, but premier track technology is trickling down to entry-level models. BMW revealed the 2027 BMW F 450 RR, a new entry-level sportbike that delivers aerodynamic front wing elements to a sub-$8,000 USD platform. The new motorcycle proves that introductory displacement no longer requires compromising on high-end design. By mirroring the sophisticated styling of elite competition bikes, the model caters directly to new riders who want an authentic race aesthetic from their first motorcycle.The heart of the motorcycle is a 420 cc parallel twin engine, uniquely configured with a 135-degree crank offset. That powerplant generates 48 horsepower at 8,750 rpm alongside 32 pound-feet of torque at 6,750 rpm. To ease the learning curve for beginners, the sportbike offers the optional BMW Easy Ride Clutch system, which renders manual clutch operation entirely optional. Maintaining sharp handling dynamics, the chassis features a sport-oriented suspension layout providing 5.5 inches of travel at both ends. Stopping power comes from high-performance Brembo braking components on the front wheel and ByBre hardware on the rear.Visually, the F 450 RR brings an aggressive silhouette modeled directly after WorldSBK-spec racing machines. Integrated aerodynamic fairing wings bring authentic track performance features into a street-ready package. This styling ensures that entry-level riders command the road with the posture and visual presence of a full-fledged superbike.Riders in the United States receive the premium M Sport trim of the BMW F 450 RR as standard. This top-spec variant equips a fully adjustable KYB suspension system, lean-sensitive ABS and advanced traction control. The cockpit includes standard heated grips, a dedicated USB-C port and a vibrant 6.5-inch TFT display to manage the onboard electronics. Priced at $7,815 USD, the upcoming 2027 model year release redefines the entry-level landscape by p

items.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Lands First Lead Television Role in A24 Drama 'The Apology' at Netflix
items.text: Gwyneth Paltrow Lands First Lead Television Role in A24 Drama 'The Apology' at Netflix Summary Gwyneth Paltrow is set to headline her first television series in A24’s upcoming drama 'The Apology'Netflix has issued a straight-to-series two-season commitment for the cold-case thrillerThe production comes amid an executive restructuring at Netflix spearheaded across its scripted divisions Netflix and A24 have officially greenlit a two-season order for The Apology, marking the first-ever lead television vehicle for Academy Award winner Gwyneth Paltrow. The thriller drama series pairs the independent entertainment company with acclaimed Danish filmmaker Thomas Vinterberg.Paltrow stars as Evelyn Amspoker, a grief-stricken mother whose son was murdered 18 years ago in a high-profile cold case. Per the series logline, “When a stranger suddenly appears and confesses, justice finally seems possible,” until Evelyn and her husband, Caleb, discover that the perpetrator may receive a reduced sentence. “Faced with that unbearable truth, Evelyn and Caleb decide to take matters into their own hands.”The drama is created, written, and showrun by Joe Murtagh (The Woman in the Wall), with Another Round director Thomas Vinterberg slated to direct. Joe Hipps of Cut To executive produces alongside Murtagh, Vinterberg, and Paltrow. While the actress's film career spans Shakespeare in Love, The Talented Mr. Ripley, the Iron Man franchise, and Marty Supreme, her past television credits have been limited to guest arcs on Glee and a supporting role in The Politician.The multi-season pickup arrives during an internal restructuring at Netflix under scripted TV head Jinny Howe, following company-wide layoffs and the high-profile exits of chief content officer Bela Bajaria and film head Dan Lin. items.title: The NFL Is Turning Football Fields Into Art With 'COLOR FIELD'
items.text: The NFL Is Turning Football Fields Into Art With 'COLOR FIELD' Summary The NFL introduces 'COLOR FIELD,' a new initiative turning football fields into large-scale art installations.Jammie Holmes will debut the project beneath the Eiffel Tower in Paris during Art Basel Paris.The initiative will continue at Miami Art Week this December with a new artist installation and cultural programming. The NFL is bringing contemporary art onto the field with 'COLOR FIELD,' a new initiative under its Artist Replay program that turns football fields into large-scale art installations.Curated in partnership with Jasmine Martin of Pivotal Arts, the project will debut in Paris during art week in the city before heading to Miami in December.Louisiana-born artist Jammie Holmes will lead the first installation, adapting his 2024 painting 'Untitled' into a hand-painted end zone beneath the Eiffel Tower. Depicting a child emerging from morning glory flowers, the work reflects on childhood, family and the passage of time. Produced in New York by six muralists and a field specialist, the installation also holds personal meaning for Holmes, whose great-grandfather was stationed in France during World War I."There's something powerful about bringing a piece of Louisiana and Saints fandom to Paris, especially knowing that my own family's history stretches across both places," Holmes shared.The installation will be on view October 23 and 24 at NFL Experience Paris, ahead of the Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints game on October 25. Additional programming includes artist talks, flag football sessions and community events.'COLOR FIELD' will then make its way to Miami Art Week, with a new artist installation and programming to be announced. items.title: BEDWIN & THE HEARTBREAKERS x KIPSSO’s “BUFFALO Jacket” Crops the MA-1 Into a ’60s Silhouette
items.text: BEDWIN & THE HEARTBREAKERS x KIPSSO’s “BUFFALO Jacket” Crops the MA-1 Into a ’60s Silhouette Summary BEDWIN & THE HEARTBREAKERS and ATTITUDE Artist KIPSSO have teamed up on the “BUFFALO Jacket,” an MA-1 offered in two versions for Fall/Winter 2026The jacket is cut wide through the body with a sharply cropped hem that nods to 1960s proportionsThe customized version adds KIPSSO’s hand-attached ATTITUDE TALISMANS, African batik patches and a white slash across the back BEDWIN & THE HEARTBREAKERS has unveiled the “BUFFALO Jacket,” a special-order MA-1 created with Japan-based ATTITUDE Artist KIPSSO for Fall/Winter 2026. The jacket draws on the MA-1 worn as a uniform by BUFFALO, the creative collective that formed around Ray Petri in 1980s Britain, and arrives in a standard “BUFFALO” model and a hand-customized “BUFFALO SPECIAL.”Both versions share the same foundation, starting with a shell of lightweight, densely woven nylon twill that blocks wind and shrugs off light rain and dirt. Inside, a glossy red satin lining contrasts with the black exterior, while padding adds insulation for colder months. The cut is where the jacket departs from a standard flight jacket, pairing a roomy body with a dramatically shortened length that echoes silhouettes from the 1960s. Each model is made from 100% nylon and comes in sizes No. 2 through No. 5.The regular “BUFFALO” model keeps things clean, finished with an original button badge designed for the release. Officially labeled as a THEKILLER Ex. piece, it presents the shape and materials with minimal embellishment.The “BUFFALO SPECIAL” is where KIPSSO’s hand comes in. Each jacket carries his ATTITUDE TALISMANS, one-of-a-kind charms that he attaches individually, so no two pieces are identical. KIPSSO also applied panels of African batik, a gift from his mentor Michael Costiff, across the chest and sleeves himself. On the back, a broad white slash reworks the red “KILLER SLASH” worn by members of THEKILLER, the creative collective KIPSSO leads.The BEDWIN & THE HEARTBREAKERS x KIPSSO “BUFFALO Jacket” drops October 24 at 12 p.m. JST via the BEDWIN & THE HEARTBREAKERS online store and select stockists. Both models will also be available at a two-day release event and KIPSSO pop-up at ARCD STORE in Jiyugaoka, Tokyo, running October 24 and 25 from 2 p.m. to 8 p.m. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Balenciaga x Automobili Lamborghini Rev Up a New Fenomeno-Inspired Capsule
items.text: Balenciaga x Automobili Lamborghini Rev Up a New Fenomeno-Inspired Capsule Summary Balenciaga and Automobili Lamborghini follow up their May 2025 collaboration with a new limited ready-to-wear dropThe capsule takes its cues from the Fenomeno, Lamborghini’s new limited-edition hybrid supercarThe partnership’s standout leather moto jacket returns alongside a cap, an oversized tee and a hoodie Balenciaga and Automobili Lamborghini have reunited for a new collaborative capsule, building a limited ready-to-wear range around the Fenomeno, the Italian marque’s latest limited-edition hybrid super sports car. The release brings back the leather moto jacket that quickly became a signature of the partnership’s 2025 debut, adding a fresh set of pieces shaped by the car’s design.The moto jacket remains the anchor of the lineup, cut from leather that holds a sharp, structured shape while staying soft and flexible in wear. It shares its detailing with a cap made from cotton drill in Balenciaga Grey, with both pieces patterned in a subtle nod to racing design rather than loud motorsport graphics. Each also features Lamborghini’s classic shield emblem, paired with a Balenciaga logo reworked to mirror the automaker’s distinctive lettering.The rest of the capsule shifts toward more relaxed, everyday shapes. An oversized T-shirt in jersey and a medium-fit hoodie in dry molleton both serve as canvases for graphics drawn from the Fenomeno. Each piece also prints the tagline “...closer than it appears,” a play on the familiar side-mirror warning that suits a collection built around speed.Together, the four pieces split the range between the technical, structured outerwear the collaboration is known for and an easier layer of graphic basics. The consistent use of the shield and the custom wordmark ties both sides together, keeping the Lamborghini connection clear across every item.The Balenciaga x Automobili Lamborghini capsule is available now at select Balenciaga stores and via Balenciaga’s online store. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: OutKast and the Atlanta Falcons Beam Down an ‘ATLiens’ 30th Anniversary Collection
items.text: OutKast and the Atlanta Falcons Beam Down an ‘ATLiens’ 30th Anniversary Collection Summary OutKast and the Atlanta Falcons mark three decades of ATLiens with a joint merchandise collectionThe lineup runs from a varsity jacket and football jersey to hoodies, a tee, a fitted cap and a full-size helmet, all finished in black and neon greenA custom “ATLiens” wordmark merges the Falcons’ lettering and bird logo with the album’s hand-drawn type OutKast and the Atlanta Falcons have teamed up on the 30th Anniversary ATLiens Collection, a capsule celebrating the album’s milestone with team-ready apparel and accessories. Built around a black and neon green palette, the range fuses the duo’s imagery with Falcons branding across outerwear, fleece, jerseys, headwear and a helmet.Released in 1996 as OutKast’s second studio album, ATLiens found André 3000 and Big Boi casting themselves as outsiders from another world, a sci-fi framing that pushed Southern hip-hop into stranger, more cosmic territory. Its comic book-style cover, which shows the pair drawn as heroes complete with a printed cover price, became one of the most recognizable pieces of art in the duo’s catalog. That artwork resurfaces throughout the collection, alongside the OutKast crown crest and the Falcons’ bird.The centerpiece is a black varsity jacket with leather-style sleeves and snap buttons, embroidered with the OutKast crown on one side of the chest and the Falcons logo on the other. Its back carries the collection’s signature wordmark in neon green, where “ATL” is set in the team’s angular lettering with the falcon head built into the “A,” before trailing into the album’s looser handwritten “iens.” The same wordmark tops a black fitted cap and wraps the side of a matte black Riddell helmet, which also features a neon falcon decal, twin racing stripes and an OutKast crest at the rear.Fleece and jersey pieces fill out the rest of the range. A bright green hoodie keeps things simple with a tonal black “ATLiens” embroidery across the chest and a small Falcons logo at the cuff, while a black hoodie and a black tee both reproduce the album’s comic artwork in full color with the wordmark beneath it. A black mesh football jersey, tagged by Mitchell & Ness, puts a neon “‘96” on the front and back, spells out “OUTKAST” across the shoulders and adds striped sleeve panels bearing both the OutKast crest and the falcon.The campaign imagery leans fully into the album’s extraterrestrial theme, staging models beneat

items.title: KEEN Taps TYAKASHA for a Mismatched Howser III Slide
items.text: KEEN Taps TYAKASHA for a Mismatched Howser III Slide Name: TYAKASHA x KEEN Howser IIIColorway: Virids/MediterraneaSKU: 1032615MSRP: ¥12,650 JPY (approx. $80 USD)Release Date: October 21Where to Buy: KEENKEEN brings TYAKASHA's playful character universe to the Howser III Slide, reworking the relaxed slip-on in a single mismatched “Virids/Mediterranea” colorway. Inspired by TYAKASHA mascots Mr. Green and Oring, the pair splits its palette between a vivid forest green and an icy Mediterranean blue, with each foot taking on a different base color.Both uppers are finished in a nubby, fleece-like textile that gives the shoe an especially soft and tactile appearance, while warm brown trim frames the collar, toe and lower edge. Bright orange bungee loops add another pop of color, and embroidered character patches - including a green figure on the blue shoe and a black cloud-like motif on the green - reinforce the asymmetrical, cartoon-driven treatment.Beneath the vibrant uppers, the Howser III retains the silhouette's comfort, pairing its roomy slip-on shape with an adjustable bungee closure and a substantial rubber outsole for everyday grip. The brown outsole and toe bumper visually ground the brighter uppers, while the plush brown lining continues the cozy material story around the interior.  View this post on Instagram   Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Air Jordan 15 “Cosmic Clay” Surfaces in a Multicolor Woven Look
items.text: Air Jordan 15 “Cosmic Clay” Surfaces in a Multicolor Woven Look Name: Air Jordan 15 "Cosmic Clay"Colorway: Cosmic Clay/Multi-ColorSKU: IV7643-800MSRP: TBCRelease Date: Fall 2027Jordan Brand is bringing the Air Jordan 15 back into focus for Fall 2027, with the upcoming “Cosmic Clay” colorway offering one of the silhouette’s more expressive treatments to date.Early imagery shared by @zSneakerHeadz provides a speculative look at the pair, dressing Tinker Hatfield’s divisive late-’90s design in a predominantly burnt-orange palette. Cosmic Clay covers much of the mudguard, heel, ankle and sculpted tooling, while the AJ15’s signature woven upper introduces flashes of blue, green, yellow, pink and orange for an almost mosaic-like finish. The multicolored weave breaks up the otherwise tonal construction, emphasizing the sneaker’s angular shape and distinctive high-cut profile.For now, however, the available images remain mock-ups rather than photographs of a physical sample or factory-floor pair, meaning several production details have yet to be confirmed. The renders suggest a tonal Cosmic Clay midsole and outsole, but the final material finish - as well as whether certain branding elements will appear embroidered, printed or molded - remains unclear until an actual pair surfaces. The Air Jordan 15 “Cosmic Clay,” style code IV7643-800, is currently expected to arrive during Fall 2027, joining a broader run of Air Jordan 15 colorways planned for the year. items.title: Hajime Sorayama Chromes Out GEEKS RULE’s DSM Ginza-Exclusive 'Ghost in the Shell' Long-Sleeve
items.text: Hajime Sorayama Chromes Out GEEKS RULE’s DSM Ginza-Exclusive 'Ghost in the Shell' Long-Sleeve Summary GEEKS RULE has reworked its popular 'The Ghost in the Shell' TV anime tee into a limited long-sleeve versionThe front shows Major Motoko Kusanagi perched on a red Fuchikoma, while the back carries an icon designed by Hajime SorayamaA one-off sleeve print makes this version a special edition that won’t be repeated GEEKS RULE has released a limited long-sleeve edition of its collaboration T-shirt with the TV anime The Ghost in the Shell, reworking a design that drew immediate buzz when it first launched. The new version keeps the original front and back artwork and adds an exclusive sleeve graphic, turning it into a one-time special edition.The release builds on one of the most influential franchises in anime and cyberpunk. Ghost in the Shell began as Shirow Masamune’s manga, first serialized by Kodansha in 1989, and went on to shape global sci-fi through Mamoru Oshii’s 1995 film and the Stand Alone Complex TV series. The latest TV anime adaptation, directed by Mokochan, is produced by Science SARU.The front of the shirt uses the series’ key visual of Major Motoko Kusanagi seated on top of a Fuchikoma, the spider-like think tank. Rendered in bold reds and cool blues, the artwork captures the Major in her blue tactical suit and visor, with “THE GHOST IN THE SHELL” lettering underneath. The Fuchikoma itself comes straight from Masamune’s original manga and served as the predecessor to the Stand Alone Complex series’ better-known Tachikoma.The back features an icon designed by Hajime Sorayama, set as glowing chrome lettering inside a triangle outline. Sorayama is best known for his hyperreal chrome robot illustrations, which have appeared on everything from album art to luxury fashion collaborations. For this edition, “DOVER STREET MARKET GINZA” is printed in bold white type down one sleeve, the detail that separates it from the earlier short-sleeve T-shirt. The shirt is silkscreen-printed on a black body and comes in sizes M through XXL.The GEEKS RULE x The Ghost in the Shell long-sleeve T-shirt drops October 24 from 11 a.m. only at Dover Street Market Ginza’s Open House event, a recurring gathering of designers and artists from Japan and abroad. Director Mokochan will also host a signing on October 23 from 6 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. at Rose Bakery on the store’s seventh floor. Entry requires advance registration through Peatix and closes once spots are filled. Atten

items.title: ‘MURCIÉLAGO’ Anime Reveals Its Main Cast in New Teaser Trailer
items.text: ‘MURCIÉLAGO’ Anime Reveals Its Main Cast in New Teaser Trailer Summary MURCIÉLAGO reveals its central cast in a new teaser trailer.Hitomi Ueda voices Kuroko Koumori, alongside Minori Suzuki and Sumire Uesaka.The crime anime premieres in January 2027. MURCIÉLAGO has unveiled a new teaser trailer that introduces the voices behind its central trio ahead of the TV anime’s January 2027 premiere.The footage puts former death-row inmate Kuroko Koumori at the center, opening on a mugshot-like image of the scarred protagonist before showing flashes of her wielding an oversized handgun with an almost gleeful disregard for the violence around her. Hitomi Ueda will voice Kuroko, while Minori Suzuki joins as her partner and minder Hinako Tozakura, whose deceptively cheerful demeanor contrasts with her extraordinary driving skills. Sumire Uesaka rounds out the newly announced leads as Chiyo Yanaoka, Kuroko’s girlfriend and the daughter of a yakuza boss. The preview debuts all three performances while leaning into the manga’s collision of black comedy, gunplay and heightened violence, offering the clearest sense yet of how the adaptation plans to translate its deliberately unhinged tone to animation.Adapted from Kana Yoshimura’s manga, which has run in Square Enix’s Young Gangan since 2013, MURCIÉLAGO follows Kuroko after she is spared execution and instead recruited as a state-sanctioned killer tasked with eliminating criminals whose brutality demands equally extreme measures.The latest teaser follows the project’s earlier “super teaser” and January release-window announcement, further establishing the dangerous buddy dynamic between Kuroko and Hinako that drives the series. MURCIÉLAGO begins airing in Japan in January 2027, with HIDIVE set to stream the series in territories including the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland, Australia and New Zealand./／ TVアニメ『ムルシエラゴ』 ティザービジュアル解禁㊗️\＼#MURCIÉLAGO#ムルシエラゴ https://t.co/VgsGtM7o7o— TVアニメ『ムルシエラゴ』公式 (@murcielago_anm) October 20, 2026 Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Kiko Kostadinov and ASICS Refresh the US8-S GEL-SJ33 in Two New Colorways
items.text: Kiko Kostadinov and ASICS Refresh the US8-S GEL-SJ33 in Two New Colorways Name: Kiko Kostadinov x ASICS US8-S GEL-SJ33Colorway: Moonrock/Tatami Green, Deep Plum/Fresh GrassSKU: 1203B116.250, 1203B116.500MSRP: $170 USDRelease Date: October 23Where to Buy: ASICSKiko Kostadinov and ASICS return to the US8-S GEL-SJ33 with two new colorways this season, following the “Black Coffee” and “Roasted Coffee” editions released earlier this summer. The “Moonrock/Tatami Green” pair takes the softer route, combining a taupe-to-grey mesh base with teal, mint and light green linework that crisscrosses the upper in a dense, almost woven-looking pattern. Pale blue ASICS Stripes cut across the lateral side, while green-toned sections around the toe, sockliner and segmented sole reinforce the cool, mineral-like palette.Meanwhile, “Deep Plum/Fresh Grass” leans darker and more saturated, layering an almost violet mesh base with black vertical striping and purple horizontal lines. Maroon appears around the toe, collar and midsole, while bright green branding introduces a sharp contrast against the plum foundation.The silhouette retains the hybrid construction that defines the US8-S GEL-SJ33. Inspired by the GEL-SUPER J33 from the 2010s, its seamless upper is designed to wrap the foot like a second skin, with an added heel counter and medial strap providing structure and support. The tooling is adapted from the GEL-CUMULUS 16, combining rearfoot and forefoot GEL inserts with FLUIDRIDE and FLYTEFOAM cushioning for a softer ride beneath the highly graphic upper. items.title: Phillips Unveils the Rarest Independent Watches Hitting the Block in Hong Kong

Journe leads with rare Chronomètre à Résonance and Tourbillon Souverain examples.Voutilainen, Haldimann, Auffret and Kiu Tai Yu also feature among the November highlights. Phillips in Association with Bacs & Russo is sharpening the focus on independent watchmaking for The Hong Kong Watch Auction: XXIII, set to take place in November. Following the previously announced group of rare Patek Philippe wristwatches leading the sale, the latest highlights bring together fresh-to-market pieces from F.P. Journe, Kari Voutilainen, Beat Haldimann, Théo Auffret and Kiu Tai Yu, with rarity, provenance and collector-driven commissions running throughout the selection.At the top of the group is the F.P. Journe Chronomètre à Résonance “Parking Meter” Mark Cho Special, one of just five examples made and offered directly from the personal collection of The Armoury co-founder Mark Cho. Created in collaboration with François-Paul Journe and Pierre Halimi, the 38mm platinum watch features a navy-and-warm-toned dial personally selected by Cho and carries an estimate of $6 million - $12 million HKD ( approx. $769,000 - $1.54 million USD).F.P. Journe continues to dominate the upper end of the independent offering. A circa-2001 Tourbillon Souverain No. 069 pairs a platinum case with an exceptionally rare shiny yellow-gold dial, with only nine examples of the configuration currently documented. Part of the sought-after third series of early brass-movement Tourbillon Souverain models, it combines a tourbillon with a remontoir d’égalité and is estimated at $3.9 million - $11.6 million HKD ($500,000 - $1.49 million USD). Also appearing is a Centigraphe Souverain Anniversaire Hong Kong Boutique Edition, number 10 of 20 pieces produced in 2016, estimated between $2.4 million - $4.8 million HKD ($308,000 - $615,000 USD), alongside the first-produced example of the Octa Calendrier Ruthenium, numbered 01 of 99 and carrying an estimate in excess of $1.6 million HKD ($205,000 USD).Beyond Journe, the sale broadens into a cross-section of contemporary independent horology. items.title: PEACEMINUSONE x WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto Put Pin-Ups and Daisies on Leather
items.text: PEACEMINUSONE x WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto Put Pin-Ups and Daisies on Leather Summary PEACEMINUSONE and WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto have joined forces on a capsule built around vintage-style pin-up illustrations and oversized daisiesThe lineup includes black and brown leather jackets, a long black coat with a printed lining and a pink leather toteEach piece pairs WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto branding with a “10th Anniversary” mark, its “Anniversary” lettering struck through G-DRAGON’s PEACEMINUSONE and WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto have unveiled a collaborative capsule that puts retro pin-up artwork and oversized daisy motifs across leather outerwear and accessories. Shot against a dark, moody backdrop, the lookbook shows a tight edit of jackets, a coat and a tote, each carrying large-scale back or front graphics.Leather jackets anchor the collection, offered in glossy black and a deep brown. Both feature a spread collar, a full-length zip and a boxy cut, with a small PEACEMINUSONE wordmark printed on the chest. The black version adds flap pockets at the waist and ribbed trim at the hem and cuffs. Turned around, each jacket reveals a different illustration: the black style shows a kneeling pin-up in a white swimsuit beside a giant daisy, set off by “10th Anniversary” type in pale blue, while the brown version places a brunette-toned figure in a black swimsuit and heels perched atop a daisy, finished with gold lettering.A long black coat brings a quieter silhouette, cut double-breasted with broad lapels and a relaxed, floor-skimming length. Its real statement is on the inside, where a white lining is printed with the pin-up and daisy artwork and the black “10th Anniversary” mark, while the sleeves are lined in a striped fabric. The lookbook styles the coat inside out to put that lining on full display.The capsule closes with an oversized tote in bubblegum pink leather. Long shoulder straps and a slouchy body give it an everyday shape, while the front carries a pin-up with roses in her hair beside a daisy, along with the “10th Anniversary” graphic in light blue and the WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto logo near the base.The PEACEMINUSONE x WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto capsule drops October 23 via PEACEMINUSONE Online, followed by a release through WILDSIDE on October 30. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nicolas Cage Transforms Into a Con Man for 'Best Pancakes in the County' Trailer
items.text: Nicolas Cage Transforms Into a Con Man for 'Best Pancakes in the County' Trailer Summary IFC Films has unveiled the first official trailer for Ken Sanzel’s crime thriller Best Pancakes in the CountyNicolas Cage stars as a con man named The S.O.B. who gets trapped in a diner standoff involving rogue federal agentsThe feature is scheduled to debut in select theaters and across digital platforms on November 20 IFC Films has debuted the official trailer for Best Pancakes in the County, an upcoming crime thriller written and directed by Ken Sanzel. The film stars an unrecognizable Nicolas Cage leading an ensemble cast through a high-stakes hostage situation.Starring Cage as a fast-talking con man named The S.O.B., the narrative centers on an unimpressive small-town diner that unexpectedly turns into the location for a violent standoff involving rogue federal agents. In the trailer, Cage’s character attempts to broker a sensitive discovery, stating, “Nine years ago, there was a hard drive with dirt on the CIA,” before adding, “I hope the hard drive can be monetized.” Later in the clip, he deadpans, “Why do you think I insisted on meeting here? For the pancakes?”Alongside Cage, the ensemble cast features Justin Long, Shelley Hennig, Lauren German, Ravi Patel, Brandon Mychal Smith, Kelly Greyson, Jaylen Moore, and Michael Sirow. Produced by Eduard Osipov, Raja Collins, Eric Brenner, Niko Fomenko, Gary Preisler, and R. Wesley Sierk III, the project follows Cage’s appearances in Longlegs, The Carpenter’s Son, and Spider-Noir, ahead of his upcoming role in David O. Russell's Madden.Best Pancakes in the County will be released in select theaters and on digital platforms on November 20, 2026, via IFC Films. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: S'YTE and TAION Reunite for Their Fourth Collaborative Collection
items.text: S'YTE and TAION Reunite for Their Fourth Collaborative Collection Summary S'YTE and TAION reunite for their fourth collaboration, combining experimental tailoring with technical down insulation.Highlights include embroidered reversible bombers, utility vests and convertible quilted pants.Launching October 22 via THE SHOP YOHJI YAMAMOTO. Yohji Yamamoto's S'YTE and TAION are reuniting for the fourth installment of their ongoing collaboration, bringing together experimental silhouettes and technical insulation for Fall/Winter 2026. Rooted in S'YTE's anti-mode philosophy, the latest collection explores the intersection of military-inspired utility and the unconventional design language associated with Yohji Yamamoto.Continuing the approach established in previous releases, the range incorporates TAION's 800-fill-power down insulation, offering lightweight warmth while minimizing the excessive bulk typically associated with padded outerwear. Every piece features either reversible construction or a two-way design, emphasizing versatility without compromising the collection's distinctive proportions and understated aesthetic.Leading the lineup is the Embroidery Reversible Bomber Jacket, crafted from lustrous black velveteen and decorated with intricate embroidery depicting birds, swallowtail butterflies and colorful flowers. Its reverse features a more restrained finish, while the back displays bold Japanese lettering and a crow perched on a branch, introducing a darker contrast to the decorative motifs.Elsewhere, the Reversible Embroidered Long Bomber Jacket reinterprets the classic MA-1 through an exaggerated, elongated silhouette, accented by vibrant pink dahlia embroidery and contrasting ribbed trims. The Reversible Utility Pouch Down Vest incorporates military-style quilting and a detachable chest pouch that doubles as a standalone shoulder bag.Completing the collection are a generously proportioned hooded down jacket featuring four oversized patch pockets and diamond-quilted convertible pants, which can be transformed into shorts through zippers positioned around the knees. Together, the five designs balance practical adaptability with S'YTE's signature oversized shapes and dramatic detailing.The S'YTE x TAION Collaboration Collection Vol. 4 is scheduled to launch on October 22, 2026, through THE SHOP YOHJI YAMAMOTO's official online store at 12 p.m. JST and select Yohji Yamamoto retail locations across Japan. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Apple Is Limiting iPhone Duo Orders to Two Per Customer After Demand Pushes Shipping to January 2027
items.text: Apple Is Limiting iPhone Duo Orders to Two Per Customer After Demand Pushes Shipping to January 2027 Summary Apple locks down global pre-orders for the new device with a strict two-unit cap per customerThe tech giant implements the checkout restriction after an extraordinary initial surge pushed shipping dates to 2027Alternative retailers currently offer faster turnaround times for different storage configurations Apple officially throttles the hype. In response to overwhelming global demand, the tech giant implemented a strict limit of two iPhone Duo pre-orders per customer across its worldwide online storefronts. The sweeping restriction applies uniformly regardless of the chosen device configuration, capping how many units buyers can secure directly from the source. Attempting to load more than two of the devices into an Apple Store digital cart immediately triggers an automated roadblock. The online checkout notification shuts down bulk buyers, stating: "A maximum of 2 iPhone Duo can be purchased per customer. Please adjust the total quantity of iPhone Duo in your order before checking out."The global lockdown spans well beyond the United States, actively restricting buyers in major international markets including Japan, Spain and the United Kingdom. When Apple initially started taking pre-orders for the iPhone Duo on October 16, the digital gates were wide open. Early adopters operating within Reddit’s dedicated iPhone Duo community reported successfully placing orders for more than two units right as the pre-order window first went live. Now, the landscape has entirely shifted, though it remains notably unclear exactly how Apple prevents dedicated scalpers from circumventing the new two-device limit by simply creating multiple fresh accounts or cycling through different credit cards.Apple previously stated that consumer demand for the iPhone Duo was "nothing short of extraordinary," an assessment verified when the company was forced to push back estimated shipping dates for the device to 2027 shortly after the pre-order period officially began. This aggressive purchase restriction acts as a direct countermeasure to that unprecedented initial surge, proving that the staggering early momentum fundamentally overwhelmed standard Apple Store fulfillment queues and forced a complete recalibration of how the drop is handled.Buyers attempting to secure the device directly from the brand today must exercise significant patience. items.title: ‘Halo’ Developer Bungie Could Helm ‘Star Wars Battlefront III’
items.text: ‘Halo’ Developer Bungie Could Helm ‘Star Wars Battlefront III’ Summary Lucasfilm is reportedly searching for a developer to take on 'Star Wars Battlefront III'According to the report, DICE and Bungie are the two major studios showing interest, though neither has committedNo third 'Battlefront' game has been officially announced in the nearly nine years since 'Star Wars Battlefront II' Star Wars Battlefront III may finally be gaining momentum, as a new report claims Lucasfilm is actively looking for a studio to develop the sequel, with both DICE and Bungie reportedly in the frame. The claim comes from the Quartermann rumor column in the latest issue of Electronic Gaming Monthly, which was later discussed on Jeff Grubb’s Game Mess Mornings podcast.According to the column, Lucasfilm has been pushing hard to find a development partner willing to lead the next entry. The report says no studio has formally signed on, but two major developers are allegedly weighing the opportunity. DICE, the Swedish studio behind the previous two Battlefront games, is named as one possible fit. If the project doesn’t land there, the column suggests it could go to Bungie, the developer behind Halo, Destiny and Marathon.The rumor arrives after a long stretch of silence for the series. Star Wars Battlefront II launched in 2017, and despite steady calls from fans for a follow-up over the years since, EA and DICE have never officially announced a third installment. The two existing games brought the sprawling, large-scale combat of DICE’s Battlefield series into the Star Wars universe, a formula that has kept the franchise in demand even without new releases.For now, the report should be treated with caution. Neither DICE nor Bungie has been confirmed as the studio behind Battlefront III, and the column itself indicates that Lucasfilm has yet to lock in a developer. None of the companies involved have publicly commented on the claims. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: thisisneverthat Brings 1960s Denim Heritage Into Its FW26 Wardrobe
items.text: thisisneverthat Brings 1960s Denim Heritage Into Its FW26 Wardrobe Summary thisisneverthat unveils its FW26 “Premium Denim Made in Japan” collection, inspired by 1960s American workwear.Highlights include 14oz Okayama selvedge denim, vintage-inspired hardware and two washes.The collection launches October 23, 2026. South Korean streetwear label thisisneverthat has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 “Premium Denim Made in Japan” collection, a new lineup inspired by classic 1960s workwear and vintage denim craftsmanship. Building on the brand's longstanding affinity for retro silhouettes and archival sportswear, the collection shifts its focus toward traditional Japanese manufacturing techniques, using 14oz selvedge denim woven on vintage shuttle looms in Okayama, one of Japan's most renowned denim-producing regions.Designed to recreate the character and durability of mid-century American jeans, the fabric emphasizes substantial construction, natural texture and the gradual development of individual wear patterns. The collection also incorporates shrinkage-control and anti-twist finishing techniques originally associated with vintage zip-fly denim, reinforcing its emphasis on longevity and preserving the garments' structure over time.Drawing from classic denim archives, the collection adopts original-inspired patterns with relaxed, natural proportions that balance vintage authenticity with contemporary everyday wear. The lineup is presented in two distinct washes: OX Blue (Oxidized), which features a treated, aged appearance, and One Wash, offering a cleaner, darker indigo finish that retains more of the fabric's original character.The washed treatments highlight the texture of the heavyweight selvedge denim, while carefully selected hardware further reinforces the collection's archival references. Japanese-made YKK snaps and rivets are paired with Talon zippers, bringing together traditional detailing and functional durability. Rather than relying on exaggerated distressing or decorative embellishments, the collection places its emphasis on fabric quality, precise construction and the subtle irregularities that give vintage denim its distinctive appeal.The thisisneverthat Fall/Winter 2026 “Premium Denim Made in Japan” collection is scheduled to launch on October 23, 2026, through the brand's Japanese online store. items.title: One More Build: LEGO and DAFT PUNK™ Team up for 'ALIVE 2007' Set
items.text: One More Build: LEGO and DAFT PUNK™ Team up for 'ALIVE 2007' Set Summary The LEGO Group has officially partnered with DAFT PUNK™ across collaborative products content and live experiencesThe inaugural project officially greenlights a fan-submitted LEGO Ideas model of the iconic 2007 ALIVE pyramid stageThe reveal arrives with a hero video set to Voyager and Human After All starring minifigures of the robot duo The LEGO Group has officially partnered with DAFT PUNK™ to develop the LEGO Ideas Daft Punk ALIVE 2007 Set, marking the musical duo's formal induction into the brick universe.Spanning product development, digital content, and experiential activations, the partnership bridges decades of music and brick-building history. The rollout follows an unannounced 30-second teaser broadcast on the duo's WDPK 83.7 channel featuring an isolated 2x4 red brick with rear tubes resembling speaker woofers. Accompanying the news is an animated hero film that sees minifigures of the robotic icons navigating a dark landscape toward a custom brick-built console, set to "Voyager" from 2001's Discovery and the title track of 2005's Human After All.The debut physical milestone stems from the LEGO Ideas community, created during lockdown as a father-and-son build by Patrick Harboun. After winning the 2020 "Music to Our Ears" challenge and gathering 10,000 community votes, the build—modeled directly after the illuminated pyramid stage from Daft Punk's 2007 ALIVE tour—has officially advanced into commercial development.“The pyramid stage is one of the most recognisable expressions of Daft Punk’s visual world, so it feels fitting that this fan-created design will be centre stage of this partnership,” said Cédric Hervet, Creative Director for DAFT PUNK™. "Fans have always played an important part in Daft Punk’s story, and we are excited to see that creativity reflected through the LEGO universe."Fan creator Patrick Harboun shared, "This all started as a creative escape during lockdown between my son and I because of our shared love of Daft Punk and LEGO building. We never dared imagine it would take off in this way. Watching our passion project become part of an official collaboration is an incredible experience, and it's a reminder of what makes the LEGO Ideas community so special."Look out for more on the partnership in 2027.
