items.title: Back Market’s Slow Tech Summit Made a Stand Against Upgrade Culture
items.text: Back Market’s Slow Tech Summit Made a Stand Against Upgrade Culture When a typical smartphone is made, it needs approximately 266 kg of raw materials and produces 80% of its carbon footprint in the first minute it’s turned on. As well as having a number of environmental effects, extracting the materials also comes with ethical and geopolitical costs.This is where Back Market’s Slow Tech Summit comes in. Taking place in Paris last week, the one-day event aimed to explore how we can make devices last at least 10 years as an alternative to buying a new smartphone. Through a diverse programme, the refurbished tech marketplace welcomed journalists, scientists, activists, as well as designers, creators and athletes to understand the cost of new technology. Over the day, talks and debates were held with a line-up of industry experts: Back Market co-founder and executive chairman Thibaud Hug de Larauze; REEcover CEO Dr. Marie Perrin; Journalist Alice Pfeiffer; Génération Lumière founder David Maenda Kithoko; and journalist and author of Power Metal, Vince Beiser. Following discussions of extraction through their respective fields, Back Market CPO Amandine Durr also took the stage to share instant solutions for reusing tech with the announcement of Back Market Outlet.Offering a more hands-on approach to repair, several creators were on the ground with specially curated workshops. Italian analog archivist Davide Bonetti, better known as lecronachedidave, worked directly with repurposed technology in the Obsolescence as a Creative Tool masterclass, showing how these parts provide new possibilities in design, music and content creation with his magic TV. Delving deeper into the craft space, British creator Ube Boobey brought an imaginative lens to reclaimed components, guiding guests through a workshop in creating a cyber deck. The space was complete with a Slow Tech exhibition. Serving as a reminder of the harrowing cost of upgrades, it featured immersive images and displays that captured the environmental, geopolitical, and human impact of sourcing materials.If you missed out, explore the Slow Tech Summit in the gallery above. Shop Back Market’s refurbished tech online now. Find out more about the cost of new devices and how to take action on its dedicated MineMyPhone webpage. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Kennedy Yanko Makes Paint and Metal-Bending a Devotional Act
items.text: Kennedy Yanko Makes Paint and Metal-Bending a Devotional Act Summary Miami-based artist Kennedy Yanko unveils a new solo exhibition, 'Ce qui nous rassemble,' in ParisThe show features a new body of sculptures made of found metal scraps and paint skins, exploring mysticism, sexuality, sacredness, and devotion through the act of creation Kennedy Yanko’s abstract sculptures are tense with history and possibility. Created from scrap metal parts wrapped with paint skins, each surface bears records of beauty and decay when shaped into luminous, veiled forms. Their histories aren’t erased, but transformed through the act of making, which makes Cité de l’Architecture et du Patrimoine in Paris an apt stage for her latest creations.The Miami-based artist debuts a new series of sculptures in Ce qui nous rassemble. Set amidst casts of architectural fragments from French churches and cathedrals, the show, which translates to “what brings us together,” explores creation as love, a devotional act that can both point back to the past and guide us through an age-old desire for transcendence.Devotion and agency thematically ground the presentation, interwoven with ideas of mysticism and gender. This particular body of work is by Mary Magdalene, one of Christianity’s most controversial figures. Here Yanko reimagines her story to consider the many labels she occupies in the cultural imaginary, while highlighting the distortion of feminine sexual power throughout religious history.It is unity, though, that persists. Yanko connects creation as a means of bodily agency — the desirer and desired — and through the act of material rupture and becoming, brings out the generative energies that bind us all. “She sees the human being in a similar way,” the exhibition text reads, “an energetic instrument whose capacity to create depends on intention, attention, and continual clearing and recalibration.”Ce qui nous rassemble is now on view in Paris until January 3, 2027, as part of Art Basel Paris’ public program.Cité de l’Architecture et du Patrimoine1 Pl. du Trocadéro et du 11 Novembre,75116 Paris, France Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Blackstock & Weber x Joe Freshgoods Etch a Checkerboard Into the “Ellis” Penny Loafer
items.text: Blackstock & Weber x Joe Freshgoods Etch a Checkerboard Into the “Ellis” Penny Loafer Name: Blackstock & Weber x Joe Freshgoods Ellis Penny LoaferColorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: $395 USDRelease Date: October 23 (Online), October 24 (In-store)Where to Buy: Blackstock & Weber, Joe FreshgoodsBlackstock & Weber and Joe Freshgoods are teaming up on the “Ellis” Penny Loafer, a glossy red take on the dress shoe made exclusively for Joe Freshgoods. The project is the Chicago designer’s first-ever release outside the athletic world, swapping performance runners for a Goodyear-welted loafer with a lug sole. The partnership grew out of a shared respect between the two labels and a desire to express it through a single, detail-driven product.The upper sets the tone with high-shine red patent leather sourced from Carasco, Italy, giving the classic penny silhouette a bold, almost lacquered finish. A checkerboard pattern is laser-etched directly into the vamp, adding a subtle graphic texture that only reveals itself as light catches the surface. Inside, a pink lining contrasts the red exterior, a detail that shows each time the shoe is slipped on or off.The construction leans toward durability as much as style. The loafer is Goodyear welted, a stitched build that allows the sole to be replaced over time and extends the life of the shoe. Underfoot, a Vibram 1757 lug sole adds chunky traction and a heavier stance than a traditional leather-soled loafer, giving the pair a more modern, rugged profile that fits street wear as easily as tailoring.The finishing touches carry the story of the collaboration. Every insole is stamped with a message from both brands that names the project “A Special Moment” and closes on a line that doubles as a shared motto: “We don’t complain... we figure it out!” Each pair ships with a branded dust bag and arrives in a special edition collaborative box in bright orange.The loafer also anchors Joe Freshgoods’ Early Fall capsule, which includes a companion “A Special Moment” T-shirt. For Joe Freshgoods, best known for his New Balance collaborations, the release is a clear step into tailored footwear. Blackstock & Weber, founded by Chris Echevarria, has built its following around modern takes on classic American loafers, with the “Ellis” serving as one of its signature silhouettes. items.title: ARC’TERYX’s Walk Gently “Salish Winter” Collection Dresses GORE-TEX in Deer Fur and Cedar
items.text: ARC’TERYX’s Walk Gently “Salish Winter” Collection Dresses GORE-TEX in Deer Fur and Cedar Summary ARC’TERYX returns with “Salish Winter,” the newest chapter of its Walk Gently platform spotlighting Indigenous artists, designers and their storiesCreative lead Cole Sparrow-Crawford of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm (Musqueam) nation shapes the gender-neutral apparel and footwear around Salish relationships to land and natural materialsDeer-fur-inspired GORE-TEX prints, weaving references and cedar-tree camouflage translate traditional practices into cold-weather technical gear ARC’TERYX has unveiled Walk Gently “Salish Winter,” a six-piece collection launching exclusively at Dover Street Market London. Led by Walk Gently creative lead Cole Sparrow-Crawford of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm (Musqueam) nation, the capsule pairs the Vancouver brand’s technical construction with design cues rooted in Salish winter life. Weaving, hide tanning and seasonal harvesting all inform the details, giving each piece a story that runs deeper than its spec sheet.The Dekoi Jacket anchors the collection as its technical centerpiece, a GORE-TEX hardshell finished in a print modeled on deer fur. That pattern nods directly to hide tanning, one of the practices the collection sets out to honor, while bursts of high-visibility orange cut through the earthy base to keep the wearer visible in snowy, low-light terrain. The result merges a waterproof, mountain-ready shell with a surface that reads like a material Salish communities have long relied on.Insulation arrives through the Mutton Insulated Jacket, offered in Arctic Silk/Rune, whose design pays tribute to Salish weaving traditions. Where the Dekoi handles weather protection, the Mutton is built for warmth, giving the capsule a layering system that can move from a heavy outer shell to a midweight insulated piece. The Adze Pant completes the ready-to-wear lineup in a matching Rune/Arctic Silk colorway, allowing the pant and insulated jacket to be worn as a coordinated set.Footwear and headwear extend the story to the extremities. The Konseal Trek Boots are engineered for winter ground and dressed in a Green/Black print drawn from cedar-tree camouflage, connecting the shoe to the forests that have sustained Salish communities. Two versions of the Selisya Toque, one in Tatsu/Blaze and one in Rune/Arctic Silk, finish off the drop and tie back to the palettes used across the jackets and pants.The release is grounded in place as much as design. items.title: Oakridge Park Delivers a Showstopping Evening of High Fashion and Music Headlined by John Legend
items.text: Oakridge Park Delivers a Showstopping Evening of High Fashion and Music Headlined by John Legend Oakridge Park transformed into an epicenter of luxury, music, and design on Thursday night, October 15, 2026, as it hosted an exclusive VIP event featuring the inaugural debut of The Front Row: Fashion Through the Ages alongside an intimate live performance by John Legend. Co-developed by QuadReal Property Group and Westbank, the multi-use Vancouver destination brought together an enthusiastic crowd in its expansive North Atrium. Shoppers unlocked access to the event through qualifying September purchases or by entering an Instagram photo booth contest, drawing a vibrant mix of local fashion enthusiasts and VIP guests to celebrate the occasion.Canadian fashion stylist, journalist, and producer Joe Zee served as the evening's host, bringing dynamic energy and decades of industry expertise to the stage. Dressed by Harry Rosen in a Tom Ford suit and statement glasses, Zee spoke to the audience against large LED screens displaying high-definition visuals of the presentation. He guided guests through the concept behind The Front Row, which highlighted fashion’s rich history by tracing iconic silhouettes across pivotal decades and designer moments. Between introductions, Zee shared his vision for leading The Style Office at Oakridge Park, emphasizing how style serves as a bridge for personal confidence, identity, and community connection.The runway show offered a stunning retrospective of luxury ready-to-wear pieces, blending past eras with modern high fashion. Models strutted down the central runway in diverse looks, ranging from a sleek, body-skimming long black dress paired with a headwrap to edgy, studded leather ensembles with metallic accents. Guests enjoyed panoramic views from the multi-tiered, amphitheater-style seating that curved through the atrium, framing the runway right alongside luxury storefronts like Chanel.The undisputed highlight came when Grammy Award-winning artist John Legend took center stage. Wearing a crisp white tuxedo jacket and dark bow tie, Legend delivered a soulful performance from a black grand piano set beneath the atrium's glowing lights. His vocals echoed across the multi-level venue, captivating spectators gathered on both the main floor and upper balconies near the Time Out Market, seamlessly bridging fashion and entertainment into a memorable night for Vancouver. items.title: Jil Sander and PUMA Expand Their Collaboration Into Apparel for FW26
items.text: Jil Sander and PUMA Expand Their Collaboration Into Apparel for FW26 Summary Jil Sander and PUMA unveil their third collaboration, introducing apparel alongside redesigned footwear icons.Highlights include a wool T7 tracksuit, leather Speedcats and minimalist Suedes.Starring Meadow Walker and Barry Lawson, the campaign precedes an October 23 launch. PUMA and Jil Sander have unveiled the Fall/Winter 2026 chapter of their ongoing partnership, expanding into collaborative apparel for the first time alongside fresh footwear iterations.Set against an overgrown green field dotted with wildflowers, the campaign juxtaposes tailored sportswear with an untamed natural landscape, capturing a quiet moment suspended between city life and the outdoors. Leading the apparel lineup is a reimagined version of PUMA's T7 tracksuit, originally introduced in 1968 and named after its signature seven-centimeter Formstrip. Simone Bellotti updates the sportswear staple with a boxy track jacket and tapered trousers, crafted from an exclusive bi-stretch wool that combines fluid movement with a structured silhouette, breathability and natural temperature regulation.Presented in a specially developed Club Navy colorway, the ensemble features a brushed silver branded zipper pull and co-branded T7 woven labels. A relaxed, boxy long-sleeve top in PUMA White, made from a cotton and recycled polyester blend, completes the apparel offering. The collection's restrained palette and refined fabrications reflect Jil Sander's minimalist sensibilities while retaining the recognizable foundations of PUMA's sporting heritage.Footwear continues the collaboration's archival exploration, with the Speedcat returning as a reissue of the original Jil Sander x PUMA design. Available in all-black and all-white leather, the low-profile motorsport silhouette incorporates an artisanal leather heel detail developed by Bellotti and a full leather lining. Meanwhile, the PUMA Suede receives a minimalist overhaul, replacing its familiar construction with premium leather, a refined outsole and concealed lacing for a cleaner, more streamlined appearance. The model is offered exclusively in white, emphasizing its understated finish.The Jil Sander x PUMA Fall/Winter 2026 collection will launch globally on October 23 through Jil Sander and PUMA stores and their respective online platforms, followed by select stockists on October 24, 2026. items.title: Zane Li of LII Wins 2026 CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund
items.text: Zane Li of LII Wins 2026 CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund SummaryChongqing-born FIT graduate Zane Li won the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund, earning $300,000 and mentorship for his label LII.Runners-up Aisling Camps and Emily Dawn Long each received $100,000.Chinese designer Zane Li of LII has been announced as the official winner of the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund, with Aisling Camps and Emily Dawn Long as runners-up.Since stepping onto the NYC scene in 2024, the Chongqing-born designer and 2023 FIT graduate has quickly become renowned for his clean blend of sport styles with unconventional silhouettes and bold color. While maintaining a minimal ethos, the designer’s collections have spoken volumes in their stark color blocking and experimental cuts, garnering attention from industry leaders. The designer has already won the Karl Lagerfeld Prize at the LVMH Prize and the Fashion Trust US Ready-to-Wear Award this year. As the winner of the main prize, Li’s label will receive $300,000 USD, while runners-up Camps and Longs will receive a $100,000 USD grant. Furthermore, the fund’s monetary prizes are complemented with guided mentorship for the awardees. Other finalists from this year’s program included Amir Taghi, Terrence Zhou of Bad Binch Tongtong, Jamie Haller, Julia Ferentinos of Juju Vera, George Inaki of Milamore, Claire Sullivan of Miss Claire Sullivan, and Zoe Gustavia Anna Whalen. In previous years, the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund has honored notable designers Melitta Baumeister (2023), Christopher John Rogers (2019), and Telfar (2017). The initiative began in 2003 as a post-9/11 effort to support America’s emerging designers. In conjunction with his other accolades from this year, Zane Li’s win at the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund cements him as one of New York’s most talked-about designers of the moment. items.title: YOSHIROTTEN Looks to Outer Space With ‘Transmissions with the Beyond’
items.text: YOSHIROTTEN Looks to Outer Space With ‘Transmissions with the Beyond’ Summary YOSHIROTTEN presents Transmissions with the Beyond at TOKYO NODE, opening October 30, 2026.The show features JAXA-collaborative space art translating astrophysical data into light and sound.Rooftop activations include a Pokémon TCG 30th-anniversary park and cosmic installations. YOSHIROTTEN is extending his long-running investigation into the unseen beyond Earth with Transmissions with the Beyond, his first large-scale solo exhibition in Tokyo in eight years. Running at TOKYO NODE from October 30, 2026 through January 11, 2027, the exhibition fills approximately 1,500 square meters with the artist’s largest presentation to date of his three principal series - RGB, FUTURE NATURE and SUN - alongside an entirely new body of “space art.”Across a career spanning roughly two decades, YOSHIROTTEN has moved fluidly between fine art, graphic design, music, fashion and spatial design, developing a visual language around what he calls the “Visualization of Things Invisible.” Here, that recurring interest in light, color and nature shifts outward, using the vantage point of TOKYO NODE, around 200 meters above the city, as a departure point for thinking about the cosmos.At the center of the exhibition is a collaboration with the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA), translating scientific observation into immersive visual experiences. Developed through conversations with Hiroya Yamaguchi of JAXA’s Institute of Space and Astronautical Science, Puddle Cygnus X-1 transforms observation data from the XRISM mission’s investigation of a black hole into painting and moving image, while "Light Pulse" converts all-sky data captured from the International Space Station into an enveloping installation of light and sound.New works including "Supernova" visualize the explosive life cycle of a star, while Halo renders stellar orbits in sculptural form. The exhibition also brings physical artifacts from Japan’s space program into the gallery, including the solar sail spacecraft IKAROS and the control console used to guide Ohsumi, Japan’s first artificial satellite, into orbit in 1970.Rather than remaining contained within the gallery, Transmissions with the Beyond expands across Toranomon Hills through music, publishing, public art and a Pokémon Trading Card Game collaboration. items.text: SOREL and Aries Take the Iconic Caribou™ DNA Into Cozy Territory For their second collaboration, SOREL and Aries introduce a tough yet tactile silhouette, called the Daystorm™ Chukka Boot. The sole features a similar chunky style, built with an outsole made from moulded XS TREK EVO Vibram™ compound and a moulded rubber midsole, while the vamp comes wrapped in soft, full-grain leather. These elements are tinted in tones of black, brown, and cream to match the two colorways and give them a plush look that fits layered winter looks. A new campaign featuring D Double E amplifies this distinctive aesthetic. Posed against a digital landscape with frosty blue tones, photographer and multimedia artist Joe Cruz captures the rapper in the Daystorm™ Chukka Boot paired with fur-trimmed coats, tonal shirts, and heavy knits.Explore the full lookbook in the gallery above. items.title: Clive Christian Turns Home Fragrance Into Fine Objects
items.text: Clive Christian Turns Home Fragrance Into Fine Objects Summary Clive Christian expands into home fragrance with the Fine Objects collection.Five candles and eight diffusers pair signature scents with sculptural, statement-making vessels.Queen Victoria’s Crown motif reinforces the range’s ornate, heritage-driven design language. Clive Christian wants home fragrance to be seen as much as it is smelled – and its new Fine Objects collection turns candles and diffusers into statement pieces, pushing beyond the discreet vessels that typically recede into an interior.The range draws on the British house’s ornate design language through glossy black, polished metallic and gold-toned finishes, giving each object a more sculptural, almost ceremonial presence. The Crown of Queen Victoria sits prominently across the collection as a recurring visual signature, reinforcing the brand’s heritage while also giving the vessels a recognizable architectural detail of their own.Fine Objects comprises five candles and eight diffusers, each available in two sizes and linked to six of Clive Christian’s Iconic perfumes, using what the house describes as its highest possible concentration of fine perfume oils for home fragrance. Instead than treating scent and object as separate considerations, the collection brings both into the same conversation: fragrance shapes the atmosphere, while the vessel remains part of the room long after the first impression. Explore Clive Christian's Fine Objects collection through their official website. View this post on Instagram Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Bose Has Officially Acquired Skullcandy in a Move to Reach a Younger Action Sports Audience
items.text: Bose Has Officially Acquired Skullcandy in a Move to Reach a Younger Action Sports Audience Summary Bose announced its official acquisition of competitor Skullcandy on Wednesday, October 21The strategic purchase aims to capture a younger, action-sports-oriented demographic through the established lifestyle brandSkullcandy will continue to operate as a separate brand within the Bose premium consumer audio business Audio heavyweight Bose has officially announced its official acquisition of competitor Skullcandy. While specific financial details regarding the acquisition were not disclosed, the move signals a strategic shift for the buyer. By absorbing an established lifestyle brand, the historically travel-focused company is actively moving to capture a younger, action-sports-oriented demographic. Rather than dismantling the former rival, Bose confirmed that Skullcandy will continue operating as an entirely separate brand within its premium consumer audio division.Staying true to the lifestyle roots that made it famous, Skullcandy will remain headquartered in Park City, Utah, specifically operating out of the Kimball Junction area. The brand traces its foundation back to a Park City chairlift in 2003, and that mountain-culture DNA is exactly what the new parent company wants to tap into. Moving forward, Bose plans to leverage the distinct product designs of Skullcandy, alongside its deeply rooted relationships with major board sports athletes. Ultimately, the acquisition helps Bose expand its reach to consumers who do not necessarily prioritize active noise cancellation in their daily headphones.Prior to the outright acquisition, the two audio companies engaged in a multiyear partnership that laid the groundwork for this deal. That earlier collaboration integrated the head-tracking spatial audio and active noise cancellation technologies engineered by Bose directly into specific Skullcandy products. Those advanced audio technologies featured in models like the Skullcandy Crusher 1080 ANC headphones and the Method 360 ANC earbuds. According to Bose CEO Lila Snyder, this strategic acquisition aligns with broader efforts by the company to reach more people through a growing portfolio of interconnected brands.This purchase highlights a broader strategy unfolding within Bose as the organization builds out its consumer audio presence. By bringing complementary audio labels into its fold, the company aims to broaden its market presence without altering the core ide

The lacing further develops the palette through a mix of flat two-tone patterned laces and a solid teal, rope-like round lace, adding another layer of texture to the design.An orange, dice-like charm threaded through the laces features a running rabbit motif, directly referencing the silhouette’s name and lending the otherwise technical shape a more playful finishing touch. items.title: HUF Goes Fishing for Its Winter 2026 Collection
items.text: HUF Goes Fishing for Its Winter 2026 Collection Summary HUF's Winter 2026 collection embraces a fishing-inspired aesthetic, blending skatewear with rugged outdoor influences.Highlights include quilted jackets, camouflage layers, textured fleece and Snoopy graphics.Dropping October 23, 2026, online and across HUF flagships. HUF heads outdoors for Winter 2026, framing its latest collection around a fishing-inspired lookbook that brings the brand's skateboarding roots into a quieter, more rugged setting.Photographed on the water, the imagery captures models navigating small fishing boats, surrounded by fishing rods and equipment, while dressed in layered streetwear that draws from traditional outdoor clothing. The lookbook reinforces the collection's emphasis on practicality, texture and versatility, with earthy greens, washed blues, browns and muted greys reflecting the surrounding landscape.Heavyweight fabrics, relaxed proportions and weather-conscious layering define the range, which includes quilted liner jackets, camouflage hoodies, plaid fleece, corduroy outerwear and washed denim. Standout pieces include the Vernon Liner Jacket, a lightweight quilted layer shown over camouflage, the Western-inspired Silverado Jacket in washed faux leather, and the Seneca High Pile Quarter-Zip Fleece, which brings a softer, more tactile finish to the collection's utilitarian aesthetic.Beyond outerwear, HUF expands the seasonal wardrobe with relaxed Cromer Faded Pants, patterned knitwear, graphic hoodies and a selection of cold-weather accessories. The collection also introduces new artwork by LA-based artist Mia Scarpa, whose illustrations draw from everyday subjects and outdoor scenery, alongside a Peanuts collaboration featuring Snoopy dressed in a puffer jacket across sweaters, T-shirts and headwear.HUF Winter 2026 is scheduled to launch on October 23 at 10 a.m. JST through HUF stores across Japan and the brand's Japanese online store. Offered in a single "Blue/White" colorway, the shoe replaces the model’s conventional smooth upper with a vivid blue, long-haired material that gives the surface a noticeably shaggy, tactile finish.Smoother blue sections around the eyestays and tongue create subtle material contrast without interrupting the monochrome base, while creamy off-white Three Stripes, shell toe, laces and sole bring a softer, slightly vintage-looking counterpoint to the saturated upper. Gold branding along the sidewall adds a small metallic accent, keeping the palette restrained despite the more expressive texture.Liberaiders also brings one of its recurring motifs into the design through a white embroidered origami crane on the tongue, with the graphic repeated across the blue insoles and accompanying packaging. The detail ties the Superstar back to the Japanese label’s wider visual identity, while the familiar shell toe and low-profile tooling preserve the model’s classic proportions beneath the unconventional upper. items.text: Formula 1 and NAHMIAS Reunite for Their Second Collaborative Collection Summary Formula 1 and NAHMIAS reunite for their second collaborative collection ahead of the 2026 U.S. Grand Prix.Highlights include suede racing jackets, graphic tees and Austin-exclusive thermals.The collection is now available too shop via NAHMIAS and the official F1 Store. Formula 1 and NAHMIAS have unveiled the second installment of their ongoing collaboration ahead of the 2026 United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas. Building on their initial debut at the Miami Grand Prix earlier this year, the latest drop continues to merge high-octane motorsport heritage with California’s relaxed surf, skate, and music culture.The latest collection is anchored by a premium suede racing jacket, offered in rich burgundy and black colorways and detailed with bold NAHMIAS typography, classic racing stripes, and co-branded insignia. Complementing the hero outerwear is an array of boxy graphic tees, washed black distressed staples, and long-sleeve thermals that incorporate the collaboration's signature "Miracle of Racing" motif alongside prominent Formula 1® branding. Designed specifically for the Texas race, exclusive Austin-themed pieces include a vintage-inspired racing graphic tee and a white thermal featuring prominent race-number graphics alongside localized Texas details.The Formula 1 x NAHMIAS second collection is now available to shop online through the official F1 Store and NAHMIAS websites, coinciding with the lead-up to the U.S. Grand Prix in Austin. items.title: Idris Elba Plunges Into Deep-Sea Terror in Official 'Above the Below' Trailer
items.text: Idris Elba Plunges Into Deep-Sea Terror in Official 'Above the Below' Trailer Summary Lionsgate has released the official first trailer for the upcoming survival thriller Above the Below starring and co-directed by Idris ElbaThe narrative follows three astronauts trapped in deep ocean waters with severed communications and dwindling oxygen following a space catastropheAbove the Below is scheduled to release in theaters on December 4 Lionsgate has unveiled the first official trailer for Above the Below, an upcoming aquatic survival thriller co-directed by and starring Idris Elba. The preview establishes a high-tension scenario following a catastrophic crash-landing into the ocean.Co-directed by Elba alongside Martin Owen and written by Elizabeth Morris, Matthew Mitchell, and Vicki Sargent, the film also stars Caitlin FitzGerald and Hero Fiennes Tiffin. According to Lionsgate's synopsis, the plot kicks off after three astronauts survive an orbital disaster in space, only to find themselves trapped within their submerged capsule deep in the ocean with lost contact to mission control and rapidly depleting oxygen reserves.Discussing the physical production, Elba revealed to Collider that the filmmakers leaned heavily on practical effects rather than digital shortcuts, "I’m very excited to show people that I can hold my breath for four minutes. Joking aside (I can hold my breath for that long), but you know, this film was very practical," Elba said. "We did a lot of the things in this film. We did build the spacecraft, we submerged it in water, we shot a lot of it underwater. There’s a real practicality to this film that adds to the claustrophobia and the thriller aspect of it. So I’m really excited for people to literally go on that journey with us, from space to the ocean, and be entertained, be thrilled, and be claustrophobic." Read more at Hypebeast

items.text: Stray Kids and BAPE Take Over Seoul for New Capsule Summary A BATHING APE has teamed up with Stray Kids to unveil a collaborative Gift With Purchase collection uniting BABY MILO and SKZOOThe multi-stage release features collectible lifestyle goods including luggage tags keycap keychains tote bags and plush dollsStray Kids celebrated the drop with an interactive takeover at BAPE STORE DOSAN sporting Fall/Winter 2026 looks and the BAPE STA A BATHING APE (BAPE®) has officially partnered with global music sensation Stray Kids to introduce the BAPE × Stray Kids Gift With Purchase collection, celebrated with a full-scale physical takeover at BAPE STORE DOSAN in Seoul.The collaboration centers on a co-branded Gift With Purchase lifestyle assortment that bridges the signature worlds of BABY MILO® and SKZOO. The collectible lineup features a branded Luggage Tag, Keycap Keychain, canvas Tote Bag, BABY MILO® Plush Keychain, and a large BABY MILO® Plush Doll, each detailed with co-branded graphics and signature BAPE® motifs.To commemorate the launch, all eight members of Stray Kids gathered at BAPE STORE DOSAN styled in selections from BAPE’s Fall/Winter 2026 mainline collection paired with the BAPE STA™, honoring the sneaker’s 25th anniversary. The retail flagship was completely reimagined for the event, showcasing oversized campaign imagery, themed window graphics, a claw machine photo booth, and a custom CAMO-wrapped Gacha machine. In-store purchases offer shoppers a turn on the machine for exclusive items, including special access passes to the location’s private (B)APARTMENT space featuring autographed memorabilia.Drop 1 of the BAPE® × Stray Kids collection released on October 17, 2026, while Drop 2 arrives on October 30, 2026, available through designated spending tiers at participating BAPE STORE locations worldwide. items.text: Burna Boy Brings His Inner Circle Into the Spotlight For Latest On Campaign As Burna Boy embarks on his European takeover, On has teamed up with the Grammy Award-winning artist for a new footwear collection, reimagining the Swiss sportswear label’s staple silhouettes.To mark the limited-edition drop, Burna Boy brings his inner circle to the forefront of the accompanying campaign, “No Giant Stands Alone.”With imagery shot by London-based photographer Ronan McKenzie and behind-the-scenes doc-style video by Bafic, the visuals get the Afrobeats artist alongside the people who have helped shape his career. Featuring his sister, Ronami and his mother, Bose - both part of his management team - as well as his dancers, vocalist and his band The Outsiders, the campaign serves as an intimate look at life behind the stage.Reworking two of On’s staple silhouettes: the Cloudmonster and THE ROGER Clubhouse, both sneakers arrive in tonal colorways, with the former in a full-red “Sienna/Sienna” and the latter in a clean “White/Mars” white makeover.The Cloudmonster BB and THE ROGER Clubhouse BB are available to shop now exclusively on the On website and Foot Locker. items.title: Justin Bieber Launches First Immersive Audio Experience at SKYLRK Seoul Pop-up
items.text: Justin Bieber Launches First Immersive Audio Experience at SKYLRK Seoul Pop-up Summary Justin Bieber's apparel and lifestyle brand SKYLRK has officially launched its first physical installation in South KoreaThe Seongsu-dong space features a multi-sensory listening environment personally conceived and produced by Bieber utilizing SKYLRK AUDIO speakersVisitors can preview a forthcoming capsule of ping pong tables and gear created in collaboration with STIGA Table Tennis SKYLRK, the apparel and lifestyle imprint founded by Justin Bieber, has debuted its first South Korean installation, headlined by the SKYLRK Seoul immersive audio experience. Conceived and personally produced by Bieber, the project marks the artist's first venture into experiential spatial audio installations.Centered around a multi-sensory listening environment, the installation bridges sound, architectural space, visual elements, and bespoke SKYLRK AUDIO speakers to transform traditional listening into a shared physical format. The activation serves as an introduction to the expanding SKYLRK AUDIO ecosystem while exploring creative avenues outside conventional music releases.In addition to the sound installation, the physical space previews an upcoming equipment collection designed in partnership with STIGA Table Tennis. The assortment highlights custom ping pong tables and matching gear created by SKYLRK, applying the imprint's design ethos to communal recreation. The Seoul stop marks the fourth physical activation for the imprint, building on prior installations hosted in Tokyo in December 2025, Indio, California in April 2026, and New York City in July 2026.The SKYLRK SEOUL installation runs from October 23 through October 25, 2026, open daily from 10:00 to 22:00 at 36 Seongsuil-ro 6-gil in Seongdong-gu, Seoul. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Kith Officially Opens New Vancouver Flagship
items.text: Kith Officially Opens New Vancouver Flagship Summary Kith has officially announced the opening of its second Canadian flagship located at Oakridge Park in VancouverDesigned alongside Porto Architecture the retail space blends walnut Belvedere marble and custom terrazzo finishesThe opening is marked by a collaborative Salomon capsule launching early at the Vancouver boutique before a global release Kith has officially expanded its Canadian footprint with the grand opening of Kith Vancouver, marking the brand’s second flagship in the country. Located inside the North Arcade of Oakridge Park on West 41st Avenue, the expansive retail destination brings together the brand's full lifestyle universe alongside a dedicated Kith Treats space.Conceived by Kith CEO, Founder, and Creative Director Ronnie Fieg alongside frequent collaborator Ben Porto of Porto Architecture, the flagship’s design draws heavily from Vancouver’s surrounding coastal environment. The architectural layout balances natural light and organic materials, integrating walnut millwork, Calacatta Vagli marble, and Belvedere stone throughout the interior.The main entrance opens into the men’s apparel department, framed by custom walnut walls, brass accents, and Kith Crest-embossed velvet panels, leading through Belvedere stone thresholds to a dedicated men's footwear salon with polished Venetian plaster. In the women’s section, accessible via a patio entryway, chevron white oak floors meet Rosa Aurora stone tops, Emerald Quartzite accents, and multi-marble shelving displaying footwear, apparel, fine jewelry, and handbags. Kith Kids features cloud-shaped architectural ceiling coves, mint accents, and vibrant display cubbies, while Kith Treats presents an independent entrance accented by Rosa Portugalo counters, Azul Cielo headers, White Carrara stone, and stainless steel fixtures.To commemorate the store opening, Kith has partnered with Salomon to introduce a footwear capsule featuring the all-new XT-4K Mid, the XT-4 OG, and the XT-VYGR 2.The collaborative Kith for Salomon collection drops exclusively at Kith Vancouver on Friday, October 23, followed by a global rollout on Monday, October 26. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Final Screen Tests for Next James Bond Reportedly Underway at Amazon MGM Studios
items.text: Final Screen Tests for Next James Bond Reportedly Underway at Amazon MGM Studios Summary Amazon MGM Studios is reportedly beginning final screen tests to cast the next James BondAuditions are being overseen by casting director Nina Gold for director Denis VilleneuveCallum Turner and Jack Lowden have emerged among the names in the mix as an official announcement looms before year's end Amazon MGM Studios is officially entering the final stages of casting for the next James Bond. Final screen tests to determine the new 007 are slated to commence within the coming week, starting as early as Friday.While the complete roster of actors invited to audition remains unconfirmed, industry sources note that British stars Callum Turner and Jack Lowden are actively in the mix. Representatives for Turner, Lowden, and Amazon MGM Studios did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Acclaimed filmmaker Denis Villeneuve is attached to direct the franchise's upcoming chapter, with veteran casting director Nina Gold managing the extensive audition process.Both frontrunners have circulated throughout the franchise's rumor mill in recent months. Lowden gained notable traction after his Slow Horses co-star Gary Oldman publicly hinted that the Scottish actor had reached the studio shortlist. Addressing the ongoing chatter, Lowden’s wife, Saoirse Ronan, downplayed the domestic speculation, noting that it’s “not really a subject that’s coming up in our house.” Turner similarly addressed 007 inquiries while promoting the arthouse film Rosebush Pruning at the Berlin Film Festival earlier this year. “It’s very early for that question,” Turner remarked at the time. “I’m not going to comment on it.”While Amazon MGM Studios has not announced a specific date for the formal reveal, the studio is widely expected to name its next James Bond before the end of the year. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Lewis Hamilton Hints at Extended F1 Career Following Africa Grand Prix Decision
items.text: Lewis Hamilton Hints at Extended F1 Career Following Africa Grand Prix Decision Summary Lewis Hamilton has indicated he plans to extend his Formula 1 career until the sport officially returns to AfricaFormula 1 confirmed an African return for the early 2030s with Rwanda set to join the schedule for the first timeHamilton revealed extensive lobbying efforts involving high-level meetings with series stakeholders and heads of state Formula 1 driver Lewis Hamilton has hinted at an extended retirement timeline following the announcement of an upcoming African Grand Prix. The seven-time world champion stated that the sport's impending return to the continent will keep him on the grid longer than previously expected.Formula 1 confirmed last week that the racing series will officially return to Africa in the early 2030s, featuring Rwanda's debut on the calendar. The continent last hosted an F1 race in 1993 at Kyalami in South Africa. With Rwanda slated to join by 2030 at the earliest, Hamilton would be at least 45 years of age and entering his 24th season, yet the British driver expressed clear determination to remain competitive."I'm now forced to have to stay longer because we have a race in Africa, that's been my dream to be able to race in Africa," Hamilton told media members. "I have to keep fighting to try and stay fit if I can. If I can still punch out good results over the next year, we'll keep it going."Hamilton highlighted his hands-on role in bringing the region back onto the calendar after years of direct campaigning. "I've been advocating for a race in Africa for many, many, many years," Hamilton detailed. "Countless meetings with the stakeholders, so many meetings with Stefano at his office in London, but also at race weekends. Countless calls. 'What's happening? Where are we going? Who are we meeting with?' Many meetings with different presidents from different countries. Lots of phone calls with different presidents from different countries within Africa."Reflecting on the cultural weight of the upcoming event, Hamilton added, "For me, it's a place that deserves to have a grand prix. It's more about... it's more than just about one country. It's about the continent in itself, and there are so many beautiful countries within it, and the people are so lovely. The culture is so rich, and I think it's important that we get to show that to the world, and we get to do that with our sport."Formula 1's return to the African continent in Rwanda is scheduled

items.title: The First Fully Authorized Fleetwood Mac Documentary ‘The Chain’ Is Premiering in 2027
items.text: The First Fully Authorized Fleetwood Mac Documentary ‘The Chain’ Is Premiering in 2027 Summary Apple Original Films has revealed the title of its Fleetwood Mac documentary, the first ever made with the band’s full authorizationThe film gathers the perspectives of Mick Fleetwood, John McVie, Christine McVie, Lindsey Buckingham and Stevie Nicks across more than five decadesIts premiere lines up with the 50th anniversary of Rumors, the album that gave the documentary its name Apple Original Films has officially titled its Fleetwood Mac documentary Fleetwood Mac: The Chain, marking the first time the band has signed off on a film telling its story from the inside. Directed by Frank Marshall, the project centers the five members of the band’s best-known lineup and is set for a global debut on Apple TV early next year.The documentary is built around the band itself rather than outside commentators. Mick Fleetwood, John McVie, Christine McVie, Lindsey Buckingham and Stevie Nicks, all Grammy winners and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees, look back on the 50-plus years that followed their chance meeting in 1974. Archival material that has never been made public sits alongside exclusive new interviews, carrying the story from their record-breaking studio sessions and tours up to the present day.The title is a deliberate choice. “The Chain” is the only track on Rumors that credits all five members as writers, and the film uses it as a symbol for a bond that held even as the band’s rise to fame strained nearly every relationship within it. Timing reinforces the point, with the premiere landing on the 50th anniversary of the Grammy-winning album’s release.Structurally, the film moves through the band’s peaks and collapses while isolating what each member contributed to a sound that has sold more than 220 million records worldwide. It also digs into the harder question of why five artists kept returning to one another, and kept producing landmark work, despite pressures from the industry and from within the group that repeatedly threatened to end it.Behind the camera, Marshall, a five-time Academy Award nominee and recipient of the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award, also produces through The Kennedy/Marshall Company. He’s joined by White Horse Pictures’ Nigel Sinclair (No Direction Home: Bob Dylan), Nicholas Ferrall (Stax: Soulsville U.S.A.) and Jeanne Elfant Festa (Lucy and Desi), along with Kennedy/Marshall’s Aly Parker (The Bee Gees: How Can You Mend a Broken Heart)

items.title: Chris Pratt Confirms Star-Lord Will Return to the MCU
items.text: Chris Pratt Confirms Star-Lord Will Return to the MCU Summary Chris Pratt has confirmed that Star-Lord will return to the Marvel Cinematic UniverseThe actor revealed on The Playlist’s Bingeworthy podcast that hard action has been taken by Marvel Studios leadershipPratt previously pitched his own creative vision to Kevin Feige to help shape future MCU storytelling Marvel Studios and actor Chris Pratt are officially moving forward with Star-Lord's return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Pratt confirmed on The Playlist’s “Bingeworthy” podcast that concrete steps have been initiated to follow up on the character’s future teased at the close of Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3.Speaking on the podcast, Pratt addressed his ongoing communication with executive leadership regarding Peter Quill's return, "I have a great relationship with Kevin [Feige] and Lou [D’Esposito], and there have been both ongoing conversations about how we make good on that promise and also hard action taken to make sure that we make good on that promise," said Pratt. He continued, "So yeah, you’ll see Star-Lord again, which is very exciting, but I’m not at liberty to say when that’s going to be, but he’s not going anywhere."The confirmation builds upon statements Pratt made earlier on the Happy Sad Confused podcast, where he admitted to pitching a concept directly to Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige. “I’m happy to do anything they want me to do and will,” Pratt previously explained. “And also, I personally have a really strong vision of what I would want him to do. And I think it’s fucking great.” When asked about bringing that proposal to Feige, Pratt stated, “Yep. And I think that, you know, I’m down to contribute any way I can to them setting up the next 10 years of storytelling, you know? And also, I have a pretty strong idea of how I think I could contribute to that.”Pratt has portrayed Star-Lord across six films to date, including Guardians of the Galaxy, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2, Avengers: Infinity War, Avengers: Endgame, Thor: Love and Thunder, and Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3.The next installment in the MCU, Avengers: Doomsday, is scheduled to arrive in theaters on December 18. items.title: ARC’TERYX’s Postour Boot Hides a Slipper Inside a GORE-TEX Shell
items.text: ARC’TERYX’s Postour Boot Hides a Slipper Inside a GORE-TEX Shell Name: ARC’TERYX Postour Boot Men'sColorway: Black/Black, Tatsu/BlackSKU: X000010507MSRP: $300 USDRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: ARC’TERYXARC’TERYX is targeting the downtime between backcountry days with the Postour Boot, a two-part recovery boot built for après touring. An insulated, waterproof overboot handles snow and ice outdoors, while a separate slipper slides out from inside so wearers can head straight indoors without swapping footwear.The overboot is the weatherproof half of the system. ARC’TERYX wraps it in GORE-TEX Invisible Fit, running the waterproof layer all the way up to the top of the collar for extra protection and warmth. That high collar closes with a drawcord that tightens much like a climbing chalk bag, sealing the opening against deep snow and slush. Endure 360 extended rubber coverage circles the entire boot, reinforcing it against scuffs and impacts.Grip comes from a Vibram Arctic Grip outsole engineered for secure footing on icy ground, paired with a lug pattern shaped to bite into snow and other soft terrain. Underfoot cushioning adds a layer of comfort for feet that have spent the day locked into stiff ski boots.Warmth runs through both layers. Coreloft synthetic insulation lines the overboot and the slipper, so the pair stays warm whether it’s worn as a full boot outside or reduced to the inner piece indoors. The slipper itself is fully functional on its own, offering support when nested inside the boot and switching to a TPU grip outsole made for indoor surfaces once it’s pulled out.The men’s Postour comes in two colorways, Black/Black and Tatsu/Black, both built with a textile upper, synthetic insole and rubber outsole, and listed for alpine, touring, freeride and resort use. ARC’TERYX notes the boot is PFAS compliant and requires surface cleaning only. Sizing runs in whole sizes, and the brand recommends sizing up for anyone between sizes or after a roomier fit. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: LISA’s ‘PRESS PLAY’ EP Plays Out Like a Six-Track Action Movie
items.text: LISA’s ‘PRESS PLAY’ EP Plays Out Like a Six-Track Action Movie Summary LISA has released 'PRESS PLAY,' a six-track EP conceived to unfold like a film from start to finishThe track “Tarantino” lands with a music video that sends LISA brawling through a hotel to reach her favorite directorThe drop sets up her VIVA LA LISA residency at Caesars Palace, the first Las Vegas residency by a K-pop artist LISA has officially released PRESS PLAY, a six-track EP built around a cinematic concept that asks listeners to settle in and hit play as if a movie were about to start. The project arrives today alongside a music video for focus track “Tarantino,” capping a run that has already delivered a record-breaking YouTube debut, a historic VMA win and a sold-out Las Vegas booking.The film framing shapes how the EP is sequenced, with six tracks moving like scenes rather than a loose collection of singles. “SaWaDiKa” opens the reel, followed by “V12” and “Cobra,” before “Tarantino” lands as the centerpiece and “Cut U Off” and “Sweat” carry things to the closing credits.“Tarantino” gets the blockbuster treatment on screen. Its video follows LISA on a mission through a hotel to hand-deliver a note to the director himself, throwing punches at anyone standing between her and the delivery. The action-heavy choreography leans straight into the genre the track is named after, making it the clearest visual statement of the EP’s movie concept.The project’s opener already arrived with serious numbers. “SaWaDiKa,” named after the Thai greeting for “hello,” came with a video shot in LISA’s hometown of Bangkok that pulled in more than 70.8 million YouTube views in its first 24 hours. That tally places it among her biggest YouTube debuts and makes it the top YouTube debut of 2026, while the song entered the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 69 for her highest debut on the chart to date. She gave the track its television debut at the MTV VMAs, where she also won Best Pop for “Dream” featuring Kentaro Sakaguchi and became the first solo K-pop artist to take the category.Las Vegas is the next stop on the rollout. LISA’s “VIVA LA LISA” Residency takes over The Colosseum at Caesars Palace for six nights in November, after the first four shows sold out in under 10 minutes and two more dates were added. The run makes her the first K-pop artist to headline a Las Vegas residency.Her story is also playing out on the big screen. items.title: Denzel Washington and Christopher McQuarrie Set to Team up for Untitled Amazon MGM Thriller
items.text: Denzel Washington and Christopher McQuarrie Set to Team up for Untitled Amazon MGM Thriller Summary Denzel Washington is set to headline an untitled original thriller directed by Christopher McQuarrieAmazon MGM and United Artists have slated the feature for an October 1, 2027 theatrical releaseWritten by Scott Barkan and Gregg Zehentner the plot centers on a terminally ill ex-detective confronting his past Amazon MGM Studios and United Artists have officially greenlit an untitled original thriller starring two-time Academy Award winner Denzel Washington and directed by Christopher McQuarrie. The high-profile feature is currently slated to arrive in theaters in the fall of 2027.Penned by screenwriters Scott Barkan and Gregg Zehentner, the project—previously developed under the working title The Frame—focuses on a former police detective who receives an early release from prison following a terminal brain cancer diagnosis. Hoping to spend his remaining time reconnecting with his family, he quickly discovers that his unresolved past refuses to stay buried.The collaboration with McQuarrie marks one of two major Washington-led productions scheduled for the near future. The actor was previously set to debut The Take—originally titled Here Comes the Flood and co-starring Robert Pattinson—before the end of 2026, though that production has since seen its release window pushed into 2027.The untitled Christopher McQuarrie thriller starring Denzel Washington is scheduled for a theatrical rollout on October 1, 2027. items.title: The Nike Air Force 1 ‘01 “Philly” Gives LeBron James a Sixers-Coded Welcome
items.text: The Nike Air Force 1 ‘01 “Philly” Gives LeBron James a Sixers-Coded Welcome Name: Nike Air Force 1 ’01 “Philly”Colorway: White/Rush Blue-University RedSKU: JW9694-100MSRP: $140 USDRelease Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: SNKRSNike is greeting LeBron James’ move to Philadelphia with the Air Force 1 ‘01 “Philly,” a city-dedicated pair dressed in Sixers colors and loaded with local references. Rather than a signature-line release, the brand is leaning on its most recognizable low-top to mark the moment, building the shoe around Philadelphia itself.This is the second time in 2026 that Nike has turned the Air Force 1 ‘01 into a snapshot of a city’s basketball mood. Earlier this year, the “NYC” edition arrived as the Knicks pushed through the playoffs, its insoles printed with a pixelated rendering of Madison Square Garden. The “Philly” pair trades arena imagery for team colors and civic shorthand, keeping the tribute rooted in the city rather than a single building.Up top, the White/Rush Blue-University Red colorway is mapped with clear intent. White leather handles the toe, lacing area and heel, while royal blue covers the perforated toe box and side panels. Red leather Swooshes sweep across each side, and a smaller red Swoosh sits just below the laces to carry the accent color toward the center of the shoe.The heel is where the city really announces itself. One shoe is embroidered with “215” and the other with “PHL,” each outlined in blue and cut through by a red Swoosh, while white “Phila” lettering stands in for standard branding on the blue heel tabs. “215” is one of Philadelphia’s area codes, giving the pair a local detail only the city would fully read.Underfoot, a white midsole carries blue “AIR” lettering and sits on a blue rubber outsole. The most pointed detail hides inside: the insoles show a black-and-white brick wall split by cracks, with a red Nike logo smashing through one section. For a shoe built around a star landing in a new city, it’s a fitting image to stand on. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Todd Snyder and New Balance Reunite for the T500 "Cafe Pack"
items.text: Todd Snyder and New Balance Reunite for the T500 "Cafe Pack" Summary New Balance has partnered with Todd Snyder to introduce the exclusive T500 Cafe Pack in Espresso and Milk colorwaysThe updated 1982 court silhouette replaces traditional canvas with a mix of hairy suede and crocodile-stamped leather atop a gum midsoleThe limited-edition collaboration launches October 22 at 10 AM ET exclusively via Todd Snyder channels for $130 USD New Balance and menswear designer Todd Snyder have officially introduced the T500 “Cafe Pack”, delivering an elevated take on the archival 1982 court shoe.Originally engineered in 1982 for tennis performance, the T500 transitioned naturally into everyday street culture, embraced by skaters and style outsiders for its flat, grounded profile. Reimagined through a contemporary leisure lens, this modern release retains its classic court foundation while upgrading its construction with refined, tactile materials.Replacing the silhouette's traditional canvas uppers, the design incorporates a contrasting blend of hairy suede and crocodile-stamped leather for added texture and polish. The low-profile uppers sit atop a distinct gum midsole, introducing an understated nod to 1980s athletic engineering over traditional vulcanized sole units. Offered in two distinct colorways—"Espresso" and "Milk"—the palette draws direct aesthetic cues from the warmth, textures, and canine visitors of local neighborhood coffee shops.The Todd Snyder x New Balance T500 “Cafe Pack” releases October 22 at 10 AM ET for $130 USD, available exclusively at online and all Todd Snyder retail locations. A third version, titled "Woodland Camo," is also expected to round out the collection. In addition, Supreme's foundational white and black leather Air Force 1 Lows are reportedly set to restock alongside the camo trio.All three Supreme x Nike Air Force 1 Low camouflage colorways are expected to release during Fall/Winter 2026. items.title: JUUN.J Releases Fall/Winter 2026 Campaign
items.text: JUUN.J Releases Fall/Winter 2026 Campaign JUUN.J has officially released its Fall/Winter 2026 campaign, starring global ambassador Ahn Hyo Seop. Themed "NEWSTALGIA," this season combines "New" and "Nostalgia," reinterpreting classic menswear and streetwear through exaggerated silhouettes, deconstructed tailoring, and the collision of different materials.This campaign continues JUUN.J's signature oversized design language, covering tuxedo suits, leather jackets, tweed garments, and casual items. Among them, a look from the Paris Fashion Week runway pairs a navy blue wool tuxedo jacket with wide-leg trousers, layered with a pinstripe coat, reinterpreting traditional formalwear through a broad-shouldered structure and elongated proportions. Another all-black leather look presents a more street-style visual with heavy materials and relaxed tailoring.In addition, the collection combines boucle wool tweed with microfiber suede, establishing a connection between formal wear and casual style through the layering of knitwear, shirts, and three-dimensional origami-structured denim trousers, paired with the brand's signature chunky-soled ARC sneakers.The JUUN.J Fall/Winter 2026 collection will gradually arrive at the brand's Chengdu Taikoo Li and Beijing Sanlitun Taikoo Li boutiques, as well as its official Tmall flagship store. items.title: Devialet Unveils the Phantom Ultimate 98 dB "Pulse Blue" Collector's Edition Speaker
items.text: Devialet Unveils the Phantom Ultimate 98 dB "Pulse Blue" Collector's Edition Speaker Devialet officially unveils the all-new Phantom Ultimate 98 dB "Pulse Blue" Collector's Edition speaker. The accompanying campaign stars French Oracle Red Bull Racing driver and global brand ambassador Isack Hadjar, seamlessly merging the thrilling culture of Formula 1 with high-end acoustic design.Inspired by the hyper-focused state right before a race begins, the new release reimagines the Phantom Ultimate's iconic spherical silhouette. The body is rendered in a deep RAL 5011 blue, while the side panels have been upgraded from matte to a mirror-polished finish. Coated in a clear lacquer, they deliver a striking metallic texture that shifts beautifully in the light. To complete the look, the brand is also releasing a matching exclusive Tree stand that echoes this cohesive design language.On the performance front, the Phantom Ultimate 98 dB retains the brand's signature acoustic architecture. It boasts a frequency response range of 18 Hz to 25 kHz, a maximum sound pressure level of 98 dB SPL, and support for high-resolution audio up to 24-bit/192 kHz. The speaker is equipped with ADH New-Gen® analog-digital hybrid amplification, SAM® Speaker Active Matching, and HBI® low-frequency technology, all while supporting both stereo and multi-room configurations.Furthermore, the new release runs on the Devialet DOS 3 system, ensuring seamless compatibility with streaming protocols like AirPlay, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, Tidal Connect, and Roon Ready. Users can also easily adjust the equalizer and switch between different listening modes via the Devialet app.The Devialet Phantom Ultimate 98 dB "Pulse Blue" Collector's Edition is now available for pre-order. The speaker is priced at 15,980 RMB, while the matching Tree stand retails for 2,090 RMB, with both available across the brand's boutiques in China, its official website, and official e-commerce channels. items.title: A-POC ABLE ISSEY MIYAKE x JAXA Turn Satellite Shots of Antarctic Ice Into “TYPE-XVII” Jeans
items.text: A-POC ABLE ISSEY MIYAKE x JAXA Turn Satellite Shots of Antarctic Ice Into “TYPE-XVII” Jeans Summary A-POC ABLE ISSEY MIYAKE has teamed up with the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency on new jeans under its “TYPE-XVII JAXA project”The design pulls from Antarctic observation images captured by JAXA’s climate change monitoring satellite “SHIKISAI”Wide and straight silhouettes are offered, each made with the label’s in-house single-cloth jacquard technique A-POC ABLE ISSEY MIYAKE is taking its textile engineering into orbit with the “TYPE-XVII JAXA project” jeans, a collaboration with the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA). Instead of printing an image onto finished fabric, the pair translates satellite data of Earth directly into the weave, with Antarctica serving as the design’s focal point.The source material comes from “SHIKISAI,” the JAXA satellite tasked with observing climate change from above. Its images of the southern continent supply the entire visual language here: sweeping fields of white ice interrupted by fissures where dark navy ocean shows through. The result reads less like a graphic and more like a topographic surface you can wear.Construction is where the project earns its spec-sheet credibility. A-POC ABLE ISSEY MIYAKE renders the imagery through its proprietary jacquard, building each pair from one continuous piece of cloth so the Antarctic pattern lives inside the textile rather than sitting on top of it. That approach lets the contrast between ice and sea carry through the garment as part of its structure.Two silhouettes anchor the drop. A wide jean offers a roomier, relaxed leg, while a straight version keeps a cleaner line, and both arrive in a run of four sizes so the satellite-derived pattern can scale across different builds.The A-POC ABLE ISSEY MIYAKE x JAXA “TYPE-XVII JAXA project” jeans drop November 1 via A-POC ABLE ISSEY MIYAKE / AOYAMA, A-POC ABLE ISSEY MIYAKE / KYOTO and ISSEY MIYAKE GINZA / 442. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ThruDark and Musto Unite for the Technical “Nautikos” Offshore Collection
items.text: ThruDark and Musto Unite for the Technical “Nautikos” Offshore Collection Summary ThruDark has teamed up with Musto to release “Nautikos,” their latest technical offshore apparel collection.Highlighted styles include GORE-TEX PRO shells, Dyneema reinforcements, modular pockets, protective sailing gear and more. Built for the unforgiving conditions of the open sea, ThruDark and Musto have joined forces on “Nautikos,” a technical apparel collection that brings together two distinct areas of British performance expertise. Marking ThruDark's entry into offshore racing apparel, the collaboration combines the military experience of its founders, former UK Special Forces operators Anthony “Staz” Stazicker and Louis Tinsley, with Musto's six-decade heritage in professional sailing equipment.Founded by Olympic sailor Keith Musto in 1964, the latter has long specialized in protective clothing engineered for demanding maritime environments. The resulting collection, described by Musto as its most durable offshore range to date, prioritizes weather resistance, adaptability and safety over decorative detailing. Its predominantly black and charcoal palette reinforces a utilitarian aesthetic, while the accompanying campaign places the garments aboard high-speed boats and against rugged coastal landscapes, emphasizing their intended use in challenging conditions.Leading the drop are the Nautikos GTX Jacket and matching GTX Trousers, constructed with GORE-TEX PRO for sustained protection against severe offshore weather. The collaboration also introduces Dyneema reinforcement to Musto's technical outerwear for the first time, combining the high-strength fiber with waterproof construction to improve durability in demanding environments. The jacket features a high protective collar, an adjustable hood and an array of oversized utility pockets, while the bib-style trousers incorporate adjustable shoulder straps and multiple storage compartments. A removable pocket system allows storage configurations to be transferred between compatible layers, extending the range's modular functionality. Additional safety features include D3O knee protection and photoluminescent reflectors designed to improve visibility in low-light conditions. For more adaptable layering, the Nautikos Trident GTX Jacket and matching trousers offer streamlined silhouettes suited to changing weather conditions, retaining the collection's emphasis on technical performance.Completing the system are the Nautikos

items.title: Doechii Detonates in the Desert for New 'Swamp Sessions' Video "CATWOMAN"
items.text: Doechii Detonates in the Desert for New 'Swamp Sessions' Video "CATWOMAN" Summary Florida rapper Doechii has released the latest installment of her Swamp Sessions series titled "CATWOMAN"The visual features the artist in dual roles as she wanders the desert before an explosive confrontationThe release builds momentum for the Grammy winner as she teases the creative direction of her upcoming debut album Top Dawg Entertainment artist Doechii has officially released "CATWOMAN," the latest explosive visual installment in her ongoing Swamp Sessions series. The music video arrived on Tuesday, October 20, following the release of last week's thunderous single "BOMBS."In the new video, the Swamp Princess wanders through a desert landscape wearing baggy washed denim jeans, a Tap Out waistband, and a white sports bra before being blown to pieces by a bazooka-wielding, alternate version of herself. Rocking an Afro, black denim, heels, and matching sunglasses, this second persona struts to the scene while delivering hard-hitting bars. Lyrically, the track features an homage to Busta Rhymes with a signature "woo-hah" ad-lib and name-drops Sean Connery's James Bond, alongside claims of channeling 2Pac's artistic tenacity.Looking ahead to her debut album, the Grammy-winning rapper recently shared a journal entry outlining her evolving creative vision. "I spent the last few years relearning Hip-Hop as a student. Studying its language, history & roots. Now I feel inspired to contribute to evolve it," she wrote, emphasizing a mission to center Black womanhood within both Hip-Hop and Pop. The single follows her recent collaboration with Lady Gaga on "Runway" for The Devil Wears Prada 2 soundtrack, which secured her another Billboard Hot 100 entry.Doechii's "CATWOMAN" Swamp Session video is available to watch now on YouTube. items.title: Dame Dash's Life Rights Officially Auctioned Off for $550,000 USD
items.text: Dame Dash's Life Rights Officially Auctioned Off for $550,000 USD Summary A Florida bankruptcy court has confirmed the sale of Dame Dash’s life rights to Everlasting Films LLC for $550,000 USDThe acquisition secures exclusive worldwide rights to his narrative alongside 100 hours of video footage memorabilia and an in-development film projectBackup bidder Doug Peters is positioned to purchase the rights for 500,000 USD if the primary sale fails to close Dame Dash has officially seen his Life Rights auctioned off for $550,000 USD, with all proceeds allocated directly to satisfy his creditors. The conclusion of the auction was formally submitted by bankruptcy trustee Traci K. Stevenson to the overseeing Florida court on Wednesday, October 21.Following the bidding process that concluded on October 1, Everlasting Films, LLC—which originally submitted an initial $37,000 USD “stalking horse” bid—won the auction to secure exclusive worldwide rights to the Roc-A-Fella co-founder's life story. Alongside narrative rights, the sale includes “100 hours of video content, photographs, and memorabilia,” as well as “an unreleased, in-development documentary/film project.” In the event that Everlasting Films does not finalize the deal within the required window, backup bidder Doug Peters is queued to claim the rights for $500,000 USD.The auction stems from a petition filed by Stevenson in August after Dash declared bankruptcy in September 2025, listing $25 million USD in liabilities against $4,350 USD in personal assets. While Dash omitted the asset in his initial filing, Stevenson argued the rights held “evident value in light of the Debtor's public profile and his historical association with Roc-A-Fella Records and [Jay-Z].” Elaborating on the commercial valuation, Stevenson wrote, "[T]he monetization of an individual's name, image, and likeness has become a well-established and actively regulated commercial market. That market confirms that rights of this character -- a person's name, image, likeness, persona, and life narrative -- are recognized as commercially valuable, transferable property, further supporting the Trustee's business judgment that the Property is a marketable Estate asset appropriate for sale."Dash also faces concurrent legal friction from filmmaker Josh Webber, who filed claims alleging Dash has failed to pay $4,408.20 USD in court-ordered sanctions while improperly asserting ownership over royalty streams for the 2018 film Honor Up. items.text: Better World Fragrance House and OVO Celebrate Drake’s 40th Birthday With "DoSayDo" Eau De Parfum Summary Better World Fragrance House has partnered with October's Very Own for an exclusive fragrance launch celebrating Drake's birthdayThe DoSayDo Eau de Parfum arrives in a reimagined translucent crimson glass sphere bottle with a matching sculptural standThe citrus aromatic scent layers top notes of passion fruit and cannabis over a base of cognac white cedarwood and roasted tonka Better World Fragrance House and Drake's lifestyle brand October's Very Own have officially presented the collaborative "DoSayDo" Eau De Parfum. Arriving during a prolific year where the artist has released three albums and teased a fourth, the exclusive fragrance launch celebrates Drake’s 40th birthday across a customized 3.4 oz. (100 mL) vessel.The DoSayDo fragrance delivers a citrus aromatic profile engineered with contrasting notes that subtly pay homage to the artist. The scent opens with top notes of passionfruit, white wine spritz, cannabis, and clary sage oil, moving into a heart of petitgrain, black pepper oil, and rose oil. As the fragrance deepens, warm base notes of cognac, white cedarwood, and roasted tonka unfold into a rich finish.Packaging elevates BWFH's signature primary design into an all-glass construction, casting the iconic globe bottle and sculptural stand in a deep burgundy, translucent crimson shade. The secondary packaging features OVO's recognizable cream-colored carton, displaying the signature October's Very Own owl logo alongside the circular Better World Fragrance House emblem.The Better World Fragrance House x OVO DoSayDo Eau De Parfum previews via a 24-hour DTC release on October 19, 2026, at BetterWorldFragranceHouse followed by an official launch on October 24, 2026, in OVO stores and at OctobersVeryOwn.
