items.title: Fender and Dark Horse Records Introduce Three Custom George Harrison Stratocasters
items.text: Fender and Dark Horse Records Introduce Three Custom George Harrison Stratocasters Summary Fender and Dark Horse Records celebrate George Harrison's legacy with a Japan-exclusive collection.Highlights include three custom Stratocasters andcollectible accessories.The collection features archival Dark Horse graphics, Japanese craftsmanship and Harrison-inspired designs. George Harrison's creative legacy takes on a new form as Fender joins forces with Dark Horse Records for a Japan-exclusive collection spanning musical instruments and accessories. Celebrating the late Beatles guitarist's influence beyond music, the collaboration draws inspiration from his personal style, artistic independence and the visual identity of Dark Horse Records, the label he founded in 1974.Harrison's longstanding relationship with Japan, particularly his celebrated 1991 tour of the country, provides a fitting backdrop for the project, which also coincides with the Year of the Horse in 2026. Bringing together Fender's instrument-making heritage and the Japanese craftsmanship of its lifestyle imprint F Is For Fender, the collection reinterprets archival imagery and recognizable Dark Horse motifs across a range of contemporary designs.Leading the release is the George Harrison Dark Horse Records Stratocaster, available in Olympic White, Black and Orange. Each guitar features custom Dark Horse graphics, gold hardware and an engraved neck plate, pairing the classic Stratocaster silhouette with artwork referencing Harrison's independent record label. The instrument is constructed with an alder body, maple Modern “C” neck and rosewood fingerboard, alongside three Player Series Alnico 5 single-coil pickups and a two-point synchronized tremolo.Complementing the guitar is a limited-edition strap featuring textured-grain detailing and Dark Horse artwork, as well as a collectible set of 12 uniquely designed picks housed in a matching tin. The lineup also includes the existing Dhani Harrison Signature Ukulele, extending the creative connection between Fender and the Harrison family.The Fender x Dark Horse Records collection began rolling out in Japan on October 16, 2026, with availability varying across products. The Stratocaster retails for ¥198,000 JPY (approx. $1,320 USD), while the limited-edition strap and pick set are priced at ¥10,450 JPY (approx. $70 USD) and ¥3,850 JPY (approx. $26 USD), respectively. items.title: Brabus Reveals the P900 Rocket Edition, a 900 HP G 63 Pickup Truck Limited to 10 Units Worldwide
items.text: Brabus Reveals the P900 Rocket Edition, a 900 HP G 63 Pickup Truck Limited to 10 Units Worldwide Summary Brabus has transformed the Mercedes-AMG G 63 into a 900-horsepower custom pickup truckThe coachbuilt conversion replaces the enclosed SUV shape with an open cargo bed and an aggressive carbon-fiber widebodyProduction of the highly modified vehicle is strictly capped at just 10 units worldwide The Mercedes-Benz G-Wagen operates as a highly audacious luxury status symbol straight from the dealership, but aftermarket heavyweights at Brabus pushed that ostentatious appeal into entirely new territory. Tuning house Brabus officially introduced the Brabus P900 Rocket Edition, a custom pickup truck based on the W 465 series Mercedes-AMG G 63. By completely rethinking the vehicle's architecture, this ultra-limited pickup conversion explicitly targets wealthy buyers in hyper-visible markets like Los Angeles and Miami who wish to stand out far beyond the footprint of a conventional SUV. Production of the highly modified truck is strictly limited to 10 units worldwide, ensuring absolute exclusivity on the streets.To create the imposing silhouette, the standard enclosed SUV shape is entirely replaced by an open rear cargo bed. The Brabus P900 Rocket Edition demands attention through an adapted, exposed carbon-fiber ROCKET EDITION WIDESTAR design. Visually, the exterior is styled with aggressive red accents that pop against the carbon weave, and the entire chassis sits on massive 24-inch BRABUS Monoblock II EVO wheels.Under the hood, the engineering overhaul is just as radical as the aesthetic transformation. Brabus increased the displacement of the standard Mercedes-Benz 4.0-liter V-8 engine up to 4.5 liters. This heavily modified 4.5-liter twin-turbo V8 engine now produces a staggering 900 horsepower, or 662 kW. That output represents a significant increase over the standard G63's already potent 577 horsepower. The newly expanded engine also generates a massive peak torque output of 922 lb-ft (1250 Nm). However, that brute force is electronically limited at 774 lb-ft purely to protect the vehicle's essential drivetrain components from the overwhelming twist.Performance metrics are staggering for a vehicle of this size and shape. The custom pickup truck accelerates from 0 to 62 miles per hour (100 km/h) in a blistering 3.7 seconds. items.text: The SOSHIOTSUKI x ASICS SKYHAND OG Is Limited to Just 50 Pairs Name: SOSHIOTSUKI x ASICS SKYHAND OGColorway: Oatmeal/BlackSKU: 1203A452-250MSRP: ¥38,500 JPY (approx. $244 USD)Release Date: October 29Where to Buy: SOSHIOTSUKI, KithJapanese menswear label SOSHIOTSUKI has unveiled its limited-edition collaboration with ASICS, offering a refined, highly crafted take on the classic SKYHAND OG. The otherwise minimal construction is interrupted by an oversized dark leather tongue, custom-made by artisans in Tokyo’s Asakusa district from Horween Chromexcel leather.The Chromexcel treatment introduces a finish designed to evolve with wear. Richly infused with oils and waxes, the leather develops a distinctive pull-up effect, producing subtle shifts in tone when bent or stretched while allowing scratches and creases to build into a deeper patina over time. A small KOTA OKUDA logo charm attached to one of the lace eyelets adds a jewelry-like accent, connecting the sneaker to pieces previously used throughout SOSHIOTSUKI’s main collection. items.title: Kith Winter 2026 Is Coming, and Kit Harington Is the First Sign
items.text: Kith Winter 2026 Is Coming, and Kit Harington Is the First Sign Summary Kit Harington stars in a teaser film for Kith’s Winter 2026 season, shot on location in the English countrysideThe clip is narrated with “The Snow Man,” a poem Wallace Stevens first published in 1921Kith has yet to reveal any pieces from the collection, which is listed as coming soon Kith has tapped Kit Harington to tease its Winter 2026 season, releasing a short, atmospheric film that follows the actor through the English countryside. The teaser reveals nothing of the collection itself, instead using mood and setting to build anticipation for what Ronnie Fieg’s label has lined up for the colder months.The clip keeps things deliberately sparse, with Harington making his way across the rural English landscape at an unhurried pace. Instead of a soundtrack, the visuals are paired with a reading of “The Snow Man,” Wallace Stevens’ short meditation on seeing a frozen winter scene as it truly is, which first appeared in 1921. The choice fits the season, and it’s hard to miss the wink to Harington’s most famous role, Game of Thrones’ Jon Snow.Check out the teaser below. items.title: Apple’s iPad mini Finally Gets OLED and Water Resistance
items.text: Apple’s iPad mini Finally Gets OLED and Water Resistance Summary Apple has redesigned the iPad mini with a larger 8.5-inch OLED display, an IP67 rating and a 5.4 mm profileThe new A20 Pro chip delivers up to 4.5x faster AI performance and up to 2.7x faster graphics than the previous generationAn Acoustic Display, a landscape front camera and Apple’s N1 and C2 connectivity chips round out the overhaul Apple has unveiled the all-new iPad mini, a top-to-bottom redesign that brings an 8.5-inch OLED display, IP67 water and dust resistance and the 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip to its smallest tablet. Apple is calling it the biggest update in the iPad mini’s history, and the spec sheet backs that up, with upgrades touching nearly every part of the device, from its audio and cameras to its wireless connectivity.The chassis is the first thing to shrink. At just 5.4 mm thick, the new iPad mini is both slimmer and lighter than its predecessor, and it now carries an IP67 rating, which Apple tested for submersion up to 1 meter for 30 minutes. That means a rainy commute or a poolside read no longer has to be a gamble. Two finishes are on offer, a new midnight and starlight, with storage configurations of 128GB, 256GB and 512GB.The display has grown without the tablet getting any bigger. Bezels that are 24 percent thinner make room for an 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR screen in the same footprint as before, and the switch to OLED brings pixel-level lighting control for much deeper blacks, a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio and P3 wide color support. Peak brightness hits up to 1,200 nits, more than double the last model, with 600 nits of full-screen brightness for SDR and HDR content. At the other end, a 1-nit minimum makes it easier on the eyes in a dark bedroom or a cockpit. For the first time on iPad mini, buyers can also opt for a nano-texture finish to cut glare outdoors, a feature previously reserved for iPad Pro.Under the hood, A20 Pro is built on Apple’s 2-nanometer process and uses a new package that borrows from the company’s M-series chips. Its 7-core GPU puts a Neural Accelerator in every core, pushing AI performance up to 4.5x higher than the previous generation, while dynamic caching, mesh shading and hardware-accelerated ray tracing lift graphics performance by up to 2.7x. A CPU with up to six cores adds up to 60 percent faster multithreaded performance, and unified memory bandwidth more than doubles. items.text: Ludens Joins the F.C.Real Bristol Roster for Kojima Productions’ 10th Birthday Summary SOPH.’s F.C.Real Bristol has teamed up with Kojima Productions on a collection marking the game studio’s 10th anniversaryEvery piece carries designs inspired by Ludens, the symbol character of Hideo Kojima’s independent studioThe collaboration also celebrates “BEYOND THE STRAND,” Kojima Productions’ anniversary exhibition in Tokyo F.C.Real Bristol and Kojima Productions have joined forces on a collaborative collection built around Ludens, the studio’s signature character, to mark a decade since Hideo Kojima launched the independent game developer in 2015. The capsule doubles as a celebration of “BEYOND THE STRAND,” the 10th anniversary exhibition the studio is staging in Tokyo this fall.Ludens sits at the center of the design, giving the collection a single, recognizable visual anchor. Rather than splashing game logos across the lineup, F.C.Real Bristol takes its cues from the studio’s symbol character, the masked, space-suited figure that has fronted Kojima Productions’ branding since its founding, and works those references into each product. The name itself nods to Homo Ludens, Johan Huizinga’s study of humans as playing beings, which ties directly into the philosophy behind the collaboration.The lineup sticks to a strict black-and-white palette and borrows its silhouettes from F.C.Real Bristol’s football training wardrobe. A black track jacket and matching track pants lead the range, each cut with contrasting white side panels printed with “FROM SAPIENS TO LUDENS” on one side and the Kojima Productions wordmark on the other, while the pants add a D-ring at the waist. A hooded black windbreaker carries a barcode graphic on the hood, a reflective-style emblem on the sleeve and “BEWARE OF LOOSE FASTENERS” printed near the hem, all nods to the studio’s sci-fi visual language. Every piece pairs Ludens with F.C.Real Bristol’s diamond Bristol emblem across the chest, placed side by side like club and sponsor crests.Shirting fills out the rest of the collection. A black short-sleeve game shirt is the most kit-like piece, with a large Kojima Productions wordmark across the chest split by a vertical barcode stripe and additional graphics on both sleeves. Short-sleeve and long-sleeve tees arrive in black and white with small chest logos, and the long sleeves carry the same “FROM SAPIENS TO LUDENS” and Kojima Productions text down each arm. items.title: Robert Pattinson Gives New Update on 'The Batman Part II' Production
items.text: Robert Pattinson Gives New Update on 'The Batman Part II' Production Summary Robert Pattinson has revealed that production on 'The Batman Part II' is officially back up and running following a brief hiatusDirector Steven Soderbergh has stepped in to shoot the final weeks of principal photography after Matt Reeves stepped away for a family matterReeves remains attached to oversee post-production alongside Soderbergh ahead of the film's scheduled February 18 2028 theatrical debut Warner Bros. and DC Studios have officially restarted filming on The Batman Part II with lead actor Robert Pattinson sharing a new update on the status of the production. Speaking to GamesRadar+, Pattinson confirmed the set is back active following a temporary pause.Filming on the anticipated sequel was briefly halted earlier this month after writer-director Matt Reeves stepped away to deal with an ongoing family matter. In response, award-winning director Steven Soderbergh reached out and offered to step behind the camera to finish the remaining weeks of principal photography with DC Studios' full support. Pattinson revealed his thoughts on Soderbergh joining the production team stating, "I am so happy he's come on to help Matt. It's incredibly generous of him – and he's doing it in the loveliest way. It's completely selfless." He addd, "I think Matt had put so much work into the script, and we're almost done. So for someone to come in and say, 'I just want to help Matt do it; I want to do it in conjunction with him and just get it to the edit.' And to have someone who's as talented as Steven doing it is great." Reeves confirmed on social media that he is not leaving the project and will collaborate closely with Soderbergh to fulfill his vision through post-production.Pattinson confirmed that cameras are rolling again and that he will return to set in a matter of days, "I think they're in production already. And I'm starting in a couple of days." The production sees Pattinson returning alongside Andy Serkis and Colin Farrell, with Scarlett Johansson, Sebastian Stan, Brian Tyree Henry, and Charles Dance joining the cast.The Batman Part II is scheduled to release in theaters on February 18, 2028. items.title: Aēsop’s 2026 Holiday Collection Is Designed for the Journey Home
items.text: Aēsop’s 2026 Holiday Collection Is Designed for the Journey Home Summary Aēsop’s 2026 holiday collection centers on homecoming, anticipation and shared rituals.Gift sets span fragrance, body care, incense, candles and seasonal accessories.Silver-toned reusable packaging and The Aēsop Valise extend the collection’s travel-inspired narrative. Aēsop welcomes the year-end season with "A time to embrace," its largest collection of seasonal Gift Kits to date. The freshly-unveiled campaign focuses on the journey toward reunion — a feeling captured in Elena Heatherwick’s accompanying film, which follows a family travelling by train, on foot and through snow to reach one another. That sense of movement carries into the range itself, spanning skin, body, fragrance and home rituals designed for moments shared or rediscovered.The lineup spans full-regimen body and skin kits alongside thoughtful interior objects, including Diaphos - a hand-blown amber glass lantern created to illuminate and diffuse Aromatique candles - and a curved, high-precision brass wick trimmer. Leading the curated gift sets are seasonal selections such as Rekindled Connections, a trio of 70-gram votive candles, the curatable Treasured Bonds fragrance and balm pairing, as well as specialized bundles dedicated to the house’s newly retitled Fragrant Fables library and staple Geranium Leaf formulations.Packaging becomes part of that return journey. The centerpiece, The Aēsop Valise, appears in the campaign as a silver suitcase lifted onto a train, opening to reveal 13 aromatic and practical gifts arranged in drawers that can be explored gradually like an Advent ritual or unpacked all at once. Across the wider collection, sturdy silver-hued boxes printed with Aēsopian motifs resemble compact pieces of luggage and are designed to be reused for keeping collected objects once their contents have been removed. Two limited seasonal editions heighten the metallic language: Resurrection Aromatique Hand Balm arrives in a striking silver tube, while the accompanying Hand Wash is housed in its own metal case and wrapped in furoshiki cloth, turning familiar formulations into objects prepared for departure and reunion.The complete “A time to embrace” collection is available globally for the 2026 festive season through Aēsop stores and online, with pricing ranging from $270 - $4,200 HKD / $50 - $600 USD. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Aesop (@aesop) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebe

items.title: Official Look at Nike and Eastside Golf's "Zero Gravity" Footwear Range
items.text: Official Look at Nike and Eastside Golf's "Zero Gravity" Footwear Range Summary Nike and Eastside Golf have teamed up on the Zero Gravity collection featuring the Infinity Next% Tour 3 and Air Max 90Both silhouettes incorporate galaxy patterns custom heel badges and specialized outsoles that leave distinct bunker imprintsThe designs feature dedicated insoles honoring Eastside Golf co-founder Olajuwon Ajanaku's late father ahead of an October 30 launch Name: Eastside Golf x Nike Air Max 90 G, Eastside Golf x Nike Infinity NEXT% Tour 3Colorway: Black/Dark Smoke Grey, Black/Black-Obsidian-Wild GrapeSKU: IO4670-001, IO4663-001MSRP: $140 USD, $200 USDRelease Date: October 30, 2026Where to Buy: Nike, Eastside GolfNike and Eastside Golf have joined forces once again to introduce the "Zero Gravity" sneaker range, delivering collaborative iterations of the Nike Infinity Next% Tour 3 and the Air Max 90 Golf. The collection translates themes of personal freedom and fluid movement into performance footwear tailored for the course and modern golf culture.Leading the collection's spiked performance is the Nike Infinity Next% Tour 3 x Eastside Golf, which features a textured black upper highlighted by reflective hits, metallic gold eyelets, and galaxy-themed accents. Outfitted with responsive Air Zoom cushioning and integrated spike traction, the shoe is finished with a translucent purple outsole displaying Swingman constellation artwork that leaves a Swoosh imprint in the sand. Alongside it, the Nike Air Max 90 x Eastside Golf is wrapped in galaxy-inspired patent leather detailed with debossed, repeated Eastside Golf typography. The shoe incorporates a metallic gold Swingman tongue emblem, visible heel Air cushioning, and a spikeless versatile outsole designed to press an "ESG" mark into bunker terrain.Both pairs feature custom co-branded Zero Gravity heel badges and canvas-inspired sockliners honoring the late father of Eastside Golf co-founder Olajuwon Ajanaku. “He’s on the insole of the shoes for a personal touch because he always wanted me to be weightless,” said Ajanaku. “You’re doing it your way, not letting anything hold you back. That’s what he would’ve wanted.”The Nike x Eastside Golf "Zero Gravity" pack launches on October 30, 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Bernini High Jewelry and Domenico Formichetti Craft 1-of-1 "ICEMAN & ADONIS" Bracelet for Drake's 40th Birthday
items.text: Bernini High Jewelry and Domenico Formichetti Craft 1-of-1 "ICEMAN & ADONIS" Bracelet for Drake's 40th Birthday Summary Bernini High Jewelry and Domenico Formichetti have created a one-of-one diamond bracelet gifted to Drake for his 40th birthdayHandcrafted in Italy from white gold the piece is set with natural gemstones and exceptional F-color VS clarity diamondsThe custom jewelry is designed to match the rapper's one-of-one $5 million USD ICEMAN Rolex Daytona Bernini High Jewelry and Italian designer Domenico Formichetti have unveiled the "ICEMAN & ADONIS" one-of-one diamond bracelet, custom-created as a 40th birthday gift for Drake.Tailor-made in Italy, the bespoke piece is forged from white gold and encrusted with hand-selected natural gemstones alongside exceptional F-color, VS clarity diamonds. Introduced under the collaborative banner "FREEZE THE WORLD," the design marries Formichetti’s streetwear sensibility with Bernini’s rigorous high-jewelry craftsmanship.The one-off piece was conceived specifically to complement Drake’s custom one-of-one "ICEMAN" Rolex Cosmograph Daytona. Valued at an estimated $5 million USD, the rare timepiece features a signature "Ice Gradient" bezel, a pavé diamond dial, and a commemorative "FREEZE THE WORLD" caseback engraving referencing the artist's ICEMAN era. Bernini and Formichetti’s matching bracelet echoes the icy visual theme of the watch, aligning identical gem-setting standards to create a cohesive high-jewelry pairing. items.title: WHOOP and Samuel Ross' SR_A Launch PROJECT TERRAIN Layer 2 Collection
items.text: WHOOP and Samuel Ross' SR_A Launch PROJECT TERRAIN Layer 2 Collection Summary WHOOP and Samuel Ross' SR_A design atelier have launched PROJECT TERRAIN Layer 2 as the second release of their multi-year partnershipThe limited-edition capsule delivers technical apparel outerwear accessories and new ATLAS bands configured for the WHOOP 5.0 and WHOOP MGBuilding upon Any-Wear technology the collection introduces modular pieces that allow sensor placement beyond the wrist Human performance brand WHOOP has officially released PROJECT TERRAIN Layer 2, marking the second collaborative collection developed alongside British designer Samuel Ross MBE and his design atelier, SR_A.Following the sold-out debut of the partnership in March, the limited-edition collection takes direct inspiration from the ongoing transition between urban landscapes and outdoor environments. The offering bridges Ross’s signature architectural design language with functional construction engineered for both active training and everyday wear.The collaborative range delivers a complete selection of technical apparel, outerwear, and accessories. Standout apparel pieces include a technical puffer, joggers, fitted tees, and a matching performance bra and leggings set. Expanding the hardware side of the ecosystem, the release introduces new ATLAS bands designed specifically for the WHOOP 5.0 and WHOOP MG. The capsule also advances WHOOP’s proprietary Any-Wear™ technology, developing modular garments and accessories that explore functional sensor placements beyond the wrist.The WHOOP x SR_A PROJECT TERRAIN Layer 2 collection is available now via Whoop, with apparel and accessory prices ranging from $60 to $650 USD and standalone bands priced at $99 USD. items.title: Nike ACG x Helinox Pack Featherweight Camp Furniture in Signature Orange
items.text: Nike ACG x Helinox Pack Featherweight Camp Furniture in Signature Orange Summary Nike ACG and Helinox have teamed up on a limited-edition collection of a chair, a table and a camp sack built for easy carryingThe chair and table use Helinox’s Ghostgrid, a see-through monofilament mesh reinforced with a ripstop gridEach piece carries ACG’s signature orange, contrasting materials and co-branded detailing Nike ACG and Helinox have unveiled a limited-edition collaboration made up of the Chair Zero LT, Table Zero LT and a 17L Camp Sack, a lightweight camp setup designed for quick stops on the trail. The collection merges ACG’s outdoor design language with Helinox’s packable furniture expertise, with every piece engineered to keep weight down without sacrificing durability.All three pieces share a common visual and material thread. ACG’s signature orange runs throughout the lineup, set against contrasting materials and co-branded details that tie the chair, table and sack together as one kit. The chair and table are both built with Helinox’s Ghostgrid, a translucent monofilament mesh laced with a reinforced ripstop grid. The material is designed to hit a balance between low weight and resistance to abrasion and wear, and its see-through finish gives both pieces a distinctly technical look.The Chair Zero LT anchors the collection with a strength-to-weight ratio that punches well above its size. It packs down to 534g yet holds up to 120kg, thanks to a shock-corded frame that pairs DAC TH72M aluminum alloy with nylon resin hubs. Reinforced corners lock the Ghostgrid seat into place, and an X-Strap spreads the chair’s footprint across more of the ground, keeping it steady on sand, mud or uneven terrain.The Table Zero LT is the lightest table in Helinox’s lineup, coming in at 254g packed while supporting up to 10kg. Built with backpackers and bikepackers in mind, it suits trips where every gram and every inch of pack space counts, and it goes from packed to standing in a matter of seconds.Rounding out the kit, the 17L Camp Sack offers a roomy main compartment and a pair of outer stash pockets, then folds completely flat when not in use. It is constructed from bluesign-certified 50D nylon ripstop and 300D ripstop and weighs only 134g. The ACG edition arrives in white with orange accents and a co-branded badge, giving the collection a lightweight way to haul outdoor essentials.The Nike ACG x Helinox collection lands November 2 exclusively via SportShoes in the UK. items.title: House of Errors Introduces Winter-Ready TOUT SCHUSS Collection
items.text: House of Errors Introduces Winter-Ready TOUT SCHUSS Collection Summary London-based label House of Errors has unveiled its latest winter clothing collection dubbed TOUT SCHUSSThe seasonal range immortalizes moments of hiemal joy featuring tactile design details like fleeced snow and embroidered tracksThe full collection officially launches on October 30 via the brand's official webstore London-based label House of Errors is gearing up for the colder months with the introduction of its TOUT SCHUSS Collection. Founded in 2020 by designer Fully, the brand continues its playful approach to luxury, blending imaginative storytelling with elevated craftsmanship to capture the essence of winter exploration.Built around a hankering for adventure far outside the city limits, the TOUT SCHUSS collection embraces cooler, less hospitable winter months. Taking inspiration from algid moments of hiemal joy, the range immortalizes scenes of classical seasonal merriment. Whether conceptualizing a ship breaking through miles of sheet ice, an open fire at a winter resort, or a rapid descent down a mountainside, the garments balance frozen aesthetics with a core of warmth.Operating outside traditional seasonal trend cycles, the London label prioritizes visual experimentation and manufacturing innovation. Throughout the new collection, these visual narratives are brought to life through intricate design details. Pieces feature textural elements like mounds of fleeced snow alongside the embroidered tracks of an explorer and his dog hot on the tail of a storm, resulting in a collection that depicts frozen moments tailored for crew expeditions or solo exploration.The House of Errors TOUT SCHUSS collection launches on October 30, 2026, at 7 p.m. BST via online. items.title: NFL Touched Down in Paris Last Week, Here’s What Happened
items.text: NFL Touched Down in Paris Last Week, Here’s What Happened Last Sunday, the first-ever NFL game in France took place at Stade de France. A landmark moment for American football, the league made sure to mark its arrival with a jam-packed schedule of events, retail pop-ups, and fan-zone activations around Paris. The week kicked off with the opening of a dedicated NFL Shop presented by American Express in Galerie Joseph. As a temporary home for all things NFL, the pop-up brought Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints team merch to the central Marais district, as well as limited-edition collaborations from Fear of God, Peace Collective, and other streetwear labels. For those looking to explore more American football-inspired fashion, Citadium transformed its space with a New Era activation, where New Orleans Saints star Cameron Jordan popped by for a meet-and-greet. Elsewhere at Galeries Lafayette Haussmann, Sweet Pants unveiled its NFL-focused streetwear, while Casablanca and PSG also brought their French heritage to collections displayed at their flagship stores.Later in the week, the league teamed up with Adobe to launch the NFL House. Taking over Pavillon Cambon-Caulines, the 1,600 m² space was curated with exhibits of memorabilia, including the Super Bowl rings and the Vince Lombardi Trophy, while hands-on workshops set out to immerse fans in the cultural side of American football. Continuing to wave the NFL flag across Paris, several iconic locations played host to special activations. The Eiffel Tower, for example, welcomed a new installation by Louisiana-born artist Jammie Holmes. As part of the “COLOR FIELD” project, the piece framed a football field at the foot of the monument with hand-painted end zones. At Seine, a Hail Mary contest caught the attention of onlookers as players attempted to get the ball over the river in excitement for the long-awaited game. The celebrations culminated on Sunday with the Steelers vs. Saints face-off. Over 78,000 fans were in attendance, and thousands more tuned in, turning the debut NFL game in France into a global moment for the sport. After the first half, Burna Boy took the field for a headline show, performing hits “Ye,” “On the Low,” and “4 Kampe.” As the second half kicked off, the Saints hoped to flip the lead but fell short as the Steelers took the victory. Take a look back at a week of NFL in France via the gallery above. You can find out more about NFL fixtures on the league’s website. Click here to vie

items.title: Netflix Examines College Title IX Accountability in 'Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell'
items.text: Netflix Examines College Title IX Accountability in 'Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell' Summary Netflix has revealed the latest installment of its quick-turn documentary series titled 'Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell'The investigative project examines university Title IX proceedings and campus safety following a student lawsuit against the institutionFeaturing interviews with New York Governor Kathy Hochul and student journalists the film is scheduled to premiere on October 29 Netflix has officially announced its upcoming investigative release, Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell. The quick-turn documentary examines the institutional fallout of a high-profile campus sexual assault lawsuit and scrutinizes university Title IX systems.The documentary centers on the legal action brought by Jane Doe, a former Cornell University student who alleges she was drugged and raped at the school's Chi Phi fraternity house in October 2024. As the incident sparked widespread campus protests and intensified national scrutiny surrounding collegiate accountability, the film investigates whether institutional reporting mechanisms, specifically campus police and Title IX offices, deliver on their intended promise of protection and due process.Produced by Words + Pictures with Steve Yaccino serving as showrunner, the installment features interviews with New York Governor Kathy Hochul, Jane Doe's attorney Thomas Giuffra, and former Brown University Title IX coordinator Amanda Walsh. The narrative also incorporates firsthand insights from The Cornell Daily Sun editor-in-chief Sophia Dasser, senior editor Cereese Qusba, a former fraternity president, and a recent alumna who navigated the school's Title IX procedures.Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell, the fifth installment in the streamer's ongoing series, premieres on Netflix on October 29, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: SOLDIER Reimagines the PUMA Suede Through Nigerian Heritage
items.text: SOLDIER Reimagines the PUMA Suede Through Nigerian Heritage Summary London-based Nigerian artist SOLDIER reimagines the PUMA Suede with his signature camouflage motif and imagery drawn from his personal archive.Created to coincide with his recent New York solo exhibition, the sneaker will be released exclusively to friends and family. PUMA has teamed up with London-based Nigerian artist SOLDIER, also known as Leonard Iheagwam, to reinterpret its iconic Suede silhouette through a deeply personal exploration of cultural identity, memory and heritage.Created to coincide with the artist’s recent New York solo exhibition, Reveal Yourself, Softly, the limited-edition sneaker incorporates imagery drawn from SOLDIER’s personal archive alongside his signature camouflage motif. The design translates elements of his multidisciplinary practice into wearable form, bridging the worlds of contemporary art and streetwear.Born in Lagos, Nigeria, SOLDIER has developed a distinct visual language rooted in personal history, military iconography and found imagery. His work frequently examines themes of identity, collective memory and the lasting influence of colonial histories, transforming familiar symbols into layered compositions that challenge their original meanings.The collaboration further underscores the growing global influence of African creative communities, positioning the PUMA Suede as a canvas for cultural storytelling and artistic expression.The PUMA x SOLDIER Suede will be released exclusively to friends and family, with no public release currently announced. items.title: You Can Now Spend the Night at a Jean Prouvè-Designed Home
items.text: You Can Now Spend the Night at a Jean Prouvè-Designed Home A Modernist home designed by Jean Prouvè and his son Claude has been restored and transformed into a guesthouse, offering a chance to stay inside an architectural gem. The home, named Maison Prouvè 58, is located near the French village of Saint-Paul-de-Vence – an area once known as a creative haven for artists and writers, filled with galleries and museums. A rare example of mid-century French prefabricated architecture, it was completed back in 1958, and marked the first collaboration between Prouvè and his son. Its distinctly modernist exterior sees huge windows run the length of one side of the building, looking out onto the surrounding Mediterranean landscape. Inside, the house is organised around a central corridor – one side leads to two bedrooms a playroom, and a bathroom. The other opens out on to the communal areas, a kitchen, dining area and living room. Not only would you be living within a slice of architectural history, you'd be living amongst objects equally as significant. Furniture throughout has been chosen to complement the building, and brings together some of the most influential figures of 20th century design, including the likes of Charlotte Perriand, Pierre Jeanneret and Le Corbusier. Bookings for Maison Prouvè are now being taken. You can find out more on the agency website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: adidas Originals by Wales Bonner FW26 Reimagines Retro Sportswear Through Refined Tailoring
items.text: adidas Originals by Wales Bonner FW26 Reimagines Retro Sportswear Through Refined Tailoring Summary adidas Originals and Wales Bonner revisit their collaborative archive for FW26.Leather outerwear, pinstripe tracksuits and retro football-inspired pieces blend sportswear with refined tailoring.Harley Weir's campaign channels 1980s London ahead of the October 29 launch. For Fall/Winter 2026, adidas Originals and Wales Bonner are looking back to move forward, revisiting the design codes that have defined their longstanding partnership. Rather than simply reproducing past favorites, the latest collection reinterprets the collaboration's signature blend of athletic heritage and sartorial refinement, bringing rich jewel tones, elevated materials and nostalgic sportswear silhouettes into a contemporary wardrobe. The collection continues Grace Wales Bonner's exploration of cultural identity through fashion, where European tailoring traditions intersect with Afro-Atlantic influences and the visual language of sport. This season, that dialogue takes inspiration from the spirit of 1980s London, a period of cultural convergence and youthful experimentation that also informs the accompanying campaign, photographed by Harley Weir.At the heart of the ready-to-wear offering is a premium leather blouson in Wales Bonner's signature bark color, distinguished by crochet side stripes and subtle tonal embossed branding. Its refined construction sets the tone for a collection that moves between tailored elegance and the relaxed familiarity of athletic uniforms. A double-knit jersey tracksuit offers a more traditional interpretation of sportswear, while a pinstripe track top and matching shorts introduce a sartorial twist to the classic coordinated set.Elsewhere, a collared football top with matching trousers draws on vintage sporting references, translating the familiar codes of football apparel into a more considered everyday silhouette. The interplay between structured and relaxed dressing gives the collection a distinct sense of versatility, allowing individual pieces to move beyond their original sporting associations.Completing the apparel lineup are stirrup-detailed track pants, a long-sleeve knit and double-logo T-shirts, alongside accessories such as a neoprene bag with crocodile leather-inspired paneling, a lanyard and two pairs of socks. The accompanying footwear lineup includes the crocodile-stamped WB Karintha and WB Gazelle Snake, the suede-crafted WB ADIZERO Adios

items.title: adidas Originals Unveils the ADAPTIK ONE Carabiner Watch
items.text: adidas Originals Unveils the ADAPTIK ONE Carabiner Watch Summary adidas Originals launched the ADAPTIK ONE, a convertible 2-way carabiner wristwatch.The 38mm aluminum timepiece features a digital display and silicone band.Priced at ¥20,900 JPY (APPROX. $132 USD), the versatile watch drops on November 27. adidas Originals is rethinking where a watch needs to be worn with the new ADAPTIK ONE, a digital timepiece that shifts between a conventional wristwatch and a carabiner-style hanging watch.Built around a clean 38mm square aluminum case, the design pairs a digital display with a color-matched silicone strap for a lightweight, sport-inflected look that leans naturally into the label’s streetwear vocabulary. A sliding mechanism allows the watch head to be transferred to the included carabiner attachment, letting it hang from a belt loop, bag or other accessories rather than remaining fixed to the wrist. The lineup spans three references in blue, black and green, giving the functional concept a simple color-led identity.Underneath the playful format, the ADAPTIK ONE keeps its specifications deliberately straightforward, using a battery-powered digital quartz movement alongside stopwatch, calendar and backlight functions, with a 38mm-wide, 11.5mm-thick case weighing approximately 45 grams and offering 3 ATM water resistance.More than a conventional watch with an interchangeable strap, the design treats the timepiece as a wearable accessory that can move between the wrist and clothing depending on the styling. Each of the three colorways is officially priced at ¥20,900 JPY (approx. $132 USD), the adidas Originals ADAPTIK ONE is scheduled to release in Japan on November 27, 2026 via the brand's website. items.title: Maison Margiela and NUDAKE Serve Tea With a Deconstructed Twist
items.text: Maison Margiela and NUDAKE Serve Tea With a Deconstructed Twist Summary Maison Margiela and NUDAKE reinterpret tea rituals through deconstructed porcelain and shared forms.Bianchetto finishes, warped rims and joined saucers define the “OOPS” aesthetic.The collection launches October 30 at NUDAKE TEAHOUSE in Seoul. Maison Margiela and NUDAKE are turning tea time into an exercise in controlled imperfection. Dubbed “OOPS,” the pair’s first collaboration takes the Maison’s deconstructive codes away from fashion and applies them to porcelain, tea and the ritual of sharing a pot.Much of the collection is washed in Margiela’s signature Bianchetto treatment, giving otherwise familiar tea objects a deliberately unfinished, timeworn character. A sculptural teapot anchors the range with a metal ring at its lid and the house’s recognizable four-stitch detail pressed into its body, while accompanying cups distort the expected symmetry of traditional teaware through gently warped rims and a joined double saucer intended for two.That idea of two people sharing one experience runs through more than the ceramics. NUDAKE’s accompanying Oops black tea takes inspiration from the image of a dark crimson plum being crushed beneath a leather shoe, translating the scene into a blend layered with delicate herbs, sweet fruit and earthy notes. An Oops Tea Bag physically joins two sachets together so that two cups can be steeped at once, while two limited Oops Loose Leaf editions extend the blend into collectible tins.A co-branded tea tumbler rounds out the functional pieces, carrying the same pared-back white finish into a more everyday format. Across the collection, Margiela’s preference for disrupting archetypes meets NUDAKE’s more playful approach to food and sensory design, making the smallest irregularities — a crooked rim, an exposed stitch or a shared saucer — central to the experience.Maison Margiela x NUDAKE “OOPS” launches on October 30, 2026 at 11 a.m. KST, with the collection offered through the NUDAKE TEAHOUSE at HAUS NOWHERE SEOUL in Seongsu-dong. The release will also be accompanied by an installation built from roughly 1,500 glasses and a glass-harp performance by Polish artists GlassDuo, extending the collaboration’s themes of chance, sound and imperfect beauty into the surrounding space. For more information, visit NUDAKE's official website. View this post on Instagram A post shared by NUDAKE (@nu_dake) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The PUMA x NAHMIAS Suede Crochet Goes From Earthy to Electric
items.text: The PUMA x NAHMIAS Suede Crochet Goes From Earthy to Electric Name: PUMA x NAHMIAS Suede CrochetMSRP: TBCRelease Date: November 5Where to Buy: NAHMIAS, PUMAPUMA and NAHMIAS build on their first Suede collaboration with three new colorways of the Suede Crochet, continuing the partnership’s mix of sport, craftsmanship and West Coast streetwear.Under the “Crafted Classics” banner, the trio gives PUMA’s familiar low-top three distinctly different personalities: one arrives in tonal chocolate brown suede with a lighter brown crochet Formstrip, another pairs a rich green suede upper with a bright yellow Formstrip, while the third goes bolder in electric blue with contrasting yellow accents.Across all three, chunky multicolored hand-crocheted laces amplify the handcrafted feel, complemented by premium suede, canvas accents and a co-branded PUMA x NAHMIAS tongue label. The crochet Formstrips add a raised, tactile texture against the smoother suede base, giving the classic silhouette a softer and more artisanal finish without obscuring its recognizable proportions.The detailing continues inside with “Let’s Be Friends” printed along the lining, while additional crochet lace sets allow the already colorful designs to be further customized. Skate and basketball references remain part of the collection’s foundation, but NAHMIAS filters those sporting cues through its relaxed California aesthetic, turning the Suede into an everyday style built around texture and craft. The launch is accompanied by a multi-city activation inspired by the label’s fictional Cornballs cereal, with surprise-filled boxes offering collectibles, sneaker redemption tickets and $1,000 USD NAHMIAS.com golden tickets.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.text: Official Look at Corteiz x Nike Shox R419 "Game Royal" Summary Corteiz and Nike are expanding their collaborative catalog with an overhauled take on the Shox R4 dubbed the Shox R419The Game Royal edition features a redesigned upper highlighted by raised horizontal ridges carbon fiber paneling and car-inspired accentsReleasing alongside Black and Metallic Silver iterations the pair is slated to drop for Holiday 2026 at a retail price of $190 USD Name: Corteiz x Nike Shox R419 "Game Royal"Colorway: Game Royal/University Red-BlackSKU: IQ9951-400MSRP: $190 USDRelease Date: Holiday 2026Where to Buy: NikeNike and Clint419's London-based streetwear label Corteiz have unveiled official imagery for their collaborative Corteiz x Nike Shox R419 "Game Royal". items.title: Japanese Artisans Rework Vintage Polo Ralph Lauren for Reimagined Collection at PoloFest Tokyo
items.text: Japanese Artisans Rework Vintage Polo Ralph Lauren for Reimagined Collection at PoloFest Tokyo Summary Polo Ralph Lauren has showcased its Reimagined collection at the inaugural PoloFest celebration in TokyoJapanese craftspeople including Yui Narita and Mitsugu Sasaki utilized traditional boro mending and embroidery across archival Polo silhouettesEach reworked piece is offered through a charity raffle with all proceeds benefiting Ralph Lauren's Pink Pony cancer initiative Polo Ralph Lauren has officially presented its one-of-a-kind "Reimagined" collection during the inaugural PoloFest activation in Tokyo. The installation brings together prominent Japanese artisans to breathe new life into vintage Polo garments using traditional mending and restoration techniques.The collection repurposes pre-worn garments into tactile, textured works of art. Key pieces on display include classic chinos embroidered with smiley face emoji patterns, heavily patchworked ties and hats rebuilt with layered fabric scraps, and distressed denim baseball caps stitched with individual red felt letters spelling out "RALPH." The initiative highlights master craftspeople such as Yui Narita, founder of Osaka vintage store Brown Tabby Works, alongside Mitsugu Sasaki of Sasaki Yōhinten, who applied the traditional Japanese practice of boro to repair and reinforce garments through hand-sewn fabric layering.The showcase directly reflects Ralph Lauren’s personal reverence for well-loved clothing, echoing the designer's philosophy that "where wear becomes character, repair becomes art, and every stitch creates a new patina." Serving as the opening activation ahead of the brand's 60th anniversary in 2027, the three-day PoloFest gathering honors Japan’s longstanding connection to the label since its arrival in 1976, celebrating decades of local craftsmanship and classic Americana.The Polo Ralph Lauren Reimagined pieces are available exclusively via charity raffle at PoloFest Tokyo, with all proceeds directly supporting the Pink Pony initiative to fight cancer. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Instagram Challenges YouTube With New 90-Minute Longform Video Uploads
items.text: Instagram Challenges YouTube With New 90-Minute Longform Video Uploads Summary Instagram has begun testing a new upload format dubbed Features allowing creators to share longform videos up to 90 minutes in lengthThe initiative aims to connect short-form Reels with in-depth video content optimized for mobile viewing and the Instagram TV appCurrently undergoing trials in Brazil the test is slated to expand to select creators across the United States Instagram has officially begun testing "Features", a new upload format enabling creators to share longform videos up to 90 minutes in length. The move marks a strategic shift toward extended media after years of prioritizing short-form video.The feature represents Instagram’s most notable longform endeavor since sunsetting IGTV. Explaining the pivot, Instagram VP of Product Tessa Lyons noted, "Reels is still going to be a core part of Instagram. But when you want to go deeper with the creators you love and the content that they’re creating, you should be able to do that on Instagram.” To build an interconnected system, the platform is testing "Clips as Reels," allowing creators to turn snippets into links pointing to full-length uploads, alongside options to push playback directly to the Instagram TV app.Addressing the strategy, Instagram head Adam Mosseri shared, “The thing that the team has been working on that we’re excited to share with you is trying to make it so that the short-form and the long-form video can be symbiotic. We’re going to try to support these different types of formats, both in the mobile app, but also on the TV app... I’m actually very excited about it, and we’re very committed to it long term.”Currently undergoing trials in Brazil, testing for "Features" and "Clips as Reels" will soon expand to select creators across the United States. View this post on InstagramA post shared by Colin and Samir (@colinandsamir) View this post on InstagramA post shared by Adam Mosseri (@mosseri) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘Resident Evil’ Could End Within the Next Decade
items.text: ‘Resident Evil’ Could End Within the Next Decade Summary Resident Evil producer Jun Takeuchi reveals the overarching story may conclude within ten years. Resident Evil: Requiem recently capped off Capcom’s initial ten-year strategic roadmap.Multiple future titles will definitively wrap up the iconic survival horror franchise arcs. Resident Evil may finally have an endgame in sight — at least for the overarching story Capcom has been building across its modern games. Speaking in an interview originally published by Yahoo Japan, franchise executive producer Jun Takeuchi revealed that the current narrative could reach its conclusion within the next decade.Takeuchi explained that Capcom began developing a 10-year strategy while planning 2019’s Resident Evil 2 remake, with the order of subsequent remakes and mainline entries forming part of a broader direction for the series. With Resident Evil Requiem arriving earlier this year, Takeuchi said he considers that first decade-long phase effectively complete, adding that he expects the larger storyline to reach its conclusion during the next 10 years. His comments refer specifically to the ongoing narrative rather than suggesting Capcom intends to retire the Resident Evil franchise altogether.That conclusion is unlikely to arrive through a single final game. Takeuchi confirmed that Capcom has “multiple titles” planned before reaching that point, although he stopped short of revealing how many or what shape the remaining story will take. The comments add further context to the company’s modern approach to Resident Evil, which has developed along parallel tracks through new numbered installments and remakes of earlier entries, with Takeuchi noting that the series’ wider narrative was never completely mapped out from the beginning but instead expanded with each release.Following the resurgence that began with 2017’s Resident Evil 7: Biohazard, Capcom has alternated between new chapters and reinterpretations of its back catalog, most recently culminating in Requiem. The next confirmed project is Resident Evil: Code Veronica, a remake of Code: Veronica currently scheduled for 2027, suggesting there remains plenty of ground to cover before the franchise’s present storyline reaches its eventual endpoint. items.title: First Look at Nike’s Ovolo 2.0 Sneaker-Heel Hybrid Revival
items.text: First Look at Nike’s Ovolo 2.0 Sneaker-Heel Hybrid Revival Name: Nike Ovolo 2.0SKU: TBCRelease Date: Holiday 2026Nike is continuing its streak of reviving obscure, experimental designs from the mid-2000s with a first look at the highly unusual Nike Ovolo 2.0. Revealed by Nike via its latest SNKRS Verified product preview, the upcoming model re-engineers a seldom-seen sneaker heel originally introduced in 2004.Slated to arrive exclusively in women's sizing for the Holiday 2026 season, the Ovolo 2.0 will debut in two bold colorways: a sleek, monochromatic "Black" and a futuristic "Metallic Silver." The Ovolo 2.0 functions as a striking hybrid, pulling heavy inspiration from the iconic Nike Shox R4. Its sleek leather upper retains much of the R4’s original DNA, most notably via the squared-off tongue and the small perforated section near the tip of the toe.However, Nike introduces key modern updates to the 2.0 — the lateral Swoosh branding is now seamlessly embossed directly into the premium leather rather than applied as a separate panel, resulting in a cleaner, more streamlined finish.The biggest update sits underfoot. Instead of recreating the original Ovolo’s heel, Nike has opened up the architecture further, creating more negative space between the raised heel structure and the outsole for a lighter, more exaggerated profile. Glossy sculpted tooling wraps the rear of the shoe, with stacked plates beneath the heel designed to produce some of the springy sensation associated with Shox cushioning without relying on its familiar exposed columns.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: A24’s ‘Elden Ring’ Movie Is Reportedly a $200 Million USD Epic
items.text: A24’s ‘Elden Ring’ Movie Is Reportedly a $200 Million USD Epic Summary A24’s Elden Ring adaptation reportedly carries a $175 - $200 million USD budget.Amazon MGM acquired international streaming rights ahead of the AFM presentation.The dark fantasy epic hits IMAX theaters on March 3, 2028. A24’s Elden Ring movie is quickly becoming one of the studio’s most ambitious productions to date. According to Deadline, Alex Garland’s live-action adaptation is carrying a reported production budget of between $175 million and $200 million USD, with sources placing the figure closer to the upper end. The same report also states that the film is now in post-production and heading to November’s American Film Market, where A24 will present the project to international buyers.Amazon MGM Studios has reportedly already secured pay-one streaming rights across a large number of international markets in a deal believed to be worth tens of millions of dollars, covering the film’s post-theatrical window rather than replacing its cinema release.Much of the project nevertheless remains under unusually tight wraps. It's reported that A24 has been sending representatives to supervise prospective buyers as they read Garland’s screenplay, while portions of the story are being withheld to prevent major plot details from leaking. The script is said to run at least 180 pages including visual material - a detail highlighted by IGN in its follow-up coverage - raising speculation that the finished film could approach three hours, although no official runtime has been announced.What has been formally confirmed by A24 and Bandai Namco is Garland’s role as writer-director, the full ensemble cast - including Kit Connor, Ben Whishaw, Cailee Spaeny, Tom Burke, Havana Rose Liu, Sonoya Mizuno, Jonathan Pryce, Ruby Cruz, Nick Offerman, John Hodgkinson, Jefferson Hall, Emma Laird and Peter Serafinowicz — and that the film is being made for IMAX. Based on FromSoftware’s 2022 action RPG, created under Hidetaka Miyazaki with mythology written by George R.R. Martin, Elden Ring is officially scheduled to open in theaters on March 3, 2028. items.title: Sounds Like Paulin Launches Paris Music Sessions and STILLZ Polaroid Archive
items.text: Sounds Like Paulin Launches Paris Music Sessions and STILLZ Polaroid Archive Summary Sounds Like Paulin has launched a dedicated YouTube channel hosting exclusive musical performances recorded inside the Paulin House in ParisSeason 1 features collaborative sessions between artists including Eartheater, Sega Bodega, the Tixier brothers, and IbeyiA companion visual project by STILLZ and the Polaroid Foundation documents over 250 creatives using the rare 1976 Polaroid 20x24 camera Sounds Like Paulin, the cultural label, recording studio, and listening space rooted in the legacy of designer Pierre Paulin, has officially launched the Sounds Like Paulin Sessions. Filmed and recorded inside the historic Paulin House in Paris, the cross-disciplinary initiative debuts on YouTube with live musical performances set against the late designer’s iconic furniture.Conceived as a dedicated space for creative exchange, the Sessions bring together emerging talents and established figures across genres including rap, classical, electronic, jazz, and experimental music. Season 1 highlights include Eartheater performing "Paradise Rains" from her album Heavenly Body alongside longtime collaborator Sega Bodega and French jazz musicians the Tixier brothers. The broader program features appearances from Mora, Ibeyi, Eddy de Pretto, Quatuor Zaïde, and NSDOS featuring Theo Croker.Running alongside the musical programming, Sounds Like Paulin teamed up with the Polaroid Foundation and filmmaker STILLZ to produce an extensive visual archive documenting the community surrounding the House. Transforming the space into a temporary studio, STILLZ captured over 250 artists and cultural figures using the historic Polaroid 20×24 camera—a rare large-format system engineered in 1976 and famously employed by Andy Warhol, Ansel Adams, and Chuck Close.Check out Sounds Like Paulin Sessions on the imprint's official YouTube channel. items.text: From Countless Chicken Nuggets to Custom PCs, Locals Reveal Their Wild New York Lottery Dream Purchases When we hit the pavement in Soho, the conversations aren’t always about what you’re wearing, so we switched up to ask about what you’d do if you bagged a life-changing payout. Alongside the New York Lottery for our popular "Ask the Community" segment, our host Eric took to the streets to ask locals something somewhat simple: "What would you do if you won the New York Lottery?" What followed was a hilarious, unfiltered look into the practical, bizarre, and brilliant minds of New Yorkers and their dreams. View this post on InstagramA post shared by HYPEBEAST (@hypebeast) Instead of standard answers about buying mansions or yachts, the responses got delightfully specific real fast. One interviewee bypassed real estate entirely, immediately declaring her priority: "8,000 chicken nuggets!" A gamer leaned into tech specs, sharing, "I'm gonna hire the dude that knows the best about PCs, and he's gonna build me the dream PC." Fashion heads naturally stayed true to form, with one guy hunting down a "really faded Twisted Sister shirt," while our own Eric spotted a military Humvee parked on the curb and admitted on the spot, "Dude, I would buy that right there!"The humor kept rolling as we chatted with different crowds across the block. When asked what he'd do first, one local hit back with an eco-agrarian route, laughing, "Buy a couple cows, got some chickens... and I'm a millionaire!" Meanwhile, one boyfriend casually mapped out his math: "75 million in the stock market” while the rest goes to his partner as she comically asks, “to me?”. He politely and smartly abides. From a guy planning an "Alaskan kickback" to a cosplayer traveling the world for conventions and someone wanting to open an open-water survival swim school, the energy was pure, unfiltered joy.That fun, unscripted vibe is exactly the point of the campaign. By capturing real community members talking candidly about their dream purchases, we turn abstract jackpot numbers into tangible, exciting possibilities. It grounds the New York Lottery’s signature "Can You Imagine?" tagline directly in street culture, proving that winning isn't just about cash but about total freedom to pursue whatever ridiculous, wonderful thing brings you joy.Whether your ultimate dream is a treehouse in Bali, a fleet of farm animals, or just an endless supply of crispy chicken nuggets, it all starts with a single ticket. items.title: Lamborghini Revuelto SV: The "Smartest" Super Veloce Ever Made
items.text: Lamborghini Revuelto SV: The "Smartest" Super Veloce Ever Made Among car enthusiasts, there's performance cars, the high-performance variants of them, and then the seriously hardcore versions. Many go by multiple acronyms: GT, RS, Type R, etc. Lamborghini's is as straight forward as possible – Super Veloce "Super Fast," or simply SV.Last weekend we were invited to a private Test Drive of the brand new Lamborghini Revuelto SV, an ultra-hardcore variation of the hybridized Revuelto. While performance was always the name of the game for the Raging Bull's flagship super car, the SV focuses on specific improvements and gains. For the Revuelto, the brand did this smarter, to create a more focused vehicle.We tested the new Revuelto SV and all of its capabilities in Rome's premier race track – Autodromo Vallelunga. The technology is new, the considerations are high, and the SV name speaks for itself. And while previous iterations of Super Veloce may have been just more of everything, Lamborghini were clever and strategic with this one.The SV Levels up Your Look and Just as Much as Your DriveAcross Lamborghini's history of Super Veloce vehicles – beginning with the Miura and most recently the Aventador – the SV moniker mostly denoted a new level of extremity. Heightened performance, lightened chassis, and reworked aerodynamics were always key upgrades, but for the Revuelto, the brand had a lot more to work with thanks to modern technologies.The brand was pretty open about what the SV brought to the table: "Everything that could have been updated, was." Bold statement. But our time and experience with the Reveulto SV confirmed this claim and we were equally shocked and impressed. Aerodynamics arrived in the form as much more aggressive front, side, and rear bumper designs. The new wing was highly developed, to work in conjunction with a gurney flap which is also bespoke to the SV. Aggressive looks only go so far – the Revuelto SV focused on these upgrades with 100% functionality in mind, maximizing on what the car can do on the track.Alongside aero, we were also educated on other upgrades that the SV utilized, some of which may have come as a surprise. For instance, the suspension of the standard Revuelto featured electronic adjustability in dampening, while the SV's KW coilover adjustments are passive – set them out-of-vehicle and tune as necessary for track use. items.title: NORQAIN Gives Its Lightest Watch a Turquoise Treatment
items.text: NORQAIN Gives Its Lightest Watch a Turquoise Treatment Summary NORQAIN released the 45-gram Wild ONE Skeleton X-Lite Turquoise.It features a carbon fiber X-Lite case and a COSC-certified movement.Limited to 300 yearly pieces, it retails for $13,900 USD. NORQAIN is bringing its signature color to its lightest watch yet with the new Wild ONE Skeleton X-Lite Turquoise, following the debut of the first X-Lite Limited Edition earlier on in the year. Weighing just 45 grams, the 41mm sports watch builds on the Wild ONE’s multi-part architecture with more than 30 individual components spanning NORTEQ®, titanium, aluminum, rubber and the proprietary X-Lite carbon-fiber composite. Developed with Swiss material specialist BIWI as an evolution of NORTEQ®, X-Lite forms the internal casing ring and is engineered around low weight and shock absorption. Unlike the earlier limited edition, the turquoise model joins the brand’s permanent collection, although production will be capped at 300 pieces per year worldwide.Visually, vivid turquoise cuts through the predominantly black construction, appearing across the rubber shock absorbers, crown, skeletonized dial details and strap. The case combines black NORTEQ® top, bottom and side components with a sandblasted black-DLC titanium container and aluminum caseback, while turquoise Super-LumiNova outlines the indexes and tips of the black-plated hands.Two strap configurations reinforce the performance-driven aesthetic: one pairs black and turquoise rubber in a double-layer construction, with perforations revealing the brighter layer underneath, while the second combines a perforated black rubber upper with an interchangeable turquoise stretch band designed to conform naturally around the wrist. Despite its lightweight construction, the watch retains 100 meters of water resistance and sapphire crystal on both sides.Inside sits the COSC-certified NORQAIN 4K Manufacture Calibre NK26/1, an automatic skeleton movement developed in collaboration with AMT. Its openworked bridges and oscillating weight take inspiration from mountain peaks, while a 28,800 vph frequency and 65-hour power reserve underpin its everyday specifications.NORQAIN will present the Wild ONE Skeleton X-Lite Turquoise at Mavericks of Time in Abu Dhabi, before making it available from October 29, 2026 through selected NORQAIN boutiques and retailers worldwide. items.text: 10 Horror Films and Series to Watch This Halloween The 2026 Halloween season is delivering a feast of new horror, spanning cinematic sequels and high-concept streaming series. Never too late to start a Halloween horror marathon, fans can hack into their fear with a deep lineup of psychological and supernatural thrills ahead of the festivities this week.Leading the charge is the return of iconic horror lore: the Friday the 13th prequel series Crystal Lake (Peacock) explores the bloody origins of Pamela Voorhees and the cursed summer camp, while Carrie (Amazon Prime Video) delivers a modernized, extended series adaptation of Stephen King’s telekinetic classic. Adding to established mythos on the big screen, Clayface (Theatrical) reimagines the tragic Batman villain as a desperate, shape-shifting actor in a grounded psychological monster movie, and American Horror Story, season 13 (Disney+) returns to its roots with gruesome murders and occult rituals at a prestigious New England boarding school.For original scares, prepare for high-concept genre blends with the likes of Below (Netflix), a deep-sea sci-fi thriller trapping a research crew with a terrifying aquatic organism, and Other Mommy (Theatrical), a slow-burn psychological nightmare about a mother usurped by her sinister doppelganger. If you prefer gripping suspense and survival, Whalefall (Theatrical) traps a scuba diver inside a sperm whale to confront his past, while Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen (Netflix) builds agonizing atmospheric dread around a doomed couple heading toward a destination wedding, and Christmas at the Kringles (Theatrical) subverts the upcoming holidays with a pitch-black slasher centered on yuletide human sacrifice. Finally, Netflix and Ryan Murphy bring Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story to your homes, as it continues the hit true-crime anthology by dissecting the intense household dynamics and repressed anger behind the infamous 1892 axe slayings.Get ready to check these off your list for a perfectly spooky October and take a look below at the full recommendation of films and series for this horror-filled Halloween season.Clayface - Film (In Theaters, Available Now)Directed by horror auteur Mike Flanagan, this standalone DC Elseworlds film reimagines the classic Batman villain through a dark, psychological horror lens. items.title: Pedro Pascal Conducts Tony Gilroy's 'Behemoth!' in Director's First Film in 14 Years
items.text: Pedro Pascal Conducts Tony Gilroy's 'Behemoth!' in Director's First Film in 14 Years Summary Tony Gilroy has unveiled the official trailer for Behemoth! starring Pedro Pascal as a cellist scoring films in Los AngelesThe nonlinear narrative features original compositions from nine acclaimed composers including Michael Giacchino and Alan SilvestriThe ensemble cast stars Olivia Wilde alongside Will Arnett and Matthew Lillard marking Gilroy's first feature film in 14 years Filmmaker Tony Gilroy has officially unveiled the trailer for his upcoming drama Behemoth!, starring Pedro Pascal as a classical cellist returning to Los Angeles to score motion pictures. The project marks the director’s first feature film in 14 years following a celebrated reception at the New York Film Festival.The formally ambitious, character-driven narrative chronicles two decades in the life of cellist Alex Serian (Pascal), exploring the unresolved reasons behind his departure and return. Constructed around a nonlinear, music-led framework where musical cues trigger memories spanning 20 years, the film consistently intercuts between live orchestral performances and Alex’s real life. Rather than serving as passive background accompaniment, the score functions as an active narrative device reflecting his personal turning points.To establish the film's complex musical architecture, Gilroy enlisted nine distinct composers—Michael Giacchino, Alan Silvestri, James Newton Howard, Michael Abels, Henry Jackman, Emily Bear, Lukas Frank, Nami Melumad, and Brandon Roberts—each scoring a different fictional movie within the story. The ensemble cast features Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, Alexa Swinton, Will Arnett, and Matthew Lillard, arriving as Gilroy’s first feature since 2012’s The Bourne Legacy and his acclaimed tenure helming Andor.Behemoth! premieres in theaters on December 4. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Onitsuka Tiger Gives the “Paraty” Mexico 66 a Furry Makeover
items.text: Onitsuka Tiger Gives the “Paraty” Mexico 66 a Furry Makeover Name: Onitsuka Tiger “Paraty” Mexico 66MSRP: $190 USDRelease Date: Available NOWWhere to Buy: Onitsuka TigerOnitsuka Tiger gives its enduring “Paraty” Mexico 66 a decidedly softer personality for Fall/Winter 2026, wrapping the laceless silhouette in long-pile faux fur. Leading the latest treatment is a monochromatic “Faded Yellow” colorway, which coats the upper, lining, eyelets and rubber tooling in a pale, slightly washed yellow. The shaggy surface introduces visible shifts in texture and shadow across the otherwise tonal build, while smoother suede-like panels reinforce the toe, eyestay and signature Onitsuka Tiger Stripes for subtle contrast. Despite the added volume, the recognizable low-profile shape of the Mexico 66 remains intact, giving the familiar retro runner an almost slipper-like appearance.The furry edition extends across a broader tonal palette that also includes Cotton Candy pink, Airy Blue, Birch and Brown Storm, ranging from soft pastels to warmer neutral shades. Each maintains the same lace-free construction, leaving the metal eyelets exposed as a decorative detail, while faux fur continues through the interior for a plush finish. The Paraty's collapsible heel also allows the shoe to be worn two ways - conventionally or stepped down like a mule - reinforcing the relaxed character of the design.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: ASICS' Life-Sized Diorama Offered a Window Into a New Human Species
items.text: ASICS' Life-Sized Diorama Offered a Window Into a New Human Species With its founding philosophy, a Sound Mind in a Sound Body, ASICS has stood as an unwavering champion of movement for the mind. Feeding into events and activations, this year on World Mental Health Day, the brand installed a life-sized diorama in Paris showing its commitment to tackling issues humanity faces today. Boxed in a see-through case, the diorama centered on a realistic human model, sitting in a familiar position in front of screens, immobile and hunched over. From a global study stating 86% of people surveyed spend their waking hours inactive, it captured one of the most widespread modern behaviors. ASICS presented the model as part of a new species it calls Homo Scrollus Canapus. Though it takes a humorous side, the installation adopted a museum format with explanatory labels and documentary-style voiceovers to engage those passing by. Hypebeast visited the forecourt of Grande Halle de La Villette, which housed the diorama for two days. Positioned in the middle of a high-traffic area, we went on the ground to catch individuals as they interacted with the installation. The video shows all walks of life observing the model and sharing personal stories of the modern-day habits that have quietly designed movement out of our lives, like doomscrolling, binge-watching, and prolonged hours in front of computer screens.The diorama, however, wasn’t just a warning of the new species. It gave onlookers a solution to kicking their restless slump to the curb. On one side of the installation, a board noted that dedicating a few minutes to movement can boost your mind and body. These insights were championed by its 15 Minutes to Thrive challenge. Aiming to encourage everyday activity, we gathered perspectives on the initiative in a dedicated Ask the Community installment. View this post on InstagramA post shared by HYPEBEAST (@hypebeast)You can take a closer look at Homo Scrollus Canapus by watching the video above.Find out more about ASICS’ Movement Conservation project online now. items.title: Prada's Holiday 2026 Campaign Turns Into a Hand-Drawn Winter Fairytale
items.text: Prada's Holiday 2026 Campaign Turns Into a Hand-Drawn Winter Fairytale Summary Prada unveils its Holiday 2026 campaign, “Drawing Prada.”Maya Hawke, Sadie Sink and other actors star in whimsical, hand-illustrated worlds.Animator John Pomeroy and photographer Glen Luchford blend live action with traditional animation. Prada is bringing the magic of traditional animation into the holiday season with its Holiday 2026 campaign, titled “Drawing Prada.” Blurring the boundaries between reality and imagination, the campaign transforms the House's festive narrative into a series of whimsical, hand-illustrated worlds that evoke the charm of classic Hollywood cinema and childhood storybooks.Under the creative direction of Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons, the project celebrates the art of storytelling through an intentionally nostalgic medium, placing hand-drawn animation at the center of its visual identity. Leading the creative process is legendary animator John Pomeroy, whose decades-long career has helped shape some of cinema's most recognizable animated productions at studios such as Disney. His team of artists brings fantastical winter landscapes and playful animal characters to life, reinforcing the campaign's emphasis on craftsmanship, human expression and the enduring appeal of stories passed between generations.The campaign features an ensemble of rising and established acting talent, including Chen Haoyu, Luther Ford, Kelvin Harrison Jr., Maya Hawke and Sadie Sink. Each appears within an imaginative setting where live-action photography merges with illustrated scenery, creating dreamlike compositions that feel suspended between a cinematic frame and a hand-painted storybook. Shot by Glen Luchford, the campaign carefully aligns lighting and perspective with the surrounding illustrations, allowing the real and imagined elements to coexist within the same visual space.Across a series of still images and short footage, the cast encounters whimsical wintertime scenes and fantastical environments, where the contrast between contemporary figures and traditional animation lends the imagery a distinctly surreal quality. The result is a playful interpretation of the holiday season that draws on the warmth of familiar festive imagery while celebrating the artistry behind its creation. items.title: 'Pokémon Unite' to Officially Shut Down in March 2027
items.text: 'Pokémon Unite' to Officially Shut Down in March 2027 Summary The Pokémon Company has announced that 'Pokémon Unite' will officially conclude service on March 23 2027Developed with TiMi Studios the five-on-five MOBA has halted gem purchases and auto-renewals ahead of a final farewell event in NovemberA newly introduced Library feature will allow players to download and view select in-game items locally before servers go offline The Pokémon Company has confirmed that Pokémon Unite will officially shut down in March 2027. The five-on-five multiplayer online battle arena title will close its servers on March 23, 2027, at 00:00 UTC (March 22 at 8:00 PM ET), concluding a nearly six-year live-service run.Developed alongside Tencent’s TiMi Studios, the free-to-play MOBA originally launched on Nintendo Switch in July 2021 before rolling out to mobile devices with full cross-platform matchmaking. The impending shutdown follows an earlier indication in July, when The Pokémon Company removed the title from the 2027 Pokémon World Championships in favor of an independent Tokyo tournament that will begin qualifiers this December.With the closure announced, in-game sales of gems, new Unite Club memberships, and subscription auto-renewals have been terminated immediately. Players can continue spending previously acquired gems until the final cutoff, and existing memberships will remain active through their standard expiration dates. A final update featuring a farewell event is scheduled for November 12, alongside a new Library feature allowing users to locally download and view select in-game inventory before the servers permanently go dark. items.title: PlayStation Revives '90s Transparent Tech Aesthetic With the “Prism Collection”
items.text: PlayStation Revives '90s Transparent Tech Aesthetic With the “Prism Collection” Summary PlayStation unveils its Prism Collection of translucent DualSense controllers and matching PS5 covers.Flare Orange, Emerald Green and Graphite Gray revive nostalgic '90s gaming aesthetics.Launching February 4, 2027, controllers cost around $85 USD, with preorders beginning November 10, 2026. Transparent gaming hardware is making a comeback as PlayStation revisits one of the most recognizable design trends of the late 1990s with its new Prism Collection. The latest lineup introduces three translucent colorways for the DualSense wireless controller and matching PlayStation 5 console covers, offering a nostalgic yet futuristic interpretation of Sony's current-generation hardware.Available in Flare Orange, Emerald Green and Graphite Gray, each design features a high-gloss, see-through shell that offers a glimpse of the technology beneath. Flare Orange delivers a vibrant finish that takes on subtle rosy tones where the transparent materials overlap, while Emerald Green adopts a deeper hunter-green hue with a silky appearance. Graphite Gray offers a more understated alternative, pairing a cool-toned, smoky exterior with the collection's glossy finish.Across all three designs, a contrasting metallic center panel brings a refined touch to the controllers, balancing their exposed internal details with the PS5's streamlined industrial aesthetic. According to PlayStation's Color, Material and Finish design team, the collection was developed in response to fans' enthusiasm for the return of transparent controllers, drawing inspiration from the see-through electronics that defined gaming culture in the late '90s.The Prism Collection is scheduled to launch globally starting February 4, 2027, with regional availability varying by market. DualSense controllers are priced at $85 USD each, while matching console covers retail for $75 USD. Preorders begin November 10, 2026, in participating markets, with the collection available through PlayStation Direct where supported and select retailers.
