items.title: Kobe Bryant's Game-Worn, Dual-Signed Air Jordan 8 Lakers PE Hits the Auction Block
items.text: Kobe Bryant's Game-Worn, Dual-Signed Air Jordan 8 Lakers PE Hits the Auction Block Summary The Realest has officially opened the auction for Kobe Bryant's game-worn and dual-signed Air Jordan 8 Lakers Player Exclusive sneakersSourced from Bryant's celebrated 2002–03 sneaker free agency season the pair features his signature and number 8 inscription across the strapsIndependently photomatched by MeiGray and SIA the size 14 sneakers are open for bidding alongside his 2003–04 game-worn jersey through November 8 The Realest has officially launched the auction for Kobe Bryant's game-worn, dual-signed Air Jordan 8 Lakers Player Exclusive sneakers. Sourced from the Black Mamba's historic 2002–03 sneaker free agency era, the rare footwear reaches the auction block following the platform’s international Gold Label Grails World Tour.Worn during the Los Angeles Lakers’ 104–96 victory over the Boston Celtics on March 21, 2003, the size 14 pair comes finished in the franchise’s signature purple, gold, and white palette. Bryant logged 13 points, seven assists, and three rebounds during the matchup at STAPLES Center, leaving behind distinct in-game wear along with the original laces and insoles. Both sneakers feature Bryant’s personal signature and his iconic "No. 8" inscription written in black marker across the model’s hallmark criss-cross straps. The artifact has been independently photomatched by both MeiGray and Sports Investors Authentication (SIA).The sneakers arrive alongside Bryant’s signed, game-worn No. 8 Lakers jersey from the 2003–04 season, which has already surpassed $712,000 USD in active bidding. Prior to the sale, both items traveled across Los Angeles and premier Asian destinations including Hong Kong, Tokyo, and Beijing, stopping at Mutianyu on the Great Wall of China and the Bird’s Nest National Stadium.Bidding on Kobe Bryant’s game-worn Air Jordan 8 Lakers Player Exclusives and his 2003–04 game-worn jersey closes on November 8, 2026, exclusively via TheRealest. The silhouette combines waterproof nubuck with a black quilted leather collar, a rugged Vibram outsole, full interior shearling lining, and co-branded debossed accents.Expanding beyond the archival wheat edition, the collection also delivers the 40 Below Shearling Super Boot in a monochrome "Wild Dove" makeup featuring waterproof nubuck, metal eyelets, and full shearling insulation. Completing the three-boot lineup is a classic 6-Inch Boot coated in rich "Burgundy" nubuck with gold-tone hardware. Each style includes extra laces and arrives packaged in illustrated commemorative boxes.The Ronnie Fieg x Timberland Winter 2026 collection releases on October 30, 2026, alongside Kith’s seasonal apparel range, available at Kith flagship locations worldwide, Kith, and through the Kith App.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Dr. Martens Channels ‘The Exorcist’ Across Three Iconic Silhouettes
items.text: Dr. Martens Channels ‘The Exorcist’ Across Three Iconic Silhouettes Name: Dr. Martens x ‘The Exorcist’ CollectionMSRP: ¥2,750 - ¥39,600 JPY (approx. $17 - $250 USD)Release Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: Dr. Martens JapanDr. Martens heads into Halloween with a capsule inspired by William Friedkin’s 1973 cult horror classic, The Exorcist, translating some of the film’s most unsettling imagery and dialogue across three of its signature silhouettes.The 1460 boot arrives in Black/Purple, using smooth leather as a backdrop for a large-scale image of possessed Regan MacNeil across the upper, while “FAITHLESS SLIME” is debossed at the heel and repeated on an alternate set of laces. Matte black eyelets, a black-and-purple AirWair heel loop and signature yellow welt stitching complete the design.The 1461 shoe takes a darker, more understated approach in Black Vintage Smooth leather, with “I’M NOT REGAN” laser-etched across the surface so that a biscuit-brown undertone shows through the lettering. Black welt stitching, a metallic “THE EXORCIST” lace charm and additional “FAITHLESS SLIME” graphics keep the low-cut silhouette visually restrained but loaded with references to the film.The Jadon boot delivers the collection’s most dramatic finish, coating its platform silhouette in glossy purple Arcadia leather with a two-tone rub-off effect that gives the surface greater depth and sheen. “I’M NOT REGAN” is embossed across the upper, joined by a custom zipper, lace jewelry and a black-and-purple heel loop, while the chunky platform sole heightens its already imposing profile.All three pairs also feature specially printed insoles and additional co-branded details, extending the horror references into less immediately visible areas. Beyond footwear, the capsule includes a black leather backpack printed with Father Merrin’s silhouette and jacquard socks covered in purple “I’M NOT REGAN” lettering.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Balenciaga Brings the Snow Indoors for Its 2026 Skiwear Campaign
items.text: Balenciaga Brings the Snow Indoors for Its 2026 Skiwear Campaign Summary Balenciaga unveils its 2026 Skiwear Collection under Pierpaolo Piccioli.Technical outerwear, oversized footwear and winterized bags combine alpine performance with luxury design.The campaign features surreal indoor snowfall across Parisian interiors, highlighting the collection's versatility. Snow-covered slopes meet Parisian interiors in Balenciaga's latest Skiwear campaign, where the boundaries between alpine performance and urban luxury are deliberately blurred. Designed by Creative Director Pierpaolo Piccioli, the House's 2026 Skiwear Collection reimagines winter dressing through high-performance materials, exaggerated silhouettes and a distinctly fashion-forward sensibility.The collection spans technical outerwear, insulated separates and versatile layering pieces for men and women, balancing functional construction with Balenciaga's distinctive proportions. High-collar parkas, reversible blousons, cropped puffers and stola jackets form the foundation of the lineup, complemented by snow pants crafted from techno cotton and nylon. Hand-drawn prints inspired by mountain animal hides and faux-fur textures introduce a more expressive dimension, appearing in high-visibility hues that contrast with the collection's streamlined silhouettes.Functional details are integrated into the visual language of the garments, from reflective Balenciaga graphics to branded pull tabs attached to zippers. Beyond the slopes, lined denim, knitwear, tracksuits and jersey essentials offer a more relaxed approach to winter dressing, allowing the technical pieces to transition into everyday wardrobes without compromising their protective qualities.Accessories further extend the collection's alpine-inspired aesthetic, with familiar Balenciaga designs receiving winter-ready material treatments. The Le City, Le 7, Rodeo and Le City Backpack are reinterpreted in merino shearling, waxed suede, vintage goat and Arena lamb, offered in seasonal shades including polar blue, storm grey, optic white, rose quartz, light espresso and caramel.Footwear takes on an equally exaggerated character, led by the oversized Alaska boots and flatform mules, alongside winterized Combat Strike and nubuck-Nappa Arctic styles featuring sturdy nylon laces and chunky treaded soles. The seasonal offering delivers an expansive lineup spanning winter-ready apparel, accessories, Kith Home decor, the elevated &Kin label, and a debut collaborative partnership with Japanese menswear imprint SEVEN BY SEVEN.Framed by sweeping rural landscapes, Harington models an assortment anchored in cold-weather functionality and layered tailoring. The core mainline revitalizes staple outerwear including the Corey, Midi, and Maverick Puffers, complemented by the Wax Cotton Darcy Cropped Hunting Jacket, Reversible Knit Jaysen Bomber, and Shearling Patchwork Becker Jacket. The refined &Kin line emphasizes elevated materiality with the pony hair Vail Jacket, lambskin Oren Blouson Jacket, shearling Rio Jacket, and the return of tailored suiting created in collaboration with Giorgio Armani. Collaborating with SEVEN BY SEVEN, Kith crafts a specialized capsule focused on washed Japanese indigo and antique-finished suede outerwear.Footwear highlights the seasonal rollout across three historic partnerships. items.title: km5 Expands Its Minimalist Audio Lineup With the Sp1 Speaker and Mp1 Mixer
items.text: km5 Expands Its Minimalist Audio Lineup With the Sp1 Speaker and Mp1 Mixer Summary km5 is expanding its audio ecosystem with a new display-friendly speaker and mixerThe hardware features built-in batteries, tactile DJ controls and wireless connectivityPreorders officially open in November 2026, with shipments scheduled for early 2027 Audio brand km5 announced the upcoming release of its Sp1 speaker and Mp1 mixer, delivering a hardware expansion designed to directly complement its Cp1 CD player. This release expands km5's minimalist audio ecosystem, providing a display-friendly setup that fundamentally encourages tactile interaction with music through manual mixing and physical equalization. Both the Sp1 speaker and Mp1 mixer borrow the flat, frame-like format of km5's Cp1 CD player to maintain a cohesive design language. Available in stark black or white finishes, the Sp1 speaker and Mp1 mixer share the exact same size dimensions, creating a uniformed aesthetic when placed side by side.The Sp1 speaker features a sleek perforated grille on its front surface. A dot-matrix display is cleverly hidden beneath its grille to show time and playback information without breaking the visual lines of the device. The top edge of the Sp1 speaker houses physical buttons and a retractable metal antenna, signaling its broader utility. Beyond standard playback, the Sp1 speaker functions as an FM radio and allows users to record radio programs. Internally, the Sp1 speaker is equipped with two 1.77-inch full-range drivers and two passive radiators. Audio playback on the Sp1 speaker is supported via Bluetooth and microSD. For a wider soundstage, two Sp1 units can be paired together to provide stereo playback. Built for portability, both the Sp1 and Mp1 operate on built-in batteries, with the Sp1 speaker boasting an estimated battery life of approximately 12 hours.The Mp1 mixer shifts the design focus toward performance, filling its front surface area entirely with knobs and sliders. It features two channels with separate level sliders and a crossfader for blending sources. Users can dial in the sound using three-band EQ controls for adjusting bass, midrange and treble, as well as additional sound filters. Adding to the DJ-style functionality, loop buttons on the Mp1 mixer allow users to repeat sections of a track. items.title: weber x BLOCKHEAD MOTORS Celebrate 20 Years of ‘Cars’ With a Lightning McQueen Tee
items.text: weber x BLOCKHEAD MOTORS Celebrate 20 Years of ‘Cars’ With a Lightning McQueen Tee Summary weber teams up with custom R/C car label BLOCKHEAD MOTORS on a T-shirt marking the 20th anniversary of 'Cars'An oversized Lightning McQueen graphic and the slogan “Lightning Speed Ahead” anchor the front, with both brands’ logos on the backThe tee arrives in white and black, packaged in a sleeve inspired by 1990s promo record jackets weber and BLOCKHEAD MOTORS have linked up on a graphic T-shirt celebrating 20 years since Cars first hit theaters. The collaboration pairs weber with BLOCKHEAD MOTORS, a name with a devoted following among custom R/C car fans, and puts the film’s star racer front and center on a tee offered in two colorways and in both adult and kids’ sizes.The front of the shirt is built around Lightning McQueen, whose likeness is printed large across the chest. Paired with him is the phrase “Lightning Speed Ahead,” a line that plays directly off the character’s name and gives the graphic its forward-moving energy. The scale of the print keeps the focus squarely on the film, letting the tee read first and foremost as a Cars piece.Flip the shirt over and the branding takes over, with weber and BLOCKHEAD MOTORS’ logos sitting together on the back. The split between a movie-led front and a logo-led back mirrors the two worlds the collaboration draws from, the film itself and the R/C car culture BLOCKHEAD MOTORS is known for. Both white and black versions are available, and the inclusion of kids’ sizes makes it a release parents and children can wear together.Packaging is where the drop goes a step further. Rather than arriving in a standard poly bag, each tee comes housed in a sleeve modeled on the record jackets used as promotional items in the 1990s, turning the purchase into something closer to a collectible than a simple shirt.The timing gives the release extra resonance. Cars debuted in 2006 as a Pixar production, introducing Lightning McQueen as a cocky rookie racer who finds perspective in the forgotten Route 66 town of Radiator Springs. Two decades on, the film’s original audience has grown up, and a tee available in both adult and kids’ cuts speaks to a generation that can now share the movie with its own children.The weber x BLOCKHEAD MOTORS Cars T-shirt drops October 31 via the weber and BLOCKHEAD MOTORS online stores. items.title: ACRONYM and ALIVEFORM Launch THE BLADE in New "SILVER FANG" Colorway
items.text: ACRONYM and ALIVEFORM Launch THE BLADE in New "SILVER FANG" Colorway ACRONYM has teamed up once again with 3D-printed footwear brand ALIVEFORM to release a new "SILVER FANG" colorway of THE BLADE. The shoe will launch exclusively at GRAFT.PD's Pudong space in Shanghai as part of a special project for the brand's Open House event this November.Inspired by Tsui Hark's 1995 martial arts film *The Blade*, the shoe's design merges ACRONYM's signature techwear aesthetic with ALIVEFORM's 3D-printing technology to create a highly sculptural silhouette. The shoe features a barefoot construction to prioritize natural foot movement and flexibility, while an open mesh design extending across the upper and sole improves breathability. Cushioning, support, and flexibility are integrated directly into the 3D-printed structure, eliminating the need for traditional stitching or glue.This new "SILVER FANG" colorway further enriches the visual language of THE BLADE and will be available exclusively through GRAFT.PD.Additionally, GRAFT.PD in Pudong, Shanghai, will host an Open House event from November 7th to 8th. The event will showcase the FW26 collection alongside exclusive releases and offer an opportunity to interact face-to-face with the designers. GRAFT.PD has long supported independent designers exploring the intersection of clothing, the body, and technology, and this event will further highlight different creators' perspectives on the future of apparel design.Event Information: GRAFT.PD Open HouseDate and Time: November 7–8, 2026, 12:00 PM – 8:00 PMLocation: Room 204, Building 5, 3000 Longdong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Dream Golf Trip Through the Canadian Rockies
items.text: The Dream Golf Trip Through the Canadian Rockies There are golf trips you come home from needing another vacation. You know, the kinds where you're stacking rounds back-to-back and spending car rides with roller bags on your lap. But over six nights in the Canadian Rockies this September, recovery and relaxation was given as much consideration as the rounds themselves.Fairmont hosted our group across three of its mountain properties: Fairmont Banff Springs, Fairmont Chateau Lake Louise and Fairmont Jasper Park Lodge. Golf was a big part of the itinerary, with rounds at two Stanley Thompson designs. Around those rounds were forest bathing, hiking, thermal bathing and enough time outdoors to make the distinction between activity and relaxation feel less obvious.The trip introduced us to Fairmont’s Wellness Without Walls campaign, which launched earlier this year with Kylian Mbappé as the brand’s first Wellness Ambassador. Across these three properties, the idea had a clear proposition: make it easier for guests to stay active, recover and spend time in their surroundings.Through its partnership with Hyperice, Fairmont offers access to recovery tools including Normatec compression boots, a Hypervolt massage gun and a Venom heated vibration wrap for the back. The Nike gear lending program addresses a simpler obstacle: arriving somewhere with the intention of exercising and realizing you haven’t packed for it. Shoes and workout clothing can be borrowed during a stay.These are useful things to have available when you travel, particularly if you want to keep your luggage manageable. Over the week, though, the strongest expression of the wellness proposition came from the places themselves.Banff: Golf Beneath the PeaksFairmont Banff Springs makes an impression before you have done very much at all. The castle-like hotel has a European grandeur, with stone corridors, period details and a scale that makes getting slightly lost feel like part of the stay. It is rugged and imposing from outside; inside, there always seems to be another staircase or room to discover.Down at the golf course, the mountains present their own architectural presence. On the Stanley Thompson 18, they sit so close to your sight lines that it can be difficult to separate the hole in front of you from everything rising behind it. items.title: REdDUO’s STEM VASE Is Built for Just One Flower
items.text: REdDUO’s STEM VASE Is Built for Just One Flower Summary RedDuo’s STEM VASE reduces the traditional vase to a sculptural steel framework for one flower.Two staggered prisms support a tilted disc with a single stem opening.Two sizes are offered; prices start at €720 EUR ( approx. $806 USD). REdDUO strips the vase back until almost nothing remains but the flower itself. Its new STEM VASE is conceived as an architectural framework for displaying a single stem, replacing the familiar enclosed vessel with a precise composition of steel planes and volumes. Two staggered prismatic forms rise vertically to support a tilted disc punctured by one small opening, through which the flower emerges. The arrangement gives the object a distinctly structural quality, somewhere between miniature architecture and functional sculpture, while intentionally leaving the organic form of the plant as the visual focal point.Made entirely from steel and left in a steel finish, STEM VASE avoids decorative embellishment in favor of sharp geometry, exposed material and carefully balanced proportions. The angled upper disc introduces tension against the upright base, while the offset volumes prevent the silhouette from becoming overly rigid or symmetrical.The construction makes the mechanics of the object immediately legible: every element appears to have a clear role in supporting and positioning the stem. REdDUO describes the design as one in which “structure and function are one,” an idea that gives the industrial-looking object its visual clarity while creating a deliberate contrast with the softness and irregularity of a flower.STEM VASE is offered in two proportions, allowing the same architectural idea to shift in scale without changing its underlying language. The taller STEM VASE 01 measures 471 mm high by 120 mm wide and is priced at €795 EUR (approx. $890 USD), while the more compact STEM VASE 02 stands 337 mm high by 86 mm wide and is priced at €720 EUR ( approx. $806 USD). For more information, visit REdDUO’s official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Lebond Gives Norman Foster His First Watch Design Project
items.text: Lebond Gives Norman Foster His First Watch Design Project Summary Norman Foster partners with Lebond on his first-ever watch design.The 38.5mm titanium model features an integrated strap and 12-hour bezel for dual-time tracking.Natural titanium and black DLC editions each use an ETA 2892-A2 automatic caliber. Norman Foster is bringing his design language to watchmaking for the first time, partnering with independent brand Lebond on a pair of mechanical watches shaped by the same ideas of proportion, engineering and functional clarity that define his architectural work.Developed alongside the Norman Foster Foundation’s Design & Innovation Unit, the project treats the watch as an everyday tool rather than a miniature architectural statement, with Foster drawing on his experience as a pilot and frequent traveler. That influence is most apparent in the bidirectional 12-hour bezel, which allows a second time zone to be tracked without adding a conventional GMT hand, while the case eliminates traditional lugs entirely so the integrated rubber strap flows directly from the watch and wraps closely around the wrist.The watch arrives in two interpretations built around the same 38.5mm Grade 5 titanium case, measuring just 10mm thick and offering 50 meters of water resistance. The Natural Titanium Edition combines matte sandblasted, brushed and polished surfaces with a sunray-finished dial, polished nickel hands and a light grey FKM rubber strap, while the Black Edition takes a more instrument-like approach with matte black DLC-coated titanium, a black lacquered dial and matching strap.Both feature blue-emitting Super-LumiNova, a date window at 3 o’clock and interchangeable integrated straps with titanium deployant clasps. Through the sapphire caseback, an ETA 2892-A2 automatic caliber provides 50 hours of power reserve, distinguished by a custom five-perforation rotor rendered in vivid blue on the natural titanium version and red on the black model.Rather than treating the collaboration as a one-off exercise in styling, Foster designed the watch around adaptability, with the modular strap attachment intended to let owners personalize the piece as additional combinations are introduced over time. The restrained typography, compact proportions and visible movement all reinforce his stated preference for an object that feels “timeless rather than fashionable,” while the integrated construction gives the watch a distinctly architectural sense of continuity. items.title: My Chemical Romance and Lauren Tsai Merge Worlds in ‘Prelude to The End’
items.text: My Chemical Romance and Lauren Tsai Merge Worlds in ‘Prelude to The End’ Summary My Chemical Romance and Lauren Tsai launch the animated short Prelude to The End .The film merges The Black Parade with Tsai’s The Dying World .Billie Eilish, Phoebe Bridgers and Hideo Kojima contribute voices. My Chemical Romance have entered Lauren Tsai’s The Dying World with Prelude to The End, a new animated short film that folds the visual artist’s surreal universe into the mythology surrounding The Black Parade.Produced by Tsai’s independent studio UNREAL INC., the film follows Astrid through an uncanny New England boarding school slowly disappearing beneath mountains of discarded objects and trash. After school authorities confiscate and throw away her cherished sketchbook, Astrid follows it down a garbage chute and tumbles into a strange subterranean realm populated by abandoned ideas, including one of her own that has continued to haunt her. The hand-drawn journey moves between oppressive school corridors and increasingly dreamlike imagery, using Astrid’s confrontation with creativity, conformity and forgotten parts of herself to echo the themes of identity and self-expression that have long run through My Chemical Romance’s work. Tsai voices Astrid, while Billie Eilish appears as her friend, Phoebe Bridgers as her sister, Hideo Kojima as The Teacher and John C. McGinley as the imposing Dean.The collaboration arrives alongside the 20th-anniversary edition of The Black Parade, with the short incorporating “The End,” the 2006 album’s opening track, into Tsai’s existing narrative world. The Dying World first appeared as a short film at the 2025 Annecy International Animation Film Festival before expanding through Tsai’s large-scale installation at Hollywood Forever Cemetery later that year, making the MCR crossover a particularly personal one for an artist who has cited the band as a formative influence and created animated fan videos for its music as a child. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Little Napoli’s New Menu Goes Deeper Into Neapolitan Comfort Food
items.text: Little Napoli’s New Menu Goes Deeper Into Neapolitan Comfort Food Summary Little Napoli expanded its Wan Chai menu with new antipasti, pastas, and desserts.Chef Gavino Pilo introduced an extra-large 40cm "Cart Wheel" style Neapolitan pizza.The MICHELIN-awarded pizzeria maintains its signature 90-second stone-oven baking process. Little Napoli is stretching beyond the pizza oven with its most extensive menu expansion since opening in Hong Kong in 2021, giving Chef and Owner Gavino Pilo more room to explore the food culture of his native Naples. Available this fall at the restaurant’s Wan Chai location, the new offering introduces four antipasti, seven hot plates and fresh pastas, five desserts and eight Special Creation pizzas, while expanding the overall pizza selection to 27 varieties.Recognized with a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand 2026 and a Top 30 spot in 50 Top Pizza Asia-Pacific 2026, the restaurant is broadening its focus beyond its established roots as a neighborhood takeaway. The refreshed culinary direction introduces four new antipasti, seven hot plates and fresh pastas, five desserts and a collection of Special Creation pizzas, bringing the total pizza selection to 27.Guests can now start their dining experience with elevated appetizers like Carpaccio di Polpo featuring Mediterranean octopus and Amalfi lemon zest, or dive into comforting hot plates such as the crispy Crochetta di Patate Ripiena and Ziti alla Genovese with slow-braised beef. Pasta now receives greater prominence too, spanning homemade Gnocchi alla Sorrentina, slow-braised beef Ziti alla Genovese, pork-and-beef Cavatelli al Ragù Napoletano, and a lighter fettuccine topped with Sicilian shrimp tartare, heirloom tomatoes and Amalfi lemon.Pizza nevertheless remains Little Napoli’s anchor, with Pilo using the expanded format to move between tradition and more expressive combinations. New Special Creations include the Luciana, topped with Mediterranean octopus, San Marzano tomato, Gaeta olives, garlic and chilli; the Parigina, built around a buffalo ricotta-stuffed crust, smoked ham and smoked Agerola mozzarella; and the sweet-and-savory Cilentana, combining Capocollo, buffalo blue cheese and Cilento fig sauce.The restaurant has also introduced old-school 40cm Pizza a Ruota di Carro, or “Cart Wheel” pizzas, characterized by their oversized diameter and exceptionally thin crust spilling over the plate. items.title: Donald Glover Drops Into Netflix’s Live-Action ‘PUBG’ Series
items.text: Donald Glover Drops Into Netflix’s Live-Action ‘PUBG’ Series Summary Netflix is developing a live-action series based on the battle royale hit 'PlayerUnknown’s Battlegrounds'Donald Glover is set to star, write, executive produce and direct, with brother Stephen Glover co-writing and executive producingThe creative team faces an unusual challenge, since the game itself has no storyline to adapt Netflix is developing a live-action PUBG series with Donald Glover attached to lead. Based on Krafton’s 2017 battle royale PlayerUnknown’s Battlegrounds, the project would put Glover in charge both in front of the camera and behind it, with the multihyphenate also writing, executive producing and planning to direct.The creative core of the series is a familiar one. Donald will write and executive produce alongside his brother Stephen Glover, reuniting a duo whose partnership defined FX’s Atlanta, which Donald created and starred in while Stephen wrote and executive produced across all four seasons. The pair has since collaborated on Amazon’s Swarm and the musical film Guava Island, and Stephen also wrote for Donald’s Mr. and Mrs. Smith series at Amazon.The producing lineup brings together film, management and gaming expertise. Michael Schaefer is executive producing for Neon TV, Fam Udeorji is on board for Gilga, and Taeseok Jang and Sujin Lee represent LV3H, the entertainment division of Krafton. That last involvement means the studio behind the game will have a direct hand in how it translates to the screen.The biggest open question is what the show will actually be about. PUBG has no narrative to speak of. Each match drops a large group of players onto one of several maps stocked with weapons, vehicles and gear, and the last player standing wins. Without a built-in story, characters or lore to follow, the writers are working with a premise rather than a plot, and specific story details for the series remain under wraps.The source material’s reach is not in question. Nearly a decade after release, PUBG remains one of the most-played games in the world, drawing hundreds of thousands of daily active players after setting multiple Guinness World Records at launch.The project would also add to Netflix’s growing slate of game adaptations. The streamer is developing an Assassin’s Creed series and a live-action Gears of War film, along with animated takes on Clash of Clans and Minecraft, and it already streams Splinter Cell: Deathwatch and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.Stay tune

items.title: A24’s ‘You Can See Everything’ Popcorn Bucket Takes Transparency Literally
items.text: A24’s ‘You Can See Everything’ Popcorn Bucket Takes Transparency Literally Summary A24 has unveiled a fully see-through popcorn bucket tied to 'You Can See Everything,' Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s documentary on Theranos founder Elizabeth HolmesThe design leans into the film’s title, putting every kernel on display through a clear shellThe bucket lands as the documentary posts box office numbers rarely seen for nonfiction film A24 is marking the release of You Can See Everything with the You Can See Everything Popcorn Bucket, a fully transparent tub that turns the film’s title into a design brief. Billed by A24 with the tagline “Radical Transparency,” the bucket swaps the usual printed cardboard for a clear shell that leaves nothing hidden, a fitting gesture for a documentary built on total access to one of Silicon Valley’s most infamous founders.The silhouette borrows from the classic movie theater popcorn box, tapering from a wide mouth down to a narrower base. A wavy, scalloped rim gives the top edge a playful finish, the one decorative flourish on an otherwise stripped-back piece. Because the walls are completely clear, the popcorn itself becomes the main visual, and the bucket only looks finished once it’s filled.Branding is kept deliberately sparse. The film’s title is printed in bold black sans-serif type across two staggered lines near the middle of the bucket, appearing to hover over the popcorn behind it, while a small A24 logo sits toward the bottom.The concept makes more sense once you know the film. Directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, You Can See Everything opens 34 days before Elizabeth Holmes, the Theranos founder convicted of defrauding investors, reports to prison, when she invites a film crew to document her life. Holmes hadn’t sat for an interview in a decade, yet she let Fielder and his crew into the San Diego home she shares with partner Billy Evans, the father of her two children, on the premise that they could see everything. The project stretches well beyond that window, with the film’s second half following the crew as it reworks its approach after Holmes enters prison and access to her becomes limited. A clear bucket and a “Radical Transparency” tagline read as a wink at that premise, and at a subject whose company collapsed over what it kept hidden.The film has also become a genuine commercial outlier. items.title: The McDonald’s ‘Pokémon’ Happy Meal Is Back This November With 15 Toys and Trading Cards
items.text: The McDonald’s ‘Pokémon’ Happy Meal Is Back This November With 15 Toys and Trading Cards Summary McDonald’s has confirmed the return of its 'Pokémon' Happy Meal with a 15-piece toy set and a 15-card trading card collectionPikachu, Eevee, Charmander, Squirtle and Umbreon headline the lineup, with leaked cards pointing to deeper cuts like Metagross, Zoroark and JirachiThe promotion launches in the US first before rolling out across Europe, Asia, Latin America and beyond over the following months The McDonald’s Pokémon Happy Meal is officially making a comeback, with the fast food giant confirming a US launch on November 10. The latest edition gives collectors two sets to chase, pairing 15 collectible toys with 15 collectible trading cards, alongside a digital game built into the packaging itself.The toys take the shape of miniature Happy Meal boxes, each one carrying the face of a different Pokémon, and they’re designed to do more than sit on a shelf. McDonald’s executive Guillaume Huin offered a closer look at the figures, showing that each box-shaped toy converts into a bag charm. McDonald’s has confirmed Pikachu, Eevee, Charmander, Squirtle and Umbreon as part of the roster, while promotional artwork shows Piplup and Eevee emerging from Happy Meal boxes with Pikachu front and center on the packaging.Huin also gave fans an early glimpse at the trading cards, which make up the second half of the drop. His preview featured Jirachi, Pikachu and Absol among several other fan favorites, though McDonald’s has not detailed the complete 15-card checklist.The box itself doubles as a gateway to a digital side quest. Scanning the QR code printed on the packaging opens an interactive game in which players hunt for all 15 Pokémon toys hidden across a virtual classroom and playground, giving fans a way to engage with the full collection even before they own every piece.The international rollout begins in November with Australia, Canada, Fiji, France, New Zealand, Spain and the US among the first markets. December brings the promotion to more than 40 additional countries, including Germany, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Netherlands, Singapore, South Africa, the UAE and Vietnam. A third wave arrives in January 2027 across Latin America and parts of Europe and Asia, including Brazil, Mexico, Italy, Thailand and the Philippines, before Ireland and the United Kingdom close out the rollout in February 2027. Bright white accents offer sharp visual contrast, defining the lateral Swoosh, the Blue Devils' hallmark "D" insignia on the tongue, and Clark’s "CC" branding along the medial support shank.The custom sneaker expands Duke's growing roster of exclusive on-court footwear, which recently included a Sabrina 4 PE rendered in blue, white, and black with the program's emblem, alongside several player-exclusive models supplied from Nike’s signature basketball category throughout the past year.The Nike Caitlin 1 "Duke" PE will not be released to the public, remaining strictly exclusive to the Duke women’s basketball program. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Duke Women's Basketball (@dukewbb) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Kobe Bryant's Game-Worn High School Jersey Sells for Record $2.2 Million USD at Sotheby's
items.text: Kobe Bryant's Game-Worn High School Jersey Sells for Record $2.2 Million USD at Sotheby's Summary Kobe Bryant's game-worn Lower Merion High School uniform has sold for $2.2 million USD at Sotheby'sThe final result sets a new world record for a high school basketball jersey eclipsing the $1.3 million USD mark set by LeBron JamesThe uniform drew 26 bids from seven collectors after previously selling for $51,400 USD in 2013 Sotheby’s has officially sold Kobe Bryant’s game-worn Lower Merion High School uniform for a historic $2.2 million USD, establishing a new world record for any high school basketball jersey sold at auction. The landmark sale concluded on October 28 following an intense bidding battle that pushed the piece far past its initial presale estimate.The auction accumulated 26 bids across seven competing bidders, propelling the final hammer price past the initial estimate in excess of $1 million USD. At $2.2 million USD, the sale breaks the previous record for a high-school basketball jersey, which was established in 2024 when LeBron James’ St. Vincent-St. Mary jersey from his famous 2002 Sports Illustrated "The Chosen One" cover sold for $1.3 million USD. The sale highlights the meteoric expansion of the sports collectibles landscape, with this exact Kobe uniform previously commanding $51,400 USD when it last sold in 2013.The uniform is matched specifically to Kobe’s junior season during a March 1995 matchup against Hazleton Area, representing a crucial developmental stage one year before he led Lower Merion to the Pennsylvania state championship. Highlighting the cultural weight of the artifact, Brahm Wachter, Sotheby’s Head of Modern Collectables, shared: “This Lower Merion jersey is where Kobe's story starts, before the rings, the records, and the Mamba Mentality, when he was just a kid in a gym outworking everyone. This jersey symbolizes that greatness has a beginning, and this jersey was there for it.” Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Skechers Honors Harry Kane With a Bespoke Gold Signet Ring and Limited-Edition Boots
items.text: Skechers Honors Harry Kane With a Bespoke Gold Signet Ring and Limited-Edition Boots Harry Kane recently made history as the first English player to win the Ballon d’Or in 25 years, and Skechers is celebrating the milestone with an exclusive collection of commemorative pieces.At the center of the tribute is a bespoke gold signet ring commissioned specifically for the Bayern Munich striker. The handmade piece is created by Deakin & Francis, a heritage British jewelry house boasting seven generations of craftsmanship. It features a unique “Mark of Greatness” insignia alongside an engraving of Kane's 73-goal 25/26 season tally with the design a direct nod to his signature goal celebration.Accompanying the ring, Skechers is also dropping a limited release of the “Mark of Greatness” boot. Producing exactly 73 pairs for the public, one for every goal scored, the boot features a refined white and gold colorway celebrating the Ballon d’Or win.Every purchased pair arrives with a special collector's edition publication which chronicles the athlete's historic season, packaged in a gold wrap sleeve displaying the same crest found on the signet ring.The limited-edition boots are available to purchase now at select retailers. items.title: Our Legacy and Nike Launch Sport Shop NYC Pop-Up Ahead of Running Partnership
items.text: Our Legacy and Nike Launch Sport Shop NYC Pop-Up Ahead of Running Partnership Summary Our Legacy and Nike are opening a three-day Sport Shop NYC pop-up at Procell in Manhattan from October 30 through November 1The activation introduces the upcoming Our Legacy Work Shop x Nike Running collection featuring bespoke footwear and technical apparelCollaborative clothing will be available at the pop-up ahead of the full collection launch in Spring 2027 Our Legacy Work Shop and Nike have officially launched their debut partnership alongside the opening of the "Sport Shop NYC" Pop-Up, hosted at vintage boutique Procell in Manhattan. The collaborative pop-up opens October 30, 2026, offering an early preview and exclusive collaborative apparel ahead of the duo's broader technical running line.Marking the Swedish brand’s first direct project with Nike following past Converse efforts under the parent umbrella, the initiative is spearheaded by Work Shop, Our Legacy's experimental division. Rather than recoloring existing silhouettes, the partnership with Nike Running develops brand-new footwear designs alongside technical men's and women's apparel from the ground up. Anchored by the conceptual ethos “Technology disguised” and “To look slow, but feel fast,” the range translates minimalist tailoring into high-performance gear built for the “all-day athlete.”While preview imagery for the Manhattan pop-up confirms collaborative clothing without footwear on-site, the brands are also preparing precursor releases utilizing vintage Nike garments and deadstock textiles before the comprehensive line's debut.The Our Legacy x Nike 'Sport Shop NYC' pop-up runs from October 30 through November 1, 2026, at 5 Delancey Street in New York, while the full Our Legacy Work Shop x Nike collection is scheduled to launch in Spring 2027 via both brands and select retailers. items.title: Bad Bunny’s adidas BadBo Stone Slides Look Carved Straight From Rock
items.text: Bad Bunny’s adidas BadBo Stone Slides Look Carved Straight From Rock Name: adidas BadBo Stone Slides “Blue,” adidas BadBo Stone Slides “Yellow”Colorway: TBCSKU: LB7191, LB7194MSRP: $70 USDRelease Date: June 2027Bad Bunny’s adidas BadBo Stone Slides are reportedly set for a Summer 2027 release, giving the artist’s signature line its first slip-on. Early images show the slide in “Blue” and “Yellow,” both defined by a textured upper engineered to resemble chiseled stone.The stone effect is the defining design element, and it runs across the entire upper rather than appearing as an accent. Slight variations in shade across the surface pick out the ridges and grooves, giving the slide a weathered, hand-cut appearance up close. That relief is what gives the model its name, and it turns a typically plain silhouette into something with real visual depth.Color blocking is kept to a minimum on both pairs, a choice that lets the texture stay front and center. The “Blue” version leans toward a cool, water-washed palette, while the “Yellow” pair applies the same carved surface in a punchier, sun-bright tone. Without contrasting overlays or panels cutting through the upper, the etched finish reads as one continuous surface from toe to heel.The slide arrives at an interesting point in Bad Bunny’s run with adidas. His earliest projects with the brand put his spin on established models such as the Campus and Gazelle, along with a take on the F50 Ghost Sprint. The BadBo 1.0 and 1.1 then moved the partnership into original signature territory, and a slide would push that franchise into more casual, everyday wear.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: LL Cool J Announces 'Rock the Bells: The Residency' at Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas
items.text: LL Cool J Announces 'Rock the Bells: The Residency' at Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas Summary LL Cool J has officially announced Rock the Bells The Residency taking over Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las VegasThe 11-show concert run spans across May and July 2027 featuring storytelling and multi-generational guest appearancesTickets will become available through presales starting October 30 ahead of the general on-sale on November 2 Hip-hop pioneer LL Cool J and MGM Resorts have officially announced Rock the Bells: The Residency, an 11-date live concert engagement heading to Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas. The multi-generational production is scheduled to stage across select dates in May and July 2027, uniting historic hits, immersive storytelling, and special guest performers on a single stage.The residency is scheduled across two separate runs, kicking off with an opening five-night stretch on May 15, 16, 19, 21, and 22, before returning for a final six-show slate on July 9, 10, 11, 14, 16, and 17. All scheduled performances will begin at 8 p.m. Designed as an all-star tribute to the global influence of hip-hop culture, the production will feature artists across generations and genres sharing the stage.“Hip-Hop started in a few neighborhoods in New York, and now it belongs to the whole world,” shared LL Cool J in an official statement. “Along the way it changed rock, R&B, pop, soul, dance music, all of it. Rock The Bells celebrates everybody who was part of that story. This isn’t me doing a show in Vegas. It’s all of us. Artists from different generations and different genres, sharing one stage, for fans who were there at the beginning and kids hearing it for the first time.” Chris Baldizan, MGM Resorts’ Executive Vice President of Entertainment, added that the collaboration marks a high-energy addition to Park MGM’s roster.Citi and AAdvantage cardholder presales begin on October 30 at 10 a.m. PT, followed by MGM Rewards, Live Nation, and Ticketmaster presales on October 31 at 10 a.m. PT, with general ticket sales opening November 2 at 10 a.m. PT. items.title: High Museum of Art to Showcase Rare Jean-Michel Basquiat Works in Landmark 2027 Exhibition
items.text: High Museum of Art to Showcase Rare Jean-Michel Basquiat Works in Landmark 2027 Exhibition Summary The High Museum of Art will present Basquiat the Blue Ribbon Paintings and the Art of Reproduction from February 19 through May 16 2027Organized by the Princeton University Art Museum the exhibition brings together 11 Blue Ribbon canvases that have not been publicly shown together in over three decadesCurated by Jordana Moore Saggese the presentation spans over 50 works highlighting Basquiat's printmaking practice alongside pieces by Robert Rauschenberg and Robert Blackburn The High Museum of Art and the Princeton University Art Museum and the Estate of Jean-Michel Basquiat have announced Basquiat, the Blue Ribbon Paintings, and the Art of Reproduction, a landmark exhibition opening in Atlanta in Spring 2027. Curated by Jordana Moore Saggese, the presentation reframes Jean-Michel Basquiat’s legacy by examining his foundational engagement with printmaking, mechanical reproduction, and appropriation.With more than 50 works on view, the exhibition is anchored by Basquiat’s 1984 Blue Ribbon paintings, reuniting a series of 11 mixed-media canvases that have not been publicly exhibited together in more than three decades. Named after their incorporation of the Pabst Blue Ribbon logo and bottlecap, the large-scale works fuse acrylic, oil stick, and screenprint to remix recurring iconography including crowned avatars and anatomical studies. The presentation frames these pieces as the conceptual culmination of Basquiat’s rigorous explorations across reproductive media.The exhibition also gathers nearly all of Basquiat's known print projects, charting his technical evolution from late-1970s Xerox postcards to lithographs, serigraphs, and silkscreens. His experimental process expanded after acquiring an in-studio color Xerox copier in 1983—one of the first artists in New York to do so. In addition, works by Robert Rauschenberg and pioneering Black printmaker Robert Blackburn are positioned in dialogue with Basquiat, illustrating how Blackburn’s print workshop and Rauschenberg’s layered collage methods informed his practice. The presentation is accompanied by a scholarly volume authored by Saggese, published by Princeton University Art Museum and distributed by Princeton University Press.Basquiat, the Blue Ribbon Paintings, and the Art of Reproduction will be on view from February 19 through May 16, 2027, on the Second Level of the High’s Anne Cox Chambers Wing. items.title: ‘South Park’ Dropped New ‘GTA VI’ Gameplay Featuring a Dog Poop Fight on Vice Beach
items.text: ‘South Park’ Dropped New ‘GTA VI’ Gameplay Featuring a Dog Poop Fight on Vice Beach Summary Comedy Central’s long-running animated series aired fresh 'Grand Theft Auto VI' gameplay during its newest episodeThe footage shows protagonist Jason Duval squaring off with a stranger on Vice Beach, with a bag of dog waste playing a starring roleTrey Parker and Matt Stone are using the game’s November launch as a running stand-in for the upcoming midterm elections Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto VI made an unexpected cameo on South Park this week, with Wednesday’s episode airing new footage of the open-world title ahead of its November release. The clip lands roughly two-thirds of the way into the episode, when the boys visit a cattle ranch and are treated to a demo by Ruth Chris, a new character who bears a strong resemblance to Ruth’s Chris Steakhouse founder Ruth Fertel.The footage centers on Jason Duval, one of the game’s leads, getting into a fight with another man on Vice Beach. Ruth Chris walks the boys through the scene’s mechanics as it plays, explaining that players can grab the dog waste, hurl objects at the person holding it and, if that person retaliates, turn the waste itself into a weapon. “Look at that, the graphics are seriously next level. You see the world-building?” Ruth Chris says in the episode.The rest of the episode takes aim at inflation, President Trump’s tariff pause on beef and elite food culture, kicking off when soaring beef prices push the renamed South America Elementary to drop Sloppy Joes from its lunch menu. The boys’ quest to win back the town’s prized beef unravels into a recurring gross-out bit in which diners who can afford the meat literally explode.Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 18.South Park has shared new GTAVI dog poo gameplay https://t.co/4TZ5zi3FPS— ben (@videotech) October 29, 2026 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Weeknd Announces the Official Streaming Release of New Single "Hong Kong" Featuring Cantopop Icon Faye Wong
items.text: The Weeknd Announces the Official Streaming Release of New Single "Hong Kong" Featuring Cantopop Icon Faye Wong Summary The Weeknd has marked the official release of his new single "Hong Kong" featuring Faye Wong as a musical tribute to the cityThe track samples Faye Wong's 1993 classic "Monsoon" and features cover art photographed by Christopher DoyleThe drop arrives as the 'After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour' surpasses $1 billion USD in gross revenue ahead of its finale in Kuala Lumpur The Weeknd has officially released his new tribute single "Hong Kong (feat. 王菲季候風)", offering a love letter to the city as he wraps up a four-night stadium residency at Kai Tak Stadium. Built on the original music and Cantonese vocal tracks of Faye Wong’s 1993 Cantopop hit "Monsoon (季候風)", the track arrives during the historic final chapter of his worldwide stadium tour.First performed live on October 24 to open his Hong Kong tour dates, the single reflects the Canadian superstar's longstanding appreciation for Cantopop and the cinematic works of director Wong Kar-wai. Connecting the release directly to that visual lineage, the single’s artwork features an archival photograph of Hong Kong sourced from the private collection of cinematographer Christopher Doyle, who filmed Wong Kar-wai’s Chungking Express starring Faye Wong alongside Tony Leung.The live concert debut immediately resonated across social platforms, where an Instagram clip generated more than 18 million views and drove Faye Wong’s original 1993 song back onto streaming charts. Regional outlets reported that “Monsoon” climbed to No. 1 on the rising charts at QQ Music and NetEase Cloud Music, reached No. 3 on Apple Music China, entered the Top 10 on Spotify Hong Kong, and jumped 15 spots to No. 3 on Shazam China's daily rankings, while hitting No. 1 on the Douyin Entertainment Chart.The release coincides with the final stages of the After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour, which has officially become the highest-grossing tour ever by a male solo artist after generating over $1 billion USD in gross revenue and selling more than 7.5 million tickets since 2022. Having expanded its debut Asia leg from 11 to 17 shows, the tour concludes with two final nights in Kuala Lumpur on November 4 and 5.The official release of The Weeknd's new single "Hong Kong (feat. 王菲季候風)" is available now on streaming platforms across East and Southeast Asia. items.title: 'Godzilla Minus One' Is One of the Most Important Blockbusters in Years and Nobody Is Talking About It Enough
items.text: 'Godzilla Minus One' Is One of the Most Important Blockbusters in Years and Nobody Is Talking About It Enough The kaiju genre has never really been about the monster. That’s the thing most Western attempts at Godzilla have fundamentally misread, loading the films with destruction tourism and treating the human characters as connective tissue between set-pieces rather than the actual point of the whole exercise. Takashi Yamazaki understood something that Roland Emmerich and even Gareth Edwards only partially grasped: Godzilla works when the monster means something, and Godzilla Minus One built its entire architecture around that idea with a precision that very few blockbusters of any budget have managed in recent memory.The setup is postwar Japan, 1945. The country is already in ruins, already processing an incomprehensible level of collective loss, and then Godzilla arrives. The film’s title refers to that compounding of disaster, a nation that was already at zero being pushed into negative numbers by something it has no framework to understand or resist. It is an elegant and genuinely devastating premise, and Yamazaki uses it not as backdrop but as the emotional engine the whole film runs on.Ryunosuke Kamiki plays Koichi Shikishima, a former kamikaze pilot who survived the war carrying guilt he doesn’t know how to put down. The film is really about that guilt, about what it means to have lived when others didn’t and what it takes to find a reason to keep going, and Kamiki carries it in a way that makes every Godzilla encounter feel personal rather than spectacle. By the time the film reaches its climax, you are not watching humans try to defeat a monster. You are watching a man decide whether his life is worth something, and the monster is just the thing forcing the question.The visual effects won the Academy Award and deserved it, which almost undersells the achievement. Godzilla Minus One was made on a budget of roughly fifteen million dollars, a figure that makes the quality of what appears on screen genuinely difficult to process. The atomic breath sequence in Ginza is as viscerally terrifying as anything the genre has produced, and the film’s restraint around Godzilla’s appearances, keeping him scarce enough that his presence never normalizes, is the kind of discipline that most studios with ten times the budget don’t have the confidence to exercise.What Yamazaki pulled off is the thing that makes the original 1954 Gojira so enduring and so rarely re

items.title: WACKO MARIA x NANGA FW26 Is Stuffed With Leopard and Down
items.text: WACKO MARIA x NANGA FW26 Is Stuffed With Leopard and Down Summary WACKO MARIA and NANGA reunite for an FW26 outerwear capsule spanning a reversible flight jacket, three down vests and three mountain parkasEvery insulated piece carries an 85% down and 15% feather fill, set inside nylon, polyester or acrylic-blend shellsLeopard print runs across four of the seven styles, with two of them pushed further into faux fur WACKO MARIA and NANGA have revealed their FW26 outerwear capsule, a seven-piece range that pairs the Tokyo label’s loud graphic sensibility with NANGA’s down insulation. The lineup splits between filled layers and weather-ready shells, offered in black, beige and gray, with WACKO MARIA’s leopard print taking over most of the collection.Down does the heavy lifting across four of the seven pieces, each insulated with the same 85% down and 15% feather ratio. What changes from style to style is the outer layer: the solid black down vest uses a full nylon shell, the leopard down vest switches to polyester, and the leopard faux fur down vest trades both for a plush acrylic and polyester blend that puts texture front and center.The reversible MA-1 flight jacket is the most technically involved piece in the drop. One side is built in 100% nylon and the other in 100% polyester, so the wearer effectively gets two jackets with one down core between them. It arrives in two contrast combinations, Black-Beige and Black-Gray, letting the jacket flip between a dark bomber and a lighter face depending on the day.Rounding out the capsule are three mountain parkas built as shell layers, with no fill listed for any of them. The base version sticks to black nylon, while its leopard counterpart moves to polyester in beige or gray. The faux fur leopard parka, offered in beige, pushes the print into a pile finish and gives the range its most statement-heavy silhouette.The WACKO MARIA x NANGA FW26 capsule drops October 31 at WACKO MARIA flagship stores, online, and authorized stockist. items.text: BAO Brings BFF and Its Taiwanese Fried Chicken to Singapore Summary BAO’s BFF pop-up lands at Singapore’s New Bahru from November 11 through December 28.The Chicken Chopper headlines a Taiwanese fast-food-inspired menu.Craft teas, grab-and-go snacks and convenience-store culture complete the concept. After making its homecoming debut in Taiwan earlier this year, BFF (BAO Fast Foods) is taking its next step in Singapore with a seven-week pop-up at New Bahru from November 11 through December 28, 2026.Developed by London restaurant group BAO with Singapore’s The Lo & Behold Group, BFF reimagines the fast-food format through the lens of Taiwanese convenience-store and street-food culture, treating speed and accessibility as only part of the experience. The Singapore edition will function as a testing ground as the team continues developing BFF ahead of its first permanent location, planned for the first half of 2027.Beyond the kitchen, the New Bahru space will borrow from the rhythms of an Asian convenience store, combining grab-and-go stations with Taiwanese snacks, Asian pantry staples, BAO-branded goods and rotating collaborations, while new items will be introduced throughout the run.At the center of the menu is the Chicken Chopper, BFF’s take on Taiwanese fried chicken and a recipe that has reportedly gone through more than 140 iterations. The bone is deliberately left attached as a handle before the chicken is dipped in soymilk batter and tapioca starch for a thin, crackly crust, then finished in three ways: Original Crispy with Taiwanese white pepper; Flame Glazed, brushed with either soy-garlic glaze or mala hot honey before being torched; and Master Scalded, dipped into a hot master sauce infused with soy, star anise and cinnamon. It can be ordered as a ricebox or combo, alongside dishes such as Dan Dan Noodles and a Beef Cup Noodle topped with meat carved from a slow-roasting spit.Drinks similarly sidestep standard fast-food conventions with Taiwanese craft teas developed with S.C Labs, including nitro-brewed Alishan Wintermelon and carbonated Orange Guava Beauty Tea, while an OATSIDE collaboration brings a peanut oat milk drink with boba and tea jelly. Egg sandos, marinated eggs, “Fried Rice” quinoa, golden kimchi, broth and soy puddings round out the grab-and-go selection. The pop-up will operate from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m., Wednesday through Monday, with 9 p.m. last orders, and will be walk-in only. View this post on Instagram A post shared

items.title: Lucien Smith’s Last Paintings Brought His Artistry ‘Full Circle’
items.text: Lucien Smith’s Last Paintings Brought His Artistry ‘Full Circle’ Summary Lucien Smith's final works are currently being shown at Tripoli Gallery in 'Delay of Game,' now on view until November 23The exhibition features four large-scale 'Rain Paintings' created this past August as part of a performance pieceThe works trace back to the early-career series that initially put Smith on the map Lucien Smith spent August at an abandoned baseball field in Montauk, New York, creating what would be his final exhibition. It was Rain Paintings, canvases sprayed by paint-filled fire extinguishers, that launched Smith, an artist turned Serving the People founder and FOOD revivalist, into stardom. Completed just a month prior to his death, at 37, last month, he saw the new show, Delay of Game, as a return to his early-career practice.Tripoli Gallery in Wainscott, New York, is currently presenting Smith’s final paintings in its ongoing exhibition. The show, which was originally slated for September and rescheduled in lieu of his death, features four large-scale Rain Paintings created as part of a live performance. Its title is drawn from a baseball call: when rain stops the play, the grounds crew roll out a tarp to protect the field. For Smith, the tarp catches the paint.Canvases take up dedicated walls, their fields of green and pink speckles have an effervescent, meditative quality, reflecting Smith’s own introspection and acceptance at the time of their creation. “A process like this is a gift,” he said. “When I was younger I thought I needed to keep looking, that landing on one thing so early meant I’d be missing something. I let the market and outside criticism dictate my practice, and that was a mistake. Life has taken me full circle. I think it is time to return to the process I was given.”Delay of Game is now on view until November 23.Tripoli Gallery26 Ardsley Road,Wainscott, NY 11975 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Rethinking Modern Workspace Lighting: The Design and Science Behind BenQ ScreenBar
items.text: Rethinking Modern Workspace Lighting: The Design and Science Behind BenQ ScreenBar For design lovers and digital creators, a desk is rarely just a place to park a laptop. It’s a carefully curated studio space where every detail, from a custom mechanical keyboard and monitor arm to a thoughtfully chosen desk mat, serves a purpose. But one essential element has often been overlooked: lighting designed around the way people use screens. As screens became central to how we work, create, and connect, desk lighting has not always kept pace with the needs of a screen-centered workspace. BenQ set out to rethink workspace lighting as an essential part of the digital ecosystem, bringing together human-centered design and optical expertise to create a lighting experience purpose-built for the digital workspace.BenQ’s approach to desk lighting extends beyond a one-size-fits-all solution. From the ScreenBar® models designed for a wide range of monitors to the iScreenBar, designed to complement the iMac’s distinctive silhouette, to the ScreenBar Max, developed for dual-monitor setups, each product reflects a considered approach to industrial design and the needs of different workspaces. Every curve, finish, and material choice is made to respect the underlying hardware. As JC Pan, Head of the Digital Lifestyle Product Business Unit at BenQ, explains: “The initial mounting concept proved workable, so subsequent iterations focused on refining it rather than replacing it with a different approach. The main challenge was to integrate iScreenBar with the iMac’s silhouette while maintaining microphone clearance and a secure mount.” That hyper-fixation on detail went so far as using acoustic frequency-response measurements to design mount cutouts that wouldn’t muffle the iMac’s internal microphones, paired with hidden magnetic cable organizers to keep Apple’s iconic logo completely unobstructed.Beyond Brightness: Lighting for Visual ComfortBeyond pure aesthetics, BenQ approaches desktop illumination as a way to support visual comfort for long-haul creators. After an eight-hour editing session, screen brightness may not be the only factor contributing to visual discomfort; strong lighting contrast between a glowing display and a dark room can also play a role. By pairing full-spectrum LEDs with precise color temperature control, creators can shift seamlessly from energizing cool light, up to 6500K on iScreenBar, for example, during daytime brainstorms to a warm, relaxing 2700K

items.title: Canelo Álvarez Dominates Christian Mbilli to Reclaim WBC Super Middleweight Championship
items.text: Canelo Álvarez Dominates Christian Mbilli to Reclaim WBC Super Middleweight Championship Summary Canelo Alvarez reclaimed the WBC super middleweight world title with a unanimous decision victory over Christian Mbilli in RiyadhAlvarez controlled the 12-round contest behind scorecards of 117-110 116-111 and 115-112 to hand Mbilli his first career defeatUndercard bouts saw Jaime Munguia and Rafael Espinoza defend their world titles as Team World edged Team Mexico 5-4 overall Mexican boxing icon Canelo Álvarez officially reclaimed the WBC super middleweight world championship with a unanimous decision victory over previously unbeaten Christian Mbilli in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Tthe commanding 12-round triumph capped a resilient return following a 13-month ring absence, elbow surgery, and his September 2025 loss to Terence Crawford.Serving as the main event of the "Mexico vs. The World" showcase, Álvarez (64-3-2, 39 KOs) dismantled Mbilli's high-pressure offense behind judges' scorecards of 117-110, 116-111, and 115-112. Executing a sharp strategic game plan designed by trainer Eddy Reynoso, the 36-year-old landed 132 power punches to Mbilli's 99, per CompuBox. Álvarez controlled the tempo throughout, taunting Mbilli from the ropes in round three before referee Hector Afu docked Mbilli a point in the eighth round for landing illegal blows.The victory re-establishes Álvarez as a world champion for the first time since losing his undisputed belts, setting up prospective clashes against Hamzah Sheeraz, Dmitry Bivol, or David Benavidez. Elsewhere on the fight card, Jaime Munguia successfully defended his WBA super middleweight title against Nikita Zon, and Rafael Espinoza retained his WBO featherweight title over Ricardo Blandon, though Team World claimed the overall card 5-4. items.title: JISOO Leans Into Dark Dance-Pop on Hypnotic New Solo Single "ADDICTED"
items.text: JISOO Leans Into Dark Dance-Pop on Hypnotic New Solo Single "ADDICTED" Summary JISOO has officially released her new solo single and accompanying music video for "ADDICTED"The dark dance-pop track explores the rush of magnetic attraction as an emotional parallel to her bond with fansThe release serves as the latest preview of her upcoming full-length solo album following her previous single "CLICK" BLACKPINK artist JISOO has officially released her new single "ADDICTED", delivering a moody dance-pop cut paired with an accompanying high-fashion music video. The track marks the latest preview of the BLACKPINK vocalist's forthcoming debut solo full-length album.Anchored by driving electronic rhythms, the single captures the intoxicating sensation of sudden attraction—a fleeting name, glance, or shared moment that lingers long after it passes. In a statement, her team explained that this romantic pull mirrors the enduring bond between JISOO and her listeners, transforming personal infatuation into a shared sentiment celebrating the anticipation of reuniting with what brings joy.The release builds directly upon the thematic groundwork laid by her previous single "CLICK," where a cinematic narrative cast JISOO as the sole sentient cyborg maintaining an abandoned theme park. Centered around the revitalizing bond between the protagonist and the symbolic "CLICK Bear"—a tribute to her global fanbase—the story emphasized unity across languages and borders. With "ADDICTED," JISOO pivots from futuristic whimsy to a sleek, nocturnal aesthetic, further expanding the visual and sonic world of her upcoming record.JISOO's new single "ADDICTED" and its accompanying music video are available now across streaming platforms. items.title: Pas Normal Studios and Salomon Reunite for Sixth Technical Running Capsule
items.text: Pas Normal Studios and Salomon Reunite for Sixth Technical Running Capsule Summary Pas Normal Studios and Salomon have unveiled their sixth collaboration designed for cyclists transitioning into cold-weather runningThe three-piece collection introduces the waterproof AERO BLAZE 4 GRVL GORE-TEX alongside the GRAVEL CONCEPT 2 vest and S/LAB BELTThe collaborative technical capsule drops on November 5 across both brands' webstores flagships and select global retailers Pas Normal Studios and Salomon have officially reunited for their sixth collaborative capsule, introducing a cold-weather running capsule headlined by the AERO BLAZE 4 GRVL GORE-TEX, the GRAVEL CONCEPT 2 vest, and the S/LAB BELT. Conceived specifically for the cyclist’s off-season transition into distance running, the three-piece lineup unites Scandinavian minimalism with alpine mountain performance.Anchoring the release is the AERO BLAZE 4 GRVL GORE-TEX, a versatile running shoe engineered for daily training across mixed terrains and unpredictable winter environments. The silhouette integrates Salomon’s signature lightweight cushioning and multi-surface traction with a fully waterproof GORE-TEX membrane for comprehensive weather resistance. Pas Normal Studios applies its refined color direction to the technical profile, establishing an aesthetic balance between high-output road and trail running and urban lifestyle versatility.The capsule is rounded out by two specialized storage solutions designed to maintain ergonomics during cold-weather movement. The GRAVEL CONCEPT 2 vest synthesizes Salomon’s proven expertise in stability, fit, and on-the-go hydration with a minimalist Nordic design language built for both daily routes and extended off-road exploration. Alongside the vest, the lightweight S/LAB BELT provides streamlined, bounce-free storage for essential gear. Highlighting the intersection of both endurance disciplines, Pas Normal Studios co-founder and creative director Karl-Oskar Olsen stated that the collection is designed to meet the demands of athletes seeking unexplored terrain during seasonal transitions.The Pas Normal Studios x Salomon collection releases on November 5, 2026, via PNS, Salomon, Pas Normal Studios flagship stores, and select global retail partners. items.text: Palace and Burberry Announce Limited-Edition Capsule for London Flagship Opening Summary Palace and Burberry have announced a limited-edition 10-piece collaborative capsule celebrating the opening of Palace's new London flagshipThe lineup reinterprets the classic Camden car coat in honey beige alongside graphic tees hooded jackets caps skateboards and a hybrid Tri-Ferg Equestrian Knight logoThe collection launches on November 5 exclusively in person at Palace's new Soho flagship located at 8 Poland Street Palace and Burberry have officially announced an exclusive collaborative collection, celebrating the opening of the London streetwear label's new flagship space. Uniting British heritage fashion with authentic skate culture, the 10-piece drop will be available exclusively at Palace’s new Soho location to commemorate the retail milestone.Leading the limited-edition lineup is Burberry’s signature Camden car coat, reworked in its original honey beige hue with countryside-inspired screen-printed artwork across the silhouette. The capsule expands across functional skate and casual wardrobe staples, encompassing hooded jackets, graphic tees, caps, and collaborative skateboards. Throughout the range, Burberry’s classic house check appears alongside a hybrid logo that blends Palace’s unmistakable Tri-Ferg emblem with Burberry’s heritage Equestrian Knight motif across select styles.The announcement lands at a defining transitional moment for Palace, which recently closed its long-standing Brewer Street location to make way for a larger, multi-floor flagship just around the corner at 8 Poland Street. Known for partnering with unexpected cultural powerhouses, the London skate imprint adds Burberry to its growing catalog of luxury collaborations, connecting high-end British tailoring directly with Soho street aesthetics.The Palace x Burberry capsule launches on November 5 exclusively at Palace’s new Soho flagship store located at 8 Poland Street in London. items.title: Golden State Valkyries Defeat Atlanta Dream in Game 7 to Capture Historic First WNBA Championship
items.text: Golden State Valkyries Defeat Atlanta Dream in Game 7 to Capture Historic First WNBA Championship Summary The Golden State Valkyries secured their first WNBA championship with a 68-63 Game 7 victory over the Atlanta DreamFinals MVP Gabby Williams scored 28 of her 30 points in the second half setting a new WNBA Finals record for points in a halfThe title comes in only the franchise's second season following previous collegiate and overseas championships for Williams The Golden State Valkyries captured their first WNBA championship in franchise history after defeating the Atlanta Dream 68-63 in Game 7 of the WNBA Finals. The victory comes in just the franchise's second season, propelled by a historic 30-point performance from Finals MVP Gabby Williams.After trailing by six points entering the locker room at halftime, Golden State mounted a fierce second-half comeback orchestrated almost entirely by Williams. The 30-year-old star exploded for 28 of her 30 points in the final 20 minutes, breaking the WNBA Finals record for the most points scored in a single half. Williams notched 15 points in the third quarter alone, shifting the momentum and handing the Valkyries a 45-44 lead heading into the final frame.With the deciding contest locked at 53-53 in the fourth quarter, Williams took control down the stretch, scoring nine straight points for Golden State. Her run was punctuated by a deep 3-pointer with 2:18 remaining to establish a 60-57 advantage that the Valkyries protected through the final buzzer. In addition to her offensive heroics, the Defensive Player of the Year runner-up anchored Golden State on the opposite end of the floor with four blocks.The triumph marks Williams' first career WNBA title following previous stints in Chicago and Seattle. The milestone also provides an elusive championship breakthrough after heartbreaking one-point international defeats representing France at the 2024 Paris Olympic Games and the women's FIBA World Cup. items.title: Louis Vuitton Unveils Weather-Defying SS27 Men's Pre-Collection
items.text: Louis Vuitton Unveils Weather-Defying SS27 Men's Pre-Collection Summary Louis Vuitton has unveiled its Spring-Summer 2027 Men's Pre-Collection designed by Men's Creative Director Pharrell WilliamsCentered on the theme Whatever the Weather the lineup showcases trompe l'oeil illusions alongside weathered Monogram Reporter bagsThe seasonal range expands into technical footwear including the LV Drop 300 sneaker and mud-splattered LV Ranger boots Louis Vuitton has officially unveiled its Spring/Summer 2027 Men’s Pre-Collection, designed by Men's Creative Director Pharrell Williams under the guiding title "Whatever the Weather." Engineered for the global traveler navigating shifting forecasts between continents, the expansive capsule blends rainwear utility with elevated dandy tailoring and weather-defying fabrications.The collection introduces the weathered Monogram Reporter motif, an aesthetic inspired by 1980s workwear that merges coated canvas with brown suede and leather paneling across blue nylon puffers, orange reversible gilets, and lasered denim sets. Archetypal rainwear garments are reimagined through luxury textiles, featuring shiny calfskin fisherman slickers, a durable puffer coat tailored in mini-Monogram jacquard, belted suiting, and packable fleece blousons that compress into their own front pocket.Optical illusion plays a defining role through Trompe L'Oeil Jersey pieces, utilizing an advanced printing technique on leather to mimic the tactile feel of classic grey sweat-shirting across hoodies, Keepall 50s, Speedy 30s, and Track backpacks. Additional trompe l'oeil treatments include a silver-coated denim jacket simulating rain saturation, cashmere suits woven to look like denim, and spongy rubber spray evoking mud splashes across denim jackets, the LV Trainer, and the LV Ranger boot.Luggage and footwear ranges further interpret the travel narrative. Bags spotlight faded blue and yellow Monogram Reporter canvases with cognac suede foundations, alongside a Keepall 35 adorned with 3D-printed glossy raindrops and an umbrella-shaped Monogram canvas bag. Footwear expands through the LV Drop 300 runner lined in fluffy mohair and mesh, the LV Titled sneaker, and the lightweight LV Ranger boot constructed from black suede, rubber, and ripstop. items.title: Vincent Cassel Transforms Into Quasimodo in Gritty Official Trailer for Netflix's 'The Hunchback, Soul of Paris'
items.text: Vincent Cassel Transforms Into Quasimodo in Gritty Official Trailer for Netflix's 'The Hunchback, Soul of Paris' Summary Netflix has debuted the first official trailer for the French-language period thriller 'The Hunchback, Soul of Paris'Vincent Cassel stars as an underground stonemason pursued by authorities for his immunity during an 1830 cholera plagueDirected by Jean-François Richet the dark historical adaptation premieres globally on Netflix on November 27 Netflix has officially released the first trailer for The Hunchback, Soul of Paris, delivering a gritty, grounded reimagining of the classic story popularized by Disney's 1996 animated feature. The French-language period thriller is scheduled to make its global streaming premiere on November 27, 2026.Directed by Jean-François Richet (Plane) and starring Vincent Cassel (Black Swan) as Quasimodo, the production strips away gothic musical conventions in favor of a realistic historical drama set against Paris' devastating 1830 cholera outbreak. In this iteration, Quasimodo is depicted as a reclusive stonemason who becomes hunted by French government officials seeking to exploit his rare immunity as a clinical test subject to manufacture a medical cure.The trailer showcases Cassel’s hooded character held captive behind underground bars before thrusting him into an atmosphere of escalating civic rebellion and personal devotion. As Quasimodo falls for a woman amid the social chaos, he evolves into an unlikely protector of the city. The release lands alongside Netflix's upcoming animated fairy-tale reinterpretation Steps, signaling a wider slate of unconventional literary revisions heading to the streamer.The Hunchback, Soul of Paris is scheduled to debut globally on Netflix on November 27, 2026.
