items.text: Official 'Pendulum' Trailer Takes Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Phoebe Dynevor on a Psychological Horror Journey Summary Vertical has debuted the first trailer for Mark Heyman's directorial debut 'Pendulum'The psychological horror film stars Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Phoebe Dynevor alongside Jacki Weaver Jena Malone and Norman ReedusProduced by Darren Aronofsky's Protozoa Pictures the movie hits theaters on January 1 2027 Vertical has officially unveiled the eerie debut trailer for Pendulum, marking the feature directorial debut of Black Swan screenwriter Mark Heyman. The psychological horror film stars Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Phoebe Dynevor, and is slated to arrive in theaters on New Year’s Day 2027.Produced by Darren Aronofsky through his Protozoa Pictures banner alongside producers Jacob and Dave, the New Mexico-set thriller follows married couple Patrick (Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Dynevor) as they travel to an isolated new-age retreat seeking recovery following a traumatic event. While Patrick seeks to support his wife, he quickly grows suspicious of the camp's enigmatic spiritual leader (Jacki Weaver) as Abigail falls deeper under her influence. The ensemble cast also features Jena Malone and Norman Reedus.Heyman revealed that the narrative is deeply personal and inspired by his own family lore, with filming taking place in his home state of New Mexico where the actual events occurred. The atmospheric preview highlights the escalating paranoia between the couple as they struggle to decipher whether the commune's esoteric practices offer true enlightenment or conceal a destructive threat.Pendulum is scheduled to release in theaters nationwide via Vertical on January 1, 2027. items.text: Nike Basketball and LeBron James Officially Introduce the LeBron 24 Summary Nike Basketball and LeBron James have officially unveiled the LeBron 24 as the lightest signature game shoe in the line's historyThe performance silhouette introduces KingKnit upper technology alongside a full-length React foam drop-in midsole and dual Air Zoom unitsThe Nike LeBron 24 officially launches November 1 followed by the debut Stars colorway releasing on November 12 Nike Basketball and LeBron James have officially debuted the Nike LeBron 24, marking the lightest signature game shoe in the franchise’s history. Built for the speed and demands of modern basketball, the performance model delivers a lighter, sharper, and more responsive setup encouraging the next generation of athletes to pursue greatness on their own terms.Engineered to provide breathable containment, responsive cushioning, and standout stability, the LeBron 24 introduces KingKnit across the upper. The LeBron-specific knit innovation utilizes a unique combination of yarns engineered for lightweight strength, ventilation, and lockdown containment during explosive cuts and changes in direction. Underfoot, a full-length React foam drop-in midsole system functions alongside forefoot and heel Air Zoom units, reinforced by a midfoot shank for structural support and a new multidirectional traction pattern.The model also signals a strategic shift in storytelling, moving from past retrospectives to sharing principles from James' career. The release framework centers around five thematic pillars: Wonder, Family, Fear, Luck, and Discovery. Leading the narrative rollout, the debut "Stars" colorway represents the Wonder principle, drawing inspiration from a formative AAU basketball team from LeBron's childhood.The Nike LeBron 24 will be available November 1, 2026, via Nikeand select retailers, followed by the release of the "Stars" colorway on November 12, 2026. items.title: Converse Really Cooked With Its New Kitchen-Ready Chucks
items.text: Converse Really Cooked With Its New Kitchen-Ready Chucks Summary Converse’s At Your Service collection reimagines traditional kitchen footwear, combining the iconic Chuck Taylor silhouette with industry-standard safety features and all-day comfort.The collection includes Chuck Taylor All Star High Top, Low Top, and Slip-On models, featuring slip-resistant soles, CX cushioning, and water- and oil-repellent canvas or easy-to-clean leather uppers.The Converse At Your Service collection launches November 3 via Converse.com and select retailers. The service industry has, quite frankly, been underserved when it comes to footwear. For years, the term "line cook shoes" has been synonymous with orthopedic-looking sneakers and clogs designed more for comfort than getting a 'fit off in the kitchen.Converse is looking to change that with its new At Your Service collection, reimagining traditional kitchen footwear through its iconic Chuck Taylor All Star. Think of it as a sneaker collection for the cooks who live and breathe by their Chucks, but haven't necessarily been able to wear them safely or comfortably through long shifts in the kitchen.Featuring the Chuck Taylor All Star High Top, Low Top, and Slip-On, the collection retains the familiar silhouettes while introducing a series of workplace-ready upgrades. These include slip-resistant diamond-pattern outsoles, CX cushioning for all-day comfort, and durable materials built to withstand demanding kitchen environments. Canvas iterations feature breathable, water- and oil-repellent uppers, while leather versions offer an easy-to-clean finish.Meeting or exceeding ASTM SRO and ISO occupational footwear standards for slip resistance, the collection brings some much-needed personality to a category where function has traditionally taken priority over style.The Converse At Your Service collection launches November 3 via Converse.com and select retailers. items.title: Unpacking the Recipe Behind Goya Gumbani’s EP
items.text: Unpacking the Recipe Behind Goya Gumbani’s EP There are a couple of things synonymous with Goya Gumbani: loafers, a large hat, and his distinctive neo-soul and jazz sound. As a continuation from his previous project, Warlord Of Weejuns, which references Miles Davis’ alias as well as his affinity for the iconic GH Bass silhouette, Gumbani took pockets of inspiration from his travels to fuel the sound of his latest EP, Bean Pie.For the Brooklyn-born, South London artist and producer, drawing from his transatlantic upbringing comes naturally. Having been working on his latest project for the past year, Gumbani has curated his story into five songs, exploring the natural challenges in life as crossroads, and the uncertainty that comes with making decisions which he explores in the EP’s focal track, “Come Or Go.”."This EP took it back to the foundations for me. It was nice to just go back and make music loosely with the love, passion and care that I started doing it for in the first place."He is never short of inspiration, the multicultural environments he grew up in exposed him to diverse worlds that shape his perspective today. His Guyanese and Jamaican heritage is integral to his self-expression as an artist. Accrediting his Rastafarian style to his family, in particular his uncle, who unapologetically embrace their culture through everyday life. Take his signature hat selection, for example, the inspiration spans a broad spectrum of influence, from London-based labels like Nicholas Daley to handmade creations by a fellow New Yorker who knits hats on a park bench in Prospect Park. Bold and adventurous in his approach, he continuously pushes both sonic and style boundaries, gathering meaningful pieces that speak to his visual narrative.Just like cooking without following a recipe, Gumbani built upon the foundations of his previous work, and incorporated the creative freedom of not making a full album, trialing new techniques and exploring a faster-paced tempo after being intrigued by house music. The sonic flow, in which Bean Pie adapts to, is a result of his open approach to experimenting with new genres, and learning new ways to tell stories which has become a cherished experience for the London-based artist.Hypebeast caught up with the artist to discuss the latest project and how it’s a reflection of his true love for music.Hypebeast: What was the inspiration behind the EP’s title, Bean Pie?Gumbani: I love beans, which my name is derived from, and I was co

items.title: 18 East Revives Alphanumeric for Artisanal Fall 2026 Skate Collection
items.text: 18 East Revives Alphanumeric for Artisanal Fall 2026 Skate Collection Summary 18 East has unveiled its Fall 2026 collection featuring a collaborative nine-piece capsule with Alyasha Owerka Moore's AlphanumericThe capsule reimagines archival skatewear designs through artisanal hand block printing organic cotton fleeces and hand-knit Japanese beaniesThe full seasonal collection is scheduled to release on October 29 at 11 AM ET via the Eighteen East webstore and its New York studio 18 East has officially introduced its Fall 2026 skate collection, anchored by a collaborative nine-piece capsule reviving Alyasha Owerka Moore's influential brand, Alphanumeric. Unveiled by designer Antonio Ciongoli, the range reinterprets the futuristic aesthetic of late-1990s skatewear through Eighteen East's signature slow-manufacturing techniques and artisanal handcraft.Rather than relying on overt cobranding, the collection grounds Alphanumeric's tech-forward legacy in hand-worked textiles. Traditional screen prints and synthetic fibers are traded for hand block printed graphics, organic cottons, and artisanal finishes. Key capsule offerings include a 19 oz all-cotton cinch-hem afterhood sweatshirt with an inset zip kangaroo pocket, two iterations of the archival "RAE" t-shirt, and a woodland camouflage full-zip jacket paired with articulated knee easy pants in loopback terry. The capsule also introduces a deep pile organic cotton fleece with 3M reflective piping, block-printed ripstop camp hats and roll-top sling bags, and a 30-piece run of Japanese hand-knit mohair beanies rendered in A#'s signature gray, royal, and gold.The capsule is accompanied by 18 East's broader seasonal release, featuring new bottom silhouettes like the 13 oz Indian denim Granite jean and the relaxed Reese Chino in cotton twill. Other utilitarian arrivals include the checkerboard-printed AJ quarter-zip thermal, a restock of double-dyed TAC cargo pants, the water-repellent Tracks quilted insulator jacket, handloomed Peruvian alpaca and merino knitwear, and an updated three-layer Cascade technical shell.The Eighteen East Fall 2026 collection and Alphanumeric collaboration is now available via 18east.co, with select pieces available at the brand's Elizabeth Street studio in New York. items.title: Here’s What You Should Check Out at ISEA2026 Dubai
items.text: Here’s What You Should Check Out at ISEA2026 Dubai The 31st edition of ISEA2026 Dubai is about to take over the city. For 10 days, the electronic and emerging art fair will go from space to systems, with cultural exhibitions, workshops, and experiences exploring the theme of “ELYAH: Constellating Place, Data and Identity.”For the first time, the event is structured around a hybrid format, hosting a citywide Artistic Programme and an Online Academic Programme. After receiving over 1,000 art submissions, the Artistic Programme brings a curation of shortlisted interactive installations, exhibitions, and live performances. These activations are set to take place across more than 20 venues in Dubai, such as The Foundry, ARTE Museum and Etihad Museum, while locations like Al Wasl Dome and Theatre of Digital Art will host more site-specific digital installations for an immersive experience.Adding to the schedule, a handful of workshops will show how to create calligraphy, letter art and typography with digital tools, including Calligraphy to Code. The workshops feature discussions with local artists, so guests can explore how traditional art forms are evolving in real-world scenarios.Expanding beyond its regional network, the academic arm comprises a series of panel talks and presentations focused on bringing humans closer to the networks that surround us. This will unfold in courses like Charting Constellations and Starlinked Worlds, as well as a cosmically attuned track called Celestial Dialogues. Alongside the courses, there is a specially curated Ecological Future Labs track that examines sustainable practices through critical thinking. Speaking on the upcoming edition, Maitha Ali Al Blooshi, Director of the Emerging Arts Department at Dubai Culture, shared, “ISEA2026 Dubai brings together diverse disciplines and expertise, creating opportunities for art, research and technology to inform one another. Through collaboration and the development of artistic practice, it supports the growth and sustainability of the digital and emerging arts sector. It also provides a platform to explore how technology, imagination, knowledge and culture can come together to generate new ideas, artworks and creative approaches.”Take a glimpse at what to expect from the art schedule in the gallery above. Find out how to visit ISEA2026 Dubai by visiting the dedicated webpage. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Sky High Goods & On Reframe Farming as the Original Sport
items.text: Sky High Goods & On Reframe Farming as the Original Sport With an official launch slated for November 5, Sky High Goods x On is readying its second collaborative collection, this time introducing the all-new Cloud Low WP SHG, alongside a farmer-focused apparel range. Strengthening their ties after an SS26 debut, the two labels have unveiled the official Farm Strong campaign shot by Jack Davison, a poetic illustration of their shared foundations. On paper, Sky High Goods, the brand powering the food equity initiative Sky High Farm, and activewear label On may not appear to have much in common. The workwear-inspired pieces from Sky High Goods support the Hudson, NY non-profit — a project centered around cultivating a more just food system. On finds its roots across the Atlantic in Switzerland, crafting premium footwear, apparel, and accessories for activities like running, outdoor treks, tennis, and more. However, by “framing farming as the original sport,” their FW26 campaign reveals that the two labels have more in common than meets the eye.“The Farm Strong campaign brings the idea to life by framing farming as the original sport." — Lucy Delacherois-Day, Global Senior Director of Product, OnThat idea extends beyond the visuals and into the actual development of the products. Ahead of the launch, Global Senior Director of Product at On, Lucy Delacherois-Day, explained, “For FW26, we’ve brought the partnership into performance workwear, looking at the physical demands of farming through On’s understanding of movement.” She added that the partners “developed and field-tested with real farmers from Sky High Farm’s community,” ensuring that “everyday utility is central to it.” Sky High Goods o Co-CEO and CMO Daphne Seybold added that farmer feedback heavily shaped the final design choices, allowing them to create a collection that “actively addresses the functional and utilitarian demands of the farmer as they move through their day.”The centerpiece of their FW26 collection is the Cloud Low WP SHG, an easy-to-wear moc-style shoe drawing from the foundation of the Cloud Hi with a waterproof construction and Missiongrip™ outsole technology for stability. Built to withstand wet, uneven farm grounds, the pair arrives in two dark monochromatic colorways, including all-black and Date/Torchwood, so you don’t have to worry about getting them dirty. items.title: Sabine Marcelis' First-Ever Solo Museum Show Has Just Opened
items.text: Sabine Marcelis' First-Ever Solo Museum Show Has Just Opened The first-ever solo show dedicated to Dutch designer Sabine Marcelis has just opened in Zürich, bringing together the most comprehensive overview of her work to date. Named "Sabine Marcelis – Light and Color", the show tracks Marcelis' output, from the opening of her studio in 2011 to present day. Across the whole show, as the title suggests, her consistent focus on light and color is examined, with visitors able to learn more about her processes while seeing the works up close. "I didn't want this exhibition to be an archive of past projects but rather an insight into how I work, how we play with light, material and colour in my studio," said Sabine Marcelis, who lives and works in Rotterdam having graduated from the Design Academy Eindhoven in 2011. With putting an emphasis on the present in mind, Marcelis revisited her relationship with UK-based lava lamp manufacturer Mathmos to create a site-specific installation that features extra large floor-to-ceiling lava lamps within a mirrored room. And while it's not an archival show as such, there are earlier works on show. Her famous "Candy Cube" series (debuted in 2014) makes an appearance, along with the Tall Stripe piece from 2013. Scenography has been developed by the designer and her studio, and of course, makes expert use of lighting to exaggerate the materiality of the works. In one section, she has created a light tunnel that features pieces from her IKEA VARMBLIXT collection. Marcelis' solo show at the Museum für Gestaltung Zürich highlights follows on from exhibitions with Jasper Morrison in 2016, Formafantasma in 2022, and Tatiana Bilbao in 2024. It will remain on view until April 4, 2027. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: PUMA and JiyongKim Channel Natural Aging on the Collaborative CELL Geo
items.text: PUMA and JiyongKim Channel Natural Aging on the Collaborative CELL Geo PUMA and Korean designer JiyongKim have officially introduced the collaborative PUMA CELL Geo, redefining the futuristic performance silhouette through the lens of weathering and time. Merging technical sportswear innovation with artisanal surface treatments, the collaboration presents a worn-in study of contemporary footwear.Renowned for experimental menswear that incorporates solar fading, environmental stains, and weather-shaped textures, JiyongKim applies his unique aging philosophy directly to the CELL Geo. The shoe's sculptural architecture is reworked with aged fabrics, distressed detailing, frayed laces, and specialized surface treatments. Each deliberate imperfection reflects the marks that accumulate naturally over time, creating a deliberate dialogue between PUMA's technical construction and a weathered aesthetic.At the foundation, the sneaker retains its signature decoupled CELL heel unit, supplying geometric structure and advanced cushioning to the silhouette. Fluid cut lines and semi-shrouded laces preserve the shoe's streamlined, futuristic profile while emphasizing the contrast with its organic finishing. In addition to the mainline offering, an exclusive Black colorway will launch in limited quantities solely through JiyongKim's direct retail operations.The PUMA x JiyongKim CELL Geo drops November 7, 2026, via PUMA, PUMA flagships, select stockists, and JiyongKim's online and Seoul flagship stores, followed by a dedicated Japan release and pop-up at GR8 on November 14. items.title: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' Reboot Hits $400 Million USD at the Global Box Office
items.text: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' Reboot Hits $400 Million USD at the Global Box Office Summary Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' reboot has crossed 400 million USD at the global box officeThe film has become the highest-grossing entry in the franchise surpassing 2016's Resident Evil: The Final ChapterProduced on a 75 million USD budget the horror feature has earned 157.399 million USD domestically and 242.6 million USD internationally Sony Pictures and filmmaker Zach Cregger have reached a major box-office milestone with Resident Evil, officially surpassing $400 million USD in worldwide ticket sales. The live-action video game reboot has now become the highest-grossing entry in the 24-year-old horror franchise.Produced on a $75 million USD budget, the film has generated $157.399 million USD in North America and $242.6 million USD internationally, toppling 2016's Resident Evil: The Final Chapter ($312 million USD) for the series crown. The milestone also cements the project as Cregger's biggest box-office achievement to date, eclipsing his 2022 breakout Barbarian ($46 million USD) and 2025's Weapons ($270 million USD).Starring Austin Abrams as a medical courier battling infested monsters across Raccoon City, the adaptation opened in September to a franchise-record $60 million USD domestically and $108 million USD globally. Buoyed by positive reviews and strong audience scores throughout October, the horror release was driven by substantial overseas returns, including $71.4 million USD in China, $19.4 million USD in the United Kingdom, and $12.7 million USD in Mexico.The commercial success delivers a profitable rebound for Sony following 2021's Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City, which stalled at $42 million USD worldwide, revitalizing the Capcom gaming property originally adapted on screen by Milla Jovovich in 2002. Pumpkin Spice-toned details introduce warmer contrast around the darker tooling, while the deeply lugged Mud Contagrip® outsole maintains the traction expected from the brand’s trail footwear. A metal buckle, subtle embroidery and intentionally exposed structural elements reinforce the utilitarian, lived-in quality of the design, reflecting THE BROKEN ARM’s concept of exploring youth and everyday life beyond major cities.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Audemars Piguet’s Code 11.59 Supersonnerie Lets You See the Chime Before You Hear It
items.text: Audemars Piguet’s Code 11.59 Supersonnerie Lets You See the Chime Before You Hear It Summary Audemars Piguet introduces a 41mm Code 11.59 Minute Repeater Supersonnerie in white gold.Two 38mm Code 11.59 models feature natural obsidian and black onyx dials.The releases combine patented chiming technology, precious metals and automatic watchmaking. Audemars Piguet is closing out 2026 with two Code 11.59 releases built around one idea: craft you can see and, in one case, hear. On one side, the Maison revisits its patented Supersonnerie technology with a new 41mm Minute Repeater, showcasing its expertise in chiming complications. On the other, two 38mm Selfwinding references introduce natural obsidian and black onyx dials, highlighting the visual depth and individual character of stone. While the releases take different approaches to watchmaking, both reflect Audemars Piguet’s continued interest in balancing technical sophistication with distinctive materials and finishing.The Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet Minute Repeater Supersonnerie 41mm arrives in an 18-carat white gold case, distinguished by a smoked sapphire dial that offers a subtle view of the mechanics beneath. Silver-toned details, white gold baton hands and hour markers, and a grey alligator strap complete its restrained aesthetic. At its core is the manually wound Calibre 2953, featuring 362 components and a 72-hour power reserve.The movement incorporates Audemars Piguet’s Supersonnerie construction, which first debuted in the Royal Oak Concept RD#1 in 2016 following eight years of development involving watchmakers, musicians and researchers from EPFL. Its patented gongs are mounted on a dedicated soundboard, while an innovative caseback construction creates a resonance chamber designed to enhance the watch's acoustic performance. The 41mm reference measures 13.6mm thick and offers 20 meters of water resistance.Meanwhile, the 38mm Code 11.59 Selfwinding Stone Dial models introduce two contrasting interpretations of natural stone. The first pairs an 18-carat yellow gold case with a gold obsidian dial, whose naturally occurring mineral inclusions are brought into focus through a sunburst finish that radiates across its dark surface. Yellow gold hands and hour markers, a shimmering brown inner bezel and a black alligator strap reinforce its warmer palette.Its counterpart takes a more understated approach, combining an 18-carat pink gold case with a mirror-polished black onyx dial. items.title: Kith's Monday Program Welcomes Back TUMI for a Third Collaborative Release
items.text: Kith's Monday Program Welcomes Back TUMI for a Third Collaborative Release Summary Kith and TUMI reunite for their third collaboration through Kith's Monday Program.Three 19 Degree Aluminum Carry-Ons feature ombré finishes and Kith monogramming.Matching travel accessories complete the capsule, with prices ranging from $395 to $1,495 USD. Kith and TUMI are back together for their third partnership, and this time the collaboration arrives through Kith’s Monday Program, the retailer’s weekly series of special releases and collaborations that goes live every Monday.The new drop focuses on TUMI’s signature 19 Degree Aluminum collection, offering three new versions of the Carry-On suitcase: Astro Ombre, which shifts from charcoal to a lighter taupe; Majestic Ombre, in deep slate teal; and Rogue Ombre, in dusty rose. The sculpted diagonal ridges of the aluminum shell carry a tonal, all-over Kith logo pattern that changes with each colorway, from a tiled KITH wordmark on Astro to a looping monogram on Rogue.Inside, each Carry-On has a lining that matches its shell, a co-branded leather patch and a set of packing cubes. Instead of bundling a full kit with every suitcase, each colorway gets one companion accessory made from the same aluminum. Astro pairs with a Travel Cigar Case fitted with a cedar interior, a cigar cutter and five slots. Majestic gets a Sunglass Case with a magnetic closure, and Rogue gets a Watch Case that holds three timepieces on cushioned pillows. Each accessory has a black leather Kith patch on its lid.The Kith for TUMI 2026 collection releases today, November 2, at 11 a.m. EST through Kith’s Monday Program, and in Japan at Kith Tokyo, Kith Osaka, JP.Kith.com and the Kith App. Prices range from $395 USD for the Sunglass Case to $1,495 USD for each Carry-On, with the Travel Cigar Case and Watch Case at $595 USD each. items.title: Fender and Pokémon Center Celebrate 30th Anniversary With "Red Version" Stratocaster and "Green Version" Telecaster
items.text: Fender and Pokémon Center Celebrate 30th Anniversary With "Red Version" Stratocaster and "Green Version" Telecaster Summary Fender and Pokémon Center have joined forces to create two special-edition Made in Japan electric guitars celebrating Pokémon's 30th anniversaryThe Red Version Stratocaster and Green Version Telecaster feature pixel-art body graphics custom single-coil pickups and an onboard 8-Bit Sound SystemBoth instruments come equipped with a commemorative engraved neck plate a certificate of authenticity and a dedicated hardshell case Fender and Pokémon Center have officially unveiled two commemorative electric guitars to celebrate the franchise's 30th anniversary: the Made in Japan Pokémon "Red Version" Stratocaster and the Made in Japan Pokémon "Green Version" Telecaster. The collaborative instruments pay tribute to the seminal 1996 Pokémon Red and Pokémon Green Game Boy releases, integrating iconic 8-bit artwork directly with Fender's Japanese craftsmanship.Both models are built upon an alder body paired with a maple neck, featuring a 9.5-inch radius fretboard and narrow-tall frets. The "Red Version" Stratocaster is outfitted with a rosewood fingerboard alongside custom-developed Pokémon "Red Version" Stratocaster Single-Coil pickups. In contrast, the "Green Version" Telecaster features a maple fingerboard complemented by bespoke Pokémon "Green Version" Telecaster Single-Coil pickups. Each body showcases pixel-art graphics drawn directly from the classic titles, paired with a specialized pixel-inspired pickguard treated with a light-reactive finish that produces a glowing effect on stage.Beyond visual aesthetics, both instruments introduce Fender's proprietary 8-Bit Sound System. Activated by depressing the master volume knob, the internal circuitry infuses the guitar's standard analog output with authentic 8-bit synthesizer tones, recreating the nostalgic chiptune sonics of the original Game Boy era. The guitars are completed with a custom 30th-anniversary pixel-art logo engraved into the neck plate, an original pick and pick tin set, an illustrated certificate of authenticity, and a dedicated protective hardshell case.Those looking to purchase the guitar can enter online at Pokémon Center via a lottery-based sales program. Applications will be accepted from November 19 at 12 p.m. JST through November 24 at 4:59 p.m. JST. Further details, including the announcement of lottery results, will be provided on Pokémon Center Online at a later date.

items.title: EVANGELION:95 Taps BOBartwork for One-Line Unit-02 Graphics in Its Latest FW26 Drop
items.text: EVANGELION:95 Taps BOBartwork for One-Line Unit-02 Graphics in Its Latest FW26 Drop Summary EVANGELION:95 reunites with BOBartwork for graphics drawn in one continuous lineThree Unit-02 heads front a sweatshirt and tee backed by crossed Lances of LonginusAn Episode 5 long-sleeve spotlights Rei and her “Could you move, please?” line Following its previous Fall/Winter 2026 releases, EVANGELION:95 returns with a new selection of graphic sweatshirts and T-shirts, continuing its exploration of archival-inspired merchandise from the original 1995 Neon Genesis Evangelion anime.This latest delivery introduces a second series of collaborative designs with Hiroshima-based artist BOBartwork, alongside a separate piece dedicated to Rei Ayanami. Maintaining the label's signature faux-vintage aesthetic, the collection imagines the kind of character merchandise that could have accompanied the anime's original television broadcast, combining nostalgic graphics with heavyweight cotton fabrics and worn-in finishes.Leading the lineup are the Unit-02 sweatshirt and T-shirt, both featuring Bob artwork's signature continuous-line illustrations. Created without lifting the pen from the paper, the artwork depicts three overlapping interpretations of EVA Unit-02, complemented by Spear of Longinus-inspired graphics on the back, “95” branding on the right sleeve and repeated “PRODUCTION MODEL-02” lettering on the left. The sweatshirt is constructed from soft cotton fleece with a substantial, reverse-weave-inspired texture, voluminous sleeves and a brushed lining.Meanwhile, the matching T-shirt is crafted from 6.5 oz heavyweight cotton with a smooth finish. Rounding out the release is a Rei Ayanami graphic top paying homage to the original anime's “Rei, Beyond Her Heart” episode. The design features a prominent scene illustration, Japanese lettering referencing Rei's dialogue on the reverse, and Unit-01 and “95” graphics across the sleeves. The collection was released on October 31, 2026, through EVANGELION:95's official online store and select retailers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The First teamLab Museum in the US Is Officially Headed to Anaheim
items.text: The First teamLab Museum in the US Is Officially Headed to Anaheim Summary teamLab is opening its first permanent U.S. museum at OCVIBE, the 100-acre arts, sports and entertainment district rising in Anaheimsmith-clementi designed a scale-textured facade that shifts in color throughout the day while concealing the windowless galleries insideThe building is planned as a visual counterpoint to the neighboring ARTIC transit center, dominating by daylight and receding after dark teamLab has revealed plans for teamLab Museum Anaheim (tentative name), its first permanent museum in the United States, set to open in 2030 at OCVIBE in Anaheim, California. Purpose-built around the collective’s immersive work, the museum is designed by smith-clementi, OCVIBE’s master planners, and will debut a new exhibition created for the space.The building’s form started with a constraint set by the art itself, since teamLab’s immersive installations depend on darkened rooms with little to no natural light. Rather than disguise a largely windowless box, smith-clementi treated the facade as an outer skin draped over the blacked-out galleries, giving a solid mass a sense of motion.That skin carries a textured pattern inspired by natural forms, with a scale-like rhythm that suggests movement across its surface. It also reacts to the sun, slowly changing in color and appearance as daylight shifts from morning to evening. Siting amplifies the effect: placed at one end of OCVIBE with clear sightlines from the freeway, the museum is meant to present a different face to drivers passing at speed than to visitors walking up to its entrance.Julie Smith-Clementi pointed to that changeability as the heart of the project. “This building feels different depending on the direction or pace of your approach. The time of day, or movement of clouds participates in rendering its iridescent cloak, enriching what you think you see,” she said in the announcement.The facade is also tuned to its closest neighbor, the ARTIC transit center, and works as its mirror image. Where ARTIC is glassy and glows from within, the museum reads as an opaque, saturated mass that peaks in daylight, then steps back after sunset so the station’s illuminated frame can take the lead. items.title: My Chemical Romance’s ‘The Black Parade’ Finally Hits No. 1 on the Billboard 200 After 20 Years
items.text: My Chemical Romance’s ‘The Black Parade’ Finally Hits No. 1 on the Billboard 200 After 20 Years Summary My Chemical Romance scores its first Billboard 200 No. 1 as 'The Black Parade' rockets from No. 139 to the top on the November 7-dated chartThe 20th anniversary deluxe reissue earned 78,000 equivalent album units, driven overwhelmingly by physical salesTwo decades after the album stalled at No. 2, its trip to No. 1 now stands as the longest wait ever for an album My Chemical Romance has landed its first No. 1 album on the Billboard 200, with The Black Parade vaulting 139-1 on the November 7-dated chart following the release of the 2006 album’s 20th anniversary deluxe reissue. The set pulled in 78,000 equivalent album units in the U.S. during the tracking week ending October 29, a 653 percent jump, per Luminate. The Black Parade first debuted and peaked at No. 2 and had remained the band’s highest-charting album until this week.Physical buyers did the heavy lifting behind the surge, with pure album sales accounting for 68,000 of the week’s units, up 2,082 percent. That total sent the record soaring 29-1 on Top Album Sales, marking the group’s first week atop that chart as well. Vinyl alone moved 42,000 copies, the best vinyl week of the band’s career, helped by a rollout spanning more than 20 physical variants across vinyl, CD and cassette, including signed editions, all of which are combined for charting purposes. Streaming equivalent albums contributed another 10,000 units, up 34 percent and equal to 10.14 million on-demand official streams, while track equivalent album units added a negligible amount.The milestone rewrites a pair of chart records in the process. Reaching No. 1 two decades after release is now the longest wait ever for an album, topping the 15-year, nine-month gap set by Toby Keith’s 35 Biggest Hits after his death in 2024. Counting from the band’s Billboard 200 debut with Three Cheers for Sweet Revenge on the June 26, 2004-dated chart, My Chemical Romance waited 22 years and four months for a leader, making it the third act this year to go at least a decade between first entry and first No. 1. Jhené Aiko did it in September with Westside Whimsy, 12 years and 10 months after her 2013 debut, and Megadeth followed a near-40-year path to No. 1 with its self-titled set in February. items.text: New Era Commemorates The Milwaukee Brewers’ First Title With a 2026 World Series Championship Collection Summary New Era marks the Milwaukee Brewers’ first World Series title with a collection spanning locker room, side patch and parade headwearThe lineup includes the caps worn during the on-field championship celebration and at the team’s World Series paradeCommissioner’s Trophy embroidery, commemorative side patches and Brewers branding run across silhouettes ranging from the 59FIFTY to a cuffed knit beanie New Era has unveiled its Milwaukee Brewers 2026 World Series Championship Collection, a headwear and apparel range commemorating the franchise’s first-ever World Series title. As the Official Cap of MLB, the brand has split the headwear into three distinct lines: Locker Room styles, team-colored Side Patch caps and a dedicated parade cap.The title closes out a postseason the Brewers controlled from start to finish, following a record-breaking regular season and ending a wait that stretched back decades. New Era CEO Chris Koch spoke to both the team’s run and the city behind it in a statement, saying, “The passion of Brewers’ fans has been incredible, and their loyalty has endured through every high and low.”Leading the lineup, the Locker Room Collection arrives in 9FORTY A-Frame, 9TWENTY and Dart Cuff Beanie styles. Each is built in official Brewers colors with an embroidered team logo up front and either a “2026 World Series Champions” or “2026 World Series” patch on the side, balanced by a New Era flag on the other side and the MLB batter logo stitched at the rear.The Parade 9FIFTY A-Frame breaks from the rest of the lineup with a white crown and gray visor. items.text: Nike SB Dunk Low "Champagne" Celebrates 25th Anniversary of SB Dunks Summary Nike SB is commemorating the 25th anniversary of the SB Dunk with an upcoming Champagne colorwayOfficial imagery reveals glossy green patent leather uppers metallic gold accents cork insoles and gothic typographyThe celebratory sneaker is scheduled to arrive at select skate shops and Nike SNKRS in November 2026 for 130 USD Name: Nike SB Dunk Low "Champagne"Colorway: Black Spruce-Black-Bright Ceramic-Metallic GoldSKU: IQ0431-300MSRP: $180 USDRelease Date: November 6, 2026Where to Buy: NikeNike SB is celebrating the upcoming 25th anniversary of its iconic flagship silhouette with the Nike SB Dunk Low "Champagne". items.title: Apple Is Reportedly Planning a New iPad Air, Base iPad, and iPad Pro for the First Half of 2027
items.text: Apple Is Reportedly Planning a New iPad Air, Base iPad, and iPad Pro for the First Half of 2027 Summary Apple is preparing a massive hardware overhaul for early 2027, introducing three new iPad models to the lineupThe mid-tier iPad Air will receive an OLED display and the M5 chip, triggering a likely price increaseThe entry-level iPad is gaining Apple Intelligence support, while the top-tier iPad Pro will integrate a vapor chamber for elite cooling According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple is gearing up to launch three new iPad models in the first half of 2027. The impending roster overhaul will officially introduce a new iPad Air, a revamped base iPad and a next-generation iPad Pro. This release strategy marks a major technical shift for Apple's more affordable tablets by bringing historically premium features down to accessible tiers. By injecting OLED technology and advanced software capabilities into the lower half of the lineup, Apple raises its baseline standard for entry-level devices.The highly anticipated iPad Air represents a significant visual leap forward, as the mid-tier tablet is expected to gain an OLED display. Despite the panel upgrade, the device will retain a standard 60Hz refresh rate and keep its traditional Touch ID sensor rather than making the jump to Face ID. Under the hood, the next iPad Air is slated to upgrade directly from the M4 processor to the M5 chip. The base 11-inch model of the new iPad Air is anticipated to see a price increase, likely hitting the market at around $799 USD to $899 USD.Further down the hierarchy, the base iPad is preparing for its first hardware update since early 2025. Apple is set to modernize its most accessible tablet, equipping the device with the A19 chip and 8GB of RAM. This memory threshold officially enables Apple Intelligence support on the entry-level model, expanding access to the company's advanced software suite. Beyond processing power, the base iPad should also gain the N1 chip and the C1X modem to improve its networking performance. While no overarching screen or physical design changes are currently expected, Apple may offer the device in a series of refreshed color options.At the top of the roster, the forthcoming iPad Pro is prioritizing performance and thermal management. The flagship tablet will add a vapor chamber to maintain cooling under heavy workloads. Powering the new iPad Pro will be an updated chipset, likely arriving as either the M6 or M7 silicon. items.title: Lunay Wants To Gift You UGGs for Christmas
items.text: Lunay Wants To Gift You UGGs for Christmas Lunay is bringing a little Puerto Rican warmth to the holiday season. The reggaeton star joins Yeat, JT and KATSEYE’s Megan Skiendiel for UGG’s latest holiday campaign, "Gift the Feeling". The campaign reflects the playfulness of gift-giving, putting personal connection, unexpected surprises and cozy footwear at the center of your holiday festivities.From walking the runway for Willy Chavarria to developing an unforgettable on-stage look, Lunay continues to make his mark in fashion. This time, he is trading the spotlight for a holiday gift exchange, bringing his recognizable Puerto Rican energy to a campaign that celebrates the joy of giving just as much as receiving.Hypebeast caught up with Lunay to discuss his favorite Christmas traditions back home in Puerto Rico, why comfort remains a non-negotiable part of his wardrobe, and the importance of putting genuine thought into the gifts we give. He also shares what makes the perfect holiday surprise and why a good pair of UGG boots might top his Christmas list.How did your holiday partnership with UGG come about?I had already had the opportunity to work with the brand on their clog campaign, so working together again felt very natural. I like how UGG combines style and comfort, and I liked this campaign because it also speaks to something I value a lot: being thoughtful with the people you love and finding ways to show them how much they mean to you with gifts.What is your first memory wearing UGG boots?The first thing that comes to mind is how comfortable they are. I always saw them as something for the cold, but I like how nowadays you can wear them with any outfit and put your own twist on them. How are you celebrating the holiday season with UGG for the first time?This year, I had the opportunity to be part of a very special holiday campaign with UGG. I truly loved the experience, especially the gift-exchange activity, where we got to surprise one another. It was a unique and fun way to kick off the holiday season.What clothing items are essential for you during the colder months of the year?In Puerto Rico, it’s rarely cold, so when I travel to cold places like New York, I do have to prepare. As a true island boy, I like to wear comfortable clothes that keep me nice and warm. items.title: Ralph Lauren Wins American Menswear Designer of the Year at 2026 CFDA Awards
items.text: Ralph Lauren Wins American Menswear Designer of the Year at 2026 CFDA Awards Summary Ralph Lauren was named American Menswear Designer of the Year at the 2026 CFDA Fashion AwardsActor Matt Damon presented the award to Lauren who previously secured the menswear title in 1996 and 2007Lauren remains the only designer in history to claim all of the CFDA's top honors throughout his career American fashion institution Ralph Lauren took home the American Menswear Designer of the Year title at the 2026 CFDA Fashion Awards, held Monday night at the American Museum of Natural History. The accolade marks the third time Lauren has secured the organization's highest menswear prize, following previous career wins in 1996 and 2007.Presented on stage by actor Matt Damon, Lauren topped an accomplished category of American designers that included Thom Browne, Todd Snyder, Willy Chavarria, and Dao-Yi Chow and Maxwell Osborne of Public School New York. The achievement follows a monumental moment last year, when Lauren was named American Womenswear Designer of the Year for the second time following his initial win in 1995, underscoring his enduring influence across both sides of the industry.The triumph reinforces Lauren's unmatched legacy as the only designer in history to receive all of the CFDA’s top honors. His career recognitions span Lifetime Achievement, Menswear Designer of the Year, Womenswear Designer of the Year, and Retailer of the Year, in addition to prestigious tributes for Humanitarian Leadership, American Fashion Legend, and the organization's inaugural Popular Vote.The evening also spotlighted a distinguished lineup of fellow winners across the American and global fashion scene. Rachel Scott of Diotima captured the American Womenswear Designer of the Year prize, while high-jewelry sculptor Ana Khouri received American Accessories Designer of the Year. Elsewhere, Colleen Allen was honored with the American Emerging Designer of the Year award, and outgoing Yves Saint Laurent creative director Anthony Vaccarello took home the International Designer of the Year Award. View this post on InstagramA post shared by Ralph Lauren (@ralphlauren) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Supreme x Vaquera Fall 2026 Collaboration Collection
items.text: Supreme x Vaquera Fall 2026 Collaboration Collection Summary Supreme has officially unveiled a collaborative Fall collection with American fashion house VaqueraThe collection spans zip-up hoodies graphic tops loose-fit denim basketball shorts and a duvet setThe full Supreme and Vaquera collection is scheduled to release on November 5 followed by an Asia launch on November 7 Supreme has officially partnered with fashion house Vaquera on a collaborative apparel and home goods capsule for Fall 2026. Designed alongside the New York-founded, Paris-based label, the seasonal offering brings Vaquera's playfully subversive "fashion fan-fiction" perspective to a focused range of streetwear garments, accessories, and bedroom lifestyle pieces.Founded in New York City in 2013 by Patric DiCaprio and co-helmed in Paris alongside Bryn Taubensee, Vaquera emerged as a campy antidote to the traditional design scene, staging early runway presentations on subway platforms and reworking classic American staples. Guided by DiCaprio’s ethos to “make clothes that unite people who identify as outsiders,” the brand challenges conventional notions of luxury and glamour through provocative, outsider-driven styling.The collaborative assortment is anchored by two graphic fleece styles—the Christ Zip Up Hooded Sweatshirt and the Kisses Zip Up Hooded Sweatshirt—accompanied by the Collage L/S Top and matching Collage Loose Fit Jean. The capsule also introduces athletic Basketball Shorts, two graphic short-sleeve options in the Bra Tee and Mannequin Tee, a co-branded Box Logo New Era® fitted hat, and a Supreme®/Vaquera Collage Duvet and Pillow Set.The Supreme x Vaquera Fall 2026 collection releases on November 5, via the official Supreme webstore and flagship locations, with an Asia release following shortly after on November 7. items.title: Crenshaw Skate Club Teams Up With Sprite for a Nostalgic Streetwear Capsule
items.text: Crenshaw Skate Club Teams Up With Sprite for a Nostalgic Streetwear Capsule Summary Crenshaw Skate Club and Sprite debut a streetwear capsule blending skate and basketball cultures.Apparel includes tracksuits and graphic tees inspired by South Central LA barbershops.Releases November 7 in LA and November 9 online, priced 50–120. Crenshaw Skate Club is teaming up with Sprite on a collaborative capsule. Rooted in a shared appreciation for authenticity and cultural impact, the partnership merges Crenshaw Skate Club's distinct skate aesthetic with Sprite's historic ties to basketball and street culture. The lineup takes cues from Sprite's deep ties to basketball and street culture, spanning graphic T-shirts, sweatpants, a six-panel cap and an updated tracksuit, with an athletic mesh track jacket paired with oversized, baggy mesh shorts. Sprite's trademark green-and-yellow palette runs throughout, merging the visual identities of both brands.Much of the collection draws on founder Tobey McIntosh's own upbringing in South Central. One of the standout tees features an illustrated portrait with the Sprite logo cut into the subject's hair. The idea comes from the haircut menus McIntosh remembers seeing on barbershop walls when he went along with his father. Those charts offered patrons a range of designs to have shaved in, including well-known sports and pop culture logos. By turning that neighborhood fixture into a graphic, the design honors the small, everyday details that still shape Crenshaw Skate Club's point of view.The collection will debut at a special Los Angeles pop-up located at 439 N Fairfax Avenue, the original site of the Supreme store that became the first retailer to carry Crenshaw Skate Club's T-shirts in 2018. Returning to this exact location eight years later serves as a profound full-circle moment for the brand, honoring the spaces and community that fostered its early growth.The Crenshaw Skate Club x Sprite collection will be available exclusively at this Los Angeles pop-up on November 7, 2026, followed by a global online release on November 9, 2026, at 11 AM PST on the brand's website, with pieces ranging in price from $50 - $120 USD.Crenshaw Skate Club x Sprite Pop-Up439 N Fairfax Ave, Los Angeles,CA 90036, USA Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Vans Premium Classic Slip-On 98 Goes Full Corduroy for Fall
items.text: The Vans Premium Classic Slip-On 98 Goes Full Corduroy for Fall Name: Vans Premium Classic Slip-On 98 CorduroyColorway: Black, BordeauxSKU: VN000D9PCJK, VN000D9PBRDMSRP: ¥13,750 JPY (approx. $90 USD)Release Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: BILLY’SThe Vans Premium Classic Slip-On 98 is getting a textured seasonal update with a new “Corduroy” pack, swapping the familiar smooth upper for ribbed corduroy across two colorways. Released under the Vans Premium line, which revisits the brand’s icons with upgraded materials and refined detailing, the pair keeps the low-profile, laceless silhouette intact while giving it a softer, more tactile feel.Corduroy wraps the entire upper, adding visible ribbing and depth to a shoe best known for its clean, flat panels. The fabric is listed as a synthetic fiber, and its raised wales give each colorway a richer, more varied tone as light catches the texture.That variation is part of the design. According to the listing, a finishing process is applied to each pair individually, so the treatment can differ from one pair to the next and even between the left and right shoe. The result is a mass-produced sneaker with a subtly one-off character.Comfort gets an update inside. The pair uses Vans’ SOLA foam ADC insole, made with 30% bio-based material and engineered to keep the foot from tiring over long days of wear, bringing a modern cushioning layer to a silhouette that first appeared in 1979, when it quickly found a following among Southern California’s BMX riders and skaters.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: H. Moser & Cie. Revisits Its Roots With Two New Heritage Collection Watches
items.text: H. Moser & Cie. Revisits Its Roots With Two New Heritage Collection Watches Summary H. Moser & Cie. adds two limited-edition steel watches to its pocket watch-inspired Heritage collection.The White fumé Chronograph revives a 1940s look with blue graphics and the 1947 logo.The Espresso fumé Centre Seconds adds oversized Globolight numerals. H. Moser & Cie. is revisiting its horological roots with two new additions to the vintage-inspired Heritage collection: the Heritage Chronograph White fumé and the Heritage Centre Seconds Espresso fumé. Heritage is the possibly the most understated line in the Maison's catalog, but also the one most closely tied to the history of a house founded in 1828. Its design language comes straight from the pocket watch era: round cases, slender tapered lugs from the period when pocket pieces were being adapted for the wrist, and a notched crown stamped with an "M." The new Heritage Chronograph White fumé and Heritage Centre Seconds Espresso fumé each draw on a different chapter of that history.The Heritage Chronograph White fumé takes its cues from Moser chronographs of the mid-20th century, when these instruments were made for explorers and adventurers who needed to time their journeys. The White fumé sunburst dial carries the brand's 1947 logo. The numerals, tachymeter scale, chronograph graduations and subdials are all printed in blue, a contrast that adds vintage charm and improves legibility. Subdials at 3 and 9 o'clock track the small seconds and a 45-minute chronograph counter, while sword-shaped hands and hour numerals are filled with Super-LumiNova. The 42 mm steel case is 13.8 mm thick and houses the automatic HMC 220 Manufacture caliber with a Dubois Dépraz chronograph module, which delivers a power reserve of at least three days. A grey kudu leather strap with matching grey hand-stitching completes the watch, and production is limited to 100 pieces at $34,100 USD.The Heritage Centre Seconds Espresso fumé recalls the early 20th century, when pocket watches were converted into wristwatches by adding slim lugs. It shares the 42 mm steel case, rounded profile and notched crown, but at 11.1 mm it sits noticeably slimmer on the wrist. The Espresso fumé sunburst dial adds warmth to the classic layout. A white railway minute track frames the edge, and oversized applied numerals in Globolight, a ceramic-based material containing Super-LumiNova, give the dial real presence alongside luminous sword-shaped hands. items.title: Diemme x Clarks Originals Sends Clarks’ Classics Straight Up the Mountain
items.text: Diemme x Clarks Originals Sends Clarks’ Classics Straight Up the Mountain Name: Diemme x Clarks Originals Wallabee, Diemme x Clarks Originals Desert Boot, Diemme x Clarks Originals Desert TrekColorway: Champagne, Cola, BlackSKU: TBCMSRP: $620 USDRelease Date: November 5Where to Buy: DiemmeDiemme and Clarks Originals have teamed up on a three-piece footwear collection that rebuilds the Wallabee, Desert Boot and Desert Trek with the hardware and outsoles of an alpine boot. Produced by Diemme in Italy, the lineup keeps each Clarks shape instantly readable while swapping in components lifted from the Italian label’s own hiking catalog.The most significant change happens underfoot, where all three styles trade their familiar soles for Diemme’s signature lug unit. That tread comes straight from two of the brand’s best-known boots, the Roccia Vet and the Cornaro, giving the Clarks lasts deeper grip and a chunkier, more planted stance than the originals ever carried.Moving up the shoe, authentic hiking D-rings take over the lacing, a functional detail borrowed from technical mountain footwear. A protective rubber mudguard wraps the lower edge of each pair, and its crepe-inspired texture serves as a visual bridge between the two labels, referencing the crepe soles long tied to Clarks while delivering the abrasion resistance expected from a trail boot.Each silhouette gets its own material treatment drawn from the Clarks Originals archive. The Wallabee is cut from Champagne-colored suede sourced from Charles F. Stead, the British tannery behind some of the industry’s most respected suedes, while the Desert Boot arrives in Clarks’ signature Cola suede. The Desert Trek takes the biggest structural leap, reworked into a mid-cut height and finished in black full-grain leather for a tougher, more weather-ready profile.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.text: Druski Sets Netflix Comedy Series 'Collect & Praise' and Signs Multi-Year Deal Summary Druski has signed an exclusive multi-year partnership with Netflix to produce original programming through his 4Lifers Entertainment companyThe deal kicks off with 'Collect & Praise' a semi-scripted comedy series starring Druski and Mike EppsNetflix will also license popular catalog content from the digital creator including Coulda Been Records Auditions and viral skits Netflix has officially partnered with comedian Druski to develop Collect & Praise, an upcoming semi-scripted comedy series that marks the creator's first project under an exclusive multi-year pact with the streamer. The deal will see the 32-year-old entertainer produce original programming through his 4Lifers Entertainment banner while bringing his viral megachurch pastor persona to longform television.duo as they navigate scandal, chaos, and controversy within their congregation. The production represents Druski's first transition from self-funded, independent digital video to a major Hollywood studio release. Alongside original productions, Netflix will also license select titles from Druski's existing digital library, including Coulda Been Love, Coulda Been Daddy, and the Coulda Been Records Auditions series, which have garnered over one billion collective views.“I’ve built my platform by creating characters and comedy that resonate with people,” Druski stated. “This partnership with Netflix will give me the resources to build on that comedy foundation and bring my work to a new global audience. It’s a tremendous opportunity for our team at 4Lifers Entertainment to expand our reach, develop original programming for the masses and take our creativity to new heights.”Collect & Praise is scheduled to premiere exclusively on Netflix on December 1, 2026. items.title: Yoshitomo Nara’s Largest Auction Painting, “In the Milky Lake / Thinking One,” Could Fetch $15 Million USD
items.text: Yoshitomo Nara’s Largest Auction Painting, “In the Milky Lake / Thinking One,” Could Fetch $15 Million USD Summary Yoshitomo Nara’s In the "Milky Lake / Thinking One* ," his only major 2011 painting, hits the block November 19. The 102 by 71 inch canvas is Nara’s largest work ever to reach auction. It marks his post-Tōhoku shift toward quieter, introspective figures. Yoshitomo Nara’s "In the Milky Lake / Thinking One" is going under the hammer this month, and it is the largest painting by the Japanese artist ever to reach auction. Fair Warning will offer the 102 x 71 inch canvas in New York on November 19. It will be the painting’s first appearance on the market after 14 years tucked away in a private collection.The painting is Nara’s lone large-scale canvas from 2011. That was the year the Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami tore through north-eastern Japan, the region where he was raised. The disaster left Nara unable to paint for a stretch. When he returned to the studio, the mischievous, combative kids that had won him devotees worldwide gave way to calmer, more contemplative figures.In the painting, a lone girl casts her gaze downward with her shoulders softly lifted. Her oversized round head sits against a cream backdrop that turns into pale water around her waist, all built from thin, glowing layers of translucent color. Reflecting on that period in remarks shared by Fair Warning, Nara said, “When something like an earthquake or a war causes total devastation, it can temporarily illuminate things that are usually kept in the dark.”The canvas has since become one of his most recognizable images. It anchored his 2012 Japanese survey across Yokohama, Aomori and Kumamoto. It also appeared at every stop of his recent retrospectives, from LACMA and Guggenheim Bilbao to Museum Frieder Burda and the Hayward Gallery, and Nara hand-picked it for his 2015 volume Self-Selected Works: Paintings. Its reach extends well beyond museum walls. A Kendall Jenner Instagram post featuring the canvas collected more than 3.1 million likes, and David Beckham shared a shot of his daughter photographing it at the Hayward.Before the sale, the painting gets its own showcase in Chelsea. Fair Warning has built out a ground-floor space at 534 West 22nd Street, modeled on the calm of a Japanese temple. The work will be on public view there from November 6 to 19, following an opening reception on November 5 from 6 to 8 p.m. The auction also lands just after Nara opened Sentinels of Stilln

items.title: Brad Pitt Hints at Cleaning Up Hollywood in the New ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’ Teaser
items.text: Brad Pitt Hints at Cleaning Up Hollywood in the New ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’ Teaser Summary Brad Pitt reprises his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth in The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth The story jumps to 1977, with the former stuntman now working as a Hollywood fixer between bartending and projectionist gigs Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross have composed the score, marking their sixth consecutive feature with Fincher Brad Pitt is back as Cliff Booth in a new teaser for The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, the sequel to Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Quentin Tarantino. The film revisits the character that earned Pitt an Academy Award, moving him into a new decade and an entirely new line of work.Set in 1977, eight years after the events of Tarantino’s original, the film finds Booth reinvented as a Hollywood fixer. When he isn’t cleaning up problems for the industry, he picks up shifts tending bar and running film in a projection booth, giving the character a very different footing in the town that once employed him as a stuntman.The handoff between filmmakers is one of the project’s defining details, with Tarantino writing and Fincher stepping behind the camera. Tarantino’s attachment to the character runs deeper than this screenplay, too, as he revealed plans earlier this year to write a new Cliff Booth novel.Pitt leads an ensemble that includes Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Peter Weller, Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Corey Fogelmanis and Karren Karagulian.The film’s official poster also confirmed Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross as composers, making this their sixth straight feature with Fincher following The Social Network, The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo, Gone Girl, Mank and The Killer. The pair, who won an Oscar for The Social Network in 2010, have stayed busy elsewhere too, landing on the 2026 Oscars shortlist for Best Original Score with TRON: Ares and teaming with Boys Noize on Nine Inch Noize earlier this year.Watch the new teaser below.* The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth opens in IMAX theaters worldwide for a two-week run beginning November 25, before arriving on Netflix on December 23. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Happily Ever After (@happilyever) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Dunkin’ Spikes Cinnamon Toast Crunch, Reese’s Puffs and Golden Grahams With Coffeehouse Flavors
items.text: Dunkin’ Spikes Cinnamon Toast Crunch, Reese’s Puffs and Golden Grahams With Coffeehouse Flavors Summary General Mills and Dunkin’ are collaborating for the first time on a limited-edition trio of cereals inspired by the coffee chain’s drinksCinnamon Toast Crunch, Reese’s Puffs and Golden Grahams each pair their signature base with a Dunkin’ beverage flavorThe flavors mimic coffeehouse drinks only, as none of the three cereals contain actual coffee or caffeine General Mills and Dunkin’ have joined forces on a limited-edition General Mills x Dunkin’ cereal lineup that reworks Cinnamon Toast Crunch, Reese’s Puffs and Golden Grahams around three of the chain’s latte and mocha flavors. Marking the first collaboration between the two companies, each box keeps its original cereal recognizable while layering in notes pulled from a familiar Dunkin’ order.Cinnamon Toast Crunch x Dunkin’ Cinnamon Caramel Latte builds on the cereal’s Cinnadust-coated squares, the most familiar base of the three. Instead of replacing the signature cinnamon, the recipe adds sweet caramel and a creamy, latte-style finish on top of it, turning the bowl into something closer to a spiced café drink.Reese’s Puffs x Dunkin’ Peanut Butter Mocha takes the opposite approach by recasting an existing pairing rather than adding a new one. Its chocolate and peanut butter backbone stays intact, but the profile is reframed as a mocha latte, giving the puffs a richer, coffeehouse-leaning edge.Golden Grahams x Dunkin’ Vanilla Graham Latte rounds out the trio with the lightest flavor direction. Crunchy honey graham squares are paired with a smooth vanilla latte note, pushing the cereal’s natural sweetness toward the vanilla drinks on Dunkin’s menu.Despite the drink-inspired names, all three cereals rely on flavoring alone. General Mills notes that the lineup contains no coffee or caffeine, so the latte and mocha profiles deliver the taste of a Dunkin’ run without the actual jolt.The General Mills x Dunkin’ cereals begin arriving on shelves nationwide in December 2026. Cinnamon Toast Crunch x Dunkin’ Cinnamon Caramel Latte and Reese’s Puffs x Dunkin’ Peanut Butter Mocha will be stocked at retailers across the country, while Golden Grahams x Dunkin’ Vanilla Graham Latte is a Walmart exclusive. items.title: General Motors Is Reportedly Scrapping Its Corvette Expansion Including a Porsche Cayenne Rival SUV
items.text: General Motors Is Reportedly Scrapping Its Corvette Expansion Including a Porsche Cayenne Rival SUV Summary General Motors has reportedly scrapped its unannounced plans to expand the Corvette brand with an SUV, an EV and a four-door sedanThe expanded lineup was originally viewed as a high-volume profit driver and was expected to launch by 2026Chevrolet will continue focusing on its traditional sports car lineup, including the current C8 generation and the upcoming C9 model General Motors reportedly pulled the plug on a brand expansion that would have pushed its most iconic nameplate into entirely new lanes. According to a report by GM Authority citing internal company sources, the automaker officially scrapped its long-rumored plans to develop a Corvette SUV, a fully electric model and a four-door fastback sedan. The expanded Corvette lineup, previously expected to launch by 2026, was never formally announced or confirmed by General Motors prior to this cancellation report. When contacted by Car and Driver regarding the scrapped models, Chevrolet representatives declined to comment or add to the speculation.This ambitious expansion was originally positioned as a high-volume profit driver for the brand. The Corvette SUV was specifically envisioned as a direct competitor to the Porsche Cayenne in an effort to replicate a formula where lucrative utility vehicles help fund high-performance sports car development. By abandoning this expansion, General Motors chooses to protect its halo car's prestige rather than chase mass-market utility revenue. That decision likely stems from a recent softening in market demand for electric vehicles, combined with anticipated backlash from brand loyalists who felt an SUV would inherently sully the iconic Corvette name. Consequently, General Motors' upcoming electric-vehicle platforms will not be used in any vehicles carrying the Corvette badge.Despite axing the fully electric Corvette model, Chevrolet still engages with modern powertrain technology. The brand currently offers two hybrid powertrains within the existing C8-generation Corvette. Even without the canceled body styles and pure electric variants, the current C8-generation lineup commands a robust footprint on the road. The existing stable features multiple distinct models, spanning from the base Stingray and Grand Sport to the high-performance Z06 and the ZR1.Moving forward, Chevrolet keeps its development focus locked on the traditional sports car format. items.text: First Look at the Nike Air Force 1 '01 "Harajuku" Summary Nike and atmos have unveiled the Air Force 1 '01 Harajuku custom in celebration of atmosconThe shoe features laser-etched street map detailing of Harajuku across the toe and heel on an all-white leather upperThe pair will be featured at the Nike booth during atmoscon in Tokyo with wider release details unconfirmed Nike and Tokyo boutique atmos have revealed the Nike Air Force 1 '01 "Harajuku", marking a celebratory custom project for atmoscon. items.title: INVINCIBLE and adidas Consortium’s “Form in Motion” Collection Hides Its Best Details Until You Move
items.text: INVINCIBLE and adidas Consortium’s “Form in Motion” Collection Hides Its Best Details Until You Move Name: INVINCIBLE x adidas Consortium “Form in Motion”Colorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: November 7, November 13Where to Buy: INVINCIBLE, adidas, Confirmed AppINVINCIBLE and adidas Consortium have unveiled “Form in Motion,” a FW26 capsule that reworks the adidas Samba and introduces the partners’ first-ever shared apparel range. Across both footwear and clothing, the collection shifts from surface-level overlays toward structural design, with pleats, gathers and layered panels that open up and change shape as the body moves.The Samba Dress Shoes push the classic trainer toward formalwear. Brogue wingtip perforations and pinked, sawtooth edges run along the signature T-toe overlay and side profile, applying traditional dress shoe finishing to athletic proportions. At the back, the usual heel counter gives way to gathered, ruched leather that flexes with each step, revealing more depth and texture as the shoe bends.The second Samba keeps the model’s familiar shape and branding codes while reworking its construction. Panels are cut and twisted so they overlap, and the raw seams that result are left exposed rather than hidden. Reinforcement stitching, borrowed from bespoke leatherwork, fills the negative spaces between the deconstructed panels, while metallic gold foil INVINCIBLE branding on the lateral side adds a restrained finishing touch.On the apparel side, all four pieces share one playful detail: a woven adidas label that tears away to reveal an embroidered INVINCIBLE logo beneath. The G-8 Flight Jacket takes the boxy, cropped cut and 3D utility pockets of the classic flight jacket and adds a box pleat down the back, which spreads open in motion to show the adidas Three Stripes tucked inside the fold.The rest of the apparel blends tailoring with sportswear staples. The L/S Knit Jersey reimagines the football jersey in a premium knit with a soft, textured hand, while the 1 Tuck Track Pants pair sharp front pleats with a long-pile wool for a trouser-meets-trackpant hybrid. The 1 Tuck Track Sweat Pants apply the same pleated tailoring to heavyweight cotton, giving everyday sweats a sharper, more structured drape.The INVINCIBLE x adidas Consortium “Form in Motion” collection is available now via a global online raffle at invincible.com.tw, open until November 4 at 12 PM (GMT+8). The capsule then releases in Asia on November 7 at INVINCIBLE locations

items.title: Casio’s CT-FS1 Is a $400 USD Keyboard That Lets Anyone Play Any Song Without Wrong Notes
items.text: Casio’s CT-FS1 Is a $400 USD Keyboard That Lets Anyone Play Any Song Without Wrong Notes Summary Casio released the CT-FS1 keyboard with adaptive tech that keeps players perfectly in keyAn algorithm analyzes user-uploaded tracks to eliminate wrong notes during play-along sessionsThe 61-key instrument arrives in striking monochrome all-black and all-white colorways Casio released the new Casio CT-FS1, a $400 keyboard built to eliminate the learning curve of standard playing. The standout feature of this hardware is the brand-new Feel Sync technology, an innovative system that adapts the instrument to any song to completely prevent the player from ever hitting a wrong note. Users control the feature through a proprietary Feel Sync app by uploading a song directly into the software. From there, a specialized algorithm instantly analyzes the audio content to ensure the keyboard remains entirely in key throughout the duration of the track.The internal algorithm is far from a basic loop-matcher, proving fully capable of handling highly complicated songs packed with multiple key changes and shifting bridges. By stripping away the immediate pressure of memorizing intricate musical scales, this algorithmic safety net fundamentally alters the entry point for musical education, empowering beginners to focus their attention entirely on nailing rhythm, precise timing and pure creative expression.Beyond solo play, the Feel Sync portion of the keyboard can be split into two distinct zones to facilitate collaborative sessions. These dual split zones allow a total novice to play guided, error-free keys on one end of the instrument while an experienced musician plays actual, unfiltered notes on the other. When users want to step away from the algorithmic assistance, the Casio CT-FS1 can also be played natively as a standard keyboard with 61 touch-responsive keys for traditional performance.Visually, the Casio CT-FS1 abandons traditional design cues in favor of a striking, minimalist look. The keyboard is available in two completely monochrome colorways, arriving in either all-black or all-white. This bold monochrome aesthetic extends fully to the keys themselves, which match the exact body color for a seamless, unified profile. At under ten pounds, the portable hardware can be powered by either an AC adapter or standard AA batteries. items.text: The Muse for Denim Tears x adidas Originals Debut? The Big Plaid Bag Denim Tears’ first outing with adidas is, fittingly, a walk down Canal Street. After weeks of speculation, Tremaine Emory’s imprint has officially unveiled its first collaboration with the Three Stripes, introducing a plaid-clad rework of two of its signature silhouettes: the Stan Smith and Superstar.With a release date yet to come, an early look shared with Hypebeast reveals the pairs outfitted in a black, blue, red, and cream woven plaid, lifted from the “Ghana Must Go,” or Market, bag. Cream keeps things clean on the soles and the Superstar’s shell toe. A Sankofa symbol also graces both pairs, sitting beneath co-branded details on the tongue. And, as those familiar with Emory’s work will know, the surface aesthetics are just half the story.Anyone who’s taken a trip to Denim Tears’ flagship, African Diaspora Goods, in the last few years may pick up the pattern from the in-store hangers and bags. But even before hitting SoHo’s luxury storefronts, flurries of plaid flank the exit of Canal Street Station, brimming with purses, garments, and tech gear sold on the street. “It’s a New York thing. It’s a New York-inspired brand,” Emory said on the project in an exclusive interview. “Of the many patterns we use and reference, I’ve never used that one in Denim Tears clothing before. When it came time to do my first [collaboration] with adidas Originals, I wanted to bring it into the shoes.”"It’s a cultural motif of the diaspora. A lot of people don’t know how it blends African and Asian history, and how it ended up on Canal Street."From Virgil Abloh for Free the Youth x Off White™ and Sandy Liang x Baggu to your local cart-hauling grandma, the checkered carryall is a fashion favorite for all. “It’s a cultural motif of the diaspora,” one that’s used by many both within and beyond the Black community. Yet for a bag so widely loved across generations and continents, as Emory pointed, its complex origins are often overlooked. “A lot of people don’t know how it blends African and Asian history, and how it ended up on Canal Street.”The pattern, he explained, originated in Africa, and first became widespread as part of Hong Kong’s architecture, where it was used for scaffolding in Hong Kong. It was later popularized as bags, courtesy of a Chinese tailor. items.text: Coperni Closes Brand as Founders Cease Operations Summary French operating entity Coperni SAS will cease operations after failing to reach an agreement with distributor TomorrowCo-founders Arnaud Vaillant and Sébastien Meyer confirmed the closure following months of dispute over unpaid sumsThe decision officially brings an end to the eight-year-old Paris-based fashion label Parisian fashion brand Coperni is closing its operations as co-founders Arnaud Vaillant and Sébastien Meyer officially shutter the label. According to statements shared by the designers, the main French operating entity Coperni SAS will cease all business activities after failing to resolve an ongoing dispute regarding unpaid sums and licensing terms with distributor and shareholder Tomorrow.The shutdown follows months of mounting friction after Tomorrow terminated its existing licensing agreement amid unpaid debts, leading Coperni to seek commercial court protection in Paris earlier this year. Complications deepened following Tomorrow Ltd’s acquisition in March by Progetto 11, the holding vehicle for The Level Group. Although Vaillant and Meyer actively attempted to buy back their brand and regain control, unresolved governance disputes, financial strain, and the abrupt cancellation of the label's Fall/Winter 2026 runway show ultimately forced an end to operations.“These eight years have been extraordinary. Coperni has always been a collective adventure, and we are immensely proud of what we have created,” the founders shared in a statement, reflecting on the label's journey. “As the world becomes increasingly challenging, particularly in the fashion industry, we believe there is still so much to create and reinvent. Innovation has always been our passion and a priority in everything we do. We look ahead with optimism and plenty of ideas, and cannot wait to share them with you.” Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
