items.title: 8 Drops You Don’t Want to Miss This Week
items.text: 8 Drops You Don’t Want to Miss This Week With another week upon us, we have yet another installment of our product drops series.This week’s lineup kicks off with Supreme teaming up with Vaquera on a campy Fall 2026 capsule that stretches from graphic hoodies to a duvet set. Fear of God follows by tapping Jon Bernthal to front the campaign for The Eternal Order, while BAPE and adidas enlist Jalen Williams for a Y2K hoops collection led by the Crazy Energy+. In London, Palace Skateboards celebrates its new Poland Street flagship with a store-exclusive Burberry capsule, and back in Los Angeles, Crenshaw Skate Club and Sprite turn South Central barbershop culture into a nostalgic streetwear range. Pas Normal Studios and Salomon reunite for a sixth running capsule built for cyclists in the off-season, and Kith brings TUMI back through its Monday Program for a third run of ombré aluminum luggage. Last but not least, The North Face and Cecilie Bahnsen deliver a romantic fourth chapter headlined by a cropped, floral-embroidered Nuptse.Check out this week’s 8 drops you don’t want to miss below.Supreme x Vaquera Fall 2026 Collaboration CollectionSupreme has partnered with Vaquera, the New York-founded, Paris-based label led by Patric DiCaprio and Bryn Taubensee, on a Fall 2026 capsule that brings the label’s irreverent, outsider-minded take on American staples into Supreme’s world. The range centers on the Christ and Kisses zip-up hoodies, a Collage long sleeve top with matching loose-fit jeans, basketball shorts and the Bra and Mannequin tees, alongside a co-branded Box Logo New Era fitted. A Supreme/Vaquera Collage duvet and pillow set carries the collaboration into the bedroom. The collection releases November 5 via Supreme’s flagship stores and online, with an Asia launch following on November 7.Fear of God “The Eternal Order” CollectionFear of God has enlisted Jon Bernthal to front the campaign for The Eternal Order, the tenth full expression of Jerry Lorenzo’s codified system of dressing. Framed as a lasting standard rather than a seasonal offering, the range leans on disciplined tailoring, restrained proportions and a dialogue between archival silhouettes and contemporary construction. The campaign places Bernthal against a sweeping, elemental landscape, with Lorenzo pointing to the actor’s grounded sense of purpose as a reflection of the house’s own values. The Eternal Order is available now via Fear of God online and select global retailers.adidas x BAPE Co

items.title: The Whitaker Group and New Balance Unveil 2010 "Willful Bias For Identity" Collection
items.text: The Whitaker Group and New Balance Unveil 2010 "Willful Bias For Identity" Collection Summary The Whitaker Group and New Balance have revealed two collaborative 2010 colorways under the Willful Bias For Identity collectionBoth pairs feature frayed suede exposed stitching orange N logo accents and raw unfinished edges across the uppersThe collection releases on November 5 for $155 USD each via The Whitaker Group and an A Ma Maniére raffle Name: The Whitaker Group x New Balance 2010 "Willful Bias for Identity"Colorway: Multi-ColorSKU: U20104WP, U20106KHMSRP: $155 USDRelease Date: November 5, 2026Where to Buy: New Balance, The Whitaker Group, A Ma ManiéreNew Balance has officially partnered with The Whitaker Group to debut two collaborative colorways of the New Balance 2010, marking the latest chapter in the ongoing "Willful Bias" series titled "Willful Bias For Identity". The collaborative capsule follows previous themes centered around discovery, education, and community by channeling personal heritage into deconstructed design language.Both iterations in the capsule feature frayed suede paneling, raw exposed stitching, and unfinished edges that lend the silhouette a worn, tactile finish. One edition combines cream mesh base underlays with earthy pink suede overlays and a contrasting grey midsole. The accompanying pair utilizes grey mesh underlays paired with purple suede paneling and a cream midsole. Vibrant orange accents highlight the iconic 'N' midfoot insignia across both designs.Accompanying the footwear rollout is a campaign captured by photographers Antiisoulcial and Nuku, who interpret the theme of identity through personal creative perspectives. Antiisoulcial incorporates floral arrangements and cultural references to Southern Black heritage in a studio setting, while Nuku documents the sneakers against the backdrop of a shared meal at a community restaurant counter.Both pairs from The Whitaker Group x New Balance 2010 “Willful Bias For Identity” collection drop November 5, 2026, for $155 USD each in-store and online through The Whitaker Group, with an additional raffle hosted via A Ma Maniére.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Asake Came Out In Two Bespoke Levi’s Looks At Headline London Show
items.text: Asake Came Out In Two Bespoke Levi’s Looks At Headline London Show Asake returned to The O2 Arena after his debut show there three years ago, marking his third sold-out headline at the 20,000-capacity venue in London.Supporting his fourth studio album, M$NEY, which dropped earlier this year as his first project released through his independent imprint Giran Republic, the Nigerian artist has been embarking on his In God We Trust World Tour.Lauded as the sonic evolution of his catalog, the project showcases his creative maturity, merging Afropop, amapiano and jazz, while lyrics draw on cultural folklore, spirituality and religious symbolism. With features from French artists Tiakola and DJ Snake, as well as South African DJ Kabza de Small, it proves how global the Afrobeats sound has travelled. And upon its launch, M$NEY broke the record for the most first-week streams in Spotify Nigeria history. Speaking to Hypebeast, he explains, “The music carries the experiences, the mindset, and the energy of a particular time in my life. With the In God We Trust World Tour, I want people to experience that energy in a way that goes beyond listening to the songs.”"When I’m on stage, I’m thinking about how the music makes people feel, how we connect, and how we bring that feeling into the room."Stepping on stage at his sold-out show, Asake sported two custom Levi’s® outfits, with concepts created by Kevin Mukuri and Mariam Afolabi, looks by Niran Nair, all completely embellished with rhinestones by London-based artisans AGR Knit, and over 200 hours of craftsmanship going into the combined looks.The first outfit was produced with premium Japanese white denim curated by the brand’s Lot 1 in-house ateliers, with each garment individually cut from bespoke patterns for the two-piece. The look incorporates 100,000 all-over hand-applied crystals, with “GIRAN” lettering on the back, as well as signature Levi’s® detailing, including The Red Tab, arcuate stitching and Two-Horse back patch.The second look takes the Levi’s® Engineered Moto Jacket from the early 2000s as its foundation. Adorned in 40,000 crystals and constructed using premium blue Kaihara denim, and treated eco-consciously by London-based specialists Laundre using laser technology to create an ombre effect, it features custom “GIRAN” lettering emblazoned on the back, laurel shoulder details, and leather piping. While underneath, a rhinestone-clad Levi’s® Batwing tee features the red-tab logo on the chest and “M$NEY”

items.title: Jason Statham and Guy Ritchie Reunite for Netflix Revenge Feature 'Dogfight'
items.text: Jason Statham and Guy Ritchie Reunite for Netflix Revenge Feature 'Dogfight' Summary Netflix has officially set 'Dogfight' a new revenge action feature written directed and produced by Guy RitchieJason Statham will star in the film marking his seventh creative collaboration with the British filmmakerProduction on the project is slated to begin in early 2027 across the United Kingdom Netflix has officially announced that Jason Statham will star in Dogfight, a new feature film written, directed, and produced by Guy Ritchie. The upcoming project marks the seventh cinematic partnership between the British filmmaker and the action star, following crime staples like Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels, Snatch, and the upcoming Viva La Madness.Described as a stylish revenge actioner set within the London criminal underworld, the film is backed by production companies Black Bear, Toff Guy Films, and Statham's Punch Palace banner. Ritchie and Statham are set to produce the picture alongside Ivan Atkinson and John Friedberg. Production on the feature is scheduled to kick off in early 2027, with principal photography taking place across the United Kingdom.The announcement lands as the duo prepares for the rollout of Viva La Madness, an adaptation of J.J. Connolly’s novel and follow-up to Layer Cake, which Connolly co-scripted with Ritchie. That project features an ensemble cast including Vinnie Jones, Jason Isaacs, Babs Olusanmokun, Camila Mendes, Ben Foster, Jonny Lee Miller, and musician Raúl Alejandro in his feature film debut, distributed domestically by Black Bear and internationally by Amazon MGM Studios. items.title: San San Gear and Jian Ye Release Techwear Collaboration Based on the "Three Mystic Apes"
items.text: San San Gear and Jian Ye Release Techwear Collaboration Based on the "Three Mystic Apes" Seoul-based technical streetwear brand San San Gear has announced a collaboration with Jian Ye, the Tokyo-based alternative brand helmed by designer Kan Sugano.The collection draws inspiration from the 'Three Mystic Apes' (see no evil, speak no evil, hear no evil). Adding a fourth monkey, 'do no evil', to the classic symbol, the brands have built a unique concept that translates this philosophical and visual essence into modern technical gear.The lineup includes a wide range of items, from a set-up featuring fur details to a packable jacket, hoodie, T-shirts, hats, and gloves. Among the pieces is a jacket that folds up to become a 'monkey-shaped bag'.A notable detail is a gimmick that allows wearers to recreate the gestures of the four monkeys depending on how they fasten the snap buttons. Additionally, some items incorporate four beads symbolizing the four monkeys as a shared detail, bringing a sense of unity to the entire collection.The released campaign visuals depict humans and monkey-like beings coexisting in everyday scenes without acknowledging each other. By capturing both from a neutral perspective at eye level, the visuals highlight the collection's worldview.This collection, where the cutting-edge youth cultures of Japan and South Korea intersect, will be available starting Friday, November 6 at domestic stockists such as GR8 and PULP. In South Korea, it will go on sale the same day at 6:00 p.m. on the San San Gear official online store and KREAM. Concurrently, a three-day pop-up store will be held in Jingumae, Tokyo, starting the same day.San San Gear × Jian Ye Pop-Up StoreVenue: Manda Bld. 2FAddress: 1-8-18 Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, TokyoDates: Friday, November 6 – Sunday, November 8Hours: Friday, November 6 and Saturday, November 7: 11:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m. / Sunday, November 8: 11:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike Brings Classic Patterning to the Zoom Hyperflight "Safari"
items.text: Nike Brings Classic Patterning to the Zoom Hyperflight "Safari" Summary Nike is revisiting its basketball archive with the upcoming Zoom Hyperflight in a new Safari colorwayThe retro model features speckled print across its molded upper paired with vibrant orange accents and a translucent outsoleThe pair is scheduled to release during Holiday 2026 for 180 USD in men's sizing via Nike and select retailers Name: Nike Zoom Hyperflight "Safari"Colorway: Black/Summit White-Ice-Total OrangeSKU: IZ2573-010MSRP: $170 USDRelease Date: Holiday 2026Where to Buy: NikeNike is dipping back into its performance basketball archive to reintroduce the Zoom Hyperflight "Safari", applying a classic heritage graphic to the turn-of-the-century court model. Newly surfaced official imagery confirms the return of the silhouette closely associated with Jason Williams in a distinctive speckled execution.The release fits directly into Nike Basketball's ongoing initiative of revisiting nostalgic archival models. While the Zoom Hyperflight has previously surfaced in several retro editions—most notably through a collaborative iteration with SLAM Magazine alongside quieter inline releases—this upcoming pair delivers a bolder visual statement. Distinctive speckled detailing blankets much of the shoe's signature molded upper, drawing its visual identity from the exotic print originally popularized by the 1987 Nike Air Safari.To balance the heavily patterned exterior, vibrant orange accents provide energetic contrast around the ankle collar and highlight the miniature Swoosh branding. Underneath the sculpted upper, a clean translucent outsole anchors the construction to complete the retro basketball design.The Nike Zoom Hyperflight "Safari" is scheduled to release during Holiday 2026.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Cecilie Bahnsen Reconnects With Uniqlo for a FW26 Capsule Collection
items.text: Cecilie Bahnsen Reconnects With Uniqlo for a FW26 Capsule Collection Summary Uniqlo reunites with Cecilie Bahnsen for a “Wandering Together” FW26 capsule.Cropped fleece jackets, a boa vest and matching skirts arrive scattered with embroidered flowers.Ditsy floral tees and bloom-dotted accessories complete looks for women and girls. Uniqlo has reunited with Cecilie Bahnsen for a Fall/Winter 2026 capsule collection. The collection is built around the concept "Wandering Together" and designed for slow, scenic weekend moments. It pairs Uniqlo's practical fleece with Bahnsen's modern femininity, romantic shapes and attention to craft.Fleece is the core of the collection. Cropped, zip-front fleece jackets with stand collars and drawcord hems come in navy, charcoal and a soft blush pink, each scattered with tiny embroidered flowers in bright reds, blues and greens. A grey boa fleece cropped vest takes the same drawstring shape, and matching fleece skirts turn the jackets into coordinated sets. Long-sleeve tees bring the floral motif back as an all-over ditsy print, and the girls' version adds a ruffled hem. A navy midi skirt with a curved hem rounds out the clothing. The accessories carry the same small details: a textured knit beanie with a flower appliqué, gloves and mittens with tiny blooms, floral-embroidered crew socks and ribbed knee-highs.The campaign leans into the collection's family focus, showing women and girls in coordinated looks on a rocky coastline by the water. Across the lineup, Bahnsen's embroidered florals and soft volumes give winter staples a warmer, more personal feel. The Uniqlo and Cecilie Bahnsen FW26 collection will officially launch later this month across Uniqlo's online store and physical shops across different regions. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: PLEASURES’ Holiday 2026 “Ciel Couvert” Collection Is Built for Overcast Days
items.text: PLEASURES’ Holiday 2026 “Ciel Couvert” Collection Is Built for Overcast Days Summary PLEASURES has unveiled its Holiday 2026 collection, “Ciel Couvert,” which takes its name from the French phrase for an overcast skyDark neutrals tie together a lineup of graphic pieces, knitwear, outerwear, denim, headwear and bottomsThe campaign was photographed in Montreal by Aime-Elle, with art direction from Nikki Nixon PLEASURES has unveiled its Holiday 2026 collection, “Ciel Couvert,” taking its name from the French phrase for an overcast sky. The Los Angeles label leans fully into that gray-weather mood, building the season around a deeper, moodier palette and a heavy rotation of layering pieces made for colder months.Dark neutrals act as the anchor for the entire range, giving even the louder graphic pieces a shared tonal base. Against that backdrop, PLEASURES works through a spread of knitwear in different constructions, alongside cold-weather layers designed to stack rather than stand alone.The category mix runs wide, covering outerwear, denim, headwear and a broad selection of bottoms. Rather than relying on new shapes, the collection takes recognizable silhouettes and gives them a different edge through careful detailing, pairing heavier and lighter fabrics, smooth and rough surfaces, and print-led pieces with pared-back everyday staples. Proportions shift from piece to piece as well, setting up contrast within a single outfit.Montreal serves as the collection’s visual counterpart. The campaign, shot across the city by photographer Aime-Elle, plays on the contrast between Montreal’s architectural styles, its varied textures and its own subdued color story, framing the clothes as part of the streetscape rather than placed in front of it. Nikki Nixon handled art direction, while Sara Takenaka styled and produced the shoot, with Aljosa Alijagic assisting on photography.The result is a collection where the setting and the garments share the same language. The rough surfaces and tonal shifts of the city echo the textural layering of the clothes, extending the overcast idea from the palette into the campaign imagery itself.The PLEASURES Holiday 2026 “Ciel Couvert” collection is available now via PLEASURES and select global retailers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Palace Skateboard's Newest London Flagship Is a Stained-Glass Museum Built From Its Own Archive
items.text: Palace Skateboard's Newest London Flagship Is a Stained-Glass Museum Built From Its Own Archive Summary Palace Skateboards is opening a 250.6-square-metre London flagship on Poland Street that borrows from the British Museum and the stained glass of British churchesArchive photographs and references to the brand’s original shop are displayed like museum exhibits, framed by oversized stained-glass windows carrying Palace artworkFurniture and fixtures nod to Manor Place and Brewer Street, while an LED video wall rises through both floors of the store Palace Skateboards is opening its new Poland Street flagship in London on Thursday, November 5, setting its skate-bred identity inside a space modeled on two pillars of British architecture. The design pulls from the grand, institutional feel of the British Museum and the stained-glass windows of the country’s churches, then filters both through Palace’s own graphic vocabulary so the store reads as equal parts city landmark and brand time capsule.The storefront’s oversized windows do the heaviest lifting, recast as stained-glass panels carrying Palace artwork and treated as a gallery installation in their own right. Inside, the museum framing carries through, with photographs pulled from the Palace archive and references to the brand’s first shop presented as curated exhibits rather than background decor.Raw and refined materials play off each other throughout the 250.6-square-metre interior. Concrete and galvanized steel lay down an industrial base, softened by light oak panelling, parquet floors and crisp white walls, while P-shaped marble tiles replicate the ones used in the original Palace shop. Unfinished stone plinths act as display points around the floor, a mirrored deck wall greets shoppers at the door, and recessed deck displays are set directly into the concrete columns as standalone art pieces.Much of the furniture doubles as a history lesson for anyone who has followed the brand from the start. A raw oak bench and stool take the shape of the Tri-ferg, Victoria benches point back to Manor Place, and a Rolls-Royce grille carried over from the original store pays tribute to Brewer Street. Even the entrance gets a custom touch in the form of a door handle rendered in Palace artwork, while a large LED video wall climbs from the ground floor to the first, stitching the two levels together visually.Poland Street is the newest stop in a retail footprint that already spans New York, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Osaka

items.title: Palace Skateboards Brings Burberry Home for Its London Flagship-Only Capsule
items.text: Palace Skateboards Brings Burberry Home for Its London Flagship-Only Capsule Summary Palace Skateboards and Burberry have created a 10-piece capsule to celebrate the opening of Palace’s new London flagshipThe collaboration pairs a screen-printed honey beige car coat with a run of pieces in Burberry’s House CheckPalace is also releasing its own limited London-exclusive range, with every item embossed with the number 8 Palace Skateboards and Burberry have teamed up on a 10-piece capsule to celebrate the opening of Palace’s new London flagship, arriving alongside a limited London-exclusive range from Palace itself. Together, the two releases turn the November 5 opening into a hometown event, uniting the city’s skate institution with one of Britain’s most recognizable heritage houses.The Palace Burberry Camden car coat leads the collaboration, cut in honey beige and finished with screen-printed artwork inspired by the British countryside. It’s joined by a cashmere scarf in the signature Burberry Check, woven with both the Palace logo and the Burberry label, giving the two brands equal billing on a single accessory.Burberry’s House Check carries the remainder of the capsule, appearing on a baseball cap, a shirt, short- and long-sleeve T-shirts, a hooded jacket and a board. A polo shirt rounds things out with an embroidered Poland Street graphic, the one piece in the lineup that speaks directly to the new store.Palace’s own London-exclusive range takes a more personal route, built around the number 8 from the flagship’s Poland Street address. A Gore-Tex jacket anchors the lineup, backed by hoodies, T-shirts, a cap, a tote and further accessories, each embossed with the numeral. An infinity symbol runs throughout the collection as a subtle callback to the Palace logo, keeping the range in step with the brand’s established visual language.Burberry is the latest British name to join a collaborator list that already includes Vivienne Westwood, Fred Perry and Barbour, alongside global partners such as Nike and Gucci. Founded in 2009 by Lev Tanju and Gareth Skewis, Palace has grown from an underground skate label into a global streetwear force, and opening a London flagship with a Burberry tie-up puts that British lineage front and center.The Palace Skateboards x Burberry capsule is available exclusively at Palace’s Poland Street flagship, which opens November 5. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Upgrade Your PS5 Setup With Razer’s $350 USD Raiju V3 Pro Signature Edition
items.text: Upgrade Your PS5 Setup With Razer’s $350 USD Raiju V3 Pro Signature Edition Summary Razer’s Raiju V3 Pro Signature Edition wraps its PS5 controller in a 260-gram magnesium alloy exoskeleton with an open-air polygonal design.Only 1,337 serialized units will be produced worldwide. Razer is pushing its PS5 controller into collector's territory with the Raiju V3 Pro Signature Edition, a limited version of its competitive pad built around a magnesium alloy exoskeleton, chosen for its strength-to-weight balance and its malleability, which lets it hold the fine curvature a premium controller demands.The frame's top and back plates are cut through with an open polygonal pattern, while chamfered edges and a nano coating help keep debris away from the exposed internals, and the whole thing comes in at just 260 grams. Finishing touches lean luxe: matte black, micro-textured TPU grips built to shrug off oils and abrasion, plus a Razer logo laser-etched into a semi-transparent tinted glass touchpad. The badge itself carries weight, too, as Razer says Signature Edition status is only granted to concepts where advanced materials, finishes and tighter tolerances produce results conventional methods can't.Under the shell, the hardware matches the standard Raiju V3 Pro's tournament credentials. Anti-drift TMR thumbsticks rely on contactless sensors, joined by six remappable multi-function buttons, two claw-grip bumpers and four mouse-click back buttons. It is officially licensed for PS5 and also tuned for PC, where Razer HyperPolling Wireless unlocks a 2,000Hz polling rate, and players can build up to four profiles, adjust thumbstick dead zones and tune trigger actuation via the Razer PS Controller App or Razer Synapse 4.The box doubles as a kit, holding a vegan leather Signature box, swappable thumbsticks, back button covers and an anodized aluminum torque driver, with the short convex sticks suited to quick rolling inputs and the tall concave pair offering more leverage for precise aim. Production is capped at 1,337 individually serialized units worldwide, launching November 10, a figure that nods to gamer "leet" speak and the controller will be sold exclusively through Razer’s official webstore and select physical locations.Meet the Razer Raiju V3 Pro Signature Edition, a new expression of competitive mastery that takes shape around a magnesium alloy exoskeleton: https://t.co/lVfTixrdWV Every detail serves a purpose, from its laser-etched glass touchpad to its micro-text

items.title: Johnny Depp Open to Reprising Jack Sparrow in 'Pirates of the Caribbean 6' Under One Condition
items.text: Johnny Depp Open to Reprising Jack Sparrow in 'Pirates of the Caribbean 6' Under One Condition Summary Johnny Depp stated he would consider returning as Captain Jack Sparrow in 'Pirates of the Caribbean 6' to give the franchise a proper send-offThe actor emphasized his trust in producer Jerry Bruckheimer and willingness to collaborate on future projectsThe five previous Pirates films accumulated over 4.5 billion USD at the global box office between 2003 and 2017 Actor Johnny Depp has addressed the possibility of reprising his role as Jack Sparrow in Disney's upcoming Pirates of the Caribbean 6, noting he would return under the condition of giving the franchise a proper farewell. The Oscar-nominated actor explained that his decision ultimately hinges on his longstanding working relationship with producer Jerry Bruckheimer.“If things are exactly where they need to be with regard to how they are going to top off the Pirates franchise… the only involvement I really want to have, truly, is just to send them off on a better note,” Depp said during a press tour for his holiday film Ebenezer. “I will go to work with [Jerry] Bruckheimer tomorrow for anything. Doesn’t matter… if it’s Jerry, I trust him. We have a deep friendship.”Bruckheimer previously noted that screenwriter Jeff Nathanson has been developing a new script for a sixth installment, which aims to follow the five-film saga that grossed $4.5 billion USD worldwide between 2003 and 2017. While Disney explored separate franchise paths in recent years, Bruckheimer remains open to Depp returning to the role he originated. Depp's upcoming slate also includes Lionsgate's thriller Day Drinker, scheduled for 2028. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Entertainment Tonight (@entertainmenttonight) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Epic Games Launches Real-World 'Fortnite' x 'ONE PIECE' Treasure Hunt in Tokyo
items.text: Epic Games Launches Real-World 'Fortnite' x 'ONE PIECE' Treasure Hunt in Tokyo Summary Epic Games has launched a real-world citywide treasure hunt across Tokyo to celebrate Fortnite's new 'One Piece' collaborationParticipants can scan hidden QR codes across Shibuya and Shinjuku to unlock exclusive posters and enter to win a custom gold Mercedes-AMG G 63The Tokyo Treasure Hunters campaign runs through November 8 culminating with a physical mega chest installation at Harajuku Station Epic Games has officially launched 'Tokyo Treasure Hunters', an interactive real-world citywide activation across Tokyo to celebrate the debut of Fortnite's newest Battle Royale season, Fortnite Treasure Hunters: The Greatest Adventure of All Time. Created in collaboration with the globally acclaimed anime series ONE PIECE and Toei Animation, the week-long campaign invites residents to search for hidden digital stamps throughout the metropolis for a chance to win exclusive rewards.Kicked off with a takeover of the iconic digital screens surrounding Shibuya Scramble Crossing, the event aligns with a new animated season trailer produced alongside Toei Animation, featuring direction by Kokoro Kondo and character designs by Chiharu Akakura. On the ground across Tokyo hubs including Shibuya and Shinjuku, participants can follow clues disseminated via the official @treasurehunters LINE account to locate QR codes stamped with Captain X's Jolly Llama insignia. The hunt incorporates physical checkpoints, including a three-wheeled Banana Cart inspired by Peely, a hidden miniature Cat Door, a custom "WANTED" photo booth, and interactive pop-ups featuring blacklight-reactive street art and Gachapon machines.The activation culminates with a grand finale at Harajuku Station's Takeshita Exit Park on November 7 and 8, where a life-sized mega chest will be unveiled. Participants who scan hidden checkpoints to collect digital stamps inside their web-based passbook unlock tiered rewards: two stamps earn a limited-edition ONE PIECE x Fortnite poster, five stamps grant entry to win a collaborative Treasure Box featuring a ONE PIECE Card Game Booster Box, and each collected stamp offers an entry into the sweepstakes for the grand prize, a custom gold Mercedes-AMG G 63.The Tokyo Treasure Hunters event runs through Sunday, November 8, 2026, with registration and rules available via online. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Two Oscar Mayer Wienermobile Pedal Cars Are Rolling Toward the Auction Block
items.text: Two Oscar Mayer Wienermobile Pedal Cars Are Rolling Toward the Auction Block Summary A pair of 1990s Oscar Mayer Wienermobile pedal cars is being auctioned as a single lot on Bring a TrailerThe new-old-stock pieces are offered together with no reserve and have never been sat in by a childBidding is currently at $1,100 with the auction set to officially close on November 4, 2026 A pair of 1990s Oscar Mayer Wienermobile pedal cars is up for bid. Currently listed on Bring a Trailer as Lot #272,200, the duo is offered as a single lot with no reserve. The seller acquired both pedal cars in 2021, and the current bid stands at $1,100. With the auction scheduled to close on November 4, collectors are eyeing a pristine piece of promotional history.Both vintage Oscar Mayer Wienermobile pedal cars date back to the 1990s and arrive in new-old-stock condition. Neither car has ever been sat in by a child, preserving display value. Each model features bright orange and yellow plastic bodywork mounted over a metal frame. Plastic wheels, a yellow seat and a black steering wheel with a yellow horn button complete the design. Pedals propel the miniature vehicles without complex mechanics.While looking nearly identical at first glance, the lot features distinct manufacturing variations. One pedal car was produced by the Bird Corporation and utilizes a seamless, single-piece hot dog body design. Konek Inc. manufactured the second pedal car using a two-piece hot dog body design. That vehicle measures 45 inches long, 21 inches wide and 19 inches tall. Located in North Port, Florida, the duo awaits a new owner.These pedal-powered replicas tap into a deep vein of American automotive marketing that stretches back nearly a century. The Oscar Mayer Wienermobile traces its origins to 1936, when Carl Mayer proposed a 13-foot hot dog vehicle to promote the family business. That concept evolved into a larger version built on a Willys Jeep chassis during the late 1950s. Pristine pedal cars anchor any collection to that advertising legacy, offering a tangible link to a brand that continues to operate a promotional fleet of six 23-foot Wienermobiles across the United States today. items.title: After Eight Years of Silence, ‘The Elder Scrolls VI’ Is Officially ‘Sentinel’
items.text: After Eight Years of Silence, ‘The Elder Scrolls VI’ Is Officially ‘Sentinel’ Bethesda has given its long-awaited sequel a full title, confirming that the next Elder Scrolls game will be called The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel. The reveal closes out more than eight years of the project going by a numeral alone, and arrives just as the studio marks its 40th anniversary and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim approaches its 15th birthday this month.Studio chief Todd Howard handled the announcement personally, closing out an anniversary video of just under 10 minutes that looked back on Bethesda Game Studios’ four-decade history. With the milestone in hand, Howard called it the “perfect time” to put a name on the game. Bethesda is keeping everything else under wraps for now, and its accompanying XBOX Wire post shares only the new Sentinel logo.Where Bethesda stays quiet, earlier reporting fills in the outline. The Verge’s Tom Warren, who reported last week that the title would land in November, says Sentinel takes players to Hammerfell, a province fans have previously visited in The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard and The Elder Scrolls Online. The name itself fits that picture, as Sentinel is a major city in the region.Warren also reports that Sentinel will be the first entry to dig into the history of the Elder Scrolls themselves, the mysterious ancient artifacts behind the franchise’s name. If that holds, it would put the series’ central mystery at the heart of the story for the first time, though Bethesda has yet to confirm any narrative details, gameplay or a release window. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bethesda Game Studios (@bethesdagamestudios) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Japanese Tradition Meets Contemporary Style in the Seiko Presage Classic Series
items.text: Japanese Tradition Meets Contemporary Style in the Seiko Presage Classic Series When streetwear enthusiasts and horology geeks talk about the modern wrist check, the conversation often leans toward high-octane sports chronographs or titanium divers. But there’s a quiet shift happening across both subcultures, where subtle texture, design heritage, and understated versatility are taking center stage.Enter the Seiko Presage Classic Series, a collection that brings traditional Japanese aesthetics into step with today’s lifestyle landscape.At the heart of the Presage lineup is a commitment to expressing traditional Japanese beauty through mechanical watchmaking. Rather than relying on overt branding, Seiko lets the details do the talking. The collection features gracefully curved cases, vintage-inspired multi-link bracelets, and intricate dials that mirror traditional textile weaving and dyeing techniques—from embossed dial patterns inspired by the flowing drape of silk fabric to soft hues like shironeri (refined silk white), wakatake-iro (bamboo green), and sakura-iro (cherry blossom pink).For watch collectors, the appeal of Presage lies in its mechanical integrity and attention to detail. Powered by reliable in-house movements like the 6R51—offering a robust 72-hour power reserve—the series satisfies the technical expectations of enthusiast culture. Features like dual-curved sapphire crystals, and well-balanced proportions (including versatile 36mm, 38mm, and 40.2mm case sizes) make these timepieces a masterclass in horology.Meanwhile, in contemporary fashion circles, Presage hits the sweet spot of the "quiet luxury" and "craft-core" movements. As streetwear evolves past loud logos toward textured layers, muted palettes, and tailored silhouettes, a watch with a subtle, light-catching dial acts as the ultimate understated flex. Whether styled alongside heavy-weight fleece, vintage denim, or a sharply draped coat, these timepieces slide effortlessly into fluid, gender-inclusive wardrobes.To showcase this crossover, platforms like The Presage Museum connect the ideas behind the watches with modern art, ikebana, and traditional calligraphy. By framing traditional Japanese aesthetics through a contemporary cultural lens, Seiko proves that true style is about wearing craftsmanship that stands the test of time.Explore the Seiko Presage Classic Series on the official website. items.title: From Couture to Blue Jeans: The Met Pivots to the Everyday for Spring 2027
items.text: From Couture to Blue Jeans: The Met Pivots to the Everyday for Spring 2027 Summary The Metropolitan Museum of Art has announced its spring 2027 Costume Institute exhibition extraOrdinary Fashion and the Poetics of the EverydayCurated by Andrew Bolton the showcase explores how designers elevate everyday staples from denim to bubble wrapThe exhibition will open to the public on May 9 2027 following the annual Met Gala the Monday before The Metropolitan Museum of Art has officially revealed its Spring 2027 Costume Institute exhibition, "extraOrdinary: Fashion and the Poetics of the Everyday", establishing the theme for the upcoming Met Gala. The presentation pivots toward quotidian wardrobe staples and utilitarian resourcefulness following the cancellation of the museum's planned John Galliano retrospective.Curated by Andrew Bolton, the exhibition will display between 200 and 230 pieces that investigate how high fashion reinterprets mundane items, spanning blue jeans, plain white T-shirts, and puffer coats to unconventional materials like paper, plastic, and bubble wrap. Archival selections include Charles James’s 1930s couture puffer, Brooke Shields’s Calvin Klein denim, Marc Jacobs’s 1990s Perry Ellis grunge designs, Junya Watanabe’s leather biker silhouettes, and Matthieu Blazy’s trompe l'oeil leather denim for Bottega Veneta.“I wanted an exhibition that I felt had something new to say, and that I felt was relevant to different conversations,” Bolton shared, highlighting how the curation questions notions of value, consumption, and care. Backed by Instagram, Moncler, and Condé Nast, the show engages the tension between necessity and high-end luxury appropriation.The "extraOrdinary: Fashion and the Poetics of the Everyday" exhibition is set to open at The Met on May 9, 2027, preceded by the Met Gala the Monday before. items.title: Pierpaolo Piccioli Steps Down as Creative Director of Balenciaga
items.text: Pierpaolo Piccioli Steps Down as Creative Director of Balenciaga Summary Pierpaolo Piccioli will step down as creative director of Balenciaga after serving less than two years in the roleKering chief executive Luca de Meo announced the departure as part of an ongoing restructuring across the luxury group's portfolioLondon-based designer Martine Rose has reportedly been tapped to take over the helm at the Parisian fashion house French luxury conglomerate Kering has announced that Pierpaolo Piccioli will step down as creative director of Balenciaga after less than two years in the role. The departure comes amid an extensive creative restructuring spearheaded by Kering chief executive Luca de Meo across the group's flagship houses.Piccioli took over the Parisian brand following Demna’s transition to Gucci in March 2025, attempting to reconcile couture craftsmanship with Balenciaga’s streetwear credibility. However, reconciling the Roman couturier’s romantic aesthetic with the house's subversive codes proved challenging amidst fluctuating sales. Addressing the transition, Kering noted that "Balenciaga faced a more challenging quarter as the House continued to work through its creative transition and to restore balance across its business.""Pierpaolo is an exceptional couturier and creative talent for whom we have the greatest respect," De Meo said in a statement. "Our ambition is to build on Balenciaga’s avant garde spirit, honour its remarkable heritage and continue to push creative boundaries, further establishing the house as a powerful and relevant voice." The departure follows recent high-profile exits across Kering, including Anthony Vaccarello at Saint Laurent and Sean McGirr at McQueen, with rumors that Martine Rose has been tapped to succeed Piccioli. Kering nor Balenciaga has confirmed Piccioli's successor. View this post on InstagramA post shared by Pierpaolo Piccioli (@pppiccioli) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: HOKA x Marni Reunite to Rework the Clifton 11 in Three Bold Colorways
items.text: HOKA x Marni Reunite to Rework the Clifton 11 in Three Bold Colorways Name: Marni x HOKA Clifton 11MSRP: $275 USDRelease Date: November 12Where to Buy: HOKAHOKA and Marni have reunited for a second collaboration, this time reworking the Clifton 11, HOKA’s everyday trainer, as the Clifton Marni. The Clifton’s running credentials stay intact: an engineered mesh upper sits on a compression-molded EVA foam midsole, with HOKA’s Smooth MetaRocker geometry for rolling transitions and a rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame that supports the heel.MARNI’s influence shows in how those functional parts are treated. Raised 3D silicone lines sweep in waves from the midfoot toward the heel, and the plush collar is lined with a textured knit that contrasts with the smooth mesh.Each of the three colorways takes a different approach to contrast. The Black version is almost completely tonal, from the mesh down to the midsole, with a cream collar lining and red lace loops adding warmth. The Orange pair is the loudest of the three: a vivid orange upper sits on a white midsole wrapped in a metallic silver band, with a black rubber outsole under the forefoot. The White colorway is soft and clean, with a sparkling silver trim along the heel collar.Branding is split across the heel on all three, with a red HOKA logo on the lateral side and Marni’s widely spaced red wordmark on the medial side. Metal lace dubraes add a hardware accent near the toe, and a custom plaid sockliner is tucked inside. MARNI’s eye for pattern carries over to the laces, which come in speckled, striped two-tone designs: black and white on the Orange pair, red and grey on the Black, and pink and grey on the White. Each pair comes with two extra sets of laces for personalizing the look.The Clifton MARNI is set to launch on November 12, 2026, through MARNI's channels, with a wider release following at HOKA and select global retailers on November 13.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. A central zip makes the boot easy to get on and off. Over it sits a removable olive leather shroud, framed by military-style lacing that uses thick, coiled olive cord threaded through metal eyelets.Maharishi’s DPM: Bonsai Tigerstripe, an update of the classic Vietnam-era Tigerstripe pattern appears in tan, brown and black on the tongue and inner collar. items.title: Apple Is Reportedly Working on a Robotic Arm Smart Display for 2028
items.text: Apple Is Reportedly Working on a Robotic Arm Smart Display for 2028 Summary Apple is actively developing a $1,000 robotic smart display internally codenamed J595The hardware boasts a 9-inch screen on an articulated arm capable of 360-degree rotationSoftware teams are holding the launch for a projected 2028 release to perfect AI integration Apple is currently developing a high-end expansion to its smart home display lineup, with a report from The Information shedding light on an unreleased product featuring a moving robotic arm. Former Apple employees state that the company could ultimately brand this higher-end model as the Apple HomeView Ultra. Internally carrying the codename J595, the robotic display product carries an estimated price tag of around $1,000 USD. Arriving at a $700 USD premium over the $299 USD standard Apple HomeView announced last month, this device expands Apple's connected smart home ecosystem into the high-end market.The defining design element of the upcoming HomeView Ultra is its physical footprint, featuring a 9-inch display that swivels around a robotic arm. This hardware closely resembles a classic articulated desk lamp, bearing a direct similarity to the fixture featured in Pixar's logo. A separate report from MacRumors notes that the 9-inch screen features full 360-degree capabilities. Rather than remaining static on a counter, the robotic display device uses built-in sensors to follow users as they move around a space during FaceTime calls.Despite the futuristic design, physical engineering is complete, as hardware for the HomeView Ultra has been ready for two years. Apple's software team is currently delaying the launch to fine-tune integrated AI and home automation features. Holding the release allows developers to refine complex automated responses before delivering robotic hardware to consumers. One planned automation feature involves the display automatically switching on a light when someone enters the room.Because of this intentional software delay, early adopters must wait several years to purchase the technology. The Information states that Apple could formally announce the device in 2027 and begin shipping to buyers in 2028. This launch timeline aligns with Bloomberg reporting from last month regarding a projected 2027 or 2028 release window. When it ultimately arrives, the $1,000 USD HomeView Ultra will represent a major functional shift for Apple's home automation platform. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebe

items.title: Maya Hawke Draws the Lead Role in Live-Action ‘Magic: The Gathering’ Movie
items.text: Maya Hawke Draws the Lead Role in Live-Action ‘Magic: The Gathering’ Movie Summary Maya Hawke has been cast in 'Magic: The Gathering,' a live-action film adaptation of the trading card gameHer role and the plot remain undisclosed, though Hawke is expected to lead an ensemble cast that has yet to be announcedDirector Matt Johnson, a longtime 'Magic' fan, is writing the script with Noah Gardner and Aidan Fitzgerald Maya Hawke is set to star in Magic: The Gathering, Legendary Entertainment and Hasbro Entertainment’s live-action take on the long-running trading card game. Deadline first reported the casting, which puts the Stranger Things actor at the center of one of Hasbro’s biggest properties as it moves to the big screen.Details beyond Hawke’s casting are still limited. Her character has not been revealed, and neither has the storyline, though Deadline reports she is expected to anchor an ensemble that has not yet been cast. That leaves the game’s own lore as the clearest guide to what the film might look like.That lore gives the production a lot to work with. Magic: The Gathering takes place across a multiverse of fantasy worlds, with players battling one another as powerful wizards known as Planeswalkers. Translating that into live action means building several distinct settings instead of a single fantasy realm, which may explain why the cast is being built around a lead before the rest of the ensemble.The team behind the camera brings indie credentials to the franchise. Matt Johnson, the director of Blackberry and creator of Nirvanna the Band the Show, is directing and co-writing the screenplay with Noah Gardner of Super 8 and Aidan Fitzgerald of Calls. Legendary and Hasbro are producing the film together.Johnson’s connection to the game goes well beyond the job. He recalled sitting near the top of the standings going into day two of a Magic Grand Prix in Detroit and seriously considering leaving film school to play professionally, only to lose his composure, make a costly misplay and drive home to Toronto convinced his competitive career was over. “To all the dreamers reading this: in every pool, there is a day 2 deck,” Johnson said.Hawke arrives with a broad résumé across genres. Best known for Netflix’s Stranger Things, she has also appeared in Quentin Tarantino’s Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, Wes Anderson’s Asteroid City, Jennifer Kaytin Robinson’s Do Revenge and Bradley Cooper’s Maestro, and she voiced Anxiety in Pixar’s Inside Out 2. items.title: Santa Monica Studio Delays 'God of War Laufey' to May 2027
items.text: Santa Monica Studio Delays 'God of War Laufey' to May 2027 Summary Santa Monica Studio has pushed the release of God of War Laufey to May 20, 2027The PlayStation 5 exclusive shifts away from its original February 16 launch dateFaye's afterlife narrative will run parallel to the events of the previous two franchise installments PlayStation fans will have to wait just a little longer to dive back into the mythological realms, as Santa Monica Studio has officially delayed the release of God of War Laufey. Originally locked in for a February 16, 2027 launch, the highly anticipated PlayStation 5 exclusive has been pushed back by three months and will now officially hit consoles on May 20, 2027. The development team formally announced the schedule change via a social media post, resetting the countdown for a project that was officially revealed this past June.Addressing the shifting timeline, Santa Monica Studio stated that the team is utilizing the extra runway to add essential finishing touches and push the game to its absolute fullest potential. The developer explicitly noted that it does not take fan trust for granted. Moving away from a crowded early 2027 release window provides God of War Laufey with vital breathing room while ensuring Sony secures a major first-party title to anchor its spring quarter.When the game finally drops in May, it promises to flip the established franchise perspective by putting players in control of a brand-new playable protagonist: Faye. Her death in the game's timeline occurs just before the beginning of the 2018 God of War story, serving as the underlying catalyst for the modern saga. Now, players will experience her isolated aftermath. Faye’s story unfolds entirely within the afterlife, focusing heavily on her journey through a mysterious area known as the Everywhen.Because the narrative places her afterlife traversal in this specific setting, God of War Laufey runs completely parallel to the events of both God of War (2018) and God of War Ragnarök. While the fanbase knows the profound impact her passing had on the overarching universe, this upcoming release finally sheds light on her own unseen battles. Alongside the heavy mythological storytelling the studio is known for, the title will also feature some unexpectedly bizarre additions to the lore, including a character described as a talking jelly cube. items.title: Liverpool Owner Fenway Sports Group Is Reportedly in Talks to Buy a Majority Stake in the Cadillac F1 Team
items.text: Liverpool Owner Fenway Sports Group Is Reportedly in Talks to Buy a Majority Stake in the Cadillac F1 Team Summary Fenway Sports Group is negotiating a potential £2bn-plus takeover of the Cadillac Formula One teamThe move follows FSG's partial sale of Liverpool to a consortium including Jeff BezosCadillac co-owner Mark Walter is currently offloading sporting assets amid US federal investigations Fenway Sports Group (FSG) is reportedly in talks to acquire a majority stake in the Cadillac Formula One team, a blockbuster move that would command a price tag of more than £2bn. The high-stakes acquisition targets a franchise that only entered the grid this year as a joint venture between General Motors and Mark Walter’s TWG Global. While TWG has firmly denied that any sale of the racing outfit is imminent, FSG stands as just one of several heavy-hitting interested parties currently holding discussions about taking over the team. Representatives for FSG have declined to comment on their investment plans. The potential acquisition signals a massive shift in global sports equity, driven by F1’s remarkable commercial growth across the United States over the last decade. Since the racing series was bought by Liberty Media in 2017, the sport's annual revenue has more than doubled to $4 billion USD.The framework for this multi-billion-pound transaction stems directly from a broader liquidation of assets by Mark Walter. Walter is actively shedding major sports properties amid allegations of insurance fraud, and is currently under investigation by the US Department of Justice and the Securities and Exchange Commission over alleged fraud involving the management of funds at Delaware Life, Clear Spring and EquiTrust. TWG has stated unequivocally that there has been no fraud, yet the firm continues to rapidly reshape its portfolio. The conglomerate already sold off its controlling interest in the Los Angeles Lakers and a 13% stake in Chelsea this past summer, and is currently looking to sell the WNBA’s Los Angeles Sparks. Walter, who remains the controlling owner of the Los Angeles Dodgers, insists that the MLB franchise will not be sold. Sportico previously reported that Walter values his specific shareholding in the Cadillac team at approximately £2.24 billion GBP, though the exact sizes of TWG’s and General Motors' respective stakes have never been made public.Financing a £2 billion GBP F1 entry leverages strategic liquidity generated from FSG's other heavyweight propert

items.text: Sit on It or Stack It: Carpet Company’s S-Tool Can Do Both Summary Carpet Company’s S-Tool reimagines the humble screw as a stackable fiberglass stool designed in Baltimore.Each 12-inch piece weighs nearly 20 pounds and carries its own individually numbered plaque.Batch 2 introduces Navy, Clementine, Rose, Slime and Jet Black colorways. Baltimore's Carpet Company is carrying its design language past skateboarding and apparel with the S-Tool, a fiberglass stool built from scratch that blurs the line between furniture and sculpture. The concept takes its cue from humble hardware: each of its four chunky legs tapers into the fluted point of a screw, while the seat's surface is stamped with four Phillips-head recesses, turning an everyday fastener into a playful, oversized object.Carpet Company leans fully into that irreverence, pitching the piece with the tagline "Sit on it. Stand on it. Spit on it." and suggesting it can serve as anything from a chair, ottoman or footrest to a paperweight, chew toy or even trash, depending on how its owner chooses to use it.Despite measuring just 12 inches tall, the S-Tool carries real heft at close to 20 pounds, giving its compact frame a grounded, substantial presence. Its high-gloss finish amplifies the toy-like silhouette, and the design does more than look good: the screw-tip legs nest into the recesses of the stool below, allowing multiple units to stack into a seamless, totem-like column.Flip one over and a metal plaque on the underside lists its colorway and individual number, with the Batch 2 plaques shown in the imagery reading "of 7." The presentation extends to the packaging, a white cube printed with rows of multicolored screws, the brand's tongue-in-cheek usage notes and a grinning blue hippo graphic on a red panel, along with a leather-bound book that showcases each shade as an illustrated screw.The S-Tool's first run arrived in Red, Yellow, Kelly, Blue and Chocolate and sold out almost immediately. For Batch 2, Carpet Company introduced five new colorways: Navy, Clementine, Rose, Slime and Jet Black. Like the debut collection, quantities are extremely limited, reinforcing the S-Tool's status as both a usable piece of furniture and a collectible design object. For more information, head over to the brand's website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘GTA VI’ Has Reportedly Pulled In $751 Million USD From Pre-Orders Alone
items.text: ‘GTA VI’ Has Reportedly Pulled In $751 Million USD From Pre-Orders Alone Summary Rockstar’s 'GTA VI' has reportedly generated more than $750 million USD in digital pre-orders weeks before launchAnalytics firm Sensor Tower estimates PS5 players account for 74% of pre-orders, far ahead of Xbox Series X|SThe estimate is already closing in on GTA V’s record first-day sales, though the two figures aren’t a direct comparison Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto VI is reportedly tracking toward one of the biggest launches in gaming history before a single copy has been unlocked. New estimates from analytics firm Sensor Tower suggest the sequel has already brought in roughly $751 million USD from digital pre-orders across PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with launch still weeks away.Sensor Tower’s tracking puts the game at around 7.71 million digital pre-orders so far. Momentum appears to be building as release approaches, as the firm estimates that more than $100 million USD of that pre-order revenue came in during the past two weeks alone.The platform split heavily favors Sony. By Sensor Tower’s count, PlayStation accounts for 74% of pre-orders, or roughly 5.74 million copies worth an estimated $559 million USD. Xbox Series X|S makes up the remaining 26%, with about 1.97 million copies bringing in an estimated $192 million USD.The natural benchmark is GTA V, which set a record when it launched in September 2013. Take-Two Interactive’s official figures showed the game passing $800 million USD in worldwide sales within its first 24 hours and crossing $1 billion USD in three days. On paper, GTA VI’s pre-order haul is already approaching that first-day mark before launch day has even arrived.The comparison has limits, though, and the caveats matter. Sensor Tower’s numbers are third-party estimates, not sales data confirmed by Rockstar or Take-Two. They also count only digital pre-orders, so physical copies, often a large share of a blockbuster launch, aren’t included. GTA V’s record, by contrast, reflected actual sales after release, which makes the two figures different kinds of measurement.GTA VI launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with preloading set to open on November 10. items.title: Columbia and BEAMS Flip the 1986 Bugaboo Jacket Inside Out
items.text: Columbia and BEAMS Flip the 1986 Bugaboo Jacket Inside Out Summary Columbia and BEAMS rework the 1986 Bugaboo Jacket, replacing its original layered system with a lighter reversible buildA Graphic Sweat Crew with period-style hunting artwork joins the jacket in two gray colorwaysFleece caps in camo and brown round out a compact three-piece capsule Columbia and BEAMS have reworked the Columbia Bugaboo Jacket for their latest collaboration, turning the 1986 outerwear staple into a reversible piece. The jacket leads a compact capsule that also includes a graphic crewneck and two fleece caps, all styled around the look of the era while being built for everyday wear today.The original Bugaboo became one of the Portland, Oregon outdoor brand’s defining pieces because of its interchange system, which paired a separate inner layer with an outer shell that could be worn together or apart. The collaboration keeps the thinking behind that design but drops the two-piece setup for a reversible construction. As a result, the jacket gives the wearer two looks in a single garment, and BEAMS says the new version is lighter and easier to throw on than the multi-layer original.The jacket comes in brown in sizes S through XL, keeping the palette in the earthy register of classic outdoor gear. The reversible build keeps its versatility while removing the bulk of a zip-in liner, making it better suited to city days than backcountry trips.The Graphic Sweat Crew carries a hunting-themed graphic designed to evoke the period when the Bugaboo first appeared. It comes in gray heather and gray in sizes XS through XL, giving the capsule a lighter layering piece to wear under the jacket.The Fleece Cap finishes the lineup in two one-size colorways. The camo version adds a field-ready pattern, while the brown version matches the jacket and pulls the set together as a coordinated look.Pre-orders for the Columbia x BEAMS collection are open now, ahead of a November 21 release at BEAMS and BEAMS BOY stores (some locations excluded) and the BEAMS online shop. The size S Bugaboo Jacket, the size XS Graphic Sweat Crew and the brown Fleece Cap are available only at BEAMS BOY stores. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Moomins Have Moved Into Bottega Veneta’s Intrecciato
items.text: The Moomins Have Moved Into Bottega Veneta’s Intrecciato Summary Bottega Veneta teams up with Moomin on a collection of bags, wallets, charms and home objects based on Tove Jansson’s characters and storiesKey pieces turn story details into leather, from Moominmamma’s striped apron to the walls and roof of MoominhouseThree-dimensional character charms and a hand-crocheted Snufkin figurine extend the house’s leatherwork beyond bags Bottega Veneta has partnered with Moomin on a collection that turns Tove Jansson’s characters, color palettes and storybook scenes into handbags, small leather goods and objects for the home. Rather than putting characters on the surface, the collection builds the references into weaves, hardware and hand-shaped leather, so many of the nods only show up up close.The clearest example is the Small Andiamo, whose design starts from Moominmamma’s striped apron. Red and soft white leathers alternate through the house’s intrecciato weave, and a gold-tone knot detail serves as the hardware. Because the reference comes through in color, the bag works even for someone who has never read the books.Several other silhouettes hide their story references in less obvious places. The Large Pinacoteca tote carries comic strip panels, and select wallets use blue and red tones that echo the exterior walls and roof of Moominhouse. On the Small Cabat, the original cover art from Comet in Moominland is placed on the internal pouch, so the reference is only visible once the bag is open.The leather charms are where the craft becomes most sculptural. Artisans hand-weave the Moomintroll charm from tubular Nappa leather to recreate his round shape, while the Moominmamma charm adds her striped apron and a miniature intrecciato bag of her own. A Moominhouse charm and a pencil holder stocked with colored pencils carry the story’s architecture into everyday objects.The Snufkin figurine is the most labor-intensive piece in the collection. It is made from finely cut Nappa leather worked with a crochet technique that takes artisans several days to finish. The result has a tactile, three-dimensional texture that differs from the house’s usual woven bags, showing how far the collaboration stretches Bottega Veneta’s leather techniques.The Bottega Veneta x Moomin collection launches early in Japan at an Isetan Shinjuku pop-up on November 11. items.title: lululemon Launches Its First GORE-TEX Collection
items.text: lululemon Launches Its First GORE-TEX Collection Vancouver-based performance apparel brand lululemon has unveiled "Silent Type™️," a new outerwear collection in collaboration with GORE-TEX®. The line will be available exclusively at nine BEAMS stores in Japan, with pre-sales starting Friday, November 13, at three Tokyo locations, followed by a wider release at the remaining six stores on Thursday, December 3.The defining feature of this collection is its ability to deliver GORE-TEX® protection while reducing the stiffness and rustling noise typically associated with high-performance outerwear.It utilizes the latest ePE (expanded polyethylene) membrane, which offers waterproof, windproof, and breathable qualities. The outer fabric is a proprietary material designed to minimize friction noise, while the lining features brushed tricot. The result is a soft touch and a remarkably quiet wearing experience.The lineup includes three models: a rain jacket (¥68,800), a raincoat (¥92,800), and a waterproof down jacket (¥128,800). Available in both men's and women's styles, the collection offers six pieces in total. The rain jacket and raincoat feature a three-layer construction with waterproof, windproof, and breathable capabilities, fully sealed seams, and multiple pockets. Meanwhile, the waterproof down jacket combines a two-layer structure with 700-fill-power RDS-certified goose down, engineered to provide lightweight warmth even in temperatures as low as -20°C. All pieces share a minimalist design that seamlessly transitions into city life and a relaxed fit ideal for layering."Silent Type™️" will pre-launch on Friday, November 13, at three locations: BEAMS MEN Shibuya, BEAMS WOMEN Harajuku, and BEAMS SPORTS. Following this, it will be available from Thursday, December 3, at six additional stores: BEAMS Shinjuku, BEAMS Futakotamagawa, BEAMS HOUSE Marunouchi, BEAMS HOUSE Umeda, BEAMS Nagoya, and BEAMS Toyosu.Additionally, with the purchase of one eligible item, customers will receive a limited-edition "Back to Life Sports Bottle" designed for the collection. This offer is limited to the first 30 customers at each store and is available while supplies last. Furthermore, a launch party will be held at BEAMS MEN Shibuya on Thursday, November 12, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM. The event is free and open to the public, featuring a DJ, food, and drinks. items.title: Valve Is Tightening Steam’s Game Submission Rules After AI-Generated Games Flood the Review Queue
items.text: Valve Is Tightening Steam’s Game Submission Rules After AI-Generated Games Flood the Review Queue Summary Valve updated its Steam game release rules to clear an approval backlog heavily driven by a surge of AI-generated titlesCurrent review times have stretched to up to 12 business days, missing the platform's standard goal of three to five daysDevelopers must now complete mandatory functionality checks to prevent re-reviews and ease the strain on indie creators Valve updated its Steam game release rules in a targeted effort to unclog a backlog of title approvals. Review times for new games on the storefront now take up to 12 business days to complete. This turnaround contrasts with Valve's operational goal of reviewing new titles within three to five days. The company instituted new guidelines to eliminate constant re-reviews that contribute to longer wait times. Developer 2 Left Thumbs stated on X that review wait times spiked significantly around September and October.The backlog follows a flood of new game titles on the platform, with a large portion created using AI. This influx of AI-generated content strained the review infrastructure at Steam, delaying submissions across the catalog. Reddit user u/ploz found that 49.9 percent of games released on Steam in October officially disclosed AI-generated content. That figure represents a rapid escalation from June, when nearly 20 percent of Next Fest game demos disclosed AI use.To clear the pipeline, the new rules mandate stronger basic quality control at the developer level. Most notably, developers must run their games through Steam for at least five minutes to ensure they function properly on the platform. Valve implemented this after noting that it wasted time reviewing game builds that creators had never played through Steam. Beyond mandatory playtime, developers must confirm common redistributables like DirectX and Visual C++. Creators must also ensure game achievements are ready before release and verify that Steam Cloud save paths are configured correctly. Finally, developers must categorize game screenshots into specific buckets, labeling them as gameplay, menus, concept art or cinematics.The approval delays caused collateral damage for indie developers, with games missing launch dates by weeks. These logistical failures cost creators marketing momentum and caused sudden player backlash during major releases. items.title: 258 Hayao Miyazaki Boards Reveal the ‘Princess Mononoke’ That Almost Was
items.text: 258 Hayao Miyazaki Boards Reveal the ‘Princess Mononoke’ That Almost Was Summary Iwanami Shoten’s Studio Ghibli-edited image board series reaches Princess Mononoke with its seventh volumeThe book collects 258 of Hayao Miyazaki’s boards, 90 of them published for the first timeA complete “early version” of the story and a closing interview with producer Toshio Suzuki trace how the 1997 film took shape Studio Ghibli and Iwanami Shoten are opening the archive on Princess Mononoke with the seventh volume of the Hayao Miyazaki Image Board Collection. The 184-page edition gathers 258 of Miyazaki’s preparatory paintings for the 1997 film, including 90 that have never been published, and documents the 16-year path from first idea to finished feature.The headline is a version of Princess Mononoke that never reached the screen. Miyazaki’s original concept, which the publisher calls the “early version,” told a very different story about a mononoke spirit and a princess, closer in spirit to Beauty and the Beast, with art that looks nothing like the eventual film. The volume reproduces that full set of early boards together with the complete text of the 1993 picture book Tokuma Shoten published from them, an edition that is now out of print.The rest of the collection shows what happened after that concept was dropped. Miyazaki originally planned to adapt the early version, then shelved it after deciding its theme had grown stale. After making the short On Your Mark, he pushed himself to break from his earlier work, and the boards that follow document that struggle as the story was rebuilt from the ground up. Several images never made it into the finished film, including a rendering of San wearing what looks like a smile, a rare sight for the famously fierce lead.The volume closes with an interview with longtime Ghibli producer Toshio Suzuki, who covers the origins of the ironworks settlement Tataraba, early ideas for Lady Eboshi, and the decision to approach the film with the gritty tone of gekiga comics. He also frames the project as Miyazaki returning to the question of nature and humanity after concluding that Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind had treated it too simply. “To exaggerate a little, it’s a film that looks like it was made by a rookie director,” Suzuki says in the book’s interview.The edition also carries an endorsement from ONE PIECE creator Eiichiro Oda, a longtime admirer of Miyazaki. items.title: Piaget Sets Sodalite and Turquoise Into Its Andy Warhol “Camouflage” Limited Edition
items.text: Piaget Sets Sodalite and Turquoise Into Its Andy Warhol “Camouflage” Limited Edition Summary Piaget and The Andy Warhol Foundation launched the 86-piece "Camouflage" watch.The 45mm white gold cushion case features a dial made of sodalite, turquoise, and gold.The self-winding timepiece honors Warhol’s 1986 self-portraits. Continuing its official partnership with The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts, Piaget has unveiled the Andy Warhol "Camouflage" limited edition watch.Following the "Collage" series last year, this second collaboration draws direct inspiration from a series of self-portraits Warhol created in 1986, which explored the dual nature of fame by obscuring the artist's face behind bold, brightly colored camouflage. Piaget secured the exclusive licensing rights to use Warhol’s name in 2024, renaming the collection - previously known as the Black Tie Vintage since 2014 - to honor the pop art icon, who was a passionate collector and owned seven Piaget models.For this release, Piaget deconstructed Warhol's 1986 self-portraits through the contemporary lens of haute horlogerie. The striking camouflage dial is a masterclass in ornamental stone marquetry, requiring over 100 hours of labor to design, research, and assemble. The abstract pattern is formed from 27 individual pieces, pairing the deep, chromatic blues of cerulean turquoise and oceanic sodalite with the contrasting textures of satin-finished gold and shiny rose gold. Framing this intricate artwork is the model’s iconic 45mm cushion-shaped case, rendered in white gold and detailed with signature gadroons.The Andy Warhol "Camouflage" is powered by Piaget’s self-winding manufacture movement, the 501 P1, driving a set of elegant dauphine hands. Flipping over the white gold case reveals Andy Warhol's famous signature engraved on the caseback, alongside the specific edition number. Production of this highly intricate, art-forward timepiece is strictly limited to 86 pieces worldwide. For more information, head over to Piager's official website or physical boutiques. items.title: The Carhartt WIP x Nike Air Max Goadome Low Gets Its First Official Look
items.text: The Carhartt WIP x Nike Air Max Goadome Low Gets Its First Official Look Name: Carhartt WIP x Nike Air Max Goadome Low “Twilight Marsh”Colorway: Twilight Marsh/Light British Tan-Light Cream-BlackSKU: IW6306-300MSRP: $190 USDRelease Date: Holiday 2026The Carhartt WIP x Nike Air Max Goadome Low takes Nike’s rugged lifestyle silhouette and outfits it with utility details pulled straight from the workwear playbook. Official images of the “Twilight Marsh” colorway have now surfaced via Nike, showing a reworked upper that departs from the standard Goadome build in both structure and hardware.The most noticeable change sits along the sidewalls, where Carhartt WIP carves out an open section edged in stitching that recalls the Nike Tailwind 4. On the “Twilight Marsh” pair, Nike’s photos show canvas filling those side zones while leather overlays wrap the rest of the upper, giving the shoe a layered, almost patched-together construction. Earlier reports pointed to suede on the tan and other earth-toned pairs and leather on the black version, so final materials may vary by colorway.Hardware does much of the talking from there. Rope laces thread through metal D-rings instead of standard eyelets, a detail more at home on a work boot than a sneaker, while a small metallic Swoosh replaces the usual oversized branding on the side panel. Carhartt WIP’s own identity shows up in two places, with a leather patch on the tongue and a black Carhartt label tacked near the outer side of the shoe.Each of the three colorways mixes the same core palette in a different order. “Twilight Marsh” pairs its namesake shade with Light British Tan, Light Cream and Black, “Light British Tan” brings in Metallic Ochre, Twilight Marsh, Black and Dark Cinder, and the “Black” pair keeps things darkest with Twilight Marsh and Light British Tan accents.The Goadome has long sat closer to a boot than a runner, with a chunky, protective profile that makes it a natural canvas for Carhartt WIP’s utility-minded approach. The project also marks the label’s first collaboration with Nike since 2018.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The 'Grand Theft Auto VI' Custom In-Game Cars Have Come to Life
items.text: The 'Grand Theft Auto VI' Custom In-Game Cars Have Come to Life Summary Rockstar Games commission West Coast Customs to recreate the in-game custom carsEach car comes with its own backstory, including stats, figures and details'Grand Theft Auto VI' finally arrives on November 19 Grand Theft Auto VI is finally coming, and one of the best, most detailed components of the game is coming to life. Literally.Developers commissioned the iconic West Coast Customs of Los Angeles to recreate some of the most recognizable in-game cars with real life counterparts. The detail that went into replicating the replicas must have been painstaking, as we even had a bit of difficulty differentiating the in-game shots (above) from the real life photos (below). And what's even better is that each car is baked with stats and IRL figures, bridging their digital and real-life connections even stronger. Ever wonder what the engine was under the Coquette? Or how much horsepower the Tempesta cop car has? Check out the breakdown of each car and judge for yourself how close each car got to its in-game version. They didn't divulge exactly what car was used to replicate the in-games, so we'll let you make your own conclusions.Grotti CheetahThe Grotti Cheetah is quintessentially Miami. The classic mid-engined ’90s supercar is clean, with Italian-styled lines broken only by intakes feeding a 4.9L naturally-aspirated V8. items.title: The Kith x New Balance 2011 “Monuments” Collection Builds New York Landmarks Into Every Panel
items.text: The Kith x New Balance 2011 “Monuments” Collection Builds New York Landmarks Into Every Panel Name: Kith x New Balance 2011Colorway: Maroon/Atomic Yellow, Amazon/Lilac, Princess Blue/SilverSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: November 9Where to Buy: KithKith and New Balance are returning to the 2011 for the Monuments Collection, a trio of colorways that each salute one of New York City’s most recognizable landmarks. The silhouette first surfaced earlier this year as part of Kith’s 15-year anniversary run, and its name points straight back to the year the retailer opened its doors. This time around, the city’s skyline does the storytelling while the materials do the heavy lifting.Under every colorway sits the same architecture. Kith built the 2011 upper from the ground up, assembling a layered, multi-piece pattern rather than adapting an existing New Balance last, then set it atop the ABZORB midsole unit originally developed for the New Balance 2002. That combination gives the shoe a familiar, cushioned ride underneath a construction that is entirely its own, leaving each Monuments colorway free to play with texture and finish.The “Maroon & Atomic Yellow” pair carries the deepest Kith lineage, revisiting the Ronnie Fieg for New Balance 530 that dropped at Kith in 2014. Perforated nubuck forms the base, layered with perforated nubuck and leather overlays and finished with quilted stitching across the vamp and collar. A full-bleed debossed 2011 graphic covers the heel, contrasting N-lock logos land on both sides, and silver-flecked laces add a subtle shimmer, with additional branding placed on the tongue and heel counter.The “Amazon & Lilac” iteration takes a bolder color-blocked route, built from perforated suede overlays on top of suede underlays. Reflective N-logos on the lateral and medial walls catch light after dark, while dual New Balance and Kith branding sits on the tongue and heel, and 2011 hits mark the outer ankle.Rounding out the set, the “Princess Blue & Silver” version swaps to a breathable mesh base dressed in vibrant suede overlays. Orange accents at the eyelets, N-logos and heel branding cut through the cool palette, joined by a co-branded tongue and 2011 detailing at the lateral heel. All three pairs arrive in New York to the World packaging, finished with a custom sockliner and an extra set of laces.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops.
