items.title: The HOKA Speed Loafer Receives a “Carbon Grey/Washed Blue” Colorway
items.text: The HOKA Speed Loafer Receives a “Carbon Grey/Washed Blue” Colorway Name: HOKA Speed LoaferColorway: Carbon Grey/Washed BlueSKU: 1162170-CBNGMSRP: $185 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: HOKAHOKA broadens its Speed Loafer lineup with a new "Carbon Grey/Washed Blue" colorway, continuing its trail-ready take on one of menswear's most traditional shoes. The upper keeps the classic slip-on shape, with a smooth leather apron across the toe and suede panels wrapping the lower sides and heel. The signature detail is HOKA's custom "speed tassel." Instead of traditional leather tassels, it uses cord-style laces gathered through a metal cord lock, an obvious nod to the quick-lace systems on HOKA's performance shoes.Billed as a crossover built entirely on the brand's own design DNA, the loafer sits on the tooling of the Speedgoat 5, HOKA's well-known trail runner. This robust base is anchored by a traction-focused Vibram Megagrip outsole, ensuring reliable stability and grip across various urban and natural terrains. Subtle yet distinctive branding ties the overall look together, highlighted by a dedicated leather heel patch featuring HOKA's signature bird logo, while a smooth leather sockliner provides an additional layer of premium comfort on the interior. items.title: Casio Shrinks Its Iconic A168 Into a Fully Functional Ring Watch
items.text: Casio Shrinks Its Iconic A168 Into a Fully Functional Ring Watch Summary Casio shrinks its long-selling A168 into a fully functional stainless steel ring watch.A module one-tenth standard size powers the LCD, stopwatch, calendar and hourly Time Flash.Silver-toned and gold ion-plated versions arrive in Japan this month, while an international launch is yet to be announced. Casio is shrinking another icon down to finger size. The brand's new Ring Watch releases are based on the A168, a model that has been a steady seller for 30 year. Everything from the function labels around the display to the shape and finish of the bracelet links is reproduced at miniature scale.To build the all-metal ring, Casio uses metal injection molding (MIM), which presses a mix of fine metal powder and resin into molds, a process that lets the intricate case and band shapes be rendered with high precision. The bracelet's matte finish contrasts with the glossier case, just like the original. Because the case, caseback and ring are molded as a single piece and the glass is sealed with a special adhesive technique, the ring is water-resistant for everyday wear while keeping its battery replaceable. The new pair follows the brand's earlier CRW-001 Ring Watch and weeighs approximately at 15 grams.Despite its micro proportions, Casio has fitted the piece with a fully functional six-digit digital LCD screen protected by mineral glass, which displays hours, minutes, seconds, date, and day of the week. Packed inside is a micro-engineered module that supports 12/24-hour timekeeping, dual time, an auto-calendar, and a 1/100-second stopwatch. Adding an engaging, emotional touch to everyday time-telling, an integrated white LED backlight features a "Time Flash" function, which emits a soft, pulsing glow at the top of every hour or at a custom preset time.Built to fit a Japanese size 22 finger (US size 10.5 / EU size U with an inner circumference of 62.8 mm), each ring watch comes complete with two size-adjusting spacers to accommodate smaller fingers down to sizes 19 and 16. The timepieces are rated water-resistant for daily use and operate on a replaceable SR621SW battery offering roughly two years of runtime.Each unit is packaged in a dedicated presentation box that includes a travel pouch and a custom silicone display stand. Confirmed to release this month in Japan, the silver CRW-002D-1A is priced at ¥19,800 JPY (approx. $135 USD), while the gold ion-plated CRW-002G-9A retails for ¥21,450 J

items.title: Netflix Officially Orders 'Stranger Things' 1950s Prequel Spinoff 'Other Worlds'
items.text: Netflix Officially Orders 'Stranger Things' 1950s Prequel Spinoff 'Other Worlds' Summary Netflix has officially ordered the 1950s prequel spinoff series 'Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure'Co-created by the Duffer brothers and showrunner Kate Trefry the series takes place in 1955 in Marion NevadaJoe Wright will direct the first three episodes of the series which is scheduled to debut on Netflix in 2028 Streaming giant Netflix has officially ordered the prequel spinoff series Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure, expanding the platform's flagship supernatural universe. Announced during the annual Stranger Things Day celebration, the upcoming drama was co-created by series creators Matt and Ross Duffer alongside writer Kate Trefry, setting the stage for an all-new era of mystery and mythology.Set in 1955 within Marion, Nevada, the prequel takes place prior to the events of both the original Stranger Things series and the London stage play The First Shadow. The storyline explores the pivotal events preceding Henry Creel’s exposure to the otherworldly substance that transformed him into the monstrous Vecna. Filming will take place in New Mexico, with Trefry serving as showrunner and executive producer, while Joe Wright is slated to direct the opening three episodes and executive produce alongside 21 Laps' Shawn Levy.The project marks the fourth title established in the franchise ecosystem, joining the flagship series, the animated spinoff Stranger Things: Tales from ’85, and The First Shadow. Produced under the Duffers’ Upside Down Pictures banner as an authorized carve-out of their multi-year overall pact with Paramount, the production expands the universe into a new decade with a fresh ensemble of characters and uncharted supernatural lore.Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure is scheduled to premiere exclusively on Netflix in 2028. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: BEAMS x Crocs Round Six: Reimagining the MA-1 and Sukajan
items.text: BEAMS x Crocs Round Six: Reimagining the MA-1 and Sukajan BEAMS, celebrating its 50th anniversary, is teaming up with Crocs once again. For their sixth collaboration, the duo is launching two footwear silhouettes inspired by classic American casual outerwear: the Sukajan (souvenir jacket) and the MA-1 flight jacket.The two brands have a history of delivering unique collaborations that defy traditional footwear conventions. This time, leaning into BEAMS' identity as an apparel purveyor and its American casual roots, they have boldly translated characteristic outerwear materials and details onto the Clog. Going far beyond simple color blocking, the collection's standout feature is how it meticulously reflects the tactile textures and intricate designs typically reserved for apparel.The Sukajan-inspired Classic Crafted Clog builds on the iconic Classic Clog, featuring a soft-washed canvas upper. In addition to a finish that evokes quilted fabric, it boasts asymmetrical embroidery of traditional Japanese motifs, including a Maiko, Mount Fuji, and a map of Japan. With careful attention paid to piping and fabric texture, the design masterfully channels the vibe of a vintage souvenir jacket. Available in black, the pair retails for 15,400 JPY (including tax).The MA-1-themed Classic EXP Clog takes a rugged olive nylon base and recreates signature flight jacket details. It incorporates a cigarette pocket, zippers, and snap buttons, while the lining and heel strap pop with the MA-1's iconic rescue orange. Built on a Vibram Christy outsole developed in partnership with Vibram, this base model offers functional grip and durability. Available in olive, the pair retails for 16,500 JPY (including tax).This collaboration boldly reinterprets American casual icons while maintaining the lightweight, cushioned comfort that Crocs is known for. The lineup shines with BEAMS' signature playful spirit, effortlessly translating apparel details into statement footwear.Both items will pre-launch on Friday, November 13, at BEAMS JAPAN Shinjuku, followed by a general release on Saturday, November 14, at BEAMS locations and the official online store. Furthermore, they will be available on the Crocs official online store starting Thursday, November 19. A reception party to commemorate the release will take place on Friday, November 13, at BEAMS JAPAN Shinjuku.Launch Celebration Reception PartyVenue: BEAMS JAPAN ShinjukuAddress: 3-32-6 Shinjuku, Shinjuku City, TokyoDate: Friday, November

items.title: This Life-Size LEGO Fujifilm QuickSnap Actually Winds, Clicks and Frames Your Shot
items.text: This Life-Size LEGO Fujifilm QuickSnap Actually Winds, Clicks and Frames Your Shot Summary A fan submission on LEGO Ideas rebuilds the Fujifilm QuickSnap, known in Japan as 写ルンです, as a 1:1-scale brick modelThe proposed set pairs the camera with a full-size display box, its Japanese pixel lettering and barcode made entirely from bricksA clicking Technic wind wheel and a see-through viewfinder make the build more than a static display piece A new LEGO Ideas submission rebuilds the Fujifilm QuickSnap, the disposable film camera sold in Japan as 写ルンです (Utsurundesu), at its exact real-world size. The fan-designed project is not an official LEGO set. It’s a community proposal that pairs a working-feel camera with a brick-built recreation of its retail packaging.The camera body takes its cues from the current Fujifilm Simple ACE version of the QuickSnap. The creator recreates its green, white and red striping in bricks and smooths out the curves around the lens housing so the shell reads as one continuous form. A strap loop is built into the side of the body, and the exterior is finished without any exposed studs. That gives the model the clean plastic look of the real camera rather than the usual bumpy LEGO surface.The two interactive details are where the engineering shows. In the top-right corner, a Technic gear sits partially sunk into the body and serves as the film-advance wheel, turning with a distinct click like the real thing. The viewfinder is fully aligned and transparent all the way through. That means you can hold the model up to your eye and frame a scene, the same way you would with the original.The packaging may be the most impressive part of the build. The proposal includes a full-size QuickSnap box built mostly with SNOT (Studs Not On Top) techniques, which let the builder lay tiles sideways to create flat, printed-looking surfaces. The "写ルンです" logo is rendered as pixel-style brick lettering, and the barcode on the side is pieced together in bricks as well. Set side by side, the camera and the box form a two-piece shelf display.The creator pitches the project as more than a nostalgia piece. In the submission, they argue that the QuickSnap was an early model of closed-loop design. When used cameras were returned to photo labs, Fujifilm would take them apart, inspect the parts and reload them into new units, a cycle the creator sees mirrored in bricks that can be built and rebuilt endlessly. items.title: Sony and ‘Stranger Things’ Send The Original Walkman Headphones to the Upside Down
items.text: Sony and ‘Stranger Things’ Send The Original Walkman Headphones to the Upside Down Summary Sony and Netflix team up on a Stranger Things Edition of the MDR-3R, a modern take on the MDR-3 that debuted alongside the original WalkmanThe silver special edition draws on Max’s signature headphones and the Upside Down, adding an engraved series logo and exclusive packagingBeneath the collab details sits a lightweight open-ear build with wired USB-C connectivity, an in-line remote and a built-in microphone Sony is linking its own 1980s audio history to Hawkins’ most famous decade with the MDR-3R Stranger Things Edition, a collaboration with the hit Netflix series. The silver headphones take their cues from Max’s signature listening setup and the shadowy Upside Down. They’re built on the MDR-3R, Sony’s present-day reinterpretation of a model that first arrived as the Walkman’s companion piece.The pairing makes sense once you trace the MDR-3R back to its source. Sony launched the original MDR-3 in 1979 with the first Walkman, and together they turned music into something people carried with them. The MDR-3R keeps that slim, recognizable silhouette and updates the hardware underneath for modern devices. Placing that lineage inside the 1980s universe of Stranger Things gives the collab a real historical link rather than a borrowed one.Max is the clearest bridge between the two. Her headphones became one of the show’s defining images in Season 4, when Kate Bush’s “Running Up That Hill” playing through her Walkman became her lifeline against Vecna. Sony designed this edition around that signature style, finished the pair in silver and engraved the Stranger Things logo onto the hardware. The Upside Down theme continues into the custom packaging, so the experience starts at unboxing.Comfort is the core of the MDR-3R’s design. It inherits the featherweight approach of the original MDR-3, and Sony describes it as the lightest over-head headphones in its lineup. An open-ear structure keeps the sound balanced and the fit airy enough for wear from morning to night. The compact build is also easy to keep in a bag for daily use.Connectivity moves to a modern wired setup without trying to recreate the 1979 cable. The MDR-3R plugs into phones, tablets and laptops through USB-C, so there’s no battery to charge and no Bluetooth to pair. An in-line remote handles playback, and a built-in microphone covers hands-free calls, which suits a pair meant to be grabbed and used immediately.S

items.title: ‘Spy x Family’ Is Coming Back Twice in 2027 With Season 4 and a New Movie
items.text: ‘Spy x Family’ Is Coming Back Twice in 2027 With Season 4 and a New Movie Summary Toho has confirmed that Spy x Family will return with a fourth anime season in 2027A new theatrical film is also in development and is scheduled to open in Japanese cinemas the same yearThe first Season 4 visual reunites Loid, Yor, Anya and Bond, though dates, plot and production details are still under wraps Toho has announced that Spy x Family Season 4 is coming in 2027, along with a new feature film for theaters in Japan the same year. The Japanese studio and exhibitor marked the news with a teaser visual for the upcoming season. Both projects are adapted from Tatsuya Endo’s manga.The teaser visual is the only look at the new season so far. Loid, Yor, Anya and Bond walk side by side through a city lined with European-style architecture, while loose newspaper pages swirl through the air around them. It’s the first image from Season 4 to put the whole Forger household in a single frame. The newspapers suggest headlines and secrets are in play, which suits a family where almost everyone is hiding something.That setup is the core of the series. Loid is a top spy who goes by the code name Twilight, and he builds a fake family to complete a covert mission. Acting as a loving husband and father gets him access to an elite school, which puts him within reach of an influential politician whose actions could affect world peace. He doesn’t know his wife Yor works secretly as a skilled assassin, and she doesn’t know who he really is either. Their adopted daughter Anya, a telepath, knows both of their secrets, and their dog Bond can see glimpses of the future.Almost everything beyond the teaser is still being held back. Toho has not set release dates for either Season 4 or the film, and it hasn’t revealed story or production details for either one. The company says that information will come later. For now, the confirmed timeline is that both projects will arrive in 2027, five years after the anime first aired on television.Spy x Family Season 4 and the new film are both set for 2027, with specific release dates to be announced by Toho. Stay tuned for the trailers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: New Balance’s Made in UK Allerdale Takes Harris Tweed Out in the Rain
items.text: New Balance’s Made in UK Allerdale Takes Harris Tweed Out in the Rain Name: New Balance Made in UK Allerdale Harris Tweed Luxe LeatherColorway: Raven with ChipmunkSKU: UADWHTWMSRP: $249.99 USDRelease Date: November 20Where to Buy: New BalanceNew Balance is giving its Made in UK Allerdale a seasonal, special-edition makeover built from two of Britain’s most recognizable materials. The unisex “Raven with Chipmunk” pair combines Harris Tweed Hebrides fabric with soft black tumbled leather. The result reads as country tailoring on the surface, with proper performance tech hiding in the sole.The upper is a material story first. New Balance uses the leather as the structural backbone of the shoe and reserves the Harris Tweed for the textile panels, which carry a houndstooth check in black, tan and brown. Those three shades let the pattern sit quietly alongside the dark leather rather than fight it. The brand ties the houndstooth to Scottish weaving and traces the motif back to Scotland in the 1880s, when it became a staple of outdoor dress.Weather protection is where this Allerdale moves past pure aesthetics. A wax finish gives the upper water resistance, which matters for a shoe pairing wool cloth with leather. Hiking-inspired D-ring hardware runs up the traditional lace-up closure, adding a rugged touch while keeping the fit adjustable. An embroidered Flying NB on the saddle provides the branding in thread instead of a stitched-on overlay, which keeps the look consistent with the tweed.The sole unit takes a more modern approach. FuelCell foam is housed inside a cupsole, so the shoe keeps a classic, grounded profile while gaining the springy, energetic ride that the compound is known for in New Balance’s performance range. An Ortholite insole adds cushioning on top, and a rubber outsole handles traction below.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Jon Rahm Captures Abu Dhabi Championship in First Start Since Leaving LIV Golf
items.text: Jon Rahm Captures Abu Dhabi Championship in First Start Since Leaving LIV Golf Summary Jon Rahm won the Abu Dhabi Championship at Yas Links by two shots over Tyrrell Hatton in his first start since leaving LIV GolfThe victory marks Rahm's 11th DP World Tour title and a record sixth Rolex Series championshipThe Spaniard vaulted to sixth in the Race to Dubai standings ahead of the season-ending DP World Tour Championship Spaniard Jon Rahm delivered a back-nine surge to capture the Abu Dhabi Championship on the DP World Tour, claiming his first victory since departing LIV Golf. In his debut start at Yas Links GC, the two-time major champion finished at 23-under-par to edge out Tyrrell Hatton by two strokes, securing his 11th DP World Tour crown and a record sixth Rolex Series title.“It means a lot,” Rahm said. “Still almost not letting myself believe it. It's been quite a while since I've played good in a DP World Tour event. And in my last showing, if you don't count the withdrawals, I think I finished last. So, from last to first is a pretty good feeling.” Breaking away from a four-way tie heading into the turn, Rahm separated himself with a decisive approach on the 15th: “That 6-iron [on 15] is a contender for shot of the year for me.”The victory moved Rahm from No. 51 to No. 6 in the Race to Dubai rankings heading into next week's DP World Tour Championship, while third-place finisher Rory McIlroy rose to No. 2 behind leader Eugenio Chacarra. “I really didn't think I was going to have a chance,” Rahm said of the season title. “Those are better odds than I expected, so [I'm] looking forward to it, and hopefully I can get my fourth one.”"THAT IS RIDICULOUS" 🤯Jon Rahm puts his 184-yard approach at the 15th to 2ft to set up another birdie and maintain a two shot lead 👏#AbuDhabiChamps | #RolexSeries https://t.co/W2qBdMiQ5l— DP World Tour (@DPWorldTour) November 8, 2026 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Epic Games Launcher Officially Coming to SteamOS
items.text: Epic Games Launcher Officially Coming to SteamOS Summary Epic Games confirmed its rebuilt Linux launcher will officially support SteamOS and the Steam DeckThe preview phase focuses on broad Linux distribution support and evaluating packaging formatsFortnite remains unplayable on the handheld due to ongoing anti-cheat compatibility hurdles Epic Games officially expanded its storefront onto new hardware, confirming that the preview version of its new Linux-based Epic Games Launcher will support SteamOS and the Steam Deck. Rebuilt from the ground up for speed, the updated platform brings Epic’s massive library directly into Valve’s highly popular handheld ecosystem. The new launcher currently sits in a preview phase, with the early build already available for download across Windows, macOS and Linux computers. Epic Games Communications Director Jake Jones confirmed the upcoming SteamOS compatibility during a recent statement provided to GamingOnLinux.This rollout follows an initial October announcement that did not explicitly list SteamOS as a supported distribution. Now, Epic Games plans to support as many Linux distributions as possible, explicitly naming Fedora, SteamOS, Cachy and Omarchy. To execute this broad release, the company is actively testing and evaluating various packaging formats for the Linux distribution. While the current Linux download is exclusively offered as a Debian/Ubuntu .deb file, Epic Games plans to formally restore the AppImage download format for the launcher later this month.However, bringing the launcher to Valve's hardware does not instantly unlock the developer's biggest cultural juggernaut. While Epic Games stated in October that it was investigating making Fortnite compatible with Valve’s Linux-based SteamOS, the launcher's newly confirmed compatibility with the operating system does not guarantee that the game will actually come to the platform. The title requires Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC) Linux v2 support, a security layer that is not currently fully functional on the Steam Deck.This unresolved technical roadblock leaves Fortnite unplayable on the device, maintaining a notable gap in the handheld's gaming library. Epic Games explicitly stated that the Steam Deck does not support the required features needed for its strict EAC v2 solution. Despite this immediate limitation, the studio is actively talking with Valve about the underlying architecture and hopes to successfully support the anti-cheat solution on the platform in the

items.text: Apple Says More Than 100,000 iPhone Duo-Optimized Apps Are Now Live on the App Store Summary Apple reveals the App Store now hosts over 100,000 applications built and optimized for the highly coveted iPhone DuoThousands of new titles are hitting the platform daily, fixing the wasted screen space and hidden menus found in unoptimized softwareHeavy consumer demand for the $1,999 device continues to push shipping estimates into 2027 amid ongoing supply constraints Apple officially announced that well over 100,000 apps built for the iPhone Duo are now live on the App Store. Thousands of new iPhone Duo-optimized apps are being added to the storefront every single day. This rapid ecosystem push effectively rewrites the narrative from the hardware’s initial launch window, where early reviews criticized the device for a glaring lack of optimized software. Consumers who managed to secure the new form factor were previously forced to navigate standard apps running with a wasted black bar on the side of the screen, or deal with user interfaces that would sometimes hide important functions under an overflow menu. Now, Apple is flooding the market with tailored experiences, matching the unexpectedly high consumer demand for the dual-screen flagship.The 100,000-app milestone announcement deliberately coincided with the release of over a dozen new Duo-ready applications. This newly available optimized roster hits everything from productivity to lifestyle, including heavyweights like Microsoft Word, Microsoft Outlook and Zoom, alongside cultural and creative staples like Etsy, LTK, Goodnotes, Extra and the Halide Mark III camera app. Sports fans are getting in on the action as well, with the NBA and NHL both releasing updated sports apps specifically optimized for the new device. These fresh arrivals join a solid foundation of iPhone Duo-optimized apps that were already available to early adopters, including massive platforms like Netflix, YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp.The software momentum extends deep into the iOS 27 ecosystem, with dozens of other major apps receiving critical updates tailored for the foldable. items.text: Kaptain Sunshine and COVERCHORD Cut a Cashmere-Linen Uniform in All Black Summary COVERCHORD returns to Kaptain Sunshine for an exclusive two-piece set built entirely from cashmere-linenA new “FIELD JACKET” layers leather onto its collar and inside its sleeves, then backs the body with flannelThe matching “SHOECUT WIDE EASY PANTS” relax COVERCHORD’s exclusive easy pant into a looser, wider leg, and both pieces arrive in black only Kaptain Sunshine and COVERCHORD are teaming up again on an exclusive set made up of a new “FIELD JACKET” and “SHOECUT WIDE EASY PANTS,” both cut from cashmere-linen. Each piece was developed as a fresh pattern for the Japanese select shop. Both build on the cropped jacket and easy trouser that proved popular in the pair’s earlier collaborative runs.The fabric does most of the talking here. By pairing cashmere with linen, the set brings a softer hand and a drier, textured surface to shapes that have previously appeared in other cloths. Keeping the run to a single colorway puts the focus on that material. In solid black, the jacket and pants read as one deliberate outfit.The “FIELD JACKET” retains the shorter, cropped body that sold well for the shop in past exclusives, while gaining a set of upgrades on the inside and at the edges. Leather covers the collar and lines the sleeves, adding structure where the jacket rubs most and helping it slide over knitwear. A flannel lining fills out the rest of the interior, giving the cashmere-linen shell extra warmth and a brushed feel against the body.The “SHOECUT WIDE EASY PANTS” take a different approach to updating a proven shape. Kaptain Sunshine kept the easy-wearing build of COVERCHORD’s original exclusive trouser and opened the leg into a relaxed, wide silhouette. The result is a looser counterpart to the cropped jacket, so the two pieces work as a matching set or slot separately into an existing wardrobe.The Kaptain Sunshine x COVERCHORD collection releases November 14 at COVERCHORD Nakameguro, COVERCHORD Fukuoka and the COVERCHORD online store. items.text: JD Rejects the Old For Something New In 2026 Christmas Ad JD’s annual Christmas ad has landed, and as expected, the sportswear retailer has rounded up its international family of creatives, DJs, singers and athletes to celebrate the moment with a fresh perspective.Encompassing the collective’s aspirational outlook, the campaign explores the holidays as a time for new possibilities and opportunities. Through the message “Create the New,” it rejects typical festive traditions and sees the talent turning to their own practices to put a personal twist on the season. In the visuals, CHRIS STASSY, Sammy Virji, and other breakthrough DJs join singer-songwriter Skye Newman to blend their signature sounds and create a new track. Channelling the spirit of collaboration, athlete Lauren James unites with custom football garment designer Antonia Bronze for a new piece that weaves their individual passions together. The stories play out through one overarching narrative that captures the next generation and their ability to carve out their futures, tying into JD’s longstanding ethos “Forever Forward.” Alongside the British cast, the retailer also calls on European talent such as footballer Ferran Torres, mixed martial artist Ilia Topuria, musicians Emelia Mernes, Ele A, and more. Reflecting on the campaign, Managing Director at JD, Paul Orange, said: “JD has always been shaped by the communities at the heart of sport, music and style. With ‘Create the New’, we’re celebrating a generation that is making its own opportunities and taking culture forward.”“Christmas is a moment to come together, and we want this campaign to capture the energy and ambition of young people who are already thinking about what comes next. It’s that attitude that drives ‘Forever Forward’ and our commitment to giving the next generation a platform.” Explore the 2026 Christmas ad in the galleries above. Construction starts up front with a molded rubber toe cap, which sits over a lugged welted outsole for grip, while a rubber rand runs above the welt to add toughness where boots take the most abuse. Uppers mix suede and leather, and the details are pure Tyler, from custom woven round laces and a le FLEUR* lace jewel clipped to the bottom eyelet to a co-branded sockliner inside. That means the same wide toe box, extra-large eyelet rows, thick laces and an embossed star stamped into the toe cap. The Tendril colorway sets lavender overlays against a gray suede base, while Quarry builds on olive suede and finishes with a sky-blue Star Chevron. The shape traces back to 1976, when the original Pro Leather moved Converse basketball from canvas to a full-grain leather upper on a cupsole and became the first of its leather hoops shoes to wear the Star Chevron.The Jogger completes the lineup in two tonal makeups, High Risk Red and Golden Haze, each dyed top to bottom in one hue. Shaggy, vintage-style suede overlays wrap the toe, eyestay and heel, contrasting with sleek nylon panels underneath. items.text: G-SHOCK Turned Singapore’s IMBA Theatre Into a Walk-Through of the New 2500 Summary The brand marked the arrival of the GMC-2500 and GAC-2500 with an evening of light, movement and fashion. G-SHOCK took over Singapore's IMBA Theatre on November 7 to launch the GMC-2500 and GAC-2500, two watches sporting fully analog faces that are built on the DNA of the iconic DW-5000C.Staged under the theme "Toughness, Refined," the night was presented as a journey through a series of zones. It opened with a history wall tracing the 2500's lineage from the DW-5000C through the DW-6900, GA-100 and GA-2100. Next came The Awakening, a darkened space anchored by a centerpiece of hanging metal mesh lit in teal, inspired by the work of Japanese artist YOSHIROTTEN. Introspective questions placed around it asked guests what toughness means to them.The main event unfolded in The Discovery zone, where guests gathered around a giant kinetic sculpture of the watch's bezel and raised date disc for a four-part dance performance, charting G-SHOCK's journey from raw toughness to something more refined. Towering projections then opened up the 2500 to reveal the components hidden inside its case, before the space turned into a runway styled around the modern urbanite who inspired the watch.Back in The Awakening zone, guests could try the collection on the wrist and add their own answer to "What does toughness mean to you?" to a growing community installation. For Tomoaki Nakamura, General Manager of Casio Southeast Asia's Timepieces Division, that hands-on approach was the point. "The keyword is 'interactive,'" he said. "To realize that immersive experience, after our research we judged that Singapore was the best place." Tomohiro Yuasa, product planner at Casio's Hamura R&D Center, added that Southeast Asia has long been known internally as home to some of G-SHOCK's most passionate fans: "We come into today hoping this launch will excite them even more."From Digital Icon to Analog FaceThe DW-5000C was the watch that started it all, a digital square built around the idea of a watch that wouldn't break when dropped. The new 2500 series translates that functional beauty into a clean analog layout. It's also a first for G-SHOCK's Basic series, which has never had a fully analog model at its price point."The general view in the watch world is that a fully analog watch is the basic standard, whereas we started out in digital," Yuasa explained. items.title: Dr. Dre Announces Hiatus to Go "Off the Grid" After 41 Years in Music
items.text: Dr. Dre Announces Hiatus to Go "Off the Grid" After 41 Years in Music Summary Dr Dre plans to take his first career hiatus and go off the grid for a year or two after 41 years in the studioSpeaking on Ice Cube and Mike Epps' Listen & Laugh podcast the producer stated he will step away after finishing two projectsDre explained that the break will allow him to pursue another creative passion outside of music production Hip-hop icon Dr. Dre has revealed plans to step away from music and go “off the grid for a year or two” after 41 years in the studio. Speaking on the premiere episode of Ice Cube and Mike Epps’ Listen & Laugh podcast, the producer and artist explained that he will take an extended hiatus following the completion of two in-progress projects, including one alongside Houston rapper Marqus Clae.“For the first time in my adult career, I’m going to take a break from that,” Dre stated. “I’m going to go away, and I’m going to get off the grid for a year or two.” Explaining that production constantly consumes his thoughts, Dre noted, “You never leave it. Even when you’re not there,” adding that the break is meant to open creative room: “For the first time in my life, it won’t be there. It’s taking up space for something else. What if there’s something else waiting for me that could give me the same exact feeling when I discovered music?”The seven-time Grammy winner and Rock & Roll Hall of Famer boasts four decades of shaping hip-hop, from N.W.A. and The Chronic to generating catalog hits for Snoop Dogg, Eminem, and Kendrick Lamar. Elsewhere in the episode, Dre crowned Larry Smith the “f**king best hip-hop producer ever” and admitted he is “extremely excited” about AI's integration into music.Take a listen to what Dr. Dre had to say in the podcast episode above. items.title: BACARDÍ and Shy FX Rewind Back to the Noughties at London Party
items.text: BACARDÍ and Shy FX Rewind Back to the Noughties at London Party Last month, BACARDÍ resurrected the ‘00s at a special party in London. Throwing it back to an era of free-spirited parties and overstated style, the iconic rum brand teamed up with legendary drum and bass producer Shy FX to bring the distinct energy back for one night. The party was set at The Cross in London’s central King’s Cross area. Once a popular music hub in the ‘00s, the venue, which still welcomes party-goers today, was transformed with nostalgic details, such as stacked televisions, flyers plastered on walls, and a bar serving BACARDÍ and Coke, a drink that’s still a dancefloor favourite today. A dress-to-impress code was also firmly on the menu. With the resurgence of Y2K styles, guests delved deep into their wardrobes to put together a mix of suave and playfully sporty looks, not shy of including a few diamante-encrusted accessories. All suited up, they enjoyed a headline set by Shy FX, who pulled out his classic ‘00s tracks “Shake Ur Body” and “Feelings” with MC Rage on the mic. “That whole era was such a special time for music,” shared Shy FX with Hypebeast. “You had drum and bass, garage, grime, dubstep, all these different sounds coming through and influencing each other. Pirate radio and record shops were a big part of the culture, and you’d go out and hear tunes you couldn’t hear anywhere else.” Reflecting on his own career during the time, the producer added, “The ‘00s were when I really started pushing things further. That whole period was about experimenting, trying out new sounds and seeing where I could take the music. I never wanted to be stuck doing just one thing.”Bringing this diverse array of sounds to the event, Shy FX invited D Double E to perform as a surprise special guest. As an artist who was seminal to the rise of British grime, he tapped into his vast portfolio of hits on the night while dressed in his own ‘00s uniform. “Having D Double E and Rage on the night was great. Bringing some of those '00s sounds back at The Cross with BACARDÍ was a lot of fun, especially seeing how well they still go down today. The music and culture from back then still mean a lot to people, and it's definitely helped shape the way I approach what I do now,” said Shy FX.If you missed out, take a look back at the takeover above. items.title: The Yangwang U9 Xtreme Hits 312.66 MPH in Abu Dhabi to Set a New Production Car Speed Record
items.text: The Yangwang U9 Xtreme Hits 312.66 MPH in Abu Dhabi to Set a New Production Car Speed Record Summary The Yangwang U9 Xtreme hit 312.66 mph on a prepared public road in Abu Dhabi to break the 500 km/h barrierThe quad-motor electric supercar utilized 2,978 hp to secure two Guinness World Records and official F.I.A. recognitionLimited to just 30 units globally, the $2.76 million USD vehicle cements the engineering might of Chinese EVs on the global stage The Yangwang U9 Xtreme registered a top speed of 312.66 mph (503.17 km/h). With veteran sports-car and endurance racer Marc Basseng at the wheel, the supercar became the first production vehicle to surpass the 500 km/h threshold. The historic run took place in Abu Dhabi on a closed 6.21-mile stretch of the Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed International Road (E11) in the Al Dhafra region. Crews cleaned and prepared the public highway specifically for the high-stakes sprint. By taking the run to a public road, parent company BYD sought to prove that its vehicle possesses capabilities extending outside the confines of a race track.A quad-motor powertrain architecture powers the vehicle, placing a distinct e-motor at each wheel. Together, the electric setup produces 2,978 hp (3,019 PS) and 2,478 ft-lbs of torque. The performance prompted BYD executive vice president Stella Li to note in a press release that the brand's engineers are "young, bold and maybe a little crazy." As the luxury brand of BYD, the world's largest manufacturer of new-energy vehicles, Yangwang developed the Yangwang U9 Xtreme as the world's fastest car to showcase the technical capabilities of Chinese electric vehicles.This Abu Dhabi performance followed the automaker's previous record run. The speed of 312.66 mph broke the vehicle's former record of 308.34 mph (496.22 km/h). Basseng set that earlier mark 13 months prior at the ATP Automotive Testing Papenburg facility in Germany. Official recognition came from the Fédération Internationale de l’Automobile (F.I.A.), the governing body of world motorsports. The single-direction run also earned two Guinness World Records: "Highest Speed achieved by a Production Car in a single-direction run" and "Highest Speed achieved by an Electric Production Car in a single-direction run."Production of the Yangwang U9 Xtreme is limited to 30 units worldwide. items.title: Razer’s New Hammerhead V3 Chroma Brings Dual-Driver Audio and RGB Lighting to Wired Gaming Earbuds
items.text: Razer’s New Hammerhead V3 Chroma Brings Dual-Driver Audio and RGB Lighting to Wired Gaming Earbuds Summary Razer launches the wired USB-C Hammerhead V3 Chroma gaming earbuds with zero latencyDual-driver audio system features an 11mm dynamic driver, a 6mm tweeter and active noise cancellationAvailable now for $79.99 USD, featuring signature RGB lighting and an ergonomic flush connector Wired audio is experiencing a general market resurgence, and Razer is stepping in to ensure the gaming segment is represented in this trend. The brand officially unveiled the Razer Hammerhead V3 Chroma, a pair of wired gaming earbuds built for modern digital devices. A standard USB-C plug connects the headset directly to hardware, eliminating latency to ensure game audio does not lag behind on-screen action.Beneath a sleek exterior built for all-day comfort, the Razer Hammerhead V3 Chroma packs a dual-driver audio system. An 11mm dynamic driver delivers low-end impact, while a dedicated 6mm tweeter provides crisp, articulate highs. The earbuds also feature active noise cancellation (ANC) to block out environmental distractions during gaming sessions. An in-line remote lets users manage audio playback and toggle the noise cancellation on or off. Signature RGB lighting completes the design, maintaining the brand's visual style.Mobile gaming ergonomics heavily influenced the hardware, resulting in a specialized USB-C connector. The plug sits flush against connected devices, preventing the cable from interfering with a user's natural palm rest. However, this physical wire carries a compatibility trade-off, as the protruding cable may prevent some mobile gaming controllers from fitting around a phone.The Razer Hammerhead V3 Chroma is available now for $79.99 USD. While this price tag is higher than standard EarPods, it offers a cheaper entry point compared to Razer's wireless lineup. For comparison, the cordless Hammerhead V3 HyperSpeed carries a $130 USD MSRP. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Sony Refreshes the PlayStation Portal for Japan With Added Internal Storage and a New Name
items.text: Sony Refreshes the PlayStation Portal for Japan With Added Internal Storage and a New Name Summary Sony announced an updated, Japan-exclusive PlayStation Portal launching in midnight black on December 10thThe new device drops the word “Remote” from its name and adds internal storageThe region-locked hardware requires Japanese language settings and a Japan-registered PlayStation account Sony announced a region-locked hardware refresh for its handheld gaming lineup. Arriving exclusively for the Japanese market, the updated PlayStation Portal launches on December 10th. The device features a midnight black color option and costs 39,980 yen, which equals approximately $253 USD. Importing the device for international use carries strict operational barriers. The handheld operates with Japanese language options only. Users must also operate the system using a PlayStation account registered in Japan, keeping the release exclusive to its domestic market.The original PlayStation Portal operates strictly as a tethered companion piece designed to stream PS5 games from a console or the cloud. The handheld lacks the hardware power required to play games locally. Beyond gaming, the current model does not support media streaming applications like YouTube, Disney Plus or Netflix. Even with the upcoming internal upgrades, the new model lacks an OLED screen, keeping the display standard identical to the original release.Sony renamed this specific version of the device, changing the title from "PlayStation Portal Remote Player" to "PlayStation Portal Player." Inside the midnight black shell, the new model includes internal storage absent from the original hardware. The company kept the exact purpose of the upgrade undisclosed, stating that the extra storage capacity remains reserved for unannounced future functionality. Representatives noted that complete details will follow once development concludes.The removal of the word "Remote" from the official title, combined with the addition of internal storage, indicates a change in product utility. This specific hardware update implies that Sony plans to equip the device for native media streaming applications or offline media playback. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Christopher Nolan’s ‘Interstellar’ Ranger Is Touching Down as an Official LEGO Set
items.text: Christopher Nolan’s ‘Interstellar’ Ranger Is Touching Down as an Official LEGO Set Summary LEGO Ideas has approved a fan-designed Ranger spacecraft from Christopher Nolan’s 'Interstellar,' marking the film’s first official LEGO setThe 561-piece preliminary build recreates Cooper and Dr. Brand’s trip to Miller’s planet, complete with both robot companionsLEGO has yet to lock in the final design, so the details below reflect the fan prototype that earned approval LEGO has greenlit Minibrick41587’s Interstellar Ranger through its LEGO Ideas program, turning a fan-built model of the film’s landing craft into the first official set tied to Christopher Nolan’s 2014 space epic. The build centers on the moment Cooper (Matthew McConaughey) and Dr. Amelia Brand (Anne Hathaway) touch down on Miller’s planet, and while LEGO has not finalized the design, the approved prototype already shows how much detail the fan designer packed into a compact ship.At 561 pieces, the prototype Ranger is built to be opened up and explored rather than just parked on a shelf. Its cabin is decorated throughout and fits two minifigures, with room left over for either TARS or CASE to ride along. The roof comes away completely to expose the interior, and a hinged rear hatch swings open for loading the crew in from behind.The figure lineup covers the core landing party, pairing Cooper and Dr. Brand minifigures with brick-built versions of the film’s slab-shaped robots, TARS and CASE. Rounding out the package is a set of accessories meant to equip the astronauts for surveying both livable and dangerous planets, giving the display a ready-made story beyond the ship itself.Any of those specs could still shift before the set reaches shelves, since LEGO’s own designers rework every approved Ideas model ahead of production. Minibrick41587 first uploaded the Ranger on December 11, 2024, and it moved into formal review in May 2026 after crossing 10,000 supporters.Stay tuned for the official LEGO set. The headline item is a Leather Bomber made with AVIREX, joined by the Mesh Leon Shirt in three colorways, the reversible Deon Shirt and the Jersey Nelson Zip Hoodie. A handcrafted commemorative bobblehead sits alongside the clothing, and the two-time champion appears in the campaign imagery himself.Jackets carry the most weight across the wider collection, and the materials list reads like a cold-weather checklist. A second AVIREX collaboration takes the form of a vintage-style aviator with a shearling collar and artwork by Michael Doret, while the Wool Varsity Bomber Jacket is covered edge to edge in embroidery. The Shearling Bomber is cut from genuine lambskin, and the NYC Basketball Moto Jacket pays tribute to Madison Square Garden and the Knicks’ role as Kith’s home team.Beyond outerwear, the Herringbone Suit Set pairs a double-breasted blazer with pleated trousers for a sharper courtside look. A multi-panel tracksuit, graphic tees in long and short sleeves, and Kith’s core fleece shapes (the Nelson Crewneck, Braxton Hoodie and Nelson Hoodie) fill out the everyday side, each finished with co-branded graphics made only for this season.Accessories cover a wide spread, starting with headwear developed alongside ‘47 and moving through premium silk ties, cushioned cotton socks, beanies and skullies. items.title: JJJJound Turns Danner’s Mountain Light Boot Into a Sidewalk Staple
items.text: JJJJound Turns Danner’s Mountain Light Boot Into a Sidewalk Staple Name: Danner x JJJJound Mountain LightColorway: Black, GraySKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: November 12Where to Buy: JJJJoundDanner and JJJJound have returned to the Mountain Light for their third collaboration, reworking the classic hiking boot around a one-piece upper and a city-first outlook. Where the duo’s earlier projects leaned into Danner’s trail heritage, this round holds on to the boot’s hefty outdoor proportions while tuning its materials and finishing for daily wear on pavement.The upper carries most of the story, with both versions cut from one continuous piece rather than stitched together from panels. The black pair uses full-grain leather sourced from Horween, giving the boot a smoother, dressier finish that sits comfortably next to tailoring. Its counterpart swaps in charcoal nubuck with a worn-in, distressed surface, trading polish for texture and a looser, more casual attitude.Underneath, the build stays true to Danner’s workwear-grade playbook. Each pair uses the label’s stitchdown construction, in which the upper is flared outward and stitched directly to the midsole for a wider, more stable platform. A Vibram Sierra outsole with XS Trek rubber handles grip, a breathable GORE-TEX liner keeps water out, and a custom Ortholite footbed adds cushioning for long days on foot. Both boots are also recraftable, so they can be rebuilt instead of replaced once the soles wear down.The finishing details keep things quiet and tonal across both colorways. Black laces thread through silver metal eyelets, while a custom JJJJound woven label sits on each tongue in a matching shade rather than a contrasting one. Both pairs are union made in the USA.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Dallas Mavericks Name New Balance Official Footwear and Apparel Partner
items.text: Dallas Mavericks Name New Balance Official Footwear and Apparel Partner Summary The Dallas Mavericks have announced a multi-year agreement naming New Balance as the franchise's Official Footwear and Apparel PartnerThe partnership bridges in-arena activations co-branded merchandise and community initiatives anchored by Mavericks forward Cooper FlaggNew Balance kicked off the partnership with a two-day fan activation outside the arena on November 8 and 9 The Dallas Mavericks have officially announced a multi-year partnership with New Balance, designating the Boston-based sportswear brand as the Official Footwear and Apparel Partner of the NBA franchise. The alliance unites two entities focused on expanding the sport's cultural reach, establishing new avenues to engage fans through collaborative merchandise, community initiatives, and in-arena experiences across the basketball calendar.Representing a significant step in the ongoing expansion of New Balance Basketball, the partnership strategically strengthens the label's footprint in Dallas. The synergy is anchored in part by New Balance signature athlete and Mavericks forward Cooper Flagg, providing a direct bridge between the brand's performance roster and the North Texas franchise. “We’re excited to welcome New Balance to the Mavericks family,” said Dallas Mavericks President Ethan Casson. “As one of the most innovative and respected brands in sports, New Balance brings a tremendous opportunity to build on its relationship with Cooper, while creating unique experiences for our fans and making a meaningful impact throughout the North Texas community.”“Dallas has an incredible basketball culture, and our relationship with the Mavericks gives us an exciting opportunity to become more connected to that community,” said Naveen Lokesh, Global Director of Sports Marketing, American Football and Basketball at New Balance. “With Cooper beginning his career here, there’s a natural connection for New Balance to show up alongside him and create meaningful experiences for Mavericks fans.”To inaugurate the multi-year partnership, New Balance hoste a dedicated two-day fan activation outside the arena on November 8 and 9 ahead of consecutive Mavericks home games, offering interactive games, giveaways, and experiential programming. items.text: Selfridges Drops 50-Plus ‘GTA VI’ Exclusives Inside a Pink Vice City Pop-Up Summary Rockstar Games and Selfridges bring Vice City to London’s Oxford Street ahead of the launch of 'Grand Theft Auto VI'The Corner Shop installation includes a full-size, working Grotti Cheetah replica and a 10-foot Macca the Gator from the in-game series Macca & FriendsMore than 50 exclusive pieces span apparel, accessories, collectibles and partner items, alongside the game’s limited-edition Collector’s Box Rockstar Games and Selfridges have launched Vice City at Selfridges, a takeover of the department store’s Oxford Street Corner Shop celebrating Grand Theft Auto VI. The pop-up opens 10 days before the game’s release and recreates the Miami-inspired setting of GTA VI in real life. It’s a limited run, so fans have less than three weeks to visit.The takeover starts outside the store. The flagship’s facade glows in Vice City’s signature pink and shifts colors as day turns to night. An extended animated sequence of GTA VI artwork and motion graphics plays across the storefront, turning Oxford Street into a version of Leonida.Inside, the Corner Shop is set up like a scene from the game. The centerpiece is a full-size, fully functional replica of the Grotti Cheetah supercar. It sits next to a 10-foot (3.05m) Macca the Gator, the mascot of Leonida’s fictional TV hit Macca & Friends. Behind both, an Art Deco–inspired set draws on Vice City’s architecture and is filled with GTA VI merchandise.The Selfridges-only items are where collectors will want to look first. The Vice City Manatees appear on a Starter jacket, sweatshirt and sweatpants, and the Vice City Narcos get a matching jersey and shorts. There’s also a Goodtime State varsity jacket and a GTA VI basketball. In-game brands show up as accessories, including a leather Burger Shot takeaway bag and a Grotti keychain. Silk scarves come in Logo, Gator and Palm prints, and beach towels come in blue and pink.The partner pieces bring outside brands into Leonida. Winmau provides a GTA VI dartboard set, Members Only offers a GTA VI version of its jacket, and Hedley & Bennett makes a Burger Shot apron. Dad caps, an “I Heart VC” tee and a cigar ashtray are among the many other items on the shelves.For collectors, the most notable item may be the game itself. items.title: BEAMS’ “Expedition Club” Hauls Rare Down Parkas and Archival Catalogs Into Pitti Uomo 111
items.text: BEAMS’ “Expedition Club” Hauls Rare Down Parkas and Archival Catalogs Into Pitti Uomo 111 Summary BEAMS is bringing its “Expedition Club” exhibition to Pitti Uomo 111 at Florence’s Fortezza da Basso this JanuaryThe show pulls rare vintage down parkas from the personal collection of BEAMS PLUS Chief Buyer Shigeru Kaneko, which numbers more than 100 outerwear piecesHistoric outdoor catalogs from Utah State University’s Outdoor Recreation Archive, rarely shown to the public, round out the display BEAMS is taking its traveling “Expedition Club” exhibition to Pitti Uomo 111, setting up at Florence’s Fortezza da Basso with a focused edit of vintage down parkas from BEAMS PLUS Chief Buyer Shigeru Kaneko’s personal archive. The installation builds on “Outdoor Expedition Book 99,” the ninth volume in the label’s “I Am Beams” book series, and turns its pages into a physical, walk-through study of outdoor apparel.Kaneko’s own wardrobe forms the backbone of the show, with the exhibition drawing a tight selection of down parkas from a collection that now tops 100 vintage outerwear pieces. Down is the through line here, and the edit leans on the rare, hard-to-find jackets Kaneko has spent years tracking down, studying and reworking into new ideas for the BEAMS PLUS line.The garments share the floor with a second archive that rarely leaves its home institution. Historic outdoor catalogs from the Outdoor Recreation Archive at Utah State University will be on view, giving visitors the printed record that sat alongside this gear in its original era, and a rare chance to see material that isn’t typically put out for public viewing.Florence marks the latest stop on a run that has already passed through New York, Tokyo and London. For BEAMS PLUS, the menswear line BEAMS launched in 1999 with a firm grounding in classic Americana, the project doubles as a statement of method: Pitti frames the show as proof that digging through archives and old research can still feed new design thinking in menswear.“Expedition Club” will be on view at the Fortezza da Basso in Florence during Pitti Uomo 111, which runs from January 12 to 15, 2027. items.title: Converse Dresses the First String Jack Purcell in “Bleached Mauve” and “Brown” Nubuck
items.text: Converse Dresses the First String Jack Purcell in “Bleached Mauve” and “Brown” Nubuck Name: Converse First String Jack Purcell NubuckColorway: Bleached Mauve/Snow White, Brown/Snow WhiteSKU: A24760C,A24758CMSRP: $315 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: Converse, Various RetailersConverse is giving the First String Jack Purcell a seasonal material update, swapping the silhouette’s familiar canvas for premium nubuck in “Bleached Mauve” and “Brown.”The Jack Purcell was first designed in the 1930s with Canadian badminton champion Jack Purcell, and Converse calls it the first signature racket shoe. The release sits within First String, Converse’s premium line that revisits archival models with better materials, more careful construction and added comfort.The First String version keeps that heritage while upgrading almost every part: a retooled rubber toe cap and midsole foxing tape, beveled metal hardware, and a Comfort Pack sockliner that combines CX foam with Nike Ambient Air cushioning on a roomier last. The accompanying campaign puts the shoe back in a sporting setting, with 17-year-old French tennis player Moïse Kouamé posing on a blue court and in empty stadium seats.The nubuck has a soft, brushed nap that catches the light unevenly, giving both colorways a slightly mottled, lived-in depth rather than a flat finish. “Bleached Mauve” is a dusty, faded pink, and “Brown” is a warm camel tan, both stitched with tonal thread along the eyestay and quarters. Each pair sits on a thick cream rubber midsole with a matching cream toe cap that carries the model’s signature “smile” inlay. Antique silver eyelets, cream flat laces with dark aglets and a cream interior lining finish the soft, neutral look. Branding stays restrained in true Jack Purcell style: there’s no oversized logo on the upper, just a small heel tag and the toe cap’s smile as the most recognizable mark.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Watch the Surreal New Trailer for Madhouse’s Original Anime Film ‘ghost - end of night’
items.text: Watch the Surreal New Trailer for Madhouse’s Original Anime Film ‘ghost - end of night’ Summary Bandai Namco and Madhouse dropped the main trailer for Shingo Natsume's film 'ghost - end of night.'The February 2027 release adds veteran voice actors like Kenjiro Tsuda to the cast.Japanese alternative-rock band, hitsujibungaku supplies six songs for the film, including the theme song, "life." Bandai Namco Filmworks and Madhouse have officially released the main trailer for ghost - end of night, the highly anticipated original anime film from Shingo Natsume -- the director behind Sonny Boy as well as the iconic season one of One Punch Man.The film features original character designs by Natsume Ono and explores the emotional subtleties of a young girl named Neekei living in a society where human labor is no longer necessary. Throughout the story, her path crosses with Masu, a man carrying deep loss, and the two loners form a bond that is neither friendship nor family, building toward a decision no one sees coming.The trailer arrives alongside the announcement of three heavyweight voice cast members - Kenjiro Tsuda as Moby Dick, Hiroki Yasumoto as Karate, and Hiroshi Kamiya as Ito - who join the previously announced lead actors Mayu Hotta (Neekei) and Issei Takahashi (Masu). Music is a also key part of the film. Alt-rock band hitsujibungaku, known for the Jujutsu Kaisen ending theme “more than words,” has written six original songs for the film, including the theme song “life.”Watch the official trailer above. ghost - end of night is scheduled for a Japanese theatrical release on February 11, 2027. items.title: See How Three Creatives Are Styling Burna Boy and On’s New Collab
items.text: See How Three Creatives Are Styling Burna Boy and On’s New Collab The latest chapter of Burna Boy and On’s partnership is taking a closer look at the people behind the artist's global success. Titled “No Giant Stands Alone,” it brings his family and band members front and center through portraits and an intimate video to mark the launch of his new limited-edition On silhouettes.In celebration of the chapter, Hypebeast now connects with three multi-faceted tastemakers from our own creative network. Spotlighting Melissa Bon, Kodjo Kuakumensah, and Koffi Wanji, they each wear the Cloudmonster BB “Sienna” from the new drop. We shoot their looks from the ground up, drawing inspiration from Burna Boy’s Twice as Tall album cover to capture their unique street style. Keep reading the round-up below to see how the collective brings out their inner giant with the bold sneakers. Melissa BonStanding tall has never been a problem for Melissa Bon. After spending years touring as a jazz vocalist, she turned to modelling and then fashion design to craft trousers that suit her tall body proportions. “I’ve enjoyed fashion since I was a kid,” she tells Hypebeast. “Now I’ve got this whole ecosystem of styling, designing trousers, and sometimes I go back to music to stay inspired.”On a typical day making inclusive garments, Bon sports baggy trousers from her own label, paired with a red sweater to match the deep jewel tone of Cloudmonster BB. “I'll always have a large pant or an exaggerated shoulder-pad jacket because I like a strong silhouette, especially if it looks like the figure of eight.”Kodjo KuakumensahKodjo Kuakumensah’s connection with Burna Boy goes back years. As the only artist he’s paid to see with his own money, wearing his new collab on foot proves to be a big deal. Kuakumensah curates a classic outfit that “balances casual and refined, but layers colors and textures.”“I constantly align my styling with the aesthetic of my work,” the set designer and concept artist explains. “My guiding principle is always to inject a deliberate touch of color.” From his studio to nights out, he’ll bring color to the dancefloor with the On sneakers as he enjoys his favorite hit “Kilometre.” Koffi Wanji“I come from an artistic background. I love music, and I'm first and foremost a dancer,” says Koffi Wanji. items.title: thisisneverthat and Danner’s Cascade Range Packs Trail-Grade Armor Into a Low-Top
items.text: thisisneverthat and Danner’s Cascade Range Packs Trail-Grade Armor Into a Low-Top Name: thisisneverthat x Danner “Cascade Range”Colorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: November 13Where to Buy: thisisneverthatthisisneverthat and Danner have joined forces on the Cascade Range, a low-cut hiker that borrows its design language and secure fit from the brand’s iconic Danner Light boot. Reworked through the Seoul-based label’s lens, the collaboration trades the original’s high shaft for a lighter, more agile profile tuned for daily wear without giving up the trail-ready hardware underneath.The upper pairs two materials chosen for very different jobs. Brown suede brings warmth and a classic outdoor texture across the overlays, while panels of CORDURA 1000D nylon add abrasion resistance in the zones that take the most punishment. Together they give the Cascade Range a rugged, two-tone build that nods directly to the Danner Light while sitting closer to the ground.Weather protection is handled from the inside out. Danner equips the shoe with DANNER DRY, the brand’s own waterproof and breathable membrane, designed to keep rain and puddles out while still letting moisture escape. Down below, a Vibram outsole supplies the traction, giving the low-top the kind of confident grip that holds up on slick pavement and rougher terrain alike.Collaboration details stay focused and functional. A heat-applied label on the tongue marks the pairing, serving as the clearest signature of the project without cluttering the upper. Each pair also ships with two lace options in contrasting looks, so the shoe can lean toward a cleaner city setup or a more outdoorsy finish depending on how it is styled.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops.View this post on InstagramA post shared by Danner JP (@danner_jp) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Rockstar Confirms GTA VI Will Run at 30 FPS on Current-Gen Consoles Ahead of Its November 19 Launch
items.text: Rockstar Confirms GTA VI Will Run at 30 FPS on Current-Gen Consoles Ahead of Its November 19 Launch Summary Rockstar Games opens console pre-loads and drops a new trailer ahead of the highly anticipated November 19 launchThe title targets 30 fps while pushing hardware limits to render the dense, visually unmatched world of LeonidaA landmark 10-year partnership brings day-one Xbox Cloud Gaming support and signals a major ecosystem expansion Rockstar Games officially released a new trailer and opened servers to make Grand Theft Auto 6 available for pre-load on the Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5. The title is scheduled to go live on November 19. Both Xbox and PlayStation announced that the upcoming open-world title is officially the most pre-ordered game ever on their respective digital storefronts.Rockstar announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 targets a baseline performance of 30 frames per second. The studio stated that pushing current-generation platforms to their absolute limits maintains the density and visual fidelity of its setting, Leonida. Official blog posts from Rockstar made no mention of potential 40 fps or 60 fps support for the PlayStation 5 Pro. However, the upgraded hardware still offers exclusive graphical advantages. On the PlayStation 5 Pro, the title supports Sony's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution upscaling technology. The PlayStation 5 Pro stands as the only console capable of running the game with advanced ray-traced shadows.Beyond graphical horsepower, Rockstar stated that the game features improved load times on Sony's console. The PlayStation 5 version includes integrated high-fidelity haptic feedback for DualSense controllers. To complement tactile upgrades, the experience includes spatial audio designed to utilize Tempest 3D Audio on PlayStation 5.While Sony secures exclusive hardware features, Microsoft offers streaming capabilities. Grand Theft Auto 6 includes baseline remote play support for PlayStation and Xbox, while also launching on Xbox Cloud Gaming directly on consoles including the previous-generation Xbox One. Rockstar noted that cloud streaming graphics are limited to Xbox Series S settings. This cloud access allows players on older hardware to join the release at launch without upgrading their consoles.Xbox CEO Asha Sharma posted on X that the launch marks the first step in a new 10-year strategic partnership with Rockstar parent company Take-Two. items.title: Formula 1 Confirms the 2026 Season Will End in Qatar and Abu Dhabi
items.text: Formula 1 Confirms the 2026 Season Will End in Qatar and Abu Dhabi Summary Formula One pushes ahead with Qatar and Abu Dhabi for the 2026 season finaleImola officially stood down as a back-up venue despite regional conflict concernsFIA president commits to delivering two outstanding Grands Prix to close the year Formula 1 is locking in its scheduled Middle East races to close out the 2026 season, officially standing down its back-up contingency plans. The Italian circuit of Imola, located just 20 miles from Bologna, had been actively lined up to replace Abu Dhabi as the final host venue amid major concerns over the ongoing conflict in the region. The Qatar race is slated to take place on November 29, leading directly into the Abu Dhabi round that will decisively wrap up the championship calendar on December 6.The decision to proceed with the Middle East finale follows severe disruptions earlier in the year, which forced organizers to restructure the calendar. As the outbreak of war triggered widespread alarm earlier in the year, Formula One canceled its scheduled April rounds in both Bahrain and Saudi Arabia. Organizers relocated the canceled Bahrain event to Malaysia, where it took place in September 2026. Management's renewed confidence in finishing the season as originally planned stems directly from the geopolitical situation having somewhat stabilized in recent months, though trackside safety remains heavily scrutinized by all involved parties.The delicate balance of committing to the region while maintaining a hard line on security was the central focus of a high-level meeting between key stakeholders that took place on November 10. During this session, Formula One teams sought out specific details and assurances regarding contingency plans in the event that an escalation occurs during the actual race weeks. Despite the elevated stakes, no Formula One teams have expressed an unwillingness to travel to the Middle East for the final two races. Instead, the teams have consistently expressed confidence in the sport and the governing body, the FIA, trusting leadership to make the right decision over exactly where to end the season safely.Even with the grid fully on board to travel, safety remains the undisputed leading concern. Formula One chiefs remain completely prepared to pull the events should a regional escalation happen in the coming weeks. items.title: Nicolas Cage Revealed He Felt Relieved Over 'Spider-Noir' Cancelation at Prime Video
items.text: Nicolas Cage Revealed He Felt Relieved Over 'Spider-Noir' Cancelation at Prime Video Summary Nicolas Cage revealed he felt relieved when Prime Video canceled 'Spider-Noir' after a single seasonThe actor stated that one season of portraying the idiosyncratic Ben Reilly was perfect to avoid wearing out his welcomeDespite pulling 2.6 billion viewing minutes and five Emmy wins the series ended following tensions surrounding an AI waiver Hollywood actor Nicolas Cage has revealed he felt relieved following Prime Video's decision to cancel Spider-Noir after only one season. Speaking in an interview with IGN, the National Treasure star praised the solitary run of the live-action comic adaptation as "perfect" and emphasized that he had no interest in wearing out his welcome by continuously reprising the idiosyncratic character of private investigator Ben Reilly.“It’s a perfect season. You never wanna get stuck repeating a character and wear out your welcome,” Cage explained. “Ben Riley is so idiosyncratic. I was doing something that was pretty high-risk, tightrope stuff — if you do that for Season 2, Season 3, you could really wear out your welcome. So when they didn’t pick it up, I was like, ‘Whew, thank you!’ Because now I’m doing True Detective, and that’s only one season. It’s better that way, you know? I didn’t wanna keep repeating it. I don’t like repeating myself.”Despite drawing 2.6 billion viewing minutes within its opening six weeks and earning five Emmy wins across 11 nominations, the series came to an abrupt close. The cancellation also followed friction surrounding artificial intelligence, with Cage revealing at New York Comic Con that he refused to sign an AI waiver for the production. Looking forward, Cage is slated to star alongside Antonio Banderas in the upcoming fifth season of HBO's True Detective and will appear in the John Madden biographical film Madden. items.title: Jordan 4 Retro TD “Bred” Takes MJ’s ‘89 Classic From Hardwood to Turf
items.text: Jordan 4 Retro TD “Bred” Takes MJ’s ‘89 Classic From Hardwood to Turf Name: Jordan 4 Retro TD "Bred"Colorway: Black/Cement Grey/White/Fire RedSKU: HQ0207-001MSRP: $205 USDRelease Date: November 27Where to Buy: SNKRSThe Jordan 4 Retro TD “Bred” moves Michael Jordan’s 1989 game shoe onto the football field, translating one of the most celebrated sneakers in the Jumpman catalog into a fully functional cleat. Dressed in Black, Cement Grey, White and Fire Red, the pair revives one of the AJ4’s first colorways while swapping its basketball outsole for a stud plate made for the gridiron.Few colorways carry the weight of the “Bred” 4. The black-and-red scheme was among the looks that launched the silhouette in 1989, and it has since become one of the most coveted versions of the shoe. It also has a place in playoff history, as Jordan wore the pair when he hit “The Shot” over Craig Ehlo to eliminate the Cleveland Cavaliers that same year. Bringing that colorway to football gives the cleat instant recognition before it ever touches the field.Up top, the cleat stays remarkably faithful to the original. The upper blends genuine and synthetic leather for structure and durability, with breathable textile zones working alongside the shoe’s classic detailing. A high collar and traditional lacing complete the silhouette, so from the ankle up the TD reads unmistakably as a 4, a design originally penned by Tinker Hatfield.The real transformation happens below the midsole. Jordan Brand pairs a foam midsole with Air Zoom cushioning, which is designed to deliver a springy, responsive feel each time the foot leaves the ground. Beneath it, a plate of wide molded studs bites into both turf and natural grass, giving players the grip needed for sharp lateral changes of direction and sudden bursts downfield.What results is a cleat that serves two audiences at once. Players get a performance tool built around traction and responsiveness, while collectors get one of the AJ4’s most storied colorways reworked for an entirely new arena, a reminder of how far the Jumpman legacy now extends beyond the hardwood.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Altra Rewrites Its Running DNA for the City With the Ease
items.text: Altra Rewrites Its Running DNA for the City With the Ease Name: Altra EaseColorway: Black, White, GreySKU: TBCMSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: November 11Where to Buy: AltraAltra is stepping beyond running with the Ease, a brand-new sneaker silhouette that the brand calls its first lifestyle shoe after 15 years of making foot-shaped footwear for runners. Instead of designing for one setting, Altra’s design team built the Ease around the commute: the walk to the station, the bike ride across town, the coffee stop on the way to the office, the trip from the gym to dinner. The idea is that city life rarely stops; it just changes speed. “So instead of designing for a destination, we designed Ease around that constant state of transition. It’s footwear designed for the journey itself,” the team explained in an exclusive statement.The design centers on a translucent TPU exoskeleton that wraps around the shoe and gradually fades into a soft, collapsible mesh upper, leaving the supportive structure visible. From the side, the effect looks almost anatomical, like a see-through view of the foot inside. The cage holds the foot securely and carries Altra’s DNA into the vamp, where five lines run across the toe area as a nod to the natural toe splay at the heart of the brand.The rest of the shoe is built for easy, all-day wear: a plush collar with the soft give of a wetsuit, a design that’s simple to slip on, and the lowest stack height Altra has offered. Underfoot, the team kept things minimal, with refined lug geometry and clean detailing on a rubber outsole tuned for grip on city pavement. The Ease comes in three colorways: Black, White and Grey.To test the shoe in a real setting, Altra gave early pairs to Brooklyn photographer Dev Moore, who wore them across Lower Manhattan on foot and by bike for the lifestyle campaign. For Moore, the appeal is how easily the shoe fits into a full day of movement without looking out of place. “These have that balance: a sporty look that’s easy to style, with the added comfort to keep me in motion,” he said. items.title: Nike Book 2 "Be Legendary" Honors Kobe Bryant in Signature Purple
items.text: Nike Book 2 "Be Legendary" Honors Kobe Bryant in Signature Purple Summary Nike and Devin Booker are releasing the Book 2 in a purple Be Legendary colorway honoring Kobe BryantThe silhouette features light purple tumbled leather dark purple ripstop and a black patent leather SwooshThe pair is expected to release on November 20 in men's sizing for 145 USD via Nike and select retailers Name: Nike Book 2 "Be Legendary"Colorway: Bright Violet/Black-Wolf GreySKU: FZ7013-501MSRP: $145 USDRelease Date: November 20, 2026Where to Buy: NikeNike and Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker are set to release the Nike Book 2 “Be Legendary,” porting one of Booker’s most meaningful Kobe Bryant-inspired aesthetics over to his second signature silhouette. The forthcoming colorway translates a career-defining personal tribute into a general release ahead of the winter basketball season.The design lineage traces back to 2016 during Bryant's final NBA campaign, when the late legend gifted Booker a signed pair of Kobe 11s inscribed with the handwritten phrase “Be Legendary.” Booker previously channeled the commemorative purple palette onto a Kobe 4 PE during the 2021 NBA Finals, followed by an exclusive Book 1 PE. Now transitioning to the Book 2, the low-top features lighter purple tumbled leather across the lower mudguard and overlays, contrasted by durable dark purple ripstop on the upper panels. A glossy black patent leather Swoosh cuts across the lateral side, balanced by purple laces, a matching tongue, and a textured interior sockliner.While the retail edition omits the literal “Be Legendary” inscription, signature franchise motifs remain intact, featuring Booker branding on the tongue and “Chapter Two” typography running down the vertical heel pull tab. A grey speckled midsole cushions the ride underneath, capped off with an icy translucent rubber outsole.The Nike Book 2 “Be Legendary” is expected to release November 20, 2026.
