items.title: JR Turns Bangkok’s Cloud 11 Into a 2,500-Portrait Monument With “Thailand Creative Archive”
items.text: JR Turns Bangkok’s Cloud 11 Into a 2,500-Portrait Monument With “Thailand Creative Archive” Summary JR’s global Inside Out Project lands at Cloud 11 with “Thailand Creative Archive,” its biggest presentation yet in Southeast AsiaMore than 2,500 members of Thailand’s creative community were photographed for the installation over five monthsPortraits take over the building’s main façade, its Level 2 exhibition room and the surrounding retail floors Cloud 11 is unveiling “Thailand Creative Archive,” a sprawling art installation that brings French artist JR’s Inside Out Project to Thailand at its largest scale in Southeast Asia to date. The work gathers the portraits of more than 2,500 people from across the country’s creative sector, from headline names to the crews and specialists whose work usually goes uncredited, and spreads them across the entire Cloud 11 complex.The numbers behind the project set the tone. Between May and September 2026, a mobile Inside Out Photobooth truck traveled to capture its subjects, logging more than 2,500 portraits drawn from 11 professional groups. The roster covers music, art, film, software, gaming and animation, advertising, design, architecture, fashion, culinary arts, and crafts and handicrafts, with a final category reserved for other creative roles.Scale is the point once those faces go up. The installation is staged both outdoors and throughout the building, with portraits covering Cloud 11’s main façade, filling the primary exhibition room on Level 2 and threading through the retail area. The format follows the Inside Out signature of oversized black-and-white portraiture, turning everyday shoppers and passersby into an audience for the people who power Thailand’s creative output.The lineup deliberately mixes the visible with the invisible. Performers and artists share wall space with photographers, designers and production staff, putting equal weight on every contributor rather than spotlighting a handful of stars. Cloud 11 Chief Executive Officer Paul Sirisant framed the choice of collaborator in a statement: “The way JR tells stories through people’s faces felt right for a project about the people Cloud 11 was built for.”The Thai edition plugs into a participatory platform that JR founded so communities worldwide could share their identities and causes through large-scale portraits. items.title: The Nike Moon Shoe OG Suede Reshapes a ’70s Runner for Modern Comfort
items.text: The Nike Moon Shoe OG Suede Reshapes a ’70s Runner for Modern Comfort Name: Nike Moon Shoe OG Suede “Sanddrift,” Nike Moon Shoe OG Suede “Baroque Brown”Colorway: Sanddrift/Pale Ivory/Gum Light Brown/White, Baroque Brown/Tar/Gum Dark Brown/SailSKU: IU5934-100, IU5934-201MSRP: ¥15,730 JPY (approx. $100 USD)Release Date: Available nowWhere to Buy: Nike JapanNike is giving the women’s Moon Shoe OG Suede a quiet but meaningful update, refining the fit of its heritage runner while holding onto the vintage profile that defines it. The new pair keeps the low, slim lines of the original ’70s design, then layers in plush suede, a smoother interior and a reshaped last aimed squarely at all-day comfort.The biggest change is one you feel before you see it. Nike has redrawn the overall shape of the Moon Shoe to sit more comfortably on foot, a notable adjustment for a silhouette rooted in early running design. From the outside, the proportions still read as unmistakably retro, so the update lives mostly in how the shoe wears rather than how it looks.Materials do much of the heavy lifting up top. The upper combines nylon with soft suede, a pairing that keeps weight down while adding durability and a richer texture across the overlays. Inside, a smooth lining gives the shoe a more premium step-in feel, and a foam insole adds a layer of underfoot comfort. Nike has also swapped in a new material for the heel tab, a small refinement that sharpens the rear of the shoe.Underfoot, the rubber Waffle outsole anchors the design in its running heritage. Its gridded lug pattern provides traction on pavement while serving as the Moon Shoe’s most recognizable visual signature, tying the update back to the brand’s earliest track-ready designs.The two colorways lean into warm, natural tones. The Sanddrift version combines a light sandy upper with Pale Ivory and White accents over a light gum outsole, while the Baroque Brown take goes deeper with Tar and Sail details set against a dark gum sole. Both palettes play well with the shoe’s vintage character and slot easily into cold-weather rotations.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: ScHoolboy Q and Malbon Golf Release Collaborative Apparel Collection
items.text: ScHoolboy Q and Malbon Golf Release Collaborative Apparel Collection Summary The South Central Los Angeles rapper shapes a personal capsule featuring handwritten graphics and bespoke woven details Lifestyle imprint Malbon and Grammy-nominated hip-hop artist ScHoolboy Q have officially teamed up to release a collaborative golf apparel collection. Widely known as Quincey Hanley, the South Central Los Angeles rapper who helped define a generation of West Coast hip-hop has steadily brought his personal passion for the sport to the forefront. Having recently played in the AT&T Pro-Am, the artist is now channeling his transformative experiences on the green into a dedicated physical capsule.For Hanley, the traditional golf landscape was never supposed to be his world. However, at a time when he needed a new creative outlet the most, the game became a sanctuary to clear his head, compete, and see himself from a new perspective. Finding meaning and peace far beyond the traditional scorecard, the sport ultimately became an integral part of how he moves through life and navigates his career. In a statement, Hanley said, "They have no idea how the game opened up my mind. I was in a dark place, and golf got me inspired again"For Hanley, the traditional golf landscape was never supposed to be his world. However, at a time when he needed a new creative outlet the most, the game became a sanctuary to clear his head, compete, and see himself from a new perspective. items.text: The Doctor Doom Statue Bucket Lets Latveria’s Ruler Guard Your Popcorn Summary The Doctor Doom Statue Bucket turns the Marvel villain’s armored bust into a display-ready popcorn vesselThe collectible is sold as part of The Bundle of Doom alongside one ticket to see Avengers: Doomsday in theatersThe piece lands as the latest entry in Fandango’s growing lineup of film-themed collector buckets Doctor Doom is coming home in sculpted form with the Doctor Doom Statue Bucket, a collectible offered through The Bundle of Doom ahead of Avengers: Doomsday. items.title: LeBron James, Kevin Durant, and More Are Launching the Futures Basketball League for Top Under-18 Talent
items.text: LeBron James, Kevin Durant, and More Are Launching the Futures Basketball League for Top Under-18 Talent Summary LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Paolo Banchero and Derrick Rose are investing in the new Futures Basketball LeagueThe under-18 circuit aims to consolidate fragmented youth basketball while offering cash and equity NIL compensationThe inaugural 10-weekend season tips off in April 2027 and will be broadcast on national television The youth basketball landscape is bracing for a massive structural shift backed by some of the most influential figures in the sport. Organizers announced the Futures Basketball League (FBL) in a Tuesday press release as a premium under-18 circuit aiming to consolidate top-tier talent. This ownership group features a heavyweight roster of NBA icons, with LeBron James and Kevin Durant leading the charge alongside Paolo Banchero and Derrick Rose. These athletes are moving strategically through established business channels to fund the venture. James is steering his investment alongside Maverick Carter through LRMR Ventures, while Durant is maneuvering alongside Rich Kleiman via Boardroom Sports Holdings.Targeting a launch in 2027, the Futures Basketball League will host 120 under-18 athletes competing across a tightly curated 12-team setup. The inaugural season is scheduled to span 10 weekends from April to August, delivering high-stakes weekend tournaments that will be streamed or distributed on national television. By centralizing the talent pool, the league intends to establish a streamlined development path and comprehensive Name, Image and Likeness (NIL) framework for elite prospects who were previously scattered across hundreds of fragmented grassroots teams and disparate events.Compensation is the primary engine driving this new ecosystem. Youth players suiting up in the FBL will be eligible to receive direct NIL compensation in the form of cash or, notably, equity in the league itself, though the equity proposal remains subject to pending administrative approvals. Securing talent is already well underway, with top prospects from the 2028 through 2031 recruiting classes actively signing NIL contracts with the league. items.title: The Rick Owens x adidas Springblade Collection Runs on a Full-Length Bed of Blades
items.text: The Rick Owens x adidas Springblade Collection Runs on a Full-Length Bed of Blades Name: Rick Owens x adidas Springblade Runner, Rick Owens x adidas Springblade BootColorway: Core Black/Core Black/Light Brown, Core Black/Core Black/Light Brown, Light Brown/Light Brown/Core BlackSKU: KJ3110, KJ5663, KJ3122MSRP: $590 USD, $850 USDRelease Date: November 17Where to Buy: adidas CONFIRMED App, adidas, Rick OwensThe Rick Owens x adidas Springblade collection marks the first major step in bringing back adidas’ blade-cushioned performance model from the 2010s, with Owens among the earliest collaborators to put his stamp on its return. The capsule spans three pairs in total, built from a pair of low-top runners and a dramatic matching boot, all sitting on the Springblade’s signature row of individual cushioning blades.Everything about the collection starts with the sole. Rather than a conventional foam midsole, the Springblade relies on a series of separate, angled blade elements that run the full length of the shoe from heel to toe, giving each pair its instantly recognizable profile and a visibly segmented footprint. Owens leaves that tooling untouched in principle, letting the oversized sole serve as the visual and functional anchor of all three designs.The runners keep the upper deliberately restrained so the blades can do the talking. A streamlined mesh base forms the core of the build, reinforced by leather overlays that add structure through the midfoot and toe. Extra-large adidas branding stretches across the lateral and medial sides, giving the low-top a bold graphic presence despite its pared-back construction.Color blocking is where the two runners split. One pair leads with Light Brown and the other with Core Black, and each flips the placement of those two shades across the upper, the Three Stripes and the tooling itself. The result is a mirrored duo that reads as a matched set, a fitting move for a designer whose work so often lives in a tight, earthy palette.The boot pushes the silhouette into far more theatrical territory. Its shaft rises well above the ankle in a gathered textile construction, trading the runner’s taut mesh for a softer, bunched upper with a distinctly Owens-coded drape. items.title: Step Inside teamLab's Otherworldly Biovortex Museum in Kyoto
items.text: Step Inside teamLab's Otherworldly Biovortex Museum in Kyoto Summary teamLab's largest museum in Japan features expansive installations that explore the relationship between physical space, digital technology and the natural world.The collective's 25-year artistic evolution is further explored in the new book teamLab: Everything Exists in Infinite Continuity, featuring insights from founder Toshiyuki Inoko. Japanese art collective teamLab continues to push the boundaries of immersive art with Biovortex Kyoto, its largest museum in Japan. Located near Kyoto Station, the permanent museum spans more than 10,000 square meters and features over 50 artworks that explore the relationship between human perception, physical space and the natural world.Built around the concept of "Universe of Existence, Universe of Perception," the museum invites visitors to reconsider how objects, environments and even their own bodies exist in relation to one another. Through an interplay of light, sound, movement and digital technology, teamLab transforms conventional exhibition spaces into expansive, ever-changing worlds where the boundaries between artwork and viewer begin to dissolve.Among the museum's highlights is Massless Amorphous Sculpture, an installation composed of floating, cloud-like forms that continuously emerge, shift and disappear. Meanwhile, Morphing Continuum presents a seemingly weightless sculpture in a perpetual state of transformation, challenging the distinction between material and immaterial forms. Elsewhere, *Megaliths* brings together monumental structures and flowing digital imagery to create an environment that appears to extend beyond its physical dimensions.Beyond its large-scale installations, Biovortex Kyoto incorporates teamLab's Athletics Forest, a multi-dimensional environment that encourages visitors to navigate space through physical movement, alongside Future Park, an interactive project centered on collective creativity. Together, these experiences reflect the collective's ongoing interest in dissolving the separation between the human body, art and the surrounding environment.Situated in a city celebrated for its historic temples, gardens and traditional craftsmanship, the museum introduces another dimension to Kyoto's cultural landscape. items.title: CART X Makes History at Retromobile's First New York Edition
items.text: CART X Makes History at Retromobile's First New York Edition Summary Retromobile celebrates its 50th anniversary with its first US edition at New York City's Javits Center from November 19–22.CART Department debuts CART X, featuring art cars and works by Keith Haring, Ai Weiwei, Damien Hirst, Jeff Koons and more.CART X partners with Public School New York on custom uniforms and exclusive merchandise, bridging automotive culture, art and fashion. A new chapter in automotive and cultural history is unfolding in New York City as Retromobile, the renowned French collector car salon, makes its American debut after five decades in Paris. Taking place at the Javits Center from November 19 to 22, 2026, the landmark event will also mark the launch of CART X, a new global platform by CART Department exploring the intersection of automobiles, art, fashion, music and popular culture.Founded in Paris in 1976, Retromobile has grown from a gathering of automotive enthusiasts and collectors into one of the world's leading celebrations of automotive heritage. Now marking its 50th anniversary, the renowned salon expands beyond France for the first time, bringing its legacy of rare and historic vehicles to New York City.Founded by art collector Larry Warsh, CART Department marks a major milestone with the debut of CART X, a new global platform exploring the automobile as both an artistic canvas and cultural artifact. The presentation features art cars and works by Keith Haring, Ai Weiwei, Jeff Koons, Shepard Fairey, Damien Hirst, Zaha Hadid, Barbara Kruger, Daniel Arsham, Esther Mahlangu, Olafur Eliasson, Richard Prince and Kenny Scharf. Highlights include the customized Maybach from JAY-Z and Ye's 2011 "Otis" music video, bridging automotive culture with hip-hop history.They’re canvases for art. CART X explores how cars are appreciated in a broader lifestyle context and absorbed into popular culture."“Vehicles have become more than transportation, status symbols, or engineering marvels,” said Warsh, who has spent more than three decades collecting art and assembled over 70 one-of-a-kind art cars. “They’re canvases for art. CART X explores how cars are appreciated in a broader lifestyle context and absorbed into popular culture.”The exhibition also extends into fashion through an exclusive collaboration with New York-based label Public School. items.text: Sorel Pushes Its Icons Forward With the “Age of Discovery” Collection On the eve of its 65th anniversary year, Sorel is heading into Fall/Winter 2026 with its “Age of Discovery” collection, a lineup that merges the brand’s heritage with new innovation. At its center are three new men’s styles: the Callsign Enigma GTX sneaker, the Daystorm Horizon Zip GTX boot and the Caribou Horizon Zip GTX boot. Each one pairs arctic-grade performance with a sharper, street-ready attitude.The Callsign Enigma GTX blends street style with outdoor grit. A waterproof GORE-TEX® textile upper is finished with a leather mudguard and a gusseted rubberized zip shroud. Speed laces with a cord-lock and SOREL-branded aglets handle the closure, and reflective SOREL branding runs along both quarters. Underfoot, a lightweight molded LIVELYFOAM midsole and a removable Ortholite footbed sit on a Vibram XS TREK EVO outsole. The sneaker comes in “Black/Black,” “Tawny Buff/Black” and “Deep Woods/Bleached Ceramic.”Built to stand firm in the storm, the Daystorm Horizon Zip GTX, in a “Black/Tawny Buff” colorway, combines full-grain leather with patented GORE-TEX® fully waterproof construction. A removable zip shroud lets wearers switch up the look, while a molded rubber midsole and Vibram XS TREK EVO outsole bring the traction.Rounding out the trio, the Caribou Horizon Zip GTX reimagines one of Sorel’s most legendary silhouettes for today. A suede and full-grain leather upper sits atop an injected rubber shell and features a removable zip shroud, a custom zipper and military lacing. Inside, 200 grams of insulation and a removable O-THERM Ortholite footbed with a felt top cloth keep things warm. A Vibram XS TREK EVO outsole anchors it all, complete in a “Tawny Buff/Black” colorway.Take a closer look at the collection above. The Callsign Enigma GTX retails for $225 USD, the Daystorm Horizon Zip GTX for $280 USD and the Caribou Horizon Zip GTX for $400 USD. The “Age of Discovery” collection is now available to shop via Sorel's official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Lids Brings Realtree Camo to Its Holiday Gift Lineup
items.text: Lids Brings Realtree Camo to Its Holiday Gift Lineup Holiday gifting rarely goes to plan. Between last-minute runs and the dreaded “it’s the thought that counts” reaction, finding something that actually lands can feel like a sport of its own. This holiday season, Lids is making the case for a trip to the mall with the upcoming in-store release of its New Era Realtree collection.The collection adds two new fabrics to the Lids assortment, the New Era Realtree Excape and New Era Pink Realtree, and puts them on classic fitted and A-Frame silhouettes. The result is a fresh take on traditional camouflage that keeps team identity front and center, with styles spanning MLB, NFL, NBA and NHL teams.Leading the lineup is the 59FIFTY New Era Realtree Excape. It works tonal team-color details into the print with metallic thread, so logos blend naturally into the camo while still giving a subtle point of contrast. The New Era Excape 9FORTY A-Frame comes in two distinct colorways. The New Era Chrome/Realtree version pairs a classic palette with a mix of throwback and alternate team logos. The second is built on a brown crown, a nod to the color’s recent run of popularity that sits naturally alongside the New Era Realtree pattern.For something brighter, the New Era Pink Realtree brings the new fabric to the classic New Era 59FIFTY fitted. It also carries over to the New Era 9FORTY A-Frame, where the pattern meets team branding for a fashion-forward take on fan headwear.Beyond the collection, Lids is giving shoppers the opportunity to make their holiday gifts even more personal with in-store customization, from custom embroidery and patches to pins and more. Style, team and product selection vary by market, so not every team or silhouette is offered at every location. Lids’ New Era Realtree collection is available in store beginning November 10. Find your local Lids today through their official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Robert Pattinson Is Officially the Next James Bond
items.text: Robert Pattinson Is Officially the Next James Bond Summary Robert Pattinson has been officially cast as the next James Bond following months of intense industry speculationThe actor will take over the legendary 007 mantle from Daniel Craig under the direction of Denis VilleneuvePattinson adds the iconic super spy to a dominant 2026 acting resume that includes multiple massive box office successes Robert Pattinson has officially been cast as the next James Bond. Ending months of rabid industry speculation, Amazon MGM has handed the keys to the Aston Martin to the highly in-demand Batman and Odyssey star, marking the beginning of a new era for the legendary 007 film franchise.Pattinson will pick up the 007 mantle following Daniel Craig’s five-movie run as the super spy, which concluded with 2021’s No Time to Die. The highly anticipated casting decision comes after Amazon MGM acquired creative control of the franchise from longtime producers Michael G. Wilson and Barbara Broccoli for $20 million USD. Denis Villeneuve, who previously directed Pattinson in the upcoming Dune: Part Three, was officially tapped to helm the next installment of the Bond series in June 2025. The casting marks a defining moment for Amazon MGM Studios as it looks to carry the six-decade legacy of the franchise forward. Mike Hopkins, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, cited Pattinson's remarkable range, magnetic screen presence, and quiet intensity as the driving forces behind his selection. Director Denis Villeneuve echoed this sentiment, adding that Pattinson possesses the timeless soul of 007 while bringing an entirely new spirit to the super spy.“James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honor of a lifetime,” Pattinson said in a statement. “I’m deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team.”The casting decision cements Pattinson's current status as a dominant box-office force. In 2026 alone, he drove A24's The Drama to a $134 million USD worldwide gross, found global success with Primetime, and starred in the $1.8 billion USD hit The Odyssey. Having already proven his franchise-leading capabilities as Bruce Wayne in Matt Reeves' The Batman, Pattinson is now primed for a new long-term relationship with another hi

items.title: How Did A Secretlab Chair End Up in Every Room That Matters?
items.text: How Did A Secretlab Chair End Up in Every Room That Matters? Once you notice it, you can't stop noticing it. It's behind Magnus Carlsen as he dismantles an opponent from home. It's under Hans Zimmer while he builds the low, seismic dread of Dune. It's the seat Keith Gill — Roaring Kitty to the internet — chose to sit on, in its Game of Thrones House Lannister trim, as he faced the US House Financial Services Committee. Jose Mourinho plots in one; Kevin De Bruyne recovers in one; Post Malone, Marshmello, iShowSpeed and Max Verstappen have all shown up in the same tall-backed silhouette.A quick search for "gaming chair" pulls up dozens of near-identical products, which is exactly what makes the real question interesting. It isn't why gaming chairs are having a moment, but more of why this one keeps appearing in rooms that have nothing to do with each other.  View this post on Instagram A post shared by Verstappen Sim Racing (@verstappensimracing)To find out, I flew to Singapore, where Secretlab was founded in 2014 by two former StarCraft II semi-pros, Ian Ang and Alaric Choo. They were training in chairs they couldn't stand, so they decided to build their own.The problem they were solving was specific and punishing. Competitive players can stay seated for up to 16 hours in a single training day. They swing between locked-in concentration and short breaks, and a chair built for that has to stay supportive through all of it, day after day. That spec made the chair a fixture at major esports tournaments, where pros compete for multi-million-dollar prize pools, and in the backgrounds of streamers broadcasting to millions from their bedrooms. Before most people knew the name, they'd already seen the silhouette.The logic that followed was simple: a chair that could keep up with a pro player could keep up with anyone who spends serious time sitting down. The pandemic put that to the test at scale. When work, school and much of social life moved home, millions of people suddenly found themselves at a desk all day and started paying attention to how they felt at the end of it. Plenty of them went looking for the chair that people who never get up were already sitting on. Today, a Secretlab sits in the homes of more than three million people worldwide.That explains how the chair got into all those rooms, but it doesn't explain why it stayed long after the rush to furnish home offices faded, or why an Academy Award-winning composer, a chess grandmaster a

items.title: Supreme and Dickies Reunite for an Extensive Fall 2026 Collection
items.text: Supreme and Dickies Reunite for an Extensive Fall 2026 Collection Summary Supreme and Dickies have officially unveiled a new collaborative apparel collection designed for the Fall 2026 seasonThe extensive lineup includes durable workwear essentials like leather hooded work jackets and flannel-lined double knee painter pantsThe highly anticipated collection releases globally on November 19 with a subsequent launch in Asia on November 21 Supreme and Dickies have reunited to officially unveil their new collaborative Fall 2026 Collection. Merging the New York streetwear institution's bold aesthetic with the heritage workwear brand's longstanding commitment to rugged durability, the upcoming release delivers a robust selection of heavy-duty cold-weather staples and completely reimagined apparel classics.Leading the Fall 2026 assortment is a range of premium outerwear engineered to combat the dropping temperatures. The collection is highlighted by the Supreme x Dickies Leather Hooded Work Jacket, which elevates a traditional utilitarian silhouette, alongside the heavy-duty Flannel Lined Hooded Work Jacket. For versatile layering options, the extensive lineup also features a Quilted Lined Hooded Flannel Zip Up Shirt and a Quilted Zip Up Hooded Sweatshirt, ensuring substantial warmth and functional wearability throughout the harsher months.Rounding out the apparel selection, the collaboration introduces a co-branded Thermal top designed for foundational layering. The collection also reimagines classic legwear with the highly durable Flannel Lined Double Knee Painter Pant, merging heavy-duty construction with modern streetwear sensibility. To seamlessly complete the seasonal offering, the duo has produced a collaborative Script Beanie. The entire capsule perfectly blends dependable utility with distinct co-branding elements, celebrating the enduring legacy of both brands while outfitting the modern wardrobe.The Supreme x Dickies Fall 2026 releases on November 19, via the official Supreme webstore and flagship locations, with an Asia release following shortly after on November 21. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and moseyec Pack Their First Collaboration in a Custom Spray Can
items.text: WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and moseyec Pack Their First Collaboration in a Custom Spray Can Summary WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and moseyec collaborate on an all-black SHIFT FRAME GLASS.The release officially reveals Japanese rapper Vingo as moseyec’s founder.Each customizable pair is packaged in a unique spray can. WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto and Tokyo-based eyewear brand moseyec are taking on the SHIFT FRAME GLASS for their first-ever collaboration. The collaboration arrives alongside a major announcement for moseyec, which has officially unveiled Japanese rapper Vingo as the creative mastermind behind its operations.Centering around moseyec’s signature “SHIFT FRAME GLASS”, and channeling Yohji Yamamoto’s signature design language, every single component of the collaborative eyewear has been painted to ensure an all-black palette. The frames feature a unique structural design that allows the wearer to detach the temples and swap out components for different visual expressions. Each pair is equipped with UV400 lenses, offering 99.9% UV protection.Beyond the frames themselves, the premium presentation also extends to the packaging. Instead of the traditional luxury eyewear boxes, the sunglasses are housed in a custom spray can-shaped case. The canister not only serves as protection for the shades, but also operates as a nod to Vingo’s roots in street culture and the urban landscape of Tokyo. The limited-edition kit is rounded out by a co-branded cleaning cloth and box.The WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto x moseyec SHIFT FRAME GLASS is available for ¥44,000 JPY (approx. $400 USD), and will first release in Japan on November 20 at WILDSIDE Yohji Yamamoto Shibuya Parco. It'll become available online soon after, via WILDSIDE’s website and select physical locations on November 21. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike and One Block Down Elevate an Icon With the Air Max 95 Lux “Italy”
items.text: Nike and One Block Down Elevate an Icon With the Air Max 95 Lux “Italy” Summary One Block Down and Nike unveil the Air Max 95 LUX "Italy" and matching apparel.The premium leather sneakers feature Black, Red, Green, and White colorways.Releases start November 13 at OBD, with a November 19 global launch. One Block Down and Nike have officially unveiled their latest collaboration: the Air Max 95 LUX “Italy”, alongside a football-inspired apparel capsule. Centered on the rich cultural intersections of Italian footwear craftsmanship and the 1990s golden era of Nike Football, the collaboration serves as a contemporary evolution of the original Made-in-Italy Air Max 95 LUX from 2001.Rather than reproducing the original 2001 model, One Block Down opted to elevate the silhouette by introducing a newly sculpted, padded upper that honors the original sneaker while feeling contemporary. Constructed with premium Italian leather chosen for its distinct character, the footwear is available in four distinct colorways: a Black edition pays tribute to the original 2001 release, while Red, White, and Green editions serve as a nod to the Italian tricolor. The latter three feature digitally printed gradients that were developed and applied directly in Italy.Accompanying the sneakers is a technical apparel capsule collection inspired by Nike Football’s heritage. The collection includes a jersey, jacket, trousers, and two skull caps that reinterpret the iconic Nike Football Dorito identity and Total 90 branding rather than simply reproducing them. As a nod to One Block Down’s founding year and its ethos to “give everything from day one,” the Total 90 symbol is flipped to read “09”. Additional tributes to the Italian flag are woven throughout the garments’ construction, highlighted by the contrast stitching on all garments and an internal tricolor tape featured on the Training T-shirt.The One Block Down x Nike Air Max 95 LUX “Italy” collection launches on November 13. The Black colorway and accompanying apparel capsule collection will drop both online on One Block Down’s website and in-store at One Block Down’s Milan flagship, while the Red, Green, and White colorways will be available exclusively in-store. A wider global release for the Black colorway will follow on November 19 through Nike’s website and select retailers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Nike Dunk Low “Grandma’s Couch” Brings Vintage Living-Room Charm to the Court Classic
items.text: The Nike Dunk Low “Grandma’s Couch” Brings Vintage Living-Room Charm to the Court Classic Name: Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium “Grandma’s Couch”Colorway: Golden Hops/Velvet BrownSKU: JF4566-900MSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: NikeNike brings a heavy dose of nostalgia to its latest release with the Dunk Low Retro Premium “Grandma’s Couch,” officially arriving in a “Golden Hops/Velvet Brown” colorway. True to its playful nickname, the sneaker’s entire upper is wrapped in a rich, textured velvet fabric decorated with an elaborate, vintage-inspired floral brocade pattern. The deep autumnal palette of golden hues and velvety browns evokes the comforting, familiar aesthetic of classic living room upholstery. This heavily patterned execution transforms the traditional basketball silhouette into a highly tactile, lifestyle-focused statement piece perfect for the fall and winter seasons.Contrasting the busy floral upper, the design incorporates carefully considered branding and structural embellishments. The iconic Nike Swooshes on both the medial and lateral sides are uniquely rendered using puffy white stitching, outlined by subtle brown piping that gives the logos a distinct, three-dimensional definition. To balance the warm tones, a muted "Pale Ivory" canvas tongue is matched by complementary laces and a premium leather inner lining. Finished with a classic rubber sole unit, the "Grandma's Couch" Dunk Low merges heritage athletic DNA with a cozy, granny-chic aesthetic.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Margot Robbie Set to Star in A24's 'The Week of Pain'
items.text: Margot Robbie Set to Star in A24's 'The Week of Pain' Summary Margot Robbie will star in the upcoming film 'The Week of Pain' directed by Kristoffer BorgliA24 will finance and produce the project alongside Square Peg, Dilemma Films, and Robbie's LuckyChapThe announcement follows Borgli's recent box office success with The Drama starring Robert Pattinson and Zendaya A24 is teaming up with director Kristoffer Borgli and actress Margot Robbie for an upcoming feature film titled The Week of Pain. Set to be financed and produced by A24, the project will also feature production contributions from Ari Aster and Lars Knudsen’s Square Peg banner, alongside Dilemma Films and Robbie’s own LuckyChap production company.While official plot details for The Week of Pain remain heavily under wraps, the film is expected to deliver the squirmy, cringe-comedy drama that has become Borgli's signature following works like Dream Scenario and Sick of Myself. The new project reunites Square Peg and A24 with the filmmaker following their collaboration on April’s The Drama. That original dramedy, which starred Robert Pattinson and Zendaya, proved to be a massive box office success, grossing $135 million USD globally against a slim $28 million USD budget.For Robbie, the casting announcement follows her recent appearance in the Warner Bros. cinematic adaptation of the literary romance Wuthering Heights. Starring alongside Jacob Elordi as Heathcliff, the film rocketed to $241 million USD worldwide. Looking ahead, the superstar is also set to star alongside Bradley Cooper in a highly anticipated Ocean’s 11 prequel centered around an epic heist at the 1962 Monaco Grand Prix. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: G-SHOCK x XG Reunite for a Tattoo-Inspired Take on the Classic 6900
items.text: G-SHOCK x XG Reunite for a Tattoo-Inspired Take on the Classic 6900 Summary G-SHOCK reunites with X-POP group XG for the metal-bezel GM-6900XG-8 watch.Features a tattoo-printed translucent strap, hesonoo kanji caseback, and howling wolf backlight.Built with 200M water resistance, dropping November 2026 in custom collector's packaging. G-SHOCK has reunited with its global brand ambassador, the seven-member X-POP group XG, G-SHOCK has teamed up with its global brand ambassador XG for a second collaboration watch. The seven-member group, made up of JURIN, CHISA, HINATA, HARVEY, JURIA, MAYA and COCONA, has built its own “X-POP” sound that sits outside the usual J-POP and K-POP lines, a rebellious streak Casio ties to G-SHOCK’s “Never Give Up” ethos.The new GM-6900XG-8 is built around the creative concept “TIME, INKED ON YOU,” which treats the watch less as a tool for keeping time and more as something worn like ink on the wrist, carrying the feeling of XG’s music. It starts from the classic 6900 shape, adding a silvery metal bezel meant to evoke the weight of accumulated time, and a translucent band printed with the group’s full name, “Xtraordinary Genes,” in multi-angle print for a tattoo-like effect.Packed with custom details honoring the septet, the watch features an engraved "X" motif on its signature front button. Pressing the "X" button will light up the display, revealing a howling wolf, which is the fandom’s symbol. The caseback is engraved with the Japanese character "緒," the last character of hesonoo, the chant the members share in a circle before going on stage, standing for the bond between XG and ALPHAZ. Even the special packaging carries a hidden graphic of seven wolves on its base, one for each member.Under the styling, it’s a standard G-SHOCK: a resin and stainless steel case, complete with 200-meter water resistance, a 1/100-second stopwatch, countdown timer, multi-function alarm, flash alert, a Super Illuminator LED backlight and roughly five years of battery life.Casio lists the watch as a new release for this month, but an exact release date and regional availability have yet to be confirmed. For more details, keep an eye out on the official webpage for the collaboration via Casio. View this post on Instagram Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Buffer Plugs Into Sony’s Studio and Camcorder Legends for Its Latest Capsule
items.text: Buffer Plugs Into Sony’s Studio and Camcorder Legends for Its Latest Capsule Summary Buffer has made its own version of Sony’s MDR-CD900ST studio headphones, labeled the Buffer SPThree graphic T-shirts are based on Sony hardware, from a broadcast monitor to a 2000s camcorderEach T-shirt has a small chest graphic and a larger back print that tells a different scene Buffer has released a Sony-inspired capsule led by the MDR-CD900ST Buffer SP, its version of the Japanese studio headphone, alongside three graphic T-shirts based on Sony gear. The release celebrates the tools behind making and listening to music and video, from the recording booth to the skate video.The MDR-CD900ST has long been a recording-studio standard for checking vocals and performances, and Buffer leaves the sound engineering untouched. The Buffer SP edition comes in black, with the Buffer logo and the line “Protecting you from the world friction” on the ear cup label. Specs follow the studio original: 63 Ω impedance, a 1,000 mW maximum input, a 5 to 30,000 Hz frequency response and a 2.5 m cable ending in a 6.3 mm stereo plug, with a 3.5 mm mini plug adapter included. The Sony headphones weigh about 200 g without the cable and are made in Japan, and they ship with a natural wood block.The PVM-6041Q T-shirt is based on stacking monitors to make video art. Its back shows a wall of nine screens playing weather-forecast and news-style images next to “Buffy” and “Buffer” lettering, while a single monitor showing Buffy sits small on the chest. Front and back look intentionally different, and the shirt comes in White and Black.The DCR-VX2000 T-shirt is the most personal of the three. The product copy says Buffy relied on this Sony camcorder more than any other while shooting independent films in the early 2000s. The left chest has a small skater holding a camera, and the back is covered with a large shot of the VX2000 framed by a filmer’s hands and feet. The VX2000 became one of the most iconic cameras in skate video during that era, so the reference will land with anyone who grew up on skate tapes. It comes in Black and Blue.The MDR-CD900ST T-shirt links the capsule back to the headphones. On the front, the headphones frame a row of alphabet blocks spelling “Buffer,” and the back shows a listener wearing them in profile, putting the tool and the person using it on one shirt. It comes in Green and White.The Buffer capsule drops November 21 via the Buffer Online Store, with a limit of two per pr

items.title: Brain Dead x adidas Originals Complete the Adventure Collection With Apparel and Accessories
items.text: Brain Dead x adidas Originals Complete the Adventure Collection With Apparel and Accessories Summary Brain Dead and adidas Originals have revealed apparel and accessories for their latest collaboration.The capsule collection includes a shaggy half-zip fleece, lilac crewneck, crackle-print cargo pants and more.A fuzzy “DEAD” trapper beanie and carabiner-clipped socks round out the drop alongisde the previously revealed ZUPERKLIMB sneakers. Brain Dead and adidas Originals are rounding out their ZUPERKLIMB revival with a full apparel and accessories collection that brings back adidas’ 2000s Adventure line from head to toe. The early-2000s approach shoe returns in the label’s signature hairy suede, but the clothing does just as much to carry the outdoor theme.The standout is a half-zip fleece in a shaggy, long-pile knit, with an abstract mix of purple, brown and acid yellow broken up by an olive yoke, cuffs and hem. A garment-dyed lilac crewneck sweater takes a more vintage approach, with black Three Stripes down the sleeves and tonal embroidered logos on the chest. Dark grey nylon cargo pants have a crackled, all-over print, front pleats and a side cargo pocket with a co-branded patch. Product imagery also shows a brown tee with olive raglan sleeves, black stripes and red piping that the press release doesn’t mention. Each piece carries adidas’ Adventure logo, often alongside Brain Dead’s head motif.The accessories bring the shaggy texture back. A fuzzy trapper-style beanie in lilac and brown has ear flaps, long braided ties and a bright yellow band spelling “DEAD” across the front. Olive-and-brown terry crew socks pair the Adventure logo with the Brain Dead head, and come clipped together with a metallic carabiner carrying co-branded details. The collection reflects Brain Dead’s talent for bringing overlooked corners of the adidas archive back into focus. It follows the Samba Bowling packs earlier this year, and here the duo pushes that approach into technical climbing and hiking gear. The Brain Dead x adidas Originals Adventure collection releases in limited quantities on November 20 via CONFIRMED, select adidas stores and retailers and wearebraindead.com. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: SEGA Unveils Brutal “Act 2: Kure” Trailer for ‘Stranger Than Heaven’
items.text: SEGA Unveils Brutal “Act 2: Kure” Trailer for ‘Stranger Than Heaven’ Summary SEGA’s Stranger Than Heaven drops its “Act 2: Kure” story trailer.The prequel explores Makoto Daito’s 1929 yakuza rise in Hiroshima.The preview highlights brutal combat, sword clashes, and heavy emotional stakes. mineSEGA and Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio (RGG) have released the second story trailer for Stranger Than Heaven, moving Makoto Daito’s saga from Kokura in 1915 to Kure, Hiroshima, in 1929. The new footage opens with Daito trying to get close to Genzo Iwaki, the “Emperor of Kure,” and being surrounded by Iwaki’s guards before he is granted an audience. A key moment shows Daito accepting a ceremonial sake cup from Iwaki, sealing his entry into the yakuza after an attack on the family’s patriarch.From there, his new role takes shape: he oversees the city’s gambling halls and collects debts owed to the clan. The trailer intercuts his rise with combat as he earns the nickname “Red Oni.” SEGA’s official description frames the act bluntly: “In Kure, Daito swears his loyalty to Iwaki Genzo, and steels himself to commit any atrocities to climb the yakuza ranks.” The trailer also hints at the cost, showing Daito struggling with his life in the yakuza and facing the choices that led him there.Previously codenamed “Project Century,” Stranger Than Heaven is RGG Studio’s latest project after its long-running Yakuza/Like a Dragon series. The game follows Daito across five eras and five cities between 1915 and 1965. Its settings include Kokura, Fukuoka; Kure; Minami, Osaka; Atami, Shizuoka; and Kamurocho, the fictional Tokyo district that anchors the studio’s earlier games. The Act 2 trailer follows an earlier “Act 1: Kokura” story trailer, and SEGA has said more are on the way, each covering a different chapter of Daito’s life. Yū Shirota leads the cast as Daito, joined by Snoop Dogg as Orpheus and Tori Kelly as Suzy Day. Stranger Than Heaven launches January 15, 2027, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC via Steam and the Microsoft Store, and it will also be available on Game Pass. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Disney Reports a Massive Ticket Sales Spike for 'Avengers: Doomsday' Following the 'VisionQuest' Finale
items.text: Disney Reports a Massive Ticket Sales Spike for 'Avengers: Doomsday' Following the 'VisionQuest' Finale Summary The 'VisionQuest' season finale generated 3.7 million global views in its first 24 hours to become the most-watched MCU finale since 2023A shocking post-credits scene revealing the return of Elizabeth Olsen's Scarlet Witch drove an estimated 60,000 additional ticket sales for 'Avengers: Doomsday'The upcoming theatrical crossover event had already surpassed 50 million USD in domestic pre-sales ahead of its December 18 premiere This post may contain spoilers. Proceed at your own risk.Disney has confirmed a massive surge in viewership and ticket sales following the season finale of VisionQuest, the latest installment in the Marvel Cinematic Universe's acclaimed WandaVision trilogy. Surpassing 3.7 million global views on Disney+ within its first 24 hours, the episode broke MCU streaming records while simultaneously boosting advanced ticket sales for the highly anticipated theatrical release of Avengers: Doomsday.The record-breaking viewership makes "Forever" the most-watched finale of any MCU television series since Loki Season 2 concluded in 2023, surpassing recent hits like Agatha All Along and Daredevil: Born Again. The series—which reintroduced Paul Bettany's Vision alongside returning franchise veterans like James Spader's Ultron—provided crucial narrative closure for the overarching storyline that began with 2021's WandaVision. Most notably, the finale officially introduced Rauridh Mollica as the reincarnated Thomas Shepherd (Tommy Maximoff), formally reuniting the surviving members of the Maximoff-Vision family on screen.The immense streaming success directly translated into a theatrical box office boost for Marvel Studios. According to reports, a shocking post-credits scene in the VisionQuest finale triggered an estimated 60,000 additional ticket sales for the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday film. The sequence revisited the climax of Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, revealing Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom unearthing and reviving Elizabeth Olsen’s Scarlet Witch from beneath the rubble. With Avengers: Doomsday having already crossed $50 million USD in domestic pre-sales back in September—largely driven by Disney's new Infinity Vision premium format—the sudden return of Wanda Maximoff has further accelerated anticipation for the massive crossover event.The VisionQuest finale is now streaming exclusively on Disney+. items.title: Slate Auto Is Selling a $30 USD “Screenless GPS” That Is Actually a Rand McNally Road Atlas
items.text: Slate Auto Is Selling a $30 USD “Screenless GPS” That Is Actually a Rand McNally Road Atlas Summary Slate Auto is offering a limited-edition $30 USD "Screenless GPS" that is actually a branded Rand McNally Road AtlasThe accessory is marketed for the company's upcoming electric Truck, which features an intentionally analog, screen-free cabinStarting under $25,000, the minimalist EV relies on driver smartphones rather than built-in displays for navigation and entertainment Slate Auto introduced a limited-edition accessory on its online store, offering a "Screenless GPS" for $30. Instead of a high-tech routing gadget, the product is a physical, Slate-branded Rand McNally Road Atlas. Designed as a companion for the open road, the physical atlas contains comprehensive maps covering the United States, Canada and Mexico.The paper atlas is marketed specifically for the company's new electric vehicle, the Truck. Scheduled to launch in the back half of the 2020s, the Slate Truck lacks a central screen and digital bloat, embracing a minimalist design language. Drivers navigate a cabin featuring manual hand-crank windows and no traditional carpeting. Slate built the vehicle with the expectation that owners will mount their own smartphones to handle navigation and entertainment needs.The "Screenless GPS" highlights the automaker's back-to-basics design, offering a physical map instead of a glowing central infotainment hub. While a standard, unbranded version of the Rand McNally atlas sells for $19.99 USD on Amazon, the Slate-stamped edition carries a premium markup typical of exclusive automotive merchandise.Beyond the paper maps and hand-crank windows, the core specifications of the Slate Truck remain straightforward. The vehicle achieves an electric driving range of 205 miles on a single charge and comes in three distinct, customizable body styles. Starting prices range from just under $25,000 USD to just over $32,000 USD . Preorders for Slate products are live on the company's website as delivery windows fill up. items.title: Netflix’s 'Magic: The Gathering' Animated Series, 'Planeswalker,' Is Officially Coming in 2027
items.text: Netflix’s 'Magic: The Gathering' Animated Series, 'Planeswalker,' Is Officially Coming in 2027 Summary Netflix drops a sneak peek for the reworked animated series debuting in 2027Roy Graham confirms the highly anticipated adaptation is officially titled PlaneswalkerThe release puts an end to a chaotic seven-year development cycle following a ground-up rework After years of false starts and behind-the-scenes silence, the multiverse is finally opening up. Netflix dropped a sneak peek video officially announcing that the long-awaited animated adaptation of the iconic card game is set to debut in 2027. Officially titled Magic The Gathering: Planeswalker, the series arrives with a heavy burden of expectation, prompting the franchise’s brass to address the fanbase directly. Roy Graham, the Head of Story at Magic: The Gathering, introduced the teaser video with a mix of relief and reassurance, stating, "It’s really happening. I promise. For real." That self-aware introduction directly addresses the heavy skepticism surrounding a project that has been largely theoretical for the better part of a decade.The 2027 debut of Planeswalker resolves an exhausting seven-year development cycle that saw the property pushed to the brink of cancellation. An animated Magic: The Gathering series was first teased in 2019. That original version was initially helmed by Joe and Anthony Russo, carrying heavy prestige before the highly publicized project fell apart. For years, the property sat in limbo until Netflix confirmed in 2024 that it still planned to adapt the game, though the streaming giant mandated reworking the series entirely from the ground up. This creative reboot marks a fresh attempt to adapt the tabletop franchise after years of production uncertainty.The November announcement video included a sneak peek of the show that highlights why the studio opted for a complete creative overhaul. Production takes an ambitious visual approach to its expansive lore, treating its various settings as distinct artistic showcases. Because each plane in the series exists in its own pocket universe, the production team gave every plane a completely unique design, animation and filmmaking style. items.title: Getting Down & Dirty with Li Hei Di
items.text: Getting Down & Dirty with Li Hei Di Li Hei Di was Pace’s youngest artist when they joined the mega-gallery in 2024. In just a few years, their atmospheric dreamscapes propelled them into the ranks of contemporary art’s most promising new painters. “There’s me, and there’s sugar-coated me,” Li tells me from beneath one of several majestic canvases in their ongoing New York solo. Judging by the cloudy menageries of severed limbs overhead, in the year of mud, the London-based artist is ready to scrape off the sweet stuff.“It feels like I’m stumbling through mud, but also a part of it — I can reshape myself,” they express. “It’s all about turning a muddy situation into a beautiful one.”The Shenyang-born, London-based artist is just getting started. After completing their painting MA from the Royal College of Art, Li has shown work at Linseed Projects, Michael Kohn Gallery, and Pippy Houldsworth Gallery, with now three presentations with Pace under their belt. Spanning deep blues and purples to blushing sunset hues, their works pull from an eclectic mix of inspirations. Because sincerity, be it in bell hooks or survival reality TV, books wrought with grief or Hoppers, as Li points, has no one medium. They see painting as a raw, expressive “language” to get at truths and tragedies of life, sex, desire, and emotion, unearthing them from the ten-dollar art jargon they’re so often buried beneath.On and off the canvas, Li’s on a transformational run. You’d think a career full-send this early on would set the tensions high, but for Li, painting is still the escape. During their last solo exhibition, land marks, they began medically transitioning, having reached a point where gender dysphoria and the fear of coming out came to eclipse their burgeoning successes. “I already made the scariest decision of my life, so everything exterior, materialistic, doesn’t matter that much.” These days, Li’s got little interest in playing it safe. Having shed the need to fit so neatly into a box, they’re finally painting on their own terms, and the newfound freedom meant more risks in the studio. Earlier celestial bodies meld into human ones, a figurative turn that long felt out of reach. “Because I conquered that fear, there was nothing to lose.”For this new installment of Hypeart Visits, Li takes us through their year of mud, how a Pixar film inspired some of this latest painting suite, and why the secret behind their breakthrough was simply letting go.“I kept painting because it’s

items.title: BEYOND THE STREETS Brings Over 100 Artists to London's Saatchi Gallery
items.text: BEYOND THE STREETS Brings Over 100 Artists to London's Saatchi Gallery Summary Over 100 international artists, including FUTURA 2000, KAWS and Shepard Fairey, come together for a major exhibition at London's Saatchi Gallery.Curated by Roger Gastman, the show traces six decades of graffiti, hip-hop, fashion and activism through rare archives, historic works and immersive installations. BEYOND THE STREETS has returned to London's Saatchi Gallery with an expansive new exhibition celebrating six decades of street culture and its lasting influence on contemporary art. Bringing together more than 100 international artists and cultural figures, the presentation explores how graffiti, hip-hop, fashion, music and activism have shaped creative expression across generations.Spanning more than ten rooms, the exhibition features a mix of historic works, new commissions, rare archival materials and immersive installations. Among the participating artists are graffiti pioneers FUTURA 2000, LADY PINK, TAKI 183, DONDI and PHASE 2, alongside contemporary figures including KAWS, Shepard Fairey, Barry McGee, Kenny Scharf, Damien Hirst, Jenny Holzer, Invader and VHILS.Rather than focusing solely on street art's visual language, BEYOND THE STREETS examines the broader cultural movements that emerged alongside it. Highlights include "Subway Art," "Tube Graffiti History," "Londonz Burning Archive" and "History of Spray Paint & Infinity Room," tracing the evolution of graffiti from New York City's subway system to London's underground scene. Dedicated sections also spotlight the influence of 2Tone music and fashion, hip-hop photography, underground publications and the evolution of breakbeat culture.Photography and archival materials play a central role in the exhibition, with contributions from Martha Cooper, Henry Chalfant, Janette Beckman and Estevan Oriol documenting the communities and creative movements that helped define street culture. Elsewhere, works by the Guerrilla Girls and archival material from activist collectives explore how public spaces have historically served as platforms for protest, resistance and social commentary.Additional highlights include "Freestyle '85," "BreakBeat Lou – Ultimate Breaks & Beats" and "Chrome & Black," which spotlights a group of graffiti writers including DIET, FATSO, TEACH, TIME, TOX, VEXZA, WISE and ZOMBY. items.title: Zain Memon Designs a Jaeger-LeCoultre Escape Game Set Inside the Manufacture
items.text: Zain Memon Designs a Jaeger-LeCoultre Escape Game Set Inside the Manufacture When Jaeger-LeCoultre first teased the idea of making a video game, the response from journalists was blunt. "I got feedback like, 'You're crazy! How do you want to develop a video game?'" recalls Chief Marketing Officer Matthieu Le Voyer. How, critics asked, could a watch Maison hope to compete with Blizzard and Activision? But the Vallée de Joux Manufacture was never trying to build the next Call of Duty. Instead, the latest chapter of its Made of Makers™ program brings video games, often called the "10th Art," into a cross-disciplinary roster that already counts sound artist Zimoun, musician TØKIO M¥ERS, street light-painter Roy Wang and pastry chef Nina Métayer.This time, the Maker in the spotlight is Zain Memon, a Mumbai-born, Goa-based storyteller widely regarded as India's most influential game designer. The self-taught creative is best known for SHASN, a political strategy board game that won the Social Impact Award at IndieCade Europe, and its sequel SHASN: AZADI. He’s now deep into MAYA, a sprawling transmedia universe spanning novels, graphic novels, board games and film. For Le Voyer, the board-game pedigree was the point. Unlike mobile games built on quick dopamine hits, board games ask players to sit with a system for hours, making Memon a more natural fit than any digital agency.The result is The Valley of Inventions, an escape game set inside the Manufacture-Atelier at the Maison's origins, with the player stepping into the role of Élie LeCoultre as he inherits the secrets of the trade. Progress hinges on understanding how watchmaking works: iconic complications and inventions, from the chronograph and minute repeater to the tourbillon, perpetual calendar and worldtime, are reimagined as enigmas, interwoven with puzzles about the Vallée de Joux and the Manufacture's many métiers.The game launches globally today as a free app and web experience in seven languages, before taking on physical form: a city-wide hunt across Dubai in December, an in-store activation for clients, a phygital edition gifted to select collectors and, in 2027, a three-room escape-room exhibition in Hong Kong. items.title: REO Trucks Unveils the Antithesis of the Modern Truck
items.text: REO Trucks Unveils the Antithesis of the Modern Truck Summary REO unveils the Runabout truck and SUV lineup.Its utilitarian design prioritizes physical controls, simplicity, and easy repairs.Texas-built models start at $21,500 USD, with deliveries expected by late 2028. The historic American marque REO is officially back, teaming up with Frank Stephenson's eponymous design studio to debut the all-new Runabout range. Powered by petrol, the range consists of the T4X work truck, the T4C crew cab and the S4C family SUV. The lineup is a significant departure away from the bloated, tech-heavy trucks currently dominating the market. Instead, REO is doubling down on a radically simple, right-to-repair ethos, delivering a trio of vehicles engineered to be affordable, easily maintained, and last decades.Visually, the Runabout range grounds itself in its utilitarian aesthetic while still carving out a distinct identity. The upright front grille draws direct inspiration from America’s oldest pick-up, the 1915 REO Speed Wagon, while its broad shoulders and forward-leaning stance are modeled after the American bison. Simplicity and repairability are at the heart of the design. Frankstephenson design opted for standard-size, stacked LED headlights and bolt-on wheel arch extensions that owners can easily source and replace off the shelf if damaged. Inside the cabin, physical controls have been intentionally retained and sized for everyday use, even with thick work gloves on.All three models sit on a shared ladder-frame chassis, utilizing the same wheelbase and front bodywork before diverging into different purpose-built forms. The two-seat T4X features a steel flatbed with drop sides for versatility loading from either the sides or the rear, while the T4C crew cab accommodates five passengers alongside a separate load bed. Rounding out the lineup, the six-seat S4C SUV features the shortest rear overhang of the group and a side-hinged tailgate complete with a fully drop-down window. Committed to their anti-obsolescence ethos, REO plans to make its factory service manual completely free, as well as provide a comprehensive parts catalogue for its owners.Production for the REO Trucks Runabout range will take place at a new facility in Texas. The vehicles are priced for true accessibility, with the T4X starting at just $21,500 USD, the T4C at $25,000 USD, and the S4C at $28,500 USD. Diving into the technical specifications, the Book 3 is constructed with a predominantly mesh upper for lightweight breathability. Underfoot, the sneaker is engineered with a forefoot Zoom Strobel unit and a Cushlon 3.0 midsole to deliver a highly responsive and flexible ride. Ensuring stability during rapid lateral movements, the design incorporates a supportive TPU shank, while a modernized herringbone traction pattern on the outsole maximizes grip on the hardwood.Highlighting the silhouette's initial rollout, Booker is introducing a trio of distinct colorways. items.title: 007's New Watch Dilemma: Will Robert Pattinson Bring Jaeger-LeCoultre to MI6?
items.text: 007's New Watch Dilemma: Will Robert Pattinson Bring Jaeger-LeCoultre to MI6? The announcement that Robert Pattinson will officially step into the tuxedo as the next James Bond didn’t just shake up the film industry—it set off a high-stakes turf war in the luxury watch world. For 31 years, Omega has enjoyed an ironclad, incredibly lucrative grip on the 007 franchise. Since GoldenEye in 1995, every cinematic iteration of the British spy has checked his Omega Seamaster before saving the world.But Pattinson’s arrival introduces a massive complication: just months before being unveiled as the new Bond, he was named a global brand ambassador for Jaeger-LeCoultre (JLC).The Commercial Tug-of-WarWhen Pattinson appeared in his official Bond announcement photos, watch enthusiasts immediately noticed the glaring detail: his wrist was bare. This conspicuous absence is fueling rampant speculation about a behind-the-scenes battle between two Swiss giants.Historically, the actor playing Bond naturally absorbs the Omega partnership—both Pierce Brosnan and Daniel Craig became direct Omega ambassadors during their respective tenures. But Pattinson enters the franchise with an active, high-profile contract with a rival, Richemont-owned brand.While Jaeger-LeCoultre will undoubtedly push hard to break Omega’s three-decade exclusivity streak and finally put a JLC on 007's wrist, Omega (backed by the massive marketing budget of the Swatch Group) is unlikely to surrender its most iconic cultural pillar without a fierce financial fight. The ultimate compromise might see Pattinson retaining his JLC ties off-screen while dutifully wearing Omega on-camera—but if the franchise decides to pivot, JLC has the perfect arsenal for a modern Bond.What Could a JLC Bond Wear?If 007 makes the unprecedented switch, here are the Jaeger-LeCoultre pieces that would perfectly fit the life of a cinematic super-spy:Jaeger-LeCoultre Polaris DateIf Bond needs a direct substitute for his trusty Omega Seamaster, the Polaris Date is the obvious choice. Inspired by JLC's iconic 1968 diver, it features 200 meters of water resistance, an inner rotating bezel (adjusted via the secondary crown), and a rugged rubber strap. It is tough enough for an underwater infiltration sequence, yet refined enough to peek out from under the cuff of a tactical wet suit.Jaeger-LeCoultre Reverso TributeBond is just as famous for his high-stakes casino scenes as he is for his action sequences, and the Reverso is the ultimate tuxe

items.title: Slam Jam and Levi’s Reunite for a Star-Studded Custom Denim Collection
items.text: Slam Jam and Levi’s Reunite for a Star-Studded Custom Denim Collection Summary Slam Jam and Levi's have joined forces for the third chapter of their ongoing collaborative partnershipThe DIY-inspired project reimagines deadstock denim with black-painted seams and custom star-shaped metal studsThe collection officially drops on November 19 at Slam Jam locations, SKP-S Beijing, and Worksout Seoul Slam Jam and Levi's have joined forces once more, officially introducing the third chapter of their ongoing partnership with a custom take on the 501 Original and Trucker Jacket. Rooted in the DIY practices that have long shaped denim culture, the latest collaborative project breathes new life into deadstock garments, celebrating customization as an instinctive form of self-expression.Approaching the Levi’s archive with a rebellious attitude, Slam Jam injects its distinct visual vocabulary into the classic silhouettes. The collection is highlighted by the Italian institution's upside-down "A" logo, which has been reimagined as a star-shaped metal stud. These custom hardware additions run across both the Trucker Jacket and the 501 Original jeans, serving as wishful badges that embody the community's restlessness and urge for change.Adding further contrast to the raw aesthetic, both pieces feature striking black-painted external seams. Drawing from a deep pool of cultural references—spanning from military insignia and punk counterculture to David Bowie's imagery and sports iconography—the star motif solidifies the collection's punk-inspired, DIY ethos.The Slam Jam x Levi’s custom collection drops on November 19 across all Slam Jam retail doors, as well as at SKP-S Beijing and Worksout Seoul. To celebrate the launch, Slam Jam’s Milan store will host an evening of live performances from 7 to 10 PM featuring edeF., NINA, and Sindy. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Crocs Honors the Island With the "Puerto Rico" Classic Clog
items.text: Crocs Honors the Island With the "Puerto Rico" Classic Clog Summary Crocs has unveiled a new iteration of its Classic Clog dedicated to celebrating Puerto RicoThe white Croslite silhouette features the island's flag wrapping around the sides alongside thematic Jibbitz charmsThe celebratory footwear is scheduled to arrive during the Holiday 2026 season via Crocs and select retailers Name: Crocs Classic Clog "Puerto Rico"Colorway: White/Blue/RedSKU: 216181-100MSRP: $70 USDRelease Date: Holiday 2026Where to Buy: CrocsCrocs is paying homage to the island of Puerto Rico with its latest footwear release, officially introducing the Classic Clog "Puerto Rico." Blending the brand's signature comfortable construction with vibrant cultural storytelling, the upcoming drop goes well beyond traditional red, white, and blue color blocking to deliver a highly detailed silhouette.Anchoring the commemorative design, the Classic Clog utilizes a crisp white Croslite upper with matching heel straps and tonal branding. Along the sidewalls, the stripes of the Puerto Rican flag curve up and down the base before narrowing around the toe. Toward the heel, a light blue triangle and a white star create the appearance of the flag waving around the shoe.The release is highlighted by eight removable, culturally thematic Jibbitz charms that vary in size and finish. The custom accessories include a woven pava hat, a silver-tone Taíno-inspired coquí, a white plastic chair, and a gold-colored outline of the island. Completing the playful set are two golden-brown tostones, a "Wepa!" graphic, and an "¡Toma!" charm featuring a flying red chancleta. All eight accessories can be freely rearranged across the upper's ventilation holes.The Crocs Classic Clog "Puerto Rico" drops Holiday 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Soho House Puts 11,000 Artworks Between Cloth Covers in ‘Soho Art House’
items.text: Soho House Puts 11,000 Artworks Between Cloth Covers in ‘Soho Art House’ Summary 'Soho Art House' is the first book dedicated to the art collection that hangs across roughly 50 Soho House locations in 19 countriesChief Art Director Kate Bryan wrote and edited the cloth-bound volume, which combines essays, conversations and photographyTwelve cultural figures, including Klaus Biesenbach and Helen Fielding, each pick a favorite work from their local House Soho House has released Soho Art House, a cloth-bound book that opens up its global art collection, which spans more than 11,000 works, for the first time. Kate Bryan, the club’s Chief Art Director, wrote and edited the volume after spending the past decade curating and caring for the collection, and she organized it as a guided tour through the Houses rather than a straight catalog.The book is built in clear layers. Andrew Carnie writes the foreword, and Bryan’s own writing appears alongside essays from Ferren Gipson, Jennifer Higgie, Suzanne Hudson and Alastair Sooke. Photography of the works in place throughout the clubs runs between the texts, showing how the art lives in bars, bedrooms and hallways instead of on gallery walls.The most personal section hands the selection over to outsiders. Twelve cultural figures each choose a favorite piece from their local House and explain why it matters to them. Neue Nationalgalerie director Klaus Biesenbach takes on Damien Hirst, and novelist Helen Fielding writes about Harland Miller. The book also includes a roundtable moderated by Bryan with Soho House founder Nick Jones, Jonathan Yeo, who first came up with the collection, and writer and curator Francesca Gavin, one of its early collaborators.The collection’s approach explains its size. It follows the model of La Colombe d’Or, the French hotel where artists once traded their work for meals and rooms, inviting artists to contribute pieces and join a worldwide network. Each House leans toward artists who were born, based or trained in its region. Little House Balham shows work by artists from south of the Thames, and Soho House Bangkok features 33 artists born in or based in Thailand.Across its pages, the book covers a wide range of names, including Tracey Emin, Rashid Johnson, Catherine Opie, Bharti Kher, David Shrigley, Tschabalala Self, Ming Smith, Guerrilla Girls and Olafur Eliasson. items.text: Mark Wahlberg Reopens Memberships for His Exclusive Golf Society, The Underground Summary Mark Wahlberg is officially reopening memberships for his ultra-exclusive golf society and custom golf ball brand, The UndergroundThe invitation-only platform will open its website on November 18 to welcome the upcoming 2027 classThe announcement follows the official closure of the brand's foundational inaugural 2026 membership class Mark Wahlberg is officially reopening memberships for his ultra-exclusive, invitation-only golf society and custom golf ball brand, The Underground. Following a highly coveted initial launch that captured the attention of the sports and lifestyle crossover space, the exclusive platform is gearing up to expand its tight-knit community by welcoming a new wave of golf enthusiasts for the upcoming year.Operating at the intersection of premium sportswear and private club culture, The Underground has established itself as a sought-after destination for those seeking an elevated on-course experience. According to the brand's official website, the inaugural 2026 class has been officially closed, locking in its foundational roster of members and paving the way for fresh inductions.Moving forward, the society will open its digital doors to prospective members for the 2027 class. This upcoming enrollment period will allow a new, curated group of invitees to access the brand's highly exclusive golfing community and its signature custom-branded golf balls.The Underground website officially opens for 2027 class applications on November 18 online. items.title: Louis Vuitton Returns to the Strip With a Bespoke Trophy Trunk for the 2026 Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
items.text: Louis Vuitton Returns to the Strip With a Bespoke Trophy Trunk for the 2026 Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix Summary Louis Vuitton unveils a custom Trophy Trunk for the 2026 Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix.The handcrafted case features signature Monograms and a personalized Victory patch.This design honors the brand's 129-year heritage in automotive culture. Louis Vuitton has unveiled a new bespoke Trophy Trunk ahead of the Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026, taking place from November 19 - 21 on the Las Vegas Strip Circuit. The race will also feature the Louis Vuitton signature displayed across on-track signage. The latest creation follows Louis Vuitton’s previous bespoke Trophy Trunk designed for the 2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix, celebrating Formula 1’s 75th anniversary with a classic black-and-white Damier pattern honoring the checkered flag.The 2026 Trophy Trunk continues the House’s tradition of creating custom cases to transport and showcase trophies for some of the world’s most famous sporting competitions. Dressed in Louis Vuitton’s signature Monogram. Colored Damier strips, reminiscent of the finish line, come together to form an iconic “V” in white gold leaf, standing for both “Victory” and “Vuitton”. Also new for the 2026 season is the Victory patch, inspired by traditional travel labels that are engraved with the winner’s initials to commemorate the drivers shaping Grand Prix history.As with all custom Louis Vuitton pieces, the 2026 Trophy Trunk is made by hand at the House’s historic atelier in Asnières-sur-Seine, France. The workshop is where the first automotive trunks were designed under Georges Vuitton, in 1897, cementing the House’s 129-year association with automotive culture.Take a closer look at the Trophy Trunk above Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: HOKA Taps WTAPS for an Armor-Inspired Speedgoat TS Sneaker
items.text: HOKA Taps WTAPS for an Armor-Inspired Speedgoat TS Sneaker Name: WTAPS x HOKA Speedgoat TSColorway: Galactic Grey/High Rise, Black/Volcanic AshSKU: 1185590-GHG, 1185590-BKVLMSRP: $175 USDRelease Date: November 27Where to Buy: HOKAThe ongoing collaboration between WTAPS and HOKA continues with the Speedgoat TS, blending WTAPS’ utilitarian streetwear aesthetic with HOKA’s renowned trail-running performance.Releasing in two distinct colorways - “Galactic Grey/High Rise” and “Black/Volcanic Ash” - the silhouette utilizes a breathable mesh base overlaid with extensive protective paneling across the toe, midfoot, and heel, giving the sneaker an almost armor-like appearance. The “Galactic Grey” iteration relies on varying shades of grey accented by sharp pops of purple on the heel pull tab and midsole, while the “Black/Volcanic Ash” version takes a darker approach, juxtaposing its black and grey upper against a crisp white sole unit for a sharp visual contrast.Designed with both urban wear and off-road capability in mind, the Speedgoat TS is packed with HOKA’s signature functional elements, including a supportive EVA midsole that provides plush cushioning and impact absorption. The shoe is grounded by a heavy-duty Vibram Megagrip outsole, which features aggressive lugs that guarantee traction on both wet and dry surfaces. The design is finished with subtle but unmistakable WTAPS branding; the phrase “VISUAL UPARMORED” is boldly printed across the lateral side panel, while “WTAPS” text is placed on the heel, solidifying the military-inspired, street-ready aesthetic of this highly anticipated drop.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Bare Knuckles Brings Brooks’ Archival Cascadia 1 Back to the Trail
items.text: Bare Knuckles Brings Brooks’ Archival Cascadia 1 Back to the Trail Name: Brooks x Bare Knuckles Cascadia 1Colorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: $160 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: Bare Knuckles, BrooksBrooks Running and Portland clothing label Bare Knuckles have teamed up to reissue the Cascadia 1, bringing one of Brooks’ most storied trail shoes back from the archive in a limited-edition release.First introduced in 2004, the Cascadia 1 earned its reputation underfoot: Brooks athlete Scott Jurek wore it during his sixth consecutive Western States 100 victory. This version keeps that performance lineage intact, restoring the original Pivot Post technology, roll bar and HydroFlow, and adding upgraded foam for more comfort on the trail and in daily wear. A chunky, dark brown sole unit carries the archival profile, with sculpted sidewalls, “PIVOT” embossed on the lateral midsole and deep, aggressive lugs wrapping up from the outsole. The collaboration grows out of both brands’ focus on considered design, quality materials and craftsmanship, steering the trail runner toward everyday wear without losing its technical roots.Bare Knuckles’ influence shows mainly in the materials. The upper uses a tonal, earthy brown palette, layering a distressed taupe suede base with darker chocolate hairy suede overlays that sweep across the toe and quarters. Dark, irregular stitching traces winding contour shapes across the suede panels, adding a hand-finished, organic texture. Smooth, perforated chocolate leather reinforces the toe and heel, and a dark brown mesh tongue and collar complete the build. Brooks’ logo appears only as a grey stitched outline on the lateral side, part of a subtle approach to co-branding throughout the shoe. Two contrasting lace options add lighter accents: a pale yellow pair and a cream rope lace speckled with brown, which pop against the otherwise monochrome brown upper.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops.
