items.text: nonnative Touches Down at Gallery HBX With "SKY'S THE LIMIT" Pop-Up and Exclusive Releases Summary Nonnative is officially arriving at Gallery HBX in Hong Kong for the Fall/Winter 2026 seasonTo celebrate the launch, the brand is hosting a special pop-up event featuring a GORE-TEX archive exhibitionThe event will see the release of exclusive items created alongside GUIDI, ARTIST PROOF, FRGMT, and Gallery HBX nonnative is officially making its debut at Gallery HBX in Hong Kong for the Fall/Winter 2026 season. To celebrate the milestone launch, the brand is hosting a special pop-up event titled "SKY'S THE LIMIT," presenting its latest collection alongside an immersive exhibition and a robust lineup of exclusive collaborative releases. nonnative designer Takayuki Fujii arrived in Hong Kong to celebrate the reveal of the pop-up, speaking with Hypebeast regarding the collaboration.Drawing heavily on workwear, military, and outdoor clothing, nonnative consistently translates functional design into contemporary silhouettes. The "SKY'S THE LIMIT" pop-up event will highlight this ethos through a special archive exhibition showcasing selected GORE-TEX pieces from previous seasons. Tracing the evolution of the brand's waterproof, breathable, and windproof designs, the showcase explores nonnative's longstanding approach to balancing technical performance with everyday comfort. The space will also feature a wide selection of current FW26 styles. Fujii-san told Hypebeast that bringing the collection to Hong Kong goes well with theme, "I think this is a city where many people engage in various activities, so it is well-equipped to accommodate to that, and I intend to create clothing for that. I really wanted to incorporate the feeling of Hong Kong. The Windstopper jacketfundamentally actively prevents sweating. Because this is so specialized, I think it fits perfectly with the city of Hong Kong. Easy to move in and I am very conscious of keeping it light. That is why I want to make clothes that are more suitable and can be easily worn.Marking the occasion, the label has prepared a lineup of exclusive collaborative releases. The offering includes a co-branded S/S Tee with Gallery HBX, as well as an ARTIST PROOF and FRGMT-assisted Trooper Coat crafted in nylon twill with WINDSTOPPER® technology. items.title: JAY-Z’s Paper Planes and Droplet Bottle Mexican Tuberose in the Jet-Black “Paper Garden Nº1” Diffuser
items.text: JAY-Z’s Paper Planes and Droplet Bottle Mexican Tuberose in the Jet-Black “Paper Garden Nº1” Diffuser Summary British fragrance house Droplet and JAY-Z’s lifestyle label Paper Planes team up on Paper Garden Nº1, a limited-edition reed diffuser built around the idea of escapismThe scent was developed with master perfumers in Grasse, France, and layers Mexican tuberose over warm sandalwood and creamy vanillaA hand-blown crystal glass vessel in glossy, opaque black carries the Paper Planes logo and a single sculptural reed Droplet and JAY-Z’s Paper Planes have released Paper Garden Nº1, a limited-edition reed diffuser that pairs a floral fragrance with a vessel designed to stand on its own as a decorative object. The collaboration combines Droplet’s background in contemporary home fragrance with Paper Planes’ focus on imagination, and the result is a piece that works as both scent and sculpture.The vessel is the main event. Droplet starts with its signature diffuser shape, hand-blows it in crystal glass and finishes it in a glossy, opaque black, a departure from the clear glass usually used for home fragrance. The Paper Planes logo appears on the body, and a single sculptural reed rises from the top in place of the usual bundle, which gives the piece a strong, minimal silhouette on a shelf or side table. “The glossy, opaque black glass gives our signature diffuser a striking new identity – bold, sculptural and beautifully understated,” said Droplet co-founders Sam and Lucie Beecham in a statement.Droplet developed the fragrance with master perfumers in Grasse, France, the traditional center of French perfumery. Mexican tuberose leads the composition with a rich, heady floral, and warm sandalwood and creamy vanilla underneath soften it into something smoother and more rounded. “We wanted a scent that felt like floral escapism above the clouds; Mexican tuberose, warm sandalwood, and creamy vanilla, built for the dreamers and the believers,” Paper Planes said in the release.The diffuser runs on 150ml of fragrance oil, enough for up to three months of steady scent with no flame or electricity. The formula is vegan and cruelty-free, in line with Droplet’s focus on carefully chosen ingredients.The Droplet x Paper Planes Paper Garden Nº1 Reed Diffuser is available now in store at Selfridges, Liberty and CNCPTS, and online. items.title: How Citizen Turned Five Decades of Light Powered Energy Into Everyday Fashion and Modern Luxury with Eco-Drive
items.text: How Citizen Turned Five Decades of Light Powered Energy Into Everyday Fashion and Modern Luxury with Eco-Drive Fifty years after Citizen revolutionized timekeeping with the 1976 Crystron Solar Cell, light-powered watches* have evolved from a bold answer to an energy crisis into a central pillar of modern style. Today, roughly 80% of Citizen timepieces are powered by Eco-Drive technology — a testament to a five-decade obsession with eliminating disposable batteries without sacrificing aesthetic flair. Over those 50 years, relentless engineering has slashed light-transmission requirements from 80% down to under 15%, giving designers total creative freedom while packing movements with atomic-level precision and power reserves that run up to a full year in total darkness.What started as pure technical problem-solving now strikes a chord with contemporary culture, particularly among a wide generation of audiences. Today’s landscape is shaped by conscious consumerism, where young buyers look for traditional, stylish wristwatches that seamlessly align with sustainable values. Fueled by a data-first approach and a deep digital transformation, light-powered horology has captured new and veteran watch fans as its fastest-growing demographic, proving that environmental mindfulness and individual self-expression go hand in hand.Within streetwear culture - a world obsessed with the intersection of functional utility and high-concept design - this fifty-year evolution feels entirely at home. Sleek integrated bracelets, sharp geometric silhouettes, and ultra-durable Super Titanium™ treated with scratch-resistant Duratect coatings directly mirror the modern technical aesthetic. High-tech dial details, like translucent patterns inspired by quantum physics and wave interference, turn microscopic light-harvesting engineering into a subtle, everyday flex for a scene built on elevated industrial gear.At the same time, this continuous innovation has quietly reshaped accessible luxury through vertical integration and elevated craftsmanship. Rather than hiding solar cells behind basic covers, modern dial making embraces artful complexity—utilizing structural color iridescence, floating hour markers, and delicate Japanese Tosa washi paper dusted with hand-applied gold or platinum leaf. These intricate materials channel ambient light to internal receptors while delivering rich visual depth, proving that high-level finishing and eco-conscious engineering belong on the same canvas.To

items.title: What Went Down at the Inaugural Hypegolf Social Club, Powered by Toyota
items.text: What Went Down at the Inaugural Hypegolf Social Club, Powered by Toyota Hypegolf Social Club is built on a simple idea: the best way to get into golf is to play it. Golf has a well-earned reputation for being notoriously stiff. Between the strict dress codes, the obsession with handicaps, and the unspoken rules, getting into the game can feel like navigating a minefield. And Hypegolf Social Club was built to completely flip that script.On November 14, that exact energy took over the Scholl Canyon Golf Club in Los Angeles. Powered by the Toyota Grand Highlander and Toyota RAV4, the inaugural LA event stripped away the sport's usual intimidation factor and replaced it with a heavy focus on community, gear and a genuinely good time.Scholl Canyon was the perfect venue for this blueprint. The 18-hole executive course plays shorter than a standard layout and has a driving range on site. Rounds move quickly and the game feels approachable from the first tee, which made it a natural fit for an event designed with newer players in mind. When doors opened at 1 p.m., a 200-person crowd rolled up. The turnout featured a true cross-section of the culture, with scratch players warming up right next to people gripping a club for the literal first time.The afternoon was built to bring everyone together and get them playing, whatever their experience level. Out on the links, experienced players locked into a fast-paced, nine-hole scramble. At the same time, newcomers linked up with Toyota Pros rocking custom caddie bibs for real-time clinics on tee shots and short-game fundamentals.Back at the driving range, the energy was loud. Cobra took over the TrackMan bays for heavy-hitting club demos, while LAB Golf was on the practice green dialing in bespoke putter fittings. Guests who took on “The Perfect Putt” challenge on the practice green or stepped up for the Toyota Longest Drive at the range each earned tokens to trade in at a curated prize wall.The actual heartbeat of the event was the central plaza, anchored by Toyota’s interactive setups. Inside the Toyota Grand Highlander, artist Sophia Chang posted up as the "Cartist in Residence," sketching 1-of-1 personalized portraits on co-branded postcards for guests. Meanwhile, the Toyota RAV4 was turned into a trivia hot seat. Attendees hopped in the back for “Par for the Car,” a 60-second trivia round on golf and culture, with a live leaderboard outside tracking the scores.At its core, Social Club is about the people actively p

items.title: ASICS SportStyle and Dime Reunite for a Motorsport-Inspired GEL-SD Lyte Collection
items.text: ASICS SportStyle and Dime Reunite for a Motorsport-Inspired GEL-SD Lyte Collection Summary ASICS SportStyle and Montreal-based label Dime have teamed up to release the GEL-SD LYTE in two new colorways alongside a matching apparel rangeInspired by the use of carbon fiber in automotive design, the collection blends lightweight construction with motorsport-influenced metallic finishesThe full footwear and apparel capsule officially drops on November 21 through Dime's website and physical store locations ASICS SportStyle and Montréal-based label Dime have come together once again to introduce the Dime x ASICS GEL-SD LYTE, accompanied by a matching collection of tracksuits and caps. Inspired by high-performance sports cars and the technical aesthetic of carbon fiber in automotive design, the collaborative capsule explores the balance between speed, durability, and lightweight construction.Originally taking inspiration from the protective structure of an eggshell, the collaborative GEL-SD LYTE features a molded upper engineered to provide a highly supportive fit. Reimagined through Dime's lens, the updated silhouette utilizes a two-tone mesh construction accented by glossy metallic detailing that channels the collection's automotive influences. For the tooling, the sneaker rests on FLYTEFOAM™ PROPEL cushioning to ensure responsive comfort and impact absorption underfoot.Extending the motorsport-inspired influence into everyday wear, the footwear is accompanied by a coordinated apparel range featuring track jackets, pants, and caps in complementary black and grey colorways. Drawing directly from archived ASICS training apparel, the relaxed tracksuits utilize water-repellent fabrics and breathable mesh detailing, seamlessly merging functional performance branding with Dime's understated streetwear aesthetic.The Dime x ASICS SportStyle collection will be available on November 21, 2026, via Dime's website and in-store locations. items.title: The Brand Crossovers That Shaped Culture in 2026
items.text: The Brand Crossovers That Shaped Culture in 2026 In 2026, the most interesting collaborations didn't stay in their lane. A football federation gave its kit to a Paris designer. A pop star turned a halftime look into a high-street wardrobe. Lunazul Tequila and a New York designer found a shared muse in the moon, and translated the spirit of blue weber agave into a moonlit runway capsule.The common thread was context. The pairings that mattered this year were tied to moments people were already living through: a home World Cup, a championship parade down Broadway, a festival debut, a fashion week under the Unisphere. They gave fans something to wear to the moment, not just something to collect.Below, we look back at the brand crossovers that shaped culture in 2026, where fashion met sport, music and lifestyle, and both sides came out bigger for it.LUAR x Lunazul TequilaFew pairings this year shared a muse quite so literally. "Luar" means moonlight in Galician and Portuguese, and Lunazul translates to "blue moon" in Spanish, a connection Raul Lopez summed up simply: "The moon brings people together." From there, the collaboration became a study in shared craft. Lopez stepped away from New York to visit an agave farm and follow the plant from seed to sewing machine, then built the capsule around vegan agave leather, a plant-based material that echoes the blue weber agave at the heart of Lunazul's tequila, a craft the brand has honed for more than seven generations. Lunazul's signature blue runs through the contrast stitching and leather details against deep black denim: black for the night sky, blue for the moon cutting through it. The result is LUAR's '90s hip-hop-inflected New York uniform, a trucker jacket with an agave leather collar, wide-leg shorts, a cap and a basketball-shaped bag, with the kind of detail you only notice up close, just as Lopez sees the meticulous work behind Lunazul's tequila.The capsule made its debut on LUAR's SS27 "Christopher Street Columbus" show, where the full look came down an outdoor runway circling the Unisphere in Queens just as the sun set, with Jose Alvarado in the front row. Three months earlier, the Brooklyn-born, Puerto Rican point guard had lifted the Larry O'Brien Trophy with the Knicks, ending a 53-year title drought, and he brought that hometown energy straight into fashion week. The night carried on at 99 Scott Street in Brooklyn, where Lunazul took over the afterparty with a custom bar, Lunarita and La Luna Rosa

items.title: F1 Drivers Will Now Race With WHOOP Strapped to Their Biceps
items.text: F1 Drivers Will Now Race With WHOOP Strapped to Their Biceps Summary WHOOP is now the first consumer wearable the FIA has approved for use during a Formula 1 raceDrivers wear the band on the bicep inside a specially designed fire-resistant sleeve for continuous physiological monitoringStarting in 2027, WHOOP Live will feed real-time data from participating drivers into the F1 broadcast WHOOP has signed a four-year global partnership with Formula 1, becoming the sport’s Official Health & Fitness Wearable Partner and the first consumer wearable the FIA has cleared for in-race use. The band makes its race debut at this weekend’s Las Vegas Grand Prix, the first time F1 drivers have been allowed to wear WHOOP while competing.Getting the wearable into the cockpit meant rethinking where it sits on the body. Instead of the wrist, participating drivers wear WHOOP on the bicep, held in a fire-resistant sleeve designed specifically for racing. The band tracks the body continuously, so it doesn’t stop when the car does. It logs how drivers respond to training, competition, long-haul travel and sleep around the clock. That builds on what the hardware already does for everyday members, with a 14-day battery and guidance across sleep, recovery, strain, fitness and longevity.The broadcast side is where fans will see it, under the name WHOOP Live. Starting in 2027, real-time physiological data from participating drivers will appear on F1’s coverage through the season. It will show at key moments like the start, a big overtake or the final lap, adding a layer of driver data next to the car telemetry the sport already shows. “Now, for the first time, we can show what happens inside a driver’s body during the most intense moments of a race,” said Will Ahmed, Founder and CEO of WHOOP, in a statement. WHOOP has done this kind of live broadcast data before, with the PGA Tour, the Giro d’Italia, the Tour de France and the WHOOP UCI Mountain Bike World Series.Lewis Hamilton, who drives for Scuderia Ferrari HP, is already a longtime user. “I’ve been using WHOOP for years to better understand my body, my recovery, and what it takes to perform at the highest level,” he said. The F1 deal expands on the WHOOP and Scuderia Ferrari partnership announced in January 2026. items.title: Vibram Opens the Doors to Its North Brookfield Factory for Second Annual Creator Program
items.text: Vibram Opens the Doors to Its North Brookfield Factory for Second Annual Creator Program Most people recognize Vibram by the signature yellow octagon on the bottom of their favorite boots, though far fewer have seen where those outsoles actually come from. From November 4 to 6, the brand opened the doors of its US headquarters in North Brookfield, Massachusetts, for the second edition of Made in North Brookfield. This year’s program brought together 15 creators, designers and brand partners from across the US and Canada, including Nicole McLaughlin, Ella Emhoff, Bailey Goldberg, John Chen of ArchivePDF, Gabriele Fazi of Kith and Victoria Wells of Arc’teryx. The three days centered on New England craft and American bootmaking heritage.North Brookfield is Vibram’s primary US manufacturing center, with factory roots in Massachusetts dating back to 1965. Now owned by Vibram, the plant makes soles for everything from industrial footwear to a classic American boot. It is one of the only rubber outsole factories operating in the US.The experience kicked off with a tour led by Christopher Nikopoulos, Vibram’s US VP of Operations, following the process from start to finish. In compounding, raw rubber is blended with custom performance formulas and colors. Milling then rolls the rubber into precise sheets, known as “breads,” ready for molding. Finally, in the molding presses, heat and high pressure vulcanize the sheets into finished outsoles with their final shape and tread.From there, the creators took over. In the boot and sole workshop, each one chose a custom rubber colorway and tread. They worked with either rubber pellets or shapes cut from rubber sheets, and placed the rubber into the molds themselves. The signature moment came with the yellow octagon: a separate piece of yellow rubber, made from its own special compound, set into the mold as the brand’s mark of quality.With the soles complete, focus shifted to the uppers. Supported by Easymoc, one of Maine’s last traditional bootmakers, the workshop used handcrafted Old Port uppers from the brand’s Lewiston workshop. Master cobblers Michele Pirrone and Refugio Contreras guided creators step by step through lasting, cementing the soles to the uppers and hand-stitching the finished pairs.At midday, bench work paused for “cucinare insieme,” or cooking together, with Matteo Ceppi, owner of Sugo Milano. items.title: Stone Island Brings NO SEASONS to Shanghai Art Week 2026
items.text: Stone Island Brings NO SEASONS to Shanghai Art Week 2026 Stone Island took NO SEASONS to Shanghai Art Week 2026, staging a dedicated installation at Capsule Plaza Shanghai @ IYOUTH from November 10 to 15. Designed with Milan studio NM3, the space marked the installation's China debut following its first outing at Milan Design Week in April.First launched by Massimo Osti between 1989 and 1994, NO SEASONS returns as a study in a single silhouette. One hooded jacket comes in six proprietary fabrics: Tela Resinata, Nylon Prismatico-TC, Raso Gommato, David-TC, Crinkle Reps NY and Panno. All six are dyed in lead-gray "piombo," so the material does the talking. Standouts include Tela Resinata, an evolution of the brand's foundational Tela Stella canvas, and David-TC, garment-dyed under pressure at up to 130°C for a compressed, textured hand.NM3 carried that logic into the space. Four powder-coated steel benches, upholstered in the same six fabrics, anchored the room, while the jackets sat on black metal shelving raised to eye level on a new plinth. "NO SEASONS is all about material. And so is our work," NM3 co-founder Nicolò Ornaghi told Hypebeast. "We solve all the design problem[s] basically using one single detail. So it's a metal sheet that is bent and screwed. That's it."Co-founder Francesco Zorzi saw the same approach in the collection. "It's actually the same attitude that Stone Island operated with in this collection," he said. "It's one jacket, one design, extremely well done, crazy good details, that works all season."An LED wall screened the collection's new global campaign film by Capsule, while SYLOW, the new Stone Island Sound system, powered a week of live sets from BYYB.Radio. The program also included a talk between NM3 and architect Guo Liaohui of Atelier Guo, and a collectors' panel moderated by Hypebeast China Editor-in-Chief Phil Gong.Asked to sum up the project in one word, Zorzi chose "rigorous." Ornaghi went with "very autonomous." "It's a very statement project from Stone Island I guess," he said. "And we tried to follow this and to have a very recognizable design and installation that can travel and be adapted to different spaces." Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Runtime Reportedly Confirmed
items.text: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Runtime Reportedly Confirmed Summary A new report suggests the standard version of the upcoming film will clock in at just under two and a half hoursMarvel Studios President Kevin Feige recently confirmed Robert Downey Jr is playing Victor Von Doom rather than an Iron Man variantRecent developments also tease the return of Scarlet Witch and the involvement of Deadpool and Wolverine This post may contain spoilers. Proceed at your own risk.According to recent industry rumors, Marvel Studios' highly anticipated Avengers: Doomsday might be shorter than audiences initially expected. While early speculation previously pegged the crossover event at two hours and 45 minutes, a new report from Omelete suggests a slightly tighter runtime for the upcoming superhero tentpole.According to Omelete, the standard theatrical cut will clock in at 2 hours, 29 minutes, and 36 seconds. The outlet also reports that an "Infinity Vision" edition of the film will run a little longer at exactly 2 hours, 30 minutes, and 55 seconds, owing to the inclusion of an extra scene. Disney has reportedly declined to comment on the rumored runtime, which would put the film roughly on par with 2018's Infinity War but considerably shorter than Endgame.Despite the potentially shorter timeline, the scope of the project continues to expand. Based on recent confirmations from Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige and co-director Joe Russo to Empire Magazine, Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom is officially Victor Von Doom, and the villain's backstory involves the tragic loss of a child. The film is also expected to weave in major character arcs, following the recent on-screen resurrection of Elizabeth Olsen's Scarlet Witch by Doom himself in the VisionQuest finale. items.title: Ford Celebrates Henry Ford’s First Race Win With the Mustang GTD 1901
items.text: Ford Celebrates Henry Ford’s First Race Win With the Mustang GTD 1901 Summary Honors Henry Ford’s 1901 "Sweepstakes" race car with a Royal Red exterior, black stripes, and exposed carbon fiber.Featuring Mahogany Red leather, suede, and F-22 fighter jet titanium hardware.Orders open December 2026 for Q2 2027 delivery. Ford has officially unveiled the 2028 Ford Mustang GTD 1901, an exclusive special edition that pays homage to the roots of the brand. Celebrating Henry Ford’s legendary 1901 victory in the two-cylinder “Sweepstakes” race car, the win that secured the financial backing to start the Ford Motor Company, the GTD 1901 merges racing heritage with cutting-edge engineering. Visually, the GTD 1901 turns the vintage black and deep red palette of the original Sweepstakes into a striking modern livery. The car is draped in a deep Royal Red finish, contrasted by an off-center black racing stripe split by a bright red centerline. Diagonal lines running off the strip inject a sense of motion, while exposed carbon fiber covers much of the car’s aero, including its towering active rear wing. To ensure the GTD 1901 lives up to its name, Ford’s aerodynamic performance Package comes standard, and buyers can opt for magnesium wheels in Black or Luster Nickel to shave over 50 pounds of unsprung weight.In contrast to the usual spartan interiors of track weapons, the GTD 1901’s interior is decorated with luxurious and bespoke touches. The seats are wrapped in Mahogany Red leather detailed with contrasting Race Red stitching, a hue extends to the seatbelt edges to echo the exterior stripe. Full-grain leather covers the instrument panel, door panels, and center console, while Mahogany Red suede lines the inner portion of the steering wheel. To give the car an extra special touch, Ford used 3D-printed titanium reclaimed from retired F-22 Raptor fighter jets for the lengthened paddle shifters, shock-tower-inspired gear selector, and a serialized passenger dashboard VIN plaque.Underneath the skin lies Ford’s iconic 5.2-liter supercharged V8 cranking out 815 horsepower and 664 lb-ft of torque to the rear wheels via an eight-speed dual-clutch transmission. Orders for the 2028 Ford Mustang GTD 1901 are slated to open in late 2026, with deliveries expected to begin in Q2 2027, joining the Liquid Carbon editions in offering collectors a bespoke take on American supercar engineering. items.title: Brad Pitt Reveals 'Ocean's 14' Filming Delayed Until Late 2027
items.text: Brad Pitt Reveals 'Ocean's 14' Filming Delayed Until Late 2027 Summary Brad Pitt has confirmed that the highly anticipated fifth installment of the Ocean's franchise will not begin filming until late 2027 Informat.roThe heist movie will feature the return of original cast members George Clooney, Julia Roberts, Matt Damon, and Don Cheadle, with David Leitch directing NewsBytesPitt also discussed his upcoming role in 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth', a sequel penned by Quentin Tarantino and directed by David Fincher Brad Pitt has officially provided an update on the production schedule for the highly anticipated Ocean’s 14. Speaking at the Hollywood premiere of his latest film, the actor confirmed that the next chapter in the iconic heist franchise will not begin shooting until late 2027, shifting from its previously scheduled start date next month.Despite the delay, the fifth installment of the beloved Ocean's series is gearing up to be a massive reunion. Pitt confirmed that George Clooney, Julia Roberts, Matt Damon, and Don Cheadle are all set to reprise their legendary roles, with David Leitch tapped to direct the project. Building anticipation for the film's narrative, Pitt praised the script crafted by Grant Heslov and Clooney, echoing earlier sentiments from Roberts who expressed her own surprise and excitement regarding the story's direction, "I tell you, Grant and George, they can write a good script."Beyond the heist franchise, Pitt is currently promoting The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, a sequel to Quentin Tarantino's acclaimed Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. Set a few years after the original film in 1970s Los Angeles, the project sees Cliff transitioning from Hollywood stunt work to a movie theater projectionist and occasional hitman. While Tarantino penned the script, directing duties were handed over to David Fincher, marking a reunion between Fincher and Pitt 32 years after their collaboration on Seven. The film also stars Elizabeth Debicki and Scott Caan. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: McDonald's and 'Home Alone' Unveil the Festive Home Alone Meal
items.text: McDonald's and 'Home Alone' Unveil the Festive Home Alone Meal Summary McDonald's is dropping four collectible pairs of Home Alone socks as part of a new holiday meal promotionThe nostalgic merchandise arrives alongside thematic menu updates like Little Nero's Pizza McShaker FriesMacaulay Culkin officially returns as Kevin McCallister to anchor the collaboration's advertising campaign McDonald's has officially teamed up with the beloved holiday classic Home Alone to release a series of collectible Home Alone socks alongside a thematic festive meal. Bringing a touch of 1990s nostalgia to the fast-food giant's menu, the limited-time offering places a heavy emphasis on exclusive apparel pieces and new culinary options inspired by Kevin McCallister's iconic cinematic adventures.Serving as the focal point of the promotion, each specialty meal arrives with one of four collectible pairs of socks. Available while supplies last, the exclusive apparel pieces feature distinct designs inspired by memorable characters, iconic scenes, and famous quotes from the legendary 1990 film. Anchoring the merchandise drop, actor Macaulay Culkin is officially reprising his historic role as Kevin McCallister for a dedicated advertising campaign celebrating the crossover.Beyond the collectibles, the collaboration introduces a themed culinary lineup available throughout the day. The standout addition is the Little Nero’s Pizza McShaker Fries, which pairs medium fries with a custom seasoning blend of tomato, garlic, Italian herbs, and cheese to replicate Kevin’s favorite plain cheese pizza. A new Lovely Cheese Pizza Dipping Sauce accompanies the launch, while an Everything Sundae McFlurry—combining vanilla soft serve with hot fudge, Oreo cookie pieces, and M&M’s—will be sold separately as a standalone dessert.The McDonald's Home Alone collectible socks and specialty meal drop on December 1 at participating restaurants nationwide. items.title: Cardón Tavern Turns DUMBO House Into a Tableside Steakhouse
items.text: Cardón Tavern Turns DUMBO House Into a Tableside Steakhouse Summary Soho House has opened Cardón Tavern, its new contemporary steakhouse concept, at DUMBO House in BrooklynThe menu leans on steakhouse and tavern classics, with steak tartare and a wagyu tomahawk both served tablesideCocktails like the Dirty Agave Martini and mezcal-based San Luis Swizzle point to a sister restaurant arriving at Soho Beach House Los Cabos in early 2027 Soho House has opened Cardón Tavern at DUMBO House, introducing its new contemporary steakhouse concept to Brooklyn. Named after a cactus native to Baja California, the restaurant pairs big steakhouse portions and a deep drinks list with the easygoing feel of a neighborhood tavern.The starters stick to New York steakhouse staples, with a few made at the table. A New England Crab Cake and Shrimp Cocktail with horseradish sit next to East and West Coast oysters. The Steak Tartare is finished tableside, which makes even the first course feel like a bit of a show.The mains are built around hand-picked steaks, led by a wagyu tomahawk brought out and presented at the table. For non-beef eaters, there’s whole fish, lobster and a chicken stuffed with truffle. Dessert brings the house Cardón Sundae and a Chocolate Soufflé served with warm chocolate sauce and vanilla ice cream, along with Apple Crumble and New York Cheesecake.The bar program is where Cardón’s Los Cabos connection shows most. The Dirty Agave Martini mixes Patrón Reposado with tomolive brine, the San Luis Swizzle is built on mezcal, and a Cobbler uses Patrón Añejo. A classic Manhattan, a Cosmopolitan and a dedicated martini menu cover the New York side, backed by a sommelier-chosen wine list and a short selection of draft beers.DUMBO House’s dining room has been redesigned around the new concept. Long tables are set up for group dinners, with exposed wood and warm brass under dim lighting to keep the room intimate. Running the kitchen is Head of Culinary Jonathan Benno, formerly of Per Se and Lincoln Ristorante, with VP of Culinary Joshua Brown, who previously worked at Groot Hospitality and Wolfgang Puck. Director of Bar and Beverage Mark Murphy, who comes from STARR Restaurants, and New York Area Head of Bars and Beverage Javier Salgado, formerly of Schroeder Hospitality Group, lead the drinks.Cardón Tavern serves dinner at DUMBO House Tuesday through Saturday, with reservations available through the Soho House app.DISCLAIMER: We discourage irresponsible and/or underage

items.title: Rolls-Royce’s Backgammon Set Hides a Self-Centering Spirit of Ecstasy in Its Hinge
items.text: Rolls-Royce’s Backgammon Set Hides a Self-Centering Spirit of Ecstasy in Its Hinge Summary Rolls-Royce’s Bespoke Collective spent more than a year developing the Backgammon Set at the Home of Rolls-Royce at GoodwoodA proprietary aluminum hinge counter-rotates the central spine as the case opens, revealing the board, the counters and a Spirit of Ecstasy that rights itselfOchre, stone and sand tones throughout the set point back to backgammon’s origins in ancient Mesopotamia Rolls-Royce Motor Cars has unveiled the Backgammon Set, a playable objet d’art built by the marque’s Bespoke Collective at the Home of Rolls-Royce at Goodwood. It sets one of the oldest known board games inside a mechanical case engineered with the same rigor as the marque’s cars, and it’s made to sit in a client’s home as a working game and a permanent display piece.The set is built around a proprietary hinge machined from a single billet of aluminum, hand-polished, then anodized. As the case swings open, the central spine turns the opposite way to reveal the playing pieces and the board underneath. A Spirit of Ecstasy mounted on the hinge always turns upright, wherever the board comes to rest, using the same idea as the self-leveling wheel center caps on a Rolls-Royce. The counters are stored inside the spine. The precision dice, the doubling die and two dice shakers sit around a removable plinth that also works as the bar for captured counters.Solid American walnut forms the board, chosen because it’s strong enough to carry the weight of the hinge. The playing surface is book-matched at 55 degrees, the same angle Rolls-Royce uses for veneer inside its cabins, and every sheet is checked one by one so the stones slide cleanly. Each point on the home and outer boards is marquetry, precision-cut from open-pore Royal Walnut and Smoked Eucalyptus veneers. The design team played the game together throughout the yearlong development, and those sessions shaped everything from how much the stones weigh to how the components are laid out.The stones are machined from a composite infused with bauxite ore and come in Deep Night Sky black and Antarctica white. Their high-gloss finish carries a faint fleck that flashes under light, and in the hand they feel heavy and smooth, more like river stones than standard checkers. items.title: NOVITEC Gives the Ferrari 12Cilindri an Elegant Carbon Fiber N-Largo Widebody Kit
items.text: NOVITEC Gives the Ferrari 12Cilindri an Elegant Carbon Fiber N-Largo Widebody Kit Summary Novitec’s carbon-fiber N-Largo kit widens the Ferrari 12Cilindri significantly.The upgrade includes aerodynamic enhancements, custom Vossen wheels, and a gold-plated exhaust.Production is limited to 20 units. German tuning house Novitec has unveiled its latest N-Largo project, giving Ferrari’s flagship V12 grand tourer, the 12 Cilindri, a widebody kit. Designed by long-time collaborator Vittorio Strosek, the aim was to enhance the original, rather than creating something entirely different from what Ferrari originally intended.Constructed entirely from high-strength, lightweight carbon fiber, the N-Largo kit dramatically alters the 12Cilindri’s proportions, widening the front by 7 cm, and pushing out the rear by a substantial 13 cm. Refined in a wind tunnel, the new front fascia replaces the standard car’s Daytona-inspired black band in favor of a larger intake system, and an integrated spoiler engineered to reduce front-axle lift at high speeds. The most striking change they did is a custom one-piece carbon hood, which features an opening that prominently showcases the V12 engine’s dual red intake manifolds.At the rear, Novitec eliminates the rear window entirely in favor of a carbon fiber lid with three narrow viewing slits to save weight. Ferrari’s active aero flaps have been replaced with a sculpted three-part ducktail spoiler spanning the rear to provide fixed downforce, which sits above a massive carbon fiber diffused that houses the quad-exit exhaust.To fill the expanded wheel arches, Novitec once again collaborated with Vossen to create NF12 N-Largo forged wheels. The staggered setup, 21 inches in the front, and 22 inches in the rear, features five Y-shaped spokes, a deep concave profile in the back, and a stylized center-lock nut. The aggressive stance is rounded out by Novitec sports springs, which drop the 12Cilindri’s ride height by around 30 mm.Novitec has also upgraded the soundtrack, equipping the 12Cilindri N-Largo with a high-performance stainless steel exhaust system featuring actively controlled valves for adjustable acoustics. For maximum heat dissipation and a touch of luxury, buyers can opt to have the entire exhaust system plates in 999 fine-gold.Limited to just 20 units, the NOVITEC Ferrari 12Cilindri N-Largo will be highly exclusive. items.title: Globe-Trotter Rewrites Its Signature Case for Lighter Travel With GT897
items.text: Globe-Trotter Rewrites Its Signature Case for Lighter Travel With GT897 Summary Globe-Trotter’s GT897 collection is the British luggage house’s lightest and most streamlined case yet.A zip-around construction replaces the traditional frame and locks while keeping Vulcanised Fibreboard and rivets.Four colorways launch now, with Black and Oxblood arriving in 2027. Globe-Trotter has unveiled GT897, a new collection that asks how light one of its cases could get. The name nods to 1897, the year the British luggage house was founded, and the line is its slimmest and lightest take on the signature case so far. Since then, every Globe-Trotter suitcase has been handmade in Hertfordshire, England, by artisans using original Victorian-era methods and machinery, and the brand’s cases have been carried by figures ranging from Captain Robert Falcon Scott and Queen Elizabeth II to Eddie Redmayne and Kate Moss. GT897 is built for frequent, spontaneous travel, whether that means long-haul flights, city breaks, business trips or last-minute weekends. It gives first-time buyers a new way into the brand and gives longtime owners a more relaxed alternative to the classic case.The biggest change is the opening. The traditional frame and locks are gone, replaced by a zip-around construction that softens the case’s curves and trims its profile. The details that identify a Globe-Trotter are still there: Vulcanised Fibreboard, leather trims, nickel hardware and exposed rivets, so the case reads as Globe-Trotter from across a room and shows its new form up close.“What makes GT897 special is the refined balance between new materials and production details that make our designs recognisable,” Executive Chairman Vicente Castellano told Hypebeast in an exclusive statement. “The leather finishes, nickel hardware and exposed rivets retain a clear connection to our heritage, while the overall form brings a different expression of the brand. It is not about replacing what came before but instead continuing to evolve the collection and introduce new ways for people to enjoy Globe-Trotter.”The collection launches in a pared-back palette of Black, Navy and Cream, each paired with nickel hardware to keep attention on the silhouette, alongside a Green and Brown option inspired by the brand’s travel heritage. items.text: Take a Look at A24 Music’s Custom Audio-Technica Sound Burger Summary A24 Music and Audio-Technica launch a limited-edition Sound Burger portable turntable.The Bluetooth-enabled AT-SB727 features a custom red, blue, and green colorway.Priced at $270 USD, the 1,000-unit drop hits A24’s webstore. A24 Music has officially teamed up with Audio-Technica to introduce the Sound Burger A24 Music Edition. Serving as a limited-edition iteration of the AT-SB727 portable turntable, the collaborative release breathes new life into a historic piece of audio tech. Originally introduced to the market in 1982, the Sound Burger is celebrated for its highly unique, compact design that allows vinyl records to spin outside of the main body, enabling users to play physical media without the need for a full stereo setup.Aesthetically, the A24 Music Edition updates the retro turntable with a striking, signature red, blue, and green colorway. The highly portable device features an exclusive panel stamped with an original A24 Music logo design, alongside a special emblem plate to mark the partnership.In terms of technical specs, the internal AT-SB727 mechanism supports both 33-1/3 and 45 RPM records and boasts a USB-C rechargeable battery that delivers approximately 12 hours of playback. Embracing modern connectivity, the device seamlessly streams audio to wireless speakers and headphones via Bluetooth 5.2, while also providing a traditional RCA cable for wired home setups.Priced at $270 USD with only 1,000 units produced, the Sound Burger A24 Music Edition is sold exclusively through A24’s website and only in North America. Pre-orders are now open via the A24 Shop, and units are expected to ship in late January 2027. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 12_Things Rejects The Conventions of Perfumery
items.text: 12_Things Rejects The Conventions of Perfumery 'Challenging' isn't a word you'd normally use when describing perfumes and colognes, but its a term that's become somewhat of an inspiration for a new fragrance brand named 12_Things. Founded in London by Charlie Vickery, the brand has been built around a "rejection of conventional perfume language", resulting in notes taken from unexpected sources. Throughout the initial collection of eight fragrances, Vickery explores modern life, particularly one spent in the city. Rather than your typical rose, vanilla, or musk, he opts for a combination of skin, salt, asphalt, oxygen, plastic, metal, ink, dust and air. Even the names themselves are intentionally evocative – some more literal than others: Inkskin; White Dust; Infrastructure; Condensation; Vacuum; Interference; Cold Storage; and Void. "The smells that stay with me are often the ones nobody would put in an advert," Vickery says. "A hospital corridor can hold an entire period of your life. The smell of rain lifting off asphalt can tell you where you belong. I wanted to give those experiences the care normally reserved for more beautiful subjects."Every detail, from the bottle, through to the store itself, is the brainchild of Vickery. "The physical experience matters as much as the image on a screen," he says. Conceptually, Vickery also wants clients to think about the end of the brand – which may seem like a funny idea, considering it's only just launched. This particularly manifests in the physical store itself, which gradually deconstructs as each perfume is bought. Inside the London space, located at 198 Hackney Road, the perfumes are kept inside reclaimed bank vault drawers. "When someone buys a store edition, a drawer leaves with them. Each purchase removes a piece of the room," he adds."The store has an ending built into it. You can see the effect of the transaction on the space, and take part of it home. The brand has the right to end, too. Once it is gone, you cannot repeat the past."Take a look at the store in the gallery above, and head to the 12_things website to find out more. items.title: Kith and Hasbro Teases the 'Star Wars' Sith Collection With Limited-Edition Figures and Accessories
items.text: Kith and Hasbro Teases the 'Star Wars' Sith Collection With Limited-Edition Figures and Accessories Summary Kith has fully unveiled its expansive 'Star Wars' capsule featuring limited-edition Hasbro Black Series action figuresThe collection includes Darth Vader and Darth Maul collectibles alongside Canadian maplewood skate decks and playing cardsThe 'Sith Collection' drops early at Kith London on November 20 before a global launch on November 25 Kith has fully unveiled the expansive accessory lineup for its upcoming Star Wars Sith Collection. Partnering closely with Hasbro, the New York-based lifestyle brand is bringing the dark side of the Force to life through a meticulous range of limited-edition collectibles, home goods, and premium action figures.Anchoring the release are two exclusive 1:12-scale Hasbro Black Series action figures starring Darth Vader and Darth Maul. Each highly detailed collectible features approximately 20 points of articulation and arrives in custom 1990s-inspired co-branded packaging. The Darth Vader figure includes a lightsaber hilt, a blade attachment, a custom Kith-branded lightsaber effect, and a monogrammed display base. Similarly, the Darth Maul figure comes equipped with six accessories, including two connecting lightsabers to form his signature double-bladed weapon and dual Kith-branded effects.Beyond the action figures, the capsule delivers a range of lifestyle accessories steeped in Sith lore. The assortment also includes a custom black playing card deck highlighting characters from across the saga, alongside 24x35.5-inch movie posters depicting iconic dark side figures like Emperor Palpatine. Rounding out the collection are heavy-duty natural rubber mouse and media pads showcasing vintage-inspired graphics, epic space battles, and cinematic spacecraft.The Kith x Star Wars Sith Collection releases early at Kith London on November 20. A global release will follow on November 25 at 11 a.m. EST across all Kith shops, on online, and via the Kith App. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Kith (@kith) View this post on Instagram A post shared by Kith (@kith) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: A Night Out in NYC with Xaviersobased and PUMA
items.text: A Night Out in NYC with Xaviersobased and PUMA A party for the new Hypebeast Magazine issue with Xaviersobased and his hometown crowd — what better way to spend a Friday the 13th? Last week, we celebrated the launch of The Juice Issue with the cover star in New York City, and between the pop-up signing and live performance, the energy never let up.First stop was Iconic Magazines & Cafe, a perennial Nolita favorite. Fans started wrapping the building hours before Xav pulled up, and by the time he arrived, donning his signature green hair and a new pair of earrings he copped for the occasion, the street was packed. From behind the cafe's counter, he signed copies for a few hours, took photos with fans, and even gave away free copies. Of course, his mom and aunt showed up to show some love.Afterwards, Xavier and the crowd moved the night to lounge one4one just a short walk away. The floor filled quickly as DJs Nurse and Rennessy set the tone before the rapper took the mic for a performance of his own. The setlist included songs from his self-titled album, like "Room service" and "Party at my place," before moving into the earlier "Softer" and unreleased "Wassup W It." Sporting classic PUMA Suedes, that he eventually tossed into the crowd, he kept the momentum up as fans and friends packed in close.This year has been a big one for the under-turned-overground rap star — a debut album, a world tour with Ken Carson, another of his own, all with Coachella 2027 on the horizon — and there's no signs of slowing down. His stage is only growing, but as the night proved, keeping his people close as always part of the plan. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Ann Demeulemeester and Billy Idol Connect for a Graphic-Heavy Capsule Collection Summary Ann Demeulemeester and Billy Idol have teamed up on a limited ten-piece capsule timed to the musician’s Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductionCreative Director Stefano Gallici draws on Idol’s 1980s image and archive, putting lyrics, song titles and photo references into the graphicsA black leather Perfecto with a burgundy collar leads a lineup of eight jersey styles and a striped open-neck knit Ann Demeulemeester and Billy Idol are celebrating the punk icon’s Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction with a ten-piece capsule collection. The linkup first went public when Idol appeared on the runway at Ann Demeulemeester’s Fall/Winter 2026 show. He then wore a custom look to the induction ceremony itself. This new drop represents the next stage in Idol's partnership with the brand: his musical and visual identity, reworked through the house’s moody, poetic lens. The cuts and styling and graphics of the line follow the look Idol made famous in the 1980s. At its core is jersey. Eight t-shirt styles span standard, relaxed, and micro fits produced in an ivory, ecru and washed black color palette. The graphics come straight from Idol’s archive. Lyrics and song titles such as “Eyes Without a Face” appear across the pieces, along with nods to some of the most recognizable photographs of his career. Completing the collection is a red-and-black stripe on the open-neck knit, and a hero limited-edition Perfecto jacket in black leather with a contrasting burgundy collar. The Ann Demeulemeester x Billy Idol capsule ranges from $350 for the micro t-shirt to $5260 USD for the leather jacket and is now available on the brand's web store, at Ann Demeulemeester boutiques in Milan, Paris and Antwerp, and through select retail partners. items.title: A Look Back at Maison Martell’s Creative Exchange in Chanteloup
items.text: A Look Back at Maison Martell’s Creative Exchange in Chanteloup Maison Martell invited four fashion visionaries to Château de Chanteloup earlier this fall. Serving as the base for a unique creative exchange, the historic estate, which the Cognac Maison has called home for decades, inspired discussions on heritage, craft, and, more importantly, future collaborations.The collective in attendance included Johannesburg-based multidisciplinary artist Rich Mnisi and Nigerian-American designer and image director Ugo Mozie, as well as New York-based designers Brandon Blackwood and Jacques Agbobly. Hailing from different areas of fashion, the experience aimed to bring them together under a shared mission of discovery, where they would find out what shapes their creative worlds.Before delving further into their own practices, the appointed “Swift Ones” explored the journey behind Martell’s cognacs, from the vineyard through to distillation, barrel-making and ageing. The group later took part in a blending experience, where they created their individual blends. The immersion also included the Signature Martell dinner at Château de Chanteloup, providing a gastronomic experience by three-Michelin-starred chef Alexandre Mazzia.The collective then joined heads for a group conversation led by Martell Culture Ambassador Ivie Ani. With the tour bringing heritage into perspective, they spoke about the stories that form their journeys. Reflecting on this, Mozie shared, “Every final expression is built through layers, people, process, material, time, and instinct. That is very similar to how I approach designing and styling; what you eventually see is the result of many different elements coming together with intention.”For Blackwood, an entrepreneur whose contemporary brand is built on visual identity, the experience was more about staying true to what makes you unique. “The brand has been around for generations, but it hasn’t lost what makes it special,” he said. “I think about that a lot as a founder: How to build something with a strong identity that people connect with but never stop evolving or challenging yourself creatively.”While the Swift Ones exchange helped to build relationships, it also set out to connect the Maison with contemporary culture and the people driving new ideas from a mutual respect for craft. Check out the gallery above to see what went down at the creative exchange. To find out more about Martell’s cultural programme, head to its website now. Click

items.title: Noah and Converse Take the Chuck 70 Back to the ’90s in Black Watch Tartan
items.text: Noah and Converse Take the Chuck 70 Back to the ’90s in Black Watch Tartan Name: Noah x Converse Chuck 70 TartanColorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: November 19Where to Buy: Converse, NoahConverse and Noah have teamed up on a new Chuck 70 Ox in Black Watch tartan, the navy and green check that began in the Scottish Highlands roughly 300 years ago and later became a mainstay of collegiate style. The pair keeps the focus on its materials and construction, giving the traditional plaid a Chuck 70 built to ’90s specs.The upper does most of the work. It is made from a three-tone woven canvas with the Black Watch plaid running across the whole shoe, so the pattern comes from the weave itself rather than a surface print. That gives the check a richer, more textured look than a printed plaid, and it suits the cold-weather timing of the release.Noah based the shoe’s build on Chucks from the ’90s. The brand removed the wing tongue stitch seen on the current Chuck 70 and swapped in a woven tongue tag, so the profile reads closer to how the shoe looked in that decade. The upper sits on a light brown gum rubber outsole, which warms up the navy and green and adds to the vintage feel.Inside, an OrthoLite sockliner adds cushioning for everyday wear. Noah keeps its branding minimal, placing it on the heel license plate, the tongue tag and the insole and leaving the tartan to carry the design. The release follows the two brands’ Spring 2026 Chuck 70 capsule, which first brought plaid into the partnership.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: NORQAIN Debuts the Arctic Blue Independence Skeleton Watch With a Redesigned Bracelet
items.text: NORQAIN Debuts the Arctic Blue Independence Skeleton Watch With a Redesigned Bracelet Summary NORQAIN refreshes its Independence collection with a slimmer, tapered stainless steel bracelet.Narrower lugs and a micro-adjust clasp sharpen fit and integration.The Skeleton 40mm debuts it with a translucent Arctic Blue dial. NORQAIN is refreshing its Independence collection, the sporty line at the heart of the independent Swiss brand’s catalog. The update has two parts: a redesigned stainless steel bracelet for the collection, and a new version of the Independence Skeleton 40mm, which builds on a design that debuted last year.The bracelet, now slimmer and more refined than before, still retains the original's sporty appeal with an asymmetrical design built around NORQAIN’s signature center link. That link has a gently curved lower edge, contrasting sides and a vertical brushed finish, framed by sculpted, brushed H-links with beveled edges.The bracelet tapers toward the clasp for a more balanced fit. NORQAIN has also reworked where the bracelet meets the case, using narrower lugs so the two flow together more like an integrated design. A micro-adjustment system built into the folding clasp lets the wearer fine-tune the fit during the day, and the clasp opens with discreet pinch-pushers on each side so it doesn’t break up the bracelet’s clean lines.The Independence Skeleton 40mm debuts with the new bracelet. Its translucent Arctic Blue dial lets the movement show through, then turns solid toward the edge so the hour and minute track stays easy to read. Inside is NORQAIN’s COSC-certified Calibre N08S automatic movement, with a 41-hour power reserve and a custom NORQAIN rotor visible through the sapphire caseback. The familiar Independence details carry over: hands and indices filled with white X1 Super-LumiNova, and the engraved steel NORQAIN plate on the left side of the case.The new timepiece will retail at £4,220 GBP (approx. $5,544 USD) and will be available through NORQAIN's official webstore and physical stores. items.title: Lamborghini Proves There Doesn’t Need To Be a Compromise With the Temerario Spyder
items.text: Lamborghini Proves There Doesn’t Need To Be a Compromise With the Temerario Spyder Summary Lamborghini unveils the Temerario Spyder, featuring its first-ever fully electric retractable hard top.Featuring a 907-horsepower twin-turbo V8 hybrid powertrain catapults the supercar from 0 to 62 mph in 2.8 seconds.An enlarged cabin and 13 driving modes ensure uncompromised comfort and performance. Lamborghini has officially unveiled the Temerario Spyder, marking 50 years of open-top series-production with another bold engineering milestone. A first for any Lamborghini Spyder, the supercar features a fully electric retractable hard top.Rather than relying on traditional hydraulics, the roof utilizes ten electric actuators to tuck vertically behind the seats. This packaging preserves the car’s weight distribution while lowering its center of gravity by three mm when stowed. The entire mechanism operates at near silence, taking 17 seconds to go up or down at speed of up to 31 mph. Underneath, torsional rigidity has been increased by six percent over its predecessor while reducing structural complexity. Power comes from a HPEV setup, mating its flat-plane 4.0 liter twin-turbo V8 with three electric motors. Revving to a screaming 10,000 rpm, the hybrid powertrain churns out a combined 907 horsepower and 590 pound-feet of torque, catapulting the car from 0-to-62 in just 2.8 seconds.Inside, the enlarged cabin gains space over its predecessor, comfortably fitting drivers up to two meters tall, complete with integrated neck warmers and an electronically adjustable rear window that lets occupants listen to the V8 sing. With 13 selectable driving modes, including a three-level Drift mode and quiet all-electric cruising, the Temerario Spyder proves that there doesn’t need to be a compromise when turning a coupe into a convertible. View this post on InstagramA post shared by Lamborghini (@lamborghini) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Golden Goose and Shah Rukh Khan's D'YAVOL X Unveil Debut Collaboration
items.text: Golden Goose and Shah Rukh Khan's D'YAVOL X Unveil Debut Collaboration Summary Golden Goose has teamed up with D'YAVOL X for a new collection of co-branded footwear and ready-to-wear apparelThe capsule reimagines the iconic Super-Star sneaker alongside washed cotton workwear jackets, hoodies, and graphic teesThe first release arrives on November 24 with a second drop planned for early 2027, featuring pieces from the upcoming film 'King' Golden Goose and luxury lifestyle brand D’YAVOL X have officially teamed up for an exclusive collaborative apparel and footwear collection. Co-founded by global icon Shah Rukh Khan alongside his son Aryan Khan, Leti Blagoeva, and Bunty Singh, the streetwear imprint merges its contemporary aesthetic with the Italian label's signature craftsmanship.The comprehensive capsule spans a selection of sneakers, ready-to-wear garments, and accessories. Highlighting the footwear offering, the collection reinterprets Golden Goose’s iconic Super-Star sneakers in three exclusive unisex colorways. The lineup includes a silver laminated leather version detailed with black suede, a white leather iteration featuring a red suede star, and two distinct black leather styles. Standout details on the silver and white pairs include "D'YAVOL X" foxing lettering, finished with either "Forever King" or "No crown needed" phrases and red 'X' branding on the upper.Beyond footwear, the apparel range is anchored by a charcoal-grey washed cotton workwear jacket adorned with silver studs and a black velvet collar. The ready-to-wear selection is rounded out by unisex T-shirts and relaxed hoodies in washed cream, charcoal grey, and burgundy, alongside a women's crystal-embellished cropped hoodie and a burgundy baseball cap. Notably, iconic pieces from the collaboration are set to be featured in Shah Rukh Khan’s upcoming movie, King, and this drop marks the first time D'YAVOL X collections will be available at physical retail locations.The first release of the Golden Goose x D’YAVOL X collection drops on November 24, 2026, followed by a second release in early 2027. The capsule will be available at Golden Goose stores across India and online via the brand's official webstore in select countries. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Gucci to Present Cruise 2028 Collection in Shanghai
items.text: Gucci to Present Cruise 2028 Collection in Shanghai Summary Gucci has officially announced its Cruise 2028 runway show will take place in Shanghai on May 17The upcoming presentation marks artistic director Demna's first show in the Chinese metropolisThe event coincides with the 30th anniversary of the brand's original store opening in the region Gucci is officially heading to China to debut its highly anticipated Cruise 2028 collection. Scheduled for May 17, the upcoming runway presentation will take place in Shanghai, marking a major milestone for the Italian luxury house as it celebrates the 30th anniversary of its very first store opening in the country.While the event serves as artistic director Demna’s first show in the city, Gucci is no stranger to the Chinese metropolis. The heritage brand previously hosted runway presentations in Shanghai for its Fall 2012 collection under Frida Giannini and its centenary Aria collection by Alessandro Michele in 2021. The label has also maintained a strong cultural footprint in the region through various high-profile exhibitions, including 2015's "No Longer / Not Yet," the Maurizio Cattelan-curated "The Artist Is Present" in 2018, "Gucci Cosmos" in 2023, and "Gucci Bamboo: Decoding an Icon" in 2025.The Shanghai announcement follows Demna's massive debut Cruise collection for the house, which took over New York City's Times Square last May. Despite wider reports of a luxury slowdown in the region, major fashion houses continue to heavily invest in Chinese activations this season. Notably, Jonathan Anderson will present Dior's Cruise 2028 collection in Shanghai just days prior on May 14, while Zegna plans to showcase its Spring 2028 range in Beijing on June 11. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike's 3D-Printed AIRMAX 1000 Just Got Even More Customizable With Zellerfeld
items.text: Nike's 3D-Printed AIRMAX 1000 Just Got Even More Customizable With Zellerfeld Summary Nike updates the Zellerfeld 3D-printed AIRMAX 1000 on Nike By You with embossed custom heel text.A new Lilac upper colorway joins Black and Stone, alongside seven independent Air unit colors for each shoe.Options launch November 19 on Nike's website. Name: Nike AIRMAX 1000 By YouColorway: Multi-Color/Multi-ColorSKU: JK3542-900MSRP: $190 USDRelease Date: November 19Where to Buy: NikeNike is once again pushing the boundaries of footwear customization with a major update to the AIRMAX 1000. Following its initial October debut, the 3D-printed silhouette, developed in partnership with Zellerfeld, is rolling out with a new suite of personalization features with Nike's By You feature that leans even deeper into individual expression.AIRMAX 1000 owners can add custom text directly onto the sneaker’s heel, positioned just above the Air unit. Rather than relying on traditional screen printing or embroidery, the personalized text is integrated directly into the shoe during the manufacturing process. Leveraging Zellerfeld’s 3D-printing technology, the wearer’s name, initials, or short message is formed as raised, embossed lettering that becomes part of the shoe’s sculpted surface.The colors on the upper also receive a upgrade, with a fresh Lilac joining the existing Black and Stone palette. Notably, Nike now allows customers to go for asymmetrical styling by allowing wearers to choose from seven distinct Air unit colors independently for the left and right shoes. Whether it is a clean, monochromatic look, or a bold, mismatched one, the expanded palette gives the 1987 Air Max 1 inspired silhouette a brand new look.The updated AIRMAX 1000 By You customization options go live today, November 19, exclusively via Nike’s website Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: First Look at the Air Jordan 11 Low Golf "The Masters"
items.text: First Look at the Air Jordan 11 Low Golf "The Masters" Summary Jordan Brand has an Air Jordan 11 Low Golf lined up for the upcoming 2027 MastersThe striking pair features a green-and-white colorway inspired directly by the Augusta National tournamentThe modified sneaker officially drops in April 2027 as part of the brand's growing fairway lineup Jordan Brand is officially gearing up for the 2027 Masters with the introduction of the Air Jordan 11 Low Golf "The Masters." Tied directly to the iconic tournament at Augusta National, the forthcoming release serves as the latest addition to the brand's rapidly growing golf lineup, seamlessly transitioning familiar basketball models onto the fairway.Keeping the timeless look of the original basketball shoe intact, the new iteration arrives with a crisp white leather upper paired with a striking green patent leather mudguard. The carefully chosen shade of green perfectly mirrors the distinct color closely associated with Augusta National and the prestigious Masters Tournament.On the performance side, the silhouette has been heavily modified for the green. Underneath, the low-top sneaker rests on a green-to-silver gradient plate that features seven strategically placed circular spikes to ensure premium traction throughout the golf course.The Air Jordan 11 Low Golf "The Masters" drops in April 2027. Official pricing and retail channels remain TBA. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Maserati Celebrates a Century of their Legendary Trident at AutoClassica 2026
items.text: Maserati Celebrates a Century of their Legendary Trident at AutoClassica 2026 Summary Maserati celebrates 100 years of its Trident emblem at Milano AutoClassica 2026.A rare 1959 3500 GT Convertible Vignale Prototype is displayed alongside the new 490-hp GranCabrio.Historic motorsport icons also headline the showcase from November 19 to 22. Maserati is celebrating a century of its legendary Trident emblem by placing two of its iconic grand tourers side-by-side at Milano Auto Classica 2026. The showcase puts the ultra-rare 1959 Maserati 3500 GT Convertible Vignale Prototype next to the modern Maserati GranCabrio.Built in Modena and unveiled at the 1959 Turin Motor Show, the 3500 GT Convertible Vignale Prototype is one of just six units ever produced. Designed by Carrozzeria Alfredo Vignale under Giovanni Michelotti, the drop-top established the blueprint for Maserati’s modern convertible grand tourers. Having been meticulously restored over the past three years, the silver-bodied classic retains its original 235-hp, 3.5-liter inline-six engine and a striking ivory, red, and gold interior inspired by the Vignale emblem.Placed beside its predecessor, the contemporary Maserati GranCabrio demonstrates the evolution of their design language. Finished in Blu Emozione over a Greige leather and carbon-fiber cabin, the latest iteration features a redesigned front end for improved downforce and a wider track. Under the hood, Maserati’s F1-derived 3.0-liter Twin Turbo V6 delivers 490 hp alongside a new Country driving mode.Beyond the main booth, attendees can explore Maserati’s lineage in the main hall, with motorsport icons 6C34, the Tipo 61, and the 2014 Alfieri concept on display. The Milano AutoClassica runs from November 19 to 22, with tickets available to purchase online. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Albino & Preto and Affliction Join Forces for Combat Sports Capsule
items.text: Albino & Preto and Affliction Join Forces for Combat Sports Capsule Summary Albino & Preto has partnered with Affliction for a new combat sports and streetwear collectionThe capsule includes performance gear such as a co-branded Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gi and no-gi apparelThe full collection officially drops online this Friday, November 20 Albino & Preto and Affliction are officially joining forces for a collaborative capsule collection that bridges classic combat sports heritage with modern streetwear. Merging Affliction’s unmistakable early-2000s subcultural DNA—defined by aggressive tribal line work, gothic typography, and distressed aesthetics—with Albino & Preto's tailored, mat-ready design language, the drop delivers a complete crossover range built for both training and everyday wear.On the performance side, the collection reinterprets martial arts staples through Affliction’s rebellious lens. The lineup features a co-branded Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gi heavily accented with detailed embroidery and flame-tribal insignias. An expansive no-gi offering includes rashguards and training shorts bearing all-over cross-monogram prints and gothic co-branding, while a technical wrestling polo anchors the training assortment in functional athletic tailoring with branded collar details.Off the mats, the lifestyle selection translates that same raw energy into casual apparel. The range includes relaxed-fit washed denim detailed with oversized back-pocket graphics, layered long-sleeves, heavy hoodies, and sweatpants. Mineral-washed graphic tees featuring layered skull, ribcage, and tribal motifs round out the versatile crossover capsule.The Albino & Preto x Affliction collaborative collection drops online this Friday, November 20 at 11 a.m. PST. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Bottega Veneta Looks Homeward for Spring 2027 With "Colours of Venice"
items.text: Bottega Veneta Looks Homeward for Spring 2027 With "Colours of Venice" Summary Bottega Veneta unveils "Colours of Venice," a Spring 2027 photo series shot by Chris Rhodes.Under Creative Director Louise Trotter, the imagery pairs saturated hues with historic Venetian interiors.Accessories spotlight the iconic Cabat tote and the new, 1970s-inspired Verde handbag. Returning to its roots in the Veneto region, Bottega Veneta didn’t settle for just a tourist’s-eye view of the city. For Spring 2027, Creative Director Louise Trotter once again taps British photographer Chris Rhodes to lens “Colours of Venice,” a photo series that focuses on tactile, live-in study of light and surface instead of grand canal panoramas.Rather than treating the city as a static backdrop, Rhodes weaves between intimate interiors and open streets. Pink-plastered walls, intricate terrazzo flooring, rich damask fabrics, and gilded mirrors add textural depth to the clothing. Held close to the surroundings, the garments’ construction and saturated tones are highlighted through the use of natural light, creating a visual dialogue between Venice’s weathered surfaces and Trotter’s contemporary tailoring.Leather goods remain the anchor of the seasonal narrative. Alongside the signature Cabat tote, Spring 2027 introduces the Verde, a new handbag that channels the laid-back ease of 1970s designs into a compact, architectural silhouette. Finished with engraved gold-toned hardware, the Verde features a soft leather flap that lifts to reveal Bottega Veneta’s signature Intrecciato weave tucked underneath.Rooted in Bottega Veneta’s Venetian roots, “Colours of Venice” focuses on an understated conversation between place and craft. By letting the saturated colors and architectural textures take the lead, Trotter and Rhodes deliver a unique perspective on both the collection and the city. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bottega Veneta (@newbottega) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Oris and Doraemon Travel Through Time on a Big Crown Pointer Date Watch
items.text: Oris and Doraemon Travel Through Time on a Big Crown Pointer Date Watch Summary Oris reimagines its Big Crown Pointer Date with Japanese manga icon Doraemon.A light blue dial, red minute track and yellow hands mirror the character.A flying Doraemon caseback engraving marks the 1,000-piece edition. Oris is teaming up with one of Japan’s best-loved characters for its latest limited edition. The Swiss brand has released a Doraemon version of its signature Big Crown Pointer Date, inspired by the original manga by Fujiko F. Fujio, first published in 1970.Conceived around a shared fascination with mechanics and time travel, the timepiece channels the cheerful aesthetic of the 22nd-century robotic cat into a wearable, subtle design. The idea came from Jo Haertel Yamaguchi, Sales Manager of Oris Japan, who drew inspiration from the brand’s earlier Kermit the Frog edition and grew up reading the manga in the 1980s. “I don’t think we’ve ever seen a Doraemon watch as charming as this,” he said in an interview included with the release.The design keeps the references subtle. Housed in a 40mm multi-piece stainless steel case, this special timepiece features a vertically brushed light blue dial that matches Doraemon’s body color, while the red minute track picks up the color of his signature collar. The central seconds hand and the tip of the pointer date hand are yellow, a nod to the HOPTER, the propeller gadget Doraemon pulls from his 4D pocket so he can fly.Flipping the watch over reveals a caseback engraved with Doraemon in flight, a fitting touch given the Big Crown’s aviation roots, along with each watch’s limited-edition number. The fun extends to the packaging. The box sleeve features Doraemon, the back shows his TIME MACHINE, and inside is a microfiber cloth modeled on the TIME KERCHIEF, a gadget that can turn time forward or backward.Priced at 2,250 CHF (approx. $2,667 USD), the Oris Doraemon Limited Edition is limited to 1,000 numbered pieces and is available through the brand's webstore. items.title: Axel Arigato Invites You to Its Community Game Night
items.text: Axel Arigato Invites You to Its Community Game Night Axel Arigato has launched a new series titled Games We Play, which focuses on organizing community nights inspired by the time shared between people during game nights.Set to travel around the world, the first session of pool takes place in New York, followed by bowling in Berlin and chess in Stockholm. United through music, each stop on the tour is accompanied by a limited run of ceramics created specifically for the series by Sydney-based ceramist Gus Fredericksen of Slow Burn.The drops are an extension of his pre-existing work, exploring individuals around a ceramic table. “I love the whole atmosphere of old pool halls, the characters, the pub and everything that comes with it. Bowling and chess were a bit more of a challenge, as they were completely new territory for me,” he explains.Each piece is hand-crafted from stoneware, making no two the same. “It’s all the tiny details that I’m really proud of. The snapback on the back of the baseball caps, the sideburns on the characters, the collars on the shirts and all the little chess pieces,” he says. Each city will have a set of five incense burners tailor-made for the game played at the community events and offers a playful take on incorporating the functioning incense stick into the holders.The designs hold a familiar feeling reminiscent of active gameplay, whether in third spaces or within the home. “I like the idea of someone having one of my pieces sitting on a shelf or coffee table and people noticing all the little details. Then when they light an incense stick, it adds another layer to the whole thing,” Fredericksen says. “I don’t think art always needs to be too serious. If something I’ve made can make someone laugh or bring a little bit of enjoyment into their day, I’m pretty happy with that.”The Axel Arigato Games We Play runs until December 3. Explore the latest season with full details of the event on the brand’s website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Already at over one million members, it continues to redefine how fans engage with the sport.For this weekend’s Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix, the membership platform honed in on its community-forward ethos. Coming off its recent collaboration with Defected Records, it brought fans across genres together for a distinctive experience that extended beyond the racetrack. Mirroring the city’s energy, the activation delivered fitness, style and dance, all powered by non-stop beats. Providing a backdrop unlike any gym studio, the store overlooked the famously buzzing strip, allowing guests to take in the views while partaking in high-intensity fitness. With more activations scheduled later in the day, they were handed energy drinks to stay on top form. After the class, I / AM transformed the space for an exclusive after-party that brought music front and center. items.title: Victorian Spirits and the Sea Haunt ERCOLE Studio’s FW26 “Holy Water” Collection
items.text: Victorian Spirits and the Sea Haunt ERCOLE Studio’s FW26 “Holy Water” Collection Summary ERCOLE Studio has released its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, Holy Water, inspired by Oregon’s Heceta Head LighthouseStudded Japanese denim, and t-shirts and hoodies printed with themed graphics and vintage washes lead the lineupThe label was founded by creative director Abigail Hercules and Charlie Giannetti, and is based in LA where production also takes place ERCOLE Studio's FW26 Holy Water collection has landed. Featuring gothic, weathered pieces that build on the Los Angeles label’s detail-heavy approach, the line is a mashup of personal references from creative director Abigail Hercules, including Catholic motifs from her youth and Heceta Head Lighthouse on the Oregon coast. Pieces span studded Japanese denim, black corsets with sun-faded finishes, silver jewelry and graphic jersey. An independent label, ERCOLE Studio is run by Hercules and co-founder Charlie Giannetti, each of whom covers a different side of the business. Hercules leads creative direction with a background in fashion, styling and luxury retail, while Giannetti owns production, which takes place locally in Downtown, Los Angeles.Each ERCOLE collection builds a cinematic world using vintage research, natural fabrics and detailed finishing techniques. For Holy Water, the inspiration is the contrast of the Oregon coast, where lush forests seemingly collide with ocean cliffs, an environment that led Hercules to ruminate on spirits, the unknown and a sense of presence. The clothes take on this haunting feeling while bringing in additional personal references like rosary motifs and Victorian mourning jewelry, flipping them into ornate trims, stud patterns and visuals on patches.Tees and hoodies round things out. Their prints borrow from billboards along Southern highways, thrift-store finds and the line's own lore, which is derived from a short film concept Hercules herself wrote. Eco-friendly washes give everything a broken-in look straight off the rack and ensure that all of the pieces carry traces of the brand's characteristic laid-back California coast attitude.The ERCOLE Studio Holy Water collection is now available via the brand's website and stockists like ESSX in New York City, with prices ranging from $210 to $2,000 USD.
