items.title: Licensed to Dress: Will Jonathan Anderson's Dior Re-Tailor James Bond?
items.text: Licensed to Dress: Will Jonathan Anderson's Dior Re-Tailor James Bond? When Amazon MGM officially tapped Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond, it didn't just shake up British cinema—it ignited a massive high-fashion turf war. While the battle for 007's wrist dominates watch forums, the battle for his wardrobe is equally fiercely contested.Since Quantum of Solace in 2008, Tom Ford has served as the official tailor to MI6, outfitting Daniel Craig in razor-sharp, ultra-fitted suits that defined the era. However, Pattinson enters the franchise with a massive LVMH trump card: he has been a marquee global ambassador for Dior since 2013. Now, with the visionary Jonathan Anderson at the helm as Creative Director in this new era (2025 and beyond), the stars have aligned for a radical, hyper-stylish overhaul of the cinematic super-spy.Anderson is famous for blending traditional heritage tailoring with experimental volumes, technical pragmatism, and a touch of playful, subversive irreverence. If Pattinson brings his Dior contract into the 007 universe, it would mark a seismic shift from Tom Ford’s rigid traditionalism to Anderson’s avant-garde elegance.By pulling straight from Jonathan Anderson's Dior Men vision and Pattinson's own real-world Dior moments, here are five quintessential James Bond archetypes that would redefine the cinematic super-spy:The High-Stakes Meeting: The Sleek Tailored SuitThe Look: No Bond wardrobe is complete without a striking, perfectly tailored suit for a high-stakes meeting in a sun-drenched, exotic locale. Here, Pattinson brings an effortless 007 presence to a sleek, classic grey Dior suit. Whether it’s a sharp single-breasted silhouette with a crisp collar and tie, a commanding white double-breasted variation, or an intense all-black ensemble featuring a matching suit, shirt, and tie, Anderson's Dior blends traditional elegance with a modern sensibility. It can also easily be pared down with a blue shirt underneath to adapt to less formal situations. Ultimately, it is the perfect armor for stepping off a speedboat to confront a billionaire villain on their private island. items.title: Vintage Modern Reimagines Classic Muscle With the 840-HP Vintage Fastback
items.text: Vintage Modern Reimagines Classic Muscle With the 840-HP Vintage Fastback Summary Vintage Modern debuts the bespoke Vintage Fastback, pairing a handcrafted carbon-fiber body with a modern S650 chassis.Featuring a 486-horsepower V8, with an optional Whipple supercharger boosting output to 840 horsepower.Commissioned to order, pricing starts at $295,500 USD. Atlanta-based luxury vehicle builder Vintage Modern has unveiled a new addition to its range with the all-new Vintage Fastback. Unveiled at the inaugural American edition of Retromobile New York, the vehicle introduces a bespoke, classic-inspired silhouette engineered atop a contemporary 2026-27 S650 platform.Rather than restoring an old chassis, Vintage Modern handcrafts each Fastback from the ground up using modern underpinnings. Over 900 hours of craftsmanship go into each vehicle, pairing carbon-fiber body panels with billet-aluminum accents across the grille, door handles, and mirrors. A long hood with a functional scoop, sculpted side intakes, and full-width taillights give the coupe a wide, aggressive stance. Inside the cabin, it’s thoroughly modern, featuring digital screen, leather upholstery, and three distinct seat stitching patterns alongside an optional JL Audio sound system.Under the hood lies a 5.0-liter V8, delivering 486 horsepower and 418 pound-feet of torque. Drivers seeking an even higher output can opt for a 3.0-liter Whipple supercharger that pushes performance to 840 horsepower and 615 pound-feet of torque on 93-octane fuel. The engine is mated to either a six-speed manual transmission with rev matching, or a 10-speed paddle-shifted automatic. Additional notable features include a MagneRide adaptive suspension system, Brembo brakes, and a four-mode active exhaust. Unlike traditional restomods, the Fastback is built to meet Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards and includes eight airbags, crumple zones, and electronic stability control.Currently on display at Retromobile New York through November 22, each Vintage Fastback is commissioned to order in over 40 standard paint finishes or bespoke paint-to-sample options. Pricing starts at $295,500 USD, with allocations available now through Vintage Modern’s website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Receives PG-13 Rating With Unique "Bloody Images" Content Warning
items.text: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Receives PG-13 Rating With Unique "Bloody Images" Content Warning Summary Marvel Studios' upcoming ensemble film 'Avengers: Doomsday' has officially been rated PG-13The rating includes a unique content warning for bloody images, marking a first for the 'Avengers' franchiseThe highly anticipated film will officially hit theaters in the Infinity Vision format on December 18 Marvel Studios' highly anticipated Avengers: Doomsday has officially received its MPA rating. The massive ensemble film has been rated PG-13 for violence/action, bloody images, and language, signaling a noticeably darker, more visceral shift in tone for the Marvel Cinematic Universe.According to the official Film Ratings database, the "bloody images" descriptor marks uncharted territory for the franchise, which has historically leaned on standard "sci-fi violence" for massive blockbusters like Avengers: Infinity War and Avengers: Endgame. The shift signals that Doctor Doom's (Robert Downey Jr.) multiversal rampage will bring a heavier, more brutal edge to the screen. With a plot centering on Doom using powerful figures like Franklin Richards, Wanda Maximoff, and Bruce Banner to forge a new reality from a collapsing multiverse, the unprecedented rating warns that the impending hero casualties will likely hit harder than ever.As teased in early trailers, the villain is already inflicting serious damage, effortlessly blocking Thor's Stormbreaker axe and blasting the thunder god point-blank. Establishing a threat level that seemingly surpasses Thanos, the darker tone implies that the stakes for the remaining heroes are significantly higher—and potentially more fatal—than usual. As anticipation builds, the film will need to draw wide audiences to hit the projected $2.5 billion USD to $3 billion USD box office expectations set by recent releases like Spider-Man: Brand New Day.Avengers: Doomsday drops December 18 in theaters worldwide in Infinity Vision. items.title: NEON Drops Official Trailer for Luca Guadagnino's 'Artificial' Starring Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman
items.text: NEON Drops Official Trailer for Luca Guadagnino's 'Artificial' Starring Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman Summary NEON has unveiled the official trailer for 'Artificial', a new tech-focused drama directed by Luca GuadagninoThe film stars Andrew Garfield as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and explores the company's internal battle for control over artificial intelligenceThe corporate satire is officially slated to open in theaters on Christmas Day NEON has officially released the trailer for Artificial, a highly anticipated Silicon Valley drama directed by Luca Guadagnino. Starring Andrew Garfield as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, the darkly comic film unpacks the extraordinary 2023 boardroom coup that briefly ousted the tech executive before an employee revolt and intense investor pressure engineered his unprecedented return just five days later.Written by Simon Rich, the corporate satire examines the tense battle for control over artificial intelligence, highlighting the severe friction between OpenAI's original mission, its commercial ambitions, and the looming dangers of the technology itself. The film features a massive ensemble cast portraying the tech industry's most recognizable figures. Yura Borisov takes on the role of OpenAI co-founder and former chief scientist Ilya Sutskever, a central figure in Altman’s removal, while Monica Barbaro plays former executive Mira Murati. Cooper Hoffman stars as co-founder Greg Brockman, Ike Barinholtz appears as Elon Musk, and Mark Rylance portrays pioneering computer scientist Geoffrey Hinton, with Jason Schwartzman also joining the stacked roster.Originally developed at Amazon MGM Studios before being acquired by NEON, the project navigates the competing personalities and extreme power dynamics behind one of the world's most consequential companies. Garfield's portrayal of Altman delivers a charming, elusive executive whose unique ability to command absolute loyalty serves as the narrative anchor of the film.Artificial officially opens in theaters on December 25, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: beabadoobee Shares Long-Teased Fan Favorite “No Punctuation” From Upcoming Album
items.text: beabadoobee Shares Long-Teased Fan Favorite “No Punctuation” From Upcoming Album Summary beabadoobee announced her fifth studio album, Bananas 4 Cats , arriving February 19, 2027.Lead single “No Punctuation” trades Pylon's rock edges for an intimate, breezy acoustic sound recorded in east London.Following a surprise live debut at London's O2 Arena, the track centers on themes of home and devotion. beabadoobee has announced Bananas 4 Cats, her fifth studio album, on the same day as the release of its first single, “No Punctuation.”The news comes less than two months after the release of her Pylon album, which reached the Top 10 on the Billboard 200 and became her second consecutive UK number 1. It also follows her first US and UK arena tours, which wrapped with sold-out shows at Madison Square Garden, The Kia Forum and London’s O2 Arena.Bea frames the two records as different sides of the same person. Pylon was written and recorded on the road with a large cast of collaborators, while Bananas 4 Cats centres on the idea of home: it was made in her East London living room with only a friend, her partner and her cats for company. “I just needed to write an album like this after Pylon,” she says. “It happened naturally, I got back home and felt inspired, and made another album.”“No Punctuation” has near-mythical status among fans, who have traded snippets of it for more than four years. It only joined the setlist of "The Powerlines Tour" this week, and the O2 show ended with meowing over the sound system as the lights came up, a hint of what was coming. The finished song leans fully into Bea’s softer side. Acoustic guitar strums at an unhurried mid-tempo while reversed synth loops and light percussion gather behind it, and the lo-fi textures thicken until the track settles into a looping, hypnotic outro. True to the title, her vocal lines run into one another without hard stops, so the song feels like one unbroken thought.Lyrically, it’s a devoted love song about finding home in another person. The narrator has no wish to be anywhere else, because the person beside her already feels like home, and the chorus boils that feeling down to a simple, repeated declaration that this person is everything. After Pylon’s rougher, louder edges, it’s a tender first look at an album built around comfort and closeness.Listen to “No Punctuation" now across major music streaming platforms. beabadoobee's Bananas 4 Cats album will release on February 19, 2027. items.title: IWC and Mercedes-AMG Petronas Light up the Las Vegas Grid
items.text: IWC and Mercedes-AMG Petronas Light up the Las Vegas Grid Summary IWC and Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS unveiled bespoke racing suits for the Las Vegas Grand Prix.Inspired by Ceralume ceramic, the gear mirrors the material's day-to-night aesthetic shift.Kimi Antonelli wears white for daylight, while George Russell wears blue for the dark. Celebrating its longstanding partnership with the newly crowned nine-time Constructors’ Champion, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, IWC has unveiled a bespoke set of racing suits ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix.Designed for drivers George Russell and Kimi Antonelli, the custom gear translates the dual aesthetic of IWC’s Big Pilot's Watch Perpetual Calendar Ceralume directly onto the track. The Ceralume material, engineered to store light energy via Super-LumiNova pigments, shifts dramatically between day and night. To capture this transformation, the two drivers are hitting the Las Vegas Strip in contrasting colorways that mirror the material’s shifting states.Kimi Antonelli’s suit arrives in a clean white finish, channeling the crisp, daylight expression of the ceramic characterized by subtle interplay across white and gray tones. Conversely, George Russell’s racing suit is finished in a striking blue hue, serving as a direct nod to the signature bluish glow Ceralume emits once darkness falls.Blending their material innovation with high-octane motorsport apparel, the contrasting suits turn the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS duo into a striking visual spectacle of light and dark under the neon glow of the Las Vegas skyline. View this post on InstagramA post shared by Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team (@mercedesamgf1) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Erewhon Brings Its Viral Smoothies to NYC With Newly Opened The Tonic Bar Inside Kith Women Summary Erewhon is officially opening its first public New York location dubbed The Tonic BarThe new space is housed within the Kith Women flagship store in the heart of SoHoTo celebrate the launch, the brand is debuting an exclusive 'Erewhon State of Mind Smoothie' Erewhon has officially announced the opening of The Tonic Bar by Erewhon, marking its highly anticipated East Coast debut. Located in the heart of SoHo within the Kith Women Manhattan flagship, the new destination brings the Los Angeles-based organic grocer's signature wellness experience to New York City for the very first time.Open to the public seven days a week, the standalone bar concept will offer a curated selection of organic menu items, including signature tonics, superfood smoothies, bowls, juices, cold-pressed shots, coffee, and ceremonial-grade matcha. The new location maintains the same uncompromising standards for ingredient sourcing and preparation that have become synonymous with the brand's Southern California outposts.Commemorating the massive East Coast milestone, the location is introducing an exclusive Erewhon State of Mind Smoothie. The red-apple-inspired blend features organic cold-pressed apple juice, warming winter spices, goji berries, maca, creatine, and coconut cream. With this specific release, Erewhon is proudly supporting the Bowery Mission, a historic nonprofit offering care and healing for New Yorkers experiencing homelessness.The Tonic Bar by Erewhon officially opens on November 20 as a walk-in destination at 644 Broadway. items.title: côte&ciel and Joe Chia’s “What We Carry” Collab Folds Cotton Into Fluid, Shape-Shifting Bags
items.text: côte&ciel and Joe Chia’s “What We Carry” Collab Folds Cotton Into Fluid, Shape-Shifting Bags Summary côte&ciel and Joe Chia launch the "What We Carry" capsule collection.Origami-folded cotton LINGGI convertible backpack and fluid ENDAU crossbody bag.Available globally today with prices ranging from $310 - $370 USD. côte&ciel has teamed up with Malaysian minimalist designer Joe Chia on “What We Carry,” a two-piece bag capsule about how material and movement interact. Known for translating architectural geometry into ergonomic bags, côte&ciel meets Chia’s fluid, garment-focused tailoring in a project exploring both physical materiality and emotional weight.As Joe Goodwin from côte&ciel's marketing team notes, the duo aimed to unpack "what we carry" - not just literally, but emotionally - acknowledging how past experiences shape the way individuals move through the world. By filtering the brand's sculptural archives through Chia’s apparel sensibilities, the partnership creates what Goodwin describes as a sense of "jamais vu": an aesthetic that feels simultaneously familiar and entirely unexpected.Both bags are named after rivers in Malaysia, a nod to Joe Chia’s roots and the idea of flow. The LINGGI is a convertible backpack that also wears as a shoulder bag. Its crossed straps meet a soft, teardrop-shaped body that sags and fills out depending on its contents.As for the ENDAU, it's a crossbody that can also go over one shoulder. A single strap tapers into a sculpted, drop-like body, and in the product shots it hangs almost like draped fabric. Both bags are made from black cotton with a crinkled, textured surface. They’re built with an origami-style folded construction and have expandable main compartments that fit laptops up to 16 inches, though neither has a dedicated laptop sleeve.Small details tie the collaboration together. Satin-finish metal teardrop zip pulls carry embossed côte&ciel branding, and a black strap slider bears both brands’ names. Inside, a lined interior includes a zippered pocket for smaller items. The all-black, texture-led palette keeps the attention on shape and drape. The côte&ciel x Joe Chia “What We Carry” capsule launches globally today via coteetciel.com, with prices from $310 - $370 USD. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

First introduced as part of the brand's Thirteenth Collection, titled The Void, the new footwear serves as an expression of careless luxury and a statement of power borrowed and reclaimed.The Wall Street Loafer is cut from premium polished full-grain cowhide leather and rests securely on a sculpted leather outsole equipped with a stacked one-inch leather heel. The brand is also debuting a matching Mule silhouette. Both foundational styles are detailed with a debossed ERL logo at the side, lined entirely in natural full-grain leather, and feature an electric green lining discreetly concealed beneath the vamp.Expanding the premium offering, the range includes three specialty made-to-order silhouettes crafted from faux skunk fur: the Vamp Boot Skunk, the Wall Street Skunk Mule, and The Cozy Skunk.The Wall Street Loafer and Mule are available now in men's sizes 6 to 14 at ERL.STORE and the ERL Studio Store for $475 USD. The specialty faux skunk fur styles are available exclusively in-store and are made to order, with the Vamp Boot Skunk priced at $1,600 USD, the Wall Street Skunk Mule at $885 USD, and The Cozy Skunk at $1,200 USD. items.title: G-SHOCK Serves Up Salmon, Tuna and Ikura With Its Made-in-Japan Sushi Series
items.text: G-SHOCK Serves Up Salmon, Tuna and Ikura With Its Made-in-Japan Sushi Series Summary G-SHOCK debuts the Japan-made Sushi Series across the GA-2100, DW-5600, and DW-6900 silhouettes.Inspired by salmon, tuna, and ikura, featuring yunomi teacup casebacks and takeaway box packaging.Available now starting at $145 USD. G-SHOCK is serving up sushi. The new Sushi Series is made in Japan and turns three of the brand’s most recognizable models into tributes to one of Japan’s most famous foods, with each watch drawing its colors and details from salmon, tuna or ikura (salmon roe). All three are produced at Casio’s Yamagata factory, continuing a string of Japan-made, culture-themed G-SHOCK releases.Each model plays a different role on the plate. The GA-2100SSH takes on salmon, with a bright orange, marbled finish that mimics fresh fish, knife-shaped hour and minute hands and an inset dial shaped like a piece of nigiri. The square DW-5600SSH is the tuna piece, using translucent resin and a dial patterned after lean tuna, finished with a wasabi-green accent and a small tuna silhouette.The DW-6900SSH is modeled on ikura gunkan-maki: glossy salmon roe graphics over a translucent dial, a black bezel standing in for the seaweed wrap, and a white band underside that represents the rice. All three share a caseback engraving of a yunomi teacup, a nod to the cup of tea traditionally served at the end of a sushi meal. Under the theme, they keep standard G-SHOCK specs, including 200-meter water resistance and mineral crystals.The packaging is designed after the folded takeaway boxes sushi often comes in. Lifting the watch out reveals a hidden wasabi graphic that changes by model: a little for the salmon, a lot for the tuna and none for the ikura.Available to shop now via G-SHOCK’s official US webstore and select retailers, the Sushi Series retails between $145- $165 USD. items.title: Post Malone Is Throwing ‘Stoney’ a 10th Birthday Party at the Palladium
items.text: Post Malone Is Throwing ‘Stoney’ a 10th Birthday Party at the Palladium Summary Post Malone marks 10 years of ‘Stoney’ with a one-night-only show at the Palladium in Los AngelesThe concert falls on the album’s exact release date, and a VIP tier adds early entry and pre-show merch shoppingAn expanded anniversary edition follows two days later with eight previously unreleased tracks and a 7,000-copy Slime Green 3-LP Post Malone is celebrating a decade of Stoney with “Stoney 10th Anniversary - Live at The Palladium,” a one-night-only concert in Los Angeles on Wednesday, December 9, the same date his debut album arrived in 2016. Promoted by Live Nation, the show sits at the center of a wider anniversary rollout that also includes an expanded reissue of the record two days later.The show is set up as a strict one-off, with a single date at the Palladium and no general ticket sale planned. Landing on December 9 puts the night on Stoney’s actual 10th birthday, giving fans a dedicated celebration of the multi-platinum record that produced three RIAA Diamond-certified singles in “White Iverson,” “Congratulations” featuring Quavo and “I Fall Apart.”Instead of a standard on-sale, access ran entirely through Ticketmaster Request, which opened on November 18 at 9 a.m. PT and shut on November 19 at 10 p.m. PT. Applicants named their preferred ticket type and handed over payment details up front, with charges going through only for requests that can actually be filled. With demand expected to outstrip the number of available seats, some requests will go unmet, and those fans won’t be charged.A VIP package sits on top of the standard ticket, bundling general admission entry with a commemorative VIP laminate, an early-entry wristband, early access to the venue and pre-show merch shopping, among other perks.The concert also leads into a broader anniversary release on Friday, December 11, when a digital edition adds eight previously unreleased tracks to the album. Seven of those songs, all recorded during the 2016 Stoney era, carry over to the physical formats, while “Free” featuring Leon Thomas stays streaming-only. The headline format is a 3-LP pressed on Slime Green vinyl with a 12" x 24" poster insert and the never-before-seen cover art Rodney Matthews originally created for the album, and it also brings the original deluxe tracks to vinyl for the first time. A limited double CD with a panel poster and a limited double cassette complete the lineup.Post Malone’s “Stoney 1

items.title: Hennessey Unveils 1776 Off-Road Sub-Brand With Lifted RAM 1500 and 2500
items.text: Hennessey Unveils 1776 Off-Road Sub-Brand With Lifted RAM 1500 and 2500 Summary Hennessey launches 1776 Off-Road sub-brand, offering factory-backed customization for American trucks and SUVs.The debut lineup upgrades the RAM 1500 and 2500 with suspension lifts, exterior upgrades, and quilted interiors.Every vehicle sold directly funds educational scholarships through Folds of Honor. Hennessey has officially unveiled 1776 Off-Road, a new Texas-based vehicle enhancement aimed at delivering factory-backed customization for American trucks and SUVs. Stepping away from the extreme horsepower figures typically associated with the Hennessey name, 1776 Off-Road focuses on bold styling, practical off-road capability, and everyday usability for working drivers.Debuting with dedicated enhancement packages for the RAM 1500 and RAM 2500, the lineup equips both pickups with bespoke styling upgrades and substantial hardware. THe 1776 RAM 1500 features a six-inch front and rear suspension lift paired with 22-inch off-road wheels wrapped in 35-inch all-terrain tires, alongside a stainless cat-back exhaust with black tips, exterior upgrade, and a grille-mounted LED light bar. Stepping up to the heavy-duty 1776 RAM 2500 brings a BDS suspension setup with a four-inch lift, high-clearance radius arms, performance shocks, a dual steering stabilizer setup, and larger 37-inch all-terrain tires. In addition to the off-road enhancements, both models receive a signature Stars & Stripes bedside vinyl livery and raised exterior badging. Going into the interior, the package brings diamond-quilted leather and Alcantara seats, WeatherTech floor liners, and a numbered console plaque. Every 1776 Off-Road vehicle sold generates a direct donation to Folds of Honor, funding educational scholarships for the spouses and children of fallen or disabled U.S. service members and first responders. The 1776 Off-Road RAM 1500 and RAM 2500 packages are available now through participating RAM dealerships in the U.S., with expansion to Ford, GM, and additional Stellantis platforms slated for the future. items.title: UP THERE and New Balance’s 1890 “Horizon” Trades Mesh for Shiny Nylon Under Australian Skies
items.text: UP THERE and New Balance’s 1890 “Horizon” Trades Mesh for Shiny Nylon Under Australian Skies Name: UP THERE x New Balance 1890 “Horizon”Colorway: TBCSKU: U18901CYMSRP: $280 AUD (approx. $185 USD)Release Date: November 27Where to Buy: UP THEREThe New Balance 1890 “Horizon” by UP THERE lands as the two partners close in on five years of collaboration, reworking one of New Balance’s standout silhouettes of 2026 around a distinctly Australian color story. UP THERE leans on material swaps, a heritage New Balance shade and a few of its own long-running signatures to make the model its own.The inline 1890 usually pairs mesh with synthetic overlays, but UP THERE builds its version from shiny nylon and natural suede for a richer, more tactile finish. Instead of carrying over the printed graphics found on the general release, the suede panels are debossed, letting the detailing show through texture alone. Underfoot, full-length ABZORB tooling handles cushioning from heel to toe.The palette starts with Castlerock Grey, a heritage New Balance shade carried over from the 990v1, the model that kicked off the 990 line in 1982. Cerulean Blue and Scarlet Red play off that base, with both tones pulled from the wide-open skies over Australia that inspired the release.The lace shroud, a recurring UP THERE signature, is back on the 1890, this time in an iridescent finish that splits light into a full rainbow. The brand compares the effect to the glowing ring that can appear when the sun breaks through a passing shower. The shroud is removable, and the pair includes three lace options in total (flat, sawtooth and bungee), so it can be toned down with a white lace or a two-tone sawtooth setup for a more traditional look.UP THERE’s own green is kept to a minimum, appearing only on the branding and lace tips before resurfacing across the insole. That green footbed has been a fixture of UP THERE designs since 2023, giving the 1890 an immediate tell for anyone who has followed the Melbourne store’s releases.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: J.Crew Pulls Miles Davis off the Album Cover for Its “Centennial Collection”
items.text: J.Crew Pulls Miles Davis off the Album Cover for Its “Centennial Collection” Summary J.Crew marks Miles Davis’s 100th birthday with a limited three-piece capsule built from everyday staples.The 1983 Oxford nods to the shirt Davis wore on the cover of ‘Milestones’ and pairs a longer collar with J.Crew’s relaxed “heritage fit.”A vintage-wash graphic T-shirt and an embroidered washed-canvas cap complete the lineup. J.Crew is marking Miles Davis’s 100th birthday with Miles Davis x J.Crew: The Centennial Collection, a limited-edition capsule that carries the musician’s lasting sense of style into three everyday pieces. The lineup covers an Oxford shirt, a graphic T-shirt and a cap, and each one ties back to Davis through a specific design reference.The 1983 Oxford anchors the capsule and takes its cue from the Oxford shirt Davis wore for the cover of his 1958 album Milestones. J.Crew cuts it from all-cotton Oxford cloth with real substance to the weight, extends the collar slightly past standard proportions and loosens a classic shirt block into a relaxed shape the brand calls its “heritage fit.”The graphic T-shirt brings Davis in through a 1970 image by music photographer Glen Craig, who captured him performing at the Fillmore East, with J.Crew’s design team reworking the shot into the shirt’s artwork. The graphic sits on J.Crew’s vintage-wash cotton, and a co-branded neck label identifies the piece as part of the collaboration.Davis’s signature takes the lead on the cap, embroidered onto a body of hard-wearing washed canvas that echoes the faded finish of the T-shirt. That signature is the cap’s only Davis reference, keeping the tribute personal and pared back.Miles Davis x J.Crew: The Centennial Collection lands November 20 online, as well as in-store at J.Crew’s Bond Street, Rockefeller Center, Fifth Avenue, Century City, Newbury Street, North Michigan Avenue and Georgetown locations. items.text: Marvel Drops Sprawling 11-Part 'Avengers: Doomsday' Characters Poster Montage Summary Marvel Studios has officially revealed a massive lineup of new posters showcasing the ensemble cast of 'Avengers: Doomsday'The 11 interconnected images form a large montage featuring the combined forces of the X-Men, Fantastic Four, and AvengersVisual details in the artwork tease potential character team-ups and a major power upgrade for Thor Marvel Studios has officially revealed a massive new lineup of ensemble posters for Avengers: Doomsday. The posters also reveal detailed costume updates, such as Alan Cumming's Nightcrawler fully suited up for battle. Furthermore, the strategic character pairings across the montage hint at potential on-screen dynamics, notably pairing Vanessa Kirby's Invisible Woman with Tenoch Huerta's Namor—a nod to their comic book history.Among the most heavily discussed details is the poster featuring Chris Hemsworth's Thor alongside Chris Evans' Steve Rogers. items.title: Nike Hits the Grid With a Long-Term Formula 1 Partnership Starting in 2027
items.text: Nike Hits the Grid With a Long-Term Formula 1 Partnership Starting in 2027 Summary Nike becomes an official Formula 1 partner from the 2027 season under a long-term global agreementThe deal spans uniforms for F1 event staff, sporting apparel for F1 ACADEMY and fan collections across footwear, apparel and accessoriesA limited Nike x Las Vegas Grand Prix capsule debuts during race weekend, with more limited capsules planned from 2027 Nike and Formula 1 have signed a long-term global partnership that makes the Swoosh an official F1 partner from the 2027 season, with a remit that runs from event uniforms to fan-facing sportswear. Neither company has put a number on the term, but the scope is clearly mapped, covering F1’s own staff, the all-female F1 ACADEMY series, fan collections and new race-weekend experiences.The most direct piece of the agreement puts Nike in charge of dressing Formula 1 itself, with the brand named official apparel and uniform provider for F1 personnel at races around the world. The announcement makes no mention of individual teams or drivers, so this layer of the deal centers on the people working behind the scenes at each race weekend rather than the cars on the grid.Nike’s role with F1 ACADEMY leans harder into product development, with the brand named Official Sporting Apparel Partner of the all-female racing series and set to work alongside its athletes on future performance products. The series is built to support young women and girls in motorsport, giving Nike a direct line to the next generation of drivers as it shapes that gear.NIKE, Inc. President & CEO Elliott Hill tied the partnership to a competitive outlook he sees in both the brand and the sport. “Formula 1 is driven by competition, speed and a constant push to innovate. That’s an athlete mindset, and it’s one we share at Nike,” Hill said in a statement.For fans, Nike will produce sportswear collections spanning footwear, apparel and accessories, alongside new race-weekend experiences both trackside and away from the circuit. That product will roll out through a series of limited capsule collections beginning in 2027, with further details on both product and experiences to follow over the 2027 season and beyond.The first product from the partnership, a limited Nike x Las Vegas Grand Prix capsule, debuts November 20 during the Las Vegas race weekend at the Nike Las Vegas store at Caesars Palace and the F1 Hub at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas. items.text: Engineered Garments x NANGA Stuff 770-Fill Down Into Denim and Corduroy for FW26 Summary Engineered Garments and NANGA reunite for a fourth time, bringing back the Zip Jacket, Field Vest and Down Hoody.Every style is insulated with NANGA’s water-repellent UDD down at 770 fill power and produced in Japan.Each piece arrives in a choice of indigo denim, brown corduroy, navy tropical wool or black nylon. items.title: The Patek Philippe Watch That Rewrote Split-Seconds History Heads to Sotheby’s Zürich Exhibition
items.text: The Patek Philippe Watch That Rewrote Split-Seconds History Heads to Sotheby’s Zürich Exhibition Summary Sotheby’s ‘The Human Touch’ spotlights Patek Philippe’s Reference 1563 “The Doctor” in Zürich.The 1943 watch is the earliest known water-resistant split-seconds wristwatch.Once owned by Jean-Claude Biver, it’s the only example with a pulsation dial. Revealed as a centerpiece within Sotheby’s The Human Touch exhibition, the Patek Philippe Reference 1563, also known as “The Doctor,” stands as the earliest known water-resistant split-seconds wristwatch in horological history.The timepiece started life as a Reference 1436 split-seconds chronograph, movement number 862,420. That year, at the request of its first owner, Patek Philippe rehoused it in a 34.8mm water-resistant screw-back case by Taubert & Fils, the firm that took over François Borgel’s case-making business and kept its “FB” hallmark. The case is based on the Reference 1463 but made taller to fit the split-seconds movement, and it came with a two-tone pulsation dial, a scale used to measure a patient’s heart rate. The converted watch received a new case number, 630,552, and its case is stamped “Key 11” and “FB.”Only three examples of the Reference 1563 appear in Patek Philippe’s archives, and just two have the dedicated Taubert & Borgel case. Their case numbers are consecutive: 630,551, fitted in 1946 to the watch later owned by Duke Ellington, and 630,552, this one, fitted three years earlier. That makes “The Doctor” the oldest of the three, and the only one with a pulsation dial.The reference was unknown to the public until Ellington’s watch came up at Antiquorum in 1998, prompting Patek Philippe to issue an Extract from the Archives that officially confirmed it. This example comes with its own Extract, dated August 6, 2024, verifying its reference, movement and case numbers, and the 1943 conversion.It was also previously part of Jean-Claude Biver’s collection. Of the other two, one is in a private collection and the third is on display at the Patek Philippe Museum in Geneva. Sotheby’s has not published an estimate or price for “The Doctor,” so that remains TBA. With a steel Reference 1436 having sold for 6.3 million CHF (approx. $7.4 million USD) , interest from top collectors is likely to be strong. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: UNIQLO x Studio Ghibli "LIVE FOR TODAY, MY DEAR" UT Collection
items.text: UNIQLO x Studio Ghibli "LIVE FOR TODAY, MY DEAR" UT Collection Summary UNIQLO and Studio Ghibli unveil nine UT tees themed “LIVE FOR TODAY, MY DEAR,” releasing in the US in January 2027.Toshio Suzuki’s all-character illustration leads adult designs spanning Totoro, Howl and the Robot Soldier from Castle in the Sky . UNIQLO and Studio Ghibli have announced a new UT graphic tee collection built around the theme “LIVE FOR TODAY, MY DEAR,” a reminder to enjoy each day that runs through the whole lineup. Grounded in a shared appreciation for everyday wonder and hand-crafted storytelling, the range brings together iconic imagery from across Studio Ghibli’s beloved filmography, including My Neighbor Totoro, Howl’s Moving Castle, Castle in the Sky, and Spirited Away.Beyond classic film stills, the collection incorporates original calligraphy and multi-character illustrations by Studio Ghibli co-founder and producer Toshio Suzuki, alongside floral photography and exhibition poster art captured at the Ghibli Museum, Mitaka by longtime studio collaborator and Thai artist Kanyada.Spanning five adult styles and four kids' silhouettes, the 100% cotton assortment balances subtle chest hits with bold, full-back artwork. Key adult highlights include a white namesake "LIVE FOR TODAY, MY DEAR" tee pairing Suzuki’s handwritten slogan on the front with a sprawling ensemble illustration on the back.Other standout pieces feature an olive green Castle in the Sky shirt showcasing Kanyada’s flower-draped Robot Soldier, a pale yellow Howl’s Moving Castle design starring Calcifer and Turnip Head, and two My Neighbor Totoro offerings — one spotlighting Soot Sprites on black cotton and another weaving miniature characters into bold orange typography.Meanwhile, the four kids’ styles bring in Spirited Away with a light blue No-Face tee, alongside smaller-scale versions of the Calcifer, Totoro logo and “LIVE FOR TODAY, MY DEAR” designs, so parents and kids can match.The collection is rolling out in stages, starting in Thailand, Malaysia and Taiwan in December, 2026 before arriving in Uniqlo’s U.S. stores in late January 2027, with prices ranging from around $13 to $30 USD. items.title: Joaquin Phoenix Debuts Gentle Monster's Smart Glasses & Gucci Announces Shanghai Runway in This Week's Top Fashion News
items.text: Joaquin Phoenix Debuts Gentle Monster's Smart Glasses & Gucci Announces Shanghai Runway in This Week's Top Fashion News SummaryGucci and sacai scheduled upcoming runway presentations for Shanghai and Hong Kong, respectively.Collaborative releases came from BEAMS’ 50th-anniversary adidas Originals collection and Gentle Monster’s cinematic Intelligent Eyewear campaign with Joaquin PhoenixThe Museum at FIT revealed a new sociopolitical exhibition featuring Willy Chavarria.Gucci to Present Cruise 2028 Collection in ShanghaiThis week, Gucci officially announced its Cruise 2028 runway presentation will take place in Shanghai on May 17, 2027. The event will mark artistic director Demna’s first show in the city, aligning with the 30th anniversary of the Italian house's original store opening in the region. The move expands the ongoing focus on major brand activations in China from global luxury maisons, joining upcoming regional shows by Dior and Zegna. The Shanghai destination follows Demna’s high-profile Cruise debut in New York City’s Times Square earlier this year.Gentle Monster Premieres Intelligent Eyewear Campaign Film Starring Joaquin PhoenixGentle Monster released an unconventional campaign film for its new Intelligent Eyewear line directed by Jonathan Glazer. Rather than highlighting technical specifications, the short places the glasses into a heightened cinematic environment fronted by Hollywood actor Joaquin Phoenix. A New York City public preview ran through late November, allowing visitors to view the 16-piece collection firsthand. Pre-orders are currently live online, with a full commercial launch across the United States and South Korea scheduled for December 10, 2026.sacai to Present SS27 Collection Runway Show in Hong KongJapanese label sacai will stage an exclusive Spring/Summer 2027 runway show at Hong Kong’s iconic HSBC Main Building on December 13, 2026, marking the brand's first-ever runway presentation in the city. The event celebrates sacai’s historical ties to Hong Kong, which opened the label’s first international store in 2015. The upcoming presentation signals the fashion house's ongoing and increasing presence throughout the Greater China region.BEAMS 50th Anniversary adidas Loafer Apparel Pack CollaborationTo celebrate its 50th anniversary, BEAMS partnered with adidas Originals on a 14-piece apparel and footwear pack. Leaning into "Preppy" and "Yankee" aesthetics, the capsule centers around two distinct collaborative loafer models.

items.title: Get a Closer Look at the Hypebeast x Formula 1 x ODITI Grand Prix Poster Collection
items.text: Get a Closer Look at the Hypebeast x Formula 1 x ODITI Grand Prix Poster Collection Summary ODITI, Hypebeast, and Formula 1 release an exclusive art print collection for the Las Vegas Grand PrixThe five-piece range features work by an international of artists specializing in painting, digital art, and drawingAvailable in four sizes, the prints range from $105 to $328 USD, exclusively via the ODITI webstore We're linking up with ODITI to help F1 fans take home a piece of the Las Vegas Grand Prix. The London-based publisher has unveiled a limited-edition poster lineup with Hypebeast and Formula 1 to capture the occasion through the eyes of artists.The collaboration, which spans five art prints, marks ODITI's reunion with the championship group. It follows the season-long run with the Cadillac Team, which premiered bespoke pieces every week, created by artists local to the host city, including Slawn, Opake, Rhymezlikedimez, Nychos and Vxmeee most recently.The Hypebeast x F1 x ODITI range builds on the partnership with five all-new works fit for Las Vegas. Featuring the likes of Richard Nadler, Claudia Locurcio, Cesar Botta, Caitlin Flood-Molyneux, and Emans91, the collection ranges in style and mood — from a deep blue, up-close portrait of a driver locking in mid-ride, to the cartoonish cars in West Coast tones and vintage-inspired gestural compositions — detailing the intensity, speed, and energy that makes the weekend.ODITI's on a mission to bring back the once-thriving sport and art love affair. “Our aim is to publish prints that will become cultural artefacts to our grandkids, in the same way Haring x Le Mans or Miro x FIFA is to us today,” said Lysander Campbell-Gray, the publisher's Head of Partnership.All five prints in the ODITI x Hypebeast x Formula collection are giclée prints, produced on archival paper with museum-grade inks, and are available in four sizes, ranging from $108 to $328 USD. Go to ODITI's webstore to cop yours. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Fear of God Introduces Collection TEN and Debut In-House Trainer
items.text: Fear of God Introduces Collection TEN and Debut In-House Trainer Summary Fear of God has officially introduced Collection TEN as the latest evolution of the house's visual codes and foundationsThe expansive range debuts a new Athletics category and the brand's first in-house athletic shoe featuring supercritical foamCollection TEN will officially arrive in Fall 2027 as the first collection to land at the brand's Los Angeles flagship store Fear of God has officially unveiled its highly anticipated Collection TEN. Rooted in a conviction that extends beyond the material, the latest seasonal offering distills thirteen years of the brand's foundational instincts into a more fully realized expression of American luxury.Refining its vision through a studied approach to fabrication and construction, Collection TEN utilizes bonded details and articulated sleeves to bring fresh structure and dimension to signature silhouettes. Contrasting fabrics and intentional finishes further define the apparel, while the iconic Fear of God bar has been updated in brushed champagne and matte black metal to mark a distinct evolution in the house's visual codes.Beyond traditional ready-to-wear, the collection introduces Athletics, a brand-new category informed by vintage American sportswear. This segment delivers washed training wear that seamlessly translates athletic dressing into the label's refined design language. Anchoring the new category is the Fear of God Trainer, marking the house's very first athletic shoe built entirely in-house. Uniting modern performance technology with a considered aesthetic, the silhouette features responsive supercritical foam cushioning to merge high-level performance with modern luxury.Fear of God Collection TEN will be available in Fall 2027, becoming the first collection to officially arrive at the Fear of God flagship store in Los Angeles. items.title: Things Are Heating up in the Official Trailer for Disney's 'Ice Age: Boiling Point'
items.text: Things Are Heating up in the Official Trailer for Disney's 'Ice Age: Boiling Point' Summary Disney has officially unveiled the full trailer for the upcoming animated sequel 'Ice Age: Boiling Point'The franchise's sixth installment brings the prehistoric crew into uncharted regions filled with dinosaurs and lavaOriginal voice actors including Ray Romano, Denis Leary, and John Leguizamo return for the 2027 theatrical release Disney has officially unveiled the full trailer for Ice Age: Boiling Point, marking the sixth cinematic installment in the long-running animated comedy franchise. Reaching a massive 25-year milestone, the beloved prehistoric herd is heading back to the big screen for a brand new fiery adventure.Directed by John Donkin, Ice Age: Boiling Point (also known as Ice Age 6) follows Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Scrat, Crash, and Baby Scrat as they navigate uncharted regions of the dangerous "Lost World." The new footage reveals a chaotic journey packed with towering dinosaurs and flowing lava.The film sees the return of the franchise's veteran voice cast, bringing back Ray Romano, Denis Leary, and John Leguizamo from the 2002 original, alongside Simon Pegg and Queen Latifah. The upcoming theatrical release represents the continuation of the fan-favorite series entirely under the Disney banner, following the company's acquisition of 20th Century and the original Blue Sky Animation studios.Ice Age: Boiling Point is officially slated to smash into theaters in February 2027. items.title: Dior Names Stray Kids' Hyunjin as New Brand Ambassador
items.text: Dior Names Stray Kids' Hyunjin as New Brand Ambassador Summary French luxury house Dior has officially signed Stray Kids member Hyunjin as its newest brand ambassadorThe South Korean rapper, singer, and dancer will represent the brand's beauty division and creative director Jonathan Anderson's collectionsThe major announcement arrives alongside the K-pop group's ongoing Run It World Tour which runs through July 2027 Dior has officially appointed South Korean rapper, singer, and dancer Hyunjin as its newest brand ambassador. Cementing a rapidly growing relationship with the French luxury house, the Stray Kids member will represent the brand's expansive beauty division alongside the collections designed by creative director Jonathan Anderson.The official partnership follows Hyunjin's standout front-row debut at the Dior men's show this past January, as well as recent appearances at two of the label's women's shows. The artist has already been deeply integrated into the house's visual language, wearing the brand for cover shoots . Highlighting his massive cultural pull, a September Instagram post featuring the star in a T-shirt promoting Dior's partnership with A24 garnered 2.6 million likes. The ambassadorship strategically coincides with the Stray Kids' Run It World Tour, which is scheduled to conclude in Milan in July 2027.Praising his instinctive sensitivity and singular charisma, Dior noted Hyunjin's ability to captivate audiences through an intense and magnetic stage presence. The multifaceted performer—who also serves as a face for Guess Jeans and Cartier—now joins an elite roster of Dior ambassadors. Sitting alongside heavyweights like BTS' Jimin, Exo's Sehun, Astro's Cha Eunwoo, Seventeen's Mingyu, and TXT, the appointment further underscores the absolute dominance of Asian celebrities in generating earned media value across the luxury sector. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Nike and Jun Takahashi Announce the Official Return of GYAKUSOU
items.text: Nike and Jun Takahashi Announce the Official Return of GYAKUSOU Summary Nike and Undercover founder Jun Takahashi have officially announced the return of their collaborative running label GYAKUSOUThe sub-brand comes back from a five-year hiatus with a new short film featuring the original members of GIRAA new collection is expected for Holiday 2026, with runners recently spotted teasing a collaborative Alphafly 4 silhouette Nike and Undercover founder Jun Takahashi have officially announced the return of GYAKUSOU, reviving the avant-garde running label after a five-year hiatus. Translating to "running in reverse," the collaborative sub-brand first launched in 2010 to merge the Swoosh's deep performance history with Takahashi's unique design lens, and is now confirmed to be warming up for a highly anticipated second act.Taking to social media to break the news, Takahashi shared a heartfelt statement reflecting on his 16-year journey with the label and his evolution as an athlete. Acknowledging the personal lifestyle shifts that led to the brand's pause in 2021, he emphasized that running remained a deeply rooted meditative practice in his daily routine, even prompting him to hunt for secondhand archival pieces online. To celebrate the comeback, GYAKUSOU has released its first film in seven years, featuring the three original members of GIRA—now playfully described by Takahashi as "weathered, middle-aged runners."The returning initiative stays true to its core philosophy: creating running apparel that blends naturally into both the city and the outdoors to motivate movement. While the fashion-running intersection has exploded into a massive category during the brand's sabbatical, GYAKUSOU promises to deliver results driven by Takahashi's purpose-driven ethos and Nike's cutting-edge materiality. Glimpses of the future are already appearing in the wild, with runners at the Setagaya Half Marathon recently spotted wearing a teased GYAKUSOU Alphafly 4.The returning Nike GYAKUSOU collection is expected to drop in Holiday 2026. View this post on InstagramA post shared by JUN TAKAHASHI (@joniotakahashi) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Jerry Lorenzo Unveils the Independent Fear of God Trainer Following adidas Split
items.text: Jerry Lorenzo Unveils the Independent Fear of God Trainer Following adidas Split Summary Jerry Lorenzo has officially unveiled the Fear of God Trainer as his first independent sneaker model since parting ways with adidas in 2025The low-top silhouette features a lightweight mesh base overlaid with a molded synthetic cage and a contrasting suede toe capThe new athletic sneaker is officially slated to release in Summer 2027 Following his highly publicized departure from adidas in 2025, Jerry Lorenzo has officially introduced the independent Fear of God Trainer. Despite recent speculation regarding a potential return to Nike after the designer was spotted wearing vintage Moon Shoes, the new silhouette marks a definitive return to entirely in-house footwear for the luxury American label.The Fear of God Trainer opts for a low-cut profile, anchored by a breathable lightweight mesh base. A molded synthetic cage runs continuously from the lacing system around the heel, featuring side cutouts that expose the mesh underneath. Round cream laces weave directly through this structural cage, while a contrasting blue-grey suede strip wraps the front edge of the toe box to break up the shoe's monochromatic cream upper.Branding remains signaturely minimal, with the Fear of God name printed in black across the insole and a small rectangular badge positioned low on the heel directly beneath the pull tab. Underfoot, the sole unit is engineered with supercritical foam for premium modern cushioning, completed by a herringbone traction pattern that extends across nearly the entire length of the outsole.According to Lorenzo, the Fear of God Trainer will release in Summer 2027. View this post on InstagramA post shared by JERRY LORENZO (@jerrylorenzo) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Lewis Hamilton's +44 Unveils "Area +44" Collection Ahead of Las Vegas Grand Prix Summary Lewis Hamilton's lifestyle brand +44 has announced its new concept-driven Area +44 collection for the Las Vegas Grand PrixThe versatile range is inspired by mystery and the unknown, featuring utility silhouettes and technical detailingThe collection is available online and at a dedicated pop-up at the Wynn in Las Vegas +44 has officially unveiled its new Area +44 collection. Launched ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix, the latest capsule from Lewis Hamilton's lifestyle brand is concept-driven and heavily inspired by the unknown, taking ideas of mystery and restricted access and exploring them through a technical, utility-inspired visual language.Urban versatility sits at the core of the collection, offering layering pieces designed to transition seamlessly from day to night. Hero outerwear and bottoms include the Night Shift Windbreaker, Ground Crew Bomber, Ground Crew Vest, and Area 44 Cargo Pant, all arriving in a sleek Blackout finish. Notably, the drop expands the brand's catalog into new categories, introducing knitwear for the first time through the Experimental Lab Knit in Nevada Sand and Blackout.The core lineup is rounded out by the Redacted Tee, Intercept LS Tee, and Nebula Women’s Top. Throughout the range, considered technical detailing and finishes sit alongside experimental graphics, creating a cohesive wardrobe crafted to move directly from the race track to the city.The +44 Area +44 collection is available now via the brand's official webstore and a special pop-up located in the Encore Esplanade within the Wynn resort complex. items.title: POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF) Opens Hannam Flagship Store in Seoul Alongside FW26 Drop
items.text: POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF) Opens Hannam Flagship Store in Seoul Alongside FW26 Drop Summary POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF) has officially opened the doors to its new flagship store in the Hannam-dong neighborhood of SeoulThe immersive two-story space features adjustable display panels and a bespoke sound system developed with artist Erika CoxThe retail launch coincides with the third drop of the brand's Fall/Winter 2026 collection highlighting premium Italian fabrics POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF) has officially expanded its physical retail footprint with the opening of a new Hannam flagship store in Seoul. Sitting at the heart of the city's art and cultural landscape, the space echoes the brand's avant-garde identity and arrives alongside the third release of the Fall/Winter 2026 collection.Designed in collaboration with Studio Unravel, the two-story flagship embodies the brand's continuous pursuit of balance between form and function. On the ground floor, movable rails are arranged in the label's signature curved form, complemented by a custom sound system and speakers developed with local artist Erika Cox. Moving to the second floor, adjustable panels act as product displays while dynamically controlling the natural light and shadow filtering through the windows to add depth to the space.Coinciding with the grand opening is the third release from the brand's FW26 collection. Emphasizing premium materials and expert craftsmanship, the drop includes technical puffer jackets constructed with specialized fabrics from Italy's Olmetex and Limonta. Elevating the offering, the release also delivers tailored cashmere jackets and coats made from luxurious Colombo and Loro Piana fabrics.The POST ARCHIVE FACTION (PAF) Hannam flagship store is officially open daily from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. at 682-16 Hannam-dong, Seoul. The third FW26 drop is available now at the new location, the Shinsegae Gangnam store, and via the brand's official webstore. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Sun Day Red and VESSEL Golf Unveil the Tigris Slamus Collection Honoring the Tiger Slam
items.text: Sun Day Red and VESSEL Golf Unveil the Tigris Slamus Collection Honoring the Tiger Slam Summary The collaborative drop celebrates the 25th anniversary of Tiger Woods' historic run of four consecutive major championships Sun Day Red has officially unveiled the Tigris Slamus Collection, a commemorative apparel and equipment release honoring the 25th anniversary of Tiger Woods' historic "Tiger Slam." Celebrating the unprecedented achievement of holding all four major championships simultaneously, the expansive collection looks back at the legendary 294 days that redefined golf history.The drop is anchored by "The First One Polo," a meticulous recreation of the shirt worn by a 19-year-old Woods during his second round at the 1995 Augusta major. Available in both adult and youth sizing, the polo is constructed from a cooling micro-pique performance fabric and comprises nine unique art panels. Complementing the apparel is an unstructured six-panel hat crafted from a weather-resistant 100% wool seasonal fabric, featuring a custom felt and high-density front patch, a full leather adjustable rear strap, and commemorative 25th-anniversary internal taping.In collaboration with VESSEL Golf, the capsule introduces premium bags built on the Lux platform to handle tour-level demands. The collection includes a 4-way stand bag utilizing black PU leather alongside a limited-run Staff Bag. Expanding the equipment range, the brand is releasing a series of 100% wool vintage knit headcovers for drivers, fairways, and utility clubs. Each piece is completed with a specialized Tiger Slam crest and unique tasseled pom styling, with the driver cover sporting four specific stripes representing each major. Additional items across the release include a chainstitch hoodie, signature backpack, wallet, and ball marker.The Sun Day Red Tigris Slamus Collection is available now online. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Louis Vuitton Keith Haring Collaboration Fragrance Release Info
items.text: Louis Vuitton Keith Haring Collaboration Fragrance Release Info Summary Louis Vuitton is launching a collaborative fragrance collection designed alongside the Keith Haring FoundationThe capsule reimagines the Attrape-Rêves, Imagination, and Ombre Nomade scents with the late artist's iconic motifsThe trio of artistic fragrances officially releases globally on January 1, 2027 Louis Vuitton and the Keith Haring Foundation have officially merged the worlds of fine art and perfumery for a newly revealed fragrance collection. Born from a creative dialogue initiated by Nicolas Ghesquière during the recent Cruise 2027 show at New York's Frick Collection, the collaborative project pays direct tribute to the city that heavily nourished the legendary artist's creative universe.The collaborative endeavor translates Haring's infectious energy across three distinct Louis Vuitton fragrances. First in the lineup is Attrape-Rêves, a radiant and optimistic scent that prominently features the artist's emblematic "radiant baby," embodying the motif's underlying promise of hope. Next, Imagination brings the artist's celebrated characters to life directly through the glass bottle and its accompanying case. Visually representing the infinite possibilities held within everyone, the Imagination scent also includes a matching travel case crafted from coated Monogram canvas.Rounding out the trio is Ombre Nomade. The bottle's design presents a golden labyrinth with no definitive beginning or end, with its intricate, endless lines perfectly echoing the complex swirls of the fragrance's signature oud wood.The Louis Vuitton x Keith Haring fragrance collection drops January 1, 2027, via Louis Vuitton stores worldwide. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 'Twilight' x Crocs Unveils "Edward and Bella" Classic Clog After Robert Pattinson is Named Next James Bond
items.text: 'Twilight' x Crocs Unveils "Edward and Bella" Classic Clog After Robert Pattinson is Named Next James Bond Summary 'Twilight' has officially teamed up with Crocs for a new take on the Classic Clog centered around Edward and BellaThe design channels the iconic meadow scene with dedicated quote Jibbitz, character portraits, and a split color schemeThe collaborative pair drops this December shortly after the official announcement that Robert Pattinson will play James Bond Name: Twilight x Crocs Classic Clog "Edward and Bella"Colorway: Multi-ColorSKU: 215785-90HMSRP: $90 USDRelease Date: December 4, 2026Where to Buy: CrocsShortly after the massive official announcement that Robert Pattinson will step into the iconic role of James Bond, Crocs is bringing fans right back to the actor's sparkly vampire days with the official Twilight x Crocs Classic Clog "Edward and Bella." Channeling the heavy nostalgia of the mid-2000s, the collaborative footwear explicitly references the famous meadow scene where Bella first discovers Edward’s true nature in the sun.To get the full narrative experience, the thematic clogs are designed to be read from right to left, spelling out Edward's most famous line from the scene. The right toe features a printed portrait of the vampire positioned next to custom Jibbitz reading "and so the lion" and "fell in love." Over on the outer edge of the left toe, Bella looks back, completed with a "with the lamb" charm to finish the quote.The color palette directly references the cinematic meadow, anchored by a split green and purple scheme. Green wraps from the toe around the inside of each clog, while purple runs aggressively along the outside and seamlessly onto the heel strap. The upper is heavily decorated with flower Jibbitz and purple gems, while the heel is embellished with additional gems, metal hardware, and other recognizable lines from the film.The Twilight x Crocs Classic Clog "Edward and Bella" drops on December 4, 2026, for $90 USD in unisex sizing. Look for the pair via Crocs and select retailers online and in-store. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Everything That Went Down During Hypebeast LATAM's 2026 Latin GRAMMY Week Activations
items.text: Everything That Went Down During Hypebeast LATAM's 2026 Latin GRAMMY Week Activations During Latin GRAMMY Week, Hypebeast LATAM turned a three-bedroom space at Encore Tower Suites into its Las Vegas coverage home base. More than 40 artists passed by throughout the week, giving us a chance to dig deeper into what excites them about Latin music’s biggest week. The interview suite became the starting point for a wider program at Wynn Las Vegas that brought many of those same artists together over dinner, onstage, and out on the Strip.Colombian producer Ovy On The Drums arrived with “Yo y Tú,” his collaboration with Beéle and Quevedo. Argentine artist Dillom was up for Best Rock Song with “Rojo Profundo,” while Grupo Frontera’s Lo Que Me Falta Por Llorar was nominated for Best Norteño Album. Kapo, J Noa and The Warning also joined the lineup, bringing reggaetón, Dominican rap and Mexican rock together across a line-up of Latin GRAMMY nominees.On Tuesday night, Arcángel co-hosted the first Hypebeast Latin America Dinner at Zero Bond in Wynn Las Vegas, bringing artists, creatives and executives who have helped shape Latin music around the same table. The evening continued at Disco Bébé in Wynn Las Vegas, where we hosted an afterparty with performances from Farruko, Ryan Castro and Kapo for 150 exclusive guests. The DJ set was brought by DSCNTRL, a Venezuelan group formed by Mazzarri, Brizza and Puche.Arcángel also led Hypebeast LATAM’s first Run Club, a 9 a.m. 5K along the Las Vegas Strip presented by New Balance. More than 80 runners powered under the Nevada sunshine, including Ryan Castro, DJ Dynamiq, and Corridos del Rey. A Red Bull truck provided music, while a custom bike fitted with turntables and speakers brought tunes onto the route. This experience was powered by Etho Club. Special thanks to After Drink.By the time the red carpet arrived, Hypebeast LATAM’s 2026 Latin GRAMMY activations had already conquered the city. We brought some of the biggest names in Latin music together across four events that spoke to the platform’s importance and impact, highlighting established legends, emerging talent, and so much more.Take a closer look at the artists that passed through Hypebeast LATAM’s 2026 Latin GRAMMY interview suite above. items.title: Introducing HypeAwards: The People, Products, and Brands That Defined 2026
items.text: Introducing HypeAwards: The People, Products, and Brands That Defined 2026 Meet HypeAwards, Hypebeast's new annual celebration of the people, brands, and products that defined the year in culture. From the drops everyone chased to the albums, films, and games that dominated the conversation, HypeAwards honors the names and ideas that made the biggest mark on 2026.The program spans every world Hypebeast covers. There are awards for the people who drove the year, like Person of the Year, Creator of the Year, and Culture's MVP in both men's and women's sports. There are awards for the things everyone wanted to get their hands on, from Shoe of the Year and Music Merch of the Year to The Art of the Drop and Better by Design. And there's the Timeless Award, presented with The Macallan, which honors a legacy visual artist whose work continues to shape art and culture today.The list also looks ahead. Alongside the biggest names of 2026, categories like Next in Menswear, Next in Womenswear, and Next in Music spotlight the emerging designers and artists who broke into the mainstream this year and are poised to define what comes next.To decide what truly broke through, we looked at how millions of Hypebeast readers engaged with our website, app, and social channels this year: what they read, watched, shared, and clicked. Then we paired that with our editors' perspective. The result is 145 nominees across fashion, footwear, art, design, music, automotive, entertainment, and beauty.The inaugural HypeAwards ceremony will kick off in Miami during Art Week on December 1, with the winners of this year's HypeAwards to be announced on December 2. Until then, head to hypebeast.com/hypeawards to see all 145 nominees and get a closer look at every name, product, and project in the running. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER Find Upheaval Worth Running Toward on 'PERFECT STORM'
items.text: TOMORROW X TOGETHER Find Upheaval Worth Running Toward on 'PERFECT STORM' A line in "Angel Bite" is "Even love costs money," and it's about as blunt as TOMORROW X TOGETHER have ever been. Taehyun says that's on purpose. Over the years, the group has written different versions of this song, penning metaphors to express what it's like to hold on to someone you have nothing to give. This time around, he says they wanted to "strip down all the romanticized notions of youth and actually confront the anxiety, pain, and sense of deprivation underneath it." Another line on the song pushes it further: "Ain't got nothing, so how am I supposed to afford a future?"The intentionality runs across the entirety of PERFECT STORM. Their latest project arrives only only seven months after 7TH YEAR: A Moment of Stillness in the Thorns, and shifts the focus from 7TH YEAR's anxieties to what they did next. "For us, a storm isn't an obstacle to fight against, but a catalyst for change that sweeps away the stagnant air and opens doors to new possibilities," Taehyun explains. "We definitely felt the need for change, and this album is our way of diving headfirst into that whirlwind of transformation."Soobin reveals the storm wasn't the plan from the start. When they first sat down, the only thing everyone agreed on was that they needed to do "something completely different" from what they've done before. The storm idea came later, as they worked it through with their team. What he talks about more is what happened once they started writing. "In the beginning, all the anxieties we had felt massive and uncontrollable, almost like we were bracing ourselves for an approaching storm. But after writing our thoughts and feelings into the lyrics and vocalizing it, everything started to feel a lot more manageable." The concept photos follow that change fairly literally, taking the members from waiting for the storm to riding it, standing in its eye and finally holding it in their hands. "Now, I can say that we are getting closer to truly embracing the storm, just like in our last concept photos, 'HOLDING THE STORM.'"The music doesn't stay in one place either, moving through dance punk, minimal techno and avant-pop over the course of the album. Ask whether there's a point where it stops sounding like them, and Hueningkai doesn't really accept the premise. "We don't really draw a line or set rules on what sounds like us. items.title: American Airlines and Alpha Industries Reimagine the MA-1 Flight Jacket for Airline’s 100th Anniversary
items.text: American Airlines and Alpha Industries Reimagine the MA-1 Flight Jacket for Airline’s 100th Anniversary American Airlines has teamed up with Alpha Industries to celebrate its 100th anniversary with a limited-edition MA-1 Flight Jacket, transforming leather reclaimed from retired aircraft seats into a wearable piece of aviation history.Spearheaded by creative agency Ceeze, the collaboration brings together American Airlines’ archival heritage and Alpha Industries’ iconic MA-1 silhouette. Rather than relying on conventional fabrics, the project repurposes authentic upholstery from American Airlines’ retired fleet. Each jacket is handcrafted in New York City, with the reclaimed leather carefully cut, rearranged and reconstructed into a distinctive patchwork design. Only 100 pieces will be produced worldwide.Design-wise, the jacket features a dark blue leather exterior complemented by a red satin lining, silver zipper and graphite-colored ribbed cuffs. An American Airlines logo patch dating back to the 1930s completes the design, paying homage to the airline’s century-long history.Originally developed as functional military outerwear, the MA-1 Flight Jacket has since transcended its utilitarian origins, becoming a staple across youth subcultures, streetwear and high fashion. This latest collaboration reconnects the silhouette with its aviation roots, giving authentic aircraft materials a second life while offering a fresh interpretation of an enduring wardrobe icon.The American Airlines x Alpha Industries 100th Anniversary MA-1 Flight Jacket has officially been unveiled, with further release details yet to be announced.Of the 100 jackets made, American Airlines plans to make 50 available to AAdvantage® members through AAdvantage Exchange for 200,000 AAdvantage® miles each. The offering is currently scheduled for November 30 through December 4, 2026. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

Flight-style parkas in navy and sage add button-through plackets, a utility sleeve pocket, rib-knit hems and a hood with a shaggy white trim.Fleece takes up a large part of the collection. Sand sherpa zip jackets are paneled with green woven trim on the collar and chest flap pockets, which carry a Tri-Ferg patch, and the back shows a chenille oval-logo patch. items.title: Supreme and The North Face Unveil Fall 2026 Bones Collection
items.text: Supreme and The North Face Unveil Fall 2026 Bones Collection Summary Supreme and The North Face have teamed up once again to deliver a comprehensive collaborative collection for the Fall 2026 seasonThe extensive capsule heavily features graphic appliqué details across staple outerwear silhouettes like the Nuptse Jacket and Mountain JacketTechnical apparel is joined by an assortment of winter-ready accessories including touchscreen-compatible gloves and a rolltop backpack Supreme and The North Face have officially partnered to release their collaborative Fall 2026 collection. Bringing a striking graphic appliqué motif to a range of signature outdoor silhouettes, the comprehensive "Bones" capsule spans a variety of winter-ready apparel alongside heavy-duty technical accessories.Leading the heavy outerwear lineup is the Bones Nuptse Jacket, which arrives constructed from water-resistant, breathable nylon packed with premium 700-Fill down insulation. It is joined by the Bones Mountain Jacket and matching Bones Mountain Pant, both of which utilize waterproof, breathable, and fully seam-sealed Dryvent nylon alongside the collection's standout graphic appliqué. To ensure maximum warmth, the Mountain Jacket is further enhanced with a cozy micro-fleece lining.Rounding out the apparel selection, the New York imprint introduces a pile fleece Bones Hooded Fleece Jacket and a classic cotton jersey Bones S/S Top. For technical accessories, the duo has prepared a lightweight dot knit poly Bones Lightweight Balaclava and silicone-gripped Bones Etip Gloves outfitted with touchscreen-compatible fingertips. Rounding out the offering is a spacious 34.5-liter Bones Backpack constructed from water-resistant 210D ripstop nylon, complete with welded seams and a secure roll-top closure.The Supreme x The North Face Fall 2026 releases on November 27, via the official Supreme webstore and flagship locations, with an Asia release following shortly after on November 28. items.title: SR_A Unveils New GRIND Editorial Collection
items.text: SR_A Unveils New GRIND Editorial Collection SR_A recently unveiled its new GRIND Editorial collection, which centers on traditional indigo dyeing techniques to combine functional fabrics, natural silk, and retro sportswear. Through manual dyeing, fading, and distressing treatments, the collection presents clothing pieces that boast both utilitarian attributes and unique textures.This collection includes items such as parkas, jackets, zip hoodies, and tracksuits. After garment construction, all pieces undergo a 72-hour handmade indigo dyeing process, allowing different materials to display natural color variations and textural depth.In outerwear, the BONDED GARNET INDIGO SILK PARKA and SILENT FOREST INDIGO SILK PARKA are crafted from Italian Limonta water-repellent functional fabric and matte gabardine, respectively. They feature natural raw silk from Jaipur, India, vintage brass hardware, and vegetable-tanned leather brim details incorporating Japanese Sashiko embroidery, forging a connection between modern outdoor functionality and traditional craftsmanship. The BRONZE TINT INDIGO SILK JACKET uses crinkled raw silk as its main fabric, combined with a high-collar design and satin lining to present a more fluid silhouette. The CERU INDIGO SHELL PARKA opts for lightweight pure cotton fabric and adds adjustable webbing and vintage prints, emphasizing the practicality of outdoor wear.For sportswear, the collection brings the AQUA, MARINE, and WOODLAND INDIGO ZIP HOODIES, as well as the VIOLET INDIGO RAGLAN top. The designs carry on the cropped proportions and dropped shoulders of retro sportswear, imparting varying degrees of wear marks through high-temperature plastisol printing, bleaching, sun-fading, and localized distress treatments. Notably, the MARINE version specifically utilizes waffle cotton fabric, paired with a more tailored athletic silhouette.Additionally, the TREATED INDIGO 1/4 PULLOVER and TREATED INDIGO ZIP JOGGER are based on classic tracksuits, utilizing brushed, high-density pure cotton fabric. They combine understated water-based distressed prints, zippered pockets, and a quarter-zip high collar structure, integrating more functional details into the retro athletic style.From Italian functional fabrics and Indian raw silk to traditional Japanese handcrafts, SR_A re-explores the relationship between modern apparel and traditional manufacturing methods through a combination of different materials and techniques. items.text: SOMEWHERE and ASICS Honor D.C. Heritage With the GEL Stratus MC “Chocolate City” Summary Washington, D.C. boutique SOMEWHERE reunites with ASICS for a “Chocolate City” GEL-Stratus MC honoring the capital's heritage.The hybrid runner features white mesh, blue overlays, neon hits, and chocolate-wrapper brown-trimmed silver panels.Launches November 28 for $110 USD. Name: SOMEWHERE x ASICS GEL-Stratus MC “Chocolate City”Colorway: Quiet Grey/Neon BlueSKU: 1203B382-020MSRP: $110 USDRelease Date: November 28Where to Buy: SOMEWHEREWashington, D.C. boutique and café SOMEWHERE is reuniting with ASICS to honor its hometown heritage with the GEL-Stratus MC “Chocolate City”.
