items.title: Closer Look at Action Bronson's Bespoke Saint Jewels New York Knicks Championship Ring
items.text: Closer Look at Action Bronson's Bespoke Saint Jewels New York Knicks Championship Ring Summary Action Bronson was spotted courtside wearing a bespoke championship-inspired ring by Gerard Alexander of Saint JewelsThe one-of-one piece celebrates the New York Knicks' 2026 title and the end of the franchise's 53-year championship droughtThe intricate design features a miniature Madison Square Garden concealed under the top and can also be worn as a pendant Celebrated rapper, chef, and New York native Action Bronson stepped out courtside last night wearing a one-of-a-kind bespoke Saint Jewels New York Knicks 2026 Title Ring. Designed by Gerard Alexander, the Beverly Hills-based and Queens-raised founder of the luxury jewelry atelier, the exclusive piece serves as a true New Yorker’s tribute to the franchise’s first championship since 1973.The meticulously crafted piece is constructed from 14k white gold and set with 45.88 carats of natural, certifiably conflict-free diamonds. Honoring the 53-year championship drought, the ring incorporates exactly 53 blue and orange sapphires. Pushing the boundaries of conventional jewelry design, the top of the ring lifts away to reveal a miniature replica of Madison Square Garden, complete with the court and stands fully rendered in pavé diamonds.Further commemorative details are hidden on the underside, which carries a sculpted relief of the historic tip-in that secured Game 4 of the Finals and erased a 29-point deficit. Adding versatility to the bespoke creation, the top section can be unscrewed and worn as a pendant. Alexander, a GIA Graduate Gemologist who trained in the New York City Diamond District, is known for his high-profile creations, having previously crafted pieces for J Balvin, Lewis Hamilton, and Pusha T. The custom ring is bespoke and not available for public purchase. View this post on InstagramA post shared by SAINT JEWELS ® (@saintjewels) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Jeff Staple Announces the Closure of Staple 21 Mercer in New York City
items.text: Jeff Staple Announces the Closure of Staple 21 Mercer in New York City Summary Jeff Staple is officially closing his Staple 21 Mercer retail space in New York City after a 20-month runThe SoHo location served as a community-driven gathering place for music, art, sports, gaming, and entrepreneurshipStaple plans to pivot away from a permanent flagship in favor of pop-ups and experiential retail activations around the city Jeff Staple has officially announced the closure of his Staple 21 Mercer retail store in New York City. Taking over the former NikeLab space in SoHo, the destination operated as a vibrant retail and cultural hub for 20 months, with its final day of operation officially set for Friday, November 27.Reflecting on the space's tenure, the brand emphasized that the location was always intended to be more than just a traditional retail storefront. Built as a cultural gathering place where community came before commerce, Staple 21 Mercer frequently welcomed creatives and innovators across the spheres of music, art, sports, and gaming. The brand's founder noted that the most memorable moments of the store's run were entirely unplanned, capturing the serendipitous spirit of New York City. Employees similarly echoed the sentiment, expressing gratitude for the connections built and legends met during the store's operations.While the physical address is shutting its doors, the Staple brand and its iconic Pigeon logo are shifting strategies rather than slowing down. The label plans to transition away from a permanent seven-days-a-week flagship model in favor of dynamic pop-ups, retail experiments, and global activations. This pivot aims to ensure that every future physical brand experience feels more intentional and impactful for the community.Staple 21 Mercer will remain open for one final stretch, inviting fans to shop and share memories before officially closing its doors on Black Friday, November 27. View this post on InstagramA post shared by @staple21mercer Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Ferrari Sheds Hybrid Tech to Create the Ultimate V6 Track Monster
items.text: Ferrari Sheds Hybrid Tech to Create the Ultimate V6 Track Monster Summary The new Ferrari 296 Challenge Stradale drops its hybrid system.Shedding 310 pounds, the 670-horsepower V6 delivers pure analog speed.Massive aero and a stripped carbon-fiber cabin maximize track performance. Ferrari has officially unveiled its latest track-focused weapon, the Ferrari 296 Challenge Stradale. Arriving 23 years after the original 360 Challenge Stradale, this new iteration strips away the hybrid system to reduce weight and deliver an analog experience. At the heart of the 296 Challenge Stradale sits a tuned 3.0-liter, 120-degree twin-turbo V6 engine. Without the electric motor, the engine produces 670 horsepower at 8,000 rpm and 546 lb-ft of torque, sending power exclusively to the rear wheels via an eight-speed dual-clutch transmission. Dropping the hybrid hardware sheds significant bulk, resulting in a dry weight of just 2,932 pounds, nearly 310 pounds lighter than the GTB. This diet allows the car to launch from zero to 62 mph in just 2.8 seconds and reach a top speed in excess of 186 mph. Around Ferrari’s famed Fiorano test track, it clocks a blistering lap time of 1:18.5, beating the likes of the LaFerrari and SF90.Visually, the car leans heavily into its motorsport roots. The GTB’s active spoiler has been replaced with a massive fixed rear wing, which helps generate over 1,360 pounds of downforce at 155 mph. A newly designed twin-exit exhaust system minimizes back pressure while amplifying the V6’s high-pitched wail. To harness the immense grip, Ferrari has equipped the car with recalibrated semi-active suspension, carbon-ceramic brakes, and bespoke Pirelli P Zero R or Trofeo RS tires.On the inside, the cabin embraces the stripped-back look. The door panels are crafted from a single piece of carbon fiber, deliberately lacking armrests and storage pockets. The redesigned center console utilizes lightweight technical fabrics, while newly developed tubular carbon-fiber seats anchor the driver. For those looking to strip even more weight, buyers can opt to remove the lower carpeting, leaving parts of the chassis exposed.Ferrari has positioned the 296 CS as an addition to the lineup rather than a replacement for the standard range model, and will not be a limited edition model. This stripped-back sports car is expected to start at €291,000 EUR (approx. $320,000 USD), with US deliveries expected to begin sometime in late 2027. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: A Ma Maniére Officially Opens New Chicago Flagship Summary The Whitaker Group has officially opened the doors to its new A Ma Maniére Chicago flagship located in the Fulton Market districtThe expansive 10,103-square-foot space spans four stories and features the Galerie lounge, the Maison consumer experience, and two Living suitesThe meticulously designed overnight suites pay tribute to iconic Chicago figures Fred Hampton and Michael Jordan The Whitaker Group has officially expanded its physical footprint with the grand opening of the A Ma Maniére Chicago flagship. Located at 1144 West Washington Blvd in the city's Fulton Market neighborhood, the massive 10,103-square-foot destination serves as a home for gathering, discovery, and overnight hospitality. Spanning four stories and featuring an outdoor courtyard, the new location was built to reflect Chicago's massive contribution to global culture, leadership, and sound.The immersive experience begins on the ground floor with the Galerie. Outfitted with dark stone and low lighting, the lounge offers a quiet daytime retreat that shifts into a vibrant hub for culinary tastings, mixology events, card games, and community programming in the evening. Moving up to the second floor, the Maison houses the A Ma Maniére collection alongside a curated selection of iconic brands built for intentional browsing.The third floor introduces two meticulously designed Living suites built for overnight stays and private events, each honoring a foundational Chicago figure. "The Hampton" pays tribute to the legacy of young organizer Fred Hampton and his dedication to uniting neighborhoods across racial lines. "The Jordan" honors Michael Jordan, reflecting his pursuit of excellence and enduring influence on the city's global identity. The Chicago location marks the fifth expression of A Ma Maniére, joining established outposts in Houston, Washington, D.C., Charleston, and Atlanta.The A Ma Maniére Chicago flagship officially opened its doors on November 5, 2026, and is now welcoming guests. items.title: Tom Brady Reportedly Purchases Minority Stake in Chelsea FC Following Birmingham City Departure
items.text: Tom Brady Reportedly Purchases Minority Stake in Chelsea FC Following Birmingham City Departure Summary Seven-time Super Bowl champion Tom Brady has purchased a minority stake in Premier League club Chelsea FCThe NFL legend joins the Clearlake Capital vehicle that controls the team and will serve in an advisory capacityThe major investment arrives shortly after Brady departed his previous ownership role with English club Birmingham City Following a brief stint with Birmingham City, Tom Brady has officially purchased a minority stake in Chelsea FC. According to multiple sources, the seven-time Super Bowl champion quarterback has joined the Clearlake Capital investment vehicle that currently controls the prestigious English Premier League soccer club.The high-profile deal, navigated with the assistance of defense attorney Alex Spiro, positions the NFL legend as an operating adviser to Clearlake Capital, though he will not hold official voting rights. This strategic pivot arrives just weeks after Brady left his 3.3% minority ownership stake and advisory board position with second-tier English club Birmingham City.Brady's arrival coincides with a significant boardroom shift for the London-based club. This past September, Todd Boehly and Mark Walter sold their respective shares, handing private equity firm Clearlake Capital full control of Chelsea. Led by Behdad Eghbali and Jose E. Feliciano, Clearlake previously held a 61.5% stake in the consortium that originally purchased the club for £2.5 billion GBP in 2022. While he will not dictate daily operations, Brady's extensive championship experience is poised to help guide the ownership group's long-term vision. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: The Pearl White DJI Osmo Pocket 4P Turns High End Camera Tech Into an Everyday Style Essential
items.text: The Pearl White DJI Osmo Pocket 4P Turns High End Camera Tech Into an Everyday Style Essential For decades, professional imaging equipment has adhered to a rigid, monochrome script: matte black, utilitarian, and distinctly industrial. Cameras were built to hide in the background of production sets rather than exist out in the open. But as creative tools have seamlessly integrated into daily life—flooding street style snaps, OOTD breakdowns, travel vlogs, and backstage EDC (everyday carry) dumps—a fundamental question has emerged: when your camera is as visible as your outfit, why must high-end gear still look like a traditional piece of tech clutter?DJI answers that shift with the Osmo Pocket 4P Pearl White Edition, a device that treats design not as an afterthought, but as an intrinsic extension of modern personal style. Moving away from dark hardware, this release bridges high-performance filmmaking and lifestyle essentials.Rather than looking like an isolated gadget pulled from a camera bag, the Pearl White finish incorporates a multi-layer mica pearlescent coating. As ambient light changes throughout the day, the surface subtly shifts with a soft-touch luminescence that feels elevated and intentional. It sits naturally in flat-lays next to silver jewelry, high-end leather goods, and designer eyewear, functioning just as smoothly as a style object as it does a capture device. By challenging the classic black industrial standard, DJI is redefining how imaging tools fit into fashion’s inner circle.The Osmo Pocket 4P Pearl White shows that form and firepower can coexist effortlessly. Its refined, 230-gram body looks right at home in fashion week, concerts, travel, and everyday moments while housing a pro-grade imaging system with two lenses and 3-axis mechanical stabilization.The 20mm wide-angle lens pairs a new 1-inch CMOS sensor with LOFIC technology to deliver 4K at 240 fps and 17 stops of dynamic range, preserving detail in sunsets, backlit portraits, and high-contrast scenes. The 10-bit D-Log 2 profile captures over one billion colors for cinema-grade grading flexibility. Meanwhile, the 60mm medium-tele lens with an f/1.8 aperture and 3× optical zoom creates the shallow-focus portraiture that defines cinematic production.Together, these give creators the control of a cinema director in a camera that fits in their pocket. It’s the new standard for creative tools in modern culture. The DJI Osmo Pocket 4P Pearl White Edition is available to puchase via D

items.title: The Avengers, X-Men, and Fantastic Four Unite in the Final 'Avengers: Doomsday' Trailer
items.text: The Avengers, X-Men, and Fantastic Four Unite in the Final 'Avengers: Doomsday' Trailer Summary Marvel Studios has officially released the final trailer for its highly anticipated superhero blockbuster 'Avengers: Doomsday'The cinematic event introduces Robert Downey Jr. as the fearsome Doctor Doom while bringing back Chris Evans as Steve RogersDirected by Joe and Anthony Russo, the unprecedented crossover film officially hits theaters everywhere on December 18 Marvel Studios has officially debuted the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday. With less than a month remaining until the highly anticipated cinematic event, the new footage sets the stage for an unprecedented crossover as heroes from three different Earths are forced to band together to face total extinction.The upcoming blockbuster introduces a massive existential threat in the form of Doctor Doom, portrayed by returning Marvel veteran Robert Downey Jr. To combat the impending doom, the film officially assembles the Avengers, the X-Men, and the Fantastic Four on screen together for the very first time in Marvel's cinematic history. Adding to the massive scale, the project brings back Chris Evans as Steve Rogers alongside Hayley Atwell's Peggy Carter, abruptly interrupting the happily-ever-after ending established in 2019's Avengers: Endgame.Steering the massive ensemble are returning directors Joe and Anthony Russo, who previously shepherded Steve Rogers' arc from Captain America: The Winter Soldier through the conclusion of the Infinity Saga. The new film reframes Rogers' previous storybook ending as the catalyst for a brand new chapter. “We sort of played one beat past where Steve Rogers’ story ended with Peggy Carter,” Anthony Russo explained. “And in that moment, that's where Doomsday is born.”Avengers: Doomsday officially hits theaters everywhere on December 18. items.title: Rare Hilma af Klint Masterpiece Commands a Record-Breaking $12.7 Million USD at Auction
items.text: Rare Hilma af Klint Masterpiece Commands a Record-Breaking $12.7 Million USD at Auction Summary A 1920 abstract painting by pioneering artist Hilma af Klint recently sold for a record-breaking $12.7 million USD at a Swedish auction houseThe rare offering of 'Ser III No. 5' marks a historic moment for the artist whose foundation typically keeps her work strictly off the marketThe unprecedented sale sparked controversy among art historians who argue the esoteric work was never intended for commercial consumption Pioneering artist Hilma af Klint has set a new posthumous record following the landmark sale of her 1920 abstraction, Ser III No. 5. Hosted by the Bukowskis auction house in Stockholm, the extremely rare market appearance resulted in a staggering $12.7 million USD final price, a sum roughly 15 times its initial high estimate of $800,000 USD.Held closely by a single unnamed family since 1995, the painting was originally acquired after the artist's foundation deaccessioned a small number of works. The sale adds a lucrative new chapter to af Klint's posthumous ascent. While the artist remained relatively obscure following her death in 1944, a series of blockbuster museum exhibitions in the 2010s—including a record-shattering 2018 showcase at the New York Guggenheim Museum—firmly repositioned her as a foundational inventor of European abstraction. Her enigmatic canvases, featuring dazzling arrays of curlicuing lines and inscrutable symbols, were famously created in response to spirits she contacted.Because the foundation generally restricts her artwork from entering the commercial market, the recent Bukowskis auction sparked debate among art historians. Critics of the sale, including af Klint scholar Rachel Villari, argued that placing a price tag on the esoteric works contradicts the artist's original intentions and removes culturally significant pieces from public access. Despite the pushback, the auction house celebrated the historic hammer price, with CEO Louise Arén noting that simply selling an abstract work by af Klint is a remarkable feat on its own. items.title: LeBron James Sues AI Betting Platform Over Unauthorized Digital Replica
items.text: LeBron James Sues AI Betting Platform Over Unauthorized Digital Replica Summary LeBron James has officially filed a lawsuit against artificial intelligence company PlayVision Inc over an unauthorized promotional campaignThe Philadelphia 76ers forward alleges that the platform used a digital replica of his likeness to mislead consumers into believing he was affiliated with the appThe legal action seeks damages and an injunction to prevent the continued use of his identity NBA superstar LeBron James has officially taken legal action against PlayVision Inc. and its AI-powered sports betting research app, "Bron," over the alleged unauthorized use of his name, likeness, and voice. Filed on Tuesday, November 17, the lawsuit claims the California-based company deliberately deployed an artificial intelligence-generated version of the athlete to promote its platform without permission.The legal dispute centers on a heavily circulated advertisement that accumulated approximately one million views and reposts before being removed. The campaign featured a digitally recreated basketball player wearing a No. 23 jersey and displaying tattoos resembling those of the Philadelphia 76ers forward. The character also utilized a voice explicitly intended to sound like James, shown browsing betting information involving other professional NBA players. James’ attorneys argue the campaign went beyond borrowing his appearance, creating a highly misleading impression that he actively endorsed the platform.The distinction carries significant weight, as NBA rules strictly prohibit players from betting on league games. Furthermore, James already holds an existing endorsement relationship with the prediction market platform Polymarket, making the unauthorized association with a separate betting service a major conflict. The lawsuit names PlayVision alongside its co-founders, Anish Gupta and Marc Zoghby. While the company reportedly indicated it would rename the application after receiving a cease-and-desist letter on November 5, the filing alleges that the platform was still utilizing the "Bron" moniker when the complaint was officially submitted. items.text: Art Basel Hong Kong 2027 Lands 232 Galleries and a Brand-New Floor Plan Summary Art Basel Hong Kong returns to the HKCEC from March 25 to 27, 2027, with 232 exhibitors from more than 40 countries and territories, 31 of them at the fair for the first timeA redesigned layout moves Discoveries, Echoes, Insights and Zero 10 onto Level 3, giving the smaller curated sectors more room and visibilityHighlights range from Nnena Kalu's first showing in Asia to Pierre Huyghe's AI-powered mask and a new curator for the digital-art sector Art Basel Hong Kong has revealed the gallery line-up for its 2027 edition, with 232 exhibitors from more than 40 countries and territories heading to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre (HKCEC) in March. Thirty-one of those galleries are first-time participants, from places as far apart as Georgia, Estonia, Thailand and Brazil. The fair is also reworking how visitors move through the building, with a new floor plan that puts its experimental sectors side by side.The biggest structural change is on Level 3 of the HKCEC, where Discoveries, Echoes, Insights and Zero 10 will now share a single floor. Grouping the special sectors and curated presentations this way gives them more space than in past editions and lets visitors move between emerging, mid-career, historical and digital work without changing levels. The main Galleries sector takes up the rest, with 171 exhibitors showing everything from 20th-century masters to emerging names.The Asia-Pacific region remains the fair's core, and more than half of all participating galleries run spaces there. Twenty-seven have locations in Hong Kong itself, including Blindspot Gallery, Empty Gallery, Kiang Malingue and Rossi & Rossi. Mainland China contributes 32 galleries, Japan 20, South Korea 16 and Taiwan eight.The 13 newcomers to the Galleries sector bring some of the most interesting booths on paper. Yares Art is pairing Abstract Expressionist and Color Field figures such as Helen Frankenthaler, Joan Mitchell and Kenneth Noland. Richard Saltoun Gallery is showing Li Yuan-chia and Rosa Lee, two Chinese-diaspora artists who built calligraphy-based abstraction in Britain. VeneKlasen is putting new work by Issy Wood next to historic pieces by Sigmar Polke. For Karol Palczak's Asian debut, Emalin is bringing four almost-identical still lifes of eels painted in oil on marble. items.title: You Can Watch Super Bowl LXI and JAY-Z's Halftime Show in IMAX
items.text: You Can Watch Super Bowl LXI and JAY-Z's Halftime Show in IMAX Summary ESPN's telecast of Super Bowl LXI will screen live in hundreds of IMAX theaters on February 14, 2027, the first time the game has ever reached the formatThe four-hour-plus presentation covers pregame, the full game, the Apple Music Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show headlined by JAY-Z and postgame analysisScreenings span the US, Australia, New Zealand and Brazil, with the 'Monday Night Football' booth calling the action ESPN, The Walt Disney Company, the NFL and IMAX are taking Super Bowl LXI to the big screen, with ESPN's live telecast set to play across hundreds of IMAX theaters on February 14, 2027. It's the first time the Super Bowl has ever been shown in IMAX, and the partners are billing it as the largest live event the company has hosted. The screening lands in the same season as another milestone, since Super Bowl LXI is also the first Super Bowl ESPN has produced in its 47-year history.The theatrical feed mirrors what viewers at home will see, starting at 6 p.m. ET and running for more than four hours as a one-day-only event. The full package covers pregame coverage, ESPN's main game telecast, the Apple Music Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show with 25-time GRAMMY winner JAY-Z, and postgame analysis. The Monday Night Football crew of Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, Lisa Salters and Laura Rutledge will call the game.Hundreds of IMAX locations across the US will carry the broadcast, and Australia, New Zealand and Brazil are also confirmed. The exact theater count hasn't been announced yet, and a list of participating locations is set to arrive in the coming weeks. For IMAX, the Super Bowl is its largest test so far as a venue for live programming. IMAX CEO Rich Gelfond said in the announcement that the game is "a one-of-a-kind global cultural event imbued with spectacle, sound, drama, and heroes ... all the makings of a great IMAX experience.""Watching the Super Bowl with your fellow fans is one of the great shared experiences in sports, and this first-of-its-kind collaboration with the NFL and IMAX takes it to a historic new scale," said Ken Potrock, President of Major Event Integration at The Walt Disney Company.Tickets for the Super Bowl LXI IMAX screenings are expected to go on sale in January 2027 via IMAX and local theaters that sell IMAX tickets. items.text: XLARGE Releases Collaborative Apparel with Artist Unit OBS OBS, an artist unit formed by New York-based artist DRAGON76 and Osaka-based artist COOK, has announced a collaborative collection with XLARGE. Additionally, the duo will hold an exhibition titled "OBS Dépôt" at the calif art gallery in Nakameguro, Tokyo.Born in Shiga Prefecture, DRAGON76 has long expressed the concepts of beginnings, endings, and the coexistence of different entities through the motif of OUROBOROS, which frequently appears in his work. COOK, on the other hand, is a member of DISSIZIT!, led by OG SLICK, a prominent artist in the LA graffiti scene. His artist name stems from his tag, OBSURD, used during his street art days.The exhibition title, Dépôt, means a storage or workspace. The show reinterprets this concept as a place where art and craftsmanship intersect. In a space reminiscent of a warehouse, visitors will find collaborative artworks by DRAGON76 and COOK, hand-finished edition pieces titled *OBS HELLO MY NAME IS POSTER*, and custom-painted work tools used in actual art production. The exhibition focuses not only on finished pieces but also on the process from creation to product.The collaboration with XLARGE, launching in conjunction with the exhibition, uses XLARGE FABRIC, an original material made from recycled resources. Based on workwear, the collection features items incorporating OBS's signature graphics and finishes.The lineup combines the functionality of workwear with artistic expression, offering pieces like formal jackets, utility jackets, and twill pants. These items incorporate the distinct artworks of DRAGON76 and COOK and feature different label designs.T-shirts are available in models featuring graphics by DRAGON76 and COOK, as well as a model utilizing the PRIORITY LABEL. Additionally, name stickers and sticker packs will be offered, providing a wide range of items from apparel to accessories.A reception party will be held on Friday, November 20, the day before the exhibition opens, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. items.text: Snow Peak Introduces Arma Stove, a New Wood-Burning Stove That Lets You Enjoy the Flames from Any Angle Leading Japanese outdoor brand Snow Peak is releasing a new wood-burning stove, the Arma Stove (ST-210). Featuring heat-resistant glass on all four sides, its design allows you to view the flames from any direction. It is proposed not just as a heating appliance for winter campsites, but as the centerpiece of a living space where family and friends naturally gather.Unlike standard wood-burning stoves, this item, with heat-resistant glass placed on all four sides, lets you enjoy the flickering flames no matter where you sit. A spark arrestor inside the chimney suppresses the scattering of sparks, considering its impact on tents, tarps, and surrounding gear.Its setup method is also unique, accommodating integration with the separately sold Arma Stand or Iron Grill Table (IGT) frame. You can choose a setup style that fits your campsite layout and usage scenario. It weighs 19.6kg, including attached parts like the chimney set. Note that it cannot be used directly on the ground by itself and must be combined with the specified products.It is also intended to be used in combination with the large two-room shelter Land Lock X, which Snow Peak released in June 2026. Currently, it is also approved for use inside the Merak Pro. When using it inside a tent, a fly cover must be used together, and the specified tent body and setup method must be confirmed in advance through official information.Snow Peak's Arma Stove will be available starting Saturday, November 28th. items.title: Conquering the Holiday Gift Scramble at Lids
items.text: Conquering the Holiday Gift Scramble at Lids With the holiday season just around the corner, finding the perfect gift for coworkers can often feel like an insurmountable task. As offices prepare for end-of-year celebrations, Lids is making the dreaded holiday scramble easier by offering an endless rotation of customizable headwear.Tasked with playing Santa for the office, Eric navigates the bustling street of Times Square to find a gift that is thoughtful yet universally appreciated. His destination for the day is the iconic Lids flagship store, and he’s taking Hypebeast along the way in a new installment of Day in the Life.Once inside, the walls are lined with an endless array of premium headwear. But Eric has his sights set on something specific, so he wastes no time and heads straight for Lids’ newly dropped Realtree collection. Bringing rugged outdoor aesthetics to classic streetwear silhouettes, the lineup features the intricate Realtree Escape and vibrant Pink Realtree patterns applied to iconic 59FIFTY fitted caps and 9FORTY A-Frames across all major sports teams.Eric takes a meticulous approach, carefully handpicking a hat for each team member based on which team they support, even if it means picking up a cap for a rival team he would never personally choose. To give the gifts an extra personal touch, Eric takes his selections over to the machinery in the store’s custom zone, getting each cap customized with his coworkers’ initials.With the gifts secured, Eric heads back to the Hypebeast office on the subway to surprise the team, handing out customized Yankees and Mets caps to smiling colleagues. Holiday gifting can be hard, but as Eric proved today, Lids makes it effortless with all the different team hats and styles available, so you can get each person on your list the perfect present.Watch the full Day in the Life episode with Eric Zhang below.Lids237 West 42nd StreetNew York, NY 10036 View this post on InstagramA post shared by HYPEBEAST (@hypebeast) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: 24 Hours with Red Bull during Latin Music’s Busiest Week
items.text: 24 Hours with Red Bull during Latin Music’s Busiest Week Red Bull kept the energy flowing as Hypebeast LATAM returned to Las Vegas during Latin GRAMMY Week. From an exclusive interview suite at the Encore Tower Suites to dinner at Zero Bond, an after-hours celebration at Disco Bébé and a five-kilometer morning run, the brand joined a packed schedule that stretched from early morning interviews to late-night performances.Inside Hypebeast LATAM's three-bedroom suite, Red Bull fueled a steady rotation of interviews. Alongside its signature Energy Drink, the brand introduced its Winter Edition Pistachio and Berries, bringing an unexpected pairing of nutty and fruity notes to the week's lineup.That flavor followed the celebrations to Hypebeast LATAM's Zero Bond dinner. Served alongside fresh seafood, crispy rice appetizers, and rich chocolate desserts, Red Bull Winter Edition Pistachio and Berries took on cocktail duty, mixed with spirits and finished with fresh citrus.When dinner wrapped, the night went straight into Disco Bébé, Hypebeast LATAM's after-hours celebration. Red Bull stayed on hand as some of Latin music's biggest names took the stage for exclusive performances, carrying the party well past midnight.The following morning, Red Bull picked up the pace as more than 80 guests gathered for a five-kilometer run. A monstrous Red Bull truck supplied the soundtrack at the starting point, while chilled cans helped kick off the early call time. Guests, including Arcángel and Ryan Castro, joined the experience, while a custom bike equipped with turntables and speakers brought the music along for the run.From the suite to the dinner table, the Disco Bébé stage and the starting line, Red Bull kept Hypebeast LATAM's Latin GRAMMY Week moving. items.title: NANGA to Host Limited-Time Pop-Up Store in New York
items.text: NANGA to Host Limited-Time Pop-Up Store in New York Summary Japanese outdoor brand NANGA is opening a New York pop-up at 325 Canal Street from December 4 to 21.The store will stock NANGA’s signature down apparel, sleeping bags, comforters, accessories, and pieces from MODMNT.An accompanying exhibition will explore the brand’s history dating back to 1941, its craftsmanship, and the technology behind its down products. NANGA, one of Japan’s leading outdoor brands, will host a pop-up store at 325 Canal Street in New York from Friday, December 4 through Monday, December 21.The pop-up will offer a wide range of categories, including the brand’s signature down wear, as well as sleeping bags, down comforters, and accessories. Items from MODMNT will also be featured in the lineup. The store offers visitors the chance to see and purchase, in person, everything from pieces built with functionality honed in outdoor settings to products designed for everyday use.Beyond retail, the pop-up will also feature exhibition content exploring the brand’s history and craftsmanship. This includes a history board tracing the brand’s journey from its founding as Yokota Sewing in 1941 to the present day, along with displays introducing the sewing techniques and commitment to quality the brand has cultivated over the years, as well as the characteristics of down and the mechanics behind its insulating properties. The content offers a look not only at the functionality of the products themselves, but also at the technology and brand philosophy behind them.The NANGA New York Pop-Up Store will run from Friday, December 4 through Monday, December 21, open daily from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM ET.NANGA New York Pop-Up StoreDates: December 4 – December 21, 2026Hours: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM ETVenue: 325 Canal Street, New York, NY, USA Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Infinix Packs Its ZClip 2 Pro Earbuds Into a Snack Bag
items.text: Infinix Packs Its ZClip 2 Pro Earbuds Into a Snack Bag The Infinix ZClip 2 Pro comes in a foil snack pouch, a form familiar to all. Tear the notched edge, hear the crinkle, and instead of chips you get a pair of metallic open-ear earbuds.The ZClip 2 Pro ships in air-filled foil pouches modeled on real snack packaging. The thinking is simple. Snacks and earbuds are two of the easiest everyday escapes, so Infinix put one inside the other and turned unboxing into a small reward ritual. Infinix calls it "Snack Aesthetics," and for a social-first generation that shares everything it opens. Where the industry keeps packaging quiet and serious, Infinix makes it loud and playful. The brand brings a sense of delight to everyday tech products through fun packaging and unboxing experiences.Each foil pouch is fronted by one of three art-toy characters, blending distinct style personas with playful snack pairings. The Streetwise Gorilla, wearing a street jersey and gold chains, channels the bold, loud crunch of spicy chips. The High-Fashion Black Rabbit wears a dark leather jacket, evoking the smooth bite of premium dark chocolate. Finally, the Laid-back Sheep pairs vintage leather with retro shades, matching the relaxed comfort of a classic sweet puff. Beyond driving the packaging's visual style, their distinct features: the gorilla's human-like ears, the rabbit's tall points, and the sheep's floppy drop, demonstrate what Infinix calls its universal "All-Ear Fit."The pouch is only the first step. The same idea carries through the whole campaign, built around "Clip on, drift away". Opening a snack and clipping on a pair of earbuds are both quick ways to step out of a busy day, and Infinix takes that idea out of the packaging and into the city. To launch the ZClip 2 Pro, Infinix turned ride-hailing cars into small mobile sanctuaries. Inside, passengers found plants, soft warm lighting, shelves of snacks and the new earbuds. They could snack, listen to music, call someone, watch something, or just sit quietly between the office and home. That ordinary stretch of road between work and home becomes a few minutes reserved just for yourself.The Airy U-Bridge sits on the ear rather than in it, using a nickel-titanium memory alloy wire that Infinix says has been tested to more than 5,000 flexes. items.title: Zamna Will Bring 10 Days of Global Dance Music to Tulum for Landmark 10th Anniversary
items.text: Zamna Will Bring 10 Days of Global Dance Music to Tulum for Landmark 10th Anniversary The Tulum jungle in Mexico has been integral to Zamna’s rise, hosting its first music festival back in 2017. Though the culture and hospitality group has taken the festival to over 20 countries since its inception, it returns to its roots for Zamna’s 10th anniversary with a special 10-day line-up in the ancient area. Teasing global festival-goers, Zamna launched a commemorative film last week, which captured celebrations from the last decade. From high-octane sets by renowned DJs Peggy Gou and David Guetta to theatrical productions that gave a stage to Tale Of Us, Rüfüs du Sol, and Gorillaz, the visuals traced iconic moments that fed off the “land, culture and history” to shape a festival that connects people and platforms dance music. For the upcoming 10th anniversary event, the group continues to cement itself as a global destination for dance culture. Turning the programming up a notch, the schedule kicks off on New Year’s Eve with a takeover from British electronic music platform RENAISSANCE. After welcoming Sasha, Maceo Plex, and Ida Engberg to the festival, Amnesia makes its Zamna debut, bringing a piece of Ibiza to Mexico for its own milestone anniversary. Other curated line-ups include ANYMA’s Berlin club night ÆDEN, Adriatique’s X, and Black Coffee, culminating with a special showcase from Adam Port of Keinemusik. Alongside announcing the full line-up, Zamna has also revealed it will be partnering with UMusic Hotel and Beach Club in Tulum for the anniversary festival. Having built its local presence through collaborations with nearby institutions, Zamna’s latest partnership will elevate its efforts in hospitality by introducing a VIP experience at the property. Attendees will be able to flow from the festival space to the hotel with a new multipass, while also getting to visit special Zamna events there all year round. “For us, it has always been about the people. This 10th anniversary series honors a decade of shows, shared memories, and lessons learned, and we’re celebrating it back where it all began: Tulum,” shared Founder of Universal Xperience Fabricio Ledesma Heinrich on the anniversary.“Every detail is designed around the audience, and this time we want to raise the bar again, making every night immersive and unforgettable. items.title: AAPE x BABY MILO® FW26 Turns Signature Camo Into a Game of Hide-and-Seek
items.text: AAPE x BABY MILO® FW26 Turns Signature Camo Into a Game of Hide-and-Seek AAPE BY *A BATHING APE® has teamed up with BABY MILO® once again for Fall/Winter 2026. The campaign was shot at a real Tokyo arcade and stars Japanese gyaru model Yukipoyo alongside twin influencers Aqua & Akuto. The crew filled the crane machines with BABY MILO® plushies, and the cast moves between the neon lights and stacked toys for a playful, street-ready feel.Graphics lead the way this season. BABY MILO® and his animal friends appear as hidden Easter eggs throughout AAPE’s signature camo, so fans have a reason to look closely. The hoodie, long AAPE’s most recognizable piece, keeps the brand’s asymmetric hood with different embroidery on each side. This time the hood also splices half of AAPE’s MOONFACE logo with half of BABY MILO®’s face. The resulting split face shows both brands at a glance.The hoodie comes in three exclusive colorways, pink, cream and green, in both adult and kids’ sizes. Long-sleeve T-shirts make up the rest of the apparel. One has a relaxed, drop-shoulder fit with a co-branded logo on the chest and BABY MILO® peeking out from behind an oversized MOONFACE on the back, and it comes in black and white. Another shows BABY MILO® hugging MOONFACE on the front, with the collaboration logo on the back. It comes in black, white and gray, plus a kids’ version for matching parent-and-child looks.Winter accessories include co-branded beanies, gloves, scarves and plush keychains. items.title: LISA Gives The Nike Zoom Streak 3 "Black/Red" an Early Debut at the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
items.text: LISA Gives The Nike Zoom Streak 3 "Black/Red" an Early Debut at the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix Summary LISA wore an unreleased pair of Nike Zoom Streak 3 sneakers in Black/Red to the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix drivers paradeFirst introduced in 2009, the racing flat pairs a one-piece mesh upper with a Cushlon midsole and a Zoom Air heelThe sighting is one of the first public moments since Nike and Formula 1 announced their long-term global partnership The Nike Zoom Streak 3 got an early public outing in Las Vegas when global musician and Nike ambassador LISA wore an unreleased Black/Red pair to the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix drivers parade. Appearing alongside drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc, she gave the public its first look at a colorway from the Zoom Streak 3 collection due in Spring 2027.The Zoom Streak 3 was built for racing, and its construction reflects that. A one-piece mesh upper keeps weight to a minimum and cuts down on overlays, while a Cushlon midsole provides responsive, low-profile cushioning. A Zoom Air unit in the heel adds impact protection without making the shoe heavier, a balance of lightness and performance that made the model a favorite among Nike athletes after its 2009 debut.The shoe's racing record backs up that reputation. Between 2009 and 2013, no earlier Nike racing shoe had been worn across more finish lines than the Zoom Streak 3, which made it one of the brand's most successful racing flats. Now Nike is pulling it from the archive and repositioning the low-slung silhouette as an everyday sneaker, and the Black/Red colorway gives it a sharp, high-contrast look.The setting for the reveal was deliberate. LISA's appearance follows the announcement of a long-term global partnership between Nike and Formula 1. Debuting a revived racing shoe at one of the sport's highest-profile weekends ties Nike's running heritage directly to its new motorsport partnership.The Nike Zoom Streak 3 "Black/Red" is set to release in Spring 2027, with release details still to be announced.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Official Images of the Cactus Plant Flea Market x Nike Flea 1 “Cave Purple”
items.text: Official Images of the Cactus Plant Flea Market x Nike Flea 1 “Cave Purple” Name: Cactus Plant Flea Market x Nike Flea 1 “Cave Purple”Colorway: Cave Purple/Dark Raisin-Purple DynastySKU: IU5238-500MSRP: $180 USDRelease Date: December 2026Cactus Plant Flea Market and Nike have revealed the official images of the Flea 1 "Cave Purple," listed as Cave Purple/Dark Raisin-Purple Dynasty. The colorway covers the silhouette in tonal purple from top to bottom and adds a heavily textured sole that gives the pair a rugged, almost unfinished look.Suede makes up most of the upper, wrapping the shoe in a soft purple finish across a series of geometric panels. The paneling is where the Flea 1's roots show, with clear nods to the Dunk and the Air Force 1, though CPFM pulls the overall shape well away from either one. A heavily padded collar and an oversized tongue add bulk around the ankle and give the shoe its chunky, cushioned profile.The sole is the most unusual part of the build. Rather than a clean, smooth cupsole, the dark purple unit has a rough, uneven surface that looks like dried mud, so the pair appears worn in straight out of the box. It's also a shade darker than the upper, which keeps the tonal look from feeling flat.Contrast is saved for the back of the shoe. A black-and-white yin-yang logo sits on the heel, the only real break from the purple, and CPFM branding appears across the rest of the design. "Cave Purple" is one of two Flea 1 colorways the pair has lined up for the holidays, alongside a "Barley" version, and LeBron James was recently spotted wearing the purple pair ahead of the official reveal.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Fred again.., Nike and Monkey Shoulder Lifestyle, Merch & Music Collective Stitch India's 2007 and 2011 Winning Kits Into One Cricket Shirt
items.text: Fred again.., Nike and Monkey Shoulder Lifestyle, Merch & Music Collective Stitch India's 2007 and 2011 Winning Kits Into One Cricket Shirt Summary Fred again.. has teamed up with Monkey Shoulder Lifestyle, Merch & Music Collective and Nike on a limited-edition cricket shirt designed by Kunel GaurThe design merges the geometric graphics of India's 2011 kit with the blue of its 2007 kit, two winning shirts from Nike's archiveThe release comes just ahead of Fred's five sold-out India shows in December Fred again.. is suiting up for his India tour with a limited-edition cricket shirt made with Monkey Shoulder Lifestyle, Merch & Music Collective and Nike. Designed by Kunel Gaur, the jersey goes back into Nike's archive of India's championship-winning kits, combining two of the country's most recognizable cricket shirts into a single piece and adding the artist's own visual signatures.The base of the shirt comes straight from cricket history. Gaur takes the geometric graphics of India's 2011 kit and lays them over the bright blue of the 2007 kit, so two separate eras of the team's identity appear together on one jersey. Those years carry real weight for fans, as India won the ICC World Twenty20 in 2007 and the ICC Cricket World Cup on home soil in 2011, which makes the shirt a tribute to two trophy runs.The finishing details make it Fred's own. His distinct visual language is worked into the design alongside the Monkey Shoulder Lifestyle, Merch & Music Collective logo, and the partnership marks the first time the William Grant & Sons India lifestyle brand has named a Creative Partner. The result looks like matchday gear and works as tour merch at the same time.The rollout leaned into that crossover. Over the past week, the shirt has been spotted on some of India's best-known figures across sport, music, food and style, including Test and ODI captain Shubman Gill, rapper Hanumankind, executive chef Hussain Shahzad, dancer Ruhee Dosani, stylist Shaleena Nathani and longtime cricket commentator Harsha Bhogle.All of it leads up to Fred's December run in India. When tickets went on sale in June, the tour sold faster than any previous Indian tour by an international solo act, and all five dates are now sold out. He opens at Leisure Valley Ground in Gurugram on December 5, plays Mahalaxmi Race Course in Mumbai on December 8 and 9, and closes at NICE Grounds in Bengaluru on December 12 and 13.The Fred again.. x Monkey Shoulder Lifestyle, Merch & Music Collective x Nike

items.title: Deborah Ann Woll Is Bringing Faye From the 'God of War' Games to Prime Video's Live-Action Series
items.text: Deborah Ann Woll Is Bringing Faye From the 'God of War' Games to Prime Video's Live-Action Series Summary Deborah Ann Woll will reprise her video game role as Faye in Prime Video's live-action God of War adaptationProduction is undergoing massive reshoots after Dave Bautista replaced Ryan Hurst as Kratos due to an on-set injuryThe casting points toward a potential third season aligning with the upcoming 2027 game God of War Laufey Prime Video officially brought a familiar face to its highly anticipated God of War TV series. Deborah Ann Woll joined the live-action adaptation of the blockbuster Santa Monica Studio video game franchise as Faye. Woll steps into a role she knows intimately, having previously provided the voice and motion capture for the character in the 2022 video game God of War Ragnarök. Deadline reported that Woll was always the producers’ definitive choice for the role of Faye. The television show follows the Greek god of war, Kratos, as he travels with his son Atreus to scatter the ashes of his late wife Faye from the highest peak in the Nine Realms.Producers kept Woll’s involvement strictly under wraps due to a behind-the-scenes production pivot. Amazon picked up the God of War series for two seasons, which crews are filming back-to-back. Four of the first season's ten episodes were filmed in spring 2026 before production stopped when original Kratos actor Ryan Hurst injured his shoulder on set. The production team scrapped all footage shot with Hurst and is currently reshooting those episodes with Dave Bautista taking over the leading role of Kratos. Woll’s casting emerged only now because Faye did not appear in any of the episodes initially filmed with Hurst.Bautista joins an ensemble cast that is actively taking shape. Callum Vinson was cast to play Kratos's son Atreus. Mandy Patinkin joins the roster as Odin, alongside Max Parker as Heimdall and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor, a character originally voiced by Hurst in the God of War Ragnarök game. Danny Woodburn portrays Brok, while Jeff Gulka plays Sindri. Prime Video has not set a release date for the series.While the first two seasons follow the foundational events of the 2018 God of War game and its 2022 sequel, Woll's confirmed presence points toward future narrative expansion. Woll is already scheduled to voice and perform motion capture for Faye in the upcoming 2027 game God of War Laufey, a title that shifts its protagonist from Kratos to Faye. items.title: Blancpain Unveils New Watch Featuring the World's First 30-Degree Inclined One-Minute Flying Carrousel
items.text: Blancpain Unveils New Watch Featuring the World's First 30-Degree Inclined One-Minute Flying Carrousel Blancpain, the world's oldest watch brand founded in Villeret, Switzerland in 1735, has announced a new watch, the Tourbillon Carrousel Inclined. Completed after four years of development, this model features what the brand claims to be the world's first one-minute flying carrousel inclined at 30 degrees.The carrousel is a mechanism designed to minimize the rate variations caused by the orientation of the watch. By housing the balance wheel and escapement—which regulate the timekeeping—in a rotating cage, it averages out the effects of gravity. In 2008, Blancpain introduced a wristwatch equipped with a flying carrousel whose cage makes one full rotation per minute. For this new release, tilting the rotation axis of that cage by 30 degrees ensures that the orientation of the balance wheel continues to change relative to gravity even when the watch is laid flat with the dial facing up.During development, multiple inclination angles from 0 to 35 degrees were tested, measuring amplitude and rate across six different positions. As a result, 30 degrees was adopted as the angle that best balances precision performance, movement thinness, and design. The newly developed manual-winding Calibre 222ISQ secures a 100-hour power reserve via two series-connected barrels. Furthermore, every piece comes with an individual chronometry certificate showing an average daily rate tolerance between 0 and +2 seconds.The exterior also boasts a major distinguishing feature. It adopts Blancpain's first-ever full sapphire case, with sapphire also used for the dial. The movement's action can be admired not just from the front, but from the back and sides as well. The entire movement has been thoroughly skeletonized so that normally hidden gears, barrels, and even the winding state of the mainspring are visible.The case is available in two versions: 5N red gold and rhodium-plated gold. The 30-degree inclined complication is housed within relatively compact dimensions of 40.30 mm in diameter and 11.30 mm in thickness. The two parts that make up the sapphire case reportedly take approximately 100 hours each to machine and polish.The movement finishing is not to be missed either. The Calibre 222ISQ receives a total of 210 hours of hand decoration at the in-house workshop in Le Brassus. items.title: Starbucks Japan Launches the Potato Soupaccino, a Half-Soup, Half-Cappuccino Winter Drink
items.text: Starbucks Japan Launches the Potato Soupaccino, a Half-Soup, Half-Cappuccino Winter Drink Summary Starbucks Japan introduces the Potato Soupaccino as a half-soup, half-cappuccino hybrid beverage for the winter seasonThe savory comfort drink features a potato, caramelized onion and sweet vegetable flavor profile topped with customizable foamThe exclusive seasonal release continues a regional trend of savory coffee alternatives that are not launching in the United States Starbucks Japan launched its unconventional winter offering, the Potato Soupaccino, on November 13. The menu item is a half-soup, half-cappuccino hybrid beverage that blurs the line between a traditional hot drink and a savory comfort meal. By launching this savory option, the brand continues a regional trend of offering exclusive winter coffee alternatives that bypass Western menus.For this winter season, Starbucks added a potato flavor to the lineup to create a profile rooted in culinary comfort. The Potato Soupaccino features a pillowy texture reminiscent of freshly baked potatoes. To build the flavor profile, the recipe combines an earthy potato base with caramelized onions and subtle notes of sweet vegetables.The preparation process embraces a traditional coffeehouse aesthetic. Starbucks baristas finish the drink by adding a frothy layer of cappuccino foam on top of the savory base. Customers can choose their preferred milk variety for the foam layer to customize the beverage.The new potato flavor expands on the savory hybrid concept that Starbucks Japan introduced in 2025 with truffle and pumpkin flavors. This evolution demonstrates how Starbucks Japan establishes its seasonal lineup as a permanent space for experimental savory coffee alternatives rather than standard sweet syrups. The Potato Soupaccino remains exclusive to Japan and will not launch in the United States. A Short size of the Potato Soupaccino costs 491 yen, which is approximately US$3.11. Tall sizes cost 530 yen, or approximately US$3.32. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: PORTER Remakes Its Exclusive PX TANKER Line in 100% Plant-Derived Nylon
items.text: PORTER Remakes Its Exclusive PX TANKER Line in 100% Plant-Derived Nylon Summary PORTER has fully renewed PX TANKER, the exclusive line it has offered since 2019Every bag in the five-piece lineup is made from 100% plant-derived nylon, the same fabric used across the TANKER lineThe update also brings two new colorways, adjustable-length straps and the tighter construction standards PORTER is known for PORTER has given its PX TANKER line a complete renewal, moving the exclusive series onto 100% plant-derived nylon and expanding it to five models. The relaunch includes a tote, a daypack and a hip bag, and each one is built to what the Yoshida & Co. label presents as its highest standard of manufacturing.The fabric is the main change. Each bag uses the same 100% plant-derived nylon found across the TANKER family, a material that is credited as the first of its kind to reach mass production. Changing what the bags are made of while keeping the TANKER identity means the renewal is about substance more than appearance, and the shell keeps the distinctive surface texture the line is recognized for.Construction is where PORTER's craftsmanship shows. The bags are put together with very precise sewing and carefully engineered components, and the coloring has been refined to match. Two new colorways join the series, and the straps can now be adjusted in length, so each piece can be fitted to the body whether it's worn as a tote, carried as a daypack or strapped across the waist as a hip bag.The lineup is small and the distribution even smaller. Across its five models, the renewed PX TANKER covers everyday carry from a full-size tote down to a compact hip bag, and only four stores worldwide will stock the collection. items.title: ‘GTA VI’ Stays Off Limits, But Hollywood Can Reportedly Have ‘Red Dead Redemption’ for $100 Million USD
items.text: ‘GTA VI’ Stays Off Limits, But Hollywood Can Reportedly Have ‘Red Dead Redemption’ for $100 Million USD Summary Rockstar Games is reportedly more open to bringing 'Red Dead Redemption' to film or television, even as it continues to turn down Hollywood interest in 'Grand Theft Auto'An unnamed agent claims the studio at one point floated a licensing price of more than $100 million USDNo studio, producer or talent has been tied to the project, and Rockstar has not commented Rockstar Games may finally be willing to let Hollywood into its catalog, with Red Dead Redemption reportedly emerging as the franchise the studio is most open to adapting for film or TV. According to an exclusive report from Lesley Goldberg at The Ankler, multiple sources say Rockstar has become more receptive to a screen version of its Western series, while Grand Theft Auto is still firmly off the table despite years of interest from entertainment companies.The reported figure is what makes this story stand out. An unnamed agent who works with writers in the video game space told The Ankler that Rockstar had, at one point, floated a minimum of more than $100 million USD for the licensing rights alone. For a sense of scale, the report sets that number beside the roughly $250 million USD Amazon reportedly paid in 2017 for the global TV rights to The Lord of the Rings. The wording suggests the figure came up in past discussions rather than as a current, finalized offer.Beyond that price tag, almost nothing about a potential deal has been made public. The report doesn't say whether Rockstar would prefer a film or a series, and it names no bidders, studios, producers or talent attached to a Red Dead Redemption project. Rockstar, a subsidiary of Take-Two, did not immediately respond to The Ankler's request for comment, so the adaptation remains exploratory for now.The timing helps explain why the franchise might be worth that much to Hollywood. The report landed just as GTA VI arrived after a 13-year wait, with The Ankler projecting the game could earn between $3 billion USD and $5 billion USD in its first week. That kind of firepower gives Rockstar little reason to chase outside deals, and the wider industry backs that up: the global gaming market is valued at well over $200 billion USD across 3.7 billion active players, which arguably gives game publishers the upper hand in negotiations with studios.Streamers have been spending heavily to get their share. items.title: UNDERCOVER x fragment design's Mohair Knit Cardigan Puts Texture First in Two Necklines
items.text: UNDERCOVER x fragment design's Mohair Knit Cardigan Puts Texture First in Two Necklines Summary UNDERCOVER and fragment design return with the second installment of their "Undercover meets Fragment" capsuleThe drop is built around a single mohair knit cardigan taken from the FW26 men's collectionThe cardigan comes as a crew neck or a V-neck, with each one offered in Ivory Base and Black Base UNDERCOVER and fragment design have unveiled the second chapter of their "Undercover meets Fragment" capsule, a mohair knit cardigan taken from the FW26 men's collection and reissued in a limited run of new colors. Jun Takahashi and Hiroshi Fujiwara offer the piece in two cuts, crew neck and V-neck, so this round is all about one garment rather than a full lineup.Instead of spreading Drop 2 across several categories, the duo commits entirely to a single knit and changes only the neckline. The crew-neck version keeps the front closed and simple, while the V-neck opens up the chest and frames whatever is layered underneath. Both are cut from the same mohair knit, so choosing between them comes down to how you plan to wear it, not what it's made of.Color is the other variable, and the two designers keep it disciplined. Each neckline is available in Ivory Base and Black Base, giving the cardigan a light, clean option and a darker one that sits easily inside an all-black wardrobe. Because the colors are produced in limited numbers, this version stands apart from the cardigan's original appearance in the seasonal collection.The narrow format matches the idea behind the whole capsule. The project grew from a philosophy Takahashi and Fujiwara share: make the clothes they personally want to wear right now. Taking one strong knit from the collection and refining it, instead of designing a sprawling range, carries that idea straight into the product.The UNDERCOVER x fragment design "Undercover meets Fragment" mohair knit cardigan drops November 28 at 11 a.m. JST via the UNDERCOVER online store. It will also be available the same day at UNDERCOVER Aoyama, Sendai, Nagoya and Kyoto. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: lululemon Launches New Winter Apparel Collections, Featuring Oversized Silhouettes and Functional Fabrics for Winter Layering
items.text: lululemon Launches New Winter Apparel Collections, Featuring Oversized Silhouettes and Functional Fabrics for Winter Layering lululemon recently introduced a variety of winter apparel, covering the Big Cozy, Steady State SuperLoft, Tumbled Fleece, and the all-new High-Loft PrimaLoft UltraPeak collections. Through oversized silhouettes, rich fabric textures, and functional designs, the collections meet diverse wardrobe needs, from lounging at home and city commuting to outdoor exploration.The Big Cozy collection features a super-oversized half-zip hoodie and cocoon joggers as key items, utilizing a thick, stretchy fabric with a smooth exterior and brushed interior, enriched visually by 3D stitching in the shape of the brand logo. For menswear, the Steady State SuperLoft collection offers a hoodie and sweatpant set, made with a cotton-blend SuperLoft fabric that is brushed on both sides. Paired with low-saturation winter hues like mahogany muse brown, it presents a relaxed athleisure style. Additionally, the Wunder Puff™ long puffer coat and the bomber jacket filled with 600-fill-power goose down provide even more options for winter layering.In terms of fleece apparel, the Tumbled Fleece collection uses a lightweight, double-sided fleece fabric, offering items such as men's and women's hoodies and sweatpants; the women's Polartec 200 Series athletic fleece jacket balances moisture-wicking and breathability, while the Polartec Thermal Pro zip jacket presents a rich, shearling-like texture through the splicing of two fabrics. The collection also includes styles such as vests and half-zip hoodies, further enriching the layers of winter outfits.Notably, the all-new High-Loft PrimaLoft UltraPeak jacket collection features a PrimaLoft UltraPeak insulation layer, boasting a puffy texture akin to down, while also being highly compressible and able to regain its loft. The outer layer utilizes Glyde fabric, which is both windproof and water-resistant, and comes in two silhouettes: a hip-length short style and a long style. The relaxed fit allows room for layering, catering to both the need for protection in wet and cold environments and everyday style expression. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Yvng Patra Releases New Album 'Regalia' Featuring Kohjiya, Vingo, and More
items.text: Yvng Patra Releases New Album 'Regalia' Featuring Kohjiya, Vingo, and More Rapper Yvng Patra has released his latest album, Regalia. The 17-track release features appearances by Kohjiya, Vingo, D.O, DADA, 27AM, and Pxrge Trxxxper. Welcoming a diverse array of producers and guest artists, the project delivers a broader soundscape than ever before.Production is handled by Oddy lozy, TAXON, and VetteBoy, among others. Pxrge Trxxxper joins the high-energy party anthem "We Gon' Rock the Party," while close allies 042ghxst and Gam Ball guest on "Siren" and "Money Talks," respectively. Additionally, D.O provides spoken-word narration on "9 Tips," with S TILL I DIE adding a verse."Beyond," originally released in August 2026, is included as a remix featuring 27AM. "Night wida AMG" featuring Kohjiya boasts a West Coast-inspired sound, while the uptempo "One Time" features Vingo. Conversely, "Where is the Real Love" featuring DADA expresses serious emotions over a slow track. The album boasts a variety of moods, ranging from heavy-hitting bangers to more introspective cuts.The album title, Regalia, refers to the emblems and ornaments symbolizing royalty and majesty. The project features lyrics that assert his position and presence within the scene, making it a work that showcases exactly where Yvng Patra stands today.He has also announced a solo live show, "Yvng Patra One Man Live," to be held at Toyosu PIT in Tokyo on Saturday, March 20, 2027. Following his sold-out show at Zepp Shinjuku earlier this year, he is taking on a new stage at the largest venue of his career to date. The presale has ended, and general ticket sales are scheduled to begin on Monday, November 30 at 8:00 p.m.Yvng Patra's latest album, Regalia, is available now on all major streaming services as of Wednesday, November 25, 2026. The 17-track album is produced by Oddy lozy, TAXON, Broks Beatz, liv., VetteBoy, cabernett, shango, and Ivand Beats. items.title: The Nike Mind 001 Sets Its Moving Nodes in Chocolate Brown for "Palomino"
items.text: The Nike Mind 001 Sets Its Moving Nodes in Chocolate Brown for "Palomino" Name: Nike Mind 001 “Palomino”Colorway: Palomino/Tar-Metallic PlatinumSKU: HQ4307-201MSRP: $95 USDRelease Date: Spring 2027The Nike Mind 001 "Palomino" is set to give one of Nike's more experimental silhouettes an earthy update, with a palette built from olive, brown and flashes of metallic platinum. According to early details, the build is focused on how the shoe connects you to the ground, and Nike frames the design around feeling every surface and staying aware of each step.From the side, olive does most of the work. It covers much of the profile and continues down to the wavy edge of the sole, while brown tones take over higher on the upper. A perforated panel in light brown runs from the collar almost to the toe and carries a small metallic silver Swoosh in its center. A second Swoosh stands upright on the outside of the molded shell for a bolder branding moment.The outsole is where the Mind 001 stands apart. Twenty-two chocolate brown nodes are spread across the bottom, and each one moves on its own as you walk, so the sole adjusts to whatever is under it instead of acting as one rigid platform. That setup is central to Nike's pitch for the shoe, which centers on ground feel and a more deliberate stride.Nike also adds a playful detail inside. The footbeds don't match: one carries "Nike Mind" in white lettering, and the other reads "Mind Science Department," which points back to the research-lab theme behind the line.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. items.title: Panini Turns ‘GTA VI's’ In-Game Collectibles Into a Real Sports Trading Card Collection
items.text: Panini Turns ‘GTA VI's’ In-Game Collectibles Into a Real Sports Trading Card Collection Summary Panini America and Rockstar Games are releasing the ‘GTA VI’ Sports Trading Card Collection, their first trading card tie-in for the gameThe officially licensed set turns the collectible cards found inside ‘GTA VI’ into physical cardsParallels range from Special Silver, Pink, Teal and Light Blue up to numbered Legend Bronze, Silver and 1-of-1 Gold cards Panini America and Rockstar Games are launching the GTA VI Sports Trading Card Collection, a licensed set that takes the card collectibles players chase in Grand Theft Auto VI and puts them into physical packs. It's the first trading card partnership built around the game, so collectors can open real packs of the same cards that show up in-game.Each box holds four packs and is built to give a predictable spread of base hits. On average, a box yields two Rookies, one Retro and one Illustrated card, plus four Special Silvers, so every rip covers the set's main card styles. With the Rookies, Retros and Illustrated cards working as distinct subsets, collectors have a clear checklist to work through before the parallel hunt begins.The parallels are where the chase gets serious. Beyond Special Silver, the set comes in Pink, Teal and Light Blue versions for collectors building rainbows. The numbered tiers then narrow quickly: Legend Bronze is limited to 49 copies, Silver drops to 25, and the Gold parallels are true 1-of-1s, making them the hardest cards in the set to pull.The GTA VI Sports Trading Card Collection from Panini America and Rockstar Games is set to release in December 2026. items.title: Lil Uzi Vert Weaves a Rainbow of Thread Into the Vans Authentic 44 "Pink Cosmos"
items.text: Lil Uzi Vert Weaves a Rainbow of Thread Into the Vans Authentic 44 "Pink Cosmos" Name: Lil Uzi Vert x Vans Authentic 44 “Pink Cosmos”Colorway: Pink/Multi-ColorSKU: VN0010WY3TDMSRP: TBCRelease Date: Holiday 2026Lil Uzi Vert's Vans Authentic 44 "Pink Cosmos" is reportedly set to close out the year, giving one of the label's most pared-back silhouettes a heavily textured finish. The pair arrives as the rapper steps back into the spotlight with new music, so his latest era comes with footwear to match.The upper is made from a dense weave of multicolored threads. So many shades are packed in that the surface reads as tactile rather than printed, and it changes depending on how close you look. Pink is the loudest of the bunch, and it doesn't stay in the weave. It runs onto the eyelets and wraps the ankle collar, so the colorway holds together from toe to heel.Branding is kept to a few deliberate touches, which leaves most of the work to the woven upper. Inside, the insole carries a Vans logo with a "By Lil Uzi Vert" credit tucked underneath. A second Vans logo on the heel bumper anchors the back of the shoe.That restraint suits a silhouette that has always been about simplicity. The Authentic began as Style 44, the canvas deck shoe the Van Doren Rubber Company sold when it opened in Anaheim, California, in 1966. Skaters later adopted it for its grippy waffle outsole, and that makes 2026 the model's 60th year. A woven, pink-forward reading of it is a deliberate departure from the plain canvas the shoe built its name on.The pink is no accident either. The color has become a calling card for Uzi, most visibly through his 2023 album Pink Tape, and his wardrobe has long ignored the usual lines between menswear and womenswear. His ties to Vans go back to at least May 2025, when he fronted the label's Premium Old Skool campaign. Earlier this year he teased further collaborative designs online, including a pink and black checkerboard Slip-On and several takes on the chunky Lynzie skate shoe. Against those louder pieces, the Authentic is the most wearable entry yet.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Apple Is Reportedly Planning an M6 MacBook Air Refresh for Spring 2027 Ahead of an OLED Redesign
items.text: Apple Is Reportedly Planning an M6 MacBook Air Refresh for Spring 2027 Ahead of an OLED Redesign Summary Apple is preparing a dual-phase rollout for the MacBook Air, starting with an M6 chip update in spring 2027The initial launch will be a straightforward spec refresh, arriving alongside the new MacBook Neo 2A major design overhaul featuring an OLED display is slated to follow in late 2027 or 2028 During a Thanksgiving mailbag episode of his Power On podcast, Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman fielded a listener Q&A segment that laid out the immediate roadmap for Apple’s most popular laptop. Titled "Mailbag: Mark Answers Your Questions About Apple’s Product & Political Future," the episode detailed major two-part release plans for the MacBook Air. According to Gurman, Apple is planning to launch new 13-inch and 15-inch iterations of the machine in spring 2027. Developed internally under the project codenames J913 and J915, these forthcoming models will officially introduce Apple's M6 chip to the lightweight laptop line. However, the spring drop isn't meant to reinvent the wheel. Gurman specifically described this spring 2027 release as a straightforward "chip and ship" refresh that brings minimal hardware changes to the table.When these M6-powered MacBook Air models hit the market, they are scheduled to launch right alongside an entirely new device known as the MacBook Neo 2. But while the internals are getting a performance boost, the exterior of the current generation is rapidly aging out. Gurman noted on the podcast that the current MacBook Air aesthetic is nearing the "end of the road." Apple originally introduced this specific industrial design language back in 2022 and updated the line by adding a larger 15-inch model to the roster in 2023.Because the MacBook Air is currently Apple's most popular computer, heavy pressure remains on the company to keep its hardware designs fresh and relevant. To answer that demand, Apple is aggressively developing a major design overhaul for the lineup, slated for release in late 2027 at the earliest, or potentially shifting into 2028. The focal point of this highly anticipated aesthetic revamp is expected to be the integration of an OLED display. Transitioning to OLED represents a massive leap for the machine, upgrading the visual fidelity of the brand's biggest seller to maintain its competitive edge.Executing two distinct MacBook Air generations within a single calendar year is an aggressive product cadence that mirro

items.text: Y-3 and Jeff Hamilton Celebrate Kimi Antonelli’s First F1 Title With a Bespoke Jacket Summary Y-3 and Jeff Hamilton create a custom jacket for Kimi Antonelli’s first F1 Drivers' World Champion title.The quilted black piece features stripes, Italian accents, and championship graphics.Made exclusively for Antonelli, the bespoke tribute won’t release publicly. Marking a defining milestone in Kimi Antonelli’s career, Y-3 and Jeff Hamilton have unveiled a one-of-one jacket created exclusively for the driver to celebrate his first Formula 1 Drivers’ World Championship win with the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team.Turning his achievement into a wearable trophy, the custom piece arrives in a sleek black quilted silhouette with a structured hood, featuring bold contrasting white stripes down the sleeves alongside checkered detailing. Co-branded Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team and Y-3 logos sit cleanly across the chest, while personalized touches — including red “ANTONELLI” lettering and the Italian tricolor flag along the sleeve — serve as a direct nod to the champion’s heritage. A prominent “2026 F1 World Champion” graphic spans the back, placing his win squarely at the center of the design.Built purely as a personal tribute to Antonelli’s championship-winning season, the bespoke jacket is not slated for a public release. items.title: Moncler x Rick Owens FW26 Arms Quilted Outerwear With Studs and Straps
items.text: Moncler x Rick Owens FW26 Arms Quilted Outerwear With Studs and Straps Summary Moncler and Rick Owens return with a Fall/Winter 2026 collection built mainly around quilted outerwearGeo Quilting, metal studs, oversized Tour pockets and a carry-ready Mega Strap appear across the lineupThe collection uses a tight palette of black, metallic Palladium, Cloud Grey and a muted Grease tone The Moncler x Rick Owens Fall/Winter 2026 collection is built around outerwear. It brings Owens' subversive eye together with the Italian house's background in warm, protective technical gear. The two labels have shaped each other's work over time, and this season puts that exchange into a run of quilted pieces in a wide range of shapes.Quilting is the collection's backbone. A graphic Geo Quilting pattern breaks up the surfaces into sharp, architectural sections, so even the simpler shapes have an edge. Owens' hardware sits on top: metal studs run along the outerwear, and oversized Tour pockets add real storage without diluting the look.The most practical detail is the Mega Strap. It's a large carrying strap that lets you sling a jacket over your shoulder or across your body when you've taken it off, so heavy layers don't have to be either worn or left behind. It's a small change, but it makes these voluminous pieces easier to get through a day of changing temperatures with.The palette stays restrained so the textures stand out. Black anchors the range, and metallic Palladium adds a liquid shine, Cloud Grey softens the mix and Grease gives a quieter, lived-in tone. The pieces are designed to be layered from head to toe, and Thyra sunglasses and Trailgrip Pentalace ankle boots complete the looks.Owens photographed the campaign himself and cast Joe Dallesandro, the cult star of Warhol-era underground film, who wears the collection's biggest shapes in black and white. The designer explained the choice by pointing to Dallesandro's link to Lou Reed. "Little Joe mythologized an indifferent beauty in Lou Reed's hymn to queer subculture. 'Take a Walk on the Wild Side' was a turning point for me and a lot of other suppressed kids of my generation," Owens said in the release.The Moncler x Rick Owens Fall/Winter 2026 collection will release via HBX, at select Moncler stores and online, as well as at Rick Owens flagship stores, online and select partners.
